Later sections gather material on packers and obfuscation, anti-debugging, ELF infection, kernel modules and rootkits, exploitation, crackmes, radare2 walkthroughs, detection tools and books. It is a lightly annotated link list last changed in January 2022, useful as a background syllabus rather than a maintained course.
description_zh: Michal Malik 以单个 README 维护的 Linux 逆向工程阅读清单，收录约 230 条链接与书目：从系统调用、ELF 和各处理器 ABI 的速查资料，到讲解程序启动、链接与重定位的 101、201 两级阅读。后续部分汇集加壳与混淆、反调试、ELF 感染、内核模块与 rootkit、漏洞利用、crackme、radare2 实战、检测工具及书籍等资料。这是一份注释很少、最后改动于 2022 年 1 月的链接清单，适合作为背景阅读提纲，而不是持续维护的课程。
requirements: The reviewed master commit f858da0, dated 2022-01-16, contains a single file, README.md, which calls the list a work in progress. It holds 231 bullet entries under 15 headings; the largest are Linux kernel, rootkits and LKM development (40), 101 (22) and viruses and infection techniques (20), and several articles appear in more than one section.

Entries give a title and a link, sometimes marked Optional or followed by a short remark; beyond the 101 and 201 headings they state no level, prerequisites or exercises. 148 of the 229 URLs use plain HTTP, and most dated links point to posts from 2008–2017.

The material centres on Linux ELF binaries on x86, x86-64, ARM, ARM64 and MIPS, and the hands-on section mostly uses radare2, with GDB, IDA and LIEF references elsewhere. The repository supplies no labs, sample binaries or setup; crackme and challenge links lead to external archives, and readers need a Linux system plus whatever tools each linked article names.

The packer, anti-debugging, infection, rootkit and exploitation sections link offensive write-ups, rootkit source repositories and external virus collections alongside detection material; linked code and samples are third-party material with their own risks and terms.
GitHub detects no license and the repository has no license file, so the list states no reuse terms; linked articles, books and code keep their own rights. An independent learning list.

name: XAPKDetector
description_en: APK and DEX detector from hors, the author of Detect-It-Easy, that reports the build tools, libraries and protections it identifies in Android packages, using scan engines and signature databases from the Detect-It-Easy family. The Qt GUI also shows AndroidManifest.xml, MANIFEST.MF, DEX and ELF contents, strings, hex, entropy, hashes and the APK signature, and can scan whole directories. A console build runs recursive, deep, heuristic or all-types scans and writes XML, JSON, CSV or TSV results.
description_zh: 由 Detect-It-Easy 作者 hors 开发的 APK 与 DEX 检测工具，借助 Detect-It-Easy 系列的扫描引擎和签名库，报告在 Android 软件包中识别出的构建工具、库和保护措施。其 Qt 图形界面还可查看 AndroidManifest.xml、MANIFEST.MF、DEX 和 ELF 内容，以及字符串、十六进制、熵、哈希和 APK 签名，并能扫描整个目录。命令行版本支持递归、深度、启发式或全类型扫描，并以 XML、JSON、CSV 或 TSV 格式输出结果。
requirements: Latest release at review: 0.03, published 2022-03-14, with Windows portable zips (including a Windows XP build), macOS packages including a Qt 6 build, a Linux AppImage and Debian and Ubuntu packages; release_version.txt still reads 0.03. The master branch was still receiving submodule updates at review, such as new Detect-It-Easy signatures on 2026-10-19, so the source is ahead of the released binaries.

Building needs a recursive clone of 55 git submodules from the author's other repositories, including Formats, XDEX, SpecAbstract, the signatures database and Detect-It-Easy, plus Qt. docs/BUILD.md covers Docker, a Debian package build tested on Ubuntu 14.04 to 20.04, autotools and CMake, macOS with Qt 5.15.2, and Windows with Visual Studio 2019 and Qt 5.15.2 or, for Windows XP, Visual Studio 2013 and Qt 5.6.3.

Input is APK, APKS or DEX files the analyst already has; the changelog adds APKS support in 0.03. Detections are signature and heuristic identifications for analyst confirmation. The repository itself contains no tests or CI workflows.
MIT license, copyright 2020-2026 hors; the submodules are separate repositories.

name: BREAD
description_en: Injectable real-mode x86 debugger for legacy BIOS code, boot code and DOS programs on real hardware or in a virtual machine. A small 16-bit assembly stub placed in the target code installs interrupt handlers, single-steps the processor and talks over a serial line to a Linux bridge, which translates its simple packets into the GDB remote protocol so GDB can read and write memory and registers, step, continue and set one hardware breakpoint and one watchpoint at a time. A companion script turns an address–label list into a minimal ELF symbol file for GDB.
description_zh: 可注入的 x86 实模式调试器，用于在真实硬件或虚拟机上调试传统 BIOS 代码、引导代码和 DOS 程序。放入目标代码中的 16 位汇编小程序会安装中断处理程序、让处理器单步执行，并通过串口与 Linux 上的桥接程序通信；桥接程序把这些简化报文转换为 GDB 远程协议，使 GDB 能读写内存和寄存器、单步、继续执行，并可同时设置一个硬件断点和一个观察点。配套脚本可将地址与标签列表转换为供 GDB 加载的最小 ELF 符号文件。
requirements: No releases are published. The reviewed master commit of 2025-10-21 fixes EIP handling in the interrupt-based mode; the previous code change, adding the symbolify tool, dates from 2023-10-19. Building needs a Linux host with GNU Make, a C compiler such as GCC, Clang or TCC, and NASM. The default build polls the UART at full CPU load, while UART_POLLING=no selects the interrupt-based mode, which is not the default because interrupts are not always enabled.

dbg.asm must be edited for each target, changing its ORG and return path and restoring any instructions replaced by the call into it, and the assembled dbg.bin then goes into the user’s own BIOS ROM image or runs as a DOS .COM program from a minimal FreeDOS or DOS boot floppy. Real hardware needs a serial connection to the Linux host. The repository ships no ROM; symbols/ami_ipm41d3.txt holds the author’s symbol names for one PCWare IPM41-D3 AMI legacy BIOS, which its header calls the author’s interpretation, not official or leaked symbols.

The README lists limits: the debugged code is unaware of the debugger, so a switch to protected mode, a changed IDT or a missing stack stops it from working, and BIOS code cannot be followed from the boot block because RAM must already be set up; a warm reboot can replay initialisation but may take a different path from a cold boot. Virtual machines need debug-register support, from a Bochs build with its x86 debugger enabled or QEMU with KVM, which the bundled qemu target uses with a floppy built from the included boot sector and debugger.

The repository has no tests or CI; the README links a demonstration video that changes the CPU name string. MIT license by Davidson Francis; firmware and programs being debugged keep their own rights.

name: Mergen
description_en: Function-level lifter that symbolically lifts one x86-64 function from a Windows PE binary into LLVM IR, then iterates LLVM and custom passes to a fixpoint so obfuscated or virtualized code reduces to simpler control flow and semantics for analysis. Its scope document lists 119 instruction handlers, two-way branches and tested jump-table shapes; README examples lift small test functions the authors protected with VMProtect and Themida, and the IR can be compiled for viewing in a decompiler.
description_zh: 函数级提升器：对 Windows PE 二进制中的单个 x86-64 函数进行符号化提升，生成 LLVM IR，再反复运行 LLVM 与自定义优化 pass 直至收敛，使经混淆或虚拟化的代码化简为更清晰的控制流和语义，便于分析。其范围文档列出 119 个指令处理器，支持双向分支和若干已测试的跳转表形态；README 示例提升的是作者自己用 VMProtect 和 Themida 保护的小型测试函数，输出的 IR 可编译后在反编译器中查看。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.7, published 2026-03-29, with Windows lifter and microtest executables for the iced and Zydis decoder backends. The reviewed main commit, dated 2026-05-08, is 150 commits past the later v0.8 tag, which has no release. docs/SCOPE.md limits support to x86-64 PE files and one function per run: 32-bit x86, other formats and architectures, self-modifying code, floating-point or AVX code beyond the listed SSE2 integer instructions and whole-binary lifting are unsupported, and general-purpose decompilation is a non-goal.

The lifter takes a PE file and the target function's address, with optional --outline addresses; analysts supply their own binaries. The VMProtect check runs against local protected samples that are not committed, and the reviewed tree holds source, assembly and C test sources and documentation rather than prebuilt executables. Output is LLVM IR text plus output_diagnostics.json, which records unresolved indirect jumps and returns.

Developed and CI-tested mainly on Windows with CMake, Ninja, clang-cl using MSVC headers and libraries, LLVM 18 and Rust/Cargo for the default iced backend; the Zydis-only lane builds from a vendored Zydis 4.1.0 amalgamation, and linux-pe is a git submodule. A secondary Ubuntu 22.04 Dockerfile builds and exports a Linux lifter.

docs/SCOPE.md reports 115 of 119 handlers covered by a Unicorn-generated oracle suite, 33 semantic samples with 177 runtime cases checked under lli, golden IR hashes and Windows build lanes in CI, and says reliability on protected code varies by protection level. The README's branch example still says jumps with more than two targets are unsupported, while the newer scope document lists tested jump-table shapes. These gates cover the project's own compiled samples, not arbitrary protected software.
LICENSE is GPL-3.0; the vendored Zydis source and the submodule keep their own licenses. Lifted IR still needs analyst validation.

name: readpe (formerly pev)
description_en: Command-line toolkit, formerly named pev, for analyzing 32- and 64-bit Windows PE files. readpe prints the DOS, COFF and optional headers, sections, data directories, imports and exports, while companion tools disassemble code (pedis), hash the file, headers or sections with ssdeep and imphash among others (pehash), list and extract resources (peres), match packer signatures (pepack), flag traits such as TLS callbacks, high entropy or an unusual entry point (pescan), report ASLR, DEP/NX, SEH and stack-cookie flags and dump certificates (pesec), find strings and convert between file offsets and RVAs. Output plugins write text, CSV, XML, HTML or JSON, and the bundled libpe C library provides the parser.
description_zh: 命令行工具集（原名 pev），用于分析 32 位和 64 位 Windows PE 文件。readpe 输出 DOS、COFF 与可选头、节区、数据目录以及导入和导出表；配套工具可反汇编代码（pedis），以 ssdeep、imphash 等算法对整个文件、文件头或节区计算哈希（pehash），列出并提取资源（peres），匹配加壳签名（pepack），标出 TLS 回调、高熵值或异常入口点等特征（pescan），报告 ASLR、DEP/NX、SEH 与栈 cookie 标志并导出证书（pesec），还能查找字符串以及在文件偏移和 RVA 之间换算。输出插件支持文本、CSV、XML、HTML 和 JSON，附带的 libpe C 库提供解析功能。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.85.1, published 2025-08-29 to correct the version string reported by v0.85 (2025-08-08); only the older v0.81 and v0.82 releases attach Windows ZIP builds. The reviewed master commit, from 2026-07-08, is five commits ahead, fixing peres version output and ordinal-only imports and moving the macOS CI build to a newer OpenSSL. The README explains the rename from pev and that libpe was merged into this repository.

Built from source with make and a C compiler and needs OpenSSL development headers. On Linux, make install puts files under /usr/local, and /usr/local/lib must be registered with ldconfig so libpe.so is found; macOS builds pass Homebrew OpenSSL paths in CFLAGS and LDFLAGS, and Windows builds use Cygwin with gcc-core, binutils, make, zip and libssl-devel, where make zip also builds cpload and bundles the needed Cygwin DLLs. CI only compiles on Linux, macOS and Cygwin.

Input is a PE file the user supplies. The other tools parse it, but the Windows-only cpload loads a Control Panel (.cpl) item and sends it CPL messages for debugging, so it runs that item's code. pepack depends on the bundled userdb.txt list of PEiD-style signatures, whose header counts 3,520 entries without naming their source, and pescan and pesec report heuristic indicators and header flags rather than verdicts.

tests/run.sh runs each tool in every output format and diffs the results against an expected_outputs directory that is not in the repository; valgrind scripts and a helloworld.exe sample built from tests/samples_src with MinGW are also included. CI does not run these tests.
The tools are GPL-2.0-or-later with an OpenSSL linking exception, lib/libpe is LGPL-3.0, and the bundled udis86 disassembler keeps its BSD notice.

name: sniffROM
description_en: Python tool that reconstructs serial flash contents from passive bus captures: it parses SPI or I²C analyzer exports from Saleae Logic, recorded while a device reads and writes its own flash chip, and writes the observed data into a binary image at the original memory addresses. It recognizes more than 100 SPI flash commands from vendors such as Winbond, Macronix, Spansion and GigaDevice and currently parses 12 of them, reports manufacturer and device IDs seen in JEDEC ID reads, and can print a command summary, show a visual map of the captured address ranges and plot the timing of reads and writes.
description_zh: 通过被动总线抓包重建串行闪存内容的 Python 工具：它解析 Saleae Logic 的 SPI 或 I²C 分析器导出文件（这些数据记录了设备读写自身闪存芯片的过程），并把观察到的数据按原始内存地址写入二进制镜像。它可识别 Winbond、Macronix、Spansion、GigaDevice 等厂商的 100 多条 SPI 闪存命令，目前可解析其中 12 条，能报告 JEDEC ID 读取中出现的厂商和设备 ID，还可输出命令摘要、显示已捕获地址范围的可视化分布图，并绘制读写操作的时序图。
requirements: No releases or tags; the script was last changed in July 2020. A README note added on 2023-12-07 says Saleae Logic 2 breaks the SPI analyzer export that sniffROM depends on, so it currently works only with data exported from Logic 1.x, and that it was unknown when this would be fixed.

A single Python 2 script (it uses print statements) that needs matplotlib for the data map and timing plot; the README's usage text calls it sniffROM_new.py. Input is a CSV export from Saleae Logic's SPI or I²C analyzer, with options for 2-, 3- or 4-byte SPI addresses, byte endianness and analyzing only read or only write commands.

Capturing needs a Saleae logic analyzer connected to the flash bus of a device the analyst is permitted to examine; the wiki's Getting Started page points to an external guide for the capture itself. Only data the device accessed during the capture is recovered, and unseen bytes are filled with a padding value; the wiki's boot-time SPI examples captured about 29% and 42% of the rebuilt images.

GPL-3.0 (COPYING). The repository also stores manufacturers' datasheet PDFs for the supported SPI and I²C chips and a commands.xlsx command table; the datasheets remain their vendors' documents. No firmware images or bus captures are committed.

name: IDAssist
description_en: IDA Pro plugin by Jason Tang, who also wrote GhidrAssist, that adds a dockable PySide6 panel for LLM-assisted analysis of the open database. Its tabs explain decompiled or disassembled functions with a security summary, keep persistent chats with context macros and an optional ReAct agent mode, propose function, variable and type renames for review before they are applied, and build a semantic knowledge graph of functions, calls, data flows and security traits, with retrieval over reference documents the analyst adds. Models can call built-in IDA tools or external MCP servers, and a SymGraph tab imports and publishes names, types and graph data through the hosted symgraph.ai service.
description_zh: 由 GhidrAssist 作者 Jason Tang 开发的 IDA Pro 插件，提供一个可停靠的 PySide6 面板，借助大语言模型分析当前打开的数据库。各标签页可解释反编译或反汇编后的函数并附安全摘要，保存带上下文宏和可选 ReAct 智能体模式的持久对话，为函数、变量和类型提出重命名建议并在审阅后应用，还能构建涵盖函数、调用、数据流和安全特征的语义知识图谱，并检索分析人员添加的参考文档。模型可以调用内置的 IDA 工具或外部 MCP 服务器；SymGraph 标签页则通过托管的 symgraph.ai 服务导入和发布名称、类型及图谱数据。
requirements: Latest release at review: 2.4.0, published 2026-09-14 as a source-only GitHub release; the reviewed master commit is one commit later and only updates model guidance. The README and getting-started guide require IDA Pro 9.0+ with its bundled Python 3.11+ and PySide6, while ida-plugin.json lists IDA 9.1–9.4, and the 2.3.0 notes report fixes for IDA 9.3 and 9.4 on Windows with Python 3.14. Hex-Rays is recommended for pseudocode, with disassembly used otherwise. It installs with Hex-Rays' hcli plugin manager, or from a release archive in the IDA plugins directory with requirements.txt installed into IDA's Python; that file adds boto3 for Bedrock, which the manifest's dependency list omits.

Analysis needs at least one configured LLM provider. The reviewed provider types cover Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini and xAI API keys, OpenAI and Gemini subscription sign-in through OAuth, the local Claude Code CLI, AWS Bedrock, a LiteLLM proxy, and local Ollama, LM Studio or Open WebUI endpoints; the README's table also lists an Anthropic OAuth type that the source does not define. Explanations, chats and agent runs send pseudocode or disassembly to the active provider, so only a local or self-hosted endpoint keeps code on the machine. The documentation says chats, graphs, settings and feedback are kept in local SQLite databases in the .idapro/idassist folder of the user's home directory, with API keys encrypted in the settings database.

Programs come from the user's own IDA databases. Rename suggestions show confidence scores and are written to the IDB only for the rows the user selects. During a chat, built-in tools and external MCP servers, reached by URL over SSE or streamable HTTP or launched over stdio, can read and modify the IDB; in the Query tab, calls to tools whose names do not look read-only wait for an allow-once, allow-for-session or deny decision unless the chat accepts all tools, and this classification relies on tool-name keywords.

The SymGraph tab looks up the input binary by SHA-256 without a key, but importing, publishing and uploading need a SymGraph API key, and publishing uploads the raw binary itself when the service does not already hold it. The repository has no tests or CI workflows. MIT, per LICENSE and ida-plugin.json; IDA Pro, the Hex-Rays decompiler, model providers and SymGraph keep their own terms.

name: Pawn
description_en: Linux command-line tool from Google that reads the BIOS/UEFI firmware image out of the SPI flash of Intel-based workstations and laptops. Running as root, it identifies the chipset's LPC bridge over PCI, maps the chipset's root-complex registers through /dev/mem, and reports the flash descriptor regions and the BIOS write- and read-protection settings it finds. It then reads the flash through the SPI controller's hardware sequencing into a single image file, which the README suggests processing further with tools such as UEFITool.
description_zh: Google 发布的 Linux 命令行工具，可从基于 Intel 平台的工作站和笔记本电脑的 SPI 闪存中读出 BIOS/UEFI 固件镜像。它以 root 权限运行，通过 PCI 识别芯片组的 LPC 桥，借助 /dev/mem 映射芯片组的根复合体寄存器，并报告读到的闪存描述符分区以及 BIOS 写保护和读保护设置。随后它通过 SPI 控制器的硬件时序读取闪存，写入单个镜像文件；README 建议再用 UEFITool 等工具进一步处理。
requirements: Releases v0.1 and v0.2, published 2017-08-30 and 2017-09-09, each ship a Debian amd64 package with its source; the reviewed main commit, from 2026-02-17, updates dependencies and GitHub Actions and still declares version 0.2. The README states that Pawn is not an official Google product. Builds need Linux on x86_64 (FreeBSD might also work, per the README), CMake 3.31+, GCC or Clang 7+ and Ninja or Make; CMake fetches Abseil, and GoogleTest for tests, at pinned commits. CI builds and runs the unit test on Ubuntu 24.04 and keeps the binary only as a workflow artifact.

Runs as root on the machine whose firmware is read, using I/O-port access to PCI configuration space and /dev/mem. On Linux kernels newer than 4.8.4 the README requires CONFIG_IO_DEVMEM=n or booting with iomem=relaxed; the program's own error message names IO_STRICT_DEVMEM. Only Intel ICH8, ICH9 and ICH10 and 6 to 9 Series chipsets are recognized, the newest being the 9 Series whose datasheet the source cites from May 2014; the BIOS must boot from SPI flash in descriptor mode.

It always reads 16 MiB from flash address 0, so flash beyond that size is not dumped, and failed block reads are ignored; the default output name is bios_via_spi_hs.bin. The repository contains only source, build and Debian packaging files, with no firmware images; a dump is the machine vendor's firmware and keeps the vendor's rights.
Apache-2.0.

name: EMBArk
description_en: Web-based enterprise interface for the EMBA firmware security scanner, which it installs and runs as its scanning backend. In the browser, users upload firmware, configure and follow EMBA scans, open the full EMBA HTML report and a security overview per firmware, and compare results in an aggregated dashboard; results are access-controlled per user and can be archived. The current main branch adds a REST API for upload, scan status and SBOM retrieval, and an orchestrator that distributes scans to EMBA worker nodes reached over SSH.
description_zh: EMBA 固件安全扫描器的 Web 企业级界面，会安装 EMBA 并将其作为扫描后端运行。用户可在浏览器中上传固件、配置并跟踪 EMBA 扫描，查看完整的 EMBA HTML 报告和每个固件的安全概览，并在汇总仪表板中比较结果；结果按用户控制访问，也可归档隐藏。当前 main 分支还加入了用于上传、查询扫描状态和获取 SBOM 的 REST API，以及通过 SSH 将扫描分派到 EMBA 工作节点的编排器。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.3, published 2025-06-24. The reviewed main commit is 941 commits ahead of it and identifies itself as 0.3-630649d1 in VERSION.txt; the REST API and worker orchestrator described here come from that branch. The installation wiki calls the software alpha and strongly recommends a virtual machine, and the README notes that the new tracking application does not work offline and that device, vendor and version tracking is not yet in every dashboard.

The README names Ubuntu 24 LTS as the only supported OS. installer.sh -d installs Docker, pipenv and EMBA and configures the MySQL and Redis containers defined in docker-compose.yml; EMBA is pinned as a git submodule (at review an EMBA commit from 2026-04-07, older than EMBA's latest releases) and runs in its Docker mode, while -s skips it. The wiki suggests 8–32+ GB RAM, 4–16+ CPUs, at least 20 GB of disk (100+ GB recommended) and an isolated network, and EMBA's own requirements also apply.

run-server.sh serves HTTP on port 80 on all interfaces under the default name embark.local, which must resolve through a hosts file or DNS; -a adds names or addresses and -b opens the admin pages beyond localhost. The installer and server script run with sudo, and the server is deployed to /var/www under a dedicated service user. API calls carry an API key in a header or query parameter, and the orchestrator scans an IP range and installs EMBA on workers using SSH credentials the user supplies.

Supply the firmware images yourself; the repository contains no firmware, and its test fixtures are EMBA result exports such as a CycloneDX SBOM and module CSV/JSON files. Scan findings come from EMBA and still need analyst interpretation. CI installs the server without EMBA and runs Django and server tests, linters, ShellCheck and CodeQL, so no firmware scan is part of it.
MIT license, copyright The AMOS Projects and Siemens Energy AG; EMBA and the tools it installs keep their own licenses.

name: Frida Labs
description_en: Eleven Android challenge apps with step-by-step write-ups for learning Frida instrumentation, progressing from setting up frida-server and hooking a Java method through calling static methods, changing fields, creating instances and hooking constructors to hooking, calling and patching native functions. The author presents them as beginner-to-intermediate exercises rather than hard CTF challenges: each app hides a flag, but the stated goal is learning Frida’s common APIs and being able to read scripts written by others.
description_zh: 收录十一个 Android 挑战应用及逐步讲解，用于学习 Frida 插桩：从部署 frida-server、Hook Java 方法开始，依次练习调用静态方法、修改变量、创建实例和 Hook 构造函数，最后到 Hook、调用及修补原生函数。作者将其定位为入门到中级的练习，而非高难度 CTF：每个应用都藏有 flag，但目标是掌握 Frida 常用 API，并能读懂他人编写的脚本。
requirements: Reviewed at the 2026-02-22 main commit, which adds Frida 17 workarounds to the native-hooking write-ups for challenges 0x8 to 0xB; the first write-up deploys frida-server 16.1.4. There are no releases, and the README says new challenges will be added over time.

Each challenge is a prebuilt APK committed by the author, with package names such as com.ad2001.frida0x1; the apps’ source code is not in the repository, and the solutions are Markdown write-ups with screenshots. They assume a rooted Android device or emulator, adb, frida-tools from pip and a frida-server build matching the device architecture, with jadx for the Java code and Ghidra for the native libraries; the 0xB write-up shows instruction patches for both x86 and ARM64 builds.

Flags and solution scripts are published next to each APK, so the set works as guided practice rather than an assessment. The README points to learnfrida.info and Frida CodeShare for further material.
MIT license for the repository; Frida, jadx, Ghidra and the Android tools keep their own terms.

name: malware-jail
description_en: Node.js sandbox for semi-automatic analysis of JavaScript malware: it runs a sample in Node's vm module against emulated Windows Script Host and ActiveX objects such as WScript.Shell, MSXML2.XMLHTTP, ADODB.Stream, Scripting.FileSystemObject and WMI, plus a partial browser context with selectable browser profiles. It logs the objects created and methods called, keeps every eval() argument to help deobfuscation, records requested URLs and WMI queries, and saves the files a dropper tries to write so payloads can be examined. When the run ends, the whole sandbox context is dumped to JSON for review.
description_zh: 用于半自动分析 JavaScript 恶意代码的 Node.js 沙箱：在 Node 的 vm 模块中运行样本，并模拟 Windows Script Host 与 ActiveX 对象，例如 WScript.Shell、MSXML2.XMLHTTP、ADODB.Stream、Scripting.FileSystemObject 和 WMI，另有可选择浏览器配置的部分浏览器环境。它记录创建的对象和调用的方法，保留每次 eval() 的参数以辅助去混淆，记下请求的 URL 和 WMI 查询，并保存投放器试图写入的文件，便于检查载荷。运行结束时，整个沙箱上下文会导出为 JSON 供复查。
requirements: There are no releases or tags, and the README says an npm package is not yet available. The reviewed master commit, from 2023-06-16, only edits the README; the last code change, adding newly analyzed malware and ADODB methods, dates from 2019-08-08. Version labels disagree: package.json says 0.18.0, the README 0.19 and jailme.js 0.20.

Requires Node.js and npm: package.json declares Node 6 or later, and the README says the tool was developed and tested on Linux with Node.js v6.6.0. npm install fetches minimist, iconv-lite, entities and sync-request, npm test runs a small tap suite for the WScript emulation, and native_test holds scripts meant to run under Windows cscript for comparison. Emulation covers the WScript and ActiveX features the author saw malware use and only part of the browser context, so a sample may stop early or diverge from real Windows behavior; the logs and dumps are traces for an analyst, not a verdict.

Node's vm module is not a security boundary: the README warns that sandbox-aware malware may try to escape and recommends an unprivileged Linux account or a virtualized Windows machine. By default HTTP requests are not sent and receive dummy responses; --down lets the sample contact remote servers and download payloads, while --h404 and --t404 answer every request with HTTP 404 so all remote URLs can be listed. Execution stops after 60 seconds unless -t sets another limit.

The malware folder holds real-world samples, most of them downloaded from malwr.com according to the README, with their logs and dumps. Besides scripts and HTML pages it includes two extracted Windows payload files, a .exe under malware/20171004 and a .tmp under malware/20190808, and the README states that the Angler files are not disarmed, so a clone contains live malware.
MIT, per the LICENSE file and README.

name: IDAPython Embedded Toolkit
description_en: Maddie Stone's IDAPython scripts for triaging and annotating embedded-device firmware images in IDA Pro, presented at RECON Montreal and DerbyCon in 2017. Triage scripts define code and functions from per-architecture prologue and epilogue patterns, mark address ranges as bytes, words or double words and turn unexplored bytes into strings; analysis scripts resolve memory accesses made at offsets from a known base value and add cross-references and value comments, and annotation scripts list CPU port (GPIO) use, tag functions without cross-references as possible dead code and trace where an operand is used. An Android folder adds a script that comments JNIEnv function calls in native libraries and one that decrypts the strings of ARM32 libraries packed with the WeddingCake anti-analysis wrapper.
description_zh: Maddie Stone 编写的 IDAPython 脚本集，用于在 IDA Pro 中对嵌入式设备固件镜像进行初步梳理和标注，曾于 2017 年在 RECON Montreal 和 DerbyCon 上介绍。梳理类脚本依据各架构的函数序言和尾声模式定义代码与函数，把地址范围标记为字节、字或双字，并把未探索的字节转换为字符串；分析类脚本根据已知基址解析以偏移方式进行的内存访问，并添加交叉引用和数值注释；标注类脚本列出 CPU 端口（GPIO）的使用位置，把没有交叉引用的函数标为可能的死代码，并追踪某个操作数的使用位置。Android 文件夹另有一个为原生库中的 JNIEnv 函数调用添加注释的脚本，以及一个解密经 WeddingCake 反分析外壳打包的 ARM32 库中字符串的脚本。
requirements: Ten Python scripts and the slides of the two 2017 talks as PDFs, with no releases or tags; the reviewed master commit, from 2019-08-14, is the latest. The README says the scripts have only been tested on IDA Pro 6.95, with IDA 7.0 testing in progress, and runs each one separately through File > Script file in an open IDA database with IDAPython. Most use Python 2 print statements and pre-7.0 IDC calls such as MakeCode, MakeComm, MakeStr and AskAddr; jni_translate.py, added in 2019, uses Python 3-compatible print calls but still calls idc.MakeComm.

The user supplies the firmware image or Android native library and its IDA database, and enters address ranges, regular expressions or base values at prompts or in each script's user-defined section. Processor-specific syntax is chosen from IDA's processor name: define_code_functions.py covers 8051, PIC18, Mitsubishi M32R, TI TMS320C28x and AVR, and find_mem_accesses.py only 8051, while identify_port_use_locations.py ships one active PIC18 pattern with commented 8051 alternatives. Unsupported processors stop with an error until the analyst adds patterns, and find_mem_accesses.py cannot create references into segments that do not yet exist.

Several scripts rewrite the database: define_data_as_types.py first undefines the range, overwriting code or strings there, and WeddingCake_decrypt.py overwrites encrypted strings with their decrypted contents and needs JNI_OnLoad defined and exported. The WeddingCake files accompany Maddie Stone's Black Hat USA 2018 talk on that packer.

MIT, copyright 2017 Maddie Stone, in LICENSE; the README's copyright notice instead names The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory, and the Android README and WeddingCake script carry a Google LLC 2018 copyright line without separate license terms.

name: osx & ios re 101
description_en: A single-README reading list for macOS (OS X) and iOS reverse engineering, kept by Michal Malik from 2015 to 2019 and labelled a work in progress. Its 98 entries in nine sections run from must-read blogs and Mach-O, ABI and system-call references through Mach-O basics, malware, anti-debugging and obfuscation write-ups, kernel, sandbox and jailbreak research, kernel-extension development and kernel debugging, and forensics and monitoring material, to crackmes and six books. Entries are bare links or titles, mostly with no annotation.
description_zh: 以单个 README 维护的 macOS（OS X）与 iOS 逆向工程阅读清单，由 Michal Malik 于 2015 至 2019 年间整理，并标注为仍在进行中。九个部分共 98 个条目，依次涵盖必读博客与 Mach-O、ABI 和系统调用参考资料，Mach-O 基础知识，恶意软件、反调试和混淆相关文章，内核、沙箱与越狱研究，内核扩展开发与内核调试，取证与监控资料，以及 crackme 练习和六本书。条目只有链接或标题，大多没有说明。
requirements: The reviewed commit, from 2019-12-19 and the latest, closes a history of 69 commits that began on 2015-07-13. Most linked material targets OS X 10.x and iOS 8–10 era internals, such as El Capitan kernels and iOS 9 and 10 jailbreak analyses, and the list predates current macOS and iOS releases and Apple silicon Macs. A December 2019 commit replaced some broken and outdated links.

No target files are supplied or needed by the list itself; the linked tutorials and crackmes bring their own samples, and the books are listed by title only. Following the material assumes a Mac or iOS device and the tools each article uses, such as LLDB, Hopper, and VMware Fusion or VirtualBox for kernel debugging.

The list mixes analysis tutorials with malware infection, rootkit, privilege-escalation and jailbreak write-ups. The repository contains only README.md and no license file, so the list states no reuse terms, and linked works keep their own rights.

name: gxpc
description_en: macOS command-line XPC sniffer, inspired by xpcspy, that injects a Frida agent into an attached or newly spawned process and logs the XPC messages it sends and receives, labelled with the libxpc function, connection name, peer PID and process name. The agent recursively converts xpc_object_t dictionaries, arrays and scalar values into readable output and decodes binary-plist payloads, while a Go host built on frida-go selects a local, USB or remote Frida device, filters connections by name or PID and can save the trace to a file. It observes how Apple-platform apps and services communicate over XPC and does not alter or inject messages.
description_zh: 受 xpcspy 启发的 macOS 命令行 XPC 嗅探工具：把 Frida 代理注入已附加或新启动的进程，记录其收发的 XPC 消息，并标出对应的 libxpc 函数、连接名、对端 PID 与进程名。代理会递归地把 xpc_object_t 字典、数组和标量值转换为可读输出，并解码二进制 plist 负载；基于 frida-go 的 Go 主程序负责选择本地、USB 或远程 Frida 设备，按名称或 PID 过滤连接，并可将跟踪结果保存到文件。它用于观察 Apple 平台应用与服务如何通过 XPC 通信，不会修改或注入消息。
requirements: Latest release at review: v2.2.1, published 2025-08-12, with macOS x86_64 and arm64 archives that GoReleaser links against the Frida 17.2.16 core devkit; the reviewed main commit adds only a cobra dependency bump (2025-09-02). Installing with go install instead needs Go, cgo and the Frida devkit set up as frida-go documents; go.mod declares Go 1.20 and frida-go 1.0.0.

On first run the binary writes its embedded TypeScript agent and package files to a gxpc folder in the system temp directory, runs npm install for frida-objc-bridge and compiles the agent with Frida’s compiler, so Node.js, npm and network access are needed at least once; the compiled agent is then reused. The analyst picks the target by PID, process name or a file to spawn, on a local device (-i local), a USB device (the default) or a remote Frida server; the README documents no device setup or tested OS versions.

Outgoing messages come from hooks on the public libxpc send, reply and notification functions, and new connections from xpc_connection_create_mach_service and xpc_connection_set_event_handler. Incoming messages rely on the private _xpc_connection_call_event_handler and __CFBinaryPlistCreate15, which the agent resolves from debug symbols and caches as offsets per machine and OS build in gxpc.conf in the user’s home directory (or a file given with -c). bplist16 payloads are decoded through an external jlutil executable when one is installed on the host, otherwise by the agent’s own parser or as base64. In the reviewed main.go the --whitelistp option reads the --whitelist value, so PID allow-listing may not work as documented.
MIT. frida-go, the Frida devkit and frida-objc-bridge keep their own licenses, and jlutil is a separate third-party tool not shipped with gxpc.

name: Jsxer
description_en: C++ decompiler for JSXBIN, the binary format of Adobe's legacy ExtendScript, the ECMAScript 3 dialect used to script applications such as Photoshop, InDesign and After Effects. It reads a JSXBIN 1.0, 2.0 or 2.1 literal, parses it into a syntax tree and prints JavaScript source with a header naming the format version. An experimental --unblind option renames symbols obfuscated by JsxBlind, and the same decompiler is exposed as a shared library with a ctypes-based Python binding.
description_zh: 面向 JSXBIN 的 C++ 反编译器。JSXBIN 是 Adobe 旧版 ExtendScript 的二进制格式，ExtendScript 则是用于为 Photoshop、InDesign、After Effects 等应用编写脚本的 ECMAScript 3 方言。它读取 JSXBIN 1.0、2.0 或 2.1 字面量，解析为语法树，再输出 JavaScript 源码，并在文件头注明格式版本。实验性的 --unblind 选项可为经 JsxBlind 混淆的符号重新命名；同一反编译器还以共享库形式提供，并附基于 ctypes 的 Python 绑定。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.7.4, published 2025-03-31 with macOS arm64, macOS x86 and Windows archives. The reviewed master commit, from 2025-04-22, is one commit later and only makes the README's notice more visible: it says the project is being rewritten in Rust on a separate rust-rewrite branch, whose latest commit is from 2025-03-11.

Input is a file holding only the JSXBIN literal, usually beginning with @JSXBIN@; the README warns that other content around it must be removed first. The CLI writes a .jsx file next to the input unless -o names another path; input that fails the JSXBIN signature check yields an error message and no decompiled code.

Source builds need CMake 3.26+ and a C++17 compiler; configuring fetches fmt 9.1.0, plog 1.1.9 and CLI11 2.3.2 from GitHub. The README documents only the macOS build, while CMakeLists.txt also has Windows and Linux branches and builds a static library and a shared library, the latter loaded by bindings/python/decompiler.py from the build directory.

ctest builds four small programs that decompile embedded array, object, member-expression and for-statement samples and print the result; they report the decompiler's status code but do not compare output with the original source, and CI runs them on macOS and Windows for pull requests. TODO.md lists open problems with function argument order, comma-expression declarations, number printing and some XML nodes producing improper code.

AGPL-3.0. The README says Jsxer was made for source code recovery and security research and asks users not to use it to pirate scripts from their authors; it credits Andrin Meier's format research and jsxbin-to-jsx-converter, whose original repository it says was removed after an Adobe DMCA takedown. Decompiled scripts keep their authors' rights.

name: jni_helper
description_en: Static helper by evilpan for reverse engineering Android JNI code. Its extract_jni.py script parses an APK's DEX files with Androguard, finds methods declared native, derives each one's mangled Java_ symbol name and C prototype, including overloaded methods, and saves them with the exported Java_ and JNI_OnLoad functions of the APK's arm64-v8a native libraries as a JSON signature file. Scripts for Ghidra, IDA Pro and Binary Ninja load that file and apply the prototypes and JNI types to the matching functions; a radare2 script is a work in progress.
description_zh: evilpan 开发的 Android JNI 代码静态逆向辅助工具。其 extract_jni.py 脚本用 Androguard 解析 APK 中的 DEX 文件，找出声明为 native 的方法，推导出每个方法（包括重载方法）对应的 Java_ 修饰符号名和 C 函数原型，并连同 APK 中 arm64-v8a 原生库导出的 Java_ 函数和 JNI_OnLoad 一起保存为 JSON 签名文件。面向 Ghidra、IDA Pro 和 Binary Ninja 的脚本读取该文件，把函数原型和 JNI 类型应用到相应函数上；radare2 脚本仍在开发中。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.6, published 2024-10-23, whose only asset is the demo APK built by CI; the reviewed master commit of 2025-02-24 only updates a README link. CI builds the demo app with JDK 17 and runs extract_jni.py on it as its only test, without checking the output or exercising the disassembler scripts.

extract_jni.py needs Python 3 with androguard, rich and pyelftools from requirements.txt and takes an APK the analyst already has; it reads native libraries only from lib/arm64-v8a. Methods bound at run time through RegisterNatives are not covered, which the README lists as an open TODO, and the disassembler scripts find functions only by their mangled Java_ symbol names.

The Ghidra script is installed by a Makefile into the ghidra_scripts folder in the user's home directory, together with the bundled jni.h.gdt data-type archive; the IDA plugin has separate versions for IDA Pro before 7.4 and for 7.4 and later; the Binary Ninja script runs from File > Run Script and parses the bundled headers/jni.h. Supported versions of Ghidra, Binary Ninja and radare2 are not stated.

No license file, and GitHub detects none, so reuse terms for the scripts are unstated. Bundled headers keep their own notices: headers/jni.h is Oracle's GPL-2.0 file with the Classpath exception, while r2/jni.h and headers/art_method.h are Android Open Source Project files under Apache-2.0. The demo_apk folder holds the source of the author's test app.

name: Manticore
description_en: Trail of Bits' now-archived symbolic execution tool for Linux ELF binaries on x86, x86-64, AArch64 and ARMv7, Ethereum smart contracts as EVM bytecode, and WebAssembly modules. It runs a program on symbolic inputs to explore the states it can reach, generates concrete inputs that lead to a chosen state and detects crashes and other failures, solving constraints with an external Yices, Z3 or CVC4 solver. The manticore CLI writes generated test cases to an mcore_ workspace, while the Python API adds instruction hooks, event callbacks and custom initial states; manticore-verifier checks contract properties written in the contract's own language.
description_zh: Trail of Bits 开发、现已归档的符号执行工具，可分析 x86、x86-64、AArch64 和 ARMv7 上的 Linux ELF 二进制、以 EVM 字节码表示的以太坊智能合约以及 WebAssembly 模块。它以符号输入运行程序，探索可到达的各个状态，生成能到达指定状态的具体输入，并检测崩溃等错误情形，约束由外部的 Yices、Z3 或 CVC4 求解器求解。manticore 命令行工具把生成的测试用例写入 mcore_ 工作目录，Python API 则支持指令钩子、事件回调和自定义初始状态；manticore-verifier 用于检查以合约自身语言编写的属性。
requirements: Archived and unmaintained: the README states that the project is no longer internally developed and maintained, and GitHub marks the repository archived. The reviewed master commit, from 2026-06-24, only changes that status; the last change under manticore/ dates from 2022-08-07. The latest release is 0.3.7 on GitHub and PyPI (2022-02-17), and PyPI's nightly 0.3.8.dev builds end on 2024-02-27.

Requires Python 3.7 or later. pip install manticore covers EVM and WASM, manticore[native] adds the pinned capstone 5.0.0rc2 and unicorn 2.x needed for native binaries, and a trailofbits/manticore Docker image is offered. The README names the latest Ubuntu LTS on GitHub Actions as the supported platform, gives macOS experimental EVM and WASM support but no native-binary support, and recommends a larger stack limit; CI at the reviewed commit still runs Python 3.7 on ubuntu-20.04.

Inputs are the user's own ELF binaries, Solidity or Vyper sources or EVM bytecode, or WASM modules. Contract analysis needs solc on PATH and compiles through crytic-compile; the README says EVM Istanbul semantics are not fully implemented, so some opcodes may be unsupported. Whole-program CLI runs are prone to state explosion, which the README suggests limiting by tailoring the initial state through the API.

CI runs ethereum, native, WASM, examples and other test suites after downloading Yices 2.6.2 and solc 0.4.24. tests/native/binaries and examples/linux/binaries hold small prebuilt Linux test programs for amd64 and ARMv7, some with their C sources; larger examples, including CTF problems, live in the separate manticore-examples repository, and server/ holds an unpublished gRPC wrapper for the Manticore UI.
AGPL-3.0; the README says Trail of Bits can be contacted for an exception to its terms. The ASE 2019 paper (arXiv 1907.03890) describes the tool.

name: Awesome Executable Packing
description_en: A single-README list of resources on executable packing, meaning the bundling, compression, encryption, mutation, protection or virtualization of PE, ELF and other executables, including Android apps, and on detecting and unpacking packed files. About 770 entries are grouped into documentation, dated scientific papers, sample datasets, packers sorted by era from before 2000 to after 2010, and tools for packer identification, unpacking and binary analysis.
description_zh: 以单个 README 维护的可执行文件加壳资源清单。加壳指对 PE、ELF 等可执行文件（包括 Android 应用）进行打包、压缩、编码、加密、变形、保护或虚拟化，清单也涵盖已加壳文件的检测与脱壳。约 770 个条目分为文档、注明日期的学术论文、样本数据集、按年代（2000 年以前至 2010 年以后）排列的加壳工具，以及用于加壳识别、脱壳和二进制分析的工具。
requirements: The reviewed README, committed 2026-10-10, has 768 list rows: 94 documentation links and 328 scientific publications under Literature, 37 datasets, 190 packers (90 after 2010, 41 from 2000 to 2010 and 59 before 2000) and 119 tools. All but one publication give a month and year; Literature rows carry emoji type markers and 110 publications carry a star, neither of which the README explains. One documentation row links to the list itself.

Rows give a name, a link and usually a one-line description, with no license, maintenance or platform fields, and many packers and tools are specific to Windows PE files. Packer rows point to vendor sites, SourceForge, GitHub projects, blog analyses and 30 Internet Archive copies of old pages or download archives.

The Datasets section lists public malware repositories and feeds next to packed and benign PE and ELF sample sets and benchmark datasets such as EMBER and SOREL-20M. Samples obtained through them can be live malicious software and fall under each provider's access terms.

CC0-1.0 for the list; CONTRIBUTING.md asks for alphabetically sorted rows and one commit per suggestion. Linked papers, packers, tools and datasets keep their own licenses. An independent discovery list.

name: fiano
description_en: LinuxBoot's Go tools and libraries for parsing and modifying UEFI firmware images. Its utk command shows an image's firmware volumes and files as a table or JSON, finds, dumps, inserts, removes or replaces files, and extracts an image into a directory that can be reassembled, with a DXE cleaner for deleting unneeded DXE drivers. Further commands cover flash maps (fmap), coreboot CBFS, Intel FIT tables, FSP headers, microcode and LZMA data, and its Go packages also parse Intel ME regions, Boot Guard and CBnT manifests and AMD firmware structures.
description_zh: LinuxBoot 项目用 Go 编写的 UEFI 固件镜像解析与修改工具及库。其 utk 命令可用表格或 JSON 展示镜像中的固件卷和文件，查找、转储、插入、删除或替换文件，并把镜像解包到可重新组装的目录中，还提供用于删除多余 DXE 驱动的 DXE 清理功能。其他命令涵盖闪存布局（fmap）、coreboot CBFS、Intel FIT 表、FSP 头部、微码和 LZMA 数据；其 Go 包还能解析 Intel ME 区域、Boot Guard 与 CBnT 清单以及 AMD 固件结构。
requirements: No GitHub releases; the newest tags, v7.0.2 and v6.0.1, both point to commits from 2021-12-01, while main keeps receiving fixes, documentation and dependency updates, the reviewed commit being from 2026-05-14. The README installs utk and fmap with go install at @latest and still says Go 1.13 is required, whereas go.mod declares Go 1.21 and CircleCI uses Go 1.22.

Pure-Go command-line tools; go install places the executables in the go/bin folder of the user's home directory. Input is a firmware image the analyst already has, such as a full flash ROM, and fspinfo supports only FSP 2.0 files. CI checks formatting, runs ineffassign and the unit and race tests, and the Go tests include an extract, reassemble and extract round trip and a JSON regression check on a bundled OVMF image.

BSD-3-Clause, copyright LinuxBoot. Test fixtures include an OVMF.rom built from EDK2's open-source vUDK2018 tag, coreboot ROMs, compression samples and manifest samples, plus two Intel binaries kept under Intel's own redistribution terms with their license files: the Apollo Lake FSP blob Fsp.fd under the FSP License, and the Purley ME Ignition firmware MeRegion.bin for Cascade Lake servers, whose binary-only license forbids reverse engineering that image.
Modification commands rewrite firmware images; the README does not discuss flashing or recovery.

name: Deluder
description_en: Frida-based interceptor for the traffic of proxy-unaware applications. JavaScript hook scripts on the send and receive functions of WinSock, Linux libc sockets, OpenSSL, GnuTLS and SChannel pass plaintext buffers to Python interceptor modules, which log them or forward them to a proxy for inspection. It spawns or attaches to a process, optionally through a remote frida-server, and was designed mainly as the backend for the author's PETEP proxy; a proxifier interceptor works with other proxy tools, and new scripts and interceptors can be added.
description_zh: 基于 Frida 的拦截工具，用于捕获不支持代理设置的应用程序的流量。JavaScript 挂钩脚本作用于 WinSock、Linux libc 套接字、OpenSSL、GnuTLS 和 SChannel 的收发函数，将明文缓冲区交给 Python 拦截模块记录日志，或转发到代理中查看。它可启动或附加到进程，也可通过远程 frida-server 操作，主要作为作者 PETEP 代理的后端而设计；proxifier 拦截模块可配合其他代理工具使用，并可添加新的脚本和拦截模块。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.2.1, published 2025-11-14; the reviewed main commit is identical to that tag. The changelog adds remote frida-server support in 1.1 and GnuTLS and Linux sockets in 1.2. The README lists the hooked functions for each library and their Windows, Linux and macOS module names; other libraries need custom Frida scripts.

Python 3.9+ with the pinned frida 16.4.10, psutil 6.0.0 and argparse 1.4.0. It is installed from a release or clone with setup.py, or run as a module after installing requirements.txt. Analysts choose the process to spawn or attach to by path, PID or name, remote targets need a frida-server for their platform, and child processes are hooked unless that is disabled.

Captured messages go to log, debug, proxifier or PETEP interceptors. PETEP integration uses its own protocol on port 8008 by default, and the proxifier frames data by length prefix, suffix or buffer size. The README warns that dropping intercepted messages is unsupported and breaks interception.

Scripts resolve exported functions in loaded modules whose names match a configurable list, so applications that link these libraries statically or use other TLS stacks need custom scripts. The tests directory has pytest cases for the PETEP and proxifier interceptors and for byte formatting. The reviewed tree has no CI workflow and no automated tests for the Frida hook scripts.
LICENSE.md is GPL-3.0.

name: Pyrrha
description_en: Quarkslab's firmware cartography tool, which indexes an extracted firmware filesystem into a database browsed with NumbatUI, Quarkslab's fork of the Sourcetrail code explorer. The fs mapper uses LIEF to map ELF and PE files, their imports and exports and the symlinks that point to them; fs-cg disassembles every executable with IDA Pro or Ghidra and links their call graphs across binaries, and decomp indexes one executable's decompiled functions with call cross-references. JSON exports can be post-processed in Python, for example to diff two firmware versions.
description_zh: Quarkslab 的固件“测绘”工具，将已提取的固件文件系统编入数据库，再用 NumbatUI（Quarkslab 基于 Sourcetrail 代码浏览器的分支）浏览。fs 映射器借助 LIEF 映射 ELF 和 PE 文件、其导入与导出，以及指向这些文件的符号链接；fs-cg 用 IDA Pro 或 Ghidra 反汇编每个可执行文件，并把各二进制的调用图跨文件连接起来；decomp 则为单个可执行文件的反编译函数建立索引并附调用交叉引用。JSON 导出可用 Python 进一步处理，例如比较两个固件版本的差异。
requirements: Latest release at review: v2.0.3, published to GitHub and PyPI as pyrrha-mapper on 2026-09-21; the reviewed main commit sets the same version. v2.0.0 (2026-07-07) added the Ghidra backend and removed the earlier Quokka dependency. pyproject.toml marks the package Beta and lists Linux and Windows.

Input is a firmware root filesystem that the user has already extracted or mounted, or a single executable for decomp; Pyrrha does not unpack firmware images. The fs quick start uses an OpenWrt x86-64 rootfs downloaded from the OpenWrt project.

pyproject.toml requires Python 3.11+, although the installation page says 3.10. fs needs no disassembler, but fs-cg and decomp need a local IDA Pro 9.1+ or Ghidra 12.0+, found on PATH or through IDADIR or GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR; a Ghidra-based Docker image is published on GitHub's registry, and the IDA CI image is built from the user's own Hex-Rays installer and licence. Results are viewed in NumbatUI or, without newer features such as node renaming, Sourcetrail 2021.4.19.

The GitLab CI file runs pytest unit tests and CLI runs of each mapper, with IDA and Ghidra images for fs-cg and decomp; the GitHub workflows only build documentation and publish releases. tests/test_fw is a small 32-bit ARM Linux fixture holding an OpenSSL 1.1.1n executable built with Buildroot and glibc libraries.
Apache-2.0; NumbatUI is a separate GPL-3.0 project, and IDA Pro is commercial software. The README lists SSTIC, Hack.lu, Pass The SALT and RE//verse talks by the authors.

name: GhidraGPT
description_en: Ghidra extension that sends one function’s decompiled C to a hosted or local language model the user selects and streams the answer into a GhidraGPT console. Its three actions, offered in the Decompiler and Listing context menus, explain the function; rewrite it by writing recovered function, parameter and variable names, types, the prototype and inline comments back into the program; or audit it for likely security issues. Every action uses only the current function’s decompiler output, and the README calls audit findings leads to verify rather than sound static analysis.
description_zh: Ghidra 扩展，把单个函数的反编译 C 代码发送给使用者选定的托管或本地大模型，并将回复流式显示在 GhidraGPT 控制台中。反编译视图和列表视图的右键菜单提供三项操作：解释函数；改写函数，把恢复出的函数名、参数名与变量名、类型、函数原型及行内注释写回程序；以及审查函数中可能存在的安全问题。每项操作只使用当前函数的反编译输出，README 称审查结果只是需要核实的线索，并非严谨的静态分析。
requirements: The reviewed main commit is the v1.4.0 release of 2026-07-22, which attaches GhidraGPT-1.4.0.zip. extension.properties declares Ghidra 12.1.2, and the README requires Ghidra 12.1.x, noting that the extension declares compatibility with the Ghidra version it is built against. Building from source needs JDK 21+, Maven and GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR pointing at a local Ghidra; the zip is then added through Ghidra’s Install Extensions dialog.

Each request sends the function name and its decompiled code, prefixed with instruction addresses for Rewrite together with a list of its variables, to the configured provider: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Cohere, Mistral AI, DeepSeek, Grok, OpenRouter, a local Ollama model or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Hosted providers need the user’s own API key, which the README says is stored in config.properties in a .ghidragpt folder under the user’s home directory with XOR obfuscation that is not encryption; every provider except Ollama needs network access.

Rewrite applies the parsed names, types, prototype and comments in Ghidra transactions without a separate confirmation step. The README states that there is no interprocedural or whole-program analysis, so callers, callees and data flow outside the function are not given to the model.

CI downloads Ghidra 12.1.2, sets up JDK 21 and runs Maven unit tests for configuration handling, prompt building and parsing of model responses and rewrite edits; these do not exercise the Ghidra interface or model output.
Apache-2.0 license; the README names Mohamed Benchikh as author. Ghidra and each model provider keep their own licences and terms.

name: Ghidra Ninja ghidra_scripts
description_en: Thomas Roth's (Ghidra Ninja) collection of Ghidra Python scripts, which appear under a Ghidra Ninja category in the Script Manager. binwalk.py and yara.py run binwalk or bundled YARA crypto-constant rules over the loaded program and bookmark the findings, YaraSearch.py does the same with a rule file the user chooses, swift_demangler.py demangles Swift function names, golang_renamer.py restores function names in stripped Go binaries from the .gopclntab table, and export_gameboy_rom.py writes a working ROM back out of a Game Boy program imported with GhidraBoy.
description_zh: Thomas Roth（Ghidra Ninja）编写的 Ghidra Python 脚本合集，脚本会出现在 Script Manager 的 Ghidra Ninja 分类下。binwalk.py 和 yara.py 对已加载的程序运行 binwalk 或自带的 YARA 密码常量规则，并为发现的结果添加书签；YaraSearch.py 则使用用户选择的规则文件完成同样的工作；swift_demangler.py 还原 Swift 函数名；golang_renamer.py 依据 .gopclntab 表恢复去符号 Go 二进制中的函数名；export_gameboy_rom.py 可将用 GhidraBoy 导入的 Game Boy 程序重新导出为可运行的 ROM。
requirements: No releases or tags; the last commit is a merge from 2020-10-07. Open issues filed between 2020 and 2025 report problems including golang_renamer data-type errors, a binwalk.py temporary-file error and an out-of-memory failure, with no later commits.

Installed by adding the checked-out repository as a script directory in Ghidra's Script Manager. The scripts are Python 2 code for Ghidra's Jython interpreter, and the README names no supported Ghidra version. binwalk.py, yara.py and YaraSearch.py need binwalk or yara on PATH, swift_demangler.py needs the swift toolchain, and export_gameboy_rom.py needs the GhidraBoy extension.

Input is a program the analyst has loaded into Ghidra; export_gameboy_rom.py works on a Game Boy ROM the user imported, and an open issue says it fails for single-page ROMs. golang_renamer.py only searches for the .gopclntab header used before Go 1.16, and an open issue asks for Go 1.16 support. YARA and binwalk hits are signature matches.

GPL-3.0 (LICENSE). The README says the bundled yara-crypto.yar rules are licensed under GPLv2, with an added SHA256 rule credited to @phoul, and credits golang_renamer.py as a port of George Zaytsev's go_renamer.py.

name: BudsPro-Headtracking: streaming Galaxy Buds Pro head tracking over Samsung’s serial protocol
description_en: Reimplements the Samsung Galaxy Buds Pro’s proprietary spatial-audio messages in a small Python script so that a PC can stream the earbuds’ head-tracking data in real time. It connects to the earbuds’ GEARMANAGER (or FACTORY) RFCOMM serial service, frames packets with start and end markers and a CRC16-CCITT checksum, enables the sensor stream with attach and two-second keep-alive messages, and decodes the rotation quaternion from the data events. A contributed script converts the quaternion to Euler angles and forwards it over local UDP to a Unity receiver; results are shown only as author-provided sample output.
description_zh: 用一个小型 Python 脚本重新实现 Samsung Galaxy Buds Pro 专有的空间音频消息，使电脑能实时获取耳机的头部追踪数据。脚本连接耳机的 GEARMANAGER（或 FACTORY）RFCOMM 串口服务，以起止标记和 CRC16-CCITT 校验封装数据包，通过 attach 消息和每两秒一次的保活消息开启传感器数据流，并从数据事件中解码旋转四元数。另有贡献者编写的脚本把四元数转换为欧拉角，经本机 UDP 转发给 Unity 接收端；效果仅以作者给出的示例输出展示。
requirements: The reviewed master commit 63b321a (2024-12-30) merges a contributor change that also accepts the FACTORY service name reported for Galaxy Buds2; the README covers only the Galaxy Buds Pro, and the project has no releases, tests or list of tested earbud firmware. Headtracking.py prints the raw x, y, z, w quaternion (four signed 16-bit values divided by 10,000) or, with -b, frame-timing statistics, and reports gyro-bias and stuck-sensor events only in verbose mode.

It needs the user’s own paired Galaxy Buds Pro, addressed by its Bluetooth MAC address; no Samsung app or firmware is used at runtime or included in the repository. The repository does not document how the message IDs and framing were derived; code comments point to the author’s separate Galaxy Buds desktop client for the full parser and quaternion conversion.

Python 3 with PyBluez on Windows or Linux; the README requires PyBluez 0.22 on Windows because 0.23 fails to enumerate Bluetooth devices. buds_to_unity.py also needs NumPy, hardcodes a device address and sends to 127.0.0.1:12562, and getBudsUDP.cs is a Unity MonoBehaviour adapted from a receiver credited to KAIST UVR Lab.

The README shows sample quaternion output, and benchmark mode reports the average, minimum and maximum time between motion frames, but no captures, tests or recorded benchmark results are published. In the reviewed SpatialSensorManager.py the command payloads are built with Python’s bytes(n), which yields n zero bytes rather than the value n, so the bytes sent may differ from what the constant names suggest.
LICENSE grants MIT (2021, Tim Schneeberger); the Unity script carries an attribution to its original author but no separate license. Galaxy Buds and its services belong to Samsung.

name: FindCrypt - Ghidra Edition
description_en: Ghidra script that ports Ilfak Guilfanov's FindCrypt plugin for IDA, searching a program's memory or the current selection for constants of cryptographic and compression algorithms. Its serialized signature database keeps the original plugin's 79 algorithm constant sets and, by the README's count, holds 122 detectable constants for hash functions, block and stream ciphers, Curve25519 code, Keccak and zlib; when a whole constant is absent, the script also looks for its individual elements and reports partial matches above a detection threshold. Hits become Ghidra bookmarks and a results table from which matching data can be defined.
description_zh: 移植自 Ilfak Guilfanov 为 IDA 编写的 FindCrypt 插件的 Ghidra 脚本，在程序内存或当前选区中查找密码算法与压缩算法的常量。其序列化签名库保留了原插件的 79 组算法常量，按 README 的统计共含 122 个可检测常量，涵盖哈希函数、分组密码与流密码、Curve25519 代码、Keccak 和 zlib；若找不到完整常量，脚本还会查找其中的单个元素，并报告超过检测阈值的部分匹配。命中结果会生成 Ghidra 书签和结果表，可从表中将匹配位置定义为数据。
requirements: The README says the project is discontinued because its author cannot keep it maintained, and points to forks such as TorgoTorgo/ghidra-findcrypt. The reviewed master commit dates from 2021-03-18; the last release, 1.5 of 2020-04-17, attaches FindCrypt.java and database.d3v, and the script and database both report version 7. No supported Ghidra versions are stated; the installation example path names Ghidra 9.0.

Installation is manual: copy FindCrypt.java into Ghidra's Features/BytePatterns/ghidra_scripts directory and the findcrypt_ghidra database folder into the user's home directory, then run the script from the Script Manager on a program already loaded in Ghidra. Headless runs print the results instead of opening the table.

By default each run contacts raw.githubusercontent.com to compare script and database versions with this repository and downloads a newer database.d3v into the home-directory folder; the README describes the __FORCE_NO_DBUPDATE and __FORCE_NO_SCRIPTUPDATE flags in the script that turn this off.

Detection is a byte search for known constants, so hits mark candidate locations, and code that carries no table constants is not found. New signatures are built with the FCExporter Visual Studio project in Utils, which needs Crypto++ for compression.

GPL-3.0, with the Crypto++ license notice included for the exporter. The README credits Ilfak Guilfanov's original plugin, and the database changelog credits contributor Pawlos with its current format.

name: ReArk
description_en: Desktop reverse-engineering and AI-assisted analysis workbench for HarmonyOS NEXT packages (.hap, .app and .abc), whose binary releases add Android .apk/.aab, iOS .ipa and standalone PE, ELF and Mach-O analysis. The README describes browsing package structure, resources, signatures and metadata, ABC bytecode disassembly and decompilation with strings and cross-references, Java-like Android decompilation, native header, import and mitigation views, and HDC/ADB device workflows for installing apps, reading logs and mirroring screens. Its built-in ReArk Agent answers questions about the open package with OpenAI-compatible or local Ollama models, retrieving package evidence on demand behind approval flows for host and device actions.
description_zh: 面向 HarmonyOS NEXT 安装包（.hap、.app 和 .abc）的桌面逆向与 AI 辅助分析工作台，其二进制发行版还加入了 Android .apk/.aab、iOS .ipa 以及独立 PE、ELF 和 Mach-O 文件的分析。README 介绍的功能包括浏览包结构、资源、签名和元数据，反汇编和反编译 ABC 字节码并查看字符串与交叉引用，Android 类 Java 反编译，原生文件的头部、导入表和安全缓解措施视图，以及通过 HDC/ADB 安装应用、读取日志和投屏的设备工作流。内置的 ReArk Agent 借助 OpenAI 兼容接口或本地 Ollama 模型回答关于当前包的问题，按需检索包内证据，主机和设备操作需经审批流程。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.1.1, published 2026-10-15, with a Windows x64 installer and macOS arm64 and x86_64 disk images; the README lists Windows 10+ and macOS 14.0+ and says Linux is coming in the next release. According to the release notes, Android support arrived in v1.0.0, and iOS, PE, ELF and Mach-O analysis with packer detection in v1.1.0.

The published source lags those releases: the v1.0.0, v1.1.0 and v1.1.1 tags point to commits with no source changes after 2026-07-10, VERSION still reads 0.2.0, and the tree holds HarmonyOS and HDC code but no Android, iOS or native-format backends. Building it needs Qt 6, CMake 3.21+ and C++20 plus the author's hyle package, which CMake requires but which is not published; the optional Wuwe agent runtime is a separate Apache-2.0 repository.

Supply the packages or binaries to analyze yourself. For device and signing workflows the repository bundles plugin/hdc/hdc.exe with libusb_shared.dll and the OpenHarmony hap-sign-tool.jar and app_packing_tool.jar. samples/ holds small HarmonyOS packages (Bridge.hap, contacts.hap, EasyHap-default-unsigned.app and fpt-default-signed.app), the shctf.app and shctf.zip CTF sample documented in docs/shctf-analysis-path.md, and 倩倩手机逆向包.rar, an archive of the fpt sample with its app-data files. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES lists only Font Awesome icons.

ReArk Agent needs a configured model provider: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, a provider named in the release notes or a local Ollama model. The README asks users not to send secrets, certificates, user data or trade secrets to remote providers, and limits use to legally authorized reverse engineering, interoperability, malware and security research. The app checks GitHub's latest-release API for updates.

The repository is Apache-2.0; the bundled OpenHarmony tools and icons keep their own licenses, and the release installers contain components absent from the published source. Decompiled output and agent answers still need analyst review.

name: Binary Refinery
description_en: Large collection of composable Python command-line units for transforming binary data: encodings, compression, encryption, archive and executable-format extraction, carving and pattern search. Each unit reads stdin and writes stdout, so units chain into shell pipelines, while framing, multibin arguments and meta variables let one pipeline process many chunks, and the binref command searches unit help. The author describes it as a command-line take on CyberChef focused on malware triage; the README also points to a separate binref/agent repository of instructions for language-model agents that use refinery.
description_zh: 由大量可组合的 Python 命令行单元组成的二进制数据转换工具集，涵盖编码、压缩、加密、归档与可执行文件格式提取、数据切割（carving）和模式搜索。各单元从标准输入读取、向标准输出写入，因此可串联成 shell 管道；分帧（framing）、multibin 参数和元变量使一条管道能处理多个数据块，binref 命令可检索各单元的帮助文本。作者称其为面向恶意软件初步分析、在命令行上实现类似 CyberChef 功能的工具；README 还指向独立的 binref/agent 仓库，其中提供供语言模型智能体使用 refinery 的说明。
requirements: Latest release at review: 0.11.2, uploaded to PyPI on 2026-07-14 and requiring Python 3.10+. The reviewed master commit of 2026-10-11 is 1,138 commits past that tag and still reports version 0.11.2, while its changelog already lists breaking 0.11.3 changes, including Python 3.11+ and renamed meta variables. The README says refinery is still in alpha and that units and parameters can be renamed or removed.

Installed with pip as binary-refinery, preferably into its own virtual environment. The default, extended and all extras add progressively more optional dependencies, and units name a missing dependency when run. Installation creates one shell command per unit, optionally with a prefix to avoid name clashes. The README rates Bash and CMD support as good, PowerShell 7.4+ as reasonable, and Zsh and Fish as having minor issues. Several decompression and cipher routines have Cython extensions next to pure-Python versions.

Inputs are the analyst's own files or data piped on stdin. CI runs pytest on Windows, macOS and Ubuntu with Python 3.11 and 3.13. Tests that need real-world inputs fetch encrypted files from the separate binref/refinery-test-data repository. Unit output depends on the parameters chosen and needs analyst validation.

LICENSE.md is the 3-Clause BSD License, which GitHub does not classify. refinery/lib/thirdparty keeps third-party modules under their own licenses, and refinery/lib/seven ports compression code from 7-Zip.

name: ARSCLib
description_en: Java library, modeled on AOSP's androidfw ResourceTypes.h and meant to replace aapt/aapt2, that reads, writes, modifies and creates Android resource tables (resources.arsc) and binary XML files such as AndroidManifest.xml. It decodes resources to readable JSON, which also handles obfuscated names, or to XML source when names are intact, and builds either form back into binary resources; APK module classes decode, merge and write whole packages. It also has an experimental DEX read/write package, and the APKEditor command-line tool is built on it.
description_zh: 参照 AOSP androidfw 中 ResourceTypes.h 的结构开发、旨在取代 aapt/aapt2 的 Java 库，可读取、写入、修改和创建 Android 资源表（resources.arsc）以及 AndroidManifest.xml 等二进制 XML 文件。它能将资源解码为可读的 JSON（也适用于名称已混淆的资源），或在名称完好时解码为 XML 源码，并把这两种形式重新构建为二进制资源；APK 模块类可解码、合并并写出整个安装包。库中另有实验性的 DEX 读写组件，命令行工具 APKEditor 即基于该库开发。
requirements: Latest release at review: V1.4.0, published 2026-07-01 with an attached ARSCLib-1.4.0.jar; the same version is on Maven Central as io.github.reandroid:ARSCLib. The reviewed main commit, from 2026-10-19, is 34 commits ahead, already sets version 1.4.1 in build.gradle and is labeled part 1 of an overhaul of the library core, so its APIs may differ from the release.

Pure Java with no runtime dependencies (JUnit 4.12 for tests); the Gradle build targets Java 8, ./gradlew jar builds the JAR, and CI runs the unit tests and JAR build on JDK 8. The README says it works on Java platforms including Android, Linux, macOS and Windows. It is used as a Maven dependency or a JAR, not as a standalone command-line tool; the README points to APKEditor for that.

Works on APKs and resource files the user supplies. The README says decoding to XML needs un-obfuscated, valid resource names, so obfuscated tables are decoded to JSON instead, and that building validates far less than aapt/aapt2, leaving the user to know which values Android accepts. The dex package's README calls it experimental and not fully implemented.

src/main/resources/frameworks bundles Android framework resource tables for API levels 23 to 37, each a small APK holding only resources.arsc and AndroidManifest.xml, used to resolve framework references; the commit adding API 37 names Google's platform-37.2-beta3 SDK package as its source. The tests include one small type_id_offset.apk fixture.
Apache-2.0.

name: Pithus (bazaar)
description_en: Self-hostable Django platform behind the Pithus Android analysis service, which its README describes as built for activists, journalists, NGOs and researchers. An uploaded APK is stored under its SHA-256 and queued for static analyses: Androguard attribute and class extraction, APKiD compiler and packer identification, ssdeep and Dexofuzzy similarity, Quark-Engine behavior rules, androcfg call graphs, Exodus tracker signatures, a MobSF static report, APK signing-block metadata and analyst-written YARA rules with retrohunts over stored samples. Results are indexed in Elasticsearch and shown as web reports and through a REST API, optionally enriched with MalwareBazaar, VirusTotal, MISP and Google Play lookups.
description_zh: Pithus Android 应用分析服务背后的可自托管 Django 平台，README 称其面向活动人士、记者、非政府组织和研究人员。上传的 APK 以 SHA-256 为名保存，并排队执行多项静态分析：用 Androguard 提取属性与类，用 APKiD 识别编译器与加壳工具，用 ssdeep 和 Dexofuzzy 计算相似度，用 Quark-Engine 规则识别行为，用 androcfg 生成调用图，匹配 Exodus 跟踪器特征，生成 MobSF 静态报告，读取 APK 签名块元数据，并运行分析者编写的 YARA 规则，还可对已存样本进行回溯检索。结果写入 Elasticsearch，以网页报告和 REST API 呈现，并可选用 MalwareBazaar、VirusTotal、MISP 和 Google Play 查询补充信息。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.0.1-beta, published 2026-10-12, a bug-fix and dependency update to v1.0.0-beta of 2026-09-21. That release upgraded the 2021 code base, rewrote the API with a separate Python client and is not compatible with earlier Pithus data; its notes say import documentation will follow. The reviewed master commit, from 2026-10-16, is 27 commits later and adds a MISP connector. A hosted beta runs at beta.pithus.org.

The README documents a Linux development stack started with docker-compose -f local.yml and served at localhost:8001, and warns that a missing-index error may appear on first load. The stack runs a Python 3.13 Django 6 app with a django-q worker, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch and Kibana 8.19 with a 2 GB Elasticsearch heap, MobSF v4.5.3, RustFS S3-compatible storage and Prometheus; separate compose files cover Apple M1, staging and production.

Input is an APK uploaded through the web interface or API, or fetched from a URL. VirusTotal and MalwareBazaar lookups send the sample's SHA-256 to those services with configured API keys, MISP matching needs a MISP URL and key, Google Play metadata is scraped by package name, tracker signatures are downloaded from Exodus Privacy at analysis time, and an upload_to_mb management command uploads stored samples to MalwareBazaar when an operator runs it.

The analysis tasks are static or lookup-based; no dynamic or sandboxed execution is part of the pipeline, and rule, similarity and reputation results are indicators. The pytest suite mocks Elasticsearch and storage and uses tests/_data/test.apk, a project-built sample app with the package com.pithus.basicapp. The CI pytest job is commented out, so CI lints, runs bandit and builds and pushes Docker images. Quark-Engine is installed from a fork, and quark-rules holds 280 rule files.
AGPL-3.0; the bundled front-end libraries and the analyzers it calls, including MobSF, keep their own licenses.

name: AngryGhidra
description_en: Ghidra extension that runs angr symbolic execution from a CodeBrowser panel. The analyst marks a destination address, an optional start address and addresses to avoid with hotkeys, and can make program arguments, memory ranges or registers symbolic, write concrete values into memory and registers, hook instructions or apply bytes patched in Ghidra to the angr project. A bundled Python script runs angr's explorer on the program's original file, the listing highlights the instructions along the path it finds, and the panel shows the argument, memory and stdin values that reach the destination.
description_zh: 在 CodeBrowser 面板中调用 angr 符号执行的 Ghidra 扩展。分析者可用快捷键标记目标地址、可选的起始地址和需要避开的地址，并可将程序参数、内存区域或寄存器设为符号值，向内存和寄存器写入具体值，钩住指定指令，或把在 Ghidra 中修补的字节应用到 angr 项目。随附的 Python 脚本对程序的原始文件运行 angr 路径探索，反汇编列表会高亮找到的路径上的指令，面板则显示能到达目标地址的参数、内存和标准输入取值。
requirements: Latest release at review: 1.1, published 2024-02-13, with prebuilt extension archives for Ghidra 11.0 and 11.0.1; the older 0.1 release carries builds for Ghidra 9.1.2 through 10.3. The reviewed master commit of 2024-07-29 is two commits later, changing the plugin type and the README. Compatibility with newer Ghidra releases is not stated.

Install angr with pip for Python 3 and put python3 on the PATH; the plugin starts the bundled angryghidra.py as an external process and passes the analyst's settings through a temporary angr_options.json file. No angr version is pinned. Building from source uses Gradle with GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR, followed by File → Install Extensions in Ghidra; if no new-plugin prompt appears, enable AngryGhidraPlugin under File → Configure → Miscellaneous.

angr loads the binary from the path Ghidra recorded at import, so the original file must still be there; raw binaries are loaded as blobs with the architecture of the Ghidra language. The analyst supplies the binary and chooses the find, avoid, hook and symbolic-input settings. Path explosion, unmodeled environment behavior and solver limits remain angr's, and a found path gives one satisfying input.
The README demonstrates it on the SecurityFest 2016 fairlight CTF challenge from angr's examples; no other results or tests are published. MIT license.

name: fpicker
description_en: Frida-based fuzzing suite for closed-source programs, listed here for its in-process instrumentation and coverage layer. A JavaScript harness injected with Frida starts Stalker at an analyst-chosen function and records the basic blocks executed in the target module on each call, feeding either AFL++'s coverage bitmap or fpicker's own standalone mode. Its passive mode works as a tracer: it attaches to a running process without sending inputs and stores each input that reaches the function together with new coverage, on the local host or on USB and network devices running frida-server.
description_zh: 基于 Frida 的闭源程序模糊测试套件，本条目收录的是其进程内插桩与覆盖率采集部分。经 Frida 注入的 JavaScript 测试框架会在分析者选定的函数处启动 Stalker，记录每次调用时目标模块中执行过的基本块，再提供给 AFL++ 的覆盖率位图或 fpicker 自己的独立模式。其被动模式相当于跟踪器：附加到正在运行的进程而不发送输入，并在出现新覆盖时保存到达该函数的输入及对应覆盖信息，可用于本机，也可用于通过 USB 或网络连接、运行 frida-server 的设备。
requirements: There are no releases or tags. The reviewed main commit, from 2025-07-24, moves the harness to the Frida 17 APIs, and the Makefile pins frida-core 17.2.14. The README points to a 2021 blog post for background and says fpicker builds on ToothPicker, developed during the author's master's thesis, and was mostly written at ERNW.

make fpicker-macos, fpicker-linux or fpicker-ios builds the C host program; the Makefile downloads the matching frida-core devkit from Frida's GitHub releases, although the README still describes placing the devkit files by hand. iOS builds use Xcode's iPhoneOS SDK on macOS, harness scripts are bundled with frida-compile, and AFL++ is needed only for AFL++ mode, built with USEMMAP on macOS and iOS.

Each target needs a hand-written harness that names the function where instrumentation starts and, for in-process input, how to call it, so that function and its arguments must first be identified in the target. The README warns that coverage becomes unreliable if the function runs more than once per iteration. Shared-memory communication is unavailable for USB-attached devices, and attach mode does not respawn a target that crashes.

Coverage covers basic blocks in the target module during the instrumented call, not a whole-program trace. The examples are small project-written C programs with seed inputs and slides from a WiSec 2021 tutorial; the repository has no automated tests or CI.
MIT; Frida and AFL++ are separate projects with their own licenses.

name: Even G2 protocol: reverse-engineering Even Realities G2 smart-glasses BLE traffic
description_en: Documents the Bluetooth Low Energy protocol between the Even app and Even Realities G2 smart glasses, worked out from captured traffic: GATT characteristic UUIDs, an 8-byte transport header with sequence, multi-packet and two-byte service-ID fields, a CRC-16/CCITT over the payload, and protobuf payloads with draft .proto definitions. A Python example built on bleak sends the seven-packet session handshake and drives the teleprompter service to show custom text. The README’s status table marks connection, handshake, teleprompter and calendar widget as working, notifications as partial, and Even AI and navigation as still under research.
description_zh: 记录 Even 应用与 Even Realities G2 智能眼镜之间的低功耗蓝牙协议，依据抓取的通信流量推断得出：包括 GATT 特征 UUID、含序号、分包和双字节服务 ID 字段的 8 字节传输头、针对载荷计算的 CRC-16/CCITT，以及 protobuf 编码的载荷和初步的 .proto 定义。基于 bleak 的 Python 示例会发送七个报文的会话握手，并调用提词器服务显示自定义文字。README 的状态表将连接、握手、提词器和日历小组件标为可用，通知标为部分可用，Even AI 和导航仍在研究中。
requirements: The reviewed main commit of 2026-01-03 is a documentation snapshot with no releases or tags. Only the teleprompter has example code, and docs/teleprompter.md is marked work in progress; the .proto header says field numbers and types are inferred from captured packets and may be incomplete or wrong, and several field meanings carry question marks. The README reports the calendar widget working but includes no calendar example or detailed format, and CONTRIBUTING.md labels Even AI “Cracked!” with its request format unclear while the README still lists it as research.

Using the example needs Even G2 glasses and a host with BLE and Python with bleak 0.21+; it scans for device names containing G2 and connects to the left arm’s device, or the right one with --right. The README says the glasses use standard BLE with no special pairing, and the example’s handshake consists of fixed capability messages and the current time, with no keys. The repository contains no Even app or glasses firmware.

CONTRIBUTING.md describes collecting Android Bluetooth HCI snoop logs while using features in the official app, and the repository commits four such raw logs from the author’s sessions; they are not limited to the glasses’ traffic. No tests or verification beyond the README’s status table are provided.

No license file is present and GitHub detects none, so the documentation and code carry no reuse grant. The README calls this an unofficial community project for educational purposes, not affiliated with Even Realities, and credits the Even Realities community with the protocol research.

name: RetroWrite
