description_zh: 面向 ESP8266/ESP8285 和 ESP32 开发板的 Arduino 库，可在 VAN（Vehicle Area Network）舒适系统总线上收发报文；PSA 在 2009 年前的部分标致和雪铁龙车型中使用这种总线。它用软件解码经 CAN 收发器或仅供接收的电阻分压电路接入 GPIO 引脚的信号，得到包含标识符、命令标志、数据和 15 位 CRC 的报文，可校验 CRC，或通过逐位翻转尝试修复，并提供队列与错误统计。示例程序可转储原始报文、发送报文，并在串口或实时网页上把舒适总线流量解析为可读字段。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.5.1, published 2026-05-29, the version library.properties and VanBusVersion.h declare; the single later master commit (2026-08-22) only adds a pin-swap note to two example sketches. The README says the library supports only the 125 kbit/s VAN rate, with other rates such as 62.5 kbit/s still to be added.

Builds in the Arduino IDE (the author uses 1.8.19) with the ESP8266 board package (tested 2.6.3–3.1.2, CPU at 160 MHz) or the ESP32 package (tested 1.0.6, 2.0.17 and 3.3.5, CPU at 240 MHz), installing the library through the Arduino Library Manager. The LiveWebPage example also needs the arduinoWebSockets library and has the browser load jQuery from Google's CDN; dumping packets into a character buffer needs PrintEx.

Live use needs a PSA vehicle with a VAN comfort bus: the README locates it on pins 2 and 3 of ISO block A at the head unit and documents wiring through an MCP2551 transceiver with a 5 V–3.3 V level converter, an SN65HVD230 transceiver, or a receive-only resistor divider that it says works well only with ESP8266 boards. It warns that the transceiver boards' CAN terminator resistors may make other equipment on the bus malfunction, and transmitting puts packets on the car's bus. The only bundled traffic is the author's serial-monitor log, examples/PacketParser/example_log.txt.

CI compiles the example sketches for an ESP8266 D1 mini and for ESP32 board packages 1.0.6, 2.0.17 and the latest, and runs Arduino Lint in strict mode; it does not exercise a bus. PacketParser calls its packet interpretation highly experimental, gathered from various sources and from experiments on the author's own 2003 Peugeot 406, and the README points to external lists of known IDEN values.
MIT.

name: Class Informer
description_en: IDA Pro plugin that scans Microsoft Visual C++ binaries for virtual function tables (vftables) through their C++ run-time type information (RTTI), names, labels and comments the vftables it finds, defines the RTTI data structures and identifies single, multiple and virtual inheritance in each class hierarchy. It also processes static initializer and terminator tables, and opens a list window of the vftables with their method counts and class hierarchies, where each line jumps to its vftable. Its author notes that IDA 9's built-in RTTI plugin now finds nearly all of this data, so the current version only sets types that IDA missed and serves mainly as a gathering and browsing view.
description_zh: 一款 IDA Pro 插件，借助 C++ 运行时类型信息（RTTI）扫描 Microsoft Visual C++ 编译的二进制中的虚函数表（vftable），为找到的虚函数表命名、添加标签和注释，定义 RTTI 数据结构，并识别各类层次结构中的单继承、多继承和虚继承。它还会处理静态初始化与终止函数表，并打开一个列表窗口，显示各虚函数表的方法数量和类层次结构，点击任一行即可跳转到对应的虚函数表。作者指出，IDA 9 内置的 RTTI 插件现已能找到几乎全部此类数据，因此当前版本只为 IDA 遗漏的结构设置类型，主要用作汇总和浏览视图。
requirements: Latest release at review: v6.0.3, published 2026-08-04, which tags the reviewed master commit and attaches a zip holding a single Windows plugin DLL; its notes describe it as a fix for IDA 9.4, and a September 2025 commit had updated the plugin for IDA 9.2 and Qt 6. The plugin loads only for x86/x64 (metapc) databases.

The README's IDA 9.4 note says the plugin flags had to change before IDA would recognize the plugin, which broke loading it through plugins.cfg, so the Alt-2 hotkey is now built in and the plugin also runs from Edit > Plugins. The installation steps still name an older Class_Informer.plw file, and the plugins.cfg arguments the README gives for turning off the demoscene-style intro and its music predate that note.

Source builds need Windows and Visual Studio 2022 (v143 toolset) with Qt 6 for MSVC 2022 x64 and the Qt Visual Studio tools, the IDA SDK inside the IDA directory, and the author's separate IDA_Support repository and libxmp, neither of which is in this repository. There is no CI and there are no tests. The analyst supplies the IDA database; the README says the plugin is tailored to MSVC-compiled binaries and results with other compilers may be unpredictable.
The README states the MIT License, but the repository has no separate license file; according to the README, the tracker module in res is used with the permission of its composer, Drax.

name: Bravo: a reverse-engineered Minecraft server
description_en: Reimplements the server side of Minecraft’s Alpha- and Beta-era multiplayer in Python on Twisted; its documentation calls it a reverse-engineered implementation written from scratch, credits network traffic dumps and says general Minecraft data went to a community wiki. The final 2.0 release speaks the 1.4.x client protocol for login, chunk transfer, entities, server-side inventories, lighting, physics and Anvil saves, while deliberately changing behaviour such as chunk loading and item stacking. A pluggable architecture adds terrain generation, seasons and commands, and small scripts inspect packets, NBT and region files.
description_zh: 以 Python 基于 Twisted 重新实现 Minecraft Alpha 与 Beta 时期多人游戏的服务端；其文档称这是从零编写的逆向实现，致谢了网络流量转储的提供者，并说明通用的 Minecraft 资料已贡献给社区 wiki。最终的 2.0 版支持 1.4.x 客户端协议，涵盖登录、区块传输、实体、服务端背包、光照、物理和 Anvil 存档，同时有意改变了区块加载和物品堆叠等行为。可插拔架构提供地形生成、季节和命令，另有几个小脚本用于查看数据包、NBT 和区域文件。
requirements: Unmaintained: the GitHub description marks the project UNMAINTAINED, and the reviewed master commit dates from 2014-09-09, 90 commits after the 2.0 tag (2013-01-10, also the latest PyPI release). The 2.0 changelog adds 1.4.x protocol support without server-side encryption, disables broken online authentication and replaces the Alpha and Beta save formats with Anvil; source pins protocol version 78. The introduction says creative games are probably safe but some Survival-Multiplayer elements are missing, and older pages such as the feature list predate these 2.0 changes.

The server needs no original game files; clients connect with the matching Minecraft client the player owns, which the FAQ says Bravo will not replace. The repository commits no game assets or Mojang code: block, item and recipe definitions are written as Python tables, and the documentation says Bravo inherits no code from other Minecraft projects.

Python 2.6 or 2.7 (CPython or PyPy); requirements.txt pins construct 2.0.6 and Pillow 2.4.0 and needs Twisted 11.0+, including Twisted Conch, with Twisted Words or Web for the IRC and web plugins. It runs as the twistd bravo plugin, configured from bravo.ini.example with a world path, creative or survival mode and the anvil serializer; the packet-parser script still imports a pre-2.0 module path.

Travis CI ran trial over the in-tree tests for protocol packets, chunks, inventories, plugins and serializers on Python 2.6, 2.7 and PyPy. MIT/X11 license, with bravo/nbt.py taken from Thomas Woolford’s MIT NBT library; Minecraft and its client keep Mojang’s rights.

name: dex-oracle
description_en: Pattern-based Dalvik deobfuscator that takes an APK, a DEX file or a Smali directory, disassembles it with baksmali and runs plugins that look for obfuscation patterns in the Smali code. To learn what a matched call returns, such as a decrypted string, it merges a small driver into the app's DEX, pushes it to a connected Android device or emulator and invokes the static method there through reflection; the result replaces the call as a constant before the APK or DEX is reassembled. Plugins cover simple string encryption, indexed string and class lookups, certain DexGuard patterns and some reflection, and the author describes it as the inspiration for Simplify.
description_zh: 基于模式匹配的 Dalvik 反混淆工具，可处理 APK、DEX 文件或 Smali 目录：先用 baksmali 反汇编，再由各插件在 Smali 代码中查找混淆模式。为得知匹配到的调用会返回什么（例如解密后的字符串），它把一个小型驱动程序合并进应用的 DEX，推送到已连接的 Android 设备或模拟器，并通过反射在设备上调用对应的静态方法；返回值以常量替换原调用，之后再重新组装 APK 或 DEX。插件涵盖简单字符串加密、按索引查找字符串和类、部分 DexGuard 模式以及部分反射调用；作者称它启发了另一个反混淆工具 Simplify。
requirements: Development is inactive: the latest RubyGems and GitHub release is 1.0.5 of 2016-07-26, while the reviewed master commit of 2018-12-13 already declares an unpublished 1.0.6. It is installed as a Ruby gem or from source with Bundler; the repository pins Ruby 2.5.3 and needs Java, adb, and smali and baksmali on the PATH, with the README's setup snippet using smali 2.2.5.

Input is the user's own APK, DEX or Smali directory, and a running emulator or attached device with Android 5.0 or later is required because matched methods really execute on it. The README prefers an emulator and warns that the executed code may be hostile; its troubleshooting section instead suggests Android 4.4.2 (API level 19, ARM) if the driver crashes. Only static methods can be executed, and plugins can be disabled when a pattern matches code that is not obfuscation.

The res directory ships the prebuilt driver.dex and a copy of the Android SDK's dx.jar, which the tool uses for DEX merging; rebuilding the driver needs Gradle and the SDK's dx tool. The README lists three plugins, while the plugins directory holds six, adding indexed string and class lookups and a bitwise string-decryption pattern.
RSpec tests with tiny hello-world APK and DEX fixtures and Smali pattern samples ran through a Travis CI configuration on Ruby 2.5.3; the repository has no GitHub Actions workflow.
MIT (LICENSE.txt and the gemspec); dx.jar and the smali tools keep their own terms.

name: Ghidra Snippets
description_en: A single-page collection of 30 commented Python examples for scripting Ghidra, grouped by task: projects, programs, functions and cross-references, basic blocks, instructions, stack variables, decompiler output, comments, P-code emulation and dumps, call graphs and program slices. It starts from the Flat Program, Flat Decompiler and Flat Debugger APIs, then shows where a task needs Ghidra's fuller API; most snippets include an example of their output.
description_zh: 单页汇集 30 个带注释的 Ghidra Python 脚本示例，按任务分组：项目、程序、函数与交叉引用、基本块、指令、栈变量、反编译输出、注释、P-code 模拟与导出、调用图和程序切片。示例从 Flat Program、Flat Decompiler 和 Flat Debugger API 入手，再说明哪些任务需要 Ghidra 更完整的 API；大多数示例附有输出样例。
requirements: Everything is in one README, with no script files or releases. The last change, on 2023-07-19, fixed a typo; the one before, on 2022-11-09, added Flat API notes for Ghidra 10.2. Version remarks range from Ghidra 9.1 and 9.2.2 to 10.2, so names and behavior in current Ghidra releases may differ; the README points to Ghidra's built-in API help and to the ghidra.re online docs, which it says may not be up to date.

The examples run in Ghidra's Python scripting environment, which the README calls the Jython console, against a program the user has loaded. Plotting a function AST also needs GraphViz's dot plus networkx and pydot importable from Jython, and the README notes that Python modules with native code do not work there. Compatibility with PyGhidra or Python 3 is not stated.
Released under CC0 1.0. The README calls the snippets a verbose mashup with more than one way to do each task and invites pull requests.

name: minusone
description_en: Airbus CERT's Rust deobfuscation engine for scripts: it parses PowerShell or JavaScript with tree-sitter, applies rules that infer the values of syntax-tree nodes and prints a simplified script. The PowerShell rules fold arithmetic, string operations, casts, -join, -replace and format operators, Base64 and UTF decoding, predictable variables and loops, and also resolve Gzip or Deflate streams and AES decryption when the data and key are in the script; the newer JavaScript rules cover literals, operators, string and array built-ins, atob and btoa, Buffer calls, predictable function calls and JSFuck constructs. The CLI can list, select or skip rules and export every rewrite step as HTML or JSON, and Python and WebAssembly bindings embed the engine, including in an online version linked from the README.
description_zh: Airbus CERT 开发的 Rust 脚本去混淆引擎：用 tree-sitter 解析 PowerShell 或 JavaScript，应用一组推断语法树节点取值的规则，再输出化简后的脚本。PowerShell 规则可折叠算术与字符串运算、类型转换、-join、-replace 和格式化运算符、Base64 与 UTF 解码、可预测的变量和循环；当数据和密钥都在脚本中时，还能还原 Gzip 或 Deflate 流以及 AES 解密。较新的 JavaScript 规则涵盖字面量、运算符、字符串与数组内置方法、atob 与 btoa、Buffer 调用、可预测的函数调用以及 JSFuck 写法。命令行工具可列出、选用或跳过规则，并把每一步改写导出为 HTML 或 JSON；Python 和 WebAssembly 绑定可嵌入该引擎，README 中链接的在线版本即基于此。
requirements: No prebuilt CLI binaries: the latest GitHub release, v0.4.2 from 2025-10-01, has no attached files, and the published packages are minusone 0.4.1 on crates.io, pyminusone 0.4.1 on PyPI with Linux x86_64 and Windows wheels, and minusonejs 0.5.0 on npm. The reviewed main commit is 538 commits past v0.4.2 and declares the core library 0.5.0 and minusone-cli 0.6.1.

Build with Cargo; the crates use Rust edition 2024, Cargo.lock is not committed, and the PowerShell grammar comes from an unpinned Git dependency on a tree-sitter-powershell fork. The CLI needs --lang powershell or --lang javascript. The project's devenv/Nix environment uses nightly Rust, the Python bindings build with maturin, and the WebAssembly module targets wasm32-wasip2 and is transpiled to JavaScript with jco.

The README still lists only PowerShell as supported, names basic JavaScript support as a roadmap item and links rule files at older src/ paths; the JavaScript backend dates from March 2026, after the crates.io and PyPI packages and the v0.4.2 release. Rules rewrite the script statically from values they can infer, and the analyst supplies the scripts; the samples folder holds only small JSFuck test files next to their plain sources.

CI runs devenv test, which runs cargo test and the Python binding test script; the core has unit tests for both languages. MIT license; Cargo metadata names Airbus CERT as author, and the LICENSE copyright line names Sylvain Peyrefitte.

name: Kam1n0
description_en: Server platform from McGill University's Data Mining and Security Lab that indexes collections of disassembled binaries into shared repositories and searches them for cloned assembly functions. Its applications cover subgraph clone search within one instruction-set family (Asm-Clone), cross-architecture semantic search over VEX IR using symbolic and concrete execution (Sym1n0), Asm2Vec representation learning aimed at compiler optimization and obfuscation, and executable classification built on Asm2Vec. An IDA Pro plug-in sends functions to the server and shows flow-graph, text-diff and clone-group views; the README's accuracy and query-time figures come from the authors' own papers.
description_zh: McGill 大学数据挖掘与安全实验室开发的服务端平台，可把大量已反汇编的二进制建立索引、存入可共享的仓库，并在其中搜索克隆的汇编函数。平台提供多种应用：在同一指令集家族内进行子图克隆搜索（Asm-Clone），借助符号执行与具体执行在 VEX IR 上进行跨架构语义搜索（Sym1n0），面向编译优化与混淆的 Asm2Vec 表示学习，以及基于 Asm2Vec 的可执行文件分类。IDA Pro 插件把函数发送到服务端，并以控制流图、文本差异和克隆分组视图展示结果；README 中的准确率与查询耗时数据出自作者自己的论文。
requirements: Latest stable release at review: 2.2.0, published 2020-11-15, with Windows installers and Linux tarballs for the server and the IDA Pro plug-in; a nightly-action pre-release from 2023-02-27 attaches Windows builds only. The reviewed master2.x commit of the same date is the default branch's latest, and README says repositories and configuration files from versions before 2.0.0 are no longer supported.

The server needs a 64-bit Java 11 runtime (README asks for Oracle's) and, to disassemble uploaded binaries, an IDA Pro installation with IDAPython set in kam1n0.properties; the shipped configuration requests a 12 GB maximum JVM heap and serves the web interface on port 8571. The plug-in needs IDA Pro newer than 6.7 with IDAPython and the CEF Python wheels its installer bundles. Source also contains an undocumented Ghidra disassembly backend.

Users supply the binaries to index and query. The repository commits test and example binaries built from open-source code: zlib and libpng builds for several architectures and optimization levels, a Chromium DLL, and IDA databases for PuTTY and zlib. Windows installer sources commit the Microsoft .NET Framework 4.0 and Visual C++ x64 redistributable installers and CEF Python wheels, and the server resources commit JavaFX SDK 11.0.2 DLLs, a prebuilt LibVEX library (VEXIRBB.dll) and a local Maven repository holding a z3 jar.

Maven builds the Java 11 modules against those pre-compiled LibVEX and z3 binaries; README says LibVEX comes from angr's fork, and z3 is a submodule. The Maven tests drive Chrome through chromedriver and, per the README, take about three hours; CI only builds the Windows distribution and WiX installers. Accuracy and timing figures are taken from the README and the authors' KDD 2016 and IEEE S&P 2019 papers.

Apache-2.0 (LICENSE.txt), copyright McGill University and the researchers. Bundled runtimes, redistributable installers, wheels and test binaries keep their own licenses, and IDA Pro is separately licensed commercial software.

name: bn
description_en: Agent-oriented command-line interface for the Binary Ninja database already open in the GUI, reached through a companion plugin that listens on a local Unix-domain socket. Agents read decompilation, IL, disassembly, cross-references, callsites, types and data, export multi-function bundles and run unrestricted Python inside Binary Ninja; renames and prototype, structure and type edits can be previewed, are verified after they apply and roll back on failure. Large text output spills to hashed artifact files, and a packaged Codex skill describes the workflow.
description_zh: 面向智能体的命令行工具，用于操作已在 Binary Ninja 图形界面中打开的数据库，通过监听本地 Unix 域套接字的配套插件连接。智能体可读取反编译结果、中间语言、反汇编、交叉引用、调用点、类型和数据，导出多函数打包结果，并在 Binary Ninja 内运行不受限制的 Python；重命名以及函数原型、结构体和类型修改可先预览，应用后会校验结果，失败时回滚。较大的文本输出会转存为附带哈希的产物文件，随包提供的 Codex 技能说明了使用流程。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.15.0, published on GitHub and PyPI as bn-cli on 2026-09-04; the reviewed master commit is that tag and the repository's last push. It needs Python 3.12+ and installs as a uv tool; bn plugin install links the BN Agent Bridge plugin into Binary Ninja, and bn skill install links the skill into the skills folder of the Codex home directory. The CLI and the loaded plugin must share bridge protocol 2, so Binary Ninja is restarted or its plugins reloaded after upgrades.

Work happens against a database open in the Binary Ninja GUI; the README says the companion works with a personal license and needs no headless license. The bridge socket lives in the user's cache directory, and the README names no supported operating systems or Binary Ninja versions. With several views open, commands need an explicit --target selector instead of silently using the active tab.

The analyst supplies the binary and database; the repository holds no target binaries. bn py runs unrestricted Python with the user's privileges inside Binary Ninja, and its writes bypass the preview, verification and rollback of built-in mutations; the reviewed bridge code adds no authentication beyond access to the socket path. Whole-database text and constant searches stop after a default five-second analysis budget and report incomplete results.

CI runs pytest on Python 3.12 and 3.14 against a stub binaryninja module, checks release metadata and smoke-tests plugin and skill installation from the built wheel, so no real Binary Ninja instance is exercised. Mutations report verified, noop, unsupported or verification_failed, and the README notes that decompiled output can stay stale after type changes until types are read back or analysis is refreshed.
MIT, added to the repository in v0.14.1; Binary Ninja keeps its own license terms.

name: Titan M tools (Quarkslab)
description_en: Tools Quarkslab published from its research on Google's Titan M security chip in Pixel phones: a Ghidra loader for Titan M (Citadel) firmware files, nosclient for tracing and sending the chip's protobuf-based commands from Android with a black-box fuzzer built on libprotobuf-mutator, a parser for sigrok SPI captures, and scripts that convert firmware images to the rec files of the chip's SPI rescue feature. The repository also holds the Black Hat Europe 2021 white paper and slides, the ROOTS'21 paper and the Black Hat USA 2022 slides, which describe reverse engineering the firmware, sniffing its SPI communication with the application processor, and black-box and emulation-based fuzzing; the authors say the vulnerabilities they found were disclosed to Google.
description_zh: Quarkslab 发布的 Google Pixel 手机 Titan M 安全芯片研究工具：包括用于 Titan M（Citadel）固件文件的 Ghidra 加载器；可在 Android 上跟踪并发送芯片基于 protobuf 的命令的 nosclient，内含基于 libprotobuf-mutator 的黑盒模糊测试器；sigrok SPI 抓包解析器；以及把固件镜像转换为芯片 SPI rescue 功能所用 rec 文件的脚本。仓库还收录 Black Hat Europe 2021 白皮书与幻灯片、ROOTS'21 论文和 Black Hat USA 2022 幻灯片，介绍固件逆向、嗅探芯片与应用处理器之间的 SPI 通信，以及黑盒与基于仿真的模糊测试；作者称所发现的漏洞均已向 Google 披露。
requirements: A research release with no tags or packages: the last commit, on 2022-08-22, added the Black Hat USA 2022 slides two days after nosclient was updated for that talk. The emulation-based fuzzer those slides describe is not in the repository, and no Titan M firmware images, Boot ROM dumps or keys are committed.

Firmware files must come from the analyst's own Pixel device; the white paper notes that Titan M first shipped with the Pixel 3. Sending commands with nosclient needs root access on the device, as the white paper explains, and the SPI parser expects a sigrok CSV export of the analyst's own capture.

citadelimgloader builds with Gradle against a local Ghidra installation named by GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR; no supported Ghidra version is stated. nosclient builds with CMake for Linux, for Android arm64 with the NDK, or in the provided Debian 10 Docker image with NDK r21e, after the libnos (AOSP), protobuf, libprotobuf-mutator and sqlite submodules are initialized.

The ROOTS'21 paper reports that the black-box fuzzer rediscovered several known vulnerabilities within seconds and found a new one in the then-latest firmware; these are the authors' results on their own devices. The README says the toolkit also contains an exploit for a known vulnerability.

LICENSE is Apache-2.0. The fuzzer bundles a generated libradamsa.c without its own license notice, the client includes protobuf sources generated from the nugget/app message definitions and small KeyMint enum headers, and the presentation PDFs state no license.

name: iblessing
description_en: Toolkit for analyzing iOS apps and arm64 Mach-O binaries, built on Capstone, Unicorn and Keystone. Its scanners extract app-bundle metadata such as URL schemes and transport-security settings, locate Objective-C class references and NSPredicate uses, detect symbol wrappers, and partially emulate arm64 code with Unicorn to recover objc_msgSend cross-references, including those passed through blocks. Generators turn the reports into IDA Pro scripts that add cross-references and rename wrappers, or into a local query server, and a shared core library with a plug-in interface supports custom tools.
description_zh: 用于分析 iOS 应用和 arm64 Mach-O 二进制的工具集，基于 Capstone、Unicorn 与 Keystone 构建。其扫描器可提取应用包元数据（如 URL Scheme 和传输安全设置），定位 Objective-C 类引用和 NSPredicate 用法，识别符号包装函数，并借助 Unicorn 部分模拟 arm64 代码以恢复 objc_msgSend 交叉引用，包括经由 block 传递的调用。生成器可把扫描报告转成 IDA Pro 脚本，用于添加交叉引用和重命名包装函数，也可启动本地查询服务；共享核心库及插件接口可用于开发自定义工具。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.0.4-beta, published 2021-11-26 and tagged at the reviewed master commit; every release is marked as a pre-release. Each recent release attaches macOS and Linux command-line and all-in-one binaries, framework archives with the shared core library and headers, and a JSON table of Foundation and UIKit method signatures. The README's feature list leaves Swift class parsing, following branches and calls, and Android scanners unfinished.

Users supply an iOS .app bundle for app-info or an arm64 Mach-O binary for the other scanners; README examples analyze commercial third-party apps after restoring symbols with a separate tool, but no app binaries are committed. The class and objc_msgSend cross-reference scanners accept arm64 binaries only, and app-info is unavailable on Linux because it still depends on Cocoa. The README warns that binary scanners reserve 12 GB of virtual memory per Mach-O file, so physical memory or swap must cover that.

Builds on macOS or Linux with CMake 3.5+ and a C++17 compiler after a recursive clone; compile-cmake.sh first builds the pinned Capstone, Unicorn (arm, aarch64 and x86) and Keystone submodules as static libraries. An Xcode project is also included. IDA Pro is needed only to apply the generated scripts.

GitHub Actions builds on Ubuntu and macOS and, on macOS only, scans the bundled sample-app benchmark and runs the built-in objc_msgSend cross-reference test; Travis CI builds and publishes tagged releases. The README notes that objc-msg-xref follows no calls to save time, so its results are partly missing.

GPL-3.0 (LICENSE). The project calls itself an iOS security exploiting toolkit. Analyzed apps and Apple frameworks keep their own terms, and the Capstone, Unicorn and Keystone submodules carry their own licenses.

name: NTRGhidra
description_en: Ghidra loader and plugin for Nintendo DS programs. It checks the .nds header, maps either the ARM9 or the ARM7 binary at its RAM address together with the console's memory regions and I/O register labels, decompresses SDK-compressed ARM9 code and overlays, and fills the overlays the user selects at import, while an optional overlay-manager plugin swaps overlays in and out afterwards. The repository also keeps a small Ghidra Function ID database of NitroSDK 3.0 routines for function identification.
description_zh: 面向 Nintendo DS 程序的 Ghidra 加载器与插件。它校验 .nds 文件头，把 ARM9 或 ARM7 二进制映射到其内存地址，并建立主机的内存区域和 I/O 寄存器标签；经 SDK 压缩的 ARM9 代码和覆盖模块（overlay）会被解压，导入时用户选中的覆盖模块会载入内容，可选的覆盖模块管理插件还能在导入后切换各覆盖模块。仓库另附一个小型 Ghidra Function ID 数据库，收录 NitroSDK 3.0 例程，用于识别函数。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.5.1, published 2026-03-24 as NTRGhidra-build.zip for Ghidra 12.0.4, and its tag is the reviewed master commit; earlier releases were built for individual Ghidra 10.x and 11.x versions, and the README names 12.0.4 as the latest supported Ghidra version. The zip installs from the Ghidra project window's File → Install Extensions, and the overlay manager is enabled separately under CodeBrowser's File → Configure → Miscellaneous. The README says the project is looking for maintainers and contributors.

Source builds need a Ghidra installation: build.gradle applies Ghidra's buildExtension.gradle from GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR, the README describes an Eclipse build with the GhidraDev extension, and a GitHub Actions workflow builds the zip with Gradle on every push and attaches it to new releases. The repository has no tests; src/test holds only a placeholder README.

Input is a .nds file the user supplies; the repository contains no ROMs or BIOS files. On import the loader rejects files whose header CRC does not match, asks whether the file is a commercial Nintendo SDK title or homebrew, and asks whether to load the ARM9 or the ARM7 code; commercial titles must carry the expected Nintendo logo CRC and have their ARM9 binary decompressed. The overlay manager re-reads overlays only from the original file at its import path, or from a substitute whose MD5 and SHA-256 match it.

The fidb folder holds nitrosdk3.0.fidb, a 2 KB Function ID database that its README describes as hashes of NitroSDK 3.0.0 functions from commercial games, covering crt0 and file-system routines in ARM code but not Thumb; the loader does not apply it automatically. The loader names its format Nintendo DS (NTR) and DSi (TWL), and the source carries DSi register and memory-region lists, but import maps only the DS ARM9 and ARM7 lists, and CRT0 autoload handling is marked as a TODO.
Apache-2.0. The README credits GBATEK for DS technical information and Gericom's Every File Explorer for the original header and ARM9 decompression code.

name: bosectl: reconstructing Bose’s BMAP headphone protocol
description_en: Controls Bose headphones from Linux and macOS without the Bose app, account or cloud, through Python, Rust and C++ libraries and command-line tools that implement Bose’s BMAP protocol over Bluetooth RFCOMM. The author documents BMAP’s function blocks, operators, payload layouts and error codes in NOTES.md, reportedly worked out by probing RFCOMM channels, capturing Bluetooth traffic while changing settings in the Bose app and testing each operator, and the libraries cover noise cancellation, EQ, spatial audio, button remapping, profiles and device settings. Support is reported per model by the author and contributors.
description_zh: 无需 Bose 应用、账号或云服务，即可在 Linux 和 macOS 上控制 Bose 耳机：项目提供 Python、Rust 和 C++ 库及命令行工具，在蓝牙 RFCOMM 上实现 Bose 的 BMAP 协议。作者在 NOTES.md 中记录了 BMAP 的功能块、操作符、载荷布局和错误码，据称是通过探测 RFCOMM 通道、在 Bose 应用中更改设置时抓取蓝牙通信并逐一测试各操作符得出的；这些库涵盖降噪、均衡器、空间音频、按键重映射、配置档和设备设置。各型号的支持情况由作者和贡献者报告。
requirements: The reviewed commit is the v0.5.0 release of 2026-09-28, which ships Linux x86_64 bmapctl binaries built from the Rust and C++ code with SHA256SUMS; the Rust crate is also on crates.io as bose-bmap 0.5.0, while the Python package installs from the repository through its install scripts or pipx. The README’s device table marks six models, led by the QC Ultra Headphones 2, as verified to differing extents and the Ultra Open Earbuds as partial from a device report; other cataloged BMAP products are recognized by product ID but have no tested configuration.

Needs the user’s own paired Bose headphones and a Bluetooth adapter: BlueZ on Linux, or macOS 10.15+, where the Python library uses PyObjC’s IOBluetooth bindings. The Rust crate is Linux-only, and C++ builds on Linux need CMake, a C++17 compiler and the BlueZ development headers. No Bose software or files are needed at runtime.

README reports probing RFCOMM channels, capturing Bluetooth HCI traffic while toggling settings in the Bose app and testing operators on each function block, and NOTES.md cites class names from the Bose Android app. The app, decompiled code and raw HCI or network captures are not in the repository: captures/ holds eight before-and-after setting snapshots from bmap-capture.py with the MAC address, serial number and other identifiers partly masked, and fixtures/ holds a packet used by the tests.

README says the project uses only BMAP operations the headphones accept without authentication, and that no keys are extracted, no encryption is broken and no traffic is replayed; writes that the app performs after cloud-mediated authentication stay out of reach. USB control is not implemented, and NOTES.md treats the USB interface as being for firmware updates.
CI runs the Python, Rust and C++ test targets on Ubuntu and macOS without headphones; integration tests that need a paired device run only when enabled. MIT license.

name: mgbdis
description_en: Python disassembler that turns a Game Boy or Game Boy Color ROM, including multi-bank ROMs, into RGBDS-compatible assembly plus a Makefile that reassembles it, so the rebuilt ROM can be compared with the input. An optional .sym file beside the ROM supplies labels and marks code, data, text, padding and 1bpp/2bpp tile-image blocks; images are written as PNG files that rgbgfx converts back, text can use custom character maps, and hardware registers get hardware.inc names. The README explains that SM83 instructions vary in length and data is interleaved with code, so marked code blocks keep it from disassembling mid-instruction.
description_zh: 用 Python 编写的反汇编器，可把 Game Boy 或 Game Boy Color ROM（包括多存储体 ROM）转换为与 RGBDS 兼容的汇编代码，并生成用于重新汇编的 Makefile，以便将重建出的 ROM 与输入文件比对。ROM 旁可放置同名 .sym 文件，用来提供标签，并标出代码、数据、文本、填充以及 1bpp/2bpp 图块图像区段；图像会输出为 PNG，再由 rgbgfx 转换回去，文本可使用自定义字符映射，硬件寄存器则采用 hardware.inc 中的名称。README 解释说，SM83 指令长度不一，且数据与代码交错存放，因此需要标出代码区段，避免从指令中间开始反汇编。
requirements: Latest release at review: v3.0, published 2025-04-22; the reviewed master commit of 2026-07-31 is 15 commits ahead of that tag and still reports version 3.0. It is a single Python script that needs Python 3.6+, and the generated assembly targets RGBDS v0.8.0 or later, whose rgbasm, rgblink, rgbfix and rgbgfx the generated Makefile calls. Options control hexadecimal case, indentation, operand alignment and mnemonic variants, and a --tiny mode handles unbanked 32 KiB ROMs.

The input is a ROM file the user supplies, optionally with a same-named .sym file; the repository ships no game ROMs. It bundles PyPNG's png.py and a copy of gbdev's hardware.inc, and its only test ROM is assembled during testing from the project's own assembly sources. The README suggests generating code-block symbol files with the author's separate Beaten Dying Moon emulator, which records the instructions actually executed.

GitHub Actions installs the latest RGBDS release, builds the test ROM, disassembles it, diffs the output against committed expected files, then reassembles the disassembly and compares it byte for byte with the test ROM. This checks the tool on its own fixture, not on commercial games. The README notes that RGBDS inserts a NOP after STOP, so a STOP not followed by NOP is emitted as a data byte, and calls the tool slow on large ROMs.
MIT license; png.py carries its own MIT notice. mgbdis produces assembly rather than C, and labels and block boundaries come from the analyst's symbol file.

name: SiMBA
description_en: Research tool from Denuvo that simplifies linear mixed Boolean-arithmetic (MBA) expressions, which combine bitwise and integer operations and are used in code obfuscation. Like MBA-Blast and MBA-Solver it works algebraically, using the fact that a linear MBA is fully determined by its values on inputs of zeros and ones: it evaluates the expression on every such combination and rewrites it as a linear combination of basic bitwise expressions, without first translating it to 1-bit space. Python scripts simplify single expressions or whole datasets, can check that an input is linear and can prove the result equivalent with Z3.
description_zh: Denuvo 发布的研究工具，用于化简线性混合布尔-算术（MBA）表达式；这类表达式混合使用位运算和整数运算，常见于代码混淆。它与 MBA-Blast、MBA-Solver 一样采用纯代数方法，依据线性 MBA 完全由其在 0/1 输入上的取值决定这一性质：对所有 0/1 输入组合求值，再把表达式改写为基本位运算表达式的线性组合，而无需先转换到 1 位空间。所附 Python 脚本可化简单个表达式或整个数据集，可检查输入是否为线性 MBA，并可用 Z3 证明结果与原式等价。
requirements: Accompanies Benjamin Reichenwallner and Peter Meerwald-Stadler's paper at the CheckMATE 2022 workshop, co-located with ACM CCS 2022 (DOI 10.1145/3560831.3564256, arXiv 2209.06335); the repository also holds the paper PDF, slides and a talk video. The reviewed main commit dates from 2022-12-12, and there are no releases or packages: the scripts run directly from src/.

Needs Python 3; Z3's Python bindings are required by simplify_dataset.py and by the -z verification option of simplify.py. Input is expression text, or a file with one complex expression and its simpler equivalent per line, built from variables, constants and the operators ~, unary minus, *, +, -, &, ^ and |; the tool has no disassembler or decompiler integration. Output constants depend on the bit width, 64 by default and set with -b.

Only linear MBAs are handled: the optional -l check rejects nonlinear input such as products of variables, and the README warns that operator precedence follows Python, so parentheses are needed. Result refinement through lookup tables of bitwise expressions covers up to three variables; expressions with more variables keep the generic linear-combination form.

For reproducing part of the paper's experiments, data/ holds generated sets of 1,000 equivalent linear MBAs per target function with 2 to 4 variables, plus 5- and 6-variable sets for x+y; the README also mentions 7 variables, which are not in the tree. The datasets assume 64 bits, and simplify_dataset.py reports how many results Z3 verified or matched exactly and the average runtime. There is no test suite or CI.
GPL-3.0, copyright 2022 Denuvo GmbH.

name: ghidra-allegrex
description_en: Ghidra processor module for the Allegrex CPU of the PlayStation Portable, derived from Ghidra's MIPS module. It adds Allegrex-specific instructions, VFPU disassembly and basic decompilation, the PSP calling convention, and an ELF loader that detects PSP executables and applies the PSP-specific type A and B relocation sections, with rebasing after import. Bundled scripts import and export PPSSPP .sym function-label files, and an exporter writes kernel modules as relocatable object files for linking.
description_zh: 面向 PlayStation Portable 所用 Allegrex CPU 的 Ghidra 处理器模块，由 Ghidra 的 MIPS 模块衍生而来。它补充了 Allegrex 特有指令、VFPU 指令的反汇编与基础反编译、PSP 调用约定，以及可识别 PSP 可执行文件的 ELF 加载器；加载器会处理 PSP 特有的 A 类和 B 类重定位节，并支持导入后重新设定基址。附带的脚本可导入和导出 PPSSPP 的 .sym 函数标签文件，另有导出器可把内核模块写成可供链接的可重定位目标文件。
requirements: Latest release at review: v21.5, published 2026-10-25, built for Ghidra 12.2 and requiring JVM 25; the reviewed master commit is that tag. Each release zip targets one Ghidra version, so v21.4 of 2026-08-25 remains the build for Ghidra 12.1.3 and 12.1.4. Extension v19 and later install through Ghidra's File > Install Extensions; v18 and earlier are unpacked into Ghidra's Processors directory.

Source builds set GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR and run the Gradle wrapper's buildExtension task, compiling Kotlin and Java against the local Ghidra installation with a JVM 25 toolchain. CI builds the extension against Ghidra 12.2 on Ubuntu and uploads the zip; the repository has no automated tests. The two PPSSPP scripts are written in Ghidra's Python 2 (Jython) dialect, and the .sym file comes from the user's own PPSSPP debugging session.

Inputs are PSP executables in ELF/PRX form, kernel modules or raw binaries that the user supplies; the README notes that game executables must already be decrypted, and the repository contains no PSP software or firmware. Raw binaries need the processor and image base set by hand, and some kernel modules need the reboot.bin type B relocation option at import.

The README lists limits: almost every VFPU operation decompiles to a function call such as vadd_q(...), the vpfxs, vpfxt and vpfxd prefix semantics are not modeled, vfim.s shows its half-float operand as an integer, object files cannot be rebased after import, and functions with 64-bit arguments need custom storage because of a Ghidra issue.

Apache-2.0; the README says it is derived from Ghidra's Apache-2.0 MIPS module and that type B relocation parsing is based on prxtool under AFL v2.0. Separately, REA's PSP static ELF guide uses it as a caller-installed extension and pairs v21.4 with Ghidra 12.1.3.

name: Frida Boot: a beginner binary instrumentation workshop
description_en: A beginner workshop by leonjza on binary instrumentation with Frida, served as offline pages from a Docker container that has gdb with GEF and frida-tools preinstalled. Three chapters move from a small Linux C program, LD_PRELOAD hooks and how library calls resolve through the PLT and GOT, to Frida’s Interceptor for reading arguments and changing return values, NativeFunction for calling a program’s own functions, Python injector tools, RPC exports, TypeScript agents, frida-server and frida-gadget. It deliberately leaves out Frida’s mobile-app uses, and every exercise targets sample programs shipped with the workshop.
description_zh: leonjza 编写的 Frida 二进制插桩入门工作坊，课程页面由一个 Docker 容器离线提供，容器内已预装带 GEF 的 gdb 和 frida-tools。三个章节从一个小型 Linux C 程序、LD_PRELOAD 钩子以及库函数调用如何经由 PLT 和 GOT 解析讲起，再到用 Frida 的 Interceptor 读取参数和修改返回值、用 NativeFunction 调用程序自身的函数、编写 Python 注入工具、RPC 导出、TypeScript 代理，以及 frida-server 和 frida-gadget。课程有意不涉及 Frida 在移动应用上的用法，所有练习都针对工作坊自带的示例程序。
requirements: The reviewed master commit dates from 2021-04-28, with no releases or tags; the prebuilt leonjza/frida-boot image on Docker Hub (tag latest, amd64 only) was last updated the same day. The README links a YouTube recording of the workshop and keeps a PDF of the slides in slides/.

Needs a host with Docker. docker.sh pulls or builds the image and starts it with the SYS_PTRACE capability, serving the course at localhost:9999 and mounting a local code folder into the container. The Dockerfile builds on Debian bullseye-slim and downloads frida-server and frida-gadget 12.9.4 for linux-x86_64, but installs frida-tools, GEF and the frida-agent-example project unpinned, so a fresh build will not reproduce the 2021 tool versions.

Exercises compile and instrument the workshop’s own C samples in software/: a random sleep loop, a fake_sleep LD_PRELOAD library and a PIN-check program whose test_pin function the lessons call directly from Frida, with numbered JavaScript, TypeScript and Python snippets for each step. No third-party target binaries are included or needed; the material covers x86_64 Linux user-space processes.
The repository has no license file and GitHub detects none; the bundled docsify scripts and themes keep their own licenses, and Frida, GEF and the base image are fetched under theirs.

name: IDA Pro MCP Server (fdrechsler)
description_en: An IDA Pro plugin and a TypeScript MCP server by Florian Drechsler: the plugin starts an HTTP server inside IDA on 127.0.0.1:9045, and the stdio MCP server forwards agent requests to it. Its twelve tools run IDAPython scripts passed inline or by file path, list functions, exports and strings, search names, immediate values and byte sequences, return cross-references to and from an address, and disassemble address ranges. It is a separate codebase from the mrexodia and Hex-Rays IDA MCP servers listed here.
description_zh: 由 Florian Drechsler 编写，包含一个 IDA Pro 插件和一个 TypeScript MCP 服务器：插件在 IDA 内的 127.0.0.1:9045 启动 HTTP 服务，stdio 方式运行的 MCP 服务器把智能体请求转发给它。其 12 个工具可执行以内联代码或文件路径传入的 IDAPython 脚本，列出函数、导出项和字符串，搜索名称、立即数和字节序列，返回某地址的入向与出向交叉引用，并反汇编指定地址范围。它与本合集已收录的 mrexodia 版和 Hex-Rays 官方 IDA MCP 服务器是不同的代码库。
requirements: Dormant: its six commits date from 2025-03-24 to 2025-03-26, with no tags, releases or npm package. The README asks for IDA Pro 8.3 or later, Node.js 18+ and TypeScript; the MCP server is built from a clone with npm install and npm run build, and ida_remote_server.py is copied into IDA's plugins directory, where it starts its server when IDA loads. MCP clients launch the built dist/index.js over stdio.

IDA Pro is commercial software installed separately, and the tools act on whatever database the analyst has open; the repository holds only source files and a screenshot. The README documents eight of the twelve tools and an npm test command, but package.json defines no test script and the project has no tests. At the pinned commit index.ts imports llamaindex, which package.json does not declare, and the search_text tool queries a MongoDB strings collection at localhost:27017 instead of IDA, with its IDA call commented out.

Script tools run arbitrary IDAPython inside IDA, and while a script runs the plugin overrides IDA's prompt functions so that dialogs are auto-confirmed or suppressed. The HTTP server has no authentication: the README's security note relies on the localhost-only default bind and warns about the implications of changing DEFAULT_HOST.
The LICENSE file and README state MIT, while package.json declares ISC. IDA Pro, MCP clients and analysed binaries keep their own terms.

name: Ghidra Headless MCP
description_en: Headless-only MCP server that drives Ghidra through PyGhidra and is meant to share a container with the agent rather than attach to a Ghidra GUI. Its 212 tools in 34 groups cover program and project lifecycle, disassembly, decompilation and P-code, patching and memory edits, symbols, references, types and structure layouts, search and graph extraction, with raw Python, Java-API and script access for anything else. Programs open read-only by default, edits run in transactions with undo and redo, a fake backend lets development and CI run without Ghidra, and a ghidra_cli client exposes the same tools to shells and agents without MCP.
description_zh: 仅以无界面方式运行的 MCP 服务器，通过 PyGhidra 驱动 Ghidra，设计为与智能体运行在同一容器中，而不是连接 Ghidra 图形界面。其 34 组共 212 个工具涵盖程序与项目生命周期、反汇编、反编译与 P-code、补丁与内存修改、符号、引用、类型与结构布局、搜索和图提取，其他需求可通过直接执行 Python、调用 Java API 或运行脚本完成。程序默认以只读方式打开，修改在支持撤销与重做的事务中进行；伪后端让开发和 CI 无需安装 Ghidra 即可运行，ghidra_cli 客户端则把同一套工具提供给不使用 MCP 的命令行和智能体。
requirements: The reviewed main commit (2026-09-16) reports version 0.1.0, with no tags or releases; the changelog keeps all changes under Unreleased, and RELEASING.md says source releases go to GitHub only, not PyPI, and that no public release tag should be created until a license is chosen. Install from a checkout with pip. The README says the code, tests and documentation are entirely vibe coded.

Python 3.11+ with pyghidra 3.0.2+ and a local Ghidra installation given through GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR or --ghidra-install-dir; the README names no minimum Ghidra release. MCP runs over stdio or TCP, with setup examples for Claude Code, Codex and generic MCP hosts and a sample Kali-based Dockerfile that installs Ghidra beside the agent. Debugger, Version Tracking, FID, BSim and emulator workflows are listed as not exposed.

ghidra.eval, ghidra.call and ghidra.script run arbitrary Python, Java and scripts inside the Ghidra runtime, and both transports are unauthenticated; the TCP server binds 127.0.0.1, and the README limits use to trusted, containerized environments. Read-only sessions protect program state but do not sandbox filesystem or process access.

The repository bundles a stripped AArch64 GNU coreutils ls executable in samples/ as the feature fuzzer’s default target, and a small compiled hello test fixture with its C source. The README says CI also runs live Ghidra tests and a wheel check, but the reviewed workflow runs only Ruff and the non-live pytest suite on the fake backend.
GitHub detects GPL-2.0 from the LICENSE file added in the initial commit, while the README and RELEASING.md still treat the license as unchosen and pyproject.toml declares none.

name: Binary Ninja Headless MCP
description_en: A third-party, headless-only MCP server by Ruben Marks (mrphrazer) that gives agents a large Binary Ninja tool surface the project counts as 181 tools across 36 feature groups, including disassembly, intermediate languages, cross-references, types, search, patching with undo/redo transactions, and arbitrary scripting through binja.eval and binja.call. It speaks MCP over stdio or TCP, ships a schema-derived command-line client (binja_cli), and is meant to run in the same container as the agent runtime. A fake-backend mode runs the CLI, tests and a feature fuzzer without a Binary Ninja license, while real analysis needs a headless-capable license.
description_zh: Ruben Marks（mrphrazer）开发的第三方、仅无界面运行的 MCP 服务器，向智能体提供庞大的 Binary Ninja 工具集，项目称共 181 个工具、分 36 个功能组，涵盖反汇编、中间语言、交叉引用、类型、搜索、带撤销/重做事务的打补丁，以及通过 binja.eval 和 binja.call 执行任意脚本。它通过 stdio 或 TCP 使用 MCP 协议，附带一个由模式生成参数的命令行客户端 binja_cli，设计上与智能体运行时位于同一容器内。假后端模式可在没有 Binary Ninja 许可证的情况下运行 CLI、测试和功能模糊器，实际分析则需要支持无界面模式的许可证。
requirements: Reviewed at main 7fafd75 (2026-09-19); the pyproject declares package version 0.2.0 and there are no tagged releases. The README positions it against GUI-bound or limited Binary Ninja MCP servers as a headless-only, agent-driven alternative with mutation workflows and scripting, and states the whole project, including its code, tests and documentation, is vibe coded.

Needs Python 3.11+. Real analysis requires a Binary Ninja installation with a headless-capable license and the binaryninja Python module importable; the README notes enterprise and debugger APIs are not covered. A fake-backend mode (BINARY_NINJA_HEADLESS_MCP_FAKE_BACKEND=1) runs the CLI, the pytest suite and the feature fuzzer without a license, which is what CI exercises on Python 3.11 with ruff and pytest.

Install with pip from a clone or straight from the repository. Register it with an MCP host such as Claude Code or Codex over stdio (default) or TCP; the recommended deployment runs the agent and this server in one container. The repository bundles a sample binary, samples/ls (a stripped aarch64 GNU coreutils ls), as the fuzzer and verification target, plus small C fixtures.

The README's security model states that stdio and TCP transports are unauthenticated by default and that binja.eval and binja.call expose arbitrary scripting and broad API access, intended only for trusted containerized environments and not to be exposed to untrusted users or networks. Read-only mode is the session default, memory.read is capped at 65536 bytes, and mutations use undo/redo transactions.

The bundled CLI_VERIFICATION.md reports native coverage of all 181 tools on Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 Ultimate (AArch64 Linux host) across both architectures, transports and argument styles, but its evidence links point to files in the authors' analysis environment rather than the shipped package. GPL-2.0. Use it on binaries the operator is authorized to examine.

name: GM8Decompiler
description_en: Command-line tool that turns games built with GameMaker 8.0 or 8.1 back into editable .gmk or .gm81 project files. It reads the gamedata section that a built executable carries next to the runner and writes its settings, sprites, sounds, backgrounds, paths, scripts, fonts, timelines, objects, rooms, extensions, included files and GML code in the project format matching the game's version. A Rust rewrite on the OpenGMK project's gm8exe library that replaced the team's fork of WastedMeerkat's gm81decompiler, it is now developed in the OpenGMK repository alongside the GM8Emulator runner reimplementation.
description_zh: 命令行工具，可把用 GameMaker 8.0 或 8.1 构建的游戏还原为可编辑的 .gmk 或 .gm81 项目文件。它读取已构建可执行文件中与运行器（runner）并存的 gamedata 部分，按游戏版本对应的项目格式写出其中的设置、精灵、声音、背景、路径、脚本、字体、时间线、对象、房间、扩展、附带文件以及 GML 代码。该工具基于 OpenGMK 项目的 gm8exe 库用 Rust 重写，取代了团队此前对 WastedMeerkat 的 gm81decompiler 的分支，现与重新实现 GameMaker 运行器的 GM8Emulator 一同在 OpenGMK 仓库中开发。
requirements: Latest release at review: v2.2.0, published 2024-02-12 with i686 and x86_64 Windows MSVC builds. Its tag points at the January 2022 commit that leaves only the README and licence in this repository, because development moved to OpenGMK while releases are still published here. The release notes list a Rust update from 1.59 to 1.76, a fix for executables written by gm82, and support for the 810 and 811 room formats; the OpenGMK gm8decompiler crate is also at 2.2.0, and its later commits only raise the Rust version and update dependencies.

Source builds use the OpenGMK Cargo workspace, cloned with submodules and built with cargo build --release, which also builds GM8Emulator. rust-toolchain.toml pins Rust 1.77 to keep Windows 7 support, and the OpenGMK README says only MSVC targets are supported on Windows and, because releases are rarely updated, recommends building it yourself. The decompiler crate has no tests, and neither repository has CI workflows at the reviewed commits.

Input is a GameMaker 8.0 or 8.1 game executable the user supplies; neither repository includes games. Usage is gm8decompiler FILENAME: -o names the output, which otherwise is the input path with the .gmk or .gm81 extension for the detected version; -l disables data-integrity checks; -s decompiles on one thread to lower memory use; -p keeps broken custom Execute Code actions instead of converting them to standard ones; and -d sets deobfuscation of GML code processed by Schreib's GM Obfuscator, which the default auto mode enables when assets have empty names.

The README reports the Rust loader as over ten times faster than the old gm81decompiler fork, safer, more thorough and able to read more games; these are project claims, and no per-game compatibility list or output check is published. GPL-2.0-only per Cargo.toml, with the GPL v2 text in LICENCE.md. Recovered projects contain the game's own assets and code, which remain subject to the rights of the game's owner.

name: UELib (Unreal-Library)
description_en: C# library that reads Unreal Engine 1, 2 and 3 package files such as .u, .upk and .udk, auto-detects a matching game build and deserializes their exports, imports and properties. Its main goal is decompiling UnrealScript bytecode back to source by reconstructing classes, states, functions, structs, enums and default properties; it also deserializes fonts, sounds, palettes and textures. The README’s per-game compatibility table runs from Unreal and Deus Ex to Splinter Cell, Mass Effect and the Batman: Arkham games, and the separate UE Explorer GUI is built on it.
description_zh: 读取 Unreal Engine 1、2、3 包文件（如 .u、.upk 和 .udk）的 C# 库，可自动识别匹配的游戏构建，并反序列化其中的导出、导入对象和属性。其主要目标是通过重建类、状态、函数、结构体、枚举和默认属性，把 UnrealScript 字节码反编译回源码；它也能反序列化字体、声音、调色板和纹理。README 中的逐游戏兼容表从 Unreal、Deus Ex 一直列到 Splinter Cell、Mass Effect 和 Batman: Arkham 系列，独立的 UE Explorer 图形界面即基于此库构建。
requirements: Published on NuGet as Eliot.UELib: the latest stable package at review is 1.13.7, published 2026-07-17, targeting .NET Framework 4.8, .NET Standard 2.0 and 2.1 and .NET 10, while the newest GitHub release page is 1.12.0 from 2025-09-22. Versions come from Nerdbank.GitVersioning, and the reviewed master commit (2026-10-16) is later than both. The repository also holds a small .NET 10 command-line client, a separate decompiler project and a work-in-progress T3D decompiler.

Input is package files from the user’s own game installations. The README warns that opening an unsupported package could crash the system, that production UE3 packages are often compressed and must first be decompressed with a separate tool, and that some games need third-party decompression or extraction. Textures in .tfc caches, models and animations are not supported, and audio and texture output is expected to work for most games but not confirmed.

Compatibility rows are the author’s and contributors’ reports per game and package version, including known problems such as bad output at function starts for X-COM: Alliance, wrong UStruct offsets for Duke Nukem Forever (2001) and bad byte-codes for Medal of Honor (2010); some rows are marked unverified. The MSTest suite reads TestUC1–TestUC3 packages compiled from the project’s own UnrealScript test classes, and some tests point at local Unreal Tournament or UT2004 installations.

MIT license (Eliot van Uytfanghe). Game packages, scripts and assets keep their rights holders’ terms, and decompiled UnrealScript is a reconstruction, not the original source files. The GitHub description also mentions .uasset, but the README’s compatibility table covers only Unreal Engine 1–3 games.

name: Embedded Hacking (mytechnotalent)
description_en: A free English course by mytechnotalent on developing, debugging and reverse engineering firmware for the Raspberry Pi Pico 2 (RP2350, Arm Cortex-M33). A fourteen-week syllabus with slides, Markdown notebooks and a 40-chapter PDF textbook follows a write, debug, then hack pattern from hello-world through variables, data types, constants, operators, conditionals, structures and functions, using GDB with OpenOCD and Ghidra, with Binary Ninja and IDA versions of the notebooks from week 4; an I2C LCD, GPS, LoRa radio, servo and IR remote supply the exercises. Graded CTFs, story-driven classified-brief challenges and a secure-boot custom bootloader ship as author-built binaries alongside their source.
description_zh: mytechnotalent 编写的免费英文课程，讲解 Raspberry Pi Pico 2（RP2350，Arm Cortex-M33）固件的开发、调试与逆向。14 周的课程大纲配有幻灯片、Markdown 笔记和 40 章 PDF 教材，按“编写、调试、再破解”的模式，从 hello world 讲到变量、数据类型、常量、运算符、条件语句、结构体和函数，使用 GDB 配合 OpenOCD 以及 Ghidra，第 4 周起的笔记另有 Binary Ninja 和 IDA 版本；练习围绕 I2C LCD、GPS、LoRa 无线模块、舵机和红外遥控展开。计分 CTF、剧情式“机密简报”挑战和一个安全启动自定义引导程序均以作者构建的二进制文件形式提供，并附有源码。
requirements: Reviewed at commit 76fa253 (2026-10-19). The repository dates from October 2023, but its current history restarts with an initial commit on 2026-10-07 and has received commits almost daily since; there are no releases. Weeks 1–7 and 9–11 have slides and notebooks; Week 8 is a midterm built on CTF-02, Weeks 12–13 list only topics, and the two Week 14 final projects are scenario descriptions with no linked files. A supplemental section, which the README places beyond the course, links Rust, Arm-assembly and RISC-V-assembly tutorials, drivers and IoT CTF projects in the author's other repositories.

The README expects intermediate C including pointers, bare-metal assembly basics, a working model of registers and the stack, command-line use and breadboarding. Hardware is a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 with a Raspberry Pi Debug Probe and the listed parts, among them LEDs, a push button, a 1602 I2C LCD, a DHT11 sensor, an SG90 servo, a VS1838B IR receiver with an NEC remote, a u-blox NEO-6M GPS module, two REYAX RYLR998 LoRa modules and an FT232RL USB-serial adapter; Fritzing and wiring diagrams are in hardware/.

Setup is native on Windows x64, Apple-silicon macOS and Linux x64: the VS Code Raspberry Pi Pico extension installs the Pico SDK, Arm GNU Toolchain, picotool and OpenOCD, builds use CMake and Ninja, and the course adds Ghidra with JDK 21, a serial terminal and a licensed Binary Ninja Personal; the IDA notebook variants additionally assume IDA. Root flash and debug-server scripts wrap flashing and the debug server.

No third-party firmware is needed: the exercises target programs the author wrote, and the repository commits their source with build outputs (ELF, BIN, UF2, HEX, disassembly and map files), two Binary Ninja databases, CTF-02's static libraries (its auth module, an mbedTLS subset and the Argon2 reference implementation), the RP2350 SVD file and the custom bootloader's signed images. datasheets/ holds copies of the RP2350 datasheet, the Pico C/C++ SDK book, Arm's Cortex-M33 Technical Reference Manual, the Armv8-M Architecture Reference Manual, AAPCS32 and Application Note 132, which keep their publishers' terms.

Apache-2.0 for the repository. The README's legal disclaimer limits use to educational, research and defensive work on devices the user owns or is explicitly authorized to test. A bundled OpenCode skill only enforces the author's C coding standard.

name: Apple Continuity Reverse Engineering Toolkit
description_en: Three macOS helpers from SEEMOO Lab that the Open Wireless Link project used to study Apple wireless services such as AirDrop, Wi-Fi Password Sharing, Handoff and Offline Finding from the host side. process_recon summarizes which processes, log categories and subsystems emit log entries matching chosen keywords; keychain_access uses Frida to hook SecItemCopyMatching in a process and exports the keychain items it accesses to JSON; and lldb breakpoint commands print the Handoff and Universal Clipboard messages that the rapportd daemon sends and receives.
description_zh: SEEMOO 实验室的三个 macOS 辅助工具，Open Wireless Link 项目曾用它们从主机一侧研究 AirDrop、Wi-Fi 密码共享、Handoff 和离线查找等 Apple 无线服务。process_recon 汇总哪些进程、日志类别和子系统产生了含指定关键词的日志；keychain_access 借助 Frida 挂接某一进程中的 SecItemCopyMatching，把该进程访问的钥匙串条目导出为 JSON；另有一组 lldb 断点命令，可打印 rapportd 守护进程收发的 Handoff 与通用剪贴板消息。
requirements: The repository has three commits: the initial release and a paper link on 2021-04-12, and a 2026-08-17 README edit that replaces the former Open Wireless Link website link with a note that the site is no longer associated with the project. There are no releases. The process_recon example was recorded on macOS 11.0 and the breakpoints name private Rapport framework methods; support for current macOS releases is not documented.

Runs on the analyst's own Mac with Python 3 in a virtual environment and Node.js; make install installs the pinned requirements, including frida 14.2.7 and frida-tools 9.1.0 from 2021, plus the prettier dev dependency. continuity_messages needs lldb and SIP's debugging protection turned off, and keychain_access needs SIP fully disabled for system processes; the README warns about the security implications.

Inputs are the analyst's own devices and accounts: the rapportd examples involve an iPhone next to the Mac and keys for the analyst's iCloud devices, so keychain_access output holds real secrets and should be handled accordingly. keychain_access/tests has small Swift and Objective-C hackme programs and a test.sh that stores and then extracts a dummy keychain password; there are no other tests.

The tools watch logs, keychain calls and daemon messages on the host; they do not capture or decode over-the-air Bluetooth LE or AWDL traffic, unlike the separately listed furiousMAC Continuity notes and Wireshark dissector for Continuity advertisements. The README lists the authors' USENIX Security 2021 Continuity and 2019 AWDL papers and a 2020 dissertation as related publications.

name: lib-osmo-ble: DJI Osmo Pocket 3 Bluetooth LE protocol library
description_en: Reconstructs the DUML-over-BLE protocol that DJI's Mimo app uses with the Osmo Pocket 3 camera as a Node.js library and CLI for scanning, pairing, gimbal commands and roughly 20 Hz position telemetry without the vendor app. The author reports working from a third party's Wireshark captures and dissector of Mimo traffic, a Go client and trial-and-error debugging; PROTOCOL.md documents the frame layout, CRC parameters, BLE characteristic roles and command IDs. A write-up and bundled patch trace seven bugs that kept the earlier node-osmo library from working with the camera, and the author reports that the patched library completed pairing, Wi-Fi setup and RTMP streaming.
description_zh: 重建 DJI Mimo 应用与 Osmo Pocket 3 相机之间基于 BLE 的 DUML 协议，提供 Node.js 库和命令行工具，无需官方应用即可扫描、配对、发送云台指令并接收约 20 Hz 的姿态遥测。作者称其依据第三方对 Mimo 通信的 Wireshark 抓包与解析器、一个 Go 客户端以及反复试验调试完成；PROTOCOL.md 记录了帧结构、CRC 参数、BLE 特征值的用途和命令 ID。一篇过程记录和随附补丁梳理了导致早期 node-osmo 库无法配合该相机工作的七个缺陷，作者报告打过补丁的库完成了配对、Wi-Fi 设置和 RTMP 推流。
requirements: Reviewed at the 2026-02-21 main head, which is also the last push; package.json declares 1.0.0, and there are no releases or tags. The README says gimbal motor commands are built and parsed correctly but the camera silently ignores them over BLE alone, probably until Wi-Fi streaming is active, while telemetry works. The library itself implements pairing, gimbal control and telemetry only; Wi-Fi setup and streaming were reached with the patched node-osmo.

Requires the user's own DJI Osmo Pocket 3 and a Bluetooth LE host. PROTOCOL.md reports verification on that model only, from macOS, and the patch notes list Apple Silicon macOS Sequoia, Node.js v25.5.0 and @stoprocent/noble 1.18.2; other DJI devices may differ. Pairing sends a client-chosen PIN (love by default in the CLI) that the user approves on the camera. No DJI firmware, app files or the author's own captures are committed.

Plain Node.js ES modules with two runtime dependencies, @stoprocent/noble ^2.3.10 for BLE and crc-full for the CRC8/CRC16 checks, and no build step; npm link installs the dji-osmo CLI. Diagnostic scripts scan for DJI devices, list characteristic properties and decode and CRC-check DUML hex messages. The node-osmo patch applies with git am to a separate clone of datagutt/node-osmo and builds with pnpm and TypeScript.

There are no automated tests; the npm test script is a placeholder that exits with an error. Evidence is the author's write-up, analysis notes on characteristic mapping, byte order, the Node.js buffer-pool bug and a false-positive run, and an experiment index whose raw logs are gitignored. Device behavior remains author-reported.

LICENSE is MIT, although package.json still says ISC. The reference folder copies the CC0-1.0 Wireshark dissector and message notes from xaionaro/reverse-engineering-dji, and node-osmo is MIT. DJI firmware, apps and trademarks keep their own rights.

name: uefi_retool
description_en: Python command-line tool and IDA Pro plugin for UEFI firmware reverse engineering. uefi_retool.py unpacks a firmware image with uefi-firmware-parser, collects its executable modules and runs IDA in batch mode on each one, writing their boot-service calls and protocol GUIDs to JSON; a separate command lists protocols whose GUIDs are absent from its EDK2, AMI and vendor GUID tables as proprietary. Inside IDA the plugin applies EFI system-table types and names, lists protocols in an explorer window and, from the JSON, shows a dependency browser and graph across the firmware’s modules.
description_zh: 用于 UEFI 固件逆向工程的 Python 命令行工具及 IDA Pro 插件。uefi_retool.py 用 uefi-firmware-parser 解包固件镜像，收集其中的可执行模块，并以批处理模式逐一交给 IDA 分析，把各模块的引导服务调用和协议 GUID 写入 JSON；另一条命令则把 GUID 不在其 EDK2、AMI 及厂商 GUID 表中的协议列为专有协议。在 IDA 中，插件会应用 EFI 系统表的类型和名称，在浏览窗口中列出协议，并根据该 JSON 展示固件各模块之间的依赖浏览器和依赖图。
requirements: The repository is archived. Its last commit (2024-12-28) only updates the README, the last code changes date from 2021-08-03, and the only tag, 1.2.0 from 2020-05-07, is eight commits older; there are no GitHub releases. The tree contains an IDA plugin only and no Ghidra component.

Needs a licensed IDA Pro with IDAPython and PyQt5: copy uefi_analyser.py and the uefi_analyser package into IDA’s plugins directory, then set the IDA and IDA64 executable paths and the module, dump and log directories in config.json, whose example points to IDA Pro 7.6 on Windows. The script uses Python with Click, colorama, terminaltables, tqdm and uefi-firmware-parser 1.8, installed from a tarball named in requirements.txt.

Input is a UEFI firmware image the user supplies; README examples name a ThinkPad X1 Carbon 5th-generation image that the repository does not include, and no firmware images are committed. The analyser recognizes x86 and x86-64 instruction patterns and chooses IDA or IDA64 from each image’s machine type. The bundled GUID tables come from EDK2 and EDK, from ida-efiutils for AMI, and from Dell, Lenovo and ASRock lists, and tools/update_edk2_guids.py refreshes the EDK2 table.
MIT license (2018–2021, yeggor). The repository has no tests or CI. Labels and dependency graphs come from GUID matching and instruction patterns, so they need analyst checking.

name: GTIRB
description_en: GrammaTech's intermediate representation for passing disassembly, analysis and rewriting results between binary tools, modeled on the role LLVM-IR plays for compilers. An IR holds modules for executables or libraries with their sections, byte intervals, code and data blocks, symbols and symbolic operands, plus an inter-procedural CFG and AuxData tables for analysis results, all referenced by UUID; instruction semantics are deliberately left out, so machine code stays as raw bytes for Capstone/Keystone or any other IL. It serializes as protobuf, with C++, Python and Common Lisp APIs and a partial Java API; the separately listed ddisasm produces it.
description_zh: GrammaTech 开发的二进制中间表示，用于在各类二进制工具之间传递反汇编、分析与改写结果，其定位参照 LLVM-IR 在编译器中的作用。一个 IR 包含代表可执行文件或库的模块及其节、字节区间、代码块与数据块、符号和符号化操作数，另有过程间控制流图和存放分析结果的 AuxData 表，所有元素都通过 UUID 引用；它刻意不表示指令语义，机器码以原始字节保存，可交由 Capstone/Keystone 或其他中间语言处理。GTIRB 以 protobuf 序列化，提供 C++、Python 和 Common Lisp API 以及不完整的 Java API；另行收录的 ddisasm 可生成这种表示。
requirements: PyPI's newest gtirb is 2.3.2, uploaded 2026-06-16 as a pure-Python wheel for Python 3.8+; the changelog says the PyPI package needs protobuf 4.21.1 or newer. The reviewed master commit of the same day bumps version.txt to 2.3.3, which CHANGELOG marks unreleased. GitHub releases stop at v2.0.0 (2023-12-14, no files), and later versions are git tags. The README says ABI compatibility is not yet provided across any version change, and that stable or unstable packages must match the installed ddisasm and gtirb-pprinter.

Prebuilt options are Windows .zip builds and Ubuntu 20.04 (focal) apt packages from GrammaTech's download server, and the grammatech/ddisasm Docker image with GTIRB, ddisasm and gtirb-pprinter; the README warns that apt metapackages for stable gtirb 2.0.0 and older conflict on upgrade. Source builds need a 64-bit C++17 compiler (GCC, Clang or Visual Studio), CMake 3.10+, Protobuf 3.0.0+ and Boost 1.68+; the Common Lisp API needs further manual setup, and the Java API is marked incomplete.

GTIRB is a data structure, not an analyzer: IR comes from a producer such as ddisasm. The schema names file formats including ELF, PE, COFF, XCOFF, Mach-O and raw images, and ISAs from IA-32 and x64 to ARM, MIPS, PowerPC and, from 2.3.2, RISC-V; what a given producer actually supports is up to that tool. Programs in doc/examples walk the C++ API and compute CFG paths, data symbols and functions in several languages.

The GitLab CI configuration builds and tests on Ubuntu 20.04, 22.04 and 24.04 with GCC and Clang, plus static, Java, Common Lisp, Python and coverage jobs; the GitHub Actions workflow only builds and publishes documentation.

LICENSE.txt places GTIRB under MIT (2018, GrammaTech) and appends Apache-2.0 with LLVM Exceptions for included third-party code, which GitHub leaves unclassified; contributors must sign GrammaTech's CLA.

name: Quokka
description_en: Quarkslab’s binary exporter, inspired by BinExport, saves a disassembler’s analysis to a protobuf .quokka file so functions, basic blocks, data, cross-references, segments and optionally decompiled code can be used later without the disassembler. Its Python bindings load an export together with the original binary, decode instructions at runtime with Capstone, or optionally lift them to P-code with pypcode, and expose programs, functions and control-flow graphs through one API. The main branch adds Ghidra and Binary Ninja exporters beside the IDA Pro plugin, a parallel quokka-cli batch exporter and name and type edits that can be written back to an IDA database.
description_zh: Quarkslab 的二进制导出工具，受 BinExport 启发，把反汇编器的分析结果保存为 protobuf 格式的 .quokka 文件，此后无需反汇编器即可使用其中的函数、基本块、数据、交叉引用、段以及可选的反编译代码。其 Python 绑定将导出文件与原始二进制一并载入，运行时用 Capstone 解码指令，也可选用 pypcode 将其提升为 P-code，并通过统一的 API 提供程序、函数和控制流图。main 分支在 IDA Pro 插件之外新增了 Ghidra 与 Binary Ninja 导出器、可并行批量导出的 quokka-cli，以及可写回 IDA 数据库的名称和类型编辑。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.6.2, published 2025-12-08 together with quokka-project 0.6.2 on PyPI; its README supports IDA 7.3+, and it ships prebuilt IDA plugins for IDA 7.4 through 9.2 on Windows, Linux and macOS. The reviewed main commit (2026-10-14) is 261 commits later and declares version 1.0.0; the Ghidra and Binary Ninja exporters, quokka-cli and the IDA 9.1+ requirement described here exist only on main, not in a released package.

Exporting needs one disassembler. The main-branch C++ plugin targets IDA Pro 9.1+, installs through hcli on 9.2+ or builds with CMake, which fetches the open-source IDA SDK for 9.2+ and needs a separately obtained SDK for older versions; the Java extension needs Ghidra 12.0.3+ and JDK 21+; the Binary Ninja plugin declares version 4.0 build 4911 as its minimum, and headless use there needs a commercial license. The Python bindings need Python 3.10+ on main, or 3.8+ for 0.6.2, with capstone, networkx, protobuf and python-magic.

Only the LIGHT export mode works: exports hold block-level data, so loading them needs the original binary for Capstone to decode instructions, and the self-contained FULL mode is planned but not implemented. quokka-cli offers decompiled-code export for IDA only. The README warns that Capstone’s disassembly can differ from the disassembler’s.

Test fixtures in tests/dataset are stored with Git LFS: programs built from the included many_types and sig_test sources, a Linux kernel module (nf_nat_pt.ko), a UEFI PEI module (StatusCodeHandlerPei.efi), a puraUpdate executable and their exports; docs/samples adds a qb-crackme sample and its export. Workflows build the IDA plugin, build and test the Ghidra extension, test the Binary Ninja plugin and run the Python tests on Python 3.10–3.13.
Apache-2.0 license; IDA Pro, Ghidra and Binary Ninja keep their own terms.

name: knife
description_en: Static reverse-engineering toolkit in Rust, installed as the knife command, that parses PE, ELF, Mach-O and WebAssembly files without running them. It triages hashes, sections, mitigations, imports, strings, indicators and crypto constants; recovers functions, call graphs and CFGs through recursive-descent disassembly for x86/x64 and AArch64; and lifts functions to experimental pseudocode. Analysts' names, notes, types and staged patches persist in a per-binary database shared by the CLI, a terminal UI and an MCP server, and further passes rank risky API call sites by argument provenance and summarize Windows driver dispatch and IOCTL surfaces.
description_zh: 以 Rust 编写的静态逆向工程工具包，安装后为 knife 命令，可在不运行目标的情况下解析 PE、ELF、Mach-O 和 WebAssembly 文件。它能分诊哈希、节区、缓解措施、导入、字符串、威胁指标和加密常量；通过面向 x86/x64 与 AArch64 的递归下降反汇编恢复函数、调用图和控制流图；还能把函数提升为实验性伪代码。分析者添加的命名、注释、类型和暂存补丁保存在按二进制区分的数据库中，由命令行、终端界面和 MCP 服务器共享；另有分析步骤按参数来源对有风险的 API 调用点排序，并汇总 Windows 驱动的派发例程和 IOCTL 接口。
requirements: The repository was created on 2026-08-08. Release v1.8.3 (2026-10-11) ships Linux x86_64, macOS arm64/x86_64 and Windows x86_64 archives, while the reknife crate on crates.io stops at 1.8.0 (2026-09-15); the reviewed main commit is 48 commits past v1.8.3, with unreleased changes listed in CHANGELOG. Source builds need Rust 1.88+, and the README says no system libraries are needed beyond the platform default; knife update needs curl.

Input is a binary the analyst supplies, which knife only reads. Disassembly covers x86/x64 and AArch64, the audit data-flow checks are x86/x64 only, and the README says empty reachability results do not prove unreachability because indirect dispatch is outside the direct call graph. WebAssembly gets section, import/export and WAT views without code analysis. The repository contains no target binaries: tests build synthetic PE and ELF fixtures in code, and data/loldrivers.json is a snapshot of the public LOLDrivers list used for SHA-256 matching.

knife mcp speaks MCP over stdio; docs/MCP.md lists 58 tools, four of which write names, notes, prototypes or staged patches to the project database rather than the binary. The optional investigation desk sends prompts and tool results to the model provider the user configures (local Ollama, OpenRouter, OpenAI or another OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and keeps hosted API keys in the OS credential vault. Optional adapters call a separately installed Rizin, and the provider docs also describe Ghidra headless and capa adapters; YARA-X 1.12 is linked in for rule scans, and a GDB runtime exporter is documented but not yet exposed.

CI runs cargo build and test on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS, plus cargo fmt and clippy. The README presents audit hits as call sites whose argument provenance matches a bug pattern, and its 7z.dll, kernel32.dll and CVE-2017-11882 figures are the author's results.

MIT (2026, 0xblack). The LOLDrivers snapshot comes from that project's public API, and Rizin, Ghidra, capa and YARA-X keep their own licenses. The repository's AGENTS.md is contributor guidance for coding agents.

name: Interactive IDA Plugin List
description_en: A sortable, filterable list of 618 plugins, loaders, processor modules and scripts for Hex-Rays' IDA Pro, published as a GitHub Pages table with a static copy generated into the README. Each entry links to its project, almost always on GitHub, with a short description and, where recorded, its language (C++ or Python), category tags such as decompiler, deobfuscation, loader, debug or integration, and the date the project was last updated. The list grew out of onethawt's idaplugins-list of about 200 plugins.
description_zh: 可排序、可筛选的 Hex-Rays IDA Pro 插件清单，收录 618 个插件、加载器、处理器模块和脚本，以 GitHub Pages 表格发布，并在 README 中生成静态副本。每个条目链接到对应项目（几乎都在 GitHub 上），附简短说明；如有记录，还标出实现语言（C++ 或 Python）、反编译器、反混淆、加载器、调试、集成等分类标签，以及项目的最近更新日期。该清单由 onethawt 约 200 个插件的 idaplugins-list 扩展而来。
requirements: The reviewed main commit, of 2024-11-19, refreshed every last-updated date and holds 618 entries in data.js, mirrored in the README. Those dates record each project's latest activity at refresh time, from 2006 to 2024 with 136 in 2024.

Category tags cover 313 entries; the most common are integration (97), decompiler (63), development (51), loader (42) and debug (39). data.js also notes an IDA version for 385 entries, the highest being 8.4, but the table does not show it, and no entry is marked for IDA 9 or later, so compatibility must be checked at each plugin's source.

The list itself is a static page that needs only a browser; tools/gen_readme.py regenerates the README from data.js and depends on demjson. Listed plugins need the user's own IDA installation, and the list records no license, edition or install requirements for them.
LICENSE is MIT, and lib/DEPENDENCIES.md lists the bundled Tabulator 5.1.8, moment.js and jQuery 3.6.0 files as MIT; listed plugins keep their own licenses.

name: IDA-Skill
description_en: Agent skill that has an AI agent triage malware samples statically in IDA Pro through headless idat. An initialization script builds the IDA database and exports a summary, imports, exports, entry-point decompilation and filtered strings, and an executor runs IDAPython snippets or files against that database. SKILL.md sets a static-only rule, a top-down method and a rule to hand large string dumps to a sub-agent, and bundled scripts add cryptographic-constant detection, an export-size check and REAI, which sends decompiled functions to a configured OpenAI-compatible model to describe them and rename them with an AI_ prefix.
description_zh: 一个智能体技能，让 AI 智能体通过无界面的 idat 在 IDA Pro 中对恶意样本进行静态初步分析。初始化脚本会生成 IDA 数据库，并导出基本信息、导入表、导出表、入口点反编译结果和过滤后的字符串；执行脚本则可对该数据库运行 IDAPython 代码片段或脚本文件。SKILL.md 规定只做静态分析、采用自顶向下的分析方法，并要求把大型字符串列表交给子智能体处理；附带脚本提供加密常量识别、导出函数大小检查，以及 REAI——它把反编译出的函数发送给配置好的 OpenAI 兼容模型，生成功能说明并以 AI_ 前缀重命名。
requirements: Reviewed at main commit 4595864 of 2026-10-21; there are no releases or version numbers, and recent commits are titled only "update". The skill is a SKILL.md with name and description front matter for agent clients that load skill folders; the README demonstrates it with the author's Spore multi-agent framework and names no other tested client. Its commands use Windows PowerShell here-strings and paths under skills/IDA-Skill/tools/.

Requires a licensed IDA Pro installation whose idat executable is set in config.json (the README example is IDA Pro 9.0's idat64.exe) and Python on the host to launch it; decompilation calls rely on the Hex-Rays decompiler. Users supply the samples, and SKILL.md forbids debugging or executing them. REAI needs openai 1.0+ and an API key, endpoint and model edited into tools/reai.py, and it sends decompiled pseudocode to that endpoint.

API.md and docs/ hold a Markdown IDAPython API reference whose source and terms are not stated, analysis/ holds short method notes for tasks such as protocol, algorithm, firmware and driver analysis, and movie.mp4 is a 25 MB demo video. TOOLS.md tells the agent to run reai check first and not to run analyze when a call chain exceeds 40 functions.
The repository has no tests or CI and reports no evaluated samples or accuracy. REAI names and descriptions are model output that needs analyst review.

LICENSE holds the AGPL-3.0 text, while both READMEs call the project GPL-3.0 and add an education-and-research-only, no-commercial-use condition that neither license contains, so reuse terms are unclear. IDA Pro and model APIs keep their own terms.

name: Reverse-Engineering a Bluetooth-Enabled Radar Detector
description_en: Write-up of how the author decoded the Bluetooth RFCOMM protocol of a Cobra iRAD 900 radar detector so that a Raspberry Pi 3 could receive alerts without the iOS or Android app. Traffic was logged on a jailbroken iPhone with BTServer and filtered in Wireshark; the README then documents the detector's half-second status payload and the 9-byte reply whose ACK byte must echo the detector's sequence byte, and replays recorded responses to the initial settings sync instead of decoding it. A short beginner's case study on RFCOMM traffic analysis with a rough proof-of-concept script, not a maintained client.
