description_zh: 作者记录了如何解析 Cobra iRAD 900 雷达测速预警器的蓝牙 RFCOMM 协议，使 Raspberry Pi 3 无需 iOS 或 Android 应用即可接收警报。作者在越狱 iPhone 上用 BTServer 记录通信，再用 Wireshark 过滤；README 随后说明预警器每半秒发送的状态载荷，以及 9 字节的回复报文，其中 ACK 字节必须回显预警器发来的序号字节；对于连接初期的设置同步，则直接重放录制的响应而不加解析。这是一个面向初学者的 RFCOMM 流量分析简短案例，附带粗略的概念验证脚本，并非持续维护的客户端。
requirements: Written in 2017 and last expanded on 2017-07-06; the latest commit, from January 2025, only updates the contact email. It covers one detector model. The alert-type values are only partly identified because the author had no radar gun, the initial sync is replayed rather than decoded, and the README expects the replay data would need re-recording after app settings change.

Following the method needs a Cobra iRAD 900 used with its vendor app and a way to log the phone's Bluetooth traffic; the author used BTServer logging on a jailbroken iPhone 5 and Wireshark. The repository commits the author's three .pklg captures, the Wireshark XML export (data.xml) and the processed packetData.dat; no app or device firmware is included.

radar.py is a self-described extremely rough proof of concept that talks RFCOMM through PyBluez, with the author's detector address and service UUID hard-coded; its setup notes install the Python 2 python-bluez package. parseData.py converts data.xml into packetData.dat, which radar.py loads with pickle, so treat that file as executable input.
MIT License. Cobra's detector, app and trademarks keep their own rights.

name: BARF
description_en: Python binary analysis framework that loads ELF and PE programs, disassembles 32- and 64-bit x86 and 32-bit ARM code with Capstone and translates it into the REIL intermediate language, so its analyses do not depend on the source architecture. Modules recover control-flow and call graphs, emulate REIL and turn code fragments into Z3 or CVC4 formulas for checking constraints on registers and memory; release 0.6.0 added basic symbolic execution. Bundled command-line tools recover CFGs and call graphs, replay x86 execution traces and search, classify and verify ROP gadgets.
description_zh: 一个 Python 二进制分析框架：加载 ELF 和 PE 程序，借助 Capstone 反汇编 32 位与 64 位 x86 及 32 位 ARM 代码，并将其翻译为 REIL 中间语言，使各项分析不依赖源架构。其模块可恢复控制流图和调用图、模拟执行 REIL，并把代码片段转换为 Z3 或 CVC4 公式，以检查寄存器和内存上的约束；0.6.0 版加入了基础的符号执行。随附的命令行工具可恢复 CFG 和调用图、重放 x86 执行轨迹，以及搜索、分类和验证 ROP gadget。
requirements: Inactive since 2019: the reviewed master commit, dated 2019-11-24, is tagged v0.6.0 and is the last commit; 0.6.0 is also the newest PyPI release of barf. GitHub does not mark the repository archived, and it has tags but no GitHub release entries, although the README links a v0.6.0 release page. setup.py classifies it as alpha, and the README still calls it under development.

setup.py and the Travis CI configuration target Python 2.7 and 3.6, with Python 3 support added in 0.6.0. The README says all packages were tested on Ubuntu 16.04 x86_64, and the Dockerfile installs it on Ubuntu 18.04 through Python 2 pip. Dependencies include Capstone 3.0.5rc2+, pefile, pyelftools, networkx, pydot and pyparsing, plus at least one of the Z3 or CVC4 solvers; Graphviz is needed for graph output and PyAsmJIT for some tests.

Binaries come from the analyst. The repository bundles small sample binaries built from included C sources under examples/misc/samples and tests, and two challenge binaries for its worked examples: Flare-On 2015 challenge #2 (examples/flareon-2015/2/bin/very_success) and kao's toy project (examples/kaos-toy-project/bin/toyproject.exe). The Sphinx manual is in Spanish and refers to an install.sh script that is not present at the reviewed commit.

BSD 2-Clause license, copyright 2014 Fundación Dr. Manuel Sadosky. The README describes checking instruction translations by running code natively through PyAsmJIT and in the REIL emulator and comparing the final contexts.

name: cbyge: reconstructing the C by GE smart-bulb cloud protocol
description_en: Reimplements the cloud control path of the C by GE (now Cync) smart-bulb app as a Go library and a small self-hosted web app. The author reports decompiling the Android app with Apktool, finding its JSON HTTP API for login and device lists and a separate raw TCP protocol to the vendor's server, then working out that protocol's type-and-length message framing and packet encodings from proxied traffic and the Smali code. The resulting API lists devices, reads their status and sets power, brightness, color tone and RGB color.
description_zh: 以 Go 库和一个可自行部署的小型网页应用，重新实现 C by GE（现名 Cync）智能灯泡应用的云端控制通道。作者称先用 Apktool 反编译 Android 应用，找到用于登录和设备列表的 JSON HTTP 接口，以及另一条连接厂商服务器的原始 TCP 协议，再结合代理记录的通信和 Smali 代码，推断出该协议以类型和长度开头的消息格式及各类数据包编码。最终的 API 可列出设备、读取状态，并设置开关、亮度、色温和 RGB 颜色。
requirements: Reviewed at the 2021-11-09 main commit; there are no releases. The README states that the code was not informed by a protocol specification and may stop working or fail on some networks and devices. Only the author's own lightbulbs were examined, so the outlets, sensors and switches the same app controls were not reverse-engineered.

Requires the user's own C by GE or Cync account with devices already set up in the official app; newer accounts need the email two-factor login, which the web app or the login_2fa command performs. Control goes through the vendor's cloud rather than local Bluetooth or LAN. The Android app, traffic captures and account data are not in the repository; the README quotes only short Smali excerpts and one status packet from the author's devices.

Builds with Go; go.mod declares Go 1.14 and two small dependencies. The server directory serves a browser front end and a JSON API protected by an optional web password, and the repository also keeps the small TCP and HTTP logging proxies used during the investigation.
There are no tests or CI. The README reports that others have used the API successfully in some cases and that the author found it faster and more reliable than the official app.
BSD-2-Clause, copyright 2021 Alexander Nichol. This is an independent client, not recovered vendor source; the vendor's apps, services and trademarks keep their own rights.

name: Shannon Modem Loader for IDA Pro
description_en: IDA Pro loader and post-processing scripts for Samsung Exynos "Shannon" baseband modem images that carry a TOC header, including crash dumps. The loader maps the TOC entries to aligned segments and entry points; after auto-analysis the post-processor restores debug-trace structures, names functions from strings and debug-log calls, rebuilds the MPU table and memory map, comments MMU-related coprocessor instructions, performs the ARM scatter-load with its decompression, and labels platform-abstraction-layer and task-initialization functions. The README adds the author's notes on ShannonOS, the PAL and the move from Cortex-R to Cortex-A cores.
description_zh: 用于 IDA Pro 的加载器和后处理脚本，处理带 TOC 头的三星 Exynos“Shannon”基带调制解调器镜像，也支持崩溃转储。加载器把 TOC 条目映射为对齐的段并设置入口点；自动分析完成后，后处理程序会恢复调试跟踪结构，依据字符串和调试日志调用为函数命名，重建 MPU 表和内存映射，为 MMU 相关的协处理器指令添加注释，执行 ARM 分散加载及其解压，并标注平台抽象层与任务初始化函数。README 还附有作者对 ShannonOS、PAL 以及从 Cortex-R 转向 Cortex-A 内核的说明。
requirements: Latest release at review: 01.2025, published 2025-01-01; the reviewed main commit of 2025-01-03 only adds IDA Essential 9.0 to the installer's search list. The README calls the code work in progress and reports testing on a larger set of images from older models such as the G8700 and S7 up to the S22 and S24, with task identification working on recent images.

The README reports testing with IDA Pro 9.0, IDA Pro 8.3 to 8.4 SP2 and IDA Home ARM, and says 7.x with the revamped IDAPython API might work. install.sh copies the loader, Python modules and signatures into a Linux IDA installation; on macOS or Windows the files are copied by hand following the README's table.
Users supply a TOC-format Shannon modem image or crash dump; the repository contains no modem firmware. The README reports that a complete analysis takes about 10 minutes on average hardware.

sig/ holds 17 premade FLIRT signature files for ARM Compiler/RVCT runtime functions, from version 3.1 to 5.06u7. The post-processor reads the image's RVCT build string, applies the matching signature, and on Linux offers to use the include directory of a matching legacy ARM compiler installed in the user's home directory. There are no tests or CI.
MIT License. Modem firmware, IDA Pro and ARM compilers keep their own terms.

name: rabbitizer
description_en: MIPS instruction decoder written in C that never allocates on the heap, with Python, C++ and Rust bindings in the same repository and the stated aim of producing matching assembly. It decodes one instruction word at a time, focusing on MIPS I to III with partial MIPS IV support, and also handles the N64 RSP, the PlayStation's R3000 GTE, the PSP's R4000 Allegrex and the PS2's R5900; it offers validation checks, instruction-grouping queries, configurable pseudo-instructions and register names, and small helpers for building pointer and symbol detection. Matching-decompilation tooling builds on it: splat and spimdisasm both list it as a Python dependency.
description_zh: 使用 C 编写、完全不在堆上分配内存的 MIPS 指令解码器，同一仓库还提供 Python、C++ 和 Rust 绑定，目标是生成可匹配的汇编。它逐条解码指令字，重点支持 MIPS I 至 III，部分支持 MIPS IV，还能处理 N64 的 RSP、PlayStation 的 R3000 GTE、PSP 的 R4000 Allegrex 以及 PS2 的 R5900；提供指令有效性检查、按特征分组查询指令、可配置的伪指令与寄存器命名，以及用于自建指针和符号检测的小工具。匹配式反编译工具以它为基础：splat 和 spimdisasm 都把它列为 Python 依赖。
requirements: Latest stable release at review: 1.16.2, published 2026-05-29 on GitHub, PyPI and crates.io, which matches the reviewed 1.x commit. A 2.0.0 alpha series (2.0.0-alpha.9, 2026-05-20) is published from a separate Rust branch; splat and spimdisasm both pin versions below 2.0.0.

Install with pip install rabbitizer or cargo add rabbitizer. The README gives Python 3.9 as the minimum, although pyproject.toml still declares >=3.4, and building the Python bindings from source needs the Python development headers. The C and C++ libraries build with make and clang (C11 and C++17), and the Rust crate declares Rust 1.66.0. Instruction tables for every binding are generated from templates in tables/, and CI checks that the generated files are current.

Input is raw 32-bit instruction words, so callers must take code from their own binaries, choose the CPU variant and handle addresses and symbols themselves. Pseudo-instructions that expand to more than one instruction are deliberately unsupported; the README says output should match, reports that RSP output reassembles to matching code with armips, and calls MIPS IV support partial.

GitHub Actions build the C code with warnings as errors on Ubuntu 22.04 and run build-info, logic and instruction checks, and Python unit tests run on Linux, macOS and Windows; tests/asm holds assembly samples for the GTE, Allegrex and R5900. The README's reference list points to third-party CPU manuals and documentation hosted elsewhere.
MIT.

name: EchoMuse: replacement software that turns the Echo Dot 2nd gen into a Home Assistant voice satellite
description_en: Replaces the software on an unlocked second-generation Amazon Echo Dot (2016, codename biscuit) so it works as a local Home Assistant voice satellite over the ESPHome API: EchoMuse's own Go firmware drives the microphones, speaker, LED ring and buttons, and a controller on the LAN handles wake words, devices and a dashboard. Its default emOS mode swaps Amazon's Android userspace for the project's own init and busybox while keeping the Dot's kernel from the owner's boot image. An engineering journal records how codec routes, the mute key and other hardware behavior were worked out by measuring the device and diffing the mixer and DAPM state while stock FireOS plays a sound.
description_zh: 替换已解锁的第二代 Amazon Echo Dot（2016 年款，代号 biscuit）上的软件，使其通过 ESPHome API 成为本地 Home Assistant 语音终端：EchoMuse 自己的 Go 固件驱动麦克风、扬声器、LED 灯环和按键，局域网中的控制器负责唤醒词、设备管理和仪表盘。默认的 emOS 模式用项目自有的 init 和 busybox 取代 Amazon 的 Android 用户空间，同时保留取自机主自身启动镜像的 Dot 内核。工程日志记录了如何通过在设备上测量，并在原厂 FireOS 播放声音时对比混音器和 DAPM 状态，摸清编解码器通路、静音键等硬件行为。
requirements: Reviewed main commit 4bbf7ff (2026-10-27) is in active development. At review the latest stable device firmware is v2.18.1 (2026-10-15) and emOS 0.10 (2026-10-02), the controller add-on declares 2.26.3, and early-access v2.19.0-ea.2 and emos-v0.11-ea.1 builds followed. Only the Echo Dot 2nd gen is supported; README calls ports to the Echo Dot 3, Echo 2 and Echo Show 8 in progress and lists open issues, including no WPA3 on emOS under FireOS 6.

Needs the user's own Echo Dot 2nd gen, first unlocked with third-party tools (firebreak running R0rt1z2's amonet-biscuit); README says this is done at the user's own risk and can soft-brick the device. The setup wizard keeps a copy of the device's own boot partition and builds the emOS image from its kernel and device trees, and emOS mounts bionic and tinyalsa read-only from the device's /system. The emOS README says no bootable image is published because it would contain Amazon's kernel; releases carry the project's own firmware binary, init and userspace payload, and busybox with its source.

Requires a working Home Assistant with an Assist pipeline, an always-on host for the controller as a Home Assistant add-on or Docker container, and Chrome or Edge for the one-time WebUSB setup. Source builds use the project's Docker compiler image for the Go device firmware, Python 3.12 for the controller, and emos/build.sh, whose release workflow compiles the init with a pinned Android NDK.

CI runs the controller pytest suite with coverage floors, dashboard and Go device tests, dependency audits and image builds, and the journal and acceptance-test reports describe runs on the maintainer's own devices. It does not reproduce Alexa, and no Amazon software or service is recovered.

MIT, with vendored SpeexDSP (BSD-3-Clause), an ONNX Runtime header, aioesphomeapi protocol buffers and a CC BY 4.0 timer sound listed in NOTICE.md; the project states it is not affiliated with Amazon. README says EchoMuse is written largely with Claude, directed by the maintainer, and that more than half the commits carry a Co-Authored-By: Claude line.

name: ghidrecomp
description_en: Python command-line decompiler that drives Ghidra through pyghidra to decompile every function of a binary into separate C files, or into one C file and header with Ghidra's C++ exporter, keeping the Ghidra project so later runs can reuse the analysis. Options filter functions by regex, apply PDB symbols from a local file or from Microsoft, Chromium, Mozilla, Intel, NVIDIA and AMD symbol servers, apply extra GDT data-type archives, write Mermaid call-graph Markdown, generate BSim function signatures, and scan the decompiled code with Semgrep rules into SARIF reports.
description_zh: 通过 pyghidra 驱动 Ghidra 的 Python 命令行反编译工具：把二进制中的所有函数分别反编译为独立的 C 文件，或借助 Ghidra 的 C++ 导出器生成一个 C 文件和头文件，并保留 Ghidra 项目以便后续运行复用分析结果。可按正则筛选函数，从本地文件或 Microsoft、Chromium、Mozilla、Intel、NVIDIA、AMD 符号服务器应用 PDB 符号，加载额外的 GDT 数据类型库，输出 Mermaid 调用图 Markdown，生成 BSim 函数签名，并用 Semgrep 规则扫描反编译代码、输出 SARIF 报告。
requirements: Latest release at review: v0.5.9, published to PyPI and GitHub on 2026-01-06; the reviewed main commit is that tag. setup.cfg requires Python 3.10+ and pyghidra 2.2.1+ and marks the project as alpha; the CodeQL option is a placeholder that only prints a coming-soon message.

Needs a separate Ghidra installation and the Java runtime it requires, found through GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR. The Dockerfile and devcontainer build on the author's ghidra-python image and pin pyghidra 2.2.1 for Ghidra 11; CI runs pytest in that image for the latest Ghidra and for 11.3, 11.3.2 and 11.4.2. SAST scanning needs Semgrep, installed with the sast extra.

Binaries to decompile are the analyst's own; symbol lookups contact the listed public symbol servers unless --skip-symbols is set. The tests bundle tests/data/afd.sys.10.0.22621.1415, a Microsoft Windows driver build also used in the README examples, an AArch64 ls binary and an ntddk_64.gdt data-type archive; these files keep their publishers' terms.

The README presents the output as decompilations for research and analysis and makes no recompilation claim; the tests check function counts, call graphs, one signature after GDT application, BSim and SAST output. GPL-3.0 (LICENSE); Ghidra and Semgrep keep their own licenses.

name: arkdecompiler
description_en: Decompiler for HarmonyOS NEXT apps, published under the jd-opensource GitHub organization, that turns Panda binary files (.abc Ark bytecode) back into ArkTS source. Its xabc program parses the bytecode, lifts it into the Ark compiler's Panda IR for analysis, rebuilds an ArkTS syntax tree with loop, class, lexical-environment and module-variable reconstruction, and prints that tree as ArkTS code. A cross-platform GUI, built with either Electron or Tauri, adds a file explorer, function and symbol lists, cross-references, search and a hex view; the README links Black Hat Arsenal presentations from 2025 and 2026.
description_zh: 面向 HarmonyOS NEXT（纯血鸿蒙）应用的反编译器，发布于 jd-opensource GitHub 组织下，可将 Panda 二进制文件（.abc 方舟字节码）还原为 ArkTS 源码。其 xabc 程序解析字节码，将其提升为方舟编译器的 Panda IR 以便分析，再通过循环、类、词法环境和模块变量的重建生成 ArkTS 语法树，最后输出为 ArkTS 代码。跨平台图形界面可基于 Electron 或 Tauri 构建，提供文件浏览、函数与符号列表、交叉引用、搜索和十六进制视图；README 链接了 2025 年和 2026 年的 Black Hat Arsenal 展示。
requirements: Reviewed at the 2026-07-23 master commit. The README marks all instructions as supported and a basic GUI as done, while covering enough corner cases from the official compiler and test262 is still in progress. Release v0.1.0 (2026-04-23) attaches Electron and Tauri GUI builds for Linux x86, macOS arm64 and Windows x86; decompilation runs only on Linux and disassembly on all three, and the GUI needs the paths of the command-line tools configured first.

Building xabc is tested on Ubuntu 22.04 inside an OpenHarmony arkcompiler standalone build: scripts/prepare.sh installs the repo tool, syncs the ark-standalone-build manifest from Gitee, downloads its prebuilts and checks out OpenHarmony v6.0.0.1-Release, and the files in patches/ must be applied to arkcompiler runtime_core, ets_frontend and third_party/protobuf before gn and ninja build xabc. The Dockerfile instead uses Ubuntu 20.04 and the OpenHarmony 5.1.0 release.

xabc reads one .abc file and writes ArkTS plus an AST dump, defaulting to demo.abc and arkdemo.ts. The documented workflow compiles the user's own demo.ts with OpenHarmony's es2abc and decompiles the result; any other bytecode must come from the user's own app packages, and the repository ships no apps or .abc samples.

tests/ holds 18 TypeScript samples for features such as classes, loops, generators, async functions and modules. autotests/scantstests.py compiles cases from the test262 and OpenHarmony TypeScript submodules and records whether decompilation exits cleanly, fails, crashes or times out, with a blacklist of skipped cases. No pass rates or semantic-equivalence results are reported, and the repository has no CI workflow.
Apache-2.0; the OpenHarmony components it builds against keep their own licenses.

name: Vivisect
description_en: Pure-Python reverse-engineering framework that combines the vivisect static analyzer, the vtrace debugging library and the vdb debugger. Vivisect loads PE, ELF, Mach-O, Intel HEX, S-record and raw blob files into workspaces, disassembles and emulates code through envi architecture modules for x86, AMD64, ARM, Thumb, AArch64, MSP430, H8 and Z80, and adds symbolic execution, a Qt GUI and a remote workspace server. vtrace drives processes on Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, macOS and Solaris and has GDB-stub and VMware backends.
description_zh: 纯 Python 编写的逆向工程框架，集成了 vivisect 静态分析器、vtrace 调试库和 vdb 调试器。Vivisect 可将 PE、ELF、Mach-O、Intel HEX、S-record 和原始数据块文件载入工作区，借助 envi 架构模块对 x86、AMD64、ARM、Thumb、AArch64、MSP430、H8 和 Z80 代码进行反汇编和模拟执行，并提供符号执行、Qt 图形界面和远程工作区服务器。vtrace 可在 Windows、Linux、FreeBSD、macOS 和 Solaris 上控制进程，另有 GDB stub 和 VMware 后端。
requirements: Latest release at review: 1.3.2, uploaded to PyPI on 2026-03-31 from tag v1.3.2 (the project publishes no GitHub release pages); it requires Python 3.8+ and pins PyQt5 5.15.7 for the GUI, and AArch64 support arrived in 1.3.0. The reviewed master commit (2026-09-03) is ten commits later and, still labelled 1.3.2, requires Python 3.11+ and PyQt6 6.5+. Install with pip install "vivisect[gui]"; releases before 1.0.0 are Python 2 only, and Python 2 workspaces are typically not loadable in Python 3.

Bundled helper libraries: vtrace/platforms/windll holds Microsoft’s dbghelp.dll and symsrv.dll for amd64 and i386, committed since 2014 and loaded by the Windows vtrace backend for symbol handling, and pyproject.toml packages them into the PyPI distribution. They are Microsoft binaries under Microsoft’s terms, not the project’s Apache-2.0 license, and no Microsoft license or notice accompanies them. The macOS backend ships a prebuilt machhelper.dylib next to its C source and Makefile.

Input is binaries or firmware images the user supplies. CircleCI runs the unittest suite on Python 3.11 against sample binaries from a separately cloned vivtestfiles repository, and a GitHub Actions workflow checks formatting; documentation is on Read the Docs.
Apache-2.0 license (COPYRIGHT names invisigoth, 2014); the Microsoft DLLs keep their own terms.

name: JNIAnalyzer
description_en: A Ghidra extension by Terry Chia (Ayrx) with scripts for analyzing the native libraries of Android NDK apps. JNIAnalyzer.java uses the bundled JADX decompiler to extract the signatures of all native methods declared in an APK and applies the return types, parameter names and parameter types to the matching functions in the loaded .so. RegisterNatives.java uses Ghidra's P-Code API to find RegisterNatives calls and lay down the JNINativeMethod structures for dynamically registered methods, and TraceRegisterNatives.java applies the output of the author's trace_registernatives tool. A JNI data-type archive sets up the jni.h types.
description_zh: Terry Chia（Ayrx）编写的 Ghidra 扩展，包含用于分析 Android NDK 应用原生库的脚本。JNIAnalyzer.java 使用随附的 JADX 反编译器从 APK 中提取所有原生方法的签名，并把返回类型、参数名和参数类型应用到已加载 .so 中的匹配函数。RegisterNatives.java 借助 Ghidra 的 P-Code API 查找 RegisterNatives 调用，为动态注册的方法铺设 JNINativeMethod 结构；TraceRegisterNatives.java 则应用作者 trace_registernatives 工具的输出。随附的 JNI 数据类型归档用于设置 jni.h 类型。
requirements: Reviewed at master 7170ce6 (2023-01-02); there are no releases and the default branch has had no commits since that date, so treat it as unmaintained and check compatibility with current Ghidra. Build the extension with Gradle against a Ghidra install (gradle -PGHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR=<dir>), then install the produced zip through Ghidra's Install Extensions dialog and restart.

Analysis runs inside Ghidra on an Android native library the analyst has loaded and is authorized to examine. JNIAnalyzer.java reads a supplied APK with JADX to recover native-method signatures; the README warns it overwrites existing function return types and parameter names and types, and that a function annotated JNIAnalyzer:IGNORE is skipped. RegisterNatives.java is marked experimental.

No third-party target files are committed. The repository vendors its Java build dependencies as JARs under JNIAnalyzer/lib/, including JADX, smali/baksmali, dexlib2, dx, apksig, Guava, ANTLR, RxJava, logback and others, each keeping its own open-source license; the committed android-5.1.jar is a 4-entry stub (a single android/R$style class plus JADX resources), not the Android SDK. The Gradle wrapper JAR is also committed, and data/jni_all.gdt is a Ghidra data-type archive of the JNI types.

The repository has no license file, so reuse terms are unstated; the vendored dependency JARs remain under their respective licenses. A Binary Ninja port exists in the author's separate binja-JNIAnalyzer repository.

name: IMSProg
description_en: Qt desktop programmer that reads, writes, erases and verifies I2C, SPI and MicroWire EEPROMs, FeRAM, DataFlash and SPI NOR/NAND flash chips through low-cost CH341A, CH347T and FT232H USB programmers. It identifies SPI flash by JEDEC ID against an editable chip database, shows SFDP, status and security registers, scans NAND bad blocks, and keeps the chip image in a hex-editor buffer that can save or load parts of the image and import or export Intel HEX. Companion programs edit the chip database and update it from the author's web server.
description_zh: 基于 Qt 的桌面编程器，通过低成本的 CH341A、CH347T 和 FT232H USB 编程器读取、写入、擦除和校验 I2C、SPI 与 MicroWire EEPROM、FeRAM、DataFlash 以及 SPI NOR/NAND 闪存芯片。它根据 JEDEC ID 在可编辑的芯片数据库中识别 SPI 闪存，显示 SFDP、状态寄存器和安全寄存器，可扫描 NAND 坏块，并把芯片镜像放在十六进制编辑缓冲区中，支持按区段保存或载入以及导入导出 Intel HEX。配套程序用于编辑芯片数据库，并从作者的网站更新数据库。
requirements: Latest release at review: v1.9.1, published 2026-09-04 with a Flatpak and a macOS arm64 build; the ChangeLog says it added FT232H v1.2 support. The reviewed main commit is 41 commits ahead, mostly macOS packaging and path fixes. README lists Debian, Fedora, openSUSE, AUR, ALT, ROSA and RED OS packages and an Ubuntu PPA; a Windows build is maintained separately by a third party.

Builds with CMake, g++ or clang, Qt5 or Qt6 with the Linguist tools, libusb 1.0, libftdi, pkg-config and udev on Linux, where README says Debian before 11 and Ubuntu before 20.04 are unsupported, or with Homebrew packages and the Xcode command-line tools on macOS. build_all.sh compiles and installs the programmer, database editor and updater with the udev rules and chip database. CI builds Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04 DEB packages, a Fedora 44 RPM checked with rpmlint and a macOS 15 build; no automated tests are published.

Needs one of the supported USB programmers and, per README, adapters for 93xxx MicroWire, 45xxx DataFlash, WSON-8 SPI NAND and 1.8 V chips. CH347 devices do not support MicroWire, and Verify and Check erase do not skip bad blocks on NAND chips. Images come from the user's own chips; the repository holds no firmware dumps, only its IMSProg.Dat chip database, which the updater downloads from the author's antenna-dvb-t2.ru site.

GPL-3.0-or-later per README, with SNANDer-derived parts under GPL-2.0+, QHexEdit2 under LGPL-2.1 and CH347 code under BSD-1-Clause. IMSProg transfers chip contents only; analysing a dump needs other tools.

name: rbasefind
description_en: Multithreaded Rust command-line tool that brute-forces the load address of a flat 32-bit firmware image, reimplementing mncoppola's basefind.py and rsaxvc's basefind.cpp. It records the offsets of ASCII strings, reads every 32-bit word as a possible pointer, and ranks candidate base addresses by how many strings each one would turn into pointer targets. The README calls it a simple heuristic that works rather well on some ARM (non-Thumb) binaries and will not work miracles.
description_zh: 一个多线程 Rust 命令行工具，以暴力搜索推算平面 32 位固件镜像的加载基址，是 mncoppola 的 basefind.py 和 rsaxvc 的 basefind.cpp 的重新实现。它记录 ASCII 字符串的偏移，把每个 32 位字都当作可能的指针，再按候选基址能让多少字符串成为指针目标来排序。README 称这只是一个简单的启发式方法，对部分 ARM（非 Thumb）二进制效果相当好，但不会创造奇迹。
requirements: Latest tag at review: v0.1.3, on the reviewed master commit of 2020-09-27, with no GitHub release binaries and no crates.io package. Build it from source with Cargo; Cargo.toml declares no edition and Cargo.lock is ignored, so dependencies such as clap 2.33 and regex 1.3 resolve within their version ranges at build time. The README's TODO lists an automatic mode that would detect endianness and narrow the offset around the best match.

Input is a flat 32-bit image supplied by the user, little-endian by default or big-endian with -b; no firmware or samples are included. By default it takes NUL-terminated printable ASCII strings of at least 10 characters, reads 4-byte-aligned words from the start of the file as pointers, and tests candidate bases every 0x1000 bytes across the 32-bit address space, splitting the range across one thread per CPU core. The whole file is loaded into memory.

Results are a ranked list of candidate bases with match counts, 10 by default, that the analyst must confirm. The README's example takes about 41 seconds on 8 threads for one image and shows that raising the minimum string length to 100 cuts the time at some cost in accuracy. Unit tests cover only the address-range split between threads, and there is no CI.
MIT License (2017, Scott Gayou). Analyzed firmware keeps its own terms.

name: Link Pi ENCx encoders (unofficial documentation)
description_en: A single-README notebook, kept since 2021 by an owner with no ties to the vendor, on the internals of LinkPi ENC-series video encoders and the TBS 2603SE, which share one firmware line; the author's first units use the F3520D board with a HiSilicon Hi3520DV400. It covers the Linux system and PHP web interface, undocumented features and internal pages, intercom and tally interfaces, default accounts and network services with hardening steps, HiSilicon media-pipeline diagnostics, board pinouts including the UART, firmware recovery, and translated release notes for firmware updates from 2020 to 2026.
description_zh: 一份自 2021 年起维护的单 README 笔记，作者是与厂商无关的设备用户，记录 LinkPi ENC 系列视频编码器和 TBS 2603SE 的内部结构；这些设备共用同一条固件线，作者最初的设备采用搭载 HiSilicon Hi3520DV400 的 F3520D 主板。内容涵盖 Linux 系统与 PHP 网页界面、未公开功能和内部页面、对讲与 tally 接口、默认账户与网络服务及加固步骤、HiSilicon 媒体管线诊断、包括 UART 在内的主板引脚定义、固件恢复，以及 2020 至 2026 年固件更新的翻译版发布说明。
requirements: The reviewed main commit, of 2026-07-13, added release notes for firmware 5.2.0 (build 20260531). Findings come from the author's and contributors' own devices; several sections are marked outdated, the release notes are machine-translated from Chinese, and the README says TinyENC1 appears to ship different firmware that the author has not examined.

The procedures need the reader's own encoder and shell access to it. Firmware upgrade and full-flash packages come only from LinkPi's official download pages; none are committed. The repository's only other file is v4l2-ctl, a prebuilt ARM uClibc build of the V4L2 control utility added in 2021 without source or a license notice.

The README lists the vendor's default credentials and exposed services as a security warning, says LinkPi did not answer the author's reports, and gives hardening steps. A 2026 update credits AI for in-progress LD_PRELOAD timestamp hooks.
There is no license file, so the notes state no reuse terms; LinkPi firmware, software and documentation keep the vendor's rights.

name: BinAssist
description_en: Binary Ninja plugin by Jason Tang, who also wrote GhidrAssist and IDAssist, that adds a BinAssist sidebar for LLM-assisted analysis of the open binary. Its tabs explain functions at the LLIL, MLIL and HLIL levels and individual instructions, keep chats with context macros, MCP tool calling and an optional ReAct agent mode, propose function and variable renames, retypes and structures with confidence scores for review before they are applied, and build a semantic graph of functions and calls with community detection and source-to-sink taint paths, alongside retrieval over reference documents the analyst adds. A SymGraph tab imports and publishes names, graph data and documents through the hosted symgraph.ai service.
description_zh: 由 GhidrAssist 与 IDAssist 作者 Jason Tang 开发的 Binary Ninja 插件，在侧边栏加入 BinAssist 面板，借助大语言模型分析当前打开的二进制。各标签页可在 LLIL、MLIL 和 HLIL 层级解释函数，也能解释单条指令；保存支持上下文宏、MCP 工具调用和可选 ReAct 智能体模式的对话；为函数和变量提出带置信度评分的重命名、类型修改及结构体建议，并在审阅后应用；还能构建涵盖函数与调用关系的语义图谱，进行社区检测并查找从输入源到危险调用点的污点路径，同时可检索分析人员添加的参考文档。SymGraph 标签页则通过托管的 symgraph.ai 服务导入和发布名称、图谱数据及文档。
requirements: Latest release at review: 2.1.0, published 2026-05-25 as a source-only GitHub release without notes; the reviewed master commit is four commits later and adds a default Claude Code CLI path on macOS and updated model guidance. plugin.json requires Binary Ninja build 5000 or later and lists Linux, Windows and macOS, while the README gives both 4000 and 5000 as the minimum; the README names Linux as the primary development platform and calls Windows and macOS less tested. The packages in requirements.txt, including openai, anthropic, mcp 1.23.3 and whoosh, plus pywin32 on Windows, are installed into Binary Ninja's Python, and a separate Windows guide covers installing them into its user site-packages.

Analysis needs at least one configured LLM provider. The provider types cover Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini and xAI API keys, OpenAI and Gemini subscription sign-in through OAuth, the local Claude Code CLI, a LiteLLM proxy for services such as AWS Bedrock and Azure, and local Ollama, LM Studio or Open WebUI endpoints; the documentation's provider tables also list an Anthropic OAuth type that the source does not define. Explanations, chats, Actions, agent runs and the graph's Semantic Analysis step send code from the binary to the active provider, so only a local or self-hosted endpoint keeps it on the machine, while the documentation describes re-indexing, Security Analysis and community detection without the model. The settings documentation places the analysis and RLHF feedback SQLite databases and the RAG index in a .binaryninja/binassist folder of the user's home directory, with analysis results keyed by the binary's SHA-256.

Programs come from the user's own Binary Ninja sessions; the plugin supplies no target binaries. Actions suggestions are applied only for the rows the user selects. Chats can reach MCP servers over streamable HTTP or SSE or launch them over stdio, and the documentation recommends the author's separate BinAssistMCP server for Binary Ninja analysis tools. In the Query tab, calls to tools whose names do not look read-only wait for an allow-once, allow-for-session or deny decision unless the chat accepts all tools, and this classification relies on tool-name keywords.

The SymGraph tab looks up the binary by SHA-256 without a key, but importing, publishing and uploading need a SymGraph API key, and publishing uploads the raw binary bytes, not the .bndb database, when the service does not already hold them. The repository has no tests or CI workflows. MIT, per LICENSE and plugin.json; Binary Ninja, model providers and SymGraph keep their own terms. The repository moved from jtang613/BinAssist.

name: Supplementary AST-Based Deobfuscation Materials
description_en: Companion code for the ReverseJS blog's 2022 series on deobfuscating JavaScript by manipulating abstract syntax trees with Babel. Each folder pairs a small obfuscated sample with a deobfuscator script and its output, covering string concealing (escape sequences, concatenation, string arrays and string encryption), constant folding including JSFuck-style code, substitution of constant variables, bracket-to-dot property access, dead-code removal, proxy functions and sequence expressions. The README presents them as short learning examples rather than a production deobfuscator.
description_zh: ReverseJS 博客 2022 年系列文章的配套代码，该系列讲解如何借助 Babel 操作抽象语法树来反混淆 JavaScript。每个目录都包含一个小型混淆样例、对应的反混淆脚本及其输出，主题涵盖字符串隐藏（转义序列、字符串拼接、字符串数组和字符串加密）、常量折叠（含 JSFuck 风格代码）、常量变量替换、方括号属性访问改为点号访问、死代码删除、代理函数以及逗号序列表达式。README 将其定位为简短的学习示例，而非可用于生产的反混淆工具。
requirements: Reviewed at the 2023-10-20 master commit, whose last change bumped @babel/traverse to 7.23.2. The blog lists seven posts in the series from May and June 2022, and folders such as Proxy Functions and Sequence Expressions have no matching post; the README warns that code not published on the blog is outdated and experimental, may be inaccurate or buggy, will likely not be updated and should not be used in a production deobfuscator.

Needs Node.js and npm install: package.json declares @babel/core and js-beautify, and the lockfile resolves @babel/parser, @babel/traverse and @babel/generator 7.23.x. Each script is run with node from its folder against the bundled sample. The String Encryption example also imports chrome-remote-interface-extra, which package.json does not list.

The samples are short, author-written obfuscations, so applying the techniques to other code needs the analyst's own inputs and checking. The VM-evaluation proxy-function example and the String Encryption example run code from the sample through Node's vm module, which Node.js documents as not a security mechanism. The author's later blog post reports CVE-2023-45133, an arbitrary-code-execution flaw in @babel/traverse before 7.23.2; the reviewed lockfile already resolves 7.23.2.
There are no tests or CI (the npm test script is a placeholder); expected outputs are committed beside each sample.
MIT (LICENSE), although package.json keeps npm's default ISC field.

name: Cabana (standalone openpilot-cabana)
description_en: Qt desktop CAN and CAN FD analyzer for decoding signals and reverse engineering unknown messages, split out of openpilot's cabana by Dean Lee, a frequent contributor to it, and now maintained on its own. It shows live per-bit change heatmaps, colors bytes by trend such as counters, toggles or noisy data, searches for signals by value or for bits that change together across messages and buses, mutes known bits, plots signals and edits DBC files with undo, while replaying openpilot drives with synchronized camera video. Sources are openpilot routes, Vector ASC, candump and PEAK TRC logs, SocketCAN, comma.ai Panda devices and live streams from a comma device, with a bundled set of opendbc DBC files.
description_zh: 基于 Qt 的桌面 CAN 与 CAN FD 分析工具，用于解码信号和逆向分析未知报文；由 openpilot cabana 的活跃贡献者 Dean Lee 从 openpilot 中独立出来，现单独维护。它实时显示逐位变化热图，按计数器、切换位、噪声数据等趋势为字节着色，可按数值搜索信号或查找在不同报文和总线间同步变化的位，屏蔽已知位，绘制信号曲线，并以可撤销方式编辑 DBC 文件，同时能回放 openpilot 行车记录并同步显示摄像头视频。数据来源包括 openpilot 行车记录、Vector ASC、candump 和 PEAK TRC 日志、SocketCAN、comma.ai Panda 设备以及来自 comma 设备的实时流，并附带一组 opendbc DBC 文件。
requirements: The repository was created on 2025-12-30; its README says Cabana was originally developed as openpilot's CAN analysis tool and is now maintained independently, while openpilot still carries its own cabana under openpilot/tools/cabana. Latest release at review: v1.1.2, published 2026-03-16 as a Linux x86_64 tarball; the reviewed main commit, of 2026-06-09, is 66 commits ahead of it.

Source builds use SCons, a C++20 compiler and Qt 6 with Charts, SVG, SerialBus and OpenGL, plus capnproto, ZeroMQ, FFmpeg, libusb and the other Ubuntu/Debian packages the README lists, after initializing the openpilot-replay submodule from the same author. The README also names an AUR package for Arch Linux; SConstruct has a macOS arm64 branch, but the release workflow builds only on Ubuntu 22.04.

Analysis needs the user's own CAN data: logs or live buses from their own vehicle and interface, a Panda, or openpilot routes from their own comma device or comma connect account; --demo opens a demo route instead. The tool highlights candidate bits and signals.
MIT (LICENSE, copyright 2025 Dean Lee); the openpilot-replay submodule is also MIT, and data/opendbc holds 93 DBC files from comma.ai's MIT-licensed opendbc.

name: Awesome RE-MCP
description_en: A single-README list, written in July 2025, of 28 MCP servers for reverse-engineering tools, grouped into disassemblers and decompilers (IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja and others), debuggers, static and dynamic analysis, network analysis, Android and security testing, with a one-line note per entry. It also names tools the author found without an MCP server, links four talks and guides, and points to starting material for writing new servers.
description_zh: 以单个 README 维护的清单，编写于 2025 年 7 月，收录 28 个逆向工程工具的 MCP 服务器，按反汇编器与反编译器（IDA Pro、Ghidra、Binary Ninja 等）、调试器、静态与动态分析、网络分析、Android 和安全测试分组，每项附一句说明。清单还列出作者认为尚无 MCP 服务器的工具，链接四个演讲与教程，并给出编写新服务器的入门资料。
requirements: All seven commits were made on 2025-07-26 and the list has not changed since, so its entries, star counts and status remarks are a July 2025 snapshot. Some of its gap lists no longer hold: for example, it reports no WinDbg MCP server.

Rows give a name, link and short description without language, transport, maintenance status or license, although the contribution guidelines ask submitters for implementation status and transport. One debugger row links a PulseMCP directory page rather than a project.
The network and security-testing entries, such as a collection wrapping SQLMap, Nmap and other scanners, are dual-use tools. The list itself has no tests or verification of its entries.
The README says the list is released under the MIT license, but the repository has no license file and GitHub detects none. An independent discovery list.

name: RE list (extremecoders-re)
description_en: A single-README list of 71 open-source reverse-engineering tools with a focus on binary analysis, kept as one alphabetical list from Amoco to X86isa. Each entry gives the tool's name, a link and a one- to three-sentence description; the entries span binary analysis frameworks, lifters to LLVM and other intermediate representations, symbolic execution and emulation engines, dynamic instrumentation, whole-system and virtual-machine introspection platforms, decompilers, debugger front ends and deobfuscation tools.
description_zh: 以单个 README 维护的开源逆向工程工具清单，侧重二进制分析，共 71 项，按字母顺序从 Amoco 排到 X86isa，不分类别。每个条目给出工具名称、链接和一到三句说明，涵盖二进制分析框架、提升到 LLVM 及其他中间表示的工具、符号执行与模拟引擎、动态插桩、全系统分析与虚拟机自省平台、反编译器、调试器前端以及去混淆工具。
requirements: The reviewed README, last changed on 2024-04-16 when Cannoli was added, links 71 entries in one alphabetical list without categories; the repository's 56 commits since October 2017 mostly add one tool at a time. These are list rows.

Entries give only a name, a link and a short description: 56 point to GitHub and 15 to project, university or vendor pages, such as Intel's Pin page and Tetrane's REVEN Free Edition page rather than source repositories. They state no maintenance status, supported platforms, license or date added.
The repository holds only README.md, with no license file or contribution guide, so the list states no reuse terms; linked tools keep their own licenses. An independent discovery list.

name: DJI MIMO BLE artifacts: reconstructing the DJI Osmo control protocol
description_en: Documents the Bluetooth Low Energy message format that DJI's proprietary MIMO app uses to control DJI Osmo devices, as artifacts produced while building the independent djictl CLI. The author derives the framing — a magic byte, length, protocol version, header CRC8, subsystem and message-id fields, a payload and a message CRC16 — from the author's own Android BLE logs, and ships a Wireshark dissector plus an annotated catalog of message types. Many message types are labelled as guesses or unknown; the author reports reaching working livestreaming on a DJI Osmo Pocket 3 and pausing further analysis.
description_zh: 记录 DJI 专有 MIMO 应用用于控制 DJI Osmo 设备的低功耗蓝牙报文格式，是作者在开发独立 CLI 工具 djictl 时产出的逆向工程素材。作者依据自己手机的蓝牙日志推断出报文结构——魔数、长度、协议版本、头部 CRC8、子系统与消息 ID 字段、载荷以及消息 CRC16——并提供一个 Wireshark 解析插件和一份带注释的消息类型目录。许多消息类型被标注为推测或未知；作者报告在 DJI Osmo Pocket 3 上实现了可用的直播推流后暂停了进一步分析。
requirements: Reviewed at the main-branch head of 2025-06-08. The repository is a set of reverse-engineering notes, not a runnable application: the companion tool djictl lives in a separate repository. The README describes a DJI Osmo Pocket 3.

The method uses the user's own Android phone: the README captures a Bluetooth HCI snoop log through an adb bug report, then opens it in Wireshark. No DJI firmware, app binary or account is committed to or required by this repository, and no captured log is included beyond one Wireshark screenshot.

mimo/ble/message_types.md lists annotated sample frames for about two dozen message types, and the Wireshark dissector in mimo/ble/wireshark-dissector/ maps message-type codes to names; many entries are marked with a question mark or as unknown, so the catalog is partial and author-interpreted rather than a complete specification.

Building the dissector needs Wireshark development headers and pkg-config on a system with a C compiler; its Makefile installs a shared-object plugin into the Wireshark 4.2 plugin directory. The notes record protocol observations only.
The repository is licensed CC0-1.0 (public-domain dedication). DJI, MIMO and Osmo remain trademarks of their owners.

name: Reversecore MCP
description_en: MCP server that puts radare2 with r2ghidra, LIEF, Capstone, YARA, CAPA, Detect It Easy, binwalk, angr, Volatility3, Scapy, Sleuth Kit and other engines behind 177 typed tools for AI clients such as Claude and Cursor. The tools cover disassembly and decompilation, binary parsing, string, IOC and capability extraction, ESIL emulation and symbolic execution, YARA scanning, memory, PCAP and disk forensics, source-code pattern scanning and session reports with MITRE ATT&CK mapping, alongside 22 guided analysis prompts and per-binary MCP resources. File access is confined to a configured sample workspace, and the server runs over stdio or HTTP/SSE, typically from the project's Docker image.
description_zh: MCP 服务器，将 radare2 及 r2ghidra、LIEF、Capstone、YARA、CAPA、Detect It Easy、binwalk、angr、Volatility3、Scapy、Sleuth Kit 等引擎封装为 177 个带类型的工具，供 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 客户端调用。工具涵盖反汇编与反编译、二进制解析、字符串、IOC 与能力提取、ESIL 模拟与符号执行、YARA 扫描、内存、PCAP 与磁盘取证、源码模式扫描，以及带 MITRE ATT&CK 映射的会话报告，另有 22 种引导式分析提示词和按二进制划分的 MCP 资源。文件访问限定在配置的样本工作目录内，服务器通过 stdio 或 HTTP/SSE 运行，通常使用项目提供的 Docker 镜像。
requirements: Latest release at review: v3.0.5, published 2026-09-28 on GitHub with a wheel, sdist, SBOMs and Sigstore bundles, on PyPI as reversecore-mcp and as a GHCR image. The reviewed main commit of 2026-10-17 is 147 commits ahead of that tag, while pyproject.toml still declares 3.0.5. The README's test and coverage figures (3,069 tests, 88%) are hard-coded badges and differ from the older counts in AGENTS.md.

Python 3.10–3.12, with angr installed only on Python 3.12. Local installs need radare2 on the PATH, plus Volatility3, Scapy and Sleuth Kit for forensics; the README recommends the Docker image, which bundles the engines, with x86 and Apple Silicon compose profiles. It lists Linux or macOS hosts or any Docker environment, at least 4 cores, 8 GB RAM and 20 GB storage; Redis backs the task queue and result cache, and an SQLite memory database keeps notes across sessions.

Binaries, memory images, PCAPs and disk images come from the analyst and are mounted into the workspace, where path validation confines tool access. Optional container sandboxing for dynamic-analysis tools is disabled by default, and HTTP mode accepts only loopback clients unless MCP_API_KEY is set. Some tools and prompts target exploit and PoC development.

CI runs linting, type checks, Bandit, pip-audit and CodeQL, unit tests on Python 3.10–3.12 with an 85% coverage gate, security-boundary, integration and MCP client end-to-end suites, and a wheel build-and-install check; ClusterFuzzLite and nightly fuzzing run separately. Test fixtures include small synthetic vulnerable C targets with seeds, proof-of-concept inputs and ASan logs, and scratch/binaries holds only a hello.c source.

MIT; the wrapped engines and the packages in the Docker image keep their own licenses. ORIGINAL_REQUEST.md records a 2026-08-22 brief asking an orchestrating agent to dispatch subagents for transport hardening, prompt expansion and output optimization, so parts of the code were developed with AI agents.

name: r2pipe
description_en: radare2's official scripting interface, with implementations for more than two dozen languages in one repository. Every binding sends radare2 command strings and returns their text output, the design behind r_core_cmd_str(), and the README recommends asking for JSON output and decoding it into native objects instead of using the C API. Bindings connect through the R2PIPE_IN/R2PIPE_OUT pipes of a script run from inside r2, a spawned r2 -q0 process, TCP, HTTP or radare2's RAP protocol, many offer asynchronous calls, and r2pipe scripts can also implement radare2 plugins such as disassemblers, IO backends or ESIL syscall handlers.
description_zh: radare2 官方的脚本接口，同一仓库内收录了二十多种语言的实现。所有绑定都向 radare2 发送命令字符串并返回其文本输出，这正是 r_core_cmd_str() 背后的设计；README 建议请求 JSON 输出并将其解码为本地语言对象，而不是直接调用 C API。绑定可经由从 r2 内部运行脚本时的 R2PIPE_IN/R2PIPE_OUT 管道、新启动的 r2 -q0 进程、TCP、HTTP 或 radare2 自有的 RAP 协议连接，其中许多支持异步调用；r2pipe 脚本还可用于实现反汇编器、IO 后端或 ESIL 系统调用处理器等 radare2 插件。
requirements: The newest GitHub release at review is 6.1.2, published 2026-04-20 as source only, and the reviewed master commit is 54 commits ahead of it; each language is also packaged separately. The Python package r2pipe 2.1.0 (Python 3.6+) was uploaded to PyPI on 2026-10-19, matching python/pyproject.toml, while npm's r2pipe was at 2.8.6 from 2024-01-16 and r2pipe-ts at 0.4.0. The Rust crate lives in the separate r2pipe.rs repository, and the README's capability table marks which backends each language supports.

Apart from the WebAssembly variant, every binding talks to a radare2 process, either spawned locally or reached as a TCP, HTTP or RAP server, and command strings and output formats follow the radare2 version in use. CI installs the radare2 6.1.4 Debian packages on Ubuntu 24.04 and tests the Perl, Python, TypeScript, Ruby, Tcl, Vala, Swift and .NET bindings.

python-wasm is a separate r2pipe_wasm package that runs radare2's wasi-api WebAssembly build inside Python through Wasmer's Python SDK 1.1.0, downloading the newest stable release with that asset by default. Its README verifies only CPython 3.9 on Linux x86_64, pins its examples to 6.1.4 and reports that the published 6.2.2 API module traps during startup.

GitHub detects no repository-wide license. The Python, Python WASM, Go, .NET, Haskell and Erlang directories carry MIT license files and the npm packages declare MIT. Binaries to analyze come from the user, and the TypeScript tests bundle one fixture, typescript/tests/fixtures/wasm-api.wasm.

name: Aptio V UEFI Editor
description_en: Browser-based editor for the setup menus of AMI Aptio V UEFI firmware, offered as an alternative to AMIBCP. From four sections the user takes from their own BIOS image, it rebuilds the setup forms and their references and shows each setting's VarStore, offset, size, options, failsafe and optimal defaults, access level and Suppress If conditions. Changes to top-level menu targets, suppressions, access levels and defaults are written back into the section files with a change log, and a session can be saved as hash-checked JSON; a separate IFR-Formatter.js script condenses IFRExtractor-RS output into a per-setting VarStore and offset listing.
description_zh: 在浏览器中运行的 AMI Aptio V UEFI 固件设置菜单编辑器，作为 AMIBCP 的替代工具。它根据使用者从自己的 BIOS 镜像中取得的四个区段重建设置表单及其引用关系，并显示每个设置项的 VarStore、偏移、大小、选项、故障安全和最优默认值、访问级别以及 Suppress If 条件。对顶层菜单目标、隐藏条件、访问级别和默认值的修改会写回区段文件并附带变更日志，会话可另存为带哈希校验的 JSON；另附的 IFR-Formatter.js 脚本可将 IFRExtractor-RS 的输出整理为按设置项列出 VarStore 与偏移的清单。
requirements: Reviewed master commit 44e8c9b (2026-03-15, hash-check changes); the previous source change was in April 2025. There are no releases or tags: the app, version 0.1.0 in its source, is served from GitHub Pages by a workflow that builds it with Node 20, npm ci and Vite. Building locally uses the React, Mantine and TypeScript package.json scripts.

Inputs come from the user's own Aptio V UEFI image, found with UEFITool NE: the Setup PE32 image section, its text output from IFRExtractor-RS 1.6.1 (the only version the editor accepts), the AMITSE PE32 image section and the setupdata body. The page reads them in the browser, rejects non-UEFI IFR output, and checks saved JSON against the files' SHA-256 hashes. The repository includes no firmware images or extracted sections, only screenshots of the tools.
README says the modified files are put back with UEFITool 0.28.0 and that setting visibility methods vary between firmware, so either may need trying.
The repository has no license file, and package.json marks the package private, so reuse terms are not stated. No automated tests are published.

name: DiztinGUIsh
description_en: Windows disassembler for Super NES ROMs in which the user marks bytes as code or data, steps through 65816 code while the tool tracks the M and X flags and the data bank and direct page registers, adds labels and comments, and exports assembly for the asar assembler that the README says compiles back into the original binary. Execution context can come from BizHawk or BSNES trace logs, BSNES usage maps and BizHawk code/data logs, or live capture over a socket from a custom bsnes-plus build. Project files keep the annotations in merge-friendly XML with a link and checksum for the ROM rather than the ROM itself, so several people can work on one disassembly.
description_zh: 面向 Super NES ROM 的 Windows 反汇编工具：使用者把字节标记为代码或数据，逐步跟踪 65816 代码，工具同时记录 M、X 标志位以及数据库（data bank）和直接页寄存器；使用者添加标签和注释后，可导出供 asar 汇编器使用的汇编代码，README 称其能重新编译回原始二进制。执行上下文可来自 BizHawk 或 BSNES 的跟踪日志、BSNES 使用情况图和 BizHawk 代码/数据日志，也可通过套接字从定制的 bsnes-plus 版本实时采集。项目文件以便于合并的 XML 保存注释，只记录 ROM 的链接和校验和而不包含 ROM 本身，便于多人协作完成同一份反汇编。
requirements: Latest release at review: v2.5.1.0, published 2025-12-07 as a self-contained Windows x64 build; the reviewed master commit of 2026-08-09 is 106 commits later and adds, among other changes, Avalonia versions of several dialogs and a second Diz.AvaloniaUI-Beta executable. The WinForms app targets net10.0-windows, and CI builds, tests and publishes it on Windows with the .NET 10 SDK, while contributing.md still asks for Windows 10+ and .NET SDK 8 or higher.

Input is a SNES ROM file the user supplies; the repository includes no ROMs. HELP.md says project files (.diz, which is gzip-compressed XML, or uncompressed .dizraw) store a link to the ROM with its internal name and checksum instead of the ROM, so they can be shared without it. Live trace capture needs the custom bsnes-plus build from binary1230/bsnes-plus, which listens on port 27015, rather than stock BSNES+, and the README suggests an asar fork with a relative-addressing fix.

The test project bundles small .asm samples, a 4 MB binary trace-log fixture (ct-binary-tracelog7.758s-60fps-locked.bin) from a 7.8-second emulator capture that only commented-out performance-test code references, and SuperFamicheck 1.0's superfamicheck.exe as a helper; tools/dizpack holds Python packing scripts and tools/dizpack-game/ct a Chrono Trigger (US) LZSS codec. Disassembly depends on the user's marking and stepping: the README says the program pauses for input whenever it cannot disassemble accurately, and lists SPC700 and SuperFX support as planned. CI runs the repository's xUnit tests, but no per-game results confirm that exported assembly rebuilds the original.

GPL-3.0 per LICENSE.md, with third-party library licenses listed in Diz.App.Winforms/dist/docs. Exported assembly contains the ROM's code and data and remains subject to the rights of the game's owner.

name: awesome-te
description_en: A public-domain directory, started in June 2026, of hacking projects for Teenage Engineering devices: custom firmware, reverse-engineering notes and protocol documentation, tools, hardware mods, teardown and recovery guides and community hubs for the OP-1, OP-Z, OP-XY, TP-7, SP-1 Stem Player, EP series, Pocket Operators and other gear. One-line entries are grouped by device and task, each with a maintainer-assigned active, dormant or archived marker, and the scope rule admits only released, TE-specific projects.
description_zh: 一份进入公有领域的目录，始建于 2026 年 6 月，收录 Teenage Engineering 设备的破解与改造项目：涵盖 OP-1、OP-Z、OP-XY、TP-7、SP-1 Stem Player、EP 系列、Pocket Operator 等设备的自定义固件、逆向笔记与协议文档、工具、硬件改装、拆解与恢复指南以及社区站点。每个条目只有一行，按设备和用途分组，并由维护者标注活跃、休眠或归档状态；收录范围仅限已发布、专门针对 TE 设备的项目。
requirements: The reviewed README, committed 2026-10-20 and marked as last reviewed that day, has 195 status-marked rows under 11 device sections and a cross-device section, some of them bundling several links: 136 marked active, 56 dormant and 3 archived. Under the contribution guide the marker reflects activity in the past 12 months; the weekly lychee workflow only checks that links resolve.

Entries mix open-source projects, commercial apps and forum, wiki and repair pages, ranging from SysEx, file-transfer and file-format documentation to Ghidra Blackfin support, and include a few AI tools such as an SP-1 reference packaged as a Claude agent skill and an MCP server for the OP-1 field. Several firmware and flashing entries warn that they erase stored data or can brick a device.

A few rows point to unofficial mirrors of OP-1 and OP-1 field firmware and to an OP-1 firmware decryptor; the list itself recommends Teenage Engineering's official downloads. Device firmware keeps its vendor's terms, and each linked project keeps its own license.
The list and its contributions are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0. An independent discovery list.

name: FirmLoader
description_en: IDA plugin that applies a microcontroller's memory map to a raw firmware image: once the analyst picks an MCU model, it creates RAM and other memory segments, adds peripheral segments with named registers and, where a vector table is described, labels its entries and turns the handlers they point to into functions. The README compares it to IDA's built-in SVD loader, but it uses a simpler JSON description that can be written by hand from public datasheets. The reviewed commit bundles 813 descriptions for Microchip/Atmel, ST, NXP, TI, Silicon Labs and other MCUs.
description_zh: 为原始微控制器固件镜像套用芯片内存布局的 IDA 插件：分析者选定 MCU 型号后，它会创建 RAM 等内存段，添加带有寄存器命名的外设段，并在描述文件包含中断向量表时标注各表项，把它们指向的处理程序创建为函数。README 称其类似 IDA 内置的 SVD 加载器，但采用更简单的 JSON 描述格式，可依据公开的数据手册手工编写。所审阅提交附带 813 个描述文件，涵盖 Microchip/Atmel、ST、NXP、TI、Silicon Labs 等厂商的 MCU。
requirements: The only release is tag 1.0, titled “IDA 8.X” and published 2024-12-05; it points to a February 2024 commit. The reviewed main commit 5c9c1a1, the last change on 2024-12-05, is four commits ahead: a contributed pull request adds IDA 9.0 support and another adds an STM32L4x1 SRAM2 segment.

Installed by copying firmloader.py and the firmloader_data folder into IDA's plugins directory; it needs IDA with IDAPython, and the plugin code uses Python 3.8+ syntax. The analyst loads the image at the base address the processor documentation gives, renames the main code segment to ROM and chooses the model under Edit > FirmLoader; applying it marks the ROM segment for IDA auto-analysis.

Input is a firmware image the analyst has already read out of a microcontroller; the repository contains no firmware, only the plugin, MCU description JSON files, a data_template.json and two README images. Of the 813 descriptions, 812 are 32-bit; the 16-bit ATmega328 one lists no peripherals, and four for SPC5 and AURIX TC27x parts have no vector table; README says that where a series has several memory sizes, every unit was generated with the largest RAM. Other MCUs need a hand-written description.
Apache-2.0. README names SPC560B64x as a purely hand-written description and otherwise presents the files as a supplement to SVD data without documenting how they were generated.

name: Cat Printer BLE: reconstructing the MXW01 thermal printer protocol
description_en: Replaces the vendor phone app for the MXW01 “cat printer”, a small Bluetooth Low Energy thermal printer, with a Windows command-line client. The author reports starting from the iOS-only Moblin implementation and then reverse-engineering the vendor's phone app further, and the client sends CRC8-checked commands to one GATT service while streaming 384-pixel image lines in 1-bit or 4-bit grayscale. Several command IDs remain marked as unknown, and the author tested only this one printer model.
description_zh: 以一个 Windows 命令行客户端替代 MXW01“猫猫打印机”（一款小型低功耗蓝牙热敏打印机）的厂商手机应用。作者称以仅支持 iOS 的 Moblin 实现为起点，再进一步逆向厂商的手机应用；该客户端向一个 GATT 服务发送带 CRC8 校验的命令，并以 1 位或 4 位灰度传输每行 384 像素的图像数据。若干命令 ID 仍标为未知，作者也只测试了这一款打印机。
requirements: Reviewed at the release 1.2.0 commit of 2025-05-22. The tool prints images with Bayer or Floyd–Steinberg dithering, feeds or retracts paper, and reads battery, paper, temperature and state information; README says it is not an editor and that other printer models are not planned because the author has none to test.

Requires the user's own MXW01 printer. The repository contains only original C# source and a photo; the vendor app the author analysed, any decompiled code and any traffic captures are not included, and no account or vendor software is needed at runtime.

Windows only: the project targets .NET 8 for Windows 10 build 19041 or later with native AOT publishing, using the InTheHand.BluetoothLE and SixLabors.ImageSharp packages; the README asks for the .NET 8 Runtime.

CatPrinter.cs names the GATT service and its command, notification and data characteristics and lists the command IDs, with comments marking several as unknown or guessed. The repository has no test suite or CI, so printing behaviour is author-reported.
MIT license.

name: JS-Deobfuscator (0x1Avram)
description_en: Node.js deobfuscator for JavaScript produced by Timofey Kachalov's javascript-obfuscator, also offered as obfuscator.io. It parses the sample with esprima and runs eleven stages named after the obfuscator's own, which remove injected self-defending and debug-protection code, unwind control-flow flattening and dead-code injection, restore converted literals and object keys, replace string-array calls with the decoded strings, simplify the result and recursively process code passed to eval. String-array code is detected automatically or supplied as separate files, and an Examples folder pairs original, obfuscated and deobfuscated samples.
description_zh: 面向 Timofey Kachalov 的 javascript-obfuscator（亦以 obfuscator.io 提供）所生成 JavaScript 的 Node.js 反混淆工具。它用 esprima 解析样本，依次运行十一个与该混淆器同名的阶段：移除注入的自我防护和调试保护代码，还原控制流平坦化和死代码注入，恢复被转换的字面量和对象键，把字符串数组调用替换为解码后的字符串，化简结果，并对传给 eval 的代码递归处理。字符串数组相关代码可自动识别，也可拆成单独文件输入；Examples 目录收录了原始、混淆后和反混淆后的成对样本。
requirements: Inactive since the reviewed main commit, a README update on 2023-04-17. The last release, 1.0.7 (2022-12-29), attaches binaries.zip with standalone Windows and Linux builds made with pkg, while package.json still reports 1.0.2. The README says it was developed with Node.js 16.15 and worked with obfuscator versions current at the time; output from older obfuscator versions may produce a different AST.

Run from source after npm install (esprima, escodegen, esquery, estraverse, winston and yargs) with node index.js -i input -o output. When automatic detection fails, the string array, its wrappers, the wrapper names and the rotate code are passed as separate files with -s, -w, -n and -r. esprima does not parse all newer JavaScript syntax, so the README suggests transpiling such input with Babel first.

The README warns that the code is not secure and should run only in an isolated environment such as a virtual machine: string-array decoding evaluates code taken from the sample with eval inside the deobfuscator's own Node.js process. The identifier- and property-renaming stages are empty placeholders, so obfuscated names are not recovered.

Supply the obfuscated script yourself. The Examples text files are derived from small snippets, javascript-obfuscator's example script (BSD-2-Clause) and javascript-algorithms (MIT), with both licenses included.
MIT (LICENSE). A different project from ben-sb javascript-deobfuscator, whose npm package is also named js-deobfuscator; this one is used from its repository or release binaries.

name: a0rfid: an open driver for A0-protocol UHF RFID readers
description_en: Reconstructs the A0 serial protocol of R2000-family 915 MHz UHF RFID desktop readers, which ship with only Windows software and an Android app, from the vendor app's native command encoder rather than its misleading Java SDK. A userspace CH340 driver, a Python CLI and GUI, and a small Android app then talk to the reader directly for inventory and tag-memory reads. docs/PROTOCOL.md records the frame layout, checksum, command table, response formats and the different field orders of READ and WRITE.
description_zh: 从厂商安卓应用的原生指令编码器（而非其具有误导性的 Java SDK）重建 R2000 系列 915 MHz UHF RFID 桌面读写头的 A0 串口协议；这类读写头原本只随附 Windows 软件和安卓应用。项目据此提供用户态 CH340 驱动、Python 命令行与图形界面，以及小型安卓应用，直接与读写头通信，进行标签盘存并读取标签存储区。docs/PROTOCOL.md 记录了帧格式、校验和、指令表、响应格式，以及 READ 与 WRITE 不同的字段顺序。
requirements: The reviewed main commit of 2026-09-17 is the second of two commits, with no tags or releases. docs/REVERSE.md describes decompiling the vendor APK, finding that the app bypasses its Java codec and calls libnative-lib.so through JNI, reading per-command field layouts from that library's rfid_encode() jump table, and then confirming the frames on hardware. The result is a protocol description and new host software; no reader firmware or vendor app is recovered, and the reader model is not named beyond the R2000 family.

Using the tools requires a compatible A0-protocol reader on its CH340 USB-UART at 115200 8N1, plus tags to test with. Repeating the analysis requires the vendor's own software package and manual, which are not included: REVERSE.md states that the repository contains no vendor code, only frames observed on the wire and code written from them. android/RFID助手.apk is the project's own prebuilt app, built from android/app by android/build.sh.

The Python tools need Python 3 with pyusb and pyserial. --port USB uses the bundled ch340_usb.py userspace driver, which on macOS needs Homebrew libusb; Linux can instead use the stock ch341 kernel driver through /dev/ttyUSB0. The Android app needs Android 7.0+ with USB host; android/build.sh assumes macOS/Homebrew paths, JDK 17, Android SDK platform 34 and build-tools 34.0.0.

test_offline.py runs 17 hardware-free checks of checksums, frame construction and response parsing, several against frames the author recorded from a reader reporting firmware V2.4.1, and docs/ANDROID.md reports 261 offline Android checks against simulated tags. The author reports confirming the read and write paths on one reader and installing and reading with the app on one DJI Smart Controller Enterprise (Android 7.1.2); the app's multi-bank write features were checked only in simulation. The docs also note occasional firmware hangs and a 20 dBm maximum power on the author's unit.
MIT License (2026, a0rfid contributors); the vendor software, SDK and reader firmware keep their own terms. Write, lock and kill commands change real tags.

name: Android Reverse
description_en: Android app, published only as release APKs, that runs an APK reverse-engineering workflow entirely on the phone, from package extraction and Java decompilation to native analysis, editing and rebuilding. It extracts APK, XAPK and split APKS packages from storage or installed apps, decompiles each class with Jadx (with fallback and IR modes), CFR, Procyon, JD-Core, Krakatau or Vineflower, analyzes native libraries through an embedded radare2 with pseudo-C, assembly, hex, control-flow-graph and call-graph views, and since v20 edits resources, binary XML, the manifest and smali before rebuilding and signing the APK. A built-in MCP server lets MCP clients edit those project files while rebuilding stays a manual step; the README also lists Flutter Dart AOT analysis through Unflutter and Unity il2cpp metadata parsing.
description_zh: 一款仅以发布版 APK 形式提供的 Android 应用，把 APK 逆向工作流全部放在手机上完成，涵盖安装包提取、Java 反编译、原生代码分析、编辑和重新打包。它可从存储或已安装应用中提取 APK、XAPK 和拆分的 APKS 安装包，逐个类在 Jadx（含回退与 IR 模式）、CFR、Procyon、JD-Core、Krakatau 和 Vineflower 之间选择引擎反编译，通过内嵌的 radare2 分析原生库并提供伪 C、汇编、十六进制、控制流图和调用图视图；自 v20 起还能编辑资源、二进制 XML、清单和 smali，再重新打包并签名 APK。内置的 MCP 服务器允许 MCP 客户端编辑这些项目文件，重新构建仍需用户手动触发；README 还列出借助 Unflutter 分析 Flutter 的 Dart AOT 代码以及解析 Unity il2cpp 元数据。
requirements: Latest release at review: v20, published 2026-08-24, with arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and universal APKs; the README's badges name those two architectures and mark the project as in active development. The first release, on 2026-06-17, said editing and repacking were not yet available. Neither the README nor the release notes state a minimum Android version.

At the reviewed commit the repository holds only the README and six screenshots: no app source, build files or license file, and GitHub detects no license, so the app's terms are unstated. The README credits radare2, Sora Editor and the CFR, Procyon, JD-Core, Krakatau, Vineflower and Jadx engines without naming their licenses.

According to the README everything runs on the device, with no PC, ADB or desktop tools. Users supply the packages or installed apps they analyze, and its disclaimer limits use to education and to security research on apps whose authors have given explicit permission.

The MCP server is described only in one README paragraph and the release notes, with no transport, port, tool list or setup steps, and open issue #2 reports edits made through MCP that did not appear in the app. The README does not say how its Smali Explainer produces explanations.

name: eCapture
description_en: eBPF-based Linux and Android tool that attaches uprobes to TLS libraries such as OpenSSL, BoringSSL, GnuTLS and NSS, and to Go's TLS stack, recording the plaintext a process sends and receives without a proxy or an installed CA certificate, so analysts can inspect an application's encrypted traffic on a host they control. Output modes write plaintext text, NSS key logs, or pcapng files with embedded TLS secrets for Wireshark and tshark, and a text mode can rebuild complete HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 messages from the captured stream. Separate modules audit bash and zsh commands and MySQL and PostgreSQL queries.
description_zh: 基于 eBPF 的 Linux 与 Android 工具，在 OpenSSL、BoringSSL、GnuTLS、NSS 等 TLS 库以及 Go 的 TLS 实现上挂载 uprobe，记录进程收发的明文，无需代理或安装 CA 证书，便于分析者在自己掌控的主机上检查应用的加密流量。输出模式包括明文文本、NSS 密钥日志，以及内嵌 TLS 密钥、可交给 Wireshark 和 tshark 解读的 pcapng 文件；文本模式还能从捕获的数据流中重建完整的 HTTP/1.1 和 HTTP/2 报文。另有独立模块审计 bash、zsh 命令以及 MySQL、PostgreSQL 查询。
requirements: Latest release at review: v2.9.0, published 2026-10-24; the reviewed master commit is identical to that tag. Release assets are Linux amd64, arm64 and loong64 archives and .deb packages plus Android amd64 and arm64 archives; the Docker image is Linux only. The README states that Windows and macOS are not supported; the separate eCaptureQ GUI can connect from them to a remote eCapture service.

Needs Linux kernel 4.18+ on x86_64, 5.5+ on aarch64 or 6.6+ on LoongArch64, or Android on x86_64 or aarch64. Loading the eBPF programs requires root or, per the minimum-privileges guide, CAP_BPF, CAP_PERFMON and CAP_SYS_PTRACE on kernel 5.8+ (CAP_SYS_ADMIN on older kernels), plus CAP_NET_ADMIN for pcapng mode. Source builds need Go 1.26+, clang and LLVM 9+, cmake 3.18.4+, libelf and the pinned libpcap submodule; make nocore builds for kernels without BTF.

Analysts choose the library or program to observe: the tls module locates the system OpenSSL through ld.so.conf paths or takes --libssl, which can also name a statically linked program, and gotls takes the Go program's ELF path; pcapng mode also needs a network interface and capture filter. Pcap mode records TLS-protected HTTP/1.x and HTTP/2 over TCP and HTTP/3 over QUIC, while the pcapng text source rebuilds only HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 over TCP. The project documents root-only end-to-end tests per module (make e2e).

Apache-2.0; libpcap is a git submodule and the bin, dist, deps and bytecode directories hold only placeholders. Captured plaintext and keys can contain passwords, tokens and personal data: the project's defense-and-detection guide asks for written authorization before production use, scoping capture to chosen processes with --pid and handling the data under organizational policy, and describes how to detect eBPF capture tools.

name: AutoProber
description_en: Flying-probe control stack meant to let a coding agent or an operator take a circuit board on a GRBL 3018-style CNC from locating it on the plate, through XYZ-tagged USB-microscope frames and an annotated map of pads, pins and chips, to probing targets the operator has approved. Python wrappers, a Flask dashboard and AGENTS.md safety rules run every move under an oscilloscope-monitored optical endstop that triggers feed hold and a STOP state with no automatic recovery. The published code covers device control, camera-to-motion calibration and map and probe-candidate review; the README presents locating, stitching and annotating the board as agent tasks.
description_zh: 飞针探测控制套件，旨在让编程智能体或操作员在 GRBL 3018 型 CNC 上处理电路板：先在平台上定位电路板，再拍摄带 XYZ 坐标的 USB 显微镜画面并生成标注焊盘、引脚和芯片的地图，最后探测经操作员批准的目标点。Python 封装、Flask 仪表盘和 AGENTS.md 安全规则让每次移动都处于示波器监测的光电限位之下，一旦触发即暂停进给并进入 STOP 状态，不会自动恢复。公开的代码涵盖设备控制、相机与运动的标定，以及地图和探测候选点的审核；README 把定位、拼接和标注电路板描述为智能体的任务。
requirements: README calls the reviewed commit ff0e01f ("1st Release", 2026-04-16) a source-available release candidate; pyproject.toml declares version 0.1.0, no releases are published, and the RELEASE_MANIFEST.md the README cites is not in the repository. There have been no commits since.

The tested hardware is a GRBL-compatible 3018-style CNC over USB serial, a UVC USB microscope served by mjpg_streamer, a Siglent oscilloscope over LAN/SCPI (Channel 4 for the optical endstop, Channel 1 for pogo-probe measurement), an optical endstop on an external 5 V supply, an optional Matter power strip controlled through chip-tool, and the 3D-printed toolhead parts in cad/. docs/BOM.md lists the parts.

Runs on a Linux control host with Python 3.8+ via uv; pyproject.toml declares only Flask and pyserial, while the calibration script also imports OpenCV. Lab hosts, ports and paths come from environment variables in the example config. README says calibration must be generated on the machine that moves and the microscope-to-probe offset measured before real probing, and that the dashboard must not be exposed to untrusted networks. No automated tests are published.

Works with whatever agent the operator uses: README has it ingest the project and drive the dashboard or Python scripts, and AGENTS.md sets the safety rules; no MCP server or specific agent is bundled. README limits use to equipment and targets the user is authorized to test.
PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 with a required copyright notice for GainSec; commercial use needs a separate paid license.

name: MCP Reversing Dataset (mrexodia)
description_en: Three worked examples by mrexodia of a language model reverse-engineering crackme binaries in IDA Pro through his IDA Pro MCP server. Each folder holds the input binary, a README giving its origin, the prompt and the model, the agent's own report and the exported session transcript, so readers can follow every tool call, rename, retype and comment the agent made on the database. The tasks cover a small Linux password check, an obfuscated Linux flag checker and a Windows crackme that, according to the agent's report, routes its checks through vectored exception handling.
description_zh: mrexodia 发布的三个实例，展示语言模型借助他编写的 IDA Pro MCP 服务器在 IDA Pro 中逆向分析 crackme 二进制。每个文件夹都包含输入二进制、说明其来源、所用提示词和模型的 README、智能体自己撰写的报告以及导出的会话记录，读者可以逐一查看智能体对数据库的每次工具调用、重命名、类型修改和注释。三个任务分别是一个简单的 Linux 密码校验程序、一个经过混淆的 Linux flag 校验程序，以及一个 Windows crackme；据智能体的报告，它借助向量化异常处理来执行校验。
requirements: Three tasks, committed between 2025-03-28 and 2025-04-14 and unchanged since. Each folder's README gives the input, the prompt and the model, next to the agent's report.md and an exported task-history.md transcript; crackme03 adds the agent's solve.py and a launcher that runs the ELF through WSL. All three runs used Claude 3.7 Sonnet in Roo Cline or Roo Code with the author's IDA Pro MCP server.

The repository bundles the three challenge binaries it analyzes: VEHMeme.exe, a Windows crackme the README credits to Brit and xenocidewiki from an earlier CTF; crackme03.elf, compiled with GCC 11.4.0 on Ubuntu 22.04 from a NoraCodes crackmes source file; and transformed.elf, described as a modified version of babush's mcp-job-security obfuscation project. They are small CTF-style samples rather than commercial software, but the repository states no redistribution terms for them.

Following a run needs IDA Pro, which is commercial, the IDA Pro MCP server and an MCP client. The prompts ask the model to rename, retype and comment the database and write a report, and the crackme03 prompt forbids brute forcing. The transcripts are single, unscored runs: the crackme03 report records a password confirmed by running the binary, the mcp-job-security report names the flag it extracted, and the VEHMeme report explains the exception-based check without stating a flag. These are author-published results.
There is no license file, so reuse terms for the transcripts and reports are unstated; the README welcomes contributions, but only the original three tasks exist.

name: jsc-decompile-mozjs-34
description_en: PHP decoder and decompiler for SpiderMonkey 34 JavaScript bytecode, which the README says may handle .jsc files compiled by cocos2d-x. It parses the XDR-serialized scripts with their atoms, constants, objects, regular expressions and try and scope notes, decodes instructions from a SpiderMonkey 34 opcode table and rebuilds approximate JavaScript for each function context, while a second script prints the decoded operations instead. The author describes it as unfinished and as an example of how a JavaScript virtual machine works.
description_zh: 用 PHP 编写的 SpiderMonkey 34 JavaScript 字节码解码与反编译工具，README 称它可能可以处理 cocos2d-x 编译生成的 .jsc 文件。它解析以 XDR 序列化的脚本及其中的原子（atom）、常量、对象、正则表达式和 try/作用域注记，依据 SpiderMonkey 34 的操作码表解码指令，并为每个函数上下文重建近似的 JavaScript 代码；另一个脚本则改为输出解码后的操作序列。作者称该项目尚未完成，可作为理解 JavaScript 虚拟机工作方式的示例。
requirements: No releases; the last commit, on 2021-07-27, fixed global-variable and object-initialization opcodes, and the README says the project may no longer be updated and is not complete. It targets SpiderMonkey 34 bytecode: the README notes that opcodes differ between SpiderMonkey versions, lists the magic values for bytecode versions 33 to 47, and says the tool does not check the magic, so files from nearby versions may partly decode.

Runs on PHP 7.0 or later (the README says it still works on 7.4) after composer install, which only generates the autoloader. php run.php prints reconstructed code for each script context, and php scan.php prints atoms, decoded operations, constants and regular expressions for files that do not decompile. Input .jsc files come from the user; the repository holds no sample files or tests, and the source has no decryption or decompression step, so it reads only plain XDR bytecode.

The README reports a fatal bug when decompiling deeply nested contexts and says output is not runnable, with generated names for local variables that the compiler discarded, so results should be checked against the scan.php operations. There is no license file, and composer.json declares the package proprietary, so the repository grants no reuse terms; recovered scripts remain subject to the rights of the application's owner.

name: Andromeda
description_en: Interactive command-line tool by Lasha Khasaia for first-pass reverse engineering of Android APKs, written in C/C++ for speed. It unpacks an APK, parses AndroidManifest.xml, the signing certificate and the DEX files at the archive root, then opens a shell with tab completion for listing permissions, activities, services, receivers and likely entry points, listing and searching classes, methods and strings, disassembling a method's Dalvik bytecode and listing, hashing or extracting native libraries. Further commands report whether the app is debuggable, a creation date taken from its certificate, URL and email strings, and a guess at whether it was written in Java, Kotlin or Xamarin .NET.
description_zh: Lasha Khasaia 开发的交互式命令行工具，用于对 Android APK 做初步逆向分析，以 C/C++ 编写以求速度。它解包 APK，解析 AndroidManifest.xml、签名证书和压缩包根目录下的 DEX 文件，随后打开一个支持 Tab 补全的交互环境，可列出权限、Activity、Service、Receiver 和可能的入口点，列出并搜索类、方法和字符串，反汇编某个方法的 Dalvik 字节码，以及列出、计算哈希或提取原生库。其他命令可报告应用是否可调试、依据证书得出的创建日期、URL 和电子邮件字符串，并推测应用使用 Java、Kotlin 还是 Xamarin .NET 编写。
