WinDbg MCP officially supports GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code and GitHub Copilot CLI, one client per session; clients may send debugger context to their model service, AI findings are not authoritative, and default secure mode blocks high-risk commands such as .shell.

name: 010 Editor
description_en: SweetScape Software's commercial hex and text editor whose Binary Templates, C/C++-like struct definitions with control flow and functions, parse binary files into hierarchical, editable structures. Templates can run when a file opens and are shared through an online repository, scripts with C/C++-like syntax automate edits and batch runs, and the tools include a Capstone-based disassembler for x86, ARM, MIPS, PowerPC and other code, byte-by-byte comparison, checksums and hashes, and editing of drives and, on Windows, process memory.
description_zh: SweetScape Software 推出的商业十六进制与文本编辑器，其 Binary Templates 采用类似 C/C++ 结构体、可含控制流语句和函数的写法，将二进制文件解析为可编辑的层级结构。模板可在打开文件时自动运行，并能通过在线仓库分享；语法类似 C/C++ 的脚本可自动完成编辑和批处理；工具还包括基于 Capstone、支持 x86、ARM、MIPS、PowerPC 等架构的反汇编器、逐字节比较、校验和与哈希计算，以及磁盘和 Windows 进程内存编辑。
requirements: Version 17.0.1, released 2026-11-04, has 64-bit builds for Windows 11/10, macOS 10.14 to 27 on ARM and Intel, and Ubuntu 18.04 to 26.04, plus 32-bit Windows and Linux builds and a portable Windows build. Version 10 dropped Windows XP, macOS 10.7–10.11 and Ubuntu 10.04–14.04, where older releases still run.

Commercial: the evaluation version works for 30 days, after which a license must be bought. Licenses are per user and perpetual, with a year of free upgrades and support, and come as commercial or lower-priced home/academic licenses; the EULA bars home/academic licenses from commercial use, except for members of registered non-profits, and from government or military organizations.

The disassembler only converts bytes to assembly: the manual says 010 Editor cannot execute the result and points to a separate emulator or debugger. Process editing is Windows-only, and the manual warns that incorrect process edits can make programs misbehave or crash the system.
Only ZIP, BMP and WAV templates ship with the editor; templates in the online repository are written and submitted by other users.

name: pestudio
description_en: Winitor's Windows tool for initial malware assessment, which statically inspects Windows executable files and reports key indicators such as hard-coded URLs and IP addresses, flagged imports, resources and overlay data. The free basic edition also detects file signatures, debug information and TLS callbacks, computes entropy and imphash, shows the rich header and .NET metadata and looks up VirusTotal scores by hash; pestudio-pro adds MITRE ATT&CK mapping, XML reports and the pestudiox.exe command-line version.
description_zh: Winitor 推出的 Windows 恶意软件初步评估工具，以静态方式检查 Windows 可执行文件，报告硬编码的 URL 和 IP 地址、被标记的导入函数、资源及附加数据（overlay）等关键指标。免费的基础版还能识别文件签名、调试信息和 TLS 回调，计算熵值与 imphash，显示 rich header 和 .NET 元数据，并凭哈希查询 VirusTotal 评分；pestudio-pro 另提供 MITRE ATT&CK 映射、XML 报告和命令行版本 pestudiox.exe。
requirements: Version 9.61, whose feature and licensing sheets are dated March 2025, ships as a ZIP that needs no installation; the download page says it is fully portable, does not alter the system it runs on and runs on any Windows system.

The free basic edition may be used only in a private context for occasional malware static analysis, not in a professional or corporate environment. pestudio-pro is sold as a one-year license per user that includes free updates, is not renewed automatically and is delivered as a password-protected ZIP.

VirusTotal lookups send only the file's MD5 hash, never the sample, and an XML switch disables them; searching VirusTotal by imphash needs a VirusTotal Intelligence account. The software is provided as-is without warranty, and its bundled XML files may not be used outside pestudio without the author's permission.

name: OllyDbg
description_en: 32-bit assembler-level analyzing debugger for Windows that emphasizes binary code analysis for programs without source; its site says development is frozen, and the newest version it lists is 2.01 of 27 September 2013. Its analysis recognizes procedures, loops, API calls, switches, tables, constants and strings and decodes calls to more than 1,900 standard API and 400 C functions; it attaches to running programs, debugs DLLs directly, sets conditional, logging, memory and hardware breakpoints and writes patches back to the executable.
description_zh: 面向 Windows 的 32 位汇编级分析型调试器，侧重二进制代码分析，适用于没有源码的程序；其网站称开发已冻结，列出的最新版本是 2013 年 9 月 27 日发布的 2.01。它能识别过程、循环、API 调用、switch 结构、表、常量和字符串，解码对 1900 多个标准 API 和 400 个 C 函数的调用；还可附加到运行中的程序、直接调试 DLL，设置条件、日志、内存和硬件断点，并把补丁写回可执行文件。
requirements: Version 2.01 (27 September 2013) is the newest the site lists, and 1.10 is offered as the final 1.x version. The requirements page lists Windows 95, 98, NT 4.0 SP2 or later, or Windows 2000 and later, and says debugging on NT or 2000 may need administrative rights; the 2.x notes say version 2 does not run on Windows 95 or 98.
OllyDbg is a 32-bit debugger. The 64-bit version is offered only as incomplete, and its latest progress note, of 5 February 2014, put the debugging engine at 70% and analysis at 15%.

Shareware that may be downloaded and used for free; the FAQ says it is rated shareware for copyright reasons only. The download page's agreement covers only version 1.10 and its Plugin Development Kit: permanent or commercial use needs a free registration, the software comes as is, and copies may be shared only complete, unchanged and without a fee. Disassembler 2.01 is released under GPL v3.

The download page warns that many vendors forbid disassembling, decompiling or reverse engineering their programs, including third-party and system libraries, and suggests asking a lawyer whether fair use applies.

name: Practical Malware Analysis
description_en: No Starch Press book, published in February 2012, that teaches hands-on malware analysis from basic static and dynamic techniques in virtual machines through x86 disassembly with IDA Pro, debugging with OllyDbg and kernel debugging with WinDbg. Later chapters cover malicious Windows programs, covert launching, data encoding, network signatures, anti-disassembly, anti-debugging and anti-VM techniques, unpacking, shellcode, C++ and 64-bit malware, and hands-on labs with solutions have readers dissect malware samples.
description_zh: No Starch Press 于 2012 年 2 月出版的书籍，以动手实践的方式讲解恶意软件分析：从在虚拟机中运用基础静态与动态分析技术入手，进而讲解用 IDA Pro 进行 x86 反汇编、用 OllyDbg 调试以及用 WinDbg 进行内核调试。后续章节涵盖恶意 Windows 程序、隐蔽启动、数据编码、网络特征、反反汇编、反调试与反虚拟机技术、脱壳、shellcode、C++ 和 64 位恶意软件；书中配有附解答的动手实验，让读者剖析恶意软件样本。
requirements: An 800-page book, sold in print with a free ebook or as a PDF, Mobi and ePub ebook. Chapter 12, the detailed table of contents and the index are free PDFs, and an errata PDF is posted.
Following the book needs a safe virtual analysis environment, which it teaches readers to set up, and the analysis tools it covers, such as IDA Pro, OllyDbg and WinDbg.

The publisher's “Download the labs” link leads to a GitHub repository offering the lab binaries as a self-extracting archive or a password-protected 7-Zip file. Its README warns that the binaries contain malicious code that should not be installed or run without first setting up a safe environment, and that, like real malware, some may crash, leak memory or behave unexpectedly.
The labs target Windows XP: many work on newer Windows but some do not, and a separate archive holds labs rebuilt for Windows 7 whose results differ from the book's answers.

name: UABEA
description_en: Cross-platform reader and writer for the asset bundles and serialized asset files of Unity games, originally based on, though not a fork of, the archived UABE. Its README presents it as a modding and research tool rather than an extractor and points users who only want to extract assets to AssetRipper or AssetStudio; it opens bundles from Unity's Addressables system, whose CRC checks must be cleared with a separate tool before edited bundles load. It builds on AssetsTools.NET with Cpp2IL and Mono.Cecil, and the repository includes texture, audio-clip, font and text-asset plugins.
description_zh: 跨平台的 Unity 游戏资源包（asset bundle）与序列化资源文件读写工具，最初参照已归档的 UABE 编写，但并非其分支。README 将它定位为改造（modding）与研究工具而非提取工具，只想提取资源的用户可改用 AssetRipper 或 AssetStudio；它能打开 Unity Addressables 系统使用的资源包，但修改后的资源包须先用另一个工具清除 CRC 校验才能加载。它基于 AssetsTools.NET，并借助 Cpp2IL 和 Mono.Cecil；仓库中还附有纹理、音频片段、字体和文本资源插件。
requirements: Windows and Linux builds come from the releases or from nightly CI artifacts, and the project targets .NET 8. Release at review: v8, published 2024-11-03; the reviewed master commit dates from 2026-05-11. The README also points to UABEANext, a successor with docking and multi-bundle opening that is still a work in progress.
Bundles that belong to Addressables need their CRC checks cleared with the separate AddressablesTools patchcrc command before edited bundles are used, as the README describes.
MIT per the license file; bundled libraries keep their own terms, including the PVRTexTool license for PVRTexLib, zlib for Unity crnlib and CC BY 4.0 for Font Awesome.

name: Tenet
description_en: IDA Pro plugin for exploring execution traces of a binary: it loads an externally recorded trace and lets the analyst step forwards and backwards through time while the disassembly shows the execution flow in both directions. Execution, memory and region breakpoints mark every execution of an instruction or every read and write of an address or range along a trace timeline, register seeking jumps to the instruction that set a register's value, and a timestamp shell seeks to a position or percentage of the trace.
description_zh: 用于浏览二进制程序执行跟踪的 IDA Pro 插件：载入外部录制的跟踪后，分析人员可沿时间轴向前或向后单步，反汇编视图会标出前后两个方向的执行流。执行断点、内存断点和区域断点可在跟踪时间轴上标出某条指令的每次执行，或某个地址、某段内存的每次读写；寄存器回溯可直接跳到设置该寄存器当前值的指令；时间戳命令行可跳转到跟踪中的指定位置或百分比处。
requirements: IDA Pro 7.5 or newer on Windows, macOS or Linux; Tenet is a pure Python 3 plugin with no third-party dependencies, installed by copying the repository's plugins folder into IDA's user plugin directory. Release at review: v0.2.0, published 2021-09-14, whose tag is the reviewed master commit.

Tenet only reads traces in its own text format, which records general-purpose register changes and memory reads and writes; a separate tracer must record them, and the repository's Intel Pin tracer for Windows and Linux user-mode programs and its QEMU tracer are marked experimental.
It loads only x86 and AMD64 traces, and its pure-Python reader gives no guarantee that traces of more than 10 million instructions stay reasonable to navigate.
MIT per LICENSE.

name: findcrypt-yara
description_en: IDA Pro plugin that scans the loaded database with YARA rules for cryptographic constants and similar signatures, lists the matches in a results window and names each matching address after its rule. Its bundled findcrypt3.rules has 126 rules covering constants and tables of hash, cipher and checksum algorithms such as MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, RIPEMD-160, Whirlpool, DES, Blowfish, RC6, TEA and CRC32, big-number and prime constants, crypto API names and functions of libraries such as OpenSSL, Crypto++, MIRACL and FGint; users can add their own .rules files.
description_zh: IDA Pro 插件，用 YARA 规则在已加载的数据库中扫描密码学常量等特征，在结果窗口中列出匹配项，并按规则名为每个匹配地址命名。随附的 findcrypt3.rules 包含 126 条规则，涵盖 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512、RIPEMD-160、Whirlpool、DES、Blowfish、RC6、TEA 和 CRC32 等哈希、加密与校验算法的常量和查找表，大数与素数常量，加密 API 名称，以及 OpenSSL、Crypto++、MIRACL 和 FGint 等库中的函数；用户还可添加自己的 .rules 文件。
requirements: IDA Pro with IDAPython and the yara-python package; the README warns against installing the yara pip package, which is not compatible. Custom rule files go in .idapro/plugins/findcrypt-yara/ under the home directory on Linux and macOS, or in the Hex-Rays IDA Pro plugin folder under %APPDATA% on Windows.
The repository has no releases; the plugin reports version 0.2 with the default hotkey Ctrl-Alt-F, and the reviewed master commit is dated 2024-11-19.
BSD-3-Clause per LICENSE.

name: deREferencing
description_en: IDA Pro plugin that adds register and stack views to the debugger in which pointers are dereferenced and colored, similar to the context displays of GDB plugins such as PEDA, GEF and pwndbg. It supports x86, x86-64, ARM, ARM64, MIPS32 and MIPS64; both views open from Debugger > Debugger Windows or with Alt-Shift-D and Alt-Shift-E, and a saved desktop layout reopens them in later debugging sessions.
description_zh: 为 IDA Pro 调试器新增寄存器视图和栈视图的插件，视图中会显示解引用后的指针并加以着色，效果类似 PEDA、GEF、pwndbg 等 GDB 插件的上下文显示。它支持 x86、x86-64、ARM、ARM64、MIPS32 和 MIPS64；两个视图可从 Debugger > Debugger Windows 菜单或用 Alt-Shift-D、Alt-Shift-E 快捷键打开，保存桌面布局后，之后的调试会话会自动重新打开它们。
requirements: IDA Pro 7.1 or later. Install it with hcli plugin install dereferencing, or copy dereferencing.py and the dereferencing folder into IDA's plugin directory (.idapro/plugins under the home directory on Linux and macOS, %AppData%\Hex-Rays\IDA Pro\plugins on Windows). Release at review: v2026.09.03, published 2026-09-03, whose tag is the reviewed master commit.
Options are changed in the plugin's config.py file.
GPL-3.0 per LICENSE.

name: HexRays Toolbox
description_en: IDAPython scripts that find code patterns in Hex-Rays decompiler output, independent of the binary's processor architecture, by running user-written lambda queries over the decompiled ctree. Queries run from the hxtb-shell GUI inside IDA, from IDAPython through functions such as find_expr() and find_item(), from interactive command-line helpers or in batch mode over a set of files. The README's use cases include finding vulnerabilities and their variants, locating code patterns from previously reversed executables in newly decompiled code, malware variant analysis and finding patterns across binaries built for different architectures.
description_zh: 一组 IDAPython 脚本，通过对反编译得到的 ctree 运行用户编写的 lambda 查询，在 Hex-Rays 反编译输出中查找代码模式，与二进制文件的处理器架构无关。查询可在 IDA 内的 hxtb-shell 图形界面中运行，也可在 IDAPython 中通过 find_expr()、find_item() 等函数调用，或借助交互式命令行辅助函数运行，还能以批处理方式对一组文件执行。README 列出的用途包括查找漏洞及其变种、在新反编译的代码中定位此前逆向过的程序里的代码模式、恶意软件变种分析，以及在为不同架构编译的二进制文件之间查找相同模式。
requirements: Needs a valid IDA license and a valid Hex-Rays decompiler license for each target architecture. The repository has no releases; the reviewed master commit dates from 2023-06-20.
Example queries for hxtb-shell are in the hxtbshell_queries folder, and the shell also accepts Python expressions copied from the context viewer of the separate HRDevHelper plugin.
CC0-1.0 per LICENSE.

name: Virtuailor
description_en: IDAPython tool that reconstructs C++ virtual tables in IDA Pro for 32- and 64-bit Intel and AArch64 code by observing indirect calls while the program runs under IDA's debugger. Its static part finds indirect calls and hooks the assignment of their targets with conditional breakpoints; when those breakpoints hit, the dynamic part creates vtable structures, renames vtables and virtual functions, adds structure offsets to the call instructions and cross-references from each indirect call to the virtual functions it reached, and for AArch64 firmware tries to fix undefined vtables and their functions.
description_zh: 在 IDA Pro 中重建 C++ 虚函数表的 IDAPython 工具，适用于 32/64 位 Intel 和 AArch64 代码，通过在 IDA 调试器中运行程序并观察间接调用来完成。静态部分负责找出间接调用，并用条件断点挂钩其调用目标的赋值；断点命中后，动态部分会创建虚表结构体、重命名虚表和虚函数、为调用指令加上结构体偏移，并从每个间接调用添加指向其实际调用的虚函数的交叉引用；对 AArch64 固件，它还会尝试修复未定义的虚表及相关函数。
requirements: IDA Pro 7.0 to 7.5: the master branch targets 7.5, and IDA versions older than 7.4 need the beforeIDA-7.4 branch. Run Main.py through File > Run script, ideally after taking an IDB snapshot as the README recommends, then exercise the program under IDA's debugger; AArch64 targets can be debugged through a remote GDB server. The repository has no releases; the reviewed master commit dates from 2020-06-06.
Only vtables used by virtual calls that are hit at run time are reconstructed, and the README says some breakpoints may be missed.
GPL-3.0 per LICENSE.

name: xAnalyzer
description_en: x64dbg plugin that annotates the static code of the debugged x86 or x64 executable with function-call, argument and loop analysis. It adds argument and type information from over 13,000 API definitions for almost 200 DLLs, handles undefined and register-based calls generically and detects loops automatically. Analysis runs on a selection, a function or a whole module from menus or the xanal commands, can run automatically at the entry point like OllyDbg's initial analysis, and users can extend its .api and header definition files.
description_zh: x64dbg 插件，为被调试的 x86 或 x64 可执行文件的静态代码添加函数调用、参数和循环分析注释。它依据覆盖近 200 个 DLL、超过 13,000 个 API 的定义补充参数和类型信息，对未定义的调用和基于寄存器的调用做通用处理，并自动识别循环。分析可通过菜单或 xanal 命令作用于选中范围、单个函数或整个模块，也可像 OllyDbg 的初始分析那样在到达入口点时自动执行；用户还可以自行扩充其 .api 定义文件和头文件。
requirements: Needs x64dbg; copy xAnalyzer.dp32 or xAnalyzer.dp64 and the extracted apis_def folder into the matching x64dbg plugin directory. Release at review: 2.5.12, published 2025-08-13, the same day as the reviewed master commit.

The README lists known limits: the first undefined call with generic arguments in a function is not processed unless a jump precedes it, nested calls work correctly only in some cases, loops are detected only within function boundaries and can be misdetected around unconditional jumps, and extended analysis can take much longer and use large amounts of RAM.
MIT per LICENSE.

name: AssetStudio
description_en: Tool for exploring, extracting and exporting the assets and asset bundles of Unity versions 3.4 to 2022.1. It converts Texture2D and Sprite images to PNG, TGA, JPEG or BMP and AudioClip to MP3, OGG, WAV, M4A or FSB, with FSB-to-WAV conversion, and exports fonts, meshes as OBJ, text assets, shaders, movie and video clips and MonoBehaviour data as JSON; models export from the scene hierarchy, and Animators export to FBX with their bound AnimationClips. MonoBehaviour export asks for the folder holding the assemblies, such as Managed, or, for IL2CPP builds, the dummy DLLs that Il2CppDumper generates.
description_zh: 用于浏览、提取和导出 Unity 3.4 至 2022.1 版本资源与资源包（asset bundle）的工具。它可把 Texture2D 和 Sprite 图像转换为 PNG、TGA、JPEG 或 BMP，把 AudioClip 转换为 MP3、OGG、WAV、M4A 或 FSB（并支持将 FSB 转为 WAV），还能导出字体、OBJ 格式网格、文本资源、着色器、影片与视频片段，以及 JSON 格式的 MonoBehaviour 数据；模型可从场景层级中导出，Animator 可连同绑定的 AnimationClip 导出为 FBX。导出 MonoBehaviour 时需要指定程序集所在目录（如 Managed 文件夹），IL2CPP 构建则需改选 Il2CppDumper 生成的 dummy DLL 目录。
requirements: Builds target .NET Framework 4.7.2, .NET Desktop Runtime 5.0 or .NET Desktop Runtime 6.0. Building needs Visual Studio 2022 or newer, and the native FBX exporter needs Autodesk's FBX SDK 2020.2.1. The latest release is v0.16.47 (2022-06-16), and the repository is archived on GitHub.
Loading asset bundles decompresses and reads them in memory, which can use a large amount of memory; the README suggests extracting them to a folder first and reading them from there.

The README states that neither the repository, the tool nor its owner is affiliated with, sponsored or authorized by Unity Technologies. MIT per LICENSE; the bundled texture decoders come from separately licensed open-source projects.

name: Voltron
description_en: Extensible Python debugger UI toolkit that attaches utility views to LLDB, GDB, VDB and WinDbg/CDB sessions. Each view retrieves data from the debugger host and can run in its own terminal, so users can assemble a custom debugger interface; built-in views cover registers, disassembly, stack, memory, breakpoints and backtrace, and any debugger command can be split off into a view highlighted with a chosen Pygments lexer. The views complement the debugger's command line rather than replace it.
description_zh: 可扩展的 Python 调试器界面工具包，能为 LLDB、GDB、VDB 和 WinDbg/CDB 会话附加实用视图。每个视图从调试器宿主获取数据，并可在单独的终端中运行，使用者可借此组合出自己的调试界面；内置视图涵盖寄存器、反汇编、栈、内存、断点和调用栈回溯，任意调试器命令都能拆分成独立视图，并用指定的 Pygments 词法分析器高亮显示。这些视图是对调试器命令行的补充，而不是替代。
requirements: Runs on macOS, Linux and Windows; WinDbg/CDB support goes through PyKD and is described as fairly new. The install script fully supports only macOS and Debian derivatives, and the debugger's init file (.lldbinit or .gdbinit) loads Voltron's entry.py. Architecture support differs by debugger: x86 and x86_64 with all four, ARM except with WinDbg, ARM64 only with LLDB and PowerPC only with GDB.
The newest release is the v0.1.8 pre-release of 2025-01-30, following v0.1.7 from 2016; the reviewed master commit is from the same day as v0.1.8.
MIT per LICENSE.

name: Remill
description_en: Static binary translation library that lifts AArch64, SPARC32, SPARC64, x86 and amd64 machine code, including AVX and AVX512, into LLVM bitcode, with AArch32 support underway. It focuses on lifting individual instructions accurately and is meant as a library for other tools such as McSema; its documentation walks through how an instruction is lifted, how instruction semantics are implemented and the overall design.
description_zh: 静态二进制翻译库，可把 AArch64、SPARC32、SPARC64、x86 和 amd64 机器码（包括 AVX 与 AVX512 指令）提升为 LLVM bitcode，AArch32 支持正在开发中。它专注于准确提升单条指令，定位是供 McSema 等其他工具调用的库；文档逐步介绍了一条指令如何被提升、如何实现指令语义以及整体设计。
requirements: Supported on Linux and tested on Ubuntu 22.04; it also works on macOS, and Windows support is experimental. Building uses the superbuild in dependencies/ with CMake 3.21+, Ninja, LLVM and Clang 15+, Intel XED, Google Flags, Log and Test and Python 3, and Linux builds can also run in Docker. Release at review: v6.0.1, published 2026-04-21; the reviewed master commit dates from 2026-08-27.
Apache-2.0 per LICENSE.

name: iaito
description_en: Official Qt-based graphical interface for the radare2 reverse-engineering framework, aiming for parity with radare2's commands, features and keybindings so that existing r2 plugins and scripts keep working. Its README lists forensics, binary diffing and binary patching alongside disassembly; iaito was the original name before the project was forked as Cutter.
description_zh: radare2 逆向工程框架的官方图形界面，基于 Qt 构建，力求在命令、功能和快捷键上与 radare2 保持一致，现有的 r2 插件和脚本都能继续使用。README 列出的功能除反汇编外，还包括取证分析、二进制对比和二进制修补；iaito 是该项目被分叉为 Cutter 之前的原名。
requirements: Needs radare2 and Qt 5 or Qt 6. CI builds and releases cover Linux, macOS and Windows, Linux and WSL users can install it from Flathub (org.radare.iaito), and on macOS the app may need its signature fixed with xattr and codesign as the README shows. Release at review: 6.2.2, published 2026-09-06; the reviewed master commit dates from 2026-11-05.
GPL-3.0 per COPYING.

name: HexRaysCodeXplorer
description_en: Hex-Rays decompiler plugin for navigating and reconstructing C++ code in IDA's pseudocode window. It reconstructs C++ object types from a selected pointer variable into IDA's local types, identifies virtual function tables and generates structures for them, lets the analyst click through virtual calls once objects are typed, visualizes a function's ctree as a graph, jumps from a pseudocode line to its disassembly and dumps ctrees and types to files. Its Object Explorer lists vtables with cross-references and RTTI parsing, and a batch mode processes many files without user interaction.
description_zh: 用于在 IDA 伪代码窗口中浏览和重建 C++ 代码的 Hex-Rays 反编译器插件。它能根据选中的指针变量重建 C++ 对象类型并存入 IDA 本地类型，识别虚函数表并为其生成结构体，在对象类型确定后可直接点击跳转到虚函数调用，以图形方式展示函数的 ctree，从伪代码行跳转到对应的反汇编，并把 ctree 和类型导出到文件。其 Object Explorer 可列出虚表及其交叉引用并解析 RTTI，批处理模式可在无人干预的情况下处理大量文件。
requirements: Written in C/C++ for x86/x64 IDA with the Hex-Rays decompiler on Windows, Linux and macOS; the README says only the latest IDA and decompiler versions are tested. The newest GitHub release is 2.1, the IDA 7 edition, from 2018-03-14; the reviewed master commit dates from 2025-11-25.
The repository has no license file and GitHub detects no license.

name: vgmstream
description_en: Library and tools that decode streamed, prerecorded video game audio in hundreds of formats and codecs, from common game engine files to single-game codecs, including looped music, subsongs, companion files, custom containers and encryption keys. TXTH text descriptors add support for further formats, including raw audio, and TXTP files set per-file options such as forced looping or merging files. It ships as the vgmstream-cli decoder, which converts supported files to WAV, the vgmstream123 player and plugins for Winamp, foobar2000, XMPlay and Audacious, and an online web player is available at vgmstream.org.
description_zh: 用于解码电子游戏中流式预录音频的库与工具，支持数百种格式和编解码器，从常见的游戏引擎文件到单款游戏专用的编解码器，并能处理循环音乐、子曲目、配套文件、自定义容器和加密密钥。借助 TXTH 文本描述文件可为更多格式（包括原始音频）添加支持，TXTP 文件则可为单个文件设置强制循环、合并多个文件等选项。它提供 vgmstream-cli 解码器（可把受支持的文件转换为 WAV）、vgmstream123 播放器，以及 Winamp、foobar2000、XMPlay 和 Audacious 插件，vgmstream.org 上还有在线网页播放器。
requirements: Numbered releases are on GitHub and nightly builds on vgmstream.org; release at review: r2168, published 2026-10-25, and the reviewed master commit dates from 2026-11-05. Users supply the game audio files; doc/FORMATS.md lists the supported formats.
An ISC-style permissive license in COPYING, with portions under their own copyright notices.

name: payload dumper
description_en: Python script that extracts the partition images, such as boot.img and system.img, from the payload.bin inside an Android OTA update package. It handles full OTAs directly and incremental OTAs with --diff by applying the update to original images that the user copies from a full OTA or dumps from the device, and it can also run from a Docker image.
description_zh: 从 Android OTA 更新包内的 payload.bin 中提取 boot.img、system.img 等分区镜像的 Python 脚本。完整 OTA 可直接提取；增量 OTA 则需加 --diff，并由使用者提供从完整 OTA 中取得或从设备上转储的原始镜像，脚本会在其基础上应用更新。它也可以通过 Docker 镜像运行。
requirements: Python 3.6 or later with the protobuf package from requirements.txt; the user supplies the OTA package's payload.bin. The README says the script was tested on Yandex Amber OTAs, both full and incremental, under Linux and may also work on Windows.
The repository has no releases, and the reviewed master commit dates from 2025-04-18.
The repository has no license file and GitHub detects no license.

name: Windows Malware Analysis training, volume 1 (malware_training_vol1)
description_en: Slides and exercises for a Windows malware analysis training that builds an understanding of common malware techniques through programming, reverse engineering and Windows internals, and shows how analysis tools are used for particular goals. Module 1 covers compilation, the PE format, processes, WoW64, shellcode and PE loaders; module 2 introduces malware missions and tactics, hooking, persistence and banking trojans; module 3 introduces evasion and self-defence and fingerprinting, with obfuscation, anti-hooking, deobfuscation and kernel-mode components planned.
description_zh: 一套 Windows 恶意软件分析培训的幻灯片与练习，通过编程、逆向工程和 Windows 内部机制帮助学员理解常见的恶意软件技术，并演示如何用各种分析工具达成特定分析目标。第 1 单元涵盖编译、PE 格式、进程、WoW64、shellcode 和 PE 加载器；第 2 单元介绍恶意软件的目标与战术、挂钩、持久化和银行木马；第 3 单元介绍规避与自我保护以及指纹识别，混淆、反挂钩、反混淆和内核态组件等内容尚在计划中。
requirements: Aimed at people who already know the basics of programming and reverse engineering and want to enter Windows malware analysis. Slides are in slides/ and exercises in exercises/.
The README marks the material as a work in progress: several topics still lack slides or exercises. The reviewed main commit dates from 2024-07-01.
Published under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license, per the README; the repository has no license file.

name: IDA NO MCP
description_en: IDA Pro exporter that turns an analyzed binary into plain files for AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code instead of serving it over MCP. It writes each decompiled function as a .c file, or as .asm when decompilation fails, under a header listing its name, address, callers and callees, along with the string, import and export tables, 1 MB hexdump chunks of every segment and logs of fallbacks, failures and skipped library functions. It ships as an IDA plugin (Export for AI, Ctrl-Shift-E) for small and medium files and as a Rust command-line binary for large or batch exports, which can skip IDA's auto-analysis.
description_zh: IDA Pro 导出工具，不走 MCP，而是把分析好的二进制导出为普通文件，交给 Cursor、Claude Code 等 AI 编程工具使用。它把每个反编译成功的函数写成一个 .c 文件（反编译失败时改为 .asm），文件头列出函数名、地址、调用者和被调用者；同时导出字符串表、导入表和导出表，按 1 MB 分块输出各段内存的十六进制转储，并记录回退、失败和被跳过的库函数。它提供两种形态：适合中小文件的 IDA 插件（Export for AI，快捷键 Ctrl-Shift-E），以及适合大文件或批量导出、可跳过 IDA 自动分析的 Rust 命令行程序。
requirements: The plugin, oldpython/INP.py, goes into IDA's plugins directory (%APPDATA%\Hex-Rays\IDA Pro\plugins on Windows, .idapro/plugins under the home directory on Linux and macOS). The Rust binary needs a local IDA Pro 9.x, whose non-redistributable libida and libidalib libraries it links at run time, plus LLVM/Clang for bindgen; it must be built natively on each platform, with an idalib crate version that matches the IDA release, such as idalib 0.9.0 for IDA 9.3sp1.

The Chinese README says the in-IDA plugin can hang on files of 100 MB or more, which the standalone binary's --skip-analysis option avoids. The repository has no releases, and the reviewed main commit dates from 2026-07-26.
The repository has no license file and GitHub detects no license.

name: ida-mcp-rs
description_en: Headless MCP server written in Rust that drives IDA Pro through idalib, so agents such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI or Cursor can open and analyze binaries without the IDA GUI. Apple targets are single tool calls, including universal Mach-O slice selection, dSYM/DWARF loading and dyld_shared_cache module loading; a 28-tool lean profile sits beside the full tool set, run_script executes IDAPython and returns JSON, and editing tools such as rename, comments, patches and type application each take exactly one address or exact symbol name. save_idb writes checkpoints, and crashed or wedged IDA workers are replaced automatically.
description_zh: 用 Rust 编写的无界面 MCP 服务器，通过 idalib 驱动 IDA Pro，让 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、Cursor 等智能体无需 IDA 图形界面即可打开和分析二进制文件。针对 Apple 目标的操作只需一次工具调用，包括选择通用 Mach-O 中的架构切片、加载 dSYM/DWARF 以及从 dyld_shared_cache 加载模块；除完整工具集外还提供 28 个工具的精简配置，run_script 可执行 IDAPython 并以 JSON 返回结果；重命名、注释、补丁和类型应用等修改类工具每次只接受一个地址或精确的符号名。save_idb 可写入检查点，崩溃或卡死的 IDA 工作进程会被自动替换。
requirements: Needs a released IDA Pro 9.5 with a valid license on the same host architecture, a Hex-Rays decompiler for the target processor for pseudocode tools and working IDAPython for run_script; IDA's first-launch setup, including license acceptance, must be completed by the user. Server versions follow IDA versions (v9.5.x for IDA 9.5, with Homebrew casks for 9.2 to 9.4), and the IDA 9.5 beta runtime is not compatible with the stable server.

Installs through Homebrew, Scoop, Nix or release archives for macOS, Linux and Windows on ARM64 and x86_64; the binary loads IDA's libida and libidalib at run time from standard install paths or IDADIR and library-path variables. Release at review: v9.5.0, published 2026-11-01 and validated with IDA 9.5.261026 on macOS, Linux and Windows ARM64.
MIT per LICENSE.

name: ida-multi-mcp
description_en: MCP server that lets an agent analyze several IDA Pro databases at once through one endpoint. Each database with its plugin registers itself when opened and headless idalib sessions can be added, and a router exposes up to 76 tools for triage, decompilation and disassembly, cross-references and call graphs, search, types, renaming, comments and patching, plus analysis-wait gating so agents can wait for IDA's auto-analysis to settle; its IDA tool implementations come from the ida-pro-mcp project. Function-similarity search compares functions within or across binaries using name-independent instruction MinHash, API, string and constant anchors and control-flow shape, with optional local neural recall, and nothing is uploaded.
description_zh: 让智能体通过同一个端点同时分析多个 IDA Pro 数据库的 MCP 服务器。装有其插件的数据库在打开时会自动注册，也可加入无界面的 idalib 会话；路由器最多提供 76 个工具，涵盖初步分析、反编译与反汇编、交叉引用与调用图、搜索、类型、重命名、注释和补丁，并提供等待自动分析完成的机制，让智能体在 IDA 分析稳定后再下结论；其 IDA 工具实现来自 ida-pro-mcp 项目。函数相似度搜索可在单个二进制内或跨二进制比较函数，依据不依赖函数名的指令 MinHash、API/字符串/常量锚点和控制流结构，并可选用本地神经网络召回，不会上传任何数据。
requirements: Needs Python 3.11 or later and IDA Pro 8.5 or later (9.1 or later recommended); IDA 9.0 SP0 (build 240925) is not supported. The package must be installed for both the terminal's Python and IDA's Python, and headless idalib sessions need IDA Pro, because IDA Home and IDA Free do not ship idalib. The repository has no releases; pyproject.toml declares version 0.1.0, and the reviewed main commit dates from 2026-09-19.

The README lists limits: the router binds to localhost only and speaks only stdio, calls to the same IDA instance still run one at a time, cancellation is not forwarded to IDA, and resources need manual routing. Renames, retypes and comments stay in memory until idb_save is called. The optional neural recall downloads its model on demand.
MIT per the README and pyproject.toml; the repository has no LICENSE file.

name: x64dbg MCP (x64dbgMCP)
description_en: MCP server that connects LLM clients to the x64dbg and x32dbg debuggers through a native plugin and a Python MCP script. It exposes more than 40 tools built on the x64dbg SDK and was tested with Claude and Cursor; agents can query registers, search byte patterns in a module and drive debugging sessions. The README advises giving the model the executable's full path so it can restart a crashed or hung target through the command-execution tool, and starting from GetModuleBase so that queries use valid addresses.
description_zh: 通过原生插件和 Python MCP 脚本把 LLM 客户端连接到 x64dbg 与 x32dbg 调试器的 MCP 服务器。它提供 40 多个基于 x64dbg SDK 的工具，已用 Claude 和 Cursor 测试；智能体可以查询寄存器、在模块中搜索字节模式并控制调试会话。README 建议把可执行文件的完整路径告诉模型，以便它在目标崩溃或卡住时通过命令执行工具重新启动，并建议从 GetModuleBase 开始，以确保查询使用有效地址。
requirements: Needs x64dbg: copy the .dp64 or .dp32 plugin into x64dbg's plugins folder, then register src/x64dbgmcp.py, which needs pip install mcp requests, as the MCP server in the client configuration. Building the plugins needs CMake and MSVC. Release at review: build1.1 (2026-03-15); the README recommends building from source for the latest features, and the reviewed main commit dates from 2026-06-05.
GPL-3.0 per LICENSE.txt.

name: IDASQL
description_en: SQL interface to IDA Pro databases that exposes a binary's analysis as more than 30 live virtual tables for agents and scripts. The tables cover functions, segments, names, imports, cross-references, basic blocks, instructions, strings, types, decompilation and annotations, and part of the database can be edited through them. It runs as a standalone CLI that can open raw binaries through idalib, as a plugin in IDA's command-line dropdown, as an HTTP REST or MCP server, or through a skills plugin for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI and Codex, and it can work across several databases at once.
description_zh: IDA Pro 数据库的 SQL 接口，把二进制的分析结果以 30 多张实时虚拟表的形式提供给智能体和脚本。这些表涵盖函数、段、名称、导入、交叉引用、基本块、指令、字符串、类型、反编译结果和注释，部分数据库内容也可通过它们修改。它可作为独立命令行程序运行（可借助 idalib 打开原始二进制文件），也可作为 IDA 命令行下拉菜单中的插件、HTTP REST 服务器或 MCP 服务器使用，还能通过面向 Claude Code、GitHub Copilot CLI 和 Codex 的技能插件使用，并支持同时处理多个数据库。
requirements: Needs IDA Pro with its directory on PATH and the idasql release artifact built for the installed IDA version (ida92, ida93 or ida94); plugin binaries are SDK-version-specific. The HCLI-compatible plugin archive covers Windows x86-64, Linux x86-64 and macOS ARM64, with separate ARM64 archives for IDA 9.3 and 9.4. Building from source needs IDA SDK 9.0 or later. Release at review: v0.0.19, published 2026-10-10.
The MCP server serves SSE on a local port and is compiled in by default (-DIDASQL_WITH_MCP=ON); the agent skills live in the separate idasql-skills repository. Deep-link features need IDA 9.4.

Licensed under the Human-Origin Source License v1.0, a source-available license derived in structure from MPL 2.0 that is not OSI-approved: it allows using, building and redistributing unmodified copies, including commercially, but forbids shipping modified versions outside upstream contributions and using the code as an implementation source without the author's written permission.

name: Luyten
description_en: Graphical Java decompiler front end for the Procyon decompiler, with its editor view powered by RSyntaxTextArea.
description_zh: Procyon 反编译器的图形界面前端，编辑视图由 RSyntaxTextArea 驱动。
requirements: Prebuilt downloads are on the Releases page; building from source uses Maven 3. The newest release was published on 2019-06-06.
Apache-2.0 per license.txt.

name: GDB dashboard
description_en: Standalone .gdbinit file written with GDB's Python API that shows a modular status interface each time the debugged program stops, reducing the commands needed to inspect its state. No GDB command is redefined; its features sit under a single dashboard command.
description_zh: 用 GDB Python API 编写的独立 .gdbinit 文件，被调试程序每次停下时显示模块化的状态界面，减少查看程序状态所需的命令。它不重定义任何 GDB 命令，所有功能都集中在 dashboard 命令之下。
requirements: Needs GDB with Python API support; the single .gdbinit file goes in the home directory, and Pygments is optional for syntax highlighting.
MIT per LICENSE.

name: REHex
description_en: Cross-platform hex editor for reverse engineering that handles files over 1 TB. It adds inline disassembly, integer and floating-point decoding, byte-range annotations, side-by-side comparison, virtual address mapping and bitmap visualisation, with Binary Templates that annotate data automatically and Lua scripting.
description_zh: 面向逆向工程的跨平台十六进制编辑器，可处理超过 1 TB 的文件。它提供内联反汇编、整数与浮点数解码、字节范围标注、并排比较、虚拟地址映射和位图可视化，还支持自动标注数据的 Binary Templates 和 Lua 脚本。
requirements: Runs on Windows, Linux, macOS and BSD. Releases provide standalone Windows and macOS packages and Linux packages; 0.64.0 was published on 2026-04-04.
GPL-2.0 per LICENSE.txt.

name: Dobby
description_en: Lightweight, modular hook framework for Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and Linux on x86, x86-64, ARM and ARM64.
description_zh: 轻量的模块化钩子框架，支持 Windows、macOS、iOS、Android 和 Linux，覆盖 x86、x86-64、ARM 和 ARM64 架构。
requirements: Compiled from source as described in docs/compile.md, or downloaded as a prebuilt library from the release tagged latest, dated 2024-03-14.
Apache-2.0 per LICENSE.

name: XLMMacroDeobfuscator
description_en: Command-line tool and Python library that extracts and decodes obfuscated Excel 4.0 (XLM) macros from xls, xlsm and xlsb files. An internal XLM emulator interprets the macros without fully performing the code, and results can be exported as JSON.
description_zh: 用于从 xls、xlsm 和 xlsb 文件中提取并解码混淆 Excel 4.0（XLM）宏的命令行工具和 Python 库。内置的 XLM 模拟器解释宏，但不完整执行其代码，结果可导出为 JSON。
requirements: Installed with pip. Loading xls files through Microsoft Excel requires Windows, pywin32 and the --with-ms-excel switch; otherwise the xlrd2 library reads them. The newest release is v0.2.7 from 2022-09-21.
Apache-2.0 per LICENSE.

name: PE Tree
description_en: Python module that shows Portable Executable files in a tree view using pefile and PyQt5, as a standalone application and as a plugin for IDA Pro, Ghidra, Volatility, Rekall and minidump. It reads PE images from files, ZIP archives, Windows memory dumps and analysis databases.
description_zh: 基于 pefile 和 PyQt5、以树状视图展示 PE 文件的 Python 模块，既可作为独立应用，也可作为 IDA Pro、Ghidra、Volatility、Rekall 和 minidump 的插件使用。它能从文件、ZIP 压缩包、Windows 内存转储和分析数据库中读取 PE 映像。
requirements: The standalone application needs Python 3.5+ and runs on Windows, Linux and macOS; each plugin needs its host tool. The repository is archived, with the last release 1.0.29 from 2020-10-05.
Apache-2.0 per LICENSE.

name: RpcView
description_en: Open-source Windows tool that explores and decompiles the RPC functionality present on a Microsoft system. New rpcrt4.dll runtime versions are added by extending its version table or by reversing the runtime's internal structures.
description_zh: 开源 Windows 工具，用于查看并反编译 Microsoft 系统上存在的 RPC 功能。若要支持新的 rpcrt4.dll 运行时版本，可扩充其版本表，或逆向该运行时的内部结构。
requirements: Needs the Microsoft Visual C++ 2019 Redistributable; building takes Visual Studio, CMake and Qt5. The README lists runtime support for Windows XP, 7, 8, 8.1 and 10.
GPL-3.0 per LICENSE.

name: jd-cli
description_en: Command-line wrapper around a jd-core fork that decompiles Java class and JAR files to the console, a directory or a ZIP file, with options for line numbers, file-matching patterns and parallel processing. It also ships as a Docker image and as a Java library.
description_zh: 基于 jd-core 分支的命令行封装，可把 Java 类和 JAR 文件反编译到控制台、目录或 ZIP 文件，并提供行号、文件匹配模式和并行处理等选项。它还提供 Docker 镜像和 Java 库。
requirements: Versions 1.3.0 and later need Java 17+, older ones Java 8+. The newest release is 1.3.0-beta-1 from 2025-10-30.
GPL-3.0 per LICENSE.txt.

name: amoco
description_en: Python package for symbolic analysis of binaries. It combines an instruction-decoding framework for adding architectures, a symbolic algebra module that describes instruction semantics, an abstract memory and execution model, and disassembly techniques from linear sweep and recursive traversal to solver-based path-predicate exploration.
description_zh: 用于二进制符号分析的 Python 软件包。它包含便于添加新架构的指令解码框架、描述指令语义的符号代数模块、抽象内存与执行模型，以及从线性扫描、递归遍历到基于求解器的路径谓词探索等反汇编技术。
requirements: The README marks version 2.9 as under development: x86 FPU semantics and ARM SIMD, VFP, NEON, TrustZone and Jazelle instruction sets are not implemented, some solver-based disassembly strategies are unmerged, and IDB import and export are missing.
GPL-2.0 per LICENSE.

name: Chisel
description_en: Collection of LLDB commands for debugging iOS apps. Commands print view and view-controller hierarchies, find views by class-name regex, show or hide views without resuming the process, mask or border views, set symbolic breakpoints on a class's method and watchpoints on instance variables, and can be extended with custom commands.
description_zh: 用于调试 iOS 应用的 LLDB 命令集。这些命令可打印视图和视图控制器层级，按类名正则查找视图，无需继续运行进程即可显示或隐藏视图，可遮罩视图或为其加边框，还能为类方法设置符号断点、为实例变量设置观察点，并支持自定义命令。
requirements: Installed with Homebrew or by download, then imported from the .lldbinit file in the home directory. Command support differs between iOS and macOS, as the README's command table marks. The newest tagged release is 2.0.1 from 2020-08-17.
MIT per LICENSE.

name: gdbgui
description_en: Browser-based frontend to the GNU debugger, gdb.
description_zh: GNU 调试器 gdb 的浏览器前端。
requirements: Documentation lives on gdbgui.com; release 0.15.3.0 was published on 2025-06-29.
GPL-3.0 per LICENSE.

name: Android Unpacker
description_en: Code and slides from the Defcon 22 talk "Android Hacker Protection Level 0". It holds a gdb and adb script for Bangcle and SecShell, a native unpacker for APKProtect, Bangcle, LIAPP and Qihoo Packer, tweaks that hide QEMU and debuggers from APKProtect, and a Corellium-based dynamic unpacking approach with automation.
description_zh: Defcon 22 演讲“Android Hacker Protection Level 0”的代码与幻灯片。其中包括针对 Bangcle 和 SecShell 的 gdb 与 adb 脚本，针对 APKProtect、Bangcle、LIAPP 和 Qihoo Packer 的原生脱壳工具，向 APKProtect 隐藏 QEMU 与调试器的调整，以及基于 Corellium、带自动化的动态脱壳方法。
requirements: The gdb-scripts unpacker requires gdb and adb; the native unpacker does not depend on gdb. The newest tagged release is v1.2 from 2014-09-11.
Apache-2.0 per LICENSE.txt.

name: Porosity
description_en: Decompiler that turns Ethereum Virtual Machine bytecode into readable Solidity-syntax contracts, supported on Linux and macOS.
description_zh: 把以太坊虚拟机字节码反编译为可读的 Solidity 语法合约的工具，支持 Linux 和 macOS。
requirements: The README marks the project unmaintained and points to the JEB decompiler for smart contracts as an alternative; the newest release is v20180116.2 from 2018-01-16.
The repository has no license file.

name: ReverseAPK
description_en: Command-line tool that decompiles an APK to Java and Smali, lists the extracted files, and statically checks AndroidManifest.xml and the source for common vulnerabilities and behaviours such as intents, command execution, content providers, crypto references and hardcoded secrets.
description_zh: 命令行工具，可把 APK 反编译为 Java 和 Smali，列出提取的文件，并静态检查 AndroidManifest.xml 与源代码中的常见漏洞和行为，例如 Intent、命令执行、Content Provider、加密引用和硬编码密钥。
requirements: Installed with the bundled install script and run as reverse-apk with an APK name; the README describes version 1.2.
The repository has no license file.

name: Xori
description_en: Automation-ready disassembly and static analysis library for shellcode and PE binaries that outputs disassembly, functions and imports as JSON. It offers a light emulation mode that enumerates all paths and a slower full emulation mode, simulated TEB and PEB structures, and FLIRT-style signatures.
description_zh: 面向自动化的反汇编与静态分析库，处理 shellcode 和 PE 二进制文件，并以 JSON 输出反汇编、函数和导入表。它提供枚举所有路径的轻量模拟模式和较慢的完整模拟模式，以及模拟的 TEB、PEB 结构和 FLIRT 风格签名。
requirements: Covers i386 and x86-64 PE, PE+ and plain shellcode. Built with Rust and Cargo; the README cites rustc 1.27.0, and the browser GUI needs Node.js.
AGPL-3.0 per LICENSE.txt.

name: binglide
description_en: Visual reverse-engineering tool that gives a quick overview of the data types present in a file. It reads no particular format, so it also works when headers are missing or corrupted or the format is unknown.
description_zh: 可视化逆向工具，用于快速了解文件中存在的数据类型。它不依赖任何特定文件格式，因此在文件头缺失或损坏、格式未知时也能使用。
requirements: Needs Python 3, PyQt4 with OpenGL, pyqtgraph and numpy, with numba for JIT speed-ups. The author points to Veles as a more mature successor.
MIT per LICENSE.txt.

name: ERESI
description_en: Reverse Engineering Software Interface built around ELFsh, an interactive and scriptable shell for reading and modifying ELF objects, and e2dbg, an embedded ELF debugger. ELFsh analyses sections, edits headers and symbol and relocation tables, disassembles through libasm, draws control-flow graphs and injects code into ELF files.
description_zh: 逆向工程软件接口，核心是 ELFsh 和 e2dbg：前者是可交互、可脚本化的 ELF 对象读取与修改 shell，后者是嵌入式 ELF 调试器。ELFsh 可分析节，编辑文件头、符号表和重定位表，通过 libasm 反汇编，绘制控制流图，并向 ELF 文件注入代码。
requirements: README.FIRST describes ELFsh 0.65 and is marked as not updated for ERESI 0.8; e2dbg is described for Linux on IA32. The newest release is 0.83-a3-phoenix from 2018-07-09.
The repository has no top-level license file.

name: pixd
description_en: Terminal tool that visualises binary data like a hexdump, but draws each octet as a coloured square from a palette.
description_zh: 终端工具，以类似十六进制转储的方式可视化二进制数据，但把每个字节画成调色板中的彩色方块。
requirements: Needs a terminal emulator that supports 24-bit colour SGR escape sequences.
MIT per LICENSE.

name: Universal Extractor 2
description_en: Unofficial, extended continuation of Universal Extractor that unpacks files from standard archives, application installers, disk images and game archives. Version 2 adds batch mode, a scan-only mode that detects a file's type, password lists and silent mode.
description_zh: Universal Extractor 的非官方扩展延续版本，可从标准压缩包、应用安装程序、磁盘映像和游戏归档中解包文件。第 2 版增加了批处理模式、只检测文件类型的扫描模式、密码列表和静默模式。
requirements: Runs on Windows XP or newer; on XP online features are disabled and some extractors may not work. The README links v2.0.0-rc.3.
GPL-2.0 per LICENSE.

name: ElleKit
description_en: Function hooking toolkit for arm64 XNU devices: a C function hooker that patches memory pages directly, an Objective-C function hooker, an arm64 assembler, JIT inline assembly for Swift and a reimplementation of the Substrate and libhooker APIs. The README lists the Dopamine, palera1n and meowbrek2 jailbreaks as users.
description_zh: 面向 arm64 XNU 设备的函数钩子工具包：包括直接修补内存页的 C 函数钩子、Objective-C 函数钩子、arm64 汇编器、Swift JIT 内联汇编，以及 Substrate 和 libhooker API 的重新实现。README 列出 Dopamine、palera1n 和 meowbrek2 越狱工具为其使用者。
requirements: Needs an arm64 device running the XNU kernel. Tested on iOS 15-27 (arm64), iOS 15-17 (arm64e) and macOS Ventura; the README says it is unsupported on the latest macOS because of code-signing changes.
BSD-3-Clause per LICENSE.

name: xHook
description_en: PLT hook library for Android native ELF executables and shared libraries. It handles ELF HASH and GNU HASH symbols and SLEB128-encoded relocations, selects targets with regular expressions, and needs no root or system permissions.
description_zh: 面向 Android 原生 ELF 可执行文件和共享库的 PLT 钩子库。它支持 ELF HASH 和 GNU HASH 符号以及 SLEB128 编码的重定位信息，可用正则表达式选择目标，无需 root 或系统权限。
requirements: Supports Android 4.0 to 10 on armeabi, armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86 and x86_64; building takes Android NDK r16b.
MIT for the code per LICENSE, with documentation under a Creative Commons license per LICENSE-docs.

name: Epic
description_en: Continuation of Dexposed on ART: a runtime method-hooking framework that loads into an app and can hook both the app's own code and Android framework code running in its process. Stated uses include instrumentation and security audits.
description_zh: Dexposed 在 ART 上的延续：运行时方法钩子框架，加载到应用内后既能钩住应用自身代码，也能钩住在其进程中运行的 Android 框架代码。其说明的用途包括插桩和安全审计。
requirements: The README states support for ART thumb2 and arm64 on Android 5.0 to 11 and none for arm32, x86, x86_64 or MIPS, which rules out Android emulators on those architectures. Short methods and fully inlined methods cannot be hooked. The newest release is 0.11.2 from 2021-07-31.
Apache-2.0 per LICENSE.

name: ProcDump for Linux and macOS
description_en: Linux and macOS reimagining of the Sysinternals ProcDump tool that writes process dumps in response to performance, runtime, signal and resource-tracking triggers, including native dumps through a Rust ELF writer and managed dumps through .NET diagnostics IPC.
description_zh: Sysinternals ProcDump 工具在 Linux 和 macOS 上的重新实现，可按性能、运行时、信号和资源跟踪触发条件写出进程转储，包括通过 Rust ELF 写入器生成的原生转储，以及通过 .NET 诊断 IPC 生成的托管转储。
requirements: Runs on Linux kernels 3.5+ or macOS Sierra+. Building needs stable Rust with rustfmt and clippy, plus Clang, pkg-config, libelf and zlib headers, gdb and gcore on Linux, or Xcode command-line tools, gdb and gcore on macOS. The macOS version has no resource tracking. Release 3.5.3 is from 2026-09-10.
MIT per LICENSE.

name: fishhook
description_en: Small library that dynamically rebinds symbols in Mach-O binaries running on iOS, on device and in the simulator, by updating the lazy and non-lazy symbol pointers that dyld uses.
description_zh: 小型库，可动态重新绑定运行在 iOS（真机和模拟器）上的 Mach-O 二进制文件中的符号，方法是更新 dyld 使用的惰性和非惰性符号指针。
requirements: Used by adding fishhook.h and fishhook.c to a project.
BSD-3-Clause per LICENSE.

name: pcode2code
description_en: VBA p-code decompiler based on pcodedmp, written for Office documents whose macro source has been stomped to leave only bytecode. It takes a document or a previously saved pcodedmp dump and also works as a Python module.
description_zh: 基于 pcodedmp 的 VBA p-code 反编译器，用于处理宏源代码已被抹除、只留下字节码的 Office 文档。它接受文档或先前保存的 pcodedmp 转储，也可作为 Python 模块使用。
requirements: Works with Python 2.6+ and Python 3.x and installs with pip along with pcodedmp.
GPL-3.0 per LICENSE.

name: Weeping of the Empire: statically recompiling Tears of the Kingdom for Windows
description_en: Weeping of the Empire builds a native Windows port of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom from the user's Switch game dump. It recompiles ARM64 code ahead of time to x86-64, supplies Switch services through a host runtime and renders through Vulkan. The engine documentation credits totk-recomp as the starting point and identifies the added Windows port, renderer, controls and menus.
description_zh: Weeping of the Empire 从用户自己的 Switch《塞尔达传说 王国之泪》转储构建原生 Windows 版本。它预先将 ARM64 代码重编译为 x86-64，以宿主运行时提供 Switch 系统服务，并通过 Vulkan 渲染。引擎文档说明其以 totk-recomp 为起点，另行开发了 Windows 移植、渲染、控制和菜单。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 x64, a Vulkan 1.3 GPU driver and the user's game dump are required; encrypted dumps also require the user's keys. Installation needs internet access.
Game version 1.0.0 is supported, with 1.4.3 in beta; first visits may stutter while shaders are built.
MIT License.

name: Exoproc
description_en: Exoproc exposes Windows x64 process inspection and instrumentation to agents through a CLI and MCP server. It enumerates processes, reads and scans memory, installs function detours, redirects thread contexts and compiles C snippets for execution in a target process.
description_zh: Exoproc 通过命令行和 MCP 服务向智能体开放 Windows x64 进程检查与插桩。它可枚举进程、读取和扫描内存、安装函数钩子、重定向线程上下文，并编译 C 代码片段供目标进程执行。
requirements: Live process instrumentation requires native Windows x64.
The Node.js route requires Node.js 18 or newer; the README also describes Bun and a standalone executable.
MIT License.

name: GTA Mode: reverse-engineering SimCity 3000 Unlimited for a native plugin
description_en: GTA Mode is a native plugin that adds direct control of spawned citizens and cars to SimCity 3000 Unlimited. It uses findings from Ghidra analysis of the game's binaries, GZCOM plugin loading, in-memory city structures and sprite archives. The C plugin runs in the original game, reads city data from its memory and decodes art from the user's installation; MODLOG.md records addresses, formats and dead ends.
description_zh: GTA Mode 是为《SimCity 3000 Unlimited》加入可操控行人和车辆的原生插件，这些行人和车辆由插件生成。项目利用 Ghidra 对游戏二进制、GZCOM 插件加载机制、内存中的城市结构和精灵图档案的分析成果。C 插件在原游戏中运行，从游戏内存读取城市数据，并从用户安装的游戏文件解码图像；MODLOG.md 记录了地址、格式和未成功的尝试。
requirements: A user's copy of SimCity 3000 Unlimited is required; the supported game DLLs are the Steam release's April 2000 builds.
Building requires a 32-bit mingw-w64 compiler; the HUD uses cnc-ddraw's OpenGL renderer.
The game's own traffic cannot yet be stolen and its own pedestrians cannot yet be punched; water does not block movement.
MIT License.

name: FH2MP: reconstructed Forza Horizon 2 online services
description_en: FH2MP restores Forza Horizon 2 multiplayer with a replacement server based on protocol behavior recovered from the Xbox One game client. An in-game shim redirects sockets and web-service calls, while Python and Go servers handle lobbies, worlds and online features; a launcher manages setup and updates.
description_zh: FH2MP 根据 Xbox One 版《Forza Horizon 2》客户端中恢复的协议行为，搭建替代服务器以恢复多人游戏。游戏内 shim 重定向网络连接和 Web 服务请求；Python 与 Go 服务器处理大厅、世界及在线功能，启动器负责安装与更新。
requirements: A legitimately owned Forza Horizon 2 Xbox One build 1.0.0.64 and Azimuth are required.
The source warns of crashes, desynchronization and rough edges.
GPL-3.0 licence.

name: OpenDeviceDB
description_en: OpenDeviceDB indexes devices with existing firmware or protocol reverse-engineering work and links back to source projects. Its website lists installation routes and remaining vendor dependencies, while importers aggregate existing databases and an MCP server lets agents query device records.
description_zh: OpenDeviceDB 索引已有固件或协议逆向成果的设备，并链接原始项目。网站列出开放固件的安装途径及仍依赖厂商的部分；导入器汇集其他数据库，MCP 服务器供智能体查询设备记录。
requirements: Using the local website, importers or MCP server requires the repository's npm workflow.
Some device entries retain non-free vendor components or require vendor cloud services.
Code is AGPL-3.0-or-later; data is CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: esp-idf-injection-ng
description_en: esp-idf-injection-ng documents an investigation of ESP-IDF's compiled libnet80211.a frame-type check. The author traces why symbol overrides fail in v5 and later, then supplies an objcopy patch, demonstration firmware and captures for transmitting additional 802.11 management frames through esp_wifi_80211_tx.
description_zh: esp-idf-injection-ng 记录了对 ESP-IDF 已编译 libnet80211.a 中帧类型检查逻辑的研究。作者追查旧版符号覆盖方法在 v5 以后失效的原因，并提供 objcopy 补丁、演示固件和抓包资料，用 esp_wifi_80211_tx 发送额外的 802.11 管理帧。
requirements: An ESP-IDF installation and ESP32 hardware are needed for the demonstrated patch and firmware.
The author tested ESP-IDF v6.1-dev on classic ESP32; other listed versions and chips are conditional.
The patch changes the local ESP-IDF archive globally and affects builds using it.
MIT License.

name: Cursed Lands: a Godot engine for Evil Islands and Lost in Astral
description_en: Cursed Lands reimplements the engine for Evil Islands and Lost in Astral in Godot, reading maps, models, audio, scripts and tables from the player's own game copy. Its native rendering, combat, AI, scripting and interface systems follow the original game's rules, with releases for desktop, Android and browsers.
description_zh: Cursed Lands 使用 Godot 重建《Evil Islands》及扩展《Lost in Astral》的引擎，从玩家自备的游戏文件读取地图、模型、音频、脚本和数据表。项目重新编写渲染、战斗、AI、脚本及界面系统，提供桌面、Android 和浏览器版本。
requirements: An owned copy of Evil Islands or Lost in Astral is required; the GOG base-game edition is the main tested version.
The browser version requires WebGL 2.
Apache License 2.0.

name: pkg-to-anyps5
description_en: pkg-to-anyps5 extracts PS5 debug game packages or game folders into the layout expected by the AnyPS5 relinker. It parses FIH, PFS and NAPS structures, decodes supported Kraken blocks, and unwraps fake-signed SELF executables and modules into ELF files.
description_zh: pkg-to-anyps5 将 PS5 调试版游戏包或已提取的游戏目录整理为 AnyPS5 重链接器所需的结构。它解析 FIH、PFS 和 NAPS，解码支持的 Kraken 块，并把假签名 SELF 可执行文件及模块还原为 ELF。
requirements: Rust 1.88 or newer to build from source; input is a PS5 debug package or extracted game folder.
Retail packages, encrypted filesystems and encrypted SELF segments are refused; several Kraken entropy types are unimplemented.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: QuestPad: a USB gamepad from the Quest Touch radio protocol
description_en: QuestPad implements the Quest Touch controllers' private 2.4 GHz radio protocol on nRF52840 firmware so a computer can use them as a USB gamepad. Its protocol reference documents pairing, AES-CCM encrypted controller packets, 2 ms link frames and input data; the firmware exposes generic gamepad, DS4 and XInput modes.
description_zh: QuestPad 在 nRF52840 固件中实现 Quest Touch 手柄的私有 2.4 GHz 无线协议，让电脑将手柄作为 USB 游戏控制器使用。协议文档记录了配对、AES-CCM 加密数据包、2 毫秒链路帧和输入数据；固件提供通用手柄、DS4 与 XInput 模式。
requirements: A Nordic nRF52840 Dongle or nice!nano v2 and Quest Touch controllers are required.
Python 3 is required for the control panel.
Quest 3/3S controllers and Linux support are listed as untested.
The repository provides MIT and Apache-2.0 licence files.

name: PMCA-RE RELOADED
description_en: PMCA-RE RELOADED is a Rust desktop and CLI toolkit for Sony cameras that includes experimental analysis of where menu settings reside in camera settings memory. It also parses firmware files, backup images and usage logs offline, and provides USB access to camera information, apps, firmware updates and settings. Supported operations depend on the camera generation.
description_zh: PMCA-RE RELOADED 是面向 Sony 相机的 Rust 桌面与命令行工具，实验性功能可分析菜单设置在相机设置存储区中的位置。它还可离线解析固件文件、备份镜像和使用日志，并通过 USB 读取相机信息、管理应用、固件和设置；可用功能随相机代际而异。
requirements: Windows, macOS or Linux and a supported Sony camera connected by USB for device operations.
App installation, settings memory and function analysis require user-imported key material.
Function analysis is experimental; firmware flashing is reported on one camera and unconfirmed on other models.
MIT license.

name: nfs-mw: a Rust reconstruction of Need for Speed: Most Wanted
description_en: nfs-mw reconstructs Need for Speed: Most Wanted 2005 PC v1.3 in Rust using data read from the user's installation. Its format readers decode bChunk, JDLZ, HUFF, cars, textures, and the streamed city; the current runtime provides viewers, driving, menus, and free roam.
description_zh: nfs-mw 用 Rust 重建 2005 年 PC 版《极品飞车：最高通缉》v1.3，并从用户本机安装目录读取数据。项目解析 bChunk、JDLZ、HUFF、车辆、纹理和分区加载的城市数据；目前提供查看器、驾驶、菜单与自由漫游。
requirements: Rust stable and an installed copy of Need for Speed: Most Wanted PC v1.3 / Black Edition are required.
Windows and Linux are documented; gameplay beyond the listed menus and free roam remains on the roadmap.
Apache-2.0 and MIT license files are present.

name: OSIRIS: replacing Onkyo receiver firmware through MCU protocol research
description_en: OSIRIS replaces the DSP-board software of Onkyo TX-NR515 and TX-NR717 receivers with its own boot loader, Linux services and DSP code. The project documents the SPI exchange between the main MCU and DSP board, including 1032-byte transfers, frame structure and command meanings recovered from stock firmware and logs.
description_zh: OSIRIS 以自制引导程序、Linux 服务和 DSP 代码替换 Onkyo TX-NR515、TX-NR717 功放的 DSP 板软件。项目依据原厂固件和日志整理主 MCU 与 DSP 板之间的 SPI 通信，记录 1032 字节传输、帧格式及命令含义。
requirements: An Onkyo receiver with a D830 or OMAP-L137 DSP board; installation requires a DSP-board serial connection and BOOT-pin switching.
The README reports TX-NR717 working and TX-NR515 working with incomplete testing; DTS, Spotify, internet radio and DLNA are unfinished.
Original OSIRIS code is BSD-2-Clause; bundled upstream components retain the licenses stated in the README.

name: Stadiacast: reconstructing the Stadia Controller's Wi-Fi service
description_en: Stadiacast recreates the network service used by the Stadia Controller's Wi-Fi firmware so the controller can connect to a local computer. The receiver answers boot and discovery requests, completes WebRTC and DTLS sessions, decodes input and sends rumble commands. Protocol notes record findings from firmware reading and live controller runs, with protobuf schemas and receiver code in the repository.
description_zh: Stadiacast 重建 Stadia 手柄 Wi-Fi 固件所依赖的网络服务，让手柄连接本地电脑。接收端响应启动和发现请求，完成 WebRTC、DTLS 会话，解码按键输入并发送震动命令。协议文档记录了固件阅读和真机交互所得的结果，仓库还提供 protobuf 结构与服务端代码。
requirements: A Stadia Controller with Wi-Fi firmware; the author tested ota.282115.
A Windows, macOS or Linux host on the controller's network; running from source requires Python 3.11+.
Linux needs root or CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE to bind the required low ports.
MIT license.

name: rust-deobf
description_en: rust-deobf analyzes compiled, mainly Rust, ELF, PE and Mach-O binaries to recover hidden strings and related artifacts. It combines static call-site analysis with Unicorn function emulation, identifies Rust metadata and library functions, and offers unpacking and Ghidra annotations. CLI and MCP interfaces expose the core analysis; deeper control-flow and virtualization modules have separate licensing.
description_zh: rust-deobf 分析以 Rust 为主的 ELF、PE 和 Mach-O 二进制文件，恢复隐藏字符串及相关信息。工具结合静态调用点分析与 Unicorn 函数仿真，还可识别 Rust 元数据和库函数、处理打包样本并为 Ghidra 添加注释。核心功能提供命令行和 MCP 接口；更深入的控制流及虚拟化模块另有许可。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer is specified for the core package.
The documented analysis covers x86-64, ARM64 and 32-bit x86 across ELF, PE and Mach-O.
The core is Apache-2.0; premium modules are dual-licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later or a commercial license.

name: ThisFirmwareDoesNotExist
description_en: ThisFirmwareDoesNotExist maps Arturia MicroFreak firmware 5.0.0.2084 and provides freakpatch to modify a user's official update file. Its notes cover the update format and firmware subsystems, while Ghidra scripts and assembly sources support the documented patch locations.
description_zh: ThisFirmwareDoesNotExist 分析 Arturia MicroFreak 5.0.0.2084 固件，并用 freakpatch 修改用户自备的官方更新文件。文档记录更新格式与固件子系统，Ghidra 脚本和汇编源码对应具体补丁位置。
requirements: Python 3.11 or newer and the official MicroFreak 5.0.0.2084 .mff update file are required.
Some MIDI CC assignments may interfere with an untested stock function.
MIT license.

name: RE-Workstation
description_en: RE-Workstation is a Chinese reference library for reverse-engineering workflows and related security research. Its topic pages cover native binaries, APKs, firmware, JavaScript, patch diffing and malware analysis, with indexes, evidence templates and pattern references for locating relevant methods.
description_zh: RE-Workstation 是中文逆向分析与相关安全研究知识库。专题页面涵盖原生二进制、APK、固件、JavaScript、补丁差分和恶意代码分析，并提供索引、证据模板及特征参考，帮助按任务查找方法。
requirements: The full directory, including SKILL.md, CATALOG.md, knowledge/ and references/, is needed for agent-skill use.
Analysis tools are supplied by the host environment.
Original and newly organized content is GPL-3.0-only; third-party content retains its own terms.

name: bf-private-server: a Brave Frontier revival server
description_en: bf-private-server recreates a self-hosted server for Brave Frontier client version 2.19.6. Its C++23 service answers the game's HTTP requests, stores saves in SQLite and works with CDN workers and a patcher for the user's Android client; request tables and boot-flow notes document the protocol investigation. The server builds on an earlier emulator fork.
description_zh: bf-private-server 为《Brave Frontier》2.19.6 客户端重建可自行部署的服务端。C++23 服务处理游戏 HTTP 请求并以 SQLite 保存进度，配套 CDN Worker 和自有 Android 客户端补丁工具；仓库还记录请求表和启动流程。服务端以较早的模拟器分支为基础。
requirements: Git and Docker or a native C++23 toolchain are required for the server.
Game data and a copy of the Android client must be obtained separately.
Some client requests remain unimplemented and return a not-available response.
AGPL-3.0 license.

name: Clickwill: reconstructing iPod library database editing
description_en: Clickwill reconstructs direct editing of iPod classic and iPod nano music libraries in a Swift Mac app. It reads and writes iTunesDB and ArtworkDB on the device, preserves unknown record bytes, handles hash58 signatures and publishes a byte map that distinguishes measured fields from uncertain ones.
description_zh: Clickwill 以 Swift Mac 应用重建 iPod classic 和 iPod nano 音乐库的直接编辑功能。它读写设备上的 iTunesDB 与 ArtworkDB，保留未知记录字节，处理 hash58 签名，并发布区分实测字段与待确认字段的字节映射。
requirements: macOS 14 or later and an iPod classic or supported iPod nano for normal writing.
Building from source requires Xcode 27 and XcodeGen.
iPod nano third- and fourth-generation editing does not add new artwork until their formats are confirmed; other iPods open read-only by default.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Virtual MPC Sample: rehosting Akai MPC Sample firmware in QEMU
description_en: Virtual MPC Sample rehosts Akai MPC Sample 1.3.0.12 firmware in QEMU using a custom lab kernel and a browser panel for the device controls. The repository documents firmware and device architecture, emulates the panel's UART communication and provides a shell, tracing and mod testing against the user's own firmware files.
description_zh: Virtual MPC Sample 使用定制实验内核和浏览器控制面板，在 QEMU 中运行 Akai MPC Sample 1.3.0.12 固件。仓库记录固件及设备架构，模拟面板 UART 通信，并可对用户自备固件进行 shell 检查、跟踪和改装测试。
requirements: Requires the user's own MPC Sample 1.3.0.12 firmware partitions; the factory library additionally requires the user's own device.
Requires QEMU 9 or later, Docker for building, Python 3.9 or later and an OpenSSH client.
USB audio, other firmware versions and a Windows test run remain unfinished.
MIT licence, except Linux kernel patches under GPL-2.0.

name: OpenJooki: replacing the Jooki 2 software and recovery path
description_en: OpenJooki replaces the Jooki 2 music speaker's embedded Linux core and provides phone-based control, updates and SD-card recovery. Its technical notes map the device's Ingenic Linux and ESP32 split, storage partitions, Mender update slots and recovery behavior, while the repository contains the replacement Lua services and installer tooling.
description_zh: OpenJooki 替换 Jooki 2 音乐音箱的嵌入式 Linux 核心，提供手机控制、更新与 SD 卡恢复。技术文档记录 Ingenic Linux 与 ESP32 的分工、存储分区、Mender 更新槽及恢复机制；仓库包含替代 Lua 服务和安装工具。
requirements: A Jooki 2 device is the target hardware.
The replacement system is installed on the device's SD-card based embedded Linux environment.
MIT license.

name: intel_ma
description_en: intel_ma inspects PC management firmware in ME/TXE/CSME region images and full SPI dumps. Its Rust library and CLI parse partition tables, AMD PSP directories, UEFI firmware volumes and FIT records, and report Boot Guard, BIOS Guard and descriptor locks. It can also remove selected Intel ME components and set documented disable flags in an output image.
description_zh: intel_ma 检查 ME/TXE/CSME 区域镜像和完整 SPI 转储中的 PC 管理固件。其 Rust 库与命令行工具解析分区表、AMD PSP 目录、UEFI 固件卷和 FIT 记录，并报告 Boot Guard、BIOS Guard 及描述符锁定信息。它还可从输出镜像中移除部分 Intel ME 组件并设置禁用标志。
requirements: A compatible firmware region image or full SPI dump is required for image analysis.
The source lists x86_64 Linux and FreeBSD/amd64; live ME probing is Linux only.
AMD PSP support is inspection only.
GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: breakinggood
description_en: breakinggood captures a website's screenshots, cleaned DOM, computed design values, images, and XHR/fetch responses, then generates a Vite, React, and Tailwind rebuild with a mock API replaying observed JSON. Its CLI and MCP server expose site capture alongside a separate Git repository setup workflow.
description_zh: breakinggood 采集网站截图、清理后的 DOM、计算得到的设计参数、图片和 XHR/fetch 响应，再生成 Vite、React、Tailwind 重建项目，并用模拟 API 重放观察到的 JSON。命令行和 MCP 服务器也提供独立的 Git 仓库准备功能。
requirements: Node 20 or newer and Git; website mode needs an installed Chrome or Edge browser and a configured model provider.
Pages behind logins, strong bot protection, or mostly rendered with canvas/WebGL may capture poorly.
MIT license.

name: OpenLF2: a Little Fighter 2 engine reimplementation
description_en: OpenLF2 reimplements Little Fighter 2 v2.0a as a playable C++ and Lua engine. It loads resources from the original game installer and provides local modes, replays, mods and network matches between OpenLF2 players. The author states that gameplay compatibility is still being refined.
description_zh: OpenLF2 用 C++ 和 Lua 重实现了可玩的《Little Fighter 2》v2.0a 引擎。它从原版游戏安装程序读取资源，支持本地模式、回放、模组及 OpenLF2 玩家之间的联机对战。作者表示仍在改进与原版的玩法兼容性。
requirements: The Little Fighter 2 v2.0a installer is needed for original game data; Flatpak downloads it during installation, while other platforms prompt users to provide a copy.
Building requires CMake 3.25+, Ninja, a C++23 compiler, and the development libraries listed in BUILDING.md.
Gameplay compatibility is still under development; original LF2 network compatibility is unsupported.
MIT license covers OpenLF2 code, scripts and documentation, not the original game assets.

name: Stickwalker: porting Pokéwalker firmware to the Stick S3
description_en: Stickwalker ports a matching reconstruction of Pokéwalker firmware to the M5Stack Stick S3. The repository includes firmware source, build tooling and placeholder artwork; users can build with artwork extracted from their own ROM, and a BPV10NF photodiode supplies infrared reception.
description_zh: Stickwalker 将 Pokéwalker 的匹配固件重建成果移植到 M5Stack Stick S3。仓库提供固件源码、构建工具和占位图像；用户可从自有 ROM 提取原版图像参与构建，并通过 BPV10NF 光电二极管接收红外信号。
requirements: An M5Stack Stick S3, BPV10NF photodiode and USB-C data cable are specified.
Original graphics require artwork extracted from the user's own ROM; downloads use placeholder artwork.
MIT license.

name: qemu-rtd2841
description_en: qemu-rtd2841 adds a Realtek RTD2841/RTK284x TV machine model to QEMU for bare-metal diagnostics and local firmware experiments. Its board profile models AArch32 Cortex-A53 cores, GICv2, timers, SDHCI, Ethernet, UART, and a framebuffer, with diagnostic assembly and a staged test runner.
description_zh: qemu-rtd2841 为 QEMU 添加 Realtek RTD2841/RTK284x 电视硬件模型，用于裸机诊断和本地固件实验。其板级配置涵盖 AArch32 Cortex-A53、GICv2、定时器、SDHCI、以太网、UART 和帧缓冲，并附汇编诊断程序及分层测试脚本。
requirements: Build against the pinned QEMU revision with the RTD2841 patch and the documented host toolchain.
Linux boot requires a compatible local RTD2841 zImage and composite eMMC image.
The author reports that public tests cover bare-metal and synthetic storage tiers; full Android init and framework services remain open.
GPL-2.0 license.

name: os-xgs-npu: reconstructing Sophos XGS coprocessor interfaces
description_en: os-xgs-npu reconstructs interfaces to Sophos XGS appliance coprocessors through FreeBSD kernel modules and an OPNsense plugin. The work documents undocumented registers, PCIe device families and measured coprocessor behavior to expose front ports and offload firewall flows and IPsec associations.
description_zh: os-xgs-npu 通过 FreeBSD 内核模块和 OPNsense 插件重建 Sophos XGS 设备的协处理器接口。项目记录未公开寄存器、PCIe 设备系列及实测行为，用于开放前面板端口并卸载防火墙连接和 IPsec 关联。
requirements: Sophos XGS hardware and a matching OPNsense or FreeBSD environment; kernel modules are built on the appliance.
The author says the project is still being completed; two coprocessor families currently respond.
BSD-2-Clause license.

name: Spark Mail: rehosting the Windows desktop app on Linux with Wine shims
description_en: spark-mail-linux rehosts the Windows Spark Mail desktop app on Linux with Wine, two compatibility DLL shims and launcher scripts. The project documents application startup, browser authentication, notifications, clipboard and file-opening behavior, then patches specific DLL imports and bridges those functions to the Linux desktop.
description_zh: spark-mail-linux 通过 Wine、两个兼容 DLL 和启动脚本在 Linux 上运行 Windows 版 Spark Mail。项目记录应用启动、浏览器登录、通知、剪贴板及文件打开行为，并通过修改 DLL 导入项和桌面桥接处理这些问题。
requirements: An official Windows Spark.exe installer, Wine, and Arch Linux or an Arch-based system as documented.
The author reports that Spark 3.32.2.141404 starts; mail, calendar, attachment and notification delivery checks remain incomplete for that version.
MIT licence.

name: LibreMP: an Epson EasyMP screen caster from packet-capture research
description_en: LibreMP casts desktop screens to Epson EasyMP projectors using a protocol reconstructed from Windows client packet captures. Its Rust core handles registration and login messages, projector QR decoding, JPEG tile streaming and changed-region updates; a CLI and Tauri interface use the same core. The project documents control on TCP 3620 and video on TCP 3621.
description_zh: LibreMP 根据 Windows 客户端抓包还原 Epson EasyMP 协议，实现桌面向投影仪投屏。Rust 核心处理注册与登录消息、投影仪二维码解码、JPEG 分块传输及画面变化区域更新；命令行和 Tauri 界面共用该核心。文档记录控制通道使用 TCP 3620，视频通道使用 TCP 3621。
requirements: An Epson EasyMP-compatible projector and a supported desktop operating system; building requires Rust, Cargo, Node.js, npm, NASM and CMake.
The keyword-protected login path has not been tried against real hardware; Windows and macOS casting still need hardware testing.
MIT License.

name: CFG Visualizer
description_en: CFG Visualizer extracts function control-flow graphs from ELF, PE and Mach-O binaries with radare2 and presents them in an interactive 3D browser view. Its FastAPI backend returns graph JSON, while the frontend shows branch edges and node disassembly.
description_zh: CFG Visualizer 借助 radare2 从 ELF、PE 和 Mach-O 文件提取函数控制流图，在浏览器中交互式显示三维节点、分支边及反汇编。FastAPI 后端负责分析并输出图结构 JSON。
requirements: Python 3.10+ and radare2 on PATH are required for local binary analysis.
The public upload service lacks authentication, rate limiting and subprocess sandboxing.
MIT.

name: Atlantis Native: porting the Atlantis and Atlantis II engines to Rust
description_en: Atlantis Native ports the reverse-engineered CryOmni3D Atlantis engine to Rust for Atlantis: The Lost Tales and Atlantis II. It reads files from the user's own game copies and runs their scripts, panoramas, cinematics and puzzles on desktop systems and in browsers, with optional display and bug fixes.
description_zh: Atlantis Native 把经逆向重建的 CryOmni3D Atlantis 引擎移植到 Rust，支持 Atlantis: The Lost Tales 与 Atlantis II。它读取用户自备游戏文件，在桌面系统和浏览器中运行原有脚本、全景画面、过场动画及谜题，并提供可选的显示改进和错误修复。
requirements: Users supply their own copies of Atlantis: The Lost Tales or Atlantis II; game data is not included.
Desktop builds cover Windows, macOS and Linux; a browser build is also described.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: Sony CDX-A250: reconstructing the LCD panel interface
description_en: Sony CDX-A250 LCD Panel reconstructs the serial control needed to drive the radio's detachable display independently through its LC75826W driver. Wiring notes, CCB transfer documentation, and an Arduino sketch cover display-data groups, control bits, test patterns, and experimental segment mapping.
description_zh: Sony CDX-A250 LCD Panel 还原通过 LC75826W 驱动器独立控制汽车收音机可拆卸显示屏所需的串行接口。接线说明、CCB 传输文档和 Arduino 程序涵盖显示数据组、控制位、测试图案及实验性段位映射。
requirements: The documented setup uses a Sony CDX-A250 front panel, an Arduino-compatible board, bench power, a pushbutton, and wiring components.
The project documents the demonstrated panel setup and the LC75826W interface used by its Arduino sketch.
Code is MIT licensed; original documentation and project media are CC BY 4.0.

name: apkscope
description_en: apkscope inspects Android application packages through a Rust viewer, CLI, and MCP server. It decompiles DEX classes into Java, searches code and references, reads manifests and resources, scans URLs and secrets including native libraries, and can export or modify packages.
description_zh: apkscope 通过 Rust 编写的查看器、命令行和 MCP 服务器分析 Android 应用包。它把 DEX 类反编译为 Java，检索代码与引用，读取清单和资源，扫描包括原生库在内的 URL 与密钥，并支持导出或修改包。
requirements: Supply an Android application package such as an APK or XAPK.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: MacroPad: reconstructing a USB macropad configuration protocol
description_en: MacroPad reconstructs the USB HID configuration exchange of a 12-key, two-knob macropad identified as 1189:8840 and implements it in a Linux GUI. The author documents capturing MINI_KEYBOARD.exe traffic with usbmon, decoding configuration and commit reports, and replaying captured packets in tests.
description_zh: MacroPad 重建了 USB ID 为 1189:8840 的 12 键双旋钮宏键盘的 HID 配置交互，并提供 Linux 图形客户端。作者记录了用 usbmon 抓取 MINI_KEYBOARD.exe 流量、解析配置与提交报告，以及在测试中重放抓包数据的过程。
requirements: Linux, Python 3.9+ and the 1189:8840 macropad are documented for the supported configuration path.
Other pad IDs are reported as unsupported until their layout and protocol are added.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Monix: reconstructing Audient iD USB mixer control on Linux
description_en: Monix implements Linux mixer control for Audient iD USB audio interfaces through a companion kernel module, protocol library and GUI. Its protocol documentation maps USB control requests from official-app captures and macOS binary analysis, covering routing, faders, metering and device profiles.
description_zh: Monix 通过配套内核模块、协议库和图形界面为 Audient iD USB 声卡实现 Linux 混音控制。协议文档依据厂商应用的 USB 抓包及 macOS 二进制分析，整理路由、推子、电平表和设备配置的控制请求。
requirements: Requires Linux kernel 5.9 or newer and an Audient iD-series interface.
Building requires a C++17 toolchain, CMake 3.16 or newer, kernel headers, ALSA, GLFW and OpenGL development packages.
The author reports hardware testing on iD24; other models have limited or unconfirmed routing support.
MIT license.

name: SF2Recomp: statically recompiling Shadow Fight 2 for native platforms
description_en: SF2Recomp converts a user's Shadow Fight 2 Nintendo Switch game files into native builds for Linux, Windows, macOS, and Android. Its converter combines translated game code with a runtime and user-supplied assets, adding controls, graphics options, sparring, and LAN play.
description_zh: SF2Recomp 将用户提供的 Nintendo Switch 版《Shadow Fight 2》游戏文件转换为 Linux、Windows、macOS 和 Android 原生版本。转换器将重编译代码、运行时与用户素材结合，并加入控制设置、画面选项、对战练习及局域网联机。
requirements: Supply a combined base plus v1.1.0/update v131072 NSP with sidecars and prod.keys, or already extracted updated game files.
A Vulkan 1.3 compatible GPU and driver are required; platform version requirements vary.
macOS Apple Silicon support is experimental, with gameplay and GPU validation pending.
Project code is MIT licensed; dependencies and the project icon have separate terms.

name: Scooter Link: a Xiaomi scooter client built from BLE protocol research
description_en: Scooter Link implements an Android client for Xiaomi Electric Scooter 5 Pro and 5 Max using a reconstructed BLE authentication protocol. Its research log covers GATT characteristics and investigation of the ECDH P-256, HKDF-SHA256, and AES-CCM exchange; the app reads ride and battery data and controls supported settings.
description_zh: Scooter Link 使用还原的 BLE 认证协议，为 Xiaomi Electric Scooter 5 Pro 和 5 Max 提供 Android 客户端。研究日志记录 GATT 特征及 ECDH P-256、HKDF-SHA256、AES-CCM 交互的调查；应用可读取骑行、电池数据并控制受支持的设置。
requirements: Android and a supported Xiaomi Electric Scooter; the author reports testing the 5 Pro and 5 Max.
Other listed models have experimental read-only support or remain untested.
PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0.

name: sony-bravia-linux: pre-Android BRAVIA platform and media behavior
description_en: sony-bravia-linux investigates the Linux-based, pre-Android Sony BRAVIA platform and reconstructs selected media and portal behavior for owner-run services. Its documentation records observations from 2011–2012 AZ1, AZ2 and AZ3 sets, including remote input, browser media handling and 3D signalling.
