The repository also contains tools for H.264 3D SEI and related media workflows.
description_zh: sony-bravia-linux 调查基于 Linux 的前 Android 时代 Sony BRAVIA 平台，并为用户自建服务还原部分媒体和门户行为。文档记录了 2011 至 2012 年 AZ1、AZ2、AZ3 系列电视的遥控输入、浏览器媒体处理和 3D 信号表现；仓库也提供处理 H.264 3D SEI 等媒体流程的工具。
requirements: The documented platform scope is 2011–2012 pre-Android Sony BRAVIA AZ1, AZ2 and AZ3 chassis families.
The author reports testing media behavior on two owned TVs.
The main LICENSE file is GPL-2.0; the README also identifies separate licences for parts of the repository.

name: dfsdk
description_en: dfsdk dumps Delta Force object metadata by enumerating its object array, decoding per-entry XOR-encrypted names and walking class super chains and property lists. The README documents name-pool addressing, pointer masking, selected field offsets and example output.
description_zh: dfsdk 遍历 Delta Force 对象数组，解码逐条 XOR 加密的名称，并沿类继承链和属性列表导出对象元数据。README 记录了名称池寻址、指针掩码、部分字段偏移和示例输出。
requirements: A Delta Force process with the documented object and name-pool layout is the target input.
The documented offsets are specific to the investigated layout.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Sound Blaster AE-9: reconstructing Linux control from Windows driver analysis
description_en: Sound Blaster AE-9 Linux support reconstructs card and Audio Control Module behavior using static analysis of Creative's Windows drivers and hardware observations. The included investigations document CtxHda.sys, CtxHdb.sys, and the ACM's SysEx-framed UART protocol; the driver implements selected playback and controls.
description_zh: Sound Blaster AE-9 的 Linux 支持项目通过静态分析 Creative Windows 驱动并观察硬件行为，重建声卡及 Audio Control Module 的部分控制逻辑。仓库记录 CtxHda.sys、CtxHdb.sys 和 ACM 的 SysEx 帧 UART 协议，驱动实现了部分播放与控制功能。
requirements: Linux kernel 6.17 or newer, headers, DKMS, build tools, PipeWire, and WirePlumber are specified.
A Creative driver package is needed to extract a DSP firmware segment locally.
The author reports support for 7 of 16 listed features across the card and Audio Control Module; recording is disabled because opening capture hard-locked the test machine.
GPL-2.0 license.

name: KBot
description_en: KBot inspects and transforms Total Annihilation and TA: Kingdoms game files, pairing a Go CLI with a proprietary format reference. It decompiles COB bytecode to BOS source, disassembles scripts, checks round trips and examines formats including HPI archives, GAF sprites, TNT maps and 3DO models.
description_zh: KBot 将 Go 命令行工具与专有格式参考文档结合，用于检查和转换《Total Annihilation》及《TA: Kingdoms》的游戏文件。它把 COB 字节码反编译成 BOS、反汇编脚本并检查往返转换，还分析 HPI 归档、GAF 精灵、TNT 地图和 3DO 模型等格式。
requirements: Go is needed to install or build the CLI.
Asset inspection requires files from Total Annihilation or TA: Kingdoms; an installed game can provide them.
MIT license.

name: thermalmaster: a Go client for ThermalMaster camera USB commands
description_en: thermalmaster implements a Go USB client for ThermalMaster P3 and P1 thermal cameras using documented VDCMD control transfers. It captures PNG frames, streams thermal and IR video to Linux v4l2loopback, and records USB command framing and model identifiers for interoperability.
description_zh: thermalmaster 根据所记录的 VDCMD USB 控制传输，为 ThermalMaster P3 和 P1 热像仪实现 Go 客户端。它可抓取 PNG 画面，并向 Linux v4l2loopback 输出热成像和红外视频；协议文档列出 USB 命令格式与设备型号标识。
requirements: A ThermalMaster P3 or P1 camera, a C toolchain, pkg-config and libusb development files.
Linux with v4l2loopback is required for video streaming; USB permissions must be configured.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: Cpp2CS
description_en: Cpp2CS recovers managed methods from Android ARM64 Unity IL2CPP ELF binaries and matching metadata, emitting CIL assemblies, C# source and per-method diagnostics. Its pipeline models machine IR, IL2CPP runtime idioms, memory SSA and type recovery while marking unresolved portions.
description_zh: Cpp2CS 从 Android ARM64 Unity IL2CPP ELF 二进制文件和匹配元数据中恢复托管方法，输出 CIL 程序集、C# 源码及逐方法诊断。其流程建模机器 IR、运行时惯用法、内存 SSA 和类型，并标记未恢复部分。
requirements: .NET 10 SDK, the Il2CppDumper submodule, and a matching binary and metadata pair.
Recovery is modeled for Android ARM64 ELF, Unity 2022.3.62f2 and metadata v31.
Generated project files do not establish that the source compiles or runs.
MIT license.

name: ghidra-c6000
description_en: ghidra-c6000 adds Texas Instruments C64x, C67x and C674x DSP support to Ghidra 12.x. Its SLEIGH languages decode full-width and compact instructions, supply p-code for decompilation, and add C6000 calling conventions and packet-aware analyzers for ELF or raw images.
description_zh: ghidra-c6000 为 Ghidra 12.x 增加德州仪器 C64x、C67x 和 C674x DSP 支持。其 SLEIGH 语言解码完整及紧凑指令，提供反编译所需的 p-code，并为 ELF 或原始镜像加入 C6000 调用约定和指令包分析器。
requirements: Requires a matching Ghidra 12.x build and its declared JDK: JDK 21 for Ghidra 12.0 or 12.1, JDK 25 for 12.2.
Raw images require a chosen base address and entry point.
C66x-specific instructions and complete C66x ISA support are absent.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: Sheypoor MCP: mapping marketplace APIs from browser traffic
description_en: Sheypoor MCP implements a client and MCP server for the Sheypoor classifieds site using API behavior documented from browser traffic. Its reference records observed endpoints, request headers, cookies and phone-based login. The server exposes listing search and details, account functions, chat room lists and unread message counts to MCP clients.
description_zh: Sheypoor MCP 根据浏览器流量记录的接口行为，为 Sheypoor 分类信息网站实现客户端和 MCP 服务器。其文档列出已观察到的接口、请求头、Cookie 和手机短信验证码登录流程。服务器向 MCP 客户端提供信息搜索与详情、账户功能，以及聊天会话列表和未读消息数。
requirements: Node.js 20.11+ is indicated for the MCP server.
Account features require Sheypoor phone and SMS authentication.
MIT License.

name: open-rknpu: Rockchip NPU task-program reconstruction
description_en: open-rknpu reconstructs a task-program interface for the Rockchip RV1103/RV1106 NPU from board experiments and black-box comparisons. Its Python compiler emits register commands, weight and quantization blocks, and a container for bounded static ONNX convolution graphs; a C runtime submits them through /dev/rknpu. Research files document register and numerical findings.
description_zh: open-rknpu 通过板卡实验和黑盒对照还原 Rockchip RV1103/RV1106 NPU 的任务程序接口。Python 编译器为限定范围内的静态 ONNX 卷积图生成寄存器命令、权重与量化数据块及容器文件；C 运行时经 /dev/rknpu 提交任务。研究文件记录了寄存器和数值行为。
requirements: Host compilation needs Python, NumPy and ONNX; hardware runs need a compatible board and cross toolchain.
The reference board is a Luckfox Pico Mini B with the shared RV1106 NPU IP and driver v0.8.2.
Dynamic shapes, LSTM/GRU, 1-D convolution, MatMul/Gemm and multi-stage detection heads are outside the documented scope.
MIT license for the compiler, runtime, tests, examples and documentation.

name: Devil May Cry: an experimental PS2 static recompilation
description_en: dmc-recomp translates the PlayStation 2 PAL release of Devil May Cry into native PC code through PS2Recomp and a project runtime. Its pipeline rebuilds generated code locally from the user’s own game executable, while research notes and patches track boot, CD services, MPEG playback, rendering and gameplay behavior.
description_zh: dmc-recomp 借助 PS2Recomp 和项目运行时，将 PAL 欧版 PlayStation 2 游戏 Devil May Cry 转换为 PC 原生代码。其流水线从用户自行提供的游戏可执行文件在本地生成代码，研究笔记和补丁记录启动、光盘服务、MPEG 播放、渲染及游戏流程的分析。
requirements: A user-supplied copy of the PAL Europe Devil May Cry version 1.02 executable or disc image.
PS2Recomp at the pinned upstream commit and the documented build toolchain.
The source describes the port as experimental, with incomplete rendering and gameplay.
GPL-3.0 licence.

name: hardsid4u: reconstructing the HardSID 4U USB protocol
description_en: hardsid4u reconstructs the HardSID 4U USB protocol and implements a libusb Python driver for its SID-chip sockets. The investigation combines vendor-binary analysis, USB captures, and hardware probes to document command framing, initialization, register writes, timing, and flow control; a MIDI instrument uses the driver.
description_zh: hardsid4u 还原 HardSID 4U 的 USB 协议，并用 libusb 实现控制 SID 芯片插槽的 Python 驱动。研究结合厂商二进制分析、USB 抓包和硬件探测，记录报文封装、初始化、寄存器写入、时序及流量控制；MIDI 乐器建立在该驱动之上。
requirements: A HardSID 4U device is needed for hardware use; the core driver requires Python 3.9+, libusb1, and libusb.
MIDI output additionally uses python-rtmidi and CoreMIDI as documented.
The author reports that a stalled device may require a physical power cycle; isochronous mode and SID file playback are unused or absent.
MIT license.

name: MS4X
description_en: MS4X analyzes Siemens MS42 and MS43 engine-control firmware for BMW M52TU and M54 engines. Its Python tools disassemble and assemble C166 instructions and inspect image checksums, stock-code differences and TunerPro patchlists; companion documents cover memory maps and findings in the factory programs.
description_zh: MS4X 分析 BMW M52TU、M54 发动机所用 Siemens MS42/MS43 控制单元固件。Python 工具负责 C166 反汇编与汇编，并检查镜像校验和、原厂代码差异及 TunerPro 补丁列表；文档记录内存映射和原厂程序发现。
requirements: Python 3 and a user-supplied MS42 or MS43 image.
New material is paused; the author says error reports are still addressed.
Code is Apache-2.0; documents and data are CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: ZCode-Android: reconstructing the ZCode remote-control client
description_en: ZCode-Android recreates ZCode remote control on Android from captured traffic and analysis of its official web page. Its Kotlin client implements WebSocket relay, HMAC pairing, IPC encoding, fragmented RPC frames and Conversation V4 session messages.
description_zh: ZCode-Android 根据官方远程控制网页的抓包与逆向结果，在 Android 上重建 ZCode 会话控制。Kotlin 客户端实现 WebSocket 中继、HMAC 配对、IPC 编解码、RPC 分片帧和 Conversation V4 会话消息。
requirements: Android 12+ on arm64-v8a and a desktop ZCode pairing link are required.
Building requires JDK 17 and Android SDK 35.
Changes to the official web protocol may break the client.
The README declares an MIT licence.

name: PyEilik: a client for the Eilik robot's USB protocol
description_en: PyEilik implements control of an Eilik desk robot over a recovered USB serial protocol. Its C library and Python wrapper move four servos, read and update the 128×64 display, and play video with synchronized movement. The protocol reference documents 125000-baud framing, command IDs, checksums and acknowledgements.
description_zh: PyEilik 基于恢复出的 USB 串行协议控制 Eilik 桌面机器人。C 库与 Python 封装可驱动四个舵机、读取和更新 128×64 屏幕，并在视频播放时同步动作。协议文档记录了 125000 波特率、帧结构、命令号、校验和及应答。
requirements: macOS and Python 3.9 or newer are required; the serial link uses an Apple-specific ioctl for 125000 baud.
Video playback requires ffmpeg on PATH; PNG display requires the image extra.
The robot's speaker cannot receive audio through the documented protocol.
MIT license.

name: libfprint-goodixtls: a reconstructed Goodix GXFP5187 fingerprint driver
description_en: libfprint-goodixtls reconstructs communication with the Goodix GXFP5187 SPI fingerprint sensor in the Huawei MateBook X Pro as a libfprint TOD driver. It reads a PSK from sensor RAM, establishes the sensor's TLS-PSK channel, decodes captured images, and uses local descriptors for host-side matching. The author reports enrolment and verification through fprintd and GNOME Settings; detailed reverse-engineering notes are kept outside the repository.
description_zh: libfprint-goodixtls 为 Huawei MateBook X Pro 的 Goodix GXFP5187 SPI 指纹传感器实现 libfprint TOD 驱动。它从传感器内存读取 PSK，建立 TLS-PSK 通道，解码采集图像，并用局部特征描述子在主机端匹配。作者报告可通过 fprintd 和 GNOME 设置录入、验证指纹；详细的逆向研究笔记另行保存，未收入仓库。
requirements: Goodix GXFP5187 sensor on the Huawei MateBook X Pro MACH-WX9, with a usable spidev node.
The detailed protocol-frame and matching-engine notes are kept separately from the repository.
Matcher error rates in the README are author-reported results from the described capture sets.
LGPL-2.1 License.

name: Walksnail Ascent VRX UART Protocol
description_en: Walksnail Ascent VRX UART Protocol documents serial control messages for Walksnail video receivers and supplies a C reference transmitter with an STM32 example. It specifies framing, payload checksums, remote keys, channel selection and status queries, while recording contradictions and unknown reply layouts.
description_zh: Walksnail Ascent VRX UART Protocol 记录 Walksnail 视频接收机的串口控制消息，并提供 C 语言发送实现和 STM32 示例。资料涵盖帧结构、校验和、按键、频道选择与状态查询，同时标明来源中的矛盾和未知回复格式。
requirements: A Walksnail VRX and a controller with a compatible UART interface for hardware use.
The library limits payloads to 64 bytes; baud rate, electrical levels and pinout need hardware confirmation.
TX examples are tested against supplied documentation; RX telemetry layout and device behavior remain unresolved.
MIT license.

name: Sin & Punishment: a work-in-progress N64 static recompilation
description_en: Sin & Punishment: Recompiled uses N64Recomp and RSPRecomp to build an experimental native C++ port from a user-supplied Japanese N64 ROM and the repository's symbol maps, with RT64 rendering. The author reports that it reaches the title screen; menu navigation, gameplay, audio validation, and a public pipeline for its patched working image remain unfinished.
description_zh: Sin & Punishment: Recompiled 使用 N64Recomp 和 RSPRecomp，基于用户提供的日版 N64 ROM 及仓库中的符号映射构建原生 C++ 移植程序，并通过 RT64 渲染。作者报告程序已进入标题画面；菜单导航、游戏流程、音频验证，以及补丁工作镜像的公开生成流程仍待完成。
requirements: A legally obtained Japanese Sin & Punishment ROM, Python 3, the pinned submodules, and the platform build toolchain described in the README.
The current recompilation configuration also expects a patched working image whose preparation pipeline is absent from the public repository.
No licence file in the repository.

name: scvk: replacing SimCity 4's renderer with Vulkan
description_en: scvk reconstructs SimCity 4's renderer interface as a native Vulkan DLL loaded through the game's GZCOM plugin system. It claims existing renderer class IDs and emulates the cIGZGDriver fixed-function API with pipeline state and shaders for terrain, buildings, lighting, textures and interface drawing.
description_zh: scvk 通过 SimCity 4 的 GZCOM 插件系统加载原生 Vulkan DLL，以替换游戏渲染器。它使用已有的渲染器类 ID，并通过管线状态和着色器模拟 cIGZGDriver 固定功能接口，绘制地形、建筑、光照、纹理和界面。
requirements: SimCity 4 with the documented GZCOM plugin interface and Vulkan-capable graphics hardware.
SCGL cannot be installed concurrently because it claims the same renderer class ID; Intel graphics are untested.
LGPL-2.1-or-later license.

name: RazerStream: reconstructing Stream Controller device control
description_en: RazerStream replaces the retired control software for the Razer Stream Controller with a macOS app, Swift protocol library and CLI. Its documented device protocol runs over a USB serial port, performs a WebSocket upgrade, then exchanges framed commands and input events. The app configures touchscreen tiles, knobs, buttons and LEDs.
description_zh: RazerStream 用 macOS 应用、Swift 协议库和命令行工具替代 Razer Stream Controller 已停用的控制软件。文档记录设备通过 USB 串口完成 WebSocket 升级，再交换封装的命令与输入事件；应用可配置触摸屏按键、旋钮、实体按钮和 LED。
requirements: macOS 14 or newer and a Razer Stream Controller with USB VID 0x1532 and PID 0x0D06.
Xcode 16 or newer to build from source; Accessibility permission is needed for keystroke and media-key actions.
The app targets macOS only.
MIT license.

name: DABplay+: reconstructing USB DAB+ dongle control
description_en: DABplay+ implements an Android DAB radio using a reverse-engineered USB dongle protocol. It drives the DTR-100 family directly, decodes broadcast data and audio, and documents additional dongle protocols alongside hardware findings and tests.
description_zh: DABplay+ 借助逆向得到的 USB 接收器协议实现 Android DAB 收音机，可直接控制 DTR-100 系列设备并解码广播数据与音频。仓库还记录其他接收器协议、硬件发现和测试。
requirements: Android 8+ and a supported USB DAB+ dongle are required.
Building requires JDK 25 and the Android SDK.
Only the first listed dongle family has been tested on real hardware; several on-air features remain unconfirmed.
MIT.

name: T2 platform research
description_en: T2 platform research maps Apple T2 firmware, hardware and Linux-facing interfaces using static analysis, hardware observations and driver comparisons. Its chapters cover Secure Enclave services, boot and recovery, graphics, audio, sensors, storage and other subsystems. Machine-readable findings and board indexes connect claims to their evidence, with Python reference code for selected message formats.
description_zh: T2 platform research 通过静态分析、硬件观察和驱动比对，整理 Apple T2 的固件、硬件及 Linux 所需接口。研究章节覆盖 Secure Enclave 服务、启动与恢复、图形、音频、传感器和存储等子系统。机器可读的研究发现和主板索引将结论与证据关联，并标明适用范围；仓库还提供部分消息格式的 Python 参考代码。
requirements: The main firmware inventory covers bridgeOS 23P6068 across 16 production configurations.
Most host observations concern MacBookPro16,1 / J152fAP; other board and firmware claims have separate scope.
The reference code does not provide a driver or fingerprint service.
MIT license.

name: PocketPrinter5890: reconstructing the Lidl 5890 printer protocol
description_en: PocketPrinter5890 reconstructs the BLE printing protocol of Lidl's Tronic, SILVERCREST, and Parkside model 5890 pocket printers. Its specification documents activation writes, flow-control credits, and raster bands; Swift, Kotlin, and TypeScript libraries implement printing for Apple devices, Android, and browsers.
description_zh: PocketPrinter5890 重建了 Lidl Tronic、SILVERCREST 和 Parkside 5890 型便携热敏打印机的 BLE 打印协议。协议文档记录激活写入、流控额度和分段光栅传输；Swift、Kotlin、TypeScript 库分别面向 Apple 设备、Android 和浏览器。
requirements: The documented reference device is model A2Y with firmware V1.06LY; other revisions may differ.
The browser demo requires Web Bluetooth in Chrome, Edge, or Opera.
Firmware updating is not implemented, and roughly twenty transcribed commands were not executed on the reference firmware.
MIT license.

name: Salamander UEFI: a disassembly-based UEFI port of the NES game
description_en: Salamander UEFI ports the NES game Salamander to a native UEFI Shell application by translating its 6502 disassembly into a platform-independent C core. The repository includes a 6502 disassembler, a user-ROM resource extractor, host tests and a fidelity checklist. UEFI GOP, input and timing services replace the original console environment.
description_zh: Salamander UEFI 将红白机游戏《沙罗曼蛇》的 6502 反汇编翻译成平台无关的 C 核心，移植为原生 UEFI Shell 应用。仓库提供 6502 反汇编器、基于用户自有 ROM 的资源提取器、宿主机测试和保真清单，以 UEFI GOP、输入和定时服务替代原主机环境。
requirements: A legally held Salamander NES ROM is required to generate game-resource headers.
Building requires Windows, Visual Studio 2019, EDK2 and Python 3.10 or newer; QEMU/OVMF is used for emulated runs.
The app has no audio, and the source lists score display and some boss sprite differences.
No licence file in the repository.

name: cocos2d-dumper
description_en: cocos2d-dumper extracts defined function symbols from ELF shared libraries and demangles C++ names with GNU binutils. It produces a map of ELF symbol values and names for inspecting unstripped cocos2d-x binaries and other native libraries.
description_zh: cocos2d-dumper 使用 GNU binutils 从 ELF 共享库提取已定义的函数符号，并对 C++ 名称进行反修饰。它生成 ELF 符号表值与名称的对应表，可用于检查未剥离符号的 cocos2d-x 二进制文件及其他原生库。
requirements: Python 3.9 or newer and GNU binutils readelf and c++filt are required.
Unstripped libraries provide the usable function symbols described by the tool.
MIT license.

name: Binary Ninja Security Analysis Plugin
description_en: Binary Ninja Security Analysis Plugin batches binary analysis from a Rust plugin and exports Parquet reports. It records architecture, hashes, functions, strings, segments, cyclomatic complexity, entropy and references to selected process-execution functions.
description_zh: Binary Ninja Security Analysis Plugin 是用 Rust 编写的批量二进制分析插件，输出 Parquet 报告。报告包含架构、哈希、函数、字符串、段、圈复杂度、熵，以及指向指定进程执行函数的交叉引用。
requirements: Requires Binary Ninja, a stable Rust toolchain and Binary Ninja API development headers.
The author reports testing the rebuilt command in Binary Ninja Personal 6.1.10951-dev.
MIT License.

name: NWBinAnalyzer
description_en: NWBinAnalyzer inspects compiled NW.js .bin files by checking their header and walking constant-pool entries. Its Python code extracts UTF-8, null-terminated and length-prefixed strings, then groups findings such as API names, paths, URLs and cryptographic terms.
description_zh: NWBinAnalyzer 检查 NW.js 编译后的 .bin 文件头并遍历常量池条目。其 Python 程序提取 UTF-8、空终止及带长度前缀的字符串，再按 API 名称、路径、URL 和密码学术语等类别整理。
requirements: Python 3.6+; the author says the tool uses only the standard library.
The author states that it shows constant-pool strings and does not fully decompile V8 bytecode.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Parking sensor kit: reconstructing its display protocol
description_en: This parking-sensor investigation reconstructs the signal sent from a kit's controller to its display. Oscilloscope observations and tests with different sensor states identify fields in roughly 48-bit frames for sensor address, connection and proximity. A PlatformIO example for ATmega328P reads and reports the parsed frames.
description_zh: 该倒车雷达研究重建控制板向显示器发送的信号。作者结合示波器观察与不同传感器状态测试，在约 48 位的帧中定位传感器地址、连接状态和接近程度标志，并提供基于 ATmega328P 的 PlatformIO 解析示例。
requirements: The example targets an ATmega328P microcontroller and a compatible parking-sensor kit.
Controller electronics vary across similar kits, so the code may need changes.
Check signal voltage before connecting a microcontroller; the documented unit exceeded 5 V.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Glaurung Models
description_en: Glaurung Models contains tokenizer and model experiments for executable analysis. Its documented 64K BPE tokenizer encodes compiled PE and ELF bytes using Latin-1, with x86 and ARM64 training coverage; an accompanying analysis compares learned SSE and AVX instruction patterns across two tokenizers.
description_zh: Glaurung Models 收录面向可执行文件分析的分词器与模型实验。其 64K BPE 分词器以 Latin-1 编码 PE 和 ELF 字节，训练范围涵盖 x86 与 ARM64；附带分析比较了两个分词器学到的 SSE 和 AVX 指令模式。
requirements: The documented tokenizer workflow uses the tokenizers and transformers Python packages and Latin-1 conversion of binary bytes.
The document reports an average of 2.849 bytes per token for the 64K tokenizer.
No licence file in the repository.

name: pyhaseiq: reconstructing the older Hase iQ stove's WebSocket protocol
description_en: pyhaseiq reconstructs the local WebSocket protocol of Hase iQ wood stoves used with the flamemonitor app and implements an asynchronous read-only Python client. The specification records base64-encoded request and response frames, serial dialogue and observation status for each finding; the client reads combustion phase, temperature and performance.
description_zh: pyhaseiq 复原与 flamemonitor 应用配套的旧款 Hase iQ 木炉本地 WebSocket 协议，并实现异步、只读的 Python 客户端。协议文档记录 base64 编码的请求与应答、串行交互及各项结论的证据状态；客户端读取燃烧阶段、温度和性能数值。
requirements: Python 3.13 or newer and a supported flamemonitor-generation Hase iQ stove on the local network.
The newer HASE iQ app generation is unsupported; the API is described as alpha.
The library implements no write commands.
MIT license.

name: CrackMes
description_en: CrackMes is a set of walkthroughs for purpose-built crackme binaries from crackmes.one. The supplied Linux x86-64 examples identify ELF executables, inspect program disassembly, use breakpoints and runtime observations, and explain how candidate input is checked.
description_zh: CrackMes 收录 crackmes.one 专用逆向练习程序的解析文章。 Linux x86-64 示例识别 ELF 可执行文件、检查反汇编、使用断点和运行时观察，并说明输入值的校验过程。
requirements: The covered examples use Linux x86-64 crackme binaries obtained separately from crackmes.one.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Human-Readable Decompilation
description_en: Human-Readable Decompilation restructures C produced by Ghidra's binary decompiler using an ANTLR parser and AST transformations. It recovers switches from conditional chains, introduces guard clauses, flattens nested branches and simplifies selected expressions. A GUI can launch Ghidra headlessly before transformation, while a CLI handles existing C output.
description_zh: Human-Readable Decompilation 使用 ANTLR 解析 Ghidra 从二进制文件反编译得到的 C 代码，并进行 AST 转换。功能包括从条件链恢复 switch、引入卫语句、压平嵌套分支及简化部分表达式；图形界面可先启动 Ghidra 无头分析，命令行也能处理已有 C 文件。
requirements: Ghidra 11.4.2 or later, a Java runtime and Python 3 are specified for the full workflow.
ANTLR Python runtime and tools are needed to generate the parser.
Further transformation coverage, including iteration statements, remains planned.
BSD-3-Clause license.

name: BinStruct Inspector
description_en: BinStruct Inspector is a GUI for examining binary file layouts through user-defined field trees. It parses files as structures are edited, shows parsed values beside synchronized hex and JSON views, and tracks byte-level insertions, deletions, and replacements; plugins add custom data types.
description_zh: BinStruct Inspector 是通过自定义字段树检查二进制文件布局的图形工具。编辑结构时可实时解析文件，并同步显示字段值、十六进制和 JSON 视图；差异监控记录字节级增删替换，插件可扩展数据类型。
requirements: The package manifest requires Python 3.11+ and PySide6 6.0+.
MIT license.

name: SimpleParserPE
description_en: SimpleParserPE is a C++ command-line inspector for PE32 Windows executables. It reads DOS and NT headers, section metadata, data directories, and imported DLL functions, translating RVAs through the section table without Windows headers or external libraries.
description_zh: SimpleParserPE 是检查 PE32 Windows 可执行文件的 C++ 命令行工具。它读取 DOS、NT 文件头、节信息、数据目录和 DLL 导入函数，并通过节表换算 RVA；实现不依赖 Windows 头文件或外部库。
requirements: A C++17 compiler and a PE32 executable input are required.
PE32+ is rejected; bounds checking is absent, and exports, relocations, and resources are not parsed.
MIT license.

name: BNDExtract
description_en: BNDExtract is a Go command-line tool for extracting the ALL.BND archive used by Kuon and some other FromSoftware PlayStation 2 games. It takes a .bnd file and an output directory, providing access to the archive's contents for inspection.
description_zh: BNDExtract 是 Go 命令行工具，用于提取《九怨》及部分其他 FromSoftware PlayStation 2 游戏的 ALL.BND 归档。输入 .bnd 文件和输出目录后，可取得归档内容供检查。
requirements: A supported .bnd archive and Go to build the tool.
The documented support centres on Kuon's ALL.BND and some other FromSoftware PS2 releases.
No licence file in the repository.

name: tenet_tracer
description_en: tenet_tracer uses Intel Pin to record instruction-level execution traces for Tenet. It captures program counters, register changes and memory accesses, stores them in SQLite tables, and provides a script to export the trace text.
description_zh: tenet_tracer 使用 Intel Pin 采集指令级执行轨迹，供 Tenet 查看。它记录程序计数器、寄存器变化和内存访问，将轨迹存入 SQLite 表，并提供导出文本的脚本。
requirements: Intel Pin is required; the documented Windows build uses Visual Studio 2022 and Pin 3.31 with LLVM clang-cl.
Kernel debugging must be disabled for the documented Pin setup.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Binary BPE Tokenizer for Executable Analysis
description_en: Binary BPE Tokenizer for Executable Analysis studies byte-pair encoding of ELF, PE, Mach-O and APK files for transformer-based binary analysis. The repository provides paper sources, 4K to 64K tokenizer vocabularies, Python evaluation scripts and a sample archive. The author reports 2.89 bytes per token for the 64K vocabulary.
description_zh: Binary BPE Tokenizer for Executable Analysis 研究面向 Transformer 二进制分析的 ELF、PE、Mach-O 和 APK 字节对编码。仓库包含论文源文件、4K 至 64K 词表、Python 评测脚本和样本压缩包。作者报告 64K 词表平均每个 token 对应 2.89 字节。
requirements: Python 3.10+ with uv; TeX Live 2023+ is required to compile the paper.
Rust 1.70+ is optional for retraining the tokenizer from scratch.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Power BI API Scraper: decoding a published report query format
description_en: Power BI API Scraper reconstructs the web client's undocumented query and response format for published reports. It sends SemanticQueryDataShapeCommand requests, follows restart tokens and expands bitsets and ValueDicts into CSV rows. The included example is hardcoded for an Ohio liquor permit report.
description_zh: Power BI API Scraper 还原公开报表所用的网页客户端查询与响应格式。程序发送 SemanticQueryDataShapeCommand 请求，使用重启令牌翻页，并将位集和 ValueDicts 还原为 CSV 行；附带示例固定针对俄亥俄州酒类许可证报表。
requirements: Python 3.7+ and requests; access to a public Power BI report.
The included query, resource key and model ID are hardcoded for one report; retargeting requires code changes.
Non-200 responses stop the run, and overlapping pages are not deduplicated.
MIT License.

name: m0rph: tracing an obfuscated ELF flag checker
description_en: The m0rph investigation examines an obfuscated x86-64 ELF CTF flag checker with readelf, strings, Cutter and Radare2. Its write-up traces indirect CALL RAX execution into allocated memory and describes recovering expected characters by breaking at the call and inspecting RDI during each loop iteration.
description_zh: m0rph 调查使用 readelf、strings、Cutter 和 Radare2 分析一款经过混淆的 x86-64 ELF CTF 字符串校验程序。报告追踪 CALL RAX 跳转到动态分配内存的执行过程，并说明如何逐次在调用处设断点、检查 RDI 以还原预期字符。
requirements: The m0rph x86-64 ELF challenge binary and a Linux analysis environment are needed to repeat the investigation.
Radare2, Cutter and standard Linux inspection utilities are used in the described workflow.
MIT license.

name: OpenTracks: a UWP port of OpenTracks7 BETA1
description_en: OpenTracks is an early UWP port of the OpenTracks7 BETA1 Windows Phone music app informed by the author's reverse engineering. Its C# and XAML implementation updates page control access and replaces WP7 MediaPlayerLauncher with UWP media playback APIs.
description_zh: OpenTracks 是基于作者对 OpenTracks7 BETA1 的逆向研究所做的早期 UWP 移植。仓库中的 C# 和 XAML 实现更新了页面控件访问方式，并以 UWP 媒体播放 API 替换 WP7 的 MediaPlayerLauncher。
requirements: Targets Windows 10 Mobile; the project uses Windows SDK 19041 with minimum SDK 10240.
The author describes the port as pre-beta, with settings storage, playback behavior and background tasks still needing work.
MIT license.

name: BinScan
description_en: BinScan scans files in bulk and emits per-file JSON containing format identification, structural metadata, hashes and entropy. Its C++ library includes parsers for PE, ELF and Mach-O executables alongside archives, packages, documents and images, with a staged read, analyze and write pipeline.
description_zh: BinScan 批量扫描文件，为每个文件输出含格式识别、结构信息、哈希和熵值的 JSON。其 C++ 库包含 PE、ELF、Mach-O 可执行文件及压缩包、安装包、文档和图像的解析器，按读取、分析、写入三个阶段处理。
requirements: C++20, CMake and OpenSSL; the README provides Windows, Linux and macOS build instructions.
The author describes the current version as unreleased and warns that results may contain inaccuracies.
MIT license.

name: Patch-0xC0000022
description_en: Patch-0xC0000022 instruments the running Windows SysMain service by changing its NtCreateFile response to STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED. The C++ program finds the service process, resolves the remote function address and applies a six-byte patch to study the effect on prefetch behavior.
description_zh: Patch-0xC0000022 修改运行中的 Windows SysMain 服务，使 NtCreateFile 返回 STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED。该 C++ 程序定位服务进程和远程函数地址，再应用六字节补丁，以研究预取行为的变化。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 x64, Visual Studio C++ tools and administrator permission are required.
The source calls for a controlled test environment and says restarting Windows restores runtime state.
Restoring or removing the patch is listed as future work.
No licence file in the repository.

name: LED Controller: a BanlanX BLE client with audio-feed protocol findings
description_en: LED Controller uses BanlanX BLE commands to control SP611E-family LED strips from a desktop app. Its documentation maps GATT commands and state notifications, and reports probing an audio-feed message used by the controller’s music effects; included tools inspect advertisements, GATT state and Bluetooth captures.
description_zh: LED Controller 通过 BanlanX BLE 命令在电脑上控制 SP611E 系列灯带。文档列出 GATT 命令和状态通知，记录作者探测到的音乐效果音频数据消息；随附工具可检查广播、GATT 状态与蓝牙抓包。
requirements: A PC with Bluetooth Low Energy, uv and a compatible BanlanX controller.
PC audio input works on Windows only; BanlanX v3 models are implemented from UniLED documentation but untested on hardware.
No licence file in the repository.

name: CPQ IO Scheduler: reconstructing Xiaomi's block scheduler
description_en: CPQ IO Scheduler reconstructs Xiaomi's proprietary cpq.ko Linux block scheduler from a stripped ARM64 kernel module. Its out-of-tree C implementation combines priority classes, thread-group queues, deadline handling, and blk-mq elevator integration, with a whitepaper and author-reported benchmarks.
description_zh: CPQ IO Scheduler 从已剥离符号的 ARM64 cpq.ko 内核模块还原小米的 Linux 块设备调度器。独立 C 模块实现优先级类别、线程组队列、期限处理及 blk-mq elevator 集成，并附技术论文和作者报告的基准测试。
requirements: Building requires Linux kernel headers for the block layer and scheduler APIs; the author reports testing on Linux 6.1 with RK3588 and eMMC 5.1.
The author reports a 5-of-6 workload win against mq-deadline, with about 1.9% average IOPS uplift.
GPL-2.0 license, as stated in the README and source-file notice.

name: Zemismart Blind Controller Protocol: RF command reconstruction
description_en: Zemismart Blind Controller Protocol documents the 433.92 MHz OOK PWM messages used by Zemismart motorized blind remotes. It records pulse timing, payload fields and formulas for channel and button commands, with Python scripts to capture IQ samples and encode or decode transmissions.
description_zh: Zemismart Blind Controller Protocol 记录 Zemismart 电动窗帘遥控器的 433.92 MHz OOK PWM 消息。文档给出脉冲时序、载荷字段以及频道和按键命令的计算公式；Python 脚本用于采集 IQ 样本和编解码发送内容。
requirements: Zemismart motorized blind remote captures; the capture script uses LimeSDR and SoapySDR.
No licence file in the repository.

name: RE4METoolbox
description_en: RE4METoolbox provides command-line utilities for examining and modifying Resident Evil 4 Mobile Edition files. RE4MEAcvTool unpacks and repacks ACV .bin archives, while RE4METextTool converts Mission and Resource .bin text files to TSV and repacks edited text.
description_zh: RE4METoolbox 提供命令行工具，用于处理《生化危机 4》移动版文件。RE4MEAcvTool 解包和重打包 ACV .bin 归档；RE4METextTool 将 Mission、Resource 文本 .bin 转成 TSV，并可将修改后的文本重新打包。
requirements: Resident Evil 4 Mobile Edition .bin files; the text tool requires a Mission or Resource format flag.
MIT license.

name: AC46 Firmware Tool
description_en: AC46 Firmware Tool unpacks firmware images for JieLi AC4600/BT15 devices. It accepts a dumped flash image or a BFU file with its first 512 bytes removed, detects an encryption state, extracts bootloader and resource files, and writes a repacking batch script. The repository also lists cipher, CRC16, and chip-key utilities.
description_zh: AC46 Firmware Tool 用于解包 JieLi AC4600/BT15 设备固件。它读取设备闪存转储，或去掉前 512 字节的 BFU 文件，检测加密状态，提取引导程序与资源，并生成重新打包的批处理脚本。仓库还列出密码处理、CRC16 和芯片密钥工具。
requirements: A flash image from a JieLi AC46/BT15 device, or a BFU file with its first 512 bytes removed, is required.
Repacking requires an AC46 SDK.
No licence file in the repository.

name: iMonitor
description_en: iMonitor is a Windows endpoint activity monitor for examining running software. It records process, file, registry and network events, adds DLL-load analysis, and supports custom columns and matching rules through plugins and scripts.
description_zh: iMonitor 是用于观察 Windows 运行中软件的系统行为工具，可记录进程、文件、注册表和网络事件，分析 DLL 加载，并通过插件和脚本扩展列及匹配规则。
requirements: Windows is required.
MIT license.

name: RTO eChalan: investigating a BankBot Android APK
description_en: The RTO eChalan report investigates an Android APK impersonating an Indian government eChallan service through manifest review, JADX decompilation and sandbox analysis. The author reports identifying a BankBot variant, a REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES permission, a BIND_VPN_SERVICE entry and extensive obfuscation that limited decompilation.
description_zh: RTO eChalan 报告通过检查 AndroidManifest.xml、使用 JADX 反编译及沙箱分析，调查一个冒充印度政府交通罚单服务的 APK。作者报告将其识别为 BankBot 变种，并记录了 REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES 权限、BIND_VPN_SERVICE 条目及妨碍反编译的大量混淆代码。
requirements: The report covers one Android APK named RTO eChalan.apk.
The author reports that approximately 96% of classes failed to load during decompilation.
CC-BY-4.0 license.

name: m68kdasm
description_en: m68kdasm disassembles Motorola 68000-family machine code in Go and returns assembly with structured instruction metadata. It supports selectable CPU variants, optional FPU and PMMU decoding, symbol and label formatting, streaming input and helpers for 68000 ELF binaries.
description_zh: m68kdasm 用 Go 反汇编 Motorola 68000 系列机器码，同时输出汇编文本和结构化指令信息。它支持选择 CPU 型号、按需解码 FPU 与 PMMU 指令、符号和标签格式化、流式输入，以及 68000 ELF 文件辅助功能。
requirements: Go 1.27, as specified in go.mod.
Some CPU instructions, including CPU32 TBLS/TBLU and 68040 MOVE16/CINV/CPUSH, remain unimplemented.
MIT license.

name: Malware Analysis: njRAT and Casdet behavior investigation
description_en: A malware investigation examines njRAT and a UPX-packed Casdet executable with PEStudio static triage and ANY.RUN sandbox telemetry, alongside a malicious PDF and benign comparison files. The author reports process, registry and network behavior, extracted indicators and MITRE ATT&CK mappings in a report and screenshots.
description_zh: 该恶意软件研究用 PEStudio 静态检查和 ANY.RUN 沙箱遥测分析 njRAT 与经 UPX 打包的 Casdet 可执行文件，同时检查恶意 PDF 和良性对照文件。作者在报告及截图中记录了进程、注册表、网络行为、入侵指标和 MITRE ATT&CK 映射。
requirements: The investigation used PEStudio 9.56 and ANY.RUN on a Windows 10 guest.
The author reports that Infected.exe crashed because libelf.dll was missing, so no sandbox behavior was observed for it.

name: IR Lifting Benchmark
description_en: IR Lifting Benchmark compares binary lifting workflows across Ghidra P-code, angr VEX, BAP BIL and optional LLVM IR paths. Shell and Python scripts run analyses on binary samples, collect performance and control-flow metrics, check lifted semantics and generate reports and visualizations.
description_zh: IR Lifting Benchmark 比较 Ghidra P-code、angr VEX、BAP BIL 及可选 LLVM IR 的二进制提升流程。Shell 与 Python 脚本分析样本、收集性能和控制流指标、检查提升后的语义，并生成报告与图表。
requirements: Linux, Python 3.8 or later, Ghidra 10.x or 11.x and the selected analysis tools.
BAP and LLVM lifting are optional; true binary-to-LLVM IR lifting needs RetDec or llvm-mctoll.
User-provided samples are needed for malware analysis.
MIT license.

name: OpenOCD SPI Dump Plugin
description_en: OpenOCD SPI Dump Plugin guides an agent through extracting SPI flash or EEPROM contents using a target MCU's SWD/JTAG debug connection. It supplies MCU register maps, a RAM-resident C reader, linker and OpenOCD Tcl templates, and a workflow for JEDEC identification and dump checking.
description_zh: OpenOCD SPI Dump Plugin 引导智能体经目标 MCU 的 SWD/JTAG 调试连接提取 SPI 闪存或 EEPROM 内容。仓库提供 MCU 寄存器表、驻留 RAM 的 C 读取程序、链接脚本、OpenOCD Tcl 模板，以及 JEDEC 识别和转储核对流程。
requirements: OpenOCD, an ARM GNU toolchain, and netcat are required.
A working SWD/JTAG probe connection and an MCU connected to SPI flash or EEPROM are required.
The maximum dump chunk size remains to be parameterized.
MIT license.

name: Bin-Hunter
description_en: Bin-Hunter is a Python command-line tool for initial static inspection of binary files. It identifies formats from magic bytes, calculates whole-file and peak-region Shannon entropy, extracts readable strings, and finds URLs, IP addresses, email addresses, and suspicious keywords in those strings.
description_zh: Bin-Hunter 是用于二进制文件初步静态检查的 Python 命令行工具。它通过魔数字节识别格式，计算整体及高熵区域的 Shannon 熵，提取可读字符串，并查找其中的 URL、IP 地址、邮箱和可疑关键词。
requirements: Python standard library; no external dependencies are stated.
MIT license.

name: vanmoof-certificates: decoding VanMoof bike certificates
description_en: vanmoof-certificates decodes the access certificates used with VanMoof SA5 and Series 6 bikes. It documents an Ed25519 signature followed by a CBOR payload containing bike serials, user identity, access role and expiry, and provides Go code to request, parse and check certificates. The source says the SA5 verification key was recovered from a bike BLE certificate.
description_zh: vanmoof-certificates 解析 VanMoof SA5 与 Series 6 自行车使用的访问证书。文档描述了 Ed25519 签名及其后的 CBOR 载荷，包括车架与模块序列号、用户身份、权限角色和到期时间；Go 代码负责请求、解析和检查证书。项目称 SA5 验证公钥取自车辆的 BLE 证书。
requirements: A VanMoof account with a supported bike is needed to request certificates.
The source states that the Series 6 signing key is not yet known, so its signatures are not verified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Aspyr Archive Tool
description_en: Aspyr Archive Tool unpacks and rebuilds Android OBB archives used by three Aspyr game ports: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II, Jade Empire: Special Edition and Fahrenheit: Indigo Prophecy Remastered. Its command-line options support full or selective compression and a CRC64 checksum for Jade Empire.
description_zh: Aspyr Archive Tool 用于拆包和重建三款 Aspyr Android 游戏移植版的 OBB 归档：Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II、Jade Empire: Special Edition 和 Fahrenheit: Indigo Prophecy Remastered。命令行支持完整或选择性压缩，以及 Jade Empire 所需的 CRC64 校验值。
requirements: An OBB archive from one of the listed games is required.
MIT.

name: BinaryInsight
description_en: BinaryInsight inspects ELF, PE, and Mach-O executables and libraries in an interactive terminal view or a text-report CLI. Its Rust core uses goblin to parse binary structure and exposes sections, symbols, printable strings, and security mitigation indicators such as PIE, NX, RELRO, ASLR, and DEP.
description_zh: BinaryInsight 以交互式终端界面或文本报告检查 ELF、PE、Mach-O 可执行文件和库。其 Rust 核心使用 goblin 解析文件结构，展示节、符号、可打印字符串，以及 PIE、NX、RELRO、ASLR 和 DEP 等安全缓解标志。
requirements: Rust and Cargo are required to build from source.
MIT License.

name: ScriptSource-Dumper
description_en: ScriptSource-Dumper extracts scripts from Call of Duty: Black Ops II scriptsrc.clump archives. Its C++ parser reads the archive table of contents and data chunks, locates the internal name table, and writes files under their recovered names and directories.
description_zh: ScriptSource-Dumper 从《使命召唤：黑色行动 2》的 scriptsrc.clump 档案提取脚本。C++ 解析器读取目录表与数据块，定位内部名称表，并按还原的文件名和目录输出内容。
requirements: A scriptsrc.clump archive from Call of Duty: Black Ops II.
Visual Studio 2022 or newer and the MSVC v145 toolset to build.
No licence file in the repository.

name: derkt
description_en: derkt parses and disassembles Hermes Bytecode files in Racket. It decodes HBC structures and function data, detects the bytecode version and loads a matching generated instruction definition before producing disassembly. The repository includes versioned ISA definitions, parsers and a sample HBC file.
description_zh: derkt 是 Racket 编写的 Hermes Bytecode 解析与反汇编工具。它读取 HBC 结构和函数数据，识别字节码版本，再加载对应的生成式指令定义输出反汇编。仓库包含分版本 ISA 定义、解析器和 HBC 样本。
requirements: Racket is required; the CLI accepts an HBC file path.
MIT.

name: .AUP-File-Type-Decryptor-and-Viewer
description_en: .AUP-File-Type-Decryptor-and-Viewer is a local browser tool for inspecting Dragon Soul .aup game asset files. It implements the documented LZSS variant, previews image, audio and text formats, and exports files while preserving folder structure. The README specifies the four-byte size header and ring-buffer command stream.
description_zh: .AUP-File-Type-Decryptor-and-Viewer 是本地浏览器工具，用于查看《Dragon Soul》的 .aup 游戏资源文件。它实现文档所述的 LZSS 变体，可预览图像、音频和文本，并按原有目录结构导出文件。README 还说明了四字节长度头与环形缓冲命令流。
requirements: A browser and Dragon Soul .aup files are required for use.
Encoding and compression of raw files back into .aup is listed as unfinished.
MIT license.

name: ODIS file unpacker
description_en: ODIS file unpacker extracts protected Java classes from ODIS plugin JARs and files from its DIDB data archives. The author traces AES class decryption and Blowfish ECB data decryption through debugging, a Java agent and decompiled class code; some extracted files also require GZIP decompression.
description_zh: ODIS file unpacker 从 ODIS 插件 JAR 中提取受保护的 Java 类，并解包 DIDB 数据。作者通过调试、Java 代理程序和反编译后的类代码定位 AES 类解密及 Blowfish ECB 数据解密；部分文件还需 GZIP 解压。
requirements: User-supplied ODIS plugin and DIDB data files.
Python with pycryptodome and blowfish installed.
No licence file in the repository.

name: rust-sig-gen
description_en: rust-sig-gen generates IDA FLAIR library signatures from compiled Rust crates for executable analysis. Its Python script obtains the top 100 crates, builds them for Linux and x86-64 Windows, and processes the outputs with sigmake, pelf and pcf.
description_zh: rust-sig-gen 为可执行文件分析生成 Rust crate 的 IDA FLAIR 库签名。其 Python 脚本获取排名前 100 的 crate，编译 Linux 与 x86-64 Windows 版本，再使用 sigmake、pelf 和 pcf 处理编译产物。
requirements: Python packages requests and toml, a Rust compiler, and IDA Pro FLAIR tools sigmake, pelf and pcf are required.
The documented scope is the top 100 Rust crates and Linux and x86-64 Windows builds.
No licence file in the repository.

name: tMock-Server: reconstructing Terraria server handshakes
description_en: tMock-Server is an unfinished C++ reimplementation of the Terraria server's initial network flow. It uses socket code and packet classes to accept connections, check protocol versions, request passwords, and assign player slots; the README records packet IDs, fields, directions, and structures informed by traffic analysis.
description_zh: tMock-Server 是用 C++ 重建 Terraria 服务器初始联网流程的未完成项目。它以套接字代码和数据包类处理连接、协议版本、密码交换及玩家槽位分配；README 根据流量分析记录了消息 ID、字段、方向和结构。
requirements: GNU/Linux is currently required because the server relies on its socket support.
CMake 4.1 and a C++26 toolchain are specified by the build file.
Player and world information handling remain unfinished.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: 1C 7.7 Configuration Parser (MD Parser)
description_en: 1C 7.7 Configuration Parser inspects 1C:Enterprise 7.7 1cv7.md configuration containers. Its Win32 interface displays OLE streams, decompresses ZLib data, removes the documented XOR layer and parses Main MetaData Stream into an object hierarchy.
description_zh: 1C 7.7 Configuration Parser 检查 1C:Enterprise 7.7 的 1cv7.md 配置容器。其 Win32 界面展示 OLE 流，解压 ZLib 数据、去除文档所述的 XOR 加密层，并将 Main MetaData Stream 解析为对象层级。
requirements: Windows and a 1cv7.md configuration file are required.
Building uses Visual Studio or Build Tools with NMAKE.
MIT license.

name: x64dbg-tenet
description_en: x64dbg-tenet is a native x64dbg plugin that records execution steps in Tenet trace format. Commands start and stop logging or trace a specified number of steps, with an option to stop when execution leaves the current module.
description_zh: x64dbg-tenet 是将执行步骤录制为 Tenet 轨迹格式的原生 x64dbg 插件。命令可启动和停止记录，也可追踪指定步数，或在执行离开当前模块时停止。
requirements: x64dbg is required.
MIT license.

name: VanMoof BLE: a client for S5, A5 and S6 bicycle protocols
description_en: VanMoof BLE implements a Python client for the S5, A5 and S6 bicycle BLE protocols. It authenticates with an Ed25519 certificate, reads and writes documented topics, decodes captured messages, and exposes controls and telemetry according to each model's message format.
description_zh: VanMoof BLE 用 Python 实现 VanMoof S5、A5 和 S6 自行车的 BLE 协议客户端。它使用 Ed25519 证书认证，读写文档化的主题、解码抓取的消息，并按不同车型的消息格式提供控制与遥测功能。
requirements: A VanMoof S5, A5 or S6, a BLE-capable device, Python 3.8+, and the bike certificate and private key.
Region changes, streaming telemetry and module status are listed for S5/A5 only.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Holley EFI Parser
description_en: Holley EFI Parser decodes Holley DL and DLZ data logs and live ECU CAN messages. Its Python tools decompress DLZ with byte swapping and RLE, parse versioned DL records into pandas DataFrames, and decode CAN messages using supplied DBC files. The documentation records the proprietary 29-bit CAN identifier layout.
description_zh: Holley EFI Parser 解析 Holley 的 DL、DLZ 数据日志及 ECU 实时 CAN 消息。Python 工具通过字节交换和 RLE 解压 DLZ，将不同版本的 DL 记录读入 pandas DataFrame，并用附带的 DBC 文件解码 CAN；文档还记录了专有的 29 位 CAN 标识符结构。
requirements: Python and the package dependencies are required; live CAN use additionally needs a configured Linux CAN interface.
V4 DL support is partial, and V5 files require conversion to V6 with Holley software.
The author reports DLZ decompression accuracy from nine file pairs.
MIT License.

name: CAN Bus Parser
description_en: CAN Bus Parser decodes VanMoof SA5 and later bicycle CAN captures from CSV or candump input. It reassembles multi-frame CBOR messages, maps device IDs and heartbeat frames, and provides live or saved-capture diagnostics for components such as the electronic lock and shifter.
description_zh: CAN Bus Parser 解析 VanMoof SA5 及后续车型的 CSV 或 candump CAN 抓包，重组多帧 CBOR 消息并映射设备 ID 与心跳帧。它还可对电子锁、变速器等组件进行实时或离线诊断。
requirements: Go 1.24 or newer.
Live capture requires Linux SocketCAN and a CAN adapter supporting 1 Mbps and 29-bit extended IDs.

name: Cosmic Byte Firestorm Controller: a USB protocol client for mouse settings
description_en: Cosmic Byte Firestorm Controller implements a Linux client for the mouse's recovered USB settings protocol. Its Python CLI sends control and interrupt transfers to configure lighting effects, per-DPI indicator colours and sensitivity levels, while PROTOCOL.md records packet structures and command sequences.
description_zh: Cosmic Byte Firestorm Controller 是基于已解析 USB 设置协议实现的 Linux 鼠标控制工具。其 Python 命令行程序通过控制传输和中断传输配置灯效、各档 DPI 指示颜色及灵敏度；PROTOCOL.md 记录了数据包结构和命令序列。
requirements: Linux and a Cosmic Byte Firestorm mouse with VID 0x04d9 and PID 0xa09f; USB access typically requires sudo.
Running from source requires Python, pyusb and PyYAML.
Device support was tested only with the named Firestorm model.
GPL-3.0 licence.

name: NuVelocity Engine: reimplementing Reflexive's Velocity Engine
description_en: NuVelocity Engine reimplements Reflexive Entertainment's Velocity Engine as a C++ and SDL3 game engine. It provides modular 2D rendering, asset and resource loading, audio playback, screen management, and a property-based object system, with decoder source included in the repository.
description_zh: NuVelocity Engine 用 C++ 和 SDL3 重实现 Reflexive Entertainment 的 Velocity Engine。它包含模块化二维渲染、资源加载、音频播放、界面管理和基于属性的对象系统，仓库中还提供资源解码器源码。
requirements: SDL3, SDL3_image, SDL3_mixer, SDL3_ttf, zlib, physfs, CMake, and submodules are required for the documented build.
Mozilla Public License 2.0 applies to the engine and main code.

name: FreeRS42: reimplementing Ricochet Xtreme
description_en: FreeRS42 is a C++ project to reimplement the PC game Ricochet Xtreme using the NuVelocity engine. The repository contains source for game objects, playfield behavior and screens, with a CMake build that includes the engine submodule.
description_zh: FreeRS42 是使用 NuVelocity 引擎、以 C++ 重现 PC 游戏《Ricochet Xtreme》的项目。仓库包含游戏对象、场地逻辑和界面的源码，并通过 CMake 构建游戏及引擎子模块。
requirements: Clone the repository with submodules and install the engine dependencies documented by the project.
MPL-2.0 license for the main code and engine.

name: Universal GBA Pokedex
description_en: Universal GBA Pokedex scans Game Boy Advance Pokémon ROMs to locate and display evolution, name and item tables. It searches byte signatures, scores candidate tables using text and pointer patterns, and aligns entries against known anchors instead of requiring fixed offsets.
description_zh: Universal GBA Pokedex 扫描 Game Boy Advance 宝可梦 ROM，定位并展示进化、名称和道具表。它搜索字节特征，依据文本及指针模式评分候选表，再用已知条目对齐索引，无需预设固定偏移。
requirements: Requires a Game Boy Advance Pokémon ROM supplied by the user.
Running from source requires Python 3.x and Tkinter.
Support for expanded Pokédex hacks such as Radical Red is experimental.
MIT licence.

name: NullSec BinGaze
description_en: NullSec BinGaze analyses ELF executables by parsing headers, listing sections and calculating entropy. It also reports NX stack, PIE, RELRO, stack-canary and RWX-segment properties through command-line modes for full analysis, section listing or security assessment.
description_zh: NullSec BinGaze 通过解析 ELF 头、列出节区和计算熵来分析可执行文件。命令行提供完整分析、节区列表和安全属性检查，可报告 NX 栈、PIE、RELRO、栈保护及 RWX 段。
requirements: A C++20 compiler and CMake are required to build it.
The README labels the licence NullSec Proprietary; the file list contains no licence file.

name: Centerpiece Projects: decoding Finalmouse Centerpiece USB control
description_en: Centerpiece Projects documents observed USB control messages for the Finalmouse Centerpiece keyboard and implements scripts around them. Its notes describe HID framing and message types for uploads, status, slot switching and preview chunks; PowerShell and Python helpers expose device operations.
description_zh: Centerpiece Projects 记录 Finalmouse Centerpiece 键盘的 USB 控制消息，并据此编写交互脚本。协议笔记描述 HID 帧结构，以及上传、状态、槽位切换和预览分块的消息类型；PowerShell 与 Python 工具提供相应操作。
requirements: A connected Finalmouse Centerpiece, Windows 10 or later, PowerShell and Python for the public scripts.
The vendor-specific WinUSB bulk interface remains under investigation, and the notes are not a complete protocol specification.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Facebook BitMap Codec
description_en: Facebook BitMap Codec encodes and decodes Facebook web API parameter values using the project's reverse-engineered bitmap, run-length and custom Base64 scheme. Its Python module exposes a FacebookCodec class for converting ID lists to encoded strings and back across parameters including __dyn and __csr.
description_zh: Facebook BitMap Codec 按项目还原的位图、游程编码和自定义 Base64 规则，对 Facebook 网页 API 参数进行编解码。Python 模块提供 FacebookCodec 类，可在 ID 列表与 __dyn、__csr 等参数值之间转换。
requirements: Python 3.8+ and the FCodec.py module are required.
The author claims lossless conversion and compatibility with the listed bitmap parameters.
No licence file in the repository.

name: pdbinspector
description_en: pdbinspector analyzes Microsoft PDB files to list structures, classes, enums, functions, public symbols and exports. It demangles MSVC C++ names, decodes MSVC string literals and emits text, JSON or tab-separated reports through a CLI; a WebAssembly version runs online.
description_zh: pdbinspector 分析 Microsoft PDB 文件，列出结构体、类、枚举、函数、公共符号和导出项。它可还原 MSVC C++ 符号名、解码 MSVC 字符串字面量，并通过命令行输出文本、JSON 或制表符分隔报告；另有 WebAssembly 在线版本。
requirements: A Microsoft PDB file is required as input.
Building from source requires Rust; the manifest specifies Rust 1.75 or later.
MIT License.

name: Assassin's Creed III online service docs
description_en: Assassin's Creed III online service docs record method IDs and request and response fields for the PC game's online services. The files cover RMC services such as online saves and account management, alongside notes on P2P Duplicated Objects over PRUDP.
description_zh: Assassin's Creed III 在线服务文档记录 PC 版游戏服务的方法编号，以及请求和响应字段。现有文件涵盖在线存档、账户管理等 RMC 服务，并记载 PRUDP 上的 P2P Duplicated Objects。
requirements: Scope is Assassin's Creed III PC online services.
No licence file in the repository.

name: AOL 7.0 Retro Server: reconstructing the P3 server session
description_en: AOL 7.0 Retro Server implements local Python servers for the 2001 AOL 7.0 client. It reconstructs the proprietary P3 login and security exchange, the handoff between login and BOS servers, and post-login data used to display the welcome screen and buddy list.
description_zh: AOL 7.0 Retro Server 为 2001 年的 AOL 7.0 客户端实现本地 Python 服务端。它复现专有 P3 登录与安全握手、登录服务器到 BOS 服务器的切换，以及显示欢迎页和好友列表所需的登录后数据。
requirements: Python 3.x and an installed English or German AOL 7.0 client on a VM or older machine are required.
Interactive chat rooms, email simulation and keyword navigation remain on the roadmap.
No licence file in the repository.

name: VG Reverse Engineering
description_en: VG Reverse Engineering decodes Vainglory: Community Edition replay files into recorded player names, heroes, K/D/A, items, gold and scoreboard counters. Its offline tools also export JSON and CSV, maintain a SQLite catalog and document VGR record and event interpretation. Output records provenance and leaves unsupported values unresolved.
description_zh: VG Reverse Engineering 将 Vainglory: Community Edition 回放文件解码为玩家名称、英雄、击杀／死亡／助攻统计、物品、金币和计分板计数。离线工具还可导出 JSON、CSV，维护 SQLite 目录，并记录 VGR 记录结构与事件解释；输出保留数据来源，对缺少依据的数值保持空值。
requirements: Python 3.12 or newer for the offline decoder; the complete regression suite also requires Node.js 18 or newer.
A user's own .0.vgr recording and numbered sibling files are needed for decoding a match.
The source says recordings lack a client build identifier and currently cannot enter its definitive-analysis subset.
No licence file in the repository.

name: 8086 Register Command Debugger
description_en: 8086 Register Command Debugger is an MS-DOS machine-code inspection tool written in 8086 assembly. It loads a program into a 64 KB segment, decodes 8086 instructions and lets users inspect or edit memory and registers while stepping through real CPU instructions using the Trap Flag.
description_zh: 8086 Register Command Debugger 是以 8086 汇编编写的 MS-DOS 机器码分析工具。它把程序装入 64 KB 段，反汇编 8086 指令，供用户查看和修改内存、寄存器，并借助 Trap Flag 逐条执行真实 CPU 指令。
requirements: MS-DOS or a compatible environment such as DOSBox is needed to run the executable.
The program uses a 64 KB memory segment and original 8086 instructions.
MIT license.

name: AC4 docs
description_en: AC4 docs records online service interfaces for the PC version of Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag. Its RMC documents list method IDs and request and response types, while the repository also contains HTTP API specifications for service revival work.
description_zh: AC4 docs 记录《刺客信条 IV：黑旗》PC 版在线服务接口。RMC 文档列出方法编号及请求、响应类型；仓库还收录 HTTP API 规格，供在线服务恢复工作参考。
requirements: Scope is the PC online services of Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag.
No licence file in the repository.

name: DevLens Ultra
description_en: DevLens Ultra is a Chrome extension for inspecting and extracting website component structure. It analyzes selected DOM elements, computed styles and framework state such as React Fiber props, then generates React JSX and Tailwind classes. An optional AI step refines selected snippets through a configured provider.
description_zh: DevLens Ultra 是用于检查和提取网页组件结构的 Chrome 扩展。它分析所选 DOM 元素、计算样式及 React Fiber 属性等框架状态，生成 React JSX 与 Tailwind 类；用户还可配置 AI 服务进一步整理所选片段。
requirements: Chrome with extension Developer Mode to load the unpacked extension.
AI refinement requires a configured provider API key and base URL.
No licence file in the repository.

name: FAAC E145 Gate Connect: reconstructing EasyBoard gate commands
description_en: FAAC E145 Gate Connect implements local control of an FAAC E145 gate through serial commands reconstructed from EasyBoard software traffic. The documentation lists POLL, OPEN, CLOSE and STOP byte sequences and describes their framing and checksum. The Python gateway adds position monitoring plus web, REST and MQTT interfaces.
description_zh: FAAC E145 Gate Connect 使用从 EasyBoard 软件通信中还原的串口命令，本地控制 FAAC E145 门机。文档列出 POLL、OPEN、CLOSE、STOP 的字节序列，并解释帧结构和校验字段。Python 网关还提供位置监控、网页、REST 与 MQTT 接口。
requirements: An FAAC E145 controller connected by serial or USB, Python 3.8+ and the documented dependencies.
MIT.

name: stagg-net: investigating the Fellow Stagg EKG kettle UART
description_en: stagg-net investigates the Fellow Stagg EKG kettle's internal UART interface and documents its connector, serial settings, observed heartbeat packet, and startup message. The repository includes a logic capture, decoder source, probing scripts, and ESPHome configuration for an ESP32-C6 connection.
description_zh: stagg-net 调查 Fellow Stagg EKG 电水壶的内部 UART 接口，记录连接器、串口参数、周期心跳包和启动消息。仓库还提供逻辑分析采集文件、解码源码、探测脚本和用于 ESP32-C6 的 ESPHome 配置。
requirements: Fellow Stagg EKG kettle hardware and a 3.3 V serial connection are needed for the described investigation.
The author has observed status traffic but reports that the UART interface does not respond to the BLE packets tried.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Malware Analysis & CTI Reports
description_en: Malware Analysis & CTI Reports collects ten PDF investigations of malware, security tools and binaries with disputed detections. The author describes static inspection with Detect It Easy, strings and imports, followed by manual disassembly or decompilation in Ghidra or radare2.
description_zh: Malware Analysis & CTI Reports 收录十篇 PDF 调查，涉及恶意软件、安全工具及检测结果存疑的二进制文件。作者采用 Detect It Easy、字符串和导入表检查，并使用 Ghidra 或 radare2 人工反汇编、反编译。
requirements: Reports are PDF files; the repository does not include live malware samples.
No licence file in the repository.

name: advantage
description_en: advantage is a Windows research tool for inspecting Lenovo Vantage and add-in RPC commands. It injects a stub into a Lenovo-signed process, supplies an RPC JSON payload from a local server, and returns the command response through a CLI or web interface; the repository also contains Frida contract and request dump scripts.
description_zh: advantage 用于检查 Lenovo Vantage 及其插件的 RPC 命令。它把存根注入 Lenovo 签名进程，从本地服务器提供 RPC JSON 请求，并通过命令行或网页界面返回响应；仓库还包含导出契约和请求的 Frida 脚本。
requirements: A Windows Lenovo Vantage process is required for the documented RPC path.
Go 1.25 or newer and donut are required by the documented build procedure.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: Chip-8 Emulator and c8-disassembler
description_en: The c8-disassembler in Chip-8 Emulator translates CHIP-8 ROM opcodes into assembly instructions. Its source and sample Pong ROM listing show the supported output; the repository also contains a companion emulator whose SDL2 display is marked as work in progress.
description_zh: Chip-8 Emulator 中的 c8-disassembler 将 CHIP-8 ROM 操作码转换为汇编指令。仓库提供源码及 Pong ROM 的输出示例；配套模拟器的 SDL2 显示功能仍在开发。
requirements: CMake 3.9 or newer is required to build the disassembler; the emulator also requires SDL2.
Super Chip-48 instructions are listed as unsupported.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: eRepublik API Documentation
description_en: eRepublik API Documentation maps endpoints observed in the browser-based strategy game's web client. Its reference pages cover authentication cookies and requests for travel, battles, economy, social features and other game functions, with HTTP methods and example parameters.
description_zh: eRepublik API Documentation 整理从网页策略游戏客户端观察到的接口。文档记录认证 Cookie，以及旅行、战斗、经济和社交等功能的请求路径、HTTP 方法与参数示例。
requirements: Most documented endpoints require authentication.
The source warns that undocumented endpoints may change or stop working.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Garmin Strength Workout API
description_en: Garmin Strength Workout API documents payloads for creating strength workouts through Garmin Connect's undocumented API. Its reference describes repeat groups, exercise and rest steps, conditions, weights and exercise identifiers, with JSON examples plus a small builder and validator.
description_zh: Garmin Strength Workout API 记录了通过 Garmin Connect 未公开接口创建力量训练的请求结构。参考资料说明重复组、动作与休息步骤、条件、重量和动作标识，并附 JSON 示例及简单的生成与校验工具。
requirements: Garmin Connect OAuth tokens are required to call the workout endpoint.
The source warns that the undocumented API may change.
MIT License.

name: netdumper
description_en: netdumper extracts loaded .NET assemblies from Windows processes through the CLR Data Access Component. It enumerates AppDomains and assemblies, recovers JIT method IL, converts memory layouts to PE files, and repairs damaged PE headers or metadata streams for subsequent inspection.
description_zh: netdumper 通过 CLR Data Access Component 从 Windows 进程中提取已加载的 .NET 程序集。它枚举 AppDomain 与程序集，恢复 JIT 方法的 IL，将内存布局转换为 PE 文件，并修复受损的 PE 头或元数据流以供分析。
requirements: Windows, Rust nightly, and the same architecture as the target process are required.
Administrator privileges may be required for some processes.
MIT License.

name: TOZO Control: a Linux earbuds client built from the TOZO BLE protocol
description_en: TOZO Control provides a Linux GTK4 client for TOZO earbuds using a BLE GATT protocol recovered from the vendor's Android app. It sends commands to characteristic B611, receives notifications on B612, and documents GET and SET packet layouts and parameter IDs. The author reports testing the T10 model for battery, game mode, equalizer and balance controls.
description_zh: TOZO Control 是 Linux GTK4 耳机客户端，使用从 TOZO Android 应用逆向得到的 BLE GATT 协议。它向 B611 特征写入命令，从 B612 接收通知，并记录 GET、SET 数据包结构及参数编号。作者报告已在 T10 上测试电量、游戏模式、均衡器和声道平衡功能。
requirements: Linux with GTK4, libadwaita, BlueZ and the Python bleak package; a compatible TOZO BLE earbud is needed.
Only TOZO T10 is reported as tested; command support varies by model.
MIT License.

name: BMS RS485 Service Suite: reconstructing a battery-service bus protocol
description_en: BMS RS485 Service Suite documents an observed ASCII RS485 protocol for battery-management services and implements frame building and decoding in Node-RED. The specification covers framing, length and checksum fields, request and response rules and decoded service IDs; the wider suite connects JK and DALY BLE data to MQTT and dashboards.
description_zh: BMS RS485 Service Suite 记录电池管理服务中观察到的 ASCII RS485 协议，并在 Node-RED 中实现构帧与解码。规格涵盖帧结构、长度与校验字段、请求响应规则及已解析的服务编号；套件还将 JK、DALY 的 BLE 数据接入 MQTT 和仪表板。
requirements: A Raspberry Pi and Node-RED are the documented service environment; BLE gateways use MQTT and optional Python dependencies.
The specification records observed and currently decoded RS485 services; some write acknowledgements are handled generically.
No licence file in the repository.

name: BGI Converter TGA
description_en: BGI Converter TGA analyzes BGI-Ethornell game image files and converts custom RGB or RGBA layouts and BMP images into 32-bit TGA. Its C++17 utility detects formats from headers, reports dimensions and offsets, and supports single-file or batch conversion.
description_zh: BGI Converter TGA 分析 BGI-Ethornell 游戏图像文件，将自定义 RGB、RGBA 布局及 BMP 图像转换为 32 位 TGA。该 C++17 工具按文件头识别格式，显示尺寸和偏移信息，并支持单文件或批量转换。
requirements: Requires a C++17 compiler with std::filesystem support.
Inputs are the documented BMP 24-bit, BMP 32-bit, BGI custom RGBA or BGI custom RGB layouts.
MIT license.

name: Valkyrie
description_en: Valkyrie analyzes suspect binaries through static inspection and Docker-based execution. Its documented pipeline examines PE headers, entropy and packing, then captures system calls, file activity and PCAP traffic for reports and threat-intelligence output.
description_zh: Valkyrie 通过静态检查和 Docker 执行环境分析可疑二进制文件。文档所述流程检查 PE 头、熵和加壳，并采集系统调用、文件活动及 PCAP 流量，生成分析和威胁情报报告。
requirements: Python 3.9+ is required; dynamic analysis requires Docker Desktop or Docker Engine.
Optional API keys enable VirusTotal and OpenAI integrations.
MIT License.

name: PE Disassembler
description_en: PE Disassembler is a WPF application that extracts the .text section of 32-bit Windows PE executables and displays decoded x86 instructions. It checks MZ and PE signatures, handles a limited set of movement, arithmetic and control-flow opcodes, and can save the listing as text.
description_zh: PE Disassembler 是一款 WPF 程序，从 32 位 Windows PE 可执行文件的 .text 节提取并显示 x86 指令。它检查 MZ 和 PE 签名，解码有限的传送、算术与控制流指令，并可保存文本清单。
requirements: Windows with .NET Framework 4.7.2+ or .NET 5/6/7/8 with WPF support; Visual Studio 2019/2022 to build.
Only 32-bit x86 PE files and implemented opcodes are supported; output uses raw file offsets without relocation handling.
MIT License.

name: SIC/XE Disassembler and Linking Loader
description_en: SIC/XE Disassembler and Linking Loader converts SIC/XE object code into assembly listings and reconstructed symbols. Its first pass identifies instruction boundaries and addressing modes; its second emits assembly, while a separate loader resolves external symbols and applies relocation records.
description_zh: SIC/XE Disassembler and Linking Loader 将 SIC/XE 目标代码转换为汇编清单与重建的符号表。第一遍识别指令边界和寻址方式，第二遍输出汇编；另有链接装载器解析外部符号并处理重定位记录。
requirements: A C++17 compiler is required.
Character-literal reconstruction is limited, and the loader assumes well-formed object files.
MIT license.

name: Xenus DT1 Decompiler
description_en: Xenus DT1 Decompiler extracts DT1 and DT2 texture caches from Xenus 2: White Gold and Boiling Point: Road to Hell; its current decoder has not been tested with The Precursors. Its C# decoder reimplements behavior recovered from VELoader.dll, handles zlib and UCL NRV2E streams, and exports DDS or converted image formats.
description_zh: Xenus DT1 Decompiler 可提取 Xenus 2: White Gold 和 Boiling Point: Road to Hell 的 DT1/DT2 纹理缓存；当前解码器尚未在 The Precursors 上测试。其 C# 解码器重实现了从 VELoader.dll 还原的处理流程，可处理 zlib 和 UCL NRV2E 数据流，并导出 DDS 或转换后的图像格式。
requirements: The release targets 64-bit Windows; building requires .NET SDK 8.0 or later.
The Precursors has not been checked with the decoder used since version 3.0; method 7's additional encryption is unsupported.
MIT license.

name: Lutron Protocols
description_en: Lutron Protocols researches CCA radio packets, CCX Thread and CoAP messages, the LEAP processor API and IPL Designer integration frames for Lutron lighting systems. Its documentation covers device behavior and firmware, while TypeScript tools capture and decode traffic and parse Designer project files.
description_zh: Lutron Protocols 研究路创照明系统的 CCA 无线报文、CCX Thread 与 CoAP 消息、LEAP 处理器 API，以及 IPL Designer 集成帧。仓库记录设备与固件分析，并提供 TypeScript 工具用于抓取和解码流量、解析 Designer 项目文件。
requirements: Packet-capture hardware uses an STM32H723 Nucleo with CC1101 and nRF52840 radios.
LEAP tools require mutual TLS certificates.
Native Vive pairing and a long-running LEAP connection watchdog remain future work.
No licence file in the repository.

name: SteelSeries Overlay Hook: mapping and hooking the GameOverlay swapchain
description_en: SteelSeries Overlay Hook documents IDA analysis of SteelSeriesGameOverlay.dll’s window, object layout and Direct3D 11 swapchain, then uses recovered offsets in a C++ DLL hook. Its injector and hook render Dear ImGui content through the existing GameOverlay window by intercepting Present and ResizeBuffers.
description_zh: SteelSeries Overlay Hook 记录了用 IDA 分析 SteelSeriesGameOverlay.dll 的窗口、对象布局和 Direct3D 11 交换链，并在 C++ DLL 钩子中使用恢复的偏移。配套注入器通过拦截 Present 和 ResizeBuffers，在现有 GameOverlay 窗口中绘制 Dear ImGui 内容。
requirements: Windows, Visual Studio 2022 with the v143 C++ toolset, and a Windows 10 SDK are required to build.
The hook relies on fixed internal offsets; compatibility with other SteelSeries versions is not established.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Sandwitcher
description_en: Sandwitcher instruments Java and Kotlin method calls in Android apps by replacing ART method entry points with a trampoline through Pine and LSPlant. Its AAR exposes callbacks before and after the original call to inspect or change arguments and results and inspect thrown exceptions; it also includes a demo application.
description_zh: Sandwitcher 通过 Pine 和 LSPlant 在运行时以跳板替换 ART 方法入口，对 Android 应用中的 Java 和 Kotlin 方法调用进行插桩。其 AAR 提供原方法调用前后的回调，可检查或修改参数与返回结果、查看抛出的异常，并附有演示应用。
requirements: Android and the AAR integration are required; building from source needs JDK 17 and Android SDK 35.
The README lists Android 5.0 through 15 compatibility.
Apache License 2.0.

name: Bin X-ray
description_en: Bin X-ray visualizes byte patterns in unknown files and firmware blobs through a 256×256 byte-pair matrix and a 3D byte-trigram plot. A sliding window, ribbon overview, transition-offset search and hex view let analysts move from a pattern to its bytes in the file.
description_zh: Bin X-ray 用 256×256 字节对矩阵和三维字节三元组图展示未知文件及固件数据中的模式。滑动窗口、总览带、字节对偏移搜索和十六进制视图可将可视化异常定位到具体字节。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11; building requires Visual Studio 2022, Windows SDK 10.0 or newer, and Python 3 for the version helper.
Bookmarks, entropy strips, comparison mode and structured decoders are roadmap items.
MIT license.

name: Malware Deobfuscator
description_en: Malware Deobfuscator analyzes obfuscated malware scripts and generates code, behavior and indicator reports. A deterministic pass extracts indicators with regexes and maps keyword signatures to MITRE ATT&CK; an OpenAI or Ollama model supplies deobfuscated code and execution-flow explanations. The CLI handles individual files or directories and can emit JSON.
description_zh: Malware Deobfuscator 分析经过混淆的恶意脚本，输出代码、行为和指标报告。确定性流程用正则表达式提取 IOC、以关键词签名映射 MITRE ATT&CK；OpenAI 或 Ollama 模型补充去混淆代码与执行流程解释。命令行支持单文件和目录，并可输出 JSON。
requirements: Python 3.9 or later is specified in the package metadata.
Full analysis requires an OpenAI API key or a configured Ollama model; IOC extraction works without one.
The included samples are described as defanged educational examples.
MIT license.

name: PIC microcontrollers disassembler
description_en: PIC microcontrollers disassembler converts Intel HEX dumps for MidRange and Enhanced MidRange PIC12/PIC16 devices into disassembly listings, HI-TECH PICC assembly files, or both. Processor descriptions and instruction definitions are supplied as JSON configuration files.
description_zh: PIC microcontrollers disassembler 将 MidRange 和 Enhanced MidRange PIC12/PIC16 设备的 Intel HEX 转储转换为反汇编列表、HI-TECH PICC 汇编文件，或同时输出两者。处理器参数和指令定义存放在 JSON 配置文件中。
requirements: An Intel HEX dump and the matching PIC12/PIC16 processor selection are required.
Support is stated for MidRange and Enhanced MidRange PIC12/PIC16 devices.
MIT.

name: flashkit
description_en: flashkit is a Python toolkit for examining Adobe Flash SWF files and AVM2 bytecode. It parses and rebuilds SWF and ABC structures, disassembles instructions, constructs call and reference indexes, and decompiles classes or methods to ActionScript 3 through a control-flow pipeline.
description_zh: flashkit 是分析 Adobe Flash SWF 与 AVM2 字节码的 Python 工具包，可解析及重建 SWF 和 ABC 结构、反汇编指令、建立调用与引用索引，并通过控制流分析将类或方法反编译为 ActionScript 3。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later.
SWF or AVM2 bytecode input for analysis.
Dead-code detection is heuristic because ActionScript 3 dynamic dispatch cannot be fully ruled out.
MIT License.

name: Petkit Local: reconstructing feeder cloud and fountain BLE controls
description_en: Petkit Local replaces selected Petkit D4 feeder cloud exchanges with a local Home Assistant server and relays Eversweet Max 2 CTW3 fountain messages over BLE. The integration implements device registration, heartbeats, schedules, events and commands based on observed device communication.
description_zh: Petkit Local 用本地 Home Assistant 服务响应 Petkit D4 喂食器的部分云端请求，并通过 BLE 中继 Eversweet Max 2 CTW3 饮水机消息。集成依据设备通信实现注册、心跳、计划、事件和控制命令。
requirements: Home Assistant 2024.1 or newer, a D4-family feeder, port 80 and local DNS or IP redirection are required.
CTW3 fountain support requires a D4 feeder already running the integration.
The documented tested firmware versions are D4 1.267 and CTW3 1.11.
MIT licence.

name: AppThreat wasm-tools
description_en: wasm-tools is a pure-Python parser and disassembler for WebAssembly core modules and Component Model binaries. It reports sections, decoded instructions, strings with memory provenance, imports, exports and static call graphs, then adds heuristic capability and risk findings in JSON.
description_zh: wasm-tools 是纯 Python 编写的 WebAssembly 核心模块及 Component Model 二进制文件解析、反汇编工具。它输出段表、指令、带内存来源的字符串、导入导出项和静态调用图，并在 JSON 中加入启发式能力与风险判断。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later is specified in pyproject.toml.
Text-format .wat parsing and specification validation are excluded.
MIT license; the author raises uncertainty about third-party specification text in the AI-assisted code provenance.

name: dos-mcp
description_en: dos-mcp connects AI agents to DOS programs running in js-dos for interactive reverse engineering. Its MCP tools send keyboard and mouse input, capture frames, exchange files with the guest and read or search emulated memory; the documentation shows a save-format comparison workflow using Ultima Underworld.
description_zh: dos-mcp 将智能体连接到 js-dos 中运行的 DOS 程序，用于交互式逆向分析。MCP 工具可发送键鼠输入、抓取画面、交换客户机文件，并读取或搜索模拟内存；文档以 Ultima Underworld 展示存档格式对比流程。
requirements: Node.js 22.13 or newer is required; Puppeteer installs a browser dependency.
A DOS program or bundle is needed as input.
Save-state snapshot and restore are missing; breakpoints and stepping are only proposed.
MIT License.

name: premium5
description_en: premium5 emulates the Volkswagen Premium 5 car radio at the register and signal level so its original firmware can run without patches. It models the NEC microcontroller, LCD controller, EEPROM and selected vehicle interfaces, with live disassembly, memory inspection and execution controls for firmware research.
description_zh: premium5 在寄存器与信号层仿真 Volkswagen Premium 5 汽车收音机，使原版固件无需修改即可运行。它模拟 NEC 微控制器、LCD 控制器、EEPROM 及部分车载接口，并提供实时反汇编、内存检查和执行控制，供固件研究使用。
requirements: A Premium 5 firmware binary is required.
PyPy and a modern CPU with strong single-threaded performance are needed to emulate the original 4.19 MHz speed.
Audio output and the tape deck are not emulated.
BSD-3-Clause.

name: IPI STAY FLY Driver: reconstructing mouse configuration over HID
description_en: IPI STAY FLY Driver reconstructs mouse configuration in a Windows app using reverse-engineered 16-byte HID frames. It exposes DPI, polling, button and sensor settings, documents a frame checksum, and includes a WebHID capture extension plus protocol notes for ATK FIERCE X.
description_zh: IPI STAY FLY Driver 使用逆向得到的 16 字节 HID 报文，在 Windows 应用中重建鼠标配置功能。它提供 DPI、回报率、按键和传感器设置，记录报文校验和，并附有 WebHID 抓包扩展及 ATK FIERCE X 协议笔记。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11, WebView2 and an IPI STAY FLY mouse are required for device control.
Building from source requires Node.js 20 or later, Rust and Visual Studio Build Tools 2022.
Non-mouse button actions, including keyboard keys and macros, are not yet exposed.
MIT license.

name: Kaiju
description_en: Kaiju is a Rust reverse-engineering framework with a headless CLI for binary loading and analysis. Its current crates parse selected ELF, PE and Mach-O metadata, extract strings, decode a limited x86-64 instruction subset and inspect saved network evidence.
description_zh: Kaiju 是带无界面命令行工具的 Rust 逆向框架。现有模块解析部分 ELF、PE、Mach-O 元数据，提取字符串，解码有限的 x86-64 指令集，并检查保存的网络证据。
requirements: Rust 1.76+ is specified by the workspace.
ELF, PE, Mach-O and x86-64 support is limited to the documented parser and decoder subsets.
Apache-2.0.

name: x64dbg MCP
description_en: x64dbg MCP gives agents debugger control over Windows binaries through a native x64dbg plugin and a C# stdio MCP server. The plugin serves local HTTP requests to x64dbg's bridge API, while MCP tools expose disassembly, memory and register access, modules, execution control, and breakpoints.
description_zh: x64dbg MCP 通过原生 x64dbg 插件和 C# stdio MCP 服务器，让智能体分析 Windows 二进制程序。插件将本地 HTTP 请求转给 x64dbg bridge API；MCP 工具提供反汇编、内存与寄存器访问、模块查看、执行控制和断点操作。
requirements: Windows, Visual Studio 2022, CMake 3.20 or newer, .NET 10 SDK, and a built x64dbg checkout.
The plugin's HTTP endpoint binds to localhost and grants control over the debugged process.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Metroid Dread: a hand decompilation in progress
description_en: DreadComp is an in-progress hand decompilation of Metroid Dread that recreates game source code in C++. The repository includes initial source files, build tooling and symbol data; building requires assets and the version 2.1.0 executable from the user's own game copy.
description_zh: DreadComp 正在以手工反编译方式重建《Metroid Dread》的 C++ 源代码。仓库已有初步源码、构建工具和符号数据；构建需要使用者自行提供游戏资产及 2.1.0 版可执行文件。
requirements: An owned copy of Metroid Dread and its original 2.1.0 main NSO executable are required.
Windows users are directed to use WSL; installation lists Python, Ninja, CMake, ccache, xdelta3, Clang and a Rust toolchain.
The decompilation is a work in progress.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Soundcore D3200: reconstructing BLE recording transfer and decryption
description_en: A Soundcore D3200 investigation reconstructs the BLE exchange used to list and transfer encrypted recordings. Its Python client performs a P-256 ECDH handshake, derives session and file keys, decrypts AES-256-CTR Opus packets and writes an Ogg/Opus file.
description_zh: 该研究重建 Soundcore D3200 通过 BLE 列出和传输加密录音的消息流程。Python 客户端执行 P-256 ECDH 握手、派生会话与文件密钥、解密 AES-256-CTR Opus 数据包，并生成 Ogg/Opus 文件。
requirements: Python 3.12 or newer, a Bluetooth adapter and an available D3200 recorder are required.
The recorder must be disconnected from the Soundcore app before connecting.
A real-recording regression test requires the user's own capture fixtures.
GPL-3.0-or-later licence.

name: K1 Pro OpenDeck Suite: a Linux driver for the Stream Dock K1 Pro
description_en: K1 Pro OpenDeck Suite includes a Linux OpenDeck driver for the HOTSPOTEK/Mirabox Stream Dock K1 Pro based on its reverse-engineered USB/HID CRT protocol.
