Some internal entities cannot be restored perfectly.
Released into the public domain per LICENSE.md.

name: OGhidra
description_en: OGhidra is an AI integration for analyzing binaries with Ghidra through natural language. It supports function analysis, automated renaming, malware pattern detection, and either an MCP or PyGhidra backend.
description_zh: OGhidra 是一款将 AI 接入 Ghidra、通过自然语言分析二进制文件的集成工具。它支持函数分析、自动重命名、恶意软件模式检测，并可使用 MCP 或 PyGhidra 后端。
requirements: Python 3.12 or later and Ghidra; version 12.0.3 is recommended.
Java 21 is required to build the Ghidra 12.0.3 extension.
Configure a local or external AI provider; the MCP backend requires a running Ghidra client, while PyGhidra requires a valid Ghidra project or a binary to import.
BSD 3-Clause with a commercial license alternative, per LICENSE.

name: aiDAPal
description_en: aiDAPal is an IDA Pro plugin that uses a locally hosted language model trained for Hex-Rays pseudocode to assist with code analysis. It presents generated changes for acceptance before updating the pseudocode.
description_zh: aiDAPal 是一款 IDA Pro 插件，使用针对 Hex-Rays 伪代码训练、在本地运行的语言模型辅助代码分析。用户可以先决定是否接受生成的修改，再更新伪代码。
requirements: IDA Pro with Hex-Rays is required.
Ollama must be configured with the downloaded model weights and modelfile.
The plugin requires the Python requests package; its default configuration connects to a local Ollama service.
The repository has no license file.

name: OpenLara: Tomb Raider engine reimplementation
description_en: Open-source engine for classic Tomb Raider, with a WebGL build and a standalone release. Its format code defines object types for Tomb Raider 1 through 4.
description_zh: 经典《古墓丽影》的开源引擎，提供 WebGL 版本和独立版本。其格式代码定义了《古墓丽影》1 至 4 代的对象类型。
requirements: The repository declares the BSD-2-Clause license.

name: Thyme: Command & Conquer Generals: Zero Hour reimplementation
description_en: Thyme is an open source reimplementation of Command & Conquer Generals: Zero Hour. It rewrites the game from the ground up and uses the original binary for functions it has not yet replaced.
description_zh: Thyme 是《命令与征服：将军之绝命时刻》的开源重实现。项目从底层重写游戏，并借助原版二进制文件提供尚未重写的功能。
requirements: Running Thyme requires an installed copy of Command & Conquer Generals: Zero Hour.
Building a working binary requires Microsoft Visual Studio 2017 or later.
Thyme currently runs only on Windows; its custom launcher supports the English disc version patched to 1.04.
The repository is archived.
License: GPL-2.0.

name: Chariot: Age of Empires engine reimplementation
description_en: Chariot is an open-source effort to reimplement the engine of the original Age of Empires (1997). It aims to support ports and enhancements; the README describes it as a work in progress with asset-loading demonstrations, not a playable game.
description_zh: Chariot 是一个开源项目，旨在重新实现初代《帝国时代》（1997）的游戏引擎。项目希望支持移植和功能改进；README 称其仍在开发中，当时只能展示游戏资源加载，尚不能游玩。
requirements: Building requires Rust, a supported C/C++ compiler, and SDL2.
Running requires an original Age of Empires CD for game data.
The README reports that the project was not yet playable as of 2016-07-08.
The README declares an MIT license.

name: OpenDiablo2: Diablo 2 engine reimplementation
description_en: OpenDiablo2 is a cross-platform ARPG engine written in Go that supports playing Diablo 2. The project is being split into a separate engine and toolset, called Abyss Engine, and a game project retaining the OpenDiablo2 name.
description_zh: OpenDiablo2 是一个用 Go 编写的跨平台动作角色扮演游戏引擎，支持运行 Diablo 2。项目正在拆分为名为 Abyss Engine 的引擎与工具集，以及继续使用 OpenDiablo2 名称的游戏项目。
requirements: Playing Diablo 2 requires a legally purchased copy of Diablo 2 and its Lord of Destruction expansion installed on the computer.
The project does not include the assets or content needed to play Diablo 2.
The repository is archived.
License: GPL-3.0.

name: Black Magic Debug
description_en: Black Magic Debug is a self-contained debugger for microcontrollers. It detects and configures connected targets without configuration files.
description_zh: Black Magic Debug 是一套用于微控制器的独立调试工具。它无需配置文件，即可检测并配置已连接的目标设备。
requirements: Needs a connected microcontroller target.
The project moved to Codeberg, and this GitHub repository is archived.
GPL-3.0 per COPYING, with BSD and MIT license files for parts of the code.

name: OpenOCD
description_en: OpenOCD is a tool for programming and debugging embedded targets through hardware debug adapters. It supports flash programming, breakpoints, single stepping, and remote debugging through GDB.
description_zh: OpenOCD 是通过硬件调试适配器对嵌入式目标进行编程和调试的工具。它支持闪存编程、断点、单步执行，以及通过 GDB 进行远程调试。
requirements: Hardware access requires a supported adapter and a target configuration.
Source builds require GCC or Clang, make, libtool, pkg-config 0.23 or newer or pkgconf, and libjim 0.79 or newer.
GPL-2.0-or-later per COPYING.

name: LogicAnalyzer
description_en: LogicAnalyzer is a hardware and software tool for capturing digital signals and decoding communication protocols. It supports triggered capture, multiple channels, and Sigrok protocol decoders.
description_zh: LogicAnalyzer 是一套用于采集数字信号和解析通信协议的软硬件工具。它支持触发采集、多通道采集和 Sigrok 协议解码器。
requirements: Requires supported Pico hardware, matching firmware, and capture software.
Licensed under GPL-3.0.

name: BtleJuice
description_en: BtleJuice is a framework for intercepting Bluetooth Low Energy GATT operations between devices. Its web interface displays intercepted operations and supports replay, data modification, and export.
description_zh: BtleJuice 是用于拦截设备间蓝牙低功耗 GATT 操作的框架。其网页界面可显示截获的操作，并支持重放、修改数据和导出记录。
requirements: Requires Node.js 4.3.2 or newer, npm, and the listed Bluetooth system dependencies.
The core and proxy require separate machines with two Bluetooth 4.0 or newer adapters.
The proxy does not work in a Docker container.
The repository is archived and has no license file.

name: NearDrop
description_en: macOS menu bar app that partially implements Nearby Share and Quick Share to exchange files and links with Android devices. Its protocol document describes the protocol as understood from Chromium sources and a decompiled Google Services Framework APK.
description_zh: macOS 菜单栏应用，部分实现 Nearby Share 和 Quick Share，可与 Android 设备交换文件和链接。其协议文档根据 Chromium 源码和反编译的 Google Services Framework APK 描述该协议。
requirements: Requires a Mac and an Android device on the same Wi-Fi network.
Android devices must be publicly visible when connecting through NearDrop’s QR code.
Works over Wi-Fi LAN only and remains visible to everyone on the network while running.
License: Unlicense.

name: x64dbg MCP Server Plugin
description_en: An MCP server plugin for x64dbg and x32dbg that lets external applications and AI agents control debugging through HTTP. It provides tools for execution, memory, registers, breakpoints, and disassembly, along with debugger context resources and workflow prompts.
description_zh: x64dbg MCP Server Plugin 是适用于 x64dbg 和 x32dbg 的 MCP 服务器插件，使外部应用和 AI 智能体能够通过 HTTP 控制调试过程。它提供执行控制、内存、寄存器、断点和反汇编工具，以及调试器上下文资源和工作流程提示。
requirements: Requires a 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 host and x64dbg or x32dbg build 2023 or later.
Building requires CMake 3.15 or later, Visual Studio 2022 with the C++ Desktop Development workload, vcpkg, and Git.
Debugging operations require the debugger to be paused; memory and register writes are disabled by default.
License: MIT.

name: JEB-MCP
description_en: JEB-MCP is an MCP server and JEB Pro script that lets MCP clients inspect and rename elements of Android apps in JEB. Its documented commands include reading decompiled code, examining classes and methods, and renaming them.
description_zh: JEB-MCP 是由 MCP 服务器和 JEB Pro 脚本组成的集成工具，让 MCP 客户端在 JEB 中查看和重命名 Android 应用的内容。README 列出的命令包括读取反编译代码、检查类与方法，以及重命名。
requirements: JEB Pro with the project script started in its GUI.
Python 3.11 or later and uv.
An MCP client configured to connect to the server.
The repository has no license file.

name: re-shell
description_en: re-shell is a Nix flake development environment that provides Claude Code with reverse engineering tools and workflows. Its skills select guidance for Windows binaries, Android packages, and web captures based on the files being analyzed.
description_zh: re-shell 是一个基于 Nix flake 的开发环境，为 Claude Code 提供逆向工程工具和工作流程。它会根据待分析的文件，为 Windows 二进制文件、Android 安装包和网页流量记录启用相应指导。
requirements: Nix with the nix-command and flakes experimental features enabled.
Claude Code for the file-specific skills and workflows.
The repository has no license file.

name: ghidra-rpc
description_en: ghidra-rpc is a CLI integration that lets AI coding assistants use a persistent Ghidra session for binary analysis. It returns structured JSON for tasks such as decompilation, symbol annotation, type recovery, patching, and binary version comparison.
description_zh: ghidra-rpc 是一个命令行集成工具，让 AI 编程助手通过持续运行的 Ghidra 会话分析二进制文件。它以结构化 JSON 返回反编译、符号标注、类型恢复、修补和二进制版本比较等操作的结果。
requirements: Requires Ghidra 11+, Python 3.11+, Java 17+, and uv.
An AI coding assistant must be able to run shell commands to drive a session.
The repository has no license file.

name: Bloaty
description_en: Bloaty is a binary size profiler that attributes file and memory usage to sources such as symbols, compilation units, and sections. It can compare sizes between binaries and supports ELF and Mach-O, with experimental PE/COFF and WebAssembly support.
description_zh: Bloaty 是一款二进制文件体积分析工具，可按符号、编译单元和节等来源统计文件大小与内存占用。它还能比较二进制文件的体积变化，支持 ELF 和 Mach-O，并以实验性方式支持 PE/COFF 和 WebAssembly。
requirements: CMake is required to build the project.
Check out the Git submodules when building from a clone that did not include them.
PE/COFF and WebAssembly support is experimental.
The repository declares the Apache-2.0 license.

name: Soot
description_en: Soot is a Java optimization framework for analyzing and transforming Java bytecode. It provides four intermediate representations, including forms suited to optimization, decompilation, and code inspection.
description_zh: Soot 是用于分析和转换 Java 字节码的优化框架。它提供四种中间表示，可用于优化、反编译和代码检查。
requirements: Requires a Java runtime and Java classes or bytecode to analyze.
Available as a dependency through Maven, Gradle, or SBT, or as a JAR.
The repository declares the LGPL-2.1 license.

name: bingrep
description_en: bingrep is a command-line tool for inspecting and colorizing binary files. It displays details from ELF, Mach, Unix and BSD archives, and PE files, with experimental views of hexadecimal data and file offset ranges.
description_zh: bingrep 是用于查看二进制文件并以颜色区分其内容的命令行工具。它可显示 ELF、Mach、Unix 和 BSD 归档文件及 PE 文件的信息，并提供实验性的十六进制数据和文件偏移范围视图。
requirements: Building requires rustc 1.74 or later.
PE support is debug only.
The repository declares the MIT license.

name: libPeConv
description_en: libPeConv is a Windows library for loading and manipulating PE files. It supports tasks such as section remapping, relocation, import loading, resource parsing, and rebuilding import address tables from memory dumps.
description_zh: libPeConv 是用于加载和处理 PE 文件的 Windows 库。它支持节区重映射、重定位、导入项加载、资源解析，以及从内存转储中重建导入地址表。
requirements: Requires Windows.
Applications that use MUI are unsupported.
License: BSD-2-Clause.

name: Viper
description_en: Viper is a framework for binary analysis and for organizing malware samples, exploit samples, and research scripts. The Viper 1.x repository is archived and development has ended.
description_zh: Viper 是一个二进制分析框架，也用于整理恶意软件样本、漏洞利用样本和研究脚本。Viper 1.x 仓库已归档，开发已停止。
requirements: Install with pip3.
Viper 1.x is archived and no longer developed; the refactor continues as Viper 2.
BSD-3-Clause per LICENSE.

name: DroidLysis
description_en: DroidLysis is a pre-analysis tool for Android apps that disassembles samples, organizes their contents, and flags code patterns for further inspection. It accepts APK, DEX, ODEX, ARM executable, ZIP, RAR, and directory inputs.
description_zh: DroidLysis 是一款安卓应用预分析工具，可反汇编样本、整理文件内容，并标出值得进一步查看的代码模式。它支持 APK、DEX、ODEX、ARM 可执行文件、ZIP、RAR 和目录输入。
requirements: Requires Python 3 and the listed system packages, including a Java runtime.
Requires Apktool and Baksmali, with their locations set in the configuration file; Dex2jar is optional.
Known third-party SDKs are excluded from analysis by default unless the relevant option is enabled.
The repository declares the MIT license.

name: PKHeX
description_en: PKHeX is a C# Windows Forms editor for Pokémon core-series save data. It can edit and save supported files, import Pokémon and teams, and convert data between game generations.
description_zh: PKHeX 是一款用 C# 编写的 Windows Forms 宝可梦系列游戏存档编辑器。它可以编辑并保存受支持的文件、导入宝可梦与队伍数据，并在不同游戏世代之间转换数据。
requirements: Requires .NET 10.
Save files must be free of console-specific encryption; a save-data manager is needed to move saves to and from a console.
License: GPLv3.

name: Thug
description_en: Thug is a Python low-interaction honeyclient that mimics a web browser to detect and emulate malicious content. It supports the study of client-side attacks.
description_zh: Thug 是一款用 Python 编写的低交互蜜罐客户端，通过模拟网页浏览器来检测和仿真恶意内容。它可用于研究针对客户端的攻击。
requirements: GPL-2.0 per the README.

name: Cuckoo3
description_en: Cuckoo3 is a malware analysis tool that tests suspicious files and links in sandboxed platform emulators. It reports what the files or websites did during the test.
description_zh: Cuckoo3 是一款恶意软件分析工具，可在沙箱化的平台模拟器中检查可疑文件和链接。它会生成报告，记录文件或网站在检查过程中的行为。
requirements: Requires a Linux (Ubuntu) host with Python 3.10 and Windows sandboxes.
The README says it is not ready for production use.
License: EUPL-1.2.

name: Cuckoo Sandbox
description_en: Cuckoo Sandbox is an automated malware analysis system that executes suspicious files in an isolated environment and reports their behavior.
description_zh: Cuckoo Sandbox 是自动化恶意软件分析系统，可在隔离环境中执行可疑文件并报告其行为。
requirements: The README marks Cuckoo Sandbox 2.x as unmaintained and the repository is archived.
GPL-3.0 per docs/LICENSE.

name: fq
description_en: fq is a command-line tool and query language for inspecting and decoding binary formats. It provides a structural hex viewer, bit-level decoding, nested format parsing, and an interactive query interface.
description_zh: fq 是用于查看和解码二进制格式的命令行工具及查询语言。它提供结构化十六进制视图、位级解码、嵌套格式解析和交互式查询界面。
requirements: Go 1.22 or later is required to build from source.
The repository declares the MIT License.

name: innoextract
description_en: Unpacks Inno Setup installers on non-Windows systems without running them. It also handles modified variants, including GOG.com's Inno Setup-based game installers.
description_zh: 在非 Windows 系统上解包 Inno Setup 安装程序，无需运行它们。它也支持修改版安装包，包括 GOG.com 基于 Inno Setup 的游戏安装包。
requirements: Building requires Boost 1.37 or newer, CMake 2.8 or newer, and a working C++ compiler.
liblzma is optional, but most installers made with newer Inno Setup versions cannot be extracted without it.
Individual components cannot be selected for extraction, and filtering by name is limited.
License: ZLIB.

name: Metasm
description_en: Metasm is a Ruby suite for assembling, disassembling, debugging, and modifying executable binaries. It supports formats including PE, ELF, Mach-O, and shellcode.
description_zh: Metasm 是一套用于汇编、反汇编、调试和修改可执行二进制文件的 Ruby 工具。它支持 PE、ELF、Mach-O 和 shellcode 等格式。
requirements: Ruby is required to use the suite and its sample scripts.
LGPL per the README; the LICENCE file carries LGPL-2.1.

name: OpenTomb: Tomb Raider engine reimplementation
description_en: OpenTomb is an open-source reimplementation of the classic Tomb Raider engine for playing levels from Tomb Raider 1–5 and custom TRLE levels. It is no longer maintained.
description_zh: OpenTomb 是经典《古墓丽影》引擎的开源重新实现项目，可运行《古墓丽影》1–5 及自制 TRLE 关卡。该项目已停止维护。
requirements: Playing original game levels requires assets from the corresponding games.
Building from source requires C++11 and the development dependencies listed in the README.
CD audio is supported only in OGG format.
License: LGPL-3.0.

name: Savage Wind Recomp: statically recompiling The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description_en: Savage Wind Recomp is an in-progress static recompilation of the Nintendo Switch version of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild for Windows and Linux. It builds native game code locally from the player's extracted files; the README reports playable early areas but says the full story remains unconfirmed.
description_zh: Savage Wind Recomp 是一个仍在开发中的静态重编译项目，旨在让 Nintendo Switch 版《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》在 Windows 和 Linux 上以原生程序运行。它在本地根据玩家自行提取的游戏文件构建代码；README 称前期区域可以游玩，但尚未确认主线全程可通关。
requirements: Requires a personally obtained and extracted Nintendo Switch copy of the game with update 1.9.0; game files are not included.
Requires Windows 10 or later or Linux, a 64-bit CPU with SSE4.2, a Vulkan 1.3 GPU, 16 GB of RAM, and about 20 GB of free disk space.
The project is in alpha; later parts of the main story may have bugs or crashes.
MIT per LICENSE.

name: retruxx: reverse-engineered Hard Truck Apocalypse
description_en: retruxx is a reverse-engineered Hard Truck Apocalypse project that builds the game executable and separate renderer, input, and sound DLLs. Its 32-bit build matches the original game's memory layouts.
description_zh: retruxx 是《Hard Truck Apocalypse》的逆向工程项目，可构建游戏可执行文件以及独立的渲染、输入和声音 DLL。其 32 位构建与原游戏的内存布局一致。
requirements: Building requires Windows, Visual Studio C++ build tools, CMake, Git, the DirectX SDK (June 2010), and the FMOD Core SDK.
Running the game requires an installed copy of Ex Machina / Hard Truck Apocalypse for its game data.
The executable and driver DLLs must have compatible bitness.
The repository has no license file.

name: nxnative
description_en: nxnative is a tool that packages Nintendo Switch games as apps that run their code natively on Apple hardware, with graphics translated to Metal. It builds iPhone, iPad, or Mac apps from supported Switch games; Switch 2 builds are documented for Mac only.
description_zh: nxnative 是一款将 Nintendo Switch 游戏打包为 Apple 设备应用的工具，让游戏代码在设备上原生运行，并将图形处理转换为 Metal。它可为受支持的 Switch 游戏生成 iPhone、iPad 或 Mac 应用；Switch 2 游戏目前仅说明了 Mac 构建方式。
requirements: Building requires a Mac with macOS 26.6 or later, Xcode 27.2, Homebrew, and arm64 Python 3.12 or later.
Switch game builds require the user's game files and prod.keys; Switch 2 builds use a NUP file or extracted game files and do not require prod.keys.
iPhone and iPad play requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later and the specified newer hardware; Switch 2 games are documented for Mac only.
License: MIT.

name: Impacket
description_en: Impacket is a Python library for constructing and parsing network packets and working with protocol implementations. It covers protocols including SMB and MSRPC and includes example tools.
description_zh: Impacket 是用于构造、解析网络数据包及使用协议实现的 Python 库。它涵盖 SMB、MSRPC 等协议，并附带示例工具。
requirements: Requires Python 3; the README recommends pipx for system-wide installation.
The README describes the software as intended for research and education, not production or commercial use.
Apache Software License with slight modifications, per LICENSE.

name: r0idamcp
description_en: r0idamcp is a single-file MCP server that connects IDA Pro to an MCP-capable assistant for automated reverse engineering. Its tools expose functions, strings, decompilation, cross-references, comments, and renaming through an SSE connection.
description_zh: r0idamcp 是一个单文件 MCP 服务器，可将 IDA Pro 连接到支持 MCP 的助手，用于自动化逆向分析。它通过 SSE 连接提供函数和字符串查询、反编译、交叉引用、注释及重命名等功能。
requirements: IDA Pro is required; version 8.3 or later is recommended.
Install FastMCP with pip into the Python environment used by IDA Pro.
Use an MCP client that can connect to an SSE server, and allow access to the configured server port.
License: MIT.

name: SOMCP
description_en: SOMCP is an Android MCP server for analyzing and modifying native SO libraries. It exposes ELF analysis, disassembly, patching, and optional dynamic analysis tools to MCP clients.
description_zh: SOMCP 是在 Android 设备上分析和修改原生 SO 库的 MCP 服务器。它向 MCP 客户端提供 ELF 分析、反汇编、补丁以及可选的动态分析工具。
requirements: Requires Android 8.0 or later.
Emulation in official release APKs requires a 64-bit device; Frida features require a separately installed Frida server or gadget on a rooted device.
The repository declares the AGPL-3.0 license.

name: VirtualXposed
description_en: VirtualXposed is an Android app that runs Xposed modules alongside apps in a virtual environment without root access, an unlocked bootloader, or a custom system image. It is based on VirtualApp and epic.
description_zh: VirtualXposed 是一款 Android 应用，可在虚拟环境中让 Xposed 模块作用于应用，无需 Root、解锁引导程序或刷入自定义系统镜像。它基于 VirtualApp 和 epic。
requirements: Requires an Android 5.0–10.0 device and installation of the VirtualXposed APK.
Apps and Xposed modules must both be installed inside VirtualXposed for modules to take effect.
Modules that modify the system and resource hooks are unsupported; the README prohibits commercial use.
The repository declares the GPL-3.0 license.

name: EdXposed Framework
description_en: EdXposed is a Riru module that provides an Xposed-compatible ART hooking framework for Android 8.0 through 11. It lets Xposed modules change system and app behavior without modifying APKs.
description_zh: EdXposed 是一个 Riru 模块，为 Android 8.0 至 11 提供兼容 Xposed 的 ART Hook 框架。它让 Xposed 模块无需修改 APK 即可改变系统和应用的行为。
requirements: Android 8.0 through 11.
Magisk v21+ and Riru v23+.
EdXposed Manager for the documented installation process.
License: GPL-3.0.

name: Vector Framework
description_en: Vector Framework is a Zygisk module that provides ART hooking for Android apps. It supports Xposed APIs and lets modules change app and system behavior in memory without modifying APK files.
description_zh: Vector Framework 是为 Android 应用提供 ART Hook 功能的 Zygisk 模块。它支持 Xposed API，让模块在内存中改变应用和系统的行为，无需修改 APK 文件。
requirements: Requires Android 8.1 through Android 17 Beta.
Requires a recent Magisk or KernelSU installation with Zygisk enabled.
Licensed under GPL-3.0.

name: JustTrustMe
description_en: JustTrustMe is an Xposed module that disables SSL certificate checks in Android apps. It can help expose network traffic from apps that use certificate pinning.
description_zh: JustTrustMe 是一个用于关闭 Android 应用 SSL 证书检查的 Xposed 模块。它可帮助查看采用证书固定机制的应用的网络流量。
requirements: Requires a rooted Android device.
Requires the Xposed framework to be installed.
Apache-2.0 per License.md.

name: spy-debugger
description_en: spy-debugger is a tool for remotely debugging pages in mobile browsers and app WebViews while capturing HTTP and HTTPS traffic. It injects weinre debugging code into HTML responses and can use its built-in proxy or an external one.
description_zh: spy-debugger 是一款远程调试手机浏览器和应用 WebView 页面、抓取 HTTP 与 HTTPS 流量的工具。它会在 HTML 响应中注入 weinre 调试代码，并可使用内置代理或外部代理。
requirements: Install spy-debugger with npm on a computer.
Connect the phone and computer to the same network and configure the phone's HTTP proxy.
Install a certificate on the phone for HTTPS debugging; on iOS 15, the tool cannot identify whether a request came from a browser.
License: MIT.

name: WebsiteBench
description_en: Benchmark that asks whether AI agents can rebuild websites through browser exploration: given a production-level website they can explore through a browser, agents must reverse-engineer a full-stack version that matches its appearance and behavior as closely as possible. Its 70 tasks hold 46,916 hidden test cases in total, and a case passes when its functional checks pass and every visual checkpoint reaches an RGB SSIM of 0.99.
description_zh: 评测 AI 智能体能否通过浏览器探索重建网站的基准：给定一个可通过浏览器探索的生产级网站，智能体需要逆向出一个全栈版本，在外观和行为上尽可能与原站一致。70 个任务共含 46,916 个隐藏测试用例；用例须通过功能检查，且每个视觉检查点的 RGB SSIM 均达到 0.99 才算通过。
requirements: Runs through Harbor with Docker: each trial uses separate agent and verifier environments, and every task requests 8 CPUs, 8 GiB of memory and 20 GiB of disk for each, with up to 16 hours for the agent and 8 hours for the verifier. An agent and its credentials are required. The PyPI package needs Python 3.12–3.14.
The 70 task downloads total 9.7 GB. Tasks are published on Harbor Hub and Hugging Face.

The verifier needs Landlock ABI 4 or newer (Linux 6.7+) and seccomp user notification, and the host kernel needs nftables fib support. Older kernels, including Debian 12's 6.1 and Ubuntu 22.04's 5.15, produce INVALID_RUN and no reward for every trial.
Benchmark code, task definitions and verifier are Apache-2.0. The reference websites reproduce third-party sites; their content belongs to its owners and is provided for non-commercial research only.

name: COGBox: static recompilation ports of Xbox 360 Gears of War games
description_en: COGBox packages native Windows ports of Gears of War 2, Gears of War 3, and Gears of War: Judgment built by translating Xbox 360 code to C++ ahead of time. A launcher imports the user's game copies and required title updates; the project supplies a Direct3D 12 renderer and experimental Vulkan option.
description_zh: COGBox 收录《战争机器 2》《战争机器 3》和《战争机器：审判》的原生 Windows 移植版，将 Xbox 360 代码预先翻译为 C++。启动器导入用户自备的游戏及必要更新；项目提供 Direct3D 12 渲染器和实验性 Vulkan 选项。
requirements: A Windows PC and the user's own copies of the supported games.
Required title updates: Update 6 for Gears of War 2 and 3, and Update 4 for Judgment.
The author reports playable builds with some remaining hiccups; Vulkan is experimental.
MIT license.

name: Downhill Revived: a matching decompilation and PC port of Downhill Domination
description_en: Downhill Revived ports the PlayStation 2 game Downhill Domination to native 64-bit Windows using C/C++ source matched byte for byte to the original game program. Native platform code replaces PS2 hardware interfaces, and game data is read from the user's USA disc image. The author reports 4,527 of 4,593 target game and engine functions matched.
description_zh: Downhill Revived 将 PlayStation 2 游戏《Downhill Domination》移植到 64 位 Windows，基础是编译结果与原程序逐字节匹配的 C/C++ 源码。原 PS2 硬件接口由本机代码替换，游戏数据从用户提供的美版光盘镜像读取。作者报告游戏与引擎目标函数已有 4,527／4,593 个完成匹配。
requirements: An owned USA Downhill Domination disc image, SCUS-97177, is required for play; building also needs its original executable.
Windows 10/11 64-bit and Direct3D 12 or Vulkan graphics are required for the main port.
Mac, Linux, and Android builds are experimental; online races on Android phones are not available.
GPL-3.0-or-later license for project code.

name: Dark Souls PS2: a PlayStation 2 port of Dark Souls Remastered
description_en: Dark Souls PS2 ports parts of Dark Souls Remastered to PlayStation 2 with a new C engine and hand-written VU1 programs. Python exporters convert maps, characters, animations, collision, scripts, and menus from the user's PC copy; executable findings document constants and rules used to reproduce behavior. The author describes it as an early prototype covering only the first few areas.
description_zh: Dark Souls PS2 使用新的 C 引擎和手写 VU1 程序，将 Dark Souls Remastered 的部分内容移植到 PlayStation 2。Python 工具从玩家自有的 PC 版导出地图、角色、动画、碰撞、脚本和菜单；可执行文件研究笔记记录用于复现行为的常量与规则。目前仍是只覆盖前几个区域的早期原型。
requirements: A user-owned Steam PC copy of Dark Souls Remastered is required; build 10943698 with English data is the checked version.
The developer setup requires Linux, ps2dev with gsKit, Python 3.10 or newer, and PCSX2 2.x.
The prototype is not a complete playable game; real PS2 hardware has not been tested.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: God of War — Native Port: a PS2 static recompilation with native hardware services
description_en: God of War — Native Port translates the NTSC-U PlayStation 2 game's executable into C++ with PS2Recomp and supplies native replacements for graphics, sound, input, memory cards, and other PS2 services. The repository provides configurations, overrides, code generators, build instructions, and zone tests for its Windows port.
description_zh: God of War — Native Port 使用 PS2Recomp 将美版 PS2 游戏可执行文件静态翻译为 C++，并以原生代码替代图形、声音、输入、记忆卡等 PS2 服务。仓库提供配置、覆盖代码、代码生成工具、构建说明和 Windows 移植版的关卡测试。
requirements: A legally owned God of War USA disc and its SCUS_973.99 executable.
Windows 10 or 11 x64, OpenGL 4.3 GPU, MSVC build tools, Python 3.11, and the repository's runtime branch.
The build pipeline remains manual; the Nintendo Switch build is planned.

name: Colin McRae Rally 2005: an Xbox XBE recompilation for Windows
description_en: A Colin McRae Rally 2005 port recompiles the US original-Xbox game for native Windows execution using Xbox XBE Recomp. The bundled runtime supplies Xbox kernel and XDK replacements, Direct3D 12 rendering, audio and controller support, while game code and assets come from the user's own copy. The port adds display settings and rendering fixes.
description_zh: 该项目使用 Xbox XBE Recomp 将美版初代 Xbox《Colin McRae Rally 2005》重编译为原生 Windows 程序。仓库中的运行时提供 Xbox 内核与 XDK 替代层、Direct3D 12 渲染、音频及手柄支持；游戏代码和素材取自用户自己的副本，移植版另加显示设置与渲染修正。
requirements: The US NTSC Xbox game files, including the specified default.xbe, must come from the user's own copy.
Windows 10 64-bit and a Direct3D 12-capable GPU are required; source builds require Visual Studio 2022 with the listed C++ tools.
Other Xbox regions and the PC game release are unsupported.
GPL-3.0 license for the port; the bundled SDK retains its stated MIT terms.

name: SWBF2 Browser Reconstruction: rebuilding Battlefront II maps in a browser
description_en: SWBF2 Browser Reconstruction rebuilds parts of Star Wars Battlefront II (2017) in a three.js browser runtime using data extracted from the user's installed game. The pipeline converts Frostbite meshes, textures, lighting, animations, audio and gameplay values; its reference scene is Death Star II with Blast and Free for All modes.
description_zh: SWBF2 Browser Reconstruction 从用户安装的 Star Wars Battlefront II（2017）提取数据，在 three.js 浏览器运行时中重建部分游戏。流程转换 Frostbite 网格、纹理、光照、动画、音频与玩法参数，参考场景为 Death Star II 的 Blast 和 Free for All 模式。
requirements: A legitimately owned, installed copy of Star Wars Battlefront II (2017) and Frosty Editor 1.0.5.2.
Windows 10/11, Python 3.11, Node.js 20+, .NET Framework 4.x and Chrome are listed for the pipeline.
The author states that it is unfinished and omits ragdolls, cloth simulation and parts of native animation and audio.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: Aion 2: reconstruction of the client-to-server network protocol
description_en: Aion 2 Network Protocol Research reconstructs parts of the game's client-to-server network protocol from captures and client inspection. It documents unsigned-varint framing, LZ4 bundles, an RSA-OAEP-SHA1 world handshake and continuous RC4 over post-handshake client frame bodies. Python tools analyze captures, recover session material and implement client cryptographic primitives.
description_zh: Aion 2 Network Protocol Research 根据抓包和客户端分析复现游戏的部分客户端到服务端协议。文档记录 unsigned-varint 分帧、LZ4 数据包、RSA-OAEP-SHA1 世界服握手，以及握手后客户端帧体持续使用的 RC4；Python 工具用于抓包分析、会话材料提取和客户端加密流程实现。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later is required; live opcode viewing and process-memory tools target the Windows client.
The documented snapshot is the Global client revision 3527; most client-to-server payload meanings remain unmapped.
The author reports validation of the RC4 model across six independently keyed sessions.
MIT license.

name: PartyBox for Home Assistant: reconstructing JBL speaker control over Bluetooth
description_en: PartyBox for Home Assistant replaces the JBL PartyBox phone app's control path with a Bluetooth client and MQTT entities. Its documented protocol was reconstructed from the JBL PartyBox Android app 3.14.20 and observed traffic, including command frames over GATT and ATT over classic Bluetooth.
description_zh: PartyBox for Home Assistant 通过蓝牙客户端和 MQTT 实体控制 JBL PartyBox 音箱。项目依据 JBL PartyBox Android 应用 3.14.20 及通信观察还原协议，记录了 GATT 命令帧和经典蓝牙上的 ATT 连接方式。
requirements: Home Assistant OS or Supervised and a Bluetooth adapter within range of the speaker.
The author reports testing one PartyBox model on one Home Assistant OS installation; other models may differ.
MIT license.

name: carlinkit-cxx: Linux receiver for Carlinkit Auto Box USB messages
description_en: carlinkit-cxx implements a Linux host for Carlinkit Auto Box USB dongles using their framed bulk-message protocol. It receives CarPlay or Android Auto H.264 video and PCM audio, sends touch input and displays decoded video through VAAPI, V4L2 or software paths.
description_zh: carlinkit-cxx 根据 Carlinkit Auto Box 的 USB bulk 消息格式实现 Linux 主机端，接收 CarPlay 或 Android Auto 的 H.264 视频与 PCM 音频、发送触摸输入，并通过 VAAPI、V4L2 或软件路径解码显示。
requirements: Carlinkit Auto Box USB dongle with ID 1314:1520 or 1314:1521 and Linux.
CMake, Meson, a C++17 compiler, libusb and the documented media/display dependencies.
A software-only decoder build is available; some display targets require drm-cxx and further libraries.
Apache-2.0 licence.

name: mchose-linux: MCHOSE HID settings protocol and Linux client
description_en: mchose-linux reconstructs the MCHOSE mouse settings protocol and implements Linux CLI and GUI clients for it. Its documentation traces HID feature-report commands and configuration fields from the M HUB web bundle and an L7 Pro mouse. The clients read and change DPI, polling rate, lift-off distance and other stored settings.
description_zh: mchose-linux 重建 MCHOSE 鼠标的设置协议，并提供 Linux 命令行和图形客户端。协议文档依据 M HUB 网页程序包及 L7 Pro 鼠标整理 HID 功能报告命令和配置字段；客户端可读取、修改 DPI、回报率、抬起距离等设备设置。
requirements: Linux with access to the mouse's hidraw node; Rust and Cargo are needed to build the clients.
The author reports exercising the protocol on an MCHOSE L7 Pro; other listed models are not individually confirmed.
The G3 family uses a different protocol and is unsupported.
MIT license.

name: PGBank Unofficial API: reconstructing web-client request behavior
description_en: PGBank Unofficial API implements a Python client for account operations using behavior documented from the bank’s web client. Its notes cover HTTP interception, encrypted JSON payloads, changing bootstrap values, custom request IDs and OTP session handling. The client supplies authentication, balances, history, transfers and scheduling.
description_zh: PGBank Unofficial API 根据对银行网页客户端行为的分析实现 Python 客户端。研究笔记涉及 HTTP 拦截、加密 JSON 载荷、动态启动参数、自定义请求 ID 和 OTP 会话处理；客户端提供认证、余额、交易记录、转账及定时任务功能。
requirements: PGBank credentials and a browser ID are needed to configure an account; the documented login flow uses OTP verification.
MIT license.

name: K1C CFS without official Creality firmware: CFS protocol client and Klipper integration
description_en: K1C CFS without official Creality firmware reconstructs part of the Creality CFS RS-485 control protocol so a K1C running a community Klipper stack can operate the filament box. Its Python client and Klipper extension cover discovery, addressing, sensors, RFID, filament feed and retraction; the combined toolchange macro remains unfinished.
description_zh: K1C CFS without official Creality firmware 还原了 Creality CFS 料盒的部分 RS-485 控制协议，使运行社区版 Klipper 的 K1C 能操作料盒。Python 客户端与 Klipper 扩展覆盖发现、寻址、传感器、RFID、进料和退料；组合换料宏仍未完成。
requirements: A K1C or similar printer with a CFS box and USB connection.
SSH/root access to the printer and Python with pyserial.
The full cut and combined toolchange macros remain pending.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Crysis 2: running the Mod SDK's x64 engine as a game client
description_en: crysis2-64bit launches Crysis 2 through the x64 engine DLLs supplied with its Mod SDK. The accompanying findings investigate a 64 FPS timer ceiling, renderer faults and truncated pointers in engine modules, while the launcher applies targeted runtime corrections and borderless display handling.
description_zh: crysis2-64bit 使用 Crysis 2 Mod SDK 附带的 x64 引擎 DLL 启动游戏。附带的研究记录分析了 64 FPS 计时限制、渲染器故障和引擎模块中的指针截断；启动器实施针对性的运行时修正和无边框显示处理。
requirements: Crysis 2 version 1.9 and the Crysis 2 Mod SDK are required; the SDK supplies the x64 engine DLLs.
The author describes the launcher as working but rough around the edges.
The author reports a fourteen-level campaign run in one process and a separate tester's completion.
MIT license.

name: Open TechEd: reconstructing NanoDrop 1000 USB control
description_en: Open TechEd reconstructs USB control of the Thermo Fisher NanoDrop 1000 spectrophotometer. The pilot captures vendor-software traffic, documents command and data endpoints, calibration reads, lamp and clamp controls, and pixel decoding, then implements a Python driver used through PyLabRobot.
description_zh: Open TechEd 重建 Thermo Fisher NanoDrop 1000 分光光度计的 USB 控制协议。项目采集原厂软件流量，记录命令与数据端点、校准数据读取、灯和夹具控制及像素解码，并实现供 PyLabRobot 使用的 Python 驱动。
requirements: A NanoDrop 1000, Python, and an open USB driver are required for instrument control.
The investigation and demonstration cover one pilot instrument; the author reports a paracetamol absorbance measurement.
MIT license.

name: douze: SSL 12 USB control protocol and Linux client
description_en: douze reconstructs the Solid State Logic SSL 12 USB control protocol and applies it in a Linux command-line controller and local mixer interface. Its protocol notes and captures cover framing, checksums, gain routing, monitoring, preamps and loopback.
description_zh: douze 根据 SSL 360 与 Solid State Logic SSL 12 之间的 USB 通信整理控制协议，并用它实现 Linux 命令行控制程序和本地混音界面。协议笔记与抓包覆盖帧格式、校验、增益路由、监听、前级和回环。
requirements: SSL 12 hardware and Linux with PipeWire.
Python 3.11+ and pyusb for the controller and GUI.
A few settings and clock controls are identified but undecoded.
Code is AGPL-3.0; protocol documentation is CC0-1.0.

name: Osmotic: a Mac client for DJI Osmo camera protocols
description_en: Osmotic implements a macOS client for DJI Osmo cameras using their BLE pairing, DUML-over-UDP control and file-list protocol. It downloads media over the camera's Wi-Fi, provides recording and live-view controls, and includes Swift protocol code and documentation derived in part from earlier Osmo projects.
description_zh: Osmotic 是使用 BLE 配对、DUML UDP 控制与文件列表协议连接 DJI Osmo 相机的 macOS 客户端，可通过相机 Wi-Fi 下载媒体并控制录制和实时画面。仓库提供 Swift 协议实现及文档，部分工作移植或改编自较早的 Osmo 项目。
requirements: macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon or Intel, with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.
The author reports hardware testing of Files and Live with an Osmo Pocket 3; Webcam and several other listed cameras have not been hardware-tested.
MIT License.

name: th06-headless: deterministic Touhou 6 logic runtime
description_en: th06-headless adapts reconstructed Touhou 6 game logic into a deterministic Linux runtime for replay and learning research. It removes window, audio and frame-pacing requirements, accepts seeded per-tick actions, exports JSONL state, and offers a lockstep observation/action interface. The fork builds on GensokyoClub/th06 and uses the user's original Japanese game data.
description_zh: th06-headless 将还原出的《东方红魔乡》逻辑改造成用于回放与学习研究的确定性 Linux 运行时。它去除窗口、音频和实时帧率要求，接受带固定种子的逐帧动作，导出 JSONL 状态，并提供同步观测与动作接口。该分支基于 GensokyoClub/th06，使用用户自己的日文原版游戏数据。
requirements: A user-supplied original Japanese Touhou 6 data installation and compatible Japanese font.
Linux build requires a C++20 compiler, Premake 5, SDL2, SDL2_image and SDL2_ttf.
The author reports repeatable Linux execution.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: GogglesView: receiving DJI Goggles 3 video over USB-C
description_en: GogglesView receives the DJI Goggles 3 live video feed over a reverse-engineered USB-C connection on macOS. It decodes H.264 with VideoToolbox and offers local viewing, passthrough recording and streaming outputs; the repository includes protocol research notes and Swift source.
description_zh: GogglesView 在 macOS 上通过逆向得出的 USB-C 通信方式接收 DJI Goggles 3 实时画面，以 VideoToolbox 解码 H.264，并提供本地观看、直通录制和串流输出。仓库包含协议研究笔记与 Swift 源码。
requirements: Requires macOS 14+ on an Apple Silicon Mac, DJI Goggles 3 and a data-capable USB-C cable.
The goggles must have OTG Wired Connection to Computer enabled and an active live view.
The author reports limited real-device testing for several newer output features; the Linux and Windows receiver is early.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: moi3-cluster-pipeline-re: MOI3 instrument-cluster video pipeline
description_en: The MOI3 cluster pipeline study reconstructs the display path from a VW MIB3 head unit to its instrument cluster on a PC bench. It documents a Wayland ivi_share handoff, RGBA-to-YUV conversion, H.264 encoding and RTP/UDP multicast, and supplies shims and a compositor stub for running a user-provided multi-screen-server binary. Ghidra scripts and a protocol extractor support the investigation.
description_zh: MOI3 仪表盘链路研究在 PC 实验台上重现 VW MIB3 车机向仪表盘传输画面的流程。文档记录 Wayland ivi_share 交接、RGBA 转 YUV、H.264 编码和 RTP/UDP 组播；仓库提供垫片、简化合成器、Ghidra 脚本及协议提取器，完整实验需用户提供 multi-screen-server 程序。
requirements: The full bench requires a user-extracted MOI3 firmware sysroot, multi-screen-server binary, encoder shader and glforward base.
The conversion demo uses a C compiler and Mesa software GL; the user supplies the encoder shader.
The project is experimental and confines its implementation to a PC display bench.
Code is MIT licensed; documentation is CC BY 4.0.

name: Xiaomi X-WPFTB LiDAR: decoding a robot-vacuum sensor's UART frames
description_en: Xiaomi X-WPFTB LiDAR documents the one-way UART data format of the X-WPFTB-V2.6.2 sensor used in Xiaomi and Dreame robot vacuums. The author reports decoding 36-byte frames carrying eight distance samples, angle, quality and flags, then implements an Arduino parser and Windows visualizers.
description_zh: Xiaomi X-WPFTB LiDAR 记录了小米和 Dreame 扫地机器人所用 X-WPFTB-V2.6.2 传感器的单向 UART 数据格式。作者报告已解析每帧 36 字节中的八个距离采样及角度、质量和标志位，并实现 Arduino 解析库与 Windows 可视化工具。
requirements: An X-WPFTB-V2.6.2 LiDAR and a serial-capable host such as the documented Arduino Uno setup.
The supply voltage must be measured before changing the original power arrangement.
The final two-byte checksum and exact RPM scale are unresolved.
MIT license.

name: pag-extract: reconstructing the m-anage/VMX public programme interface
description_en: pag-extract documents the recovery of public programme endpoints used by m-anage/VMX medical congress sites and implements a client for them. Its Node.js CLI exports days, sessions, rooms, chairs, talks and speakers as Markdown, CSV or JSON; accompanying documentation explains the endpoint discovery process.
description_zh: pag-extract 记录了 m-anage/VMX 医学会议网站公开议程接口的发现过程，并实现了调用这些接口的客户端。Node.js 命令行工具可将日期、场次、会场、主持人、报告及讲者导出为 Markdown、CSV 或 JSON；附带文档讲解接口定位方法。
requirements: Node.js 18 or newer, or Bun.
A public m-anage/VMX congress programme URL or its instance and congress code.
The tool covers public pre-login programme data.
MIT license.

name: openwrt-dlink-dir842-r1: OpenWrt port informed by Realtek datapath research
description_en: openwrt-dlink-dir842-r1 ports OpenWrt to the D-Link DIR-842 R1 using a pinned base checkout and device-specific overlays. Its engineering notes investigate the RTL8197F and RTL8367S network path, switch setup and hardware NAT, while the build produces RAM-boot and NOR-flash firmware images.
description_zh: openwrt-dlink-dir842-r1 通过固定版本的基础代码和设备专用覆盖文件，将 OpenWrt 移植到 D-Link DIR-842 R1。工程笔记调查 RTL8197F 与 RTL8367S 的网络路径、交换机配置和硬件 NAT；构建流程生成内存启动及 NOR 闪存固件映像。
requirements: D-Link DIR-842 hardware revision R1 with RTL8197F.
Back up the unit's NOR flash before flashing; recovery may require a serial connection.
The author reports 891 Mbit/s upstream and 896 Mbit/s downstream in a hardware-NAT bench test.
GPL-2.0 license.

name: RedMagic Cooler for macOS: a Bluetooth controller for the VC Cooler 6 Pro
description_en: RedMagic Cooler for macOS reconstructs the REDMAGIC VC Cooler 6 Pro's Bluetooth control path in a menu bar app. It uses packet captures and vendor app observation to map GATT characteristics for cooling, fan speed, lighting and telemetry, and includes probe scripts for testing command bytes.
description_zh: RedMagic Cooler for macOS 依据抓包和厂商应用行为，在菜单栏应用中实现 REDMAGIC VC Cooler 6 Pro 的蓝牙控制。项目记录了制冷、风扇、灯光和遥测所用的 GATT 特征值，并提供命令字节探测脚本。
requirements: macOS 13 or later and a REDMAGIC VC Cooler 6 Pro; Apple Silicon enables direct die-temperature readings.
Only the VC Cooler 6 Pro is documented as hardware-tested; other models remain unverified.
MIT license.

name: dola-client: reconstructing Dola's Android app API access
description_en: dola-client reconstructs access to the Dola AI Android app API from captured phone traffic. It provides Python signing and API-call code, a demonstration chat CLI, and session import from a logged-in Android app or browser cookies.
description_zh: dola-client 根据手机抓取的流量重建 Dola AI Android 应用 API 的访问方式。仓库提供 Python 签名与接口调用代码、演示聊天命令行程序，以及从已登录 Android 应用或浏览器 Cookie 导入会话的功能。
requirements: Python 3.11 or newer, requests and Pillow are required.
Android session extraction needs a rooted device or emulator with a logged-in Dola app and ADB in PATH.
Browser cookies can be used as an alternative session source.
No licence file in the repository.

name: pc-dragonquestswords: a partial static recompilation of Dragon Quest Swords for PC
description_en: pc-dragonquestswords ports the European Wii release of Dragon Quest Swords toward native PC execution by statically recompiling its PowerPC code to C++ and providing a replacement runtime through wiikit. Its notes map the disc, FPK archives and stripped executable; the author reports that the current port reaches the opening and early tutorial battles.
description_zh: pc-dragonquestswords 将欧版 Wii 游戏《勇者斗恶龙之剑》的 PowerPC 代码静态重编译为 C++，并通过 wiikit 提供替代运行层，推进原生 PC 移植。文档梳理光盘、FPK 包和去符号可执行文件；作者报告目前可运行开场及教程前段战斗。
requirements: A user-owned European RDQPGD disc is required; game data and executables are excluded from the repository.
Python 3.8+, CMake, Ninja, a C++20 compiler, SDL3 and OpenGL 4.5 are described for the tool and build workflow.
The port stops at the tutorial's Master Stroke and does not yet support the stab.
MIT license for repository documentation and tools.

name: pc-virtualhydlide: statically recompiling Virtual Hydlide for PC
description_en: pc-virtualhydlide ports the European Sega Saturn release of Virtual Hydlide toward PC by statically recompiling fifteen SH-2 programs to C++ and running them with saturnkit. Its notes document disc structure, game files, executable behavior, video and sound; the author reports playable output and an optional interpolated display between the game's logic frames.
description_zh: pc-virtualhydlide 通过将欧洲版 Sega Saturn《Virtual Hydlide》的十五个 SH-2 程序静态重编译为 C++，并交由 saturnkit 运行时执行，推进 PC 移植。文档记录光盘结构、游戏文件、程序行为、画面和声音；作者报告已有可玩画面，并提供在逻辑帧之间插值显示的选项。
requirements: The user's own European MK-81380 V1.000 disc image in a Redump-style .cue/.bin set is required; the repository ships no game assets.
Python 3.8+ is required for the tools; C++ builds use CMake, Ninja, clang and SDL3, with saturnkit as a submodule.
The author reports that interpolated output still has glitches and further game areas remain to be covered.
MIT license.

name: WCW Nitro: a checksum-checked PlayStation decompilation
description_en: WCW Nitro is a PlayStation game decompilation that rebuilds code from the SLUS_003.97 executable and WGAME.BIN and WMENU.BIN overlays. Its source tree contains reconstructed C files and build configurations; users supply files from their own disc, then run a checksum check on the generated binaries.
description_zh: WCW Nitro 是 PlayStation 游戏反编译项目，围绕 SLUS_003.97 主程序以及 WGAME.BIN、WMENU.BIN 覆盖段重建代码。仓库提供 C 源码和构建配置；用户需从自己的光盘提供文件，构建后通过校验和检查生成的二进制文件。
requirements: Supply SLUS_003.97, WGAME.BIN, and WMENU.BIN from the game's disc; decode the two BIN files first.
A Linux build environment or the supplied Dockerfile is needed.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Panasonic HC-X2 / HC-X20 Remote Control: HC-ROP protocol client
description_en: Panasonic HC-X2 / HC-X20 Remote Control implements a Python client for the cameras' HC-ROP/P2Control protocol. It sends XML control commands over TCP, decodes UDP telemetry and recording events, and documents the handshake and command set. The author reports testing it on HC-X2 and HC-X20 bodies.
description_zh: Panasonic HC-X2 / HC-X20 Remote Control 用 Python 实现摄像机的 HC-ROP/P2Control 客户端，通过 TCP 发送 XML 控制命令，并解析 UDP 状态数据和录制事件。文档记录了握手与命令格式；作者报告已在 HC-X2 和 HC-X20 实机上测试。
requirements: Python 3.8 or newer and access to an HC-X2 or HC-X20 with IP REMOTE enabled and a user account.
The author reports testing HC-X2 and HC-X20; other HC-X and AG-CX models remain untested.
Live preview is not implemented.
MIT license.

name: open-m711pro: reconstructing Redragon M711 Pro USB control
description_en: open-m711pro reconstructs the Redragon M711 Pro mouse's USB HID configuration exchanges from vendor-app traffic captured with usbmon and Wireshark. Its Python Linux driver and interfaces read and set lighting, DPI, button mappings and polling rate through hidraw, with packet builders tested against captured bytes.
description_zh: open-m711pro 依据 usbmon 与 Wireshark 抓取的厂商程序流量，重建 Redragon M711 Pro 鼠标的 USB HID 配置报文。其 Python Linux 驱动和界面通过 hidraw 读取或设置灯效、DPI、按键映射及轮询率，并用抓包字节测试报文构造。
requirements: Linux, Python 3.8+ and an M711 Pro/Cobra Pro device with USB ID 25A7:FA07 or 25A7:FA08 are required.
The Qt interface optionally needs PySide6; device access uses hidraw and a udev rule.
Macros and modifier combinations are unmapped; keyboard keys are experimental.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: ZOOM F8: BLE remote-control protocol reconstruction
description_en: ZOOM F8 BLE protocol documentation reconstructs remote control for F8-family field recorders. It describes advertising, GATT handles, the connection handshake, commands, telemetry, settings and SD-card browsing, while distinguishing live observations from firmware-derived and inferred details.
description_zh: ZOOM F8 BLE 协议文档重建了 F8 系列录音机的遥控方式，记录广播、GATT 句柄、连接握手、命令、状态通知、设置及 SD 卡浏览，并区分实测、固件推导与推测内容。
requirements: A ZOOM F8n Pro was used for the documented hardware observations.
F8n and F8 compatibility is untested; F6, F3 and H-series devices are outside scope.
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence.

name: vestaboard-offline: local control of a Vestaboard display
description_en: vestaboard-offline restores local control of a Vestaboard split-flap display with a Python web controller running on the board. It sends 6×22 character grids to the on-board vbctrl service and documents the display's RS485 flap-bus framing, commands and recovery path.
description_zh: vestaboard-offline 在 Vestaboard 翻页显示屏本机运行 Python 网页控制器，向内置 vbctrl 服务发送 6×22 字符网格，实现本地控制。仓库还记录 RS485 翻页模块总线的报文格式、命令及设备恢复过程。
requirements: A Vestaboard with a compatible Compute Module 4 and Yocto Linux image, including the on-board vbctrl driver.
Root access to the board is required for installation.
The documented Linux-side method may differ on other hardware generations.
MIT license.

name: Better RGB: reconstructing the Tongfang/ITE8291 keyboard lighting protocol
description_en: Better RGB reconstructs the USB HID lighting protocol of Tongfang laptops with an ITE8291 keyboard controller and implements a Windows per-key RGB client. The author describes comparing vendor-software captures with visible lighting changes to identify feature-report commands, output-report buffers and key offsets.
description_zh: Better RGB 还原采用 ITE8291 键盘控制器的 Tongfang 笔记本电脑的 USB HID 灯光协议，并实现 Windows 逐键 RGB 控制客户端。作者记录了如何对照厂商软件的抓包与实际灯光变化，识别 HID 功能报告中的命令、输出报告中的颜色缓冲区及各按键的字节偏移。
requirements: A Tongfang/ITE8291 keyboard with the documented USB HID interface and Windows.
Building requires MSYS2 with mingw-w64, CMake and Ninja.
MIT license.

name: geow2: a native Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 port
description_en: geow2 rebuilds Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 as a native Windows, macOS, and Linux game based on analysis of the Xbox 360 executable. It implements the six original modes and local multiplayer, while a bundled extractor prepares data from the player's own XBLA release.
description_zh: geow2 根据 Xbox 360 原版可执行文件的分析，将 Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 重建为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 原生游戏。项目实现六种原版模式与本地多人玩法，并通过附带的提取工具处理玩家自有的 XBLA 版本数据。
requirements: Supply your own Xbox Live Arcade release with title ID 584108FF, version 0x102.
FFmpeg is needed to prepare sound data; Windows and Linux require Vulkan, while macOS uses Metal.
Building from source requires CMake 3.28+, Ninja, glslc, and a platform C++ toolchain.
MIT License.

name: YouDao-Translater: Youdao web response decryption
description_en: YouDao-Translater recreates Youdao's web translation response decoding in Python. Its write-up traces the JavaScript Base64 handling and AES-128-CBC decryption, including MD5-derived key and IV bytes, and the repository provides a request module and decoder.
description_zh: YouDao-Translater 用 Python 复现有道翻译网页响应的解码过程。文档追踪 JavaScript 中的 Base64 处理和 AES-128-CBC 解密，包括由 MD5 得到密钥与 IV 字节；仓库附有请求模块及解码器。
requirements: Python and the Youdao translation web API are needed.
The source notes that fixed encryption parameters may change and break the client.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Top Spin 4 decompilation: matching Xbox 360 functions against three XEX modules
description_en: Top Spin 4 decompilation reconstructs C source for the Xbox 360 game and compares compiled functions against code in three retail XEX modules. The repository includes reconstructed functions, Ghidra analysis tooling, build configuration and progress reports; the author reports partial exact compiler matches.
description_zh: Top Spin 4 decompilation 为 Xbox 360 游戏重建 C 源码，并将编译后的函数与三个零售版 XEX 模块中的代码比较。仓库包含已重建函数、Ghidra 分析工具、构建配置和进度报告；作者报告部分函数已达到精确编译匹配。
requirements: A user-supplied retail game copy is required; the repository excludes game images and executables.
The analysis workflow specifies Ghidra 12.1.2 and XEXLoaderWV.
The reconstructed source has not been linked into a runnable XEX.
MIT license for original repository code and documentation.

name: samsung-re-find: reconstructing Samsung Find account and device operations
description_en: samsung-re-find reconstructs selected Samsung Find account and device operations in a Python SDK, JSON CLI, and MCP server. Protocol notes describe a master-token-to-web-session exchange and the request sequence for active location updates. The implementation lists devices and exposes available location, connectivity, battery, ringing, and tracking operations, with support varying by device category.
description_zh: samsung-re-find 用 Python SDK、JSON CLI 和 MCP 服务器实现部分 Samsung Find 账户与设备操作。协议笔记记录了主令牌换取网页会话的流程，以及主动定位的请求序列。实现可列出设备，并按设备类别提供可用的定位、连接、电量、响铃和持续追踪操作。
requirements: Python 3.11 or newer and an authorized Samsung Account login.
Operation support varies by device category and returned data; encrypted SmartTag locations are not decoded.
Live-device validation varies by operation and device category.
MIT License.

name: Adventure Island II: a static recompilation of the NES game
description_en: Adventure Island II is statically recompiled from its NES ROM into a generated C catalog of fixed bank and program-counter identities for a native Windows frontend. The runtime includes NES CPU bus, PPU, APU, DMA, controls and MMC3B mapper behavior, validates a user-supplied USA ROM by SHA-256, and stops on unknown execution identities.
description_zh: 该项目把 NES 版 Adventure Island II 的 ROM 路径静态分析为固定物理存储区和程序计数器身份组成的 C 代码目录，并由原生 Windows 前端运行。运行时实现 NES CPU 总线、PPU、APU、DMA、手柄和 MMC3B 映射器，按 SHA-256 检查用户提供的美版 ROM，遇到未知执行身份时停止。
requirements: Supply the original Adventure Island II (USA).nes ROM with the documented SHA-256 hash.
Building requires 64-bit Windows 10 or later, Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools and CMake 3.20 or newer.
The separate static-core certification gate remains incomplete.
No licence file in the repository.

name: mcp-fitbod: mapping Fitbod Android models and backend APIs
description_en: mcp-fitbod maps Fitbod backend endpoints and serialization schemas from decompiled Kotlin models in the Android app, then uses the documented interface in an MCP account client. Its endpoint map and schema notes identify request paths, model fields and wire names, including JSON:API and Moshi naming differences.
description_zh: mcp-fitbod 从 Fitbod Android 应用反编译的 Kotlin 模型整理后端端点与序列化结构，并据此实现 MCP 账户客户端。端点表和结构文档列出请求路径、模型字段及传输字段名，包括 JSON:API 与 Moshi 的命名差异。
requirements: The schema documentation is based on Fitbod Android 8.30.0-0 and calls for review after app updates.
The MCP client requires Python 3.10 or newer and a Fitbod account token.
The source reports that the login endpoint is blocked by a Cloudflare WAF rule.
MIT license.

name: FlyBird-ProtocolAnalysis: FlyBird client subscription protocol and APXS v2 format
description_en: FlyBird-ProtocolAnalysis investigates the FlyBird proxy client's subscription delivery and APXS v2 format across Windows, Android, Linux and OpenWrt. Its reports describe client static analysis, process-memory inspection, GDB breakpoints and TLS observation; accompanying code decrypts the envelope and reproduces the documented mTLS request flow using user-supplied account credentials and certificates from the user's installed client.
description_zh: FlyBird-ProtocolAnalysis 研究 FlyBird 代理客户端在 Windows、Android、Linux 和 OpenWrt 上的订阅交付链路与 APXS v2 格式。报告记录了客户端静态分析、进程内存检查、GDB 断点及 TLS 流量观察；配套代码可解密数据封套，并利用用户提供的账号凭据和从已安装客户端导出的证书复现所述 mTLS 请求流程。
requirements: Subscription retrieval requires user-supplied account credentials and certificate files exported from the user's installed client.
The source describes Python 3, with additional client binaries and GDB for some tracing routes.
The author reports byte-for-byte matching of decrypted output and an approximately eight-second protocol route.
MIT.

name: SimCity 4 Deluxe: static recompilation from the Steam executable
description_en: SimCity 4 Deluxe statically recompiles the user's Steam game executable into locally generated C with pcrecomp and runs it in a native32 host. The repository supplies setup, lift and runtime code while excluding generated game source and assets. The author reports that scripted runs load a region and city, simulate a month and save data the original game can load.
description_zh: SimCity 4 Deluxe 使用 pcrecomp 将用户自有的 Steam 游戏可执行文件静态重编译为本地生成的 C 代码，并在 native32 运行时上运行。仓库提供设置、代码转换和运行时代码，不分发生成的游戏源码和资源。作者报告脚本运行可载入区域与城市、模拟一个月，并生成原版游戏可读取的存档。
requirements: A personal Steam installation of SimCity 4 Deluxe, Windows 10/11, Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools and about 3 GB free space are required.
pcrecomp is required beside the repository; setup can obtain it.
A full manual play session and DirectX 7 renderer remain untested.
MIT license for the host and scripts.

name: SwiftCUA: reconstructing a macOS computer-use service
description_en: SwiftCUA reconstructs the behavior of a macOS computer-use service in Swift 6 after studying the Codex Computer Use.app bundle, its local IPC, permissions and input engine. It provides a background service, CLI, JavaScript bridge and MCP servers for accessibility inspection, screenshots and input, with separate research reports on the original.
description_zh: SwiftCUA 研究 Codex Computer Use.app 的应用结构、本地 IPC、权限和输入引擎后，以 Swift 6 重建 macOS 计算机操作服务。项目提供后台服务、命令行、JavaScript 桥接与 MCP 服务，用于无障碍树检查、截图和输入操作，并附有原应用的逆向报告。
requirements: macOS with Screen Recording and Accessibility permission is required for the installed service.
Swift 6 is used for the service; the JavaScript client requires Node.js 18 or newer.
The reconstructed service does not support locked-screen operation or byte-compatible communication with the original service.
MIT License.

name: aiowapy: a Python implementation of WhatsApp Multi-Device protocols
description_en: aiowapy implements a Python client for WhatsApp Multi-Device using Noise transport, Signal sessions and a WABinary codec. Its protocol notes describe framing, pairing and message stanzas; the code also covers media, groups, app-state sync and SQLite session storage. The author reports extensive offline tests but no live end-to-end message delivery yet.
description_zh: aiowapy 使用 Noise 传输、Signal 会话和 WABinary 编解码器实现 WhatsApp Multi-Device 的 Python 客户端。协议文档说明帧结构、配对和消息节点，代码还覆盖媒体、群组、应用状态同步及 SQLite 会话存储。作者报告已进行大量离线测试，但尚未完成线上端到端消息投递。
requirements: Python 3.11 or newer and a phone account for device linking.
Live traffic has not been exercised; calls, channels, statuses, polls, buttons and LID-based encryption are not implemented.
MIT licence.

name: redmi-buds-linux: rebuilding Redmi earbud controls over JieLi RCSP
description_en: redmi-buds-linux reimplements Redmi and Xiaomi earbud controls on Linux using a documented variant of JieLi RCSP over Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM. The author derived the challenge-response transform from the companion app's native library and compared protocol behavior with a phone-to-buds HCI capture. Its Rust CLI and GTK app expose battery status, EQ, gestures and earbud finding; noise control is available on models with ANC.
description_zh: redmi-buds-linux 基于有文档记录的小米版 JieLi RCSP 蓝牙经典模式 RFCOMM 协议，在 Linux 上实现 Redmi 和 Xiaomi 耳机控制功能。作者从配套应用的原生库中恢复挑战响应变换，并用手机与耳机之间的 HCI 抓包核对协议行为。Rust 命令行工具和 GTK 应用提供电量查看、EQ、手势设置及寻找耳机功能；具备 ANC 的机型还可使用降噪控制。
requirements: Requires Linux with BlueZ, paired earbuds and Rust 1.87 or newer.
The GUI additionally requires GTK 4.12 or newer and libadwaita 1.7 or newer.
The author reports testing on Redmi Buds 6 Play and 6 Lite; other models are speculative and may differ.
MIT License.

name: iPod Classic LCD: recovering the display pinout and bus protocol
description_en: The iPod Classic LCD investigation maps the 34-pin display connector and decodes its 18-lane RGB666, 8080-series bus using logic-analyser captures and electrical measurements. It documents command framing, initialization, power sequencing and pixel timing, and includes Python tools to decode captures and reconstruct screen images.
description_zh: iPod Classic LCD 研究通过逻辑分析仪采集和电气测量，绘制 34 针显示屏接口，并解析 18 线 RGB666、8080 式总线。文档覆盖命令传输、初始化、上电时序和像素传输时间；Python 工具可解码采集数据并重建屏幕图像。
requirements: The documented unit is the 2009 thin iPod Classic 160 GB, model A1238, with its type 2 LCD.
New captures require a logic analyser and the separately obtained gusmanb LogicAnalyzer binaries.
The RGB666 pair test and the exact assignment of two control pins remain unresolved.
MIT for the project's work; vendored Rockbox sources in refs/ are GPL v2.

name: UAD-2 OCTO: tracing PCIe command rings and DSP resource loading
description_en: UAD-2 OCTO-RE investigates the PCIe host transport of a Universal Audio DSP card through driver analysis and experiments on one Rev 5 board. The author reports reproducing command-ring and DMA startup across eight DSPs and recovering parts of the firmware and Bill resource containers. General-purpose DSP execution remains blocked by an unresolved runtime response and opaque payload format.
description_zh: UAD-2 OCTO-RE 通过驱动分析和一块 Rev 5 卡上的实验研究 Universal Audio DSP 卡的 PCIe 主机传输。作者报告已在八个 DSP 上复现命令环和 DMA 启动，并还原部分固件及 Bill 资源容器结构；通用 DSP 程序执行仍受运行时应答与载荷格式问题阻碍。
requirements: Experiments target a UAD-2 OCTO Rev 5 card with an isolated IOMMU group and the documented PCIe profile.
The hardware procedures involve low-level PCIe, MMIO, DMA, interrupt and reset access.
General-purpose DSP execution has not been achieved.
GPL-2.0-only licence.

name: GameSir Cyclone 2: firmware findings and controller bridge
description_en: GameSir Cyclone 2 documents analysis of the controller’s JieLi BR23 firmware, including image layout, instruction encodings, timer behavior and firmware patches. It also describes a Raspberry Pi bridge that maps Bluetooth HID input to an Xbox 360 Wireless Receiver USB interface for Windows XInput.
description_zh: GameSir Cyclone 2 项目记录控制器 JieLi BR23 固件的镜像布局、指令编码、定时器行为和补丁，并说明如何用 Raspberry Pi 将 Bluetooth HID 输入映射为 Windows XInput 使用的 Xbox 360 无线接收器 USB 接口。
requirements: A GameSir Cyclone 2 and a dump of the user’s own device are needed for firmware patching.
The bridge needs a separately powered Raspberry Pi; its kernel patch was developed against Linux 6.12.75+rpt-rpi-v8.
Findings and offsets came from one device and firmware revision.
Original code and documentation are MIT licensed; the bridge kernel patch is GPL-2.0-only.

name: OBSBOT Tiny 3: USB control protocol investigation
description_en: obsbot-tiny3-protocol investigates direct USB control of the OBSBOT Tiny 3 camera. It documents UVC extension-unit addressing, V3 frame fields and CRC, Tiny 3 AI mode values, and command behavior checked against camera-reported state; Python probes inspect UVC properties and test vendor opcodes.
description_zh: obsbot-tiny3-protocol 研究 OBSBOT Tiny 3 相机的直接 USB 控制。项目记录 UVC 扩展单元寻址、V3 帧字段及 CRC、Tiny 3 的 AI 模式数值，并将命令效果与相机返回状态对照；Python 脚本探测 UVC 属性和厂商操作码。
requirements: The observations concern an OBSBOT Tiny 3 tested on Windows 11.
Auto Zoom framing control is reported unavailable through the examined USB and OSC paths.
MIT License.

name: NHL 14 Recomp: a static Xbox 360 recompilation and franchise-mode investigation
description_en: NHL 14 Recomp translates a user-supplied Xbox 360 NHL 14 executable into C++ for a native PC build using ReXGlue. The repository also provides host runtime code, save and roster tools, and documented findings about Be a GM rules derived from game code and saves.
description_zh: NHL 14 Recomp 使用 ReXGlue 将用户提供的 Xbox 360 版 NHL 14 可执行文件转换为 C++，构建 PC 原生版本。仓库还提供主机运行时代码、存档与阵容工具，以及依据游戏代码和存档整理的 Be a GM 机制分析。
requirements: Supply your own legally obtained NHL 14 copy and executable dump; game data and generated C++ are excluded.
Building requires Clang 18+, CMake 3.25+, Ninja, and the ReXGlue SDK; the 3D build needs a Vulkan-enabled SDK built from source.
The author reports full games and Be a GM progression; audio polish and broader gameplay fidelity remain open.
MIT License for the repository's original code and documentation.

name: Solomon's Key: byte-identical source reconstruction of three NES releases
description_en: Solomon's Key NES source reconstruction rebuilds the USA, European, and Japanese releases from shared ca65 assembly. The build extracts private CHR data from a user-supplied ROM, then compares rebuilt revisions byte for byte with the originals. Documentation covers the game architecture, RAM map, data formats, and subsystem behavior.
description_zh: Solomon's Key NES 源码重建项目使用共享的 ca65 汇编源码生成美版、欧版和日版。构建过程从用户自行提供的 ROM 提取 CHR 数据，并将生成结果与原版逐字节比较；文档涵盖游戏架构、RAM 映射、数据格式和各子系统行为。
requirements: Python 3.11 or later, GNU Make, and Retrolarium Kit with ca65 and ld65.
A user's own USA, European, or Japanese Solomon's Key NES ROM is required for assets and comparison.
The MAME-based attract-mode check covers the first demo only.
No licence file in the repository.

name: FSR 4 INT8: reconstructed GPU passes and comparison harness
description_en: An FSR 4.1.1 INT8 investigation reconstructs the upscaler’s GPU passes in HLSL and compares their outputs with AMD’s compiled kernels through a D3D12 harness. The author reports byte-identical offline results for the documented passes and supplies an FFX-compatible provider build that obtains network weights from a user-supplied official DLL. Colour-mode paths and live frames have narrower comparison evidence.
description_zh: 该项目研究 FSR 4.1.1 INT8 升频器，用 HLSL 重建 GPU 计算阶段，并通过 D3D12 工具与 AMD 编译后的内核比较输出。作者报告所列阶段在离线重放中逐字节一致；FFX 兼容提供程序从用户提供的官方 DLL 提取网络权重。色彩模式与实时画面的比较范围较窄。
requirements: Windows 10/11, Visual Studio with MSVC v143+, CMake and dxc are required for the documented build.
The provider build requires a user-supplied official FSR 4.1.1 DLL and FidelityFX-SDK checkout.
The author reports byte-exact offline kernel comparisons; live output is not compared frame by frame.
MIT license.

name: Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed: differential x86 source recovery
description_en: prsche-disasm recovers C/C++ source for Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed from its Windows x86 binaries. It indexes original modules and addresses, studies resource formats, and compares recovered functions with recorded original inputs, state, outputs, and ABI behavior. The recovered C++ modules build separately, but the full game does not yet link into a playable executable.
description_zh: prsche-disasm 从 Windows x86 二进制恢复 Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed 的 C/C++ 源码，索引原始模块与地址，研究资源格式，并用原程序的输入、状态、输出及 ABI 行为比较已恢复函数。现有 C++ 模块可分别构建，但完整游戏尚未链接成可玩的程序。
requirements: A user-owned copy of the original game is required as a read-only input.
Building recovered modules requires Windows x64, Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with C++ workloads, Windows SDK, CMake, and Python 3.
The recovered C++ game is unfinished and does not yet link into a playable executable.
MIT license applies to project-owned contributions, subject to LICENSING.md.

name: airport-express-tools: rebuilding AirPort Express configuration and Wi-Fi client mode
description_en: airport-express-tools reconstructs configuration and Wi-Fi client functions for the second-generation AirPort Express A1392 from firmware and ACP protocol research. Its Python CLI configures Wi-Fi, connection sharing and device settings; a local web UI provides Wi-Fi and device controls. A replacement supplicant joins WPA2 networks. Reference pages map ACP properties, RPCs, firmware contents and client-mode behavior, with Ghidra and unpacking helpers.
description_zh: airport-express-tools 基于固件和 ACP 管理协议研究，重建第二代 AirPort Express A1392 的配置与 Wi-Fi 客户端功能。Python 命令行工具可配置无线网络、连接共享和设备设置，本地网页界面提供无线网络及设备控制。替代版 wpa_supplicant 可连接 WPA2 网络。文档记录 ACP 属性、RPC、固件内容及客户端模式，并附 Ghidra 脚本和解包工具。
requirements: A1392 on firmware 7.8.1 is the documented fully tested model; other models have limited or untested write support.
The CLI requires Python 3.8 or newer; installing the replacement Wi-Fi client requires the device's debug SSH login.
The firmware's own wpa_supplicant crashes in client mode on 7.8.1; the replacement supports WPA2-PSK on 2.4 GHz.
MIT License.

name: StargateCryo: an Intel Cryo controller dashboard built on serial-protocol research
description_en: StargateCryo is a Rust dashboard that monitors and controls Intel Cryo cooling controllers over a documented reverse-engineered serial protocol. It adds controller telemetry, PID profiles, diagnostics, session history, and sensor integrations to an earlier open-source controller. The documented hardware evaluation covers one modified Gen 1 controller with a Gen 2 TEC.
description_zh: StargateCryo 是通过已记录的逆向串行协议监控和控制 Intel Cryo 散热控制器的 Rust 面板。它在早期开放源码控制器基础上增加遥测、PID 配置、诊断、会话记录和传感器集成。文档中的硬件测试对象是一台改装的 Gen 1 控制器，配有 Gen 2 TEC。
requirements: Windows builds require the Rust MSVC toolchain and Visual Studio C++ Build Tools.
The documented hardware evaluation covers one modified Gen 1 controller with a Gen 2 TEC; other installations are not certified.
TF2 readings with SignalRGB require a compatible plugin.
MIT.

name: Gaomon M10K 2018: firmware decoding and report-rate investigation
description_en: Gaomon M10K 2018 research decodes a substitution-encoded GD32F350 tablet firmware image and investigates its sensor loop and USB report path. The repository includes an image codec, constrained patch builder, DFU transaction documentation, and observations from experimental report-rate changes.
description_zh: Gaomon M10K 2018 项目解码采用字节替换编码的 GD32F350 数位板固件镜像，并研究传感器循环和 USB 上报路径。仓库提供镜像编解码器、限制修改范围的补丁构建器、DFU 事务文档，以及实验性上报速率调整的观察记录。
requirements: Supply the official M10K 2018 OEM02 T17b 241030 firmware image yourself.
The builder and codec require Python 3.10 or newer; Raw Input diagnostics and flashing require Windows.
The author reports measurements from one tablet.
MIT License.

name: nokia105-emu: Nokia 105 firmware emulation
description_en: nokia105-emu runs a Nokia 105 TA-1423 firmware dump from boot ROM to a usable menu interface. Unicorn emulates the ARM926EJ-S CPU, while Python modules model the SC6531E interrupt controller, flash, display, keypad, power management and other peripherals based on firmware behaviour. The user supplies the phone’s own flash and boot ROM images.
description_zh: nokia105-emu 将 Nokia 105 TA-1423 的固件镜像从启动 ROM 运行到可操作的菜单界面。Unicorn 仿真 ARM926EJ-S CPU，Python 模块依据固件行为模拟 SC6531E 的中断控制器、闪存、屏幕、键盘和电源管理等外设；闪存与启动 ROM 镜像由用户自行提供。
requirements: A Nokia 105 TA-1423 flash.bin and bootrom.bin dumped from the user's own phone are required.
Python 3 with Tk, a C compiler and the listed Python dependencies are required; ffplay is needed for sound playback.
Only firmware MOCOR_20C_6531E_W23.19.4 was tested; SIM, network, radio, camera and USB functions remain absent.
MIT license.

name: inFAMOUS: First Light — a native Windows port through a PS4 compatibility runtime
description_en: inFAMOUS: First Light — PC Edition runs the user's PS4 game files on Windows through a compatibility runtime while executing the game's x86-64 code on the PC CPU. It adds First Light-specific imports, system services, and hash-checked engine hooks to a runtime shared with Second Son, with a Vulkan 1.3 backend and GCN-to-SPIR-V shader translation. The author reports that the early build reaches open-world gameplay.
description_zh: inFAMOUS: First Light — PC Edition 通过兼容运行时在 Windows 上运行用户自备的 PS4 游戏文件，游戏的 x86-64 代码直接由 PC CPU 执行。项目在与 Second Son 共用的运行时中加入专属导入表、系统服务和按原函数哈希校验的钩子，并使用 Vulkan 1.3 后端及 GCN 到 SPIR-V 的着色器转换。作者称早期版本已进入开放世界玩法。
requirements: A legally obtained, decrypted CUSA00897 game folder with eboot.bin, sce_module, sce_sys, and art.
Windows 10 or 11 x64, a CPU with AVX, F16C, BMI1, LZCNT, and MOVBE, and a Vulkan 1.3 GPU.
Early status; the author reports gameplay on one development PC, while AMD and Intel GPUs and physics above 60 FPS remain unchecked.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Hisense VIDAA (MT9603): firmware and local bridge findings
description_en: Hisense VIDAA (MT9603) records an investigation of a TV firmware container and browser-facing local services. The notes map the phoenix:// message format, its WebSocket and HTTP transports, a 96-function bridge and permission checks, with sanitized probe outputs. The author reports that the encrypted firmware payload remained inaccessible.
description_zh: Hisense VIDAA（MT9603）记录了对电视固件容器及浏览器侧本地服务的调查。笔记梳理了 phoenix:// 消息格式、WebSocket 与 HTTP 传输、96 个桥接函数及权限检查，并附有脱敏探测结果。作者报告称加密的固件载荷仍无法读取。
requirements: Findings concern a Hisense VIDAA TV with MTK9603 and software version V0000.09.60V.Q0612.
The firmware payload is encrypted; the studied ordinary browser page could not obtain usable filesystem access or a write path.
Code and probe pages are MIT licensed; documentation is CC BY 4.0.

name: LittleBigPlanet PSP: a matching decompilation of EBOOT.BIN
description_en: LittleBigPlanet PSP reconstructs code from the game's UCUS98744 disc version 2.00 executable as C and C++. Its checker compiles each source with a recorded compiler profile and compares the resulting function bytes with the original. The author reports 5,020 individually matched functions; a whole-module build of the published proofs has not been measured.
description_zh: LittleBigPlanet PSP 将 UCUS98744 光盘 2.00 版可执行文件重建为 C 和 C++。项目按记录的编译器配置编译每个函数，再与原版机器码逐字节比较。作者报告已有 5,020 个函数单独匹配，但公开源码的整模块构建尚无测量结果。
requirements: A personal copy of the game and a locally decrypted PSP_GAME/SYSDIR/EBOOT.BIN are required.
The documented checking workflow uses WSL and the specified PSP compiler toolchains.
The author reports 17.9% of public-scope code bytes matched individually; whole-module progress is unmeasured.
Project code is GPL-3.0-or-later; bundled third-party code retains its stated terms.

name: GT5 Native Recomp: an early Gran Turismo 5 static recompilation
description_en: GT5 Native Recomp is an early static recompilation of Gran Turismo 5 for Windows x86-64. Its pipeline lifts PS3 PPU and SPU code ahead of time into a native runtime that supplies PS3 services and uses Vulkan for RSX commands; the author reports reaching audio and controller initialization without a game frame.
description_zh: GT5 Native Recomp 是面向 Windows x86-64 的 Gran Turismo 5 早期静态重编译项目。流水线预先转换 PS3 的 PPU 和 SPU 代码，由本地运行时提供 PS3 服务并以 Vulkan 处理 RSX 命令；作者报告已到达音频和控制器初始化阶段，但尚未观察到游戏画面。
requirements: Users must supply their own Gran Turismo 5 PS3 BCUS98114 v2.17 game files and installed update inputs.
The public clone's regeneration workflow has not been validated end to end; no game frame or playable race is reported.
MIT license for original integration code and documentation.

name: RTAGlass: a Windows reimplementation of Road Trip
description_en: RTAGlass reimplements the PS2 game Road Trip as a C++ Windows port. Its build analyzes the user's own USA disc image, generates tables and VU1 microcode conversions from the executable, converts models, textures and sound, and assembles a playable Windows build.
description_zh: RTAGlass 将 PS2 游戏 Road Trip 重实现为 C++ Windows 移植版。构建流程分析用户自备的美版光盘镜像，从可执行文件生成表格和 VU1 微代码转换结果，并转换模型、纹理及音频，最终组装可运行版本。
requirements: A Road Trip USA disc image, release SLUS-20398, is required.
Building requires Windows 10 or 11, Visual Studio 2022 with v141 and XP support tools, DirectX SDK June 2010, and Python 3.11+.
The resulting game targets Windows XP SP2 or later with a DirectX 9.0-compatible GPU.
MIT License.

name: h4r: rebuilding the Heroes of Might and Magic IV engine
description_en: h4r reimplements the Heroes of Might and Magic IV engine in Rust using data from a player's installation. It parses .h4r archives and .h4c maps, renders an adventure-map prototype and reconstructs selected movement and combat rules, with a separate harness comparing some rule outputs to the original executable.
description_zh: h4r 使用玩家本地安装的数据，以 Rust 重建 Heroes of Might and Magic IV 引擎。它解析 .h4r 归档和 .h4c 地图，呈现冒险地图原型并重建部分移动与战斗规则；另有工具将若干规则结果与原始可执行程序对照。
requirements: A user's own Heroes of Might and Magic IV installation is required; game assets are not included.
Rust and Cargo are required; development uses Rust 1.99.1.
The prototype cannot complete a game; combat has no playable battlefield, and AI, saves and sound are absent.
GPL-3.0-or-later License.

name: IOSVM: booting iOS 16.5 user space in QEMU on Linux
description_en: IOSVM ports Darwin/XNU components so user-supplied iOS 16.5 user space can boot in QEMU on Linux. Its QMP input channel and web/VNC bridge expose taps, swipes, keyboard input, and rendered frames; the author reports that home-screen boots remain intermittent and rendering uses a CPU rasterizer.
description_zh: IOSVM 移植 Darwin/XNU 组件，让用户自行提供的 iOS 16.5 用户空间在 Linux 的 QEMU 中启动。QMP 输入通道及网页/VNC 桥接支持点击、滑动、键盘输入和画面查看；作者报告主屏启动仍不稳定，渲染依赖 CPU 光栅化。
requirements: Linux x86-64, QEMU, and a user-supplied iOS 16.5 IPSW.
The author reports home-screen boot in about 40% of attempts, with roughly 4–7 fps animation; DNS and GPU acceleration are unavailable.
Project code is MIT; XNU portions retain APSL and GPL-2.0 portions retain GPL-2.0.

name: infrared: LG and Vityas remote command mappings
description_en: infrared documents command mappings for LG 6710CMA family and Vityas RC-5 remotes through LIRC and irplus configuration files. The LG notes describe the 0x0808 pre-data, a possible 38.3 kHz carrier and a 256-code command space; a full irplus configuration lets readers try that space against compatible devices.
description_zh: infrared 以 LIRC 和 irplus 配置记录 LG 6710CMA 系列及 Vityas RC-5 遥控器的命令映射。LG 笔记说明 0x0808 前导数据、估计约 38.3 kHz 的载波，以及 256 个可能的命令码；完整 irplus 配置可用于逐一尝试。
requirements: LIRC or WinLIRC is used on PCs and ARM boards; irplus is used on Android devices.
The LG carrier frequency is presented as an estimate, and some buttons work only on some devices.
MIT license.

name: WebTV PTL: documenting the set-top box listings format
description_en: WebTV PTL documents the binary television-listings database used by WebTV Plus and DishPlayer set-top boxes. The write-up describes its location on device storage, big-endian integer encoding, versioned header, block layout and footer.
description_zh: WebTV PTL 记录了 WebTV Plus 和 DishPlayer 机顶盒使用的二进制电视节目表数据库格式。文档说明文件在设备存储中的位置、大端整数编码、不同版本的文件头、数据块布局与文件尾。
requirements: The documented format concerns PTL listings databases used by WebTV Plus and DishPlayer boxes.
No licence file in the repository.

name: SL-GlassesLed26x7: LED matrix pin mapping and replacement driver
description_en: SL-GlassesLed26x7 documents the connections of a 26×7 charlieplexed LED-glasses matrix and drives it with an ESP32 in place of the original controller. The repository records its pin layout and LED sections, with Arduino display examples and a bitmap generator.
