description_zh: SL-GlassesLed26x7 记录了 26×7 查理复用 LED 眼镜矩阵的连接方式，并用 ESP32 替代原控制芯片驱动显示。仓库提供引脚和 LED 分区图、Arduino 显示示例及位图生成器。
requirements: The examples use the LED-glasses matrix and an ESP32; the source specifies driving the LEDs at about 3.3 V.
Development is halted; the author reports a design brightness limit of at most 1/13 PWM.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Winbond Keyboard Colour: reconstructing keyboard lighting commands
description_en: Winbond Keyboard Colour implements lighting control for Winbond-based keyboards on Linux using USB command bytes mapped from the original Windows software. Its graphical interface lets users select and apply lighting effects.
description_zh: Winbond Keyboard Colour 根据原厂 Windows 软件的 USB 通信记录重建灯光控制命令，在 Linux 上通过图形界面设置 Winbond 系键盘的灯效。
requirements: Linux and a compatible Winbond-based keyboard.
Rust toolchain to build from source with Cargo.
MIT License.

name: BOSS GX-10: reconstructing the TSL preset format
description_en: A specification reconstructs the .tsl.json preset format used by BOSS Tone Studio for the GX-10 processor. It maps the JSON structure, hex-encoded parameter arrays, patch names, effect routing and control assignments, with Python examples and research notes.
description_zh: 这份规范重建 BOSS Tone Studio 为 GX-10 处理器使用的 .tsl.json 预设格式，记录 JSON 结构、十六进制参数数组、预设名称、效果链路和控制分配，并附有 Python 示例与研究笔记。
requirements: A GX-10 TSL export from BOSS Tone Studio is the documented input.
The three-byte fxItem encoding remains a working hypothesis, and hardware validation is requested.
MIT license.

name: OBOX Controller ViGEm Driver: a Windows client for the Snail OBox gamepad
description_en: OBOX Controller ViGEm Driver implements a Windows client for the Snail OBox Bluetooth gamepad using a documented HID protocol. Its Rust driver maps buttons, sticks and triggers to a ViGEmBus Xbox 360 controller and sends rumble and LED commands through HID output reports; the repository also includes a Python prototype.
description_zh: OBOX Controller ViGEm Driver 根据仓库记录的蓝牙 HID 协议，为蜗牛 OBox 手柄实现 Windows 客户端。Rust 驱动经 ViGEmBus 映射按键、摇杆和扳机，并用 HID 输出报告控制振动与指示灯；仓库还提供 Python 原型。
requirements: Snail OBox Bluetooth gamepad and Windows.
ViGEmBus driver; HidHide is optional.
Only one controller is supported at a time.
MIT license.

name: OsmoFresh Quella Pro: hardware and UART protocol investigation
description_en: An OsmoFresh Quella Pro investigation records reconstructed PCB schematics, identified components and a UART communication model for the water dispenser. The protocol notes distinguish main-to-display responses from display-to-main AA frames and give a SUM16 calculation, while leaving several payload meanings unresolved.
description_zh: 该项目调查 OsmoFresh Quella Pro 饮水机，发布重绘的 PCB 电路图、元件清单和 UART 通信模型。协议笔记区分主板到显示板的响应与反向 AA 帧，并给出 SUM16 算法；部分载荷含义仍未确定。
requirements: The published schematics may contain errors or incomplete sections.
UART payload state discrimination and several field meanings remain unknown.
MIT license.

name: FIFINE SC3: firmware decryption and four-fader patch
description_en: FIFINE SC3 research documents decryption of the mixer's MVsilicon firmware and its ACP control protocol over USB HID. The repository provides cipher and container tooling, protocol findings, and a firmware patch that exposes all four fader positions to host-side volume tools.
description_zh: FIFINE SC3 项目研究混音器所用 MVsilicon 固件的解密方法，以及通过 USB HID 传输的 ACP 控制协议。仓库提供加解密算法和固件容器处理工具、协议分析，以及向主机公开全部四个推子位置的固件补丁。
requirements: Supply your own FIFINE SC3 firmware image; the repository does not include firmware images.
The patch targets the SC3; stock firmware exposes only one fader to the host.
MIT License.

name: Valeton GP180: USB MIDI SysEx protocol investigation
description_en: Valeton GP180 Reverse Engineering investigates the guitar processor's USB MIDI SysEx traffic, firmware and companion Suite software. Its capture analysis reassembles fragmented SysEx messages and records framing, transaction fields and observed message families for presets, effects, settings and file transfers.
description_zh: Valeton GP180 Reverse Engineering 研究这款吉他效果器的 USB MIDI SysEx 通信、固件及配套 Suite 软件。抓包分析重组分片的 SysEx 消息，记录帧格式、事务字段，以及预设、效果、设置和文件传输相关的已观察到的消息类别。
requirements: The investigation covers Valeton GP-180 firmware and Suite software, with USBPcap captures of device traffic.
The integrity-byte algorithm and some message-family meanings remain unresolved.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: Doraemon: a byte-identical Famicom source reconstruction
description_en: Doraemon reconstructs the Japanese release of Hudson Soft's 1986 Famicom game as ca65 assembly source. The build extracts private assets from the user's ROM, assembles and links the source, then compares the resulting ROM byte for byte with the original. Documentation covers cartridge architecture, memory, subsystems, and data formats.
description_zh: Doraemon 将 Hudson Soft 于 1986 年发行的日版红白机游戏重建为 ca65 汇编源码。构建过程从用户自有 ROM 提取素材，汇编链接后逐字节比对生成的 ROM；文档记录卡带架构、内存、子系统和数据格式。
requirements: The Japanese Doraemon PRG0 ROM must be supplied by the user.
Python 3, GNU Make, and Retrolarium Kit are required to build and compare the ROM.
Relocating modules is unsupported because some pointer tables still contain raw addresses.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Colorful 2F4C:1018: reconstructing a motherboard ARGB HID interface
description_en: Colorful 2F4C:1018 reconstructs the HID commands used to drive a COLORFIRE motherboard's ARGB headers from vendor-app analysis and live probing. It identifies interface 2 as the lighting channel and documents 20-LED data reports followed by commit reports. Included OpenRGB controller code sends direct frames and host-rendered effects.
description_zh: Colorful 2F4C:1018 项目通过厂商软件分析和实机探测，还原 COLORFIRE 主板 ARGB 接口的 HID 控制命令。项目确定接口 2 承载灯效数据，记录每包 20 颗 LED 的数据报文及后续提交报文，并提供可发送直控帧和主机渲染动效的 OpenRGB 控制器代码。
requirements: The documented test hardware is a COLORFIRE B850M-MEOW WIFI7 V14 with HID ID 2F4C:1018.
The supplied driver sources must be built into an OpenRGB checkout; reported testing used CachyOS, kernel 7.x and OpenRGB 0.9+ git.
Firmware animation modes remain unimplemented because their parameters are only partly understood.
GPL-2.0 license.

name: Deli XiangYinBao X1: reconstructing a Bluetooth label printer protocol
description_en: Deli XiangYinBao X1 reconstructs the portable label printer's proprietary Bluetooth printing protocol from HCI captures and Frida observations. It documents CRC32 framing, 384-dot bitmap encoding, replies, and print sequencing, with Python and JavaScript implementations, capture parsers, and regression tests.
description_zh: Deli XiangYinBao X1 项目依据 HCI 抓包及 Frida 观察重建便携标签打印机的私有蓝牙协议，记录 CRC32 帧格式、384 点位图编码、应答与打印顺序，并提供 Python、JavaScript 实现、抓包解析器和回归测试。
requirements: A Deli XiangYinBao X1 printer is required for physical printing; protocol tests can use the included captures without hardware.
The PC client uses bleak, pyserial, Pillow, and segno.
MIT license.

name: HHKB Professional Classic: vendor HID and firmware investigation
description_en: HHKB-reverse-engineering investigates the vendor USB HID protocol of the HHKB Professional Classic keyboard. It documents 64-byte request and response frames, command behavior, keymap layouts and firmware-dump behavior, with macOS IOKit tools for probing and changing keymaps.
description_zh: HHKB-reverse-engineering 研究 HHKB Professional Classic 键盘的厂商 USB HID 协议，记录 64 字节请求与响应帧、命令行为、键位映射布局及固件转储行为，并提供基于 macOS IOKit 的探测和修改工具。
requirements: The author reports measuring the findings on a PD-KB401B with firmware A4.29 under macOS 27.0.
Building the tools requires the Xcode command line tools.
Firmware flashing is not implemented; the author reports that dumping firmware leaves the keyboard read-only until it is unplugged and replugged.
MIT License.

name: KardiaMobile 6L Unlocked: a direct BLE ECG client
description_en: KardiaMobile 6L Unlocked reconstructs the BLE exchange used to obtain ECG samples from the AliveCor KardiaMobile 6L. Android HCI captures inform the bonding sequence, derived unlock token, and two-channel sample framing; a Python client records the stream on Linux and writes CSV, PNG, and PDF outputs.
description_zh: KardiaMobile 6L Unlocked 根据 Android HCI 抓包重建 AliveCor KardiaMobile 6L 的 BLE 心电数据通信过程，记录配对顺序、解锁令牌算法和双通道采样格式。Python 客户端可在 Linux 上采集数据并输出 CSV、PNG 和 PDF。
requirements: A KardiaMobile 6L, Linux Bluetooth adapter, BlueZ, Python 3, and bleak are required.
The sixth lead is not decoded; the raw stream contains two channels.
MIT license.

name: fiilpod: FIIL earbud protocols integrated into HyperOS
description_en: fiilpod reconstructs FIIL earbud control protocols and integrates their battery, noise-control, EQ, and spatial-audio state into Xiaomi HyperOS. Its LSPosed module injects into Bluetooth and settings processes, communicates over SPP or BLE GATT, and documents GAIA, Mate, Airoha, and other command families.
description_zh: fiilpod 还原 FIIL 耳机控制协议，并将电量、降噪、EQ 和空间音频状态接入小米 HyperOS。LSPosed 模块注入蓝牙与设置进程，通过 SPP 或 BLE GATT 通信；仓库文档记录 GAIA、Mate、Airoha 等命令族。
requirements: A Xiaomi or Redmi arm64 device with HyperOS 2, 3, or 4 on Android 15 or newer, LSPosed with libxposed API 102, and Bluetooth permissions.
The module requires the documented LSPosed process scopes and does not support Android 14 or older.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Scooby-Doo! Night of 100 Frights: matching GameCube decompilation
description_en: The Scooby-Doo! Night of 100 Frights project reconstructs GameCube source for two USA disc revisions and builds main.dol executables checked against original SHA-1 hashes. It uses decomp-toolkit, target-specific split and symbol maps, compiler profiles and reconstructed C/C++ source. Users provide their own game disc; original disc files remain outside the repository.
description_zh: Scooby-Doo! Night of 100 Frights 项目为 GameCube 游戏的两个美国版修订重建源码，并用原始 SHA-1 校验构建出的 main.dol。工程使用 decomp-toolkit、各版本的拆分与符号映射、编译器配置及重建的 C/C++ 源码。用户需自行提供游戏光盘，原始文件不进入仓库。
requirements: Requires the user's own game disc and the corresponding original main.dol for each target revision.
Build instructions specify patched decomp-toolkit 1.8.3, Python 3 and Ninja.
GIHE78-rev1 began with a byte-identical relink but no reconstructed source units linked; source coverage differs by revision.
Imported sources have credits and separate licenses under licenses/.

name: Super Mario Galaxy 2: selected gravity behavior and format reconstruction
description_en: Super Mario Galaxy 2: selected gravity behavior and format reconstruction implements host-side C++ versions of selected CubeGravity, PlanetGravity and PointGravity operations. It provides bounds-checked readers for Yaz0, RARC, U8, BCSV/JMap, Wii FST and selected J3D metadata, with synthetic-input tests.
description_zh: 该项目用 C++ 实现《超级马力欧银河 2》中部分 CubeGravity、PlanetGravity 和 PointGravity 操作，并提供 Yaz0、RARC、U8、BCSV/JMap、Wii FST 及部分 J3D 元数据的边界检查读取器和合成输入测试。
requirements: CMake 3.20 or later and a C++20-capable compiler are required.
The optional game-data test and asset scanner require a user-supplied extracted DATA directory.
The shared source lacks the complete runtime; J3D support is partial, and the separate macOS preview has a fresh-launch error.
No licence file in the repository for the original native modules, tests and scripts; runtime patches carry their upstream notices.

name: Secret of Evermore: reconstructing ROM formats and game assets
description_en: Secret of Evermore: reverse engineering documents the Europe/PAL game's ROM layout, compression, maps, sprites, text, scripts and audio. Python extractors use a user-supplied ROM; Mesen2 scripts capture game-rendered results, and Ghidra labels support routine analysis. A pygame viewer displays extracted maps and sprites.
description_zh: Secret of Evermore: reverse engineering 记录欧版游戏的 ROM 布局、压缩、地图、精灵、文字、脚本与音频。Python 提取器读取用户自备 ROM，Mesen2 脚本采集游戏渲染结果，Ghidra 标签辅助例程分析；pygame 查看器展示提取出的地图和精灵。
requirements: A user-supplied, headerless Europe Secret of Evermore ROM is the tested input.
Python 3.11+ and Pillow are required; Mesen2, Ghidra and pygame support optional workflows.
Audio coverage is partial, and some event-script opcode meanings remain open.
MIT License.

name: Elan 04f3:0903: reconstructing a fingerprint sensor's Linux interface
description_en: Elan 04f3:0903 reconstructs a laptop fingerprint sensor's USB interface after analysis of its Windows driver DLLs and provides a Linux capture and authentication pipeline. The source identifies command, touch and raw-frame endpoints, then describes OpenCV preprocessing, ORB features and RANSAC matching for a PAM integration.
description_zh: Elan 04f3:0903 项目报告通过分析 Windows 驱动 DLL 复原笔记本指纹传感器的 USB 接口，并实现 Linux 采集与认证流程。文档列出命令、触摸检测和原始图像端点，后续以 OpenCV 预处理、ORB 特征及 RANSAC 匹配接入 PAM。
requirements: An ElanTech 04f3:0903 sensor on Linux, with the Python, OpenCV and PAM dependencies installed by the project.
The author reports a greater than 99.5% match verification rate and under 300 ms authentication latency; the README provides no evaluation sample size.
MIT license.

name: FIIL 耳机控制: a Windows client for FIIL headphone BLE commands
description_en: FIIL 耳机控制 implements a Windows client from reverse-engineered BLE GATT commands used by FIIL headphones. Protocol notes describe the fdb3 service, ff17 write and ff18 notification characteristics, message framing, unlock sequence and command responses. The desktop app controls supported modes and records raw traffic alongside parsed results.
description_zh: FIIL 耳机控制依据逆向得到的 BLE GATT 命令实现 Windows 客户端。协议文档记录了 fdb3 服务、ff17 写入与 ff18 通知特征、帧格式、解锁顺序和命令响应。桌面应用可控制已支持的耳机模式，并同时记录原始收发数据与解析结果。
requirements: Live use requires Windows 10/11 and a supported FIIL headset; running from source requires Python 3.10 or newer.
The author reports physical tests with FIIL Key Max firmware 3.0.1.1 and FIIL Atom.
EQ writing is not confirmed to take effect; Linux and macOS are untested.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Tekken 3 Recomp: lifting PlayStation game code into Rust
description_en: Tekken 3 Recomp statically recompiles the US PlayStation release of Tekken 3 by extracting its MIPS executable and overlays from a user-supplied disc. Ghidra exports instructions and p-code to CSV sheets, a generator translates them into Rust, and a custom PlayStation runtime hosts the result inside a Bevy app.
description_zh: Tekken 3 Recomp 对《铁拳 3》美版 PlayStation 光盘中的 MIPS 主程序和覆盖段进行静态重编译。工具用 Ghidra 将指令及 p-code 导出为 CSV，再生成 Rust，由自制 PlayStation 运行时在 Bevy 应用中执行。
requirements: A user-supplied Tekken 3 USA SLUS-00402 disc image with all three tracks.
Python 3, Rust, Ghidra 12.1 and ghidra-cli are required for regeneration.
Function statuses range from raw to verified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Tekken 5 Recomp: statically recompiling the PS2 game to Rust
description_en: Tekken 5 Recomp statically translates the PlayStation 2 game's Emotion Engine programs, IOP modules, and VU microcode into native Rust. Its pipeline extracts a user's disc image, analyzes programs with Ghidra, generates instruction sheets and Rust code, and runs the result in a Bevy app with a project-specific PS2 runtime.
description_zh: Tekken 5 Recomp 将 PS2 版 Tekken 5 的 Emotion Engine 程序、IOP 模块及 VU 微码静态翻译为原生 Rust。流水线从用户的光盘镜像提取数据，经 Ghidra 分析生成指令表和 Rust 代码，再由 Bevy 应用与专用 PS2 运行时执行。
requirements: A legally obtained Tekken 5 USA disc image, SLUS-21059.
Python 3, Rust, Ghidra 12.1.4 with ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded 2.1.38, and ghidra-cli.
Arcade History mode remains unfinished.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Limbo: restoring Fortnite Save the World OT6.5 missions
description_en: Limbo restores mission play in the 2016 Fortnite Save the World OT6.5 client using an injected game-server DLL and a separate backend. Its development notes describe UE 4.12 name and object table discovery, ProcessEvent tracing, executable analysis and hooks used to rebuild mission behavior. The author reports up to four-player cooperative play, while some missions and enemy behaviors remain incomplete.
description_zh: Limbo 通过注入游戏服务器 DLL 并配合独立后端，恢复 2016 年 Fortnite Save the World OT6.5 客户端的任务玩法。开发记录说明了 UE 4.12 名称表和对象表定位、ProcessEvent 跟踪、可执行文件分析及用于重建任务行为的挂钩。作者报告支持最多四人合作，但部分任务与敌人行为尚未完成。
requirements: The user's own Fortnite OT6.5 build 2252016-3240987; hosting also requires the separate Limbo-Backend.
Windows and Visual Studio with the C++ desktop workload are required to build the DLL and injector.
Some missions are untested through completion, Flingers remain inactive and outpost construction is not saved.
MIT License for Limbo's own code.

name: Rogue Byte: matching decompilation of Sly 2: Band of Thieves
description_en: Rogue Byte reconstructs the USA PlayStation 2 release of Sly 2: Band of Thieves as readable C/C++ through a matching decompilation workflow. It splits a user-supplied executable, compiles recovered functions with the original compiler and checks the linked image byte for byte; the same C is also checked against the optional PAL executable.
description_zh: Rogue Byte 以匹配反编译流程，将 PlayStation 2 美版 Sly 2: Band of Thieves 的程序代码恢复为可读的 C/C++。它拆分用户提供的可执行文件，用原版编译器编译恢复的函数，并逐字节比较链接后的映像；也可选用欧版可执行文件检查同一份 C 代码。
requirements: A legitimately obtained USA/NTSC-U Sly 2 copy, executable SCUS_97316.
The PAL executable SCES_52529 is optional for cross-version checks.
The work is unfinished; the author reports 76.37% matched USA code, including original assembly retained for blockers.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: rustify-doom: reconstructing Doom in Rust from a stripped binary
description_en: rustify-doom reconstructs the Doom engine in Rust from a stripped doomgeneric binary using Rustify. Its source covers game systems, rendering and SDL integration, and its compatibility report compares replay scenarios and recovered requirements against the original build with Freedoom data.
description_zh: rustify-doom 使用 Rustify 从去符号的 doomgeneric 二进制重建 Rust 版 Doom 引擎。源码涵盖游戏系统、渲染与 SDL 集成；兼容性报告以 Freedoom 数据对照原始构建，记录回放场景及恢复需求的结果。
requirements: macOS on Apple silicon, Rust and Homebrew sdl2-compat are required to build.
Freedoom: Phase 1 version 0.13.0 supplies game data and is not included.
The author reports incomplete parity, including savegame differences and open requirements.
GPL-2.0-or-later.

name: openSA: reimplementing the GTA San Andreas runtime
description_en: openSA is an early C++ reimplementation of the GTA San Andreas runtime built on librw. It parses original IMG, IDE, IPL, model and texture data, and supplies viewers for streaming world geometry. The author documents comparisons with the owned 1.0 US executable while noting that the result is not yet a playable game.
description_zh: openSA 是基于 librw 的早期 C++ GTA San Andreas 运行时重建项目。它解析原版 IMG、IDE、IPL、模型和纹理数据，并提供流式加载世界几何的查看器。作者记录了与自有美版 1.0 可执行文件的对照研究，同时说明目前尚不能作为完整游戏游玩。
requirements: A user-owned copy of GTA San Andreas is required; viewers read its data/ and models/ folders.
The project is at an early stage and is not a playable game.
MIT license.

name: Pokémon Dash: a byte-matched Nintendo DS decompilation
description_en: pokemon-dash-decomp reconstructs source for the USA Nintendo DS release of Pokémon Dash and checks functions against exact compiled bytes while rebuilding the ROM byte for byte. It uses Metrowerks mwccarm and contains generated source, configuration and progress data; the author reports partial code matching.
description_zh: pokemon-dash-decomp 重建美版 Nintendo DS 游戏 Pokémon Dash 的源码，以编译后的精确字节核对函数，并以整包逐字节一致为目标重建 ROM。项目使用 Metrowerks mwccarm，包含生成的源码、配置和进度数据；作者报告代码匹配仍未完成。
requirements: A user-supplied decrypted USA Pokémon Dash base ROM.
Metrowerks mwccarm; the exact compiler version is still being identified.
The author reports 19.60% of code matched and 1,817 of 3,280 functions counted as matching.
The decompilation is CC0-1.0; the native runtime directory has its own MIT license.

name: LMA Manager 2007: an Xbox 360 static recompilation in Rust
description_en: LMA Manager 2007 statically translates the Xbox 360 game's PowerPC code into Rust from a user's disc image. A native runtime replaces console kernel, graphics and audio services, and the repository includes XEX loading, decoding, translation and application crates. The author reports that the game plays with career mode, 3D matches, saves and sound.
description_zh: LMA Manager 2007 从用户自备的 Xbox 360 光盘镜像将游戏 PowerPC 代码静态翻译为 Rust，并以原生运行时代替主机内核、图形和音频服务。仓库包含 XEX 加载、解码、翻译和应用程序模块。作者报告生涯模式、3D 比赛、存档及声音均可运行。
requirements: A legally obtained LMA Manager 2007 Xbox 360 disc image or extracted copy is required.
Rust and Python 3 are required to build from source; the Mac app requires Apple Silicon and macOS 12 or later.
Windows and Linux currently require source builds.
The project's own code is dual-licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0, at the user's option.

name: Wireless AA Bridge: reconstructing a wireless Android Auto relay
description_en: Wireless AA Bridge reconstructs a wireless Android Auto relay on a spare Android phone. It presents a USB AOA connection to a wired car head unit, performs Bluetooth and Wi-Fi projection setup with the client phone, and forwards AAP traffic while preserving its in-band TLS exchange.
description_zh: Wireless AA Bridge 在备用安卓手机上重建无线 Android Auto 中继。它通过 USB AOA 连接有线车机，通过蓝牙与 Wi-Fi 完成客户端手机的投屏准备，并转发含 TLS 握手的 AAP 数据流。
requirements: An Android bridge phone capable of USB accessory operation, a wired Android Auto head unit, and an Android Auto client phone are required.
The author reports end-to-end operation on one car, client, and bridge combination.
MIT license.

name: upright: reconstructing Lightroom Classic's perspective correction
description_en: upright reconstructs Lightroom Classic's Upright perspective correction from catalog transforms, controlled application runs, and selected CameraRaw binary observations. It publishes a two-camera homography model, measured Auto-mode behavior, evidence files, and an MIT-licensed Python port; the author reports that the port performs poorly on real photographs.
description_zh: upright 根据 Lightroom Classic 目录中的变换、受控应用运行结果及 CameraRaw 二进制的部分观察，重建 Upright 透视校正。仓库提供双相机单应变换模型、Auto 模式的测量结果、证据文件和 MIT 许可的 Python 移植版；作者报告移植版在真实照片上表现较差。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer, NumPy, and OpenCV are needed for the port.
The author reports that the port often returns identity on real photos and has a 40.7% loss rate against plain identity in the stated comparison.
MIT License.

name: nano3-os: reconstructing the Avalon Nano 3 mining protocol
description_en: nano3-os reconstructs the Canaan Avalon Nano 3's K230-to-K210 mining protocol from analysis of btcminer and UART captures. Its notes cover CN frames, CRC-16/XMODEM, job bursts and nonce reports; a Go daemon uses that protocol to run the miner with a Stratum V1 pool, board controls and a web dashboard.
description_zh: nano3-os 通过分析 btcminer 与 UART 抓包还原 Canaan Avalon Nano 3 的 K230 至 K210 挖矿协议。笔记记录 CN 帧、CRC-16/XMODEM、任务数据和 nonce 报告；Go 守护程序据此连接 Stratum V1 矿池，并控制板载功能与网页面板。
requirements: Requires a Canaan Avalon Nano 3; installation uses root SSH access to the miner.
Building the daemon requires Go 1.26 for Linux riscv64.
The author reports that the front button has not yet been pressed in hardware testing and a 24-hour unattended run was still in progress.
MIT License.

name: studio3svg: reconstructing the Silhouette Studio document format
description_en: studio3svg reconstructs readable parts of Silhouette Studio .studio3 documents and converts their cut outlines to millimetre-based SVG. Its format specification records section structure, shapes, page size and stored previews, while a CLI, library and browser converter implement the reader.
description_zh: studio3svg 解析 Silhouette Studio 的 .studio3 文档，并把切割轮廓转换为以毫米为单位的 SVG。格式规范记录分段结构、图形、页面尺寸和内嵌预览；CLI、程序库及浏览器工具实现了读取与转换。
requirements: Node.js 22 or newer is required for the CLI and library.
Colours, line styles, layer visibility, raster images and files in formats older than Studio 5's `silhouette05;` format are outside current coverage.
The author reports that 224 of 225 comparable previews passed the differential check.
MIT licence.

name: technics-az100: a Windows client for EAH-AZ100 earbud controls
description_en: technics-az100 reimplements control of Technics EAH-AZ100 earbuds on Windows through the Airoha RACE Bluetooth RFCOMM channel. A tray app and CLI set noise cancellation and ambient modes and read battery and codec status; a protocol log records frames and command IDs recovered from Android app analysis and Bluetooth captures.
description_zh: technics-az100 通过 Airoha RACE 蓝牙 RFCOMM 通道，在 Windows 上重新实现 Technics EAH-AZ100 耳机控制。托盘程序和命令行工具可设置降噪、环境声并读取电量与编解码器状态；协议记录整理了从 Android 应用分析和蓝牙抓包取得的帧格式及命令 ID。
requirements: Windows 11, Python 3.12 or later, and EAH-AZ100 earbuds paired and connected to the PC; the tray app requires WebView2.
The author reports tests on one AZ100E with firmware JNZ1ZE 1.040; other accepted variants and Windows 10 are untested.
MIT license.

name: SberBoom Remote: reconstructing local speaker control and StarOS messages
description_en: SberBoom Remote implements Android and Windows clients for local control of SberBoom speakers over StarOS WebSocket messages. It ports the TLV protocol from a credited Home Assistant integration, then records pairing behaviour, opcodes and responses measured on a SberBoom Mini. An accompanying investigation examines the official Салют APK for device settings and their transport.
description_zh: SberBoom Remote 通过 StarOS WebSocket 消息实现 Android 和 Windows 端的 SberBoom 音箱本地遥控。项目注明其 TLV 协议实现移植自 Home Assistant 集成，并记录 SberBoom Mini 上实测的配对流程、操作码和响应；另有对官方 Салют APK 设备设置及传输路径的分析。
requirements: A SberBoom speaker on the local network; pairing requires pressing its physical + button.
Android build uses Gradle and AGP 9; Windows build uses .NET 9 and WinUI 3.
Local control excludes equalizer, LED-ring brightness, multiroom and offline tracks, which the source places in cloud settings.
MIT license; the protocol port credits the MIT-licensed sboom_ha integration.

name: Rollerbot: a reconstructed Android and Linux runtime
description_en: Rollerbot-Android reconstructs the 2000 game Rollerbot: A Time Journey for Android and Linux from its original scripts and user-supplied assets. It implements gameplay, scene, audio and platform components, with an Android disc importer and a Linux Flatpak. Supporting notes map Direct3D Retained Mode call sites in the original executable.
description_zh: Rollerbot-Android 根据原版脚本和用户提供的资源，为 2000 年游戏 Rollerbot: A Time Journey 重建 Android 与 Linux 运行环境。项目实现玩法、场景、音频和平台组件，提供 Android 光盘导入及 Linux Flatpak；配套笔记梳理了原版可执行文件中的 Direct3D Retained Mode 调用。
requirements: Users must provide their own Rollerbot disc or installed game files.
Desktop builds need SDL2 and GLES2 development packages; Android builds need JDK 17, Android SDK 34, NDK 26.3 and CMake 3.22.
The author reports about 85% completion; real AYN Thor testing and full level playthroughs remain pending.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Kuru Kuru Kururin: functional GBA decompilation and PC port
description_en: kururin reconstructs the European Game Boy Advance Kuru Kuru Kururin in C for functional rather than byte-identical behavior, and builds an SDL2 PC port for Linux and Windows. The author's reported tests run the original and rebuilt ROMs side by side through recorded input, comparing RAM, sound and video; the port loads game data from the user's own ROM.
description_zh: kururin 以 C 重建欧洲版 GBA《Kuru Kuru Kururin》，目标是功能一致而非逐字节一致，并构建 Linux 与 Windows 的 SDL2 PC 移植。作者报告测试用录制输入并排运行原版和重建 ROM，比较内存、声音及画面；PC 版从用户自己的 ROM 载入游戏数据。
requirements: The user's own European AKRP ROM dump with SHA1 6025ef597db2684ae064ffe22b4fd1d37941f887 is required.
The GBA build uses x86-64 Linux, Python 3.11+ and agbcc; the PC port additionally needs 32-bit SDL2 build dependencies.
The author reports 14 gameplay inputs matching across about 168,000 frames, with incomplete function and instruction coverage.
GPL-3.0 license for the main repository; the port also carries its own MPL-2.0 licence file.

name: gear360-raw: recovering RAW capture and calibration from the Gear 360 SM-R210
description_en: gear360-raw investigates the Samsung Gear 360 SM-R210 camera's capture firmware and calibration data to enable 12-bit Bayer RAW shooting. SD-card mod files trigger sensor dumps, while Python tools convert them to DNG using camera color data and stitch images using the decoded per-unit lens model; command and safety notes document the underlying behavior.
description_zh: gear360-raw 研究 Samsung Gear 360 SM-R210 的拍摄固件和校准数据，以取得 12 位 Bayer RAW 照片。SD 卡修改文件触发传感器转储，Python 工具利用相机色彩数据转成 DNG，并按解析出的逐台镜头模型拼接图像；命令与安全文档记录其内部行为。
requirements: Samsung Gear 360 2017 SM-R210 hardware and the referenced SD-card mod are required.
DNG conversion requires the Python packages; exiftool is optional for copying EXIF data. Stitching needs demosaiced image input.
The 2016 SM-C200 model has not been tested, and long exposure attempts can hang the camera.
GPL-3.0 license for the code; a separate LICENSE-docs file is present.

name: pc-finalfantasy12revenantwings: a static recompilation port of Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings
description_en: pc-finalfantasy12revenantwings ports the European Nintendo DS release of Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings to PC by statically recompiling its ARM9 and ARM7 programs and six overlays to C++. The ndskit runtime replaces DS hardware, while repository tools and notes examine the cartridge, packed data, movies and executable layout. The author reports playing from a new game into the second chapter.
description_zh: pc-finalfantasy12revenantwings 将欧洲版 Nintendo DS 游戏《最终幻想 XII：归来之翼》的 ARM9、ARM7 程序及六个覆盖模块静态重编译为 C++，通过 ndskit 运行时替代 DS 硬件。仓库工具和文档分析卡带、封包、影片及可执行文件布局；作者报告已从新游戏玩到第二章。
requirements: A user-dumped European release cartridge image with decrypted secure area is required; game data is absent from the repository.
ndskit must be checked out as a submodule; building requires Python 3, clang, CMake, Ninja, SDL3 and an OpenGL 4.5 GPU.
The author reports play through the first chapter into the second.
MIT license.

name: atmos-lcd: a replacement client for the MasterLiquid Atmos II LCD
description_en: atmos-lcd is a Windows client for the Cooler Master MasterLiquid Atmos II LCD built around a reverse-engineered USB HID protocol. It controls screen content, brightness, rotation, and stored media; the repository documents handshake and command framing and includes a C# probe and packet-capture parser.
description_zh: atmos-lcd 是面向 Cooler Master MasterLiquid Atmos II LCD 的 Windows 客户端，依据逆向得到的 USB HID 协议控制画面、亮度、旋转和设备内媒体。仓库记录了握手与命令封装，并提供 C# 探测程序和抓包解析脚本。
requirements: Windows 10 2004 or later, 64-bit, and a MasterLiquid Atmos II LCD device.
GPU temperature display requires a WDDM 2.7+ graphics driver; MasterCTRL must be closed before use.
MIT license; the bundled Slint backend and Pretendard fonts retain their separate licenses.

name: Snowboard Kids Plus: a matching PlayStation decompilation
description_en: Snowboard Kids Plus reconstructs C for the Japanese PlayStation release SLPS-01823 and rebuilds its boot executable with remaining assembly. A build script extracts data from the user's disc image and checks that the resulting executable matches the original byte for byte. The SNB.DAT data file is extracted unchanged.
description_zh: Snowboard Kids Plus 为日版 PlayStation 游戏 SLPS-01823 重建 C 代码，并结合尚未还原的汇编重新生成启动可执行文件。构建脚本从用户的光盘镜像提取数据，逐字节核对生成结果；SNB.DAT 仍按原样提取。
requirements: An existing copy of the Japanese Snobow Kids Plus disc image is required.
The documented build is on x86-64 Linux and needs make, git, Python, cpp, MIPS binutils, and the specified PSX GCC binaries.
SNB/SNB.DAT is extracted but not rebuilt.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Dragon Ball GT: Final Bout: a native static recompilation of the PS1 game
description_en: Dragon Ball GT: Final Bout statically translates MIPS code from the user's NTSC-U PlayStation disc into C and compiles it for Windows or Linux. Its own runtime handles GPU, GTE, SPU, MDEC/XA, CD, and memory-card functions. The author reports playing the main game modes on Windows; Linux builds and launches but has not received equivalent gameplay testing.
description_zh: Dragon Ball GT: Final Bout 将用户自有的 NTSC-U 版 PlayStation 光盘中的 MIPS 代码静态转换为 C，编译成 Windows 或 Linux 原生程序。项目自建运行时处理 GPU、GTE、SPU、MDEC/XA、光盘及记忆卡功能。作者报告已在 Windows 游玩主要模式；Linux 可构建和启动，但游戏过程尚未同等测试。
requirements: The user's own NTSC-U SLUS-004.93 disc image is required; the documented workflows accept .cue or .bin input.
For Linux source builds, the documented toolchain is gcc, Python 3, and SDL2 development files.
The author reports gameplay validation on Windows; Linux gameplay, other regions, macOS, and video XA audio have not been validated.
No licence file in the repository.

name: B&K 2318: reconstructing a thermal printer's serial interface
description_en: B&K 2318 documents measured behavior of a vintage thermal printer's ZI 0054 serial interface, including XON/XOFF flow control, text commands, character sets, and graphics. An ESP32-C6 and SP3232 adapter connects a modern computer to the unmodified printer; the repository includes firmware, a Python client, probe scripts, and logs.
description_zh: B&K 2318 项目记录老式热敏打印机 ZI 0054 串口模块的实测行为，包括 XON/XOFF 流控、文本命令、字符集和图形指令。ESP32-C6 与 SP3232 组成外接适配器，无需改动打印机；仓库提供固件、Python 客户端、探测脚本及日志。
requirements: Measurements are from one B&K 2318 printer with a ZI 0054 module and PROM VP1915.
The adapter build uses an ESP32-C6, SP3232 or MAX3232, and the documented B&K-SI wiring.
Only battery power is advised for the printer in the documented setup.
CC0 1.0 license.

name: TCOMAS LG600: reconstructing a cooler LCD's USB HID display protocol
description_en: TCOMAS LG600 reconstructs the USB HID image-transfer protocol of a 480×480 cooler LCD from vendor-app traffic. Its Python package encodes images as JPEG, splits each frame into HID output reports, and streams them to the display. The documented report format and timing constraints are based on one tested LG600 unit.
description_zh: TCOMAS LG600 项目依据厂商软件流量还原一块 480×480 水冷屏的 USB HID 图像传输协议。Python 软件包将图像编码为 JPEG，把每帧拆成 HID 输出报文并持续推送到屏幕；报文结构和时序约束来自一台 LG600 的测试。
requirements: The documented hardware is a TCOMAS LG600 LCD with VID 0x1A2C and PID 0x1520; testing was on Windows 11.
Python, hidapi, and Pillow are required.
Other TCOMAS models and Linux/macOS operation are not confirmed.
MIT license.

name: Curiosity Daily API: endpoints recovered from the Android app
description_en: Curiosity Daily API documents endpoint paths recovered by decompiling version 3.21.6 of the Curiosity Android app. Its tables group GET, POST and DELETE routes for feeds, content, subscriptions, likes and authentication.
description_zh: Curiosity Daily API 记录从 Curiosity Android 应用 3.21.6 版反编译取得的接口路径，并按 GET、POST、DELETE 整理动态、内容、订阅、点赞和身份验证等路由。
requirements: The endpoint list is based on Curiosity Android APK version 3.21.6.
The app was discontinued in 2020; the listed routes describe its former API.
MIT License.

name: ReverseSanta: a reconstruction of Santa Claus in Trouble
description_en: ReverseSanta is a C++ reimplementation of Joymania's Santa Claus in Trouble built from study of the original without disassembly tools. Its source includes game, level, graphics, and editor components using DirectX 9. The author describes the result as inaccurate to the original and has not tested it from start to finish.
description_zh: ReverseSanta 是对 Joymania《Santa Claus in Trouble》的 C++ 重新实现，作者称研究原作时没有使用反汇编工具。源码包含游戏、关卡、图形和编辑器组件，并使用 DirectX 9。作者称实现与原作不一致，且尚未测试能否从头到尾通关。
requirements: DirectX 9 SDK and the dependencies referenced by the CMake build are needed.
The author reports inaccurate behavior and has not tested playability from start to finish.
MIT license.

name: Wanderer: rebuilding sensor control over a reverse-engineered serial link
description_en: Wanderer implements control software and a data plotter for an Elektrobit/Extrabit portable sensor device from around 1991. The author says the unit they examined measures ambient temperature and vibration, and reports reversing its serial protocol and reimplementing parts of the original Windows control software in Python.
description_zh: Wanderer 为约 1991 年的 Elektrobit/Extrabit 便携式传感器设备实现控制程序和数据绘图工具。作者称其研究的设备可测量环境温度和振动，并表示已逆向分析串口协议、用 Python 重实现原 Windows 控制软件的部分功能。
requirements: A Wanderer device and an RS232 connection are required.
The author reports success only on Windows 10 with a motherboard RS232 port; USB–RS232 adapters and Linux did not work in their attempts.

name: MegaVoltsPP: reconstructing the MicroVolts game backend
description_en: MegaVoltsPP rebuilds a backend for MicroVolts Plaza 1.0.0–1.0.3 in C++23 after analysis of the game binary. Its Front, Main and Cast processes handle authentication, lobby state and matches for the retail client, using a documented binary TCP packet format and RC5/RC6 encryption.
description_zh: MegaVoltsPP 在分析 MicroVolts 游戏二进制后，以 C++23 重建 Plaza 1.0.0–1.0.3 的后端。Front、Main 和 Cast 三个进程分别处理认证、大厅状态和对局，并使用文档所述的二进制 TCP 报文格式及 RC5/RC6 加密与原版客户端通信。
requirements: MicroVolts Plaza client versions 1.0.0–1.0.3 are the stated target; other version paths are deprecated.
Building requires CMake 3.30+, cmkr, a C++23 compiler and Git; a database connection is required for deployment.
No licence file in the repository.

name: prism_connect: PRISM Live Studio remote protocol implementation
description_en: prism_connect implements the remote-control protocol of PRISM Live Studio v4.0.0+ as a Dart library. Its protocol notes describe the QR-code connection data, raw TCP session, message layout and commands; the example connects, sends commands and handles server messages.
description_zh: prism_connect 用 Dart 实现 PRISM Live Studio v4.0.0 及以上版本的远程控制协议。附带文档记录二维码连接信息、原始 TCP 会话、消息结构和命令；示例演示连接、发送命令及处理服务端消息。
requirements: PRISM Live Studio v4.0.0+ and the port shown in its QR code are needed.
The Dart library uses dart:io and does not support the web.
MIT licence.

name: Apple Music authorization workflow: documenting MusicKit JS message exchange
description_en: Apple Music authorization workflow documents how MusicKit JS starts and completes browser authorization. It breaks down the authorization URL, Base64-encoded third-party information, popup creation, and postMessage methods for supplying app information and receiving a user token.
description_zh: Apple Music authorization workflow 记录 MusicKit JS 在浏览器中启动并完成授权的过程，拆解授权 URL、Base64 编码的第三方信息、弹窗创建，以及用于提供应用信息和接收用户令牌的 postMessage 方法。
requirements: An Apple Music developer token is needed to use the described workflow.
The author says the documentation was derived from understanding the library and was not tested across varied cases.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Minager: reconstructing Antminer control interfaces
description_en: Minager builds a remote monitoring and control client for Antminer ASIC hardware from reconstructed CGI interfaces. Its Go code maps device responses into typed structures and uses Telegram menus for statistics, pool changes, power modes and alerts; the author also reports firmware and packet analysis.
description_zh: Minager 基于重建的 Antminer CGI 接口实现 ASIC 矿机远程监控与控制。Go 客户端将设备响应映射为类型化结构，并通过 Telegram 菜单提供状态、矿池、功率模式和告警功能；作者还报告分析了固件与网络数据包。
requirements: Go 1.25.0+, PostgreSQL 12+, OpenSSL and a Telegram bot token are required.
The author reports development and testing with public data, firmware dumps, network logs and simulators, without physical mining equipment.
PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0.

name: Clockwise Calipers Data Interface: reconstructing the DTCR-02 cable
description_en: Clockwise Calipers Data Interface reconstructs the DTCR-02 data cable for Clockwise Tools DCLR-XX05 calipers. An Arduino reads the caliper's synchronous 24-bit measurements and presents them as USB keyboard input; the repository includes packet notes, firmware, KiCad designs and case models.
description_zh: Clockwise Calipers Data Interface 重制适用于 Clockwise Tools DCLR-XX05 卡尺的 DTCR-02 数据线。Arduino 读取同步传输的 24 位测量值，并作为 USB 键盘输入发送；仓库还提供数据包说明、固件、KiCad 电路设计和外壳模型。
requirements: Clockwise Tools DCLR-XX05 calipers and an Arduino capable of USB keyboard emulation are needed; native USB support or an alternative such as HoodLoader2 can provide that capability.
The caliper data pins operate at 1.5 V and the README limits total current draw from them to about 0.3 mA.
Android device compatibility is described as untested.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: chave-sandeiro: investigating the Renault Sandero turn-signal switch
description_en: chave-sandeiro documents an investigation of the Renault Sandero turn-signal switch through connector, interior and schematic images. An accompanying Arduino sketch reads turn-signal and headlight inputs from digital pins and prints state changes over serial.
description_zh: chave-sandeiro 通过连接器、内部结构和电路图图片记录对 Renault Sandero 转向灯开关的研究。配套 Arduino 程序从数字引脚读取转向灯和前照灯输入，并通过串口输出状态变化。
requirements: The documented sketch uses Arduino digital inputs and a 9600-baud serial connection.
No licence file in the repository.

name: pocket_polar: WOOSIM PORTI-SM40 printer commands
description_en: pocket_polar investigates command bytes for a WOOSIM PORTI-SM40 Bluetooth receipt printer. Python scripts pack style, alignment and image commands and write them to a Bluetooth serial device; the image path is marked unfinished.
description_zh: pocket_polar 研究 WOOSIM PORTI-SM40 蓝牙小票打印机的命令字节。Python 脚本打包文字样式、对齐和图像命令，并向蓝牙串口写入数据；图像路径标为尚未可用。
requirements: The scripts address a WOOSIM PORTI-SM40 printer through a Bluetooth serial device path.
The README lists Python 3.6 for binary packing; the image script imports wand.
Image printing is marked as not working.
No licence file in the repository.

name: f407 大绿板: display and button pin mapping
description_en: The f407 大绿板 investigation maps the pins connecting an ST7735S display module and five onboard buttons to an STM32F407VET6 development board. It provides display and GPIO probe programs, the author's reported pin assignments and a combined display-and-button demo.
description_zh: f407 大绿板研究记录了接在 STM32F407VET6 开发板上的 ST7735S 屏幕模块及五个板载按键的引脚映射。仓库提供屏幕和 GPIO 探测程序、作者报告的引脚分配，以及屏幕与按键组合演示代码。
requirements: Requires an STM32F407VET6 development board with five onboard buttons and the described ST7735S display module connected to it.
The probe instructions use a firmware build and flash workflow and a 115200-baud serial connection.
MIT license.

name: Hyper Street Fighter Zero Gold: byte-matched PS2 source recovery
description_en: Hyper Street Fighter Zero Gold reconstructs the hidden PS2 game Hyper Street Fighter Zero as C source, with one file per matched function. Its round-trip tools compile the recovered C, assemble remaining code, link a full image and compare it byte for byte with the user's original. The author reports the project is about 91% complete; a native PC hardware-abstraction layer remains unfinished.
description_zh: Hyper Street Fighter Zero Gold 将日版 PS2 合集中的隐藏游戏 Hyper Street Fighter Zero 重建为 C 源码，每个已匹配函数对应一个文件。工具编译已恢复的 C、汇编剩余代码、链接完整映像，并与用户提供的原版逐字节比对。作者称项目约完成 91%；原生 PC 硬件抽象层尚未完成。
requirements: The user must own the original Street Fighter Zero: Fighter's Generation disc and extract its data.
Testing is currently described only for Windows 11.
The author reports the project is about 91% complete; a native PC hardware-abstraction layer remains unfinished.
MIT license.

name: qcywatch-android: a QCY Watch GT2 client built from BLE protocol research
description_en: qcywatch-android replaces the QCY companion app for the QCY Watch GT2 using BLE frames derived from the vendor app and captured watch traffic. It forwards notifications and weather, exports health data to Health Connect and saves workouts as TCX files; frame handling and parsers are implemented in Kotlin.
description_zh: qcywatch-android 根据厂商应用及手表通信抓包还原的 BLE 帧，为 QCY Watch GT2 实现替代客户端。它转发通知和天气，将健康数据写入 Health Connect，并把运动记录保存为 TCX 文件；帧处理和解析器由 Kotlin 实现。
requirements: Android 13 or later and a QCY Watch GT2 are required for the documented setup.
The QCY app must be disabled or uninstalled before use because the watch connects to one app at a time.
Other QCY watches are unconfirmed; firmware updates and several watch features remain outside the implemented scope.
MIT License.

name: Dell Precision A34: mapping SMBIOS tokens to BIOS setup fields
description_en: A Dell Precision Tower 5810 and 7810 BIOS A34 investigation maps SMBIOS DA tokens to Dell setting IDs and AMI Setup bytes. It publishes per-model token tables, setting and token maps, setup-form options, and read-only token and byte-scanning tools. The author reports checking selected mappings against live reads and an NVRAM change.
description_zh: 这项 Dell Precision Tower 5810、7810 的 BIOS A34 研究，将 SMBIOS DA 令牌映射到 Dell 设置 ID 和 AMI Setup 字节。仓库提供分机型令牌表、设置及令牌映射、设置表单选项，以及只读令牌读取与字节扫描工具。作者报告用实时读取和一次 NVRAM 变化核对了部分映射。
requirements: Repeating the firmware analysis requires the relevant Precision Tower 5810 or 7810 BIOS A34 image.
Live token reads require a compatible machine and libsmbios for tools/daread.c.
Some EC sensor and fan fields remain unknown or unsupported.
No licence file in the repository.

name: autowonder-claude-executor: reconstructing the AutoWonder executor interface
description_en: autowonder-claude-executor reconstructs AutoWonder's scheduler-to-executor interface in a Node and TypeScript daemon that runs Claude Code for dispatched tasks. Its specification covers WebSocket dispatch frames, package checks, inventory heartbeats, handoff, checkpoints and crash recovery.
description_zh: autowonder-claude-executor 用 Node 和 TypeScript 实现 AutoWonder 调度器与执行器之间的接口，并由 Claude Code 执行派发任务。规格文档记录 WebSocket 派发帧、任务包校验、心跳、交接、检查点及崩溃恢复。
requirements: Node.js 22 or newer and a local AutoWonder community deployment are required.
Claude Code or another compatible CLI agent is required as the execution engine.
The source notes that community task packages arrive unsigned and scheduler protocol changes may affect compatibility.
MIT licence.

name: LocalAC: local Gree air-conditioner control from protocol research
description_en: LocalAC reconstructs local control of a Gree Pular T3 air conditioner through its LAN protocol. The author documents UDP port 7000 discovery, a bind handshake, AES-GCM command envelopes and property behavior measured on one firmware version. A C# protocol library supports a CLI and .NET MAUI app for status, temperature and other controls.
description_zh: LocalAC 根据局域网协议重建对 Gree Pular T3 空调的本地控制。作者记录了 UDP 7000 发现、绑定握手、AES-GCM 命令封装，以及在一个固件版本上的属性响应。C# 协议库支撑命令行工具和用于状态查看、温度等控制的 .NET MAUI 应用。
requirements: .NET 10 and a Gree-protocol air conditioner on the same LAN are required.
The documented hardware findings concern one Gree Pular T3 unit with firmware U-WB05RT13V1.45.
Some reported properties are read-only or ignore writes on that unit.
MIT license.

name: Panoptes: reconstructing Hik-Connect live-stream encryption
description_en: Panoptes reconstructs the encryption layout of Hik-Connect live video streams for a self-hosted Hikvision DVR video wall. The author compares clear SPS data in SDP with encrypted in-band SPS, reports AES-128-ECB with the device verification code as key, and implements per-NAL decoding in an RTSP client that feeds go2rtc.
description_zh: Panoptes 为自托管 Hikvision DVR 视频墙还原 Hik-Connect 直播流的加密布局。作者对比 SDP 中的明文 SPS 与流内加密 SPS，得出使用设备验证码作为密钥的 AES-128-ECB 规则，并在向 go2rtc 供流的 RTSP 客户端中实现逐 NAL 解密。
requirements: Hikvision DVR or NVR access and its device verification code are required for encrypted streams.
The installation guide targets Debian 12 or 13 and uses go2rtc.
The author reports that sampled encrypted streams decoded without ffmpeg errors.
MIT license.

name: Boulder Dash: an NES disassembly and C/SDL2 port
description_en: Boulder Dash reconstructs an annotated disassembly of the USA NES game and translates its routines into a native C11 and SDL2 port. A local ROM supplies game data and generated assembly; recording tools capture original RAM changes and hardware accesses for routine-by-routine comparison with the C implementation.
description_zh: Boulder Dash 对美版 NES 游戏生成带注释的反汇编，并将各例程移植为原生 C11 与 SDL2 程序。游戏数据和生成的汇编来自用户本地 ROM；记录工具采集原版的 RAM 变化及硬件访问，用于逐例程比较 C 实现。
requirements: A legally owned Boulder Dash USA NES ROM; other releases and modified ROMs are unsupported.
CMake 3.20 or later, a C11 compiler, SDL2, Python 3, and cc65 for the disassembly build.
The author reports that approximately 144,000 recorded calls matched on the author's machine.
MIT license.

name: Tekken 5 × Tekken 3 Merge: Tekken 3 characters reconstructed in Tekken 5
description_en: Tekken 5 × Tekken 3 Merge adds five Tekken 3 characters to a statically recompiled Tekken 5. Its tools extract programs from the user’s discs, analyse them with Ghidra, generate Rust code from instruction sheets, and convert models, movesets, animations, and portraits for the expanded roster. The project documents patches and character-specific findings in its merge plan.
description_zh: Tekken 5 × Tekken 3 Merge 在静态重编译的 Tekken 5 中加入五名 Tekken 3 角色。工具从用户的光盘提取程序，经 Ghidra 分析后按指令表生成 Rust 代码，并转换模型、招式、动画和肖像；合并计划记录了补丁和角色相关的分析结果。
requirements: Provide your own Tekken 5 (USA, SLUS-21059) and Tekken 3 disc images to generate the game code and converted character data.
Install Python 3, a Rust toolchain, Ghidra 12.1.4 with ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded 2.1.38, and ghidra-cli.
Character-data conversion has no one-command pipeline yet; some helper scripts retain developer paths as defaults.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Devil Within Co-op: statically recompiling Tekken 5's Devil Within mode
description_en: Devil Within Co-op statically recompiles the Devil Within mode from a user's Tekken 5 USA disc into generated Rust, then runs it through a Rust PS2 runtime and Bevy application. Its pipeline extracts the compressed ELF, exports Ghidra analysis and generates code locally; added hooks provide cooperative play, a mod menu and reconstructed developer menus.
description_zh: Devil Within Co-op 从用户自备的美版 Tekken 5 光盘提取 Devil Within，将其静态重编译为本地生成的 Rust 代码，再通过 Rust PS2 运行时与 Bevy 应用启动。流程包括解包压缩 ELF、导出 Ghidra 分析和代码生成，并加入双人合作、模组菜单及重建的开发菜单。
requirements: A legally obtained Tekken 5 USA SLUS-21059 disc image is required; game files and generated code are produced locally.
Rebuilding requires Python 3, a Rust toolchain, Ghidra 12.1.4, ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded 2.1.38 and ghidra-cli.
The project is marked work in progress and covers Devil Within rather than the other Tekken 5 modes.
No licence file in the repository.

name: mchose-linux: reconstructing MCHOSE mouse controls on Linux
description_en: mchose-linux reconstructs MCHOSE A5 and AX5 Pro mouse settings on Linux from a decompiled Windows driver. It documents 65-byte HID Feature Reports, command groups and field offsets, then provides DPI and polling-rate controls, battery status and other settings through a CLI, GNOME extension and GTK app.
description_zh: mchose-linux 依据反编译的 Windows 驱动，在 Linux 上重建 MCHOSE A5 与 AX5 Pro 鼠标设置功能。项目记录了 65 字节 HID Feature Report、命令组和字段偏移，并通过 CLI、GNOME 扩展及 GTK 应用提供 DPI、回报率等设置和电量查询。
requirements: Linux and a supported MCHOSE A5 or AX5 Pro series mouse are required.
The GTK app requires GTK4, libadwaita and python3-gobject.
The source states that lighting, button remapping and macros are not wrapped in the CLI, and firmware upgrades are excluded.
MIT license.

name: epson-scan-to-mac: reconstructing Epson panel scanning on Macs
description_en: epson-scan-to-mac reconstructs Epson's Scan to Computer exchange for Macs from captured printer and Event Manager traffic. A Python listener answers SLPv2 discovery and PushScan requests, then asks Epson ScanSmart to scan; a separate WSD listener can save JPEGs directly. The protocol notes document the observed message flow and bytes for an EPSON L6270.
description_zh: epson-scan-to-mac 根据 Epson 打印机与 Event Manager 的抓包，重建 Mac 上的“扫描到电脑”交互。Python 监听程序响应 SLPv2 发现和 PushScan 请求，再调用 Epson ScanSmart；另有 WSD 监听程序可直接保存 JPEG。协议文档记录了 EPSON L6270 的消息流程和字节细节。
requirements: macOS and Python 3.9+; the printer and Mac must share a subnet that permits multicast.
The ScanSmart route requires Epson ScanSmart installed and able to scan over the network.
The author reports testing only an EPSON L6270.
MIT.

name: OpenMouse: reconstructing Kysona M600 V2 mouse control
description_en: OpenMouse implements a macOS client for the Kysona M600 V2 mouse from recovered HID control messages. The author derived framing and checksums from the vendor's Windows library, refined the protocol with USB captures, and wrote Swift code for settings such as DPI, report rate and button mapping.
description_zh: OpenMouse 根据还原的 HID 控制消息实现 Kysona M600 V2 鼠标的 macOS 客户端。作者从厂商 Windows 库分析帧结构与校验方式，再用 USB 抓包修正协议；Swift 客户端可调整 DPI、回报率和按键映射等设置。
requirements: macOS 13 or later and a Swift 5.9 toolchain to build; Input Monitoring permission is needed.
Kysona M600 V2 with USB ID 3554:F5D5 was tested through its 2.4G dongle; other matched connections are untested.
Macros, shortcuts, fire key and LED settings remain undecoded; firmware updates are excluded.
MIT license.

name: WDA Konfigurator: a reconstructed Microsoft Wireless Display Adapter configuration client
description_en: WDA Konfigurator reconstructs the configuration client for Microsoft Wireless Display Adapters. The author derived its CGI request protocol from original-app traffic and app inspection, then built a Windows GUI and CLI for settings and official firmware installation. The documented protocol covers commands, discovery, errors and firmware transfer for Gen 1, Gen 1.5 and Gen 3.
description_zh: WDA Konfigurator 重建 Microsoft Wireless Display Adapter 的配置客户端。作者从原应用通信流量和应用文件中整理 CGI 请求协议，并开发 Windows 图形界面和命令行工具，用于修改设置及安装官方固件。协议文档覆盖 Gen 1、Gen 1.5 和 Gen 3 的命令、发现、错误码与固件传输。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 with Miracast support and a connected adapter are required; source use needs Python 3.10+.
Only the Gen 1.5 adapter was tested on physical hardware; Gen 1 and Gen 3 firmware updates were not.
Microsoft firmware is fetched from Microsoft's servers and is not included.
MIT License for repository code and documentation.

name: irca-ble-protocol: reconstructing heater control over Bluetooth LE
description_en: irca-ble-protocol documents the Bluetooth LE control protocol observed on an Olle POWER-family towel rail. It describes GATT characteristics, 20-byte command frames, status fields and authentication behavior, and provides Python, Home Assistant and Android implementations.
description_zh: irca-ble-protocol 记录在一台 Olle POWER 系列毛巾架上观察到的蓝牙低功耗控制协议，包括 GATT 特征、20 字节命令帧、状态字段和认证行为，并提供 Python、Home Assistant 和 Android 实现。
requirements: A compatible heater and Bluetooth LE access; Home Assistant use requires HA 2024.8 or newer.
The author reports hardware checks against one Olle POWER-family unit; the Home Assistant integration and Celsius climate path were not exercised against a real heater.
MIT license.

name: egm6-nixie-clock: reconstructing a nixie clock's Wi-Fi protocol
description_en: egm6-nixie-clock reconstructs the EGM6 six-tube clock's Wi-Fi control protocol from vendor Windows-app traffic. Its Python CLI sends TCP port 10000 frames for display, time, effects and scheduling settings. The README records the frame layout, command groups, sample bytes and unresolved groups.
description_zh: egm6-nixie-clock 通过抓取厂商 Windows 应用的流量重建 EGM6 六管辉光钟的 Wi-Fi 控制协议。Python 命令行工具向 TCP 10000 端口发送显示、时间、效果和定时设置命令；文档列出帧结构、命令组、示例字节及未识别的组。
requirements: An EGM6 clock reachable over Wi-Fi is required for device control.
Python 3.8 or later is required; the CLI uses the standard library.
The command map is incomplete and the clock sends no acknowledgement.
MIT license.

name: StarCombat Offline: reconstructing a discontinued game's backend
description_en: StarCombat Offline reconstructs backend services for the discontinued mobile game Star Combat: Space battle Online. Original Python and Android mock servers handle its HTTP and TCP exchanges, while scripts patch a user-supplied Unity IL2CPP client for local addresses and offline behavior; Frida probes support the investigation.
description_zh: StarCombat Offline 为停服手游 Star Combat: Space battle Online 重建后端服务。原创 Python 与 Android 模拟服务处理 HTTP 和 TCP 交互；脚本修改用户自备的 Unity IL2CPP 客户端，使其连接本地地址并进入离线模式，Frida 探针用于调查运行行为。
requirements: A user-supplied original APK of the matching Star Combat version.
Python 3.9 or newer, JDK 8, Android build tools, Il2CppDumper, Cpp2IL, Frida, and an Android device or emulator are listed for the workflow.
Patch addresses are version-specific and require fresh analysis for a different libil2cpp.so.
MIT license covers the repository's original code.

name: Guoran nixie clock: reconstructing its Bluetooth control protocol
description_en: Guoran nixie clock documents the BLE control protocol of GANXIN IN1204M family clocks and implements it in a Web Bluetooth app and Home Assistant integration. The author derived the commands from the original Android app and the clock manual; the protocol document records GATT characteristics, message handling, and open questions.
description_zh: Guoran nixie clock 记录 GANXIN IN1204M 系列辉光管时钟的 BLE 控制协议，并提供 Web Bluetooth 应用和 Home Assistant 集成。作者从原版 Android 应用及设备手册梳理命令；协议文档列出 GATT 特征值、消息处理方式和待确认问题。
requirements: A supported Guoran or GANXIN clock; the web app requires Chrome with Web Bluetooth on a computer, while Home Assistant requires a nearby Bluetooth adapter or active ESPHome proxy.
Several packet details remain inferred from app code and unconfirmed on hardware.
MIT license.

name: 1st Player RT LCD: reconstructing a case-display HID protocol
description_en: 1st Player RT LCD reconstructs the USB HID control protocol for displays in 1st Player RT5, RT7, and RT9 cases. Its protocol notes describe 64-byte output reports, and Python scripts drive CPU and GPU telemetry, scrolling text, and a panel test on Linux.
description_zh: 1st Player RT LCD 重建 1st Player RT5、RT7 和 RT9 机箱显示屏的 USB HID 控制协议。协议文档说明 64 字节输出报告；Python 脚本在 Linux 上显示 CPU/GPU 状态、滚动文字并测试面板。
requirements: Linux, Python 3.8 or newer, and a compatible RT5, RT7, or RT9 display are required.
The documented test unit uses USB ID 5131:2007.
MIT license.

name: Earbud-case LED display: a probed pinout and segment map
description_en: The earbud-case LED display study reconstructs the pinout and electrical drive map of an unmarked charging-case display. It documents 31 segments on eight charlieplexed lines, including ribbon-finger wiring and anode/cathode combinations, and supplies an ESP32-C3 driver and serial probing sketch.
description_zh: 该耳机盒 LED 显示屏研究还原了无标识模块的引脚和电气驱动映射。文档列出 8 条查理复用线路上的 31 个显示段、排线触点接线及阳极和阴极组合，并提供 ESP32-C3 驱动和串口探测程序。
requirements: The documented driver uses an ESP32-C3, GPIO wiring and a 1 kΩ series resistor on each line.
The upper and lower hundreds-stub segments, separate outline edges, current and exact scan rate remain unresolved.
MIT license.

name: Dogfish: reconstructing Conquest of Skyrim's strategic systems
description_en: Dogfish investigates the Conquest of Skyrim mod for Skyrim Special Edition and reconstructs its strategic systems as a standalone Rust simulation. Its documents cover behavioral contracts, original Papyrus and binary research, and an experimental SKSE integration bridge. The project reports that in-game execution checks remain blocked pending human playtesting.
description_zh: Dogfish 研究 Skyrim Special Edition 的 Conquest of Skyrim 模组，并将其派系、领土、战争、政治和经济系统重建为独立 Rust 模拟程序。仓库记录行为约定、原版 Papyrus 与二进制研究，以及实验性的 SKSE 桥接；项目报告游戏内运行检查仍等待人工试玩。
requirements: Skyrim Special Edition and the Conquest of Skyrim mod are the referenced original environment.
The author reports that in-engine runtime execution remains blocked pending human playtesting.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Ecovacs Deebot X1: reconstructing local map and control interfaces
description_en: Ecovacs Deebot X1 Local Control Research documents the robot's map format, ROS messages, state stream, and control services for local operation. The repository includes captured message definitions, scripts for querying and calling the ROS graph, and deployment notes for a separate Valetudo fork. The author reports working map, cleaning, and settings control on an X1 device.
description_zh: Ecovacs Deebot X1 Local Control Research 记录了扫地机器人本地运行所需的地图格式、ROS 消息、状态流和控制服务。仓库包含采集的消息定义、查询和调用 ROS 图的脚本，以及独立 Valetudo 分支的部署笔记。作者报告已在 X1 设备上实现地图、清扫和设置控制。
requirements: An Ecovacs Deebot X1 device with an accessible local ROS interface is required for live investigation.
The README identifies rooting and unlocking as prerequisites based on earlier public guides.
The status notes report observations on an X1 Plus; X1 Turbo behavior is not separately verified.
MIT license applies to original research documentation and scripts.

name: My biggest work: reconstructing Brawlhalla replay simulation
description_en: My biggest work investigates how Brawlhalla patch 11.00 replays matches from recorded inputs, aiming to reproduce the simulation outside the game. Its Python toolkit parses replay, SWF, ABC and SWZ data, while notes map the tick loop, random generator and movement; the full simulator and player-position rendering remain unfinished.
description_zh: My biggest work 研究 Brawlhalla 原始 11.00 补丁如何根据记录的输入重放比赛，目标是在游戏外复现模拟过程。Python 工具解析 replay、SWF、ABC 和 SWZ 数据，研究笔记梳理逐时间步模拟循环、随机数生成器与移动机制；完整模拟器和角色位置渲染仍未完成。
requirements: Python 3.10+ and the user's own Brawlhalla installation are required.
Findings are pinned to the original patch 11.00 code and replay format 271; a later hotfix changed the main ABC.
The simulator does not yet reproduce complete matches or player positions.
MIT license.

name: MyEnergy Dashboard: reconstructing INFINITY 1000 Bluetooth controls
description_en: MyEnergy Dashboard reconstructs Bluetooth control and telemetry for the INFINITY 1000 portable power station in a browser app. Its TypeScript protocol package builds frames, checks Modbus CRC, decodes device messages and runs a simulator, while the web interface exposes power readings and controls.
description_zh: MyEnergy Dashboard 在浏览器应用中重建 INFINITY 1000 便携电源的蓝牙控制与状态读取。TypeScript 协议包负责组帧、Modbus CRC 校验、消息解码和设备模拟，网页界面显示功率数据并提供控制功能。
requirements: Node 20.12 or newer and pnpm 10 are listed for development.
Real hardware use requires a Web Bluetooth browser and an INFINITY 1000 station.
The author reports testing on one station with model code MGI032GR1HEU.
MIT licence.

name: sk700v-linux: a Linux display client for the Sudokoo SK700V
description_en: sk700v-linux drives the Sudokoo SK700V cooler LCD from Linux using its observed USB HID protocol. The write-up maps 64-byte output reports, command payloads and sensor fields from vendor-app traffic and trial frames; a Python daemon sends CPU readings and a probe script sends manual frames.
description_zh: sk700v-linux 根据观察得到的 USB HID 协议，在 Linux 上驱动 Sudokoo SK700V 散热器 LCD。文档通过厂商程序流量及试验帧整理出 64 字节输出报告、命令载荷和传感器字段；Python 守护进程发送 CPU 读数，探测脚本可手动发帧。
requirements: A Sudokoo SK700V cooler and Linux with Python 3 are required.
The service runs as root to read the RAPL power counter; Intel temperature support requires changing the source.
The source says only its documented commands have been tested.
MIT licence.

name: OpenNoiseRep: a BLE client for the Noise REP fitness band
description_en: OpenNoiseRep implements a BLE client for the Noise REP band, with desktop, menu-bar and command-line views for historical health data and local CSV or JSON export. Its protocol notes reconstruct GATT characteristics, chunk framing and commands from a vendor sync capture and live probing.
description_zh: OpenNoiseRep 为 Noise REP 手环实现 BLE 客户端，通过桌面界面、菜单栏和命令行读取历史健康数据，并在本地导出 CSV 或 JSON。协议笔记依据厂商同步抓包及现场探测还原 GATT 特征、分块帧格式和命令。
requirements: Requires a Noise REP band, macOS or Linux, and Python 3.10 or newer.
The band accepts one BLE central at a time; the phone's Bluetooth should be off while syncing.
Hardware validation remains open for live heart rate, haptics, staged sleep and workout files.
MIT license.

name: rtchair: local control of the Rotai RT7709S massage chair
description_en: rtchair reconstructs local control of the Rotai RT7709S massage chair from its communication protocol. An OpenWrt router redirects the chair's MQTT connection to a local broker, while a CLI and Home Assistant integration expose controls and timed massage programs.
description_zh: rtchair 根据荣泰 RT7709S 按摩椅的通信协议重建本地控制。OpenWrt 路由器把按摩椅的 MQTT 连接转到本地代理，CLI 和 Home Assistant 集成提供设备控制及定时按摩程序。
requirements: An RT7709S already configured through the official app, plus an OpenWrt or ImmortalWrt router with passwordless SSH, is required for offline mode.
The local broker has no authentication and is intended for a trusted home network.
MIT license.

name: Urja Meter Ops API Service: reconstructing portal data access
description_en: Urja Meter Ops API Service reconstructs the web portal's internal data access and wraps it in a typed Fastify gateway for meter inventory, hierarchy, coordinates, and telemetry. The author describes finding JSON routes and an HMAC-signed bulk export through JavaScript inspection and HTTP probing, then handling sessions and normalizing returned data.
description_zh: Urja Meter Ops API Service 还原网页门户的内部数据访问方式，并用 Fastify 网关提供电表清单、配电层级、坐标和遥测数据。作者描述了通过检查 JavaScript 和探测 HTTP 请求发现 JSON 路由及 HMAC 签名批量导出接口，再处理会话和数据规范化。
requirements: Using the gateway requires portal credentials configured through its environment variables.
The implementation assumes portal timestamps use Indian Standard Time and treats cumulative energy registers as readings rather than interval usage.
No licence file in the repository.

name: th07: reconstructing Touhou 7 retail 1.00b
description_en: th07 reconstructs C++ for the retail 1.00b executable of Touhou 7: Perfect Cherry Blossom using Ghidra analysis, the original Visual C++ .NET 2002 toolchain and byte comparisons against a user supplied game copy. The author reports that its standalone executable matches all 650,752 bytes of the original and documents replay trace comparisons.
description_zh: th07 使用 Ghidra、原版 Visual C++ .NET 2002 工具链和逐字节比对，重建《东方妖妖梦》零售版 1.00b 可执行文件的 C++ 源码。作者报告称，独立构建的可执行文件与原版 650,752 字节完全一致，并记录了回放轨迹比对。
requirements: A user supplied copy of Touhou 7 retail 1.00b is required.
Build dependencies include 32-bit Wine, Python 3, just, binutils, 7-Zip, Visual C++ .NET 2002, the Windows XP SP2 Platform SDK and the DirectX 8.0 SDK.
The author reports whole-file byte identity; ten of 36 replay recordings fail full-route validation in both the original and rebuilt executable.
GPL-3.0-only.

name: th06: an independently matching Touhou 6 decompilation
description_en: th06 reconstructs C++ source for Touhou 6: Embodiment of Scarlet Devil retail version 1.02h from the original executable. The workflow uses headless Ghidra analysis, the original MSVC and DirectX toolchain under Wine, and byte comparisons of functions and the whole executable. The author reports that all 511 game functions and the rebuilt executable match the original, with replay traces compared separately.
description_zh: th06 从《东方红魔乡》零售版 1.02h 的原始可执行文件重建 C++ 源码。流程使用无界面 Ghidra 分析、Wine 下的原版 MSVC 与 DirectX 工具链，并逐字节比对函数及完整可执行文件。作者报告称，511 个游戏函数和重建的可执行文件均与原版匹配，并单独比较游戏回放的运行轨迹。
requirements: Requires the user's own retail Touhou 6 files updated to version 1.02h.
Building requires Wine, Python 3, just, binutils, 7-Zip, Visual C++ .NET 2002, Windows XP SP2 Platform SDK, and DirectX 8.0 SDK.
Replay checks additionally require Xvfb, xdotool, ImageMagick, 32-bit Mesa, and the ja_JP.UTF-8 locale.
GPL-3.0-only licence for the project source.

name: ReJet: running Jet Set Radio Future's Xbox code on Windows
description_en: ReJet runs the European Xbox release of Jet Set Radio Future on Windows from the user's own disc image or extracted files. It loads the game's original x86 code and replaces Xbox graphics, sound and controller interfaces with PC implementations, adding configurable display options.
description_zh: ReJet 从用户自己的光盘镜像或提取文件，在 Windows 上运行欧版 Xbox 游戏 Jet Set Radio Future。它加载原始 x86 代码，用 PC 实现替换 Xbox 图形、声音和控制器接口，并提供显示选项。
requirements: 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 and the user's own European PAL Xbox copy of Jet Set Radio Future.
The author calls it alpha and says later levels and local multiplayer have not been tried.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: zte-cpe-sms: reconstructing ZTE CPE SMS API access
description_en: zte-cpe-sms reconstructs access to the internal SMS API of ZTE MC889 and related 5G CPE devices. Its protocol notes describe login hashing, an RSA session-key exchange, a token that must be recalculated after key exchange, and UCS-2 message encoding; Node.js CLI and web clients use those findings to read and send SMS.
description_zh: zte-cpe-sms 重建了 ZTE MC889 等 5G CPE 设备内部短信 API 的访问流程。协议文档记录登录哈希、RSA 会话密钥交换、交换后需重新计算的令牌，以及 UCS-2 消息编码；Node.js 命令行和网页客户端据此收发短信。
requirements: Node.js 18 or newer and the router's web UI password are required.
The documented protocol findings were checked on MC889 firmware BD_ATMC889V1.0.0B19.
The web UI has no login and is intended for a trusted LAN.
MIT License.

name: TCL AC Original Module ESPHome: reconstructing WL6U air-conditioner control
description_en: TCL AC Original Module ESPHome reconstructs local control of a TCL air conditioner on its original WL6U Wi-Fi module. The author traced command building and status decoding in a stock RTL8720CF firmware dump, compared selected functions with replacement codecs, and implemented ESPHome controls and readings over the module's UART link.
description_zh: TCL AC Original Module ESPHome 在原装 WL6U Wi-Fi 模块上重建 TCL 空调的本地控制。作者分析 RTL8720CF 原厂固件中的命令构造和状态解码，用模拟执行比对部分函数与替代编解码器，并通过 UART 实现 ESPHome 控制及读数。
requirements: An original WL6U_V4.0 module with RTL8720CF and 2 MiB flash; first installation needs a 3.3 V USB–UART adapter, 5 V supply and Linux computer.
Back up the original firmware before writing; the module must be disconnected from AC mains during programming.
The author tested one TAC-12CHSD; other models and full stock restoration remain untested.
Apache-2.0 and MIT license files are included.

name: Slip Stream: static recompilation of a Sega System 32 arcade game
description_en: Slip Stream translates the arcade game's V60 program from the player's ROM into C and runs it with a Sega System 32 board model on Windows or Linux. The translation driver follows reference execution to emit functions. The author reports matching state hashes against a MAME based reference runner over 1,800 frames and a separate video comparison during development; the port remains unfinished.
description_zh: Slip Stream 将玩家自备街机 ROM 中的 V60 程序翻译为 C，配合 Sega System 32 板级模型在 Windows 或 Linux 上运行。翻译器依据参考执行路径生成函数。作者报告，与基于 MAME 的参考运行器比较，1,800 帧的状态哈希一致；开发期间还另行比较过画面。移植仍未完成。
requirements: A personally owned MAME slipstrm.zip ROM set is required.
Python 3.10+, CMake 3.20+, Git and a C11/C++17 compiler are required; SDL2 development files are needed for the windowed build.
The port is a work in progress and is not yet a finished playable release.
Original project code uses PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0; reused components retain BSD-3-Clause notices.

name: gs5-rgb: Creative Sound Blaster GS5 lighting protocol
description_en: gs5-rgb reconstructs the Creative Sound Blaster GS5 lighting protocol from USB captures and implements it as a Linux Python library and CLI. Its protocol notes specify HID report framing, acknowledgments, effects, and status reads; the client controls seven strip segments, brightness, and built-in effects.
description_zh: gs5-rgb 从 USB 抓包还原 Creative Sound Blaster GS5 灯光协议，并提供 Linux Python 库和命令行工具。协议笔记记录 HID 报文格式、确认响应、灯效和状态读取；客户端可控制七段灯带、亮度及内置效果。
requirements: Linux, Python 3.8 or newer, a GS5 connected by USB, and hidraw access through the supplied udev rule.
The author tested firmware 1.25.251009.1430; other firmware versions, mode 07, and power-cycle persistence remain open questions.
MIT license.

name: EKIY / Melis reverse engineering: emulating display firmware and decoding UI resources
description_en: EKIY / Melis reverse engineering runs the original home-screen firmware of an Allwinner F133-B display in a TypeScript application-level emulator. It documents the observed DATAV1.0 UI format, provides tools to read and rebuild UI packages, and records firmware-specific modification findings using a dump supplied by the user.
description_zh: EKIY / Melis reverse engineering 通过 TypeScript 应用层仿真器运行 Allwinner F133-B 显示设备的原版主屏固件。项目记录所观察到的 DATAV1.0 UI 格式，提供资源包读写工具及针对该固件的修改研究，固件转储由用户自行提供。
requirements: A user-supplied firmware dump from the documented EKIY board is required.
Node.js 22.6 or newer, npm and Python 3; image tools require Pillow.
The emulator has stubbed services; the brightness and skin changes have been checked in the emulator but not on hardware.
MIT.

name: CyberStrike Server Specification: DOS client protocol and map format
description_en: CyberStrike Server Specification reconstructs the server-facing behavior of the 1994 DOS client of CyberStrike from observation of the client and its printed manual. Four documents describe serial transport, session phases, messages, client rules, server policy, implementation steps and the CBD city-map format so a replacement server can interoperate with the original game.
description_zh: CyberStrike Server Specification 根据对 CyberStrike 1994 年 DOS 客户端的观察及纸质手册，重建其面向服务器的行为。四份文档说明串口传输、会话阶段、消息、客户端规则、服务器策略、实现步骤和 CBD 城市地图格式，供替代服务器与原版游戏互通。
requirements: The specification covers the GEnie DOS client version 1.5; other versions may differ.
The author reports that a server built from the specification supported a full multiplayer game with the original client.
Specification text: CC-BY-4.0; code examples: CC0 1.0.

name: Telly Remote: reconstructing TYRC-1 remote control over Bluetooth and infrared
description_en: Telly Remote controls a Telly TV through a Flipper Zero that emulates the TYRC-1 remote over Bluetooth HID and infrared. Its documentation records captured NEC extended infrared codes, Bluetooth advertisements and scan responses, and the PnP ID that selects the TV's key map; a local web server sends keys and menu sequences to the Flipper.
description_zh: Telly Remote 通过 Flipper Zero 模拟 TYRC-1 遥控器，以蓝牙 HID 和红外控制 Telly 电视。项目记录了捕获的 NEC extended 红外码、蓝牙广播包与扫描响应包，以及决定电视按键映射的 PnP ID；本地网页服务器向 Flipper 发送按键和菜单操作序列。
requirements: Telly TV and Flipper Zero; Bluetooth control requires the Telly Remote app and patched Flipper firmware 1.5.1. Infrared works on stock firmware.
macOS and Python 3; the author says the server may also work on Linux after adjusting the Flipper port glob.
Tested on Telly model TY55_1.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: vfs495-driver: a Linux driver from fingerprint-reader protocol research
description_en: vfs495-driver implements a Linux libfprint TOD driver for the Validity VFS495 swipe fingerprint reader. Its documented research traces the sensor's USB handshake, encrypted command and image streams, and firmware patch setup; a build recipe extracts required command data from the user's HP SoftPaq download.
description_zh: vfs495-driver 为 Validity VFS495 滑动式指纹读取器实现 Linux libfprint TOD 驱动。研究笔记追踪传感器的 USB 握手、加密命令和图像数据流及固件补丁加载；构建配方从用户下载的 HP SoftPaq 提取所需命令数据。
requirements: A Validity VFS495 reader with USB ID 138a:003f and libfprint with TOD support are required.
The build downloads HP SoftPaq sp84530 to extract setup commands and firmware patches; the repository does not contain that data.
The author reports testing on one HP ZBook 17 G3 with Ubuntu 25.10 and 26.04; other sensor variants may need different patches.
LGPL-2.1-or-later license.

name: Wave Buds: a client for the JBL Wave Buds control protocol
description_en: Wave Buds implements an Android companion for the original JBL Wave Buds using a Bluetooth control protocol documented from the author's traffic captures. It controls ambient sound, equalization and touch settings, and its reference records GATT characteristics and command frames.
description_zh: Wave Buds 根据作者采集的蓝牙通信，为初代 JBL Wave Buds 实现 Android 配套应用，可设置环境声、均衡器和触控操作；协议文档列出 GATT 特征值及命令帧。
requirements: Android 13 or newer and original JBL Wave Buds with product ID 0x2090.
The author tested one phone and one pair of earbuds; firmware updates are unsupported.
MIT license.

name: Beli API: reconstructing the app's backend specification
description_en: Beli API reconstructs the backend interface used by Beli app 10.2.0 as an OpenAPI 3.1 specification. It combines HAR-derived operations, endpoints extracted from the app's decompiled JavaScript and response shapes inferred from live GET replies. Source markers distinguish observed operations from app-code-only entries and failed live checks.
description_zh: Beli API 将 Beli 应用 10.2.0 使用的后端接口重建为 OpenAPI 3.1 规范。资料合并 HAR 流量中的操作、应用反编译 JavaScript 中提取的端点，以及依据实时 GET 响应推断的结构；来源标记区分已观察操作、仅见于客户端代码的条目和实时检查失败的请求。
requirements: Python 3.10+, PyYAML and openapi-spec-validator are required to regenerate and validate the specification.
The source covers Beli app 10.2.0; many write operations and app-code-only endpoints have not been exercised.
MIT license.

name: Tabelog API: reconstructing the Tabelog Inbound backend specification
description_en: Tabelog API reconstructs an OpenAPI 3.0.3 description of the Tabelog Inbound 2.24.1 app backend from decompiled smali. Its scripts extract API definitions and serializers into YAML and JSON specifications, while notes cover endpoint paths, token handling, and selected live checks reported by the author.
description_zh: Tabelog API 从 Tabelog Inbound 2.24.1 的反编译 smali 还原后端 OpenAPI 3.0.3 规范。脚本提取接口与序列化结构，生成 YAML 和 JSON 文件；研究笔记记录端点路径、令牌流程及作者报告的部分在线核查结果。
requirements: Regeneration requires Python 3.10+, a decompiled com.kakaku.tabelog.tourists 2.24.1 smali ZIP, and openapi-spec-validator.
Required fields, nullability, and endpoint authentication are partly inferred from code; the author reports only selected calls were checked live.
MIT license.

name: Platinenlupe: reconstructing an EarVision camera protocol for browser viewing
description_en: Platinenlupe reconstructs an EarVision Wi-Fi ear camera's communication for browser-based PCB inspection. The author documents APK and firmware analysis that recovered BLE wake-up, Wi-Fi access, UDP JPEG framing and light control, then implements a two-board ESP bridge and local viewer.
description_zh: Platinenlupe 重建 EarVision Wi-Fi 耳镜相机的通信方式，将画面用于浏览器中的电路板检查。作者记录 APK 与固件分析，整理 BLE 唤醒、Wi-Fi 接入、UDP JPEG 分帧及灯光控制，并实现双 ESP 开发板桥接和本地查看页面。
requirements: Requires a compatible EarVision camera, an ESP32, a NodeMCU or second ESP32, and wiring for the documented bridge.
PlatformIO builds the firmware; local part identification additionally requires a vision model served by LM Studio, Ollama or a compatible server.
The author reports hardware measurements on a TXW810 camera with firmware 125.
Repository code is MIT licensed; enclosure files use CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: manifold-558s-ble: reconstructing testo 558s measurement messages
description_en: manifold-558s-ble reconstructs the testo 558s refrigeration manifold's Bluetooth LE message format from observed traffic between the device and its phone app. Its Python client subscribes to live pressure and temperature measurements, while companion scripts inspect GATT services and decode Android Bluetooth captures.
description_zh: manifold-558s-ble 根据 testo 558s 制冷歧管仪与手机应用之间的蓝牙通信还原 BLE 消息格式。Python 客户端订阅实时压力和温度数据，配套脚本可检查 GATT 服务并解码 Android 蓝牙抓包。
requirements: A testo 558s, Python with bleak and a Bluetooth LE connection are required for live readings; Windows pairing is required before connecting.
The author reports testing one 558s on Windows 10 only; pressure units remain unconfirmed under pressure.
MIT license.

name: attackshark-x11prov2: decoding the X11 PRO V2 mouse configuration protocol
description_en: attackshark-x11prov2 reconstructs the ATTACK SHARK X11 PRO V2 mouse's HID configuration exchanges and implements a Python CLI for DPI stages, polling rate and lift-off distance. The documented report layouts include the LOD byte, checksum and read and write acknowledgments.
