description_zh: attackshark-x11prov2 复原 ATTACK SHARK X11 PRO V2 鼠标的 HID 配置交互，并提供调节 DPI 档位、回报率及抬起距离的 Python 命令行工具。文档列出报告中的 LOD 字节、校验和与读写确认格式。
requirements: ATTACK SHARK X11 PRO V2 in 2.4 GHz receiver mode, Python 3.8 or newer, and hidapi.
The author reports testing on Windows 11; wired mode and other mice are untested.
MIT license.

name: AULA Hub: reconstructing the AULA F99 Pro keyboard protocol
description_en: AULA Hub reconstructs the AULA F99 Pro keyboard's wired and 2.4 GHz HID commands and uses them in a Windows control app. Its protocol notes describe frame layouts, configuration pages, key records and per-key colour data; the app provides lighting, remapping, macros and battery display.
description_zh: AULA Hub 还原 AULA F99 Pro 键盘的有线及 2.4 GHz HID 命令，并用于 Windows 控制程序。协议笔记记录帧格式、配置页、按键记录和逐键颜色数据；程序提供灯效、改键、宏和电量显示。
requirements: AULA F99 Pro keyboard; the author identifies wired 258A:010C and 2.4 GHz 3554:FA09 devices.
Windows 10 or 11 x64; source use requires Python 3.10+ and Edge WebView2.
Wireless mode cannot write key mappings, per-key colours or macros.
MIT License.

name: Potensic ATOM: reconstructing the DSRC02A controller cable
description_en: The Potensic ATOM cable investigation reconstructs the directional USB-C connection between a DSRC02A drone controller and an Android phone. Multimeter measurements inform an editable KiCad schematic, wiring notes and a replacement adapter design using SBU/CC connections and two 56 kΩ resistors. The author reports one prototype carrying video and controller input during a short flight.
description_zh: Potensic ATOM 连接线调查重建 DSRC02A 无人机控制器与 Android 手机之间的定向 USB-C 连接。作者依据万用表测量编制 KiCad 原理图、接线记录和替代适配器设计，涉及 SBU/CC 接线及两只 56 kΩ 电阻；据其报告，一个原型在短途飞行中传输了视频和控制输入。
requirements: The design applies to the reported Potensic ATOM, DSRC02A controller and Android phone setup.
The author reports one prototype test; other controller models and iOS remain untested.
Hardware design and STL: CERN-OHL-S-2.0; documentation and measurements: CC BY 4.0.

name: hpcs330: reconstructing the Hopoo spectrometer serial protocol
description_en: hpcs330 implements a Python reader for the Hopoo HPCS-330 spectrometer using a USB serial protocol recovered from the vendor's Windows application. The protocol notes describe framing and measurement commands; the client retrieves spectral samples and the meter's computed light measurements.
description_zh: hpcs330 根据原厂 Windows 程序还原的 USB 串口协议，实现了 Hopoo HPCS-330 光谱仪的 Python 读取程序。协议文档记录消息格式和测量命令，客户端可读取光谱样本及仪器计算的照明指标。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later and pyserial 3.4 or later.
A Hopoo HPCS-330P in USB COM mode; this is the model the author reports testing.
Other HPCS-330 variants and HPCS-310/320 models are unconfirmed; some computed values have not been checked against the screen.
MIT License.

name: Touhou 8: an independent matching decompilation of Imperishable Night
description_en: Cirno-Labs/th08 reconstructs Touhou 8: Imperishable Night retail 1.00d in C++ and checks the build against the user's original game. The author reports byte matches for all game functions and the standalone executable, using the original MSVC toolchain, per-function comparisons and replay traces.
description_zh: Cirno-Labs/th08 用 C++ 重建《东方永夜抄》零售版 1.00d，并将构建结果与用户持有的原版游戏比较。作者报告所有游戏函数和独立可执行文件均逐字节匹配；校验使用原版 MSVC 工具链、逐函数比较及回放轨迹。
requirements: A user-supplied retail Touhou 8 copy updated to version 1.00d.
The documented build uses the original Visual C++ .NET 2002 toolchain under Wine on Linux.
Byte identity and replay parity are author-reported results.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Wuwa Tappo Linux: a Qt reconstruction of the desktop shell
description_en: Wuwa Tappo Linux reimplements the Windows-only shell of the Wuwa Tappo desktop pet as a Qt 6 application for Linux. It loads the web frontend extracted locally from the user's own 1.0.1 installer and supplies native window, input and WebSocket components; the author reports tests mainly in a nested Fedora Asahi Remix Wayland session.
description_zh: Wuwa Tappo Linux 使用 Qt 6 为 Linux 重建 Wuwa Tappo 桌面宠物应用的 Windows 专属外壳。它从用户自己的 1.0.1 安装程序中于本机提取网页前端，并提供原生窗口、输入和 WebSocket 组件；作者报告的测试主要在 Fedora Asahi Remix 的嵌套 Wayland 会话中进行。
requirements: The user's own Wuwa Tappo global 1.0.1 Windows installer is required; setup checks its SHA-256.
Building requires a C++17 compiler, CMake, Ninja and Qt 6.5 or newer; setup also needs Python 3, 7zip and brotli.
The author tested mainly on one Fedora Asahi Remix 44 machine in a nested KDE Wayland session; other systems and full login remain unverified.
MIT licence covers the repository's files only.

name: LB-M8 Settings: reconstructing Lingbao M8 mouse commands
description_en: LB-M8 Settings implements a browser client for the Lingbao M8 mouse using HID commands recovered from its Windows driver. A byte-level protocol reference describes 40-byte feature reports, request and reply behavior, and settings for DPI, polling rate, sleep, and sensor options.
description_zh: LB-M8 Settings 根据 Lingbao M8 Windows 驱动还原的 HID 命令实现浏览器控制界面。字节级协议文档说明 40 字节特征报告、请求与响应流程，以及 DPI、回报率、休眠和传感器设置。
requirements: A Lingbao M8 mouse connected by USB cable or its 2.4 GHz receiver, and a Chromium-based browser with WebHID.
Linux browser access requires the supplied udev rule.
The author reports testing on CachyOS with Brave; Bluetooth, button remapping, macros, and lighting are unsupported.
MIT License.

name: iMist: local diffuser control from a reconstructed Bluetooth protocol
description_en: iMist implements local Home Assistant control for an aroma diffuser whose Bluetooth command format was inferred by observing reports while its buttons were pressed. Its protocol notes map the fff4 characteristic's aa MM LL mist and light bytes; the integration exposes state, color, mist, schedules, and a sleep timer.
description_zh: iMist 通过观察按键操作时的蓝牙报告，还原香薰机的命令格式，并实现 Home Assistant 本地控制。协议文档解释 fff4 特征值中的 aa MM LL 雾化和灯光字节；集成提供状态、颜色、雾化模式、日程和睡眠定时器。
requirements: Home Assistant 2024.11+ with Bluetooth and an iMist diffuser advertising the fff0 service and fff4 characteristic.
Diffusers using the separate f501 protocol are unsupported; the device has no brightness or water-level sensor.
MIT license.

name: bcwc_pcie: auditing the FaceTime HD camera driver against Apple's kext
description_en: bcwc_pcie audits the community FaceTime HD Linux driver against Apple's AppleCameraInterface.kext for Broadcom PCI 14e4:1570 cameras. Its scripts trace MMIO register accesses through the kext and compare offsets, masks and sequencing with the vendored driver; the author reports finding 19 registers the Linux implementation does not cover.
description_zh: bcwc_pcie 针对 Broadcom PCI 14e4:1570 FaceTime HD 摄像头，将社区 Linux 驱动与 AppleCameraInterface.kext 进行对照审计。脚本追踪 kext 的 MMIO 寄存器访问，并比较偏移、位掩码和操作顺序；作者报告发现 Linux 驱动尚未覆盖的 19 个寄存器。
requirements: Targets Broadcom FaceTime HD PCI 14e4:1570 cameras; Apple firmware is extracted locally and is absent from the repository.
The driver derives from patjak/facetimehd; the audit and extraction tools are this repository's added work.
The author reports hardware testing on Ubuntu 26.04.1 with kernel 7.0.0-38.
GPL-2.0-only for the driver modifications, tools, scripts and documentation.

name: YBX ESP32 System Emulator: reconstructing e-ink reader hardware in QEMU
description_en: YBX ESP32 System Emulator reconstructs selected hardware behavior so original ESP32-S3 and ESP32-C3 e-ink reader firmware can run in QEMU. Its patches and host tools model display and touch paths, capture panel framebuffers, and record boot, peripheral and navigation experiments for YBX X4 Pro and CrossPoint images.
description_zh: YBX ESP32 System Emulator 在 QEMU 中重建部分硬件行为，以运行 ESP32-S3 和 ESP32-C3 电子阅读器的原始固件。补丁及主机工具模拟屏幕和触控路径、采集面板帧缓冲，并记录 YBX X4 Pro 与 CrossPoint 镜像的启动、外设和界面实验。
requirements: Users must supply firmware images separately; the repository does not distribute factory images.
The source identifies the emulator as research-grade with incomplete peripheral coverage.
Original host tooling is MIT licensed; QEMU-derived patches are GPL-2.0 licensed.

name: Toshiba e-STUDIO2323AM: reconstructing a PJL/JBIG print stream for CUPS
description_en: Toshiba e-STUDIO2323AM/2823AM CUPS driver reconstructs the printers' PJL and JBIG-1 print stream from captured Windows GDI driver output. A CUPS raster filter and PPD generate jobs for a socket print queue, while protocol notes describe job envelopes, page blocks, paper options, and copy behavior. The author reports byte-level capture comparisons and printing on an e-STUDIO2323AM.
description_zh: Toshiba e-STUDIO2323AM/2823AM CUPS 驱动根据 Windows GDI 驱动抓包还原 PJL 与 JBIG-1 打印流。CUPS raster filter 和 PPD 为 socket 打印队列生成作业；协议笔记记录作业封装、页面数据块、纸张选项及多份打印行为。作者报告完成了抓包逐字节比对，并在 e-STUDIO2323AM 上出纸。
requirements: A macOS CUPS environment and an e-STUDIO2323AM or 2823AM printer for the documented driver route.
The printers have no automatic duplex unit; the filter always sends single-sided jobs.
The author reports capture replay and printer tests; some management UI actions have only stub-based tests.
GPL-2.0-or-later License.

name: Destruction Derby 2: portable C port of the PlayStation game
description_en: Destruction Derby 2 is ported from its USA PlayStation executable and overlays into portable C11 using SDL3. The source replaces the game's PSX SDK calls for graphics, sound, disc access, controls and memory cards, and builds its asset directory from the user's own disc image.
description_zh: 项目将美版 PlayStation《Destruction Derby 2》的可执行文件及覆盖模块改写为基于 SDL3 的可移植 C11 代码，并重实现游戏调用的图形、声音、光盘、手柄和记忆卡接口。资源目录由用户自己的光盘镜像生成。
requirements: A user-supplied Destruction Derby 2 USA .cue/.bin disc image and Python 3 are required to prepare assets.
Building requires CMake 3.24 or newer and a C11 compiler. CMake uses an installed SDL3 or downloads the pinned 3.4.18 release; the author reports testing with MSVC.
Some behavior remains to be compared against the original game.
No licence file in the repository.

name: CustomWatch: a Prixton Life Fit companion from BLE protocol research
description_en: CustomWatch implements an Android companion for the Prixton Life Fit smartwatch using a BLE protocol studied through static analysis, limited capture and one-device tests. It requests activity, pulse and battery data, stores sleep observations locally, and forwards selected notifications.
description_zh: CustomWatch 根据静态分析、少量 BLE 抓包和单台设备测试，为 Prixton Life Fit 智能手表实现 Android 配套应用。它读取活动、心率和电量数据，在本地保存睡眠记录，并转发选定通知。
requirements: Android 8.0 or newer and a compatible Prixton Life Fit watch.
Building requires JDK 17 or newer, Android SDK 35 and Gradle 8.9.
The author tested one watch; firmware compatibility and several health interpretations remain uncertain.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Between Us: an offline remake informed by Action ou Vérité APK analysis
description_en: Between Us is an offline couple game rebuilt after analysis of the Action ou Vérité Android APK. The report records the original's React Native and Hermes packaging, card database and gameplay model; the replacement uses original Chinese card text, browser JavaScript and a small Android WebView shell.
description_zh: Between Us 是在分析 Action ou Vérité Android APK 后重制的离线情侣游戏。分析报告记录了原版的 React Native、Hermes 打包结构、卡片数据库和玩法模型；重制版采用原创中文卡片、浏览器 JavaScript 和轻量 Android WebView 外壳。
requirements: The browser version runs from remake/www/index.html; the APK targets Android 5.0 or later.
Building the APK requires JDK 17, Android build-tools, android.jar and Python 3.
The original game's card text is not included; the replacement cards are author-written.
MIT license.

name: reticos-rgb: Speedlink RETICOS RGB mouse profile protocol
description_en: reticos-rgb reconstructs the Speedlink RETICOS RGB mouse's HID profile protocol from a capture of its vendor driver. Its Python tools read and back up the onboard profile, change lighting, DPI and polling settings, and decode exported .bkm profiles. The documentation maps feature reports and selected profile bytes.
description_zh: reticos-rgb 根据厂商驱动的 USB 抓包还原 Speedlink RETICOS RGB 鼠标的 HID 配置协议。Python 工具可读取和备份板载配置，修改灯效、DPI 与轮询率，并解析导出的 .bkm 配置文件；文档列出了报告类型和部分字节布局。
requirements: Speedlink RETICOS RGB mouse, hardware revision V3; Windows or Linux.
Windows requires hidapi; Linux uses the included hidraw module and a udev rule or sudo.
The author reports testing one mouse on Windows 10 and Bazzite; one write command and several bytes remain undecoded.
MIT license.

name: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse: a paused native Apple Silicon port
description_en: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse native preserves a paused Apple Silicon port adaptation of the game. Its source supplies Horizon service replacements, IL2CPP and SDK startup integration, NVN-to-Metal rendering, input support and loader diagnostics. The author reports reaching a title loading screen on macOS; menu, gameplay and iPhone operation remain unconfirmed.
description_zh: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse native 保存了该游戏暂停开发的 Apple Silicon 原生移植研究。源码提供 Horizon 服务替代、IL2CPP 与 SDK 启动集成、NVN 到 Metal 的渲染适配、输入和加载器诊断。作者报告 macOS 上到达标题加载画面；菜单、实际游玩及 iPhone 运行尚未确认。
requirements: Matching privately supplied game inputs and generated profiles or tables are required to reproduce the work.
Build and run targets are disabled in the paused snapshot.
An Addressables failure and SDK mount-query rejection block progress beyond the title loading screen.
The preserved component licence is in native-target/LICENSE.

name: SPL Lab Web: NEXT LAB measurement client and device protocol
description_en: SPL Lab Web replaces the measurement functions of the NEXT LAB bass meter's Windows software with a Node service, browser interface and Electron app. Its device protocol document draws on Ghidra decompilation, configuration files and live tests; the client reads USB serial data, computes measurements and exposes an HTTP/SSE API.
description_zh: SPL Lab Web 用 Node 服务、浏览器界面和 Electron 应用替代 NEXT LAB 低音声压计原有 Windows 软件的测量功能。协议文档依据 Ghidra 反编译、配置文件和实机测试整理；客户端读取 USB 串口数据、计算测量结果，并提供 HTTP/SSE API。
requirements: NEXT LAB meter connected by USB for hardware measurements; Node.js 22 or newer to run from source.
The author reports USB operation and synthetic-signal tests; LAN/UDP transport is prepared but untested.
RTA, SQL, PWR, Delay and event management are not implemented.
MIT license.

name: SainSmartDDS140: a USB oscilloscope client built from protocol research
description_en: SainSmartDDS140 reimplements control of the SainSmart DDS140 USB oscilloscope through its recovered USB protocol. The author describes decompiling the vendor .NET app, examining its WinUSB wrapper and checking commands against hardware. A pyusb client exposes capture, calibration, recording and a local browser interface, while protocol notes document control transfers and interleaved channel samples.
description_zh: SainSmartDDS140 根据恢复的 USB 协议控制 SainSmart DDS140 示波器。作者分析厂商 .NET 应用和 WinUSB 封装，并以实机核对命令；pyusb 客户端提供采集、校准、记录和本地浏览器界面，协议文档记录控制传输及双通道交错采样格式。
requirements: A SainSmart DDS140 is required for device capture and hardware self-tests.
Python 3, pyusb and libusb-1.0 are required for the client.
Hardware trigger, eight-channel logic analysis and the signal generator are not implemented.
MIT license.

name: Frontier FS2340: investigating Majority Touro radio firmware
description_en: A firmware investigation of a Majority Touro radio on the Frontier Venice X/FS2340 platform maps compressed update blocks, menu and language tables, graphics, bootloaders and recovery paths. Offline Python tools parse owner-supplied firmware and extract resources; the author reports recovery of one affected unit.
description_zh: 该研究分析采用 Frontier Venice X/FS2340 平台的 Majority Touro 收音机固件，梳理压缩更新块、菜单、语言表、图形、引导程序和恢复路径。离线 Python 工具可解析用户提供的固件并提取资源；作者报告修复过一台受影响设备。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer and the user's own original firmware image are required.
Findings concern one documented Majority Touro firmware version; other devices are unverified.
No installable custom firmware or general recovery method is provided.
MIT licence for original scripts and documentation.

name: haylou-rt-tools: reconstructing Haylou RT BLE and watch-face formats
description_en: haylou-rt-tools reconstructs selected Haylou RT LS05S watch interactions and the .tbwf watch-face format from device observation and study of the Hello Haylou app. Its Python tools query firmware and battery status, pair with the watch, show a text alert during pairing, build and check faces, and preview main text elements. The protocol notes specify BLE services, frame checksums, and command IDs.
description_zh: haylou-rt-tools 根据设备观察和对 Hello Haylou 应用的分析，还原 Haylou RT LS05S 手表的部分交互及 .tbwf 表盘格式。其 Python 工具可查询固件与电量、与手表配对、在配对连接中显示文字提醒、构建和检查表盘，并预览主要文字元素。协议笔记记录了 BLE 服务、帧校验和命令编号。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer and a Haylou RT LS05S watch for device operations.
Documented device tests use firmware V21.01.004.2.1.1.3.51 and Hello Haylou 3.7.19; other versions are untested.
Generated faces and previews have not been confirmed against a real watch screen; direct upload and firmware update code are absent.
MIT License.

name: The Oregon Trail: mapping the Apple II disks, programs and data formats
description_en: The Oregon Trail investigation maps the two disk sides of the Apple II game from their bytes. It documents the DOS 3.3 layout, sector-addressed loader, Applesoft programs, machine-language commands, saved variables, picture packing and music files, with Python readers and recorded outputs.
description_zh: 该研究逐字节分析 Apple II 版 The Oregon Trail 的两个磁盘盘面，记录 DOS 3.3 布局、按扇区地址读取的加载器、Applesoft 程序、机器语言命令、保存的变量表、图像打包格式和音乐文件，并提供 Python 读取工具及分析输出。
requirements: Users supply the two Apple II .do disk images; game bytes are not included.
The tools run with Python 3; PNG rendering additionally needs PIL.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Wizardry IV: Apple II disk and format investigation
description_en: An investigation of the Apple II release of Wizardry IV uses SYSTEM.RELOC to map five disk sides into a virtual volume and examines the separate sixth side. It studies the game's p-machine program, Huffman text, level maps and leftover files, with purpose-built readers and saved command output supporting the format findings.
description_zh: 该研究利用 SYSTEM.RELOC 将 Apple II 版《Wizardry IV》的五张磁盘面还原为虚拟卷，并分析独立的第六张磁盘面。研究还考察游戏的 p-machine 程序、Huffman 编码文本、关卡地图和残留文件，提供专用读取工具及命令输出记录。
requirements: Python 3 and the six Wizardry IV disk images are needed to reproduce the commands.
The author reports that 29.40% of disk blocks were decoded and closed; the rest were identified but not decoded.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Ocypus Digital Controller: reconstructing cooler display communication
description_en: Ocypus Digital Controller implements a Linux daemon and CLI for Ocypus digital cooler displays using USB HID communication recovered from the Ocypus Digital Elite Windows utility. Its documentation maps standard 64-byte reports and a YCC variant, including temperature, utilization, fan and display mode fields.
description_zh: Ocypus Digital Controller 根据对 Windows 软件 Ocypus Digital Elite 的分析，实现了通过 USB HID 驱动散热器显示屏的 Linux 后台服务和命令行工具。文档列出标准 64 字节报文与 YCC 变体的字段，包括温度、利用率、风扇转速和显示模式。
requirements: Requires Linux with /dev/hidraw, Python 3.9+ and a supported Ocypus or related digital cooler display.
The documented USB identifiers and report variants define the supported device scope.
MIT.

name: The Witcher 3: bounded native function recovery for ARM64
description_en: The Witcher 3 native research recovers selected vector, VM, and decoder functions from The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt for ARM64 port experiments. Ghidra helpers extract references, while C models and harnesses compare x64 and ARM64 behavior; the author reports checks of 21 small function bodies and no complete engine or playable port.
description_zh: 该研究为《The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt》的 ARM64 移植实验恢复部分向量、VM 与解码函数。Ghidra 辅助脚本提取参考信息，C 模型和测试程序比较 x64 与 ARM64 行为；作者报告已检查 21 个小型函数体，尚无完整引擎或可运行移植版。
requirements: A user-authorized original executable is needed to generate reference fixtures locally.
The author reports comparison of 21 small native functions; the VM, engine, renderer, asset pipeline, and iPhone app remain incomplete.
No licence file in the repository.

name: dvpn-decrypter: exporting SOLAR Labs dVPN mnemonics
description_en: dvpn-decrypter reconstructs a mnemonic export path for the SOLAR Labs dVPN app. Its Go utility signs in with account credentials, requests the encrypted app key and mnemonic from the service, and uses Themis to decrypt the key and then the mnemonic.
description_zh: dvpn-decrypter 为 SOLAR Labs dVPN 应用重建助记词导出流程。Go 工具使用账户凭据登录，从服务端获取加密的应用密钥与助记词，再用 Themis 依次解密。
requirements: Requires an account email and password.
Requires Themis and Go 1.17; the instructions suggest Linux or Windows with WSL.
No licence file in the repository.

name: DJI RC Plus 2: control protocol and gamepad bridge
description_en: A DJI RC Plus 2 investigation reconstructs its control-report protocol and maps the handheld’s sticks, wheels and buttons to gamepad input. The Android library decodes DUML reports, a tester displays live controls, and a Java SDL3 bridge presents them as an Xbox-style controller. Protocol notes give frame layout, checksums, keepalive and report rates.
description_zh: 该项目调查 DJI RC Plus 2 的控制状态协议，并将摇杆、滚轮和按键映射为手柄输入。Android 库解码 DUML 报告，测试应用显示实时控制状态，Java SDL3 桥接器将其呈现为 Xbox 风格手柄；协议文档列出帧结构、校验、保活消息和报告速率。
requirements: A DJI RC Plus 2 Enterprise running Android 11 is the documented target; building the tester requires JDK 17 and Android SDK.
The protocol notes were checked on RC firmware 01.41.02.08; one additional client can read the controls at a time.
MIT license.

name: AK820 Center: a Linux configurator for the AJAZZ AK820 Pro
description_en: AK820 Center implements a Linux configurator for the AJAZZ AK820 Pro keyboard using a vendor HID protocol recovered from the Windows DeviceDriver.exe. Its protocol notes describe 65-byte feature reports, transaction framing and command banks; the Qt application controls lighting, remapping, macros and TFT uploads over wired USB.
description_zh: AK820 Center 利用从 Windows DeviceDriver.exe 恢复的厂商 HID 协议，为 AJAZZ AK820 Pro 实现 Linux 配置程序。协议文档记录 65 字节功能报告、事务封装和命令区；Qt 程序经有线 USB 管理灯效、键位、宏和 TFT 图像上传。
requirements: AJAZZ AK820 Pro family B keyboard connected by USB-C; 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth control are unsupported.
Linux with Qt 6 Widgets, hidapi, CMake and GCC or Clang.
MIT license.

name: Contax N Digital: reconstructing a CCD Parameter Disc
description_en: The Contax N Digital CCD Parameter Disc recreator rebuilds a camera-specific calibration disc from newly captured RAW dark and white frames. It derives white balance, defective-pixel and reference-image files, then combines them with colour matrices and tone curves extracted from another N Digital disc. The author reports comparison with a known disc but notes unresolved factory scaling details.
description_zh: Contax N Digital CCD Parameter Disc 重建工具使用新拍摄的暗场与白场 RAW 照片恢复相机专属校准数据，并结合从另一张 N Digital 光盘提取的色彩矩阵和色调曲线，生成校准光盘文件。作者报告了与已知光盘的比对结果，同时指出工厂参考图像的缩放方式尚未完全厘清。
requirements: Requires Python 3.8+, numpy, Pillow, a Contax N Digital, RAW reference captures and a model profile containing values obtained from an N Digital disc.
Creating an ISO requires an ISO creation tool; burning a physical disc requires a CD-R writer.
The exact factory scaling of D.TIF and G.TIF remains uncertain; developed images should be checked.
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.

name: Komimi: a Redmi Buds 6 Lite client built on its reconstructed control protocol
description_en: Komimi reconstructs the Redmi Buds 6 Lite control protocol and uses it in a Windows tray client for battery status, noise control, and equalizer presets. Its protocol reference describes RFCOMM transport, framing, and commands, with a reusable C++17 message implementation.
description_zh: Komimi 重建 Redmi Buds 6 Lite 的控制协议，并通过 Windows 托盘客户端显示电量、调整降噪和均衡器预设。协议文档记录 RFCOMM 传输、消息帧及命令，并提供可复用的 C++17 实现。
requirements: Windows 11 x64 and Redmi Buds 6 Lite paired through Windows Bluetooth; Windows 10 is untested.
Visual Studio 2022 or newer with the C++ desktop workload and Windows 11 SDK is required to build.
The author tested one pair; custom EQ curves can be selected but not edited.
MIT License.

name: Fisher & Paykel RF505BRNUX1: decoding refrigerator board traffic
description_en: The Fisher & Paykel RF505BRNUX1 bridge decodes two 9600-baud serial links on the refrigerator's main board and exposes door, setting, compressor, defrost, and temperature states to Home Assistant. Its documentation specifies frame layout, CRC-16/MODBUS, addresses, and byte maps; an ESPHome configuration reads the links without transmitting.
description_zh: Fisher & Paykel RF505BRNUX1 桥接项目解析冰箱主板上的两条 9600 波特串行链路，将门状态、设定值、压缩机、除霜和温度信息送入 Home Assistant。文档说明帧结构、CRC-16/MODBUS、地址和字节映射；ESPHome 配置只接收数据，不向冰箱发送信号。
requirements: A Fisher & Paykel RF505BRNUX1 refrigerator and Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3 are needed for the documented setup.
The ESPHome configuration targets version 2026.10 and requires Wi-Fi secrets and an isolated 5 V supply.
Other F&P or Haier boards may differ; the author advises checking their byte map with a logic analyser.
MIT.

name: Lightstick Vibed Studio: reconstructing the Super Junior Ver. 2 BLE controls
description_en: Lightstick Vibed Studio reconstructs BLE control of the Super Junior Ver. 2 lightstick from study of the SMTOWN Android app and checks on hardware. A local FastAPI console scans the device, sends color and effect commands, and offers a byte-level packet lab. The repository also contains a protocol specification and an Android client awaiting hardware BLE testing.
description_zh: Lightstick Vibed Studio 通过研究 SMTOWN Android 应用并在实物上检查，重建 Super Junior Ver. 2 应援棒的 BLE 控制协议。本地 FastAPI 控制台可扫描设备、发送颜色与灯效命令，并提供逐字节数据包实验界面；仓库还包含协议规格及待实机验证 BLE 功能的 Android 客户端。
requirements: The web console needs a Bluetooth-capable Mac and a Super Junior Ver. 2 lightstick.
Android BLE behavior still requires testing on a physical phone.
MIT license.

name: Chrono Tales: a browser world viewer built from decoded GBox2 archives
description_en: Chrono Tales reconstructs part of the 2012 MMORPG as a three.js browser world viewer using terrain, scenery and a character decoded from the original GBox2 archives. Its Python toolchain extracts .gpak archives, decodes game formats including maps, meshes and animation clips, and exports glTF assets. A format specification records findings from static analysis of chronotales.exe.
description_zh: Chrono Tales 将原版 GBox2 档案中的地形、场景和角色解码，借助 three.js 重建这款 2012 年 MMORPG 的部分世界，供浏览器浏览。项目的 Python 工具可提取 .gpak 档案、解析地图、网格及动画片段等格式，并导出 glTF 资源；格式文档还记录了对 chronotales.exe 的静态分析成果。
requirements: Supply the original Chrono Tales archives; the repository does not distribute game data.
Python 3.12+; pefile and capstone are used for disassembly helpers, and Pillow is optional for textured rendering.
The browser viewer covers the starting zone; character animation, gameplay, other zones and wall collision are unfinished.
MIT License.

name: IOTBT701: BLE LED strip protocol and Windows client
description_en: IOTBT701 BLE LED Strip applies the protocol from the open-source lednetwf_ble integration to a Zengge-family Bluetooth light strip, checks it against the physical device and implements Windows C# clients. The notes describe GATT service FFFF, command characteristic FF01, status characteristic FF02, power and v3 color frames, plus device-specific hue behavior. A GUI maps screen color to the strip.
description_zh: IOTBT701 BLE LED Strip 将开源 lednetwf_ble 集成中的协议用于 Zengge 系列蓝牙灯带，在实体设备上核对后提供 Windows C# 客户端。文档记录 GATT 服务 FFFF、命令特征 FF01、状态特征 FF02、开关及 v3 颜色帧和该设备的色相行为；GUI 可将屏幕颜色映射到灯带。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 and an IOTBT701-family BLE LED strip are the documented environment.
The vendor phone app must be closed while the PC tool holds the GATT connection.
MIT License.

name: OpenCfMoto for iOS: a PXC motorcycle-dashboard client
description_en: OpenCfMoto for iOS reimplements the PXC dashboard exchange used by Carbit and EasyConnect motorcycle displays. The Swift app joins the bike's Wi-Fi, performs the control handshake, streams an H.264 navigation interface, and receives dashboard touch events. Its specifications trace behavior extracted from the Android OpenCfMoto app.
description_zh: OpenCfMoto for iOS 重建 Carbit 与 EasyConnect 摩托车仪表使用的 PXC 通信流程。Swift 应用连接摩托车 Wi-Fi、完成控制握手、传送 H.264 导航画面并接收仪表触摸事件；配套规格文档记录了从 Android 版 OpenCfMoto 提取的行为。
requirements: An iPhone running iOS 17 or later and a compatible Carbit or EasyConnect dashboard are required for device use.
Building from source requires a Mac with Xcode 16 or later.
Version 0.1 is in early field testing; some dashboard types have not been tested with the iOS app.
AGPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: Heat & Glo RC300: a Homey client for the reconstructed 433 MHz protocol
description_en: The Heat & Glo RC300 Homey app reimplements 433 MHz commands from the IntelliFire Plus RC300 fireplace remote. Captures made with Homey's RF recorder inform a documented 47-symbol frame layout; the app learns the user's remote address, sends on/off, flame, and fan commands, and receives remote state changes.
description_zh: Heat & Glo RC300 的 Homey 应用重建 IntelliFire Plus RC300 壁炉遥控器的 433 MHz 命令。项目用 Homey 的 RF 录制器抓取信号，记录 47 符号帧结构；应用学习用户遥控器地址，发送开关、火焰及风扇命令，并接收实体遥控器的状态变化。
requirements: A Homey device, a compatible Heat & Glo IntelliFire Plus RC300 fireplace, and its physical remote are required for pairing.
AUX1 and AUX2 are unsupported because the author did not capture their RF commands.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: APC SU1400RM2U: display pinout and LED driver reconstruction
description_en: An Arduino sketch reconstructs control of the APC SU1400RM2U display panel from its cable pinout and LED mapping. It identifies the A6276ELW LED driver, assigns latch, clock and serial-data lines, and demonstrates individual and sequential LED updates.
description_zh: 该 Arduino 程序依据 APC SU1400RM2U 显示面板的线缆引脚和 LED 编号映射重建面板控制方式。代码标出 A6276ELW 驱动器的锁存、时钟和串行数据线，并演示单灯及顺序点亮。
requirements: An Arduino-compatible controller must connect to the display panel's latch, clock, serial-data, power and ground pins.
The sketch covers display LEDs and button inputs.
No licence file in the repository.

name: lp-engine: rebuilding the LovePlus+ runtime
description_en: lp-engine runs the Nintendo DS game LovePlus+ on desktop systems using the player’s own Japanese game dump. Its Rust runtime executes the original game logic while recreating graphics, sound, input, clock and save services, with higher-resolution rendering and an English translation delta. Research notes document the script VM, game flow and save format.
description_zh: lp-engine 使用玩家自备的日版 LovePlus+ 游戏镜像，在桌面系统上运行这款 Nintendo DS 游戏。Rust 运行时执行原有游戏逻辑，并重建图形、声音、输入、时钟和存档服务，同时提供高分辨率渲染及英语翻译差分。研究笔记记录脚本虚拟机、游戏流程和存档格式。
requirements: A user-owned LovePlus+ Japanese-release BOXJ .nds dump is required; game code and assets are read from that copy.
The documented builds target macOS 11 or later, Windows 10/11 64-bit, or Linux x86-64.
Wireless features requiring a second DS are unsupported.
MIT license.

name: Silverbud: Galaxy Buds3 control over a documented RFCOMM protocol
description_en: Silverbud implements a Windows manager for Galaxy Buds3 over Samsung's RFCOMM control channel. It parses framed status and battery messages and sends settings commands for noise control, equalization and finding earbuds; its protocol notes credit GalaxyBudsClient for base layouts and document Buds3 observations.
description_zh: Silverbud 通过 Samsung 的 RFCOMM 控制通道实现 Windows 版 Galaxy Buds3 管理器，解析带帧结构的状态和电量消息，并发送降噪、均衡器与寻找耳机等设置命令。协议文档注明基础布局来自 GalaxyBudsClient，并记录 Buds3 实机观察结果。
requirements: Windows 10 build 19041 or newer or Windows 11, x64, and Galaxy Buds3 are required; building from source needs the .NET 10 SDK.
The author reports end-to-end testing on Galaxy Buds3 firmware R530XXU0AYG3 with Windows 11 LE Audio; Buds3 Pro remains untested.
Base message IDs and layouts are credited to GalaxyBudsClient.
MIT license.

name: DW3 Remake: reimplementing Digimon World 2003
description_en: DW3 Remake reimplements the PlayStation game Digimon World 2003 in Godot 4 and C#. Its extractor decodes a user-supplied European BIN/CUE disc into a private SQLite and image data pack, which the new game runtime reads. Exploration and dialogue are playable; combat remains in progress.
description_zh: DW3 Remake 用 Godot 4 和 C# 重建 PlayStation 游戏 Digimon World 2003。提取程序把用户自备的欧洲版 BIN/CUE 光盘解码为本地 SQLite 与图像数据包，供新游戏运行时读取。探索和对话可玩，战斗仍在开发中。
requirements: Godot 4.7.2 .NET, .NET 10 SDK, Git and the user’s own Digimon World 2003 European BIN/CUE disc image are required.
Combat fidelity remains under verification; saves, quests, shops, cutscenes and audio have not started.
PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0; the Required Notice must be retained and commercial use is prohibited.

name: hiska-keg450-lcd: reconstructing HISKA keyboard HID control
description_en: hiska-keg450-lcd reconstructs Linux control of the HISKA HX-KEG450 keyboard from vendor HID traffic captured under Wine. Its Python client sends images, animation, lighting, settings, and clock commands through hidraw, while protocol notes specify report sizes, opcodes, acknowledgments, and upload sequences.
description_zh: hiska-keg450-lcd 根据在 Wine 中抓取的厂商 HID 流量，重建 HISKA HX-KEG450 键盘的 Linux 控制方式。Python 客户端通过 hidraw 发送图像、动画、灯效、设置和时钟命令；协议文档记录报告长度、操作码、确认消息及上传序列。
requirements: Requires Linux hidraw, the HX-KEG450 connected by USB-C, Python 3.10 or later, Pillow, and input-group access.
The panel is unavailable over Bluetooth or 2.4 GHz; uploads rewrite screen flash.
MIT license.

name: week-aqua-ble: reconstructing Week Aqua light control over BLE
description_en: week-aqua-ble reconstructs the Week Aqua P1200 Pro aquarium light's BLE commands by decompiling the Android app and recording its writes to a simulated light. ESPHome configurations use the recovered messages for channel brightness, fan, clock and schedule control through Home Assistant.
description_zh: week-aqua-ble 通过反编译 Week Aqua Android 应用，并用模拟灯具记录其 BLE 写入，还原 P1200 Pro 水族灯命令。ESPHome 配置用这些消息通过 Home Assistant 控制各通道亮度、风扇、时钟和日程。
requirements: An ESP32, ESPHome, Home Assistant and a Week Aqua light are needed for the documented setup.
Only the P1200 Pro is reported as tested; other model families are untested.
MIT license.

name: mc4.sav: reconstructing the Midnight Club: Los Angeles save format
description_en: mc4.sav documents the save format written by the Midnight Club: Los Angeles recompiled PC runtime. It maps big-endian section records, career values, garage slots and performance-upgrade bytes from observed saves, and supplies a browser editor and PowerShell commands for inspecting and changing supported fields.
description_zh: mc4.sav 记录 Midnight Club: Los Angeles 重编译 PC 运行时写出的存档格式。项目根据实际存档解析大端序分节记录、职业数据、车库车位和性能升级字节，并提供浏览器编辑器与 PowerShell 命令来查看和修改已知字段。
requirements: The tools expect a plain mc4.sav produced by the MC_LA_Recompiled runtime; Xbox 360 saves must first be extracted from STFS.
Close the game before editing; the tools reject files whose structure fails validation.
Visual customization in garage slots has not been decoded.
MIT License.

name: Eternal Fighter Zero -Memorial-: exact-function source reconstruction
description_en: Eternal Fighter Zero -Memorial- reconstructs source from a locally supplied game executable using Ghidra analysis and a VC7.1 build oracle. Its comparison checks complete COFF function extents after explicitly binding relocation fields. The author reports two exact functions totaling 434 code bytes; the full game and runtime comparison remain unfinished.
description_zh: Eternal Fighter Zero -Memorial- 使用本地提供的游戏可执行文件、Ghidra 分析和 VC7.1 构建比对程序重建源码。比较流程绑定重定位字段后核对完整 COFF 函数范围。作者报告已有两个精确匹配函数，共 434 字节代码；完整游戏和运行时比较仍未完成。
requirements: The user's own Memorial executable matching the documented SHA-256, plus the pinned VC7.1 toolchain and Ghidra 12.1.3.
CPython 3.13.5 for the control scripts.
The author reports an initial checkpoint of two exact functions; the full Windows product and runtime comparison remain open.
MIT license for repository-authored code and documentation.

name: Fosi Audio MD3: mapping the DAC and replacing its controller firmware
description_en: fosi-md3 investigates the Fosi Audio MD3 USB DAC and implements replacement firmware for its ESP32-S3 controller. Its notes map the USB mux, DAC I2C control, Savitech link and stock settings record from hardware observation and firmware disassembly; the ESP-IDF implementation preserves audio control and photo storage. The author reports testing on one unit.
description_zh: fosi-md3 研究 Fosi Audio MD3 USB DAC，并为其 ESP32-S3 控制器实现替代固件。笔记依据硬件观察与原厂固件反汇编，记录 USB 切换、DAC 的 I2C 控制、Savitech 链路及设置记录；ESP-IDF 实现保留音频控制与照片存储。作者报告仅在一台设备上测试。
requirements: A Fosi Audio MD3 unit and a backup of its own 32 MB flash for restoration.
ESP-IDF 5.5.1 and LVGL 9.2 for the replacement firmware; documented use was on macOS.
The author reports testing on one unit; power transitions remain unverified.
MIT license for the repository's original code and documentation.

name: dataflash-re: reconstructing the Dataflash LWR lighting protocol
description_en: dataflash-re reconstructs the LWR control protocol used by Lightwave Research Dataflash xenon strobes. It combines 8051 fixture firmware disassembly, schematics and controller captures to document 9-bit serial frames, then implements an ESP32 bridge from Art-Net, sACN and TouchOSC to the original RS-485 link.
description_zh: dataflash-re 重建 Lightwave Research Dataflash 氙气频闪灯使用的 LWR 控制协议。项目结合 8051 固件反汇编、原理图和控制器采集数据，记录 9 位串行帧，并实现将 Art-Net、sACN 和 TouchOSC 转接至原 RS-485 链路的 ESP32 网桥。
requirements: ESP32 board and suitable RS-485 transceiver for the bridge.
The existing sniffed program library needs recapture after a polarity correction.
MIT license.

name: etnga-obd: mapping Toyota eTNGA vehicle diagnostics
description_en: etnga-obd maps the OBD-II diagnostic surface of Toyota eTNGA vehicles, including the bZ4X, Subaru Solterra and Lexus RZ. It records UDS over ISO-TP addresses, gateway sub-targets, decoded telemetry formulas and selected broadcast CAN frames, with confidence levels for individual findings.
description_zh: etnga-obd 绘制 Toyota eTNGA 平台车辆的 OBD-II 诊断接口映射，涵盖 bZ4X、Subaru Solterra 和 Lexus RZ。资料记录 UDS over ISO-TP 地址、网关子目标、遥测计算公式及部分广播 CAN 帧，并为各项发现标注可信度。
requirements: Access to an eTNGA vehicle's OBD-II diagnostic bus is needed for independent captures.
Coverage is limited to read-only OBD-II diagnostics and visible broadcast frames; three standardized-range IDs remain unidentified.
MIT license for bin/ code; CC BY 4.0 for documentation and decoded knowledge.

name: MechControl: replacing Uniwill laptop control through EC research
description_en: MechControl replaces the OEM Control Center on Uniwill-built MECHREVO, XMG and Eluktronics laptops with a native Windows application. It uses recovered embedded-controller registers, encodings and write sequences to manage CPU and GPU power, fans, battery modes and lighting. The author reports hardware testing on one MECHREVO IDY_7Y board; other model profiles derive from OEM data.
description_zh: MechControl 以原生 Windows 程序替代 Uniwill 代工的 MECHREVO、XMG 和 Eluktronics 笔记本原厂控制中心。它利用恢复出的 EC 寄存器、编码和写入序列管理 CPU/GPU 功率、风扇、电池模式及灯光。作者报告仅在一块 MECHREVO IDY_7Y 主板上完成硬件测试，其他机型配置来自 OEM 数据。
requirements: Windows 10 version 2004 or later, or Windows 11 x64; administrator access and the OEM UWACPIDriver.
A supported Uniwill laptop profile; the project reports hardware testing only on MECHREVO IDY_7Y.
Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools, MSVC v143, CMake tools and Windows SDK for building.
No licence file in the repository.

name: DMR-39 Remote Bridge: reconstructing set-top-box remote control
description_en: DMR-39 Remote Bridge reconstructs remote control of the SUPER DMR-39 set-top box by probing its I2C front panel and capturing NEC infrared signals. The resulting ESP32-C3 firmware and Python tools expose mapped buttons through a web relay, with HDMI capture used to observe responses. The author reports mapping all 41 remote buttons.
description_zh: DMR-39 Remote Bridge 通过探测 SUPER DMR-39 机顶盒前面板的 I2C 交互并捕获 NEC 红外信号，重建遥控功能。ESP32-C3 固件与 Python 工具通过网页中继发送已识别的按键，分析过程用 HDMI 采集观察设备响应。作者报告已映射全部 41 个按键。
requirements: A SUPER DMR-39 set-top box, ESP32-C3, and access to the demodulated IR traces; HDMI capture supports the documented observation workflow.
The author reports finding only one working key code through I2C injection before switching to IR control.
MIT licence.

name: Super Mario Bros.: ca65 reconstruction of seven releases
description_en: Super Mario Bros. Disassembly reconstructs seven NES, Vs. System, and Famicom Disk System releases as readable ca65 modules. Its build splits assets from user supplied images, rebuilds each supported revision, and compares the result byte for byte with the original; documentation maps source modules and game data formats.
description_zh: Super Mario Bros. Disassembly 将七个 NES、Vs. System 和 Famicom Disk System 版本重建为可读的 ca65 模块。构建流程从用户自备镜像提取资源，重新生成各版本并与原版逐字节比较；文档还梳理源码模块和游戏数据格式。
requirements: A user supplied copy of the original Super Mario Bros. image; other revision images are optional.
Python 3, GNU Make, and Retrolarium Kit with rltool available.
The repository grants no license to Nintendo game code or assets; tooling and imported material have separate status documented in docs/licensing.md.

name: Diep.io Parser: reconstructing game packet structure
description_en: Diep.io Parser documents packet structures used by the Diep.io game client and server. Its notes describe update packets, entity deletion and creation fields, and per-build XOR values; a JavaScript parser parses incoming packets and generates outgoing packets.
description_zh: Diep.io Parser 记录 Diep.io 游戏客户端与服务器之间的数据包结构。笔记介绍更新包、实体删除和创建字段，以及随游戏构建版本变化的 XOR 值；JavaScript 解析器可解析传入数据包并生成传出数据包。
requirements: The documented XOR values change with each game build.
No licence file in the repository.

name: opal-c1-revive: mapping the Opal C1 firmware and restoring camera controls
description_en: opal-c1-revive investigates the Opal C1 webcam's Myriad X hardware, 32 MB NOR flash and DepthAI pipeline. It documents the bootloader and app package, supplies scripts to back up flash and edit the pipeline, and provides a macOS menu-bar app for standard UVC controls.
description_zh: opal-c1-revive 分析 Opal C1 摄像头的 Myriad X 硬件、32 MB NOR 闪存和 DepthAI 管线。项目记录引导程序与应用包，提供闪存备份和管线修改脚本，并以 macOS 菜单栏程序控制标准 UVC 参数。
requirements: An Opal C1 webcam is required for device operations; the app requires macOS 27 or newer and Xcode 27 to build.
Flash scripts use depthai earlier than version 3; back up the camera flash before writing.
The face-detection-free pipeline was checked offline but had not been flashed, and UVC extension controls remained unexplored.
No licence file in the repository.

name: maxmessenger: reconstructing the MAX WebSocket client
description_en: maxmessenger reconstructs the MAX messenger web client's WebSocket protocol and implements a Python client around it. Its notes describe binary frames, msgpack IDs, LZ4 payload compression, HELLO/AUTH and chat operations; the codec has synthetic round-trip tests, while a complete live client run remains pending.
description_zh: maxmessenger 根据 MAX 网页客户端的 WebSocket 帧重建通信协议，并据此实现 Python 客户端。协议笔记记录二进制帧、msgpack ID、LZ4 载荷压缩、HELLO/AUTH 及聊天操作；编解码器通过了合成数据的往返测试，但客户端尚未完成针对真实服务器的完整运行测试。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer and a MAX browser session providing a token and device ID.
The full live client run against the server is unfinished; public tests use a synthetic trace.
MIT license.

name: open-drong-display: reconstructing Drong Display USB control
description_en: open-drong-display replaces the Drong Display 1CBE:0003 dongle's Windows software with an IddCx display driver using a reconstructed USB protocol. The project documents bulk-transfer commands and session startup, then sends H.264 frames to the dongle for HDMI output.
description_zh: open-drong-display 为 Drong Display 1CBE:0003 USB 显示棒实现替代 Windows IddCx 驱动。项目依据厂商 DLL 静态分析和设备观察记录 USB 批量传输命令与会话启动流程，并通过该协议发送 H.264 画面供 HDMI 输出。
requirements: Windows 10 2004 or newer or Windows 11, x64, and a Drong Display dongle with USB ID 1CBE:0003.
Building requires Visual Studio 2022 or newer with the C++ desktop workload and Windows Driver Kit 10.0.26100.
NVIDIA and Intel hardware encoding is untested; software encoding is available as a fallback.
MIT license.

name: codex-app for macOS: reconstructing the Codex desktop workspace
description_en: codex-app for macOS reconstructs the Codex desktop workspace as an Electron, React and TypeScript client for the official Codex app-server. Its study combines source and asset inspection, recorded interactions, layout measurements and protocol traces; the client implements chats, editing, diffs, terminals and browser tabs.
description_zh: codex-app for macOS 以 Electron、React 和 TypeScript 复刻 Codex 桌面工作区，并连接官方 Codex app-server。项目通过源码与资源检查、交互记录、布局测量和协议追踪研究原应用；客户端实现聊天、编辑、差异查看、终端和浏览器标签页。
requirements: macOS 13 or newer, Node.js 24.11 or newer, and a configured Codex CLI or app-server are required.
Functional and visual parity are incomplete; remote integration, MCP Apps, voice and some Git review workflows have gaps.
No licence file in the repository.

name: FIIL headphones: reconstructing Bluetooth control commands
description_en: The FIIL headphone study reconstructs Bluetooth control framing and command behavior from FIIL+ 3.5.2 analysis and headset captures. Its documents cover GAIA, Mate and Doubao command spaces, SPP and BLE GATT transport, connection handshakes and response parsing.
description_zh: FIIL 耳机研究结合 FIIL+ 3.5.2 静态分析和耳机抓包，还原蓝牙控制帧与指令行为。文档涵盖 GAIA、Mate、豆包命令空间，以及 SPP、BLE GATT 传输、连接握手和应答解析。
requirements: Hardware observations cover one FIIL Key Max headset with firmware 3.0.1.1.
Other models, custom EQ writes, Doubao voice payloads and OTA are outside the device tests.
CC BY-SA 4.0 license.

name: zhihu-core: mapping Zhihu request signatures and session behavior
description_en: zhihu-core implements a Node.js Zhihu API client alongside findings on web request signatures, anti-bot cookies and authenticated sessions. Its notes describe the x-zse-96 body-signing rule, the paired d_c0 and z_c0 cookies, and invitation endpoints found in the Android client; some invitation request formats remain unresolved.
description_zh: zhihu-core 实现 Node.js 知乎 API 客户端，并记录网页请求签名、反爬 Cookie 与登录态的研究结果。笔记说明 x-zse-96 对请求体的签名规则、d_c0 与 z_c0 的配对关系，以及从 Android 客户端找到的邀请端点；部分邀请请求格式仍未解出。
requirements: Node.js and browser-exported Zhihu cookies are needed for authenticated requests.
The x-zse-96 signer is ported from zhihu-plus-plus.
The POST invitation parameter format remains unresolved.
No licence file in the repository.

name: 喜鹊儿 App: reconstructing login, timetable and attendance API behavior
description_en: The 喜鹊儿 App notes reconstruct login, timetable and attendance API behavior from packet captures, app decompilation and active server probes. They describe school routing, action/step requests, timetable day buckets and attendance checks, and pair those findings with a small Python client. The request-envelope encoder remains a version-specific placeholder.
description_zh: 喜鹊儿 App 笔记通过抓包、应用反编译和服务端探测，还原登录、课表及签到接口行为。文档说明学校路由、action/step 请求、课表按星期分桶及签到校验，并附有简化的 Python 客户端；请求信封编码仍需按版本补全。
requirements: Python and the requests package for the included client.
The request-envelope encoding must be implemented for the relevant app version.
Each note identifies behavior that remains unconfirmed.
MIT licence.

name: INNO X2 for macOS: reconstructing mouse control over HID
description_en: INNO X2 for macOS reconstructs configuration of the VortexSeries INNO X2 PRO mouse through its vendor HID feature reports. Its Swift app sets DPI, polling rate, buttons and macros, and shows battery status; the notes document 64-byte packets, checksums, receiver exchanges and opcodes.
description_zh: INNO X2 for macOS 通过厂商 HID 功能报告重建 VortexSeries INNO X2 PRO 鼠标的配置功能。Swift 应用可设置 DPI、回报率、按键和宏并显示电量；文档记录了 64 字节报文、校验和、接收器交互及操作码。
requirements: An INNO X2 PRO mouse connected by 2.4 GHz receiver or USB cable; macOS 15 or later.
Xcode 16 or later with the Swift 6 toolchain to build from source.
Bluetooth mode cannot be configured; only the INNO X2 PRO has been tested.
MIT licence.

name: pro2-linux: reconstructing Logitech PRO 2 LIGHTSPEED control on Linux
description_en: pro2-linux reconstructs configuration of the Logitech G PRO 2 LIGHTSPEED mouse on Linux from its HID++ 2.0 exchanges and onboard profile format 0x07. Its Python tools and libratbag patch handle DPI, report rate, RGB and button settings, while protocol notes record feature IDs and report layouts.
description_zh: pro2-linux 根据 Logitech G PRO 2 LIGHTSPEED 的 HID++ 2.0 交互及 0x07 板载配置格式，在 Linux 上实现鼠标设置功能。Python 工具与 libratbag 补丁覆盖 DPI、回报率、RGB 和按键配置，协议笔记记录了功能 ID 与报文布局。
requirements: Linux and a Logitech G PRO 2 LIGHTSPEED; Python 3.10+, Meson, Ninja, a C compiler, GTK 3/PyGObject and libratbag build dependencies.
Back up onboard profiles before writing; profile writes persist on the mouse.
The author reports wired USB testing on one unit; receiver support needs testing on more units.
MIT licence.

name: Blake Stone: static recompilation of Aliens of Gold and Planet Strike
description_en: Blakestone statically recompiles Blake Stone: Aliens of Gold and Planet Strike from user-supplied DOS executables into native Windows, Linux and macOS programs. Its lift driver uses pcrecomp to translate 16-bit x86 functions to C, while a local runtime implements the DOS, video, audio and input services the games expect.
description_zh: Blakestone 从用户提供的 DOS 可执行文件静态重编译 Blake Stone: Aliens of Gold 和 Planet Strike，生成 Windows、Linux 与 macOS 原生程序。其驱动使用 pcrecomp 将 16 位 x86 函数提升为 C，并以本地运行时实现游戏所需的 DOS、图像、音频和输入服务。
requirements: Users need their own Aliens of Gold v2.10R and Planet Strike V1.01 game files; other versions are untested.
The project is in alpha: the author reports scripted conformance runs, but neither game has had a full playthrough and macOS has not been run on a Mac.
MIT license.

name: NosCore.ClientLab: statically recompiling the NosTale client for browser tests
description_en: NosCore.ClientLab statically recompiles a user-supplied NosTale Windows client from x86 into C and WebAssembly for automated tests against a NosCore server. Ghidra and IDR provide function information, a custom lifter translates instructions, and a browser host replaces Windows graphics, audio and networking services.
description_zh: NosCore.ClientLab 将用户自行提供的 NosTale Windows 客户端由 x86 静态重编译为 C 和 WebAssembly，以便在浏览器中对 NosCore 服务器进行自动化测试。Ghidra 与 IDR 提供函数信息，自定义提升器翻译指令，浏览器宿主替代 Windows 图形、音频及网络服务。
requirements: A user-supplied NosCore-patched NosTale client and a NosCore server are required.
The documented pipeline uses Python 3 with capstone and pefile, Emscripten and Ghidra 12; IDR requires Windows.
Browser execution requires Chromium with WebAssembly JavaScript Promise Integration.
MIT license.

name: beam-revival: local Beam+ control from motor protocol research
description_en: beam-revival reconstructs local control of the Suitable Technologies Beam+ telepresence robot after its cloud service ended. Its Python stack implements the documented motor-board serial protocol and provides browser driving, camera video, audio and docking, plus tools to build a bootable USB image.
description_zh: beam-revival 在 Beam+ 云服务停止后重建本地控制能力。其 Python 系统实现了文档记录的电机板串行协议，提供浏览器驾驶、摄像头视频、音频和停靠功能，并附有构建可启动 USB 镜像的工具。
requirements: A Beam+ with a working battery, a 16 GB or larger USB stick, and a Linux image-building machine are needed for robot use.
The author reports testing core driving on a real Beam+; AI driving has only been tried in the simulator, and BeamPro is untested.
MIT license.

name: Robotech: Battlecry: statically recompiling the Xbox game for PC
description_en: Robotech: Battlecry ports the 2002 Xbox game to PC by statically recompiling a user-supplied XBE into C and linking it to a replacement Xbox runtime. The project adds an x86 frontend, symbol maps, handwritten engine code and Direct3D 11, sound and input bridges. The author reports that the menu and selected missions run, with frame comparisons against xemu.
description_zh: Robotech: Battlecry 把用户自备的 2002 年 Xbox 游戏 XBE 静态重编译为 C，再连接替代 Xbox 运行时以移植到 PC。项目提供 x86 前端、符号映射、手写引擎代码，以及 Direct3D 11、声音和输入桥接。作者报告菜单与部分任务已能运行，并与 xemu 做逐帧对照。
requirements: The user’s own Robotech: Battlecry game files, including default.xbe, dsstdfx.bin and Media, are required.
The documented build needs Python 3.10 or later with Capstone, CMake 3.20 or later, MSVC x64 and an adjacent xboxrecomp checkout.
The Direct3D 11 bridge and broader platform and feature support remain incomplete.
BSD-3-Clause license.

name: Juiced: static recompilation of the Windows game executable
description_en: Juiced documents an x86-32 static recompilation of the 2005 Windows game executable into portable C using pcrecomp. Ghidra analysis, PE-section findings, build scripts, a runtime entry point and differential-test work accompany the pipeline. The original executable and generated lifted units stay outside the repository.
description_zh: Juiced 项目用 pcrecomp 将 2005 年 Windows 游戏的 x86-32 可执行文件静态重编译为可移植 C。仓库提供 Ghidra 分析、PE 节区记录、构建脚本、运行时入口及差异测试资料；原始程序和生成的提升代码保留在仓库外。
requirements: The user's Juiced.exe, pcrecomp, Python, Ghidra and the documented build toolchain are required.
The encrypted .securom section and a zero-filled section are excluded from lifting.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Skies of Arcadia Legends: matching GameCube decompilation
description_en: The Skies of Arcadia Legends project reconstructs C source for the USA GameCube release and builds a byte-identical main.dol from a user-provided disc image. It tracks function-level matches, uses objdiff for comparison and documents compiler behavior affecting Sega's Ninja graphics library; some matched library code is imported with attribution.
description_zh: Skies of Arcadia Legends 项目为美国版 GameCube 游戏重建 C 源码，并使用用户提供的光盘镜像构建字节一致的 main.dol。项目逐函数统计匹配情况，借助 objdiff 比对，并记录影响 Sega Ninja 图形库匹配的编译器行为；部分已匹配的库代码注明了外部来源。
requirements: An existing copy of the GEAE8P Rev 0 USA game disc image is required.
Python and Ninja are required for the build; Linux and macOS builds also use wibo.
The author reports 74.75% of code bytes matched with stock compilers; the work remains in progress.
CC0-1.0 license for the repository's own work; imported library source retains documented upstream provenance.

name: Spirit Halloween Remote: decoding Multi-Prop radio commands
description_en: Spirit Halloween Remote documents radio messages recovered from a Spirit Multi-Prop remote and replays four captured commands through a Raspberry Pi nRF24L01+ transmitter. The protocol notes give the 250 kbit/s setting, channel, address and 22-byte command bodies; an optional Home Assistant bridge exposes trigger buttons.
description_zh: Spirit Halloween Remote 记录从 Spirit Multi-Prop 遥控器还原的无线消息，并通过树莓派连接的 nRF24L01+ 重放四条指令。协议文档列出 250 kbit/s 速率、信道、地址和 22 字节指令体；可选的 Home Assistant 桥接提供触发按钮。
requirements: A Raspberry Pi with Linux SPI and GPIO access, an nRF24L01+ radio and a matching powered receiver are required.
The author reports testing one remote and receiver setup; compatibility with other units or revisions is unestablished.
Packet field meanings, checksum and radio-chip identity remain unresolved.
MIT license.

name: NXOSC Reborn: reconstructing Waves Nx Head Tracker BLE output
description_en: NXOSC Reborn reconstructs the Waves Nx Head Tracker's BLE communication from analysis of Nxosc and captures from a physical tracker. Its Python app decodes orientation packets and sends configurable OSC messages to spatial-audio software, with profiles, smoothing and adjustable output rate.
description_zh: NXOSC Reborn 通过分析 Nxosc 和实体追踪器抓取数据，还原 Waves Nx Head Tracker 的 BLE 通信。Python 程序解码姿态数据，并以可配置的 OSC 消息发送给空间音频软件，支持配置文件、平滑处理和发送速率调节。
requirements: A Waves Nx Head Tracker and Bluetooth access are required.
Python 3.10+ is required to run from source; Linux operation is untested.
Bridgehead raw= and /travel are not implemented.
MIT license.

name: OpenCrown PC: a native Dragon's Crown Pro host for console dumps
description_en: OpenCrown PC runs Dragon's Crown Pro from a user-supplied decrypted PS4 or PS5 dump on Windows and Linux. Its native loader executes the game's code while replacing PS4 libraries, rendering, input, saves and online services; the repository includes format readers and a separate Linux host.
description_zh: OpenCrown PC 在 Windows 和 Linux 上运行用户自行提供的《Dragon's Crown Pro》PS4 或 PS5 解密镜像。原生加载器执行游戏代码，并替代 PS4 系统库、渲染、输入、存档和联机服务；仓库还包含格式读取代码及独立的 Linux 宿主。
requirements: A user-supplied decrypted Dragon's Crown Pro CUSA10454 dump is required for Windows and Linux.
Windows 10/11 x64 or 64-bit Linux with glibc 2.35 or later is required.
The Android beta requires a user-supplied decrypted PS Vita PCSE00019 base game and 1.09 update.
No licence file in the repository.

name: BLE LED Matrix Controller: reconstructing GIF upload for a 96×20 display
description_en: BLE LED Matrix Controller investigates the BLE commands of an ATOTOZONE CI-VIALD19 96×20 LED matrix and supplies a Python uploader for GIFs and static images. Its notes record packet acknowledgments and commands for brightness and screen blanking; the author reports successful GIF uploads below 49,980 bytes.
description_zh: BLE LED Matrix Controller 研究 ATOTOZONE CI-VIALD19 96×20 LED 屏的 BLE 命令，并提供上传 GIF 与静态图像的 Python 脚本。笔记记录数据包确认通知、亮度和息屏命令；作者报告可上传小于 49,980 字节的 GIF。
requirements: An ATOTOZONE CI-VIALD19 96×20 BLE LED matrix is the documented target.
The author reports support for GIF files under 49,980 bytes.
Brightness control, stored-animation switching and drawing uploads remain unimplemented.
MIT License.

name: HotaSim: reconstructing Horn of the Abyss battle mechanics
description_en: HotaSim reimplements selected Heroes III: Horn of the Abyss battle mechanics in C++ and uses them in a battle simulator. The author describes reverse-engineering game code, recording Cheat Engine addresses and annotating AI disassembly. The simulator currently handles simple melee units without additional abilities.
description_zh: HotaSim 用 C++ 重建《魔法门之英雄无敌 III：深渊号角》的部分战斗机制，并用于战斗模拟。作者记录了游戏代码分析、Cheat Engine 地址及 AI 反汇编注释。当前模拟器仅处理没有额外能力的简单近战单位。
requirements: Visual Studio and the Horn of the Abyss game are needed for the documented build and analysis workflow.
Simulation is limited to simple melee units, and the outcome replay is buggy.
MIT license.

name: 4x4e: reconstructing 4x4 Evolution Build 57
description_en: 4x4e reconstructs source for Terminal Reality's 4x4 Evolution Build 57 from analysis of the original binaries. The repository contains game code and DirectX and OpenGL renderers. Its stated goal is a playable implementation; the source is incompatible with the original Build 44 release.
description_zh: 4x4e 根据原始二进制文件重建 Terminal Reality《4x4 Evolution》Build 57 的源码。仓库包含游戏代码以及 DirectX 和 OpenGL 渲染器。项目以实现可玩的游戏为目标；其源码与最初的 Build 44 版本不兼容。
requirements: Microsoft Visual Studio and the DirectX 9.0 SDK are required.
The source targets Build 57 and is incompatible with the original Build 44 release.
MIT license.

name: Thecus N7510: reconstructing front-panel control on Linux
description_en: Thecus N7510 on modern Linux restores the NAS front-panel LCD, buttons, fans and LEDs with Python daemons. The investigation images the original firmware DOM, traces and disassembles its agent2 daemon, then documents serial frames exchanged with the ATmega168 panel controller and maps board pins. The author reports testing on one N7510.
description_zh: Thecus N7510 on modern Linux 用 Python 服务恢复该 NAS 的前面板 LCD、按键、风扇和 LED。研究先对原厂固件 DOM 制作镜像，再跟踪并反汇编 agent2 服务，记录其与 ATmega168 面板控制器交换的串口帧及主板引脚映射。作者报告在一台 N7510 上测试。
requirements: A Thecus N7510 and the user's own internal DOM firmware image for reproducing the analysis.
Python 3.7 or later, systemd and the named mainline kernel drivers.
Only one N7510 was tested; other Thecus models and the eSATA LED remain untested or unsupported.
MIT license.

name: Blood Omen 2: functional decompilation toward a Switch port
description_en: BloodOmen2NX functionally decompiles the Spanish Windows PC release of Blood Omen 2 into C++17 for a planned Nintendo Switch port. The Linux host build reads game formats and renders a level for comparison with the original under Wine. The author reports that no chapter can yet be completed and the Switch backend has not begun.
description_zh: BloodOmen2NX 将《血兆 2》西班牙语 Windows PC 版进行功能性反编译，译成 C++17，目标是移植到 Nintendo Switch。Linux 主机构建可读取游戏格式并渲染关卡，与 Wine 下的原版对比。作者称目前尚无法完成任何章节，Switch 后端也未开工。
requirements: The user's own Blood Omen 2 PC game files are required.
Linux with C++17, CMake, SDL2 and OpenGL is the current development environment.
The author reports that no chapter can yet be completed; the Switch backend has not started.
The LICENSE file states that no license has been chosen and no rights are granted yet.

name: LSC Smart Connect / Battletron: reconstructing LAN lighting control
description_en: LSC Smart Connect / Battletron reconstructs the desktop application's LAN lighting protocol in a Rust bridge for SignalRGB. It supports QR login, authenticated local color streaming and device management, with a JavaScript and QML plugin for the SignalRGB canvas.
description_zh: LSC Smart Connect / Battletron 将桌面应用的局域网灯控协议还原为供 SignalRGB 使用的 Rust 桥接程序。项目支持二维码登录、经认证的本地色彩串流及设备管理，并提供 JavaScript 与 QML 插件。
requirements: Windows, SignalRGB, an LSC Smart Connect account and already paired Wi-Fi lights are required.
The PC and lights must share a reachable LAN.
Compatibility was checked only against the author's device group; LotusLamp Bluetooth is excluded.
MIT license.

name: Razer Key Light Chroma: a SignalRGB client for its lighting protocol
description_en: Razer Key Light Chroma adds local RGB control to SignalRGB using the lamp's documented TCP and UDP message sequence. It performs acknowledged setup on TCP port 10003, streams 95-byte color packets on UDP port 10005, and includes fixtures and tests comparing packets with the original SDK.
description_zh: Razer Key Light Chroma 插件根据灯具的 TCP 与 UDP 消息流程，为 SignalRGB 加入本地 RGB 控制。它在 TCP 10003 端口完成带确认的初始化，再通过 UDP 10005 端口发送 95 字节颜色包，并附有与原始 SDK 数据包对比的样例和测试。
requirements: A Razer Key Light Chroma paired to a reachable local network, SignalRGB, and the lamp's IPv4 address.
Control covers the Chroma RGB section; automatic network scanning and white-panel control are absent.
MIT license.

name: lochinvar-native-modbus: mapping Knight boiler telemetry
description_en: lochinvar-native-modbus reconstructs the read-only Modbus register map exposed by Lochinvar Knight boilers through the SMART SYSTEM display's USB PC Connection port. Probe scripts and display comparisons identify telemetry for temperatures, firing rate, flame signal and counters; ESPHome and MQTT bridges publish readings to Home Assistant.
description_zh: lochinvar-native-modbus 重建 Lochinvar Knight 锅炉 SMART SYSTEM 显示屏 USB PC Connection 端口的只读 Modbus 寄存器映射。项目用探测脚本对照显示屏读数，识别温度、燃烧负荷率、火焰信号和计数器数据，并通过 ESPHome 或 MQTT 将读数发送至 Home Assistant。
requirements: A boiler with the SMART SYSTEM display and USB PC Connection port, a USB cable, and an ESP32-S3 board or Linux Docker host.
Home Assistant is required; the MQTT route also needs a broker.
Only read requests are implemented; lockout codes are not mapped, and some values remain guesses.
No licence file in the repository.

name: BtCarKey: reconstructing a BLE car-key box client
description_en: BtCarKey implements an Android client for a keyless car box using a reconstructed FTK BLE interface. Its protocol notes map advertising data, GATT UUIDs, a 16-byte frame header, checksums, challenge authentication and car control commands. The client uses those messages to pair with and operate the box.
description_zh: BtCarKey 根据重建的 FTK BLE 接口，为车载钥匙盒实现 Android 客户端。协议文档记录广播数据、GATT UUID、16 字节帧头、校验和、挑战认证及车辆控制命令；客户端据此完成配对和操作。
requirements: Android 10 or later and a compatible BLE keyless car box are required.
Smart unlock requires Android 12 or later.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Cindy Band: a client for the Xiaomi Smart Band 8 BLE protocol
description_en: Cindy Band implements PC and Android clients for Xiaomi Smart Band 8 NFC using a documented BLE protocol. The project records FE95 GATT framing, cmd26/27 authentication, HKDF session keys and AES-CCM business frames, alongside a local server and MCP access to band functions.
description_zh: Cindy Band 基于所记录的 BLE 协议，实现小米手环 8 NFC 的 PC 与 Android 客户端。项目说明了 FE95 GATT 分帧、cmd26/27 认证、HKDF 会话密钥及 AES-CCM 业务帧，并提供本地服务端和访问手环功能的 MCP 接口。
requirements: A Xiaomi Smart Band 8 NFC and its binding key or an unbound device for experimental local binding.
Python 3.10 or newer for the PC client, or Android 8.0 or newer for the Android client.
Local binding field order remains unconfirmed on an unbound device; custom watch faces are still under study.
MIT license.

name: printer-craft: reconstructing PdfCraft.app's CUPS printing pipeline
description_en: printer-craft reconstructs the CUPS printing pipeline identified in PdfCraft.app as a Python library and CLI. Its analysis maps Mach-O symbols and disassembly to printer discovery through lpstat, PPD option parsing through lpoptions, argument assembly and print submission through lp.
description_zh: printer-craft 将 PdfCraft.app 的 CUPS 打印流程重建为 Python 库和命令行工具。分析报告结合 Mach-O 符号与反汇编，梳理 lpstat 发现打印机、lpoptions 解析 PPD 选项、组装参数及通过 lp 提交任务的流程。
requirements: Python 3.9 or later on macOS or Linux, with CUPS command-line binaries.
MIT license.

name: studo.js: a client for Studo's recovered chat API
description_en: studo.js implements a TypeScript client for the Studo app's REST and socket.io chat interfaces after APK and network-packet analysis. Its endpoint notes cover request headers and API paths, while the client handles SMS login, channels, tabs, topics and messages.
description_zh: studo.js 在分析 Studo Android APK 与网络数据包后，实现其 REST 和 socket.io 聊天接口的 TypeScript 客户端。文档列出请求头和 API 路径，客户端支持短信登录、频道、标签页、话题与消息操作。
requirements: A Studo session token is needed for authenticated use; the project describes obtaining one through its site or adb.
The client currently focuses primarily on chat.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: a2854-siri-remote-linux: reconstructing Siri Remote BLE and IR controls
description_en: a2854-siri-remote-linux reconstructs Apple Siri Remote A2854 button and voice notifications for a Linux bridge that reads btmon output. It documents GATT button values, a 100-byte Opus audio wrapper, and an IR provisioning sequence observed through HID reports; separate research examines the remote's flash image and IR database.
description_zh: a2854-siri-remote-linux 解析 Apple Siri Remote A2854 的按键与语音通知，并通过读取 btmon 输出实现 Linux 桥接。项目记录 GATT 按键值、100 字节 Opus 音频封装及通过 HID 报告观察到的 IR 写入流程；另有对遥控器闪存映像和 IR 数据库的分析。
requirements: An Apple Siri Remote 3rd generation A2854 and a Linux host with Bluetooth are required for the bridge.
The documented rig uses Ubuntu 24.04, BlueZ 5.72 and btmon access.
The left d-pad button value was untested; the investigated appliance did not respond to the IR approximation.
MIT License.

name: MAL Private API: reconstructing MyAnimeList Android endpoints
description_en: MAL Private API documents the private MyAnimeList JSON interface recovered from version 0.11.8 of its Android app and supplies a Node.js client. Its reference describes request encoding, selected endpoint fields, and client-ID use for the examined app version.
description_zh: MAL Private API 记录从 MyAnimeList Android 应用 0.11.8 版分析得到的私有 JSON 接口，并提供 Node.js 客户端。参考文档说明请求编码、部分端点字段和所研究版本的客户端 ID 用法。
requirements: The documented behavior comes from MyAnimeList Android app version 0.11.8.
package.json declares an ISC license; no LICENSE file appears in the repository.

name: ReChan: reimplementing Jackie Chan Stuntmaster for PC
description_en: ReChan reimplements Jackie Chan Stuntmaster's PlayStation game logic and systems in C++ for x86_64 Windows and Linux. It rebuilds data structures and formats, extracts required assets locally from a user's NTSC-U disc image, and adds widescreen, higher-resolution and keyboard-and-mouse support.
description_zh: ReChan 将 PlayStation 游戏 Jackie Chan Stuntmaster 的逻辑和系统以 C++ 重建，运行于 x86_64 Windows 与 Linux。项目还原数据结构与格式，从用户自备的 NTSC-U 光盘映像中本地提取资源，并增加宽屏、高分辨率及键鼠支持。
requirements: A legally obtained Jackie Chan Stuntmaster NTSC-U disc image, SLUS-00684, in .bin or .iso format is required.
The supported platforms are x86_64 Windows and Linux; PAL releases are unsupported.
MIT License applies to the ReChan codebase.

name: Better Essential Space: reconstructing a macOS client for Nothing's service
description_en: Better Essential Space reconstructs access to Nothing's Essential Space in a native macOS client after studying its Android app and undocumented APIs. It implements the five-step account login, request signing, record and collection retrieval, audio downloads, and edits to record titles, summaries, and topics; research notes and Frida scripts document the findings.
description_zh: Better Essential Space 研究 Nothing 的 Android 应用和未公开 API，重建了原生 macOS 客户端。客户端实现五步账号登录、请求签名、记录与集合读取、音频下载，以及记录标题、摘要和主题编辑；研究笔记与 Frida 脚本保存了相关发现。
requirements: Requires macOS 26 or later and Xcode 26 to build the SwiftUI app.
Requires a Nothing account.
MIT license.

name: hd60-macos: reconstructing Elgato HD60 USB control on macOS
description_en: hd60-macos recreates host control of the original Elgato Game Capture HD60 on macOS from USB traces of Elgato's application. Its libusb driver uploads a user-extracted firmware image, replays trace-derived I²C initialization sequences, and streams H.264 video and audio as MPEG-TS to stdout, UDP, or OBS.
description_zh: hd60-macos 根据 Elgato 应用的 USB 抓取记录，在 macOS 上重建原版 Game Capture HD60 的主机控制流程。libusb 驱动上传用户自行提取的固件，重放由抓取记录生成的 I²C 初始化序列，并将 H.264 视频和音频以 MPEG-TS 输出到标准输出、UDP 或 OBS。
requirements: Requires the original HD60, macOS, Homebrew, Xcode command line tools, and libusb.
The firmware image must be extracted from Elgato Game Capture HD; it is not included.
Only the original HD60 is supported; the camera extension builds but is untested.
MIT license.

name: Lumalou Revival: reconstructing the lamp's encrypted BLE control
description_en: Lumalou Revival reconstructs control of the Fisher-Price Lumalou lamp after its app was discontinued. An ESPHome bridge and Python client implement the documented MPID BLE exchange, including ECDH session setup, AES-128-CTR packets and framed sound-and-light commands. The reference lists 68 opcodes; the author reports testing on one lamp.
description_zh: Lumalou Revival 在原应用停用后重建 Fisher-Price Lumalou 灯具的控制方式。ESPHome 网关和 Python 客户端实现了已记录的 MPID BLE 通信，包括 ECDH 会话建立、AES-128-CTR 数据包及声光命令帧。参考文档列出 68 个操作码；作者报告仅在一台灯具上测试。
requirements: A Fisher-Price Lumalou lamp; tests used toy-IC firmware 1.99.
An ESP32 board with BLE and ESPHome, or a Bluetooth PC with Python 3.10 or later.
The lamp accepts one BLE connection at a time; music timer and routine music controls are absent from the web page.
MIT license.

name: EasyKit: reconstructing local TLS and SIP control of a door station
description_en: The EasyKit investigation reconstructs local access to a BTicino / Legrand door station from companion-app analysis and SIP-TLS traffic. Its scripts recover the owner's TLS client identity; the author reports a successful handshake and accepted SIP registration. The author also reports a separate home service for ring photos and lock release, whose implementation remains unpublished.
description_zh: EasyKit 调查通过分析配套 Android 应用和 SIP-TLS 通信，还原 BTicino / Legrand 门禁机的本地访问方式。脚本提取设备所有者的 TLS 客户端身份；作者报告已成功完成握手并获得 SIP 注册响应。作者还报告在家中运行来铃拍照和开锁服务，其实现尚未公开。
requirements: An owned EasyKit door station, its companion app and LAN access are required.
The documented environment uses jadx, Frida, mbedTLS 3.6.x and PJSIP 2.17.
The always-on ring, photo and lock-release service is not published.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Bull MosHome: reconstructing cloud controls for Home Assistant
description_en: Bull MosHome implements a Python client and Home Assistant integration using MosHome cloud behavior analyzed from the Android app and network requests. Its protocol notes cover x-ca HMAC-SHA256 signing, login encryption, HTTPS controls and MQTT state updates for supported switches, lights, curtains and chargers.
description_zh: Bull MosHome 根据对 MosHome Android 应用和网络请求的分析，实现 Python 客户端及 Home Assistant 集成。协议文档记录 x-ca HMAC-SHA256 签名、登录加密、HTTPS 控制和 MQTT 状态回推，支持开关、灯、窗帘及充电桩等设备。
requirements: Home Assistant 2024.6 or later and a MosHome account with password login are required for the integration.
Unknown load devices are created disabled by default; certain device classes remain read-only.
MIT license.

name: HDF / HarmonyOS: mapping driver IPC and Linux userland compatibility
description_en: The HDF / HarmonyOS investigation maps the Driver Foundation's user-to-kernel IPC path and tests selected HarmonyOS libraries on Linux. It records the HDF_WRITE_READ ioctl, HdfWriteReadBuf layout and I2C command IDs, supported by harness code, a kernel stub and QEMU experiment logs.
description_zh: HDF / HarmonyOS 研究梳理 Driver Foundation 从用户态到内核的 IPC 路径，并测试部分 HarmonyOS 库在 Linux 上的运行情况。项目记录 HDF_WRITE_READ ioctl、HdfWriteReadBuf 结构和 I2C 命令编号，附有测试程序、内核桩模块及 QEMU 实验日志。
requirements: Reproduction requires user-provided HarmonyOS libraries and image sysroot, a DevEco-compatible clang toolchain and a Linux VM for kernel tests.
Firmware images, proprietary shared libraries and kernel binaries are not included.
HDF Research Viewing License 1.0 permits viewing and study but limits reuse and redistribution.

name: Link: The Faces of Evil — a native PC port of the CD-i decompilation
description_en: A native Windows port of Link: The Faces of Evil runs C code from the Philips CD-i game decompilation and replaces CD-i video, audio, disc and input services with an SDL3 host. It reads the player's own raw disc image and includes a small 68000 interpreter for enemy graphics stored on the disc.
description_zh: 该项目把 Philips CD-i 游戏《Link: The Faces of Evil》的反编译 C 代码移植到 Windows，以 SDL3 实现视频、音频、光盘和输入接口。运行时读取玩家自己的原始光盘镜像，并用小型 68000 解释器处理光盘上的敌人图形代码。
requirements: A user-supplied raw 2352-byte-sector disc image of Link: The Faces of Evil is required.
Building requires WSL or Linux, make, Python 3, 32-bit MinGW and SDL3 MinGW development files.
The port is early and the author reports that bugs remain.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon: a Windows port of decompiled CD-i code
description_en: The Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon PC port runs the CD-i game's decompiled C code natively on Windows. An SDL3-based layer replaces video, audio, disc and input hardware behavior while loading game data from the user's own disc image. The port supports five regional releases.
description_zh: Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon PC 移植版让这款 CD-i 游戏的反编译 C 代码在 Windows 原生运行。基于 SDL3 的替代层处理视频、音频、光盘和输入，并从用户自有光盘镜像读取游戏数据。移植版支持五个地区版本。
requirements: A user-owned raw 2352-byte-sector disc image of a supported release is required; game data is not included.
Building requires Linux or WSL, make, Python 3, 32-bit MinGW and SDL3 MinGW development files.
The port is early and the author expects bugs.
No licence file in the repository.

name: MK Typist research: mapping a keyboard and its bootloader
description_en: MK Typist research maps the Mechanical Keyboards MK Typist keyboard and its stock firmware while developing a QMK port. The notes cover its Holtek HT32F52352 board, flash layout, Cheng Yong IAP boot flow, USB identities, update behavior, pinout and captured command output from one unit.
description_zh: MK Typist research 在移植 QMK 的过程中解析 Mechanical Keyboards MK Typist 键盘及原厂固件，记录 Holtek HT32F52352 电路板、闪存布局、Cheng Yong IAP 启动流程、USB 标识、更新行为、引脚和单台设备的命令抓取结果。
requirements: Findings come from one MK Typist unit with stock firmware V1.00.05; the QMK port is maintained in a separate repository.
The chip ships with flash protection enabled; unlocking it mass-erases the stock IAP bootloader.
Documentation, photos and OpenOCD configuration use CC BY 4.0.

name: Crackdown 2: byte-matched Xbox 360 decompilation
description_en: Crackdown2-Decomp reconstructs C++ source for the Xbox 360 title-update build of Crackdown 2. It uses the original XDK compiler and game flags to compare each compiled function byte for byte with the user's executable, while additional checks compare references, source ownership, and a full split-game relink.
description_zh: Crackdown2-Decomp 重建《Crackdown 2》Xbox 360 更新版的 C++ 源码。项目使用原版 XDK 编译器和游戏编译参数，逐函数对照用户自备可执行文件的字节，并检查引用、源码归属及拆分后游戏的完整重新链接。
requirements: A user supplied latest title-update XEX matching the documented SHA-1.
Xbox 360 XDK 9328 with the pinned compiler build; Windows, PowerShell, git, Python 3.8 or later, and Rust build tools.
The author reports 3,332 matched functions out of 74,551 as of 2026-11-06.
AGPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: Forza Horizon 6: asset formats and executable findings
description_en: Forza Horizon 6 format notes and tools document the PC game's asset layout and investigated swatchbin textures, FMOD/FSB5 audio, Bink 2 video, PGZP containers and .str text tables. Python tools read or repack selected files, while separate scripts inspect RTTI and disassembly in the game's executable.
description_zh: Forza Horizon 6 格式笔记与工具记录 PC 版游戏的资源布局，以及 swatchbin 纹理、FMOD/FSB5 音频、Bink 2 视频、PGZP 容器和 .str 文本表等格式。Python 工具可读取或重打包部分文件，另有脚本检查游戏可执行文件的 RTTI 与反汇编。
requirements: The game-file tools require a user-provided PC Steam copy of Forza Horizon 6.
Python 3 is required; luttool.py uses numpy, and the reversing scripts use capstone and pefile.
Several formats, including .modelbin and ZIP method 22, remain undeciphered.
MIT license.

name: xperia-firmware-toolkit: Xperia Companion and firmware-delivery findings
description_en: xperia-firmware-toolkit documents how Xperia Companion stores and downloads Sony Xperia firmware. Its investigation covers the app's Java/OSGi bundles, the ESS API request sequence and the SIN boot-image layout. PowerShell scripts capture firmware downloaded by Companion, and a separate guide covers Xperia 1 IV rooting and data migration.
description_zh: xperia-firmware-toolkit 记录 Xperia Companion 存储和下载 Sony Xperia 固件的方式，分析其 Java/OSGi 组件、ESS API 请求流程及 SIN 启动镜像布局。PowerShell 脚本可捕获 Companion 下载的固件，另有 Xperia 1 IV 获取 root 权限及数据迁移指南。
requirements: The documented Windows scripts use PowerShell on Windows 10 or 11; firmware capture requires Xperia Companion, while device migration and rooting steps use Android platform-tools.
The rooting workflow targets Xperia 1 IV XQ-CT72 / PDX223 and requires bootloader unlocking, which wipes the device and revokes DRM keys.
MIT license.

name: Tom and Jerry Tales: matching decompilation of the EU Nintendo DS game
description_en: Tom and Jerry Tales reconstructs C source for the EU Nintendo DS game with Metrowerks mwccarm. Its matching process counts a function only when its compiled bytes match the original and the user's ROM still rebuilds byte for byte; the author reports 92.10% matched code and 1889 of 1931 functions in the dated progress table.
description_zh: Tom and Jerry Tales 使用 Metrowerks mwccarm 重建欧版 Nintendo DS 游戏的 C 源码。只有函数编译字节与原版一致且用户提供的 ROM 仍可逐字节重建时，才计为匹配；作者在注明日期的进度表中报告代码匹配率为 92.10%，函数为 1889／1931。
requirements: Requires the user's decrypted EU base ROM named baserom_tom_and_jerry_tales_eu.nds.
The compiler version remains to be identified, and auto-matched m2c output still needs cleanup.
The author reports 92.10% matched code and 1889 of 1931 functions as of 2026-11-05.
CC0-1.0 license for the main repository; the native runtime directory states MIT.

name: openedu09: reconstructing WSEDU09 oscilloscope control
