description_en: openedu09 reconstructs control of the Whadda WSEDU09 USB oscilloscope from analysis of the vendor software and captures from a real device. It implements the HID protocol in a Python driver, GUI, calibration tools and an MCP server that lets agents acquire and measure signals.
description_zh: openedu09 通过分析原厂软件和真实设备抓包重建 Whadda WSEDU09 USB 示波器的控制协议。项目用 Python 实现 HID 驱动、图形界面、校准工具及供智能体采集和测量信号的 MCP 服务。
requirements: Python 3.12+ on Linux or Windows and a Whadda WSEDU09 are required for hardware use; a simulator is included.
The author reports hardware testing with firmware 1.01; macOS, other firmware versions and other scopes are untested, and only CH1 is supported.
MIT license.

name: Final Fantasy Tactics: a matching PlayStation decompilation
description_en: Final Fantasy Tactics decompilation reconstructs the North American PlayStation release SCUS-94221 as C and assembly source. The author reports that its build reproduces the original disc byte for byte; build checks compare functions against stored hashes, and the repository includes architecture and game-mechanics documentation. It extends an acknowledged earlier decompilation.
description_zh: Final Fantasy Tactics decompilation 将北美 PlayStation 版 SCUS-94221 重建为 C 和汇编源码。作者报告构建出的光盘与原版逐字节一致；构建检查按保存的哈希比较函数，仓库还提供架构及游戏机制文档。项目基于已注明来源的早期反编译成果继续开发。
requirements: Docker and a user-supplied SCUS-94221 disc BIN are required to build the matching disc; function-hash checks can run without the BIN.
The author reports a byte-for-byte matching rebuilt disc.
MIT license.

name: Sonic the Hedgehog 2: byte-identical REV00 and REV01 source reconstruction
description_en: The Sonic the Hedgehog 2 Source Reconstruction extends Sonic Retro's disassembly into shared 68000 and Z80 source for retail REV00 and REV01. It organizes modules by subsystem, models selected game data formats, and checks rebuilt ROMs byte for byte against the user's own images; the author also reports MAME runtime comparisons.
description_zh: Sonic the Hedgehog 2 Source Reconstruction 以 Sonic Retro 的反汇编项目为基础，将 REV00 和 REV01 零售版整理为共用的 68000 与 Z80 源码。项目按子系统组织模块、建立部分游戏数据格式模型，并将重建 ROM 与用户自备映像逐字节比较；作者还报告了 MAME 运行对比。
requirements: Windows x64 with Python 3.10 or later, Git, GNU Make, and the pinned Retrolarium Kit and Core dependencies.
Legally obtained REV00 and REV01 reference ROM images are required for extraction and full verification.
REV02, prototypes, modifications, compilations and lock-on builds are excluded; the full Linux gate has not been validated.
No licence file in the repository.

name: FABA on Linux: reconstructing the speaker's song format
description_en: FABA on Linux reconstructs how the FABA speaker stores and plays songs by examining the myFaba Electron app and files on the device. It documents MKI folder naming and XOR plus bit-rotation audio encoding, then provides Python tools to convert, encode, and load user-provided MP3s from Linux.
description_zh: FABA on Linux 通过分析 myFaba Electron 应用和设备文件，还原 FABA 音箱存储、播放歌曲的方式。它记录 MKI 目录命名以及 XOR 加位旋转的音频编码，并提供在 Linux 上转换、编码及写入用户 MP3 的 Python 工具。
requirements: Linux, Python 3, ffmpeg, a data-capable USB cable, and a FABA device are required for loading songs.
Song folders depend on the RFID figure placed on the device.
The author reports working playback on one device; full-card reads are slow over its USB 1.1 storage interface.
GPL-3.0-only license.

name: Tonebook: decoding NanoCore preset SysEx commands
description_en: Tonebook documents and implements MIDI control of the LIVTRA NanoCore guitar pedal from a browser. Its protocol notes map the documented control messages and observed SysEx framing used by the vendor app to name and save presets. The site applies song tones, adjusts parameters live, and stores presets on the pedal after confirmation.
description_zh: Tonebook 在浏览器中通过 MIDI 控制 LIVTRA NanoCore 吉他效果器。协议笔记整理官方控制消息，并记录从厂商应用观察到的预设命名与保存 SysEx 报文结构。网站可应用歌曲音色、实时调整参数，并在用户确认后将预设保存到设备。
requirements: A LIVTRA NanoCore with firmware 1.04 or newer and a USB connection are required.
Chrome, Edge, or Brave with Web MIDI support is required; Android use needs a USB OTG adapter.
Amp model, cabinet IR, chain order, and preset volume cannot be changed through the described MIDI path.
Licensed under MIT.

name: Dishonored: reconstructing Windows XP compatible storefront DLLs
description_en: The Dishonored XP stub project replaces two GOG storefront DLLs so the GOG Definitive Edition can run on Windows XP SP3 with local saves. The author traced incompatible imports, Steamworks exports, vtable calls and save routines in the game executable, then implemented XP-targeted common.dll and libcurl.dll substitutes. The author reports successful play and save/load on an XP system.
description_zh: Dishonored XP stub 为 GOG 版《Dishonored: Definitive Edition》替换两个 DLL，使游戏能在 Windows XP SP3 上运行并使用本地存档。作者分析了不兼容的 DLL 导入项、Steamworks 接口、游戏可执行文件中的虚表调用和存档流程，并实现了面向 XP 的 common.dll 与 libcurl.dll 替代件。作者报告在 XP 机器上测试了游戏运行、存档和读档。
requirements: Requires the GOG Dishonored Definitive Edition build 334700_2022 (60656) and Windows XP SP3.
The author states that One Core API must not be installed on the XP system.
Achievements and Steam Cloud are unavailable; DLC detection and friends or matchmaking behavior are untested.
MIT license.

name: DKB Recomp: static recompilation of Donkey Kong Bananza
description_en: DKB Recomp statically translates Donkey Kong Bananza's Switch 2 ARM64 code to C and builds a native Windows x86-64 application. A Horizon host, NVN 2 implementation, shader translation, and Vulkan renderer handle game services and graphics. The author reports title-screen and tutorial rendering, with crashes and missing effects.
description_zh: DKB Recomp 将 Donkey Kong Bananza 的 Switch 2 ARM64 代码静态转换为 C，并构建 Windows x86-64 原生程序。Horizon 宿主层、NVN 2 实现、着色器转换和 Vulkan 渲染器处理游戏服务与图形。作者报告标题画面和教程场景可显示，但仍有崩溃与缺失效果。
requirements: A user-dumped base 1.0.0 ExeFS and RomFS are required; game files are not included.
The build uses MSYS2 UCRT64 Clang, Ninja, Python 3.12, and a .NET SDK; the source states 16 GB RAM minimum.
The game is not yet playable and may crash during the tutorial.
GPL-3.0-or-later applies to the project; reused TotK Recomp files retain MIT terms.

name: tmnt-recomp: porting the NES Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles game to C
description_en: tmnt-recomp ports the 1989 NES Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles game to C from analysis of its 6502 code. It loads a user-provided European or American ROM at runtime, implements game logic and needed NES hardware behavior, and compares recorded runs with emulator traces.
description_zh: tmnt-recomp 根据 6502 代码分析，将 1989 年 NES 版 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 移植为 C 程序。运行时读取用户提供的欧版或美版 ROM，实现游戏逻辑及所需的 NES 硬件行为，并用模拟器轨迹核对重放结果。
requirements: A user-provided European or American .nes ROM is required.
Windows builds use Visual Studio Build Tools and Python 3; Linux builds use gcc, SDL2 and Python 3.
The author reports that unvisited paths still emit TODO messages and randomness follows a different sequence.
MIT license covers the repository code.

name: Resonance: reconstructing Sony headphone control on Windows
description_en: Resonance reconstructs Sony headphone controls in a Windows app using a documented Bluetooth Classic MDR protocol. Its core library and CLI implement framing and commands for noise control, equalizer, battery, touch settings, and device switching; the protocol notes distinguish app-derived fields from device observations.
description_zh: Resonance 根据已记录的 Bluetooth Classic MDR 协议，在 Windows 应用中还原 Sony 耳机控制。核心库与命令行工具实现降噪、均衡器、电量、触控设置和设备切换等命令；协议笔记区分应用分析所得字段与设备实测结果。
requirements: Windows 10 version 1809 or later and .NET 10 SDK for source builds; a paired supported Sony headset for live control.
WF-1000XM6 is device-tested; other models have narrower recorded-session checks or remain unconfirmed.
PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0.

name: Voicemeeter: mapping the Audio Callback API
description_en: Voicemeeter Audio Callback research maps callback modes, command codes, buffer layouts, and calling conventions observed in Voicemeeter Potato. Python ctypes examples explore modes, preserve audio passthrough, and measure channel levels. The author reports testing on Potato 3.1.3.0.
description_zh: Voicemeeter Audio Callback 研究记录在 Voicemeeter Potato 中观察到的回调模式、命令码、缓冲区布局和调用约定。Python ctypes 示例用于探索模式、保持音频直通和测量通道电平。作者报告测试环境为 Potato 3.1.3.0。
requirements: Windows, Voicemeeter, Python 3.8 or newer, and NumPy are required for the examples.
The author tested Potato 3.1.3.0; Banana, Basic, older versions, multi-app coexistence, and 32-bit Python remain untested.
MIT license applies to the documentation.

name: REA Rutube: rebuilding an Android TV client from APK and API analysis
description_en: REA Rutube rebuilds a RUTUBE client for Android TV in Kotlin from analysis of the official APK and its server requests. Its research notes map app architecture, API endpoints, menus and playback requests; the client provides browsing, search, playback and locally stored viewing history.
description_zh: REA Rutube 根据官方 APK 及其服务器请求的分析结果，以 Kotlin 重写 RUTUBE Android TV 客户端。研究文档梳理了应用架构、API 端点、菜单和播放请求；客户端提供浏览、搜索、播放以及本地观看记录。
requirements: Android 7 or newer; the author reports testing on a Xiaomi ES Pro 55 with Android 9.
JDK 17 and Android SDK 36 are required to build the client.
Paid and DRM-protected content is not played.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Power Automate MCP: reconstructing the personal-flow service API
description_en: Power Automate MCP reconstructs personal-flow operations exposed by the undocumented api.flow.microsoft.com service and presents them through a local MCP server. It probes live read routes, then offers flow listing, run inspection, state changes, and definition updates using delegated device-code login.
description_zh: Power Automate MCP 根据对 api.flow.microsoft.com 未公开服务接口的观察，还原个人云端流程操作，并通过本地 MCP 服务提供访问。它探测读取接口，支持列出流程、检查运行记录、切换状态及更新定义，使用设备码登录获取委托权限。
requirements: Node.js 18 or newer, pnpm, and a Microsoft work or school account with Power Automate access are required.
The undocumented service API may change or disappear, and access follows the signed-in user's permissions.
Version 1 excludes flow deletion, desktop flows, tenant administration, and standalone connection listing.
MIT license.

name: AtomFast → ESP32 → Web UI: reconstructing dosimeter BLE telemetry
description_en: AtomFast → ESP32 → Web UI implements a read-only BLE gateway for AtomFast dosimeters. ESPHome firmware parses a 13-byte measurement payload into count rate, dose, battery and temperature readings and publishes them in a browser; protocol notes map GATT characteristics and payload fields.
description_zh: AtomFast → ESP32 → Web UI 为 AtomFast 剂量仪实现只读 BLE 网关。ESPHome 固件将 13 字节测量载荷解析为计数率、剂量、电池及温度数据，并显示在网页中；协议笔记列出 GATT 特征值和字段布局。
requirements: An AtomFast 5xx BLE dosimeter and a supported ESP32 board are required.
The documented ESPHome path requires Python 3.10+ and ESPHome 2026.5 or newer.
The author reports that the ESP32-C3 build still awaits device smoke testing.
MIT license.

name: JioSaavn API: reconstructing music-service requests and media URLs
description_en: JioSaavn API documents internal music-service requests and implements them in a TypeScript client. It maps search and content endpoints under api.php, models song and playlist responses, and decodes Base64-wrapped DES-ECB media URLs.
description_zh: JioSaavn API 记录音乐服务的内部请求，并以 TypeScript 客户端实现。项目列出 api.php 下的搜索与内容接口、歌曲及播放列表响应结构，并解码以 Base64 包装的 DES-ECB 媒体 URL。
requirements: A JavaScript or TypeScript runtime is needed; browser use requires a CORS reverse proxy.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: TempleRun-RL: reconstructing Temple Run mechanics for simulator training
description_en: TempleRun-RL reconstructs Temple Run's track generation, hazards, and runner physics in a headless training simulator. A Frida gadget reads live state and calls game methods on an arm64 Android phone so the project can measure behavior and evaluate a PPO policy against the original. The author reports a longest device run of 16,782 metres.
description_zh: TempleRun-RL 将 Temple Run 的赛道生成、障碍与角色运动机制重建为无界面训练模拟器。Frida gadget 在 arm64 Android 手机上读取游戏状态并调用游戏方法，用于测量原作行为和评估 PPO 策略。作者报告的最长实体设备成绩为 16,782 米。
requirements: A non-rooted arm64 Android phone with USB debugging, adb, and a user-supplied Temple Run v1.39.0 APK are required for device evaluation.
The APK must be patched with a Frida gadget; the game is not included.
The C++ simulator was developed and tested on Windows only.
Licensed under MIT.

name: Bumpy's Arcade Fantasy: reconstructing a DOS game in C
description_en: Bumpy's Arcade Fantasy reconstructs the 1992 DOS game's engine as C source guided by Ghidra analysis. It includes a build target for a faithful executable and a playable target with a host layer, plus Python decoders for PAV, DEC, BUM, VEC, BIN and CAR resources. The original game files are supplied separately by the user.
description_zh: Bumpy's Arcade Fantasy 依据 Ghidra 分析，将 1992 年 DOS 游戏引擎重建为 C 源码。项目提供忠实重建的可执行文件目标、加入宿主适配层的可玩目标，以及解析 PAV、DEC、BUM、VEC、BIN、CAR 资源的 Python 工具；原版游戏文件由用户自行提供。
requirements: A user-supplied copy of the DOS game and Open Watcom 16-bit DOS toolchain are required for the reconstruction build.
The faithful BUMPY.EXE target is described as link-only and never run; the separate BUMPYP.EXE target is playable.
No licence file in the repository.

name: moldqueen: Mould King toy control through reconstructed BLE advertisements
description_en: moldqueen controls Mould King building-block toys by encoding commands as BLE advertisements derived from a reconstructed device protocol. Raspberry Pi, Android and ESP32-S3 radio cores expose a shared WebSocket API to a browser client; the Mould King 13112 excavator is the documented hardware reference.
description_zh: moldqueen 根据重建的设备协议，将控制命令编码为 BLE 广播报文以操控 Mould King 积木玩具。Raspberry Pi、Android 和 ESP32-S3 无线核心向浏览器客户端提供相同的 WebSocket API；Mould King 13112 挖掘机是文档中的硬件参考型号。
requirements: Requires a compatible Mould King toy and a Raspberry Pi with USB BLE dongle, an Android device, or an ESP32-S3 radio core.
The Raspberry Pi path specifies Python 3.13 and a 5 V / 3 A power supply.
The author identifies the Mould King 13112 excavator as the hardware-proven reference.
MIT License.

name: DJI RC: reconstructing joystick values from DUML USB messages
description_en: DJI RC Joystick Bridge reconstructs the stick-value exchange of a locked DJI RM-series controller over its DUML USB interface. The Python client polls command set 0x06, command 0xf5, decodes four little-endian axes from the payload and exposes them as a Linux uinput gamepad.
description_zh: DJI RC Joystick Bridge 重建锁定状态下 DJI RM 系列控制器通过 DUML USB 接口发送的摇杆数据。Python 客户端轮询命令集 0x06、命令 0xf5，从载荷解析四个小端轴值，并通过 Linux uinput 呈现为游戏手柄。
requirements: Linux, Python 3, libusb, uinput access and a powered DJI RM-series controller with USB ID 2ca3:1023 are required.
DUML framing and CRC routines are derived from dji-firmware-tools.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Minisforum MS-A1: reconstructing embedded-controller sensor access
description_en: Minisforum MS-A1 EC fan / temperature driver documents the embedded controller's sensor command exchange and implements a Linux hwmon module for CPU temperature, board temperature and three fan RPM readings. The investigation records direct port I/O at 0x6C and 0x68, the 0xDD temperature and 0xD5 fan commands, and a command sweep used to examine the available interface.
description_zh: Minisforum MS-A1 EC fan / temperature driver 记录嵌入式控制器的传感器指令交互，并实现 Linux hwmon 模块，读取 CPU 和主板温度及三个风扇的转速。调查文档说明 0x6C、0x68 端口 I/O，0xDD 温度指令、0xD5 风扇指令，以及用于调查接口的指令扫描。
requirements: A Minisforum MS-A1 and Linux kernel build environment are required for the driver.
Secure Boot installations require module signing and one-time MOK enrollment.
The driver exposes read-only sensors; it does not control fan speed.
Licensed under GPL-2.0.

name: Hexwaste: reimplementing a slice of the Fallout 2 engine
description_en: Hexwaste reimplements part of the Fallout 2 engine in C# and MonoGame using files from the user's own installation. It reads DAT archives, maps, sprites, scripts, audio, and cutscenes, and implements exploration, dialogue, combat, travel, and persistent state. Its research notes compare behavior and formats with fallout2-ce while documenting the playable scope.
description_zh: Hexwaste 使用 C# 和 MonoGame 重建部分 Fallout 2 引擎，并读取用户自行安装的游戏文件。它解析 DAT 归档、地图、图像、脚本、音频和过场动画，实现探索、对话、战斗、旅行及持久状态。研究笔记将行为和格式与 fallout2-ce 对照，并记录可运行范围。
requirements: An original Fallout 2 installation containing master.dat, critter.dat, and patch000.dat is required.
The implementation covers a slice of the engine rather than the complete game.
Licensed under Sustainable Use License 1.0.

name: XexTool-RE: reconstructing the Xbox 360 XexTool utility
description_en: XexTool-RE reimplements the closed XexTool utility from analysis of its binary and processes Xbox 360 .xex executables. Its C++ CLI and GUI inspect headers, extract basefiles and resources, convert compression or encryption, and document XEX layout and digest behavior. The author reports byte-identical output for most compared operations, with stated exceptions.
description_zh: XexTool-RE 通过分析原版 XexTool 二进制，以 C++ 重建 Xbox 360 .xex 可执行文件处理工具。命令行和图形界面支持查看头部、提取内容及转换压缩或加密形式；文档还记录了 XEX 布局和摘要链。作者报告多数已比对操作输出逐字节一致，但列出若干例外。
requirements: A C++17 compiler is required; the author built and tested with MinGW-w64 g++ on Windows.
Users supply their own .xex files; original XexTool and test files are not included.
Special patches are unusable, several limit variants are unmapped, and one delta-patch sample differs.
MIT license.

name: NFC PM-Pro: reconstructing the FURUI reader's HID protocol
description_en: NFC PM-Pro reconstructs the FURUI NFC PM-Pro reader's USB HID command exchange and implements a Linux GUI and CLI around it. The protocol notes describe report framing, RC4 encryption, CRC-16 and device commands; the client reads, writes and clones supported RFID cards, runs dictionary, nested, darkside and hardnested key recovery, and handles dumps and NDEF records.
description_zh: NFC PM-Pro 还原 FURUI NFC PM-Pro 读写器的 USB HID 指令交互，并据此实现 Linux 图形界面与命令行工具。协议文档记录报文封装、RC4 加密、CRC-16 和设备指令；客户端支持读写和复制相应的 RFID 卡，可运行字典、nested、darkside 和 hardnested 密钥恢复，并处理转储文件和 NDEF 记录。
requirements: A FURUI NFC PM-Pro FR-RATEL device and Linux access to its hidraw node are required for device operations.
Building requires GTK4, libadwaita, liblzma, a C compiler and CMake/Ninja.
Firmware updates, hotel-card presets and agreements for other device models are outside the project's scope.
Licensed under GPL-3.0.

name: RF Power Meter V5 Companion: reconstructing the meter's serial protocol
description_en: RF Power Meter V5 Companion reconstructs the USB RF Power Meter V5 serial exchange and uses it in a Windows monitoring app. Its protocol notes describe 460800 8N1 communication, calibrated dBm records, burst markers, and device settings; the author reports comparing live captures with an IL decompile of the vendor executable.
description_zh: RF Power Meter V5 Companion 重建 USB RF Power Meter V5 的串口通信，并在 Windows 监测应用中使用。协议文档记录 460800 8N1 参数、校准后的 dBm 记录、数据块标记和设备设置；作者称将实机抓取结果与厂商程序的 IL 反编译结果进行了对照。
requirements: USB RF Power Meter V5 with STM32F401CCU6 and AD8317 or AD8318, plus 64-bit Windows.
The source build requires the .NET 7 SDK.
MIT.

name: miband-lit: reconstructing Mi Band 5 BLE heart-rate access
description_en: miband-lit implements direct BLE communication with a Mi Band 5 to authenticate, stream heart-rate readings and send notifications or vibration commands. Its write-up describes the band's 16-byte key and AES challenge-response exchange. A Streamlit dashboard displays readings, while an optional WiZ bulb integration reacts to them.
description_zh: miband-lit 通过 BLE 直接连接 Mi Band 5，完成认证、读取心率，并发送通知或振动命令。研究记录了 16 字节密钥与 AES 挑战应答过程；Streamlit 面板显示读数，可选的 WiZ 灯泡联动会随心率变化。
requirements: A Mi Band 5, macOS with Bluetooth access, Python dependencies, and the band's 16-byte key from the user's Zepp account are required.
The author reports intermittent heart-rate sessions and a reading cadence of only one value every few seconds.
MIT license.

name: Zafro AC: replacing the I4season device cloud locally
description_en: zafro-ha-local replaces the cloud endpoint used by a Zafro A9092R air conditioner with a LAN server. Its protocol notes derive the device's REST login, MQTT 3.1 WebSocket messages, topics and state commands from captured traffic. The Python service handles the device connection and publishes Home Assistant entities through MQTT Discovery.
description_zh: zafro-ha-local 用局域网服务器替代 Zafro A9092R 空调使用的云端点。协议笔记根据抓取的设备流量记录 REST 登录、MQTT 3.1 WebSocket 消息、主题及状态命令；Python 服务处理设备连接，并通过 MQTT Discovery 向 Home Assistant 发布实体。
requirements: The author tested a Zafro A9092R-12K with firmware 1.0.28; other I4season models are unconfirmed.
Requires an always-on Linux host, Home Assistant with MQTT, a broker, nginx, Python 3.9+ and local DNS override capability.
The AC uses legacy TLS 1.2 RSA ciphers and sends no SNI, which the supplied nginx configuration accommodates.
MIT license.

name: Lidl Plus: mapping Lidl Pay API requests
description_en: lidl-plus-reverse documents Lidl Pay requests observed between the Lidl Plus app and its server. Its endpoint reference records authentication headers, methods, and bodies for loyalty lookup, payment methods, PIN validation, QR generation, and activation in the Spain region.
description_zh: lidl-plus-reverse 记录 Lidl Plus 应用与服务器之间观察到的 Lidl Pay 请求。端点文档列出西班牙地区忠诚度查询、支付方式、PIN 验证、二维码生成和激活操作的方法、认证头及请求体。
requirements: The documented endpoints are adapted to the Spain region.
Coupon support and additional regions are planned but absent.
No licence file in the repository.

name: open-apt-flash: reconstructing the APT 860C UART flasher
description_en: open-apt-flash reconstructs the UART bootloader exchange used by APT Burn Tools to flash the APT 860C e-bike display. Its Python library, CLI and GUI implement 57600 8N1 communication, page framing, checksum, acknowledgments and a sync handshake. The author reports comparison with original-tool traffic and a complete flash on a live display.
description_zh: open-apt-flash 重建 APT Burn Tools 刷写 APT 860C 电助力自行车显示器时使用的 UART 引导程序通信。Python 库、CLI 和 GUI 实现 57600 8N1 通信、分页面帧、校验和、应答与同步握手。作者报告曾与原工具流量对比，并在真实显示器上完成刷写。
requirements: Python 3.11+, pyserial, a serial connection to an APT 860C, and a firmware image positioned for 0x08004000 are required for hardware flashing.
The author reports simulator tests and a complete 145-page flash on a live 860C.
MIT license.

name: MADLIONS 60 Configurator: reconstructing MAD60 USB HID configuration
description_en: MADLIONS 60 Configurator implements a Windows client for the MAD60 keyboard using USB HID commands reconstructed from vendor web app traffic. Its device layer builds configuration reports and reads settings back from the board; the interface covers per-key lighting, animations, Hall Effect settings, and profiles. Capture helpers support investigation of other models.
description_zh: MADLIONS 60 Configurator 根据厂商网页应用的通信记录重建 MAD60 键盘的 USB HID 配置命令，并实现 Windows 客户端。设备层生成配置报文并读取键盘设置；界面支持逐键灯光、动画、霍尔参数和配置档案。仓库另含用于研究其他型号的抓取工具。
requirements: Windows, Python 3.11+, hidapi, and the Edge WebView2 runtime are required for source use.
A MADLIONS MAD60 with USB VID 0x373B and PID 0x1054 is the documented hardware.
Key remapping, Fn layers, and macros are outside the implemented scope.
Licensed under PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0.

name: ax206-usb-display-macos: driving the QDtech display over USB
description_en: ax206-usb-display-macos implements macOS control of a QDtech AX206-derived USB display. Its Python driver sends RGB565 frames through USB Mass-Storage Bulk-Only framing and the device's BLIT command; an image viewer and live system dashboard use that driver.
description_zh: ax206-usb-display-macos 在 macOS 上控制 QDtech 的 AX206 衍生 USB 显示屏。Python 驱动通过 USB Mass-Storage Bulk-Only 帧和设备的 BLIT 命令发送 RGB565 图像；看图工具及实时系统仪表盘复用该驱动。
requirements: macOS, a compatible 480×320 AX206 display, libusb and the listed Python packages are required.
The documented SmartCool firmware implements BLIT only; other vendor commands can stall the USB endpoint.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: SP542E MQTT ↔ BLE bridge: local control through the controller protocol
description_en: An MQTT-to-BLE bridge that controls the SP542E LED controller from Home Assistant using BanlanX_6xx commands. Its protocol notes identify service FFE0, write characteristic FFE1, plaintext 53-prefixed frames and acknowledged writes for power, white color temperature and brightness.
description_zh: 这项实现通过 MQTT-to-BLE 桥接服务，让 Home Assistant 使用 BanlanX_6xx 命令控制 SP542E 灯带控制器。协议记录列出 FFE0 服务、FFE1 写入特征、以 53 开头的明文帧，以及电源、白光色温和亮度命令所需的确认写入。
requirements: An always-on Mac with a local GUI session, Bluetooth permission and BLE access to the SP542E.
Home Assistant with MQTT and credentials configured for the bridge.
The bridge keeps optimistic local state; changes made through the original app or remote are not reflected.
MIT License.

name: ESPHome — Technibel SCDF32C5I IR Climate: reconstructing air-conditioner infrared control
description_en: ESPHome — Technibel SCDF32C5I IR Climate reconstructs the air conditioner's 48-bit infrared command format from raw captures. Its protocol notes map frame fields and checksum behavior, while an ESP32 frame builder and ESPHome configuration send commands through a Home Assistant climate entity.
description_zh: ESPHome — Technibel SCDF32C5I IR Climate 根据原始采集数据解析空调的 48 位红外命令，记录帧字段、编码和校验和，并用 ESP32 帧生成代码及 ESPHome 配置接入 Home Assistant 空调实体。
requirements: Technibel SCDF32C5I air conditioner, ESP32 board and infrared emitter are required for control.
ESPHome and Home Assistant are required for the documented integration.
MIT license.

name: Atomberg BLDC IR Remote: reconstructing fan infrared commands
description_en: Atomberg BLDC IR Remote implements an Android infrared client for Atomberg ceiling fans using 38 kHz NEC commands. Its command table covers power, speed, boost, timer and sleep; the author reports recovering a working Sleep code after an earlier published value failed on an Erica Meta fan.
description_zh: Atomberg BLDC IR Remote 使用 38 kHz NEC 命令，为 Atomberg 吊扇实现 Android 红外遥控器。命令表覆盖电源、档位、增强、定时和睡眠；作者报告在 Erica Meta 上发现既有 Sleep 代码无效后，重新解析出可用代码。
requirements: An Android phone with a built-in infrared blaster and a compatible Atomberg fan are required.
The author reports testing with Erica Meta and Redmi Note 10 Pro and Note 8 Pro devices.
LED control is not implemented, and additional discovered commands are excluded pending validation.
MIT license.

name: GameGent: reconstructing GameSir Tarantula Pro HID configuration
description_en: GameGent is a Linux client for configuring GameSir Tarantula Pro controllers through a reconstructed USB HID exchange. Its protocol notes derive packet fields from the vendor Electron app and a Ghidra-decompiled DLL; the CLI reads state and mappings and sets lighting, sticks, motion controls, remaps and rumble.
description_zh: GameGent 是通过重建的 USB HID 交互配置 GameSir Tarantula Pro 手柄的 Linux 客户端。协议笔记依据厂商 Electron 应用和经 Ghidra 反编译的 DLL 推导数据包字段；命令行工具可读取状态与按键映射，并设置灯光、摇杆、体感、重映射和震动。
requirements: Linux, Python 3 and a GameSir Tarantula Pro controller are required.
Onboard GameSir profile slots are not implemented; the project uses software profiles.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: xgecu-t48-reverse: reconstructing the T48 eMMC USB protocol
description_en: xgecu-t48-reverse reconstructs the XGecu T48 programmer's eMMC USB exchange from Xgpro.exe analysis and captured device traffic. Its notes describe command opcodes, endpoint roles, bulk transfers and ISP settings; Python examples read and write eMMC through the T48 adapter.
description_zh: xgecu-t48-reverse 结合 Xgpro.exe 静态分析与设备 USB 抓包，重建 XGecu T48 编程器的 eMMC 通信流程。文档记录命令码、端点、批量传输和 ISP 设置，Python 示例可通过 T48 适配器读写 eMMC。
requirements: Python 3 and pyusb; a T48 and eMMC-ISP adapter are needed for hardware operations.
The author reports 1-bit, 3.3 V ISP reads and writes on real hardware; 1.8 V operation has not been checked on hardware.
MIT license.

name: Miele XKM3000Z: reconstructing a local Zigbee appliance bridge
description_en: The Miele XKM3000Z bridge decodes local Zigbee telemetry from an older Miele washing machine and publishes status, program, timing, and door events through MQTT for Home Assistant. Its protocol notes map endpoints and clusters, including the raw 0x0B02 event cluster and parameter blocks.
description_zh: Miele XKM3000Z 网关解码旧款 Miele 洗衣机的本地 Zigbee 遥测，并通过 MQTT 向 Home Assistant 发布状态、程序、时间及机门事件。协议笔记记录端点、簇、0x0B02 原始事件簇及参数块。
requirements: A Miele appliance with XKM3000Z, a TI ZNP-compatible Zigbee adapter, Python, and an MQTT broker.
Program-selection and pause or cancel writes remain experimental; several sensor states have no confirmed readout.
MIT license.

name: PolyWollyWin: reconstructing ASUS AniMe Matrix HID control
description_en: PolyWollyWin controls the ASUS ROG Strix Flare II Animate keyboard's AniMe Matrix through a USB HID format confirmed from captures of the official software. The Windows app sends 312 LED values in a documented report and provides effects, image playback, and a paint editor. The repository also documents hardware porting.
description_zh: PolyWollyWin 使用经官方软件 USBPcap 抓包确认的 USB HID 格式，控制 ASUS ROG Strix Flare II Animate 键盘的 AniMe Matrix。Windows 应用按文档所列报文发送 312 个 LED 数值，提供特效、图像播放和绘图工具；仓库另有硬件移植文档。
requirements: Requires Windows, Python 3.10 or newer, and an ASUS ROG Strix Flare II Animate for source use.
Hardware support is currently tested only for USB VID 0x0B05 and PID 0x19FC.
MIT License.

name: Huawei MUT Unbrick Tool: reconstructing router multicast recovery
description_en: Huawei MUT Unbrick Tool reimplements the multicast firmware upgrade exchange used by HuaweiMUT.exe for router recovery. Its Python GUI and CLI send documented UDP packet types with firmware chunks and INI metadata; research notes record findings from the original utility. The author reports that secure boot prevents software recovery on several listed models.
description_zh: Huawei MUT Unbrick Tool 重建 HuaweiMUT.exe 用于路由器恢复的组播固件升级通信。Python 图形界面和命令行程序按记录的 UDP 数据包类型发送固件块与 INI 元数据；研究笔记列出对原工具的分析结果。作者报告部分机型受安全启动限制，无法软件恢复。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11, Python 3.7 or newer, administrator access, and wired Ethernet are required.
Users supply a matching firmware .bin file; the author reports that secure boot prevents software recovery on models including WS7200 and AX3.
MIT license.

name: Goodreads CLI: mapping the logged-in Goodreads web API
description_en: Goodreads CLI maps the logged-in Goodreads web interface into route documentation and a shared TypeScript engine exposed through a CLI and MCP server. It covers shelves, books, ratings, reviews, quotes, and Kindle annotations using HTML pages, Rails form requests, and selected AppSync operations. The repository distinguishes live actions from catalog-only or planned routes.
description_zh: Goodreads CLI 将 Goodreads 登录后的网页接口整理为路由文档，并通过共享的 TypeScript 引擎提供 CLI 和 MCP 服务器。它利用 HTML 页面、Rails 表单请求及部分 AppSync 操作处理书架、图书、评分、评论、引文和 Kindle 批注，并区分可实时调用、仅收录在目录中及计划实现的路由。
requirements: Node.js 20 or newer and the repository-pinned pnpm through Corepack.
Authenticated actions use the user's Goodreads browser cookie and CSRF token; writes default to dry-run.
Some AppSync operations remain catalog-only, and Goodreads may change its web routes.
MIT.

name: gloriousctl: mapping Pixart Model I 2 mouse settings
description_en: gloriousctl adds Linux control of Pixart Model I 2 mice through a hardware-mapped, write-only HID report format. The author documents corrected DPI, stage color, polling-rate, and fragment timing fields, alongside a CLI and GTK front end.
description_zh: gloriousctl 通过实物测绘的只写 HID 报文，在 Linux 上控制 Pixart Model I 2 鼠标。作者记录了 DPI、档位颜色、轮询率和分片时序字段的修正，并提供命令行与 GTK 界面。
requirements: Linux, hidapi, a C compiler, and make; the GUI also needs PyGObject and GTK 3.
Pixart settings are write-only, so displayed values come from a local cache rather than a device readback.
EUPL-1.2 license; the SinoWealth code and original CLI derive from enkore/gloriousctl.

name: divoom-protocol: reconstructed BLE control for Divoom displays
description_en: divoom-protocol implements a Python BLE client for Divoom Backpack M and TimeBox-Evo-audio displays using reconstructed framing and command sequences. Its documentation covers session initialization, brightness, channel switching, image frames and animation upload, and identifies commands that remain undecoded.
description_zh: divoom-protocol 基于重建的封包格式和命令顺序，为 Divoom Backpack M 与 TimeBox-Evo-audio 显示设备实现 Python BLE 客户端。文档涵盖会话初始化、亮度、频道切换、图像帧和动画上传，也列出尚未解码的指令。
requirements: Requires Python 3.10 or newer and a compatible BLE display.
Hardware testing covers Backpack M and TimeBox-Evo-audio only.
The author reports that uploaded animations render immediately; persistence to a Custom slot has not been verified.
MIT License.

name: hestia: replacing the Keemple smart-home cloud
description_en: hestia reimplements the Keemple gateway's cleartext 0x7e-framed protocol for local smart-home control. A specification derived from observed LAN traffic covers framing, TLVs, handshakes, device commands and reports. The Python server operates as a decoding proxy or a standalone cloud replacement, with a web dashboard and local automation.
description_zh: hestia 重实现 Keemple 网关的明文 0x7e 帧协议，实现智能家居设备本地控制。其基于局域网流量的规范记录帧结构、TLV、握手、设备命令及状态报告；Python 服务可作为解码代理或独立云服务替代程序，并提供网页面板和本地自动化。
requirements: Keemple smart-home devices and a local redirect of the gateway connection to the hestia host are required.
The backend test instructions specify Python 3.14 and dependencies from requirements.txt.
The author reports 100% line and branch coverage for the backend suite.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: gigabyte-gpu-lcd: reconstructing AORUS GPU LCD control
description_en: gigabyte-gpu-lcd reconstructs I2C control of the LCD on a Gigabyte AORUS GeForce RTX 5090 MASTER ICE. Protocol notes derived from Gigabyte Control Center components map 256-byte commands, display modes, and image uploads; a Python library and CLI send static screens and RLE animations on Linux.
description_zh: gigabyte-gpu-lcd 还原 Gigabyte AORUS GeForce RTX 5090 MASTER ICE 显卡 LCD 的 I2C 控制。根据 Gigabyte Control Center 组件整理的协议笔记记录 256 字节命令、显示模式和图像上传流程；Python 库及 CLI 可在 Linux 上发送静态画面和 RLE 动画。
requirements: Linux, Python 3.10 or later, and access to the relevant /dev/i2c-N device are required.
The documented hardware is AORUS GeForce RTX 5090 MASTER ICE at I2C bus 3, address 0x61, firmware F1.4.
MIT license.

name: Ricoh SP 200 Linux CUPS Driver: reconstructing the printer's USB print protocol
description_en: Ricoh SP 200 Linux CUPS Driver reconstructs the printer's USB print exchange from captures of its Windows driver. Its notes identify PJL commands around JBIG1 raster data, document page transitions and image chunking, and accompany a C filter that converts CUPS raster input into the observed job format.
description_zh: Ricoh SP 200 Linux CUPS Driver 通过抓取 Windows 驱动的 USB 打印任务，重建打印机的通信流程。研究笔记解释包裹 JBIG1 栅格数据的 PJL 命令、分页和图像分块；配套 C 过滤器将 CUPS 栅格数据转换为该作业格式。
requirements: A Ricoh SP 200 connected by USB and a CUPS installation are required.
Building the filter requires C development tools, CUPS libraries, and jbigkit.
No licence file in the repository.

name: HyperX QuadCast 2 S: reconstructing RGB control on macOS
description_en: HyperX QuadCast 2 S RGB control implements a macOS client for the microphone's USB HID lighting exchange. The source documents seven-packet color updates, acknowledgments, upper and lower LED zones, and IOKit collection selection and response draining. The app controls solid colors and brightness through a menu bar interface.
description_zh: HyperX QuadCast 2 S RGB control 在 macOS 上实现麦克风 USB HID 灯光控制。项目记录七包颜色更新、应答、上下灯区，以及 IOKit 设备集合选择和响应读取的细节；菜单栏应用可设置纯色与亮度。
requirements: macOS 14 or later and a HyperX QuadCast 2 S are required; source builds require Xcode 15+ and xcodegen.
Animated lighting modes are unsupported because their 2 S protocol remains undecoded.
MIT license.

name: whoop4-ble: reconstructing Whoop 4.0 sensor data access
description_en: whoop4-ble reconstructs direct BLE access to Whoop 4.0 sensor records in a Python client. It documents command framing, CRCs, historical-data draining, and a five-byte SET_CLOCK payload that the author reports fixes stalled flash recording; tools export HR, RR, and accelerometer samples and monitor packets.
description_zh: whoop4-ble 用 Python 客户端重建对 Whoop 4.0 传感记录的直接 BLE 访问。它记录命令帧、CRC 与历史数据导出流程；作者报告五字节 SET_CLOCK 载荷可修复停滞的闪存记录。工具可导出心率、RR 间隔和加速度数据并监看报文。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later and a Whoop 4.0 strap are required.
The strap should be unpaired from the official app before direct BLE access.
Cloud-derived recovery, strain, and sleep scores are unavailable; some sensor fields remain partially decoded.
MIT license.

name: open-cardi: reconstructing Cardi lighting control over BLE
description_en: open-cardi reconstructs BLE control of Cardi K3 and K4 Active Ultra lighting kits in Android and web clients. The author derived GATT services, packet framing, and command behavior from decompiled vendor apps and HCI snoop replay, including color, zone, pattern, and reset operations.
description_zh: open-cardi 在 Android 和网页客户端中重建 Cardi K3、K4 Active Ultra 灯具的 BLE 控制。作者通过反编译厂商应用并重放 HCI 抓包，整理 GATT 服务、报文结构及颜色、分区、模式和重置命令。
requirements: Cardi K3 or K4 Active Ultra, or another named ConSmart-family kit, is the documented hardware scope.
The web client can leave a resetting kit blinking until power cycling and vendor-app color setting; the Android client uses the default 23-byte MTU.
Lock and unlock effects on neighboring controllers remain inferred.
MIT license.

name: Pool Comfort / Galaxywind: a local heat-pump client from Android and UDP analysis
description_en: Pool Comfort / Galaxywind implements a local Python client and Home Assistant component for pool heat pumps using UDP behavior recovered from the vendor Android app and LAN captures. It documents discovery on port 8818, sessions on port 1194, login, state attributes and control commands.
description_zh: Pool Comfort / Galaxywind 根据厂商 Android 应用和局域网抓包结果，实现泳池热泵的 Python 本地客户端及 Home Assistant 组件。项目记录了 8818 端口发现、1194 端口会话、登录、状态字段和控制命令。
requirements: Requires a compatible Pool Comfort, Galaxywind or GWCD heat pump on the local network and its device password.
The library requires Python 3.11 or newer; the Home Assistant component can be installed through HACS.
The author reports testing one Pool Comfort unit; other OEM models need further captures.
MIT License.

name: MSI Mystic Light RGB Web Control Panel: reconstructing B760M-A lighting control
description_en: MSI Mystic Light RGB Web Control Panel reconstructs USB HID lighting commands for the MSI PRO B760M-A DDR4 II motherboard. Captures from MSI Center inform its 185-byte Feature Report layout, enable bit and two-packet send sequence; a Linux Flask service exposes zone controls in a browser.
description_zh: MSI Mystic Light RGB Web Control Panel 根据 MSI Center 的 USB HID 记录重建 MSI PRO B760M-A DDR4 II 主板灯效命令，记录 185 字节报告、使能位和双包发送顺序，并通过 Linux 上的 Flask 服务提供网页控制。
requirements: MSI PRO B760M-A DDR4 II (MS-7D99) motherboard and Linux are the documented target.
Python 3.8+, Flask and python3-hid are required.
Access to the HID device requires root or custom udev rules.
The brightness and speed sliders do not change the hardware flag.
The README declares the MIT License.

name: Open Trofeo LCD: implementing Thermalright Trofeo USB display control
description_en: Open Trofeo LCD drives the Thermalright Trofeo Vision 9.16-inch display from Linux using documented USB transfers. Its notes combine the project's captures with prior trcc-linux work to describe initialization, JPEG frame chunks, and acknowledgments. A native PyUSB path feeds a dashboard with themes, system telemetry, media, weather, and game statistics.
description_zh: Open Trofeo LCD 根据已记录的 USB 传输流程，在 Linux 上驱动 Thermalright Trofeo Vision 9.16 英寸显示屏。协议笔记结合项目抓包和既有 trcc-linux 工作，说明初始化、JPEG 帧分块与确认报文。原生 PyUSB 通路为主题面板提供系统、媒体、天气和游戏数据。
requirements: A Thermalright Trofeo Vision 9.16-inch LCD with USB ID 0416:5408 is the confirmed device.
Hardware use was validated on one physical unit running Kubuntu.
The application is an active development preview; its final-packet handling supports several live-test strategies.
Project code is licensed under GPL-3.0-only; third-party components retain their own licences.

name: Soundpeats Mini Pro HS Controller: rebuilding earbud controls over Bluetooth
description_en: Soundpeats Mini Pro HS Controller rebuilds earbud control through a Kotlin Android app and Python tool using reverse-engineered Bluetooth SPP commands. It queries battery and mode state and sends ANC, touch, game-mode, and seven-band EQ commands, including 17-byte packets for individual EQ bands.
description_zh: Soundpeats Mini Pro HS Controller 以 Kotlin Android 应用和 Python 工具重建耳机控制，使用逆向得到的 Bluetooth SPP 命令。它查询电量和模式状态，并发送 ANC、触控、游戏模式及七段均衡器命令，其中单段 EQ 使用 17 字节报文。
requirements: Android 8.0 or later and paired Soundpeats Mini Pro HS earbuds are specified for the app.
The commands are specific to the WuQi WQ7033 chipset.
No licence file in the repository.

name: breezyd: reconstructing local control of Twinfresh Breezy ventilators
description_en: breezyd implements local UDP/4000 control for Vents Twinfresh Breezy 160 and Elite 160 Pro ventilators. Its Go library, CLI and daemon read sensors and set operating modes, while retained Python probes and snapshot diffs document how vendor-app actions were mapped to device parameters.
description_zh: breezyd 为 Vents Twinfresh Breezy 160 和 Elite 160 Pro 通风设备实现本地 UDP/4000 控制。Go 库、命令行工具和守护进程读取传感器并设置运行模式；保留的 Python 探测与快照差异脚本记录了如何把厂商应用操作对应到设备参数。
requirements: A supported Twinfresh Breezy 160 or Elite 160 Pro unit reachable over the local network, with its device ID and protocol password.
Go 1.26.2 is declared by the source module for building the Go code.
Other 200-series models share the described protocol but were not tested against hardware.
GNU General Public License v3.0.

name: ebkn-m61-protocol: reconstructing biometric terminal communications
description_en: ebkn-m61-protocol documents communication with EBKN and Realand BioFace M61 biometric access terminals and supplies a Python reference listener. Its specifications cover WebSocket with XML messages, FkWeb HTTP posts with JSON, and raw TCP XML streaming, including attendance events and supported command exchanges.
description_zh: ebkn-m61-protocol 记录 EBKN 和 Realand BioFace M61 生物识别门禁终端的通信，并提供 Python 参考监听程序。协议文档涵盖 WebSocket/XML、FkWeb HTTP/JSON 和原始 TCP/XML 流，包括考勤事件及命令交互。
requirements: A compatible M61BH terminal is required for device communication; the listener uses Python 3.
The author reports different levels of device and mode support across the listed models.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: fibery-cli: mapping Fibery UI endpoints from HAR captures
description_en: fibery-cli maps Fibery web UI requests into a Python command-line client. The project records undocumented endpoints found by Chrome DevTools HAR capture and token-authenticated replay, covering spaces, documents, schema changes, views, and batch entity operations alongside the official API. It also documents a workflow for finding and adding missing UI actions.
description_zh: fibery-cli 将 Fibery 网页界面的请求整理为 Python 命令行客户端。它同时使用官方 API，以及通过 Chrome DevTools HAR 抓包和令牌认证重放发现的未公开端点，覆盖空间、文档、模式修改、视图和批量实体操作。项目还记录了发现并接入缺失界面操作的流程。
requirements: Python 3.12 or newer, uv, and a Fibery API token.
Some space-document, description-update, export, cross-database, and rich-text embed operations are not yet wired.
MIT.

name: Mondeer Bluetooth scale: reconstructing BLE weighing and binding
description_en: Mondeer Bluetooth scale reconstructs the BLE exchange used by Mondeer and WanKa C1 bathroom scales and implements a Python listener that publishes weighing data to Home Assistant over MQTT. The documented work combines decompilation of the original Android app with traffic observation; a separate Android companion app displays readings and exports to Health Connect.
description_zh: Mondeer Bluetooth scale 重建 Mondeer 和 WanKa C1 体重秤的 BLE 通信，并用 Python 监听程序经 MQTT 向 Home Assistant 发布称重数据。作者结合原 Android 应用反编译与流量观察记录协议；另有 Android 伴侣应用显示数据并导出至 Health Connect。
requirements: Python 3.10+, a BLE 4.0+ adapter, the scale, and Home Assistant with MQTT are required for the listener workflow.
The author reports daily use on Windows 11; Linux and BlueZ have had less testing.
MIT license.

name: Smartboard notebook Exporter: documenting and converting .notebook files
description_en: Smartboard notebook Exporter documents the .notebook file format produced by a SMART Board MX065 iQ and converts whiteboard pages to SVG, PNG or PDF. It treats the document as a ZIP container, reads page SVGs and their order from the manifest, then adjusts page canvases before export.
description_zh: Smartboard notebook Exporter 记录 SMART Board MX065 iQ 生成的 .notebook 文件格式，并将白板页面转换为 SVG、PNG 或 PDF。它把文件作为 ZIP 容器读取，依据清单确定各 SVG 页面的顺序，调整画布后导出。
requirements: A .notebook file; source use requires Python 3.10 or later, Tkinter, Cairo and the listed Python dependencies.
The format notes are based on files created with a SMART Board MX065 iQ; some internal elements remain unstudied.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: Divoom Times Frame: partial cloud and local API reconstruction
description_en: Divoom Times Frame research maps parts of the photo frame's cloud and local HTTP command interfaces and provides Python probes for login, photo listing, file upload and local display control. The author reports that the command binding an uploaded photo to the frame remains unknown; RongCloud messaging is a hypothesis.
description_zh: Divoom Times Frame 研究梳理了相框的部分云端和本地 HTTP 命令接口，并提供 Python 探测程序，用于登录、列出照片、上传文件和控制本地显示。作者报告，上传照片与相框绑定的命令仍未知；RongCloud 消息通道目前是推测。
requirements: Requires a Divoom Times Frame for local device probing; cloud operations require an account.
The toolkit requires Python 3.10 or newer, requests and pillow.
Photo binding remains unresolved, so the toolkit cannot complete a custom-photo display flow.
No licence file in the repository.

name: labelwriter: DYMO LabelWriter protocol drivers
description_en: labelwriter implements TypeScript drivers for DYMO LabelWriter printers around a shared command-encoding core. Its documentation covers LW raster, LW5 raster and Duo tape wire protocols, while Node USB/TCP and browser WebUSB packages deliver print jobs to supported devices.
description_zh: labelwriter 以共享命令编码核心实现 DYMO LabelWriter 的 TypeScript 驱动。文档涵盖 LW raster、LW5 raster 和 Duo tape 通信协议；Node USB/TCP 与浏览器 WebUSB 包负责向受支持的设备发送打印任务。
requirements: Requires a supported DYMO LabelWriter device.
Node use requires version 20.9 or newer; browser use requires Chrome or Edge 89 or newer in a secure context.
The 550 and 5XL models enforce a genuine-label NFC lock.
MIT License.

name: jl-dv-viewer: reconstructing Jieli-DV camera streaming
description_en: jl-dv-viewer reconstructs the local streaming exchange of Jieli-DV-style Wi-Fi rearview and dash cameras in a Kotlin Android viewer. It sends length-prefixed CTP control messages over TCP, reassembles custom UDP chunks into MJPEG frames, and documents the command vocabulary and frame format. The app also offers crop, rotation and reconnection controls.
description_zh: jl-dv-viewer 用 Kotlin Android 应用重建 Jieli-DV 类 Wi-Fi 后视和行车摄像头的本地视频通信。它通过 TCP 发送带长度前缀的 CTP 控制消息，将自定义 UDP 分片重组为 MJPEG 帧，并记录命令与帧格式；应用另提供裁剪、旋转和重连功能。
requirements: A compatible Jieli-DV-style camera and an Android device connected to its Wi-Fi access point are required.
The source states Android minSdk 21 and an arm64-only build; the camera IP is fixed at 192.168.1.1.
MIT license.

name: giustizia-consulta: reconstructing Italian civil-registry app and portal access
description_en: giustizia-consulta exposes Italian civil-case data through a Portuguese REST API using endpoints and request signatures recovered from the official Android app with Jadx. It also proxies the PST web portal, rewriting links, cookies and JavaScript requests, and parses the upstream XML responses.
description_zh: giustizia-consulta 使用 Jadx 从意大利司法部门官方 Android 应用中恢复端点和请求签名，并以葡萄牙语 REST API 提供民事案件数据。项目还代理 PST 网页门户，重写链接、Cookie 和 JavaScript 请求，并解析上游 XML 响应。
requirements: Requires Node.js 20 or newer to run the server.
The service depends on the Italian justice ministry's mobile and PST endpoints.
MIT License.

name: picoscope-libusb: reconstructing PicoScope 2204A USB control
description_en: picoscope-libusb reconstructs PicoScope 2204A USB control from SDK traces and device experiments. Its protocol notes document endpoints, command framing, firmware upload, capture modes, and waveform transfers; a C libusb driver exposes these functions to a Wails desktop GUI and an Android JNI library. Firmware blobs must be extracted from the user's own device.
description_zh: picoscope-libusb 根据 SDK 抓包和设备实验重建 PicoScope 2204A 的 USB 控制流程。协议笔记记录端点、命令封装、固件装载、采集模式和波形传输；C 语言 libusb 驱动供 Wails 桌面界面与 Android JNI 库使用。固件数据须从用户自己的设备提取。
requirements: A PicoScope 2204A and firmware extracted from the user's own device are required.
The primary hardware target is Linux desktop; Windows and macOS hardware use has not been validated.
Signal-generator amplitude and offset did not respond on the tested unit.
Licensed under MIT; proprietary firmware blobs are excluded.

name: pyPredator: reconstructing Predator PH18-73 RGB control
description_en: pyPredator reconstructs RGB control for the Acer Predator PH18-73 keyboard from PredatorSense USB captures. Its Python program streams 128 main-key and 16 WASD-zone pixels through documented USB control and bulk packets at 30 Hz, with a Tk GUI for effects. Ring, logo and underglow control delegates to a separate CLI submodule.
description_zh: pyPredator 根据 PredatorSense 的 USB 抓包重建 Acer Predator PH18-73 键盘 RGB 控制。Python 程序按记录的 USB 控制与批量传输数据包，以 30 Hz 向主键盘发送 128 像素、向 WASD 区发送 16 像素，并提供 Tk 灯效界面；灯环、徽标和底部灯条由独立 CLI 子模块控制。
requirements: Requires an Acer Predator PH18-73 keyboard with USB device ID 05af:867b and Linux.
Requires Python 3.10+, pyusb and libusb; a udev setup step grants device access.
Ring, logo and underglow control requires the acer_PH18-73_rgb submodule.
MIT license.

name: ChotaDhobi CLI: reconstructing laundry app API use
description_en: ChotaDhobi CLI reimplements selected laundry-app functions through documented ChotaDhobi web API requests. Its Python client handles VIT email and OTP login, wash requests, collection QR codes and history, while a companion document records endpoint methods, headers and example responses.
description_zh: ChotaDhobi CLI 依据记录的 ChotaDhobi Web API 请求重实现部分洗衣应用功能。Python 客户端支持 VIT 邮箱与 OTP 登录、送洗申请、领取二维码和历史记录；附带文档记录端点方法、请求头和响应示例。
requirements: Python dependencies and a VIT email account are required for login.
No licence file in the repository.

name: FT9201 Linux: reconstructing fingerprint-reader USB capture
description_en: FT9201 Linux documents the USB exchanges needed to poll finger presence and capture a 64×80 grayscale frame from a FocalTech FT9201 reader. A C libusb proof of concept follows the recorded control-transfer and bulk-IN sequence and writes raw and PGM images.
description_zh: FT9201 Linux 记录了 FocalTech FT9201 指纹读取器用于检测手指和采集 64×80 灰度图像的 USB 交互。C 语言 libusb 概念验证程序按所列控制传输与 bulk-IN 顺序运行，并输出原始图像及 PGM 文件。
requirements: Requires a FocalTech FT9201 reader with VID:PID 2808:9338, Linux and libusb 1.0.
The implementation is a userspace proof of concept; libfprint, PAM and kernel-driver integration are absent.
MIT License.

name: SP656E CLI: a BanlanX Bluetooth lighting client
description_en: SP656E CLI implements a Bluetooth Low Energy client for SP656E and SP638E lighting controllers using the documented BanlanX 0x53 command format. Its Python interface scans devices, reads status and sends power, color, brightness, effect and raw commands; the protocol basis is credited to earlier community research.
description_zh: SP656E CLI 依据已有社区研究中的 BanlanX 0x53 命令格式，为 SP656E 和 SP638E 灯控器实现 BLE 客户端。Python 命令行支持设备扫描、状态读取，以及电源、颜色、亮度、灯效和原始命令发送。
requirements: Python 3.9+, macOS with Bluetooth and the bleak library are required.
The BanlanX app must be disconnected because only one BLE connection is allowed at a time.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Navico GoFree: screen-mirroring protocol findings
description_en: Navico GoFree records screen-mirroring protocol behavior observed on a Simrad NSS12 evo3 marine display. It maps UDP multicast discovery at 239.2.1.1:2052, the TCP connection on port 6633 that enables video output, and the RTSP /screenmirror endpoint, with small client probes.
description_zh: Navico GoFree 记录在 Simrad NSS12 evo3 船用显示设备上观察到的屏幕镜像协议。文档梳理了 239.2.1.1:2052 的 UDP 组播发现、使视频输出生效的 6633 端口 TCP 连接，以及 RTSP /screenmirror 端点，并附有探测脚本。
requirements: Requires a compatible GoFree marine display and access to its Wi-Fi network.
Observations are primarily from a Simrad NSS12 evo3; behavior on other models needs confirmation.
MIT License.

name: Claude Code inbox socket: documenting session messages and delivery
description_en: The Claude Code inbox-socket project documents the internal session messaging protocol carried over a Unix socket or Windows named pipe. It describes JSON-line frames, transport, receipts and delivery behavior, and supplies client examples and conformance checks against installed Claude Code versions.
description_zh: Claude Code inbox-socket 项目记录通过 Unix socket 或 Windows 命名管道传递的内部会话消息协议。文档说明 JSON 行消息帧、传输方式、回执和投递行为，并提供客户端示例及针对已安装版本的一致性检查。
requirements: An installed Claude Code version is needed for live conformance checks; those checks start temporary sessions and incur model usage.
The internal frame format may change between releases.
MIT license.

name: Tizen T-KTS firmware research: mapping the VDFS4 filesystem
description_en: Tizen T-KTS firmware research maps the VDFS4 filesystem inside a decrypted Samsung smart TV firmware image. Its notes describe superblocks, catalog records, file extents and copy-on-write block translation, while Python tools enumerate entries and locate file data. The author reports 2,113 enumerated entries; payload decompression remains unresolved.
description_zh: Tizen T-KTS firmware research 分析三星智能电视解密固件中的 VDFS4 文件系统。笔记记录超级块、目录记录、文件区段和写时复制块映射；Python 工具可枚举条目并定位文件数据。作者报告已枚举 2,113 个条目，文件内容解压仍未解决。
requirements: An official T-KTSDEUC firmware image must be obtained and decrypted separately.
The tools use paths and offsets measured from one decrypted platform.img; other firmware versions need adjustment.
File payload decompression is incomplete.
MIT license.

name: Philips Avent: reconstructing SCD923/26 local communication
description_en: Philips Avent Local Protocols investigates the SCD923/26 baby monitor's QR pairing, encrypted control session, RTSP video and separate ADPCM audio channels. The study combines handheld firmware analysis, isolated ARM emulation and tests against a paired baby unit. It marks discovery behavior and SCD973 authentication as unresolved.
description_zh: Philips Avent Local Protocols 研究 SCD923/26 婴儿监视器的二维码配对、加密控制会话、RTSP 视频及独立 ADPCM 音频通道。研究结合手持端固件分析、隔离的 ARM 模拟和已配对设备测试，并将设备发现行为及 SCD973 身份验证列为未解决问题。
requirements: The documented local interoperability tests used an SCD923/26 handheld and paired baby unit.
The SCD973 diagnostic requires Python 3.10 or newer; successful SCD973 authentication remains unconfirmed.
The diagnostic tool has a separate tools/LICENSE file; the research text has no repository-root licence file.

name: The Last Story: mapping the LastWorld engine and game formats
description_en: The Last Story research documents the Wii game's LastWorld engine and provides parsers and extractors for archives, text, textures, audio, models and scenes. Its executable analysis uses a custom DOL loader and Gekko SLEIGH language to examine main.dol, including the archive path hash and engine structures. The author reports format coverage and validation against game data.
description_zh: The Last Story 研究记录 Wii 游戏的 LastWorld 引擎，并提供归档、文本、纹理、音频、模型和场景的解析与提取工具。可执行文件分析使用自定义 DOL 加载器和 Gekko SLEIGH 语言研究 main.dol，包括归档路径哈希及引擎结构。格式覆盖和数据验证结果由作者报告。
requirements: The workflow requires a user-supplied legal copy of The Last Story disc.
Python 3.8 or newer and wit are required for extraction; Ghidra 12.x is used for main.dol analysis.
Some collision fields, gimmick trigger types and effect channels remain unidentified.
MIT license.

name: pyskylight: reconstructing the Skylight private app API
description_en: pyskylight reconstructs access to the private Skylight Calendar and Buddy app API through a Python library and CLI. It implements the app's OAuth2 PKCE login and token refresh flow, exposes calendar, meals, chores, photos and device operations, and documents request shapes the author reports checking against the live web client and API.
description_zh: pyskylight 通过 Python 库和命令行工具重建对 Skylight Calendar 与 Buddy 私有应用 API 的访问。它实现应用的 OAuth2 PKCE 登录和令牌刷新流程，提供日历、餐食、家务、照片及设备操作，并记录作者报告已对照在线网页客户端和 API 检查的请求结构。
requirements: Python 3.11+ and a Skylight account are required.
Some write requests accept a JSON pass-through while their bodies are being confirmed; some Meals functions may require Skylight Plus.
MIT license.

name: igpsport-binavi-poi: reconstructing BiNavi route points
description_en: igpsport-binavi-poi reconstructs the iGPSPORT BiNavi's .cnx route track codec and POI type values. Its Python generator combines a GPX track with distance-indexed roadbook points into a device route that shows proximity reminders during navigation; technical notes document the XML layout and observed FIT behavior.
description_zh: igpsport-binavi-poi 重建 iGPSPORT BiNavi 的 .cnx 路线轨迹编码与 POI 类型值。Python 生成器把 GPX 轨迹和按距离编排的路书点位写成设备路线，导航时显示接近提醒；技术笔记记录 XML 结构及观察到的 FIT 行为。
requirements: Python 3, a GPX track and a roadbook CSV are required; copying the result requires access to the BiNavi's Courses folder.
The author reports device testing only on BiNavi Air; behavior on other models is unconfirmed.
MIT license.

name: WeChat: recovering macOS chat databases for HTML export
description_en: The WeChat export investigation recovers chat data from WeChat 4.x for macOS. A Frida hook captures keys passed to CommonCrypto's CCCryptorCreate; Python scripts match the per-database keys to SQLCipher stores, decrypt the files, parse contact and message tables, and generate browser-readable HTML. The documentation records database paths and message-layout differences.
description_zh: WeChat export 项目从 macOS 微信 4.x 的本地数据库中恢复聊天记录。Frida 脚本截取传入 CommonCrypto 的 CCCryptorCreate 函数的密钥；Python 脚本将各数据库的密钥与 SQLCipher 文件匹配，解密文件、解析联系人和消息表，并生成可在浏览器查看的 HTML。文档还记录了数据库路径和消息格式差异。
requirements: Requires WeChat 4.x on macOS 13+ with access to the user's local databases.
Requires Python 3.10+, Frida and the sqlcipher CLI; Frida injection may require SIP changes or signing authorization.
The project specifies personal study, research and backup of one's own chat data.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Fujitsu FGL Type A Bus Protocol: decoding an air-conditioner wired remote
description_en: Fujitsu FGL Type A Bus Protocol reconstructs BWR wired-remote messages of an older Fujitsu/General air conditioner from logic-analyzer captures. Its specification records 500-baud 8E1 framing, heartbeat and command frames, and temperature and fan encoding; Python tools decode stored captures or sniff the bus live.
description_zh: Fujitsu FGL Type A Bus Protocol 从逻辑分析仪采集数据中解析旧款 Fujitsu/General 空调的 BWR 有线遥控消息。规格文档记录 500 波特率、8E1 帧格式、心跳与命令帧，以及温度和风速编码；Python 工具可解析采集文件或实时监听。
requirements: The documented capture setup uses a USB logic analyzer, a voltage divider and sigrok-cli.
Confirmed hardware is an AOG36TPAFL system with an EZ-0001HSEFR wired remote.
ESP32 sniffer, injector and smart-home integrations are planned.
MIT license.

name: turbine-api-docs: Turbine Alpha HTTP API reconstruction
description_en: turbine-api-docs reconstructs the Turbine Alpha HTTP API from the app.turbine.exchange JavaScript source map; the author reports checking it against production requests. It documents SIWE authentication, order and liquidity endpoints, and wire-format details including hex-encoded big integers and signature fields. A Python reference client accompanies the documentation.
description_zh: turbine-api-docs 根据 app.turbine.exchange 的 JavaScript 源映射文件整理 Turbine Alpha HTTP API；作者报告还通过生产环境请求进行了核对。文档记录 SIWE 认证、订单与流动性接口，以及十六进制编码的大整数和签名字段等传输格式细节，并附有 Python 参考客户端。
requirements: The reference tracks Turbine API v0.114.1; the service is in Alpha and may change without notice.
Some response shapes and status values come from SDK source without direct production observation.
CC BY 4.0 license; the repository requests a backlink when substantial portions are copied.

name: led-hue-cycle: reconstructing LEDDMX strip control over BLE
description_en: led-hue-cycle reconstructs LED LAMP's BLE commands for LEDDMX-family light strips in a native Android app and Python scripts. Its protocol reference specifies the FFE0 service, FFE1 write characteristic and nine-byte frames for color, power, brightness and patterns; the clients use those commands to cycle one or more strips through hues.
description_zh: led-hue-cycle 在原生 Android 应用和 Python 脚本中重建 LED LAMP 对 LEDDMX 系列灯带的 BLE 命令。协议资料给出 FFE0 服务、FFE1 写入特征，以及颜色、电源、亮度和图案的九字节帧；客户端据此让一条或多条灯带循环变色。
requirements: An LEDDMX-family BLE controller is required; the author reports testing a One94Store 5 m strip.
Building the Android app requires JDK 17 and the Android SDK; the Python path uses bleak and a supported BLE transport.
The Python path does not support the built-in Windows Bluetooth adapter, and strip color-byte order may need calibration.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: UniFi Protect: reconstructing siren and AI Horn audio control
description_en: The UniFi Protect audio investigation maps private HTTP endpoints and a WebSocket talkback stream for a UNVR running Protect 7.1.x. It documents siren, TTS, ringtone and volume calls, plus AAC-LC ADTS frame pacing for the AI Horn; Python examples implement the requests.
description_zh: 这项 UniFi Protect 音频研究梳理了 Protect 7.1.x 在 UNVR 上的私有 HTTP 端点和 WebSocket 对讲流。文档说明警报器、TTS、铃声和音量请求，以及 AI Horn 所需的 AAC-LC ADTS 帧节奏，并提供 Python 示例。
requirements: UniFi Protect 7.1.x on a UNVR, with the relevant siren or AI Horn hardware.
Internal endpoints use a session cookie; write requests also use a CSRF token. The source recommends a local Protect account for login.
The author reports occasional garbled talkback audio on Protect 7.1.x.
MIT license.

name: OPPO 移动电源助手: reconstructing power bank control on macOS
description_en: OPPO 移动电源助手 reconstructs power bank control on macOS from analysis of a Windows .NET assistant and its USB serial exchange. Its reports describe 0x5A packet headers, command IDs, and CRC8, while the Avalonia client displays battery and port status and synchronizes the clock.
description_zh: OPPO 移动电源助手项目通过分析 Windows .NET 助手及其 USB 串口通信，在 macOS 上重建移动电源控制功能。报告记录 0x5A 包头、命令编号和 CRC8；Avalonia 客户端显示电池与端口状态，并支持时钟同步。
requirements: macOS 10.15 or newer, .NET 7.0 SDK, a CH341 USB serial driver, and a compatible OPPO power bank are required.
The power bank must be placed in engineering mode; some functions may depend on the device model.
No licence file in the repository.

name: es4308cfg: reconstructing the Edgecore ES4308-PoE config format
description_en: es4308cfg reconstructs the Edgecore ES4308-PoE switch's proprietary NVRAM configuration format from differential exports. The repository documents TLV framing, checksums, obfuscated strings and port-bit permutations, and provides Rust and Python codecs, a Kaitai specification and sanitized fixtures.
description_zh: es4308cfg 通过对比交换机设置变更前后导出的配置文件，还原 Edgecore ES4308-PoE 的专有 NVRAM 配置格式。仓库记录 TLV 记录结构、校验和、混淆字符串及端口位映射，并提供 Rust 与 Python 编解码工具、Kaitai 规范和脱敏样本。
requirements: Python 3.9 or later for the Python tool; Rust and Cargo for the Rust codec.
The author reports validation against one ES4308-PoE unit; other units and firmware revisions may differ.
Live write and restore code is quarantined after an NVRAM corruption incident.
MIT License.

name: sr16-bridge: reconstructing SR16 smart-ring BLE history sync
description_en: sr16-bridge reconstructs the SR16 smart ring's vendor BLE history-sync protocol in a local Python client. It reassembles segmented notifications, checks CRCs, decodes heart-rate records and imports HCI snoop traffic into SQLite; probe logs record the observed message behavior.
description_zh: sr16-bridge 以本地 Python 客户端还原 SR16 智能戒指的私有 BLE 历史同步协议。它重组分段通知、检查 CRC、解析心率记录，并将 HCI snoop 流量导入 SQLite；探测日志记录观察到的消息行为。
requirements: macOS with Python 3.11 and an awake, unpaired SR16 ring nearby.
The author reports history-sync decoding through session 17; the session-17 notes say some activity metrics were absent from the captured BLE sync data.
No licence file in the repository.

name: agently-mail: reconstructing Tencent Agently Mail API access
description_en: agently-mail reconstructs Tencent Agently Mail access in a Cloudflare Worker using behavior studied from the Agently CLI. It documents the OAuth device flow, token refresh, mail endpoints and two-phase send confirmation, then exposes routes for listing, reading, searching and sending messages.
description_zh: agently-mail 根据对 Agently CLI 的研究，在 Cloudflare Worker 中重建 Tencent Agently Mail 的访问流程。文档记录 OAuth 设备授权、令牌刷新、邮件接口与两阶段发送确认，Worker 提供列出、读取、搜索和发送邮件的路由。
requirements: Requires a Cloudflare Worker, KV namespace and authorized Agently Mail tokens.
The author reports live checks against the service on 2026-07-07.
MIT licence.

name: LaMetric TIME Recovery Toolkit: recovering the clock setup API
description_en: LaMetric TIME Recovery Toolkit reconstructs the clock's Wi-Fi provisioning exchange from its Android APK and implements it in Linux scripts. It documents the setup AP's HTTP endpoints, account and Wi-Fi payloads, authentication and status codes, with DEX inspection helpers for examining the app.
description_zh: LaMetric TIME Recovery Toolkit 从 Android APK 还原时钟的 Wi-Fi 配网流程，并用 Linux 脚本执行。项目记录设置热点的 HTTP 接口、账户与 Wi-Fi 请求字段、认证方式和状态码，还提供 DEX 检查工具。
requirements: Linux with NetworkManager and curl, jq, nmcli, rg, ip and python3.
A LaMetric TIME in setup mode and an internet route while connected to its setup AP.
No licence file in the repository.

name: AvellSucks: reconstructing Avell laptop EC controls
description_en: AvellSucks is a Windows control app for an Avell gaming laptop’s fan, power settings and devices. The author recovered fan and power EC registers and WMI ACPI calls from the decompiled OEM app and hardware probes; the WPF app uses read-back checks and an audit log for EC writes. Other device controls use Windows APIs.
description_zh: AvellSucks 是用于控制 Avell 游戏笔记本风扇、电源设置和设备功能的 Windows 应用。作者通过反编译原厂应用并探测硬件，恢复风扇和电源控制所用的 EC 寄存器及 WMI ACPI 调用；WPF 程序对 EC 写入进行回读校验并记录审计日志。其他设备控制使用 Windows 接口。
requirements: Windows 10/11 x64, administrator rights, and the Avell i7-8750H hardware for which the EC register map was developed.
Keyboard RGB control is unfinished and untested.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: alpha1s: reconstructing UBTECH Alpha 1S Bluetooth control
description_en: alpha1s reconstructs the UBTECH Alpha 1S robot's Bluetooth control link as a Python SDK for telemetry, servo movement and stored actions. Its protocol layer documents FB BF frame headers, length and checksum fields, RFCOMM channel 6, a 16-servo command and optional BLE transport, with examples and tests against captured frames.
description_zh: alpha1s 将 UBTECH Alpha 1S 机器人的蓝牙控制链路实现为 Python SDK，支持遥测、舵机动作和设备内置动作。协议层记录 FB BF 帧头、长度与校验字段、RFCOMM 通道 6、16 舵机命令及可选 BLE 传输，并提供示例和基于捕获帧的测试。
requirements: A UBTECH Alpha 1S robot and compatible Bluetooth transport are required for hardware use.
The package specifies Python 3.9 or later; RFCOMM uses PyBluez on Linux, while BLE uses bleak.
The API is being consolidated, and the author notes that some LED behavior still needs checking across firmware revisions.
MIT license.

name: DARK: reconstructing the video plugin path for Proton cutscenes
description_en: dark-render-re reconstructs the video texture upload path used by DARK (2013) to restore WMV cutscenes under Proton. Its proxy loads the original VideoEnginePlugin, forwards the game's timing and UI controls, and uploads BGRA frames decoded by 32-bit Windows FFmpeg through VTextureObject::UpdateRect.
description_zh: dark-render-re 重建 DARK（2013）的视频贴图上传路径，以修复 Proton 下的 WMV 过场播放。代理插件加载原版 VideoEnginePlugin，保留游戏的时间控制和界面操作，再通过 VTextureObject::UpdateRect 上传由 32 位 Windows FFmpeg 解码的 BGRA 帧。
requirements: A DARK installation on Linux with Proton-GE and a 32-bit Windows FFmpeg/FFplay build.
The documented build uses Clang, lld and Wine i386 import libraries.
The author reports testing with a Russian-localized DARK installation on Proton-GE; other Proton builds are uncertain.
MIT license.

name: Daybreak: rebuilding COLMI R09 BLE communication for an offline ring client
description_en: Daybreak rebuilds COLMI R09 smart-ring communication in an offline Android client. Its Kotlin protocol module handles 16-byte commands and checksum validation, reassembles multi-packet sleep records, and processes heart-rate logs, steps and SpO2 data; the app computes local sleep, recovery and activity scores from the readings.
description_zh: Daybreak 在离线 Android 客户端中重建 COLMI R09 智能戒指通信。Kotlin 协议模块处理 16 字节命令及校验和，重组多包传输的睡眠记录，并解析心率日志、步数和 SpO2 数据；应用在本机计算睡眠、恢复和活动评分。
requirements: COLMI R09 smart ring and Android 8.0+ for the app.
JDK 17+ and Android SDK to build.
The source notes firmware-dependent HRV and noisy sleep staging.
MIT license.

name: USB-Endoscope: reconstructing Usee Plus USB video streaming
description_en: USB-Endoscope reconstructs the i4season Usee Plus endoscope’s vendor USB video protocol in a local WebUSB viewer. The author traced the Android app’s USBDEVFS calls with Frida and documented two stream-start control transfers followed by YUYV422 frames from bulk endpoint 0x82. The application displays live video and saves photos or recordings.
description_zh: USB-Endoscope 用本地 WebUSB 查看器重建 i4season Usee Plus 内窥镜的厂商 USB 视频协议。作者通过 Frida 跟踪 Android 应用的 USBDEVFS 调用，记录了启动视频的两次控制传输，以及从批量端点 0x82 读取 YUYV422 帧的过程。应用可显示实时视频并保存照片或录像。
requirements: The i4season Usee Plus endoscope with USB VID 0x2ce3/PID 0x3828 and a Chromium browser with WebUSB.
A secure context such as HTTPS or localhost is required; iOS browsers cannot stream via WebUSB.
GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: Cigar Oasis: reconstructing SmartHumidor cloud control
description_en: The Cigar Oasis Home Assistant integration reconstructs the SmartHumidor app’s cloud calls for humidity and temperature readings and setpoint control. The author captured app traffic with mitmproxy, documented the login and device endpoints, and implemented Python scripts and a Home Assistant package.
description_zh: Cigar Oasis 的 Home Assistant 集成还原 SmartHumidor 应用的云端调用，用于读取湿度、温度和设置目标湿度。作者以 mitmproxy 捕获应用流量，记录登录及设备接口，并实现 Python 脚本和 Home Assistant 配置包。
requirements: A Cigar Oasis 3.0, Home Assistant and a SmartHumidor account; active subscription is effectively required for setpoint control.
Readings and setpoint changes follow the device’s roughly hourly cloud sync.
MIT license.

name: PodFlick: reconstructing iPod Video library editing
description_en: PodFlick reconstructs iTunesDB editing for fifth-generation iPod Video devices in a macOS video-transfer app. It converts clips to H.264 Baseline and AAC with ffmpeg, then writes video records directly into the device database without iTunes. The repository includes a format specification, Python reference implementation and database fixtures.
description_zh: PodFlick 在 macOS 视频传输应用中重建第五代 iPod Video 的 iTunesDB 编辑方式。它用 ffmpeg 将视频转换为 H.264 Baseline 与 AAC，再直接向设备数据库写入视频记录。仓库提供格式说明、Python 参考实现及数据库样本。
requirements: iPod Video 5G or 5.5G mounted as a disk.
Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or newer; source builds require Xcode 15 or newer and ffmpeg on PATH.
Support for iPod Classic 6G and later and Intel Macs is planned; Linux and Windows are on the long-term wishlist.
MIT licence.

name: qss-switch-api: reconstructing QNAP QSS switch control
description_en: qss-switch-api reconstructs access to the private REST interface of a QNAP QSS-managed switch from its web UI JavaScript. Its Python CLI logs in, reads port, PoE, sensor and LLDP telemetry, and can send explicit API calls; the documentation records bearer-token authentication and response fields.
description_zh: qss-switch-api 根据 QNAP QSS 网页界面的 JavaScript 重建交换机私有 REST 接口。其 Python CLI 可登录、读取端口、PoE、传感器和 LLDP 数据，也可发送指定 API 调用；文档记录 Bearer Token 认证及响应字段。
requirements: QNAP QSS-managed switch; documented validation covers QSW-M2106PR-2S2T firmware 1.2.1.
Python 3.8+; PyYAML is optional for YAML configuration.
Write requests require explicit confirmation and can disrupt switch configuration.
MIT license.

name: NameLand: reconstructing Casio KL-A45 serial printing
description_en: NameLand reconstructs serial printing for the Casio KL-A45 label printer from communication observed between the device and Casio's Windows XP software. Its Python program sends arbitrary text as QR codes through a USB-to-serial cable with a 2.5 mm TRS connection. The README describes the cable wiring and notes that other printer models may need code changes.
description_zh: NameLand 依据 Casio Windows XP 软件与 KL-A45 标签打印机之间观察到的通信，重建串口打印方式。其 Python 程序通过 USB 转串口线和 2.5 毫米 TRS 接头，将任意文本打印为二维码。文档说明了线缆接法，并指出其他机型可能需要修改代码。
requirements: Casio KL-A45 label printer and a suitable serial cable with a 2.5 mm TRS plug.
Python with a serial library, numpy, qrcode and FreeSimpleGUI.
Other label-printer models may require code changes.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Vcf-compiler: reconstructing the VCutWorks VCF file format
description_en: Vcf-compiler reconstructs the binary VCF file format used by Ruida VCutWorks. It compares native files with generated variants, documents header, layer, geometry and trailer fields, and implements a Python writer that converts DXF input or a specification into VCF. The author reports that generated files load in VCutWorks with geometry and cutting parameters displayed.
description_zh: Vcf-compiler 重建 Ruida VCutWorks 使用的二进制 VCF 文件格式。项目对照原生文件和逐步生成的变体，记录文件头、图层、几何数据及尾部字段，并实现将 DXF 或 Python 规格写成 VCF 的工具。作者报告生成文件能在 VCutWorks 中加载并显示几何图形与切割参数。
requirements: Python 3.11 or later is required.
The author reports a working proof of concept with four remaining byte differences from native output.
PolyForm Shield License 1.0.0; commercial use requires a separate agreement.

name: dh360d: reconstructing the Darkflash cooler LCD protocol
description_en: dh360d reconstructs the Darkflash DH360D cooler LCD's serial protocol from traffic captured between the hardware and its Windows Electron app. Its Python Linux driver sends CPU temperature, pump speed, CPU use and RAM use through a CH340 USB-to-UART link. The protocol notes specify the 115200-baud framing, handshake, status fields and device acknowledgments.
description_zh: dh360d 通过抓取 Darkflash DH360D 散热器与其 Windows Electron 应用之间的通信，重建 LCD 的串口协议。其 Python Linux 驱动经 CH340 USB 转 UART 链路发送 CPU 温度、水泵转速、CPU 和内存占用率。协议文档列出 115200 波特率帧格式、握手、状态字段及设备应答。
requirements: Darkflash DH360D cooler with its CH340 USB-to-UART connection.
Linux and Python 3.8 or newer with pyserial and psutil.
MIT licence.

name: Sony WH-CH720N: reconstructing headset control over RFCOMM
description_en: Sony WH-CH720N control is reconstructed as a Linux Python client for the headset's Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM service. The project documents its framed messages, checksum, ACK sequence rule and command map, then uses them for battery readings, six-band EQ and noise-cancelling or ambient-mode control.
description_zh: 项目以 Linux Python 客户端重建 Sony WH-CH720N 的 Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM 控制方式。文档记录了帧结构、校验和、ACK 序号规则及命令表，并据此实现电量读取、六段均衡器以及降噪和环境声模式控制。
requirements: Linux and a paired Sony WH-CH720N headset; the documented command map is for firmware 1.0.8.
Only one MDR connection can be active at a time.
MIT license.

name: Kosmos CP1: reconstructing the CP2 cassette format
description_en: The Kosmos CP1 toolchain reconstructs the CP2 cassette interface from a digitized real save and implements Python WAV encoding and decoding. Its documentation specifies FSK carriers, bit timing, byte order and the 256-cell memory image. An assembler and emulator support writing and tracing CP1 programs; the author reports a byte-exact encoding round trip.
description_zh: Kosmos CP1 工具链从真实 CP2 存档的数字录音重建磁带接口，并用 Python 实现 WAV 编码与解码。文档说明 FSK 载波、位时序、字节顺序和 256 单元内存映像；汇编器与模拟器可编写并跟踪 CP1 程序。作者报告编码往返结果逐字节一致。
requirements: Python 3 is required; the audio tools also require numpy.
Loading a generated WAV into hardware requires a Kosmos CP1 and CP2 cassette module.
The author reports a byte-exact round trip and decoding of a genuine CP2 recording.
MIT license.

name: ISDT PB40: reconstructing a power bank's BLE protocol
description_en: pb40-bluetooth reconstructs the ISDT PB40/LIMETA EB40 power bank's BLE advertisement and GATT protocol from LiMeta app analysis and device captures. Its Home Assistant integration reads charge state without connecting, polls power and energy through GATT, and exposes a find-device command and reported settings.
description_zh: pb40-bluetooth 根据 LiMeta 应用分析和设备采集数据重建 ISDT PB40/LIMETA EB40 移动电源的 BLE 广播与 GATT 协议。Home Assistant 集成无需连接即可读取电量状态，并通过 GATT 轮询功率和累计电量，还提供设备查找命令及已报告的设置项。
requirements: Home Assistant with a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy in range of an ISDT PB40/LIMETA EB40.
GATT connections may be unreliable at the weak signal levels observed by the author.
MIT License.

name: Kid Icarus: Of Myths and Monsters: a Game Boy disassembly
description_en: Kid Icarus: Of Myths and Monsters reconstructs the Game Boy game's code and data as a documented RGBDS disassembly. The build uses an owner-supplied baserom.gb, extracts graphics and assembles a ROM; the project gives an MD5 value for checking the result.
description_zh: Kid Icarus: Of Myths and Monsters 以带文档的 RGBDS 汇编形式重建这款 Game Boy 游戏的代码和数据。构建过程使用用户提供的 baserom.gb，提取图形并组装 ROM；项目给出结果文件的 MD5 值供比对。
requirements: A copy of the game ROM named baserom.gb is required.
Building requires RGBDS and Python.
The disassembly and its documentation are works in progress.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: Jacuzzi JB1HL: decoding the J185 panel-link bus
description_en: Jacuzzi JB1HL Panel-Link Protocol documents the RS-485 messages between a Jacuzzi J185 hot tub's topside panel and I/O board. It identifies 38400 8N1 framing, a 34-byte poll-response burst, command bits and a checksum, then supplies an offline decoder and an ESPHome monitor for water temperature and pump or heater state.
description_zh: Jacuzzi JB1HL Panel-Link Protocol 记录 Jacuzzi J185 浴缸顶部面板与 I/O 板之间的 RS-485 消息。项目解析 38400 8N1 通信、34 字节轮询与响应、命令位和校验和，并提供离线解码器及显示水温、泵和加热器状态的 ESPHome 监测配置。
requirements: Monitoring requires an ESP32 with ESPHome, a TTL-to-RS-485 transceiver and access to the panel-controller A/B pair.
The implementation monitors the bus read-only; transmit control is not implemented.
MIT License.

name: Tenx USB Missile Launcher: reconstructing USB control commands
description_en: The Tenx USB Missile Launcher controller implements movement and firing commands in PureBasic for a specific USB device. Its protocol reference documents two eight-byte headers and a 64-byte payload sent across two interfaces with a nonstandard control-transfer value.
description_zh: Tenx USB Missile Launcher 控制器用 PureBasic 实现指定 USB 设备的移动和发射命令。协议文档记录了经两个接口发送的两段 8 字节头和一段 64 字节载荷，以及特殊的控制传输参数。
requirements: Windows, a Tenx launcher with VID 0x1130 and PID 0x0202, and libusb-win32 with a device-specific filter.
PureBasic 6.40 x64 was used for the documented build.
Custom Non-Commercial License; attribution is required and commercial use requires written permission.
