name: Crypto Kakadu Alternative: reconstructing device transfers and .kkd backups
description_en: Crypto Kakadu Alternative reconstructs the Crypto Kakadu password manager's serial database transfer and .kkd backup format from analysis of its Java manager and device behavior. Four PureBasic utilities read and upload device databases and convert between JSON and AES-encrypted .kkd files; protocol notes record commands, row layouts and encryption details.
description_zh: Crypto Kakadu Alternative 通过分析 Java 管理程序和设备行为，重建设备数据库串口传输及 .kkd 备份格式。四个 PureBasic 工具可读取、上传设备数据库，并在 JSON 与 AES 加密的 .kkd 文件之间转换；协议笔记记录命令、数据行布局和加密细节。
requirements: Crypto Kakadu hardware is required for device read and upload; the project reports compatibility with manager 2.3.1 and device firmware 1.5.0.
PureBasic is required to build the utilities.
The custom noncommercial licence requires attribution and separate written permission for commercial use.

name: alienware-m15-rgb: Linux control of the m15 R2 lighting controllers
description_en: alienware-m15-rgb implements Linux control of the Alienware m15 R2's per-key keyboard and chassis lighting through HID reports. Its protocol notes describe the Darfon API_V5 feature-report sequence and AW-ELC API_V4 output reports, including separate handling for the power-button light.
description_zh: alienware-m15-rgb 通过 HID 报告在 Linux 下控制 Alienware m15 R2 的逐键键盘灯和机身灯。协议笔记记录 Darfon API_V5 功能报告序列及 AW-ELC API_V4 输出报告，并说明电源按钮灯的单独设置方法。
requirements: An Alienware m15 R2 with the documented Darfon and AW-ELC controllers and Linux hidraw access are required.
A udev rule enables access without root; wallpaper matching additionally requires ImageMagick.
Other notebooks using the same keyboard protocol are described as possible but unconfirmed.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: podscribe: reconstructing the old iPod iTunesDB writer
description_en: podscribe reconstructs old-format iTunesDB writing for the 5.5-generation iPod Video in TypeScript. Its format notes map the little-endian chunk tree and playlist references, while the library writes track and playlist records and includes a reader for comparison with an iTunes-generated database.
description_zh: podscribe 用 TypeScript 重建第 5.5 代 iPod Video 的旧版 iTunesDB 写入功能。格式文档说明小端 chunk 树和播放列表引用；库代码写入曲目及播放列表记录，并提供读取器以对照 iTunes 生成的数据库。
requirements: Node.js 26 or newer is required.
Device use requires a mounted FAT32 5.5-generation iPod Video; modern hashed iTunesDB formats are outside scope.
The author describes on-device playlist playback as an acceptance gate still to be completed.
MIT license.

name: Ideal Clima Nemo 1000: reconstructing local Tuya MCU control
description_en: Ideal Clima Nemo 1000 local control replaces its Wi-Fi module with an ESP32-C3 on the CN2 connector and speaks the documented Tuya MCU UART exchange. The implementation exposes power, setpoint, mode and fan control through ESPHome or MQTT, with Python tools for passive frame decoding and bench commands.
description_zh: Ideal Clima Nemo 1000 本地控制方案在 CN2 接口接入 ESP32-C3，模拟 Wi-Fi 模块并使用记录下来的 Tuya MCU UART 通信。实现通过 ESPHome 或 MQTT 控制电源、设定温度、模式和风速，另附 Python 工具用于被动解帧及台架命令。
requirements: An Ideal Clima Nemo 1000, ESP32-C3 and access to its internal CN2 connector.
ESPHome or a PlatformIO MQTT setup; the MQTT option requires a broker.
The author reports testing on Nemo 1000 only; ambient temperature and fault values are emitted at cold boot.
MIT license.

name: Switch 2 Pro Controller: bridging its USB HID reports to Windows XInput
description_en: Windows-Switch2-Pro-Controller reconstructs the Switch 2 Pro Controller's USB wake and HID report behavior in a Windows bridge. It parses button and stick reports, forwards input through ViGEmBus as an Xbox 360 pad, and relays rumble back to the controller; an optional BLE path is also described.
description_zh: Windows-Switch2-Pro-Controller 在 Windows 桥接程序中还原 Switch 2 Pro 手柄的 USB 唤醒及 HID 报告行为。它解析按键与摇杆报告，经 ViGEmBus 输出虚拟 Xbox 360 手柄，并将震动反馈传回手柄；另有可选 BLE 路径。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 x64, a USB-connected Switch 2 Pro Controller, Python 3 and the ViGEmBus driver.
The optional Bluetooth path requires bleak.
MIT license; bundled third-party components have separate notices.

name: cyberboard-cli: reconstructing CyberBoard R4 configuration writes
description_en: cyberboard-cli reconstructs the AngryMiao CyberBoard R4 configuration protocol used by AM Master. Its CLI reads keymaps and writes keymap and LED configuration through USB CDC serial frames, with protocol notes describing 64-byte framing and CRC-8. The author reports hardware-tested writes and keymap reads; per-key LED authoring remains unfinished.
description_zh: cyberboard-cli 重建 AM Master 使用的 AngryMiao CyberBoard R4 配置协议。CLI 通过 USB CDC 串行帧读取键位映射并写入键位与 LED 配置，协议笔记记录了 64 字节帧和 CRC-8。作者报告已在实物上测试写入与键位回读；逐键 LED 编辑仍未完成。
requirements: Python 3.11+ and an AngryMiao CyberBoard R4; device operation uses pyserial.
Per-key LED authoring remains in progress.
MIT.

name: gm1356-recordings: reading a sound meter through its USB-HID protocol
description_en: gm1356-recordings implements a Python client for live readings and stored logs from the Benetech GM1356 sound level meter. Its protocol notes describe eight-byte USB-HID reports, the 0xB5 import handshake, 0xC4 pull loop and packed recording samples. The author reports comparing decoded recordings with data on the device.
description_zh: gm1356-recordings 为 Benetech GM1356 声级计实现 Python 客户端，可读取实时数值和机内日志。协议文档记录了八字节 USB-HID 报告、0xB5 导入握手、0xC4 拉取循环及打包采样格式。作者报告将解码结果与设备记录进行了对照。
requirements: Benetech GM1356 USB sound level meter.
macOS or Linux, Python 3.8 or newer, and libhidapi.
MIT licence.

name: TwoTrees SK1: reconstructing the display UART interface
description_en: TwoTrees SK1 display research documents the printer's HMI UART commands and incoming touch, numeric and startup frames. The repository uses that mapping in a Rust client connected to Moonraker, a Python demonstration host and an experimental ESP32-C6 display client.
description_zh: TwoTrees SK1 显示屏研究记录打印机 HMI 的 UART 命令，以及触摸、数值输入和启动帧。仓库据此实现连接 Moonraker 的 Rust 客户端、Python 演示主机和实验性的 ESP32-C6 客户端。
requirements: The TwoTrees SK1 display uses 5 V power and 3.3 V RX/TX logic levels.
The Rust client targets the printer's HMI UART and Moonraker; the ESP32 client targets ESP32-C6.
The protocol manual includes probe and debug commands that require checking on a live HMI.
MIT license.

name: GameSir Connect: reconstructing controller-profile share codes
description_en: GameSir Connect share-code research reconstructs the desktop app's controller-profile export format and supplies a Python codec for editing and reimporting profiles. The documented GAMESIR: pipeline combines JSON, gzip, Base64 and AES-256-CBC, with a derived key and IV; the author reports testing on a GameSir G7 Pro.
description_zh: GameSir Connect 分享码研究还原桌面应用的手柄配置导出格式，并提供 Python 编解码器，便于编辑和重新导入配置。文档记载，编码时先压缩 JSON，再进行 Base64 编码和 AES-256-CBC 加密，最后将密文编码为 Base64 并加上 GAMESIR: 前缀；密钥和 IV 由密码派生。作者报告已在 GameSir G7 Pro 上测试。
requirements: Requires Python and the cryptography dependency to use the codec.
The author reports empirical testing on the GameSir G7 Pro; other controller models are not individually tested.
GameSir Connect may reject exported profiles containing fields outside its base template; encode --importable removes those fields.
MIT license.

name: KW330 OBD Data Access: reconstructing the scanner's USB data stream
description_en: KW330 OBD Data Access reconstructs how the KONNWEI KW330 handheld scanner exposes live OBD data through its USB CDC serial port. Python scripts find the port, capture the Print Data Stream output, and parse its Latin-1 label-and-value lines into time-series JSON keyed by engine-running time.
description_zh: KW330 OBD Data Access 重建 KONNWEI KW330 手持扫描仪通过 USB CDC 串口输出实时 OBD 数据的方式。Python 脚本查找串口、采集 Print Data Stream，并将 Latin-1 标签和值解析为按发动机运行时间组织的 JSON 时间序列。
requirements: A KONNWEI KW330 with a USB data cable and suitable USB power or hub.
Python 3 and pyserial are used by the capture scripts.
The author reports end-to-end testing on macOS; other models and the listed Linux and Windows paths have narrower evidence.
MIT License.

name: AstralPool Halo Cloud: reconstructing chlorinator cloud control
description_en: AstralPool Halo Cloud reconstructs cloud control of Halo chlorinators as a Home Assistant integration. BLE onboarding retrieves device-generated credentials, after which a client uses the vendor WebSocket relay and parsed device messages for telemetry and control. The security notes document authentication values extracted from the official app binary.
description_zh: AstralPool Halo Cloud 以 Home Assistant 集成重建 Halo 氯化设备的云端控制。它通过 BLE 配网取得设备生成的凭据，再经厂商 WebSocket 中继和解析后的设备消息读取状态、发送控制。安全说明记录了从官方应用二进制中提取的中继认证参数。
requirements: Home Assistant, a Halo chlorinator and access to the vendor cloud; BLE is used for onboarding.
The pre-release has been tested on one controller firmware version, pbver 2.3; several writes remain experimental.
MIT.

name: zen-go-tui: reconstructing Zen Go USB HID controls
description_en: zen-go-tui reconstructs control of the Antelope Zen Go Synergy Core audio interface through its USB HID protocol. The Rust terminal app manages outputs, mixer strips, preamp settings and meters, while protocol notes describe captured frame types, command payloads and state fields.
description_zh: zen-go-tui 通过 USB HID 协议重建 Antelope Zen Go Synergy Core 音频接口的控制功能。Rust 终端程序管理输出、混音轨道、前级设置和电平表；协议笔记记录抓包所得的帧类型、命令载荷和状态字段。
requirements: Rust 1.70 or later, Linux and a Zen Go Synergy Core connected by USB.
A Windows cross-build target exists, but the author has not tested it on hardware.
MIT License.

name: tinyscreen: reconstructing an ArtInChip USB display protocol
description_en: tinyscreen implements a Linux client for ArtInChip USB bar displays using a reconstructed device protocol. It performs the display's two-phase RSA challenge-response exchange and sends JPEG frames with 20-byte headers over USB bulk transfers. The client can present dashboards, video, web pages or an EVDI virtual monitor.
description_zh: tinyscreen 按重建的设备协议驱动 ArtInChip USB 条形显示器：完成两阶段 RSA 挑战响应认证，再通过 USB bulk 传输带 20 字节帧头的 JPEG 图像。客户端可显示仪表盘、视频、网页或 EVDI 虚拟显示器画面。
requirements: Linux and an ArtInChip USB display; the documented working model is the ZHAOCAILIN 11.3-inch 1920×440 display with USB ID 33c3:0e02.
EVDI virtual-monitor mode requires an X11 session, evdi-dkms, libevdi1 and xdotool.
Support for USB IDs 33c3:0e01, 33c3:0e04 and 33c3:0e05 is listed as untested.
MIT.

name: Panavox PSS-12 INV: reconstructing air-conditioner UART control
description_en: Panavox PSS-12 INV reconstructs control of a split air conditioner through its W950 UART connector. The C++ library builds command frames, handles acknowledgments and periodic status requests, and parses 150-byte status responses; a companion specification records frame layout and commands refined through physical-unit testing.
description_zh: Panavox PSS-12 INV 通过 W950 UART 接口重建分体空调控制。C++ 库生成命令帧、处理确认和定期状态请求，并解析 150 字节状态响应；配套规范记录了依据实体设备测试修订的帧结构和命令。
requirements: A Panavox PSS-12 INV unit with access to its W950 UART connector and a microcontroller providing an Arduino Stream interface.
UART uses 9600 baud, 8N1; connector signals may need inversion depending on hardware.
MIT License.

name: WB-SG1-8G: reconstructing a signal generator's serial commands
description_en: The WB-SG1-8G project documents the BG7TBL signal generator's serial protocol and implements a browser controller over Web Serial. Its protocol notes specify connection settings, $X...* command framing, frequency and sweep commands, hardware toggles and observed replies. The page controls both output channels and monitors received and transmitted traffic.
description_zh: WB-SG1-8G 项目记录 BG7TBL 信号发生器的串口协议，并通过 Web Serial 实现浏览器控制页面。协议笔记列出连接参数、$X...* 命令帧、频率与扫频命令、硬件开关及观察到的响应；页面可控制双通道并监看收发数据。
requirements: A BG7TBL WB-SG1-8G signal generator and a browser with Web Serial support.
Host index.html on an HTTPS-enabled server or use the linked hosted page; the default serial speed is 9600 baud.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Brother HL-4150CDN: reconstructing the XL2HB print stream
description_en: The Brother HL-4150CDN driver reconstructs the proprietary XL2HB print stream produced by Brother's 32-bit x86 filter. Its Python and optional Cython implementation handles raster encoding, color processing, PJL job settings and CUPS integration, with comparison fixtures for byte-level output matching.
description_zh: Brother HL-4150CDN 驱动重建原厂 32 位 x86 过滤器生成的专有 XL2HB 打印数据流。Python 实现及可选 Cython 加速模块处理栅格编码、色彩转换、PJL 作业设置和 CUPS 集成，并用对比样本检查输出字节。
requirements: Linux with CUPS and Ghostscript, plus Python 3.13 or newer as system python3.
Brother's HL-4150CDN LPR package is needed to extract calibration tables locally.
The author reports eight further models using the same filter, but they remain untested on hardware.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: Shala Darpan: reconstructing a public school portal API
description_en: Shala Darpan documents the public Rajasthan school portal's observed ASP.NET WebMethods. Its reference covers 27 discovered endpoints, school-search flag codes, request and response shapes, and district, block and subject identifiers, with curl examples for public searches.
description_zh: Shala Darpan 记录拉贾斯坦邦学校门户公开页面使用的 ASP.NET WebMethods。文档涵盖 27 个发现的接口、学校搜索标志码、请求与响应格式，以及地区、区块和学科编号，并附有公开查询的 curl 示例。
requirements: Access to the Rajasthan Shala Darpan public portal is required for the examples.
Reference data is dated March 2026; the author notes intermittent 403/503 responses.
MIT license.

name: monclub-bot: reconstructing MonClub booking requests
description_en: monclub-bot reconstructs MonClub app booking exchanges from intercepted HTTPS traffic. Its research notes document two-step authentication, request identifiers and endpoints for listing sessions, booking and cancellation. A Rust CLI and Discord bot use the recovered exchanges to manage reservations and export upcoming sessions.
description_zh: monclub-bot 通过截获 HTTPS 流量还原 MonClub 应用的预约交互。研究笔记记录两步认证、请求标识符，以及查询课程、预约和取消的接口。Rust CLI 与 Discord 机器人利用这些交互管理预约并导出后续课程。
requirements: A MonClub account, club identifier and API base URL; building uses Rust/Cargo.
Discord bot operation additionally requires a Discord bot token.
No licence file in the repository.

name: glow-linux: reconstructing Spacetronik Glow Three LED control
description_en: glow-linux reconstructs the Spacetronik Glow Three 27V LED controller's USB serial exchange from captured traffic. It documents the CH340 initialization sequence and AA 55 framed handshake, color and heartbeat messages, then uses pyusb for Linux lighting control and PipeWire screen capture for ambient color sync.
description_zh: glow-linux 从抓取的 USB 流量重建 Spacetronik Glow Three 27V 灯光控制器的串行通信。项目记录 CH340 初始化序列，以及以 AA 55 开头的握手、颜色和心跳报文；Linux 客户端通过 pyusb 控灯，并用 PipeWire 抓屏实现环境灯同步。
requirements: Spacetronik Glow Three 27V with CH340 USB serial bridge for the documented device path.
Linux with the USB access and desktop components required for pyusb, GTK4 and PipeWire screen capture.
The author reports development and testing with the Glow Three 27V; other CH340-based controllers are only a possible compatibility target.
MIT license.

name: nanparty: reconstructing PavoTube II 6C BLE mesh control
description_en: nanparty reconstructs Nanlite PavoTube II 6C control over BLE mesh and bridges MIDI controls to light settings. Its Python code provisions the light, builds mesh messages and drives hue, saturation, brightness and effects; the protocol reference maps GATT characteristics, authentication and vendor PDUs.
description_zh: nanparty 重建 Nanlite PavoTube II 6C 的 BLE Mesh 控制，并把 MIDI 控制消息映射到灯光参数。Python 代码为灯具配网、构造 Mesh 消息，并控制色相、饱和度、亮度和效果；协议文档列出 GATT 特征、认证过程及厂商 PDU。
requirements: A Nanlite PavoTube II 6C light and a BLE-capable host; initial setup requires factory resetting and provisioning the light.
Python 3.13 or later and the dependencies listed in pyproject.toml.
No licence file in the repository.

name: M3508I: reconstructing the motor RS485 protocol
description_en: m3508i reconstructs the M3508I motor’s half-duplex RS485 command and reply format. The repository documents field offsets, motor selection, speed encoding and CRC16, and supplies a C frame builder and parser, an STM32 example and an adapter-board design.
description_zh: m3508i 还原 M3508I 电机的半双工 RS485 指令与回包格式，记录字段偏移、电机选择、速度编码及 CRC16 规则，并提供 C 语言组帧和解析代码、STM32 示例及转接板设计。
requirements: An M3508I motor and RS485 connection are needed for hardware use; the example targets an STM32F407 board.
The current/torque and temperature fields remain raw values without conversion formulas.
MIT license.

name: KeyMission 360 Tools: reconstructing the camera's USB formatting command
description_en: KeyMission 360 Tools documents and implements USB PTP control of the Nikon KeyMission 360, including the FormatStore command for its SD card. Its protocol research records USB endpoints, PTP container layouts and command responses. The Linux toolkit also provides camera information, downloads, time sync and media controls.
description_zh: KeyMission 360 Tools 记录并实现 Nikon KeyMission 360 的 USB PTP 控制，包括用于 SD 卡的 FormatStore 命令。研究文档列出 USB 端点、PTP 容器布局和命令响应；Linux 工具还提供相机信息读取、下载、时间同步和媒体操作。
requirements: Nikon KeyMission 360 connected over USB and a Linux system for the documented control workflow.
The documented desktop setup uses gphoto2, ffmpeg, ExifTool, Tk and Python requirements; non-root access uses the included udev instructions.
Formatting and deletion require confirmation unless the CLI caller supplies --force.
MIT license.

name: Evnia: reconstructing Philips 49M2C8900 Ambiglow USB control
description_en: Evnia reconstructs USB control of the Philips Evnia 49M2C8900 monitor's 44 Ambiglow LEDs in a macOS Swift library. Its protocol notes identify vendor-specific endpoint-zero requests, the 0xE100 RGB frame buffer, and control blocks for taking and releasing software ownership.
description_zh: Evnia 以 macOS Swift 库重建 Philips Evnia 49M2C8900 显示器 44 颗 Ambiglow LED 的 USB 控制。协议文档记录端点零的厂商专用请求、0xE100 RGB 帧缓冲区，以及获取和交还软件控制权所需的控制块。
requirements: Requires macOS and the Philips Evnia 49M2C8900 monitor with the documented USB controller.
The documented working path covers 44 RGB LEDs and the listed ownership controls.
MIT licence.

name: audeze-filter-cli: reconstructing Audeze Filter HID controls
description_en: audeze-filter-cli reconstructs the Audeze Filter USB speaker's settings interface as a Python CLI. Research notes trace command bytes and value conversions through the AudezeHub Mach-O binary, while the protocol reference describes HID report IDs, packet headers and read/write operations.
description_zh: audeze-filter-cli 以 Python 命令行重建 Audeze Filter USB 音箱的设置接口。研究记录从 AudezeHub Mach-O 程序追踪命令字节和数值转换，协议文档说明 HID 报告 ID、数据包头及读写操作。
requirements: Python 3.8 or higher, the hidapi system library and an Audeze Filter USB speaker.
Linux users may need a udev rule for HID access.
MIT License.

name: casio_fx: documenting Casio calculator serial transfers
description_en: casio_fx implements Linux serial transfers for Casio calculators and documents their section-based message exchange and CAS file structure. Its send and receive utilities handle program data for fx-7700GB and fx-7700GE; a converter turns supported monochrome CAS screen dumps into PBM images.
description_zh: casio_fx 实现 Casio 计算器与 Linux 主机之间的串行传输，并记录分段通信过程和 CAS 文件结构。收发工具支持 fx-7700GB 与 fx-7700GE 的程序数据，转换器可将受支持的单色 CAS 屏幕转储转成 PBM 图像。
requirements: Linux and a suitable serial connection with compatible voltage levels are required.
Program transfer is documented for fx-7700GB and fx-7700GE; monochrome screenshots were tested with CFX-9850G.
Other data communication functions are not implemented.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Falmec Nuvola 90: reconstructing a 433 MHz remote protocol
description_en: Falmec Nuvola 90 remote research reconstructs the range hood's 433 MHz OOK control messages from captured signals. The documented 33-bit frame encodes fan speed and light state using 320 and 640 µs pulses; Python receiver tools decode captures, while Raspberry Pi and ATtiny85 transmitters send replacement commands.
description_zh: 该研究根据采集到的信号重建 Falmec Nuvola 90 抽油烟机遥控器的 433 MHz OOK 控制消息。文档给出以 320 和 640 微秒脉冲编码风速、灯光状态的 33 位帧；Python 接收工具负责解码，Raspberry Pi 与 ATtiny85 实现替代发射器。
requirements: A Raspberry Pi running pigpiod and Python 3.10+ for the Python capture and transmitter tools.
An FS1000A or STX882 transmitter, or an MX-RM-5V receiver, for the corresponding hardware workflow.
No licence file in the repository.

name: sperax-rm01: reconstructing the Sperax RM-01 BLE controls
description_en: sperax-rm01 reconstructs the Sperax RM-01 walking pad's BLE controls as a Python library and CLI. Analysis of the Sperax Fitness Android app's Dart AOT binary informed its documented FFF0 service, F5-framed messages, CRC-16 variant and start, stop and speed commands for model WLT6200.
description_zh: sperax-rm01 将 Sperax RM-01 走步机的 BLE 控制交互实现为 Python 库和命令行工具。项目依据 Sperax Fitness Android 应用的 Dart AOT 二进制分析，记录了 WLT6200 型号的 FFF0 服务、F5 帧、CRC-16 变体及启动、停止和调速命令。
requirements: A Sperax RM-01 WLT6200 walking pad and BLE access are required for device control.
Python 3.10 or later and bleak are specified by the package metadata.
MIT license.

name: Pac-Man NES Source Reconstruction: seven byte-identical cartridge revisions
description_en: Pac-Man NES Source Reconstruction rebuilds seven official Famicom and NES Pac-Man revisions from shared, annotated 6502 ca65 modules. Its build rules extract data from a user's ROM and compare assembled output byte for byte with each available original; a relocated build also has a recorded longplay check in MAME.
description_zh: Pac-Man NES Source Reconstruction 以共享、带注释的 6502 ca65 模块重建七个官方 Famicom 与 NES《Pac-Man》版本。构建规则从用户自有 ROM 提取数据，并将生成结果与对应原版逐字节比较；迁址构建还可在 MAME 中执行录制的通关检查。
requirements: Python 3, GNU Make, Retrolarium Kit and a user's Japan v1.0 Pac-Man ROM are required for any build; other revisions' ROMs are optional.
MAME is required for the full longplay check.
The repository currently grants no open-source license for project-authored files.

name: UNAR6: reconstructing the AR6 archive format
description_en: UNAR6 reconstructs the AR6 archive format used by the Manažer M602 DOS file manager from observed archives. Its format notes specify record headers, directory entries, checksums and PKWARE DCL compression, while C, Pascal and Python implementations list, test and extract archive contents.
description_zh: UNAR6 从实际归档文件重建 Manažer M602 DOS 文件管理器使用的 AR6 格式。格式文档说明记录头、目录项、校验和与 PKWARE DCL 压缩；C、Pascal 和 Python 实现可列出、检查并解压归档内容。
requirements: AR6 archives are needed as inputs; the repository omits test archives and extracted samples.
The C and Pascal versions target Turbo C 3.0 and Turbo Pascal 6.0; Python is the modern reference implementation.
The author reports correct decoding with CRC and size checks for the samples examined.
MIT license.

name: HeronSquawk: reconstructing RYLR999 LoRa framing for a mesh network
description_en: HeronSquawk reconstructs the RYLR999 LoRa module's on-air framing from SDR captures so it can exchange packets with Heltec V3.1 SX1262 nodes. The resulting mesh system combines a Python desktop base station, MicroPython node firmware and an Android BLE client, with encrypted messages routed across nodes.
description_zh: HeronSquawk 根据 SDR 抓包重建 RYLR999 LoRa 模块的空中帧格式，使其能与 Heltec V3.1 的 SX1262 节点交换数据。项目包含 Python 桌面基站、MicroPython 节点固件和 Android BLE 客户端，支持加密消息在节点间转发。
requirements: An RYLR999 module and a USB serial adapter for the desktop base station; Heltec V3.1 hardware for portable nodes.
Python 3.9+ for the desktop component and MicroPython on Heltec V3.1 nodes.
The author says bugs may remain and that key derivation and mesh formation take time on Heltec V3.1 hardware.
MIT license.

name: TP-Link SG3428: reconstructing its USB console access
description_en: TP-Link SG3428 USB Reset reconstructs access to a JetStream switch's USB console through a Python raw-USB client. The investigation found that a vendor-class interface responds to CDC ACM line-coding requests; the tool sets 38400/8N1, exchanges data over bulk endpoints and exposes an interactive console, baud scan and BootUtil reset workflow.
description_zh: TP-Link SG3428 USB Reset 通过 Python 原始 USB 客户端重建 JetStream 交换机控制台访问方式。调查发现，声明为厂商自定义类别的接口仍响应 CDC ACM 串口参数请求；工具据此设置 38400/8N1，通过批量端点收发数据，并提供交互终端、波特率扫描和 BootUtil 重置流程。
requirements: A TP-Link switch exposing USB VID:PID 2357:0701 and Linux USB access are required; the documented setup uses python3-usb and libusb.
The author tested a TL-SG3428 v2.20; other JetStream models are proposed but untested.
MIT license.

name: AvalonEmu: reconstructing an Albion Online local server
description_en: AvalonEmu reconstructs an Albion Online local server for a specific client build in C# and .NET 10. It implements Photon UDP transport, Protocol18 serialization, encrypted handshakes, login and world systems, and a decoder for packet captures. The server loads GameData from the user's own client installation.
description_zh: AvalonEmu 使用 C# 和 .NET 10 为特定版本的 Albion Online 客户端重建本地服务器。项目实现 Photon UDP 传输、Protocol18 序列化、加密握手、登录与世界系统，并附有抓包解码器；服务器从用户自有客户端安装目录读取 GameData。
requirements: .NET 10 SDK and GameData from a client installation owned by the user are required.
The server targets client build 1.32.030.345319; other builds are unsupported.
MIT license.

name: Azazel6: an experimental Tekken 6 PSP static recompilation for Android
description_en: Azazel6 researches a native Android ARM64 port of Tekken 6 for PSP by translating selected Allegrex/MIPS code ahead of time to C++ and building a PSP service host. It includes executable analysis, an import inventory and bounded startup probes. The author reports that translated startup reaches graphics initialization; the game remains unplayable.
description_zh: Azazel6 研究将 PSP 版《铁拳 6》移植到 Android ARM64，提前将部分 Allegrex/MIPS 代码翻译为 C++，并构建配套的 PSP 服务运行时。项目包含可执行文件分析、导入项盘点和有限的启动探针。作者报告，经翻译的启动代码已运行至图形初始化阶段；游戏目前尚不可玩。
requirements: Compatible files from the user's own Tekken 6 USA copy, including a decrypted EBOOT for analysis.
Git, Python 3.10+, CMake 3.22+ and a C++20 compiler; the Android target is ARM64.
The author reports no title screen, displayed game scene, audio or guest controls; performance against PPSSPP is unmeasured.
MIT license for original Azazel6 code.

name: Vault Engine: rebuilding Fallout and Fallout 2 in Rust
description_en: Vault Engine reimplements Fallout and Fallout 2 as a Rust engine that reads the user's retail DAT archives. Its modules cover DAT formats, the INT script VM, combat, AI, saves and rendering, with behavior built from written clean-room specifications and checked through state hashes and trace oracles.
description_zh: Vault Engine 以 Rust 重建 Fallout 和 Fallout 2，读取用户零售版的 DAT 归档。其模块涵盖 DAT 格式、INT 脚本虚拟机、战斗、AI、存档和渲染；实现依据成文的净室规格，并使用状态哈希与轨迹对照进行检查。
requirements: The user's own Fallout or Fallout 2 DAT archives are required.
Linux, Windows or macOS is supported; building from source requires Rust 1.88 or later.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: Drakengard: an experimental PAL PlayStation 2 static recompilation
description_en: A source-only Drakengard project statically recompiles the European PlayStation 2 release toward a native PC port, with a runtime for original hardware and service behavior. The author reports a diagnostic runner reaching Chapter I scenes and rendering Caim, terrain, objects, radar and HUD; sustained gameplay remains unfinished.
description_zh: 该 Drakengard 项目对欧洲版 PlayStation 2 游戏进行静态重编译，目标是原生 PC 移植，并编写支持原机硬件与服务行为的运行时。作者报告诊断运行器已进入第一章场景并渲染角色、地形、物体、雷达和 HUD；持续游戏流程仍未完成。
requirements: Use a locally supplied copy of the SLES-52322 version 1.00 PAL game; game-specific bindings require the verified ELF hash.
Public checks require Python 3.10 or newer and Git; C++ service checks also require CMake 3.21 or newer and a C++20 compiler.
No playable build is available; combat, audio, saves and recovery remain unverified.
MIT license for original project code and documentation.

name: Drakengard 3: a Windows port through static recompilation
description_en: Drakengard 3 Recompile translates the PS3 release of Drakengard 3 into native Windows x64 code and replaces platform services in a local runtime. It targets NPUB31251 version 1.01 and builds from the user's game files; the author reports intro, audio, menu and story-scene milestones, with controlled gameplay still unconfirmed.
description_zh: Drakengard 3 Recompile 将 PS3 版 Drakengard 3 转换为 Windows x64 原生代码，并在本地运行时替换平台服务。项目针对 NPUB31251 1.01，使用用户自己的游戏文件构建；作者报告已运行片头、音频、菜单及剧情场景，尚未确认可操控游戏过程。
requirements: Windows x64, original Drakengard 3 NPUB31251 version 1.01 files and locally generated PPU/SPU sources.
Gameplay with working controls is not yet confirmed; rendering stability and later performance remain in development.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Metropolismania PC: porting a PS2 game function by function
description_en: Metropolismania PC rebuilds the PS2 game as readable C++ while using PS2Recomp output from the user's disc as a running scaffold. Functions are replaced individually and compared with recorded original calls; the author reports all 1,481 game functions rewritten, with 1,432 passing differential checks, while playthrough remains unfinished.
description_zh: Metropolismania PC 以玩家光盘生成的 PS2Recomp 代码作为运行框架，逐函数将 PS2 游戏改写为可读的 C++。项目用原版调用记录做差分检查；作者报告 1,481 个游戏函数均已改写，其中 1,432 个通过检查，但游戏尚不能完整通关。
requirements: The user's own USA Metropolismania PS2 disc, SLUS-20377 version 1.02, is required.
Building requires Visual Studio 2022, CMake 3.21+, Python 3.11+, Ghidra 12.1.4, JDK 21, and the Emotion Engine extension.
The port remains experimental and is not ready for a complete playthrough.

name: Sonic Adventure decomp: rebuilding the Dreamcast executable from a local disc
description_en: Sonic Adventure decomp reconstructs the European Dreamcast game's executable from a user-supplied disc, using per-function SH-4 assembly files as a byte-matching build baseline. Its tools split the executable, map text and models, disassemble SH-4 code, and compare recovered C functions against original behavior; the author reports that no C functions are complete yet.
description_zh: Sonic Adventure decomp 从用户提供的光盘提取欧洲版 Dreamcast 游戏可执行文件，以逐函数 SH-4 汇编文件建立逐字节匹配的构建基线。项目提供可执行文件拆分、文本和模型映射、SH-4 反汇编及 C 函数行为比对工具；作者报告目前尚无完成的 C 函数。
requirements: An owned Sonic Adventure Dreamcast disc in the specified European release, supplied as a .gdi with track files.
Python 3, Docker and a Katana SDK are required for the documented build; Linux x86_64 can use the stated wibo path instead of Docker.
The author reports 0 of 5,179 functions completed in C and 1,088 functions named.
No licence file in the repository.

name: openmx: porting the MX Unleashed simulation to Rust
description_en: openmx ports the PlayStation 2 game MX Unleashed's riding simulation to Rust and supplies new desktop and browser presentation. It reads tracks, vehicles, art and sound from the user's disc dump; the author reports comparing simulation functions, PCSX2 captures and frame-by-frame replay state hashes with the original.
description_zh: openmx 将 PS2 游戏 MX Unleashed 的骑行模拟逻辑移植为 Rust，并提供桌面及浏览器界面。赛道、车辆、美术和声音从用户的光盘转储读取；作者称使用函数对照、PCSX2 录制及逐帧状态哈希与原版比较。
requirements: The user's own MX Unleashed PS2 disc dump, serial SLUS-20767, is required.
Rust and Cargo are required to build from source.
Campaign races and AI opponents are unfinished.
MIT license.

name: ak820-linux: reconstructing AJAZZ AK820 Pro USB control
description_en: ak820-linux reconstructs USB HID control for the AJAZZ AK820 Pro keyboard from the vendor's Windows configurator. Its Linux CLI and GUI send lighting effects, per-key colors, images or GIFs to the keyboard screen, and clock updates; the protocol reference records interfaces, report sizes, opcodes, and payload layouts.
description_zh: ak820-linux 从厂商 Windows 配置程序恢复 AJAZZ AK820 Pro 键盘的 USB HID 控制方式。Linux 命令行和图形界面可设置灯效、逐键颜色、屏幕图片或 GIF 及时间；协议文档记录接口、报告长度、操作码和载荷布局。
requirements: AJAZZ AK820 Pro connected by USB cable; documented support is for USB ID 0c45:8009.
The AppImage requires x86_64 Linux with glibc 2.35 or newer.
Key remapping, macros, and 2.4 GHz wireless mode are not implemented.
MIT License.

name: microfreak-emu: rehosting Arturia MicroFreak firmware in Renode
description_en: microfreak-emu rehosts Arturia MicroFreak firmware 5.0.0.2084 in Renode with models for STM32 peripherals and audio output. Its research documents firmware addresses, stored formats and the SysEx message exchange, while the harness supports boot checks, MIDI-driven differential runs and preset rendering.
description_zh: microfreak-emu 在 Renode 中运行 Arturia MicroFreak 5.0.0.2084 固件，并建模 STM32 外设及音频输出。研究文档记录固件地址、存储格式和 SysEx 消息交换；工具支持启动检查、MIDI 差分实验与预设音频渲染。
requirements: Renode and a sibling checkout of microfreak-tools.
A user-supplied MicroFreak firmware image; the documented addresses apply to version 5.0.0.2084.
Presets and samples must be supplied separately for rendering content that uses them.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: Saint Seiya: The Hades: a PS2 static recompilation for Linux
description_en: Saint Seiya: The Hades is ported to Linux by translating the European PS2 executable's MIPS R5900 functions to C and building them with a native runtime. The runtime models PS2 CPU, IOP, graphics and audio services, reads the user's disc image, and renders through Vulkan or a software GS; the author reports that the separate assembly rebuild matches the original byte for byte.
description_zh: 项目把欧版 PS2《Saint Seiya: The Hades》可执行文件中的 MIPS R5900 函数转换为 C，并结合原生运行时移植到 Linux。运行时处理 PS2 CPU、IOP、图形和音频服务，从用户的光盘镜像读取数据，可使用 Vulkan 或软件 GS；作者称另一条汇编重建流程可逐字节匹配原版。
requirements: The user's own European Saint Seiya: The Hades disc, release SLES-54162.
Linux x86-64 with GCC, Python 3, glslc, SDL3 3.2+, a Vulkan driver and FFmpeg libraries for the opening video.
Full playthrough testing and Windows or macOS support are unfinished; no game function has yet been source-decompiled.
MIT license.

name: Driver 1 decomp: matching Driver and porting it to Linux
description_en: Driver 1 decomp reconstructs Driver: You Are the Wheelman for PlayStation in C while retaining original hand-written assembly routines, and compares rebuilt code with the original executable and overlays. Its Linux port runs the reconstructed game through PsyCross with SDL2 and OpenGL using data extracted from the user's own US Rev 1 disc. The author reports 1248 of 1259 game functions matched across the listed binaries.
description_zh: Driver 1 decomp 以 C 代码重建 PlayStation 版《Driver: You Are the Wheelman》，同时保留原版手写汇编例程，并将重建代码与原始主程序及覆盖模块比较。Linux 移植版借助 PsyCross、SDL2 和 OpenGL，使用从用户自有的美版 Rev 1 光盘提取的数据运行。作者报告，所列二进制文件的 1259 个游戏函数中已有 1248 个匹配。
requirements: Own US Rev 1 disc image of Driver: You Are the Wheelman (SLUS_008.42).
Linux, Python 3, and Podman or Docker for the documented setup script.
The author reports 1248 of 1259 game functions matched; other platforms and a 64-bit build remain planned.
No licence file in the repository.

name: OpenPopTB-MacOS: static recompilation of Populous: The Beginning for Apple Silicon
description_en: OpenPopTB-MacOS statically recompiles Populous: The Beginning and Undiscovered Worlds from a user's Windows executables into native Apple Silicon applications. A Python recompiler translates discovered x86 functions to C, while a C runtime provides guest memory and Win32 and DirectX behavior through SDL3. The author reports single-player playability and instruction-level and function-level differential checks.
description_zh: OpenPopTB-MacOS 从用户自有的 Windows 可执行文件静态重编译《Populous: The Beginning》及扩展包 Undiscovered Worlds，生成 Apple Silicon 应用。Python 重编译器将发现的 x86 函数转为 C，C 运行时借助 SDL3 提供内存及 Win32、DirectX 行为；作者报告单人模式可玩，并进行了指令和函数级差分检查。
requirements: A user's copy of the game, including its executables, libraries and data, is required.
The download requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later; source builds support macOS 12 or later and require Apple Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja, SDL3, Python and innoextract.
The tested game version is the GOG 1.01 release; other versions may work but are untested.
Multiplayer is in progress.
MIT license applies to the repository's original code.

name: reRBR: reimplementing Richard Burns Rally 1.02
description_en: reRBR reimplements Richard Burns Rally 1.02 for Linux, macOS and Windows, using the player's game files and NGP 7.4.778 physics. Its Rust code covers game formats, stages, cars, race flow, damage, saves and rendering; the author reports comparing gameplay behavior with recordings of the original. BTB stage support remains experimental.
description_zh: reRBR 用 Rust 重建 Richard Burns Rally 1.02，面向 Linux、macOS 和 Windows，读取玩家自备的游戏文件并使用 NGP 7.4.778 物理系统。代码涵盖游戏文件格式、赛道、车辆、比赛流程、损伤、存档和渲染；作者称已用原版录像对照游戏行为。BTB 赛道支持仍处于实验阶段。
requirements: A copy of Richard Burns Rally 1.02 with NGP 7 game files, or the original disc for launcher setup, is required.
NGP 7.4.778 is required for physics.
Supported releases target Windows 10 or later on x86_64, macOS 11 or later on Apple silicon, and Linux on x86_64 with FUSE 2 or 3.
The project is in alpha; BTB stages and the rally school are experimental.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: CTRNativePorted: rehosting Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled on Windows
description_en: CTRNativePorted rehosts Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled on Windows by loading the original PS4 x86-64 code from a user-owned dump. It replaces imported PS4 system services, supplies Direct3D 11 and Vulkan rendering paths, and provides a local service for online play; the author reports that the game is playable from start to finish.
description_zh: CTRNativePorted 从用户自有的 PS4 游戏转储加载 Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled 原始 x86-64 代码，在 Windows 上提供其所需的 PS4 系统服务、Direct3D 11 与 Vulkan 渲染路径，以及联网游戏所用的本地服务。作者报告游戏已可从头玩到尾。
requirements: A legally obtained PS4 dump of a supported Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled edition and version.
A Windows host; the repository identifies supported EU and US CUSA versions 01.00 and 01.21.
Experimental pre-release; Wumpa Challenges and Grand Prix schedules are unimplemented.
GPL-2.0 License.

name: LUMIX Remote: reconstructing Panasonic S5 camera communication
description_en: LUMIX Remote reconstructs Panasonic LUMIX camera control in a Python server, web interface and CLI. For the DC-S5, its notes map cam.cgi commands, UPnP services, UDP live view and Bluetooth LE connection sequences; the client supports shooting, settings, file import and timelapse operation.
description_zh: LUMIX Remote 以 Python 服务、网页界面和 CLI 重建 Panasonic LUMIX 相机控制。针对 DC-S5，研究笔记梳理 cam.cgi 命令、UPnP 服务、UDP 实时取景和 BLE 连接顺序；客户端提供拍摄、设置、文件导入与延时摄影功能。
requirements: Panasonic LUMIX DC-S5 for the documented hardware coverage; other camera models are untested.
Python 3.9+ and aiohttp for the Wi-Fi server.
Bluetooth LE wake remains experimental.
MIT license.

name: Ledger Nano X board map: tracing and reconstructing the main board
description_en: Ledger Nano X board map reconstructs the hardware wallet's main board from photos, tracing 40 test pads, copper nets and components into a KiCad project. Photo and 3D viewers expose the mapped connections, while scripts regenerate the board and schematic from the recorded data.
description_zh: Ledger Nano X board map 根据照片重建硬件钱包主板，将 40 个测试焊盘、铜箔网络和元件连接整理为 KiCad 工程。照片与 3D 查看器展示连接关系，脚本可根据记录的数据重新生成电路板和原理图。
requirements: Viewing the photo map requires a browser; regenerating the KiCad project requires KiCad 10 and its Python module.
Inner layers are assumed, footprints are approximate, and signal names ending in ? remain unconfirmed.
Code is MIT; photos, board data, the KiCad project and documentation are CC BY 4.0.

name: fix-whxm4-voice: reconstructing WH-1000XM4 voice-pack upload
description_en: fix-whxm4-voice creates replacement voice packs for Sony WH-1000XM4 headphones and uploads them over Bluetooth. Its research notes map the pack's language layout and trace Sony's app through the Airoha FOTA upload flow over Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM. The tool can download stock packs, convert replacement audio and install the result as a selected language.
description_zh: fix-whxm4-voice 为 Sony WH-1000XM4 耳机构建替换语音包，并通过蓝牙上传。研究笔记梳理了语音包的语言布局，以及 Sony 应用经 Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM 使用 Airoha FOTA 的上传流程。工具可下载原厂语音包、转换替换音频并按选定语言安装。
requirements: Sony WH-1000XM4 headphones; the README reports testing on firmware 3.0.1.
Linux with BlueZ and Nix, or macOS with Xcode command-line tools, Rust and ffmpeg.
English cannot be replaced in the documented default workflow; the custom pack installs as German by default.
MIT licence.

name: OpenBattlespire: reimplementing the Battlespire engine
description_en: OpenBattlespire reimplements the engine of An Elder Scrolls Legend: Battlespire in C and reads the user’s original game files at runtime. Its source includes game systems, format parsers and data tools; research notes analyze GAME.EXE and document BSA, BS6, save and other formats. The README describes playable movement, combat, dialogue and save behavior.
description_zh: OpenBattlespire 用 C 重实现 An Elder Scrolls Legend: Battlespire 的引擎，运行时读取用户自有的原版游戏文件。仓库包含游戏系统、格式解析器和数据工具；研究笔记分析 GAME.EXE，并记录 BSA、BS6、存档等格式。项目说明了移动、战斗、对话和存档等已实现行为。
requirements: A user-owned copy of Battlespire is required for game data.
Building requires CMake 3.25+ and a C17 compiler; the viewer also needs SDL3 3.2+ and OpenGL 3.3.
MIT.

name: OrangeCar: reconstructing the wired CarPlay phone side
description_en: OrangeCar reconstructs the phone side of wired Apple CarPlay on an Orange Pi 5 Plus so a car displays a locally rendered dashboard. Its protocol documentation follows USB role switching, iAP2 identification, CDC-NCM networking, mDNS and the AirPlay session that carries H.264 video, audio and input.
description_zh: OrangeCar 在 Orange Pi 5 Plus 上重建有线 Apple CarPlay 的手机端，使汽车显示本地渲染的仪表盘。协议文档依次说明 USB 角色切换、iAP2 身份协商、CDC-NCM 网络、mDNS，以及传输 H.264 视频、音频和输入的 AirPlay 会话。
requirements: Requires an Orange Pi 5 Plus, NVMe SSD, stable 5 V power and a USB-C connection to a wired CarPlay port.
The author reports testing with one Jaguar F-PACE head unit; wireless CarPlay is not implemented.
Phone calls and the Android Auto head unit are experimental.
GPL-3.0 licence.

name: Champions: Return to Arms: PS2 code research and native recompilation
description_en: Champions: Return to Arms research maps the US PS2 game's executable, symbols, level scripts, file formats and online behavior. Its tools disassemble and compare original functions, then translate a player-supplied executable to C++ for a native runtime and Godot host; the author maintains an address-based findings ledger.
description_zh: Champions: Return to Arms 研究项目测绘美版 PS2 游戏的可执行文件、符号、关卡脚本、文件格式和联网行为。工具可反汇编并比对原始函数，再将玩家自备的可执行文件转换为 C++，供原生运行时及 Godot 宿主使用；发现记录附有地址依据。
requirements: A user-supplied disc image of the US v2.00 release, including SLUS_209.73.
Research tooling requires Python 3, MIPS-capable llvm-objdump, Ghidra and the ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded extension.
The native build translates the game from the user's disc image on their machine.
MIT license for the project's tools and notes.

name: AirDrop-for-Everything: reimplementing AirDrop file transfer
description_en: AirDrop-for-Everything reimplements Apple's AirDrop discovery and file transfer in a Rust core with command-line, desktop, Android and macOS interfaces. The documented protocol covers mDNS discovery, binary-plist /Discover and /Ask requests, and DVZip-framed cpio uploads. AWDL works where an interface exists; other platforms use LAN transport.
description_zh: AirDrop-for-Everything 以 Rust 核心重建 Apple AirDrop 的发现和文件传输，并提供命令行、桌面、Android 与 macOS 界面。其协议说明覆盖 mDNS 发现、二进制 plist 格式的 /Discover 与 /Ask 请求，以及 DVZip 封装的 cpio 上传。具备 AWDL 接口的平台可使用 AWDL，其余平台使用局域网传输。
requirements: Rust toolchain for source builds; AWDL requires macOS awdl0 or a Linux AWDL implementation.
Windows and Android lack AWDL discovery and use LAN transport for compatible peers.
MIT License.

name: cyrus: rebuilding The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard in Rust and Bevy
description_en: cyrus rebuilds The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard in Rust and Bevy using files from a local GOG installation. It loads game worlds and formats for native and browser viewing, while its fidelity mode aims to reproduce visuals, audio, controls, timing, and outcomes.
description_zh: cyrus 用 Rust 和 Bevy 重建 The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard，读取本地 GOG 安装文件。它在原生程序和浏览器中加载游戏世界与资源格式，并以还原画面、音频、操作、时序和游戏结果为目标。
requirements: A GOG copy of The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard, Rust, and just.
The author reports that startup presentation and world viewing work; a complete gameplay and fidelity playthrough has not been accepted.
MIT License.

name: FA Remastered: rebuilding the Supreme Commander: Forged Alliance engine
description_en: FA Remastered reimplements the Supreme Commander: Forged Alliance engine in C++ around the user's game data, Lua scripts and mods. It provides a multithreaded simulation, renderer and interface, and compares replay states beat by beat with the original. The author reports identical results for sixteen test replays; local skirmishes are playable.
description_zh: FA Remastered 以 C++ 重建 Supreme Commander: Forged Alliance 引擎，运行用户自备的游戏数据、Lua 脚本和模组。项目包含多线程模拟、渲染器与界面，并逐个模拟节拍对比原版回放状态。作者报告 16 份测试回放结果一致，本地遭遇战已可游玩。
requirements: A personal copy of Supreme Commander: Forged Alliance; the tested setup uses Steam with Forged Alliance Forever installed.
Saving is absent, and the campaign and stock AI behavior remain in progress.
MIT License applies to the engine; the bundled M28AI variant has a separate CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence.

name: MineStrike 1.6: reconstructing Counter-Strike interfaces for a Minecraft mod
description_en: MineStrike 1.6 reconstructs interfaces of Counter-Strike 1.6's closed client and engine binaries to add Minecraft-style gameplay inside GoldSrc. A client proxy forwards and wraps exports, while server hooks add blocks, inventory and crafting; its installer builds a block version of de_dust2 from the user's game data.
description_zh: MineStrike 1.6 还原 Counter-Strike 1.6 封闭客户端和引擎二进制文件的接口，在 GoldSrc 中加入 Minecraft 式玩法。客户端代理转发并包装导出函数，服务端钩子加入方块、物品栏和合成等规则；安装程序从用户自有游戏数据生成方块版 de_dust2。
requirements: Requires Windows and a Steam installation of Counter-Strike 1.6; the project also calls for ownership of Minecraft: Java Edition for its textures and sounds.
The installed copy is intended for offline play with bots in insecure LAN mode.
Building the DLLs requires clang-cl, lld, CMake, Ninja, ReGameDLL_CS and the Half-Life SDK.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Infinite Crisis: reconstructing a preservation server
description_en: The Infinite Crisis preservation server reconstructs login, menus, Tutorial 1 and versus-AI matches for the 2015 Steam client. It uses decompilation notes and mapped network messages, while loading champions, maps and scripts from the player's game installation; the author reports broad match coverage with remaining tutorial and rendering gaps.
description_zh: Infinite Crisis 保存服务端为 2015 年 Steam 客户端重建登录、菜单、教程和对 AI 对战。项目利用客户端反编译笔记和网络消息映射，并从玩家的游戏安装目录读取角色、地图及脚本；作者报告已覆盖多项对战功能，教程和渲染仍有缺口。
requirements: A personal Steam copy of Infinite Crisis with InfiniteCrisis.exe and its rp folder.
64-bit Python 3.11+ and dependencies from requirements.txt.
Tutorial 1 has camera-control gaps; some ability animations and map rendering remain incomplete.
No licence file in the repository.

name: BlackBerry 10 Assistant: reconstructing Dragon and Maluuba protocols
description_en: The BlackBerry 10 Assistant reference reconstructs the Dragon speech-service and Maluuba intent-service exchanges needed by the phone's original Assistant. It documents multipart audio and NLSML messages, JSON classifications, plugin intent fields and dialogue turns, along with the device settings and patches needed to direct the client to a replacement server.
description_zh: BlackBerry 10 Assistant 资料重建了手机原有语音助手使用的 Dragon 语音服务和 Maluuba 意图服务消息交换。文档涵盖分段音频与 NLSML、JSON 分类结果、插件意图字段、对话轮次，以及把客户端指向替代服务器所需的设备设置和补丁。
requirements: A rooted BlackBerry 10 device; documented binary offsets apply to OS 10.3.3.3216.
A replacement speech recognizer and natural-language understanding back end are required.
Some intent families are marked unverified in the intent reference.
CC-BY-4.0.

name: Packet Tracer .pkt/.pka: reconstructing the lab file format
description_en: The Packet Tracer .pkt/.pka project reconstructs Cisco Packet Tracer's encrypted lab-file containers and their XML payloads. Its Python codec and CLI decode, re-encode, inspect, diff and export files, while a builder generates lab topologies and scored activities using documented cipher, compression and schema details.
description_zh: Packet Tracer .pkt/.pka 项目重建 Cisco Packet Tracer 的加密实验文件容器及其 XML 内容。Python 编解码器和命令行工具可解码、重编码、检查、比较与导出文件；生成器依据记录的加密、压缩和结构细节创建网络拓扑及评分活动。
requirements: Python 3.10+ is required; inspecting a file requires an existing .pkt or .pka, and Packet Tracer is needed to open generated results.
The author reports coverage of two container families spanning Packet Tracer 4.1 through 9.0.1.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: AgainROM: a new engine for Rage of Mages
description_en: AgainROM reimplements the Rage of Mages engine in Go to run the original campaign on Windows, macOS and Linux. It loads the user's RES archives, graphics, audio, movies and saves, and includes a map editor; research notes document recovered resource formats and known behavior differences.
description_zh: AgainROM 用 Go 重建《Rage of Mages》引擎，使原版战役可在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上运行。它读取用户自己的 RES 资源包、图像、音频、影片和存档，并附带地图编辑器；研究文档记录了恢复出的资源格式及已知行为差异。
requirements: A legally owned English or Russian copy of Rage of Mages and its game files.
A supported 64-bit Windows, macOS or Linux system; building from source requires the Go version in go.mod.
The game is in progress and some details differ from the original.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Pulsar II: reconstructing Linux support from Windows SCOPE analysis
description_en: The Pulsar II project reconstructs Linux support for the Creamware/Sonic Core DSP sound card from analysis of scScope.sys and Sim2k.dll. Its kernel module, loader, and SCOPE file decoders handle card initialization, DSP modules, audio streams, and device files; reports document register and boot behavior.
description_zh: Pulsar II 项目通过分析 scScope.sys 和 Sim2k.dll，为 Creamware／Sonic Core DSP 声卡重建 Linux 支持。内核模块、加载器和 SCOPE 文件解码器处理声卡初始化、DSP 模块、音频流及设备文件；研究记录说明寄存器和启动行为。
requirements: A Creamware/Sonic Core Pulsar II card and Linux kernel headers for the driver.
The official SCOPE 5.1 installer and a valid licence are needed for DSP files, which are supplied by the user.
External clock and factory synth, ADAT, S/PDIF, and MIDI port support remain incomplete or untested.
GPL-2.0-or-later for the driver and tools; the MAME-derived SHARC disassembler remains BSD-3-Clause.

name: IQOS Bar: a USB HID client for IQOS ILUMA usage counters
description_en: IQOS Bar implements read-only USB HID access to an IQOS ILUMA i ONE, displaying battery status and lifetime usage counters in a desktop tray or menu bar. Its protocol notes describe report framing, register queries and hidapi response offsets, adapting the command layer credited to iqos-scope.
description_zh: IQOS Bar 通过只读 USB HID 查询 IQOS ILUMA i ONE，在桌面托盘或菜单栏显示电量与累计使用计数。协议笔记说明 HID 帧格式、寄存器读取命令及 hidapi 响应偏移；命令层沿用并适配了 iqos-scope 的研究成果。
requirements: An IQOS ILUMA i ONE connected by USB is the author-confirmed device; fields unavailable on other models appear blank.
The application runs on macOS, Windows and Linux; Linux may require a udev rule for HID access.
The daily chart needs a couple of days of logged lifetime counters to fill in.
MIT license.

name: NMS Shipwright: reconstructing No Man's Sky ship generation and saves
description_en: NMS Shipwright investigates No Man's Sky ship generation and save structures through the user's installed game. It reads game archives, runs the game's generator code offline with Unicorn, finds seeds for chosen ship designs, locates ships in star systems, and edits ships and other save fields after creating a backup.
description_zh: NMS Shipwright 通过用户已安装的 No Man's Sky 研究飞船生成和存档结构。程序读取游戏档案，以 Unicorn 离线运行游戏的生成器代码，寻找符合所选飞船设计的种子、定位星系中的飞船，并在备份后编辑飞船及其他存档字段。
requirements: Requires the user's own No Man's Sky installation and save data.
Building from source requires Windows and Python 3.11 or later; a Linux AppImage is also described.
The app refuses save writes while the game is running; Steam Cloud can restore an older save over an edit.
MIT license.

name: Chorus: reconstructing Logitech Harmony remote programming
description_en: Chorus identifies and backs up Logitech Harmony USB remotes, learns and decodes IR codes, and controls hubs over a local network. Its browser editor creates JSON device and activity configurations; technical notes document the vendor setup app and newer USB packet protocol.
description_zh: Chorus 可识别 Logitech Harmony USB 遥控器并备份其配置，还能学习和解码红外信号、通过局域网控制 Harmony Hub。浏览器编辑器可创建 JSON 格式的设备和活动配置；技术文档记录了厂商设置程序及较新设备的 USB 数据包协议。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer and a supported Harmony remote or hub; macOS and Linux USB use libusb.
The author reports read operations on a Harmony 665; hardware write operations remain unconfirmed.
The native binary configuration's device, activity, and button sections remain unmapped.
GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: Tiberian Sun and Firestorm: static recompilation of Game.exe
description_en: Tiberian Sun and Firestorm recompiles the games' Win32 Game.exe into native C with pcrecomp and a game-specific host. The author reports playable menus, skirmishes and early campaign missions, with high-resolution display and a native Linux build. Lifted C is generated locally from the owner's game copy.
description_zh: Tiberian Sun and Firestorm 借助 pcrecomp 和专用运行层，将游戏的 Win32 Game.exe 静态转换为原生 C。作者报告菜单、遭遇战及战役初期关卡可游玩，并提供高分辨率显示和原生 Linux 构建；转换出的 C 代码由用户本地游戏副本生成。
requirements: An owned Steam copy of Tiberian Sun and Firestorm containing Game.exe, Language.dll and the .mix files is required.
The build uses the pcrecomp toolchain; manual Windows setup requires Python 3.10+, Visual Studio C++ x86 tools, CMake 3.20+ and Ninja.
The author describes the project as playable bring-up rather than a completed remaster.
MIT license.

name: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: a Win32 static recompilation
description_en: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic is statically recompiled from a user-owned Steam swkotor.exe 1.03 into native C using pcrecomp. The repository supplies the lift driver, a 32-bit Windows host, and conformance scripts; the author reports an alpha build that reaches gameplay on the Endar Spire.
description_zh: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic 项目使用 pcrecomp 将用户自有 Steam 版 swkotor.exe 1.03 静态重编译为原生 C。仓库提供提升脚本、32 位 Windows 运行时及一致性检查脚本；作者报告 Alpha 版本已能进入 Endar Spire 的游戏流程。
requirements: A Steam copy of KotOR containing swkotor.exe 1.03 and Windows 10 or 11 x64.
Python 3.10 or newer, Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools, CMake 3.20 or newer, Ninja, Git, and a pcrecomp checkout.
Alpha status; sound remains muted by default pending tests, and later game progress remains under development.
MIT License for the repository code.

name: openchrome: rebuilding a Dying Light runtime from game data
description_en: openchrome is a C++ runtime and viewer for Dying Light 1 game data, using Vulkan and SDL2 to read resources from the user's installation. Its parsers and format notes cover rpack containers, textures, meshes, materials, map placement, lighting, animation and sound banks. The author reports that the viewer renders environments and provides a stand-in walk mode.
description_zh: openchrome 是使用 C++、Vulkan 和 SDL2 开发的《消逝的光芒》初代游戏数据运行时与查看器，从用户的游戏安装目录读取资源。解析器和格式文档涵盖 rpack 容器、纹理、网格、材质、地图对象布置、光照、动画和音频库。作者报告称，查看器已能渲染场景，并提供替代物理引擎的行走模式。
requirements: A user-owned Dying Light 1 installation containing the game data.
Windows with MSVC and the Vulkan SDK for the documented viewer build.
Animation tracks, FMOD Vorbis effects, navmesh and gameplay remain unfinished.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Z80 NMOS Silicon-to-RTL CPU Core: reconstructing transistor logic in Verilog
description_en: Z80 NMOS Silicon-to-RTL CPU Core reconstructs the Zilog NMOS Z80 processor as synchronous Verilog from a transistor-level netlist and successive logic schematics. The author reports testing a Verilator model with Z80 software suites in EmuStudio.
description_zh: Z80 NMOS Silicon-to-RTL CPU Core 根据晶体管级网表和逐步整理的逻辑电路图，将 Zilog NMOS Z80 处理器重建为同步 Verilog。作者报告在 EmuStudio 中用 Verilator 模型运行 Z80 软件测试。
requirements: The repository supplies raw Verilog files for integration into an FPGA project or simulation wrapper.
The core is marked 0.9.1-alpha; the author reports a complete match on the standard Z80 tests available to them.
Source comments are currently in Russian.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: HL2-RS: a partial Rust reconstruction of Half-Life 2
description_en: HL2-RS partially reconstructs Half-Life 2 in Rust and Bevy, reading maps, models, textures, animations, and sounds from an installed copy. Its source separates Source asset readers, simulation, UI, and rendering; the author reports working menus and selected city sequences while the campaign remains incomplete.
description_zh: HL2-RS 使用 Rust 和 Bevy 部分重建 Half-Life 2，从已安装游戏读取地图、模型、纹理、动画和声音。源码分离了 Source 资源读取、模拟、界面与渲染模块；作者报告菜单及部分城市流程可用，完整战役仍未完成。
requirements: An owned Steam PC installation of Half-Life 2 is required for game content.
Source builds need Rust/Cargo and platform compiler tools.
The full campaign is not playable yet; Linux runtime behavior remains untested.
MIT.

name: tinycoral: reconstructing the Coral Edge TPU instruction set and USB runtime
description_en: tinycoral reconstructs the Google Coral Edge TPU instruction set and USB runtime for a tinygrad backend. It includes decoded instruction layouts, a code generator, DarwiNN executable handling and a Python driver for firmware upload, register access and DMA transfers; the author reports byte-identical generated programs against Google's compiler for supported operations.
description_zh: tinycoral 为 tinygrad 后端重建 Google Coral Edge TPU 指令集和 USB 运行时。项目包含指令布局、代码生成器、DarwiNN 可执行文件处理，以及负责固件上传、寄存器访问和 DMA 传输的 Python 驱动；作者报告，受支持操作生成的程序与 Google 编译器的输出逐字节一致。
requirements: Google Coral USB Accelerator, Python 3.11+, libusb and the pinned tinygrad revision.
Offline compiler comparison needs the Google compiler, Docker and the tools dependencies.
Whole-network compilation is limited to documented convolution, pooling and linear-layer chains.
MIT license.

name: ninebot-go: reconstructing Ninebot app cloud communication
description_en: ninebot-go reconstructs the Ninebot app's encrypted cloud communication in a Go client. It implements NET request encryption and response decryption using AES and RSA, then exposes vehicle, battery and travel data through CLI, web and MCP interfaces; vehicle-control commands remain unfinished.
description_zh: ninebot-go 用 Go 重建 Ninebot App 的加密云端通信。它以 AES 和 RSA 实现 NET 请求加密及响应解密，并通过命令行、网页和 MCP 接口提供车辆、电池及行程数据；车辆控制命令仍未完成。
requirements: Go 1.25 or newer and a Ninebot account for authenticated operations.
Vehicle-control commands have not been integrated; response signature verification is currently omitted.
MIT.

name: pc-thelaststory: statically recompiling The Last Story for PC
description_en: pc-thelaststory statically recompiles the European Wii release of The Last Story for a native PC port. Its tools identify functions in the stripped PowerPC executable and use wiikit to translate them to C++ while a runtime replaces Wii services. The author reports play from the title screen into the first chapter at 30 frames per second.
description_zh: pc-thelaststory 对《The Last Story》欧版 Wii 程序进行静态重编译，构建原生 PC 移植版。项目工具为去符号的 PowerPC 可执行文件识别函数，并用 wiikit 转译为 C++，由运行时替代 Wii 系统服务。作者报告游戏已能从标题画面进入第一章，帧率为每秒 30 帧。
requirements: The user's own European The Last Story disc, SLSP01; the repository contains no game data or executable.
Python 3.8 or newer, CMake, Ninja, clang, SDL3 and OpenGL 4.5 are required for the documented build.
The port reaches the first chapter; fog is not drawn yet and 60 frames per second remains a goal.
MIT applies to the repository's documentation and tools.

name: Civilization III: Conquests — static recompilation of the Steam release
description_en: Civilization III: Conquests statically recompiles the user's Steam Win32 game executable into C with pcrecomp and builds native Windows and Linux hosts. The repository supplies lift scripts, runtime shims and scripted tests; the author reports matching original game state across 19 turns in one differential run.
description_zh: Civilization III: Conquests 使用 pcrecomp 将用户自有的 Steam Win32 游戏可执行文件静态转换为 C，并构建原生 Windows 和 Linux 运行程序。仓库提供转换脚本、运行时适配代码及脚本测试；作者报告一次差分测试中连续 19 回合的游戏状态与原版一致。
requirements: A user-owned Steam copy of Civilization III Complete; retail disc builds are outside the supported scope.
For the documented Windows setup: Windows 10/11, Python 3.10+ with pefile and capstone, git, CMake 3.20+, Ninja, Visual Studio 2022 C++ x86 tools, and a sibling pcrecomp checkout.
The author describes the release as alpha; multiplayer and force feedback were untested.
MIT license.

name: pc-monsterhunter3: a static recompilation of Monster Hunter Tri
description_en: pc-monsterhunter3 ports the European Wii release of Monster Hunter Tri to PC by translating its PowerPC executable and 21 RSO modules into C++ with wiikit. The repository records disc and code findings and supplies game-specific hooks. The author reports reaching the village and a first quest with gamepad input.
description_zh: pc-monsterhunter3 使用 wiikit 将欧版 Wii《怪物猎人 3》的 PowerPC 可执行文件和 21 个 RSO 模块转换为 C++，目标是在 PC 原生运行。仓库记录光盘与代码分析，并提供针对游戏的 Hook；作者报告已能使用手柄进入村庄和首个任务。
requirements: An owned original European Monster Hunter Tri disc, release RMHP08, is required.
Building requires wiikit, Python 3.8+, CMake, Ninja, clang and SDL3; running requires OpenGL 4.5.
Sound stutters, and saving and full playthroughs have not yet been exercised.
MIT license.

name: Hover!: statically recompiling the Windows 95 game to native C
description_en: Hover! statically recompiles the Windows 95 game Microsoft Hover! from the owner's HOVER.EXE into generated C and builds a 32-bit native host. Its pcrecomp pipeline catalogs functions, lifts game code and binds Windows imports; the author reports playable level-one runs and conformance checks, while host code adds presentation and multiplayer features.
description_zh: Hover! 将用户自有的 Windows 95 游戏 Microsoft Hover! 的 HOVER.EXE 静态重编译为 C，并构建 32 位原生宿主程序。pcrecomp 流程识别函数、转换游戏代码并绑定 Windows 导入函数；作者报告第一关可玩到结束且一致性检查通过，宿主代码还增加了画面呈现和多人游戏功能。
requirements: Requires the user's own copy of Microsoft Hover! and the pcrecomp toolkit.
Windows builds require Python 3.10 or later and Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools; Linux builds require clang-cl tooling and 32-bit Wine.
The project is marked alpha; the author reports that the presenter window does not work under Wine.
MIT license.

name: open-g2-hub: a local Even G2 client built on BLE protocol findings
description_en: open-g2-hub replaces the Even Realities G2 companion app with a local hub for native widgets and voice input on stock firmware. Its protocol notes describe dual-lens BLE characteristics, an AA 21 control frame, CRC-16 checksums, service IDs, heartbeats and LC3 microphone data.
description_zh: open-g2-hub 在原厂固件上以本地服务替代 Even Realities G2 配套应用，控制眼镜固件内置的小组件并接收麦克风语音数据。协议说明记录左右镜片的 BLE 特征值、AA 21 控制帧、CRC-16 校验、服务 ID、心跳和 LC3 麦克风数据。
requirements: Even Realities G2 glasses running unmodified stock firmware are the documented device.
The Python package requires Python 3.11 or newer and the sibling eveng2-g2 protocol library.
The project describes the protocol work as ongoing.
MIT license.

name: Bunghole in One: statically recompiling a Win32 mini-golf game
description_en: Bunghole in One statically recompiles the 1998 Windows mini-golf game's EXE and DLL into C with pcrecomp, generating the lifted code from a user's own disc. A 32-bit host binds the modules and provides software DirectDraw, while a conformance harness tracks boot and play milestones.
description_zh: Bunghole in One 使用 pcrecomp 将这款 1998 年 Windows 迷你高尔夫游戏的 EXE 和 DLL 静态重编译为 C，生成代码来自用户自备的游戏光盘。32 位运行时连接两个模块并实现软件 DirectDraw，一致性工具跟踪启动和游戏进度。
requirements: A user-owned Bunghole in One CD or image, Windows 10/11, Python 3.10+, Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools and pcrecomp.
Alpha stage; the author reports 17 of 18 conformance milestones on current pcrecomp, with the first putt stalled.
MIT license for repository code.

name: OpenSE4: reimplementing the Space Empires IV Deluxe engine
description_en: OpenSE4 reimplements the Space Empires IV Deluxe engine in C++23, loading art, sound and data from the player's own installation. Its rule specifications combine the original manual, data files, observed behavior and executable analysis; the engine covers economy, movement, combat, research, diplomacy and computer players, with remaining parity differences documented.
description_zh: OpenSE4 用 C++23 重建 Space Empires IV Deluxe 引擎，并从玩家自己的安装目录读取美术、音频和数据。规则规格结合原版手册、数据文件、运行观察与可执行文件分析；引擎涵盖经济、移动、战斗、研究、外交和电脑玩家，并记录尚存的行为差异。
requirements: An owned installation of Space Empires IV Deluxe is required to supply game data.
The source lists Windows and Linux builds and macOS source builds, with Vulkan 1.3 or OpenGL 3.3 graphics paths.
The author documents small unresolved rule details and remaining computer-player expansion differences.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: miband11-watchface-maker: reconstructing the Smart Band 11 .face format
description_en: miband11-watchface-maker reconstructs the .face watch-face package format for Xiaomi Smart Band 11 by comparing inputs and outputs of the official compiler. Its format specification covers headers, metadata, indexes, embedded Lua and image data. Python, Java and JavaScript implementations assemble watch faces from media inputs.
description_zh: miband11-watchface-maker 比较官方编译器的输入与产物，重建小米手环 11 表盘的 .face 包格式。格式规范描述文件头、元数据、索引及内嵌的 Lua 和图像数据；Python、Java 与 JavaScript 实现可由媒体素材组装表盘。
requirements: The documented output target is Xiaomi Smart Band 11 watch faces.
The Windows implementation requires Python 3.8 or newer and Pillow; video input also requires ffmpeg.
Installing generated watch faces requires third-party tooling.
The format was tested against the project’s firmware and toolchain versions; other versions may differ.
MIT license.

name: mihealth-api: reconstructing Mi Fitness health-data access
description_en: mihealth-api reconstructs access to personal Mi Fitness health data from the com.mi.health client API. Its Python client implements session handling and encrypted requests, synchronizes records into SQLite, and exposes local HTTP queries and a dashboard; API notes document endpoint and field behavior.
description_zh: mihealth-api 根据对 com.mi.health 客户端接口的研究，重建个人 Mi Fitness 健康数据访问方式。Python 客户端处理会话及加密请求，将记录同步至 SQLite，并提供本地 HTTP 查询和看板；接口文档记录端点及字段行为。
requirements: Access to the user's own Mi Fitness account and valid session credentials.
Python 3.9 or later; device-based credential import requires a logged-in rooted device or emulator.
The author's account had no GPS route or diet records, and route-file download was unavailable.
MIT license.

name: CS:GO Legacy: reconstructing Game Coordinator matchmaking
description_en: CS:GO Legacy matchmaking research reconstructs a Game Coordinator path for starting and joining matches in the archived game. It combines a JavaScript coordinator, protobuf definitions, client and Linux server patches, and findings about reservation messages, match draft data, and map transitions; the author reports completing a match with map veto.
description_zh: CS:GO Legacy 匹配研究重构归档版游戏的开局与入服流程。项目结合 JavaScript 协调器、protobuf 定义以及客户端和 Linux 服务端补丁，记录预留消息、选图数据和地图切换行为；作者报告已完成含地图禁选的对局流程。
requirements: CS:GO Legacy client build 1575 and a Linux srcds server, supplied separately.
The documented setup also requires a game-server login token and separately built client/server redirection components.
Only the Prime queue is implemented; other matchmaking modes remain unfinished.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: QuestEditorRe: rebuilding the Alien Shooter quest editor
description_en: QuestEditorRe rebuilds the original QuestEditor as a standalone Windows application and a Win32 DLL compatible with map editors for Alien Shooter 2 and related games. Its C++ implementation edits levels.cfg, levels.db and mission.txt while preserving unknown fields and unchanged bytes where possible, and supports quest links, properties and backups.
description_zh: QuestEditorRe 为 Alien Shooter 2 等游戏重建原版 QuestEditor，提供独立 Windows 程序和兼容地图编辑器的 Win32 DLL。C++ 实现可编辑 levels.cfg、levels.db 与 mission.txt，尽量保留未知字段和未修改字节，并支持任务连线、属性编辑与备份。
requirements: Building requires Windows 10 or 11, Visual Studio C++ toolset v145, Windows SDK 10 and a Win32 target.
Real-game automated tests primarily target Alien Shooter 2 Reloaded; other listed games need separate checking.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Edifier Speakers BLE: reconstructing M60 and M90 speaker control
description_en: Edifier Speakers BLE reconstructs the M60 and M90 speakers' BLE control protocols and uses them in a Home Assistant integration. Its references describe model-specific GATT services, frame checksums, commands, responses, and limits; the integration exposes volume, source, EQ, playback, and selected device settings.
description_zh: Edifier Speakers BLE 重构 M60 和 M90 音箱的 BLE 控制协议，并据此开发 Home Assistant 集成。参考文档记录各型号的 GATT 服务、帧校验、命令、响应和限制；集成提供音量、输入源、均衡器、播放及部分设备设置。
requirements: Home Assistant with a working Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, plus a powered M60 or M90 speaker.
M60 reads were checked on a PC, while M60 Home Assistant reads and hardware writes remain unconfirmed.
MIT License.

name: midway: statically recompiling Midway Arcade Origins for Windows
description_en: midway statically recompiles the PS3 disc release of Midway Arcade Origins for native Windows using ps3recomp and a user-supplied game dump. Its scripts lift the EBOOT and two SPURS render jobs, then build against the shared runtime. The author reports that the front end reaches an arcade ROM set and displays the Vindicators Part II attract loop.
description_zh: midway 使用 ps3recomp 和用户提供的游戏转储，将 PS3 光盘版 Midway Arcade Origins 静态重编译为原生 Windows 程序。脚本转换 EBOOT 和两个 SPURS 渲染任务，再结合共享运行时构建。作者报告前端已加载街机 ROM 集并显示 Vindicators Part II 演示循环。
requirements: The user’s own Midway Arcade Origins PS3 disc dump and a ps3recomp checkout are required.
Windows 11, Visual Studio 2022 with clang-cl, CMake 3.20+, Ninja, Python 3.11+ and a SELF decrypter are specified.
The alpha build skips movies; audio and a played credit remain unchecked.
MIT for this repository’s own scripts and documentation.

name: crazytaxi-ps3: statically recompiling Crazy Taxi for Windows
description_en: crazytaxi-ps3 statically recompiles the PS3/PSN release of Crazy Taxi for native Windows using ps3recomp. Its scripts prepare a user-supplied EBOOT, lift PPU and SPU code, and build against the shared runtime; the author reports the title screen and in-engine attract demo rendering while gameplay remains unreached.
description_zh: crazytaxi-ps3 使用 ps3recomp 将 PS3/PSN 版《Crazy Taxi》静态重编译为 Windows 原生程序。脚本处理用户提供的 EBOOT、转换 PPU 与 SPU 代码并接入共享运行时；作者报告标题画面和引擎内演示可渲染，尚未进入实际游戏。
requirements: A user-owned copy of the Crazy Taxi PSN release NPUB30242 and the required decryption key material.

Windows 11, Visual Studio 2022 with the C++ workload and clang-cl, CMake 3.20+, Ninja, Python 3.11+ with pycryptodome, Git Bash, and a ps3recomp checkout with its runtime library built and the two documented fixes.
Menus and gameplay have not been reached; audio output has not been checked.
MIT license for this repository’s scripts and documentation.

name: pc-deepfear: statically recompiling Deep Fear for PC
description_en: pc-deepfear investigates the European Sega Saturn release of Deep Fear and statically recompiles its program toward a native PC port using saturnkit. Its notes map both discs, data formats, SH-2 code and the SCU DSP, while local scripts build and compare the translated C++ against an interpreter. The author reports reaching the first playable room.
description_zh: pc-deepfear 研究欧洲版 Sega Saturn 游戏 Deep Fear，并借助 saturnkit 将程序静态重编译，目标是原生 PC 移植。文档梳理双盘结构、数据格式、SH-2 代码和 SCU DSP；本地脚本构建转换后的 C++ 并与解释器对照。作者报告程序已进入第一个可操作房间。
requirements: The user’s own two-disc European Deep Fear release MK-81804 as .cue/.bin sets and the saturnkit submodule.
Python 3.8+; the C++ build needs CMake, Ninja, clang and SDL3; the oracle needs RetroArch with Beetle Saturn.
The port is in progress and currently reaches the first room.
MIT.

name: gh3: statically recompiling Guitar Hero III for Windows
description_en: gh3 statically recompiles the PS3 disc release of Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock with ps3recomp for native Windows execution. Its build scripts lift the game, apply import handling and run it against the user's dumped disc; the author reports playable Quickplay songs while guitar input and timing work remain.
description_zh: gh3 使用 ps3recomp 将 PS3 光盘版 Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock 静态重编译为原生 Windows 程序。构建脚本提升游戏代码、处理导入并使用玩家自行转储的光盘数据运行；作者报告 Quickplay 歌曲可玩，吉他输入和时序仍待完善。
requirements: A legally dumped Guitar Hero III PS3 disc, release BLUS30074.
ps3recomp, CMake, Ninja and clang-cl for the documented build.
Guitar controllers, 60 fps timing and modes beyond Quickplay remain unfinished.
MIT license.

name: Halyard: reconstructing Shadow cloud PC streaming on handhelds
description_en: Halyard reimplements the Shadow cloud PC streaming protocol for Nintendo Switch and PS Vita homebrew. It authenticates to a subscribed user's machine, negotiates over TLS, and carries encrypted video, audio, input and cursor channels; the consoles use hardware video decoding. The repository records protocol findings and platform-specific limits.
description_zh: Halyard 为 Nintendo Switch 和 PS Vita 自制软件重建 Shadow 云电脑串流协议。它登录用户已订阅的云电脑，经 TLS 协商后传输加密的视频、音频、输入和光标通道，并调用掌机硬件解码视频。仓库记录协议发现和各平台限制。
requirements: An active Shadow subscription and a Switch running homebrew or a PS Vita with HENkaku or h-encore.
The Vita port is described as early; clipboard and microphone channels are not implemented.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: fb200-tools: reconstructing FLAMMA FB200 firmware and control protocols
description_en: fb200-tools reconstructs the FLAMMA FB200 bass pedal's firmware behavior and USB HID/BLE controls in replacement firmware and device utilities. Its research documents the stock .mr image, command framing, DSP parity work, presets, and update path; the author reports testing selected features on a physical pedal.
description_zh: fb200-tools 为 FLAMMA FB200 贝斯效果器重构固件行为及 USB HID/BLE 控制，并提供替代固件和设备工具。研究文档记录原厂 .mr 镜像、命令帧、DSP 对照、预设与更新流程；作者报告部分功能已在实体设备上测试。
requirements: A FLAMMA FB200 and USB data cable; first installation requires the user's official .mr firmware file.
The replacement firmware runs on stock FB200 hardware only; phone-app compatibility and some pedal functions remain unchecked.
MIT License.

name: pc-arcrisefantasia: statically recompiling Arc Rise Fantasia for PC
description_en: pc-arcrisefantasia builds a native PC port of the North American Wii release of Arc Rise Fantasia by translating its PowerPC code to C++ and running it on wiikit's replacement Wii runtime. Its tools extract the user's disc, identify functions in the stripped DOL with signatures and manual evidence, and compile the translated code. The author reports gameplay through the first battle.
description_zh: pc-arcrisefantasia 将北美版 Wii 游戏 Arc Rise Fantasia 的 PowerPC 代码转换为 C++，借助 wiikit 的替代 Wii 运行环境构建原生 PC 移植版。工具从用户自备光盘提取数据，并用签名和人工证据识别无符号 DOL 中的函数；作者报告已运行到首场战斗。
requirements: The user's own North American Arc Rise Fantasia disc, release RPJE7U, and the wiikit submodule.
Python 3.8+, CMake, Ninja, a C++20 compiler, SDL3 and OpenGL 4.5; RVZ images using zstd need Python 3.14.
The author has tried gameplay only through the first battle and has not written a save.
MIT license for this repository's documentation and tools.

name: pc-conduit2: statically recompiling Conduit 2 for PC
description_en: pc-conduit2 statically recompiles the North American Wii release of Conduit 2 from PowerPC code to C++ for a native PC port. Its tools and notes map the disc and stripped main.dol, recover function names, and integrate with wiikit; the author reports gameplay through the first level with keyboard, mouse, or gamepad input.
description_zh: pc-conduit2 将北美 Wii 版《Conduit 2》的 PowerPC 代码静态转换为 C++，用于 PC 原生移植。工具和文档分析光盘与去符号的 main.dol、恢复函数名并接入 wiikit；作者报告可用键盘、鼠标或手柄玩到第一关。
requirements: The user's own North American Conduit 2 disc, game ID SC2E8P.
A wiikit submodule checkout, Python 3.8+, CMake, Ninja, a C++20 compiler, SDL3, and OpenGL 4.5.
Play beyond the first level has not been tried; fog and some input behavior remain unfinished.
MIT License.

name: Orion Unchained: reconstructing Acer Predator Orion lighting control
description_en: Orion Unchained reconstructs Acer Predator Orion desktop lighting control for Linux through a kernel driver, command-line client and desktop app. Its investigation documents PredatorSense lighting payloads, the firmware's AcerGamingFunction WMI methods and the SMBus controller path; the driver uses those findings to set and read lighting effects on the tested PO7-660.
description_zh: Orion Unchained 以 Linux 内核驱动、命令行客户端和桌面应用重建 Acer Predator Orion 台式机灯光控制。调查资料记录了 PredatorSense 灯光载荷、固件中的 AcerGamingFunction WMI 方法和 SMBus 控制路径；驱动据此在已测试的 PO7-660 上读取和设置灯效。
requirements: An Acer Predator Orion desktop, Linux 6.8 or later and kernel-module build tools through DKMS are required; the desktop app also needs PySide6.
The author tested PO7-660 with BIOS 1.08; other listed models need testing.
GPL-2.0-or-later license.

name: Axial: mapping and controlling the DJI RS 4 Mini over Bluetooth
description_en: Axial documents and implements Bluetooth control of the DJI RS 4 Mini gimbal. Its Mac GimbalProfiler observes messages and tests commands, while an iPhone app uses a model-specific .axial profile and shared DUML framing to send controls and decode signals.
description_zh: Axial 记录并实现 DJI RS 4 Mini 云台的蓝牙控制。Mac 端 GimbalProfiler 观察消息并测试命令，iPhone 应用使用机型专属 .axial 配置和共享 DUML 封装发送控制命令、解码状态信号。
requirements: A DJI RS 4 Mini is the documented working gimbal; other models require mapping and a profile.
The iPhone app needs macOS with Xcode, iOS 17 or later, and developer signing; the Mac profiler needs macOS 14 or later.
Only DJI DUML framing is implemented.
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.

name: Fiat Ducato X250: decoding the body CAN bus
description_en: The Fiat Ducato X250 WiCAN project decodes the 2009 vehicle's 50 kbit/s body-CAN messages into speed, RPM, lights, doors and other signals. It preserves five captures, a CAN ID reference, a Python decoder and listen-only WiCAN filters that publish values to Home Assistant over MQTT. The author reports checking signals against vehicle controls and instruments.
description_zh: Fiat Ducato X250 WiCAN 项目将 2009 款车型的 50 kbit/s 车身 CAN 消息解码为车速、转速、灯光、车门等信号。仓库保存五份抓包、CAN ID 参考表、Python 解码器，以及经 MQTT 向 Home Assistant 发布数据的只读 WiCAN 过滤配置。作者报告用车辆操作和仪表读数核对信号。
requirements: 2009 Fiat Ducato X250 for the documented signal mapping.
MeatPi WiCAN OBD dongle for the documented capture and MQTT setup.
Other Ducato, Jumper and Boxer variants have not been tested; several listed signal decodings remain provisional.
MIT licence.

name: EVA-Decomp: matching Neon Genesis Evangelion on Nintendo 64
description_en: EVA-Decomp reconstructs Neon Genesis Evangelion for Nintendo 64 as C and selected original assembly routines. Its build uses historical compilers and a user-provided ROM, then checks the resulting image by SHA-1. The author reports byte-identical output for the main program and eight overlays; a native PC port remains in preparation.
