description_zh: EVA-Decomp 以 C 语言和少量原始汇编例程重建 Nintendo 64《新世纪福音战士》。构建流程使用历史编译器及用户自备 ROM，并用 SHA-1 检查输出镜像。作者报告主程序和八个覆盖模块的重建结果逐字节一致；原生 PC 移植仍在准备中。
requirements: The user's own evangelion.z64 ROM with the documented SHA-1 hash is required.
Linux or WSL, splat64 and MIPS toolchain components are required for the build.
The native PC port remains preparatory work.

name: Snowboard Kids Recompiled: a native N64 recompilation for PC
description_en: Snowboard Kids Recompiled runs the USA Nintendo 64 game as a native Linux or Windows application using N64Recomp, RT64 and a separate game module. It validates a player-supplied ROM and adds desktop input, Controller Pak persistence, savestates and rendering settings around the recompiled game logic.
description_zh: Snowboard Kids Recompiled 使用 N64Recomp、RT64 和独立游戏模块，让美版 N64 游戏在 Linux 或 Windows 上原生运行。它校验玩家自备的 ROM，并为重编译后的游戏逻辑加入桌面输入、Controller Pak 持久化、即时存档和渲染设置。
requirements: A user-supplied Snowboard Kids (USA) ROM matching the documented normalized hash; .z64, .v64 and .n64 inputs are accepted.
Linux or Windows x86_64 for the public beta.
Broader full-game quality assurance remains in progress.
GPL-3.0 license for project-authored source; the README notes unresolved licensing for a pinned frontend dependency.

name: Unrack: extending reconstructed t.racks DSP control
description_en: Unrack controls the t.racks DSP 4x4 Mini Pro through WebHID, an Android USB bridge, or an ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi bridge. It builds on earlier protocol research and provides rebuilt transport, state management, and interface code; its protocol notes detail request and reply frames carried in 64-byte USB HID reports, commands, and parameter scaling.
description_zh: Unrack 通过 WebHID、Android USB 桥接或 ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi 桥接控制 t.racks DSP 4x4 Mini Pro。项目基于此前的协议研究，重建了传输层、状态管理和界面；协议文档记录 64 字节 USB HID 报文中的请求与响应帧、命令及参数换算方式。
requirements: A t.racks DSP 4x4 Mini Pro is the only currently supported device.
Desktop use requires Chrome or Edge with WebHID; the Wi-Fi bridge requires an ESP32-S3 board with USB OTG and at least 8 MB flash.
Mute and PEQ-band bypass have no device readback.
AGPL-3.0.

name: ArmorX Toolkit: reconstructing ARMORX Pro configuration and control
description_en: ArmorX Toolkit reconstructs configuration and control behavior for the BIGBIG WON ARMORX Pro controller accessory. It decodes and builds 144-byte configuration records with CRC16, records key mappings and BLE/USB command behavior, and supplies capture, CLI, and configurator tools based on the findings.
description_zh: ArmorX Toolkit 重构 BIGBIG WON ARMORX Pro 控制器配件的配置与控制行为。它解析和生成带 CRC16 的 144 字节配置记录，记录按键映射及 BLE/USB 命令，并据此提供抓取、命令行和图形配置工具。
requirements: BIGBIG WON ARMORX Pro hardware is required for live device work; documented hardware validation used an F20 wireless adapter.
Python 3.10+ for the Python toolkit.
Some key IDs and firmware-side macro encoding remain unresolved.
MIT License.

name: dsh-ls125-uv-probe: reconstructing the LS125 probe protocol and host
description_en: dsh-ls125-uv-probe reconstructs the UART exchange between a LinShang LS125 meter and its UVALED-X3 UV probe and implements a replacement STM32F103 host. Its protocol notes cover 9600 8N1 framing, polling and clear commands, measurement fields and CRC-16/MODBUS. Capture and decoding scripts and a sample trace accompany the agent skill.
description_zh: dsh-ls125-uv-probe 重建林上 LS125 仪表与 UVALED-X3 紫外探头之间的 UART 通信，并实现 STM32F103 替代主机。协议文档说明 9600 8N1、轮询与清零命令、测量字段及 CRC-16/MODBUS；仓库还提供智能体技能、抓取解码脚本和样本记录。
requirements: The hardware workflow uses a LinShang LS125 meter, UVALED-X3 probe and STM32F103 host board.
The author reports 21 received frames with zero CRC errors and zero timeouts.
The meaning of two constant response bytes remains unresolved.
MIT license.

name: LibreGrimrock: 64-bit reconstructions of the Legend of Grimrock engines
description_en: LibreGrimrock reconstructs the engines of Legend of Grimrock and Legend of Grimrock 2 as native 64-bit C++ modules from their original executables. The work follows recovered compilation units, class layouts and Lua bindings, while adapting platform libraries and loading data from owners' game installations.
description_zh: LibreGrimrock 从原版可执行文件重建《魔岩山传说》及《魔岩山传说 2》的引擎，编译为原生 64 位 C++ 模块。项目沿用恢复出的编译单元、类布局和 Lua 绑定，调整平台库，并读取用户安装的原版游戏数据。
requirements: An owned copy of the relevant game supplies its data.
Building requires a C++17 compiler, CMake 3.20 or newer, SDL3, OpenAL, libvorbisfile, zlib, minizip, FreeType, GLEW and OpenGL.
LuaJIT 2.0.0-rc3 is required; the Steamworks SDK is optional.
FBX/LWO/material import paths and the PhysX, FMOD, XAudio2 and Direct3D back ends are not reconstructed.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: HT-203U: reconstructing thermal camera capture on Linux
description_en: HT-203U Linux tools reconstruct video and temperature capture for the HT-203U USB thermal camera. Protocol notes document its UVC frame layout, USB control sequence and calibrated mode 8 temperature encoding; the supplied scripts display live video, read summaries and save per-pixel temperature frames.
description_zh: HT-203U Linux 工具重建了 HT-203U USB 热像仪的视频与温度采集流程。协议笔记记录其 UVC 帧布局、USB 控制顺序和模式 8 校准温度编码；配套脚本可显示实时画面、读取温度摘要并保存逐像素温度帧。
requirements: Python 3.11+, Linux video-device access, v4l-utils and FFmpeg with ffplay are required for live viewing.
Direct USB calibrated capture requires one HT-203U, libusb, PyUSB and access to its USB node.
The author reports testing one camera with firmware 4.09; temperature accuracy was not calibrated against a reference instrument.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: Pair-Raught: bridging Steam Controller RF to Switch 2 USB
description_en: Pair-Raught implements an nRF52840 controller bridge that receives Steam Controller input over Valve's RF link and presents a Pro Controller over USB to Nintendo Switch 2. Its firmware also sends a BLE console wake, forwards motion and rumble, and stores pairing and settings on the puck.
description_zh: Pair-Raught 实现 nRF52840 手柄桥接固件，通过 Valve RF 链路接收 Steam Controller 输入，并经 USB 向 Nintendo Switch 2 呈现 Pro Controller。固件还通过 BLE 唤醒主机，转发体感与震动，并在设备上保存配对和设置。
requirements: An nRF52840 Pro Micro board, a 2026 Steam Controller, Steam on a PC and a Nintendo Switch 2.
The board's bootloader must have the documented SoftDevice layout before flashing.
Chrome or Edge is needed for the WebSerial configuration page.
AGPL-3.0 license.

name: SPORTident SRR: reconstructing the short-range radio link
description_en: SPORTident SRR reconstructs the 2.4 GHz radio exchange used by SIAC cards and BSF8-SRR stations to send punches. Its documentation maps CC2500 settings, packet fields, acknowledgements and timing, while an ESP32/CC2500 sketch receives and acknowledges frames and a Python tool decodes captures.
description_zh: SPORTident SRR 重建 SIAC 卡和 BSF8-SRR 站点传送打卡记录所用的 2.4 GHz 无线通信。文档说明 CC2500 配置、帧字段、确认包及时间要求；ESP32/CC2500 示例程序可接收并确认帧，Python 工具可解码采集数据。
requirements: An ESP32 development board and 3.3 V CC2500 module for the reference receiver.
Arduino IDE with the ESP32 core, or arduino-cli, to build the receiver.
Some header bytes and retransmission behavior remain unexplained.
MIT license for code, documentation and photos.

name: Tapo V4: reconstructing C510W local control and media protocols
description_en: Tapo V4 reconstructs the Tapo C510W camera’s local control and media protocols from Android app analysis and device probing. A byte-level specification and Python client cover SPAKE2+ login, AES-128-CCM /ds requests, media-port authentication and SD-card clip download. The author reports operation on a C510W and limited reports from other models.
description_zh: Tapo V4 通过分析 Android 应用和探测设备，重建 Tapo C510W 摄像机的本地控制及媒体协议。逐字节规格和 Python 客户端涵盖 SPAKE2+ 登录、AES-128-CCM 加密的 /ds 请求、媒体端口认证与 SD 卡片段下载。作者报告在 C510W 上运行，并收集了其他型号的有限反馈。
requirements: A Tapo camera and its account credential; the example uses requests, pycryptodome, python-dotenv and pytest.
The author’s primary live tests used a C510W on firmware 1.3.4; other login variants have limited coverage.
MIT.

name: Omni Tray: reconstructing Arctis Nova Pro Omni USB control
description_en: Omni Tray reconstructs USB HID control of the SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni GameHub in a Windows tray client. Its protocol notes map report collections, command transfers and event channels; the client exposes battery, mute, ANC and volume state and can relay telemetry through MQTT.
description_zh: Omni Tray 在 Windows 托盘客户端中重建 SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni GameHub 的 USB HID 控制。协议笔记梳理报告集合、命令传输和事件通道；客户端处理电量、静音、ANC 与音量，并可通过 MQTT 转发状态。
requirements: SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni GameHub and Windows.
Protocol observations come from one unit on firmware revision 0x0132; opcodes may vary across revisions.
Sidetone, EQ and the 0xB8 event remain unresolved.
MIT license.

name: p2afan: mapping ASPEED BMC fan control through the P2A bridge
description_en: p2afan investigates the Tyan FT77C-B7079 BMC and controls its ASPEED AST2400 fan PWM registers from the host through the PCIe-to-AHB bridge. Its write-up maps BAR1, the PWM block and firmware layout, while the Python controller computes duty from IPMI, hwmon or command output.
description_zh: p2afan 调查 Tyan FT77C-B7079 的 BMC，经 ASPEED AST2400 的 PCIe-to-AHB 桥在主机侧控制风扇 PWM 寄存器。文档记录 BAR1、PWM 模块及固件布局；Python 控制器可依据 IPMI、hwmon 或命令输出计算占空比。
requirements: ASPEED AST2400/AST2500 BMC with an enabled, unlocked P2A bridge; root access, ipmitool and /dev/ipmi0.
Source installation requires Python 3.11–3.14.
The measured register and sensor values come from one Tyan FT77C-B7079 chassis and must be re-derived for other machines.
MIT license.

name: tapo-local: reconstructing local control of the Tapo P110
description_en: tapo-local implements local control of the TP-Link Tapo P110 smart plug using TPAP communication recovered from the Tapo Android app. Python clients provision the plug over BLE, then use Wi-Fi sessions with SPAKE2+ and AES-128-CCM for relay control, power readings and automation.
description_zh: tapo-local 根据 Tapo Android 应用分析所得的 TPAP 通信方式，实现 TP-Link Tapo P110 智能插座的本地控制。Python 客户端通过 BLE 配网，再经采用 SPAKE2+ 和 AES-128-CCM 的 Wi-Fi 会话控制继电器、读取功率并执行自动化。
requirements: A TP-Link Tapo P110 is required; setup uses BLE and a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.
Python 3.10 or later is required, with bleak for provisioning and cryptography plus aiohttp for Wi-Fi control.
The toolkit does not ship a verified helper for creating calendar schedule rules.
MIT license.

name: AnyShare University CLI: reconstructing campus cloud API access
description_en: AnyShare University CLI reconstructs direct access to a university AnyShare cloud drive through a Node.js client. Its investigation notes document OAuth client registration, authorization and token refresh, file operations, and signed object-storage transfers for the Shandong University instance.
description_zh: AnyShare University CLI 通过 Node.js 客户端重建对高校 AnyShare 网盘的直接访问。分析笔记记录山东大学实例中的 OAuth 客户端注册、授权与令牌刷新、文件操作，以及带签名的对象存储传输流程。
requirements: Requires Node.js 18 or newer and access to an AnyShare account.
The author reports full feature checks only against Shandong University's icloud.sdu.edu.cn instance; other institutions remain untested.
MIT licence.

name: castty: reconstructing Mionix Castor control on Linux
description_en: castty reconstructs configuration of the Mionix Castor mouse on Linux from captured HID feature reports. Its protocol notes describe command report 0x60, profile report 0x61, readback, and field offsets; the Rust GUI and CLI use those findings for lighting, DPI, buttons, macros, and profiles.
description_zh: castty 依据捕获的 HID feature report 重建 Mionix Castor 鼠标的 Linux 配置功能。协议文档记录命令报文 0x60、配置报文 0x61、配置回读及字段偏移；Rust 图形界面和命令行据此控制灯光、DPI、按键、宏与配置档。
requirements: A Mionix Castor with USB ID 22d4:1316 and Linux hidraw are required.
The Castor PRO is a different device and is unsupported.

name: legion-gpu-rgb: reconstructing Lenovo GPU lighting control
description_en: legion-gpu-rgb reconstructs RGB lighting control for a Lenovo OEM RTX 5070 Ti by tracing its DDC-side NvAPI I2C transactions. It documents the controller's register writes and supplies a Python controller, an OpenRGB plugin and a patch that exposes the DDC bus to OpenRGB.
description_zh: legion-gpu-rgb 通过追踪 DDC 侧的 NvAPI I2C 事务，重建 Lenovo OEM RTX 5070 Ti 的 RGB 灯光控制。项目记录控制器寄存器写入，并提供 Python 控制工具、OpenRGB 插件及向 OpenRGB 暴露 DDC 总线的补丁。
requirements: The documented hardware is the Lenovo OEM RTX 5070 Ti with PCI ID 10DE:2C05 and subsystem 17AA:C773; other cards are untested.
The standalone tool requires Python 3 and an NVIDIA driver; the plugin targets OpenRGB 1.0rc3 or 1.0rc3.1, plugin API 4 and Qt 5.15.0.
Only static effect 0x01 is implemented; the author reports that a colour update takes about 555 ms.
GPL-2.0-or-later licence.

name: cli-edvibe: reconstructing Edvibe's WebSocket RPC interface
description_en: cli-edvibe reconstructs Edvibe's private WebSocket RPC interface as a Python command-line client for lessons, homework, students and school analytics. Its target notes specify the gateway, request and response fields, authentication calls and named controllers. The client can build lessons from JSON, read submitted homework and edit teacher landing pages.
description_zh: cli-edvibe 将 Edvibe 的私有 WebSocket RPC 接口重建为 Python 命令行客户端，用于课程、作业、学生和学校统计操作。研究笔记记录了网关、请求与响应字段、认证调用及控制器方法。客户端可从 JSON 创建课程、读取已提交作业并编辑教师主页。
requirements: Edvibe account for live operations.
Python 3.9 or newer.
MIT licence.

name: Cisco CP-9951 DOOM: mapping phone input for a native game port
description_en: Cisco CP-9951 DOOM ports the game to run on the IP phone's ARM CPU using its local framebuffer, keypad, and media path. The accompanying investigation maps the Raven keypad path and a 16-byte input event format from the phone's keyhandle module and hardware observations.
description_zh: Cisco CP-9951 DOOM 将游戏移植到 IP 电话的 ARM 处理器，使用本地帧缓冲、键盘和媒体通路。配套研究通过检查 keyhandle 模块和实际设备，梳理 Raven 键盘输入路径及 16 字节事件格式。
requirements: A Cisco CP-9951 with firmware sip9951.9-2-1 is the documented tested device.
The author reports an Ethernet-disconnected cold-boot test of the final build.
No licence file in the repository.

name: battlepod: reconstructing the BattleTech arcade cockpit
description_en: battlepod reconstructs the Virtual World Entertainment BattleTech cockpit as a bring-up harness and playable emulator. It runs the cockpit's 68020 software from a user-supplied image, models serial and Remote I/O devices, decodes display lists, and records hardware and inter-pod protocol findings.
description_zh: battlepod 将 Virtual World Entertainment 的 BattleTech 座舱重建为启动研究工具和可玩的模拟程序。它运行用户提供映像中的 68020 软件，模拟串口及 Remote I/O 设备，解析显示列表，并记录硬件和座舱间通信协议的研究结果。
requirements: A user's own VWE Release 13.1.8 image set.
A C compiler, GNU make 4 or later, Git and Python 3.8 or later; SDL2 and pkg-config are required for the cockpit windows.
The author reports alpha status; sound and the secondary display are absent.
MIT License.

name: SoundcoreBridge: reconstructing Soundcore Space 2 headphone controls
description_en: SoundcoreBridge reconstructs Soundcore Space 2 headphone controls over the vendor Bluetooth channel for a macOS menu-bar app and CLI. Its protocol map documents command addressing, state offsets, noise-cancelling modes and equalizer values from observed traffic and device responses.
description_zh: SoundcoreBridge 通过厂商蓝牙通道重建 Soundcore Space 2 耳机控制，并提供 macOS 菜单栏应用和 CLI。协议文档依据采集流量及设备响应，记录命令地址、状态偏移、降噪模式和均衡器数值。
requirements: macOS 13 or later and a Bluetooth-connected Soundcore headset.
Full controls are documented for Soundcore Space 2; other detected models may expose only battery and firmware information.
MIT license.

name: Zeppelin Air: reconstructing USB firmware recovery
description_en: Zeppelin Air Recovery reconstructs the Bowers & Wilkins speaker's USB recovery procedure from its updater library and live DFU exchanges. A Python tool implements vendor commands, flashes the MCU and coprocessor in two phases, and polls the coprocessor until it is ready; protocol notes document the message sequence and flash layout.
description_zh: Zeppelin Air Recovery 从厂商更新库和实机 DFU 交互还原 Bowers & Wilkins 音箱的 USB 恢复流程。Python 工具实现厂商命令，分两阶段写入 MCU 与协处理器固件，并轮询等待协处理器就绪；协议笔记记录消息顺序和闪存布局。
requirements: Requires a Zeppelin Air, Python 3.9 or later, pyusb, libusb and a USB cable.
Requires the user's official B&W recovery utility for its firmware images.
A mains power cycle is required between recovery phases; the author reports that audio output remains unverified.
MIT license.

name: garmin-proto-lab: reconstructing Garmin watch communication
description_en: garmin-proto-lab reconstructs Garmin watch-facing GFDI communication in a Python compatibility client using findings from Garmin Connect's Android package. Its specification covers BLE routing, pairing, authentication, MultiLink transport, file access and FIT validation; the author reports offline implementation and tests, with live watch checks remaining.
description_zh: garmin-proto-lab 根据 Garmin Connect Android 包的分析结果，以 Python 客户端重建面向手表的 GFDI 通信。协议规范涵盖 BLE 路由、配对、认证、MultiLink 传输、文件访问及 FIT 校验；作者报告已完成离线实现和测试，实体手表检查仍待进行。
requirements: Requires Python 3.11 or newer; live BLE work uses the optional hardware dependencies and a Garmin watch.
Physical-watch checks for discovery, pairing, reconnect and data downloads remain pending.
No licence file in the repository.

name: EmuWorks: emulating NumWorks N0110 calculator hardware
description_en: EmuWorks recreates the NumWorks N0110 calculator's hardware environment in Renode so ARM Cortex-M7 firmware runs on an emulated STM32F730. Its peripheral models cover the ST7789V display, keyboard matrix, battery ADC and CRC unit, while a Windows app presents the screen and firmware tools. Original Core and Code firmware images are bundled; other firmware is supplied by the user.
description_zh: EmuWorks 在 Renode 中重建 NumWorks N0110 计算器的硬件环境，使 ARM Cortex-M7 固件运行于模拟的 STM32F730。外设模型涵盖 ST7789V 屏幕、键盘矩阵、电池 ADC 和 CRC 单元，Windows 应用负责显示画面及固件管理。仓库内置原创 Core、Code 固件；其他固件由用户提供。
requirements: Renode 1.16 and .NET Desktop Runtime 8 are required for the Windows application.
The installation path must not contain spaces.
Third-party Epsilon, Omega or Upsilon firmware images must be supplied by the user.
MIT License for the repository; bundled Code firmware includes separate dependency notices.

name: mcg-recomp: statically recompiling MechCommander Gold for Windows
description_en: mcg-recomp statically translates MechCommander Gold's MCX.EXE into C and runs the generated code in a native Windows host. It extracts CodeView function information, bridges imports, and provides graphics, sound, movie, and conformance support; the author reports playing the first campaign mission through its debriefing.
description_zh: mcg-recomp 将《MechCommander Gold》的 MCX.EXE 静态转换为 C，并通过 Windows 原生宿主运行生成代码。项目提取 CodeView 函数信息、桥接导入调用，并支持图形、声音、影片和一致性检查；作者报告已打通第一场战役任务及结算。
requirements: A user-owned copy of MechCommander Gold containing MCX.EXE.
For the documented step-by-step setup: Windows 10/11, Python 3.10+ with pefile and capstone, git, Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools, and a sibling pcrecomp checkout.
The author reports first-mission completion; later missions have not been tried.
MIT license.

name: NiimBridge: reconstructing the NIIMBOT D110_M print protocol
description_en: NiimBridge reconstructs the NIIMBOT D110_M printer's Bluetooth print exchange from HCI captures of the vendor Android app. Its Kotlin driver implements packet framing, checksums, row encoding, transport, and print-state handling; a separate SDK and diagnostic app expose printing and packet inspection. The author reports byte-identical packet comparisons for two captured jobs.
description_zh: NiimBridge 从厂商 Android 应用的 HCI 抓包重建 NIIMBOT D110_M 打印机的蓝牙通信。Kotlin 驱动实现数据包分帧、校验和、图像行编码、传输及打印状态处理；另有 SDK 和诊断应用提供打印与数据包查看。作者报告两次打印任务的输出包逐字节一致。
requirements: Android Studio, JDK 17, and a NIIMBOT D110_M paired with the test device are required.
The primary Bluetooth Classic SPP transport requires the printer to be bonded in Android settings.
MIT license.

name: OMS fingerprint module: reconstructing USB communication for a Linux driver
description_en: The OMS fingerprint module investigation reconstructs USB communication with the 33a7:2388 match-on-chip sensor and implements it as a libfprint driver. Its notes describe USBC transport acknowledgements, EF01 frames, checksums and enrollment and identification responses; the author reports successful hardware enrollment and verification.
description_zh: OMS 指纹模块项目重建 33a7:2388 芯片内匹配传感器的 USB 通信，并将其实现为 libfprint 驱动。文档记录 USBC 传输确认、EF01 帧、校验和及注册与识别响应；作者报告已在真实硬件上完成指纹注册和验证。
requirements: OMS fingerprint module with USB ID 33a7:2388; libfprint 1.94.100 and the listed Meson, Ninja, GCC and library dependencies for the documented build.
Keep USB autosuspend disabled for this device.
The upstream patch was prepared but had not been submitted.
LGPL-2.1-or-later license.

name: ais: reconstructing Google AI Studio web RPC access
description_en: ais reconstructs Google AI Studio web-client RPC access in a Python CLI, using recovered SAPISIDHASH authentication, browser headers and positional JSPB message fields. It uses that web route for account and workspace calls and an account API key for generation, with commands for models, quota, chat and other functions.
description_zh: ais 用 Python 命令行工具重建 Google AI Studio 网页客户端的 RPC 访问方式，采用分析得到的 SAPISIDHASH 认证、浏览器请求头和位置式 JSPB 字段。它通过网页路径调用账户与工作区功能，并用账户 API 密钥处理生成请求，提供模型、配额和聊天等命令。
requirements: Python 3.9 or newer and a signed-in Google AI Studio browser session.
Playwright is optional for first-time API-key capture.
Free-tier generation availability depends on account entitlements; the author reports an image limit of zero and unavailable Veo generation for the tested tier.
MIT license.

name: zwift-api: mapping Zwift's private data endpoints
description_en: zwift-api maps selected private Zwift HTTP data interfaces and implements a read-only Node client for profile, achievements, events, quests and catalogue data. Its documentation records proxy-captured endpoints and protobuf wire decoding without schemas. The author reports that epic-challenge progress travels over a realtime UDP path rather than the mapped HTTP endpoints.
description_zh: zwift-api 梳理 Zwift 的部分私有 HTTP 数据接口，并实现读取个人资料、成就、活动、任务和目录数据的只读 Node 客户端。项目记录代理抓包得到的端点，并在没有 schema 的情况下解析 protobuf 字段。作者报告史诗挑战进度经实时 UDP 路径传输，而非已整理的 HTTP 端点。
requirements: Node.js 18 or later; account endpoints require the user's Zwift credentials.
The client is read-only; epic-challenge progress is outside its HTTP endpoint coverage.
MIT license.

name: Gear VR Controller: decoding Samsung's BLE remote protocol
description_en: Gear VR Controller research decodes the Samsung ET-YO324 remote's Bluetooth LE commands and sensor stream. Its protocol notes map GATT characteristics, a command acknowledgement handshake, IMU samples, touchpad and button fields; Python captures and tests support a macOS air-mouse app and a live three.js viewer.
description_zh: Gear VR Controller 项目解析 Samsung ET-YO324 遥控器的 Bluetooth LE 命令与传感器数据流。协议笔记记录 GATT 特征、命令确认握手、IMU 样本、触摸板和按键字段；Python 抓包与测试代码支撑 macOS 空中鼠标程序和 three.js 实时查看器。
requirements: Requires a Samsung Gear VR Controller ET-YO324 for live use.
Python tools require Python 3.11 or later; the native macOS app requires macOS 14 or later.
The macOS remote requires Accessibility permission for synthesized pointer and click events.
MIT license.

name: CH899: reconstructing the clock's MM32–ESP exchange
description_en: CH899 firmware research reconstructs the UART exchange between the clock's MM32 movement controller and ESP8285 Wi-Fi module. It records wake, time and reset messages from stock behavior and implements replacement ESP firmware that adds Wi-Fi setup and timekeeping options while retaining the original movement controller.
description_zh: CH899 固件研究还原时钟的 MM32 走针控制器与 ESP8285 Wi-Fi 模块之间的 UART 通信。项目记录原固件的唤醒、报时和重置消息，并实现带有 Wi-Fi 配网及校时选项的 ESP 替代固件，保留原走针控制器。
requirements: The older CH899 clock board whose main chip is marked MM32.
Replacement applies to the ESP8285 Wi-Fi firmware; the MM32 movement firmware remains in place.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: Acer Predator Helios 16: reconstructing Linux lighting control
description_en: Acer Predator Helios 16 RGB documents lighting exchanges for PH16-series laptops and implements Linux control through a Python CLI and OpenRGB controllers. It maps the keyboard's vendor HID reports and the standard HID LampArray interfaces used by the front bar, lid logo, and rear glass bar.
description_zh: Acer Predator Helios 16 RGB 记录 PH16 系列笔记本的灯效通信，并以 Python 命令行工具和 OpenRGB 控制器实现 Linux 控制。研究区分了键盘的厂商 HID 报文与前灯条、顶盖标志和后玻璃灯条使用的标准 HID LampArray 接口。
requirements: A Predator Helios 16 is needed; the author reports testing on PH16-73.
PH16-71/72 and Helios Neo models still need device testing, and the PH16-71 Chicony per-key map remains open.
Code is GPL-2.0-only; documentation is CC-BY-4.0.

name: Dorado: reconstructing a Zune HD application runtime
description_en: Dorado reconstructs a Zune HD application runtime for .zcp and .ccgame packages. It parses NX and cabinet containers, remaps .NET Compact Framework identities and runs managed XNA 3.1 applications against a clean-room compatibility layer; the implemented desktop host also tests game rendering.
description_zh: Dorado 为 .zcp 和 .ccgame 包重建 Zune HD 应用运行环境。它解析 NX 与 cabinet 容器，重映射 .NET Compact Framework 程序集标识，并用自行实现的 XNA 3.1 兼容层运行托管应用；现有桌面端还测试游戏画面渲染。
requirements: .NET 8 SDK and user-provided Zune HD application packages.
The Android host is planned; encrypted marketplace packages require the owner's unwrapped key.
MIT.

name: Powerology AM8268N: reconstructing a USB display protocol for Linux
description_en: Powerology AM8268N reconstructs the USB display protocol used by dual-screen laptop extenders built around the Actions Micro AM8268N. A Linux userspace driver presents each panel through evdi and sends JSON-RPC control and H.264 video over vendor-defined HID interfaces; the protocol notes derive from captures of the Windows application.
description_zh: Powerology AM8268N 重建采用 Actions Micro AM8268N 的双屏扩展设备所用 USB 显示协议。Linux 用户态驱动通过 evdi 呈现各显示屏，并借助厂商自定义 HID 接口发送 JSON-RPC 控制消息和 H.264 视频；协议记录依据 Windows 应用抓包整理。
requirements: An AM8268N USB display panel with USB ID 1de1:f201 and a Linux host.
The extend launcher needs evdi 1.14.15 or newer, ffmpeg with libx264, Python 3.8 or newer, and an X11 session.
The author reports development on Linux Mint 22 with kernel 7.0; Wayland support is untested.
MIT License.

name: eJay: static recompilation of the Dance eJay audio engines
description_en: eJay statically recompiles the audio and graphics libraries of Dance eJay titles for a new cross-platform host. Its tools lift user-supplied DLLs to C for Linux and macOS, while a host drives the original libraries on Windows; the documented eJay 2 workspace supports sample browsing, block placement and playback.
description_zh: eJay 为 Dance eJay 系列音乐制作软件的音频和图形库构建跨平台宿主。工具将用户自备光盘中的 DLL 转换为 C 代码供 Linux、macOS 使用，Windows 宿主则调用原库；文档中的 eJay 2 工作区已支持浏览素材、放置片段和播放。
requirements: A user's own Dance eJay 2, HipHop eJay 2 or Techno eJay disc or ISO and approximately 2 GB of free space.
Linux and macOS builds require pcrecomp alongside the checkout; platform-specific build tools are listed in the README.
The author reports alpha status; transport, load and save controls are unfinished, and Dance eJay 1 samples remain silent.
MIT License.

name: SuperCam Thermal Viewer: reconstructing QuanLi camera streaming
description_en: SuperCam Thermal Viewer is a cross-platform client for QuanLi/LangChi thermal cameras built from investigation of their proprietary network traffic. It displays 160×120 radiometric infrared frames alongside 1920×1080 H.264 video, while research notes document UDP discovery, TCP control and stream negotiation.
description_zh: SuperCam Thermal Viewer 基于对 QuanLi/LangChi 热成像相机私有网络通信的调查构建跨平台客户端。它显示 160×120 红外测温帧和 1920×1080 H.264 视频；研究笔记记录 UDP 发现、TCP 控制及串流协商。
requirements: A QuanLi/LangChi SuperCam camera and a network connection; building from source requires Python 3.12 or newer.
macOS packages must be built on macOS.
MIT.

name: Advanced Daisenryaku PC: a native Windows port of the Mega Drive game
description_en: Advanced Daisenryaku PC ports the Sega Mega Drive strategy game to native Windows in C/C++ using statically translated game logic. It reconstructs cartridge flow, turn-based combat, campaign state, graphics and input around a user-supplied ROM. Its development reports describe ROM differential tests and selected presentation comparisons.
description_zh: Advanced Daisenryaku PC 使用静态翻译的游戏逻辑，以 C/C++ 将 Sega Mega Drive 战略游戏移植为 Windows 原生程序。它围绕用户自备 ROM 重建卡带流程、回合战斗、战役状态、画面和输入；开发报告记录了 ROM 差分测试及部分画面对照。
requirements: Windows x64, Visual Studio 2026 with the C++ desktop workload, and Windows SDK are required.
A user-supplied ROM matching SHA-256 47360b90ee077c2df7bb8f8bb6f46bbea25d7e5b1fd975cdf507c1048d80b062 is required.
Player-two input and some audio controls remain unfinished; presentation comparisons cover selected samples.
No licence file in the repository.

name: vclights: reconstructing VC-BLELIGHT lamp commands
description_en: vclights reconstructs VC-BLELIGHT lamp control from the Raingel Android app's BLE commands. Its Python client sets power, brightness, color and firmware modes, while protocol notes identify GATT services, write characteristics and opcode payloads; camera-based observations document device responses and color limits.
description_zh: vclights 从 Raingel Android 应用的 BLE 命令重建 VC-BLELIGHT 灯具控制。Python 客户端设置开关、亮度、颜色和固件模式；协议笔记列出 GATT 服务、写入特征及操作码载荷，并以相机观察记录设备响应和颜色限制。
requirements: A VC-BLELIGHT lamp, Bluetooth access and the Python dependencies in requirements.txt.
Intermediate RGB colors are unreliable on the tested strips; BLE writes have no acknowledgement.
MIT.

name: Toy Story disassembly: rebuilding the Mega Drive ROM from generated source
description_en: Toy Story disassembly reconstructs the Mega Drive game's ROM as generated assembly source and compares the rebuilt ROM byte for byte with the user's copy. Its 68000 tracer, ROM maps, RNC decoder, and sprite tools support ongoing recovery of routines, text, and graphics formats. The author reports that the rebuild matches while equivalent named source remains incomplete.
description_zh: Toy Story disassembly 将 Mega Drive 版《Toy Story》ROM 生成为汇编源码，并与用户自备 ROM 逐字节比较。项目用 68000 追踪器、ROM 映射、RNC 解码器和精灵工具整理程序、文本与图形格式；作者报告重建结果匹配，但具名等价源码仍在完善。
requirements: A user-provided Toy Story USA ROM, Python 3 with capstone, and AS with asl and p2bin are required.
The author reports 24.7% equivalent named source for the USA ROM; many routines and fields remain unnamed.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: ktctl: reconstructing FiiO JA11 USB equalizer control
description_en: ktctl reconstructs the FiiO JA11 runtime USB control protocol in a Rust CLI and TUI for five-band PEQ, presets and gain. Its protocol notes specify framing, CRC-8/MAXIM and command bytes derived from Android app analysis and device probing. The author reports a successful read, write and save round trip on a JA11.
description_zh: ktctl 用 Rust CLI 和 TUI 重建 FiiO JA11 的运行时 USB 控制协议，可调整五段 PEQ、预设和增益。协议文档记录了从 Android 应用分析及设备探测获得的帧格式、CRC-8/MAXIM 和命令字节。作者报告已在 JA11 上完成读取、写入和保存的往返验证。
requirements: Rust 1.75+ and macOS or Linux; USB access requires a JA11 or compatible device.
JCALLY JM12 and Moondrop KT02H20 compatibility remains unconfirmed; master-gain encoding lacks audio confirmation.
Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0.

name: AppleAVE2: reconstructing the IOKit wire format and driver validation path
description_en: The AppleAVE2 investigation maps the kernel driver's IOKit user-client selectors and input structures while examining the work-buffer size calculation associated with CVE-2026-64747. It includes a userspace reachability program, wire-format notes, overflow arithmetic and patched-host logs. The author reports that a hardware capability gate prevented a live overflow on that host.
description_zh: AppleAVE2 调查梳理内核驱动的 IOKit 用户客户端选择器和输入结构，并分析 CVE-2026-64747 涉及的工作缓冲区大小计算。仓库包含用户态可达性程序、通信格式说明、溢出计算和已修补主机的日志；作者称该主机的硬件能力检查阻止了实际溢出。
requirements: Building the reachability program requires an arm64 macOS environment with clang, IOKit and CoreFoundation.
The reported host runs the fixed AppleAVE2 905.40.1 build; its capability gate rejects the overflow dimensions before the calculator runs.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Indian Thunder Stroke: decoding motorcycle CAN signals
description_en: Indian Thunder Stroke documents a listen-only J1939 CAN decoder for a 2017 Indian Springfield motorcycle, with ESP32-S3 firmware and an Android instrument cluster. Its findings map messages for tyre pressure and temperature, fault codes, controls and engine state, including measured PGN and byte positions; the hardware publishes decoded values over BLE.
description_zh: Indian Thunder Stroke 记录了针对 2017 年款 Indian Springfield 摩托车的只监听 J1939 CAN 解码器，并提供 ESP32-S3 固件和 Android 仪表界面。资料映射了胎压与温度、故障码、控制状态和发动机状态等消息，列出实测 PGN 与字节位置；硬件通过 BLE 发布解码结果。
requirements: The documented setup uses a CANFD-MC ESP32-S3 board connected to the motorcycle's service connector.
The author developed and checked the decoding on a 2017 Indian Springfield; equipment-dependent signals on other models may differ.
MIT license.

name: telink-usb-ota: reconstructing Telink USB-HID firmware updates
description_en: telink-usb-ota reconstructs Telink's USB-HID OTA update exchange as a Rust Linux host tool for querying and flashing a CIDOO V65 v2 keyboard. Its protocol notes specify 33-byte HID reports, START and FINISH opcodes, 16-byte data chunks, CRC-16/MODBUS and the next-chunk acknowledgement rule, derived from updater and firmware disassembly and checked by the author against hardware.
description_zh: telink-usb-ota 将 Telink USB-HID OTA 更新交互实现为 Linux 上的 Rust 工具，可查询 CIDOO V65 v2 键盘版本并写入固件。协议资料记录了 33 字节 HID 报告、START 和 FINISH 操作码、16 字节数据块、CRC-16/MODBUS，以及响应中表示下一数据块序号的规则；作者称这些信息来自升级程序和固件反汇编，并经实机核对。
requirements: Linux hidraw access, Rust and a compatible Telink device are required; flashing also requires a firmware image and --confirm-flash.
The author tested a CIDOO V65 v2 keyboard; other Telink devices require device-specific checking.
Flashing has no reconnect-and-resume path or firmware read-back.
AGPL-3.0-only license.

name: Dragon Ball Z: L'Appel du Destin: rebuilding the Mega Drive ROM from source
description_en: Dragon Ball Z: L'Appel du Destin disassembly reconstructs the French Mega Drive ROM as generated assembly and compares it byte for byte with a user-provided original. A recursive 68000 tracer, labelled listing, ROM region map, text decoder, and LZSS decoder record the game's code and data formats. The author reports a matching rebuild with substantial naming work still open.
description_zh: Dragon Ball Z: L'Appel du Destin disassembly 把法语版 Mega Drive ROM 生成为汇编源码，并与用户自备原版逐字节比对。项目用 68000 递归追踪器、带标签的清单、ROM 分区图、文本解码器和 LZSS 解码器整理程序与数据格式；作者报告重建结果匹配，但命名工作仍在进行。
requirements: A user-provided French ROM, Python 3 with capstone, and AS with asl and p2bin are required.
The author reports 60.9% equivalent named source, with most traced routines unnamed.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: jgalbs cod4: porting the Call of Duty 4 multiplayer client to Apple Silicon
description_en: jgalbs cod4 ports the KisakCOD Call of Duty 4 multiplayer client to Apple Silicon macOS. Its native Metal renderer and platform work support menus, maps, input, audio, hosting and multiplayer gameplay while loading assets from a user's compatible game installation. The source documents ongoing development and tested feature boundaries.
description_zh: jgalbs cod4 将 KisakCOD 的 Call of Duty 4 多人客户端移植到 Apple silicon macOS。项目加入原生 Metal 渲染器和平台适配，支持菜单、地图、输入、音频、开服及多人对战，并从用户已有的兼容游戏安装中读取素材。文档记录了持续开发状态和已测试功能范围。
requirements: An Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 15.5 or later, Xcode Command Line Tools and Homebrew is required to build.
A compatible Call of Duty 4 installation must supply the game data.
Broad third-party mod compatibility is not guaranteed; Windows-only mod DLLs need a native port.
GPL-3.0 for project code, except where individual files state otherwise.

name: Smart Ring Dashboard: direct BLE access to generic smart rings
description_en: Smart Ring Dashboard implements direct Web Bluetooth access to Anko/Jring and Colmi/Yawell smart rings using documented BLE packet formats. Its protocol reference describes GATT services, commands and response layouts, while the browser app displays heart rate, activity, sleep and oxygen readings.
description_zh: Smart Ring Dashboard 根据已记录的 BLE 数据包格式，通过 Web Bluetooth 直连 Anko/Jring 与 Colmi/Yawell 智能戒指。协议文档列出 GATT 服务、命令和响应布局，浏览器应用展示心率、活动、睡眠和血氧数据。
requirements: Requires Node.js 20 or newer for local development and a Web Bluetooth browser such as Chrome or Edge for ring access.
The Anko/Jring family is reported tested on hardware; Colmi/Yawell support is implemented from documented protocol work.
The tested Anko ring returned zero for HRV and stress fields.
MIT licence.

name: carimer: reconstructing Mercari Japan web API requests
description_en: carimer reconstructs anonymous Mercari Japan web API requests from captured browser traffic and live probes. Its API specification records DPoP signing, headers, endpoint behavior and filter values; a synchronous and asynchronous Python client implements search, listing detail, image search and Shops access. The documented scope covers data available without login.
description_zh: carimer 根据浏览器流量抓取和在线探测重建 Mercari Japan 匿名访问的网页 API 请求。接口规格记录 DPoP 签名、请求头、端点行为及筛选值；同步与异步 Python 客户端实现搜索、商品详情、以图搜索和 Shops 访问。文档范围限于无需登录的数据。
requirements: Python 3.12+; the package uses httpx, pydantic and cryptography.
Logged-in actions such as purchases, comments and saved searches are outside scope; the private API may change.
MIT.

name: Thermal Cam: decoding the Thermal Master P1 USB stream
description_en: Thermal Cam implements a macOS viewer for the Thermal Master P1 using a documented USB control and frame protocol. Its Swift driver starts the vendor stream through libusb, decodes radiometric frames into temperatures, and displays palettes, per-pixel readings, and snapshots.
description_zh: Thermal Cam 根据已记录的 USB 控制与帧协议实现 Thermal Master P1 的 macOS 查看器。Swift 驱动通过 libusb 启动厂商数据流，将辐射测温帧解码为温度，并提供调色板、逐像素读数与截图。
requirements: A Thermal Master P1 camera and macOS 15 or newer are required for the documented viewer.
Building requires Xcode 26.4 or newer with Swift 6 and Homebrew libusb.
MIT.

name: ilo2ctl: rebuilding the HP iLO 2 remote console and controls
description_en: ilo2ctl rebuilds HP iLO 2 remote-console and management controls in C++, including DVC video decoding, keyboard and mouse input, RIBCL power and health operations, and ISO virtual media. The author reports comparing ported applet components byte for byte with recorded outputs from HP's Java classes.
description_zh: ilo2ctl 用 C++ 重建 HP iLO 2 的远程控制台与管理功能，涵盖 DVC 视频解码、键鼠输入、RIBCL 电源及健康状态操作，以及 ISO 虚拟介质。作者报告将移植的小程序组件与 HP Java 类的记录输出逐字节比较。
requirements: An HP iLO 2 is needed for live control; captured DVC streams can be replayed without hardware.
Builds on Windows with MinGW and on Linux; the optional GUI needs SDL3 and Dear ImGui.
Regenerating the Java comparison recordings requires JDK 17 and a user-supplied HP applet JAR.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: ControlVault 3: reconstructing Linux fingerprint support
description_en: controlvault3-linux-fingerprint reconstructs the encrypted command exchange of the Dell/Broadcom ControlVault 3 fingerprint sensor and implements enrollment and verification on Linux. It offers a libfprint TOD driver for fprintd and an alternative standalone PAM path. The author describes deriving the channel from Windows USB captures and crypto hooks and reports testing on a Dell Latitude 5531.
description_zh: controlvault3-linux-fingerprint 重建 Dell/Broadcom ControlVault 3 指纹传感器的加密命令通信，并在 Linux 上实现录入与验证。项目提供供 fprintd 使用的 libfprint TOD 驱动，以及独立 PAM 方案。作者记录了通过 Windows USB 抓包和加密函数钩子分析通信的过程，并报告在 Dell Latitude 5531 上测试。
requirements: ControlVault 3 sensor with USB ID 0a5c:5843; tested on Dell Latitude 5531.
Linux with the libfprint TOD development package, GLib, GUsb and OpenSSL for the driver path.
Other ControlVault 3 units and USB IDs remain untested; on-device template listing and deletion remain planned.
MIT licence.

name: glorouter: reconstructing the Huawei B311-221 HiLink API
description_en: glorouter reconstructs the Huawei B311-221 router's HiLink web API in a Python CLI and local dashboard. Its protocol notes trace endpoints from served JavaScript and browser captures, including SCRAM-SHA256 login and CSRF token handling; the client exposes signal, traffic, network, SMS and USSD controls.
description_zh: glorouter 将 Huawei B311-221 路由器的 HiLink 网页接口重建为 Python 命令行和本地仪表板。协议笔记根据设备提供的 JavaScript 与浏览器抓包整理端点、SCRAM-SHA256 登录及 CSRF 令牌处理；客户端提供信号、流量、网络、短信和 USSD 操作。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later, pipx and access to a compatible Huawei HiLink router.
The author reports live testing on a Huawei B311-221 with Glo Nigeria firmware.
Huawei HiLink allows only one active admin session, and repeated failed logins can trigger a lockout.
MIT License.

name: gpcli: reconstructing MyGP subscriber app API flows
description_en: gpcli reconstructs the MyGP Android subscriber app's API behavior as a Python command-line client. Based on decompiled APK and smali analysis, it implements authentication, balances, packs, purchases, recharge, billing and other account flows; the author reports live validation of read paths and selected transactions.
description_zh: gpcli 将 MyGP Android 用户应用的 API 行为重建为 Python 命令行客户端。项目依据反编译 APK 和 smali 分析，实现登录、余额、套餐、购买、充值、账单等流程；作者报告已在线核对读取流程及部分真实交易。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer and a MyGP account for subscriber operations.
Plain wallet recharge without a pack remains untested.
MIT.

name: OpticFilm 135i: reconstructing native USB scanning on Linux
description_en: OpticFilm 135i reconstructs USB control of the Plustek OpticFilm 135i film scanner for Linux. Its Python driver handles calibration, film movement and 16-bit image capture at five resolutions, while a separate SANE backend exposes scanning to standard frontends; research notes record protocol and calibration findings.
description_zh: OpticFilm 135i 项目为 Linux 重建 Plustek OpticFilm 135i 胶片扫描仪的 USB 控制。Python 驱动处理校准、胶片移动以及五档分辨率的 16 位图像采集；独立的 SANE 后端让标准前端调用扫描功能，并附有协议和校准研究笔记。
requirements: Requires a Plustek OpticFilm 135i scanner and Linux; the Python CLI requires Python 3.10 or later, pyusb and numpy.
The author reports CLI testing on one development unit and scans on two other units, with cross-unit compatibility still under study.
The SANE backend is installed from this repository's build while its upstream submission is under review.
Driver code is licensed GPL-2.0-or-later or MIT; documentation is CC BY 4.0.

name: Martian Notifier: reconstructing smartwatch Bluetooth commands
description_en: The Martian Notifier toolkit reconstructs Bluetooth communication with the T200/MN200 smartwatch. Its protocol notes specify RFCOMM framing, BLE GATT identifiers and command opcodes for battery queries, time and date updates and keepalive. Python tools pair with the watch, send commands and probe additional opcodes from Linux.
description_zh: Martian Notifier 工具包还原 T200/MN200 智能手表的蓝牙通信。协议文档列出 RFCOMM 封包格式、BLE GATT 标识，以及电池查询、时间日期更新和保活命令；Python 工具可在 Linux 上配对设备、发送命令并探测其他操作码。
requirements: Martian Notifier T200/MN200 smartwatch and Linux with BlueZ 5.50+.
Python 3.10+ with dbus-python and pexpect.
Android Gadgetbridge and Web Bluetooth clients remain planned.
MIT License.

name: TWD · Source Recovery: reconstructing The Walking Dead: Season One functions
description_en: TWD · Source Recovery reconstructs selected functions from The Walking Dead: Season One as C++ replacements for an experimental hybrid runtime. It publishes geometry, hash and symbol code, comparison harnesses, analysis scripts and progress reports. The author reports 14 replacements among 18,299 recognized functions; the standalone source engine remains unfinished.
description_zh: TWD · Source Recovery 将《The Walking Dead: Season One》的部分函数重建为 C++，供实验性混合运行环境使用。仓库提供几何、哈希和符号相关代码，以及比较测试、分析脚本和进度报告。作者报告已替换识别出的 18,299 个函数中的 14 个；独立源码引擎仍未完成。
requirements: Windows builds require Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools and CMake 3.24 or later.
Game binaries, assets and machine-code comparison fixtures must be supplied locally.
The standalone source engine is unfinished; the author reports 14 of 18,299 recognized functions replaced.
No licence file in the repository.

name: E88 / E99 Drone: reconstructing Wi-Fi flight control and video access
description_en: E88 / E99 Drone PC Control reconstructs the Wi-Fi control and video exchanges of an E99-labeled toy drone with an E88D board and FlyUFO app. Its Python client sends documented UDP stick and heartbeat packets, receives telemetry and presents an RTSP-derived MJPEG stream in a browser.
description_zh: E88 / E99 Drone PC Control 还原了标为 E99、采用 E88D 电路板并配套 FlyUFO 应用的玩具无人机的 Wi-Fi 控制与视频交互。Python 客户端发送文档所述的 UDP 摇杆和心跳数据包，接收遥测，并在浏览器展示由 RTSP 获取的 MJPEG 视频。
requirements: Python 3.8+, a Wi-Fi adapter connected to the drone and ffmpeg for video or snapshots are required.
The console keyboard controller is Windows-only.
The protocol was derived from the app and partially confirmed with live captures; other drone variants may need changes.
MIT license.

name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Online 3: reconstructing early server exchanges and YPK extraction
description_en: ygo3-research reconstructs early Yu-Gi-Oh! Online 3 server exchanges and provides a YPK archive extractor. Its experimental Python server responds to observed authentication, profile, player-list and selection requests and documents packet encryption, length masking and nested data encoding. The client currently stops after player selection.
description_zh: ygo3-research 还原《游戏王 Online 3》的初期服务器通信，并提供 YPK 档案提取器。实验性 Python 服务器处理观察到的认证、资料、玩家列表及选择请求，记录封包加密、长度掩码和嵌套数据编码；客户端目前在选择玩家后停止。
requirements: Windows, Python 3.12 and PyCryptodome for the local server; the YPK extractor uses the Python standard library.
The original game client and local configuration are needed for server experiments.
Development is paused; offline play and duel functionality are incomplete.
MIT License.

name: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2004 - XBE Recomp: a native PC port of the Xbox game
description_en: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2004 - XBE Recomp ports the original Xbox game to Windows by statically recompiling its XBE with Xbox XBE Recomp and building the game code from the user's copy on first launch. The port adds widescreen display, graphics settings, and PC controls, alongside an emulated Xbox audio DSP.
description_zh: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2004 - XBE Recomp 使用 Xbox XBE Recomp 静态重编译原版 Xbox 游戏的 XBE，并在首次启动时根据用户自备的游戏文件构建 Windows 版游戏代码。移植版加入宽屏显示、画面设置和 PC 操作方式，并通过模拟的 Xbox 音频 DSP 运行游戏音效。
requirements: Provide files from a legally acquired US (NTSC) Xbox copy; the supported default.xbe has SHA-1 64a4e6978026185a537e1860b755652b976f6559.
Windows 10 64-bit and a Direct3D 12-capable GPU are the minimum system requirements.
Building from source requires Visual Studio 2022 with Desktop development with C++, C++ Clang tools for Windows, and C++ CMake tools for Windows.
The mouse swing has a short delay when dragging begins.
The port is licensed under GPL-3.0; the bundled SDK has its own MIT licence.

name: Casiolator: reimplementing Casio PV-1000, PV-2000 and Loopy consoles
description_en: Casiolator emulates the Casio PV-1000, PV-2000 and Loopy cartridge consoles using its own Z80, SH-1, video and sound implementations. The project draws on hardware documentation and records original Loopy ROM and sound-chip findings; users provide cartridge dumps, BIOS ROMs and, for Loopy music, a sample ROM.
description_zh: Casiolator 使用自行实现的 Z80、SH-1、图形和声音模块模拟 Casio PV-1000、PV-2000 与 Loopy 卡带游戏机。项目参考硬件资料，并记录 Loopy ROM 与声音芯片的原创分析；用户需自行提供卡带 ROM 转储、BIOS ROM，以及播放 Loopy 音乐所需的采样 ROM。
requirements: Requires user-supplied game dumps; Loopy and PV-2000 also require BIOS ROMs, and Loopy music requires a sample ROM.
Building the graphical frontend requires C99 and SDL2.
PV-2000 BASIC keyboard and cassette support, and Loopy printer and mouse support, are absent.
MIT license.

name: Samsung Washer Monitor: reconstructing a washer panel UART feed
description_en: Samsung Washer Monitor for ESPHome decodes the receive-only UART stream between a Samsung WW11BGA046 washer's DC92-01950B panel and main board. Its ESPHome component exposes program selections, displayed time, indicators and inferred cycle status to Home Assistant. The documentation records connector observations, wiring and the limits of the author's single-machine testing.
description_zh: Samsung Washer Monitor for ESPHome 解码 Samsung WW11BGA046 洗衣机 DC92-01950B 面板与主板之间的单向接收 UART 数据。ESPHome 组件向 Home Assistant 提供程序选项、显示时间、指示灯状态及推断的洗涤周期状态。文档记录了接口观察、接线方式和单台机器测试的范围。
requirements: A Samsung washer with the DC92-01950B panel and an ESPHome-supported ESP board; the author tested WW11BGA046 with ESP32-C6 SuperMini.
A suitable 5 V to 3.3 V UART interface; the source specifies 9600 baud, 8N1.
Mains appliance work requires safe isolation and qualified installation as described in the project's safety section.
MIT License.

name: Fluval Connect light: reconstructing local Bluetooth control for aquarium lights
description_en: Fluval Connect light implements local Home Assistant control of Fluval Connect aquarium lights over Bluetooth, using commands recovered from the FluvalConnect Android app. It exposes lighting, modes, schedules and clock synchronization, with support confirmed by the author on a Roma & Shaker 2.0 light.
description_zh: Fluval Connect light 根据对 FluvalConnect Android 应用的分析，通过蓝牙在 Home Assistant 中本地控制 Fluval Connect 水族箱灯具，提供灯光、模式、日程和时钟同步功能。作者称已在 Roma & Shaker 2.0 灯具上确认可用。
requirements: Requires a Home Assistant host with Bluetooth and a supported Fluval Connect light.
The light accepts one connection at a time; holding the connection prevents simultaneous phone-app access.
MIT license.

name: Atmoph Window 2 Remote: reconstructing local BLE control
description_en: Atmoph Window 2 Remote implements local Home Assistant control of an Atmoph Window 2 through BLE commands recovered from the vendor Android app. Its documentation maps GATT characteristics, control tokens and quick settings, and records which behavior remains to be checked on AW102 hardware.
description_zh: Atmoph Window 2 Remote 根据对厂商 Android 应用的分析，以 BLE 命令实现 Atmoph Window 2 的本地 Home Assistant 控制。文档列出 GATT 特征、控制令牌和快捷设置，并标明尚待 AW102 实机确认的行为。
requirements: Home Assistant with an active Bluetooth scanner and an Atmoph Window 2.
Close the phone app before discovery because the window accepts one central connection.
The app-derived behavior has offline tests but has not been checked against AW102 hardware.
MIT license.

name: LinkedIn Profile API: reconstructing Voyager profile requests
description_en: LinkedIn Profile API reconstructs requests to LinkedIn's internal Voyager profile endpoint and exposes normalized profile data through FastAPI. Its research identifies the REST path, decoration parameter, session cookies and CSRF header, and explains why a rotating GraphQL query identifier was avoided. The client also reports truncated profile sections.
description_zh: LinkedIn Profile API 还原对 LinkedIn 内部 Voyager 资料端点的请求，并通过 FastAPI 输出整理后的资料。研究记录了 REST 路径、decoration 参数、会话 Cookie 与 CSRF 请求头，以及避开会变化的 GraphQL 查询标识的方法；客户端还标记资料分区截断情况。
requirements: Python environment with FastAPI and uvicorn.
A logged-in LinkedIn browser session's cookie header and User-Agent from the same request.
The decoration version may change between deployments; the client probes alternatives if its pinned value fails.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Citroën Connected Camera: reconstructing the ConnectedCAM local API
description_en: Citroën Connected Camera is an iOS client for browsing, downloading and managing ConnectedCAM dashcam recordings over local Wi-Fi. Its protocol reference reconstructs the camera's cleartext HTTP /virb command endpoint, media access and session handshake from traffic captured from the official app.
description_zh: Citroën Connected Camera 是通过本地 Wi-Fi 浏览、下载和管理 ConnectedCAM 行车记录仪录像的 iOS 客户端。协议文档依据官方应用的抓包，还原相机的明文 HTTP /virb 命令端点、媒体访问和会话握手。
requirements: A Citroën ConnectedCAM; the documented device has firmware 200 and vimVersion 140.
iOS 17 or later; building requires a Mac, Xcode 26.6 or later and Mint.
Other camera and firmware revisions remain untested.
MIT license.

name: Canon GM2080: reconstructing IVEC/PWG printing for macOS
description_en: The Canon GM2080 macOS driver reconstructs the printer's IVEC XML and PWG Raster print stream from observed output of Canon's Linux driver. Native CUPS filters generate that stream for a GM2080, with PPDs for related GM series models. The author reports end-to-end printing on a GM2080 running firmware 1.050.
description_zh: Canon GM2080 macOS 驱动依据对 Canon Linux 驱动输出的观察，还原 IVEC XML 命令与 PWG Raster 页面交错组成的打印数据流。原生 CUPS 滤镜为 GM2080 生成该数据流，并提供相关 GM 系列型号的 PPD；作者报告已在固件 1.050 的 GM2080 上完成实际打印。
requirements: macOS and a Canon GM2080 printer reachable through HP Jetdirect Socket; PPDs are also provided for the GM2000, GM4000 and GM4080 series.
Xcode command line tools to build the native driver; Docker Desktop for the alternate Linux-driver bridge.
The author reports hardware printing only on the GM2080; the bridge has not been printed through.
MIT License.

name: Agent Phone: Polycom CX300 HID protocol findings
description_en: Agent Phone uses a Polycom CX300 desk phone as an attention and dictation controller for coding agents. Its HID documentation preserves earlier protocol research and adds device-probe findings on report byte layouts, the voicemail LED, and host-controlled microphone mute. The Python daemon implements those controls alongside the phone’s audio and keypad handling.
description_zh: Agent Phone 将 Polycom CX300 桌面电话用作编程智能体的提示与语音输入设备。其 HID 文档整理既有协议研究，并补充设备探测得到的报告字节布局、语音信箱指示灯和主机控制麦克风静音信息。Python 守护进程实现这些控制，同时处理音频与按键。
requirements: macOS, Python 3.11+, a Polycom CX300, and hidapi for the documented USB setup.
Dictation setup uses ffmpeg and whisper.cpp.
Code is under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; the CX300 protocol documents are additionally CC BY 4.0.

name: Tales of Eternia: structural analysis of the Japanese PlayStation disc
description_en: Tales of Eternia is a structural investigation of disc 1 of the Japanese PlayStation release SLPS-03050. Python tools and committed reports examine ISO 9660 and CD-XA layout, the PS-EXE, LZSS blocks, archive indexes, TIM graphics, audio, video and Shift-JIS text.
description_zh: Tales of Eternia 研究日版 PlayStation 发行版 SLPS-03050 的第一张光盘。项目用 Python 工具和仓库内报告分析 ISO 9660、CD-XA 布局、PS-EXE、LZSS 数据块、资源索引、TIM 图像、音频、视频及 Shift-JIS 文本。
requirements: A user-supplied image of Japanese Tales of Eternia disc 1 and Python 3.
The investigation covers disc 1; the author has not analyzed the other two discs.
MIT license for code; the repository also has a separate documentation license file.

name: RingLink: an offline RingConn Gen 3 client built on BLE protocol research
description_en: RingLink reconstructs direct access to RingConn Gen 3 smart rings in an offline Android client. It uses a documented BLE framing and SM3 authentication exchange to sync history and live readings into SQLite, then exports supported health records to Health Connect; it also sends vibration commands for calls and notifications.
description_zh: RingLink 为 RingConn Gen 3 智能戒指实现离线 Android 客户端。它依据记录的 BLE 帧格式和 SM3 认证流程同步历史与实时读数，先存入 SQLite，再导出到 Health Connect，并可通过振动命令提示来电和通知。
requirements: Android 8 or newer and a RingConn Gen 3 ring; Health Connect is built into Android 14+ and available as an app on earlier versions.
JDK 21 to build from source.
Sleep periods are estimates; sleep stages and vendor scores are omitted.
MIT License.

name: FINAL FANTASY V: analysis of the 2015 Windows release
description_en: FINAL FANTASY V examines the 2015 Windows game's ICP, INP, mtxs and offset-table containers, string tables, assets and executable metadata. Python tools identify and extract resources from a user's installation, while reference tables inventory images, audio and language slots.
description_zh: FINAL FANTASY V 项目研究 2015 年 Windows 版的 ICP、INP、mtxs 和偏移表容器、字符串表、资源文件及可执行文件元数据。Python 工具可从用户的安装目录识别和提取资源，参考表列出图像、音频与语言槽位。
requirements: A legally obtained 2015 Windows Steam installation for running the tools on game files.
Python 3; some ad hoc image analysis used Pillow and NumPy.
The encrypted code section was not analyzed.
MIT license.

name: GarminHRM600: reconstructing HRM 600 BLE and stored-file exchanges
description_en: GarminHRM600 implements a direct BLE client for the Garmin HRM 600 heart-rate strap using documented Multi-Link, GFDI and protobuf FileSyncService exchanges. Its CLI streams heart rate and Running Dynamics, downloads stored FIT files and reconstructs absolute timestamps from the strap's event clock and file identifiers. A protocol reference records message layouts and the author's probe results.
description_zh: GarminHRM600 依据所记录的 Multi-Link、GFDI 和 protobuf FileSyncService 通信，实现 Garmin HRM 600 心率带的 BLE 客户端。命令行工具读取实时心率与跑步动态数据、下载已存 FIT 文件，并结合设备事件时钟和文件标识恢复绝对时间。协议文档还保存了消息布局和作者的探测结果。
requirements: Python 3.12 or newer and a BLE-capable machine; developed and tested on macOS.
A worn HRM 600 strap that is disconnected from other central devices; first connection requires pairing.
The author reports hardware testing with HRM 600 firmware 5.20.0.
MIT License; adapted portions retain attribution under the upstream MIT terms.

name: Canon IVEC driver: reconstructing PIXMA and MAXIFY print commands
description_en: Canon IVEC driver reconstructs print and maintenance commands for PIXMA and MAXIFY inkjets in an open Linux CUPS driver. Its protocol reference documents IVEC XML job framing, PWG Raster page data and USB status handling. The author reports byte-for-byte matches against Canon driver output for 1,194 checked jobs and commands.
description_zh: Canon IVEC driver 在 Linux CUPS 驱动中重建 PIXMA 与 MAXIFY 喷墨打印机的打印和维护命令。协议文档记录 IVEC XML 作业封装、PWG Raster 页面数据及 USB 状态处理。作者报告，在检查的 1,194 个作业和命令中，输出与 Canon 驱动逐字节一致。
requirements: A Linux system with CUPS and the listed build dependencies is required to build the driver.
The author reports 1,194 byte-for-byte comparisons across the checked models and commands.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: Minitela do Positivo Vision R15M: AHMI display protocol and ACF format
description_en: Minitela do Positivo Vision R15M implements Linux tools for the laptop’s 240×240 secondary display. The project documents its AHMI serial frames and ACF texture container using vendor-app captures, synthetic-image output comparisons, and analysis of the Windows texture compiler. Python tools send images, change pages and brightness, update display tags, and inspect the protocol.
description_zh: Minitela do Positivo Vision R15M 为笔记本的 240×240 副屏提供 Linux 工具。项目通过厂商应用通信捕获、合成图像输出对比及 Windows 纹理编译器分析，记录 AHMI 串口帧与 ACF 纹理容器。Python 工具可发送图像、切换页面和亮度、更新显示变量并检查协议。
requirements: A Positivo Vision R15M with its minitela package is required.
Image building requires ffmpeg and Wine; other controls are native Python.
Writing an ACF that the firmware cannot render can freeze the display until recovery.
MIT license.

name: dwshell: reconstructing the DWService browser-client protocol
description_en: dwshell implements a terminal client for DWService by reproducing the browser client's remote-access exchanges. Its protocol reference records login cryptography, HTTP endpoints and WebSocket session behavior derived from client JavaScript and captured traffic; the Go client supports remote shells and file operations.
description_zh: dwshell 复现 DWService 网页客户端的远程访问交换流程，提供终端客户端。协议文档依据客户端 JavaScript 与抓取的流量，记录登录加密、HTTP 端点和 WebSocket 会话行为；Go 客户端支持远程终端与文件操作。
requirements: A DWService account and access to an owned or shared agent.
Go 1.25 or later to build with go install.
MIT license.

name: Truma Aventa: Home Assistant control from BLE protocol findings
description_en: Truma Aventa controls a second-generation Aventa roof air conditioner from Home Assistant over BLE. The implementation uses captured TruMessageV3 and CBOR messages to expose climate, light, and diagnostic entities. Its findings document BLE framing, device addresses, routing, and pairing behavior observed on the appliance, including corrections to a prior protocol reference.
description_zh: Truma Aventa 通过 BLE 在 Home Assistant 中控制第二代 Aventa 车顶空调。实现依据捕获的 TruMessageV3 与 CBOR 消息提供空调、灯光及诊断实体。调查文档记录设备上的 BLE 封帧、地址、命令路由和配对行为，并修正既有协议资料。
requirements: Home Assistant 2025.2 or newer with Bluetooth integration and an Aventa comfort 2nd generation for the documented setup.
Pairing must be started on the appliance during setup.
Only the Aventa comfort 2nd generation has been tested.
MIT license.

name: PetKit Eversweet Max 2 UVC: reconstructing fountain BLE telemetry
description_en: PetKit Eversweet Max 2 UVC BLE Gateway uses a local Python or ESP32-C3 client in place of the Wi-Fi PetKit device that relays the fountain’s data. It reads state and drinking history and sends Telegram alerts. Its protocol notes document BLE framing, authentication, a 42-byte state map and history flow control derived from device observations.
description_zh: PetKit Eversweet Max 2 UVC BLE Gateway 使用本地 Python 或 ESP32-C3 客户端，替代为饮水机中继数据的 PetKit Wi-Fi 设备。它读取设备状态和饮水历史，并发送 Telegram 提醒。协议笔记依据设备观察，记录了 BLE 帧格式、认证流程、42 字节状态数据结构及历史数据流控。
requirements: PetKit Eversweet Max 2 UVC CTW3UV and its six-byte authentication secret.
An Android phone with the PetKit app and adb to obtain the secret by the documented method.
Only one fountain of the named model was tested.
MIT license.

name: WalleCube UPS: Home Assistant control through a reconstructed BLE protocol
description_en: WalleCube UPS provides local Home Assistant monitoring and control for the W150 mini-UPS through a reconstructed BLE GATT protocol. The author used Android app strings, Frida captures, and Dart disassembly to map telemetry and encrypted settings; PROTOCOL.md records the wire format. The integration exposes power and battery readings and selected settings, with writes checked by reading them back.
description_zh: WalleCube UPS 基于还原的 BLE GATT 协议，为 W150 迷你 UPS 提供本地 Home Assistant 监控与控制。作者通过 Android 应用字符串、Frida 捕获和 Dart 反汇编分析遥测数据及加密设置，并在 PROTOCOL.md 中记录通信格式。集成提供电源、电池数据和部分设置，写入后会回读检查。
requirements: A WalleCube W150 within range of Home Assistant or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy; W180 compatibility is unconfirmed.
Reading settings requires the device’s AES key; writing also requires its auth code.
Wi-Fi configuration and runtime-remaining reporting are not implemented.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: toppingctl: reconstructing Topping DAC control over USB HID
description_en: toppingctl implements local control of Topping DACs through USB HID reports derived from observed WebHID traffic and the vendor web bundle. The CLI addresses registers for volume, gain, power and parametric EQ, while companion scripts read settings, inspect unsolicited meter data and probe unknown values. The author reports hardware confirmation on the DX5 II.
description_zh: toppingctl 根据观察到的 WebHID 流量和厂商网页代码，实现 Topping DAC 的本地 USB HID 控制。命令行工具通过寄存器设置音量、增益、电源与参数均衡器；配套脚本读取设置、查看主动推送的电平数据并探测未知值。作者报告已在 DX5 II 上完成硬件确认。
requirements: Python 3.11 or newer, the hid package and the hidapi shared library.
A supported Topping DAC; hardware confirmation is reported for DX5 II firmware 2.39.
D90 III Discrete and DX1 II mappings are unverified and require --unverified for writes.
Apache-2.0 License.

name: tuya-ipc-p2p-sdk: Python camera client for Tuya’s P2P protocol
description_en: tuya-ipc-p2p-sdk implements a Python client for Tuya IPC cameras’ native P2P video protocol. It logs in through the mobile gateway, exchanges MQTT signaling, connects through a TCP relay with KCP conversations, authenticates a media channel, and decrypts and reassembles MJPEG frames. The implementation draws on a byte-level protocol reference in the author’s companion Go client.
description_zh: tuya-ipc-p2p-sdk 以 Python 实现 Tuya IPC 摄像头原生 P2P 视频协议。它通过移动网关登录、交换 MQTT 信令、经 TCP 中继建立 KCP 会话、完成媒体通道认证，并解密和重组 MJPEG 帧。实现依据作者配套 Go 客户端中的字节级协议资料。
requirements: Python 3.12 or newer and credentials for the account owning the camera are required.
Live validation covers MJPEG hardware and the us region; H264 cameras and other regions remain untested.
The public API is alpha and may change across 0.x releases.
MIT license.

name: SYNA8002: reconstructing a ThinkPad fingerprint reader's SPI protocol
description_en: The SYNA8002 investigation reconstructs the SPI transport, secure-channel setup and image capture path of the fingerprint reader in a ThinkPad X1 Tablet Gen 3. It includes a Python userspace driver and fprintd-compatible adapter; the author reports successful GDM login on one tablet, with a correlation matcher and an existing Windows-derived pairing key.
description_zh: SYNA8002 研究重建了 ThinkPad X1 Tablet Gen 3 指纹读取器的 SPI 传输、安全通道建立和图像采集流程。仓库提供 Python 用户态驱动及兼容 fprintd 的适配器；作者报告在一台平板上实现了 GDM 指纹登录，使用相关性匹配器及已有的 Windows 配对密钥。
requirements: ThinkPad X1 Tablet Gen 3 with a SYNA8002 SPI sensor, a python-validity checkout, and the sensor's host private key and session config blob extracted from the user's own Windows installation.
Virgin-sensor pairing is unimplemented; the matcher is not authentication-grade, based on the author's small impostor sample.
MIT License.

name: fx_lcd_software: reconstructing ID-COOLING FX display transfers
description_en: fx_lcd_software drives ID-COOLING FX cooler LCDs from Linux through a USB HID image-transfer protocol observed from the vendor software. It converts images to 240×240 baseline JPEG and sends framed data in paced 1024-byte chunks, with rotation options.
description_zh: fx_lcd_software 根据对厂商软件 USB HID 通信的观察，在 Linux 上驱动 ID-COOLING FX 冷排显示屏。它将图片转换为 240×240 的 baseline JPEG，按协议封帧并分块发送，同时支持旋转。
requirements: Requires Linux, Python 3.9 or newer, hidapi and Pillow, plus access to the cooler's hidraw device.
The author reports testing on the FX 240 LCD; other batches may use different USB IDs.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Antigravity session interoperability: reconstructing the CLI session format
description_en: Antigravity session interoperability reconstructs a subset of Antigravity CLI 1.1.16's local SQLite and protobuf session format on Linux x86-64. Its Python generator creates synthetic conversation and summary databases; the author reports that the CLI displayed and resumed the generated session.
description_zh: Antigravity session interoperability 重建了 Linux x86-64 上 Antigravity CLI 1.1.16 的部分本地 SQLite 与 protobuf 会话格式。Python 脚本生成合成对话库和摘要索引；作者报告目标 CLI 能显示并续接生成的会话。
requirements: Antigravity CLI 1.1.16 on Linux x86-64 and Python 3.
Use a disposable home directory and an unused session ID when trying the fixture.
Coverage is limited to text messages and one generic tool-call/result shape.
MIT License.

name: ti83-link: reconstructing TI-83 Plus link-port transfers
description_en: ti83-link reconstructs TI-83 Plus link-port transfers using Raspberry Pi GPIO and Python. It sends and receives calculator variables, installs Flash applications, inspects TI file containers and documents packet handshakes and token values checked against hardware.
description_zh: ti83-link 使用 Raspberry Pi GPIO 和 Python 重建 TI-83 Plus 链接口传输。它收发计算器变量、安装 Flash 应用、检查 TI 文件容器，并记录经实机核对的报文握手流程和词元值。
requirements: A TI-83 Plus and Raspberry Pi GPIO connection with Python and python3-lgpio.
The author reports testing one TI-83 Plus OS 1.19 setup with a Raspberry Pi 4; other hardware remains unverified.
OS image transfer is deliberately unimplemented.
MIT license.

name: catbus99: reconstructing Epomaker TH99 Pro screen control over USB-HID
description_en: catbus99 reconstructs control of the Epomaker TH99 Pro keyboard display from captured driver WebHID traffic. Its Rust client sends USB-HID reports to display images and rendered widgets, while a protocol document maps the configuration and TFT interfaces. A daemon governs writes to the display's flash storage.
description_zh: catbus99 根据采集到的驱动 WebHID 流量还原 Epomaker TH99 Pro 键盘屏幕控制。Rust 客户端通过 USB-HID 报文显示图片和小组件，协议文档记录配置与 TFT 接口；守护进程限制向屏幕闪存的写入。
requirements: Epomaker TH99 Pro connected by USB cable; macOS or Linux and Rust 1.82+.
The display is not reachable over 2.4 GHz or Bluetooth.
Screen uploads are subject to a rate limit with a five-minute floor.
MIT License.

name: OpenWatch: reconstructing the LJ736/LY736D smartwatch BLE client
description_en: OpenWatch implements an Android companion for LJ736/LY736D-based smartwatches using BLE commands reconstructed from the LaxaFit Pro APK and captured traffic. It handles pairing, notifications and clock synchronization locally, and can buzz the watch to help locate it. Protocol notes describe packet framing and watch-face transfer; the author reports that custom watch faces still display as blank black screens.
description_zh: OpenWatch 是 LJ736/LY736D 系列手表的 Android 配套应用，依据 LaxaFit Pro APK 的反编译结果和捕获的 BLE 流量实现通信。它在本地处理配对、通知转发和时钟同步，还能触发手表振动以便寻找。协议笔记记录了封包结构与表盘传输；作者报告自定义表盘目前仍显示黑屏。
requirements: Android Studio, JDK 17 and Gradle 8; minimum Android SDK level 26.
A compatible LJ736/LY736D watch; hardware testing covers one LJ736 board with a 240×296 display.
Custom watch-face builds require the user's own LaxaFit Pro font asset.
MIT License.

name: Quntis Monitor Light for ESPHome: reconstructing RF control
description_en: Quntis Monitor Light for ESPHome recreates local control of a 26-inch Quntis monitor light through its observed XN297-compatible RF protocol. An ESP32-C3 and RF Nano transmit commands for power, brightness, color temperature and the separate glow light; protocol notes describe frames, CRC and rolling state.
description_zh: Quntis Monitor Light for ESPHome 根据观察到的 XN297 兼容射频协议，为 26 英寸 Quntis 显示器灯实现本地控制。ESP32-C3 与 RF Nano 发送开关、亮度、色温和氛围灯命令；文档记录帧结构、CRC 与滚动状态。
requirements: ESP32-C3 SuperMini, RF Nano V3, wiring, 5 V power and Home Assistant with ESPHome or the ESPHome CLI.
The RF profile comes from one lamp with P014-TX-V1.1 remote PCB; a second unit has not been confirmed.
ESPHome component and documentation: GPL-3.0-only; RF Nano firmware: GPL-2.0-only.

name: Bosch Smart System: BLE diagnostic and live data protocol map
description_en: Bosch Smart System maps the BLE diagnostic and Live Data interfaces of Bosch eBikes through captured traffic and field comparisons. It documents characteristics 0x0011 and eb21, frame structure, telemetry scaling and request behavior, with machine-readable field tables. The principal observations come from a Performance Line CX bike; comparison with a Performance Line SX is preliminary.
description_zh: Bosch Smart System 依据抓取的通信数据和字段对照，梳理 Bosch 电助力自行车的 BLE 诊断接口及实时数据接口。资料记录特征值 0x0011 和 eb21 的帧结构、遥测字段换算及请求行为，并提供机器可读的字段表。主要观察来自 Performance Line CX，对 Performance Line SX 的比较仍属初步结果。
requirements: The principal field map is based on one Performance Line CX bike; comparison with a Performance Line SX is preliminary.
Documentation and data are licensed under CC BY 4.0; attribution is required.

name: GreenPods: reconstructing AirPods control on Android
description_en: GreenPods is an Android app that reads AirPods BLE advertisements and offers Apple Accessory Protocol controls over L2CAP where available. Its protocol research records packet structures, transport requirements and captured device behavior for battery status, noise control, gestures and head tracking. The app exposes features according to the available Android Bluetooth path.
description_zh: GreenPods 是一款 Android 应用，可读取 AirPods 的 BLE 广播，并在条件允许时通过 L2CAP 上的 Apple Accessory Protocol 控制耳机。协议研究记录了电量状态、噪声控制、手势和头部跟踪相关的数据包结构、传输要求及设备行为。应用根据 Android 蓝牙连接能力开放相应功能。
requirements: Android 8.0 or later and Bluetooth LE are required; building needs JDK 21 and the Android SDK.
AAP controls depend on a recent Android system that permits the required authenticated L2CAP channel.
AirPods Pro 3 heart-rate decoding is documented but not yet shipped as an app feature.
MIT license.

name: K2 OpenKlipper: reconstructing the Creality K2 control stack
description_en: K2 OpenKlipper rebuilds the Creality K2 printer control stack around upstream Klipper and open Python modules. Its implementation covers the strain-gauge probe, CFS filament box, closed-loop motors and touchscreen; protocol notes draw on observed printer traffic and behavior.
description_zh: K2 OpenKlipper 以主线 Klipper 和 Python 模块重建 Creality K2 的控制栈，涵盖应变片探针、CFS 供料盒、闭环电机和触摸屏，并记录通过观察打印机通信及行为得到的协议信息。
requirements: Creality K2 hardware; installation requires root access on the touchscreen and an SSH session.
Alpha firmware; K2 Pro is untested, and K2 Plus with CFS is untested.

name: dualsense-bridge: reconstructing DualSense Bluetooth microphone access
description_en: dualsense-bridge recovers microphone audio carried inside DualSense Bluetooth HID reports and exposes it as a macOS audio input. Its research note documents the extended-report switch and microphone-enable output report; the application also maps controller input to desktop controls.
description_zh: dualsense-bridge 提取 DualSense 蓝牙 HID 报告中的麦克风音频，并将其作为 macOS 音频输入。研究笔记记录扩展报告切换及麦克风启用输出报告；应用还把手柄操作映射为桌面控制。
requirements: A Bluetooth-paired DualSense and macOS; the author tested Apple Silicon on Tahoe 26.x.
hidapi and the documented Python dependencies; Accessibility permission for desktop input.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: MIRO SmartHome: reconstructing app API control in Home Assistant
description_en: MIRO SmartHome reconstructs control of devices registered in the MIRO SmartHome app through a Home Assistant integration. It uses the app-derived cloud API and server model definitions to create fan, humidifier, sensor and switch entities. The author reports hardware tests on the MF03 fan and NR07 humidifier; other listed models were checked against definitions.
description_zh: MIRO SmartHome 通过 Home Assistant 集成还原对“米罗智能家居”应用内设备的控制。它使用从应用分析得到的云端 API 和服务器型号定义，建立风扇、加湿器、传感器及开关实体。作者报告已用 MF03 风扇和 NR07 加湿器实机测试，其他列出型号仅核对了定义。
requirements: A MIRO SmartHome account with devices registered in the miroT app.
Home Assistant with the custom_components/mirot integration installed.
Only MF03 and NR07 received reported hardware command tests; the other 25 models were checked against definitions.
MIT License.

name: Open SoM Runtime: rebuilding the Sword of Moonlight runtime
description_en: Open SoM Runtime recreates Sword of Moonlight's game runtime in Unity, including content loading, event parsing, menus and explorable maps. The author reports partial event support and describes compatibility limits for Dark Destiny, SoM Ex games and some video codecs.
description_zh: Open SoM Runtime 用 Unity 重建 Sword of Moonlight 游戏运行时，处理内容加载、事件解析、菜单显示和地图探索。作者称事件支持仍不完整，并说明 Dark Destiny、SoM Ex 游戏及部分视频编码的兼容性限制。
requirements: Unity project with compiled Reign game data included for development; other games require their content in the documented StreamingAssets folder structure.
Event parsing is partial, and collision currently has no player response.
Dark Destiny and SoM Ex games do not load correctly; some video sequences depend on codec support.
MIT license for the repository code.

name: FX30 Controller: reconstructing Sony FX30 remote control
description_en: FX30 Controller implements remote control of the Sony FX30 camera on an M5Stack Cardputer ADV. It joins the camera's Wi-Fi Direct network, performs PTP-IP and Sony SDIO handshakes, and uses documented property and control codes for recording, exposure adjustments and status. It also provides live view.
description_zh: FX30 Controller 在 M5Stack Cardputer ADV 上实现 Sony FX30 相机的远程控制。它连接相机的 Wi-Fi Direct 网络，完成 PTP-IP 和 Sony SDIO 握手，并使用已记录的属性码和控制码进行录制、调整曝光及读取状态，还提供实时取景。
requirements: M5Stack Cardputer ADV and Sony FX30 with firmware 3.00+; configure PC Remote for Wi-Fi Direct and turn Access Authentication off.
Some controls, including electronic iris and playback, await camera-specific tests.
MIT.

name: P215 Scan: reconstructing the Canon P-215II file-tunnel transport
description_en: P215 Scan replaces the Canon imageFORMULA P-215II desktop scanning workflow on macOS and documents the scanner’s file-tunnel transport. Its reconstructed Auto Start mode exchanges SCSI command and data blocks through two files on an emulated USB volume; the main scanning mode uses the SANE canon_dr backend.
description_zh: P215 Scan 在 macOS 上提供 Canon imageFORMULA P-215II 的扫描与导出流程，并记录扫描仪的文件隧道传输机制。其 Auto Start 模式通过模拟 USB 卷中的两个文件交换 SCSI 命令和数据；主要扫描模式使用 SANE canon_dr 后端。
requirements: Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple Silicon and a Canon P-215II scanner.
For the preferred SANE path, set the scanner's Auto Start switch to OFF.
The author reports pale, banded images from the reconstructed Auto Start path.
MIT license.

name: Sirius Dev Kit: Hengbot Sirius API and action-format findings
description_en: Sirius Dev Kit documents a measured investigation of the Hengbot Sirius robot dog and provides a browser control tool. Its findings map command behavior, ROS topics, sensor readings, and the robot’s RIFF/AVI action-file structure. Firmware comparisons identify changes to the ToF sensor path, while the tool uses the documented interfaces for robot control.
description_zh: Sirius Dev Kit 记录对 Hengbot Sirius 机器狗的实测调查，并提供浏览器控制工具。调查梳理命令行为、ROS 话题、传感器数据及 RIFF/AVI 动作文件结构；固件比对指出 ToF 传感器路径的变化。控制工具使用这些已记录的接口操作机器人。
requirements: A Hengbot Sirius robot is required for the documented hardware workflows.
Firmware 2.5.5 disables the ToF readings used by the wandering feature.
The control tool drives motors and exposes commands without authentication.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: slopgs: reconstructing Microsoft GS Wavetable Synth
description_en: slopgs reconstructs the behavior of the Windows XP SP3 Microsoft GS Wavetable Synth driver in a portable C synthesizer. Its engine renders MIDI using gm.dls, with native and WebAssembly builds. MIDI probes and spectrogram comparisons against reference recordings guide refinements to synthesis behavior.
description_zh: slopgs 用可移植的 C 合成器重建 Windows XP SP3 版 Microsoft GS Wavetable Synth 驱动的行为。引擎使用 gm.dls 渲染 MIDI，并提供原生和 WebAssembly 构建；项目通过 MIDI 探针和参考录音的频谱对比调整合成行为。
requirements: A C compiler is required for msgs-render; GCC is the tested compiler.
Clang is required to build msgs.wasm.
Supply gm.dls from a Windows installation for MIDI rendering.
The oracle accepts only the Windows XP SP3 swmidi.sys build 5.1.2600.5512, supplied separately.
No licence file in the repository.

name: REFLEC BEAT plus: reconstructed iOS game source
description_en: REFLEC BEAT plus reconstructs Objective-C and C++ source for version 4.5.8 of the iOS rhythm game. The project uses Objective-C metadata, C++ RTTI, embedded strings, and original path fragments to organize the recovered routines; a separate OpenAPI file describes requests observed in the client. Building requires a user-supplied IPA for game assets.
description_zh: REFLEC BEAT plus 重建 iOS 音乐游戏 4.5.8 版的 Objective-C 与 C++ 源码。项目利用 Objective-C 元数据、C++ RTTI、内嵌字符串和路径片段整理还原的例程，另以 OpenAPI 文件记录客户端使用的请求。构建时需由用户提供含游戏资源的 IPA。
requirements: A user-supplied REFLEC BEAT plus IPA with game assets is required.
Building requires macOS, Xcode, an iOS toolchain, and CMake 3.14 or newer for the CMake path.
The built app is unsigned and must be signed for device use.
MIT license.

name: gswatch: reconstructing Gosuslugi's appointment-slot API
description_en: gswatch reconstructs a Gosuslugi request for passport-application appointment slots from a recorded browser session and uses it to monitor availability at selected offices. Its documentation maps the POST endpoint, request headers, service identifiers and response shape. The Python client sends requests inside a manually authenticated Chrome page and alerts through configured channels when slots appear.
