description_zh: gswatch 从浏览器会话记录还原 Gosuslugi 的护照申请预约时段请求，用于监测所选受理网点的空位。文档记录了 POST 接口、请求头、服务标识及响应结构。Python 客户端在用户手动登录的 Chrome 页面内发送请求，并在出现空位时通过已配置的渠道通知。
requirements: Python 3.11 or newer, Playwright and Chrome.
The user must sign in to their own Gosuslugi account and provide their application and office identifiers.
The author notes that portal changes may interrupt operation.
MIT License.

name: Surface Pro 11: reconstructing native Linux audio behavior
description_en: SP11X1e-audio reconstructs Surface Pro 11 speaker and internal microphone behavior on Linux from Windows runtime observations and binary analysis. Its patches and AudioReach topology address SoundWire amplifiers, LPASS microphone clocks and capture routing; reproduction scripts rebuild the accepted topology and kernel artifacts.
description_zh: SP11X1e-audio 根据 Windows 运行时观察和二进制分析，在 Linux 上重建 Surface Pro 11 的扬声器与内置麦克风行为。项目以补丁和 AudioReach 拓扑处理 SoundWire 功放、LPASS 麦克风时钟及采集路由，并提供重建拓扑与内核产物的脚本。
requirements: Targets the Microsoft Surface Pro 11 with Qualcomm X1E80100, SoundWire and dual WSA884x amplifiers.
The Dolby host uses locally supplied, hash-gated vendor DLLs.
System suspend and resume remain outside the audio release scope.
BSD 2-Clause License.

name: ScanStudio: reconstructing a Nikon LS-5000 scanning workflow
description_en: ScanStudio provides a native macOS scanning workflow for the Nikon SUPER COOLSCAN 5000 ED. It combines documented observation of Nikon Scan 4 with a Swift app, Rust engine and optional CoolscanPy hardware bridge for previewing film, selecting frames and capturing scans; the author reports testing real scans on one Mac and scanner setup.
description_zh: ScanStudio 为 Nikon SUPER COOLSCAN 5000 ED 提供原生 macOS 胶片扫描流程。项目结合对 Nikon Scan 4 的行为观察、Swift 应用、Rust 引擎及可选的 CoolscanPy 硬件桥接，实现胶片预览、选帧和扫描；作者报告已在一套 Mac 与扫描仪环境中完成实机扫描。
requirements: macOS 14 or newer, Swift 6 and Rust to build from source; real scanning requires an LS-5000 and a configured hardware bridge.
The real bridge supports one fixed C-41 color-negative fine-scan recipe; real black-and-white fine scans are unimplemented.
No signed or notarized app release is available.
The repository's top-level license is MIT; the optional hardware bridge is GPL-3.0-only.

name: Narwal Robot Vacuum: local WebSocket control and protocol probing
description_en: Narwal Robot Vacuum is a Home Assistant integration built around the vacuums' local WebSocket interface. It includes helpers to capture phone-to-robot traffic, decode protobuf frames from packet captures and probe commands, alongside cleaning, station and map controls.
description_zh: Narwal Robot Vacuum 是基于吸尘机器人本地 WebSocket 接口的 Home Assistant 集成。项目附带手机与机器人通信抓包、protobuf 帧解码及命令探测工具，并实现清洁、基站和地图控制。
requirements: Home Assistant and a Narwal model exposing the local WebSocket service on port 9002.
Narwal Flow is the actively maintained model; other listed compatible models have not been retested for this fork.
MIT license.

name: Irisu ML: reconstructing Irisu Syndrome! normal mode
description_en: Irisu ML reconstructs Irisu Syndrome! v2.03 normal mode as a deterministic C++20 simulator, Python learning environment and playable browser client. It models input timing, seeded spawning, scoring, chains and progression, with original-format replay support. The author reports event-level matches on four eligible instrumented playbacks and a selected-seed high-score replay.
description_zh: Irisu ML 将《Irisu Syndrome!》v2.03 普通模式重建为确定性的 C++20 模拟器、Python 学习环境和可玩的网页客户端。实现涵盖输入时序、按种子生成、计分、连锁、关卡推进及原格式回放。作者报告四次符合条件的回放在所观察事件上吻合，并发布了选定种子的高分回放。
requirements: A C++20 build is required for the native simulator; the Python interface needs the separately built native library.
The optional exact MSVC physics host requires separately generated local dependencies.
The published high-score replay covers a selected seed.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Xcli: reconstructing an X GraphQL terminal client
description_en: Xcli implements a command-line and terminal client for X through the web app's internal GraphQL endpoints. It uses the user's browser cookies for authentication, refreshes changing query IDs and feature settings from the public JavaScript bundle, and exposes posting, timelines, search, messages and media operations. The author states that the API was reverse engineered.
description_zh: Xcli 通过 X 网页应用的内部 GraphQL 接口实现命令行和终端界面客户端。它使用用户提供的浏览器 Cookie 认证，从公开 JavaScript 包更新变化的 query ID 和功能参数，并提供发帖、时间线、搜索、私信及媒体操作。作者称该 API 是通过逆向分析获得的。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer and the project's listed Python dependencies.
The user supplies their own X auth_token and ct0 cookies.
MIT License.

name: landbook-api: reconstructing Landbook cloud and local device access
description_en: landbook-api reconstructs Landbook smart-home client access in Python from analysis of its iOS app. It handles REST login and device queries, MQTT state and control messages over WebSocket/TLS, and direct TCP control on a local network.
description_zh: landbook-api 根据对 Landbook iOS 应用的分析，用 Python 重建智能家居客户端访问方式。它处理 REST 登录与设备查询、通过 WebSocket/TLS 传送的 MQTT 状态和控制消息，以及局域网内的直接 TCP 控制。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer and Landbook account credentials for cloud login.
EU and China endpoints are listed but untested by the author.
MIT License.

name: SF900 ESP32 Dongle: implementing the SF900 controller radio protocol
description_en: SF900 ESP32 Dongle implements the SF900/SF2000 controller's 2.4 GHz XN297L radio protocol on an ESP32-S3 receiver. It presents controller input as USB HID or BLE HID and includes a separate USB Wi-Fi mode.
description_zh: SF900 ESP32 Dongle 在 ESP32-S3 接收器上实现 SF900/SF2000 手柄的 2.4 GHz XN297L 无线协议，将手柄输入呈现为 USB HID 或 BLE HID，并提供独立的 USB Wi-Fi 模式。
requirements: Requires an ESP32-S3 board, an XN297L radio and a USB-C OTG adapter for handheld use.
Building the firmware requires PlatformIO.
MIT license; bundled third-party components retain their own licenses.

name: hydroshift2: reconstructing HydroShift II LCD-C USB control
description_en: hydroshift2 reconstructs direct USB control of the Lian Li HydroShift II LCD-C in a Rust library. It documents a DES-CBC command envelope and commands for JPEG and PNG display layers, brightness, rotation, pump and fan control, and TinyUZ-compressed RGB animations.
description_zh: hydroshift2 以 Rust 库重建 Lian Li HydroShift II LCD-C 的直接 USB 控制。项目记录 DES-CBC 命令封装，以及 JPEG、PNG 显示层、亮度、旋转、泵与风扇控制和 TinyUZ 压缩 RGB 动画的命令。
requirements: Rust 1.85+ and a HydroShift II LCD-C device; the author reports validation on the 360N with USB ID 1CBE:A021.
Multi-frame RGB uploads use a bundled Windows x64 TinyUZ executable or a supplied TinyUZ CLI on other platforms.
MIT license for the Rust library and bundled TinyUZ executable.

name: N2Elite-ng: reconstructing N2 Elite dongle control
description_en: N2Elite-ng reconstructs control of the N2 Elite / Amiiqo USB dongle in a Python CLI and Tkinter GUI. Its protocol reference describes the CP2102 serial bridge to an MFRC522 NFC frontend, while the client reads NTAG215 tags and manages banks on an unlocked N2 disc.
description_zh: N2Elite-ng 以 Python 命令行工具和 Tkinter 图形界面重建 N2 Elite / Amiiqo USB 设备的控制功能。协议文档说明 CP2102 至 MFRC522 NFC 前端的串口桥接；客户端可读取 NTAG215 标签，并管理已解锁 N2 卡片的存储区。
requirements: Requires an N2 Elite / Amiiqo USB reader-writer; multi-bank management requires the N2 disc unlocked into manager mode.
A user-supplied key_retail.bin is required for offline amiibo encryption and decryption.
LICENSE states CC BY-NC 4.0, while README and pyproject.toml state PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.

name: Huawei MateBook 13 · Linux: Goodix fingerprint protocol and Linux driver
description_en: Huawei MateBook 13 · Linux reconstructs communication with the Goodix GXFP51A0 fingerprint reader and provides a Linux libfprint driver for it. Its research notes describe SPI packet framing, acknowledgement and response handling, and static analysis of Goodix FP Windows driver versions; the repository also manages MX250 power on the target laptop.
description_zh: Huawei MateBook 13 · Linux 重建与 Goodix GXFP51A0 指纹传感器的通信，并提供 Linux libfprint 驱动。研究记录涵盖 SPI 报文结构、确认与响应流程，以及对 Goodix FP Windows 驱动版本的静态分析；仓库还管理目标笔记本的 MX250 电源。
requirements: Huawei MateBook 13 WRTB-WXX9 with the Goodix GXFP51A0 / GF3658 ST411 reader for the documented hardware profile.
The author reports three first-touch LOCK and two deep-S3 successes on the Pegasus reference machine; unknown-finger tests at ±18°, repeated S4, boot and reboot remain unverified.
Keep password login available as a fallback.
The repository identifies GPL-2.0 and LGPL-2.1 licenses for its components.

name: TP2-Y Label Studio: reconstructing Bluetooth label printing
description_en: TP2-Y Label Studio implements direct label printing to the TP2-Y thermal printer over Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM. Its protocol notes describe captured frame structure and print-job commands; the Windows Python client provides a local web designer and command-line printing.
description_zh: TP2-Y Label Studio 通过 Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM 直接向 TP2-Y 热敏打印机发送标签。协议笔记记录了捕获到的帧结构和打印任务命令；Windows Python 客户端提供本地网页设计器与命令行打印功能。
requirements: Requires Windows, Python and a paired TP2-Y Bluetooth printer.
Printing uses Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM; BLE GATT status and configuration functions remain experimental.
MIT license.

name: Halo Home for Home Assistant: reconstructing local Avi-on mesh control
description_en: Halo Home for Home Assistant controls Eaton HALO Home Bluetooth mesh lights locally and targets other Avi-on lights using the same protocol. Its CSRmesh protocol document describes GATT characteristics, encrypted packet delivery and passphrase-based key derivation for on/off, brightness and color-temperature controls.
description_zh: Halo Home for Home Assistant 在本地控制 Eaton HALO Home 蓝牙网状灯具，也面向使用同一协议的其他 Avi-on 灯具。其 CSRmesh 协议文档说明用于开关、亮度和色温控制的 GATT 特征、加密数据包传输及基于口令的密钥派生。
requirements: Requires Home Assistant 2024.12 or newer with Bluetooth enabled, plus an adapter or Bluetooth proxy within range of a fixture.
Initial setup requires an Avi-on / Halo Home account, or a previously saved avion_backup.json containing the location passphrase.
The author reports testing only the MicroEdge (HLB) on real hardware; transitions are unsupported.
MIT license.

name: ThinkCentre Fan Control: recovering fan telemetry and modes from the M70t Gen 6
description_en: ThinkCentre Fan Control uses findings from M70t Gen 6 embedded-controller probing and ACPI table analysis to show fan RPM and offer firmware fan modes. The Windows tray app reads the EC tachometer through PawnIO, obtains per-core temperatures from CPU registers and changes supported modes through Lenovo WMI.
description_zh: ThinkCentre Fan Control 根据 M70t Gen 6 嵌入式控制器探测和 ACPI 表分析结果显示风扇转速，并提供固件风扇模式。Windows 托盘程序通过 PawnIO 读取 EC 转速计，通过 CPU 寄存器读取各核心温度，再使用 Lenovo WMI 切换支持的模式。
requirements: Requires Windows 10 or 11, Administrator rights, and the PawnIO driver; building from source requires the .NET 8 SDK.

The author reports support for fan modes, including Full Speed, on ThinkCentre M70t Gen 6 board 3376. Other boards use its EC layout as a fallback, so readings may be inaccurate; mode writes are disabled.
Exact RPM setting is not supported.
MIT license.

name: foobot-local: local Foobot service and reconstructed protocols
description_en: foobot-local reconstructs Foobot communication so the air-quality monitor can send readings to a local service. It documents MQTT topics, a UDP AT configuration channel and Wi-Fi provisioning recovered from the official APK; the Python service decodes readings and computes a pollution index.
description_zh: foobot-local 重建 Foobot 空气质量监测器的通信流程，使设备向本地服务发送读数。项目记录 MQTT 主题、UDP AT 配置通道，以及从官方 APK 反编译还原的 Wi-Fi 配网流程；Python 服务负责解码读数并计算污染指数。
requirements: A Foobot and an always-on Linux host on the same LAN, with Python 3 and dnsmasq or another configurable DNS service.
The calibration constants were derived from one device; other units may need their own calibration.
The device computes its ring colour from thresholds that the project has not captured.
MIT license.

name: Rondorecomp: a partial static recompilation of Castlevania: Rondo of Blood
description_en: Rondorecomp translates Castlevania: Rondo of Blood’s PC Engine CD HuC6280 code into C at build time and runs it against C models of the console’s CPU, video, CD, input, and System Card services. Its analysis directory contains boot-chain disassembly and tools for code discovery and data decoding. The author reports rendering the intro and file-select screens and reaching the prologue, with much of the game still unverified.
description_zh: Rondorecomp 在构建时将《恶魔城 X：血之轮回》PC Engine CD 版的 HuC6280 机器码翻译为 C，并以 C 模拟 CPU、视频、光驱、输入及 System Card 服务。仓库还提供启动链反汇编、代码发现和数据解码工具。作者报告称目前可显示片头和存档选择画面并进入序章，大部分游戏尚未核对。
requirements: Supply your own System Card 3.0 image and Rondo of Blood disc data track.
Build with a C11-capable GCC, Python 3.8 or later, and bash.
Sound is unimplemented, and the game is not playable end to end.
MIT license, except src/huc_table.py, which carries GPL-3.0.

name: Splashdown: a matching PS2 decompilation and Linux port
description_en: Splashdown reconstructs C++ source for the NTSC-U PlayStation 2 game and builds a native Linux x86-64 port from it. The project checks reconstructed functions and the linked executable against retail bytes and a SHA-1 hash. The author reports that all 4,356 game functions match and that the Linux port plays the full game at 30 FPS.
description_zh: Splashdown 重建美版 PS2 游戏的 C++ 源码，并以同一份源码构建 Linux x86-64 原生移植版。项目将函数及链接后的可执行文件与零售版字节和 SHA-1 哈希比较。作者报告称 4,356 个游戏函数均已匹配，Linux 版可按 30 FPS 运行完整游戏。
requirements: Supply your own Splashdown dump, including its retail executable and, for the port, a disc image.
The matching build uses Metrowerks mwccps2 2.4, wibo, splat, and MIPS GNU binutils; the Linux port uses clang, SDL3, and zlib.

name: tc01a: reconstructing Fluke iSee TC01A USB control
description_en: tc01a reconstructs Fluke iSee TC01A camera control from the Android app and native library behavior. Its Python libusb driver streams thermal video, decodes per-pixel temperatures and sends vendor USB commands for shutter, gain and emissivity settings.
description_zh: tc01a 从 Android 应用及原生库行为重建 Fluke iSee TC01A 相机控制。其 Python libusb 驱动可传输热成像视频、解码逐像素温度，并发送快门、增益和发射率设置的厂商 USB 命令。
requirements: A Fluke iSee TC01A camera; Python and libusb1 bindings.
Windows requires WinUSB for full control; macOS uses libusb from Homebrew.
The author reports hardware checks on Windows and macOS; Linux hardware remains untested, and low-gain calibration correction is absent.
MIT License.

name: Dicing Knight. — a native port by static recompilation
description_en: Dicing Knight. — Native Recompilation translates the WonderSwan Color game’s V30 MZ machine code into C11 ahead of time and compiles it with a recreated hardware layer. Its Python recompiler discovers code from entry seeds and execution traces; the C layer models video, timers, input, EEPROM, and audio. The author reports playable Windows sections through the tower, while the ending and Android device build remain unverified.
description_zh: Dicing Knight. — Native Recompilation 预先将 WonderSwan Color 游戏的 V30 MZ 机器码翻译为 C11，再与重建的硬件层一起编译。Python 重编译器依据入口点和执行轨迹发现代码；C 硬件层处理视频、定时器、输入、EEPROM 和音频。作者报告 Windows 版可游玩至塔内，但尚未走到结局，Android 设备版也未验证。
requirements: Supply your own Dicing Knight. .wsc cartridge image.
The build uses Python 3, C11, CMake, Ninja, and the platform toolchain described by the project.
The author reports incomplete code coverage and an Android host that has not been verified on a device.
MIT license.

name: noirm1: reconstructing NOIR M1 mouse settings
description_en: noirm1 reconstructs the NOIR M1 mouse's wired USB HID settings protocol from disassembly of the vendor's Windows utility and device checks. The Rust CLI writes polling rate, DPI and lighting settings through hidraw; protocol notes record packets and EEPROM fields.
description_zh: noirm1 通过反汇编厂商 Windows 工具并对照实机，重建 NOIR M1 鼠标的有线 USB HID 设置协议。Rust 命令行工具经 hidraw 写入轮询率、DPI 和灯效，协议笔记记录数据包与 EEPROM 字段。
requirements: Linux with hidraw, Rust 1.80+ and a wired NOIR M1 mouse.
The 2.4 GHz receiver is listed but cannot configure the mouse.
Button actions and several lighting settings remain untested on hardware.
MIT License.

name: Hitachi MB110: mapping TV services and replacing its web portal
description_en: Hitachi MB110 maps the TV's network services, remote-control API, Chromium debugging endpoint and web portal. The toolkit provides discovery and remote-control scripts plus a locally served replacement home page reached through DNS redirection.
description_zh: Hitachi MB110 项目梳理电视的网络服务、遥控 API、Chromium 调试端点及网页门户，提供设备发现和遥控脚本，并通过 DNS 重定向在本地提供替代主页。
requirements: A Hitachi MB110 TV and access to the same local network are needed for device functions.
The local portal requires DNS resolution of mb100.portaltv.tv to the serving computer.
MIT License.

name: PetMarvel C1: reconstructing local litter-box control
description_en: PetMarvel C1 Local reconstructs the litter box's cloud-facing TLS and MQTT exchanges in a router-hosted Go broker. Protocol notes describe topics, TLV commands and status fields; Home Assistant patches connect to the local broker.
description_zh: PetMarvel C1 Local 在路由器上的 Go broker 中重建猫砂盆面向云端的 TLS 与 MQTT 交互。协议文档记录主题、TLV 命令和状态字段，Home Assistant 补丁接入本地 broker。
requirements: PetMarvel C1 firmware 1.0.2 is the documented device target.
Go 1.23.x is required because the device uses RSA key exchange; deployment requires a suitable OpenWrt router.
Home Assistant integration requires the upstream jarylc/hass-pet-marvel project.
Cloud and vendor OTA functions become unavailable under local routing.
MIT License for repository code; Home Assistant patches follow upstream terms.

name: omen-lcd: reconstructing HP OMEN cooler LCD control
description_en: omen-lcd reconstructs the USB HID control exchange for the HP OMEN AIO cooler's LCD and implements a Linux driver. Its protocol notes describe identification, 480×480 JPEG frames and brightness messages captured from OMEN Gaming Hub.
description_zh: omen-lcd 重建 HP OMEN 一体式散热器 LCD 的 USB HID 控制流程，并实现 Linux 驱动。协议笔记记录从 OMEN Gaming Hub 抓取的设备识别、480×480 JPEG 图像帧及亮度消息。
requirements: An HP OMEN AIO cooler LCD with USB ID 03f0:7397; testing is reported for firmware V3.05.024.
Python 3.10+ and Pillow; NVIDIA GPU temperature display additionally needs the NVIDIA driver.
Power-on effect upload and AMD temperature sensors are not implemented.
GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: TimeSplitters: Future Perfect — native PC rebuild
description_en: TimeSplitters: Future Perfect is being rebuilt as a native PC game using data imported from the user's Xbox copy. The launcher identifies the disc by the hash of default.xbe, extracts and checks game files, and manages settings and mods. The repository also contains game reconstruction code and a decompilation analysis toolchain.
description_zh: 该项目利用用户自己的 Xbox 版游戏数据，将 TimeSplitters: Future Perfect 重建为原生 PC 游戏。启动器通过 default.xbe 的哈希识别光盘，提取并校验游戏文件，还可管理设置与模组；仓库另含游戏重建代码和反编译分析工具链。
requirements: Requires the user's own copy of the original Xbox game as an ISO or extracted folder.
The launcher works, but the game is still being rebuilt and Play may be unavailable on a given platform.
Licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later; third-party components retain their own licenses.

name: QCY Control for macOS: implementing MeloBuds Pro BLE controls
description_en: QCY Control for macOS implements a Swift menu-bar client for QCY MeloBuds Pro using the documented QCY BLE GATT protocol. It controls noise modes, EQ, gaming mode and touch mappings, and lists UUIDs and example command frames.
description_zh: QCY Control for macOS 使用已有的 QCY BLE GATT 协议资料，实现 MeloBuds Pro 的 Swift 菜单栏客户端，可设置降噪模式、EQ、游戏模式和触控映射，并列出 UUID 与命令帧示例。
requirements: macOS 13+, Xcode Command Line Tools and Bluetooth access.
The tested device is QCY MeloBuds Pro firmware 2.0.4 on Apple Silicon.
Other QCY models may differ in ANC scene IDs.
MIT License.

name: tp-vita: porting Twilight Princess to PS Vita
description_en: tp-vita ports Dusklight's GameCube Twilight Princess code to PS Vita by compiling the game and JSystem sources for ARM. It retains Aurora's GX command processor and adds a vitaGL GLES2 renderer. The author reports a VPK that boots and renders in Vita3K; audio is disabled, and a memory-card prompt blocks progress past file select.
description_zh: tp-vita 将 Dusklight 的 GameCube 版《塞尔达传说 黄昏公主》代码移植到 PS Vita，把游戏与 JSystem 源码编译为 ARM 程序。它保留 Aurora 的 GX 命令处理器，并加入 vitaGL GLES2 渲染后端。作者报告 VPK 可在 Vita3K 中启动并渲染；音频已关闭，存储卡提示阻碍游戏越过选档界面。
requirements: Building requires VitaSDK, CMake, Python 3, fetched dependencies, and a Dusklight checkout.
Running requires the user's own GameCube Twilight Princess disc image; hardware installation also requires libshacccg.suprx.
The author reports Vita3K boot and rendering results; real PS Vita hardware has not been exercised, and audio is disabled.
Component licence notices are provided in LICENSES/ and NOTICE.

name: TM2020-Sim: extending Trackmania physics simulation
description_en: TM2020-Sim extends Gearbox's Trackmania physics and asset loading into a headless simulator with a native C++ and Rust SDK. It adds parallel environments, replay analysis, driving-controller research and validation tools for local game observations.
description_zh: TM2020-Sim 在 Gearbox 的 Trackmania 物理与资源加载代码上构建无界面模拟器和 C++、Rust SDK，增加并行环境、回放分析、驾驶控制研究及本地游戏对照工具。
requirements: Linux x86-64, Python 3.10+, CMake 3.21+, a C++20 compiler, Rust/Cargo 1.98+ and liblzo2.so.2.
Simulation requires the user's Trackmania installation, its Packs folder and a map file.
Client integration is experimental; a post-finish detachment fault requires a client restart.
GPL-3.0-or-later, with third-party notices.

name: BTHackers: reconstructing the AIREC recorder’s BLE protocol
description_en: BTHackers documents the AIREC voice recorder’s BLE GATT service and command protocol from captured sessions. Its protocol reference maps characteristic handles and the 55 aa command and aa 55 response frames. The repository includes capture parsers, a Python client, and a Flutter app; the author lists connection fixes and the file-download command as open work.
description_zh: BTHackers 根据抓取的通信会话整理 AIREC 录音笔的 BLE GATT 服务与命令协议。协议文档列出特征值句柄、以 55 aa 开头的命令帧及以 aa 55 开头的响应帧。仓库提供抓包解析脚本、Python 客户端和 Flutter 应用；连接修复与文件下载命令仍在研究中。
requirements: An AIREC voice recorder and BLE access are needed for live interaction.
The Python client uses bleak and is documented as needing a connection fix.
The file-download command has not yet been identified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: MacBook ALS: mapping five HID color channels
description_en: MacBook ALS maps the 122-byte HID report of an Apple Silicon MacBook ambient-light sensor. Python scripts read five raw channels, lux and color temperature, while recorded CSV runs and colored-light tests support the reported field positions and channel responses.
description_zh: MacBook ALS 解析 Apple Silicon MacBook 环境光传感器的 122 字节 HID 报告。Python 脚本读取五个原始通道、照度和色温；公开的 CSV 记录与彩色光测试支撑字段位置和通道响应分析。
requirements: Python 3.8+ and an Apple Silicon MacBook ambient-light sensor.
The author measured one MacBook Pro Mac16,8; decoding on other models remains unconfirmed.
MIT License.

name: strix-890m-macos: investigating Radeon 890M display bring-up
description_en: strix-890m-macos investigates Radeon 890M display bring-up on an ASUS GA403WM running macOS. Trace notes, IOAccelerator ABI data, Metal and Vulkan probes, and experimental kexts cover framebuffer adoption, OLED brightness and WindowServer attachment; accelerated graphics remain unfinished.
description_zh: strix-890m-macos 研究 ASUS GA403WM 在 macOS 下的 Radeon 890M 显示启动。项目提供跟踪记录、IOAccelerator ABI 数据、Metal 与 Vulkan 探测工具，以及涉及帧缓冲区、OLED 亮度和 WindowServer 接入的实验性内核扩展；图形加速仍未完成。
requirements: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 GA403WM with Radeon 890M for the documented hardware work.
macOS and Xcode command line tools to build the kexts; the install scripts generally expect an OpenCore ESP and a reboot.
Accelerated Radeon 890M graphics are unfinished.
Repository-authored code uses the Clear BSD License; the NullMoth patch has separate PolyForm Noncommercial terms.

name: SteelSeries Apex 3: reconstructing RGB control over USB HID
description_en: The SteelSeries Apex 3 RGB Controller uses recovered USB HID reports to set the keyboard’s lighting colors from Linux. Its technical notes identify the device interface, a 32-byte report, color opcode 0x0B, and RGB values for ten zones. The repository includes a command-line program for sending color settings.
description_zh: SteelSeries Apex 3 RGB Controller 利用恢复出的 USB HID 报文，在 Linux 上设置键盘灯光颜色。技术说明列出设备接口、32 字节报文、0x0B 颜色操作码及十个灯区的 RGB 字段。仓库提供发送颜色设置的命令行程序。
requirements: Requires Linux, Python 3, python-hidapi, and access to the SteelSeries Apex 3 HID device.
The source describes Arch Linux specifically and notes that other distributions may need adaptation.
No licence file in the repository.

name: YouTubeClient: a UWP port of a decompiled WP7 client
description_en: YouTubeClient adapts a decompiled Windows Phone 7 YouTube client XAP into a UWP application for Windows 10 Mobile and desktop. The port replaces WP7 navigation, settings storage, and dialogs with UWP equivalents while retaining the original page structure. The author reports an early draft with broken interface elements and nonworking search and top-video display.
description_zh: YouTubeClient 将反编译得到的 Windows Phone 7 YouTube 客户端 XAP 改编为适用于 Windows 10 Mobile 和桌面的 UWP 应用。移植版以 UWP 组件替换 WP7 导航、设置存储和对话框，同时保留原有页面结构。作者报告称项目仍是早期草稿，界面有故障，搜索和热门视频显示尚不能使用。
requirements: Build with MSBuild and the UWP SDK targeting 10.0.19041.0, with minimum version 10.0.10240.0.
Search and top-video display are reported broken, and device testing remains unfinished.
MIT license.

name: Twin Famicom: reconstructing the console power board
description_en: Twin Famicom reconstructs the Sharp console's power board as a KiCad schematic and PCB design based on visual inspection and measurement of an original unit. The repository contains the power-board project and states its hardware-design license.
description_zh: Twin Famicom 根据对 Sharp 原机的目视检查和测量，用 KiCad 重绘电源板原理图与 PCB。仓库包含电源板项目文件，并标明硬件设计的许可证。
requirements: An original Sharp Twin Famicom console was used for the inspection and measurements.
The repository contains a power-board KiCad project.
Hardware designs use CERN-OHL-P v2; content in docs/ is designated CC BY 4.0.

name: rfserver: reconstructing a 433 MHz light remote
description_en: rfserver implements Raspberry Pi Pico W firmware for controlling LED lights through a decoded 433 MHz remote signal. It sends commands over RF, tracks changes made by the physical remote and exposes HTTP endpoints for commands and state.
description_zh: rfserver 为 Raspberry Pi Pico W 实现基于已解码 433 MHz 遥控信号的 LED 灯控制固件，可发送射频命令、跟踪实体遥控器造成的状态变化，并通过 HTTP 提供命令与状态接口。
requirements: Raspberry Pi Pico W, suitable 433 MHz transmitter and receiver, Pico SDK and picotool.
The author reports trying the build only on Apple Silicon macOS.
Unlicense.

name: physics_RT: reconstructing Ballance physics behavior
description_en: physics_RT reconstructs Ballance physics behavior as a Win32 Virtools DLL using IVP numerical kernels. It covers collision geometry, force handling and simulation timing, with differential tests against an original DLL and documented runtime comparisons.
description_zh: physics_RT 使用 IVP 数值核心，将 Ballance 的物理行为重建为 Win32 Virtools DLL，涉及碰撞几何、作用力处理和模拟时序，并记录了原始 DLL 差分测试与游戏运行对照。
requirements: Windows x86 and Virtools SDK 2.1 are required to build the host DLL.
Original-image comparisons require the user's original DLL and dependency directory.
The author reports 107 original-image comparisons and matching candidate observations across 969684 frames of qualifying runs.
Apache License 2.0.

name: ro: a client for the LB-Link BL-WR2000 repeater
description_en: ro is a Rust command-line client for controlling the LB-Link BL-WR2000 repeater through its HTTP interface. It sends login and goform requests to scan for Wi-Fi networks, connect to a network, read status, reboot and reset the repeater.
description_zh: ro 是通过 HTTP 接口控制 LB-Link BL-WR2000 中继器的 Rust 命令行客户端。它发送登录和 goform 请求，可扫描 Wi-Fi 网络、连接网络、读取状态、重启及重置中继器。
requirements: Requires an LB-Link BL-WR2000 repeater for device operations.
Built as a Rust 2021 edition package.
No licence file in the repository.

name: python-onvistabank-notifications: recovering account access through OnVistaBank’s web API
description_en: python-onvistabank-notifications implements selected OnVistaBank web trading API calls recovered through reverse engineering and exposes account information through a Telegram bot. Its documented calls cover login, OTP, account lists, and positions through the service’s HTTP JSON endpoint. The implementation focuses on read-only portfolio information.
description_zh: python-onvistabank-notifications 实现了通过逆向确认的部分 OnVistaBank 网页交易 API 调用，并用 Telegram 机器人显示账户信息。文档列出通过 HTTP JSON 接口进行登录、一次性验证码验证、账户列表及持仓查询的方法。实现范围主要是读取投资组合信息。
requirements: Requires an OnVistaBank web trading account, a Telegram bot token, and allowed user IDs in secrets.properties.
Requires Python 3.11 and pipenv.
Only a subset of the web trading API is implemented.
MIT license.

name: dvf3060: reconstructing Kenwood DVF-3060 front-panel control
description_en: dvf3060 implements control of the Kenwood DVF-3060 DVD player's front panel through its PT6311 SPI controller. A TM4C123G driver displays characters and icons and polls key states; the source separates hardware access, controller commands and display logic.
description_zh: dvf3060 通过 PT6311 的 SPI 接口控制 Kenwood DVF-3060 DVD 播放机前面板。TM4C123G 驱动可显示字符和图标、读取按键状态，并将硬件访问、控制器命令和显示逻辑分层。
requirements: TM4C123G LaunchPad, PlatformIO and a board compatible with 5 V logic levels.
The front-panel IR receiver has not been investigated.
MIT License.

name: galaxy-buds-plus: controlling Buds Plus through RFCOMM
description_en: galaxy-buds-plus implements a Perl client for Samsung Galaxy Buds Plus settings through the headset's RFCOMM serial interface. The author developed it by probing the undocumented device protocol on Linux; some messages and options remain undecoded.
description_zh: galaxy-buds-plus 是通过耳机 RFCOMM 串口设置 Samsung Galaxy Buds Plus 的 Perl 客户端。作者在 Linux 上探查未公开的设备协议；部分消息和选项仍未解码。
requirements: Samsung Galaxy Buds Plus and a Linux Bluetooth connection exposing a serial port.
Some messages and options remain undecoded or unsupported.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: DT No.1 F2: reconstructing smartwatch communication
description_en: DT No.1 F2 reconstructs the Bluetooth LE exchange between the smartwatch and its Android companion. The project documents GATT handles, message framing and commands, and implements a Python framework and replacement Android app.
description_zh: DT No.1 F2 项目重建智能手表与 Android 配套应用之间的蓝牙低功耗通信，记录 GATT 句柄、消息帧及命令，并实现 Python 框架和替代 Android 应用。
requirements: A DT No.1 F2 smartwatch is the documented device target.
Building the Android app requires an OpenWeather API key in SecretKeyList.kt.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: wuibi: recovering Quibi’s mobile API for a web client
description_en: wuibi reconstructs enough of Quibi’s mobile API to provide search and playback in a browser WebExtension. The author captured iOS and Android traffic, decompiled the Android APK, and recovered readable .proto definitions from embedded Protocol Buffer descriptors. The client then used those definitions to request playback information and hand streaming to Shaka Player; the service’s shutdown has left the client inoperative.
description_zh: wuibi 从 Quibi 移动端 API 恢复了搜索和播放所需的信息，并实现为浏览器 WebExtension。作者抓取 iOS、Android 客户端流量，反编译 Android APK，再从内置的 Protocol Buffers 描述符恢复可读的 .proto 定义。客户端据此请求播放信息并交由 Shaka Player 播放；Quibi 停止运营后，客户端已无法使用。
requirements: Quibi service availability is required for the client to operate; the source states that the service no longer exists.
The client implements basic search and playback.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Maia Ds2: Bluetooth control command findings
description_en: The Maia Ds2 investigation documents Bluetooth serial commands for controlling the amplifier. A command list and Python example show how to connect and send a channel-selection message.
description_zh: Maia Ds2 调查记录了控制功放的蓝牙串口命令。命令清单和 Python 示例展示了连接设备并发送输入通道切换消息的方法。
requirements: The example needs a Maia Ds2 amplifier and a Bluetooth-capable device running Python 3.
The Raspberry Pi setup uses the bluetooth Python package and an established Bluetooth connection.
No licence file in the repository.

name: fifine-ampligame-d6: reconstructing the D6 USB control interface
description_en: fifine-ampligame-d6 reconstructs USB control of the Fifine AmpliGame D6 macro pad in a Python macOS driver. Its documentation describes vendor library disassembly, report formats, display wake behavior and LCD slot mapping; the code also bridges the device to Bitfocus Companion Satellite.
description_zh: fifine-ampligame-d6 以 Python macOS 驱动重建 Fifine AmpliGame D6 宏键盘的 USB 控制。文档记录厂商动态库反汇编、报告格式、屏幕唤醒和 LCD 槽位映射；代码还通过 Bitfocus Companion Satellite 连接该设备。
requirements: macOS, Python 3.8+, and a Fifine AmpliGame D6 or D6-Pro.
Bitfocus Companion with Satellite enabled is required for the bridge.
MIT License.

name: PS5 pela rede: rebuilding PS5 discovery and wake control
description_en: PS5 pela rede provides a Node command-line client for checking whether a PS5 is on or resting and for waking or resting it over a home network. It implements DDP discovery on UDP port 9302 and WAKEUP from documented packet behavior, while registration and rest commands use playactor.
description_zh: PS5 pela rede 提供 Node 命令行工具，可在家庭网络中查看 PS5 的开机或休眠状态，并执行唤醒和休眠。项目依据数据包资料实现 UDP 9302 上的 DDP 发现及 WAKEUP；注册与休眠功能使用 playactor。
requirements: Node.js 22 or later, a PS5 on the same local network, and Remote Play enabled for registration.
PS5 rest-mode settings must allow internet connection and network wake.
The phone page and display of the running game are drafts.
MIT License.

name: Angry Birds PC engine: reimplementing the game engine from executable analysis
description_en: Angry Birds PC engine reimplements the game's native engine in C++ from analysis of the 1.6.2 executable. It hosts the user's original Lua scripts and data with SDL2, OpenGL, Lua 5.1 and Box2D, covering menus, levels, physics, rendering and audio across several Angry Birds PC releases.
description_zh: Angry Birds PC engine 根据 1.6.2 可执行文件分析，以 C++ 重建游戏原生引擎。它通过 SDL2、OpenGL、Lua 5.1 和 Box2D 运行用户提供的原版 Lua 脚本与数据，覆盖多个 Angry Birds PC 版本的菜单、关卡、物理、渲染和音频。
requirements: A legally obtained copy of a supported Angry Birds PC game, including its scripts and assets.
Angry Birds Space coverage includes known visual gaps and untried editor behavior.
MIT License.

name: Touhou Reiiden: a C# port built around original PC-98 game data
description_en: Touhou Reiiden is a C# and .NET 8 port of the 1997 PC-98 game that loads assets from the user's own disk image or game folder. It rebuilds stages, bosses, menus, scoring, and audio, using ReC98 as a behavioral and file-format reference and measurements of the original for selected boss sequences.
description_zh: Touhou Reiiden 是 1997 年 PC-98 游戏的 C#/.NET 8 移植版，从用户自备的磁盘镜像或游戏目录读取素材。项目重建关卡、首领、菜单、计分与音频，以 ReC98 为行为和文件格式参考，并依据原版测量调整部分首领演出。
requirements: A legal copy of Touhou Reiiden as an Anex86-format .hdi image or a folder of game files.
Windows x64 and OpenGL 3.0 or later; building requires the .NET 8 SDK.
Some drawing, sound, and boss details still differ from the original.
MIT License for the code.

name: NeoTS2: rebuilding The Sims 2 engine
description_en: NeoTS2 rebuilds The Sims 2 as a native 64-bit engine that reads the user's installed game files. Its C++ implementation loads neighborhoods, lots, objects, Sims, behavior scripts, models and UI resources, then renders them through modern graphics APIs; current development builds let users visit neighborhoods and lots.
description_zh: NeoTS2 将 The Sims 2 重建为读取用户自有游戏文件的原生 64 位引擎。其 C++ 实现载入社区、地段、物件、模拟市民、行为脚本、模型和界面资源，并通过现代图形 API 渲染；当前开发版可浏览社区和地段。
requirements: The user's own The Sims 2 installation is required; the project recommends backing up saves before use.
Development is early: saving games and loading custom content are not implemented, and Sim behavior is incomplete.
The repository's LICENSE contains the Commons Clause License Condition.

name: EasyRazer: reconstructing Razer analog keyboard controls
description_en: EasyRazer reconstructs direct controls for Razer analog keyboards in a Windows Synapse replacement. Its Rust and Tauri application manages actuation, remapping, profiles and lighting, with model-specific documentation of keyboard protocol and firmware behavior.
description_zh: EasyRazer 是 Windows 上控制 Razer 模拟键盘的 Synapse 替代程序，以 Rust 和 Tauri 实现触发点、按键映射、配置档及灯效管理，并按型号记录键盘协议与固件行为。
requirements: Windows and a supported Razer analog keyboard are required; Huntsman V2 Analog has full support.
Huntsman Mini Analog lacks macro support and has not been tested on hardware; listed V3 models are in development.
GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: Galaxian2: reimplementing Galaxy on Fire 2 in Godot
description_en: Galaxian2 reimplements Galaxy on Fire 2 as a Godot engine using content imported from the player's Mac Full HD or Android HD release. The importer prepares ships, missions, audio and other resources locally and reads static declarations from the original executable. The source describes a playable campaign and add-ons with release-specific content paths.
description_zh: Galaxian2 以 Godot 引擎重建《Galaxy on Fire 2》，从玩家自己的 Mac Full HD 或 Android HD 版本导入内容。导入器在本地处理飞船、任务和音频等资源，并静态读取原版可执行文件中的数据声明；项目描述了可游玩的主线和扩展内容，以及各版本对应的导入流程。
requirements: Requires the user's Galaxy on Fire 2 Full HD Mac or Android HD game files and at least 8 GB of free space for import.
Linux is the tested desktop platform; Windows and macOS native exports, ARM64 Android devices and Mac imports on Android have not been tested.
Android imports support the documented 2.0.16 HD release with the original economy; free-to-play economy files are refused.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: Sisu DCP-3: reconstructing Nokia 3210 firmware behavior
description_en: Sisu DCP-3 recreates the Nokia 3210 NSE-8 v6.00 experience as new C firmware for a replacement Rev B2 mainboard. It uses original-firmware analysis to guide behavior and presentation, while documented ROM research reconstructs the battery gauge; fonts, tones and other Nokia-derived assets are generated locally from the user's firmware copy.
description_zh: Sisu DCP-3 为替换用 Rev B2 主板编写全新 C 固件，重现 Nokia 3210 NSE-8 v6.00 的使用体验。项目以原固件分析指导行为与界面，并记录基于 ROM 的电量计重建过程；字体、提示音等 Nokia 资源由用户自有固件在本地生成。
requirements: A Rev B2 board with RP2354B, Telit LE910C1-WWX and the named Nokia 3210 parts is the hardware target.
The build uses CMake and the pinned Raspberry Pi Pico SDK 2.3.1 commit; a user-supplied original v6.00 firmware copy is needed to generate assets.
Project-authored code and documentation use the Unlicense; separately licensed third-party files retain their terms.

name: skynet-godot: porting SkyNET and Future Shock to Godot
description_en: skynet-godot ports the 1996 XnGine shooters SkyNET and Future Shock to a rewritten Godot 4 engine. It decodes BSA archives, WLD heightmaps, textures, maps and audio from the player's installations, while DOS executable disassembly informs movers, weapons, AI and mission behavior. The author reports bounded campaign and deathmatch support.
description_zh: skynet-godot 将 1996 年的 XnGine 射击游戏《SkyNET》和《Future Shock》移植到重写的 Godot 4 引擎。它从玩家安装目录解析 BSA、WLD、纹理、地图及音频，并依据 DOS 可执行文件反汇编重建机关、武器、AI 和任务行为；作者报告已支持一定范围的战役与联机对战。
requirements: Requires the user's original SkyNET game data; Future Shock data is optional.
Source builds require Godot 4.7.2.
Development of this Godot port stopped on 2026-10-13; the Android export received less testing than desktop builds.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: vxp: reconstructing VideoNow disc playback and branching
description_en: vxp reconstructs VideoNow XP player behavior by decoding picture, audio and interactive branch data from disc images. Its .NET player handles XP, Color and original black-and-white discs; a headless CLI inspects, verifies, exports and graphs disc contents.
description_zh: vxp 通过解码光盘镜像中的画面、音频和互动分支数据，重建 VideoNow XP 播放器的行为。.NET 播放器支持 XP、Color 和早期黑白光盘；无界面 CLI 可检查、校验、导出内容并绘制分支图。
requirements: Playback requires a cue-sheet disc image or a ZIP containing its cue sheet and tracks.
Building from source requires .NET SDK 8.0 or later.
The author lists selected tested retail discs; other XP and Color titles remain unchecked.
MIT License.

name: Galaxian: reimplementing Galaxy on Fire 1 for Godot
description_en: Galaxian reimplements the iPhone edition of Galaxy on Fire 1 as a Godot engine. It imports ships, missions, artwork and other resources from the player's IPA, reads AEM and AEI formats, and extracts selected embedded Mach-O definitions into a local cache. The remake adds its own controls and play modes alongside the reconstructed campaign.
description_zh: Galaxian 用 Godot 重建《Galaxy on Fire 1》iPhone 版。它从玩家的 IPA 导入飞船、任务、图像等资源，读取 AEM 和 AEI 格式，并将部分 Mach-O 内嵌定义提取到本地缓存。除重建版战役外，它还提供自行设计的操作方式和游戏模式。
requirements: Requires the user's compatible Galaxy on Fire 1 iPhone IPA; the validated archive identifies as version 1.1.5.
The reader requires an unencrypted ARM32 app with content symbols; other editions have not been validated.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: BudsCtl: reconstructing SoundPEATS earbud controls
description_en: BudsCtl reconstructs SoundPEATS Air4 Pro GAIA V2 controls for a macOS menu bar app that changes noise mode and reads each earbud's battery level. Its documentation identifies the BLE service, command framing, and response behavior; a separate Samsung RFCOMM implementation draws on a cited protocol reference.
description_zh: BudsCtl 还原 SoundPEATS Air4 Pro 的 GAIA V2 控制指令，在 macOS 菜单栏中切换降噪模式并读取左右耳电量。文档说明 BLE 服务、命令帧及响应行为；另有依据外部协议资料实现的 Samsung RFCOMM 控制代码。
requirements: Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 26 or newer, with paired earbuds and Bluetooth permission.
SoundPEATS Air4 Pro is the hardware-confirmed model; the Samsung implementation has synthetic-byte unit tests but no reported hardware run.
MIT license.

name: Zamphenom: running Kemper Profiler firmware in a DSP emulator
description_en: Zamphenom runs Kemper Profiler firmware in an instruction-level Motorola DSP56720 emulator and exposes its audio through a VST3 plugin. The repository includes update-file unpacking, DSP bootstrap extraction and rig-to-message-stream tools; the author reports a working amp path and delay stomp.
description_zh: Zamphenom 以指令级 Motorola DSP56720 仿真器运行 Kemper Profiler 固件，并通过 VST3 插件输出音频。仓库提供更新包拆解、DSP 引导段提取和 rig 转消息流工具；作者报告放大器路径和延迟效果已可工作。
requirements: An owner-supplied Kemper Profiler OS 14.2.1 firmware dump and the complete set of 18 DSP segments are required; a rig can come from the update package or the user's own files.
A C++17 compiler and CMake 3.16 or newer are required for building.
The repository cannot generate the 18 runtime DSP segments from the update file; most effects remain incomplete.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: OpenGromada: reconstructing the Sigma Games engine
description_en: OpenGromada reconstructs the engine used by Sigma Games titles including AS1/ZS1, Theseus, Crazy Lunch and Locoland/Steamland. Its C++20 executable reads the user's game resources and supports multiple platforms and architectures, widescreen display and gamepads.
description_zh: OpenGromada 重建用于 AS1/ZS1、Theseus、Crazy Lunch 和 Locoland/Steamland 等游戏的引擎。其 C++20 程序读取用户提供的游戏资源，支持多种平台和架构、宽屏显示及手柄。
requirements: The relevant game's objects.res and data directories are required.
Building requires CMake or Premake, a C++20 compiler and SDL3; Steamworks SDK and FFmpeg 6+ are needed for the named optional features.
Sustainable Use License 1.0.

name: Babyface Pro FS: reconstructing its proprietary USB mode on Linux
description_en: A Linux ALSA driver reconstructs the RME Babyface Pro FS proprietary USB mode from Windows captures. It handles interrupt-endpoint PCM streaming, mixer controls and front-panel input, with protocol and calibration notes plus USB capture-analysis tools.
description_zh: 这款 Linux ALSA 驱动依据 Windows 抓包还原 RME Babyface Pro FS 的专有 USB 模式，处理中断端点 PCM 音频流、混音控制与前面板输入，并提供协议、校准记录及 USB 抓包分析工具。
requirements: RME Babyface Pro FS hardware and a Linux system are required.
The driver is distributed as a kernel module or patch series.
GPL-2.0-only license.

name: wolfmix-automation: reconstructing W1 project files and USB control
description_en: wolfmix-automation reconstructs the Wolfmix W1 .wpj project format and USB control protocol from controlled editor changes, owned project files, and device observations. It publishes a byte-level specification and Python tools to inspect, diff, round-trip, compile, and generate project files, plus a USB client.
description_zh: wolfmix-automation 通过受控的编辑器改动、自有项目文件及设备观察，重建 Wolfmix W1 的 .wpj 项目格式与 USB 控制协议。仓库提供字节级规范、用于检查、比较、往返转换、编译和生成项目文件的 Python 工具，以及 USB 客户端。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later; macOS or Linux is required for the USB device client.
Bring a .wpj project file of your own; USB operations additionally require a Wolfmix W1 Mk1 with WTOOLS closed.
Fields without sufficient evidence are not writable, and the project describes itself as unfinished research.
MIT License.

name: Mammotion RTK 3: reconstructing the mower's LoRa correction link
description_en: This study reconstructs the receive side of the LoRa link from a Mammotion RTK 3 station to a Luba mini AWD 800H mower. It documents frequency hopping and an RTCM3 container, with SX1276 receiver firmware and Python tools that analyse captures and extract corrections.
description_zh: 该研究还原 Mammotion RTK 3 基站至 Luba mini AWD 800H 割草机的 LoRa 接收链路，记录跳频时序和 RTCM3 封装，并提供 SX1276 接收固件及用于分析采样、提取差分数据的 Python 工具。
requirements: A compatible SX1276 board is needed for the hop-following receiver.
The measured parameters come from one station in the US 902–928 MHz band; other regions or firmware may differ.
MIT license.

name: Marstek Offline Endpoint: reconstructing Venus cloud replies
description_en: Marstek Offline Endpoint recreates the telemetry upload and time replies expected by Marstek Venus E and D batteries on a local server. The author traces firmware conditions behind network resets, implements the response path in a container and records uploaded measurements locally. The author reports that a Venus D on Control firmware v150 stopped its periodic network interruptions during the documented observation.
description_zh: Marstek Offline Endpoint 在本地服务器重建 Marstek Venus E、D 电池预期的遥测上传和时间响应。作者分析导致网络复位的固件条件，以容器实现响应并在本地记录上传数据；据作者报告，Control 固件 v150 的 Venus D 在所述观察期间停止了周期性断网。
requirements: A Marstek Venus battery, a local Docker host with ports 80 and 443 available, and DNS or traffic redirection to that host.
Set TZ to the device's local time zone for time replies.
The v151 behavior is based on decompiled code and has not been measured on a v151 device.
MIT License.

name: Smart Life cloud plug CLI: reconstructing mobile signing and control
description_en: Smart Life cloud plug CLI reconstructs the Smart Life Android 7.10.6 signing and login flow for cloud-connected plugs. It extracts app signing material from the user's APK, selects a compatible signature form, and sends signed requests to list devices, read status and switch a plug.
description_zh: Smart Life cloud plug CLI 重建 Smart Life Android 7.10.6 的签名与登录流程，用于云端插座。它从用户的 APK 提取应用签名材料、选择兼容的签名形式，再发送签名请求以列出设备、读取状态和开关插座。
requirements: Python 3.10+, Android Platform Tools, and a phone with Smart Life 7.10.6 installed.
A Smart Life account with a paired plug and its login credentials.
The app constants are specific to Smart Life 7.10.6.
No licence file in the repository.

name: DingTalk A1 Local Toolkit: reconstructing BLE recording access
description_en: DingTalk A1 Local Toolkit reconstructs the recorder's BLE authentication and recording-transfer exchange for local access from Windows or Linux. Its Python tools read device status and recording indexes, download recordings, and convert BABA/DTYJ Opus containers to Ogg/Opus.
description_zh: DingTalk A1 Local Toolkit 重建录音卡的 BLE 鉴权与录音传输流程，供 Windows 或 Linux 电脑本地访问。Python 工具可读取设备状态和录音索引、下载录音，并将 BABA/DTYJ Opus 容器转换为 Ogg/Opus。
requirements: Python 3.11+, computer Bluetooth, and an A1 device the user is authorized to use.
Device configuration requires credentials from the user's own DingTalk session.
Wi-Fi AP recording transfer is not implemented.
MIT License.

name: Remote for Apple TV: rebuilding Companion Link control on Android
description_en: Remote for Apple TV implements Apple TV control on Android through Kotlin modules for Companion Link pairing, encrypted OPACK commands, and an MRP-over-AirPlay media tunnel. Its protocol module and desktop CLI cover discovery, remote keys, text entry, and now-playing data; the project credits pyatv for protocol values and reference vectors.
description_zh: Remote for Apple TV 以 Kotlin 实现 Android 端的 Apple TV 控制，涵盖 Companion Link 配对、加密 OPACK 命令以及通过 AirPlay 传输的 MRP 媒体数据。协议模块与桌面 CLI 支持发现设备、遥控按键、文字输入和播放信息；项目注明协议值和测试向量参考 pyatv。
requirements: Android 8.0 or later and an Apple TV on the same Wi-Fi network; pairing uses the code shown on the TV.
Building requires JDK 21 and Android SDK platform 35.
The author reports end-to-end testing on Apple TV 4K running tvOS 26.6; other modern models are untested, and Apple TV 3rd generation or earlier is unsupported.
Apache License 2.0.

name: Buckler's Boot Camp API Notes: mapping Street Fighter 6 web data routes
description_en: Buckler's Boot Camp API Notes map the undocumented Next.js page-data routes used by the Street Fighter 6 Buckler web frontend. The reference covers read-only profile, battle-log, search and ranking data, observed schemas, session handling and buildId discovery.
description_zh: Buckler's Boot Camp API Notes 梳理 Street Fighter 6 Buckler 网页前端使用的未公开 Next.js 页面数据路由，涵盖只读的个人资料、对战记录、搜索和排名数据，以及观测到的数据结构、会话处理和 buildId 获取方法。
requirements: Most useful routes require a Buckler account and an authorized session.
The included example requires Node.js 20 or newer.
Routes, fields and buildId may change with site deployments.
MIT License.

name: ZTE ZXSLC SR1010: analysing configuration and NAND firmware
description_en: An investigation of the ZTE ZXSLC SR1010 maps its NAND partitions, encrypted rootfs, boot and upgrade paths, and config.bin format. Python tools inspect, decrypt, edit and repack owner-supplied configurations and extract firmware components.
description_zh: 该研究梳理 ZTE ZXSLC SR1010 的 NAND 分区、加密 rootfs、启动与升级路径及 config.bin 格式。Python 工具可检查、解密、修改和重新打包用户提供的配置，并提取固件组件。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer and pycryptodomex are required for the configuration tools.
Supply a config.bin for configuration work or a firmware image for firmware analysis; retain an original backup before writing changes.
MIT license.

name: panelbeater: reconstructing ScanSnap iX1500 panel control
description_en: panelbeater lets a Linux host respond to the Scan button on a ScanSnap iX1500 over Wi-Fi or USB. Over Wi-Fi it registers the host with the scanner; over USB it scans without registration. Its protocol notes document discovery, registration, document transfer and USB behavior, while the client assembles scanned pages into PDFs and can add an OCR text layer when ocrmypdf is installed.
description_zh: panelbeater 使 Linux 主机可通过 Wi-Fi 或 USB 响应 ScanSnap iX1500 面板上的扫描操作。Wi-Fi 路径会向扫描仪注册主机，USB 路径无需注册。项目记录设备发现、注册、文档传输及 USB 通信行为；客户端可将扫描页合成为 PDF，安装 ocrmypdf 后还可加入 OCR 文字层。
requirements: Python 3.9 or newer and a ScanSnap iX1500; Wi-Fi operation requires configuration on the scanner panel.
USB scanning requires pyusb, Pillow and numpy; PDF assembly and OCR use optional packages.
Network scanning is fixed at 300 dpi colour; USB scanning and SANE cannot claim the scanner simultaneously.
GPL-2.0-or-later license.

name: Need for Speed: Most Wanted: rehosting the Android release on R36S
description_en: The R36S port runs the 2012 Android release of Need for Speed: Most Wanted on ArkOS using the owner's game files. An ARMv7 loader maps the original libraries, while Bionic, JNI and soft-float bridges connect them to Linux graphics, controls and audio; the author reports playable races in the public alpha.
description_zh: 该 R36S 移植版使用用户自有游戏文件，在 ArkOS 上运行 2012 年 Android 版 Need for Speed: Most Wanted。ARMv7 加载器映射原始库，Bionic、JNI 和软浮点桥接层连接 Linux 图形、输入与音频；作者报告公开测试版已能进行比赛。
requirements: Running the port requires an R36S with ArkOS and the specified version 1.3.128 APK and OBB from the user's own copy; building the runtime requires an armhf Linux host or cross-build environment.
The public alpha still needs a timing workaround for one car-selection action; soundtrack playback is disabled.
MIT License for the compatibility code and packaging.

name: VT-Ragnaros: reconstructing Redragon SS552 USB control
description_en: VT-Ragnaros implements a Linux driver and daemon for the Redragon SS552 Ragnaros USB control deck. It reconstructs commands and input reports from the vendor's SDLibrary1.dll, sending JPEG frames in 1024-byte USB packets and decoding key, knob, and touch-strip events for configurable profiles.
description_zh: VT-Ragnaros 为 Redragon SS552 Ragnaros USB 控制台实现 Linux 驱动与守护进程。项目从厂商 SDLibrary1.dll 还原命令和输入报告，以 1024 字节 USB 包传输 JPEG 画面，并解析按键、旋钮及触控条事件供配置文件使用。
requirements: Redragon SS552 Ragnaros USB deck and Linux with libusb-1.0, udev, and systemd.
Initial installation requires a reboot for the USB HID quirk.
MIT License.

name: PixMob Wave2: reconstructing RF wristband commands for Flipper Zero
description_en: A Flipper Zero signal set and Python generator reproduce PixMob Wave2 and Waveband 2 group-0 RF commands for European 868.415 MHz wristbands. Protocol notes describe OOK timing, 6b/8b field encoding, CRC-12, wake frames and persistent color or OFF packets.
description_zh: 项目为欧洲版 868.415 MHz PixMob Wave2／Waveband 2 腕带生成 Flipper Zero 的 group-0 射频命令。协议笔记记录 OOK 时序、6b/8b 字段编码、CRC-12、唤醒帧及持续颜色和关闭命令。
requirements: European PixMob Wave2 or Waveband 2 hardware and a Flipper Zero with 868.415 MHz transmission permitted are required.
Python 3.10 or newer is needed to rebuild the signal files.
Other regional RF bands are outside the documented release.
MIT license.

name: zkTH06: reconstructing Touhou 6 gameplay transitions
description_en: zkTH06 reconstructs selected Touhou Koumakyou v1.02h gameplay transitions for replay-driven execution in OpenVM. It compares a Linux reference with observations of the shipped Windows game, implements bounded player, bullet, enemy, and item state transitions, and records differential results and proof obligations. The author reports matching projections over specified replay prefixes.
description_zh: zkTH06 为 OpenVM 中的回放驱动执行重建《东方红魔乡》v1.02h 的部分游戏状态转换。项目将 Linux 参考实现与发行版 Windows 游戏的观测结果对照，实现有边界的玩家、弹幕、敌人和道具状态转换，并记录差异结果与待完成的证明义务。作者报告称，指定回放片段中的状态投影相符。
requirements: The comparisons use the Japanese Touhou Koumakyou v1.02h executable and a replay.
Current proof kernels cover bounded gameplay slices; the project identifies further arithmetic and state correspondence obligations.
The reported agreement covers specified replay prefixes and state projections.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: 9mm Vita: rehosting 9mm HD Android on PS Vita
description_en: 9mm Vita ports 9mm HD Android to PS Vita by loading the user's ARMv7 game executable into memory. Its native compatibility layer resolves imports, patches a checked game build and maps Vita controls, while the user's APK and downloaded game data supply the original program and assets.
description_zh: 9mm Vita 将 Android 版 9mm HD 移植到 PS Vita，运行时加载用户提供的 ARMv7 游戏可执行文件。原生兼容层补齐导入函数、对指定版本实施校验过的补丁并映射 Vita 操作；原版程序和资源由用户的 APK 及游戏下载数据提供。
requirements: A Vita or PSTV with custom firmware, VitaShell, kubridge, libshacccg.suprx and about 1.8 GB of free space; FdFix is also required unless rePatch is installed.
A legally obtained ARMv7 APK and downloaded data for the supported Android release.
Title-screen rendering has known defects; multiplayer is untested.
MIT License.

name: Goodix 55a4: reconstructing a Linux fingerprint driver
description_en: The Goodix 55a4 project reconstructs Linux support for the 27c6:55a4 fingerprint sensor through a libfprint patch. Its research combines USB captures with examination of the vendor's Windows driver to document command behavior, image acquisition and host-side matching. Installation scripts provision the sensor key and configure fprintd.
description_zh: Goodix 55a4 项目通过 libfprint 补丁重建 27c6:55a4 指纹传感器的 Linux 支持。研究结合 USB 抓包和厂商 Windows 驱动分析，记录命令行为、图像采集与主机端匹配；安装脚本负责配置 fprintd 并写入传感器密钥。
requirements: Requires a Goodix 27c6:55a4 sensor, Linux, fprintd and the documented build dependencies.
The author reports enrollment and verification on one sensor; other models are not covered by the patch.
The sensor uses a publicly known all-zero TLS pre-shared key, and fprintd stores templates as plain files.
LGPL-2.1 license.

name: timeline-export: decoding Google Maps Timeline sync and place IDs
description_en: timeline-export reconstructs Google Maps Timeline retrieval and decoding to export on-device location history as JSON. It calls Geller BatchSync, decrypts AES-256-GCM payloads, decodes SemanticSegment records and converts stored FeatureId values to Maps place IDs.
description_zh: timeline-export 重建 Google Maps Timeline 的数据获取与解析流程，将设备端位置历史导出为 JSON。它调用 Geller BatchSync，解密 AES-256-GCM 载荷，解析 SemanticSegment 记录，并将存储的 FeatureId 转换为 Maps 地点 ID。
requirements: Requires access to the user's Google account, its Timeline decryption key and the documented Python dependencies.
Some semanticType labels are best-effort; placeTypeCode is emitted without a complete category mapping.
MIT License.

name: allmiibo-sync: reconstructing Pixl.js Bluetooth file synchronization
description_en: allmiibo-sync reconstructs the Pixl.js and AmiiboLink Bluetooth LE virtual filesystem protocol to synchronize folders with NFC emulator devices. Its browser app compares local and device trees, plans transfers and deletions, and uses VFS commands documented from official web clients and checked against firmware.
description_zh: allmiibo-sync 重建 Pixl.js 与 AmiiboLink 设备的 Bluetooth LE 虚拟文件系统协议，以同步本地文件夹和 NFC 模拟器。浏览器应用比较两端目录、规划传输与删除，所用 VFS 命令来自官方网页客户端分析，并与设备固件交叉核对。
requirements: Synchronization requires Chrome or Edge with Web Bluetooth, a compatible Pixl.js or AmiiboLink device, and a page served over HTTPS or http://localhost.
The author reports hardware checks on Pixl.js 2.11.2 and 2.16.0.
The repository contains MIT and GPL-2.0-only licence files.

name: ngp-link: reconstructing the Neo Geo Pocket Color link cable
description_en: ngp-link reconstructs the Neo Geo Pocket Color serial link cable and uses the recovered behavior for browser netplay. A hardware sniffer, ROM disassembler and headless emulator compare real traffic with game link code. The documentation covers UART framing, BIOS COM calls, handshake states and games that drive the serial chip directly.
description_zh: ngp-link 重建 Neo Geo Pocket Color 串行联机线，并用恢复的通信行为实现浏览器联机。硬件嗅探板、ROM 反汇编工具和无界面模拟器将实机流量与游戏联机代码对照；文档涵盖 UART 帧格式、BIOS COM 调用、握手状态及直接操作串行芯片的游戏。
requirements: Requires a user-supplied, legally obtained NGPC ROM for game play and ROM analysis.
Building the WebAssembly core requires Emscripten.
Original code uses MIT, hardware CERN-OHL-P and documentation CC-BY-4.0; vendored emulator and disassembler components retain GPL-2.0 and BSD-3-Clause terms.

name: EBO for Home Assistant: reconstructing Enabot cloud control
description_en: EBO for Home Assistant reconstructs the EBO HOME cloud exchange to control Enabot robots from Home Assistant. Its add-on logs in with the user's account, discovers robots, sends commands through Agora RTM and converts Agora RTC video to an RTSP camera feed. The repository includes request-signing and message-routing tests.
description_zh: EBO for Home Assistant 重建 EBO HOME 的云端通信，使 Home Assistant 能控制 Enabot 机器人。附加组件使用用户账户登录、发现设备，通过 Agora RTM 发送控制消息，并将 Agora RTC 视频转为 RTSP 摄像头画面；仓库还包含请求签名和消息路由测试。
requirements: Requires Home Assistant, an Enabot account, compatible EBO hardware and two app cryptographic keys from the user's EBO HOME installation.
The author identifies EBO Air 2 as supported; other listed cloud-family models remain experimental.
MIT license.

name: dreamREfactory: rebuilding CyberFlix's DreamFactory engine
description_en: dreamREfactory rebuilds CyberFlix's DreamFactory game engine in TypeScript for browser play using the owner's game data. It decodes container formats, interprets scripts and supports titles including Titanic: Adventure Out of Time, Dust, Timelapse and RedJack; executable disassembly supplies logic for Skull Cracker, Lunicus and Jump Raven.
description_zh: dreamREfactory 以 TypeScript 重建 CyberFlix 的 DreamFactory 游戏引擎，使用用户自有游戏数据在浏览器中运行。项目解码容器格式、解释脚本，支持 Titanic: Adventure Out of Time、Dust、Timelapse 和 RedJack 等作品；Skull Cracker、Lunicus 与 Jump Raven 的逻辑则来自可执行文件反汇编。
requirements: A copy of each game's own data files is required for play.
The development setup uses npm workspaces and separate local servers for the games.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: esphome-quietcool: reconstructing QuietCool fan radio control
description_en: esphome-quietcool reconstructs QuietCool fan control over a proprietary 433.92 MHz 2-FSK radio link. Its ESPHome C++ component sends OEM-compatible commands, receives fan status and exposes controls through Home Assistant; the protocol work draws on SDR captures and analysis of two handheld remote firmware dumps.
description_zh: esphome-quietcool 重建 QuietCool 风扇专有的 433.92 MHz 2-FSK 无线控制。ESPHome C++ 组件发送兼容原遥控器的命令、接收风扇状态，并向 Home Assistant 提供控制实体；协议依据 SDR 捕获和两份手持遥控器固件分析得出。
requirements: A supported ESP32 LoRa board, 433 MHz antenna, QuietCool fan, its working OEM remote, ESPHome and Home Assistant are required for deployment.
The maintained C++ configuration targets LilyGO TTGO LoRa32 V2.1 with SX1278; the SX1262 V3 path has not been confirmed on hardware.
MIT License.

name: iM.Master SDK: reconstructing the robot's BLE control protocol
description_en: iM.Master SDK reconstructs the iM.Master toy robot's BLE advertising commands and exposes them through a Python control API. Its protocol notes describe a 14-byte manufacturer payload under company ID 0x53A6, recovered from vendor-app captures, while the driver streams frames through Linux raw HCI to move the robot.
description_zh: iM.Master SDK 还原 iM.Master 玩具机器人的 BLE 广播控制指令，并提供 Python 控制接口。协议文档依据厂商应用的通信捕获，说明公司 ID 0x53A6 下的 14 字节厂商数据；驱动通过 Linux 原始 HCI 持续发送指令以控制移动。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer; moving the iM.Master robot requires Linux raw BLE HCI, in practice a Raspberry Pi run as root.
The protocol layer can build and decode frames without hardware on Windows, macOS, or Linux.
MIT license.

name: vibes-api: reconstructing vibes.ai generation APIs
description_en: vibes-api reconstructs parts of the vibes.ai web API in a Python client and CLI. The author used browser traffic, Next.js bundle analysis and direct endpoint probes to document batch creation, generation polling, authentication and media workflows.
description_zh: vibes-api 将 vibes.ai 网站的部分 API 流程重建为 Python 客户端和 CLI。作者结合浏览器流量、Next.js 脚本分析及接口探测，整理批次创建、生成结果轮询、鉴权和媒体操作。
requirements: Python 3.8+ and a vibes.ai session cookie.
MIT License.

name: QuietCool ESPHome: reconstructing IT-AF-SMT BLE control
description_en: QuietCool ESPHome replaces firmware on the IT-AF-SMT attic-fan controller and reimplements its stock BLE interface so the vendor app can still control the hub. Its protocol reference draws on analysis of the OEM firmware, Android app, and live BLE captures, while the new firmware adds Wi-Fi and Home Assistant control.
description_zh: QuietCool ESPHome 为 IT-AF-SMT 阁楼风扇控制器提供替代固件，并重建原厂 BLE 接口，使厂商应用仍可控制设备。协议文档依据原厂固件、Android 应用及实时 BLE 抓包分析；新固件另提供 Wi-Fi 和 Home Assistant 控制。
requirements: A QuietCool IT-AF-SMT Smart Attic Fan Control hub.
Historical analytics charts and AirControl Venting Assist are unimplemented; the browser installer does not support iOS or iPadOS.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: PumpSaver Plus: decoding the relay's infrared broadcast
description_en: A protocol reference and Python decoder reconstruct the baseband infrared register broadcast of SymCom and Littelfuse PumpSaver Plus pump-protection relays. It maps 32-bit words to voltage, current, power, settings, counters and fault history, with sample captures and decoder tests.
description_zh: 该协议参考和 Python 解码器还原 SymCom／Littelfuse PumpSaver Plus 水泵保护继电器的基带红外寄存器广播，将 32 位字解析为电压、电流、功率、设置、计数器和故障历史，并附采样与解码测试。
requirements: A baseband IR edge capture is required; a 38 kHz demodulating receiver cannot capture this carrierless signal.
Python 3.10 or newer is required for the decoder.
Several configuration registers and fault-code names remain candidates.
MIT license.

name: Mazda MX-5 ND3: mapping OBD-II PIDs and responses
description_en: Mazda MX-5 ND3 OBD-II PID Research maps diagnostic responses from a 2025 MX-5 RF Club. It records Mode 01 and manufacturer-specific Mode 22 PIDs, decoding formulas, observed values and range-scan results gathered through an OBDLink MX+ adapter.
description_zh: Mazda MX-5 ND3 OBD-II PID Research 梳理 2025 款 MX-5 RF Club 的诊断响应，记录 Mode 01 与厂商专用 Mode 22 PID、解码公式、观测值及通过 OBDLink MX+ 获得的范围扫描结果。
requirements: A Mazda MX-5 ND3 and an OBDLink MX+ adapter were used for the documented observations.
The exact gear-status value mapping remains unresolved.
No licence file in the repository.

name: GunBound Java Emulator: reconstructing Thor's Hammer servers
description_en: GunBound Java Emulator recreates Broker, Game, and Buddy services for the Thor's Hammer versions of GunBound using Java and Netty. It documents the client protocol's packet framing, command opcodes, AES-based session encryption, and sequence checks, with handlers for authentication, lobbies, rooms, gameplay, and friends.
description_zh: GunBound Java Emulator 使用 Java 和 Netty 重建 GunBound Thor's Hammer 版本的 Broker、Game 和 Buddy 服务。项目记录客户端协议的数据包封装、操作码、基于 AES 的会话加密及序列校验，并实现认证、大厅、房间、对战和好友功能。
requirements: GunBound Thor's Hammer client, specifically GIS v376 or GBS v404.
Java 21 and MariaDB or MySQL.
MIT License.

name: QUII Helper: reconstructing Qualvision intercom communication
description_en: QUII Helper reconstructs communication with QUII and Qualvision video intercoms in a Python client for snapshots, video, RTSP forwarding, device inspection, and door commands. Its protocol notes map LAN TCP setup, encrypted play, media handling, and cloud preview flow to behavior found in inspected app builds.
description_zh: QUII Helper 还原 QUII 和 Qualvision 视频对讲设备的通信流程，提供抓图、录像、RTSP 转发、设备信息查询及开门指令的 Python 客户端。协议笔记将局域网 TCP 建连、加密播放、媒体处理和云端预览流程与所分析应用版本中的行为对应。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer and a supported QUII or Qualvision device.
LAN playback requires a device IP address and saved stream key/auth pair; first-run key acquisition uses configured cloud account and app values.
LAN talk and archive downloads are experimental; support varies by device and firmware.
MIT license.

name: KlipschRemote: reconstructing Klipsch speaker control and update protocols
description_en: KlipschRemote implements Bluetooth LE control of Klipsch The Fives, Sevens and Nines speakers through desktop, CLI, Python and browser clients. Its protocol documentation describes the shared GATT control service and an investigation of the Fives Updater Android app that maps a separate GAIA/RFCOMM firmware-update exchange. The client controls volume, inputs, equalization and device settings.
description_zh: KlipschRemote 通过桌面应用、命令行、Python 库和浏览器客户端，以 Bluetooth LE 控制 Klipsch The Fives、Sevens 和 Nines 音箱。协议文档记录共用 GATT 控制服务，并分析 The Fives Updater Android 应用，梳理独立的 GAIA/RFCOMM 固件更新流程；客户端可调节音量、输入源、均衡器和设备设置。
requirements: Requires a supported Klipsch speaker paired with the host as a Bluetooth audio device; the browser client needs Web Bluetooth support.
The firmware-update protocol is documented as a reference; flashing is outside the library's implementation.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: AirMini Sync: reconstructing ResMed AirMini telemetry sync
description_en: AirMini Sync reconstructs the ResMed AirMini telemetry exchange in an Android client that retrieves and exports sleep records as JSON. Its protocol reference describes Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM transport, a Diffie-Hellman pairing exchange, encrypted JSON-RPC requests and notifications, and therapy log streams.
description_zh: AirMini Sync 通过 Android 客户端重建 ResMed AirMini 的遥测交换流程，读取睡眠记录并导出为 JSON。协议文档记录了 Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM 传输、Diffie-Hellman 配对、加密 JSON-RPC 请求与通知，以及治疗日志的数据流。
requirements: A ResMed AirMini, its four-digit PIN, and an Android device with Bluetooth are needed for data retrieval.
Building the Android app requires JDK 21 and Android SDK command-line tools; the app targets Android 12 or newer.
No licence file in the repository.

name: OpenNord: reconstructing Nord Stage file and USB transfer formats
description_en: OpenNord reconstructs Nord Stage program handling and USB transfer in a keyboard companion app. It reads Stage 2, 3 and 4 program files through a shared CBIN container and model codecs, and uses a recovered vendor bulk USB protocol to enumerate devices and transfer programs. Sample readers and a local library support inspection and playback.
description_zh: OpenNord 在键盘配套应用中重建 Nord Stage 音色程序处理与 USB 传输。它通过共用 CBIN 容器和型号编解码器读取 Stage 2、3、4 文件，并使用恢复的厂商 bulk USB 协议枚举设备、传输程序；样本读取器和本地资料库还支持查看与试听。
requirements: Requires compatible Nord Stage files or hardware; USB transfer is available on desktop and supported iPad hardware.
The author reports Stage 4 decoding and two-way Stage 4 USB transfer validated on hardware; other Nord families remain planned.
Writing a program overwrites the keyboard slot, so back up the keyboard first.
AGPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: OpenStrap research: reconstructing WHOOP 4.0 BLE data access
description_en: OpenStrap research reconstructs WHOOP 4.0 BLE framing, history synchronization and sensor-record decoding. Its Python research client can scan and connect to a band, stream heart rate and motion, drain history, decode frames and replay saved captures.
description_zh: OpenStrap research 重建 WHOOP 4.0 的 BLE 帧格式、历史同步和传感器记录解码。其 Python 研究客户端可扫描并连接腕带、传输心率和运动数据、读取历史、解码帧并回放已保存的抓取数据。
requirements: A WHOOP 4.0 band and bleak for live Bluetooth operations.
Most fields beyond the 1 Hz record header remain empirical or unknown.
MIT License.

name: fpdrv: reconstructing Synaptics 06cb:00e7 fingerprint communication
description_en: fpdrv reconstructs communication with the Synaptics 06cb:00e7 fingerprint sensor as a Linux userspace driver, libfprint TOD module and diagnostic CLI. It implements host pairing and a TLS-like encrypted session for on-chip enrollment and matching. Its protocol notes map USB endpoints and captured connection flows.
description_zh: fpdrv 将 Synaptics 06cb:00e7 指纹传感器的通信流程重建为 Linux 用户态驱动、libfprint TOD 模块和诊断命令行工具。它实现主机配对及类似 TLS 的加密会话，用于芯片内录入和匹配；协议笔记记录了 USB 端点与抓包所得的连接流程。
requirements: Requires a Synaptics 06cb:00e7 sensor, libfprint with TOD support, fprintd and the listed C development libraries.
The author reports enrollment, verification and login working on an HP Envy x360 13-ay0001nd; other 00e7 variants may need adjustment.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: PixyPilot: reconstructing EMEET PIXY camera control on Linux
description_en: PixyPilot implements Linux control of the EMEET PIXY camera using V4L2 ioctls and decoded vendor HID commands. Its research documents HID report layouts, captured commands, and UVC extension-unit investigation, while the app provides PTZ controls, preview, recording, and capture import.
description_zh: PixyPilot 通过 V4L2 ioctl 和已解析的厂商 HID 命令控制 EMEET PIXY 相机。项目记录 HID 报告布局、抓包命令和 UVC 扩展单元调查，并提供 PTZ 控制、预览、录制及抓包导入。
requirements: Ubuntu 24.04 or later and an EMEET PIXY camera; HID smart controls need write access to its hidraw node.
Raw UVC extension-unit selectors remain read-only while their meanings are investigated.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Prismatic: reconstructing SteelSeries Arena 7 RGB control
description_en: Prismatic reconstructs the SteelSeries Arena 7 speaker lighting exchange in a macOS menu bar app. It sends USB HID output report 0x06 with commands and RGB values for four zones, using a layout recovered from SteelSeries GG USBPcap traffic. The app controls left and right colors, brightness and power.
description_zh: Prismatic 在 macOS 菜单栏应用中重建 SteelSeries Arena 7 音箱的灯光通信。它发送 HID 输出报告 0x06，以抓取 SteelSeries GG USB 流量所得的格式设置四个区域的 RGB 值与命令，并控制左右颜色、亮度和开关。
requirements: Requires macOS 14+ and SteelSeries Arena 7 speakers connected by USB.
Building from source requires full Xcode.
MIT license.

name: Neverness to Everness: mapping a TCP connection's records
description_en: This investigation maps one Neverness to Everness TCP connection from locally captured PCAPs. Python scripts decode length-prefixed frames, FlatBuffers messages and player or quest records; the documented connection may cover login and initialization rather than live gameplay.
description_zh: 该研究依据本地 PCAP 分析《异环》的一条 TCP 连接。Python 脚本解析长度前缀帧、FlatBuffers 消息以及玩家和任务记录；所记录的连接可能主要用于登录和初始化。
requirements: Locally captured PCAP traffic and Python with scapy are required to run the decoders.
Findings cover one TCP connection; the author did not capture or analyse UDP traffic.
No licence file in the repository.

name: superstrike-hits-linux: reconstructing Logitech HITS controls
description_en: A Linux Python CLI uses the reconstructed HID++ HITS feature of the Logitech G PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE mouse to read and set per-button click haptics and actuation points. Protocol notes derive feature 0x1B0C and its report fields from G HUB USB captures and device probing.
description_zh: 该 Linux Python 工具使用还原的 Logitech G PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE 鼠标 HID++ HITS 功能，读取和设置左右键的点击触觉反馈与触发行程。协议笔记依据 G HUB USB 抓包和设备探测记录 0x1B0C 功能及报文字段。
requirements: A SUPERSTRIKE mouse, Python 3 and Linux are required. Wireless use requires a paired LIGHTSPEED receiver; wired/direct connection should also work.
The rapid-trigger subfield semantics remain unknown; automatic reapplication needs a user-configured hook.
MIT license.

name: ReadyNAS RN426: reconstructing front-panel control under TrueNAS
description_en: The ReadyNAS RN426 panel project reconstructs front-panel control from NETGEAR's stock firmware so the LCD and navigation buttons work under TrueNAS SCALE. Its Python driver bit-bangs the SSD1305-class display through Denverton GPIO registers and reads button state from an MSP430 over SMBus when its interrupt fires.
description_zh: ReadyNAS RN426 面板项目根据 NETGEAR 原厂固件重建前面板控制，使 LCD 和导航按键可在 TrueNAS SCALE 下工作。Python 驱动通过 Denverton GPIO 位操作驱动 SSD1305 类显示屏，并在中断触发时经 SMBus 读取 MSP430 的按键状态。
requirements: ReadyNAS RN426 or RN428 with TrueNAS SCALE is the working target; RN422/RN424 and other listed models are experimental.
Python 3, Pillow, DejaVu fonts, i2c-dev and i2c-i801 are required for the stated TrueNAS setup.
MIT License.

name: ankiweb-cli: reconstructing AnkiWeb's protobuf card API
description_en: ankiweb-cli reconstructs AnkiWeb's internal protobuf service requests for deck and card operations. Its Python CLI obtains separate cookies for ankiweb.net and ankiuser.net, encodes length-delimited messages with a small codec, and offers deck creation, card editing and search through those endpoints.
description_zh: ankiweb-cli 重建 AnkiWeb 内部 protobuf 服务请求，用于牌组和卡片操作。Python CLI 分别取得 ankiweb.net 与 ankiuser.net 的会话 Cookie，以小型编解码器处理长度分隔消息，并通过相关端点创建牌组、编辑卡片和搜索内容。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later and the owner's AnkiWeb credentials are required.
The endpoints are private and may change.
MIT License.

name: AT2 HT: reconstructing Baofeng AT2 BLE control and messaging
description_en: AT2 HT implements the Baofeng ALERVITES AT2 radio's BLE control and off-network messaging in an Android app. It supports channel programming, messages and PTT, and replaces voice encoding with OpenCORE-AMR MR475 and image processing with a Go implementation compared against the original library.
description_zh: AT2 HT 在 Android 应用中实现 Baofeng ALERVITES AT2 对讲机的 BLE 控制与离网消息协议，支持信道设置、消息和 PTT。语音编码使用 OpenCORE-AMR MR475，图像处理采用与原库输出比对的 Go 实现。
requirements: A Baofeng ALERVITES AT2 and an Android 8.1 or newer device with BLE, audio and location capability are required.
USB-C programming, firmware updates and full RF air-interface decoding are outside the project scope.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: Empatica E4 wristband: decoding BLE telemetry
description_en: Empatica E4 wristband work reconstructs the device's BLE telemetry flow and provides a local recorder and decoder for accelerometer, skin temperature, electrodermal activity, and raw photoplethysmogram data. It documents GATT services and packet layouts, preserves raw packets, and writes decoded sensor readings to CSV.
description_zh: Empatica E4 wristband 项目重建腕带的 BLE 遥测流程，提供本地采集与解码程序，处理加速度、皮肤温度、皮电活动和原始光电容积脉搏波数据。文档记录 GATT 服务和数据包格式；程序保留原始数据包，并将解码结果写入 CSV。
requirements: An owned Empatica E4 wristband and Bluetooth are required.
Python 3.11 or newer is required; the launcher installs bleak and pyusb on first run.
The PPG packing is tentative, and its original packet bytes are preserved for later decoding.
MIT license.

name: Polylux: reconstructing ASUS ROG device control
description_en: Polylux implements Windows control of ASUS ROG AniMe Matrix, LiveDash OLED, Ryujin LCD, Aura RGB, and fan hardware. It documents USB protocols decoded from Armoury Crate captures and combines direct device drivers with OpenRGB and LibreHardwareMonitor interfaces.
description_zh: Polylux 在 Windows 上控制 ASUS ROG 的 AniMe Matrix、LiveDash OLED、Ryujin LCD、Aura RGB 和风扇硬件。项目记录从 Armoury Crate 抓包解析的 USB 协议，并结合直接设备驱动、OpenRGB 与 LibreHardwareMonitor 接口。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11; the documented hardware test rig is a ROG Maximus Z690 Extreme.
Ryujin II 360 custom image upload and support for other ASUS motherboards remain untested.
MIT License.

name: AK820 Pro Modder: reconstructing keyboard HID control on macOS
description_en: AK820 Pro Modder implements macOS control of the Epomaker and Ajazz AK820 Pro keyboard through a Rust HID protocol library shared by a Tauri app and CLI. Its protocol notes distinguish two firmware families and document commands for lighting, keymaps, macros, the TFT display, and device settings.
description_zh: AK820 Pro Modder 通过 Rust HID 协议库在 macOS 上控制 Epomaker/Ajazz AK820 Pro 键盘，Tauri 应用与 CLI 共用该库。协议文档区分两类固件接口，并记录灯效、键位映射、宏、TFT 显示屏和设备设置命令。
requirements: macOS 11 or later and an AK820 Pro keyboard; building requires Rust 1.90 or later, Node.js 22, and pnpm 10.
The author reports testing most features on one ISO-DE keyboard with firmware 1.07; family-B support has not been tested on this build.
Family-B onboard key remapping and macros remain undecoded; JIS layout is unsupported.
MIT License.

name: dj-midi-sender: reconstructing Pro DJ Link tempo exchange
description_en: dj-midi-sender reconstructs the Pioneer Pro DJ Link tempo exchange and bridges it to MIDI clock. A shared C++ parser and state machine read beat and status packets, track the tempo master and drive a 24 PPQN clock on desktop or ESP32-S3 hardware. The repository includes packet captures, protocol offsets and replay tools.
description_zh: dj-midi-sender 重建 Pioneer Pro DJ Link 的节拍通信并转换为 MIDI 时钟。共用 C++ 解析器和状态机读取 beat、status 报文，跟踪节拍主设备，并在桌面端或 ESP32-S3 硬件上产生 24 PPQN 时钟；仓库提供抓包、字段偏移记录及回放工具。
requirements: Hardware operation requires an ESP32-S3 with W5500 Ethernet and MIDI output hardware; the desktop build uses the listed CMake and MIDI dependencies.
The author reports live tempo-master handoff tests with XDJ-XZ and XDJ-700; committed captures contain beat packets only.
PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0.

name: Dahua IP cameras: mapping the device JSON-RPC API
description_en: The Dahua IP camera and NVR investigation maps device JSON-RPC endpoints, request structure and two-step authentication from internal JavaScript.
