Module references cover control, configuration, media, events and maintenance methods, with a Python script for login and method discovery.
description_zh: Dahua IP 摄像机与 NVR 调查依据设备内置 JavaScript 梳理 JSON-RPC 端点、请求结构和两步鉴权。模块文档覆盖控制、配置、媒体、事件及维护方法，并附 Python 登录与方法发现脚本。
requirements: Live queries require access to a Dahua camera or NVR and its login credentials.
Method availability depends on device firmware and abilities.
MIT License.

name: Wellue O2Ring-S: reconstructing the OxyII BLE protocol
description_en: A protocol study and Python client reconstruct the OxyII Bluetooth LE link used by the Wellue O2Ring-S T8520 pulse oximeter. It documents GATT characteristics, framing, CRC-8 and commands for device information, live SpO2 and heart rate, and stored-file transfer.
description_zh: 该研究与 Python 客户端还原 Wellue O2Ring-S T8520 血氧仪使用的 OxyII BLE 链路，记录 GATT 特征、帧格式、CRC-8，以及设备信息、实时血氧和心率、历史文件传输命令。
requirements: A Wellue O2Ring-S T8520 and a Bluetooth LE connection are required.
Real-time waveform and PPG sample data have not been decoded or validated; OTA remains unexercised.
MIT license.

name: Blackmacro-lib: reconstructing the Speed Editor USB HID exchange
description_en: Blackmacro-lib reconstructs the Blackmagic Speed Editor USB HID exchange in reference MicroPython firmware. It documents report sequences and authentication research, enabling a HID-capable microcontroller to present Speed Editor controls to DaVinci Resolve.
description_zh: Blackmacro-lib 以 MicroPython 参考固件重建 Blackmagic Speed Editor 的 USB HID 交互。项目记录报告序列和鉴权研究，使支持 HID 的微控制器能够向 DaVinci Resolve 提供 Speed Editor 控件。
requirements: A HID-capable microcontroller such as a Raspberry Pi Pico 2W and the repository's modified MicroPython USB library.
Bluetooth and iOS operation are not implemented.
GNU AGPLv3 is stated in the README; no licence file is in the repository.

name: libfprint Goodix SPI Driver: reconstructing GDIX51C0 support
description_en: libfprint Goodix SPI Driver reconstructs support for the Goodix GDIX51C0 fingerprint sensor on Linux. It combines SPI transport, session and capture handling with a native ChicagoHS host-side biometric matcher, integrated through libfprint and fprintd patches. The source includes protocol research, algorithm comparison tools and deterministic tests.
description_zh: libfprint Goodix SPI Driver 重建 Linux 对 Goodix GDIX51C0 指纹传感器的支持。项目实现 SPI 传输、会话和图像采集，以及原生 ChicagoHS 主机端生物识别匹配器，并通过补丁接入 libfprint 与 fprintd；仓库还包含协议研究、算法对照工具和确定性测试。
requirements: Requires a GDIX51C0 sensor exposed through Linux spidev; the documented defaults were hardware-tested on a Huawei MateBook 16s.
Integration targets libfprint v1.94.10 and fprintd v1.94.5, with the listed build dependencies.
This is a pre-release; other laptops may need GPIO overrides.
Original project source is LGPL-2.1-or-later; adapted files and patches retain their stated upstream licenses.

name: Firestaff: rebuilding the Dungeon Master game engines
description_en: Firestaff rebuilds runtime paths for Dungeon Master, Chaos Strikes Back, Dungeon Master II and Theron's Quest using original media supplied by the player. It identifies editions by content hash and keeps their data separate from its native engine. Source-linked reports and regression checks document supported startup and gameplay slices; Nexus currently reaches a limited Saturn title presentation path.
description_zh: Firestaff 使用玩家提供的原版游戏数据，重建《Dungeon Master》《Chaos Strikes Back》《Dungeon Master II》和《Theron's Quest》的部分运行流程。它按内容哈希识别版本，并将游戏数据与原生引擎分开；基于原始游戏资料的报告和回归检查记录已支持的启动及玩法范围。Nexus 目前只能有限呈现 Saturn 版的标题画面。
requirements: Requires the user's original game media; supported editions are identified by content hash.
The author reports bounded runtime coverage for four titles; Nexus is not yet playable, and campaign, save and visual parity remain in progress.
MIT license.

name: Insta360 GO Ultra: reconstructing its Wi-Fi camera protocol
description_en: A Python toolkit and protocol study reconstruct Insta360 GO Ultra control over Wi-Fi TCP port 6666. The protocol notes document length-prefixed protobuf command packets and H.265 video frames; the repository includes scripts for live preview and packet probing.
description_zh: 该 Python 工具及协议研究还原 Insta360 GO Ultra 在 Wi-Fi TCP 6666 端口上的控制方式。协议文档记录带长度前缀的 protobuf 命令包和 H.265 视频帧；仓库提供实时预览和报文探测脚本。
requirements: An Insta360 GO Ultra connected over its Wi-Fi network is required.
The scripts require protobuf 3.20.3 and pb2 definitions from RigacciOrg/insta360-wifi-api; live preview uses an HEVC-capable player.
Native file download and unknown packet types remain on the roadmap.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Chuwi CoreBook X: recovering the left-speaker audio path on Linux
description_en: A Linux userspace daemon restores the Chuwi CoreBook X left speaker by configuring its AW88298 amplifier over I2C and mirroring the Conexant SN6180 HDA stream. The investigation documents the hidden I2S route, register behavior, volume mirroring and suspend recovery.
description_zh: 该 Linux 用户空间守护进程通过 I2C 配置 AW88298 功放并镜像 Conexant SN6180 HDA 音频流，恢复 Chuwi CoreBook X 左扬声器。研究记录了隐藏的 I2S 路径、寄存器行为、音量同步和休眠恢复。
requirements: A Chuwi CoreBook X with the described SN6180 and AW88298 audio hardware is required.
Linux HDA support, alsa-tools, i2c-tools and systemd are required.
The kernel patch is still in progress.
GPL-2.0-or-later license.

name: GNR-SMU: mapping Ryzen SMU telemetry and controls
description_en: GNR-SMU maps undocumented AMD Ryzen SMU power-management tables through hardware measurements, load experiments and Linux sensor comparisons. It publishes model-specific field maps and Linux telemetry tools, with guarded controls for Granite Ridge CPUs and read-only telemetry for the Vermeer 5600X.
description_zh: GNR-SMU 通过硬件测量、负载实验及 Linux 传感器对照，解析 AMD Ryzen SMU 未公开的电源管理表。项目发布分型号字段映射和 Linux 遥测工具，为 Granite Ridge 处理器提供受限控制，为 Vermeer 5600X 提供只读遥测。
requirements: Requires Linux, the ryzen_smu driver and a documented CPU profile: 9800X3D, 9950X3D or 5600X.
SMU writes are limited to validated Granite Ridge profiles; the 5600X profile is read-only.
Many PM-table fields remain unidentified; the author reports measuring the complete 9800X3D index map on one machine.
MIT License.

name: Freelancer.Reverse.Runtime: reconstructing the game's dacom.dll interface
description_en: Freelancer.Reverse.Runtime reconstructs part of Freelancer (2003)'s runtime DLL interface through a compatible dacom.dll proxy. The proxy loads the original module, forwards exports, and logs calls associated with hashing, string comparison, telemetry, and initialization; the author reports using it in a running game.
description_zh: Freelancer.Reverse.Runtime 通过兼容的 dacom.dll 代理模块还原 Freelancer（2003）的部分运行时 DLL 接口。代理加载原模块、转发导出函数并记录哈希、字符串比较、内部日志和初始化相关调用；作者报告已在游戏运行过程中观察到这些调用。
requirements: A Windows x86 environment and the original Freelancer (2003) installation.
Building requires Microsoft Visual C++ Toolkit 2003 / VC71 and the Windows Server 2003 R2 Platform SDK.
The implemented reconstruction currently centers on dacom.dll; other system DLLs remain future work.
MIT license.

name: LIBREPODS-RS: rebuilding AirPods AAP control in Rust
description_en: LIBREPODS-RS implements the AirPods Apple Accessory Protocol in Rust over Bluetooth L2CAP. Its core parses and builds AAP packets and decodes BLE advertisements, while Linux and Windows backends support battery status, noise modes, ear detection, and media actions; the project credits LibrePods as an inspiration and protocol reference.
description_zh: LIBREPODS-RS 以 Rust 在 Bluetooth L2CAP 上实现 AirPods Apple Accessory Protocol。核心模块解析和构造 AAP 数据包、解码 BLE 广播；Linux 与 Windows 后端支持电量状态、降噪模式、入耳检测和媒体操作。项目注明参考 LibrePods。
requirements: AirPods and a Linux or Windows system with a working Bluetooth adapter; building requires the Rust toolchain.
The author reports testing AirPods Pro 2 variants; other listed models are expected but untested.
Windows volume control and manual audio routing are unimplemented.
AGPL-3.0-only License.

name: aqi-liberator: decoding aqicn.org historical air-quality data
description_en: aqi-liberator decodes the proprietary historical air-quality series delivered to aqicn.org's web client. Its Python CLI fetches or reads saved SSE data, applies the documented delta and repeat encoding, and exports pollutant values as CSV or JSON.
description_zh: aqi-liberator 解码 aqicn.org 网页客户端接收的专有历史空气质量序列。Python 命令行工具可抓取或读取已保存的 SSE 数据，按文档记录的差分与重复编码还原污染物数值，并导出 CSV 或 JSON。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer is required.
Fetching requires a station ID; decoding accepts a saved SSE file or an encoded string from stdin.
MIT license.

name: Blue Star AC → ESPHome: reconstructing the Wi-Fi port protocol
description_en: Blue Star AC → ESPHome reconstructs the UART protocol of Blue Star smart-ready air conditioners and implements local control on an ESP32-C3. Its ESPHome component completes the Tuya MCU handshake, exchanges Blue Star DP101 key/value records and exposes climate controls to Home Assistant for tested IE518TNUR and IA318MXU models.
description_zh: Blue Star AC → ESPHome 重建 Blue Star 预留 Wi-Fi 接口空调的 UART 协议，并通过 ESP32-C3 实现本地控制。自定义 ESPHome 组件完成 Tuya MCU 握手、交换 Blue Star DP101 键值记录，为已测试的 IE518TNUR 和 IA318MXU 机型接入 Home Assistant 空调控制。
requirements: A tested Blue Star IE518TNUR or IA318MXU unit with an ESP32-C3, 4-pin connector and voltage divider.
ESPHome 2026.10 with the ESP-IDF framework.
Other Blue Star models are unconfirmed.
MIT license.

name: Wolfenstein (2009) SP: reconstructing the single-player engine
description_en: Wolfenstein (2009) SP rebuilds single-player engine behavior in C++ on idTech4A++, using game data from the user's PC copy. It implements SP PK4, SPK and MPK readers and native tests for player, MP40, actor and trainyard behavior; research notes record findings from the original executables.
description_zh: Wolfenstein (2009) SP 基于 idTech4A++，用 C++ 重建单人模式引擎行为，并读取用户自备的 PC 版游戏数据。项目实现 SP PK4、SPK 和 MPK 读取器，分别测试玩家、MP40、脚本驱动的角色动画和 trainyard 场景行为；研究笔记记录了对原版可执行文件的分析结果。
requirements: A PC copy of Wolfenstein (2009) game data; the repository and APK contain no original archives or binaries.
Android is the first target; Node.js 22+ is needed for inventory tests.
Early development: the full campaign and any complete mission remain unsupported.
GPL-3.0-or-later license for project code.

name: SACD daemon reconstruction: rebuilding Sony BDP-BX510 sacd_extract_160
description_en: SACD daemon reconstruction rebuilds Sony BDP-BX510's ARM sacd_extract_160 daemon in C. It documents TCP 2002 sector requests and the CPSA ioctl path, and supplies function-diff tools, QEMU device models and differential captures. The author reports 388 of 390 functions equivalent and byte-identical wire behavior in tested cases.
description_zh: SACD daemon reconstruction 用 C 语言重建 Sony BDP-BX510 的 ARM 守护进程 sacd_extract_160。项目记录 TCP 2002 扇区请求及 CPSA ioctl 路径，提供函数差异比较工具、QEMU 设备模型和对照捕获；作者报告 390 个函数中有 388 个达到等价，并在所测场景中得到字节一致的网络行为。
requirements: A dump from the user's own BDP-BX510 for binary comparison; an ARM cross-compiler for building.
The author reports 388/390 function equivalence in the reconstruction.
MIT license for project code.

name: Holy Stone H120D: reconstructing drone Wi-Fi control and video traffic
description_en: Holy Stone H120D research maps the drone’s Wi-Fi command, camera and video exchanges using APK decompilation, packet captures and ARM library disassembly. It documents UDP 8080 control frames, UDP 8088 camera commands and H.264 video on TCP 8888, with Python clients and an Arduino controller sketch.
description_zh: Holy Stone H120D 研究通过 APK 反编译、抓包和 ARM 库反汇编解析无人机 Wi-Fi 控制、相机及视频通信。项目记录 UDP 8080 控制帧、UDP 8088 相机命令与 TCP 8888 上的 H.264 视频流，并提供 Python 客户端和 Arduino 控制程序。
requirements: A Holy Stone H120D drone and connection to its Wi-Fi network; Python 3.8+ for the scripts.
ffplay is required for the live video example; Arduino Nano 33 IoT is used by the autonomous controller sketch.
Variable joystick-axis control over Wi-Fi remains untested at high confidence.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Intel NUC M15 Light Bar Control for Linux: reconstructing WMI lighting commands
description_en: Intel NUC M15 Light Bar Control for Linux reconstructs the WMI commands used to set the laptop's front RGB light bar. A kernel helper invokes the F351 WMI transport, while Python tools send 0x0603 packets and expose named lighting states. The research notes map packet bytes to function, state, speed and brightness fields.
description_zh: Intel NUC M15 Light Bar Control for Linux 重建笔记本前部 RGB 灯条的 WMI 控制指令。内核辅助模块调用 F351 WMI 通道，Python 工具发送 0x0603 数据包并提供具名灯效；研究笔记列出功能、状态、速度和亮度字段。
requirements: Intel NUC M15 or compatible tested Uniwill laptop revision running Linux.
Matching kernel headers and make are required to build the kernel helper.
Earlier HID-based light-bar revisions may behave differently.
MIT License.

name: Nokia E7-00 Linux: reconstructing the boot chain and device interfaces
description_en: Nokia E7-00 Linux investigates the phone's boot chain and hardware interfaces to build QEMU models and a Linux port. Its notes cover NLoader, OneNAND, GPIO, display transport, USB and memory-card control, supported by probe outputs and kernel code. The author reports a Linux shell in emulation while physical-device bring-up remains in progress.
description_zh: Nokia E7-00 Linux 研究手机启动链和硬件接口，用于构建 QEMU 模型及 Linux 移植。资料覆盖 NLoader、OneNAND、GPIO、显示传输、USB 和存储卡控制，并附探测输出与内核代码。作者报告模拟环境已进入 Linux shell，实机启动仍在推进。
requirements: Nokia E7-00 RM-626 hardware and its own firmware images are the project targets.
The author reports end-to-end boot to a Linux shell in QEMU; physical Linux bring-up remains future work.
Symbian SDK components retain their original licenses; the repository LICENSE file is MIT.

name: libfprint-microarray: reconstructing the MAFP fingerprint reader USB protocol
description_en: libfprint-microarray reconstructs the USB control workflow of the MicroarrayTechnology MAFP fingerprint reader as a Linux libfprint driver. Analysis of MicroarrayFingerprintDevice.dll and USB captures informs its handshake, image polling, fingerprint enrollment and verification commands. The author reports successful enrollment and verification on a physical 3274:8012 device.
description_zh: libfprint-microarray 将 MicroarrayTechnology MAFP 指纹读取器的 USB 控制流程重建为 Linux libfprint 驱动。项目通过分析 MicroarrayFingerprintDevice.dll 和 USB 抓包，整理握手、图像轮询、指纹录入与验证指令。作者报告在 3274:8012 实机上完成录入和验证。
requirements: MicroarrayTechnology MAFP fingerprint reader with USB ID 3274:8012 and a libfprint source tree.
The author reports enrollment and verification on real hardware.
Enrollment skips clearing stored templates when free FID slots are available; identify search is not implemented.
MIT License.

name: ntrig-calib: reconstructing Surface Pro 3 digitizer calibration
description_en: ntrig-calib reconstructs the Surface Pro 3 N-Trig digitizer's calibration exchange as a Linux Python script. The project describes Ghidra analysis of CalibG4.exe and NCPTransportInterface.dll, including NCP framing, START_CALIB and GET_STATUS commands and HID report transport. The author reports a working fix on one device while documenting uncertain response behavior and calibration longevity.
description_zh: ntrig-calib 将 Surface Pro 3 的 N-Trig 数字化仪校准流程重建为 Linux Python 脚本。项目记录对 CalibG4.exe 和 NCPTransportInterface.dll 的 Ghidra 分析，涵盖 NCP 帧格式、START_CALIB 与 GET_STATUS 指令及 HID 报告传输。作者报告单台设备修复成功，同时指出响应行为和校准持久性仍有不确定性。
requirements: Surface Pro 3 with an N-Trig DuoSense digitizer running Linux.
The author reports success on one device; the NCP response path has not been checked across multiple devices or kernel versions.
Calibration may drift again, and success conditions are not fully understood.
AGPL-3.0 License.

name: even-utils: experimenting with Even Realities G1 dashboard messages
description_en: even-utils explores the Even Realities G1 glasses protocol through an Android app. It builds custom Dashboard Map images and News source, text, creation and deletion messages, with BLE packet classes for these exchanges; navigation and standalone connection maintenance remain future work.
description_zh: even-utils 通过 Android 应用探索 Even Realities G1 眼镜协议。项目构造自定义仪表板地图图像，以及新闻来源、文本、新建和删除消息，并提供相应 BLE 报文类；导航和独立维持连接仍待实现。
requirements: Even Realities G1 glasses and an Android device.
Patch the original app to stop Map/News updates, or add periodic basic Dashboard messages to prevent disconnection.
No licence file in the repository.

name: CTS Strasbourg Ticket Reader: mapping SRI512 ticket memory
description_en: CTS Strasbourg Ticket Reader maps the SRI512 memory used by Strasbourg CTS paper tickets and provides a C utility to read and decode it through libnfc. The documented fields include ticket type, validity counter, validator ID and last-validation time.
description_zh: CTS Strasbourg Ticket Reader 解析斯特拉斯堡 CTS 纸质车票所用的 SRI512 芯片存储区，并提供通过 libnfc 读取和解码的 C 程序。文档列出票种、有效次数计数器、验票机编号和最近一次验票时间等字段。
requirements: A Strasbourg CTS contactless paper ticket, a libnfc-compatible NFC reader and Linux.
libnfc and gcc are needed to build the utility; hardware access requires root privileges.
No licence file in the repository.

name: waze-stuff: mapping Waze tile formats
description_en: waze-stuff investigates Waze map-tile files through hex patterns and Python, TypeScript and C code for parsing and partial tile generation. It documents WZM/MAP_PKG, WZDF and WZT structures, including geometry, street labels and tile coordinates.
description_zh: waze-stuff 利用十六进制模式以及 Python、TypeScript 和 C 代码研究 Waze 地图瓦片，并实现解析和部分瓦片生成。文档涉及 WZM/MAP_PKG、WZDF 和 WZT 的几何数据、街道名称及瓦片坐标。
requirements: Waze tile files are the analysis input; GeoJSON is used by the documented tile-generation workflow.
Tile creation and some WZT fields are partial; alert, search and route server handling remains unfinished.
MIT License.

name: Opel Insignia A: investigating LIN control of the Climatronic panel
description_en: The Opel Insignia A Climatronic panel project investigates control of a 2015 facelift climate panel over LIN. It records the panel's connector pinout, identifies its LIN transceiver and provides STM32G431KB code and an image of observed LIN frames. The author describes the approach as brute force and based on an earlier panel investigation.
description_zh: Opel Insignia A Climatronic panel 项目研究如何通过 LIN 控制 2015 年改款车型的空调面板。仓库记录连接器引脚、LIN 收发器，提供 STM32G431KB 代码及观测到的 LIN 帧图像。作者称研究采用穷举方式，并参考了较早款面板的工作。
requirements: Opel Insignia A facelift Climatronic panel, identified as part 26202384.
STM32G431KB project dependencies are generated from the .ioc file in MyST.
MIT License.

name: Opel Insignia climatronic panel: reconstructing LIN control with STM32
description_en: An STM32G431KB project investigates LIN bus control of a 2009 Opel Insignia climate-control panel. The author describes a brute-force approach without prior LIN frame ID information; the repository includes controller firmware, panel photographs and a frame image.
description_zh: 该 STM32G431KB 项目研究 2009 年 Opel Insignia 空调面板的 LIN 总线控制。作者描述了在缺乏 LIN 帧 ID 资料的情况下采用的穷举方法；仓库包含控制器固件、面板照片和通信帧图片。
requirements: A 2009 Opel Insignia A climate-control panel, part number 13273095, and an STM32G431KB controller.
Generate the CMSIS and STM32G4 HAL driver files from the .ioc project in MyST before building.
MIT License.

name: Peugeot 3008 II: investigating CAN control of the air-conditioning unit
description_en: Peugeot 3008 II air conditioning unit investigates CAN control of the vehicle's climate module using brute-force frame-ID exploration. An STM32G431KB project drives the module's flaps and includes notes on its TJA1055 transceiver, sensors and actuators. The author reports testing a unit marked 9811039380.
description_zh: Peugeot 3008 II air conditioning unit 通过穷举帧 ID 研究车辆空调模块的 CAN 控制。STM32G431KB 工程可驱动风门，并记录 TJA1055 收发器、传感器和执行器。作者报告测试对象的零件号为 9811039380。
requirements: Peugeot 3008 II climate-control hardware; the tested unit bears part number 9811039380.
STM32G431KB project dependencies are generated from the .ioc file in MyST.
The TJA1055 wiring requires the resistor changes described in the README.
MIT License.

name: BMW E92 CAN Live Data: decoding ECU telemetry
description_en: BMW E92 CAN Live Data investigates CAN and OBD-II messages from a 2007 BMW E92 335d with an EDC16CP35 ECU. Using an ESP32 and TJA1050 CAN transceiver, the project sniffs CAN traffic and sends Mode 01 and Mode 22 PID requests; the author reports readings for coolant temperature, RPM, airflow and boost pressure.
description_zh: BMW E92 CAN Live Data 研究 2007 款 BMW E92 335d 的 CAN 与 OBD-II 消息，目标 ECU 为 EDC16CP35。项目通过 ESP32 和 TJA1050 嗅探响应并发送 Mode 01、Mode 22 PID 请求；作者报告已读取冷却液温度、转速、进气流量及增压压力。
requirements: A BMW E92 335d with EDC16CP35 ECU, ESP32 and TJA1050 CAN transceiver.
Custom Mode 22 PID decoding and the display UI remain in progress.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Simplesoft RP5-TY-101: mapping Toyota CAN interface messages
description_en: Simplesoft RP5-TY-101 documents the function IDs and payload layouts used by a Toyota CAN interface box for aftermarket head units. Its tables cover responses such as door, tire-pressure, climate and radar state, plus head-unit requests for data and air-conditioning controls. A Python decoder is also present.
description_zh: Simplesoft RP5-TY-101 研究记录 Toyota 车型 CAN 接口盒供改装主机使用的功能 ID 与载荷布局。表格涵盖车门、胎压、空调、雷达状态等响应，以及主机的数据请求和空调控制指令；仓库另有 Python 解码脚本。
requirements: Simplesoft RP5-TY-101 CAN interface data is the documented scope.
No licence file in the repository.

name: BMW G08 blower: probing LIN payload fields
description_en: The BMW G08 heater blower project uses an STM32G431KB LIN master node to investigate which payload fields track blower drive voltage, current and fan speed. The repository includes controller firmware and images of the blower setup and serial monitor.
description_zh: BMW G08 鼓风机项目使用 STM32G431KB LIN 主节点，研究哪些载荷字段与鼓风机驱动端电压、电流及转速的变化对应。仓库包含控制器固件，以及鼓风机装置和串口监视器的图像。
requirements: A BMW G08 heater blower and STM32G431KB setup.
Generate CMSIS and STM32G4 HAL driver files from the .ioc project in MyST.
MIT License.

name: brscanner: a client for Brother DCP-1512E USB scanning
description_en: brscanner implements a Go USB client for scanning with the Brother DCP-1512E from an investigated device protocol. It provides a CLI for resolution, scan area and JPEG output, plus a Wireshark filter for examining USB captures.
description_zh: brscanner 根据设备协议研究结果，以 Go 实现 Brother DCP-1512E 的 USB 扫描客户端。命令行工具可设置分辨率与扫描区域并输出 JPEG，还提供用于查看 USB 抓包的 Wireshark 过滤条件。
requirements: A Brother DCP-1512E scanner and USB access; Go 1.24.2 for the module.
Only JPEG and one scan mode are supported; ADF is unsupported.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Chicken Invaders 1: rebuilding the 1999 game
description_en: Chicken Invaders 1 rebuilds the original 1999 game in C++ with a separate UveDX engine layer. Its reverse-engineering notes cover game classes, scoring and file formats, while the author reports that the current build is playable despite remaining bugs and decompiled variable names.
description_zh: Chicken Invaders 1 以 C++ 和独立的 UveDX 引擎层重建 1999 年原版游戏。逆向研究笔记涉及游戏类、计分和文件格式；作者报告当前版本可以游玩，但仍有错误和未整理的反编译变量名。
requirements: Original Chicken Invaders assets must be supplied separately.
CMake 3.25 or later for the root build.
The project remains in progress with bugs and decompiled variable names.
AGPL-3.0 license.

name: SC75823: mapping the H-Buster HBD-2300MP display
description_en: SC75823 reconstructs Arduino control of the H-Buster HBD-2300MP front-panel display. It maps 156 individually addressable display bits to segments and symbols, and documents routines for seven-segment digits, fourteen-segment text and display-state updates.
description_zh: SC75823 为 H-Buster HBD-2300MP 前面板显示屏重建 Arduino 控制方式。项目把 156 个可独立操作的位对应到字符段和图标，并记录七段数字、十四段文字及显示状态更新函数。
requirements: An H-Buster HBD-2300MP front panel with SC75823 display driver and an Arduino setup.
The fourteen-segment character map is complete only for numbers and uppercase letters.
No licence file in the repository.

name: recherno: investigating Chernobyl: The Legacy Continues in a custom virtual machine
description_en: recherno investigates Chernobyl: The Legacy Continues by running its original Fortran/Win32 engine inside a custom virtual machine. It uses Unicorn to execute the engine and Capstone for debugging. Engine API reconstruction and a Qt GUI for controlling game functions are in progress, with removal of the original binary blobs planned later.
description_zh: recherno 在自制虚拟机中运行 Chernobyl: The Legacy Continues 的原版 Fortran/Win32 引擎，以研究游戏行为。项目使用 Unicorn 执行引擎、Capstone 辅助调试。引擎 API 的重建和用于控制游戏功能的 Qt 界面仍在开发，移除原版二进制文件属于后续计划。
requirements: The user's original chrnob_32.dll and shutdown.icd files must be placed beside the executable.
Qt Widgets, Unicorn and Capstone are build dependencies.
Engine API recovery and removal of original blobs remain unfinished.
WTFPL version 2.

name: Notepad Tabs: mapping saved tab files
description_en: Notepad Tabs maps the binary format of Windows Notepad’s saved and unsaved tab files. It documents NP headers, paths, content, selection positions, SHA-256 and CRC fields, plus unsaved edit chunks, and supplies sample dumps and an ImHex pattern.
description_zh: Notepad Tabs 解析 Windows 记事本已保存及未保存标签页文件的二进制格式。文档列出 NP 文件头、路径、内容、选区位置、SHA-256 与 CRC 字段及未保存的编辑块，并提供样本转储和 ImHex 模式。
requirements: Windows Notepad tab files to inspect; ImHex to use the included pattern.
Some fields in the format map remain unidentified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Goldenland 2: documenting the game’s data formats
description_en: Goldenland 2 format research maps the game’s PAK archives, CSX sprites, SDB string databases and ITM item records. It includes Kaitai Struct schemas, a Total Commander viewer for ITM and SDB, and an XnView CSX plugin.
description_zh: Goldenland 2 格式研究解析游戏的 PAK 档案、CSX 精灵图、SDB 字符串数据库和 ITM 物品记录。仓库提供 Kaitai Struct 结构定义、查看 ITM／SDB 的 Total Commander 插件，以及 XnView 的 CSX 插件。
requirements: Original Goldenland 2 game files to inspect with the schemas or plugins.
The XnView plugin supports only 32-bit XnView.
Unlicense.

name: Gree-Wired-Proto: mapping the XK19 wired controller bus
description_en: Gree-Wired-Proto maps the RS-485 exchange between a Gree air-conditioner indoor unit and an XK19 wired controller. It records 1200-baud 8N1 serial settings, a 7E 7E header, source and destination bytes, body lengths, XOR checksum and observed message examples.
description_zh: Gree-Wired-Proto 解析格力空调室内机与 XK19 线控器之间的 RS-485 通信。文档记录 1200 波特率、8N1 串口设置、7E 7E 帧头、源与目的地址、消息体长度、异或校验及观测到的报文示例。
requirements: A Gree indoor unit and compatible wired controller for observing this bus.
The meaning of destination 40 remains unknown.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: WCW/nWo Thunder: a PlayStation decompilation
description_en: WCW/nWo Thunder reconstructs source for the PlayStation game from a work-in-progress disassembly. Its build takes SLUS_007.79, WGAME.BIN and WMENU.BIN from the user's disc and checks generated binaries against expected checksums.
description_zh: WCW/nWo Thunder 从进行中的反汇编工作重建 PlayStation 游戏源码。构建流程使用用户光盘中的 SLUS_007.79、WGAME.BIN 和 WMENU.BIN，并以预期校验和检查生成的二进制文件。
requirements: The user's PlayStation disc files SLUS_007.79, WGAME.BIN and WMENU.BIN; the two BIN files require decoding first.
A Linux build environment or the provided Dockerfile for other systems.
Decompilation is still in progress.
No licence file in the repository.

name: alive-serv: reconstructing the SIF2 MIRACLE LIVE! server
description_en: alive-serv reconstructs part of the SIF2 MIRACLE LIVE! game server in C from the global client's server protocol. Its four endpoints return an asset hash, initiate login, return a startup token and log client errors; the client can reach the title screen and part of login.
description_zh: alive-serv 根据 SIF2 MIRACLE LIVE! 国际服客户端的服务器协议，以 C 语言重建部分游戏服务。四个接口分别提供资源哈希、启动登录、返回启动令牌以及记录客户端错误；客户端可进入标题画面和部分登录流程。
requirements: CMake and the ulfius, jansson, orcania, OpenSSL and MariaDB libraries.
A MariaDB database and a custom proxy for an unmodified game client.
Tested only with global client version 1.0.2; the server remains heavily unfinished.
MIT license.

name: Nuga library: reconstructing NuPhy BYK916 keyboard control
description_en: Nuga library implements Go control of BYK916 NuPhy keyboards through a reconstructed USB HID protocol. It reads and sets lighting effects and brightness, while its protocol notes map HID reports, response fields and custom per-key backlight colors.
description_zh: Nuga library 依据重建的 USB HID 协议，用 Go 控制 NuPhy BYK916 键盘。它读取和设置灯效、亮度；协议笔记还记录 HID 报文、响应字段及逐键背光颜色格式。
requirements: A BYK916 NuPhy keyboard and USB HID access.
Go 1.20 or later for the module.
MIT license.

name: TL2BetaMiniLobby: reconstructing the Torchlight 2 beta lobby
description_en: TL2BetaMiniLobby reconstructs the lobby service required by the May 2012 Torchlight 2 beta. Its C# server handles lobby messages so the beta client can start offline after its configured lobby host is changed to localhost; the author reports testing client version 0.20.8.1.
description_zh: TL2BetaMiniLobby 用 C# 重建 2012 年 5 月 Torchlight 2 测试版所需的大厅服务。用户将客户端的大厅主机改为 localhost 后，可借助其消息处理代码离线启动游戏；作者报告测试过客户端 0.20.8.1 版。
requirements: A copy of the Torchlight 2 beta and .NET 8 runtime.
Change LOBBYHOST in the beta's local_settings.txt to localhost.
The emulator supports offline play only; multiplayer is unsupported.
MIT license.

name: Chronos Revived: an Android client for the recovered smart disc BLE protocol
description_en: Chronos Revived replaces the discontinued Android companion app for the Chronos smart disc using its recovered Bluetooth LE protocol. It handles notifications, steps, battery status and gestures, and can flash firmware supplied from the user's original APK. The protocol notes map GATT services, status bits, commands and device hardware identified from firmware analysis.
description_zh: Chronos Revived 利用恢复出的 Bluetooth LE 协议，替代已停用的 Chronos 智能腕表配件 Android 应用，处理通知、步数、电池状态和手势，并可从用户提供的原版 APK 取得固件进行刷写。协议文档整理了 GATT 服务、状态位、命令及固件分析所得的硬件信息。
requirements: Android 8.0 or newer, Bluetooth LE and a Chronos smart disc are required.
Firmware installation requires the user's copy of the original Chronos APK.
The app currently supports Android only.
MIT license.

name: Uncharted Waters: New Horizons — a native Windows static recompilation
description_en: Uncharted Waters: New Horizons is statically recompiled into a native Windows 10/11 application that uses the player's own USA/Canada NTSC ROM. The source includes generated native code, a target core and an SDL frontend, with an optional headless connector. Widescreen support remains experimental.
description_zh: 《Uncharted Waters: New Horizons》的 SNES 版本经静态重编译，成为面向 Windows 10/11 的原生应用，运行时使用玩家自行提供的美加 NTSC ROM。仓库包含生成的原生代码、游戏核心、SDL 前端及可选的无界面接口；宽屏功能仍处于实验阶段。
requirements: Windows 10/11 x64 and a supported USA/Canada NTSC game ROM.
Building requires x64 MinGW-w64 GCC/G++, CMake 3.28 or newer and Ninja.
Widescreen is experimental and only partially qualified.
Zlib license.

name: Battalion Wars 2: a Rust and Bevy engine reconstruction
description_en: Battalion Wars 2 is reconstructed as a native Rust and Bevy engine that loads archives, models, terrain, audio and Lua 5.0 mission bytecode from a user-supplied Wii disc image. The project documents PowerPC main.dol analysis used to implement native Lua bindings. The author reports playable campaign and multiplayer maps while listing remaining physics, AI and shader parity work.
description_zh: 该项目以 Rust 和 Bevy 重建《Battalion Wars 2》的原生引擎，从用户提供的 Wii 光盘镜像读取归档、模型、地形、音频和 Lua 5.0 任务字节码。文档记录了对 PowerPC main.dol 的分析及原生 Lua 绑定的实现。作者称战役和多人地图均可游玩，同时列出物理、AI 与着色效果仍需改进。
requirements: A user-supplied Battalion Wars 2 (USA), RBWE01, .wbfs or .iso image is required.
Rust 1.95 is specified by Cargo.toml; the viewer uses Bevy.
Physics, AI and Wii shader parity remain incomplete.
MIT license.

name: Rayman: matching decompilation of the PAL PS2 main executable
description_en: This project decompiles the PAL PlayStation 2 Rayman main executable, SLES_500.44, into C and hand-written assembly. Its build links an ELF at the original addresses and compares the main image and individual functions byte for byte with a locally supplied reference. The author reports 856 of 5,645 functions matching.
description_zh: 该项目将 PAL 版 PS2 Rayman 主程序 SLES_500.44 还原为 C 代码和手写汇编。构建流程按原地址链接 ELF，并与用户提供的原版程序逐字节比对主映像及单个函数。作者报告已有 5,645 个函数中的 856 个实现匹配。
requirements: Windows, Python 3, and the Windows py launcher.
An authorized PAL SLES_500.44 executable matching the setup script's SHA-1 check.
A legally obtained SN Systems ProDG PS2 SDK with ee-gcc.exe and ee-ld.exe.
The author reports 856 of 5,645 functions matching; DVP overlays require separate extraction and comparison.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: PS2 Floating-point: reconstructing console arithmetic behavior
description_en: PS2 Floating-point reconstructs aspects of PlayStation 2 floating-point behavior in Rust using console experiments as a baseline. Its Ps2Float type represents the console's floating-point variant and implements addition and subtraction, with test cases for ordinary values and special cases.
description_zh: PS2 Floating-point 以 PS2 实机实验为参照，用 Rust 重建主机浮点运算的部分行为。Ps2Float 类型表示其浮点格式，实现加减运算，并提供普通数值及特殊值的测试用例。
requirements: The implementation documents addition and subtraction; the author plans further findings as the emulator work progresses.
No licence file in the repository.

name: MovieOkeAI: investigating and rebuilding MovieBot
description_en: MovieOkeAI investigates the discontinued MovieBot animation app and builds a partial Python revival. The author describes APK inspection and MitMProxy captures to trace story prompts, the former web API, voice generation and animation settings, then implements basic generator, store and backend components.
description_zh: MovieOkeAI 研究已停运的 MovieBot 动画应用，并以 Python 编写部分重建。作者通过 APK 检查和 MitMProxy 抓包梳理故事提示词、原网页 API、语音生成及动画设置，随后实现基础生成器、商店与后端组件。
requirements: The original MovieBot API is described as no longer working.
The GUI, login and signup, animation uploads and planned animation generation remain incomplete.
No licence file in the repository.

name: AutoZone Hot Pursuit: reconstructing Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit
description_en: AutoZone Hot Pursuit reconstructs the 1998 Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit and Modern Patch in C++ from analysis of their binaries. Its source includes a game framework, a sound module and DirectX 5, 6 and 7 renderer implementations, with documented calling conventions and module callbacks.
description_zh: AutoZone Hot Pursuit 基于原始二进制分析，以 C++ 重建 1998 年的 Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit 及 Modern Patch。源码包含游戏框架、声音模块和 DirectX 5、6、7 渲染模块，并记录调用约定及模块回调。
requirements: Microsoft Visual Studio is required for the documented build.
DirectX 5 rendering needs further changes because 16-bit display mode failed in the author's test environments.
MIT license.

name: wotb-dvp: mapping WOTB DVPM and DVPD file structures
description_en: wotb-dvp reconstructs the layout of WOTB DVPM files and the DVPD footer. Its specification maps DVPM metadata, file entries, LZ4 and RFC1951 compression identifiers, CRC32 fields and both footer structures.
description_zh: wotb-dvp 梳理 WOTB 的 DVPM 文件布局和 DVPD 尾部结构，记录 DVPM 元数据、文件项、LZ4 与 RFC1951 压缩标识、CRC32 字段及两种尾部结构。
requirements: The DVPD body is marked TODO; only its footer is specified.
MIT license.

name: Webtoon API: reconstructing Android request signing
description_en: Webtoon API reconstructs calls to Webtoon's non-public API from Android client analysis. The author traced app traffic through Burp Suite, decompiled the APK to investigate URL signing and timestamp parameters, and implemented the resulting calls in a Python library.
description_zh: Webtoon API 基于 Android 客户端分析重建 Webtoon 的非公开 API 调用。作者使用 Burp Suite 观察应用流量，并反编译 APK 研究 URL 签名和时间戳参数，随后实现 Python 调用库。
requirements: Python 3.9 or later is required by the package.
The research account covers Android app traffic and request signing; its API reference page remains a placeholder.
MIT License.

name: Haxball Rooms API: decoding the binary room listing
description_en: Haxball Rooms API documents the binary room-listing response used by the Haxball game and displays parsed rooms in a browser table. Its layout notes identify length fields, room IDs, names, flags, coordinates, password status and player counts by byte offset.
description_zh: Haxball Rooms API 记录 Haxball 游戏房间列表响应的二进制布局，并在浏览器表格中展示解析结果。格式说明按字节偏移列出长度、房间 ID、名称、旗帜、坐标、密码状态和玩家数量字段。
requirements: The browser page reads the Haxball Rooms API.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Razer Nari Battery Level: recovering a USB battery-voltage exchange
description_en: Razer Nari Battery Level implements a USB HID exchange to read the headset's reported battery voltage through its dongle. The author captured SET_REPORT and GET_REPORT traffic and infers that two response bytes encode battery voltage in millivolts. A C program using libusb sends the requests and decodes those bytes.
description_zh: Razer Nari Battery Level 通过 USB HID 与 Razer Nari 耳机接收器交互，读取电池电压。作者抓取了 SET_REPORT 和 GET_REPORT 流量，并据此推断响应中的两个字节表示以毫伏计的电池电压。C 程序使用 libusb 发送请求并解码这两个字节。
requirements: A connected Razer Nari USB dongle, libusb and GCC are required.
The documented run command uses elevated privileges.
No licence file in the repository.

name: WeHeartIt API Endpoints: recovering paths from the Android app
description_en: WeHeartIt API Endpoints catalogs HTTP paths recovered from decompiled WeHeartIt Android app version v9.0.1.RC-GP-Free(21892). It groups the former service's paths by GET, POST, DELETE and PUT, covering accounts, collections, entries, search and messaging.
description_zh: WeHeartIt API Endpoints 整理从 WeHeartIt Android 应用 v9.0.1.RC-GP-Free(21892) 反编译源码中恢复的 HTTP 路径，按 GET、POST、DELETE、PUT 分类，涉及账户、收藏、内容、搜索和消息接口。
requirements: The author states that the documented endpoints no longer work.
MIT license.

name: Splitgate Backend: a local replacement for game service endpoints
description_en: Splitgate Backend implements local TypeScript service routes for the game's backend and redirects Splitgate's AccelByte requests to them through Fiddler or mitmproxy. The repository includes authentication, lobby, profile and WebSocket routes. Its data workflow captures HTTP calls for item and section information.
description_zh: Splitgate Backend 以 TypeScript 实现游戏后端的本地服务路由，并通过 Fiddler 或 mitmproxy 将 Splitgate 的 AccelByte 请求转发到本地。仓库包含认证、大厅、资料及 WebSocket 路由；物品与分类数据的整理流程使用抓取的 HTTP 调用。
requirements: Bun and either Fiddler or mitmproxy are needed for the documented setup.
The backend is still in development and may produce errors.
No licence file in the repository.

name: CD Changer Robot: rebuilding a Nistec ALW-501 controller
description_en: CD Changer Robot reconstructs control of a Nistec ALW-501 disc robot after tracing its motor-driver board. The repository supplies a pin map, circuit drawing, Arduino replacement firmware, Python control and imaging scripts, and mechanical parts for bulk CD transfer.
description_zh: CD Changer Robot 通过追踪 Nistec ALW-501 光盘机器人的电机驱动板重建控制系统。仓库提供引脚映射、电路图、Arduino 替代固件、Python 控制与光盘镜像脚本，以及批量转存所需的机械部件。
requirements: A Nistec ALW-501, Arduino Mega-class replacement controller and associated wiring are required.
The Python CD imaging path uses Windows-only imaging software.
Pins 22 and 46 remain unidentified; the author reports about 80% pickup reliability.
MIT license.

name: open-ssd: reconstructing SM2263XT SSD initialization
description_en: open-ssd reconstructs an initialization workflow for Silicon Motion SM2263-family SSDs. Its Python tool generates parameters, scans bad blocks, packages firmware and writes NAND system areas; accompanying documents map controller commands and JMS583 bridge passthrough behavior. The author identifies one tested SM2263XT, YMTC NAND and JMS583 combination.
description_zh: open-ssd 重建 Silicon Motion SM2263 系列 SSD 的初始化流程。Python 工具生成参数、扫描坏块、组装固件并写入 NAND 系统区；文档记录主控命令及 JMS583 桥接透传行为。作者列出了已实测的 SM2263XT、YMTC NAND 与 JMS583 组合。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later is required; USB access additionally requires system libusb.
The user's own factory package and a supported SM2263XT, YMTC NAND and JMS583 setup are required for the documented opening procedure.
Opening erases and writes NAND; the revised MPInfo output has not yet undergone a native M.2 reflashing acceptance test.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Dragon Ball Z: The Legacy of Goku — a byte-exact GBA disassembly
description_en: This project disassembles code from the USA Game Boy Advance release of Dragon Ball Z: The Legacy of Goku into ARM and Thumb assembly and reports a byte-identical ROM rebuild using data from the user's own copy. Build scripts generate assembly for identified code, rebuild compressed streams and compare the resulting image digest with the retail ROM. The author reports that much of the image is source-generated while remaining bytes come from local ROM slices.
description_zh: 该项目将美版 GBA 游戏《Dragon Ball Z: The Legacy of Goku》中已识别的代码反汇编为 ARM 和 Thumb 汇编，并使用用户自备 ROM 中的数据重建镜像；作者报告重建结果与原版逐字节一致。构建脚本生成已识别代码的汇编、重建压缩数据流，并用摘要比对生成的镜像与原版 ROM。作者报告镜像的大部分内容由源码生成，其余字节来自本地 ROM 切片。
requirements: A user-owned USA ROM must be placed as baserom.gba.
Building requires ARM Developer Suite 1.2, Python 3.12 and Visual Studio 2022 or Build Tools with the C++ workload.
Some image regions still rebuild from raw ROM slices; the project compiles no C.
MPL-2.0 license.

name: t2-cruise: reconstructing Apple SMC power-limit behavior on Linux
description_en: t2-cruise reconstructs how a T2 MacBook's Apple SMC requests CPU and GPU power limits. The author compared SMC readings under macOS and Linux, mapped MSLC and MSLG limit steps, and wrote a Linux daemon that applies them through intel_pstate and an optional Radeon power cap.
description_zh: t2-cruise 研究 T2 MacBook 的 Apple SMC 如何请求 CPU 与 GPU 功率限制。作者对比 macOS 和 Linux 下的 SMC 数据，解析 MSLC、MSLG 限制步数，并编写 Linux 守护进程，通过 intel_pstate 和可选的 Radeon 功率上限执行调节。
requirements: A T2 MacBook running Linux with t2linux kernel patches, applesmc, intel_pstate and Python 3 is required.
GPU limiting additionally requires an unlocked Radeon power cap.
The author tested MacBookPro16,1; other models remain untested.
GPL version 3 or later.

name: xLamp: LampSmartPro lamp-control protocol and Android client
description_en: xLamp reconstructs LampSmartPro 1.4.0's pairing and lamp-control flow in a Flutter Android app. It documents a 31-byte command frame with AES-128, XOR, and CRC-16/CCITT processing, then broadcasts encoded commands through 13 Bluetooth service UUIDs to control pairing, power, brightness, color temperature, and scenes.
description_zh: xLamp 根据对 LampSmartPro 1.4.0 的静态逆向，在 Flutter Android 应用中重建配对与灯具控制流程。项目记录了采用 AES-128、XOR 和 CRC-16/CCITT 处理的 31 字节命令帧，并通过 13 个蓝牙服务 UUID 广播指令，实现开关、亮度、色温和场景控制。
requirements: Android 7.0 or later on a device that supports BLE advertising; grant Nearby devices permission.
Flutter 3.47 and Dart 3.13 for local builds.
Scope is pairing and control through BLE advertising.
PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0.

name: Pix Backpack Go: reconstructing PIX display control over BLE
description_en: Pix Backpack Go reconstructs local BLE control of PIX Backpack LED displays as a Go library and CLI. Its protocol notes and code cover GATT commands, RGB palettes, image and animation upload, live updates and scrolling text, drawing on app materials and local BLE experiments.
description_zh: Pix Backpack Go 以 Go 库和命令行工具重建 PIX Backpack LED 显示屏的本地 BLE 控制。协议文档与代码覆盖 GATT 指令、RGB 调色板、图像和动画上传、实时更新及滚动文字，依据应用资料和本地蓝牙实验。
requirements: Go 1.25 or later is required; macOS hardware use also needs Bluetooth permission and Xcode Command Line Tools.
The author reports testing on PIX Original V1 firmware 2.5.1 with a 16×20 display.
Game controls, other firmware and Mini are experimental; flash persistence, OTA and PIN management remain unverified or unavailable.
MIT license for the implementation and documentation; bundled PIX Mono fonts use SIL OFL 1.1.

name: XENO: reconstructing the Xbox 360 boot chain in a low-level emulator
description_en: XENO reconstructs Xbox 360 boot behavior in a low-level emulator informed by boot-chain research and disassembly. Its Rust Xenon PowerPC core models memory, the SMC and security engine, while supporting tools analyze boot stages and XEX files. The author reports execution through the CD handoff and hypervisor guest idle state; later system components remain in progress.
description_zh: XENO 依据 Xbox 360 启动链研究与反汇编成果构建低层模拟器。其 Rust Xenon PowerPC 核心模拟内存、SMC 和安全引擎，配套工具分析启动阶段和 XEX 文件。作者称已运行至 CD 交接及虚拟机监控程序的访客空闲状态；后续系统组件仍在开发。
requirements: A stable Rust toolchain is required for the emulator; Python 3.10 or later is required for the analysis tools.
Boot-chain execution requires the user's own Xbox 360 NAND and stage dumps; they are kept outside the repository.
The hypervisor and virtual-kernel milestone remains in progress; later kernel, dashboard, southbridge and GPU milestones are pending.
GPL version 3 or later.

name: rytm-fw-re: reconstructing Analog Rytm MKII firmware
description_en: rytm-fw-re analyses the Elektron Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 update and builds a freestanding ColdFire replacement firmware wrapped as a flashable .syx file. Its Ghidra probes and notes cover the ELE3 container, bootstrap entry contract, memory map, display byte protocol and flash path. The author reports that the current replacement boots and displays a test pattern.
description_zh: rytm-fw-re 分析 Elektron Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 更新包，并构建封装为 .syx 的 ColdFire 替代固件。Ghidra 脚本与文档涉及 ELE3 容器、启动入口、内存布局、显示字节协议和闪存流程。作者报告当前版本可启动并显示测试图案。
requirements: Reproducing the analysis and hardware checks requires a separately obtained stock OS 1.74 update and an Analog Rytm MKII unit.
The firmware build uses a nixpkgs m68k cross compiler and invokes ld.bfd directly.
The replacement OS currently stops after displaying a test pattern; the USB reflash path remains a plan.
No licence file in the repository.

name: MDK in Godot: a port from game data and executable analysis
description_en: MDK in Godot ports the 1997 game MDK to Godot 4.7 using analysis of its data files and MDKD3D.EXE. It loads levels, media and scripts from the player's installed game and documents file formats, engine behavior and the script virtual machine. The author reports that all six levels run, while playtesting and bug fixing continue.
description_zh: MDK in Godot 依据原版数据文件及 MDKD3D.EXE 的分析，将 1997 年游戏 MDK 移植到 Godot 4.7。它从玩家已安装的游戏读取关卡、媒体和脚本，并记录文件格式、引擎机制及脚本虚拟机。作者称六个关卡均可运行，仍在继续测试和修复问题。
requirements: Godot 4.7 and the user's own installed copy of MDK are required.
The port is no longer actively developed; playtesting and bug fixing remain in progress.
Linux and macOS release builds are untested according to the author.
GNU General Public License version 3.

name: VFS495 fingerprint reader on Linux: reconstructing capture and login
description_en: VFS495 fingerprint reader on Linux reconstructs capture and login support for the Validity USB 138a:003f sensor. It documents USB and secure-session behavior, descrambles captured images, and bridges the vendor-driven capture path to libfprint virtual_image, fprintd and PAM.
description_zh: VFS495 fingerprint reader on Linux 为 Validity USB 138a:003f 指纹传感器重建采集与登录流程。项目记录 USB 和安全会话行为，对图像去乱序，并将依赖厂商程序的采集链路接入 libfprint virtual_image、fprintd 与 PAM。
requirements: A VFS495 USB 138a:003f reader and HP's separately obtained proprietary Linux driver are required.
The working capture path runs the vendor binary under gdb as root; the native libfprint driver remains unfinished.
The author reports end-to-end login on an HP EliteBook running Debian 13.
MIT license.

name: VTech VM901: reconstructing camera authentication and media access
description_en: VTech VM901 reconstructs the camera's authentication and media workflow for a Home Assistant bridge. The Go and C implementation uses TUTK/Kalay transport, performs the documented X25519 and ChaCha20-Poly1305 exchange, decrypts H.264 and G.711 media, and publishes streams through go2rtc.
description_zh: VTech VM901 项目重建摄像头认证与媒体访问流程，供 Home Assistant 桥接使用。Go 和 C 实现通过 TUTK/Kalay 连接设备，执行文档记录的 X25519 与 ChaCha20-Poly1305 交互，解密 H.264 视频和 G.711 音频，再经 go2rtc 发布音视频流。
requirements: An owned or authorized VM901 camera and account are required.
The Android/bionic ARM64 runtime needs locally extracted SDK libraries and application values; the account bootstrap uses an authenticated request from the official app.
The author reports testing on a local camera during the original research.
MIT License for repository source; locally extracted components retain their own terms.

name: Paper Hexagon: a reconstructed Super Hexagon port for Linux and Playdate
description_en: Paper Hexagon ports reconstructed Super Hexagon game code from the GOG Linux build to modern Linux and Playdate. Its Playdate shim replaces openFrameworks rendering, audio, input and persistence interfaces while retaining the game logic. The research documents byte-matching functions and behavioral trace comparisons; users supply their own music and sound assets.
description_zh: Paper Hexagon 将从 GOG Linux 版《Super Hexagon》重建的游戏代码移植到现代 Linux 和 Playdate。Playdate 兼容层替换 openFrameworks 的渲染、音频、输入及持久化接口，同时保留游戏逻辑。研究记录了函数字节匹配和行为轨迹比对；音乐与音效由用户自行提供。
requirements: Linux builds need the documented openFrameworks submodule, Ninja, a C++17 toolchain and host libraries; Playdate builds also need the Playdate SDK.
Users must supply the original music and sound files at the documented paths.
The Playdate port omits some desktop menu and leaderboard behavior.
No licence file in the repository.

name: KATASYMBOL E12 Lab: reconstructing BLE label printing
description_en: KATASYMBOL E12 Lab reconstructs BLE printing for E12-class label makers in Python. It combines a protocol library, command-line printer, Tkinter GUI and raw command harness, documenting GATT characteristics, 0x7E 0x5A command frames and compressed 512-byte raster frames.
description_zh: KATASYMBOL E12 Lab 用 Python 重建 E12 类标签机的 BLE 打印。项目提供协议库、命令行工具、Tkinter 界面和原始指令实验程序，并记录 GATT 特征值、0x7E 0x5A 指令帧及压缩的 512 字节栅格帧。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later and an E12-class BLE label printer are required.
The author reports the most reliable path on a 96-dot, 12 mm E12 printer using service fee7 and characteristic fec1.
Command timing and status behavior may differ across firmware revisions.
MIT license.

name: GE Opal 2: ice maker hardware and I2C interface research
description_en: GE Opal 2 research maps the ice maker's connectors, nominal voltages, plumbing and front-panel I2C communication to support an Arduino-based replacement control board. The repository includes protocol notes, a prototype schematic and firmware code. The author identifies incomplete connector documentation and unexamined front-panel and RGB behavior.
description_zh: GE Opal 2 研究记录制冰机的连接器、标称电压、管路及前面板 I2C 通信，用于开发 Arduino 替换控制板。仓库包含协议笔记、原型电路图和固件代码；部分连接器资料、前面板及 RGB 行为仍待研究。
requirements: The hardware work concerns a GE Profile Opal 2.0 Ultra ice maker and an Arduino Nano ESP32 prototype.
The schematics and code are marked unfinished.
GPL-3.0 license for the project code and author-created schematics.

name: magicJack HOME: a Linux phone system from USB and SIP protocol research
description_en: magicJack HOME is investigated through its vendor macOS driver, USB register interface and captured SIP traffic to build a Linux-controlled analog phone endpoint. Python tools drive line power, ringing, hook detection and DTMF over hidraw, while baresip and a bridge connect the handset to a self-hosted PBX. The author reports live two-way calls on the resulting setup.
description_zh: 项目通过分析 magicJack HOME 的 macOS 驱动、USB 寄存器接口和捕获的 SIP 流量，在 Linux 上实现模拟电话端点。Python 工具通过 hidraw 控制供电、振铃、摘挂机和 DTMF，baresip 与桥接服务将话机接入自托管 PBX；作者报告已完成双向通话。
requirements: A magicJack HOME, Linux host, analog phone and SIP PBX are needed for the documented setup.
The account's session-keyed SIP configuration was not recovered.
MIT license.

name: Nokia DCT Platform Emulation: reconstructing early handset hardware behavior
description_en: Nokia DCT Platform Emulation reconstructs firmware-facing hardware behavior of early Nokia phones in MAME, with the 3210 as its reference handset. Its investigation maps registers, buses, DSP mailboxes, SIM exchanges and storage behavior using static and runtime observations. The repository includes disassembly helpers, Ghidra scripts, symbol maps and subsystem reports; the author reports an interactive 3210 desktop under a modeled profile.
description_zh: Nokia DCT Platform Emulation 以 Nokia 3210 为主要对象，在 MAME 中重建早期手机固件所依赖的硬件行为。研究结合静态与运行时观察，整理寄存器、总线、DSP 邮箱、SIM 交互和存储行为，并提供反汇编工具、Ghidra 脚本、符号表及子系统报告。作者报告，所建模型已能进入可交互的 3210 桌面。
requirements: MAME and user-supplied phone firmware are required for the documented emulation workflow.
Several hardware models remain partial, including physical timing and native DSP/RF behavior.
BSD 3-Clause license.

name: PyKS2: reconstructing the Pentax K-S2 Wi-Fi API
description_en: PyKS2 reconstructs the Pentax K-S2 camera's undocumented Wi-Fi HTTP and WebSocket interface as a Python library, CLI and camera simulator. Its protocol notes map endpoint groups, request behavior, live view and event streams, backed by captured responses from firmware 01.10.
description_zh: PyKS2 将 Pentax K-S2 相机未公开的 Wi-Fi HTTP 与 WebSocket 接口重建为 Python 库、命令行工具及相机模拟器。协议文档梳理接口分组、请求行为、实时取景和事件流，并附固件 01.10 的实机响应记录。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later and access to a Pentax K-S2 Wi-Fi camera are required for hardware use.
The author tested a K-S2 running firmware 01.10; other Pentax bodies remain untested.
GPS support and the effect of live-view digital zoom remain unresolved.
MIT license.

name: TFM2DB Field Notes: mapping Teamfight Manager 2 database records
description_en: TFM2DB Field Notes maps selected Teamfight Manager 2 database records and provides template-based CSV roundtrip tools. The notes cover the TFM2 gzip wrapper, CRC32, record kinds, dynamic player offsets and fixed-width fields that the importer can patch in a matching database.
description_zh: TFM2DB Field Notes 梳理 Teamfight Manager 2 数据库的部分记录，并提供基于模板的 CSV 导出与回写工具。笔记涉及 TFM2 gzip 包装、CRC32、记录类型、玩家动态偏移，以及可在匹配数据库中修改的定长字段。
requirements: A matching original .tfm2db template and its CSV export are required for importing edits.
The importer supports fixed-width fields; record counts, names, string lengths and language-vector structure are outside its tested scope.
MIT license.

name: ESPHome — Maytronics Air Cover BLE: reconstructing pool-cover control
description_en: ESPHome — Maytronics Air Cover BLE recreates pool-cover control through a BLE GATT profile observed in the official Android app. Its ESPHome configuration sends open, close and stop payloads and reads position and motor-state notifications for Home Assistant.
description_zh: ESPHome — Maytronics Air Cover BLE 根据官方 Android 应用的蓝牙通信重建泳池盖控制。其 ESPHome 配置发送开、关、停指令，并读取位置与电机状态通知，供 Home Assistant 使用。
requirements: An ESP32 within BLE range of a Maytronics Air Cover and its BLE address are required.
Control payloads were captured from one 2023 unit; compatibility with other units is unknown.
MIT license stated in the README; no licence file in the repository.

name: ambit-firmware: mapping Palette hardware for replacement firmware
description_en: ambit-firmware develops alternative firmware for Palette devices using mapped AT90USB1286 pin connections. The hardware notes identify links to magnetic ports, I2C lines, LEDs and flashing headers; the firmware implements USB CDC control, basic LEDs and a failsafe bootloader path. Its roadmap lists display control and component communication as unfinished.
description_zh: ambit-firmware 根据 Palette 设备 AT90USB1286 的引脚连接记录编写替代固件。硬件笔记标出磁吸接口、I2C 线路、LED 和烧录接口；固件已实现 USB CDC 控制、基础 LED 功能及故障保护引导路径。路线图将显示控制和组件通信列为未完成项目。
requirements: Builds with Make and AVR tooling for AT90USB1286; the README recommends a Teensy++ 2.0 development board.
Flashing a production Palette device may require opening its base and using ISP headers to recover bootloader access.
Display control and the two-wire component interface are unfinished.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Slovak Telekom App API: mapping the mobile service requests
description_en: Slovak Telekom App API documents HTTP requests recovered from the operator's mobile app. Its reference covers PIN verification, access and refresh tokens, account profiles, dashboard data and billing calls, with a Python example client.
description_zh: Slovak Telekom App API 记录从运营商移动应用整理出的 HTTP 请求。文档涵盖 PIN 验证、访问与刷新令牌、账户资料、仪表盘数据及账单调用，并附 Python 示例客户端。
requirements: A Slovak Telekom account for authenticated requests.
The author notes that request behavior may change when the service changes its API.
No licence file in the repository.

name: perfectcharge_remote: reconstructing the Waeco PerfectCharge remote PCB
description_en: perfectcharge_remote reconstructs the Waeco PerfectCharge marine charger remote's schematic and single-layer PCB in KiCad. The design records its pushbutton, LEDs and two top-side jumper wires, with Gerber and Excellon manufacturing files alongside the KiCad files.
description_zh: perfectcharge_remote 使用 KiCad 重建 Waeco PerfectCharge 船用充电器遥控器的电路图和单层 PCB，记录按钮、LED 及板正面的两根跳线，并提供 KiCad 设计文件及 Gerber、Excellon 制造文件。
requirements: No licence file in the repository.

name: FacebookUnsentMessage: reconstructing Messenger history sync
description_en: FacebookUnsentMessage recreates the Messenger web client's MQTT-over-WebSocket history sync channel in Node.js. It authenticates with the user's browser cookies, requests replay from a sequence ID and scans message deltas for a specified message ID.
description_zh: FacebookUnsentMessage 用 Node.js 重现 Messenger 网页客户端的 MQTT-over-WebSocket 历史同步通道。它使用用户浏览器 Cookie 认证，从指定序列号请求重放，并在消息增量中查找目标消息 ID。
requirements: Node.js, an account owned by the user, its browser session cookies and a message ID.
The author describes it as a July 2021 experiment whose undocumented Messenger behavior may have changed.
The package.json declares an ISC license; no licence file is present.

name: RevCar CLI: reconstructing WowWee car BLE control
description_en: RevCar CLI is a Python controller for WowWee RevCar toys built from BLE command observations. Its notes identify GATT handles for notifications and commands, describe the handshake and driving payloads, and include a captured HCI exchange.
description_zh: RevCar CLI 是基于 BLE 命令观察编写的 WowWee RevCar 玩具车 Python 控制程序。文档列出通知与命令的 GATT 句柄、握手及驾驶数据格式，仓库还保存了 HCI 抓包。
requirements: A WowWee RevCar, Linux, Python 3 and bluepy; BLE scanning may require elevated privileges.
Hit-event notifications remain unfinished.
MIT license.

name: Open Steigen: documenting an appliance's local protocol
description_en: Open Steigen documents the local control protocol of Steigen Automatic Laundry Systems, including readable and writable data points for rack movement, lights, fan and heater. Its pairing notes describe the appliance's Wi-Fi setup exchange; the author reports testing the Solar model with protocol v3.3.
description_zh: Open Steigen 记录 Steigen 自动晾衣设备的本地控制协议，包括升降、照明、风扇和加热器的可读写数据点。配对笔记说明其 Wi-Fi 配网交互；作者报告在使用 v3.3 协议的 Solar 型号上进行了测试。
requirements: Steigen appliances compatible with the Steigen Home app; testing is reported for the Solar model.
Hidden write-only data points and additional ionizer and dust-mite data points are undocumented.
Documentation uses CC BY-SA 4.0; code uses MIT.

name: Tchibo 287717: decoding a wireless weather-sensor signal
description_en: The Tchibo 287717 investigation decodes its weather sensor's 433.85 MHz OOK transmissions. Captures and display comparisons support a pulse-distance message layout with repeated frames and mapped temperature and humidity fields.
description_zh: 该调查解析 Tchibo 287717 气象传感器的 433.85 MHz OOK 发射信号。录制信号与显示值的对照用于推断脉冲间隔编码、重复帧，以及温度和湿度字段。
requirements: A Tchibo 287717 sensor and suitable radio capture equipment to collect new transmissions.
Some bits and the presumed checksum remain unidentified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Speedos: a black-box replica of the Spe_ed game model
description_en: Speedos reconstructs the Spe_ed game rules as a Mesa model with interfaces shared by the original game. Multi-Minimax agents use the model to simulate future actions, with a Voronoi heuristic for evaluation and iterative deepening for search. The repository includes recorded games from the original for testing the model.
description_zh: Speedos 使用 Mesa 重建 Spe_ed 的游戏规则模型，提供与原版相同的接口。Multi-Minimax 智能体用该模型模拟后续行动，使用 Voronoi 启发式方法评估局面，并通过迭代加深进行搜索。仓库收录原版对局记录，用于测试模型。
requirements: Requires Python dependencies from requirements.txt and a Cython extension built with setup.py.
The model is a Spe_ed simulation used by the project's agents.
MIT license.

name: BPM: USB data access for the Aponorm blood pressure monitor
description_en: BPM documents a study of USB communication with the Aponorm Blutdruckmessgerät Oberarm Professionell blood pressure monitor and provides a Python reader for backing up measurements on Linux. The reader sends a serial command, parses cycle records containing timestamps and blood pressure values, and stores measurements in SQLite.
description_zh: BPM 记录了对 Aponorm Blutdruckmessgerät Oberarm Professionell 血压计 USB 通信的研究，并提供用于 Linux 数据备份的 Python 程序。程序通过串口发送命令，解析含时间和血压值的测量记录，再存入 SQLite。
requirements: Requires the Aponorm Blutdruckmessgerät Oberarm Professionell monitor and Linux access to its serial device at /dev/ttyUSB0.
The Python program imports bitstring, SQLObject, pyserial and matplotlib.
No licence file in the repository.

name: AFS Volume 2.00 specification: reconstructing Tenchu archives
description_en: AFS200Tools documents the AFS Volume 2.00 archive format found in PlayStation Tenchu games. It records the big-endian header, 36-byte file entries, file table placement and a tentative filename scheme, alongside C# source for handling volumes.
description_zh: AFS200Tools 记录 PlayStation《Tenchu》游戏中的 AFS Volume 2.00 归档格式，说明大端序文件头、36 字节文件条目、文件表位置及暂定的文件名规则。仓库还包含处理归档的 C# 源码。
requirements: Applies to AFS Volume 2.00 archives documented from Tenchu game files.
The filename format description is speculative, and the header length is given as 40 or 42 bytes.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon: a matching CD-i decompilation
description_en: Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon's CD-i main program is reconstructed as C compiled with Apple MPW C 3.0. The author reports byte-identical builds for English, French, German and Dutch versions after extracting data from the user's disc and checking each output hash.
description_zh: 该项目将 CD-i 游戏 Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon 的主程序重建为 C，并使用 Apple MPW C 3.0 编译。作者报告称，从用户光盘提取数据后，英语、法语、德语和荷兰语版本均可生成字节一致的程序，并通过哈希校验。
requirements: A copy of a supported Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon disc.
Linux or WSL, Python 3 with Capstone, Basilisk II, an owned 68040 Mac ROM, System 7.5.3, MPW 3.3 and MPW C 3.0.
Naming and documentation remain incomplete; some drawing and NVRAM routines remain assembly.
No licence file in the repository.

name: som-decomp: reconstructing Secret of Mana from a cartridge ROM
description_en: som-decomp reconstructs the North American SNES release of Secret of Mana with matching 65816 and SPC700 assembly, readable C routines and documentation of combat, AI, maps, menus and audio. Its build extracts data from the user's ROM and the author reports a byte-exact rebuilt image; captured-state differential checks cover much of the recovered C.
description_zh: som-decomp 重建北美版 SNES《Secret of Mana》，提供匹配原版的 65816 与 SPC700 汇编、可读 C 例程，以及战斗、AI、地图、菜单和音频文档。构建时从用户的 ROM 提取数据；作者报告可逐字节重建镜像，并用捕获状态的差分测试检查大部分 C 代码。
requirements: A user-dumped North American Secret of Mana v1.0 ROM is required; other releases are unsupported.
Python 3 and cc65 ca65/ld65 are required; emulator-based tools also need RetroArch with a snes9x or bsnes core.
The capture-based C verification harness is not published yet.

name: Jade Empire: a native port by x86-to-Odin static recompilation
description_en: A native Jade Empire: Special Edition port statically translates the user's x86 game executable into Odin. It replaces Windows, Direct3D 9, DirectSound and Bink services with SDL3, OpenGL and FFmpeg and adds controller support and two-player co-op.
description_zh: 该原生移植版将用户自有的 Jade Empire: Special Edition x86 可执行文件静态转换为 Odin，以 SDL3、OpenGL 和 FFmpeg 替代 Windows、Direct3D 9、DirectSound 与 Bink 层，并加入手柄及双人合作功能。
requirements: An installed Steam or GOG copy of Jade Empire: Special Edition and an AVX2-capable 64-bit PC.
On Linux, Odin dev-2026-10, a C compiler, curl, SDL3 and FFmpeg development files; the Steam version also needs Python 3.
Origin, EA app and retail-disc versions are untried; Windows support was tested under Wine, not on a physical Windows PC.
GPL-3.0 license; port/src/win32/smaa/ has its own license.

name: Sengoku Basara 4 Sumeragi: rehosting the PS4 game on Windows
description_en: Sengoku Basara 4 Sumeragi Native PC provides a Windows runtime for a user-supplied PS4 game folder. It links the game's executable and system modules and adapts shadPS4 graphics components to a Vulkan presentation layer, with launcher controls for display and input.
description_zh: Sengoku Basara 4 Sumeragi Native PC 为用户自备的 PS4 游戏目录提供 Windows 运行环境。它链接游戏可执行文件及系统模块，并将改造的 shadPS4 图形组件接入 Vulkan 显示层，另提供显示和输入设置启动器。
requirements: A complete dump from the user's PS4: eboot.bin, sce_module, sce_sys and nativePS4 or data.
Windows 10 1809 or newer, x64 CPU, Vulkan 1.3 runtime and VC++ 2015–2022 x64 runtime.
The release notes report a character-transition cutscene freeze mitigated by a watchdog.
The repository's LICENSE states GPL-2.0-or-later; LICENSE.txt is identified as MIT in the README.

name: dyson-lamp-ble: reconstructing local control of a Dyson lamp
description_en: dyson-lamp-ble reconstructs local control of a Dyson BLE lamp from MyDyson Android app analysis and device observations. Its Python library and CLI obtain an account-issued long-term key, perform the BLE session handshake and send power or synchronized-mode commands. The protocol notes describe GATT characteristics, HKDF-SHA256 key derivation and message framing.
description_zh: dyson-lamp-ble 根据对 MyDyson Android 应用和灯具的观察重建 Dyson BLE 灯的本地控制。Python 库与 CLI 获取账户签发的长期密钥，完成 BLE 会话握手并发送电源或同步模式命令。协议文档记录 GATT 特征、HKDF-SHA256 密钥派生和消息帧格式。
requirements: Python 3.11 or later and the ble extra are required for local control.
An owned Dyson BLE lamp and an account-issued device key are required; fetching the key uses the cloud extra and account access.
Colour-temperature and brightness mappings are currently raw 16-bit values.
MIT licence.

name: nfsu2_decomp: a native reconstruction of Need for Speed: Underground 2
description_en: nfsu2_decomp rewrites logic from the PS2 PAL release of Need for Speed: Underground 2 as native Linux C++ and uses the user's disc data at runtime. The implementation replaces PS2 graphics and audio paths with OpenGL and SDL2, reads ZDIR.BIN and ZZDATA archives, and documents recovered vehicle physics and file decoding. The project describes its current build as a playable prototype.
description_zh: nfsu2_decomp 将 PS2 PAL 版《Need for Speed: Underground 2》的逻辑改写为 Linux 原生 C++，运行时读取用户的游戏光盘数据。它以 OpenGL 和 SDL2 替代主机图形、音频路径，读取 ZDIR.BIN 与 ZZDATA 归档，并记录车辆物理和文件解码的逆向结果。项目将当前版本称为可玩的原型。
requirements: The PS2 PAL v2.00 SLES_527.25 game disc data is required.
Linux 32-bit x86, CMake, SDL2 and OpenGL are required by the documented build.
The project describes the build as a playable prototype.
MIT licence.

name: TH05: reconstructing Touhou 5's PC-98 programs
description_en: TH05 reconstructs source for the Japanese PC-98 Touhou 5: Mystic Square programs MAIN.EXE, OP.EXE, MAINE.EXE and ZUN.COM. Maintained C/C++ and reviewed assembly are compared against bounded original code and data extents, including raw bytes and relocation order. The project reports accepted units separately from its still unmeasured overall authored-byte goal.
description_zh: TH05 重建日文 PC-98 游戏《东方怪绮谈 ～ Mystic Square》的 MAIN.EXE、OP.EXE、MAINE.EXE 和 ZUN.COM 源码。项目将维护中的 C/C++ 和经审查的原版汇编与原程序的限定代码、数据区间比较，包括原始字节和重定位顺序。项目分别报告已接受的代码单元；当前整体原创字节比例仍未测量。
requirements: A user-owned Japanese game image is required; game executables and assets are not included.
The documented workflow uses pinned ReC98, Borland/Wine and Ghidra analysis tooling.
The overall authored-byte percentage remains unmeasured, and complete packed-file equality is a separate claim.
MIT licence for repository-authored code and documentation.

name: Thrasher: Skate and Destroy: a matching PlayStation decompilation
description_en: Thrasher: Skate and Destroy is being reconstructed function by function as C for its US PlayStation executable. The author reports a byte-identical full build from C and assembly, using a pinned PsyQ-era compiler, per-function comparison and a final SHA-1 check.
description_zh: 该项目逐函数用 C 重建美版 PlayStation 游戏 Thrasher: Skate and Destroy 的可执行文件。作者报告称，使用固定版本的 PsyQ 时期编译器、逐函数比较及最终 SHA-1 校验，可由 C 和汇编生成字节一致的完整程序。
requirements: A user-owned NTSC-U PlayStation disc dump of Thrasher: Skate and Destroy.
Linux, Python 3 and the pinned compiler and extraction toolchain.
Readable C reconstruction remains in progress; PsyQ library functions remain assembly.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: xmen2-pc: a matching decompilation and native port of X-Men 2: Clone Wars
description_en: xmen2-pc reconstructs X-Men 2: Clone Wars as handwritten C and ports it to Windows and Linux without 68000 emulation. Its workflow uses a byte-matching disassembly, static recompilation and the original Apple MPW C 3.3 compiler; the author reports machine-code matches for 3,047 C functions and instruction-level comparisons for 117 assembly functions. The port loads graphics, sound and levels from the user's ROM and adds widescreen play, higher display rates and rollback netplay.
description_zh: xmen2-pc 将《X-Men 2: Clone Wars》重建为手写 C 代码，并移植到 Windows 和 Linux，无需模拟 68000。项目使用逐字节匹配的反汇编、静态重编译和 Apple MPW C 3.3；作者报告称，3,047 个 C 函数与原始机器码匹配，其余 117 个汇编函数经过逐指令比对。移植版从用户自备 ROM 读取图像、声音和关卡，并加入宽屏、高刷新率显示及回滚联机。
requirements: Requires the user's own USA/Europe X-Men 2: Clone Wars ROM with SHA-1 61409e6cf6065ab67d8952b891d8edcf47777193.
Runs on Windows or Linux; the Linux release needs SDL2.
Three- and four-player modes have been played less than the rest; display pacing is experimental and has not yet been measured on a live display.
The project's original work is MIT licensed.
The included segagenesisrecomp component uses PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, so builds of the port may not be used commercially.

name: xmen2disasm: rebuilding X-Men 2 from a matching disassembly
description_en: xmen2disasm reconstructs the Sega Genesis game X-Men 2: Clone Wars as a byte-matching 68000 disassembly. Its build reads data from the user's ROM, and emulator traces support function boundaries, labels and coverage checks. The author reports a byte-identical ROM rebuild; the related C reconstruction and native PC port reside in xmen2-pc.
description_zh: xmen2disasm 将 Sega Genesis 游戏《X-Men 2: Clone Wars》重建为逐字节匹配的 68000 反汇编。构建从用户的 ROM 读取数据，模拟器跟踪用于检查函数边界、标签和覆盖情况。作者报告可重建字节相同的 ROM；相关 C 代码重建和原生 PC 移植位于 xmen2-pc。
requirements: A user-provided USA/Europe X-Men 2: Clone Wars ROM is required.
The documented setup uses Windows with Visual Studio 2022 and uv; Ghidra 12 and JDK 21 are needed for the decompiler view.
Building from the recovered C also needs the xmen2-pc checkout and MPW C.
MIT licence for the original work in this repository.

name: deco-network-optimize: reconstructing Deco Network Optimization commands
description_en: deco-network-optimize implements the TP-Link Deco app's private TMP/App-V2 Network Optimization sequence for a Deco X20-DSL. It opens an SSH direct-tcpip channel to tmpsvr, sends scan and poll commands, and requests channel optimization when the device reports an optimizable state. The accompanying protocol notes document framing, checksum and the recovered command opcodes.
description_zh: deco-network-optimize 实现 Deco X20-DSL 所用的 TP-Link Deco 应用私有 TMP/App-V2 网络优化流程。它通过 SSH direct-tcpip 连接 tmpsvr，发送扫描与轮询命令，并在设备报告可优化时请求重新选信道。协议文档记录帧格式、校验和与恢复出的操作码。
requirements: A Deco device using the TMP/App-V2 protocol and access to the master device are required; the research used an X20-DSL.
Python 3, ssh2-python and the owner's TP-Link cloud account credentials are required.
MIT licence.

name: TH06: reconstructing Japanese 1.02h authored functions
description_en: TH06 reconstructs the Japanese 1.02h game executable using a maintained source tree based on GensokyoClub/th06 and a pinned VC7.0 build. Its scripts compare complete function extents and COFF relocations; the author reports exact matches for 493 reviewed authored functions.
description_zh: TH06 以 GensokyoClub/th06 的源码为参考，使用固定版本的 VC7.0 重建日文 1.02h 游戏可执行文件。项目脚本比对完整函数范围及 COFF 重定位；作者报告称，493 个已审查的游戏函数均达到精确匹配。
requirements: Provide your own original Japanese TH06 1.02h executable.
Requires Python 3.11+, Git, Wine and a Linux headless environment; the build uses pinned VC7.0 13.00.9466.
The author reports exact matches for 493 reviewed authored functions.
GensokyoClub/th06 provides the source reference, names, mapping and VC7.0 build profile.
MIT license.

name: Playcard Cosmic: a native port from executable analysis
description_en: Playcard Cosmic recreates the 2000 Windows shoot-'em-up in C++20 and SDL3 for Windows, Linux and macOS. Its analysis maps original executable functions and Win32 resources; the port reads graphics and sound from the user's COSMIC.EXE and replaces DirectX subsystems.
description_zh: Playcard Cosmic 使用 C++20 和 SDL3 将这款 2000 年的 Windows 射击游戏移植到 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。项目映射原可执行文件的函数及 Win32 资源，从用户的 COSMIC.EXE 读取图像与声音，并替换 DirectX 子系统。
requirements: An original Cosmic COSMIC.EXE; INTRO.AVI is optional.
CMake 3.24 or newer, a C++20 compiler and Git.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: uniq-reconstruction: rebuilding GNU uniq from behavioral probes
description_en: uniq-reconstruction rebuilds GNU coreutils 9.7 uniq in C from black-box observations of a stripped ELF executable. The author records 51 probes covering flags, grouping, delimiters and error behavior, then implements argument parsing and stream processing. The author reports that the candidate passed all 43 comparison tests for output, exit code, stderr and file effects.
description_zh: uniq-reconstruction 根据对无符号 ELF 可执行文件的黑盒观察，用 C 重建 GNU coreutils 9.7 的 uniq。作者记录了覆盖选项、分组、分隔符和错误行为的 51 项探测，并实现参数解析与流处理；作者报告候选程序在输出、退出码、错误输出及文件副作用的 43 项对照测试中全部通过。
requirements: GNU coreutils 9.7 uniq is the reference program used in the documented probes.
gcc is used to build the C candidate; pytest runs the documented comparison tests.
The author reports 43 of 43 tests passing.
No licence file in the repository.

name: LEGO SPIKE medium motor: reconstructing its UART handshake
description_en: An STM32U545RE project reconstructs the LEGO SPIKE medium motor's UART startup exchange from observations of the original hub. It reproduces the handshake and heartbeat so the motor sends speed, single-turn position and accumulated angle frames at 115200 baud.
description_zh: 该 STM32U545RE 项目依据原装 SPIKE 主机的通信记录，重现中型电机的 UART 启动握手与心跳。握手后，电机以 115200 波特发送速度、单圈位置和累计角度数据。
requirements: LEGO SPIKE or MINDSTORMS Robot Inventor medium motor and an STM32U545RE board.
Generate the STM32 HAL drivers from the included .ioc file with MyST.
Speed and proportional position control loops remain future work.
MIT license.

name: BLE Blood Pressure Monitor: analysing BC54 measurement packets
description_en: An ESP32 client investigates the BC54 blood-pressure monitor's BLE exchange and parses measurements from the Blood Pressure Service. Its notes map the measurement flags, pressure values and optional fields and describe bonded, encrypted pairing.
description_zh: 该 ESP32 客户端研究 BC54 血压计的 BLE 通信，并解析 Blood Pressure Service 的测量数据。文档列出标志位、血压数值和可选字段，也说明了绑定及加密配对流程。
requirements: An ESP32 development board and a BC54 blood-pressure monitor or compatible device.
Arduino IDE with the ESP32 board package and BLE libraries.
No licence file in the repository.

name: LD2410S: investigating radar buses and firmware
description_en: The LD2410S investigation documents the I2C and SPI traffic between a Hi-Link FMCW radar board's components and examines its Puya controller firmware. It includes Saleae captures, oscilloscope images, an interpreted Range FFT frame, firmware strings and an interrupt vector map. The author labels the investigation as work in progress.
description_zh: LD2410S 研究记录分析 Hi-Link FMCW 雷达板上组件间的 I2C、SPI 通信以及 Puya 控制器固件。内容包括 Saleae 捕获、示波器图像、Range FFT 帧解析、固件字符串和中断向量表。作者将研究标为进行中。
requirements: Access to an LD2410S radar module and capture equipment is needed to repeat the bus observations.
The firmware investigation uses pyOCD and an ST-Link V2.
The investigation is work in progress.
No licence file in the repository.

name: MiFit-Hack-API: reconstructing Mi Fit account and fitness requests
description_en: MiFit-Hack-API documents Mi Fit Android app requests observed through mitmproxy and provides Python access scripts. Its notes map registration and login tokens, a band-data endpoint, and Base64-encoded step and sleep summaries.
description_zh: MiFit-Hack-API 记录通过 mitmproxy 观察到的 Mi Fit Android 应用请求，并提供 Python 访问脚本。文档梳理注册与登录令牌、手环数据端点，以及 Base64 编码的步数和睡眠摘要。
requirements: A spare Android 7.1.1 or newer device with root access, the Mi Fit app and mitmproxy on the same network.
The documented setup installs the proxy certificate on the device.
MIT license.

name: MiniToo Pixeldeck: Divoom display protocol and input research
description_en: MiniToo Pixeldeck implements and documents the Divoom MiniToo's Bluetooth Classic display exchange. Its Python driver frames and uploads JPEG or optional Zstandard RGB pixel data, while research notes record observed media-button input paths and their limits. The toolkit includes interactive pixel demonstrations and protocol diagnostics.
description_zh: MiniToo Pixeldeck 实现并记录了 Divoom MiniToo 的蓝牙经典模式显示通信。Python 驱动封装并上传 JPEG 或可选的 Zstandard RGB 像素数据；研究笔记记录了已观测到的媒体按键输入路径及其限制。工具包还包含交互式像素演示和协议诊断功能。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later; the documented live Bluetooth backend runs on Windows with a Divoom MiniToo.
Up, Down, joystick-center and the original Back key are not implemented; device animation is limited by Bluetooth throughput.
MIT license.

name: Phantom Blade Zero: documenting the PBZS v3 save format
description_en: Phantom Blade Zero Save Format documents the PBZS v3 save container used by the game's Steam PC release. It maps the cleartext header, AES-256-GCM block framing, directory records and slot compression codes, and includes a Node.js script that checks file structure and SHA-256.
description_zh: Phantom Blade Zero Save Format 记录该游戏 Steam PC 版使用的 PBZS v3 存档容器。文档列出明文文件头、AES-256-GCM 数据块结构、目录记录和存档槽压缩类型；Node.js 脚本检查文件结构与 SHA-256。
requirements: Supply a PBZSaveGame.sav file to inspect.
Node.js 18 or newer is required for verify-pbzs.mjs.
The included script checks structure and SHA-256.
MIT licence.

name: fnb58-ble-logger: FNB58 Bluetooth measurement protocol
description_en: fnb58-ble-logger reconstructs the FNIRSI FNB58's Bluetooth LE measurement exchange and logs voltage, current and power to daily CSV files. Its Linux daemon writes the stream-start commands, reassembles notification frames and decodes type 04 measurements; the repository documents the observed GATT layout and frame format.
description_zh: fnb58-ble-logger 复原了 FNIRSI FNB58 的 BLE 测量通信，将电压、电流和功率写入每日 CSV 文件。Linux 守护进程发送启动命令、重组通知帧并解析 04 型测量值；仓库记录了观测到的 GATT 布局和帧格式。
requirements: Linux with BlueZ, CMake 3.16 or later, a C compiler, libglib2.0-dev and an FNB58 with Bluetooth enabled.
Frame types 05–08 and the check byte remain unknown; the silent-link watchdog and shipped DynamicUser service have not been exercised on hardware.
MIT license.

name: Ignition: porting the 1997 racing game from executable analysis
