description_en: Ignition ports the 1997 racing game by reading routines in its Windows executable with IDA and rewriting their behaviour in portable C99. The port loads data from the user's disc image and provides races, championships, audio and multiple platform hosts. Source files, executable-analysis notes and per-routine progress records document the reconstruction.
description_zh: Ignition 使用 IDA 阅读 1997 年同名赛车游戏的 Windows 程序，并以可移植 C99 改写各例程的行为。移植版从用户的光盘映像读取数据，包含单场比赛、锦标赛和音频，并适配多个平台；仓库还记录了程序分析结果及逐例程进度。
requirements: Supply a .cue/.bin disc image from a copy of Ignition.
Build tools depend on platform; the macOS build requires Xcode command line tools.
The author reports about 70% of the game's code ported; original joystick code remains unported.
GNU General Public License v3.0.

name: KULT: a C reconstruction of the Atari ST game's core
description_en: kult-atari-st-c hand-reimplements the core of the Atari ST game Kult: The Temple of Flying Saucers in documented C, using an assembly decompilation as its behavioral reference. A Musashi-based differential harness runs original routines and compares memory and registers with the C candidates. The repository supplies core code and tests.
description_zh: kult-atari-st-c 以汇编反编译成果为行为参考，手工将 Atari ST 游戏《Kult: The Temple of Flying Saucers》的核心重建为有文档的 C 代码。基于 Musashi 的差分测试框架运行原版例程，并比较内存和寄存器；仓库提供核心代码与测试，不生成可玩的程序。
requirements: The differential test workflow is designed for Linux or WSL and uses Python 3 and the project's verification kit.
The repository supplies core code and tests but no playable executable or original game material.
Project-authored code is MIT; the verification kit is GPL-2.0.

name: Dragon Ball Z on the Nintendo 64: recompiling two GBA games for N64
description_en: Dragon Ball Z on the Nintendo 64 statically recompiles ARM and Thumb code from The Legacy of Goku II and Buu's Fury into C for N64 builds. Its runtime supplies GBA graphics, sound, DMA, timers, interrupts and saves, with an RDP renderer and wider field view. The author reports both games playable on real hardware.
description_zh: Dragon Ball Z on the Nintendo 64 将《The Legacy of Goku II》和《Buu's Fury》的 GBA ARM 与 Thumb 代码静态重编译为 C，再构建 N64 ROM。运行时实现 GBA 图形、声音、DMA、定时器、中断和存档，并提供 RDP 渲染器与加宽的场景视野；作者报告两款游戏可在实体硬件上游玩。
requirements: Supply a user-owned USA cartridge dump of the game being built; the build checks its SHA-1.
Hardware use requires an N64 with Expansion Pak or an Analogue 3D, plus a flash cart.
Building uses WSL Ubuntu, the libdragon preview toolchain, Python 3 and capstone.
Buu's Fury's 320 × 240 field view currently applies to field maps.
PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 for repository source code.

name: KBM TG700 Control: Linux keyboard settings from USB protocol analysis
description_en: KBM TG700 Control reconstructs the USB HID settings protocol of KBM! GAMING TG600 and TG700 keyboards from analysis of their Windows software. Its Linux GTK4 app sets lighting, macros and key mappings through hidraw, and the protocol document records report fields and command codes. Hardware testing is reported for the TG700.
description_zh: KBM TG700 Control 根据 Windows 软件分析重建 KBM! GAMING TG600/TG700 键盘的 USB HID 设置协议。Linux GTK4 应用通过 hidraw 设置灯效、宏和按键映射，协议文档列出报告字段与命令码；作者报告已在 TG700 上测试。
requirements: Linux, Python 3.10 or later, PyGObject, GTK 4 and libadwaita 1.4 or later.
TG600 and TG600W layouts are included but have not been tested on hardware; Fn-layer editing is unfinished.
MIT license.

name: ssmouse: a client for the Rival 3 Wireless HID protocol
description_en: ssmouse implements a client for the SteelSeries Rival 3 Wireless HID protocol recovered from SteelSeries GG. Its Rust tray app and CLI read battery and device events and set DPI, polling, lighting, buttons and power options; the repository documents report framing and commands.
description_zh: ssmouse 基于从 SteelSeries GG 还原的 HID 协议，为 Rival 3 Wireless 实现 Rust 托盘程序和命令行客户端。它读取电量与设备事件，设置 DPI、轮询率、灯光、按键及电源选项，并记录报文格式和命令。
requirements: SteelSeries Rival 3 Wireless with USB ID 1038:1830; the author reports hardware checks on firmware 1.04.
Linux, Windows or macOS; building from source requires Rust 1.89 or newer.
Firmware extraction from SteelSeries GG installers requires 7-Zip.
MIT licence.

name: Foreca S60: reconstructing a legacy weather service
description_en: The Foreca S60 weather server reconstructs the legacy HTTP service expected by Foreca Weather 1.4.x on Nokia Symbian phones. A Python bridge translates location and forecast requests to the current Foreca API and other map sources, while a SIS patcher changes the server host in a user's app package. Protocol notes describe the search and weather-package endpoints.
description_zh: Foreca S60 weather server 重建 Nokia Symbian 手机上 Foreca Weather 1.4.x 所需的旧版 HTTP 服务。Python 桥接程序将地点和预报请求转接至现行 Foreca API 及地图来源；SIS 修改器可更改用户自备应用包中的服务器主机名。协议笔记记录搜索与天气数据包接口。
requirements: Linux, Python 3.9 or later, a reachable web server, a Foreca Weather API token and a user-provided Foreca SIS. Installing a patched SIS requires a phone that accepts unsigned packages or a way to sign the package.
The country and city browsing list, update.txt and map legends are unimplemented; HTTPS mode is experimental.
MIT license for the project; tools/symdeflate.py is EPL 1.0.

name: KuKirin G2 Master: decoding the display-controller UART protocol
description_en: KuKirin G2 Master UART protocol documents the single-wire link between the display and Lenzod controller of a late-2025 Version C scooter. It identifies inverted 230400-baud signalling, 66 66 frame headers, CRC-16/MODBUS and fields for controls, speed and battery voltage. Python tools decode logic-analyser captures and display live values.
description_zh: KuKirin G2 Master UART protocol 记录 2025 年末 Version C 车型的显示屏与 Lenzod 控制器之间的单线通信。文档说明反相 230400 波特信号、66 66 帧头、CRC-16/MODBUS，以及控制、速度和电池电压字段；Python 工具可解码逻辑分析仪采集数据并显示实时数值。
requirements: The documented protocol applies to the late-2025 KuKirin G2 Master Version C with Lenzod electronics.
Python 3 runs the analysis scripts; capture requires a logic analyser, and the live dashboard requires sigrok-cli.
The author measured one scooter; the left brake sensor, some error codes and two field meanings remain unresolved.
MIT licence.

name: Katten Project: Plus+ and Touch Pets server reimplementation
description_en: Katten Project reimplements server behavior for the Plus+ social gaming network and the Touch Pets games. Python modules provide account, session, cloud-save and leaderboard endpoints, while research notes describe XML elements parsed by Touch Pets clients. The project also includes a script that patches a user's game binary to stop using HTTPS.
description_zh: Katten Project 重建 Plus+ 社交游戏平台及 Touch Pets 游戏的服务端行为。Python 模块提供账号、会话、云存档和排行榜接口，研究笔记记录 Touch Pets 客户端解析的 XML 元素；仓库还提供修改用户游戏程序、使其不再使用 HTTPS 的脚本。
requirements: Linux, Flask and SQLAlchemy; use a compatible older iOS device and a copy of the game to run the client.
The project is in an early stage; achievements, password reset and several social features are unfinished.
MIT license.

name: RJ Connect: Ruijie campus authentication protocol research
description_en: RJ Connect documents Ruijie campus-network authentication at the packet, field, cryptographic and state-machine levels. Its Zig library implements the studied macOS 1.35 and MentoHUST 0.3.1 wired EAP-MD5 profiles, including private tail fields and session transitions. PEAP and Direct paths remain internal research modules.
description_zh: RJ Connect 从报文、字段、密码构造和状态机层面记录锐捷校园网认证协议。Zig 库实现了已研究的 macOS 1.35 与 MentoHUST 0.3.1 有线 EAP-MD5 配置，包括私有尾块字段和会话状态转换；PEAP 与 Direct 路径仍保留在内部研究模块。
requirements: Use the Zig version declared in build.zig.zon; a client supplies network I/O, time, randomness and credentials.
Real-network interoperability still requires integration testing; PEAP and Direct are outside the public session interface.
MIT license.

name: aula-hero68-protocol: reconstructing AULA HERO 68 HE RGB control
description_en: aula-hero68-protocol documents the HID lighting protocol of the AULA HERO 68 HE keyboard. It specifies the 64-byte output report, checksum, lighting commands and per-key payloads, and includes a key map calibrated by lighting and pressing individual keys. Capture parsers and a device test script accompany the protocol notes.
description_zh: aula-hero68-protocol 记录 AULA HERO 68 HE 键盘的 HID 灯光协议，说明 64 字节输出报告、校验值、灯效命令和逐键颜色载荷。项目还提供逐灯点亮并按键校准所得的键位表，以及抓包解析脚本和设备测试脚本。
requirements: An AULA HERO 68 HE keyboard with HID VID:PID 0x372E:0x103E is the documented test device.
Python tools require hidapi; capture tools additionally use Playwright or USBPcap.
The author reports that frames above about 24 color packets can lose packets or show wrong colors, while continuous cmd 0x06 refresh can make the keyboard flash.
Code: MIT License; documentation: CC BY 4.0, as stated by the project.

name: DEArmoredcoreV: statically recompiling Armored Core V for Linux
description_en: DEArmoredcoreV develops a Linux port of the Xbox 360 game Armored Core V by translating PowerPC instructions to C++ through ReXGlue. Its tools inspect BHD5/BDT, BND3, FLVER, TPF and Xbox 360 texture resources, while research notes track reconstructed behavior by address and function. The author reports an existing Linux package and an unresolved Mission 2 black-screen hang.
description_zh: DEArmoredcoreV 通过 ReXGlue 将 Xbox 360 版《Armored Core V》的 PowerPC 指令转换为 C++，开发 Linux 移植版。仓库工具分析 BHD5/BDT、BND3、FLVER、TPF 和 Xbox 360 纹理资源，研究文档按地址与函数记录行为重建。作者报告已有 Linux 软件包，但任务 2 的黑屏卡住问题仍未解决。
requirements: Linux x86_64, Clang or GCC, CMake, Ninja, Python 3, Node.js and a separately installed ReXGlue SDK 0.10.0 are required for development.
A user-supplied Armored Core V game image is required.
Rebuilding the game requires the generated translation and external workspace in addition to the repository source; a Mission 2 black-screen hang remains unresolved.
Project code and documentation use GPL-3.0-only.

name: MCHOSE V9 Turbo+: reconstructing headset RGB control
description_en: MCHOSE V9 Turbo+ protocol research reconstructs the headset's USB HID RGB control exchange. It documents the 65-byte Windows write buffer, lighting fields, ACK draining and a 0x07 status query that reads back color values. C# and Python probes exercise the commands against the device.
description_zh: MCHOSE V9 Turbo+ 协议研究重建了耳机 RGB 灯效的 USB HID 通信。文档记录 Windows 下的 65 字节写入缓冲、灯效字段、ACK 排空，以及读回颜色值的 0x07 状态查询；C# 和 Python 探针可向设备发送这些命令。
requirements: A MCHOSE V9 Turbo+ headset on Windows; the C# probe is built with the included PowerShell script.
The documented lighting interface is USB device 3837:6008.
Code is MIT licensed; documentation is CC BY 4.0.

name: sindri-led: reconstructing K671 Sindri lighting control
description_en: sindri-led reconstructs the K671 Sindri keyboard's HID lighting controls from study of the Windows software and device responses. The Linux Rust CLI changes effects, brightness and lit keys through feature reports, while protocol notes record report IDs and field layouts. A separate map links report positions to physical keys on one Latin ISO keyboard.
description_zh: sindri-led 通过研究 Windows 软件和设备响应，重建 K671 Sindri 键盘的 HID 灯效控制。Linux Rust 命令行工具通过 HID 功能报告修改灯效、亮度和点亮的按键；协议笔记记录报告 ID 与字段布局，另有映射表对应一台拉美 ISO 布局键盘的实体按键。
requirements: Linux, Rust and Cargo, and a K671 Sindri keyboard with USB ID 258a:013b.
Testing covers one Latin-layout keyboard; speed and several effects remain untested.
MIT license.

name: clevo-wmi-rgb: reconstructing Clevo keyboard backlight control
description_en: clevo-wmi-rgb documents the WMI commands used to control keyboard backlighting on a Colorful X15 AT23 laptop with a Clevo NP50SNE chassis. Its protocol notes describe CLEVO_GET.SetKBLED color packing, zone values, power and brightness commands; PowerShell scripts probe the interface and register its WMI class.
description_zh: clevo-wmi-rgb 记录了七彩虹 X15 AT23 笔记本（Clevo NP50SNE 模具）的键盘背光 WMI 控制方式。协议文档说明 CLEVO_GET.SetKBLED 的颜色编码、分区值、开关灯和亮度命令；PowerShell 脚本用于探测接口和注册 WMI 类。
requirements: A Colorful X15 AT23 with a Clevo NP50SNE chassis and administrator access for the documented hardware procedure.
WMI class registration may require CLEVOMOF.dll extracted from the manufacturer's driver package.
The author tested only the X15 AT23; its keyboard behaved as a single color zone.
Code: MIT License; documentation: CC BY 4.0, as stated by the project.

name: PC-3Ddot: statically recompiling 3D Dot Game Heroes for PC
description_en: PC-3Ddot develops a native PC port of the PS3 game 3D Dot Game Heroes by statically recompiling its EBOOT for the ps3kit runtime. It includes a disc reader, file-format documentation and tools for inspecting the executable and assets. The author reports that the recompiled game reaches playable field maps, including combat and movement between maps.
description_zh: PC-3Ddot 通过静态重编译 PS3 游戏《3D Dot Game Heroes》的 EBOOT，并使用 ps3kit 运行时，开发原生 PC 移植版。仓库提供光盘读取器、文件格式文档，以及分析程序和素材的工具。作者报告，重编译后的游戏已可进入野外地图，进行战斗并在地图之间移动。
requirements: Supply a copy of the European BLES00875 version 01.01 disc and a compatible key file.
The reader needs Python 3; building the recompiled game needs CMake, Ninja, clang and SDL3, plus the ps3kit submodule.
The author reports broken polygons on some models in the character-selection screen.
MIT licence for the repository's tools and documentation.

name: Sony A7 III: firmware updater packaging and UFU container analysis
description_en: Sony A7 III firmware analysis maps the packaging of Update_ILCE7M3V404.exe from a Packman self-extractor through an inverted MSCF CAB to a UFU TLV container. The write-up records offsets, tags and CRC coverage, and a Python script reproduces extraction and structural checks. The FDAT firmware body remains encrypted.
description_zh: Sony A7 III 固件分析梳理了 Update_ILCE7M3V404.exe 从 Packman 自解压层、按位取反的 MSCF CAB 到 UFU TLV 容器的封装链。文档记录偏移、标签和 CRC 覆盖范围，Python 脚本可复现提取与结构检查；FDAT 固件主体仍为密文。
requirements: Python 3.9 or later and a local copy of Update_ILCE7M3V404.exe; 7-Zip is optional for CAB expansion.
The FDAT payload is encrypted and the script does not decrypt it.
CC BY 4.0 license.

name: TH11: byte-exact source reconstruction of Subterranean Animism
description_en: TH11 reconstructs source for the original Japanese 1.00a executable of Touhou 11: Subterranean Animism. It records function boundaries and origins, compiles maintained C and C++ with a pinned VC9 toolchain, and compares complete generated code and relocations with the target.
description_zh: TH11 重建《东方地灵殿》日文原版 1.00a 的程序源码。项目记录函数边界和来源，用固定版本的 VC9 编译所维护的 C/C++ 源码，再将生成的完整代码及重定位与目标程序逐字节比较。
requirements: Supply the original Japanese TH11 1.00a executable at resources/th11.exe with the documented SHA-256.
The workflow uses pinned Capstone, Ghidra and a VC9 compiler candidate.
The Windows i386 production build, full runtime and portability remain open.
MIT licence for repository-authored code and documentation.

name: Link: The Faces of Evil: matching CD-i program decompilation
description_en: Link: The Faces of Evil Decompilation reconstructs the Philips CD-i game's cdi_link main program as C source. Its build compiles functions with Apple MPW C 3.0, places them in the module and compares the resulting SHA-1 with the original from a user's disc. The author reports matching builds for English, French, German and Dutch releases.
description_zh: Link: The Faces of Evil Decompilation 将 Philips CD-i 游戏的 cdi_link 主程序重建为 C 源码。构建流程使用 Apple MPW C 3.0 编译各函数、组装模块，再与用户光盘中的原程序比较 SHA-1。作者报告英语、法语、德语和荷兰语版本均可匹配。
requirements: A supported game disc, Python 3, Capstone, Basilisk II, an owned 68040 Mac ROM, System 7.5.3 and MPW C 3.0.
Some drawing routines and NVRAM name coders remain in assembly; naming and documentation remain incomplete.
No licence file in the repository.

name: 358/2 Days for Android: porting Kingdom Hearts to dual-screen devices
description_en: 358/2 Days for Android ports Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days to Android using the upstream khdays-port and its decompiled C game code. It adds an Android app, ROM import, touch controls and a two-screen layout for the AYN Thor; on one-screen devices, both game screens share the display.
description_zh: 358/2 Days for Android 基于上游 khdays-port 及其反编译得到的 C 游戏代码，将《Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days》移植到 Android。项目新增应用、ROM 导入、触控操作和 AYN Thor 双屏布局；单屏设备则共用一块显示屏。
requirements: A 64-bit ARM device with Vulkan and Android 10 or later; the author reports testing on AYN Thor.
Supply a European or North American Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days .nds ROM from a cartridge.
The project is described as a beta that may have bugs.
MIT licence.

name: Nagano Winter Olympics '98: matching Nintendo 64 decompilation
description_en: Nagano Winter Olympics '98 decompilation reconstructs the USA Nintendo 64 release with compiled source and a mapped ROM data region. Its verification commands compare relocated program bytes with a user-provided retail ROM, while analysis files classify and reproduce non-code intervals. The author reports complete byte matching for catalogued functions and initialized data.
description_zh: Nagano Winter Olympics '98 反编译项目重建美国版 Nintendo 64 游戏的源码，并整理 ROM 数据区域。验证命令将编译后的程序字节与用户提供的零售版 ROM 比较，分析文件对非代码区间进行分类和重建。作者报告已编目的函数与初始化数据均实现逐字节匹配。
requirements: A legally obtained USA Rev 0 retail ROM, n64-decomp-kit and a matching toolchain.
Some transform, model and texture fields retain provisional descriptive names.
No licence file in the repository.

name: pc-abelsmt: statically recompiling ABEL for PC
description_en: pc-abelsmt ports the FM Towns game ABEL - Shin Mokushiroku Taisen to PC by statically recompiling its 386 programs and TBIOS to C++ on fmtownskit. It includes a runtime, extraction and comparison tools, and notes on disc and executable formats. The author reports that early screens match MAME pixel for pixel.
description_zh: pc-abelsmt 借助 fmtownskit 将 FM Towns 游戏《ABEL - Shin Mokushiroku Taisen》的 386 程序及 TBIOS 静态重编译为 C++，用于 PC 移植。仓库包含运行时、提取与比较工具，以及光盘和可执行文件格式记录。作者报告早期画面与 MAME 逐像素一致。
requirements: Supply the user's own ABEL disc files and the documented FM Towns BIOS files.
Build instructions use fmtownskit, Python, CMake, Ninja and clang++.
The route to the first dungeon, saving and English translation remain unfinished.
MIT licence.

name: Madden Football 64: matching Nintendo 64 decompilation
description_en: Madden Football 64 decompilation reconstructs portions of the USA Rev 0 Nintendo 64 game's code and maps its packed ROM layout. Build commands recover the resident program, compare compiled C units byte for byte with retail code and track assembly references separately. The author reports 19.60% of whole-program code as matching decompiled C at the documented snapshot.
description_zh: Madden Football 64 反编译项目重建美国版 Rev 0 Nintendo 64 游戏的部分代码，并梳理其打包 ROM 布局。构建命令恢复常驻程序，将编译后的 C 单元与零售版代码逐字节比较，另行统计汇编参考内容。作者报告文档快照时匹配的 C 反编译代码占全程序代码的 19.60%。
requirements: A matching USA Rev 0 retail ROM, n64-decomp-kit and the matching toolchains.
The project is in its initial recovery phase; executable-overlay boundaries remain provisional.
GPL-3.0-or-later license, as stated in COPYING.

name: Rugrats: Scavenger Hunt: matching reconstruction of the USA N64 release
description_en: Rugrats: Scavenger Hunt reconstructs the USA Nintendo 64 game with matching C, reviewed assembly, symbolic RSP code and descriptions of initialized data. Its tools rebuild CPU units with recorded compiler pipelines and compare code and non-code regions with a player-supplied ROM. The author reports complete executable-byte and ROM-inventory coverage.
description_zh: 《Rugrats: Scavenger Hunt》美版 Nintendo 64 游戏的重建项目包含匹配的 C 源码、审查过的汇编、符号化 RSP 代码和初始化数据描述。工具使用记录的编译流程重建 CPU 单元，并与玩家提供的 ROM 比较代码和非代码区域；作者报告可执行字节及 ROM 清单均已覆盖。
requirements: A player-supplied USA ROM matching the listed SHA-1 and legally obtained historical N64 compiler files are required.
Linux or WSL, Python 3.11 or newer, GNU Make, rabbitizer and armips are required for the stated checks.
The author reports complete byte coverage while retaining 29 functions as assembly.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Ninja Gaiden Black: running Xbox game code on a native Windows runtime
description_en: Ninja Gaiden Black native PC port runs the original Xbox game's x86 code inside a 32-bit Windows process. Its C runtime supplies an XBE loader, replacement Xbox kernel, NV2A-to-OpenGL renderer and APU audio engine; Python tools and notes document game formats and executable behaviour. The launcher imports files from the user's disc.
description_zh: Ninja Gaiden Black 原生 PC 移植版在 32 位 Windows 进程中执行原版 Xbox 游戏的 x86 代码。C 运行时提供 XBE 加载器、Xbox 内核替代实现、NV2A 到 OpenGL 的渲染器及 APU 音频引擎；Python 工具和文档记录游戏格式与程序行为，启动器从用户光盘导入文件。
requirements: Supply files from a copy of Ninja Gaiden Black for the original Xbox; PAL and NTSC-U releases are supported.
The getting-started guide specifies Windows 10 version 1803 or later or Windows 11.
Building requires Visual Studio 2022 with the C++ x86 toolset and Python 3.13.
The author reports occasional glitches, missing reflections and sword glow, and possible slowdowns.
GPL-3.0-or-later licence.

name: poketaka-sim: reconstructing PokéTaka battle rules from replays
description_en: poketaka-sim reconstructs PokéTaka battle behavior from replay logs and simulates a recorded match hit by hit. It converts damage observations into interval constraints, compares candidate critical-hit and rounding rules, and checks the inferred model against held-out hits. The author reports exact reproduction of 255 observed hits in the example battle.
description_zh: poketaka-sim 从 PokéTaka 战斗回放推导规则，并逐次攻击模拟已记录的对局。它把伤害观测转为区间约束，比较暴击倍率与取整假设，再用留出的攻击记录检验模型。作者报告示例对局的 255 次攻击均得到相同结果。
requirements: Python 3.12 and a PokéTaka replay JSON file are required.
The repository includes one example replay; the author says Choice Band and Shell Bell checks used seven replays in total, six of which are not included.
STAB cannot be identified from the example replay, and Life Orb and Rocky Helmet rules remain unconfirmed.
No licence file in the repository.

name: SOCOM Legacy: a browser reconstruction of SOCOM II
description_en: SOCOM Legacy rebuilds SOCOM II U.S. Navy SEALs in TypeScript and three.js for browser multiplayer, loading maps and other game data from the user's own disc. The project records values read from disc data and game code, and tracks parity for menus, online flow, maps, and matches while its multiplayer implementation continues to develop.
description_zh: SOCOM Legacy 使用 TypeScript 和 three.js 在浏览器中重建《SOCOM II U.S. Navy SEALs》，重点是多人游戏，并从用户自备的游戏光盘读取地图等数据。项目依据光盘数据和游戏代码中的数值，跟踪菜单、联网流程、地图和对局与原作的一致性；多人游戏功能仍在开发中。
requirements: Node 22+, a browser with WebGPU or WebGL2, and the user's own US SOCOM II disc copy as an ISO or extracted folder.
Campaign missions are not yet included; multiplayer maps and network stability remain in progress.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Dih Pinterest: reconstructing a Pinterest search site's page and data flow
description_en: Dih Pinterest reconstructs the search interface and data flow of searchpinterest.vercel.app as a static web app with an optional Vercel proxy. Its report describes a page hidden in zero-width characters, the site's search API flow and an exposed client-side database token. The repository includes small encoder and decoder scripts for the cloaking scheme.
description_zh: Dih Pinterest 将 searchpinterest.vercel.app 的搜索界面和数据流重建为静态网页，可选配 Vercel 代理。研究报告记录了零宽字符隐藏页面、搜索 API 流程和前端暴露的数据库令牌；仓库还提供该隐藏方案的编码与解码脚本。
requirements: The static frontend can be served without a build step; the optional proxy uses Vercel.
The replica's search depends on the documented third-party zelora-api service or proxy path.
MIT license.

name: XY Remote: reconstructing XinYi amplifier BLE control
description_en: XY Remote reconstructs BLE control for XinYi Sinilink amplifier boards in an iOS app and Swift library. Protocol notes derived from the vendor Android app's Hermes bytecode describe GATT service AE00, frame assembly, checksums, commands and the connection handshake. The author reports testing against app logic and a simulated amplifier.
description_zh: XY Remote 以 iOS 应用和 Swift 库重建 XinYi Sinilink 功放板的 BLE 控制。依据厂商 Android 应用的 Hermes 字节码，协议文档记录 GATT 服务 AE00、组帧、校验和、命令及连接握手。作者报告已用应用逻辑和模拟功放进行测试。
requirements: Xcode 16 or later and an iOS 17 iPhone or iPad are required for the app.
The author reports simulator and app-logic tests; real amplifier hardware has not yet been tested.
MIT license.

name: Osmo+ Studio: reconstructing DJI Osmo+ Wi-Fi control and streaming
description_en: Osmo+ Studio reconstructs DJI Osmo+ camera control and live video transport over Wi-Fi in Python. Its DUML parser and probes document frame checksums, gimbal and zoom commands, exposure settings, and the H.264 stream handshake and sequence acknowledgements. The desktop app routes the camera feed to OBS Virtual Camera.
description_zh: Osmo+ Studio 用 Python 重建 DJI Osmo+ 相机的 Wi-Fi 控制和实时视频传输。DUML 解析器及探针记录帧校验、云台和变焦命令、曝光设置，以及 H.264 视频流的握手与序号确认；桌面应用将画面送入 OBS Virtual Camera。
requirements: A DJI Osmo+ camera and a computer connected to its Wi-Fi access point are required.
The app requires Python dependencies from requirements.txt, ffmpeg on PATH and OBS Studio for its virtual camera.
The live Wi-Fi feed is 1280×720 H.264, and the author reports occasional brief flow-control pauses.
MIT license.

name: RideLink: reconstructing TVS SmartXonnect scooter communication
description_en: RideLink reconstructs TVS SmartXonnect scooter communication in an Android companion app. Protocol notes derived from static analysis of TVS Connect 8.13.2 map BLE GATT characteristics, connection steps and navigation and telemetry frames. The app forwards map directions and phone events to the display and records ride data.
description_zh: RideLink 在 Android 配套应用中重建 TVS SmartXonnect 踏板车通信。根据 TVS Connect 8.13.2 的静态分析，协议文档列出 BLE GATT 特征、连接流程以及导航和遥测帧；应用向仪表发送导航及手机事件，并记录骑行数据。
requirements: Android 8.0 or later and a compatible TVS SmartXonnect display are required.
The author reports testing a 2026 NTORQ 125 Race XP; other listed Ntorq models remain untested on a scooter.

name: cherry-mx-lighting-mac: reconstructing Cherry MX 10.0N RGB lighting control
description_en: cherry-mx-lighting-mac reconstructs lighting control for the Cherry MX 10.0N RGB keyboard in a macOS menu bar app. The author observed Cherry Utility's USB HID traffic and documented a five-report sequence, including bytes for effect, brightness, speed and RGB colour; the app also remaps keys through hidutil.
description_zh: cherry-mx-lighting-mac 为 Cherry MX 10.0N RGB 键盘重建灯光控制，并提供 macOS 菜单栏应用。作者观察 Cherry Utility 的 USB HID 通信，记录五条报文的发送顺序，以及效果、亮度、速度和 RGB 颜色的字节位置；应用还通过 hidutil 重映射按键。
requirements: Cherry MX 10.0N RGB keyboard and macOS; the author tested USB device 046A:00E2 on macOS 27 with Apple Silicon.
Xcode Command Line Tools are required to build; Input Monitoring permission is required to write to the keyboard.
Effect direction, per-key colours and Custom mode are unfinished; other Cherry models are untested.
MIT license.

name: labelibre: direct SUPVAN T50M Pro printing over a reconstructed BLE protocol
description_en: labelibre implements direct Bluetooth printing to the SUPVAN T50M Pro using protocol knowledge from community analysis of the Katasymbol app. It parses Labelife AML labels into one-bit images, compresses print buffers with LZMA and sends data frames through a BLE transport from a macOS app or CLI.
description_zh: labelibre 利用社区对 Katasymbol 应用的协议分析，通过蓝牙直接驱动 SUPVAN T50M Pro。它将 Labelife AML 标签解析为单色图像，以 LZMA 压缩打印缓冲区，再由 macOS 应用或命令行工具通过 BLE 发送数据帧。
requirements: macOS 12+, Python 3.13 and a SUPVAN T50M Pro printer with Bluetooth access.
The printer must be on and disconnected from the phone app.
AML rendering supports Image elements; text and barcode elements are skipped.
MIT license.

name: urja-api: reconstructing the Urja Meter Ops portal API
description_en: urja-api reconstructs access to the Urja Meter Ops web portal as a typed TypeScript service and REST API. The author traced browser requests and replayed them to document login cookies, signed bulk export, JSON endpoints and SvelteKit data pages; the adapter turns those responses into meter, transformer and energy-reading routes.
description_zh: urja-api 将 Urja Meter Ops 网页门户的访问流程重建为类型化 TypeScript 服务和 REST API。作者追踪并重放浏览器请求，记录登录 Cookie、签名批量导出、JSON 端点及 SvelteKit 数据页面；适配层将响应整理为电表、变压器和能耗读数接口。
requirements: Node.js 20.6 or later and an Urja Meter Ops portal account are needed for live use.
An offline mode uses the repository's fake portal and needs Node.js only.
The service is designed around one portal and an in-memory dataset.
No licence file in the repository.

name: synaptics-009b-fprintd: reconstructing Linux support for Synaptics 06cb:009b
description_en: synaptics-009b-fprintd reconstructs Linux support for the Synaptics Prometheus 06cb:009b fingerprint sensor. Its Rust modules handle USB transport, encrypted frame capture and host-side matching, while a D-Bus service presents the device through fprintd interfaces.
description_zh: synaptics-009b-fprintd 重建 Synaptics Prometheus 06cb:009b 指纹传感器的 Linux 支持。Rust 模块处理 USB 通信、加密图像帧采集和主机端匹配，D-Bus 服务则通过 fprintd 接口提供指纹功能。
requirements: Linux system with a Synaptics 06cb:009b sensor.
The installer obtains model weights from a Microsoft-distributed driver package; Rust 1.85+ is specified in the workspace.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: Tony Hawk's Underground: a matching PS2 decompilation
description_en: Tony Hawk's Underground is being reconstructed as matching C++ for the NTSC-U PlayStation 2 release SLUS-20731. The project splits the ELF into functions, compiles each recovered function with a pinned SN Systems toolchain and compares instructions; remaining functions are assembled so the complete build can be checked against the user's disc by SHA-1.
description_zh: 项目针对《Tony Hawk's Underground》美版 PS2 发行版 SLUS-20731 重建逐函数匹配的 C++ 源码。它拆分 ELF，用固定的 SN Systems 工具链编译已恢复函数并逐指令比较；其余函数以汇编保留，完整构建再与用户光盘中的文件进行 SHA-1 比对。
requirements: A legally owned NTSC-U SLUS-20731 game disc or dump is required.
The documented workflow uses Linux, Python 3 and a pinned SN Systems ee-gcc toolchain under wibo.
The author reports four C++ functions matched in the dated status report; the remaining full-ELF reconstruction is largely assembly.
CC0-1.0 license for the repository code.

name: Soleanna: a static recompilation of Sonic the Hedgehog (2006) for PC
description_en: Soleanna builds a native Windows port of the PlayStation 3 version of Sonic the Hedgehog (2006) from the user's BLES00028 disc. Its launcher decrypts EBOOT.BIN with RPCS3, uses ps3recomp to translate PowerPC code to C, and compiles an x86-64 executable with a high-level PS3 runtime and Direct3D 12 rendering.
description_zh: Soleanna 从用户的 BLES00028 光盘构建《Sonic the Hedgehog (2006)》PS3 版的 Windows 原生移植。启动器用 RPCS3 解密 EBOOT.BIN，经 ps3recomp 将 PowerPC 代码转成 C，再编译为带有 PS3 系统运行层和 Direct3D 12 渲染的 x86-64 程序。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, with at least 8 GB RAM and about 10 GB free disk space.
An owned BLES00028 disc or ISO and RPCS3 are required; building the launcher from a checkout also needs the .NET SDK.
Version 0.1.0 is a work in progress; the author reports that no stage has been played to completion and testing used one PC.
MIT license.

name: muse-cli: reconstructing the muse.ai personal gateway protocol
description_en: muse-cli implements terminal access to the muse.ai personal gateway using behavior derived from its web client bundle. It obtains access tokens over HTTPS, connects to a personal VM through a Noise-XX WebSocket, and exchanges protobuf-framed requests and events. The accompanying notes document transport framing and gateway methods.
description_zh: muse-cli 根据 muse.ai 网页客户端代码实现个人网关的命令行客户端。它通过 HTTPS 获取访问令牌，经 Noise-XX WebSocket 连接个人虚拟机，并交换 protobuf 封装的请求与事件；协议文档记录了传输帧格式和网关方法。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer and an existing muse.ai browser login are required.
Direct browser-cookie export supports Chromium-based browsers on macOS; other systems use agent-browser or manual cookie export.
The gateway API is unversioned and may change.
MIT license.

name: P3P3DS: running Persona 3 Portable on New Nintendo 3DS
description_en: P3P3DS adapts Persona 3 Portable's North American PSP release for New Nintendo 3DS through static MIPS-to-C++ recompilation, an interpreter fallback and a PSP service runtime. Its research documents the game's ELF32 PRX executable, relocations and imports. The author reports early playable progress on hardware, with sound and opening video still absent.
description_zh: P3P3DS 通过 MIPS 到 C++ 的静态重编译、解释器后备路径和 PSP 服务运行时，将北美版《Persona 3 Portable》移至 New Nintendo 3DS。项目记录了游戏 ELF32 PRX 可执行文件、重定位及导入信息。作者报告已能在实体机上游玩早期内容，但声音和开场视频仍缺失。
requirements: The North American Persona 3 Portable release, ULUS-10512, is the target input.
New Nintendo 3DS, New 3DS XL or New 2DS XL hardware and devkitARM are specified for the 3DS build.
The author reports early playable progress; later game sections remain untested, and 3DS sound and opening video are unavailable.
MIT License.

name: Capybara: reconstructing Sonix hardware for Tamagotchi Paradise firmware
description_en: Capybara reconstructs the Sonix SNC73410 hardware environment needed to run Tamagotchi Paradise factory firmware on a computer. Its Rust emulator implements an ARMv7-M core and peripherals modeled from measurement, imports a user-owned 16 MB flash dump and derives the dump's decryption value before booting it.
description_zh: Capybara 重建 Sonix SNC73410 硬件环境，使 Tamagotchi Paradise 的原厂固件可在电脑上运行。Rust 模拟器实现 ARMv7-M 核心和依据测量建立的外设模型，导入用户自有的 16 MB 闪存转储，并在启动前求出该转储的解密参数。
requirements: A 16 MB flash dump read from the user's own Tamagotchi Paradise console is required.
Cargo can build the Rust application in release mode.
Land, Water, Sky and Jade Forest editions are reported tested; White Glacier and Orange Tropical are untested.
GPL-3.0-only license.

name: STRIDE: a replacement NordicTrack console using the FitPro protocol
description_en: STRIDE reconstructs the FitPro motor-board interface for a replacement Android console app on a NordicTrack treadmill. Its protocol notes document the USB HID transport, message frames and commands derived from traffic analysis and software examination. The app communicates with the board over USB and can publish treadmill telemetry through MQTT.
description_zh: STRIDE 为 NordicTrack 跑步机开发替代 Android 控制台应用，并重建与 FitPro 电机板通信的接口。协议文档根据 USB 流量分析和软件检查，记录 HID 传输、消息帧及命令；应用通过 USB 与电机板通信，也可通过 MQTT 发布跑步机数据。
requirements: Requires a NordicTrack or ProForm treadmill with a FitPro motor board and an Android console reachable through adb; the author reports use on one NordicTrack C 1750 Gen 6 machine.
Installation uses macOS or Linux with adb and Python 3.9+; building the app additionally requires JDK 17 and the Android SDK.
The author reports that other treadmill models have not been tried.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: TonePush: reconstructing Line 6 HX editing over USB
description_en: TonePush reconstructs the Line 6 HX USB editor protocol in reusable Rust crates, a CLI and a desktop editor. Captures from HX Edit and an HX Stomp informed packet framing, preset documents, backups, settings and impulse-response transfers. The same interface also supports StompStation PRO through its separately documented device protocol.
description_zh: TonePush 在可复用的 Rust 模块、命令行工具和桌面编辑器中重建 Line 6 HX 的 USB 编辑协议。项目分析 HX Edit 与 HX Stomp 的通信，恢复报文结构、预设文档、备份、设置和脉冲响应传输；同一界面也通过另行记录的设备协议支持 StompStation PRO。
requirements: A supported Line 6 HX or StompStation PRO device and USB access are required for live editing.
Building requires Rust; the Linux GUI additionally needs X11 or Wayland development packages.
HX model names and artwork are read from a locally installed HX Edit or a user-provided installer.
MIT license.

name: ESP32Drop: rebuilding AirDrop and AWDL on ESP32-S3
description_en: ESP32Drop reimplements Apple Wireless Direct Link and AirDrop on an ESP32-S3 from observed traffic. Its Arduino library and example sketches receive files from, or send a file to, nearby Macs and iPhones over a direct wireless link. The implementation includes AWDL framing and AirDrop transfer components with host tests based partly on captured traffic.
description_zh: ESP32Drop 根据观测流量在 ESP32-S3 上重建 Apple Wireless Direct Link 和 AirDrop。Arduino 库及示例可经直接无线链路接收附近 Mac、iPhone 的文件，或向其发送文件；实现包含 AWDL 帧处理、AirDrop 传输组件，以及部分基于抓包的主机测试。
requirements: An ESP32-S3 with PSRAM and an Arduino-compatible toolchain are required.
The author reports development and testing on an M5Stack StopWatch with m5stack:esp32 core 3.3.8; other boards and core versions have not been tried.
Receive and send require separate builds, and Contacts Only transfers are unsupported.
0BSD license.

name: wc2-re: a matching Wing Commander II reconstruction and SDL2 port
description_en: wc2-re reconstructs Wing Commander II source from its Kilrathi Saga Win32 release and provides an SDL2 port. The C game core and C++ audio library rebuild with Visual C++ 4.1; the author reports that the resulting WC2.EXE matches all 714,752 bytes of the retail executable. The port runs with user-supplied game data on Windows, Linux and macOS.
description_zh: wc2-re 根据《Wing Commander: The Kilrathi Saga》中的 Win32 版本重建《Wing Commander II》源码，并提供 SDL2 移植版。C 游戏核心与 C++ 音频库使用 Visual C++ 4.1 构建；作者报告生成的 WC2.EXE 与零售版全部 714,752 字节一致。移植版在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上使用玩家自备的游戏数据。
requirements: Running the game requires a user's own Kilrathi Saga or compatible DOS data.
The matching build uses Python 3.10+, Microsoft Visual C++ 4.1 under wibo, and a retail SHA-256 comparison.
The SDL2 port requires a C/C++ compiler plus SDL2 and LZO2 development packages.
Support for original DOS game data is partial.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Abyssal: a Godot engine for DEEP using the player's JAR
description_en: Abyssal reimplements the mobile game DEEP in a Godot engine for desktop, browser and Android. It converts a player-provided MIDlet JAR locally, decoding resources and evaluating selected class-file data tables to supply the engine. The implementation covers submarine piloting, stations, trading, missions and combat.
description_zh: Abyssal 以 Godot 为桌面、浏览器和 Android 平台重建手机游戏《DEEP》的引擎。它在本地转换玩家自备的 MIDlet JAR，解码资源并对部分 class 文件数据表进行受限字节码求值，供新引擎使用。实现内容包括潜艇驾驶、空间站、交易、任务与战斗。
requirements: Playing requires a user's own compatible DEEP MIDlet JAR.
The browser build requires WebGL 2 and a desktop-class browser; self-hosting requires HTTPS.
Source development requires Godot 4.7 Standard and Python 3.10+; direct JAR conversion also requires JDK 17+ and FFmpeg.
The author reports that several platform builds have not been checked on physical hardware.
Apache-2.0 license for the engine's own source and artwork.

name: Valeton GP-50 Editor: live preset editing over reconstructed SysEx
description_en: Valeton GP-50 Editor controls GP-50 and GP-5 guitar pedals through a reconstructed MIDI SysEx protocol. Its browser interface uses WebMIDI to inspect and edit presets, reorder blocks, rename slots and convert GP-5 and GP-50 .prst files. The repository also includes protocol tooling and findings about the vendor's NAM-to-SnapTone conversion path.
description_zh: Valeton GP-50 Editor 通过重建的 MIDI SysEx 协议控制 GP-50 和 GP-5 吉他效果器。浏览器界面用 WebMIDI 查看和编辑预设、调整效果块顺序、重命名槽位，并转换两种设备的 .prst 文件；仓库另有协议研究工具及 NAM 转 SnapTone 流程的分析记录。
requirements: A GP-50 or GP-5 connected by USB and a WebMIDI-capable Chrome or Edge browser are required for live editing.
Chrome 152 has a documented SysEx framing regression; the source recommends Chrome 153 or newer.
The author no longer owns test hardware, so later device I/O changes are checked against tests rather than a live pedal.
MIT license.

name: r8link: reconstructing Uniden R8w Bluetooth telemetry
description_en: r8link reconstructs the Uniden R8w radar detector's Bluetooth LE data exchange as a Python client and protocol reference. The author used JADX on the R/Tach Android app and captured live traffic, then implemented parsing for alerts, frequency, signal strength, direction, device telemetry, and stored camera points.
description_zh: r8link 将 Uniden R8w 雷达探测器的低功耗蓝牙数据交换整理为协议文档和 Python 客户端。作者用 JADX 分析 R/Tach Android 应用并采集设备流量，实现了对警报、频率、信号强度、方向、设备遥测数据及已存测速摄像头位置的解析。
requirements: Linux with BlueZ, Python 3.10+, bleak, and a paired Uniden R8w.
The protocol observations cover one R8w and one firmware version; macOS has not been tried.
MIT license.

name: lumalou: reconstructing Fisher-Price Lumalou BLE control
description_en: lumalou reconstructs local Bluetooth LE control of the Fisher-Price Lumalou bedtime device after its companion app was discontinued. Python and TypeScript implementations perform the MPID handshake with P-256 key exchange and AES-128-CTR framing, then control lights, audio, schedules and routines. The repository includes protocol documentation, shared test vectors and a browser client.
description_zh: lumalou 在原配套应用停用后重建 Fisher-Price Lumalou 睡眠设备的本地蓝牙 LE 控制。Python 与 TypeScript 实现 MPID 握手、P-256 密钥交换和 AES-128-CTR 帧封装，可控制灯光、音频、日程与例程。仓库还提供协议文档、共用测试向量和浏览器客户端。
requirements: A Fisher-Price Lumalou gld09 device and Bluetooth LE access are required.
The Python client requires Python 3.10 or newer; the browser client requires Web Bluetooth.
Bunny and Whisper are untested, and the legacy Smart Connect device generation is unsupported.
MIT license.

name: esphome-panasonic-erv: local control through a reconstructed CN12 protocol
description_en: esphome-panasonic-erv replaces a Panasonic ERV's optional module with an ESP32-S3 that speaks the reconstructed CN12 serial protocol. Logic-analyzer captures underpin its frame decoder, command builder and ESPHome component for power, mode and fan control. It exposes state to Home Assistant, which can make the controls available through its HomeKit Bridge. The author reports physical testing on FY-25ZDP1C.
description_zh: esphome-panasonic-erv 以 ESP32-S3 替代松下新风设备的选配模块，通过重建的 CN12 串口协议控制主板。项目根据逻辑分析仪采集的数据开发帧解码器、命令生成器和 ESPHome 组件，实现开关、模式和风速控制；设备状态同步至 Home Assistant，并可通过其 HomeKit Bridge 接入 Apple Home。据作者报告，FY-25ZDP1C 已完成实机测试。
requirements: An ESP32-S3 board, jumper wires and ESPHome are required; the board connects to the ERV's CN12 port in place of the OEM module.
The author reports physical testing on FY-25ZDP1C; other listed models remain untested.
The component implements thin-domestic power, mode and fan controls; additional functions of larger units are outside its current scope.
MIT license.

name: EdgeLine: investigating Corsair Xeneon Edge control and touch interfaces
description_en: EdgeLine investigates the Corsair Xeneon Edge display's Linux control interfaces and provides a panel control app. Its notes record the vendor HID report layout and separate touch-controller descriptors, while the app uses HID for brightness, ddcutil for picture settings and xinput for touch modes. The HID command table distinguishes observed behavior from candidate commands.
description_zh: EdgeLine 研究 Corsair Xeneon Edge 屏幕在 Linux 上的控制接口，并提供面板控制应用。其文档记录厂商 HID 报文布局和独立触控控制器的描述符；应用通过 HID 调节亮度、用 ddcutil 设置画面，并用 xinput 管理触控模式。HID 命令表区分已观察行为和待确认命令。
requirements: A Corsair Xeneon Edge display and Linux desktop are required.
Picture control uses ddcutil and i2c access; touch control uses xinput.
Gestures and a lock zone are built in the agent but do not yet receive touches on the real panel.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: CSVM: a Crimson Skies engine built from game-data and executable analysis
description_en: CSVM reimplements the Crimson Skies (2000) engine in Godot and reads game data from the player's own install or disc. Its C# readers handle original formats, while format and behavior notes draw on data inspection, comparison with the game, and static analysis of crimson.exe. The build covers campaign, Instant Action and multiplayer modes.
description_zh: CSVM 使用 Godot 重建《Crimson Skies》（2000）的游戏引擎，从玩家自备的安装目录或光盘读取原始数据。其 C# 读取器处理游戏格式；格式与行为文档结合数据检查、原版运行对照及 crimson.exe 静态分析。当前版本包含战役、即时行动和多人模式。
requirements: Playing requires a legally owned Crimson Skies install, disc or disc image.
The downloadable Windows build requires 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 and a Vulkan or Direct3D 12 driver.
Source builds require Godot 4.7 .NET and the .NET 8 SDK.
The author describes the build as early and points to release notes for known issues.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: FreeMicro: decoding Codex Micro's USB and Bluetooth control protocol
description_en: FreeMicro implements Codex Micro key input and LED output through the device's vendor HID protocol, linking six keys to Claude Code project states. Its protocol notes describe different USB and Bluetooth LE report framing, device commands, and observed input events, with Python code for device control.
description_zh: FreeMicro 通过 Codex Micro 的厂商 HID 协议读取按键、控制 LED，并将六个按键关联到 Claude Code 项目状态。协议文档记录 USB 与 BLE 不同的报告帧格式、设备命令及输入事件，仓库提供相应的 Python 控制代码。
requirements: A Codex Micro device, macOS, and Python 3.9+.
The protocol observations are documented for a shipping unit with firmware v0.4.1.
MIT license.

name: Mittzon Standing Desk: decoding the LIN bus for Home Assistant control
description_en: The Mittzon Standing Desk project investigates the LIN bus between an IKEA Mittzon desk controller and its handset. Its ESPHome configuration reads position frames through an ESP32 and controls the desk by electrically emulating panel buttons, exposing height and movement controls to Home Assistant.
description_zh: Mittzon Standing Desk 项目分析 IKEA Mittzon 升降桌控制器与手控面板之间的 LIN 总线。ESPHome 配置让 ESP32 读取位置帧，并通过电气方式模拟面板按键，将高度与升降控制接入 Home Assistant。
requirements: IKEA Mittzon desk, ESP32 WROOM-32, wiring to handset button pads and the LIN line, ESPHome and Home Assistant.
Native LIN command control and panel LED status reading remain unfinished.
MIT license.

name: zenvision-linux: reconstructing ASUS ZenVision OLED control over USB
description_en: zenvision-linux reconstructs USB control of the ASUS ZenVision lid OLED on the Zenbook 14X OLED Space Edition. Its Python driver sends 256×64 grayscale frames through a documented command handshake and bulk endpoint, supporting images and animations on Linux.
description_zh: zenvision-linux 重建 Zenbook 14X OLED Space Edition 上 ASUS ZenVision 屏幕的 USB 控制方式。Python 驱动按文档中的命令握手流程，通过 bulk 端点发送 256×64 灰度图像，在 Linux 上显示静态图片和动画。
requirements: ASUS Zenbook 14X OLED Space Edition UX5401ZAS with a ZenVision panel; Linux and raw USB access.
Python 3.9+, pyusb, Pillow and libusb-1.0.
The author reports operation on UX5401ZAS; other lid-OLED models are unconfirmed.
MIT license.

name: MAX Messenger: documenting WebSocket and TCP message formats
description_en: MAX Messenger API Documentation maps the messenger's WebSocket JSON and TCP MessagePack exchanges from browser traffic and direct request experiments. It records INIT and LOGIN steps, request fields, opcodes, chat and messaging operations, plus binary TCP framing and compression behavior.
description_zh: MAX Messenger API Documentation 根据浏览器流量和直接请求实验，整理该通讯服务的 WebSocket JSON 与 TCP MessagePack 交互。文档记录 INIT 和 LOGIN 流程、请求字段、操作码、聊天及消息操作，以及二进制 TCP 帧格式和压缩行为。
requirements: A MAX account and its device ID and token are needed for the example client.
The example script lists websocket-client and certifi as dependencies.
CC BY 4.0 license; reuse requires attribution and a link to the repository.

name: orba-protocol: reconstructing Artiphon Orba 2 control messages
description_en: orba-protocol reconstructs the Artiphon Orba 2 control protocol across USB-MIDI and BLE-MIDI. Its specification maps SysEx framing, codec, CRC and device registers, while Python and JavaScript libraries decode messages and build commands for device settings. The author reports comparing the implementation with captured traffic and live responses.
description_zh: orba-protocol 重建 Artiphon Orba 2 在 USB-MIDI 和 BLE-MIDI 上使用的控制协议。规范记录 SysEx 帧格式、编解码、CRC 和设备寄存器；Python 与 JavaScript 库可解码消息并构造设置命令。作者报告曾与抓包和设备实时响应进行比对。
requirements: An Artiphon Orba 2 is required for live device control.
The Python reference requires Python 3.8 or later; the JavaScript module runs in a browser or Node.
Some specification items marked snoop still require an in-app capture to determine exact enum bytes.
Code is MIT licensed; the specification is additionally CC BY 4.0 licensed.

name: ry5088-flasher: reconstructing a magnetic keyboard's HID-DFU path
description_en: ry5088-flasher reconstructs the USB HID-DFU update path used by RongYuan RY5088 magnetic keyboards. A Rust flasher reads the board's dev_id, obtains the matching stock image and transfers it through the documented bootloader protocol. The repository also provides profile-driven AT32F405 reference firmware, whose hardware bring-up is still experimental.
description_zh: ry5088-flasher 重建 RongYuan RY5088 磁轴键盘的 USB HID-DFU 更新流程。Rust 刷写器读取所连接键盘的 dev_id，获取对应的原厂固件镜像，并通过文档记录的引导加载器协议传输。仓库还提供按机型配置的 AT32F405 参考固件，尚未完成实机调试。
requirements: An RY5088 keyboard, USB access and libhidapi are required for the flasher.
Building the custom firmware requires arm-none-eabi-gcc and the separately obtained Artery BSP.
The author reports that the custom firmware builds and passes host tests but has not completed on-hardware bring-up.
MIT license.

name: TrikiEmu: reconstructing the Żabka Triki BLE controller
description_en: TrikiEmu recreates the Żabka Triki motion controller's BLE behavior on ESP32 firmware. It reproduces advertising identity, a Nordic UART Service profile and 14-byte IMU frames using findings from TrikiScope and Android HCI captures; PC tools feed keyboard, CSV or recorded motion to the emulator. The author reports that Żappka connects and reacts to movement on M5StickC Plus2.
description_zh: TrikiEmu 用 ESP32 固件重建 Żabka Triki 运动控制器的 BLE 行为。它依据 TrikiScope 的研究与 Android HCI 抓包，复现广播身份、Nordic UART Service 配置及 14 字节 IMU 帧；电脑端工具可输入键盘、CSV 或录制的运动数据。作者报告 Żappka 已在 M5StickC Plus2 上连接并响应运动。
requirements: An ESP32 board, USB cable, phone with Żappka and a real Triki controller's BLE address are required.
PlatformIO Core builds the firmware; PC tools require Python 3 and pyserial.
The author reports that gameplay responds to motion, while saving scores requires authentication from a real controller.
MIT license.

name: TrikiScope: decoding the Żabka Triki BLE motion stream
description_en: TrikiScope investigates the Żabka Triki controller with a Python BLE terminal inspector. It inventories GATT services, decodes 14-byte gyroscope and accelerometer frames, identifies a button flag and LED control bit, and provides diagnostic probes and CSV recording.
description_zh: TrikiScope 用 Python 终端 BLE 检查器研究 Żabka Triki 控制器。它列出 GATT 服务，解码 14 字节陀螺仪和加速度计帧，识别按键标志与 LED 控制位，并提供诊断探针和 CSV 记录。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later, Bluetooth and a nearby Żabka Triki controller are required.
Windows 10/11 is documented as the main platform; the author also lists Linux and macOS through bleak.
MIT license.

name: Scarlett MixControl: rebuilding control of first-generation Scarlett interfaces
description_en: Scarlett MixControl replaces Focusrite's MixControl 1.10.6 on modern macOS for first-generation Scarlett interfaces. The Swift app exposes matrix mixing, output and capture routing, metering and presets through USB control requests. Its command mapping comes from signal tables extracted from the original application and disassembly of routing functions.
description_zh: Scarlett MixControl 在现代 macOS 上替代 Focusrite MixControl 1.10.6，控制第一代 Scarlett 声卡。Swift 程序通过 USB 控制请求提供矩阵混音、输出与采集路由、电平监测和预设管理；命令映射来自原程序的信号表提取与路由函数反汇编。
requirements: macOS 14 or later and a supported first-generation Scarlett interface are required.
Building from source requires Xcode 15 or a Swift 5.9+ toolchain.
The author reports hardware confirmation for 8i6, 18i8 and 18i20; 6i6 and 18i6 await hardware confirmation.
MIT license.

name: Tesla Dashcam Decryptor: decoding encrypted dashcam recordings
description_en: Tesla Dashcam Decryptor reconstructs the local decryption flow used by dashcam.tesla.com for Tesla 2026.20 encrypted recordings. The write-up describes intercepting browser requests and WebCrypto calls to identify file metadata, key retrieval and chunked AES-128-CBC decryption; a Python tool applies the flow to batches of clips.
description_zh: Tesla Dashcam Decryptor 重建 dashcam.tesla.com 对 Tesla 2026.20 加密录像的本地解密流程。分析记录通过拦截浏览器请求和 WebCrypto 调用，识别文件元数据、密钥获取及分块 AES-128-CBC 解密方式；Python 工具据此批量处理录像。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer, Tesla 2026.20 or newer recordings, a Tesla account and a bearer token from dashcam.tesla.com are required.
The token expires periodically and must be refreshed.
The project states an MIT license; no licence file is in the repository.

name: d2-dedicated-server: reconstructing a Diablo II realm and game-server stack
description_en: d2-dedicated-server rebuilds a self-hosted Diablo II realm and headless game-server stack. Its Zig services handle Battle.net-style login, character and game operations, while an ingress reads the game's GAMELOGON token to route connections. A separate native variant maps the 1.14d macOS Mach-O game image onto i386 Linux.
description_zh: d2-dedicated-server 以 Zig 重建可自行部署的《Diablo II》游戏区服服务和无图形界面的游戏服务器。服务处理战网式登录、角色与游戏创建及加入操作；入口组件读取 GAMELOGON 令牌并转发连接。另有原生版本，可在 i386 Linux 上映射运行 1.14d 的 macOS Mach-O 游戏映像。
requirements: Linux is the stated deployment platform; the native 1.14d variant requires i386 Linux and the game's macOS Mach-O image.
Redis and PostgreSQL provide runtime coordination and persistent realm storage.
The native variant's dry run can inspect its load path on other hosts, but execution requires i386 Linux.
MIT license.

name: accd: reconstructing the Assetto Corsa Competizione dedicated server
description_en: accd reconstructs the Assetto Corsa Competizione dedicated server in C99 for Linux and BSD systems. It accepts unmodified game clients and implements the observed connection handshake, session scheduling, car updates, results and telemetry messages. The repository includes server source and protocol validation tools.
description_zh: accd 用 C99 重建《Assetto Corsa Competizione》专用服务器，可在 Linux 和 BSD 系统上供原版客户端连接。它实现所观察到的连接握手、赛事时序、车辆更新、成绩及遥测消息，仓库还包含服务器源码和协议验证工具。
requirements: An Assetto Corsa Competizione client is needed to connect and race.
The source identifies Linux, OpenBSD and FreeBSD as server platforms.
BSD-2-Clause license.

name: transferit-py: reconstructing transfer.it upload and download exchanges
description_en: transferit-py reconstructs transfer.it file-transfer exchanges from its public web client and implements Python library and CLI clients. Its research maps MEGA-backed API commands, ephemeral sessions, AES-128-CTR encryption with CBC-MAC and WebSocket upload framing. The client uploads folders and streams decrypted downloads.
description_zh: transferit-py 根据 transfer.it 的公开网页客户端还原文件传输交互，并实现 Python 库和命令行客户端。研究文档梳理基于 MEGA 的 API 命令、临时会话、带 CBC-MAC 的 AES-128-CTR 加密及 WebSocket 上传帧格式。客户端支持文件夹上传和流式解密下载。
requirements: Python 3.11 or newer is required.
The client relies on transfer.it and MEGA service endpoints described in its protocol notes.
MIT license.

name: G2CC: a replacement Even G2 client built from Bluetooth traffic analysis
description_en: G2CC reconstructs communication with Even Realities G2 smart glasses through a replacement Android BLE client and a PC-side display compositor. Its protocol documentation describes captured Bluetooth frames and the display, input and battery exchanges used by the client.
description_zh: G2CC 通过替代 Android BLE 客户端和电脑端显示合成器，与 Even Realities G2 智能眼镜通信。其协议文档根据捕获的蓝牙帧记录显示、输入和电池信息的交互方式。
requirements: Even Realities G2 glasses, an Android phone and a PC running the Node server and PostgreSQL.
The author describes the installation as tailored to one hardware and network setup.
AGPL-3.0 license.

name: Melitta Barista & Nivona: reconstructing coffee-machine BLE control
description_en: Melitta Barista & Nivona for Home Assistant implements Bluetooth LE control of supported coffee machines through their shared Eugster/Frismag protocol. Its reference maps GATT characteristics, the HU handshake, encrypted frames, and status and brew commands. The integration exposes machine state and settings; Melitta models also have recipe and maintenance controls. Nivona support is in alpha.
description_zh: Melitta Barista & Nivona for Home Assistant 通过共享的 Eugster/Frismag 协议，以低功耗蓝牙控制兼容的咖啡机。协议文档记录 GATT 特征、HU 握手、加密帧，以及状态查询和冲煮命令。集成提供设备状态与设置控制，Melitta 机型还提供配方和维护操作；Nivona 支持仍处于 alpha 阶段。
requirements: Home Assistant 2024.7 or newer, Bluetooth LE access and a supported Melitta or Nivona machine are required.
Melitta Barista T/TS Smart is the established supported family; Nivona support is alpha across several model families.
Most Nivona families still need live hardware validation.
MIT license.

name: Mi Fitness Sync: reconstructing workout retrieval from the Android app
description_en: Mi Fitness Sync reconstructs workout retrieval from the Mi Fitness Android app and implements a Python CLI for activity export and Strava uploads. Its JADX-based notes map Xiaomi Passport authentication, activity API calls and FDS download handling. The client decrypts workout blobs and exports available data as GPX, TCX or FIT.
description_zh: Mi Fitness Sync 根据 Mi Fitness Android 应用重建运动记录获取流程，并提供用于导出活动及上传 Strava 的 Python 命令行工具。基于 JADX 的研究记录梳理 Xiaomi Passport 认证、活动 API 和 FDS 下载流程；客户端解密运动数据块，并将可用数据导出为 GPX、TCX 或 FIT。
requirements: Python 3.12 or newer and a Mi/Xiaomi account are required.
Strava upload commands require a Strava API application.
GPX export requires GPS track points; FIT export includes only fields available in the source data.
MIT license.

name: SSL Console Control: reconstructing mixing-console UDP control
description_en: SSL Console Control implements Python control of SSL Matrix-family and Sigma mixing consoles over their native UDP protocols. The author derived Matrix behavior from a Java control app and packet captures, and Sigma behavior from Android APK decompilation and ARM Thumb2 analysis. A terminal interface and CLI expose channels, routing and session controls.
description_zh: SSL Console Control 通过原生 UDP 协议实现对 SSL Matrix 系列及 Sigma 调音台的 Python 控制。作者根据 Java 控制程序与抓包还原 Matrix 协议，并通过 Android APK 反编译和 ARM Thumb2 分析研究 Sigma 协议。终端界面和命令行提供通道、路由及会话控制。
requirements: Python 3.9 or newer and a reachable SSL console on a local network are required.
Matrix was tested with firmware V3.0/5; Duality and AWS models are untested.
Sigma support is experimental and has no reported live-hardware validation.
MIT license.

name: logitech-ipc-protocol: reconstructing Logi Options+ agent messages
description_en: logitech-ipc-protocol reconstructs the Logi Options+ agent's local IPC messages for querying devices and changing their active host. Its notes specify binary framing, JSON request paths and protobuf payload types across macOS sockets and Windows named pipes. The repository includes client scripts and records a Windows 2.7 change that routes access through the app's renderer relay.
description_zh: logitech-ipc-protocol 还原 Logi Options+ 智能体用于查询设备和切换主机的本地 IPC 消息。文档列出 macOS 套接字与 Windows 命名管道使用的二进制帧、JSON 请求路径及 protobuf 载荷类型；仓库附有客户端脚本，并记录 Windows 2.7 版本改用应用渲染器中继的处理方式。
requirements: Logi Options+ and compatible Logitech multi-host devices are required.
The macOS switching script requires m1ddc.
Windows Options+ 2.7+ requires the documented UI relay setup; direct named-pipe clients are blocked.
MIT license.

name: OpenHX: rebuilding Line 6 HX preset control over USB
description_en: OpenHX implements selected Line 6 HX and Helix preset controls in a Rust CLI and includes an early GUI. USB captures between HX Edit and an HX Stomp XL informed its bulk-transfer transport, session handshake and preset operations. The published protocol notes cover packet sequences, MessagePack preset data and device quirks.
description_zh: OpenHX 通过 Rust 命令行工具实现部分 Line 6 HX 和 Helix 预设控制功能，并提供尚处早期阶段的图形界面。项目分析 HX Edit 与 HX Stomp XL 之间的 USB 抓包，梳理批量传输、会话握手和预设操作；公开的协议笔记还涵盖报文顺序、MessagePack 预设数据及设备差异。
requirements: Building from source requires Rust and libusb 1.0 or later.
The author reports validation on HX Stomp, HX Stomp XL and Helix Floor; other listed devices are planned.
Preset renaming, import/export, block reordering and a full GUI editor are listed as planned rather than implemented.
MIT license.

name: Pokémon Generation I: static recompilation with trace-driven testing
description_en: Pokémon Red, Blue and Yellow are built as native executables by translating their Game Boy SM83 code into C with gb-recompiled. The repository adds game-specific build recipes, PyBoy trace capture and a headless Red and Blue bridge for differential memory and frame testing. The author reports Red gameplay, Blue reaching its title screen and Yellow's opening sequence rendering.
description_zh: 项目使用 gb-recompiled 将《Pokémon Red》《Blue》《Yellow》的 Game Boy SM83 代码转成 C，再构建原生程序。仓库提供针对游戏的构建配置、PyBoy 轨迹采集，以及供内存和画面差分测试使用的 Red、Blue 无界面桥接层。据作者报告，Red 可进入游戏，Blue 到达标题画面，Yellow 可显示片头。
requirements: A legally obtained ROM for each game is required and is placed locally under roms/.
The documented build uses Windows 11, Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools, CMake 3.20 or later, SDL2, and Python 3.11 or later with PyBoy.
The author reports partial game progress: Red enters gameplay, while Blue and Yellow are described at boot or title sequences.
MIT license.

name: HMC47: reconstructing Hitman: Codename 47
description_en: HMC47 reconstructs Hitman: Codename 47 from the original game binaries as a modular C++ implementation. Its source covers a launcher and modules for DirectPlay, shared engine data, graphics and sound, while full playability and 64-bit support remain goals.
description_zh: HMC47 根据《Hitman: Codename 47》原版二进制文件重建模块化 C++ 游戏实现。现有源码涵盖启动程序、DirectPlay、引擎数据、图形和声音模块；完整可玩性与 64 位编译仍是项目目标。
requirements: Microsoft Visual Studio, DirectX 7.0, libexpat and ZLib are listed as dependencies.
A fully playable game and 64-bit compilation remain unfinished goals.
MIT License.

name: BunATV: reconstructing Apple TV control protocols in TypeScript
description_en: BunATV reconstructs Apple TV control protocols as a Bun and TypeScript library with a companion CLI. It implements Companion pairing and remote input, MRP playback and state messages, and AirPlay transport layers, exposing messages close to their wire format. The author credits PyATV research and reports finding additional MRP messages through Ghidra analysis of Apple frameworks.
description_zh: BunATV 以 Bun 和 TypeScript 库重建 Apple TV 控制协议，并附带命令行工具。它实现 Companion 配对与遥控输入、MRP 播放和状态消息及 AirPlay 传输层，接口贴近线上消息格式。作者引用 PyATV 的研究，并报告通过 Ghidra 分析 Apple 框架发现更多 MRP 消息。
requirements: Bun is required to run the library and CLI from source.
The project describes itself as an unstable alpha; APIs, CLI flags, output formats and credential storage may change.
Voice input, game-controller input, playback migration and endpoint discovery remain unimplemented.
MIT license is stated in the README.

name: Ember Mug: decoding the on-device drink-log stream
description_en: The Ember Mug app decodes the undocumented fc540013 Bluetooth LE statistics stream from an Ember Mug 2 into a drink log. Its format notes describe notification fragments, record fields, timestamps, and the device's backlog behavior; the macOS menu-bar app combines decoded records with its own live readings.
description_zh: Ember Mug 应用解析 Ember Mug 2 的未公开 BLE 特征值 fc540013 统计数据流，生成饮用日志。格式文档记录通知分片、记录字段、时间戳和设备积压记录的发送方式；macOS 菜单栏应用还会合并实时读数。
requirements: An Ember mug previously set up through the Ember phone app, macOS 12+, and Python 3.11+.
The statistics-stream findings come from one Ember Mug 2 with firmware 406; some fields remain hypotheses.
MIT license.

name: PreSonus Quantum Linux: investigating Quantum 2626 control for Linux audio
description_en: PreSonus Quantum Linux documents control and audio behavior of the Quantum 2626 Thunderbolt interface while developing Linux support. Its research records channel routing and the recovered TCI protocol, with an in-house driver retained as a fallback beside builds of a separately authored upstream RFC driver. The author reports bounded playback and capture tests and unresolved stability issues.
description_zh: PreSonus Quantum Linux 在开发 Linux 支持时记录 Quantum 2626 Thunderbolt 音频接口的控制与音频行为。研究资料包括通道路由和还原的 TCI 协议；项目保留自研驱动作为备用方案，同时集成另一作者提交的上游 RFC 驱动。作者报告了有限范围的播放与录音测试，并列出稳定性问题。
requirements: A Quantum 2626 Thunderbolt device is the only enabled, hardware-tested model.
Source builds require matching Linux kernel headers, a compiler, Make, Git and curl.
The driver is experimental; higher rates, physical S/PDIF and ADAT routing, and sustained stability need further testing.
Repository-authored material is MIT licensed; upstream RFC driver bundles retain their GPL-2.0 notices.

name: Berbel Remote Emulator: reconstructing kitchen-hood BLE controls
description_en: Berbel Remote Emulator recreates BFB 6bT, 8bT and 7bT remote commands on ESP32 firmware for Berbel kitchen hoods. It decodes hood status frames and exposes controls through MQTT and Home Assistant. The protocol research uses BLE captures and a Linux fake hood that pairs with real remotes to record button notifications and test status frames.
description_zh: Berbel Remote Emulator 在 ESP32 固件中重建 BFB 6bT、8bT、7bT 遥控器命令，用于控制 Berbel 油烟机。它解码油烟机状态帧，并通过 MQTT 接入 Home Assistant；协议研究结合 BLE 抓包与 Linux 假油烟机工具，记录真实遥控器的按键通知并测试状态帧。
requirements: An ESP32 board with BLE and Wi-Fi, a compatible Berbel hood and an MQTT broker are required for the firmware.
The fake-hood research tool requires Linux, BlueZ and a BLE adapter.
The author reports that the seven BFB 7bT-specific codes were read from a remote but not tried against a Skyline Edge hood.
MIT license.

name: TJ-56-654 weather clock: replacement firmware after hardware and security analysis
description_en: The TJ-56-654 weather-clock project replaces the original ESP-01S firmware after an investigation of the device's hardware and configuration page. The author reports that the original page exposed the Wi-Fi password; the replacement provides NTP time, Open-Meteo weather, OLED screens, a web settings panel, and updates on the clock's 1 MB flash device.
description_zh: TJ-56-654 天气时钟项目在调查设备硬件与配置页面后，为原有 ESP-01S 编写替代固件。作者报告原页面会暴露 Wi-Fi 密码；新固件在 1 MB 闪存设备上提供 NTP 时间、Open-Meteo 天气、OLED 页面、网页设置和更新功能。
requirements: A TJ-56-654 or compatible ESP8266 weather clock; first flashing requires a 3.3 V USB-to-serial adapter and jumper wires.
The installation guide specifies Arduino IDE 1.8.19+ or 2.x and ESP8266 board support.
MIT license.

name: KuKirin G4: decoding BLE ride-mode notifications
description_en: The KuKirin G4 BLE Mode Monitor parses observed FFF2 notifications from a scooter and prints changes between ECO, SPORT, and RACE modes. Its Python client validates frame length and a gate byte before decoding the mode field; the documented mapping comes from one scooter and firmware combination.
description_zh: KuKirin G4 BLE Mode Monitor 解析滑板车 FFF2 特征值的通知，在 ECO、SPORT 和 RACE 模式变化时输出结果。Python 客户端先检查帧长度和标志字节，再解析模式字段；映射依据一台滑板车及其固件的观察结果。
requirements: Python 3.10+, Bluetooth access, and a KuKirin G4 for the hardware path; that path is documented for macOS.
The mapping comes from one scooter and firmware combination; no raw captures or formal protocol specification are included.
MIT license.

name: Mutant Brain: mapping its SysEx configuration format
description_en: Mutant Brain's SysEx configuration format is mapped through comparisons of generated presets. The repository records message boundaries, four-byte configuration chunks, object IDs for inputs and CV or gate outputs, and parameter IDs for settings such as channel, pitch bend and trigger mode. Sample .syx mappings accompany the findings.
description_zh: 项目通过比较生成的预设文件，梳理 Mutant Brain 的 SysEx 配置格式。研究记录消息边界、四字节配置单元、输入及 CV/Gate 输出的对象 ID，以及通道、弯音、触发模式等参数 ID，并附有 .syx 样本映射。
requirements: Hexinverter Mutant Brain SysEx configuration files are the subject of the research.
The findings mark some header and parameter interpretations as uncertain.
No licence file in the repository.

name: AfroSamuraiRecomp: an Xbox 360 static recompilation of Afro Samurai
description_en: AfroSamuraiRecomp statically translates the Europe Xbox 360 release of Afro Samurai into a native Windows x64 program using ReXGlue. The repository supplies game-specific function boundaries, hooks, a launcher and GPU and audio patches; the author reports playable 30 FPS operation on one PC.
description_zh: AfroSamuraiRecomp 使用 ReXGlue 将欧版 Xbox 360 游戏 Afro Samurai 静态翻译为 Windows x64 原生程序。仓库提供游戏专用函数边界、钩子、启动器及图形和音频补丁；作者报告在一台 PC 上可按默认 30 FPS 模式游玩。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 x64, a Direct3D 12 graphics card and an ISO dumped from the user's own Europe Afro Samurai disc.
The author tested the preview on one PC; the optional 60 FPS mode is incomplete and can accelerate cutscenes.
GPL-3.0 license for the repository; the ReXGlue/Xenia patches carry their stated BSD-3-Clause terms.

name: TBBT A9 mini camera: reconstructing PPPP video login
description_en: The TBBT A9 mini camera investigation reconstructs the camera's PPPP login and video-start exchanges over UDP/32108. It documents command framing, plain-text login and the raw session ticket, then patches aiopppp; the author reports MJPEG streaming through Home Assistant.
description_zh: TBBT A9 mini camera 项目还原 UDP/32108 上的 PPPP 登录及视频启动交互，记录命令帧、明文登录载荷和原始会话票据，并修补 aiopppp；作者报告 Home Assistant 因而可接收 MJPEG 视频。
requirements: The documented TBBT PPPP camera variant with firmware mcuver 61.2.22.3 and its paired password.
The reported Home Assistant setup uses devbis/pppp_camera 1.1.2, aiopppp 0.2.2 and ffmpeg.
The patch depends on exact aiopppp source anchors and fails if they change.
MIT license.

name: OpenPlatinum: rebuilding Pokémon Platinum in a native engine
description_en: OpenPlatinum reimplements Pokémon Platinum's field engine in C++17 with SDL3 and OpenGL for Windows and macOS. It reads the user's French or US .nds dump, parses cartridge formats and runs game scripts on its own VM, using the pret decompilation as a behavior reference; several gameplay systems remain partial.
description_zh: OpenPlatinum 用 C++17、SDL3 和 OpenGL 为 Windows 与 macOS 重建 Pokémon Platinum 的场景引擎。它读取用户自备的法版或美版 .nds 转储，解析卡带格式并用自有虚拟机运行游戏脚本，以 pret 反编译项目作为行为参考；部分玩法系统仍未完成。
requirements: Windows or macOS and the user's own French or US Pokémon Platinum .nds dump.
Battles, field moves, walking Pokémon and menus are described as partial; key items and trading remain unfinished.
MIT license.

name: hercules-native: rebuilding Disney's Hercules Action Game on Apple silicon
description_en: hercules-native reimplements the 1997 Disney's Hercules Action Game engine in C11 and SDL2 for Apple silicon Macs. It reads scripts, state tables and assets from the user's PC game files, with decoders for HERCULES.FS, sprite banks, maps and ETV videos; the author reports all levels playable with some missing effects.
description_zh: hercules-native 以 C11 和 SDL2 为 Apple 芯片 Mac 重建 1997 年 Disney's Hercules Action Game 的引擎。它从用户自备的 PC 游戏文件读取脚本、状态表和素材，并实现 HERCULES.FS、精灵图集、地图及 ETV 视频的解码；作者报告所有关卡均可游玩，但部分效果尚缺。
requirements: An Apple silicon Mac, C compiler and SDL2.
The user's own PC game files, including HERCULES.FS, ENG1.DLL, ENG3.DLL and TITLE.DLL; DATA/*.ETV is optional for videos.
Music and several lighting and glow effects are not implemented.
MIT license for the repository code.

name: samsung-notes-format: decoding Samsung Notes handwriting
description_en: samsung-notes-format reconstructs the handwriting geometry stored in Samsung Notes .sdocx files. Its Python reader parses page objects and pen-stroke deltas, then renders strokes to SVG; accompanying notes describe the ZIP container and structures traced through a jadx decompilation of the Android app.
description_zh: samsung-notes-format 还原 Samsung Notes .sdocx 文件中的手写几何数据。Python 读取器解析页面对象和笔迹增量并输出 SVG；格式笔记说明 ZIP 容器及通过 jadx 分析 Android 应用得到的结构。
requirements: Python 3 and a Samsung Notes .sdocx file.
The implementation focuses on stroke geometry; pressure, tilt, color and full-ink rendering are outside its stated scope.
MIT license.

name: loxone-link-dotnet: implementing Loxone Link NAT-over-CAN devices
description_en: loxone-link-dotnet implements the Loxone Link NAT protocol over CAN in a .NET 8 library. It models extensions and Tree devices, handles framed messages and challenge flows, and includes device simulators plus a CAN capture harness informed by prior Loxone research.
description_zh: loxone-link-dotnet 以 .NET 8 实现 CAN 总线上的 Loxone Link NAT 协议，建模扩展模块与 Tree 设备，处理消息帧和挑战流程，并提供设备模拟器及 CAN 抓包测试程序。项目借鉴了已有的 Loxone 协议研究。
requirements: .NET 8 and a supported CAN adapter, such as Waveshare Serial CAN.
Real-device authentication requires AES keys and related material obtained from the user's own hardware.
The Linux SocketCAN adapter is a scaffold and needs a production P/Invoke implementation.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Polycab PSIS-3K-SM1: recovering Bluetooth telemetry for MQTT
description_en: Polycab Solar Inverter to MQTT reads Bluetooth telemetry from a PSIS-3K-SM1 inverter using values the author says were recovered from its Android monitoring app. A Python service publishes solar power, voltage, current, temperature and energy readings to a Mosquitto MQTT broker.
description_zh: Polycab Solar Inverter to MQTT 使用作者从 Android 监测应用还原的数值，通过蓝牙读取 PSIS-3K-SM1 逆变器遥测数据。Python 服务将太阳能功率、电压、电流、温度及发电量发布到 Mosquitto MQTT。
requirements: A Polycab PSIS-3K-SM1 inverter with Bluetooth access and an MQTT broker; the author runs the script on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W.
The author has not identified the meaning of the Active Power field.
No licence file in the repository.

name: reEgg: an Egg, Inc. server emulator for version 1.12.13
description_en: reEgg reconstructs part of the server behavior used by Egg, Inc. mobile game version 1.12.13 in Python. Developed alongside research into the game's protobuf API, it provides responses for selected first-contact, calendar, contract and event functions while its roadmap lists unfinished services.
description_zh: reEgg 用 Python 重建 Egg, Inc. 手游 1.12.13 版的部分服务器行为，配合该游戏 protobuf API 的逆向研究。现有实现涉及部分首次连接响应、每日奖励、合约和活动功能，路线图列出了未完成的服务。
requirements: Requires Egg, Inc. version 1.12.13 and a phone VPN app that can redirect www.auxbrain.com to the emulator host.
Several roadmap items remain unfinished, including a valid backup response and co-op computer simulations.
MIT license.

name: gopenfusion: reconstructing FusionFall packet services
description_en: gopenfusion reconstructs part of FusionFall's packet protocol and server services in Go. Its login server and dummy shard support basic joining, movement, chat and limited NPC interactions; a generator derives structures from a decompiled game assembly.
description_zh: gopenfusion 用 Go 重建 FusionFall 的部分数据包协议和服务器服务。登录服务及简化分片支持加入游戏、移动、聊天和有限的 NPC 交互；结构生成器从反编译的游戏程序集提取定义。
requirements: Go 1.19, according to go.mod; Docker Compose starts the documented Redis and PostgreSQL environment.
The structure generator takes decompiled output from FusionFall's Assembly - CSharp.dll.
The shard supports only the minimum packets needed for the landwalker demo, with limited NPC and player interactions.
MIT license.

name: aquacomputer-quadro-control: reconstructing Quadro USB configuration
description_en: aquacomputer-quadro-control reconstructs USB configuration access for the Aquacomputer Quadro fan controller. Its Linux client reads saved settings and changes fan, sensor and RGB values; accompanying captures document packet offsets, checksum placement and a usbmon capture workflow.
description_zh: aquacomputer-quadro-control 还原 Aquacomputer Quadro 风扇控制器的 USB 配置交互。Linux 客户端可读取配置并修改风扇、传感器和 RGB 参数；抓包资料记录了数据偏移、校验字段及 usbmon 抓取流程。
requirements: Linux, Python 3.8 or newer and an Aquacomputer Quadro; the author reports tests on Manjaro and Ubuntu 21.10 with firmware 1028.
Full RGB control and configuration-value validation are not implemented.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: PTD2 Server: rebuilding Pokémon Tower Defense 2 services
description_en: PTD2 Server reconstructs online services for the Flash game Pokémon Tower Defense 2 from analysis of its original SWF. Its PHP endpoints and save codecs support story, gym, one-on-one and trainer-versus modes, with MySQL-backed saves.
description_zh: PTD2 Server 通过分析原版 SWF 重建 Flash 游戏 Pokémon Tower Defense 2 的在线服务。PHP 接口和存档编解码代码支持剧情、道馆、一对一及训练家对战模式，并使用 MySQL 保存数据。
requirements: Docker and Docker Compose for the documented hosting setup; a manual setup needs PHP-FPM 8.1+, a web server and MySQL/MariaDB unless using JSON saves.
Mystery gifts and the Pokécenter remain unimplemented.
AGPL-3.0 license.

name: HT2000Lib: reconstructing an HT2000 logger's USB HID interface
description_en: HT2000Lib implements a C# client for the HT2000 CO2 logger using a USB HID interface recovered by monitoring the manufacturer's Windows application at runtime. It documents status and historical log reports; the author reports that its native Windows backend reads current sensor state and dumps stored measurements.
description_zh: HT2000Lib 是用于 HT2000 CO2 记录仪的 C# 客户端，其 USB HID 接口依据对厂商 Windows 程序的运行时监测还原。项目记录了状态和历史数据报文；作者报告其 Windows 原生后端可读取当前传感器状态并导出已存储的测量数据。
requirements: An HT2000 USB CO2 logger.
The author reports that the working native implementation requires Windows; the Device.NET and LibUsb manager variants did not work in the author's tests.
The logging interval cannot currently be read from the device.
MIT license.

name: Reko-Btech: Crescent Hawks image and map format findings
description_en: Reko-Btech investigates the 1988 MS-DOS game Crescent Hawks: Inception using Reko decompilation project files. Its findings describe run-length encoding in ICN and CMP images and two layout schemes for MTP map files. Following the project requires the user's own game executable and data files.
description_zh: Reko-Btech 使用 Reko 反编译项目文件研究 1988 年的 MS-DOS 游戏 Crescent Hawks: Inception。研究文档说明 ICN、CMP 图像的游程编码，以及 MTP 地图文件的两种布局。跟随分析需要用户自行准备游戏可执行文件和数据文件。
requirements: Requires Reko and a legally owned copy of the Crescent Hawks: Inception executable and associated data files.
The MTP map structure remains a work in progress, including unidentified fields and NPC placement.
No licence file in the repository.

name: ASUS XG34WCDG: mapping DDC/CI monitor controls
description_en: The ASUS XG34WCDG reference maps DDC/CI controls for display modes, colour, HDR, OLED care, proximity sensing and Aura effects. It correlates VCP values with on-screen changes and reports observed write and readback behavior on one unit, while separately describing the USB Aura interface from host records and published sources.
description_zh: ASUS XG34WCDG 参考文档解析显示模式、色彩、HDR、OLED 维护、接近感应及 Aura 效果的 DDC/CI 控制值。它把 VCP 值与屏幕菜单变化对应起来，记录一台设备的写入和回读行为；USB Aura 接口则依据主机记录及公开资料单独说明。
requirements: The observed DDC/CI behavior comes from one firmware-101 unit on Windows 11 over DisplayPort.
The USB Aura protocol was not captured or tested on this model.
CC BY 4.0; attribution is required.

name: MSI Optix G27C2: mapping its DDC/CI monitor controls
description_en: The MSI Optix G27C2 reference maps the monitor's DDC/CI controls from Windows API reads and writes on one unit. It records VCP codes for brightness, contrast, colour presets and input selection, along with I2C pacing, ignored writes and EDID data.
description_zh: MSI Optix G27C2 参考文档依据对一台设备的 Windows API 读写，整理显示器的 DDC/CI 控制行为。内容涵盖亮度、对比度、色彩预设和输入选择的 VCP 代码，以及 I2C 时序、被忽略的写入和 EDID 数据。
requirements: The observations concern one G27C2 connected over DisplayPort to Windows.
Other firmware revisions and HDMI input numbers are unexamined.
CC BY 4.0; attribution is required.

name: QCYbutMOD: a QCY earbuds client built from reconstructed BLE commands
description_en: QCYbutMOD is an Android client built from reverse engineering of the BLE GATT commands used by QCY earbuds with Wuqi WQ7033 and WQ7034 chips. It reads separate earbud and case battery values from characteristic 0008, sends a command to mute firmware voice prompts, and reads back gesture mappings.
