Device test notes record command acknowledgments and unanswered multipoint queries.
description_zh: QCYbutMOD 是基于 QCY 耳机 BLE GATT 指令逆向分析开发的 Android 客户端，面向采用 Wuqi WQ7033 和 WQ7034 芯片的设备。它从 0008 特征值读取左右耳及充电盒电量，发送固件提示音静音指令，并回读触控手势映射。设备测试记录列出了指令应答和未获回应的多设备连接查询。
requirements: Android 8.0 to 16+ and a supported QCY earbud model using a Wuqi WQ7033 or WQ7034 chip.
Building from source requires JDK 17 and Android SDK 36 with Build Tools 36.0.0 or newer.
The author reports that firmware on the tested device did not respond to multipoint queries 0x4D and 0x4F.
MIT license.

name: MobiGoEmu: reconstructing the VTech MobiGo console
description_en: MobiGoEmu reconstructs the VTech MobiGo handheld in C so user-provided system ROM and cartridge images can run with touch, keyboard, pad and sound support. Its research covers the GeneralPlus u'nSP CPU and cartridge-derived ADPCM36 audio format, supported by a small disassembler and CPU comparison tools.
description_zh: MobiGoEmu 以 C 重建 VTech MobiGo 掌机，使用户提供的系统 ROM 和卡带镜像可使用触摸屏、键盘、方向键和声音功能。研究内容包括 GeneralPlus u'nSP CPU 与从卡带样本分析出的 ADPCM36 音频格式，并附有反汇编器和 CPU 对比工具。
requirements: User-owned MobiGo system ROM and cartridge dumps are required.
The documented Windows build uses MSYS2 MinGW, GCC, CMake and Ninja; SDL2 enables a window.
The author reports that six tested cartridges reach menus, while only some enter gameplay.
MIT License.

name: Lian Li UNI HUB SL V2: mapping fan and lighting USB commands
description_en: The Lian Li UNI HUB SL V2 reference reconstructs the controller's USB HID commands for fan duty, RPM reporting, LED effects and motherboard passthrough. It compares an L-Connect 3 USB capture with independent tests on one hub and records report layouts, command sequences and timing.
description_zh: Lian Li UNI HUB SL V2 参考文档解析控制器的 USB HID 命令，涵盖风扇占空比、RPM 回报、LED 灯效和主板信号透传。它将 L-Connect 3 的 USB 抓包与一台集线器的独立测试相对照，整理报告格式、命令序列及时序。
requirements: Observations concern a 0CF2:A105 hub with firmware v0.7 and twelve 120 mm UNI FAN SL V2 fans.
Other firmware versions, 0CF2:A103 and 140 mm fans were not observed.
CC BY 4.0; attribution is required.

name: fh2-world-formats: reconstructing Forza Horizon 2 world file formats
description_en: fh2-world-formats reconstructs the file formats behind the Forza Horizon 2 world and supplies Python tools for reading and changing them. Its research covers PGZP GeoChunk archives, ChunkMap indexes, ModelBin meshes, PhysicsTemplate collision, placement cells and WVAN navigation data; the author reports byte-exact round trips and a visible custom-geometry experiment.
description_zh: fh2-world-formats 解析《Forza Horizon 2》的世界文件格式，并提供读取和修改文件的 Python 工具。研究范围包括 PGZP GeoChunk 档案、ChunkMap 索引、ModelBin 网格、PhysicsTemplate 碰撞、放置单元和 WVAN 导航数据；作者报告了逐字节往返测试及自定义几何体显示实验。
requirements: A personal copy of Forza Horizon 2 build 1.0.0.64 for working with its files.
Python 3; some tools also need numpy or Pillow.
Import currently writes flat UVs, and inserted geometry has no working collision in the reported experiment.
MIT License.

name: SAC9010QC/SAC12010QC: reconstructing an air-conditioner IR protocol
description_en: SAC9010QC/SAC12010QC reconstructs the IR control format of a HomeFit Living or Alaska air-conditioner remote from captured signals. A protocol reference maps its 36-bit command fields, while an ESP8266 or ESP32 web server sends AC settings through a REST endpoint.
description_zh: SAC9010QC/SAC12010QC 项目根据采集的红外信号解析 HomeFit Living／Alaska 空调遥控器的 36 位控制格式。协议文档列出各控制位，ESP8266 或 ESP32 Web 服务通过 REST 接口发送空调设置。
requirements: An Arduino-compatible ESP8266 or ESP32 setup with an IR LED for the controller.
The controller keeps its last sent state; the AC does not report its actual state back.
MIT License.

name: FSGCore: reconstructing the DJ Hero 2 core library
description_en: FSGCore reconstructs the C++ core library used by DJ Hero 2 to support decompilation of the game. The repository contains headers and implementations for strings, math, memory, files, logging and system facilities, assembled as a shared library with CMake.
description_zh: FSGCore 以 C++ 重建《DJ Hero 2》使用的核心库，服务于该游戏的反编译。仓库包含字符串、数学、内存、文件、日志和系统功能的头文件与实现，并通过 CMake 构建共享库。
requirements: CMake 3.17 and a C++17 toolchain.
No licence file in the repository.

name: hydrao-dump: decoding Hydrao shower-head Bluetooth data
description_en: hydrao-dump investigates the Bluetooth exchanges between Hydrao shower heads and their phone app, with packet captures, a Wireshark dissector and an MQTT receiver for Home Assistant. The author identifies shower volume, color thresholds, firmware and hardware versions, and device IDs while leaving temperature and flow fields unresolved.
description_zh: hydrao-dump 研究 Hydrao 花洒与手机应用之间的蓝牙通信，提供抓包、Wireshark 解析器，以及向 Home Assistant 发送数据的 MQTT 接收脚本。作者已标注淋浴水量、颜色阈值、固件与硬件版本和设备 ID；温度与水流字段尚未解码。
requirements: Home Assistant, an MQTT server, a Bluetooth adapter, the shower head's MAC address and Python 3.7 or newer.
The Wireshark dissector is a work in progress; temperature and water-flow fields remain undecoded.
No licence file in the repository.

name: LibreConga: investigating the Conga 5490 communication protocol
description_en: LibreConga investigates the Cecotec Conga 5490 robot vacuum's communication protocol through captured app traffic. Its notes describe frame lengths, identifiers and sequence fields for ping and login exchanges, with a separate table of observed command opcodes.
description_zh: LibreConga 通过采集应用流量研究 Cecotec Conga 5490 扫地机器人的通信协议。笔记解析 ping 与登录报文的长度、标识符和序号字段，并另列已识别的命令操作码。
requirements: A Conga 5490 and its app for repeating the documented observations.
The protocol research is ongoing.
MIT License.

name: Chao Resort Island X: rebuilding the Chao Resort webserver
description_en: ChaoResortWebserver recreates the Chao Resort server in Flask for the Chao Resort Island X mod. The repository contains Python server and database modules; the author reports that the replacement is functional and faster than the original implementation.
description_zh: ChaoResortWebserver 使用 Flask 重建供 Chao Resort Island X 模组使用的 Chao Resort 网络服务端。仓库包含 Python 服务端和数据库模块；作者称该替代实现可以使用，且运行速度高于原版。
requirements: Chao Resort Island X mod is the stated client.
GPL-3.0 licence.

name: FT017TH: decoding wireless thermometer and hygrometer transmissions
description_en: The FT017TH study decodes transmissions from a wireless thermometer and hygrometer. It documents Manchester encoding, repeated messages, field positions and formulas for estimating temperature and humidity from captured data and displayed readings.
description_zh: FT017TH 研究解码无线温湿度计的发射信号，记录曼彻斯特编码、重复报文、字段位置，以及根据录制的无线电信号与显示读数估算温度和湿度的公式。
requirements: The analysis covers FT017TH transmissions and compares recorded signals with values shown on the device.
Several message bit ranges remain unidentified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: cam-server: reconstructing the Digicam Print Channel backend
description_en: cam-server implements a backend for the Digicam Print Channel, producing responses in the format the client expects and rendering images from its templates. Its Python code serializes response fields as key-value lines and parses page, image, text and background settings for output.
description_zh: cam-server 为 Digicam Print Channel 实现后端，按客户端预期格式返回数据，并依据模板渲染图像。Python 代码将响应字段序列化为键值行，并解析页面、图片、文字和背景设置。
requirements: The Digicam Print Channel is the intended client.
MIT.

name: bline: decoding LINE voice-call traffic
description_en: bline investigates an earlier LINE voice-call stack and supplies tools for its custom ZLIB-compressed SIP data. The repository includes a compression and decompression library, a command-line pipe utility and a Kaitai Struct definition for heartbeat messages.
description_zh: bline 研究 LINE 早期的语音通话软件栈，并提供处理其自定义 ZLIB 压缩 SIP 数据的工具。仓库包含压缩与解压库、命令行管道工具，以及心跳报文的 Kaitai Struct 定义。
requirements: The findings concern an earlier LINE voice-call stack that the author says was later rewritten.
The role of encryption and the audio payload format remain unexplained.
MIT License.

name: mg6250_mqtt: decoding Paradox MG6250 serial events
description_en: mg6250_mqtt reconstructs part of the Paradox MG6250 alarm console's serial event protocol. It documents frame lengths, event fields and CRC-16/MODBUS checksums, and provides a Python test client plus an ESP8266 sketch that forwards decoded events to MQTT.
description_zh: mg6250_mqtt 解析 Paradox MG6250 报警主机的部分串口事件协议，记录帧长度、事件字段和 CRC-16/MODBUS 校验算法。仓库提供 Python 测试程序及将事件转发到 MQTT 的 ESP8266 程序。
requirements: An MG6250 console serial connection; the MQTT sketch is designed for ESP8266.
The implementation receives console messages only; remote arm and disarm are planned.

name: RECAR: rebuilding the RACER Chrome Experiment server
description_en: RECAR rebuilds the server for the RACER Chrome Experiment game. Its Node.js code provides HTTPS and WebSocket services, with instructions for connecting a separately downloaded official client to the replacement server.
description_zh: RECAR 为 RACER Chrome Experiment 游戏重建服务端。其 Node.js 代码提供 HTTPS 和 WebSocket 服务，使用说明要求另行下载官方客户端并将其连接至替代服务端。
requirements: Node.js, an SSL certificate and key, and a configured server address are required.
The official RACER client is downloaded separately from Google's servers.
MIT licence.

name: Tanzmaus Sysex Parser: decoding MFB Tanzmaus bank dumps
description_en: Tanzmaus Sysex Parser investigates MFB Tanzmaus MIDI SysEx bank dumps. It decodes the 7-bit transport encoding into pattern payloads, maps step, mute, flam, knob and LFO fields, and supplies scripts for extracting and comparing individual patterns.
description_zh: Tanzmaus Sysex Parser 研究 MFB Tanzmaus 的 MIDI SysEx 模式库转储格式。它将 7 位传输编码还原为节奏模式数据，标注步进、静音、装饰击、旋钮和 LFO 字段，并提供提取及比较单个节奏模式的脚本。
requirements: A Tanzmaus SysEx bank dump; the documented capture command uses amidi.
The parser is under development, and several bytes and the possible checksum remain unidentified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Ganbare Goemon 3: a checksum-checked SFC disassembly
description_en: The Ganbare Goemon 3 project reconstructs the Super Famicom game's ROM as assembly, with bank maps and notes on asset, compression and text formats. Its build extracts required data from the user's unmodified v1.0 ROM and can compare the result with the documented SHA-1.
description_zh: 《Ganbare Goemon 3》项目以汇编重建 Super Famicom 版 ROM，并记录存储区划分、素材、压缩和文本格式。构建过程从用户提供的未修改 v1.0 ROM 提取所需数据，并可用文档所列 SHA-1 比对结果。
requirements: An original, unmodified v1.0 ROM placed as base.sfc.
Asar v1.91, GNU Make, Coreutils and Python 3.
Revision 1 and revision 2 ROMs are not yet supported.
No licence file in the repository.

name: avea: controlling the Elgato Avea bulb through its BLE protocol
description_en: avea implements Python control of the Elgato Avea bulb using a BLE protocol investigated through an Android btsnoop log and Wireshark. Its documentation maps the control characteristic and color, brightness and name commands; the library discovers bulbs and reads or sets their state through Bleak.
description_zh: avea 根据 Android btsnoop 日志和 Wireshark 对 Elgato Avea 灯泡的 BLE 通信进行分析，并用 Python 实现控制。文档列出控制特征值以及颜色、亮度和名称命令；程序通过 Bleak 搜索灯泡并读取或设置状态。
requirements: Python 3, Bleak, a working Bluetooth stack and an Elgato Avea bulb.
Bluetooth discovery may require additional operating-system permissions.
Mood-based ambiance commands remain to be reverse engineered.
MIT licence.

name: Cetus3D: reconstructing printer status messages
description_en: Cetus3D reconstructs status communication between UP Studio and a Cetus3D printer using Wireshark captures and experiments. Python and Arduino implementations discover the printer and query print progress, layer, remaining time and temperature; the capture notes describe network message exchanges.
description_zh: Cetus3D 通过 Wireshark 抓包和实验重建 UP Studio 与 Cetus3D 打印机之间的状态通信。Python 脚本和 Arduino 库可发现打印机，并查询打印进度、层数、剩余时间和温度；抓包笔记记录网络消息往来。
requirements: A Cetus3D printer and a networked host; the Arduino example uses an ESP8266.
The implementation focuses on status; extrude, withdraw and initialize commands remain future work.
MIT licence.

name: TamagoC: a Tamagotchi implementation from observation
description_en: TamagoC implements Tamagotchi-style virtual-pet behaviour from observation. Its C core models feeding, health, happiness, discipline, waste and a play outcome counter.
description_zh: TamagoC 依据观察实现 Tamagotchi 式虚拟宠物行为。C 语言核心代码处理喂食、健康、快乐、管教、排泄和游玩结果计数。
requirements: The repository contains core C routines for pet state and play.

name: LILO: reconstructing BLE control for the Prêt à Pousser LILO
description_en: LILO reconstructs Bluetooth Low Energy control of the Prêt à Pousser LILO device in JavaScript. It identifies a service and separate characteristics for lighting and time, with methods to read and write those settings and a map of lighting modes.
description_zh: LILO 用 JavaScript 重建 Prêt à Pousser LILO 设备的 BLE 控制。代码定义服务及灯光、时间特征值，提供这些设置的读写方法，并列出灯光模式。
requirements: A LILO device and a Node.js environment with noble-device.
ISC license declared in package.json.

name: helix: investigating DNA 75 USB HID control
description_en: helix investigates USB HID communication with the DNA 75 vaporizer controller while prototyping configuration from Linux. It records the device's USB descriptors and describes capturing transfers through usbmon and Wireshark after triggering actions in a Windows virtual machine.
description_zh: helix 研究 DNA 75 电子雾化器控制芯片的 USB HID 通信，并尝试在 Linux 下配置该芯片。文档记录设备的 USB 描述符，说明如何在 Windows 虚拟机中触发操作，再用 usbmon 和 Wireshark 抓取传输数据。
requirements: Linux, a DNA 75 device and python-hidapi.
The configuration software is described as a prototype.
MIT licence.

name: WazeTripper: reconstructing Tripper Pod navigation over BLE
description_en: WazeTripper connects Waze navigation to a Royal Enfield Tripper Pod by patching a Waze Android APK and sending commands over a reconstructed BLE interface. Its protocol notes cover the Pod's GATT transport, packet fields and confidence levels, while the build scripts download Waze and inject Java hooks for navigation events.
description_zh: WazeTripper 修改 Waze Android APK，通过重建的 BLE 接口向 Royal Enfield Tripper Pod 发送导航信息。协议笔记记录 Pod 的 GATT 传输、报文字段和结论可信度；构建脚本下载 Waze 并注入处理导航事件的 Java 钩子。
requirements: Docker and an Android phone; the build script downloads the supported Waze 5.23.0.2 APK. Road use needs a Tripper Pod.
The author reports testing on one Meteor 350 Tripper Pod and Galaxy S23 setup.
Only Waze 5.23.0.2 is supported; parts of the protocol remain unresolved.
Apache-2.0.

name: device-reveng: rebuilding a Choiceway GT6-EAU head unit stack
description_en: device-reveng investigates a Choiceway GT6-EAU Android car head unit and rebuilds its launcher and operating-system layer. Findings on OEM applications, AIDL interfaces, camera behavior and the MCU serial link support a Kotlin/Compose launcher and Riposte OS images assembled from the owner's firmware backup.
description_zh: device-reveng 研究 Choiceway GT6-EAU Android 车机，并重建启动器和操作系统层。对 OEM 应用、AIDL 接口、倒车影像行为及 MCU 串口链路的分析支撑 Kotlin/Compose 启动器和由设备自有固件备份构建的 Riposte OS 镜像。
requirements: A Choiceway or AiNavi GT6-EAU unit; the documented configuration uses QCM6125 and Android 13 stock firmware.
JDK 17 and Android SDK platform 34 to build the launcher.
Riposte OS requires a backup of the unit's own firmware; some car checks remain pending.
Apache-2.0.

name: Torso T-1: reconstructing the .t1 backup format
description_en: The Torso T-1 backup-format project maps the sequencer's .t1 bank data through controlled device backups and byte comparisons. Python codecs parse and rebuild banks, export patterns to MIDI and import MIDI as device-loadable backups; the author reports byte-exact sample rebuilds and successful hardware imports.
description_zh: Torso T-1 备份格式项目通过受控设备备份和字节比较，解析音序器的 .t1 模式库数据。Python 编解码工具可解析、重建模式库，将模式导出为 MIDI，并把 MIDI 导入为设备可加载的备份；作者报告样本逐字节重建及硬件导入成功。
requirements: Python 3; a T-1 device is needed to load generated backups onto hardware.
Keep a known-good device backup before importing generated banks.
Timing and Delay tick units, MIDI scale mapping and some interior bytes remain unresolved.
MIT License.

name: Ha-Kake: decoding Nissan Leaf CAN signals for a telemetry dashboard
description_en: Ha-Kake documents how Nissan Leaf CAN and OBD-II signals were identified and decoded for a local vehicle dashboard. The repository pairs signal byte tables and an eight-chapter investigation guide with a Python reader, vehicle profiles, replay tools and a simulator.
description_zh: Ha-Kake 记录了 Nissan Leaf CAN 与 OBD-II 信号的识别和解码过程，并将结果用于本地车辆仪表盘。仓库包含信号字节表、八章研究指南，以及 Python 读取器、车型配置、回放工具和模拟器。
requirements: A laptop and an ELM327 BLE or USB adapter for live vehicle readings.
The author reports use on a 2012 Nissan Leaf and a 2009 Mitsubishi Lancer; some Leaf decodes are tentative.
AGPL-3.0-or-later.

name: Ökoboiler: decoding the water heater's internal UART bus
description_en: The Ökoboiler study reconstructs the single-wire UART exchange between a heat-pump water heater's display and control boards. It documents 32-byte frames, XOR masking, CRC-16/Modbus and fields for tank temperature, operating mode and PV state, with a Python decoder and an ESPHome sensor configuration.
description_zh: Ökoboiler 项目重建热泵热水器显示板与主控板之间的单线 UART 通信。文档说明 32 字节帧、XOR 掩码、CRC-16/Modbus，以及水箱温度、运行模式和光伏状态字段，并提供 Python 解码器与 ESPHome 传感器配置。
requirements: The documented capture setup uses an Ökoboiler unit and an ESP32-C6 running ESPHome.
The author reports validating the protocol on one unit over several days of traffic.
MIT licence.

name: Ritto 7630: reconstructing intercom bell and door signals
description_en: ritto-esp investigates the Ritto 7630 TwinBus intercom's board signals with oscilloscope captures, distinguishing apartment and street bell events by their chime and apartment-line behavior. An ESP32-C6 running ESPHome exposes separate bell sensors and a door-open command to Home Assistant through optocoupled inputs and output.
description_zh: ritto-esp 通过示波器测量 Ritto 7630 TwinBus 对讲机的板级信号，依据响铃线与楼层门铃线的变化区分公寓门铃和街道门铃。ESP32-C6 运行 ESPHome，经光耦连接输入与开门输出，并向 Home Assistant 提供两个门铃传感器和开门命令。
requirements: A Ritto 7630 intercom, Seeed XIAO ESP32-C6, optocouplers, resistors and USB-C power.
ESPHome and Home Assistant are used for the supplied configuration and automations.
MIT licence.

name: Marble Knights Recompiled: an iOS game port by static recompilation
description_en: Marble Knights Recompiled ports the iOS game to Windows by translating ARM64 functions in its UnityFramework into C and compiling them into a GameAssembly.dll for the Unity 2019.4.17f1 Windows player. A compatibility layer replaces iOS services, while preparation scripts process the player's own game data; the project also describes an Android path using a Mach-O loader.
description_zh: Marble Knights Recompiled 将《Marble Knights》iOS 版 UnityFramework 中的 ARM64 函数预先转成 C，再编译为供 Unity 2019.4.17f1 Windows 播放器加载的 GameAssembly.dll。兼容层替代 iOS 服务，准备脚本处理玩家自备的游戏数据；项目还提供通过 Mach-O 加载器运行的 Android 路径。
requirements: A copy of Marble Knights iOS 2.3.1, build 760642, is required; game data is not included.
Windows builds require Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools, LLVM, Python 3 with Capstone, and Unity 2019.4.17f1 Editor and Windows IL2CPP Build Support.
The early pre-release was tested on one Windows 11 PC with an NVIDIA GPU and one ARM64 Android device; AMD and Intel graphics drivers are untested.
MIT License.

name: ha-c14: reconstructing the C14 ventilator bus protocol
description_en: ha-c14 documents the C14 RS-485 bus between a COMPIT AERO 3B ventilator and Nano Color CTP room panel and implements an ESPHome bridge for ESP32. Its protocol notes describe 30-byte frames, master cycles and device roles; the YAML package parses frames and exposes controls and sensors to Home Assistant.
description_zh: ha-c14 记录 COMPIT AERO 3B 新风机与 Nano Color CTP 室内面板之间的 C14 RS-485 总线，并为 ESP32 实现 ESPHome 桥接。协议文档描述 30 字节帧、主设备通信周期和设备角色；YAML 包解析帧并向 Home Assistant 提供控制项和传感器。
requirements: An ESP32-compatible board and a 3.3 V RS-485 interface connected to the C14 bus are required.
ESPHome and Home Assistant are used for the provided integration.
Protocol reverse engineering is ongoing and some fields remain unresolved.
Documentation is CC BY-SA 4.0; firmware code is MIT.

name: Prineo_RE: PriPara arcade model-format investigation
description_en: Prineo_RE investigates the PriPara arcade games' model and resource formats and provides a Noesis addon to load skinned meshes, encrypted assets and texture bindings. Its notes describe BIN containers, MDJ geometry and scene chunks, and modified hashing and pseudorandom routines encountered during format analysis.
description_zh: Prineo_RE 研究《PriPara》街机系列的模型和资源格式，并提供 Noesis 插件加载蒙皮网格、加密资源和纹理绑定。研究记录描述了 BIN 容器、MDJ 几何与场景数据块，以及格式分析中遇到的改动版哈希和伪随机算法。
requirements: Noesis is required to use the provided addon.
The documented formats contain fields whose purpose remains unknown.
GPL-2.0 License.

name: VTech Baby Pro Bridge: reconstructing local camera streaming
description_en: VTech Baby Pro Bridge reconstructs local streaming from an RM-series camera through TUTK/Kalay and VTech's X25519 and ChaCha20-Poly1305 layer. Its C bridge serves video through RTSP, WebRTC and HLS, while companion scripts probe the owner's paired Android app for connection values and use SDK libraries extracted from that app.
description_zh: VTech Baby Pro Bridge 通过 TUTK/Kalay 及 VTech 的 X25519、ChaCha20-Poly1305 处理层，重建 RM 系列摄像头的本地串流。C 程序通过 RTSP、WebRTC 和 HLS 提供视频；配套脚本探测机主已配对的 Android 应用以取得连接参数，并使用从该应用提取的 SDK 库。
requirements: A VTech Baby Pro camera paired through the official app and a copy of the VTech Android app package are required.

One-time extraction requires a rooted Android phone exposing /sys/kernel/tracing, with the VTech app installed, and a macOS or Linux laptop for offset calculation and cross-compilation. Runtime requires an ARM64 Linux host on the camera's Layer 2 segment and SDK libraries extracted from the app package.
The author reports testing with a VTech RM5766 and a Raspberry Pi 3B+ running Debian 13.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Homiq Rescue: reconstructing the Homiq control protocol
description_en: Homiq Rescue documents the ASCII frame protocol used by older Homiq home-automation systems through a Moxa NE-4110S serial-to-TCP bridge. Its toolbox sniffs and sends frames, extracts backup data to JSON, and supplies Node-RED flows and a TCP emulator for integration work.
description_zh: Homiq Rescue 记录旧版 Homiq 家居自动化系统经 Moxa NE-4110S 串口转 TCP 桥接器使用的 ASCII 帧协议。仓库工具可抓取和发送帧、将备份数据提取为 JSON，并提供 Node-RED 流程及 TCP 模拟器。
requirements: Access to an existing Homiq installation or the included emulator is needed for integration work.
The emulator requires Node.js 18 or later and npm 9 or later.
The author notes that some documentation was generated or organized with AI tools and may contain errors.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Wizardry 6: reconstructing game formats and systems
description_en: Wizardry 6 investigates the data formats and systems of Bane of the Cosmic Forge, with parsers and viewers for graphics, maps, scenario records, text and sound. It includes portrait and character-roster editors and a developing Python game engine that reads original game data.
description_zh: Wizardry 6 研究 Bane of the Cosmic Forge 的数据格式与游戏系统，提供图形、地图、场景记录、文本和声音的解析及查看工具。仓库还包含肖像与角色名册编辑器，以及读取原版游戏数据的 Python 游戏引擎。
requirements: Original Wizardry 6 data in a gamedata directory is required for the demonstrated tools.
The Python package requires Python 3.11 or later, pygame-ce and Pillow.
Several reconstructed features are described as working or nearly working.
MIT license.

name: Reverse Engineering Scorcher: extracting its resource archive and images
description_en: Reverse Engineering Scorcher investigates the 1996 game's asset formats through a Python extractor. The script opens TAGDEN.BIN, extracts its resources and converts R0V images to PNG; the format inventory identifies additional files, including WL3 models and HMP heightmaps, that remain undecoded.
description_zh: Reverse Engineering Scorcher 通过 Python 提取脚本研究 1996 年游戏《Scorcher》的资源格式。脚本读取 TAGDEN.BIN，提取其中资源并将 R0V 图像转换为 PNG；格式清单还列出尚未解码的 WL3 模型、HMP 高度图等文件。
requirements: A copy of Scorcher containing TAGDEN.BIN is required; released game material is not included.
Python dependencies are listed in requirements.txt.
Most listed resource types remain undecoded.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: Reengineering Project for ibisPaint: investigating artwork and brush formats
description_en: Reengineering Project for ibisPaint investigates the app's IPV artwork, IPCF configuration and IPBZ brush QR formats. It records IPV chunk fields, provides a hex pattern and Python parsing scripts, and notes version data and deflate-compressed brush content in IPBZ QR data.
description_zh: Reengineering Project for ibisPaint 研究应用的 IPV 画作、IPCF 配置及 IPBZ 画笔二维码格式。项目记录 IPV 区块字段，提供十六进制模板和 Python 解析脚本，并指出 IPBZ 二维码数据包含版本信息及经 deflate 压缩的画笔内容。
requirements: ibisPaint files or QR data are needed for format inspection.
Some recorded fields and configuration interpretations remain tentative.
No licence file in the repository.

name: PreSonus StudioLive 16.0.2 USB: documenting mixer control messages
description_en: PreSonus StudioLive 16.0.2 USB documents control messages exchanged between the digital mixer and Universal Control software. Based on Wireshark captures, the notes describe vendor USB requests, response chunking, split-nibble values and commands for status, MIDI settings, channels and system controls.
description_zh: PreSonus StudioLive 16.0.2 USB 记录数字调音台与 Universal Control 软件之间的控制消息。笔记依据 Wireshark 抓包，描述厂商自定义 USB 请求、响应分块、半字节拆分编码，以及状态、MIDI 设置、通道和系统控制命令。
requirements: Understanding the notes assumes familiarity with the mixer and USB traffic.
The protocol documentation is work in progress, with several fields still unidentified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Precursor: Android ARM64 port of the Jak and Daxter trilogy
description_en: Precursor ports the Jak and Daxter trilogy to Android ARM64 using OpenGOAL's recovered GOAL code and tools. It adds an AArch64 compiler backend, C++–GOAL call bridges, an OpenGL ES 3.2 renderer, and a phone launcher that extracts and compiles game data from the user's PS2 ISO. The author reports that all three games boot on a phone, with different portions playable.
description_zh: Precursor 基于 OpenGOAL 恢复的 GOAL 代码和工具，将 Jak and Daxter 三部曲移植到 Android ARM64。项目增加 AArch64 编译器后端、C++ 与 GOAL 调用桥接、OpenGL ES 3.2 渲染器，以及从玩家 PS2 ISO 提取并编译游戏数据的手机启动器。作者报告三款游戏均可在手机上启动，但可游玩进度各不相同。
requirements: Provide a legally purchased PS2 copy of the game to be installed; PS3, PS4 and PS5 versions are unsuitable.
The Android APK requires an arm64-v8a device running Android 9 or later; building it requires the Android SDK and NDK 29.0.14206865.
The author reports that all three games are experimental and none has been checked from start to finish.
ISC License; third-party code retains its own licenses.

name: DJI Mic Mini Monitor: decoding the receiver's USB status stream
description_en: DJI Mic Mini Monitor reads transmitter battery and charging state from the receiver's USB status stream on Windows. Its Python reader uses WinUSB, while protocol notes describe MI_06 bulk endpoints, frame boundaries, CRC checks and status offsets; the author reports checking those details against a local receiver.
description_zh: DJI Mic Mini Monitor 在 Windows 上通过接收器的 USB 状态流读取发射器电量和充电状态。Python 程序使用 WinUSB；协议笔记记录 MI_06 的 Bulk 端点、帧边界、CRC 校验及状态字段偏移，作者称已用本机接收器核对。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 x64, a USB-connected DJI Mic Mini receiver, and a WinUSB binding for its MI_06 interface.
Source use requires Python 3.9+ with tkinter; tray functions also use pystray and Pillow.
Read-only status monitoring; receiver battery level is unavailable, and two-transmitter use has not been tested on hardware.
MIT license.

name: baseus-cli: reconstructing Baseus Bass BS1 NC control
description_en: baseus-cli controls Baseus Bass BS1 NC earbuds on Windows through a reconstructed Classic Bluetooth RFCOMM protocol. Its Python client reads and changes ANC, spatial audio, EQ, bass boost and other settings; a protocol map and research scripts document frame opcodes and state-difference experiments.
description_zh: baseus-cli 在 Windows 上通过重建的 Classic Bluetooth RFCOMM 协议控制 Baseus Bass BS1 NC 耳机。Python 客户端可读取和修改降噪、空间音频、均衡器及低音增强等设置；协议映射与研究脚本记录帧操作码和状态差异实验。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11, Python 3.9 or later, and paired, connected Bass BS1 NC earbuds.
The Baseus phone app must release the earbuds' sole control channel.
The protocol was investigated on one pair; gestures remain undecoded.
MIT license.

name: hxoctkl: reconstructing HyperX Alloy Origins Core profile writes
description_en: hxoctkl reconstructs USB HID profile control for the HyperX Alloy Origins Core tenkeyless keyboard and writes persistent per-key RGB animations from Linux. Its protocol notes specify 64-byte reports, command opcodes, colour-buffer packing and the upload and commit sequence. The research used device queries and one NGENUITY USB capture, and builds on OpenRGB's earlier findings about colour-buffer packing.
description_zh: hxoctkl 重建 HyperX Alloy Origins Core 无数字键区键盘的 USB HID 配置控制方式，可从 Linux 写入持久化的逐键 RGB 动画。协议文档记录 64 字节报告、命令码、颜色缓冲区排列方式以及上传和提交顺序。研究使用了设备查询和一次 NGENUITY USB 抓包，颜色缓冲区排列方式还依据了 OpenRGB 的先前研究。
requirements: Only HyperX Alloy Origins Core USB IDs 0951:16e6 and 03f0:098f are supported; development used an ANSI layout and firmware 21.08.
Linux hidraw access requires the documented udev rule and an active local seat, or root access.
The tool cannot restore overwritten onboard profiles by itself.
GPL-2.0-or-later License.

name: Grand Prix Circuit: a native Rust port of the 1988 DOS game
description_en: Grand Prix Circuit is a Rust port of the 1988 DOS racing game that loads the user's GPEGA.EXE and game assets. Its code handles EXEPACK unpacking, x86 instruction execution, EGA graphics, and DOS/BIOS services; the port also offers 60 FPS motion interpolation and a Commodore 64 display and audio mode.
description_zh: Grand Prix Circuit 是 1988 年 DOS 赛车游戏的 Rust 移植版，读取玩家提供的 GPEGA.EXE 和游戏资源。项目实现 EXEPACK 解包、x86 指令执行、EGA 图形及 DOS/BIOS 服务，并提供 60 FPS 运动插帧和 Commodore 64 画面与音频模式。
requirements: Provide GPEGA.EXE or GPEGA_UNP.EXE and the original PES and PCS game assets; a SID file is optional for Commodore 64 audio.
Build with the stable Rust toolchain, edition 2021; the README lists additional Linux build dependencies.
The documented builds target Windows x64, Linux x64 or Steam Deck, and Apple Silicon macOS.
MIT License.

name: OpenInsaniquarium: reimplementing Insaniquarium Deluxe
description_en: OpenInsaniquarium reimplements Insaniquarium Deluxe 1.1 in Rust with a deterministic simulation and Bevy presentation layer. It loads assets from the user's game installation and uses captured original-game traces for tick-by-tick comparisons; the author reports that the preview covers Adventure's first tank and all 24 pets in testing.
description_zh: OpenInsaniquarium 用 Rust 重建《Insaniquarium Deluxe 1.1》，将确定性模拟与 Bevy 展示层分开。它从用户安装的原版游戏读取素材，并利用原版运行记录逐个模拟时步对照；作者报告预览版可游玩冒险模式的第一个鱼缸，且已对全部 24 只宠物进行逐步测试。
requirements: Own installed copy of Insaniquarium Deluxe 1.1; the engine reads its assets at runtime.
Rust toolchain for source builds; Linux music playback needs libopenmpt.
The v0.1.0 preview covers Adventure levels 1-1 through 1-5; saves, tanks 2–5 and other modes remain unfinished.
Dual licensed MIT or Apache-2.0.

name: github-websocket-pipelines-api: probing GitHub Actions live-log messages
description_en: github-websocket-pipelines-api probes GitHub Actions' undocumented live-log WebSocket interface. Its TypeScript client finds an in-progress run, obtains a socket URL through GitHub's live-log endpoints, sends a JSON handshake and WatchRunAsync request with a record separator, and prints incoming messages.
description_zh: github-websocket-pipelines-api 探查 GitHub Actions 未公开的实时日志 WebSocket 接口。其 TypeScript 客户端查找运行中的任务，经 GitHub 实时日志端点取得连接地址，发送带记录分隔符的 JSON 握手与 WatchRunAsync 请求，并输出收到的消息。
requirements: A USER_SESSION environment value is required by the client.
The example is fixed to a user and repository in client.ts and looks for an in-progress Actions run.
MIT license is declared in package.json.

name: Wireless Doorbell Clone: reconstructing a Grundig QH-831A remote frame
description_en: Wireless Doorbell Clone reconstructs the Grundig QH-831A doorbell remote's transmitted data frame and implements transmitters in Arduino and MicroPython. The notes give the bit sequence and 475 µs and 1435 µs pulse lengths, while the repository includes captured radio data.
description_zh: Wireless Doorbell Clone 重建 Grundig QH-831A 无线门铃遥控器发送的数据帧，并提供 Arduino 与 MicroPython 发射程序。文档列出比特序列及 475 微秒、1435 微秒两种脉冲时长；仓库还保存了无线电采样数据。
requirements: Investigating the signal requires an SDR; transmitting it requires an Arduino- or MicroPython-compatible board and a 433 MHz ASK transmitter.
The documented software tools are GQRX, Audacity and Arduino IDE.
MIT License.

name: Durak NX: running the Durak Android game on Nintendo Switch
description_en: Durak NX runs the Android ARM64 Unity game Durak 25.0 on Nintendo Switch through a target-specific compatibility layer for graphics, audio, files and input. The project documents ELF and IL2CPP analysis of the game's libraries and loads locally extracted files from the user's own Android package; the author reports menus, gameplay and sound working on Switch hardware.
description_zh: Durak NX 通过针对游戏编写的图形、音频、文件和输入兼容层，让 Android ARM64 Unity 游戏 Durak 25.0 在 Nintendo Switch 上运行。项目记录了游戏库的 ELF 与 IL2CPP 分析，并加载用户从自己的 Android 安装包中本地提取的文件；作者报告菜单、游戏操作和声音已在 Switch 硬件上运行。
requirements: Nintendo Switch with Atmosphère and Homebrew Menu, launched in application mode.
The user's own exact Durak 25.0 Android package with ARM64 libraries is required.
The build environment described is Windows with WSL Ubuntu, Docker and Python.
Version 0.1.0 is experimental; other game versions, full completion and suspend/resume are outside current testing.
No licence file in the repository.

name: OpenCE PS4: porting Halo: Combat Evolved to PlayStation 4
description_en: OpenCE PS4 ports OpenCE's reconstructed Halo: Combat Evolved code to a jailbroken PlayStation 4. It builds the game as x32 code inside a PS4 host, maps platform services and DualShock 4 input, and routes OpenGL ES rendering through Mesa Zink and RADV; game maps come from the user's own Xbox copy.
description_zh: OpenCE PS4 将 OpenCE 重建的 Halo: Combat Evolved 代码移植到已越狱的 PlayStation 4。项目将游戏编译为运行在 PS4 宿主程序中的 x32 代码，接入平台服务与 DualShock 4 输入，并通过 Mesa Zink 和 RADV 渲染 OpenGL ES；地图文件由用户自己的 Xbox 游戏副本提供。
requirements: A jailbroken PS4 with GoldHEN, FTP access and the user's own original Xbox copy of Halo: Combat Evolved are required.
The retail Xbox NTSC 1.0 maps are the tested game data.
Only the original PS4 model has been tested; online and LAN play have not been tried.
AGPL-3.0-or-later.

name: SR1 Creator: rebuilding the Saints Row character creator
description_en: SR1 Creator recreates the Saints Row (2006) character creator in a browser using meshes, morph targets, textures and tables read from the user's Saints Reborn folder. JavaScript readers handle VPP packfiles, PEG textures, character meshes and morphs; the author reports comparing geometry and camera behavior with the running game. A photo-fitting view estimates face sliders from landmarks.
description_zh: SR1 Creator 在浏览器中重建《Saints Row》（2006）的角色创建器，从用户自备的 Saints Reborn 目录读取网格、形变目标、纹理和表格。JavaScript 读取器处理 VPP 封包、PEG 纹理、角色网格和形变；作者报告曾将几何数据与镜头行为同运行中的游戏对照。照片拟合功能可根据面部关键点估算滑块值。
requirements: The user's own Saints Reborn game folder is required; game data is not shipped.
The browser needs access to the required misc2.vpp_xbox2 and morph_stream.vpp_xbox2 packfiles.
Lighting and photo fitting are approximations, and the creator's blinking eyes are not reproduced.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Dragon Ball Z: The Legacy of Goku II: a byte-matching GBA disassembly
description_en: Dragon Ball Z: The Legacy of Goku II is reconstructed as a byte-matching GBA disassembly using ARM and Thumb assembly generated from the user's USA ROM. The build also re-encodes game containers, carries remaining bytes as slices of that ROM and compares the output with the retail digest. The author reports that 68.2846% of the ROM builds from tracked source.
description_zh: Dragon Ball Z: The Legacy of Goku II 从用户自备的美版 GBA ROM 生成 ARM、Thumb 汇编，以逐字节匹配的反汇编流程重建映像。构建过程还会重新编码容器，将其余字节作为原始 ROM 切片纳入，并对照零售版摘要。作者报告有 68.2846% 的 ROM 由跟踪的源码构建。
requirements: A user-owned USA ROM matching the documented SHA-1 is required.
ARM Developer Suite 1.2, Python 3.12, and Visual Studio 2022 or Build Tools with the C++ workload are required.
The author reports 68.2846% of ROM bytes built from tracked source; remaining bytes use slices from the user's ROM.
MPL-2.0 license.

name: LSD: Dream Emulator: a matching PlayStation decompilation
description_en: lsd-decomp reconstructs C source for the SLPS-01556 PlayStation release of LSD: Dream Emulator and checks the rebuilt executable by SHA-1. It documents the dream graph, links, randomness and engine systems with function addresses, alongside emulator-based observations; the author reports that all game functions rebuild to the retail bytes.
description_zh: lsd-decomp 为《LSD: Dream Emulator》的 PlayStation 发行版 SLPS-01556 重建 C 源码，并用 SHA-1 核对重新构建的可执行文件。项目结合模拟器中的观察结果，按函数地址记录梦境图、场景连接、随机机制和引擎系统；作者报告所有游戏函数均可重建为零售版字节。
requirements: Linux x86-64 with make, git, curl, Python 3 with venv, binutils-mipsel-linux-gnu, and stable Rust.
Own game disc dump; a Japanese PS1 BIOS dump is needed for in-game emulator checks.
The author reports that 62 of 4,103 assigned names remain guesses.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Battle Engine Aquila: a matching PC decompilation
description_en: onslaught-decomp reconstructs Battle Engine Aquila's PC game code from a published GPL source release and retail executable evidence. It compiles C++ with Visual C++ 6.0 SP5 and compares function sections with BEA.exe; the author reports matches for 5,449 of 5,482 retail functions, with the remaining 33 tied to omitted DirectX sample files.
description_zh: onslaught-decomp 以已发布的 GPL 源码和零售版可执行文件为依据，重建《Battle Engine Aquila》的 PC 版代码。项目用 Visual C++ 6.0 SP5 编译 C++ 并逐函数比较 BEA.exe；作者报告 5,482 个零售版函数中有 5,449 个匹配，其余 33 个属于未收录的 DirectX 示例文件。
requirements: Own pinned BEA.exe and game folder, Visual C++ 6.0 SP5 Professional, and DirectX 9.0 SDK inputs.
Wine with 32-bit support, Python 3, llvm-undname, and GNU objdump.
The full linked executable still requires unavailable inputs; function matching is documented separately.
GPL-3.0; included third-party material retains its stated terms.

name: Lucci Air Homey App: reconstructing two fan handset RF protocols
description_en: Lucci Air Homey App reconstructs the 433 MHz control protocols of USB-C and CR2032 Lucci Air fan handsets from recorded transmissions. Its Homey drivers learn a handset address and send fan and light commands; separate protocol documents describe frame layouts, command codes and observed hardware behavior.
description_zh: Lucci Air Homey App 根据录制的射频信号重建 Lucci Air USB-C 和 CR2032 风扇遥控器的 433 MHz 控制协议。Homey 驱动学习遥控器地址后发送风扇及灯光指令；两份协议文档记录帧结构、命令编码和硬件观察结果。
requirements: A Homey device and the user's own Lucci Air handset are needed for address learning.
The source reports that Homey flow triggers had not been run on a Homey; CR2032 light transmission was not tested on a fan with a light.

name: ash: reimplementing a Dark Souls slice for PSP
description_en: ash reimplements a limited Dark Souls: Remastered experience in a C99 engine for Sony PSP hardware. Local converters prepare models, animations and parameters from the user's game copy; the engine provides combat, rendering and AI bytecode execution. The author reports playing from the Northern Undead Asylum to Firelink Shrine on a PSP Street E1000.
description_zh: ash 用 C99 引擎为 Sony PSP 重建《Dark Souls: Remastered》的部分游戏内容。本地转换器从用户的游戏副本提取并处理模型、动画和参数；引擎实现战斗、渲染及 AI 字节码执行。作者报告曾在 PSP Street E1000 上游玩从北方不死院到传火祭祀场的路线。
requirements: Own legally obtained Dark Souls: Remastered installation; converted game data must remain local.
Linux x86-64, pspdev v20261001, CMake, Ninja, Python 3.13 and the documented asset-conversion dependencies.
PSP custom firmware is required for hardware play; the author tested PSP Street E1000 with 6.60 PRO-C.
The data-cooking commands were not rerun in the reported release pass, and there is no single cook-all script.
MIT license.

name: rrt2-decomp: a Rust reimplementation of Railroad Tycoon II
description_en: rrt2-decomp reimplements Railroad Tycoon II in Rust after studying the Platinum executable, game data and simulation rules. Its crates parse PK2 archives, LAD sprites, maps and saves, while a differential harness runs original functions for comparison; the new game uses the player's installed assets and a wgpu renderer.
description_zh: rrt2-decomp 研究《Railroad Tycoon II Platinum》的可执行文件、游戏数据和模拟规则，并用 Rust 重实现游戏。各模块解析 PK2 档案、LAD 精灵、地图与存档；差异测试工具运行原版函数进行对照。新游戏读取玩家已安装的资源，并使用 wgpu 渲染。
requirements: A copy of Railroad Tycoon II is required for game assets and original-data tests.
Building requires the pinned stable Rust toolchain; Linux builds also require clang and mold.
The author reports partial decoding of some map and save structures and ongoing classification of executable functions.
GPL-3.0-or-later License.

name: Onslaught CE: a native Battle Engine Aquila port
description_en: Onslaught CE ports Battle Engine Aquila to native 32-bit Linux and Windows builds using the game's public source and a separate matching decompilation. Its SDL3 platform layer supplies window, input and audio support, with Direct3D 9 through dxvk-native on Linux and the system implementation on Windows; retail data comes from the user's installation.
description_zh: Onslaught CE 利用 Battle Engine Aquila 的公开源码和另一项目的匹配反编译成果，构建 32 位 Linux 与 Windows 原生移植版。其 SDL3 平台层负责窗口、输入和音频；Linux 通过 dxvk-native 使用 Direct3D 9，Windows 使用系统实现，游戏数据来自用户自己的安装。
requirements: A user-owned Battle Engine Aquila installation is required for retail data.
The native builds target i686 Linux and Windows.
The project describes its current status as an early preview.
GPL-3.0-only license.

name: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater: a matching Nintendo 64 decompilation
description_en: thps64 reconstructs the C source of Tony Hawk's Pro Skater for Nintendo 64 (US V1.1) from a user-supplied ROM. It splits compressed game code into functions and compares compiled instructions with the original. The author reports a byte-identical default build, 2,449 matching functions and 62 more represented by nonmatching C.
description_zh: thps64 利用用户提供的 Nintendo 64 美版 V1.1《Tony Hawk's Pro Skater》ROM 重建游戏的 C 源码。项目将压缩的游戏代码拆分为函数，并逐条比较编译后的指令与原版指令。作者报告默认构建与原版逐字节一致，已有 2,449 个函数匹配，另有 62 个函数写成了尚未匹配的 C 代码。
requirements: Own legally obtained US V1.1 Nintendo 64 ROM.
Python 3.12+, git, splat64, rabbitizer, pyelftools, m2c, and the documented GCC 2.8.1 and gas 2.6 toolchain.
The author reports 62 functions remain nonmatching and one library routine remains in assembly.
CC0-1.0 for project code and documentation; port components retain their stated MIT license.

name: caniOn Rebirth: reconstructing the Mitsubishi ZEV CAN client and protocol
description_en: caniOn Rebirth reconstructs the Mitsubishi ZEV CAN protocol used by the caniOn v152 Android app for the i-MiEV, iOn and C-Zero. It documents frame identifiers and signal scaling, implements a JVM protocol engine with CLI and Android clients, and supplies a script that patches a user-provided APK to use standard ELM327 commands.
description_zh: caniOn Rebirth 重建 caniOn v152 Android 应用用于 i-MiEV、iOn 和 C-Zero 的 Mitsubishi ZEV CAN 协议。项目记录 CAN 帧标识符与信号换算方法，提供 JVM 协议核心、命令行及 Android 客户端，并可将用户自行提供的 APK 改为使用标准 ELM327 命令。
requirements: The open-source client build requires JDK 17 or later.
The patch script requires the original caniOn v152 APK supplied by the user.
The patched APK retains targetSdkVersion 29 for its legacy storage and Bluetooth behavior.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Taktil: reconstructing AULA F99 HID control
description_en: Taktil implements wired AULA F99 control through a Rust HID adapter and a Tauri desktop interface. Its protocol study uses static analysis of the vendor driver and KB.ini to document report layouts, keymaps, macros and per-key RGB commands, marking observed and inferred behavior separately.
description_zh: Taktil 通过 Rust HID 适配层和 Tauri 桌面界面控制有线 AULA F99。其协议研究静态分析厂商驱动与 KB.ini，记录报告布局、键位映射、宏及逐键 RGB 指令，并区分直接观察与推断的行为。
requirements: A wired AULA F99 keyboard; development uses Node.js, pnpm, Rust and Tauri platform prerequisites.
Windows release builds use MSVC and WebView2; Linux HID access needs a keyboard udev rule.
Some firmware readback behavior in the protocol study remains inferred.
GPL-3.0-only.

name: Watcom C 6.5: reconstructing damaged runtime libraries
description_en: Watcom C 6.5 run-time library restoration rebuilds damaged CLIBS.LIB and CLIBC.LIB from surviving archive modules. It maps sector loss, converts modules from intact memory-model libraries, reconstructs selected C routines from machine code and records provenance for each result; the author reports matching every surviving byte used for comparison.
description_zh: 该项目从幸存的归档模块重建受损的 Watcom C 6.5 运行库 CLIBS.LIB 与 CLIBC.LIB。它定位扇区损坏、转换其他内存模型中的完整模块、根据机器码重写部分 C 例程，并逐模块记录来源；作者报告比较范围内的幸存字节均匹配。
requirements: The specified original Watcom C 6.5 archive, Python 3.8+ and DOSBox-X.
The provenance record identifies rebuilt modules with no surviving bytes for comparison and gives their confidence levels.
MIT license.

name: MG330 Studio: reconstructing SPCP6651B mouse configuration
description_en: MG330 Studio recreates configuration control for the 2E Gaming MG330 RGB mouse on macOS using the SPCP6651B HID feature-report protocol recovered from its Windows driver. It reads and writes the device's 2 KB configuration, covering RGB zones, DPI, polling rate and effect slots; protocol notes map report IDs, offsets and checksums.
description_zh: MG330 Studio 在 macOS 上通过从 Windows 驱动还原的 SPCP6651B HID 特性报告协议控制 2E Gaming MG330 RGB 鼠标。它读写设备的 2 KB 配置，涵盖灯光、DPI、回报率和效果槽；协议文档列出报告 ID、偏移和校验规则。
requirements: macOS 14 or later, a Sunplus SPCP6651B mouse and Input Monitoring permission; tested on the 2E MG330 RGB.
Xcode 16 is required to build; a stable code-signing identity retains the Input Monitoring grant across builds.
Button remapping is read-only; effects 2–7 were accepted by firmware but their appearance was not checked.
MIT license.

name: Quake 4 Definitive Edition: recovering Xbox 360 controller behavior for PC
description_en: Quake 4 Definitive Edition ports selected Xbox 360 controller behavior into openQ4 patches for the PC game. The project documents analysis of default.xex to recover stick dead zones, a square gate, look curves and turn speeds, then adds controller settings and aim-assist behavior to the engine.
description_zh: Quake 4 Definitive Edition 将 Xbox 360 版的部分手柄行为移植为 PC 版 openQ4 补丁。项目记录了分析 default.xex 以恢复摇杆死区、方形输入范围、视角曲线和转向速度的过程，并加入手柄设置及辅助瞄准行为。
requirements: Own PC copy of Quake 4 and Xbox 360 copy for the executable analysis.
openQ4 at the documented commit; Windows builds use Meson, Ninja and Visual Studio.
Controller tuning is ongoing, and Linux remains untested.
Tools, documentation and configuration are MIT; patches follow openQ4's stated licenses.

name: qutie: reconstructing PRT Qutie Bluetooth printing
description_en: qutie implements Linux printing for the PRT Qutie label printer using a recovered Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM protocol. Its notes document handshake, session XOR, status responses and LZO raster commands derived from printer observation and HerePrint app analysis; a Python library, CLI, CUPS components and Qt designer use the protocol.
description_zh: qutie 利用恢复的 Bluetooth Classic RFCOMM 协议，在 Linux 上支持 PRT Qutie 标签打印机。协议笔记依据设备观察和 HerePrint 应用分析，记录握手、会话 XOR、状态响应及 LZO 栅格指令；Python 库、命令行、CUPS 组件和 Qt 标签设计器均使用该协议。
requirements: Linux, Python 3.10+, a working Bluetooth adapter and a PRT Qutie printer.
The author reports testing one firmware 1.1.22 printer with continuous 12 mm tape; gap labels and other models remain untested.
MIT license.

name: Inception Chat: reconstructing a chat page from design and prompt captures
description_en: Inception Chat reconstructs the public chat.inceptionlabs.ai landing page from observed desktop and mobile layouts, deployed CSS tokens and captured suggested prompts. The repository records measurements and provenance in design documents and JSON, then uses them in a React 19, Vite and Tailwind chat interface with a Bun API server.
description_zh: Inception Chat 根据 chat.inceptionlabs.ai 公开落地页的桌面与移动布局、已部署 CSS 变量及采集的推荐提示词重建界面。仓库在设计文档和 JSON 中记录测量值及来源，并以 React 19、Vite、Tailwind 和 Bun API 服务实现聊天应用。
requirements: Bun and an OpenRouter key or local Ollama setup are needed for the documented chat app workflow.
Detailed visual measurements cover the dark-mode landing page at the stated desktop and mobile viewports.
Voice and dictation buttons are placeholders.
MIT license.

name: open-smc-pad: replacing M-Vave SMC-PAD firmware
description_en: open-smc-pad replaces the M-Vave SMC-PAD controller's firmware with a USB bootloader, runtime and Arduino core. Its stock-firmware research documents the USB-MIDI SysEx service protocol, flash layout and hardware wiring; the implementation supports pads, knobs, LEDs, USB-MIDI and BLE-MIDI.
description_zh: open-smc-pad 为 M-Vave SMC-PAD 控制器编写替代固件，包含 USB 引导程序、运行时和 Arduino 核心。项目记录原固件的 USB-MIDI SysEx 服务协议、闪存布局与硬件接线；实现涵盖打击垫、旋钮、LED、USB-MIDI 和 BLE-MIDI。
requirements: An M-Vave SMC-PAD with factory firmware and a USB connection is required for installation.
Source installation uses macOS or Linux and a source build; later firmware updates use USB DFU.
The author reports operation on one pad; 3.5 mm MIDI OUT and Windows host installation remain unfinished.
MIT license; parts derived from the JieLi SDK are Apache 2.0.

name: Luna Purpura: reimplementing Purple Moon game formats and playback
description_en: Luna Purpura works toward a portable interpreter for 1990s Purple Moon games, including Rockett's New School, using the user's original CD-ROM files. Ruby format-research tools, C decoders and Lua bindings support a developing LÖVE-based player. The author describes the implementation as an early research-stage work.
description_zh: Luna Purpura 以用户原版 CD-ROM 文件为输入，尝试为包括 Rockett's New School 在内的 1990 年代 Purple Moon 游戏编写可移植解释器。仓库中的 Ruby 格式研究工具、C 解码器和 Lua 绑定用于开发基于 LÖVE 的播放器；作者称项目仍处研究初期。
requirements: Original Purple Moon CD-ROM game files are the intended input for the interpreter.
CMake is required to build; Lua 5.1 or LuaJIT headers and libraries are needed when Lua bindings are enabled.
The project remains in a research phase, with very few functions working.
BSD-2-Clause license.

name: Digimon World 2003: a handheld port of the matching decompilation
description_en: Digimon World 2003 adapts an upstream matching decompilation and PC port for RK3326 Linux handhelds including the R36S and XF35H. The fork adds direct framebuffer output, a Mali GLES renderer, Cortex-A35 and NEON performance work, a gamepad menu and PortMaster packaging. The decompilation and PC port originate with gascarcella/dw2003recomp.
description_zh: Digimon World 2003 将上游的匹配反编译成果和 PC 移植版适配到 R36S、XF35H 等 RK3326 Linux 掌机。该分支新增直接帧缓冲输出、Mali GLES 渲染器、Cortex-A35 与 NEON 性能优化、手柄菜单和 PortMaster 打包；反编译成果及 PC 移植来自 gascarcella/dw2003recomp。
requirements: The user's own European Digimon World 2003 disc image is required.
The handheld path targets RK3326 devices with a 32-bit Linux userspace and uses PortMaster.
The decompilation and PC port originate from gascarcella/dw2003recomp.
The fork's own work is under the MIT License.

name: Shadow the Hedgehog: a matching GameCube decompilation
description_en: Shadow the Hedgehog reconstructs C++ source for the USA Rev 0 GameCube release using the original Metrowerks toolchain. The project compares its rebuilt main.dol with the retail executable byte for byte and publishes function progress, symbols and compiler research notes.
description_zh: 该项目为《Shadow the Hedgehog》GameCube 美版 Rev 0 重建 C++ 源码，使用原版 Metrowerks 工具链编译，并将生成的 main.dol 与零售版逐字节比较。仓库还提供函数进度、符号表和编译器研究笔记。
requirements: Own copy of Shadow the Hedgehog USA Rev 0 for GameCube, provided as a disc image or extracted main.dol.
Python 3.10+ and Ninja; configure.py downloads the pinned toolchain and comparison tools.
Work in progress.
CC0 1.0; vendored Boost headers retain the Boost Software License 1.0.

name: Predator Sense for Linux: reconstructing PHN16-72 firmware control
description_en: Predator Sense for Linux reconstructs Acer PredatorSense controls for the Predator Helios Neo 16 PHN16-72. Its documentation traces Windows service behavior and firmware WMI methods, while a Linux kernel module and daemon expose performance modes, fan settings, keyboard lighting and battery controls to a CLI and Qt interface.
description_zh: Predator Sense for Linux 为 Predator Helios Neo 16 PHN16-72 重建 Acer PredatorSense 控制功能。文档追踪 Windows 服务行为和固件 WMI 方法；Linux 内核模块与后台服务将性能模式、风扇、键盘灯效和电池设置提供给命令行及 Qt 界面。
requirements: Predator Helios Neo 16 PHN16-72 is the primary hardware target; validation on real hardware is in progress.
Linux with systemd or elogind, Qt 6.4+, DKMS and matching kernel headers.
Per-key USB RGB keyboards and immutable Linux systems are not supported yet.
GPL-2.0-or-later.

name: Hush: reconstructing WH-1000XM6 headset control
description_en: Hush is a macOS menu-bar and command-line client for Sony WH-1000XM6 headphones using their MDR protocol over Bluetooth RFCOMM. It documents frame escaping and request sequencing, and implements noise control, equalizer settings, battery reporting and DSEE; WH-1000XM6-specific ambient and equalizer behavior is described.
description_zh: Hush 是通过 Bluetooth RFCOMM 上的 Sony MDR 协议控制 WH-1000XM6 耳机的 macOS 菜单栏应用与命令行工具。项目记录帧转义和请求顺序，并实现降噪、均衡器、电量读取及 DSEE 控制，还说明该型号的环境声与均衡器行为。
requirements: macOS 13 or later and paired, connected WH-1000XM6 headphones; Xcode command-line tools are needed to build.
The author tested WH-1000XM6 firmware 3.1.5; other Sony MDR v2 headsets were not tested.
Speak-to-chat is read-only, and firmware update is not implemented.
MIT license.

name: Aromatic BLE bridge: reconstructing AF300 Smart diffuser control
description_en: The Aromatic BLE bridge connects an AF300 Smart scent diffuser to Home Assistant through an ESP32 running ESPHome. Its BLE protocol was derived from Android-app analysis and device probes; the bridge reads and writes power, fan and schedule settings, while protocol notes document GATT characteristics, login frames and commands.
description_zh: Aromatic BLE bridge 通过运行 ESPHome 的 ESP32 将 AF300 Smart 香薰机接入 Home Assistant。其 BLE 协议来自 Android 应用分析与设备探测；桥接器读写开关、风扇和日程设置，协议文档记录 GATT 特征、登录帧及命令。
requirements: An ESP32-C3 bridge, ESPHome and an Aromatic AF300 Smart diffuser are the tested setup.
Configuration requires Wi-Fi credentials, the diffuser password and MAC address; the phone app must release the single BLE connection.
The oil figures are estimates, and custom spray times below 15 seconds were not checked against pump behavior.
MIT license.

name: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: Echoes of Time: a Wii static recompilation for PC
description_en: pc-ffcceotwii statically recompiles the European Wii release of Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: Echoes of Time into C++ for PC on the wiikit runtime. Game-specific tools name the stripped DOL using related executables and signatures, while an input layer maps keyboard and mouse controls to Wii Remote, Nunchuk and pointer actions. The author reports reaching gameplay.
description_zh: pc-ffcceotwii 在 wiikit 运行时上，将欧版 Wii 游戏 Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: Echoes of Time 的 PowerPC 代码静态重编译为 PC 用 C++。专用工具通过相关可执行文件和签名为去符号的 DOL 命名，输入层将键盘鼠标映射为 Wii Remote、Nunchuk 与指针操作。作者报告已进入游戏流程。
requirements: A user-owned European RFFP game disc is required; game data and executables are not included.
Python 3.8 or later, CMake, Ninja, clang, SDL3, wiikit and OpenGL 4.5 are needed for the documented build.
DS-edition local wireless play and online play are unfinished.
MIT license for this repository's documentation and tools.

name: Hamtaro: Ham-Ham Heartbreak: a matching GBA decompilation
description_en: Hamtaro: Ham-Ham Heartbreak reconstructs the European AH3P revision 0 GBA game as C and assembly that builds a specified 16 MiB ROM. Its technical notes cover startup, graphics, actors, scripts, text, sound and saves, and describe ROM equality checks against the original image.
description_zh: Hamtaro: Ham-Ham Heartbreak 以 C 和汇编重建欧版 AH3P revision 0 的 GBA 游戏，目标是构建指定的 16 MiB ROM。技术文档涵盖启动、图形、角色、脚本、文本、声音和存档，并说明与原始映像的 ROM 一致性检查。
requirements: The target is the European AH3P revision 0 ROM identified by the documented SHA-1 and SHA-256 hashes.
Some data meanings and execution paths remain only partially understood.
No licence file in the repository.

name: AionLink Open: investigating ICCOA CarLink connectivity for the GAC AION i60
description_en: AionLink Open investigates ICCOA CarLink connectivity for the GAC AION i60 through static analysis of Android APKs and an independently written Android client. Its Kotlin modules cover BLE discovery and GATT inspection, experimental Wi-Fi Direct and USB transport, UCar framing and authentication probes; the author reports that an ICCOA session and projection on the vehicle remain unconfirmed.
description_zh: AionLink Open 通过静态分析 Android APK 并编写独立客户端，研究 GAC AION i60 的 ICCOA CarLink 连接。Kotlin 模块涵盖 BLE 发现与 GATT 检查、实验性 Wi-Fi Direct 和 USB 传输、UCar 帧解析及认证探测；作者表示，车辆上的 ICCOA 会话和投屏尚未得到确认。
requirements: Android 10 or later; building on Windows requires Python 3, JDK 21 and Android SDK API 35 with Build Tools 35.0.0.
Research APKs must be obtained separately and kept locally; vehicle tests are described for a parked car with authorization.
ICCOA session and projection compatibility with the GAC AION i60 remain unverified.
GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: pc-4ddriving: a native port of 4D Driving
description_en: pc-4ddriving ports the FM Towns Marty game 4D Driving by recompiling its 386 program and TBIOS into C++ with fmtownskit. Its SDL3 runtime supports windowed and headless play, and the project compares frames, races and audio with MAME while documenting the disc layout and game resource formats.
description_zh: pc-4ddriving 使用 fmtownskit 将 FM Towns Marty 游戏《4D Driving》的 386 程序及 TBIOS 重编译为 C++。SDL3 运行时支持窗口和无界面运行；项目将画面、比赛与声音同 MAME 对照，并记录光盘布局和游戏资源格式。
requirements: The user must supply the 4D Driving FM Towns Marty disc and Towns font ROM.
Building uses the fmtownskit submodule, CMake, Ninja, clang++ and SDL3.
The author reports that the port is being played and compares selected frames and audio with MAME.
MIT License.

name: pc-thequeenofduellist: a native port of The Queen of Duellist
description_en: pc-thequeenofduellist ports the FM Towns game The Queen of Duellist by recompiling its 386 program and TBIOS code into C++ with fmtownskit. Its runtime displays the game in an SDL3 window, while tools compare frames and audio against MAME; the repository also documents the disc layout, executable and resource formats.
description_zh: pc-thequeenofduellist 使用 fmtownskit 将 FM Towns 游戏《The Queen of Duellist》的 386 程序及 TBIOS 代码重编译为 C++。SDL3 运行时在窗口中呈现游戏，配套工具将画面和声音与 MAME 对照；仓库还记录了光盘布局、可执行文件和资源格式。
requirements: The user must provide the FM Towns Rev A disc files and a Towns font ROM.
Building uses the fmtownskit submodule, CMake, Ninja, clang++ and SDL3.
The author reports that one fight has been played from the title; the rest of the game remains to be explored.
MIT License.

name: HH41V: reconstructing the GOTU/SUDH update process
description_en: HH41V maps the TCL/Alcatel mobile hotspot's FOTA update process, including its AP and modem package structure and GOTU/SUDH requests. It provides Python tools to inspect archive entries, fetch packages and compare package identity with a device configuration dump, plus notes on the updater and package inventory.
description_zh: HH41V 梳理 TCL/Alcatel 移动热点的 FOTA 更新流程，包括 AP 与调制解调器包结构，以及 GOTU/SUDH 请求。仓库提供检查归档、获取更新包和对照设备配置核验包身份的 Python 工具，并记录更新程序与包清单。
requirements: Python 3 and the standard library for the inspection tools.
A device configuration dump is needed for package identity checks; the repository's guarded installer checks CURef before passing a package to the vendor updater.
The modem delta format is not yet mapped precisely.
Code: MIT; documentation and data: CC BY 4.0.

name: pipepipe-sabr: reconstructing YouTube SABR streaming
description_en: pipepipe-sabr reconstructs YouTube SABR/UMP streaming behavior from source-level analysis of PipePipe and implements a separate Python client. It handles segmented sessions, signature parameters, downloading and browser playback, with a protocol report mapping fields and a Node-based PO Token component. The author reports a complete 20-minute test download.
description_zh: pipepipe-sabr 根据对 PipePipe 的源码分析重建 YouTube SABR/UMP 流媒体行为，并编写独立 Python 客户端。实现涵盖分段会话、签名参数、下载和浏览器播放，另有字段映射报告与基于 Node 的 PO Token 组件。作者报告完成过一段约 20 分钟视频的下载测试。
requirements: Python 3.8 or later; PO Token generation requires Node 22, bgutils-js and jsdom.
The author reports a complete 20-minute test download with separate audio and video segments.
LIVE_STREAM uses HLS and is outside the SABR path; the project does not implement its own adaptive-bitrate algorithm.
MIT license.

name: Band 9 表盘生成器: Huawei Band 9 HWT watch-face format reconstruction
description_en: Band 9 表盘生成器 reconstructs the Huawei Band 9 HWT watch-face package format from binary observations of public packages and builds installable packages for the 194 × 368 HWHD07 screen. Its format document records ZIP entries, payload layout, protobuf fields, data item numbers and resource slots.
description_zh: Band 9 表盘生成器通过观察公开的 HWT 包，归纳华为手环 9 表盘格式，并为 194 × 368 的 HWHD07 屏幕生成可安装的表盘包。格式文档记录了 ZIP 条目、载荷布局、protobuf 字段、数据项编号及资源槽位。
requirements: Python 3.9+, Pillow and NumPy.
A Chinese sans-serif font and a bold numeric font installed on the system.
The documented package layout applies to the 194 × 368 HWHD07 screen; other resolutions require separate observation of resource sizes, slots and previews.
MIT License.

name: Teclado RGB via USB HID: reconstructing Redragon K552-M lighting commands
description_en: Teclado RGB via USB HID reconstructs the Redragon K552-M keyboard's lighting commands from captures of its official software. The author identifies a vendor-specific HID interface, 64-byte reports, color frames and a heartbeat; PowerShell tools send captured frames and adjust lighting effects.
description_zh: Teclado RGB via USB HID 根据官方软件的 USB 抓包重建 Redragon K552-M 键盘灯光命令。作者确认厂商专用 HID 接口、64 字节报告、颜色帧和心跳消息；PowerShell 工具可发送捕获的帧并调整灯效。
requirements: Redragon K552-M keyboard and PowerShell.
Direct HID mode requires closing the official software; Studio mode uses its music-color mode.
No licence file in the repository.

name: claude-peer: reconstructing Claude's local peer IPC
description_en: claude-peer reconstructs the local Unix socket peer exchange used by Claude Code and Claude Desktop. Its protocol notes describe session registration, token authentication and line-delimited JSON frames; a Node.js CLI and SDK discover active sessions, send messages and register external peers.
description_zh: claude-peer 重建 Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop 使用的本地 Unix 套接字对等通信。协议笔记记录会话注册、令牌认证及按行分隔的 JSON 帧；Node.js 命令行工具和 SDK 可发现活动会话、发送消息并注册外部对等节点。
requirements: Claude Code v2.1.318 or newer or the documented Claude Desktop macOS app is the target.
Node.js 18 or newer; the package lists macOS and Linux.
MIT License.

name: Nona: reconstructing Redmi Note 10 Pro Max camera remosaic conditions
description_en: Nona investigates the Redmi Note 10 Pro Max camera's 108 MP remosaic behavior and implements a Camera2 app around the observed ISO and AecLux conditions. The research log describes vendor stream configurations, empty full-resolution RAW buffers and the processed YUV path; the app exposes live status, exposure assistance and image-processing controls.
description_zh: Nona 研究 Redmi Note 10 Pro Max 相机的 108 MP 重马赛克行为，并按观测到的 ISO 与 AecLux 条件实现 Camera2 应用。研究记录涵盖厂商流配置、全分辨率 RAW 空缓冲区及处理后的 YUV 路径；应用提供实时状态、曝光辅助和图像处理控制。
requirements: Redmi Note 10 Pro Max (M2101K6I); tested on MIUI 14 and Android 13. Android 12 or newer is required.
The global Redmi Note 10 Pro is untested.
The author reports that full-resolution RAW buffers were empty in the tested Camera2 sessions.
MIT License.

name: NGPC–Dreamcast link cable: reconstructing retail game uploads
description_en: The NGPC–Dreamcast link-cable project reconstructs serial exchanges between SNK vs. Capcom: The Match of the Millennium and Capcom vs. SNK: Millennium Fight 2000. A beetle-ngp patch and Python bridge connect RetroArch to Flycast's BattleCable interface; protocol notes and byte logs document the upload sequence. The author reports successful retail transfers in emulation and a prototype transfer to a homebrew responder on a real Dreamcast.
description_zh: NGPC–Dreamcast 联机线项目重建 SNK vs. Capcom: The Match of the Millennium 与 Capcom vs. SNK: Millennium Fight 2000 的串行通信。beetle-ngp 补丁和 Python 桥接程序连接 RetroArch 与 Flycast BattleCable；协议笔记及字节日志记录上传流程。作者报告零售游戏在模拟环境中传输成功，并在真实 Dreamcast 上与自制应答程序完成原型测试。
requirements: Retail reproduction requires the user's own game dumps, RetroArch, Flycast, MSYS2 mingw64 gcc and Python 3.8 or newer.
The NGPC TCP backend works on Windows; a real Dreamcast test additionally needs a 3.3 V USB-UART adapter.
Retail MF2K has not been tried on real Dreamcast hardware.
MIT License.

name: Cadence: reimplementing Geometry Dash 2.2091 in Rust
description_en: Cadence reimplements Geometry Dash 2.2091 in Rust for desktop and browser play using the user's game resources. Its notes record binary analysis, level-data study and runtime traces; comparison tools check physics and camera behavior against the original. The author reports step-by-step position and velocity matches on 135 recorded runs, while the project remains in early development.
description_zh: Cadence 用 Rust 为桌面和浏览器重建 Geometry Dash 2.2091，读取用户自己的游戏资源。技术笔记记录二进制分析、关卡数据研究和运行轨迹，比较工具将物理与镜头行为同原游戏对照。作者报告在 135 次录制运行中位置和速度逐步吻合；项目仍处早期开发阶段。
requirements: A user's own legal copy of Geometry Dash 2.2091 is required.
Rust 1.90 or newer is needed to build from source.
The project is in early development; some features are close or ported without comparison.
MIT License.

name: wibox-daemon: reconstructing Fermax Wi-Box control and media transport
description_en: wibox-daemon reconstructs Fermax Wi-Box IDS7938 communication in a Go service for door control and media access. Its protocol reference describes cloud userauth XML, UST MQTT discovery, an RB-UDP tunnel and local QUII. The daemon exposes HTTP controls and outputs H.264 video with optional G.711A audio.
description_zh: wibox-daemon 用 Go 服务重建 Fermax Wi-Box IDS7938 的通信，以控制门禁并获取媒体流。协议文档记录云端 userauth XML、UST MQTT 发现、RB-UDP 隧道和本地 QUII；服务提供 HTTP 控制接口，并输出 H.264 视频及可选的 G.711A 音频。
requirements: Fermax Wi-Box IDS7938, account credentials and the door-opening PIN are needed for control.
Tested with Go 1.27 on linux/amd64; the README also describes an arm64 build.
The battery-powered doorbell may sleep, delaying remote connections.
AGPL-3.0 License.

name: MousePods: reconstructing AirPods 3 RemoteHID motion access
description_en: MousePods reconstructs AirPods 3 RemoteHID motion access and uses it for Linux cursor control. Its protocol reference specifies AACP transport, RTBuddy framing, device announcements and reports; capture files document the receive-MTU difference that exposes motion sensors. The project also describes a SensorDataWX path for AirPods Pro 2.
description_zh: MousePods 重建 AirPods 3 的 RemoteHID 运动数据访问，并将其用于 Linux 光标控制。协议文档记录 AACP 传输、RTBuddy 帧、设备公告和报告；抓包文件展示接收 MTU 对传感器发现的影响。项目还描述 AirPods Pro 2 的 SensorDataWX 路径。
requirements: Linux with BlueZ, paired AirPods and write access to /dev/uinput; Python 3.10 or newer.
Pointer mode has been tested in simulation only; several other AirPods models are untested.
Apache-2.0 License for the code; the documented captures use CC BY 4.0.

name: OpenSRO: porting Silkroad Online v1.150 to a browser game stack
description_en: OpenSRO ports Silkroad Online v1.150 into a TypeScript and WebGPU browser client with a Go game server. Function-address evidence accompanies ported behavior, and an asset pipeline turns the user's own v1.150 client installation into data for the browser and server.
description_zh: OpenSRO 将 Silkroad Online v1.150 移植为 TypeScript 与 WebGPU 浏览器客户端及 Go 游戏服务端。移植代码旁附有原版函数地址，资源流程从用户自己的 v1.150 客户端安装目录生成浏览器和服务端所需数据。
requirements: A user's own Silkroad Online v1.150 client installation for the asset build.
Go, Node.js 24, pnpm through Corepack, Python 3.12 and a WebGPU browser.
AGPL-3.0-or-later with a section 7(b) attribution term.

name: FitFace Studio: reconstructing Galaxy Fit3 watch-face editing and delivery
description_en: FitFace Studio reconstructs Galaxy Fit3 watch-face editing and Bluetooth delivery in an Android app. It parses and rewrites the face's binary container, validates its size and content, and documents the RFCOMM transfer sequence used to send it to an SM-R390 watch. The editor supports backgrounds, widgets and styles while retaining projects on the phone.
description_zh: FitFace Studio 在 Android 应用中重建 Galaxy Fit3 表盘编辑及蓝牙传输。它解析、改写并校验表盘二进制容器，文档记录向 SM-R390 手表发送数据的 RFCOMM 交互流程。编辑器支持背景、组件和样式调整，并在手机上保存项目。
requirements: Android 9 or newer, a paired Galaxy Fit3 with its companion app and stock plugin, and internet access for catalog and package downloads.
Building locally requires Android Studio and SDK 36; the first build fetches two accessory SDK JARs.
Faces without editable containers cannot be edited, and the watch's 4 MiB container limit applies.
MIT License.

name: Echo Show camera: reconstructing LineageOS camera support
description_en: The Echo Show camera project reconstructs camera support for LineageOS 18.1 on Echo Show 5 and 8 devices. Live-device findings trace missing camera providers, legacy MediaTek blobs, kernel struct differences and sensor tuning; kernel patches and userspace shims restore preview and capture. The project also documents Bluetooth and echo-cancellation fixes.
description_zh: Echo Show 相机项目为 Echo Show 5 和 8 的 LineageOS 18.1 重建相机支持。真机研究追踪缺失的相机提供程序、旧版 MediaTek 组件、内核结构差异与传感器调校问题；内核补丁和用户态兼容层恢复预览及拍摄。项目还记录蓝牙与回声消除修复。
requirements: A supported Echo Show 5 or 8 running the specified unofficial LineageOS 18.1 port, unlocked with amonet 2.0.1 or newer and able to boot TWRP.
A Linux host with adb, Python 3 and USB, plus a LineageOS 18.1 build environment; installation includes building and flashing a boot image.
Proprietary camera blobs are fetched separately rather than included.
MIT License.

name: RO3Emu: reconstructing a Ragnarok Online 3 server
description_en: RO3Emu reconstructs a server for the Ragnarok Online 3: Genesis game client. Its C# and .NET 10 code implements multiplayer systems and client-facing message routes, while research notes document observed client behavior and mark uncertain behavior as guesses. The launcher can find an existing game installation or download the game from its update servers.
description_zh: RO3Emu 为 Ragnarok Online 3: Genesis 客户端重建服务器。其 C# 和 .NET 10 代码实现多人游戏系统及面向客户端的消息路由；研究文档记录所观察到的客户端行为，并标明尚属推测的部分。启动器可查找已有的游戏安装目录，或从游戏更新服务器下载游戏。
requirements: Ragnarok Online 3: Genesis game files, from an existing installation or through the launcher's download option.
The .NET 10 SDK to run from source.
Some server behavior remains a documented guess.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: fretwire: reconstructing Line 6 HX USB control
description_en: fretwire reconstructs the Line 6 HX family’s USB control protocol for an independent Linux editor. Its Rust code covers device sessions, message encoding, preset parsing, and a graphical editor; protocol notes describe captured MI_00 frames and request-response behavior. Model and control data are imported from the user’s HX Edit or POD Go Edit installation.
description_zh: fretwire 根据 USB 通信记录还原 Line 6 HX 系列设备的控制协议，并实现独立的 Linux 编辑器。Rust 代码涵盖设备会话、消息编解码、预设解析和图形界面；协议文档记录了 MI_00 帧及请求响应流程。模型和控制数据需从用户自己的 HX Edit 或 POD Go Edit 安装中导入。
requirements: Linux and a supported Line 6 HX or POD Go device for hardware control.
Import model and control data from the user’s HX Edit or POD Go Edit installation.
Rust 1.96 or newer to build from source.
Firmware, flash, and DFU operations are outside the project’s scope.
Apache-2.0 or MIT license.

name: Kreo Hive 65: reconstructing USB HID RGB control
description_en: Kreo Hive 65 RGB Control reconstructs the keyboard's USB HID lighting exchange and implements Linux command-line, desktop and WebSocket controls. Its protocol document specifies the vendor interface, feature report 6 and a 520-byte per-LED RGB frame derived from descriptor analysis, usbmon capture and live probing.
description_zh: Kreo Hive 65 RGB Control 重建键盘的 USB HID 灯光通信，并提供 Linux 命令行、桌面和 WebSocket 控制方式。协议文档根据描述符分析、usbmon 抓包和实机探测，记录厂商接口、功能报告 6 及 520 字节逐灯 RGB 帧。
requirements: Linux, Python 3 and a supported keyboard connected by USB cable in wired mode.
The audio-reactive mode requires PipeWire or PulseAudio.
The Aula F75 WebSocket bridge currently uses the Hive 65 layout; its F-row and knob mapping is incomplete.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Cavium SNIC10E: reconstructing a PCIe shared-memory NIC datapath
description_en: The Cavium SNIC10E project reconstructs a PCIe BAR2 shared-memory datapath for the CN6640-SNIC10E card. Host and card drivers exchange packets through per-port rings, with PIO transmit and DPI DMA receive, while boot tooling loads OpenWrt into card RAM. The author reports bidirectional traffic on two 10 GbE ports and documents unstable simultaneous load.
description_zh: Cavium SNIC10E 项目重建 CN6640-SNIC10E 板卡的 PCIe BAR2 共享内存数据通路。主机端与板卡端驱动通过各端口的环形缓冲区交换数据包，以 PIO 发送、DPI DMA 接收，启动工具将 OpenWrt 加载到板卡内存。作者报告两个 10 GbE 端口均可双向通信，但同时持续负载仍不稳定。
requirements: Cavium CN6640-SNIC10E card; Linux or Windows 10/11 x64 for the implemented host drivers.
Initial host boot provisioning needs an FT232 serial adapter and a confirmed u-boot environment write; Secure Boot must be off.
Sustained simultaneous dual-port traffic can wedge the card, requiring a host reboot.
GPL-2.0 License.

name: Deadband: reconstructing GameSir and Logitech device configuration
description_en: Deadband reconstructs configuration exchanges for GameSir controllers and the Logitech G502 X LIGHTSPEED mouse in a Linux GUI. Its research notes connect USB identities, hidraw and evdev probing, USB captures and device registers to controls for lighting, profiles, remapping, curves and macros.
description_zh: Deadband 在 Linux 图形界面中重建 GameSir 手柄和 Logitech G502 X LIGHTSPEED 鼠标的配置交互。研究文档结合 USB 标识、hidraw 与 evdev 探测、USB 抓包及设备寄存器，说明灯光、配置文件、按键映射、曲线和宏的控制方式。
requirements: Linux and one of the supported GameSir controllers or the Logitech G502 X LIGHTSPEED mouse for hardware configuration.
Support varies by model and USB identity; the Kaleid is limited to lighting, and Tarantula Pro 8K lighting is not yet supported.
MIT license.

name: Yamaha SMAF Player: MA-series ringtone playback reconstruction
description_en: Yamaha SMAF Player reconstructs ringtone playback associated with Yamaha MA-series sound chips in C++. It parses SMAF MMF containers, decodes HandyPhone and Mobile scores and Yamaha voice data, and renders FM synthesis with optional ADPCM samples. The author based the parser and synthesizer on the public SMAF format description and examination of real files.
description_zh: Yamaha SMAF Player 用 C++ 重建 Yamaha MA 系列音源芯片的铃声播放功能。它解析 SMAF MMF 容器、HandyPhone 和 Mobile 乐谱及 Yamaha 音色数据，并通过 FM 合成输出音频，也支持可选的 ADPCM 采样。作者依据公开的 SMAF 格式说明并观察实际文件来编写解析器和合成器。
requirements: C++20 and CMake 3.16 or newer to build the library and example renderer.
A SMAF MMF ringtone file to render.
Bulk voice-wave blocks and SD-1-specific higher waveshapes are listed as future work; ROM timbres, graphics chunks, MA-7 streaming and MFi files are outside the stated scope.
Apache License 2.0.

name: Pocket Libre: reconstructing Pocket recorder transfer over BLE
description_en: Pocket Libre reconstructs the Pocket AI recorder's BLE command and audio-transfer behavior in a Python client. Its protocol notes map APP commands, MCU responses, GATT characteristics and MP3 streaming from HCI captures; the client downloads recordings and offers local transcription and speaker identification.
description_zh: Pocket Libre 用 Python 客户端重建 Pocket AI 录音设备的 BLE 命令与音频传输行为。协议文档依据 HCI 抓包记录 APP 命令、MCU 回复、GATT 特征和 MP3 流；客户端可下载录音，并在本地转录和识别说话人。
requirements: Python 3.10+, a Pocket PKT01 recorder and Bluetooth LE support.
A 16-character device session key, or a hardware reset followed by pairing with a new key.
WiFi file transfer is documented for firmware 1.7 and 1.8; other versions are untested.
MIT License.

name: Betrock++: reimplementing the Minecraft Beta 1.7.x server
description_en: Betrock++ reimplements the Minecraft Beta 1.7.x server in C++, aiming to replace the Java server while prioritizing compatibility. Its source covers packet handling, player sessions, world behavior and server commands, and the project allows extensions.
description_zh: Betrock++ 以 C++ 重建 Minecraft Beta 1.7.x 服务器，目标是兼容原版 Java 服务器。源码涵盖数据包处理、玩家会话、世界行为和服务器命令，并允许在保持兼容性的基础上扩展功能。
requirements: C++23 and CMake 3.25 or later for building.
The add-on C ABI is described as early and unstable.
AGPL-3.0 license.

name: Open Apollo: reconstructing Linux support for Apollo audio interfaces
description_en: Open Apollo reconstructs Linux control of Universal Audio Apollo Thunderbolt and USB audio interfaces through hardware and driver analysis. It provides a Thunderbolt kernel driver, USB initialization stack, mixer daemon and native console, with device setup drawing needed files from the user's UAD installation.
description_zh: Open Apollo 通过设备和驱动分析重建 Universal Audio Apollo Thunderbolt 与 USB 音频接口的 Linux 控制能力。项目提供 Thunderbolt 内核驱动、USB 初始化程序、混音守护进程及原生控制台，安装时从用户自己的 UAD 安装中读取所需文件。
requirements: A supported Apollo interface and Linux system; the documented Thunderbolt x4 setup uses Ubuntu 24.04.
The user's own UAD installation supplies files needed during setup.
Support is experimental; some configurations have kernel stability issues, and the rebuilt Apollo Solo USB initialization is untested on hardware in this release.
GPL-2.0 license.

name: attack-shark-x11-driver: a client for the Attack Shark X11 HID settings protocol
description_en: attack-shark-x11-driver reconstructs Attack Shark X11 mouse configuration over USB HID as a TypeScript client. It provides DPI, profile, button, macro, lighting and polling-rate controls, plus device-state reads. Its protocol notes draw on USBPcap and Wireshark captures, HID feature reports, official software analysis and firmware investigation.
description_zh: attack-shark-x11-driver 以 TypeScript 客户端实现 Attack Shark X11 鼠标的 USB HID 配置协议，支持 DPI、配置档、按键、宏、灯效和轮询率设置，以及设备状态读取。协议笔记记录了 USBPcap 与 Wireshark 抓包、HID 功能报告、官方软件分析和固件调查所得的发现。
requirements: Requires an Attack Shark X11 mouse; wired and 2.4 GHz wireless connections are supported.
Developed and tested primarily on Linux, with Node.js and Bun support where the HID implementation is compatible.
Bluetooth is untested; wake-up mode configuration and Left-Click Macro reports 0x32–0x33 are unfinished.
MIT license.

name: CoreFW: reimplementing Novation Launchpad firmware
description_en: CoreFW reimplements firmware for Novation Launchpad controllers with accessible bootloaders in Rust. It supplies device-specific drivers, MIDI and SysEx handling, palette editing, performance and programmer modes, and build aliases for supported RGB and earlier non-RGB models.
