description_zh: CoreFW 以 Rust 重建具有可访问引导加载器的 Novation Launchpad 控制器固件。项目提供分设备驱动、MIDI 与 SysEx 处理、调色板编辑、演出模式和编程模式，并为受支持的 RGB 与早期非 RGB 型号设置构建别名。
requirements: A supported Novation Launchpad with an accessible bootloader.
Rust and Cargo for the device-specific build aliases; manual flashing uses the bootloader MIDI port.
Native Live instrument, Note, Chord and Custom modes remain on the roadmap.
GPL-3.0-only license.

name: NeMo2: reimplementing the Virtools game engine libraries
description_en: NeMo2 reimplements the Virtools game engine's CK2 and VxMath libraries in C++. It provides Virtools object, behavior and scene handling, math and rendering support, and loading and saving for CMO and NMO files, with a Windows 32-bit build targeting Virtools compatibility.
description_zh: NeMo2 以 C++ 重建 Virtools 游戏引擎的 CK2 和 VxMath 库。它实现对象、行为与场景处理，提供数学和渲染支持，并读写 CMO、NMO 文件；构建目标为兼容 Virtools 的 Windows 32 位程序。
requirements: Windows, MSVC, C++17 and CMake 3.16 or later; build for Win32 compatibility.
The miniz, stb and yyjson dependencies are supplied as git submodules.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: Hisense/Hitachi H-NET-Protocol: investigating heat-pump bus signaling
description_en: Hisense/Hitachi H-NET-Protocol investigates the H-NET bus used by Hi-Therma and Air H₂O 400 heat pumps. Its documentation maps controller connections on an AHZ-080HCDS1 unit and describes the two-wire HBS signaling, frame fields and checksums.
description_zh: Hisense/Hitachi H-NET-Protocol 研究 Hi-Therma 和 Air H₂O 400 热泵使用的 H-NET 总线。文档记录 AHZ-080HCDS1 的控制器接线，并说明双线 HBS 信号、消息帧字段及校验方式。
requirements: The documented test unit is a Hisense AHZ-080HCDS1 heat pump.
The custom Home Assistant component is planned.
No licence file in the repository.

name: MUSIC DIVER MyPage API: mapping the game's private web endpoints
description_en: MUSIC DIVER MyPage API documents the private HTTP endpoints behind the game's MyPage service and implements a self-hosted proxy for player statistics. Its reference covers authentication, profile and music requests, rankings, payloads and response structures; the server adds caching and historical rank snapshots.
description_zh: MUSIC DIVER MyPage API 记录游戏 MyPage 服务的私有 HTTP 接口，并实现可自行部署的玩家数据代理。接口文档涵盖认证、资料与曲目请求、排名、请求载荷和响应结构；服务端还提供缓存与历史排名快照。
requirements: Bun 1.0 or later, MongoDB and Redis for manual deployment.
S3-compatible object storage credentials for the documented asset-mirroring setup.
MIT license.

name: YenKeyControl: decoding the Yenkee YKB3700 Rogue keyboard protocol
description_en: YenKeyControl reconstructs the Yenkee YKB3700 Rogue keyboard's USB HID configuration protocol and implements Python commands for RGB effects, per-key colors and key remapping. Its protocol notes specify packet layouts, command values, checksums and sequencing derived from captured USB traffic and parameter tests.
description_zh: YenKeyControl 重建 Yenkee YKB3700 Rogue 键盘的 USB HID 配置协议，并以 Python 工具控制 RGB 效果、逐键颜色和按键重映射。协议文档根据 USB 抓包和参数测试记录报文布局、命令值、校验和及发送顺序。
requirements: Yenkee YKB3700 Rogue keyboard, USB VID 3151 and PID 4002, for the documented device.
The README lists other keyboards as possible matches and marks the YKB3700 Rogue as tested.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: OpenDW: porting the original Mac Deepworld client to Windows
description_en: OpenDW reverse engineers and ports the original Mac Deepworld client to Windows in C++ with Axmol. The source implements game entities, world rendering, inventory and interface components; builds require user-provided assets, and play requires a compatible server.
description_zh: OpenDW 使用 C++ 和 Axmol 对原版 Mac 平台 Deepworld 客户端进行逆向，并移植到 Windows。源码实现游戏实体、世界渲染、物品栏和界面组件；构建需用户自行提供素材，游玩需连接兼容服务器。
requirements: Visual Studio 2022 and Axmol Engine v2.11.3 for the documented Windows build.
User-provided game assets, with audio converted to OGG and skeleton data updated for Spine 4.2.
A compatible server to play the online game.
MIT license.

name: elevenlabs-reader-cli: reconstructing Reader app streaming
description_en: elevenlabs-reader-cli is a Python command-line client for creating ElevenLabs Reader documents and streaming their audio through the Reader WebSocket. It follows the mobile app’s captured authentication flow, using Firebase tokens for account access and an App Check token and device ID for WebSocket streaming, with playback and optional live text preview.
description_zh: elevenlabs-reader-cli 是一个 Python 命令行客户端，可创建 ElevenLabs Reader 文档，并通过 Reader WebSocket 串流播放语音。它依据移动应用的抓包记录完成认证，使用 Firebase 令牌访问账户，使用 App Check 令牌和设备 ID 连接 WebSocket，还提供可选的实时文本预览。
requirements: Python 3.10 or later and project dependencies.
An ElevenLabs Reader account with a Firebase refresh token from the mobile app; Reader WebSocket use also requires an App Check token and device ID.
mpv or ffplay for playback.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Mystic Nights Online: reconstructing the PS2 multiplayer server
description_en: Mystic Nights Online recreates multiplayer services for the PlayStation 2 game Mystic Nights in a Python server. The author derived expected packet replies through Ghidra decompilation of client parsing code, PCSX2 memory inspection and packet fuzzing; the server handles accounts, lobbies and game synchronization.
description_zh: Mystic Nights Online 以 Python 服务端重建 PS2 游戏 Mystic Nights 的多人联机功能。作者通过 Ghidra 反编译客户端数据包解析代码、检查 PCSX2 内存并进行数据包模糊测试，推导服务端预期的回复；服务端处理账号、大厅和游戏同步。
requirements: Mystic Nights game copy and PCSX2 with DEV9 networking for emulated online play.
Python 3.9+ and SQLite 3 or PostgreSQL 13+.
The ISO must point to the server IP; patch_ip.py does not support the original untranslated ISO.
The documented DNAS bypass works only once per PCSX2 session.
MIT License.

name: Open Arcade Coder: reconstructing LED and button control
description_en: Open Arcade Coder reconstructs control of the Tech Will Save Us Arcade Coder's 12×12 RGB matrix and buttons with an ESP32 library. The author traced board connections, identified HC595 and ICN2012 control pins, and supplies display and button examples.
description_zh: Open Arcade Coder 通过 ESP32 控制库重建 Tech Will Save Us Arcade Coder 的 12×12 RGB 矩阵和按键控制。作者沿电路追踪连接，记录 HC595、ICN2012 的控制引脚，并提供显示与按键示例。
requirements: Tech Will Save Us Arcade Coder with its onboard ESP32.
LED rendering is glitchy; individual button detection becomes less reliable with multiple presses, and accelerometer support is unfinished.
MIT License.

name: War Storm: reconstructing Sudden Strike II 2.2
description_en: War Storm reconstructs source for Sudden Strike II 2.2 from the game's original binaries. Its code covers the launcher, three resolution-specific renderer modules, menu, and game components, while the author describes a complete playable implementation and 64-bit support as future goals.
description_zh: War Storm 根据《Sudden Strike II》2.2 的原版二进制文件重建源码，涵盖启动器、三个对应不同分辨率的渲染模块、菜单及游戏模块。完整可玩的实现和 64 位支持仍是后续目标。
requirements: The author used GOG's Sudden Strike 2 version 13718 as a reference.
Building requires Microsoft Visual Studio, Ogg, Vorbis, Yoink, zlib, and Intel JPEG Library.
A complete playable game and 64-bit compilation remain goals.
MIT License.

name: 6502 Model: reconstructing 65C02 cycle behavior
description_en: 6502 Model reconstructs the 65C02 chip’s cycle behavior in Rust from traces of external buses recorded during execution on a physical chip. Contributors add programs and signed traces as failing cases, then implement behavior to match the observed cycles.
description_zh: 6502 Model 用 Rust 根据实体 65C02 芯片运行程序时采集的外部总线跟踪记录，重建其逐周期行为。贡献者将程序和已签名的跟踪记录加入失败测试用例，再实现相应行为，使模型输出与实测周期一致。
requirements: A physical 65C02 trace collected through ChipLab is used when adding behavior.
Official instructions, timing details, flags, interrupts and unofficial instructions remain on the roadmap.
BSD-3-Clause License.

name: Weathercloud JS API: mapping the private station-data endpoints
description_en: Weathercloud JS API maps the private station-data endpoints of the Weathercloud web application and implements a TypeScript client for them. Its reference records request methods, headers, parameters and response fields for weather readings, profiles, statistics and device searches.
description_zh: Weathercloud JS API 梳理 Weathercloud 网页应用的私有气象站数据接口，并提供 TypeScript 客户端。接口参考记录天气读数、站点资料、统计和设备搜索的请求方法、请求头、参数及返回字段。
requirements: A JavaScript environment and the weathercloud-js package are needed for client use.
Some endpoints require a Weathercloud account session.
Rare optional response fields may be absent from the documented shapes.
MIT License.

name: Seedra: reimplementing Minecraft Legacy Console Edition world generation
description_en: Seedra reimplements Minecraft Legacy Console Edition world generation in a C++ library. It generates chunks, maps biomes, locates structures and spawn points, and computes structure loot from seeds, with examples selecting console, game version, world size, and biome scale.
description_zh: Seedra 用 C++ 库重建《Minecraft》Legacy Console Edition 的世界生成逻辑。它根据种子生成区块、绘制生物群系、查找结构与出生点，并计算结构战利品；示例可选择主机、游戏版本、世界大小及生物群系比例。
requirements: A C++23 toolchain and CMake 3.24 or later are specified by the build configuration.
The world generator examples select a console, game version, seed, world size, and biome scale.
Apache-2.0 License.

name: AZHS: reconstructing Need for Speed: High Stakes 4.50
description_en: AZHS reconstructs Need for Speed: High Stakes 4.50 source from the original game binaries. Its technical notes map Watcom and Visual C++ calling conventions, the eacsnd.dll sound module, and several DirectX 6 and 7 renderer variants; complete playability and broader platform support remain goals.
description_zh: AZHS 根据《Need for Speed: High Stakes》4.50 的原版二进制文件重建源码。技术记录梳理 Watcom 与 Visual C++ 调用约定、eacsnd.dll 音频模块，以及多个 DirectX 6 和 7 渲染版本；完整可玩及更多平台支持仍是目标。
requirements: Building requires Microsoft Visual Studio; the SDK directories request DirectX 6.0, 7.0, and 8.0 SDK files.
Complete playability and 64-bit support remain goals.
MIT License.

name: Yi M1: reconstructing wireless camera control and live view
description_en: Yi M1 wireless protocol research reconstructs the camera’s BLE pairing, Wi-Fi handoff, HTTP remote-control commands and UDP live-view frame format. Python scripts demonstrate pairing, starting remote control and extracting JPEG previews with accompanying settings from findings based on Yi Mirrorless Android decompilation and traffic captures.
description_zh: Yi M1 无线协议研究还原相机的 BLE 配对、Wi-Fi 切换、HTTP 遥控命令和 UDP 实时取景帧格式。Python 脚本演示配对、启动遥控，以及从画面流提取 JPEG 预览和参数；研究依据 Yi Mirrorless Android 应用反编译及流量抓取。
requirements: A Yi M1 camera and a computer with Bluetooth Low Energy support are needed.
The author reports functionality on camera firmware 3.2int, BLE protocol 1.0 and WLAN protocol for firmware 2.2 or later.
Earlier firmware versions and callable wrappers for many HTTP commands are outside the implemented scope.
MIT License.

name: AZMCO: reconstructing Motor City Online and its renderers
description_en: AZMCO reconstructs parts of Motor City Online, including an offline launcher and DirectX renderer modules. The author traces most source to reverse engineering original binaries and distinguishes the game's DirectX 7 and DirectX 8 renderer versions; the game is still incomplete.
description_zh: AZMCO 重建 Motor City Online 的部分组件，包括离线启动器和 DirectX 渲染模块。作者表示大部分源码来自对原版二进制文件的逆向分析，并区分了游戏使用的 DirectX 7 与 DirectX 8 渲染版本；游戏尚未完成。
requirements: Microsoft Visual Studio and the Microsoft DirectX 8.0a SDK.
The author states that the game is incomplete; 64-bit builds, modern input support, and Linux or Mac ports are future goals.
MIT license.

name: FragmentServer.NetSlum: rebuilding the .hack//Fragment server
description_en: FragmentServer.NetSlum reimplements the server for .hack//Fragment in C#. Its networking code handles game request packets, while project documentation covers message framing, encoding and area-server hosting.
description_zh: FragmentServer.NetSlum 以 C# 重建 .hack//Fragment 的服务器。网络代码处理游戏请求报文，项目文档介绍消息分帧、编码和区域服务器托管。
requirements: Hosting an area server follows the project's hosting documentation.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: Gemnet: a Rumble Fighter/Gem Fighter server emulator
description_en: Gemnet reconstructs a server for Rumble Fighter/Gem Fighter, with handlers for inventory, avatars, lobby, chat and P2P gameplay. Its C# packet processor parses message headers, handles optional decryption and dispatches packet types and actions to game-specific handlers.
description_zh: Gemnet 用 C# 重建 Rumble Fighter/Gem Fighter 服务器，涵盖物品栏、角色、大厅、聊天和 P2P 对战。其数据包处理器解析消息头，在启用加密时解密数据，并按类型和动作分派到游戏专用处理代码。
requirements: Gift lists, timed items, plaza, fishing, runes, quests and several reward and guild functions are listed as unfinished.

name: Deye Battery Serial Bus: decoding battery CAN frames
description_en: Deye Battery Serial Bus maps CAN frames from a Deye battery system and reads RS485 cell-voltage data. Its frame reference associates identifiers with inverter, battery and BMS fields; a .NET service exposes readings through API endpoints and includes Grafana dashboard definitions.
description_zh: Deye Battery Serial Bus 梳理 Deye 电池系统的 CAN 数据帧，并读取 RS485 单体电压。帧参考将标识符对应到逆变器、电池和 BMS 字段；.NET 服务通过 API 提供读数，仓库还附有 Grafana 仪表盘配置。
requirements: Access to the Deye battery bus and an InfluxDB instance are described for operation.
InterCAN message support and detailed RS485 payload documentation remain planned.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Bonaparte: reconstructing the Napoleon eFIRE Bluetooth control protocol
description_en: Bonaparte implements a Python client for Napoleon eFIRE fireplace controllers and documents their Bluetooth LE control protocol. Its reference specifies GATT characteristics, request and response packet fields, XOR checksums, and commands for settings such as power, thermostat, and night-light level.
description_zh: Bonaparte 提供 Napoleon eFIRE 壁炉控制器的 Python 客户端，并记录其 Bluetooth LE 控制协议。协议文档列出 GATT 特征值、请求与响应包字段、XOR 校验和，以及电源、恒温器和夜灯亮度等控制命令。
requirements: Python 3.13 or later, with bleak and bleak-retry-connector.
A Napoleon eFIRE-enabled fireplace controller.
MIT license.

name: OpenIsolation: reconstructing Alien: Isolation libraries
description_en: OpenIsolation is an early-stage project to reverse-engineer Alien: Isolation's libraries and game code. Current work centers on the CATHODE core library; its C++ source and notes cover original binaries, symbols, class-layout recovery, and platform variants.
description_zh: OpenIsolation 是逆向分析《Alien: Isolation》程序库和游戏代码的早期项目。目前的工作集中在核心库 CATHODE；仓库中的 C++ 源码和技术笔记涉及原版二进制文件、符号、类布局恢复及不同平台版本。
requirements: A legally owned copy of Alien: Isolation is required.
The project is in an early stage, with active work concentrated on CATHODE.

name: IOReport: investigating and decompiling Apple’s reporting library
description_en: IOReport decompile investigates Apple’s IOReport dylib, which provides calls for reading system reports and counters. The author describes disassembling powermetrics to understand its use of IOReport and provides an incomplete Objective-C reconstruction with a Makefile-built test program.
description_zh: IOReport decompile 研究 Apple 的 IOReport 动态库及其读取系统报告和计数器的调用方式。作者描述了通过反汇编 powermetrics 理解其使用方法，并提供尚未完成的 Objective-C 重建代码及可用 Makefile 编译的测试程序。
requirements: The test build uses clang with the CoreFoundation, Foundation and IOKit frameworks.
The IOReport dylib reconstruction remains incomplete.
No licence file in the repository.

name: GunBound: a Swift server reconstruction of GunBound Classic
description_en: GunBound reconstructs GunBound Classic's world and broker servers in Swift, with client code for authentication, channels, rooms and matches. Its packet code handles encrypted messages, including AES processing and opcode based checksums.
description_zh: GunBound 用 Swift 重建 GunBound Classic 的世界服务器和登录目录服务器，并提供处理身份验证、频道、房间及对局的客户端代码。其数据包实现包含 AES 加解密和基于操作码的校验。
requirements: Swift 6.0+ and macOS 13.0+.
The broker server requires a server directory JSON file.
MIT License.

name: skyrcUSB: reading skyRC chargers through a reconstructed protocol
description_en: skyrcUSB implements a Python client for a reverse-engineered skyRC charger protocol. Its Charger API reads cell voltages, charger settings and live charge data; the author reports testing it with a D100V2 and limits the library to read operations.
description_zh: skyrcUSB 根据逆向得到的 skyRC 充电器协议实现 Python 客户端。Charger API 可读取电芯电压、充电器设置和实时充电数据；作者报告在 D100V2 上测试，库仅提供读取功能。
requirements: A skyRC D100V2 charger is the tested device; the library raises an error when it detects another model.
The library cannot change charger settings or start charging.
MIT License.

name: dargh: reconstructing Dynamic Animation Replacer for Skyrim
description_en: dargh reconstructs the Dynamic Animation Replacer DLL for Skyrim Special Edition in C++ from analysis of versions 1.1.2 and 1.1.3. Its replacement uses hooks and trampolines for animation replacement and implements condition functions. The author reports apparent operation with Skyrim GOG 1.6.659 after limited testing.
description_zh: dargh 根据对 Dynamic Animation Replacer 1.1.2 和 1.1.3 DLL 的分析，以 C++ 重建用于 Skyrim Special Edition 的替代 DLL。它通过钩子和跳板实现动画替换，并处理条件函数。作者称经有限测试后，它在 Skyrim GOG 1.6.659 上似乎可以运行。
requirements: Building requires SKSE64, xbyak and Address Library for SKSE Plugins.
Runtime requires SKSE64 and Address Library for SKSE Plugins.
The author reports limited testing of condition functions and uncertain compatibility with other Skyrim versions.
MIT licence.

name: mqtt-energi: reconstructing myenergi device traffic
description_en: mqtt-energi investigates myenergi device-to-device Ethernet traffic and bridges decoded readings to MQTT. Its documentation records multicast frames with ethertype 0x88b5 and packet layouts, while a Python decoder extracts voltage, power, energy and heater state from Eddi V2.1 messages.
description_zh: mqtt-energi 研究 myenergi 设备之间的以太网通信，并将解码后的读数转发到 MQTT。文档记录 ethertype 为 0x88b5 的组播帧和报文布局；Python 解码器提取 Eddi V2.1 的电压、功率、电量及加热器状态。
requirements: Requires a network-connected Eddi V2.1 device, a promiscuous-mode network interface and an MQTT broker.
The bridge is described as likely to work only on Linux in its current form; Python needs paho.mqtt, and the script needs root permissions to configure the network interface.
V1 devices are unsupported, and operation with V5 firmware is unknown.
Unlicense.

name: RedFIS: reconstructing the Audi A3 8P display protocol
description_en: RedFIS investigates the Audi A3 8P dashboard Driver Information System protocol and implements an alternative display controller on ESP32. Its source covers CAN communication, VWTP handling, display decoding and wiring for supported instrument clusters.
description_zh: RedFIS 研究 Audi A3 8P 仪表盘 Driver Information System 的通信协议，并以 ESP32 实现替代显示控制器。源码涵盖 CAN 通信、VWTP 处理、显示数据解码及仪表接线。
requirements: Requires an Audi A3 8P instrument cluster and ESP32 hardware connected to its CAN lines.
For a cluster numbered 8P0 920 930 with RNS-E installed, an alternative VWTP CAN ID can be selected; a cluster numbered 8P0 920 931 requires the Navigation VWTP CAN ID.
The author describes some entry and exit display scenarios as buggy.
AGPL-3.0 License.

name: Rerun: rebuilding the Sonic Runners server
description_en: Rerun rebuilds the Sonic Runners server in C# and ASP.NET Core using earlier research and the Outrun server as a basis. Its source includes login, game, store, leaderboard, and player controllers, while the author says the emulator cannot yet reach the game's main menu and its database setup remains incomplete.
description_zh: Rerun 依据既有研究与 Outrun 服务器，用 C# 和 ASP.NET Core 重建《Sonic Runners》服务器。源码包含登录、游戏、商店、排行榜和玩家控制器；作者说明当前尚不能进入游戏主菜单，数据库初始化也未完成。
requirements: The documented setup requires .NET 7 or later, ASP.NET Core build support, MySQL or MariaDB, and a development environment.
The emulator cannot yet reach the game main menu or be reliably self-hosted.
BSD-2-Clause License.

name: tutti-api: reconstructing a tutti.ch private API client
description_en: tutti-api reconstructs client access to the tutti.ch private API in TypeScript, covering search filters, listings, seller profiles, messaging, and Auth0 login. Its documentation identifies inferred request constraints, a captured Android client header set, session-token exchange, and NDJSON chat streams.
description_zh: tutti-api 用 TypeScript 重建 tutti.ch 私有 API 的客户端访问，涵盖筛选搜索、商品信息、卖家资料、消息和 Auth0 登录。项目文档记录了推断的请求约束、抓取的 Android 客户端请求头、会话令牌交换及 NDJSON 聊天流。
requirements: Node.js 18 or later, or a browser.
Messaging requires an authenticated session; full login uses a captcha provider.
Most filter element shapes are inferred; location and interval payloads need comparison with live traffic.
MIT license.

name: GalaxyBuds-rs: implementing the Galaxy Buds Bluetooth protocol
description_en: GalaxyBuds-rs implements Galaxy Buds Bluetooth messages as a Rust library. It receives status, touch, voice-wakeup and debug updates and sends controls for noise reduction, equalizer, touchpad settings, muting and finding earbuds, with examples that connect using a device address.
description_zh: GalaxyBuds-rs 用 Rust 库实现 Galaxy Buds 蓝牙消息。它接收状态、触控、语音唤醒和调试更新，并发送降噪、均衡器、触控板、静音及寻找耳机命令；示例程序通过设备地址连接。
requirements: The examples require a Galaxy Buds Bluetooth address.
Version-information reception and time updates are listed as unfinished.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: ETEKCITY Smart Nutrition Scale: mapping the ESN00 BLE packets
description_en: ETEKCITY Smart Nutrition Scale research maps the ESN00 scale’s Bluetooth Low Energy characteristics and packet payloads. A TypeScript package parses and serializes identified commands and measurements for units, tare, automatic shutoff and scale state; the documentation lists packet types still under investigation.
description_zh: ETEKCITY Smart Nutrition Scale 项目梳理 ESN00 电子秤的 Bluetooth Low Energy 特征值和数据包载荷。TypeScript 包可解析和生成已识别的单位、去皮、自动关机及称重状态消息；文档还列出尚待研究的数据包。
requirements: An ETEKCITY ESN00 scale is the documented protocol target.
Several packet types, including SET_NUTRITION, remain unresearched.
MIT License.

name: mi-scale-2: decoding Mi Smart Scale 2 weight messages
description_en: mi-scale-2 decodes Xiaomi Mi Smart Scale 2 BLE weight data and publishes the readings to MQTT. Its format notes identify unit, stabilized, and weight-removed bits in the first byte and a little-endian weight value in the next two bytes.
description_zh: mi-scale-2 解析 Xiaomi Mi Smart Scale 2 的 BLE 体重数据，并将读数发布到 MQTT。格式笔记标明了首字节中的单位、稳定状态及离秤标志，以及后续两个字节的小端序体重值。
requirements: Python 3 with python-dotenv, bluepy, and paho-mqtt; bluepy.btle requires root permissions.
The author reports testing only with a Raspberry Pi 3b and Mi Scale 2.
MIT license.

name: PSA VAN Bus: documenting Peugeot and Citroën packet formats
description_en: PSA VAN Bus documents vehicle bus packets researched chiefly on a Peugeot 307 and described as applicable to listed Peugeot and Citroën models. The repository stores packet descriptions in JSON files and displays them through an HTML page; it reviews earlier VAN findings and adds observations.
description_zh: PSA VAN Bus 记录主要在 Peugeot 307 上研究的车载总线数据包，文中称这些结果也适用于列出的其他 Peugeot 和 Citroën 车型。仓库以 JSON 文件保存数据包描述，并通过 HTML 页面展示；项目核查、审阅先前的 VAN 研究成果，并补充观察结果。
requirements: The findings chiefly originate from a Peugeot 307 and are presented as applicable to other listed Peugeot and Citroën models.
The work builds on earlier VAN packet findings.
No licence file in the repository.

name: sh3-evil-effect: reconstructing Silent Hill 3's Another World Evil effect
description_en: sh3-evil-effect recreates the Another World Evil procedural texturing effect from Silent Hill 3. Its implementation uses graphics libraries including GLEW, GLFW, GLM and FreeImage.
description_zh: sh3-evil-effect 重现《寂静岭 3》的 Another World Evil 程序纹理视觉效果，使用 GLEW、GLFW、GLM 和 FreeImage 等图形库。
requirements: Uses FreeImage, GLEW, GLFW, GLM and OBJ Loader.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: TelloPython: reconstructing app-only Tello drone commands
description_en: TelloPython implements Python control of Tello drone functions available through its mobile app beyond the documented API. Its notes describe recovering command IDs and packet fields through Android app decompilation and Xposed hooks, then using those findings for joystick movement and flip commands.
description_zh: TelloPython 用 Python 控制 Tello 手机应用提供、公开 API 未列出的无人机功能。项目记录通过 Android 应用反编译和 Xposed 钩子恢复命令 ID 与数据包字段，并据此实现摇杆移动和翻转命令。
requirements: A Tello drone is required for control.
The command-ID extraction scripts require a decompiled Tello app folder; the author recommends Jadx.
The command-ID list may be incomplete.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: Apple Wi-Fi Password Sharing: reconstructing the sharing protocol
description_en: Apple Wi-Fi Password Sharing reconstructs grantor and requestor behavior for Apple's Wi-Fi password-sharing protocol on macOS. Its Swift code handles BLE discovery and pairing, while a Python GATT relay on Linux supports the requestor role.
description_zh: Apple Wi-Fi Password Sharing 在 macOS 上重建 Apple Wi-Fi 密码共享协议的分享端和请求端行为。Swift 代码处理 BLE 发现与配对；请求端还使用运行在 Linux 上的 Python GATT 中继。
requirements: macOS, Xcode or make, and libsodium.
The requestor setup requires disabling AMFI to access an Apple ID certificate and running a GATT relay on a separate Linux machine.
The author describes the software as experimental, untested, and incomplete.
The included Python GATT relay is licensed under GPL-2.0; the repository has no top-level licence file.

name: Schellenberg 21009: investigating a USB smart-home protocol
description_en: Schellenberg USB protocol research documents communication with the 21009 Magenta SmartHome dongle through its USB serial interface. The reference lists operating modes, command responses, message fields, device identifiers and commands for paired Schellenberg devices, with receive and send examples.
description_zh: Schellenberg USB 协议研究记录 21009 Magenta SmartHome 设备通过 USB 串口通信的方式。文档列出工作模式、命令响应、消息字段、设备标识及对已配对设备的控制命令，并给出收发示例。
requirements: A Schellenberg 21009 Magenta SmartHome USB dongle is the documented device.
Some commands and fields remain unidentified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: D750 QEMU Verification Prototype: early Nikon D750 firmware execution in QEMU
description_en: D750 QEMU Verification Prototype investigates early execution of Nikon D750 firmware with a QEMU board overlay and host-side scanning and logging tools. The author reports that a selected entry function ran and returned, while the observed fragment produced no MMIO accesses or UART output. A separate toolchain changes selected 1080p bitrate-table entries in a user-supplied firmware image.
description_zh: D750 QEMU Verification Prototype 用 QEMU 板级模型及主机侧扫描、日志工具研究尼康 D750 固件的早期执行。作者报告，一个候选入口函数已执行并返回，但该片段没有 MMIO 访问或串口输出。仓库另有针对用户自备固件的 1080p 码率表修改工具。
requirements: Provide local D750_0115 firmware modules.
Build the overlay into QEMU with a C toolchain; QEMU 11.1.0 is the documented compiled version.
The camera UI, sensor and storage are outside the prototype; the bitrate change has no camera shooting test.

name: ORPHEUS: reconstructing an Overwatch 1.74 server
description_en: ORPHEUS reimplements server behavior for Overwatch 1 retail build 1.74.0.0.104319. Its Python and Rust code covers local login, lobby handoff, encrypted UDP, player input and selected Practice Range simulation for Soldier: 76. The project records observed original-client behavior and tests for selected fixtures, while broader modes and client acceptance remain in progress.
description_zh: ORPHEUS 还原《守望先锋 1》正式版 1.74.0.0.104319 的服务端行为。Python 和 Rust 代码覆盖本地登录、大厅交接、加密 UDP、玩家输入，以及士兵 76 在训练靶场的部分模拟。项目记录原版客户端观察和选定测试场景；更多模式及客户端验收仍在进行。
requirements: A prepared, authorized runtime for build 104319 is required to run the local server.
The documented Python environment is Windows with Python 3.12; public Rust checks use stable Rust.
The first target scenario has no complete original-client acceptance pass.
MIT.

name: Humax-CLI: reconstructing IR4000HD remote control
description_en: Humax-CLI implements terminal control of the Humax IR4000HD receiver from findings the author attributes to reversing its Android app. A Python script sends button commands to the receiver over UDP and exposes listed codes for navigation, recording, playback and device controls.
description_zh: Humax-CLI 根据作者对 Humax Android 应用的逆向分析，实现 IR4000HD 接收机的终端控制。Python 脚本通过 UDP 发送按键命令，并列出导航、录制、播放及设备控制码。
requirements: A reachable Humax IR4000HD receiver and Python 2.x or 3.x are required.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: My Simulation: reimplementing The Sims Online client
description_en: My Simulation is an experimental reimplementation of The Sims Online as a multiplayer game. Its client is written in Zig with Raylib, uses NioTSO libraries to read the game's proprietary formats, and connects to a FreeSO-based API server.
description_zh: My Simulation 是以 The Sims Online 为目标的实验性多人游戏重建。客户端用 Zig 和 Raylib 编写，通过 NioTSO 库读取原游戏专有格式，并连接基于 FreeSO 的 API 服务器。
requirements: The Sims Online game files are required.
The client requires Zig 0.11 or newer; the API server requires .NET 8.0 or newer.
The project describes itself as experimental.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: OpenDW: porting Dragon Wars to a C game engine
description_en: OpenDW ports Dragon Wars from its 16-bit DOS implementation toward a C game engine for modern environments. It builds an SDL2 frontend and uses the player's original DRAGON.COM, DATA1 and DATA2 files; the repository also includes resource extraction tools.
description_zh: OpenDW 尝试将 16 位 DOS 游戏 Dragon Wars 移植为面向现代环境的 C 语言引擎。项目构建 SDL2 前端，使用玩家自备的 DRAGON.COM、DATA1 和 DATA2 文件，并提供资源提取工具。
requirements: Requires the original DRAGON.COM executable and DATA1 and DATA2 files.
Requires SDL2 and CMake to build; unit tests additionally require Check.
On Linux and Unix, the original game filenames must be lowercase and placed beside the build.
The C port is described as an attempt.
ISC license.

name: Reuromancer: porting Neuromancer to 64-bit Windows
description_en: Reuromancer ports the MS-DOS game Neuromancer to 64-bit Windows. Its engine uses reverse-engineered game routines and adapted disassembled code, while a separate resource browser examines and exports resources from the game's DAT files. Running the port requires the user's own DOS game data.
description_zh: Reuromancer 将 DOS 游戏 Neuromancer 移植到 64 位 Windows。引擎使用逆向重建的游戏例程和改写后的反汇编代码，另附资源浏览器，可查看和导出游戏 DAT 文件中的资源。运行时需要用户自己的 DOS 版游戏数据。
requirements: Builds use Visual Studio, a 64-bit CSFML build and OpenAL Soft; the author used Visual Studio 2015.
Running the port requires DAT files from a Neuromancer MS-DOS distribution.
The MASM code currently limits the engine to 64-bit Windows.
MIT license.

name: 433home: reconstructing REV power-switch radio commands
description_en: 433home reconstructs the 433 MHz control signals of REV wireless power sockets. The author measured remote-control output with a receiver and logic analyzer, documented pulse timings and 25-bit on/off commands for three sockets, and implemented an ESP8266 web frontend that transmits those sequences.
description_zh: 433home 还原了 REV 无线插座的 433 MHz 控制信号。作者使用接收器和逻辑分析仪测量遥控器输出，记录脉冲时序及三个插座的 25 位开关命令，并实现发送这些序列的 ESP8266 网页控制端。
requirements: An ESP8266 and 433 MHz transmitter are used for the controller; the analysis used a receiver and logic analyzer.
Wi-Fi credentials must be compiled into the firmware, and PlatformIO builds and flashes it.
No licence file in the repository.

name: mm5sound: translating the Mega Man 5 sound driver to C++
description_en: mm5sound translates Mega Man 5's 6502 assembly sound driver into C++ while retaining ROM addresses near related code. Its comparison workflow builds register-write logs from the user's ROM and checks them against logs from NSFPlay.
description_zh: mm5sound 将 Mega Man 5 的 6502 汇编声音驱动移植为 C++，并在相关代码旁保留 ROM 地址。其比对流程用用户的 ROM 生成寄存器写入日志，再与 NSFPlay 日志核对。
requirements: Provide `Megaman V (U) [!].nes` as `mm5.nes` for the documented test build.
GNU Make, g++, Lua, and NSFPlay are used by the documented build and comparison workflow.
Music data classes and a fully annotated disassembly remain on the roadmap.
MIT license.

name: Swish QR format: mapping payment QR payloads
description_en: Swish QR format documents QR-code payloads for Swish payments. It describes type prefixes A, B and C, their number, amount and message fields, and the bit flags that mark fields as editable. Type D is listed but its format remains undocumented.
description_zh: Swish QR format 记录 Swish 支付二维码的载荷格式。文档说明 A、B、C 类型的前缀、收款号码、金额和留言字段，以及标记字段可编辑的位标志；D 类型的格式尚待记录。
requirements: The format account covers types A through C; type D remains undocumented.
package.json declares an ISC licence.

name: hearthstone-deck-format: mapping Hearthstone deck strings
description_en: hearthstone-deck-format documents the encoded deck strings used by Hearthstone. It breaks a base64-decoded example into header, hero, single-copy card, double-copy card and footer fields, and explains varint card identifiers. The author incorporated corrections from HearthSim's algorithms and includes Python format and parser files.
description_zh: hearthstone-deck-format 记录《炉石传说》套牌字符串的编码结构。它把 base64 解码后的示例拆为文件头、英雄、单张卡、双张卡和尾部字段，并解释卡牌 ID 的 varint 编码。作者吸收了 HearthSim 算法的修正，仓库也附有 Python 格式及解析文件。
requirements: The documented findings incorporate corrections from HearthSim algorithms.
Apache-2.0.

name: fcp-stuff: mapping the FirstClass TCP protocol
description_en: fcp-stuff documents the FirstClass client-server protocol over TCP. Its notes cover command constants, packet structures, login, encryption, and the Docedit document format; the repository also contains JavaScript proxy code.
description_zh: fcp-stuff 记录 FirstClass 客户端与服务器之间基于 TCP 的协议，涵盖命令常量、数据包结构、登录、加密和 Docedit 文档格式；仓库还包含 JavaScript 代理代码。
requirements: The documented transport is TCP.
The author identifies incomplete details in some format notes.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Orthoplay: reconstructing OD-11 speaker WebSocket commands
description_en: Orthoplay records a reconstructed WebSocket exchange for the OD-11 speaker. It identifies development and production endpoints and supplies JSON messages for session join, remote registration, periodic ping, and group volume changes.
description_zh: Orthoplay 记录了 OD-11 音箱的 WebSocket 通信，列出开发与生产环境的端点，并提供加入会话、注册遥控器、定期发送 ping 和调整音箱组音量的 JSON 消息。
requirements: Documented against an OD-11 running version 0.9.11.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Chsmartbulb: reconstructing Bluetooth bulb controls
description_en: Chsmartbulb documents Bluetooth control of a combined RGB bulb and speaker sold as BL08A. The author captured traffic from an Android phone and provides a script that replays color-control sequences; the findings identify SPP over Bluetooth EDR as the app's color-control channel.
description_zh: Chsmartbulb 记录了 BL08A 蓝牙彩灯音箱的控制方式。作者从 Android 手机抓取通信，并提供颜色控制序列的重放脚本；研究指出，应用通过 Bluetooth EDR 的 SPP 服务控制灯光颜色。
requirements: A Chsmartbulb Bluetooth bulb is needed to replay the captured commands.
No licence file in the repository.

name: baseus-desktop: reconstructing Baseus earbuds control
description_en: baseus-desktop reconstructs Baseus earbuds control in a Windows and Linux desktop client. Frida scripts and Bluetooth captures inform packet tables for the Bass BP1 Pro ANC and BP1 Ultra; Rust crates implement framing, per-model decoding and BLE transport. The app exposes battery status, noise controls, EQ presets and other supported device settings.
description_zh: baseus-desktop 在 Windows 和 Linux 桌面客户端中还原 Baseus 耳机控制。Frida 脚本和蓝牙抓包用于整理 Bass BP1 Pro ANC 与 BP1 Ultra 的报文表；Rust 模块实现组帧、机型解码和 BLE 传输。应用显示电量，并提供降噪、均衡器预设等受支持设置。
requirements: Windows 10 1903 or later, or Linux with BlueZ 5.6x; building uses Rust, Node.js and pnpm.
Supported hardware is limited to the Bass BP1 Pro ANC and BP1 Ultra models documented as hardware tested.
The BP1 Ultra find-my-earbuds command has not been captured.
MIT.

name: tiktok-xgnarly-decoded: reconstructing TikTok's X-Gnarly signature format
description_en: tiktok-xgnarly-decoded reconstructs the X-Gnarly request parameter used by TikTok's web client and implements its 5.1.3-ZTCA form in JavaScript. Its format account covers a 16-field TLV payload, custom base64 alphabet, embedded random key and ChaCha-style cipher. Tests include synthetic round trips and field checks against a captured parameter.
description_zh: tiktok-xgnarly-decoded 还原 TikTok 网页客户端使用的 X-Gnarly 请求参数，并以 JavaScript 实现 5.1.3-ZTCA 格式。其格式说明涵盖 16 字段 TLV、自定义 base64 字母表、嵌入的随机密钥和 ChaCha 风格密码；测试包括往返编码及抓取参数的字段检查。
requirements: Node.js 18 or later.
The reference encoder and decoder target payload version 5.1.3-ZTCA; only X-Gnarly is implemented.
MIT.

name: Skylight API: reconstructing the Skylight Calendar web API
description_en: Skylight API documents Skylight Calendar's web API from browser HAR captures and publishes the resulting OpenAPI specification. Its CLI filters Skylight requests, redacts sensitive values, normalizes URL paths, infers response schemas, and generates Swagger UI or ReDoc pages.
description_zh: Skylight API 根据浏览器 HAR 抓包整理 Skylight Calendar 的网页接口，并发布 OpenAPI 规范。其 CLI 筛选接口请求、脱敏敏感值、规范化 URL 路径、推断响应结构，并生成 Swagger UI 或 ReDoc 页面。
requirements: Generating or updating the specification requires HAR files with content captured from the Skylight web app.
Node.js and npm are used to install and run the CLI.
The author reports that the published specification covers 38 endpoints.
MIT license.

name: Flicky: byte-identical Mega Drive source reconstruction
description_en: Flicky reconstructs the Sega Mega Drive game's 68000 code and Z80 sound driver as annotated assembly. Build scripts split data from the user's ROM, assemble the source, and compare the resulting cartridge image byte for byte; recorded input movies support runtime checks in MAME.
description_zh: Flicky 将 Sega Mega Drive 游戏的 68000 代码和 Z80 声音驱动重建为带注释的汇编。构建脚本从用户的 ROM 分离数据、重新汇编，并逐字节比较生成的卡带镜像；录制的输入回放可在 MAME 中检查运行行为。
requirements: Provide your own Flicky (UE) cartridge ROM.
Python 3, GNU Make, and Retrolarium Kit are required for the documented build.
Full runtime checks use MAME and the studio check needs the Flicky level writer.
No licence file in the repository.

name: ndec-re: reconstructing an MS-DOS encryption program
description_en: ndec-re investigates an old MS-DOS COM encryption program through debugger-assisted assembly analysis and implements its encryption behavior in Go. The write-up traces the program's copied code, password-derived gamma and hashes, self-modifying instruction choice, initialization byte and mixing rounds. The repository also contains the original COM file and Go tests.
description_zh: ndec-re 借助调试器和汇编分析研究一款旧式 MS-DOS COM 加密程序，并用 Go 实现其加密行为。研究记录追踪代码搬移、口令生成的序列与哈希、自修改指令选择、初始化字节及混合轮次；仓库还包含原始 COM 文件和 Go 测试。
requirements: Go 1.21 is declared in go.mod for the reimplementation.
The author leaves parts of the unpacking and exact algorithm marked for further work.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Conker: Live & Reloaded — static recompilation of the Xbox game
description_en: Conker: Live & Reloaded translates the European original Xbox game's x86 XBE code into C++ for a native Windows x64 build. Game-specific configuration and hooks work with an Xbox runtime that replaces kernel, graphics, sound, and input services; technical notes document fixes for inlined Direct3D state.
description_zh: Conker: Live & Reloaded 将欧版初代 Xbox 游戏 XBE 中的 x86 代码转换为 C++，构建 Windows x64 原生版本。项目配置与钩子配合 Xbox 运行时替代内核、图形、声音和输入服务；技术笔记记录了内联 Direct3D 状态的处理。
requirements: Provide your own European Conker: Live & Reloaded default.xbe and game data.
Building requires Visual Studio 2022 or newer with C++, Clang, and CMake tools.
The author reports single-player progress; multiplayer matches remain untested.
MIT license.

name: ReNFS: rebuilding The Need for Speed Special Edition
description_en: ReNFS rebuilds the 1996 DOS release of The Need for Speed Special Edition as a native C and SDL2 game for Linux, Windows and macOS. The author studied NFS_DOS.EXE with Ghidra, rewrote routines by hand and compared racing, physics, rendering and replay behavior with the original. The port reads game tables and assets from the user's own Special Edition CD.
description_zh: ReNFS 将 1996 年 DOS 版《极品飞车特别版》重建为面向 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 的原生 C/SDL2 游戏。作者用 Ghidra 分析 NFS_DOS.EXE，手工重写例程，并将比赛、物理、画面和回放行为与原版对照。移植版从用户自备的特别版光盘读取表格和素材。
requirements: Provide the Special Edition CD files, including NFS_DOS.EXE; the 1995 standard edition is a different program.
Building requires SDL2, CMake and a C compiler.
Network and modem races are omitted.

name: Samsung Cloud Notes: reconstructing cloud note access
description_en: Samsung Cloud Notes reconstructs access to Samsung's private note-sync services in Mac, iOS, Android and command-line clients. Its research documents static analysis and runtime observation of Windows components, observed cloud endpoints and XML structures. The clients browse and edit supported typed-text notes, keep local caches and export note content.
description_zh: Samsung Cloud Notes 通过 Mac、iOS、Android 和命令行客户端重建对 Samsung 私有笔记同步服务的访问。研究文档记录 Windows 组件的静态分析和运行观察，以及云端接口与 XML 结构；客户端可浏览、编辑受支持的文本笔记，并缓存和导出内容。
requirements: A Samsung account is needed for cloud sign-in; supported platforms include macOS 13+, iOS 16+ and Android 8+.
Version 1.1 works with existing notes; creating or deleting notes and full page editing are outside its current interface.
The author reports live sign-in and library-sync checks for the new mobile clients; their cloud-save paths had not been exercised against a live account before release.
MIT license.

name: pc-castlevaniajudgment: statically recompiling Castlevania Judgment for PC
description_en: pc-castlevaniajudgment builds a native PC port of the Wii game Castlevania Judgment by translating its PowerPC executable to C++ with wiikit. Game-specific scripts identify functions using Dolphin symbols and a related executable, while a hook layer maps controller state. The author reports reaching menus, save creation and fights in an initial session.
description_zh: pc-castlevaniajudgment 借助 wiikit 将 Wii 游戏《恶魔城 审判》的 PowerPC 可执行文件转成 C++，构建原生 PC 版本。专用脚本结合 Dolphin 符号及相关游戏程序识别函数，钩子层映射手柄状态。作者报告，初次工作已进入菜单、创建存档并完成对战。
requirements: Provide an original North American RDGE game disc and its extracted executable and data.
Building uses wiikit, Python 3.8 or later, CMake, Ninja, clang and SDL3; running requires OpenGL 4.5.
The recorded play session leaves some sound and broader mode checks open.
MIT for the repository's documentation and tools.

name: ILME-FX30: mapping service commands and firmware settings
description_en: ILME-FX30 Service Mode Research maps USB service-session commands and settings on FX30 firmware 6.00. It documents Senser and Jiritsu exchanges, backup structures and static analysis of appFw.so, with scripts for probing the camera. The author reports enabling a hidden continuous-shooting mode through paired settings writes and a cold start.
description_zh: ILME-FX30 Service Mode Research 测绘 FX30 固件 6.00 的 USB 服务会话与设置区。仓库记录 Senser、Jiritsu 命令交互、备份结构和 appFw.so 静态分析，并提供相机探测脚本。作者报告通过成对写入设置并冷启动启用了隐藏连拍模式。
requirements: The device experiments use an ILME-FX30 running firmware 6.00, Windows 11, Zadig and libusbK, Python 3.11 and pyusb 1.3.1.
The documented settings-write method applies to firmware 6.00; the author reports that firmware 6.01 rejects modified settings data.
Documents are licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; tools are licensed MIT.

name: mf4700-print-scan: reconstructing Canon MF4700 print and scan protocols
description_en: mf4700-print-scan reconstructs printing and scanning for Canon MF4700-series devices in a macOS app. Its C encoder emits UFR II LT jobs based on differences observed in Canon driver output, while an MFNP client registers the Mac and retrieves scanned pages. A format reference records CPCA packets, job structure and print-data encoding.
description_zh: mf4700-print-scan 在 macOS 应用中还原 Canon MF4700 系列设备的打印与扫描。C 语言编码器依据 Canon 驱动输出的差分生成 UFR II LT 作业；MFNP 客户端注册 Mac 并接收扫描页面。格式文档记录 CPCA 报文、作业结构及打印数据编码。
requirements: macOS 14 or later and a supported MF4700-series printer reachable over Wi-Fi or Ethernet; USB is unsupported.
Building requires Xcode command-line tools; the byte-comparison tests also require JBIG-KIT.
The documented development device is an MF4780w.

name: YW4 Recomp: statically recompiling Yo-kai Watch 4++ for PC
description_en: YW4 Recomp translates the ARM64 code of Yo-kai Watch 4++ update 2.2.0 into a native Windows program. Its project runtime and Vulkan renderer support portions of the game from boot through early play and selected later scenes, with graphics changes including ultrawide output and revised shadows.
description_zh: YW4 Recomp 将 Yo-kai Watch 4++ 2.2.0 的 ARM64 代码转换为 Windows 原生程序。项目运行时与 Vulkan 渲染器支持从启动到游戏前期及部分后期场景，并加入超宽屏和阴影调整。
requirements: Use files from your own copy of Yo-kai Watch 4++ with update 2.2.0.
Windows x86-64 with Vulkan is the built and tested platform; Linux support is planned.
The author reports that the game is not playable from start to finish and that unvisited areas may crash.
MIT license.

name: Music Tag Desktop: reconstructing an Android music tagger for Windows
description_en: Music Tag Desktop reconstructs the behavior of Android Music Tag 1.2.5.2 as a Windows music-tag editor. Its investigation traces Java code, the native libmain.so library, resources, and music-service request logic; the Python and PySide6 app handles local tags, lyrics, artwork, and metadata matching.
description_zh: Music Tag Desktop 将 Android 版 Music Tag 1.2.5.2 的功能重建为 Windows 音乐标签编辑器。研究涵盖 Java 代码、原生库 libmain.so、资源和音乐服务请求逻辑；Python 与 PySide6 程序处理本地标签、歌词、封面和元数据匹配。
requirements: The desktop application targets Windows 10 or 11 x64; source use requires Python 3.12 and uv.
The author reports 122 passing tests and online end-to-end checks.
Some online source endpoints are intermittent or may change; several desktop features remain on the roadmap.
MIT license.

name: vector-studio-re: reconstructing Vector Studio's automation protocol
description_en: vector-studio-re reconstructs the automation interface of Vector Studio 0.1.11 from its shipped Linux AppImage. Extraction scripts unpack app.asar and split the Electron bundle into modules; protocol notes document the loopback JSON RPC endpoint, authentication and operations. A standard-library Python client and stdio MCP bridge call the recovered interface.
description_zh: vector-studio-re 从 Vector Studio 0.1.11 的 Linux AppImage 还原自动化接口。提取脚本解包 app.asar 并拆分 Electron 模块；协议文档记录本机 JSON RPC 端点、认证和操作列表。仓库另提供仅依赖 Python 标准库的客户端及 stdio MCP 桥接程序。
requirements: Provide Vector Studio 0.1.11 with automation enabled for live client use.
Python 3 is used for the client and extraction scripts.
The documented protocol covers version 1 and 16 operations in the studied release.
MIT.

name: mine-a1.1.2_01-rev: preparing a Minecraft Alpha decompilation for study
description_en: mine-a1.1.2_01-rev prepares a user-supplied Minecraft Alpha a1.1.2_01 JAR for study with Windows batch scripts and repository patches. Its setup uses IntelliJ and a Java 8 SDK, and the author notes using an MCP patch to correct decompilation artifacts. The work is described as incomplete.
description_zh: mine-a1.1.2_01-rev 使用 Windows 批处理脚本及仓库补丁，整理用户自备的 Minecraft Alpha a1.1.2_01 JAR 以供研究。配置流程使用 IntelliJ 和 Java 8 SDK；作者说明采用了 MCP 的补丁来修正反编译产物，并将项目标为未完成。
requirements: Provide the original Minecraft a1.1.2_01 JAR.
The documented setup uses Windows, IntelliJ and corretto-1.8.0_302.
The author describes the project as incomplete.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Kenwood KNS: documenting ARCP-590G radio communication
description_en: Kenwood KNS documents the ARCP-590G client's communication with a TS-590SG radio over serial and KNS TCP connections. The investigation compares Wireshark captures with CAT commands and records UTF-16LE encoding, connection sequences, cleartext authentication, and keepalive traffic.
description_zh: Kenwood KNS 文档研究 ARCP-590G 客户端通过串口和 KNS TCP 与 TS-590SG 电台的通信。项目对照 Wireshark 抓包与 CAT 命令，记录 UTF-16LE 编码、连接流程、明文认证和保活消息。
requirements: The documented equipment is the Kenwood TS-590SG with ARCP-590G.
The analysis uses Wireshark and Hercules to compare KNS TCP packet contents with CAT commands.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Overwatch: mapping highlight-file metadata
description_en: Overwatch highlight reverse engineering maps metadata embedded near the end of the game's MP4 highlight videos. Its documentation describes the Base64 and UTF-16LE encoded structure and fields for map, hero, skin and highlight type, alongside Java code for working with the findings.
description_zh: Overwatch highlight reverse engineering 解析游戏精彩片段 MP4 文件尾部的元数据。文档说明 Base64 与 UTF-16LE 编码结构，以及地图、英雄、皮肤和片段类型字段，并附有使用这些发现的 Java 代码。
requirements: Overwatch-generated MP4 highlight files are the input described by the documentation.
Map and skin identifier values remain incomplete.
No licence file in the repository.

name: truemove3-re: mapping a gaming mouse sensor's SPI interface
description_en: truemove3-re records an investigation of the TrueMove3 gaming mouse sensor's SPI interface. It lists the pinout, bus settings, register addresses, and a startup exchange observed from a Rival-310, while leaving differences from the PMW3360 unresolved.
description_zh: truemove3-re 记录了对游戏鼠标 TrueMove3 传感器 SPI 接口的调查，列出引脚、总线设置、寄存器地址，以及从 Rival-310 获取的启动通信流程；其与 PMW3360 的差异仍待确认。
requirements: Additional TrueMove3 features and differences from PMW3360 remain unclear.
No licence file in the repository.

name: AirTray: reconstructing an Elgin Air cloud client
description_en: AirTray reconstructs an Elgin Air app client as a Windows system-tray controller for compatible air conditioners. It signs in with the owner's account, discovers registered devices, reads their state and sends temperature, mode and power commands through the cloud service. The author reports live validation on one authorized device and account.
description_zh: AirTray 根据 Elgin Air 应用的行为重建 Windows 系统托盘客户端，用于控制兼容空调。它通过用户自己的账户登录云服务，发现已登记设备、读取状态，并发送温度、模式及电源指令。作者报告已在一台获授权设备和一个账户上完成实机验证。
requirements: Windows x64 and .NET Desktop Runtime 10 x64; source builds use .NET SDK 10.
A compatible air conditioner already connected to Wi-Fi and linked to the user's Elgin Air account.
The author reports live validation on one device and account; other variants need testing.
MIT License for project code.

name: pc-demolitionman: statically recompiling the 3DO Demolition Man
description_en: pc-demolitionman documents a static-recompilation port of the 3DO game Demolition Man using 3dokit. It translates the game's ARM60 programs into C++, boots a user-supplied disc through a Portfolio runtime, and records Gamegun input and boot behavior. The author reports reaching the attract loop and playing light-gun levels in a window.
description_zh: pc-demolitionman 记录借助 3dokit 静态重编译 3DO 游戏 Demolition Man 的过程。项目将游戏 ARM60 程序转换为 C++，在 Portfolio 运行时中启动用户提供的光盘，并记录 Gamegun 输入和启动行为。作者报告已进入演示循环，并在窗口中游玩光枪关卡。
requirements: A user-owned US 3DO Demolition Man disc image and the 3dokit submodule.
Python 3.8 or newer and Capstone for code tools; CMake, Ninja, clang and SDL3 for the C++ build.
MIT License.

name: Aqara G410: reconstructing doorbell cloud and P2P access
description_en: Implements access to the Aqara G410 doorbell through cloud calls and a P2P connection reconstructed from the Aqara Home app. The macOS client provides live view, talkback and event history, while a notifier sends motion media to Matrix. Protocol notes record request signing, login, event queries, media decryption and the P2P handshake.
description_zh: 项目依据 Aqara Home 应用还原的云端调用和 P2P 连接，实现 Aqara G410 门铃访问。macOS 客户端提供实时画面、双向通话和事件记录；通知程序将运动事件媒体发送到 Matrix。协议文档记录了请求签名、登录、事件查询、媒体解密和 P2P 握手。
requirements: An Aqara account paired with the G410 is required.
The menu-bar app requires macOS 13 or newer.
Aqara cloud changes may break the client.
MIT license.

name: Ratchet & Clank 3: matching PlayStation 2 decompilation
description_en: rac3-decomp reconstructs Ratchet & Clank 3 PlayStation 2 core and level programs from C and assembly, checking compiled functions against PAL and NTSC-U retail code. It tracks shared functions across versions and links functions at retail addresses; the author reports substantial matching progress while many level functions remain in assembly.
description_zh: rac3-decomp 用 C 与汇编重建《Ratchet & Clank 3》的 PS2 主程序及关卡程序，对照 PAL 和 NTSC-U 零售版代码检查函数。项目追踪跨版本共用函数，并按原始地址链接；作者报告已有部分代码匹配，许多关卡函数仍保留汇编。
requirements: A legally obtained PAL or NTSC-U game disc image is required to generate disassembly and compare builds.
Building requires Python, the SN Systems ee-gcc 2.95.3 v1.36 and Sony ee-gcc 2.9 toolchains; Linux and macOS also use wibo and Wrench.
The decompilation remains in progress, especially level-specific functions.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: The Need for Speed: static recompilation of the 3DO release
description_en: pc-theneedforspeed documents a native PC run of the 1994 3DO The Need for Speed through 3dokit static recompilation of ARM60 programs. It records disc structure, Portfolio boot behavior, replay inputs and runtime additions; the author reports reaching the race and driving in a window from a user-supplied disc.
description_zh: pc-theneedforspeed 使用 3dokit 静态重编译 1994 年 3DO 版 The Need for Speed 的 ARM60 程序，记录光盘结构、Portfolio 启动流程、按键回放和运行时改动。作者报告已从用户提供的光盘启动至比赛，并在窗口中驾驶。
requirements: The US 3DO original disc as a 2048-byte-block ISO and the 3dokit submodule are required.
Python 3.8+, capstone, CMake, Ninja, clang and SDL3 support the documented workflow.
The published repository contains documentation, replay inputs and configuration; generated port code stays in the local build directory.
MIT license.

name: OpenBoxer: incremental reconstruction of Месть боксера game functions
description_en: OpenBoxer reconstructs selected functions of the Windows game Месть боксера. Московский криминалитет as an injected replacement DLL. The project documents behavior contracts and paired checks for MS3D loading, rendering, animation and bounded attack paths; unsupported states return to the original game functions.
description_zh: OpenBoxer 以注入式 DLL 逐步重建 Windows 游戏《Месть боксера. Московский криминалитет》的部分函数。项目记录 MS3D 加载、渲染、动画及限定攻击路径的行为规格和成对检查；未覆盖状态由原版函数处理。
requirements: Building requires Windows, CMake 3.20+, Ninja, Clang and an i686 MinGW sysroot.
Native checks require the supported original game copy and the launcher's fixed laboratory directory and marker.
The replacement covers selected functions and is tied to developer-specific paths.
MIT license for newly written project code; included ColDet retains LGPL-2.0-or-later.

name: Epic Pinball HD: reimplementing the DOS pinball engine for macOS
description_en: Epic Pinball HD reimplements the DOS Epic Pinball engine as a native macOS app with classic and enhanced modes. It imports tables and media from the user's own copy, runs some original executable rules through a small x86 runtime and compares classic-mode behavior with original code in Unicorn. Across all 13 tables, the author reports matches in 415/415 physics scenarios, 415/415 rules scenarios and 413/415 full-main-loop scenarios.
description_zh: Epic Pinball HD 将 DOS 游戏 Epic Pinball 的引擎重建为原生 macOS 应用，提供经典与增强模式。它从用户自己的游戏副本导入弹珠台数据和媒体，通过小型 x86 运行时执行部分原版规则，并用 Unicorn 将经典模式的行为与原始代码比较。作者报告，在全部 13 张弹珠台的测试中，物理场景匹配 415/415，规则场景匹配 415/415，完整主循环场景匹配 413/415。
requirements: A legally owned Epic Pinball CD image or installed game files are required.
An Apple silicon Mac with macOS 14 or later, Swift 6.x, libopenmpt and pkgconf is required.
The GOG edition has not been tested directly.
GPL-3.0-or-later for the project's own code and documentation.

name: crowdstrike-cloudproto: reconstructed Falcon Sensor cloud protocol
description_en: crowdstrike-cloudproto reconstructs the cloud protocol used between Falcon Sensor and its TS event and LFO file services as an asynchronous Rust crate. It implements common packet framing, TS event exchange, and LFO file downloads; the protocol notes describe Protobuf event payloads, acknowledgments, and LFO request and response packets.
description_zh: crowdstrike-cloudproto 是异步 Rust 库，还原 Falcon Sensor 与 TS 事件服务、LFO 文件服务之间的云端通信协议。它实现通用数据包封装、TS 事件交换和 LFO 文件下载，并记录 Protobuf 事件载荷、确认机制以及 LFO 请求与响应数据包。
requirements: Rust 1.64 or later.
A valid Customer ID is required to connect to the official TS servers.
A modified client configured for an owned domain with a valid certificate, or disabled certificate validation, is required to run a third-party server.
LFO supports GET requests with optional XZ compression; uploads are not supported, and the author notes that some protocol fields or optional parts may be missing or misnamed.
Licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0, as declared in Cargo.toml.

name: Perfect Dark on Android: porting the decompilation-based game
description_en: Ports the decompilation-based Perfect Dark game to Android through a platform layer, on-screen controls and a Gradle build. It builds on an existing desktop port and requires the player's own Perfect Dark ROM. The Android guide describes touch input, landscape orientation and a launcher that imports mod folders.
description_zh: 项目在现有桌面移植版基础上，为反编译版 Perfect Dark 加入 Android 平台层、屏幕触控和 Gradle 构建。运行需要玩家自己的 Perfect Dark ROM；Android 说明还介绍了触控操作、横屏显示以及可导入模组文件夹的启动器。
requirements: A supported Perfect Dark ROM supplied by the user is required.
Android 7.0 or newer on arm64-v8a or armeabi-v7a is supported.
The source reports minor graphics and gameplay issues and possible crashes.
MIT license.

name: canopy-dotmatrix: reconstructing davidluft.com's dot-matrix window
description_en: Reconstructs the dot-matrix window on davidluft.com from its public JavaScript bundle and scene payloads. A JavaScript engine decodes six-bit temporal-delta luminance and color fields, then renders individually animated dots; an interactive page and frame exporter demonstrate the result. The author reports comparing output with browser screenshots.
description_zh: 项目依据 davidluft.com 的公开 JavaScript 文件和场景数据重建首页点阵窗景。JavaScript 引擎解码六位时间差分亮度与色彩数据，再绘制逐点动画；交互页面和帧导出工具展示结果。作者报告曾将输出与浏览器截图比较。
requirements: The public scene payloads are fetched locally for playback.
Node 20 or newer is specified in package.json.
The authoring encoder and some rendering modes remain unknown or unimplemented.
MIT license.

name: BA-KEY Menu: reconstructing Basike keyboard HID control
description_en: Reconstructs the Basike BA-KEY308 keyboard's HID configuration protocol from the vendor's Windows app and implements it in a macOS menu-bar app and CLI. The protocol notes cover Feature reports, command classes and Bluetooth, USB and 2.4 GHz receiver transport. The app controls lighting, per-key colors and profiles.
description_zh: 项目从厂商 Windows 程序还原 Basike BA-KEY308 键盘的 HID 配置协议，并以 macOS 菜单栏应用和命令行工具实现。协议笔记记录了 Feature report、命令类别，以及蓝牙、USB 和 2.4 GHz 接收器传输；应用可控制灯效、逐键颜色和配置。
requirements: macOS 13 or newer is required; source builds use Swift 5.9 or newer.
Basike BA-KEY308 was tested over Bluetooth and USB; Dareu EK75 and Husky Nomadic support is experimental.
MIT license.

name: KC Control: Keychron M6 profile switching over a recovered HID protocol
description_en: KC Control implements Keychron M6 profile switching over a reconstructed HID command exchange. A Windows tray app watches the foreground program and selects an onboard mouse profile; its protocol reference documents report IDs, framing and commands derived from the Launcher web bundle and a live device capture.
description_zh: KC Control 根据 Windows 前台程序切换 Keychron M6 鼠标的板载配置档。项目从 Launcher 网页代码和实机抓取中还原 HID 报告、帧格式与命令，并提供协议文档和托盘应用源码。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 and a Keychron M6 through its 2.4 GHz receiver; wired and Bluetooth connections are untested.
Building requires stable Rust, Node.js 18+, Microsoft C++ Build Tools and WebView2.
MIT license.

name: Xiaomi Whale Spout bidet: reconstructing its RF remote protocol
description_en: Reconstructs the 433 MHz RF remote protocol of the non-Wi-Fi Xiaomi Whale Spout bidet seat and implements it in ESPHome on an ESP32 with a CC1101 radio. The project documents 2-FSK timing, 32-bit packets, settings fields and checksum behavior, then exposes control and remote-state monitoring through Home Assistant.
description_zh: 项目还原非 Wi-Fi 版 Xiaomi Whale Spout 坐便盖的 433 MHz 射频遥控协议，并用 ESP32 与 CC1101 在 ESPHome 中实现。文档记录了 2-FSK 时序、32 位数据包、设置字段和校验规则，并通过 Home Assistant 提供控制及遥控器状态监听。
requirements: The remote-controlled non-Wi-Fi Whale Spout seat, its remote, an ESP32, CC1101 module and antenna are specified.
An RTL-SDR is used to calibrate the radio frequency.
The author reports testing with one seat and one remote; reception may miss presses.
MIT license.

name: skypsu: reconstructing the STP2S3010E22 Modbus register map
description_en: skypsu reconstructs the Modbus RTU register map of the SKY TOPPOWER STP2S3010E22 laboratory power supply. It provides a Python driver, read-only register scanner, local web interface and live plot. The documented map covers output control, measurements, setpoints and status flags; the author reports checking it on two units.
description_zh: skypsu 重建 SKY TOPPOWER STP2S3010E22 实验电源的 Modbus RTU 寄存器映射，并提供 Python 驱动、只读寄存器扫描器、本地网页界面和实时曲线。文档列出输出控制、测量值、设定值及状态位；作者报告已在两台设备上核对。
requirements: Python 3.10 or newer and a SKY TOPPOWER STP2S3010E22 connected through the COM USB-C data port.
Linux users need access to the device's /dev/ttyUSB* serial port.
Writing protection settings is disabled because those writes have not been tested.
MIT License.

name: God of War: Ascension — static recompilation of the PS3 game
description_en: Statically recompiles God of War: Ascension's PS3 code into a native Windows executable with ps3recomp's PPU and SPU lifters. The repository supplies game-specific runtime hooks, analysis scripts and build guidance; users provide their own game dump and decrypted ELF. The author describes the result as an early, nonplayable research build.
description_zh: 项目使用 ps3recomp 的 PPU 与 SPU 提升工具，将 PS3 版 God of War: Ascension 的代码静态重编译为 Windows 原生程序。仓库提供游戏专用运行时钩子、分析脚本和构建说明；用户须自备游戏转储和解密后的 ELF。作者将当前成果称为尚不可游玩的早期研究版本。
requirements: A legally acquired game dump and decrypted EBOOT.elf are required.
ps3recomp and the Windows build dependencies described by the project are required.
The author describes the build as research-stage and not playable.
MIT covers the repository's original work.

name: tModLoader Mobile: reconstructing selected mod behavior in Android Terraria
description_en: tModLoader Mobile investigates selected PC Terraria mod behavior inside Android Terraria through an independently written managed compatibility layer and native bridges. The prototype includes item and time demonstrations, a respawn adapter, texture experiments and research notes; the author reports bounded test outcomes and an unresolved in-process stability issue.
description_zh: tModLoader Mobile 通过自编写的托管兼容层与原生桥接，在 Android 版 Terraria 中研究部分 PC 模组行为。原型包含物品、时间、复活和纹理实验；作者报告了限定场景的测试结果，并记录进程内稳定性问题。
requirements: A researched Android ARM64 game build, a compatible signing certificate and authorized USB/ADB bootstrap are needed for current device work.
The toolchain uses Python, Node.js, .NET SDK, JDK, Android SDK, Mono and Frida Gadget.
Arbitrary .tmod imports, multiplayer and broad mod compatibility are unfinished; an in-process texture run crashed after controller detach.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Angelica Wardrobe: rebuilding Perfect World's fashion window
description_en: Rebuilds the Vietnamese Perfect World client's fashion collection window as a standalone 3D app. Python readers decode package, mesh, skeleton, animation and UI formats; the project also recreates face morphing, body-shape rules and shaders identified in the client's x86 code. It generates assets locally from the user's game client.
description_zh: 项目将越南版 Perfect World 的时装收藏界面重建为独立 3D 应用。Python 工具解析封包、模型、骨骼、动画和界面格式，并重现从客户端 x86 代码识别的人脸形变、体型规则与着色逻辑。素材由用户本机的游戏客户端生成。
requirements: Windows, Python 3.11 or newer, and the listed Python dependencies are required.
A TGHM / Perfect World client is required to generate game data locally.
MIT license for the code.

name: Smart-AC-Modernizer: decoding Haier YRW02 infrared control
description_en: Smart-AC-Modernizer documents the Haier YRW02 air conditioner's infrared control format and implements an ESP32 bridge for it. The author identifies a 112-bit NEC-variant state packet, captures remote signals with a TSOP4838 receiver, and sends decoded commands through a transistor-driven IR LED.
description_zh: Smart-AC-Modernizer 记录海尔 YRW02 空调的红外控制格式，并实现 ESP32 桥接。作者使用 TSOP4838 接收器采集遥控信号，解析 112 位 NEC 变体状态报文，再通过晶体管驱动的红外 LED 发送指令。
requirements: ESP32, TSOP4838 receiver, IR LED and 2N2222 transistor.
Wi-Fi and Blynk credentials are needed for cloud control.
MIT License.

name: pyidotmatrix: researching and implementing iDotMatrix BLE control
description_en: Implements the iDotMatrix BLE display protocol as a typed Python SDK while documenting findings from vendor APK analysis and hardware probes. Packet builders cover images, GIFs, text, effects and native display modes; a bundled CLI decodes Android btsnoop captures into annotated traffic. The project records feature status against a reference 32×32 panel.
description_zh: 项目将 iDotMatrix BLE 显示屏协议实现为带类型的 Python SDK，并记录厂商 APK 分析与硬件探测所得的发现。数据包构造器覆盖图片、GIF、文字、灯效和设备原生模式；附带命令行工具可将 Android btsnoop 抓包解码为带注释的通信记录。功能状态以一块 32×32 面板为参考。
requirements: Python 3.12–3.14 and bleak are required for BLE use.
Hardware findings were checked against one 32×32 panel; weekly scheduling is partially verified.
GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: Skannerz Commander: reconstructing the toy's trade protocol
description_en: Skannerz Commander trade research reconstructs the electronic toy's three-pin exchange protocol from a 200 kHz logic-analyzer capture and controlled hardware experiments. Its documentation covers clock phases, handshake, frames and monster payload fields; an Arduino slave emulator implements the exchange, which the author reports using in real trades.
description_zh: Skannerz Commander 交易协议研究利用 200 kHz 逻辑分析仪采集的数据和受控硬件实验，还原这款电子玩具的三针接口通信协议。协议文档涵盖时钟阶段、握手、帧结构和怪兽数据字段；Arduino 从设备模拟器实现了交易过程，作者报告已用它与实机完成交易。
requirements: A 5 V Arduino Uno or Nano and three wires are needed for the slave emulator; 3.3 V boards need level shifting.
Reproducing the capture analysis requires Python 3 and numpy.
The slave-side reject byte and HP zero remain open questions.
AGPL-3.0 license.

name: AUKEY KM-G15 RGB Control: decoding keyboard USB HID commands
description_en: AUKEY KM-G15 RGB Control reconstructs the keyboard's USB HID lighting protocol and supplies a Go command-line client. Its protocol notes define 64-byte SET_REPORT packets, a checksum and START–command–END transactions; the client changes lighting modes, brightness, profiles and polling rate.
description_zh: AUKEY KM-G15 RGB Control 还原该键盘的 USB HID 灯效协议，并提供 Go 命令行客户端。协议文档列出 64 字节 SET_REPORT 报文、校验和及 START、命令、END 事务流程；客户端可调整灯效、亮度、配置槽和 USB 回报率。
requirements: AUKEY KM-G15 keyboard with USB HID identifier 0x0C45:0x7666.
Go 1.21 or newer and a C compiler for source builds.
MIT License.

name: OpenCE-macOS: porting Halo: Combat Evolved to Apple silicon
description_en: OpenCE-macOS ports OpenCE's Halo: Combat Evolved decompilation to Apple silicon Macs. It builds a native macOS app, maps the game's 32-bit code into a 4 GB address window, and renders through ANGLE on Metal. At first launch, the app imports maps from the user's Xbox disc image.
description_zh: OpenCE-macOS 将基于 Halo: Combat Evolved 反编译成果的 OpenCE 移植到 Apple 芯片 Mac，构建原生 macOS 应用。它将游戏的 32 位代码放入独立的 4 GB 地址空间，并通过 ANGLE 在 Metal 上渲染。首次启动时，应用从用户提供的 Xbox 光盘镜像导入地图。
requirements: Apple silicon Mac running macOS 11 or later.
A user-owned Halo: Combat Evolved Xbox disc image in ISO or XISO format.
Source builds require Xcode command line tools, Python 3, LLVM, lld, Ninja and CMake.
CC0-1.0 License for the project's code.

name: Primal Rage: DOS engine reconstruction and SDL3 port
description_en: Primal Rage RE reconstructs the DOS game's engine in C over a memory layout matching PRAGE.EXE and runs it with SDL3 using the user's game data. The project includes Ghidra analysis scripts, LE and resource-format documentation, captures and differential checks; the author reports all 759 game-owned functions ported.
description_zh: Primal Rage RE 以 C 语言按 PRAGE.EXE 的原始内存布局重建 DOS 游戏引擎，并用 SDL3 读取用户的游戏数据运行。仓库包含 Ghidra 脚本、LE 与资源格式文档、原版采集记录和差分检查；作者报告已移植全部 759 个游戏自有函数。
requirements: A user-owned Primal Rage installation supplying PRAGE.EXE, INDEX, S16*.GRA and sound drivers is required.
Building uses CMake and SDL3; the differential gate also uses Python, capstone, unicorn and local captures.
Some original gameplay and audio outcomes remain outside the captured comparison set.
MIT license.

name: Tombi!: matching PlayStation decompilation and native port
description_en: Tombi-Decomp reconstructs PlayStation Tombi! code as C compiled against the original discs and also builds a native Windows, Linux and Android port. Its progress reports compare individual functions byte for byte across PAL, US, Japanese and demo versions; the author reports 99.68% matching game code for the PAL reference.
description_zh: Tombi-Decomp 将 PlayStation 游戏 Tombi! 的代码重建为 C，并提供 Windows、Linux、Android 原生移植版。项目按函数逐字节对照 PAL、美国、日本及试玩版本；作者报告 PAL 基准版游戏代码匹配率为 99.68%。
requirements: A legally obtained game disc image is required; the port launcher accepts PAL Rev 1 SCES-01331 or SCES-01330.
Matching work on Japanese releases remains in progress.
MIT license for the repository's work.

name: Dig Dug: translating arcade routines and modeling triple-Z80 hardware
description_en: Dig Dug translates routines from the 1982 arcade game's Rev 2 ROMs into Rust and models its three Z80 processors and Namco I/O, video and audio hardware. It includes a disassembler, memory-map report, native windowed port and differential checks against a separate Z80 interpreter. The author states that translation coverage and full hardware equivalence remain incomplete.
description_zh: Dig Dug 将 1982 年街机游戏 Rev 2 ROM 中的例程转译为 Rust，并建模三颗 Z80 处理器以及 Namco 输入输出、视频和音频硬件。项目提供反汇编器、内存映射报告、原生窗口程序，以及使用独立 Z80 解释器进行的差分检查。作者指出转译覆盖率和硬件等效性仍未完成。
requirements: Stable Rust and a user-owned Dig Dug Rev 2 arcade ROM set are needed for gameplay.
ROM-dependent regressions require the original ROMs; ordinary tests use synthetic data.
Timing, custom I/O and gameplay coverage remain incomplete.
MIT License.

name: Diddy Kong Racing on Xbox: a UWP port of Golden Balloon
description_en: Ports Golden Balloon's Diddy Kong Racing source port to an Xbox Series X UWP package. The repository adds a WinRT entry point, compatibility patches, build translation and packaging tools for a user's own Golden Balloon checkout and ROM. The author reports completing the game's modes on Series X and matching 900 of 900 simulation hashes against a PC run.
description_zh: 项目将 Golden Balloon 的 Diddy Kong Racing 源码移植版制作为 Xbox Series X 的 UWP 包。仓库提供 WinRT 入口、兼容补丁、构建转换和打包工具，供用户配合自己的 Golden Balloon 检出版本及 ROM 使用。作者报告在 Series X 完成游戏各模式，且与 PC 运行结果的 900 次模拟哈希全部一致。
requirements: Golden Balloon v1.7.0 and a user-supplied Diddy Kong Racing revision 1.1 ROM are required.
Xbox Series X Developer Mode, Visual Studio, Windows SDK, llvm-mingw, Dawn for UWP and SDL2 for WinRT are specified.
Xbox Series S has not been tried.
MIT license for the port tooling and documentation.

name: BattleTanx: Global Assault: matching PlayStation executable reconstruction
description_en: BattleTanx: Global Assault reconstructs the US PlayStation game's executable from matching C and readable assembly. Its build compares the linked output with the user's retail executable, while separate tools decode formats including TEX, IMG, FUL, MMM/3MDL and VAGS.SFX. The author reports complete exact executable reconstruction and structural decoding of the disc corpus.
description_zh: BattleTanx: Global Assault 以匹配的 C 源码和可读汇编重建美版 PlayStation 游戏可执行文件，并将链接结果与用户提供的原版文件比较。另有工具解析 TEX、IMG、FUL、MMM/3MDL 和 VAGS.SFX 等格式。作者报告可执行文件已完整精确重建，光盘文件均可进行结构解析。
requirements: Python 3.9 or newer, GNU Make and a legally obtained US executable SLUS-01044.
The supported executable is placed at baseroms/us/SLUS_010.44; extracted disc files are needed for corpus checks.
Semantic naming, consolidation and compiler corroboration remain active work.
MIT License.

name: Mega Man X6: matching PlayStation code and overlay decompilation
description_en: mmx6 reconstructs the US v1.1 PlayStation Mega Man X6 boot executable and ROCK_X6.BIN code overlays as C source. Its build uses the era's toolchain and checks each produced binary against the original hash; the repository includes source, overlay configurations and matching workflow documentation.
description_zh: mmx6 将美版 v1.1 PlayStation 游戏 Mega Man X6 的启动程序和 ROCK_X6.BIN 代码覆盖程序重建为 C 源码。构建流程使用当年的工具链，并逐个核对生成文件与原版哈希；仓库包含源码、覆盖程序配置和匹配流程文档。
requirements: A legally obtained US v1.1 Mega Man X6 disc dump is required for rebuilding and hash comparison.
The original-era compiler and linker toolchain is required for byte-matching builds.
AGPL-3.0 license for the project's own tools and documents.

name: Castlevania: The Adventure ReBirth: a PowerPC lifted PC port
description_en: Castlevania: The Adventure ReBirth is translated from its WiiWare PowerPC executable into C++ for a native PC runtime. The project supplies a lifter, SDL2 and OpenGL runtime, audio and input replacements, and hand-written readable game functions; the author reports that the port reaches Stage 1.
description_zh: 该项目将 WiiWare 游戏 Castlevania: The Adventure ReBirth 的 PowerPC 可执行文件提升为 C++，通过 SDL2、OpenGL 运行时及音频、输入适配在 PC 上运行。仓库还含可读函数源码；作者报告移植版可玩到第一关。
requirements: A legally obtained game .wad is required to generate code and game data locally.
Linux build dependencies include SDL2 and GLEW; Windows builds use MSYS2.
Readable hand-written decompilation and the port remain in progress beyond Stage 1.
MIT license for project code and tools.

name: FIFA 96: reconstructing the DOS loader, formats and game systems
description_en: FIFA 96 reconstructs the DOS game's real-mode loader, appended protected-mode image behavior and formats including QFS, POG, TGV, VIV and EACS. A C11 port implements file readers, codecs, audio and match systems, while an SDL3 engine runs from the user's CD image. The author reports complete implementation of its counted native dispatch bodies but identifies remaining runtime wiring.
description_zh: FIFA 96 重建 DOS 游戏的实模式加载器、附加保护模式程序行为，以及 QFS、POG、TGV、VIV 和 EACS 等格式。C11 移植实现文件读取、编解码、音频和比赛系统；SDL3 引擎从用户的光盘镜像运行。作者报告其统计的原生分派函数均已实现，但部分运行路径仍待接通。
requirements: A user-owned FIFA 96 DOS CD image at data/game/FIFAPCCD96.iso for game execution and capture.
C11, CMake 3.28 or newer, Python 3, NASM and DOSBox-X for the documented toolchain and capture flow.
Some runtime dispatch paths and gameplay behavior remain open work.
MIT License.

name: Chulip: matching reconstruction of the USA PlayStation 2 game
description_en: Reconstructs readable C source for the USA PlayStation 2 release of Chulip and checks functions against the original executable. Its build compares the full loaded image with a user-supplied disc dump, using compiler-specific profiles and match ledgers. The author reports 1,492 matching functions out of 2,189 provisional functions.
description_zh: 项目为美版 PS2 游戏 Chulip 重建可读的 C 源码，并将函数与原版可执行文件比较。构建流程使用特定编译器配置和匹配记录，把完整加载镜像与用户提供的光盘转储逐字节比对。作者报告暂定的 2,189 个函数中有 1,492 个匹配。
requirements: A verified dump of the USA Chulip disc is required.
The matching workflow uses the historical toolchains recorded in config/toolchains.json.
The author reports 1,492 of 2,189 provisional functions matched.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Rage of Mages / Allods: matching reconstruction of the 1998 engine
description_en: Reconstructs C++ source for the 1998 Rage of Mages / Allods engine and compares compiled functions with a specified ALLODS.EXE build. The project records executable structure, relocations and serialization findings, alongside build and matching tools. The author reports 329 exact functions out of 6,897 engine functions.
description_zh: 项目重建 1998 年 Rage of Mages / Allods 引擎的 C++ 源码，并与指定版本的 ALLODS.EXE 比较编译结果。仓库保存可执行文件结构、重定位和序列化研究资料，以及构建与匹配工具。作者报告 6,897 个引擎函数中有 329 个精确匹配。
requirements: The specified ALLODS.EXE build is the comparison target.
The author reports 329 of 6,897 engine functions exact.

name: AGS 2.x Decompilation: matching the Adventure Game Studio runtime
description_en: AGS 2.x Decompilation reconstructs the Adventure Game Studio runtime engine from reverse engineering, prior source and instruction comparisons. Its build supports DOS through DJGPP and, from version 2.03, Windows through MSVC. The author reports version 2.00 complete and a demo game playable; later versions remain in progress.
description_zh: AGS 2.x Decompilation 通过逆向分析、既有源码参考和指令对比重建 Adventure Game Studio 运行引擎。项目使用 DJGPP 构建 DOS 版本，并从 2.03 起支持使用 MSVC 构建 Windows 版本。作者报告 2.00 版已完成，演示游戏可运行；后续版本仍在推进。
requirements: GNU Make and a DJGPP environment or DOS cross-compiler; Windows targets require MSVC.
Instruction matching uses host-side bash, binutils and text utilities.
The reconstruction covers the runtime engine rather than the editor.
CC0-1.0 License.

name: hyperblade-decomp: matching HyperBlade's Windows executable
description_en: hyperblade-decomp reconstructs the HyperBlade HYPERX.EXE v1.0.0.1 source and scores byte matches per function with reccmp. Its source is organized by game subsystem and compiled with Visual C++ 6.0 SP3; a separate bring-up build runs a basic game mode. The author reports that most game functions match exactly.
description_zh: hyperblade-decomp 重建 HyperBlade 的 HYPERX.EXE v1.0.0.1 源码，并使用 reccmp 逐函数计算字节匹配情况。源码按游戏子系统组织，以 Visual C++ 6.0 SP3 编译；另有用于基本游戏测试的启动构建。作者报告大部分游戏函数已精确匹配。
requirements: Windows with Git Bash, CMake 3.21 or newer and Python 3.12 or newer.
A user-owned HyperBlade copy with HYPERX.EXE v1.0.0.1 and the Visual C++ 6.0 SP3 toolchain.
The basic bring-up build uses the user's disc DATA folder.
LGPL-3.0-only for the project's own work.

name: libadlib: reconstructing HyperBlade's ADLIB behavior system
description_en: libadlib reconstructs the ADLIB behavior system shipped with HyperBlade, including its language, PBN compiler and host-independent runtime. Its tools decompile and inspect PBN plans, draw behavior graphs, compare files and trace execution. The author reports byte-identical compiler output for the game's 32 shipped plans in compatibility mode.
description_zh: libadlib 重建 HyperBlade 使用的 ADLIB 行为系统，包括语言、PBN 编译器和独立于宿主的运行时。配套工具可反编译和检查 PBN 计划、绘制行为图、比较文件并追踪执行。作者报告兼容模式下，游戏附带的 32 份计划均可编译成逐字节相同的结果。
requirements: CMake 3.20 or newer, a C++17 compiler and Ninja or Make.
The adlib1996 compatibility mode retains the original compiler's fixed limits.
MSVC builds are untested.
MIT License.

name: Digimon World 4: a matching PS2 decompilation
description_en: A work-in-progress matching decompilation reconstructs the USA PS2 release of Digimon World 4 as readable C and C++ source. The build compares recovered functions byte for byte with a user-provided retail executable and links remaining code from that executable; the author's progress report lists 76.5% of code bytes as fully matched.
description_zh: 该项目将美版 PS2《Digimon World 4》逐步重建为可读的 C/C++ 源码。构建流程把恢复的函数与用户提供的零售版可执行文件逐字节比对，未恢复部分仍从原文件链接；作者的进度报告称，已有 76.5% 的代码字节完全匹配。
requirements: Requires an x86-64 Linux system and a user's own Digimon World 4 USA SLUS-20836 disc image or executable.
The build requires Python 3, GNU make, mipsel-linux-gnu binutils, wibo and the pinned compilers described in the installation guide.
The author reports 76.5% of code bytes fully matched; the decompilation remains unfinished.
Project tooling and documentation are dedicated under CC0 1.0; the LICENSE file gives separate terms for recovered game material.

name: Naruto: The Broken Bond — an Android ARM64 port of the Xbox 360 recompilation
