description_en: An experimental Android ARM64 port adapts the existing static recompilation of the Xbox 360 game Naruto: The Broken Bond, compiling translated PowerPC code with ReXGlue and bringing its runtime, Vulkan renderer and touch input to Android. The author reports that the original intro, menus and a training fight render on an OPPO A58 at about 1 FPS.
description_zh: 该项目把 Xbox 360 游戏 Naruto: The Broken Bond 的现有静态重编译成果移植到 Android ARM64：通过 ReXGlue 编译转换后的 PowerPC 代码，并适配运行时、Vulkan 渲染器和触控输入。作者报告称，OPPO A58 上已显示原版片头、菜单和训练战斗，速度约为每秒 1 帧。
requirements: Requires a legally obtained supported Xbox 360 game copy; the supported default.xex is title 55530825, media 09FFE047, version 0.0.0.3.
Android checkpoint was tested on an OPPO A58 with ARM64 and Android 15; the author reports about 1 FPS.
The consumer game importer is unfinished, and campaign completion, save/load, networking and other devices remain unvalidated.
GPL-3.0; dependency licences also apply.

name: Sonic 3 and Sonic & Knuckles: a byte-identical source reconstruction fork
description_en: A source reconstruction fork rebuilds three regional Sonic the Hedgehog 3 ROMs, Sonic & Knuckles and the Sonic 3 & Knuckles lock-on composition byte for byte from user-provided images. Beyond the inherited disassembly, it organizes 68000 and Z80 source by subsystem and adds ROM identity checks, MAME runtime comparisons and bounded content round trips and edits.
description_zh: 该源码重建分支使用用户提供的镜像，逐字节重建《Sonic the Hedgehog 3》的三个地区版本、《Sonic & Knuckles》及两者的卡带联动组合。它在继承的反汇编基础上按子系统整理 68000 与 Z80 源码，并加入 ROM 一致性检查、MAME 运行时对比及有限范围的内容往返转换和修改检查。
requirements: Initialization requires legally obtained reference images for all five supported profiles.
The supported host is Windows x64 with Python 3.11+, Git, GNU Make and pinned Retrolarium Kit and Core dependencies; runtime comparisons use a pinned MAME build.
Expanded ROMs, variable allocation, engine merging and a general edited-ROM composer are outside the stated scope.
No licence file in the repository.

name: redmi-perf: reconstructing Redmi laptop performance-mode control
description_en: redmi-perf reconstructs performance-mode control on Xiaomi and Redmi laptops through the MIFS WMI interface to the embedded controller. Its notes map request bytes, firmware responses and mode values; a kernel module exposes the interface, while an optional NVIDIA ACPI shim fills response fields the author says the firmware omits.
description_zh: redmi-perf 通过通向嵌入式控制器的 MIFS WMI 接口，重建小米和 Redmi 笔记本的性能模式控制通道。逆向笔记列出请求字节、固件应答和模式值；内核模块开放该接口，可选的 NVIDIA ACPI 补丁则补齐作者所述的固件缺失字段。
requirements: The reported working setup is Redmi G Pro 2024 TM2211 with Ubuntu 26.04, kernel 7.0.0-42 and NVIDIA 595.112.07; other models are unvalidated.
Building the module requires DKMS, build tools, matching kernel headers and cargo.
Turbo and full-speed modes require the DC barrel charger; the optional NVPCF shim replaces the NVIDIA kernel module.
GPL-2.0-only.

name: SonyBridge: reconstructing second-generation Sony headset control
description_en: SonyBridge extends a desktop Sony headset client to handle a second generation of its Bluetooth RFCOMM control protocol. It documents frame boundaries, service UUID families, the v2 initialization handshake, host acknowledgments, and commands for battery, equalizer, and DSEE data. The app offers controls on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
description_zh: SonyBridge 扩展桌面端索尼耳机客户端，支持第二代蓝牙 RFCOMM 控制协议。文档列出帧边界、服务 UUID、v2 初始化握手、主机确认消息，以及电量、均衡器和 DSEE 查询命令；应用提供 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 控制界面。
requirements: A supported Sony headset must first be paired through the operating system’s Bluetooth settings.
Only WH-CH720N is described as fully hardware-tested; other models have untested quirks.
MIT license.

name: HP Laser 1008a: reconstructing SPL3 printing on macOS
description_en: The HP Laser 1008a project reconstructs the SPL3/QPDL printing path for HP Laser 1003, 1006, and 1008 devices on Apple Silicon macOS. The author compares HP and SpliX streams, documents the page and band records, and patches a page-header size mismatch. A native CUPS filter and IOKit backend send the resulting output over USB.
description_zh: HP Laser 1008a 项目重建 HP Laser 1003、1006、1008 在 Apple Silicon macOS 上的 SPL3/QPDL 打印流程。作者比对 HP 与 SpliX 的输出，记录页面和条带记录格式，修补页面头尺寸错误，并用原生 CUPS 过滤器及 IOKit 后端经 USB 发送数据。
requirements: Apple Silicon macOS 26 and a USB-connected supported printer are the documented test setup.
Homebrew and Xcode command line tools are needed to build.
The project’s glue code is MIT-licensed; SpliX and its patches are GPLv2.

name: ZTE U60 Pro Toolkit: investigating and extending router controls
description_en: ZTE U60 Pro Toolkit investigates the MU5250 router's firmware behavior and extends its controls with an on-device Rust REST agent, web console and mobile clients. Research notes cover hidden web UI settings, SIM Toolkit communication through the RIL socket and firmware power behavior.
description_zh: ZTE U60 Pro Toolkit 研究 MU5250 路由器的固件行为，并通过运行在设备上的 Rust REST 智能体、网页控制台和移动客户端扩展控制功能。研究记录涉及隐藏的网页设置、通过 RIL 套接字进行的 SIM Toolkit 通信以及固件电源管理行为。
requirements: ZTE U60 Pro (MU5250) router; the agent targets its aarch64 Linux environment.
The documented device investigation identifies hardware MU5250_HW1.0 and firmware CN_ZTE_MU5250V1.0.0B27.
MIT licence.

name: siglus_rs: reimplementing four visual game engines in Rust
description_en: siglus_rs reimplements the UK2, AVG32, RealLive and SiglusEngine game engines in Rust, with its main focus on SiglusEngine. Launchers identify engines from game-directory formats and import games on supported platforms; the web launcher runs SiglusEngine, RealLive and AVG32, while UK2 runs on desktop, iOS and Android.
description_zh: siglus_rs 使用 Rust 重新实现 UK2、AVG32、RealLive 和 SiglusEngine 四款游戏引擎，重点是 SiglusEngine。启动器根据游戏目录中的文件格式识别引擎并导入游戏；网页版可运行 SiglusEngine、RealLive 和 AVG32，UK2 则可在桌面、iOS 和 Android 平台运行。
requirements: Original game files are required in a game project directory.
Protected SiglusEngine resources require a 16-byte secondary key; the engine attempts to find one when it is absent or incorrect.
UK2 is unavailable in the web launcher because its runtime needs threads.
MPL-2.0 licence.

name: BMW iDrive: interpreting F44 controller CAN messages
description_en: BMW iDrive Controller CAN Bus Interpreter decodes controls from an F44 iDrive controller using an ESP32-C3 and TJA1441A/B CAN transceiver. It reports knob rotation, joystick directions, button and touch states, and brightness commands at 500 kbps. The README also records unresolved touchpad decoding and CAN wake-up behavior.
description_zh: BMW iDrive Controller CAN Bus Interpreter 使用 ESP32-C3 和 TJA1441A/B CAN 收发器解码 F44 iDrive 控制器。它在 500 kbps 总线上识别旋钮转动、摇杆方向、按键及触摸状态和亮度命令；文档也列出触控板解码与 CAN 唤醒的未解问题。
requirements: An Adafruit QT Py ESP32-C3, TJA1441A/B transceiver, and BMW F44 iDrive controller are specified.
The touchpad stream is not decoded and CAN wake-up is not working.
MIT license.

name: ESP32 Controller for Charlton & Jenrick Fireplace: reconstructing remote control
description_en: ESP32 Controller for Charlton & Jenrick Fireplace recreates remote commands by transmitting captured RF payloads through a CC1101 module. Its firmware provides iRange 2-FSK and non-iRange ASK/OOK profiles, with controls exposed through a web interface, MQTT and Home Assistant.
description_zh: ESP32 Controller for Charlton & Jenrick Fireplace 使用 CC1101 模块发送采集到的射频数据，重建壁炉遥控命令。固件提供 iRange 2-FSK 和非 iRange ASK/OOK 配置，并通过网页、MQTT 和 Home Assistant 提供控制入口。
requirements: ESP32-WROOM-32, a 3.3 V CC1101 433 MHz module, and PlatformIO with the Arduino ESP32 framework.
The author reports testing i1800e and 1800E; other listed fireplace models remain untested.
The CC1101 misses some remote transmissions, so the physical remote cannot stay synchronized with this controller.
MIT licence.

name: GMK87 Configurator: reconstructing Zuoya keyboard USB HID control
description_en: GMK87 Configurator reconstructs the Zuoya GMK87 keyboard's USB HID control exchanges from captures of its official application. It documents 64-byte report framing and image-upload sequences, and provides desktop, CLI and Node.js controls for display images, RGB lighting and clock synchronization.
description_zh: GMK87 Configurator 根据官方应用的 USB 抓包重建 Zuoya GMK87 键盘的 HID 控制流程。项目记录了 64 字节报文结构和图片上传命令顺序，并提供桌面程序、命令行工具及 Node.js 接口，用于上传屏幕图片、设置 RGB 灯光和同步时钟。
requirements: Zuoya GMK87 keyboard; the CLI requires Node.js 14 or later.
Linux users need the included udev rule for HID access without root.
Image uploads support at most 36 frames across both display slots.
MIT licence.

name: rlapi: reconstructing Rocket League’s internal APIs
description_en: rlapi reconstructs Rocket League’s internal HTTP and WebSocket APIs and supplies a Go SDK for them. The documentation maps authentication, custom WebSocket messages, PsySig HMAC signatures, and selected endpoints. Bundled Frida hooks and a local proxy capture traffic, while a PE scanner extracts build information from the game executable.
description_zh: rlapi 重建《火箭联盟》的内部 HTTP 与 WebSocket 接口，并提供 Go SDK。文档记录身份验证、自定义 WebSocket 消息、PsySig HMAC 签名和部分接口；附带的 Frida 钩子与本地代理用于捕获流量，PE 扫描工具则从游戏可执行文件提取构建信息。
requirements: Go 1.24.5 is specified by the module; interception tools additionally require Frida, Python, and Node.js.
Some endpoints are undocumented or only partially understood.
MIT license.

name: HikVision QR export decoder: reconstructing Hik-Connect device exports
description_en: HikVision QR export decoder reconstructs the format of Hik-Connect device export QR codes and provides a Python decoder and renewal command. The author traces Base64 and zlib layers, field separators, device credentials, and expiration data, then describes using Ghidra to identify the native library’s encryption routine.
description_zh: HikVision QR export decoder 重建 Hik-Connect 设备导出二维码的格式，并提供 Python 解码与更新命令。作者分析了 Base64、zlib、字段分隔符、设备凭据和过期时间，并记录了用 Ghidra 定位原生库加密过程的研究。
requirements: A Hik-Connect device export QR string is required; macOS clipboard input needs Pillow and zxing-cpp.
No licence file in the repository.

name: ShatteredGlass: reconstructing SwiftUI Liquid Glass effects
description_en: ShatteredGlass reconstructs SwiftUI's Liquid Glass appearance on macOS using a layered Core Animation view. Its documented hierarchy combines CABackdropLayer, CASDFLayer, CASDFElementLayer, SDFPortalLayer and filters for backdrop distortion and edge highlights.
description_zh: ShatteredGlass 在 macOS 上通过分层的 Core Animation 视图重建 SwiftUI Liquid Glass 外观。项目记录了结合 CABackdropLayer、CASDFLayer、CASDFElementLayer、SDFPortalLayer 与滤镜的图层结构，用于表现背景折射和边缘高光。
requirements: macOS with Core Animation private layer types used by the project.
The basic glass effect is partial, filter tuning continues, and the Liquid Lens effect remains in progress.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Ajazz AK820 Pro: reconstructing keyboard lighting control on Linux
description_en: Ajazz AK820 Pro Linux Software reconstructs lighting control for the Ajazz SONiX AK820 Pro keyboard from USB traffic captured with Wireshark and PCapUSB. It includes a PCAP packet parser and a Linux HID application; individual LED control, macros and LCD images remain planned.
description_zh: Ajazz AK820 Pro Linux Software 根据 Wireshark 和 PCapUSB 采集的 USB 流量重建 Ajazz SONiX AK820 Pro 键盘灯光控制。仓库提供 PCAP 数据包解析器和 Linux HID 程序；单键 LED、宏及 LCD 图片功能仍在计划中。
requirements: Linux, Ajazz SONiX AK820 Pro with VID 0x8009, CMake and hidapi.
Individual LED control, macros and LCD image or GIF support remain unfinished.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Grok3API: reconstructing Grok’s mobile gRPC client
description_en: Grok3API implements a Python client for Grok’s mobile gRPC interface. It serializes protobuf requests, wraps them in gRPC frames, and parses streamed response chunks into Pydantic models. The repository includes protobuf definitions and examples for sending messages and continuing conversations.
description_zh: Grok3API 用 Python 实现 Grok 移动端 gRPC 客户端。它序列化 protobuf 请求、封装 gRPC 帧，并将流式响应片段解析为 Pydantic 模型。仓库提供 protobuf 定义，以及发送消息和续接对话的示例。
requirements: Python 3.8 or newer with aiohttp, coincurve, and Pydantic is required.
MIT license.

name: OPUS-QUAD Pro DJ Link Reverse Engineer Packet Analysis: mapping device traffic
description_en: OPUS-QUAD Pro DJ Link Reverse Engineer Packet Analysis documents how the Pioneer DJ OPUS-QUAD exchanges Pro DJ Link packets. It describes UDP announcements on port 50000, status traffic and metadata requests on port 50002, alongside a Node.js example that relays status packets to a WebSocket server.
description_zh: OPUS-QUAD Pro DJ Link Reverse Engineer Packet Analysis 记录 Pioneer DJ OPUS-QUAD 的 Pro DJ Link 通信行为，包括 50000 端口上的 UDP 广播，以及 50002 端口上的状态报文和曲目元数据请求；另附将状态报文转发至 WebSocket 服务器的 Node.js 示例。
requirements: Node.js and npm for the example script.
An OPUS-QUAD on the network, plus the host interface IP address and MAC address for the example script.
The author reports that the observed status packets omit some values, including the USB slot number and looping status.
The LICENSE file contains MIT terms; package.json declares ISC.

name: War Action: re-engineering Sudden Strike Gold 1.2.1
description_en: War Action reconstructs Sudden Strike Gold 1.2.1 from its original binaries as separate launcher, renderer, menu and game modules. It documents DirectDraw rendering at three screen sizes, added windowed-mode work and partial menu and gameplay progress; multiplayer remains in progress.
description_zh: War Action 根据《Sudden Strike Gold》1.2.1 的原版二进制文件重建启动器、渲染器、菜单和游戏模块。项目记录了三种分辨率的 DirectDraw 渲染、窗口模式改动，以及菜单和游戏逻辑的阶段性进展；多人模式仍在开发。
requirements: The work uses the GOG Sudden Strike Gold 1.2.1 release, version 13578, as its reference.
Building requires Microsoft Visual Studio, OGG, Vorbis, Yoink and zlib.
Single-player menus may contain bugs; multiplayer is unusable and the game module remains in progress.
MIT licence.

name: MiraBox StreamDock: reconstructing USB device control
description_en: MiraBox StreamDock reverse-engineer is a TypeScript demonstration of direct USB control derived from the device's packets. It reads firmware versions and key presses, controls screen state and brightness, and sends key and boot images through a replaceable USB backend.
description_zh: MiraBox StreamDock reverse-engineer 是根据设备 USB 数据包编写的 TypeScript 直接控制示例。它可读取固件版本和按键事件、控制屏幕及亮度，并通过可替换的 USB 后端传送按键与启动图片。
requirements: MiraBox StreamDock 293 and a Node.js environment with the project's dependencies.
The author reports testing only MiraBox 293 and describes the demo as experimental.
MIT licence.

name: Waygate: reconstructing Elden Ring matchmaking services
description_en: Waygate reconstructs an Elden Ring matchmaking server around the game's multiplayer protocol. Its Rust workspace includes wire serialization, message types, protocol handling and server features for summoning, invasions, player messages, bloodstains and ghosts.
description_zh: Waygate 围绕《艾尔登法环》的多人联机协议重建匹配服务端。Rust 工作区包含协议报文的序列化、消息类型和协议处理代码，并实现召唤、入侵、玩家留言、血迹及幽灵等功能。
requirements: PostgreSQL database and a generated client/server key pair.
Client setup documentation is marked TBD; quickmatch ranking, match density and some telemetry messages remain unfinished.
AGPL-3.0-only licence.

name: Summit: reconstructing a World of Warcraft 3.3.5a server
description_en: Summit rebuilds a World of Warcraft 3.3.5a server in Go, with authentication, world-server and packet-handling components. Its supporting tools include a proxy for capturing authentication traffic, a packet dumper and a DBC converter; the author describes using Ghidra during development.
description_zh: Summit 用 Go 重建《魔兽世界》3.3.5a 服务端，包含认证、游戏世界及数据包处理组件。辅助工具包括采集认证流量的代理、数据包转储器和 DBC 转换器；作者说明开发中使用了 Ghidra。
requirements: The module declares Go 1.25.0.
The author describes the project as a small, ongoing emulator and lists several planned features.
Apache-2.0 licence.

name: Flipper Zero Lego Dimensions ToyPad Emulator: rebuilding the USB accessory
description_en: Flipper Zero Lego Dimensions ToyPad Emulator reproduces the game accessory’s USB behavior on a Flipper Zero. Its C app lets players place characters and vehicles on ToyPad positions, save upgraded vehicles, and select favorites. The README credits earlier ToyPad emulators for research and code used during development.
description_zh: Flipper Zero Lego Dimensions ToyPad Emulator 在 Flipper Zero 上重现该游戏配件的 USB 行为。C 语言应用可在 ToyPad 的不同位置放置角色和载具，保存升级后的载具并选择收藏项。文档注明开发时参考了更早的 ToyPad 仿真项目。
requirements: A Flipper Zero and LEGO Dimensions on PS5, PS4, PS3, or Wii U are required.
Building from source uses ufbt.
No licence file in the repository.

name: re-sysinternals-suite: rebuilding Sysinternals strings.exe
description_en: re-sysinternals-suite records an educational rebuild of the Sysinternals strings.exe executable. Its first episode contains C++ source, comments on the implementation, a Windows XP build patch and a link to a video walkthrough of the reverse-engineering process. The repository documents one rebuilt utility.
description_zh: re-sysinternals-suite 记录了对 Sysinternals strings.exe 可执行程序的教学性重建。首个专题提供带实现注释的 C++ 源码、Windows XP 构建补丁，以及讲解逆向过程的视频链接；仓库记录了一个已重建的工具。
requirements: The Windows XP patch targets Visual Studio 2017 v141 build tools.
The repository documents one rebuilt Sysinternals utility.
The Unlicense.

name: tpp-server-emulator: a Metal Gear Solid V backend reconstruction
description_en: tpp-server-emulator rebuilds the backend used by Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain. Its C++ server implements game command handlers and database models, while the documentation tracks command coverage and shows how Lua scripts can handle client requests. Configuration supports MySQL or SQLite3.
description_zh: tpp-server-emulator 重建《合金装备 V：幻痛》的后端。C++ 服务器实现游戏命令处理和数据库模型，文档记录命令实现情况，并展示如何用 Lua 脚本处理客户端请求；配置支持 MySQL 或 SQLite3。
requirements: Premake5 is required to generate the build; Linux builds use clang or GCC with the Mold linker.
The game client must be pointed at the server’s base URL.
The command inventory marks some handlers as partial or unimplemented.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: SMB Vanilla: a C reconstruction of two NES Mario games
description_en: SMB Vanilla reconstructs the gameplay of Super Mario Bros. and Super Mario Bros. 2 Japan in C. It runs against a user-supplied ROM for level and graphical data and aims to preserve original behavior, including many glitches. The author reports both games are beatable; refactoring of Ghidra-derived code, tests, and some audio remain unfinished.
description_zh: SMB Vanilla 以 C 语言重建《超级马力欧兄弟》和日版《超级马力欧兄弟 2》的玩法。程序从用户提供的 ROM 读取关卡和图像数据，目标是保留原版行为及多种漏洞。作者称两款游戏均可通关；Ghidra 生成代码的整理、测试及部分音频仍未完成。
requirements: A legally obtained ROM dump is required to play.
Building requires C and C++ compilers, Meson, and SDL2 or SDL3.
The Super Mario Bros. 2 Japan ending audio and regression tests are unfinished.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: SiriRemote-Linux: decoding Siri Remote Bluetooth input
description_en: SiriRemote-Linux decodes Apple TV Siri Remote Bluetooth input for use on Linux. Its Python code connects to the remote and emits media, volume, and pointer controls, while the documentation maps GATT characteristics, battery notifications, button bits, and touch coordinates. Microphone data remains unexplored in the implementation.
description_zh: SiriRemote-Linux 解码 Apple TV Siri Remote 的蓝牙输入并用于 Linux 控制。Python 程序连接遥控器并输出媒体、音量和指针事件；文档列出 GATT 特征、 电量通知、按键位及触控坐标。麦克风数据尚未在实现中解析。
requirements: A paired Siri Remote and Linux system with bluepy and evdev are required.
The documented media-control command uses sudo.
Microphone data could not be tested because of the stated BlueZ limitation.
No licence file in the repository.

name: ZydDash: decoding ePowerFun scooter telemetry for an ESP32 dashboard
description_en: ZydDash builds an ESP32 dashboard for an ePowerFun ePF-1 scooter from decoded Zydtech BLE telemetry. Its notes map Bluetooth characteristics, a 115200-baud display bus, MODBUS-like command frames and registers, while Python examples read and interpret scooter telemetry.
description_zh: ZydDash 根据解析出的 Zydtech BLE 遥测数据，为 ePowerFun ePF-1 电动滑板车制作 ESP32 仪表盘。文档列出蓝牙特征值、115200 波特率的显示器总线、类 MODBUS 命令帧和寄存器；Python 示例可读取并解释遥测数据。
requirements: The dashboard example uses an ESP32 module with BLE and an SH1106-compatible OLED display.
The GUI example requires pysimplegui and libscrc.
The author says the project is largely abandoned and the scooter's update mode needs further investigation.
No licence file in the repository.

name: OpenCloud: a Dark Cloud 2 reimplementation
description_en: OpenCloud is a C++ reimplementation effort for Dark Cloud 2. Its source tree contains engine systems, character code, and handlers for game data such as ISO content and packed files. The project identifies Dark Cloud 1 as a later goal and states that it excludes original game art and sound.
description_zh: OpenCloud 是《暗黑编年史》的 C++ 重建项目。源码包含引擎系统、角色代码，以及 ISO 内容和打包文件等游戏数据处理模块。项目将《暗黑之云》列为后续目标，并声明不收录原游戏美术和音频。
requirements: CMake 3.20 or newer is specified by the build configuration.
Dark Cloud 1 is planned for later.
MIT license.

name: msattack: reconstructing the Metal Slug Attack backend
description_en: msattack is a Go reimplementation effort for the Metal Slug Attack backend. The author describes capturing traffic between the game and its server to infer private API behavior, then writing a replacement service and proxy scripts. The documented setup also requires game data obtained separately from observed traffic or another source.
description_zh: msattack 是《合金弹头：进攻》后端的 Go 语言重建项目。作者描述了捕获游戏与服务器之间的流量、据此推断私有 API 的预期行为，再编写替代服务和代理脚本的过程。文档中的运行步骤还要求从捕获的流量或其他来源另行取得游戏数据。
requirements: Go, a proxy setup, and required game binary data are needed.
The README lists features as forthcoming.
AGPL-3.0 license.

name: shin: reimplementing the engine of Entergram visual games
description_en: shin reimplements a game engine used by Entergram visual games, initially targeting the Switch release of Umineko no Naku Koro ni Saku. It runs original game data and includes a core library and CLI for extracting .rom, .bup, .pic, .nxa and other resources; .snr scenarios have execution tracing rather than decompilation.
description_zh: shin 重实现 Entergram 视觉游戏使用的引擎，起初以 Switch 版 Umineko no Naku Koro ni Saku 为目标，并读取原版游戏数据。仓库还提供核心库和命令行工具，可提取 .rom、.bup、.pic、.nxa 等资源；对 .snr 场景脚本目前提供执行跟踪。
requirements: Running the current game target requires the user's own Umineko no Naku Koro ni Saku Switch romfs containing data.rom.
Building from source requires Rust.
Advanced engine features remain missing, and the game is not fully playable; .snr support is limited to execution tracing.

name: catlink-local: reconstructing CATLINK Open X local control
description_en: catlink-local reconstructs the CATLINK Open X litter box's login and MQTT exchanges for local Home Assistant use. Python services answer its login request, decode heartbeats and visits, and bridge state to Mosquitto; protocol notes distinguish confirmed fields from hypotheses.
description_zh: catlink-local 还原 CATLINK Open X 猫砂盆的登录与 MQTT 通信，供 Home Assistant 在本地使用。Python 服务应答登录请求、解析心跳和如厕记录，并将状态发布到 Mosquitto；协议文档区分已确认字段与推测字段。
requirements: A CATLINK Open X C08 with firmware 04.22, a Linux host, local DNS routing, Mosquitto and Home Assistant are used in the documented setup.
The author reports testing one box and one firmware for days; many protocol fields remain unconfirmed.
Commands are disabled by default and require deliberate setup and supervision around moving parts.
Licensed under MIT.

name: Another Life: reconstructing The Witcher 3 save state
description_en: Another Life reconstructs parts of The Witcher 3 Remastered save format and quest state to generate new saves from a player's story choices. Its Rust crates read and write the save container, variable table and token tree, then patch game facts, journal entries and quest graphs into a user-provided template save. The author reports limited successful in-game checks on patch 5.01.
description_zh: Another Life 重建 The Witcher 3 Remastered 的部分存档格式与任务状态，根据玩家选择生成新存档。Rust 代码读写存档容器、变量表和标记树，并把游戏事实、日志条目与任务图修改写入用户提供的模板存档。作者报告在 5.01 补丁版本完成了有限的游戏内验证。
requirements: The Witcher 3 Remastered PC patch 5.01 and copies of the user's own saves as export templates.
Rust stable and Tauri CLI for source builds; the Windows app needs WebView2.
Position and world edits, DLC and mod state, other game patches and most questbook content remain unproven or incomplete.
Code is MIT OR Apache-2.0; questbook content is CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: Open Van Buren: reconstructing the Fallout 3 tech demo engine
description_en: Open Van Buren reconstructs the Fallout 3 Van Buren tech demo as a native C++17 Linux engine using the user's own game data. It parses archives, maps, models, animations, effects and Pawn/Small scripts, with documented format findings and a playable first pass of the tutorial content.
description_zh: Open Van Buren 用 C++17 将 Fallout 3 的 Van Buren 技术演示版重建为 Linux 原生引擎，读取用户自己的游戏数据。它解析档案、地图、模型、动画、特效及 Pawn/Small 脚本，并记录格式研究成果；教程内容已有初步可玩实现。
requirements: A copy of the Van Buren tech demo is required; game assets are not included.
Building requires Linux, OpenGL 3.3 or newer, CMake 3.16 or newer, a C++17 compiler, SDL2, GLEW, FreeType and OpenAL Soft.
The project is a playable first pass with known gaps.
Licensed under MIT.

name: Aurora: reconstructing EvoFox Blaze mouse configuration
description_en: Aurora reconstructs EvoFox Blaze mouse configuration through its Linux hidraw interface. A CLI and terminal UI read and change polling, DPI, lighting, button and profile settings, with writes checked against the device's returned state.
description_zh: Aurora 通过 Linux hidraw 接口还原 EvoFox Blaze 鼠标配置。CLI 和终端界面可读取、更改轮询率、DPI、灯效、按键及配置档，并通过回读设备状态检查写入结果。
requirements: Linux with hidraw, Python 3.10 or newer, and an EvoFox Blaze mouse identified as USB 30fa:1440 are required.
Macros, several button assignments and some profile button tables are unfinished.
Licensed under WTFPL.

name: CR-BYOB: reconstructing the Creality Scan Bridge
description_en: CR-BYOB reconstructs Creality Scan Bridge behavior in an Android app, letting Creality Scan discover a USB-connected scanner over a network. Its Java source handles scanner capture, bridge discovery and streams, with documentation for the communication paths and device compatibility.
description_zh: CR-BYOB 以 Android 应用重建 Creality Scan Bridge 的行为，使 Creality Scan 能通过网络发现接在手机 USB 端口上的扫描仪。Java 源码处理设备采集、网桥发现和数据流，并附有通信流程及设备兼容性文档。
requirements: An Android 8 or newer phone with USB host and USB 3, a powered USB 3 hub, and a compatible Creality scanner are required.
CR-Scan Otter and Ferret Pro are reported tested; many other listed scanners remain untested.
The bridge network services have no authentication and are intended for trusted networks.
Licensed under MIT.

name: HappyLighting-py: reconstructing LED-controller BLE communication
description_en: HappyLighting-py reconstructs BLE communication for HappyLighting-compatible LED controllers from analysis of the original APK. Its Python app changes color, mode and speed, enables the integrated microphone and drives color from screen input.
description_zh: HappyLighting-py 根据原版 APK 的分析结果重建兼容控制器的 BLE 通信。Python 应用可调整 LED 颜色、模式和速度，启用内置麦克风，并根据屏幕内容改变颜色。
requirements: Python and the dependencies in LEDStripController/requirements.txt.
Linux may additionally need libasound-dev and portaudio19-dev.
Custom mode and independent device-group control remain unimplemented.
AGPL-3.0 License.

name: dream-server: reconstructing a Pokémon Dream World server
description_en: dream-server reconstructs server behavior for Pokémon Dream World, including Game Sync save uploads and downloads. Its Flask handlers track sleeping Pokémon state, store save data and assemble byte responses; code comments record observations about how the game interprets parts of a download response.
description_zh: dream-server 重建 Pokémon Dream World 的部分服务端行为，包括 Game Sync 存档上传和下载。Flask 路由记录宝可梦睡眠状态、保存存档并组装字节响应；代码注释还记录了游戏如何解释下载响应的部分字段。
requirements: Python with Flask, Flask-SQLAlchemy, Flask-Migrate, Flask-Login, Flask-Babel, Flask-Bootstrap and Flagsmith.
The save-download response includes fields whose behavior remains under investigation.
MIT license.

name: Game Boy DMG-CPU Schematics: reconstructing the DMG-CPU B chip
description_en: Game Boy DMG-CPU Schematics reconstructs the Game Boy DMG-CPU B chip and SM83 core as KiCad schematics, Electric VLSI layouts and text netlists. Its overlay labels cells and wires on chip die shots, while the netlists record their connections and coordinates.
description_zh: Game Boy DMG-CPU Schematics 将 Game Boy 的 DMG-CPU B 芯片及 SM83 核心整理为 KiCad 电路图、Electric VLSI 布局和文本网表。叠加图标注芯片照片上的单元与连线，网表记录连接及坐标。
requirements: Die-shot images are needed to view the overlay with an SVG viewer or editor.
The netlists can be parsed with nlconv.
Licensed under CC-BY-SA-4.0.

name: pd-usb: reconstructing Playdate USB commands
description_en: pd-usb implements Playdate USB communication in a JavaScript WebSerial library using commands recovered through packet sniffing. It reads device status, controls and screen data, sends bitmaps, and exposes command and compiled-Lua payload operations.
description_zh: pd-usb 根据逆向分析和抓包获得的 Playdate USB 命令，用 JavaScript WebSerial 库与设备通信。它读取设备状态、按键与摇柄输入以及屏幕数据，发送位图，并提供发送命令和已编译 Lua 载荷的操作。
requirements: A Playdate connected over USB and a browser with WebSerial support in a secure context.
MIT License.

name: Things Cloud Python client: reconstructing to-do requests
description_en: The Things Cloud Python client reconstructs part of the service's request behavior from traffic produced by the Mac app. It implements account login and creation or editing of to-dos and projects, while documenting that some exchanged field meanings remain unknown.
description_zh: Things Cloud Python client 根据 Mac 应用发出的请求重建部分云端交互。它实现账号登录，以及待办事项和项目的创建、编辑；作者说明部分传输字段的含义仍未解明。
requirements: Things Cloud account credentials and Python 3.12 or later.
Listing to-dos, notes and Areas remains unfinished.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: GlanceClock: reconstructing its BLE command protocol
description_en: GlanceClock documents the wall clock's BLE command protocol for building a local bridge. The reference identifies its GATT service and characteristic, protobuf payloads, pairing flow and commands for notifications, scenes, settings and timers.
description_zh: GlanceClock 文档整理壁钟的 BLE 命令协议，供本地桥接程序使用。资料列出 GATT 服务与特征、protobuf 载荷、配对流程，以及通知、场景、设置和计时器命令。
requirements: A GlanceClock and BLE pairing using its displayed PIN.
Firmware-update characteristics remain undocumented.
WTFPL license.

name: TOD Tools: reconstructing Total Overdose and Kapow Engine
description_en: TOD Tools reconstructs Total Overdose game and Kapow Engine code in C++. It builds a dinput8.dll that can call functions in the original game, develops a replacement executable, and includes tools to read and extract selected assets from unpacked archives.
description_zh: TOD Tools 用 C++ 重建 Total Overdose 及 Kapow Engine 的代码。它可编译调用原游戏函数的 dinput8.dll，并开发替代可执行程序；附带工具可读取、提取已解包档案中的部分资源。
requirements: A copy of Total Overdose is required.
Windows builds use Visual Studio 2022 and the DirectX 9 SDK; other platform builds require code changes.
Native resource loading, rendering and game logic remain on the TODO list.

name: prolink-connect: implementing Pioneer PROLINK exchanges
description_en: prolink-connect implements Pioneer PROLINK network exchanges in TypeScript for DJ equipment. It discovers devices through UDP announcements, joins as a virtual CDJ, receives player status and queries track metadata from Rekordbox-formatted media or a Rekordbox link.
description_zh: prolink-connect 用 TypeScript 实现 Pioneer DJ 设备的 PROLINK 网络通信。它通过 UDP 公告发现设备，以虚拟 CDJ 身份加入网络，接收播放器状态，并从 Rekordbox 格式的存储介质或链路查询曲目元数据。
requirements: Pioneer PROLINK-compatible DJ equipment on a reachable network.
Node 20 or later, per the changelog.
MIT License.

name: open-cleverpad: reconstructing the MIDIPLUS SmartPAD hardware
description_en: open-cleverpad provides replacement Rust firmware for the MIDIPLUS SmartPAD MIDI controller and a reverse-engineered schematic of its mainboard. The firmware maps pads, encoders and buttons to MIDI messages and adds 64-color pad control.
description_zh: open-cleverpad 为 MIDIPLUS SmartPAD MIDI 控制器提供 Rust 替代固件，并附有逆向绘制的主板电路图。固件把触垫、编码器和按钮映射为 MIDI 消息，并支持 64 色触垫控制。
requirements: A MIDIPLUS SmartPAD and a compatible HID bootloader; installing the bootloader erases the original firmware.
Rust thumbv7m-none-eabi target for building the firmware.
Dual licensed under Apache-2.0 or MIT, at the user's option.

name: vakfu: reconstructing Wakfu map rendering
description_en: vakfu reconstructs Wakfu's isometric map rendering in a Rust application that loads assets from the user's game copy. Its engine reference describes map chunks, sprite definitions, element ordering, lighting and binary fields, alongside gaps in the current implementation.
description_zh: vakfu 用 Rust 重建 Wakfu 的等距视角地图渲染，并从用户自己的游戏副本读取资源。引擎文档记录地图分块、精灵定义、元素排序、光照和二进制字段，也列出当前实现的缺口。
requirements: Rust 1.95 or newer and Cargo are required to build.
A copy of Wakfu containing the assets is required to run.
Licensed under MIT.

name: ExCrypt: reconstructing Xbox 360 XeCrypt functions
description_en: ExCrypt reconstructs Xbox 360 XeCrypt functions as a C and C++ replacement for use with existing console code and data. It aims to match externally visible state and return values for functions exported by the kernel or used during boot and in games or apps.
description_zh: ExCrypt 以 C 和 C++ 重写 Xbox 360 的 XeCrypt 函数，供既有主机代码和数据使用。项目针对内核导出、启动过程以及游戏或应用使用的函数，力求保持外部可见状态和返回值兼容。
requirements: Targets x86 and x64 hosts and expects big-endian Xbox 360 data.
Function coverage follows the project's implementation status list.
Licensed under BSD-3-Clause.

name: Open Remote Start: reconstructing the Fortin antenna data-link
description_en: Open Remote Start investigates the antenna data-link protocol of Fortin remote starters and alarm systems. Its Particle firmware implements an interface that can monitor the link and serve as a cellular or Wi-Fi remote, with an EVO-One port pinout and wiring schematic.
description_zh: Open Remote Start 研究 Fortin 远程启动器和防盗系统的天线数据链路协议。其 Particle 固件可监测链路并作为蜂窝网络或 Wi-Fi 遥控端，仓库还提供 EVO-One 接口引脚图和接线图。
requirements: A Fortin remote starter or alarm system and a Particle Electron or Photon with suitable level shifting.
BSD-3-Clause License; compiled builds may include AssetTrackerRK under a separate licence.

name: NVFC: recovering undocumented NvAPI GPU controls
description_en: NVFC implements undocumented NvAPI interfaces for NVIDIA GPU monitoring and configuration. The author recovered the interfaces by observing nvapi_QueryInterface calls in existing utilities; the C++ tool reads clocks, voltage, temperature and fan state and can set fan behavior.
description_zh: NVFC 实现 NVIDIA GPU 监测与配置所需的未公开 NvAPI 接口。作者观察现有工具对 nvapi_QueryInterface 的调用以恢复接口；C++ 工具读取时钟、电压、温度和风扇状态，并可设置风扇行为。
requirements: Windows 7, 8 or 10; NVIDIA display driver 384.76 or later and a 400 Series or newer GPU.
Visual Studio 2017 for the supplied C++17 solution.
No licence file in the repository.

name: PythonWifiBulb: reconstructing MagicLight bulb commands
description_en: PythonWifiBulb reconstructs MagicLight Wi-Fi bulb control from captured phone-to-bulb traffic. The Python class sends RGB and warm-white commands over TCP, while its notes describe port 5577, message bytes and a checksum helper.
description_zh: PythonWifiBulb 根据手机与 MagicLight Wi-Fi 灯泡之间抓取的流量还原控制命令。Python 类通过 TCP 发送 RGB 和暖白光命令，文档记录了 5577 端口、消息字节和校验和处理方法。
requirements: A MagicLight Wi-Fi bulb must be configured on the local network and its IP address obtained.
The author used two bulb versions identified as v5 and v7.
Licensed under MIT.

name: SingStar Mic: reconstructing the microphone app protocol
description_en: SingStar Mic documentation reconstructs the Android and iOS app's local discovery, catalogue and game-service exchanges. It specifies UDP and HTTP ports, packet structure, commands, audio format and acknowledgement behavior, with a Python proof-of-concept server.
description_zh: SingStar Mic 文档还原 Android 和 iOS 应用的本地发现、曲库及游戏服务交互。它记录 UDP 与 HTTP 端口、数据包结构、命令、音频格式和确认机制，并附有 Python 概念验证服务器。
requirements: Python 3 and a phone running the SingStar Mic app on the same network are required for the server example.
Released under the Unlicense.

name: Laser Drift: reconstructing Carrera infrared slot-car control
description_en: Laser Drift emulates the infrared controllers of Carrera Digital 132/124 slot cars. A Python game loop synchronizes with the IR tower, encodes player state into controller packets and accepts speed and lane-change commands from a TCP server.
description_zh: Laser Drift 模拟 Carrera Digital 132/124 轨道赛车的红外控制器。Python 游戏循环与红外塔同步，把玩家状态编码成控制数据包，并通过 TCP 服务器接收速度和换道命令。
requirements: Carrera Digital 132/124 track, control unit, wireless receiver and a USB infrared transceiver.
Linux, Python 3 and lirc 0.10 or later.
Only older infrared controllers are emulated; 2.4 GHz wireless controllers are unsupported.
MIT License.

name: Novluno: parsing Redmoon Online data for a modern client
description_en: Novluno investigates Redmoon Online data files and builds a Rust client that reads the original files. Its core_compat crate parses LST lists, RLE sprites, RMD data, RMM maps and RMI information files; format notes trace references between map, data, list and sprite files.
description_zh: Novluno 研究 Redmoon Online 的数据文件，并构建读取原版文件的 Rust 客户端。core_compat crate 解析 LST 列表、RLE 精灵、RMD 数据、RMM 地图和 RMI 信息文件；格式笔记梳理了这些文件之间的引用关系。
requirements: Original Redmoon Online data files are required in ./data; the parsers are based on version 3.9.
The data files are currently required for tests; some filenames may need case normalization.
RMS sound files and MIDI files still need parsers.
Released under the Unlicense.

name: mx3000control: reconstructing Perixx MX-3000 HID settings
description_en: mx3000control configures the Perixx MX-3000 mouse on Linux using HID feature reports recovered from its Windows driver. The C tool sets DPI, sensitivity, LED behavior, buttons and macros; a development log documents analysis of the mouse communication.
description_zh: mx3000control 根据 Windows 驱动分析得到的 HID 功能报告，在 Linux 上配置 Perixx MX-3000 鼠标。C 工具支持 DPI、灵敏度、LED、按键和宏设置，开发日志记录了通信分析过程。
requirements: A Perixx MX-3000 mouse and Linux access to its USB device.
A C compiler, pkg-config and HIDAPI to build.
MIT License.

name: Mario vs. Donkey Kong: a Game Boy Advance disassembly
description_en: Mario vs. Donkey Kong is disassembled into ARM assembly and C sources that build a Game Boy Advance ROM with a specified MD5 hash. The build uses a user-provided US ROM, devkitARM and pokeruby-tools.
description_zh: 该项目将美版 Mario vs. Donkey Kong 拆解为 ARM 汇编与 C 源码，构建出具有指定 MD5 值的 Game Boy Advance ROM。构建需要用户提供原版 ROM，并安装 devkitARM 与 pokeruby-tools。
requirements: A copy of the Mario vs. Donkey Kong ROM named baserom.gba.
devkitARM and the tools folder from pokeruby-tools; build with make in its MSYS environment.
No licence file in the repository.

name: jeep-canbus: decoding the Jeep Grand Cherokee CAN-B bus
description_en: jeep-canbus documents byte-level meanings of observed CAN-B frames in a Jeep Grand Cherokee WH. The repository combines capture-based ID maps with an ATmega328 radio gateway and an ESP32 dashboard that receives and interprets vehicle data.
description_zh: jeep-canbus 记录 Jeep Grand Cherokee WH 的 CAN-B 帧及其字节含义。仓库将基于抓包整理的 ID 映射、ATmega328 车载收音机网关，以及接收和解释车辆数据的 ESP32 仪表程序放在一起。
requirements: The documented vehicle is a 2005 Jeep Grand Cherokee WH with an 83.333 kbps interior CAN-B bus.
The gateway uses an ATmega328 and MCP2515/MCP2551 module; the dashboard uses an ESP32-S3 connected by UART.
Some mapped values are labelled probable, candidate or unknown.
Licensed under MIT.

name: MDK in C# and SDL3: reconstructing the 1997 game
description_en: MDK in C# and SDL3 ports the 1997 game using reconstructed data formats and behavior from MDKD3D.EXE. It reads levels, textures, models, sound and scripts from the user's installed copy and implements the original's BSP collision and script-driven gameplay on SDL3.
description_zh: MDK in C# and SDL3 根据 MDKD3D.EXE 及原游戏数据重建 1997 年 MDK 的格式和行为。移植版通过 SDL3 运行，从用户安装的游戏读取关卡、纹理、模型、声音和脚本，并实现原版 BSP 碰撞与脚本驱动的玩法。
requirements: An installed copy of the original MDK game data.
.NET 10 and SDL3 for source builds.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: Samsung Galaxy Book4 Edge: reconstructing EC communication for Linux
description_en: Samsung Galaxy Book4 Edge Linux Research & Support investigates the ENE KB9058 embedded controller and its I2C mailbox communication. The author describes static analysis of the ARM64 EC2.sys driver and provides EC probing scripts, protocol notes and a Linux battery module for the laptop.
description_zh: Samsung Galaxy Book4 Edge Linux Research & Support 调查 ENE KB9058 嵌入式控制器及其 I2C 邮箱通信。作者记录了对 ARM64 驱动 EC2.sys 的静态分析，并提供 EC 探测脚本、协议笔记和适用于该笔记本的 Linux 电池模块。
requirements: Samsung Galaxy Book4 Edge hardware is the target.
The software is experimental; keyboard, touchpad and fan support are partial, while speakers, GPU and camera/fingerprint support are listed as broken.
The repository licence file is GPL-2.0; the README identifies MIT terms for tools and documentation where applicable.

name: Alien Soldier: byte-identical Mega Drive cartridge reconstruction
description_en: Alien Soldier source reconstruction rebuilds the Japanese and European Mega Drive cartridges from shared 68000 assembly and a separate Z80 sound-program source. The author reports byte-identical builds from user-supplied ROM dumps and provides format documentation, content-editing tools and a MAME attract-sequence check.
description_zh: Alien Soldier source reconstruction 使用共用的 68000 汇编源码和独立的 Z80 音效程序源码重建日版、欧版 Mega Drive 卡带。作者报告，使用用户自备的 ROM 转储可逐字节重建卡带；项目还提供格式文档、内容编辑工具和 MAME 演示片段检查。
requirements: Users must supply their own Japanese and European Alien Soldier cartridge dumps.
Python and Retrolarium Kit are required for building; MAME is required for the attract-sequence check.
MAME runtime coverage currently includes the Japanese attract sequence, not a full playthrough or European runtime.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Bose-Reverse-Engineering: investigating the 321GS Series III SmartSpeaker link
description_en: Bose-Reverse-Engineering investigates the SmartSpeaker link between a Bose 321GS Series III console and bass module. The author documents connector pinouts, probes a 4800-baud half-duplex UART exchange, and provides Arduino firmware and KiCad hardware for a replacement console.
description_zh: Bose-Reverse-Engineering 调查 Bose 321GS Series III 控制台与低音模块之间的 SmartSpeaker 通信，记录接口引脚及 4800 波特半双工 UART 报文，并提供替代控制台的 Arduino 固件和 KiCad 硬件文件。
requirements: Bose 321GS Series III hardware is the investigated system.
The investigation stopped after a functioning audio system was restored; some protocol questions remain unanswered.

name: Pioneer DJM-850: mapping mixer control and audio over USB
description_en: The Pioneer DJM-850 study maps USB exchanges between the mixer and its Windows driver and Setting Utility to inform Linux support. Captures and notes cover mixer input and output choices, ASIO settings, DVS timecode and music transfer, channel routing, sample rate and buffer behavior.
description_zh: Pioneer DJM-850 研究通过抓取调音台与 Windows 驱动及设置工具之间的 USB 数据，为 Linux 支持整理通信行为。抓包与文档覆盖输入输出选项、ASIO 设置、DVS 时间码和音乐传输、通道路由、采样率及缓冲行为。
requirements: Pioneer DJM-850-S with firmware 1.10 and Windows driver 1.500 were used for the documented study.
MIDI communication behavior was outside the author's planned study.
MIT license.

name: HyperX Pulsefire Dart Reverse Engineering: mouse control protocol
description_en: HyperX Pulsefire Dart Reverse Engineering documents the mouse's USB control protocol from captured exchanges with NGenuity Beta and trial-and-error probing. It records 64-byte messages, settings commands, packet captures, a HIDAPI example and a work-in-progress Wireshark dissector.
description_zh: HyperX Pulsefire Dart Reverse Engineering 通过抓取 NGenuity Beta 与鼠标之间的数据包并试探命令，还原其 USB 控制协议。仓库记录 64 字节消息及设置命令，并提供抓包、HIDAPI 示例和仍在编写的 Wireshark 解析脚本。
requirements: HyperX Pulsefire Dart mouse, identified as USB 0951:16E1 in wireless mode or 0951:16E2 in wired mode.
HIDAPI and a C compiler for the example program.
The Wireshark dissector is work in progress.
CC0 1.0 Universal.

name: Govee H6159: reconstructing direct Bluetooth light control
description_en: Govee H6159 light-strip reverse engineer provides Linux shell scripts that send Bluetooth GATT commands directly to the H6159 light strip. The README documents device discovery, a characteristic write and basic commands for power and red, green or blue lighting.
description_zh: Govee H6159 light-strip reverse engineer 提供 Linux shell 脚本，直接向 H6159 灯带发送蓝牙 GATT 命令。README 记录设备发现、特征值写入，以及开关和红、绿、蓝三种颜色的基本控制。
requirements: A Govee H6159 light strip, Linux Bluetooth adapter, Bluetooth service, root access and gatttool are required.
The author developed the scripts on Ubuntu 16.04 LTS and last reports running them in March 2021.
Control is limited to power and red, green or blue color commands.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Redragon RGB Controller: reconstructing keyboard and mouse HID color commands
description_en: Redragon RGB Controller sends recovered USB HID commands to set colors on Redragon Kala keyboards and Griffin mice. The author describes capturing the vendor software's USB exchanges with Wireshark and USBPcap, identifying command sequences, and implementing them in a Node.js CLI using node-hid.
description_zh: Redragon RGB Controller 向 Redragon Kala 键盘和 Griffin 鼠标发送还原的 USB HID 命令以设置灯光颜色。作者使用 Wireshark 和 USBPcap 捕获原软件通信，识别命令序列，并通过 node-hid 实现 Node.js 命令行工具。
requirements: Node.js dependencies include node-hid.
The README lists Kala keyboard and Griffin mouse variants as tested devices.
Brightness and effect-type commands remain on the TODO list.
MIT.

name: PES6 decompilation: matching the PS2 PAL executable and overlays
description_en: PES6 decompilation reconstructs C source for the PlayStation 2 PAL release of Pro Evolution Soccer 6, covering its resident executable, 26 executable overlays and an auxiliary ELF. Local builds compare recovered functions with the user's game inputs; the author reports 10,930 exact function matches and separately tracks provisional nonmatching C.
description_zh: PES6 decompilation 为 PlayStation 2 PAL 版 Pro Evolution Soccer 6 重建 C 源码，涵盖主程序、26 个可执行覆盖模块及辅助 ELF。本地构建使用用户自备游戏文件比较函数；作者报告已有 10,930 个函数精确匹配，并单独统计暂定的非匹配 C 代码。
requirements: A user's own supported PAL disc image containing SLES-542.03 is required.
Linux or WSL, Python 3.11+, Bash, MIPS binutils and separately supplied compiler binaries are required.
The author reports 10,930 exact matches among 34,901 function targets; nonmatching reconstructions have provisional types and call contracts.
The repository contains GPL-2.0 and other third-party licence notices; see LICENSES and THIRD_PARTY.md.

name: Rogue Squadron 3D: a native PC port by static recompilation
description_en: Rogue Squadron 3D recompiles the Steam PC release of Star Wars: Rogue Squadron 3D from x86 machine code to C with pcrecomp and runs the result in a 32-bit Windows host. The host adapts DirectDraw display handling and input, while generated code and original game files are produced or copied from the user's installation.
description_zh: Rogue Squadron 3D 使用 pcrecomp 将 Steam 版 Star Wars: Rogue Squadron 3D 的 x86 机器码静态转换为 C，并在 32 位 Windows 宿主程序中运行。宿主适配 DirectDraw 显示和输入，生成代码及原游戏文件来自用户本机的安装副本。
requirements: A user-owned Steam copy of Star Wars: Rogue Squadron 3D version 1.3, Windows 10 or 11, and about 4 GB of free space.
Source builds require Python 3.10+, pcrecomp, Visual Studio C++ tools, CMake 3.20+ and Ninja.
The author reports headless runs; later-level playthrough, sound, physical gamepad and on-screen window behavior remain untested.
MIT license for repository-authored code.

name: Drama Live: analysing its Android and web clients and rebuilding an API client
description_en: Drama Live analysis documents the Android APK and web PWA of the IPTV player, including their component stacks, endpoint maps and content-source flows. It implements a Flutter client and Node reference backend around the described Xtream Codes player_api.php contract, with synthetic and locally served test media.
description_zh: Drama Live analysis 记录这款 IPTV 播放器的 Android APK 与网页 PWA，包括组件栈、接口路径和内容来源流程。项目按整理出的 Xtream Codes player_api.php 契约实现 Flutter 客户端及 Node 参考后端，并使用合成数据和本地测试媒体。
requirements: Node 18+ for the reference backend; Flutter for the client.
The analysis artifacts require a separately obtained APK or publicly served web build.
MIT license.

name: L1J-Encode-CLI: reconstructed Lineage 1 ServerData codec
description_en: L1J-Encode-CLI reconstructs the Lineage 1 launcher's ServerData encoding as a Python encoder and decoder for IP addresses, ports, and feature flags. Its report describes disassembly, memory inspection, and differential analysis of Encode v3.63; the author reports byte-for-byte agreement in 106 comparisons with Encode.exe.
description_zh: L1J-Encode-CLI 将 Lineage 1 登录器的 ServerData 编码还原为 Python 编解码器，可处理 IP、端口和功能位。分析报告记录了对 Encode v3.63 的反汇编、内存观察和差分分析；作者称与 Encode.exe 的 106 组对比结果逐字节一致。
requirements: Python standard library; the codec has no external dependencies.
The keystream table is calibrated for Encode v3.63 and needs recalibration for other versions.
The bit3 flag requires an additional transformation file for the official tool to set it; client acceptance depends on that file.
The author reports 106 of 106 byte-for-byte comparisons with Encode.exe matched.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Techstream for Linux: recovering Toyota diagnostic formats and workflows
description_en: Techstream for Linux reconstructs selected Toyota and Lexus diagnostic resource formats, command behavior and transport handling in a Python GTK4 workbench. It browses local CT and DDB data, decodes recordings and replays diagnostic sessions using synthetic fixtures. The author reports that physical vehicle communication remains unconfirmed.
description_zh: Techstream for Linux 用 Python 和 GTK4 重建部分 Toyota/Lexus 诊断资源格式、命令行为与传输处理。工作台可浏览本地 CT、DDB 数据，解码记录并用合成数据回放诊断会话。作者表示，实体车辆通信尚未确认。
requirements: Python 3.11+; the desktop requires Linux, PyGObject, GTK4 and libadwaita 1.5+.
Compatible manufacturer resources must be obtained separately with the necessary rights.
Physical vehicle communication remains unconfirmed; the author reports 6,617 passing tests at the cited code checkpoint.
MIT license.

name: Magenta Bridge: reconstructing Octavi IFR-1 HID control for MSFS 2024
description_en: Magenta Bridge implements direct HID communication with the Octavi IFR-1 flight-simulator panel in a Windows client for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. Its source handles panel input and SimConnect mappings for radios, autopilot and transponder controls; the author says the HID protocol was recovered through observation.
description_zh: Magenta Bridge 为 Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 提供直接与 Octavi IFR-1 飞行模拟面板通信的 Windows 客户端。源码处理面板 HID 输入，并通过 SimConnect 映射电台、自动驾驶和应答机控制；作者称 HID 协议由观察还原。
requirements: Windows 11, Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and an Octavi IFR-1 panel are required; building from source requires the .NET 8 SDK.
The author reports live testing with MSFS 2024 and a physical IFR-1.
GNS530/430 knobs and five softkeys require in-simulator code beyond the client's scope; the launch mode is unknown until a control is touched.
MIT.

name: motospeedv40-re: decoding Motospeed V40 mouse HID commands
description_en: motospeedv40-re documents USB HID commands used by the Motospeed V40 mouse. The author captured Windows-driver traffic with Wireshark and records report sizes, initialization and settings commands, DPI byte values, and packet captures with diffs.
description_zh: motospeedv40-re 记录 Motospeed V40 鼠标的 USB HID 命令。作者使用 Wireshark 捕获 Windows 驱动通信，整理报告长度、初始化与设置命令、DPI 字节值，并保存抓包和差异文件。
requirements: A Motospeed V40 mouse and its Windows driver are the documented capture inputs.
The packet-capture workflow lists Wireshark, VirtualBox, a Windows ISO, usbutils and diffutils.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Exway X1 Pro: sniffing skateboard remote telemetry
description_en: The Exway X1 Pro study investigates radio traffic between an electric skateboard and its remote. An Arduino sniffer using an nRF24L01+ transceiver listens to packets and exposes direction, gear and throttle readings; accompanying notes describe the remote hardware and radio investigation.
description_zh: Exway X1 Pro 研究滑板与遥控器之间的无线流量。项目提供基于 Arduino 和 nRF24L01+ 的监听器，可从报文中提取方向、档位与油门读数，并附有遥控器硬件和无线链路分析笔记。
requirements: Arduino-compatible hardware, an nRF24L01+ transceiver and the RF24 library.
The sniffer currently supports Exway boards and Arduino only; the author is improving telemetry-reading performance.
No licence file in the repository.

name: CoffeConnect: reconstructing DeLonghi ESAM 4000 panel control
description_en: CoffeConnect investigates the DeLonghi ESAM 4000 control-panel circuit and its clock, serial-input and strobe signaling. A Raspberry Pi sampling script supports protocol inspection, while an ESP8266 prototype generates panel signals and exchanges MQTT messages with an Android app.
description_zh: CoffeConnect 研究 DeLonghi ESAM 4000 控制面板电路及其时钟、串行输入和选通信号。项目提供 Raspberry Pi 采样脚本，并以 ESP8266 生成面板信号，通过 MQTT 与 Android 应用通信。
requirements: DeLonghi ESAM 4000, Raspberry Pi 3B for the documented capture method, and an ESP8266 for the control prototype.
Raspberry Pi GPIO sampling misses some samples at the reported clock frequency; the source recommends a logic analyzer or oscilloscope for deeper analysis.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Vibease: decoding the BLE vibration-control protocol
description_en: Vibease documents the BLE communication used by a Vibease vibrator. The author maps read and write characteristics, a device-supplied handshake key, XOR-based scrambling, Base64 encoding and fragmentation, and commands for fixed vibration and patterns; the repository also contains captures and Python utilities.
description_zh: Vibease 记录 Vibease 振动器的 BLE 通信。作者梳理读写特征、设备在握手时发送的密钥、基于 XOR 的混淆、Base64 编码与分片，以及固定振动和振动模式命令；仓库还保存通信日志与 Python 工具。
requirements: A Vibease BLE device is the investigated hardware.
The author describes some command behavior and alternative UUID compatibility as uncertain.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Mieo HA102: decoding a power meter's RF packets
description_en: The Mieo HA102 study reconstructs the power meter's 433.9 MHz FSK packet format from recorded signals. It maps current, cumulative consumption and battery fields, describes CRC16/SPI-FUJITSU checking, and supplies a Python decoder for live rtl_433 output or saved captures.
description_zh: Mieo HA102 研究根据录制的信号整理电力计的 433.9 MHz FSK 报文格式，标注电流、累计用量和电池状态字段及 CRC16/SPI-FUJITSU 校验，并提供可处理 rtl_433 实时输出或录制样本的 Python 解码器。
requirements: Mieo HA102 meter captures or live rtl_433 output for decoding.
Several packet fields remain unidentified.
MIT license.

name: Midea IR tap: reconstructing a heat pump's inter-board commands
description_en: esphome-midea-ir-tap reconstructs the demodulated infrared commands carried between a Midea-built heat pump's display and control boards. It documents six-byte frame timing and checksum behavior, provides ESP32 capture and decoding tools, and uses ESPHome to expose local controls and state in Home Assistant.
description_zh: esphome-midea-ir-tap 重建 Midea 代工热泵显示板与控制板之间传递的解调红外指令。项目记录六字节帧的时序和校验，提供 ESP32 采样与解码工具，并通过 ESPHome 将本地控制和状态接入 Home Assistant。
requirements: Tested on Lennox MWMB012S4 / MPB012S4S with ESP32 DevKit v1 and ESPHome 2026.6.2.
Opening the indoor unit exposes 115 V; disconnect power before wiring. Other models and ESP32 variants are untested.
MIT license.

name: Tesvor X500: reconstructing local UART control and path data
description_en: The Tesvor X500/X500 Pro project reconstructs the robot vacuum's local UART control and path-point messages for its ESP8266/ESP-12S module. ESPHome firmware exposes cleaning commands to Home Assistant and publishes path data over MQTT for a Python writer and map viewer.
description_zh: Tesvor X500/X500 Pro 项目重建扫地机器人的本地 UART 控制与路径点消息，并在原有 ESP8266/ESP-12S 模块上运行 ESPHome。固件向 Home Assistant 提供清扫指令，经 MQTT 发送路径数据供 Python 写入器和地图页面使用。
requirements: The documented setup uses a Tesvor X500/X500 Pro with an ESP-12S module and an MQTT broker; it was tested with ESPHome 2025.7.x.
Back up the original 4 MB firmware before flashing; mop-cleaning and fan controls are experimental.
MIT license.

name: Fluval Plant Pro 4.0: reconstructing BLE light control
description_en: The Fluval Plant Pro 4.0 project reconstructs the light's CBOR-over-BLE control protocol from the FluvalConnect Android app. An ESP32 ESPHome configuration sends commands through vendor service FFF0 and exposes power, five color channels, schedules and state updates to Home Assistant.
description_zh: Fluval Plant Pro 4.0 项目通过分析 FluvalConnect Android 应用重建灯具的 CBOR over BLE 控制协议。ESP32 上的 ESPHome 配置经 FFF0 服务发送指令，并将开关、五路颜色、日程和状态同步接入 Home Assistant。
requirements: Fluval Plant Pro 4.0, an ESP32 with BLE and Wi-Fi, Home Assistant with ESPHome, and the light's Bluetooth MAC address.
The light permits only one Bluetooth connection at a time; remaining status keys 14–22 are undecoded.
MIT license.

name: Bambu Lab P2S: reconstructing LAN printer control
description_en: The Bambu Lab P2S bridge reconstructs LAN control and monitoring for the printer from direct protocol probes. Its notes describe MQTT state deltas and commands, SSDP discovery, RTSPS H.264 video and FTPS session reuse; a TypeScript service and web client use those findings for local operation.
description_zh: Bambu Lab P2S bridge 根据直接协议探测重建打印机的局域网控制与监测。文档记录 MQTT 状态增量和指令、SSDP 发现、RTSPS H.264 视频及 FTPS 会话复用，TypeScript 服务与网页客户端据此提供本地操作。
requirements: Bambu Lab P2S in LAN Mode with Developer Mode enabled and its access code; an always-on Linux host with Docker and Compose.
The author reports that automatic part ejection is experimental and its automatic trigger has only run in unit tests.
MIT license.

name: Beurer BM59 Unlocked: reconstructing direct BLE measurement transfer
description_en: Beurer BM59 Unlocked documents the BLE exchange used by a BM59 blood pressure monitor to transfer measurements. From Android HCI captures, the author maps Nordic UART handles, the time write and measurement indications, and provides a Python client using Linux L2CAP/ATT sockets.
description_zh: Beurer BM59 Unlocked 记录 BM59 血压计传输测量结果的 BLE 交互。作者依据 Android HCI 抓包确定 Nordic UART 句柄、时间写入与测量值指示报文的顺序，并提供通过 Linux L2CAP/ATT 套接字通信的 Python 客户端。
requirements: A Beurer BM59 in transfer mode, Linux, a Bluetooth adapter and root access are required.
Stored-history retrieval is in progress; the author reports receiving new measurements.
MIT.

name: PiBuddyCam: reconstructing Buddy3D camera cloud behavior
description_en: PiBuddyCam recreates the Prusa Buddy3D camera's cloud communication on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W using a protocol the author says was recovered from firmware. It registers with Prusa Connect, uploads snapshots, follows camera settings and answers WebRTC live-view requests; protocol documentation accompanies the implementation.
description_zh: PiBuddyCam 根据作者从 Prusa Buddy3D 摄像头固件中分析出的协议，让 Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W 与 Prusa Connect 通信。它可注册摄像头、上传快照、接收设置并响应 WebRTC 实时查看请求，仓库同时提供协议文档。
requirements: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W, CSI camera module and microSD card; a Prusa Connect camera token is needed for cloud registration.
The author reports that Prusa Connect may hide live-view controls, and 90°/270° rotation remains to be checked on hardware.
MIT license.

name: AirDrop for Windows: investigating iPhone discovery and AWDL reception
description_en: AirDrop for Windows investigates how an iPhone discovers receivers and sends files over AWDL. Its .NET receiver implements mDNS announcements, AirDrop endpoints and archive extraction; logs and research notes document the missing Windows radio path.
description_zh: AirDrop for Windows 研究 iPhone 如何发现接收设备并通过 AWDL 传文件。其 .NET 接收端实现 mDNS 广播、AirDrop 接口和归档解包；日志和研究笔记记录了 Windows 无线通信环节的缺口。
requirements: The research and receiver target Windows with .NET 10.
The author reports that the tested Windows Wi-Fi driver lacks the radio access needed for AWDL; native iPhone-to-PC transfers remain unfinished.
MIT license.

name: Wirenet Reverse Engineering: analysing a Linux trojan
description_en: Wirenet Reverse Engineering investigates the Wirenet Linux trojan through recovered source code and an Italian analysis report. The report covers the malware's workings, while an accompanying article focuses on its keylogger implementation.
description_zh: Wirenet Reverse Engineering 通过恢复的源码和意大利语分析报告研究 Wirenet Linux 木马，另有文章聚焦其键盘记录功能。
requirements: The analysis report is in Italian.
The repository includes a live Linux trojan sample.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: International Rally Championship: an x86-to-C native recompilation
description_en: ircrecomp statically translates International Rally Championship's RAL.EXE x86 functions into C and compiles a native 64-bit Windows game from the user's CD image. An SDL3 runtime replaces Windows 98 and DirectX 5 interfaces; analysis covers code discovery, relocations and jump tables.
description_zh: ircrecomp 将《International Rally Championship》的 RAL.EXE x86 函数静态转换为 C，再利用用户的 CD 镜像构建 64 位 Windows 游戏。其 SDL3 运行时替代 Windows 98 与 DirectX 5 接口，分析流程涵盖代码发现、重定位和跳转表。
requirements: Use the CD image with RAL.EXE 4.81, supplied as .cue and .bin files.
Windows 10 or 11 64-bit is supported; source use requires Python 3.10+.
Physical gamepad and steering-wheel controls are unfinished; network multiplayer is outside scope.
MIT licence.

name: MVP Baseball 2005: matching GameCube decompilation
description_en: MVP Baseball 2005 reconstructs C++ source for the USA GameCube release and compares built functions with the retail main.dol. Its configured units include Nintendo and EA libraries plus early game geometry code; the remaining program is assembled from a user-supplied disc image.
description_zh: MVP Baseball 2005 为美版 GameCube 游戏重建 C++ 源码，并将编译后的函数与原版 main.dol 比较。已配置的单元涵盖 Nintendo、EA 库和早期游戏几何代码；其余程序从用户自备光盘映像生成汇编。
requirements: A personal copy of the USA GameCube disc revision 0 or its main.dol is required.
Building requires Python 3 and ninja; the configured toolchain includes the original linker.
The author reports 4.67% of functions exact in the cited progress snapshot, mostly imported libraries.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: SmashUpDerby: reconstructing the Smash Up Derby player
description_en: SmashUpDerby reconstructs the Smash Up Derby player in C++. The source creates a Windows window, reads player settings from the registry, loads Virtools plugins and initializes a render context.
description_zh: SmashUpDerby 用 C++ 重建《Smash Up Derby》的播放器。源码创建 Windows 窗口，从注册表读取播放器设置，加载 Virtools 插件并初始化渲染上下文。
requirements: Windows and Virtools headers and runtime plugins are required by the source.
The source is released under the Unlicense.

name: CTR Reload Edition: extending a native Crash Team Racing port
description_en: CTR Reload Edition extends the ctr-native Crash Team Racing port into a Windows edition with a Vulkan renderer and tools for custom tracks and characters. It runs the original game logic while a native engine draws selected races and reads game content from the user's NTSC-U disc image.
description_zh: CTR Reload Edition 在 ctr-native《Crash Team Racing》移植版基础上开发 Windows 版本，加入 Vulkan 渲染器及自定义赛道、角色制作工具。原版游戏逻辑继续运行，原生引擎绘制部分比赛场景，游戏内容取自用户的 NTSC-U 光盘镜像。
requirements: Requires the user's Crash Team Racing NTSC-U disc image, SCUS-94426, in .cue/.bin format.
Requires Windows 10 version 1903 or newer, or Windows 11, with a Vulkan 1.0 driver.
The current release is 0.7.5 Beta.
GPL-3.0 licence.

name: Legaia 2: Duel Saga: matching the PAL PlayStation 2 executable
description_en: Legaia2-Decomp reconstructs the PAL PlayStation 2 release of Legaia 2: Duel Saga as readable C with a byte-for-byte executable match as its goal. Its tree includes recovered source, Ghidra scripts, build tools and a browser viewer for models, textures, audio, motions and effects from the user's disc image.
description_zh: Legaia2-Decomp 将 PAL 版 PlayStation 2《Legaia 2: Duel Saga》重构为可读 C 代码，目标是逐字节复现可执行文件。仓库提供源码、Ghidra 脚本、构建工具，以及读取用户光盘镜像中模型、纹理、音频、动作和特效的浏览器查看器。
requirements: Supply the PAL Legaia 2: Duel Saga disc image as SLES_50891.ISO.
Requires Python 3, Clang, LLD and EE-GCC 2.9-ee-991111-01; Windows users need WSL.
The matching decompilation remains in progress; the asset viewer's effects are rough previews.
MIT licence.

name: Grand Prix 4 Decompilation: behavior-matched GP4.exe functions
description_en: Grand Prix 4 Decompilation reconstructs GP4.exe functions as C++ and compares each candidate with the original under generated emulator inputs. Its repository includes a function ledger, input layouts and an in-game hook; the author reports 5,669 functions accepted by differential emulation while a playable replacement remains unfinished.
description_zh: Grand Prix 4 Decompilation 将 GP4.exe 的函数重构为 C++，并用生成输入在模拟器中对照原函数。仓库提供函数进度清单、输入布局和游戏内挂钩；作者报告已有 5,669 个函数通过差分模拟，仍未形成可玩的替代程序。
requirements: Requires the user's copy of the specified Grand Prix 4 GP4.exe build.
The author reports 5,669 functions accepted by differential emulation and 306 awaiting in-game checks.
The reconstruction does not yet build a playable replacement executable.
MIT licence.

name: Twilight Princess VR: porting the game to Apple Vision Pro
description_en: Twilight Princess VR ports The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess to Apple Vision Pro using Dusklight's decompilation-based PC version and the TPVR mod. Its visionOS app runs the game framework with immersive, portal and window views, and loads a disc image supplied by the user.
description_zh: Twilight Princess VR 基于 Dusklight 的反编译版 PC 游戏和 TPVR 模组，将《塞尔达传说：黄昏公主》移植到 Apple Vision Pro。visionOS 应用运行游戏框架，提供全沉浸、渐进式门户和窗口三种视图，并加载用户提供的游戏光盘镜像。
requirements: Apple Vision Pro with visionOS 26 or later and an Apple Silicon Mac with Xcode and the visionOS SDK are required.
Supply a personally owned Twilight Princess GameCube or supported Wii disc image in .iso, .rvz or .wbfs format.
Homebrew, CMake, Ninja, XcodeGen and the specified Rust nightly toolchain are required for the documented build.
The Korean Wii release is excluded; signing with a free Apple developer account is untested.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: sead: reconstructing Nintendo EAD engine libraries used by NSMBU
description_en: sead reconstructs Nintendo EAD engine and library code found in New Super Mario Bros. U and other games. Its C++ tree covers framework, containers, graphics, audio and file devices, with a current goal of matching the original functionality rather than its compiled bytes.
description_zh: sead 用 C++ 重构《New Super Mario Bros. U》等游戏中的 Nintendo EAD 引擎与库代码，涵盖框架、容器、图形、音频和文件设备。项目目前以与原版功能一一对应为目标，不追求编译后字节一致。
requirements: Byte-identical matching is outside the current goal because the compiler version used for NSMBU is unavailable.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Tourist Trophy: matching decompilation of the PS2 CORE.TT executable
description_en: Tourist Trophy decompilation reconstructs functions from the PS2 game's CORE.TT executable as C and C++ compiled with Sony ee-gcc 2.96. Its tools decrypt and split a user-provided executable, compare individual functions and check the complete linked build against the original.
description_zh: Tourist Trophy decompilation 将 PS2 游戏 CORE.TT 中的函数重建为 C/C++，并使用 Sony ee-gcc 2.96 编译。工具链解密和拆分用户提供的程序，逐函数比较，并检查完整链接结果与原版是否一致。
requirements: A personal copy of the NTSC-U SCUS-97502 v1.00 game disc is required.
Setup requires Linux or WSL, Python 3.11+ with rabbitizer, and the project compiler and MIPS tools.
The author reports 22,501 of 31,593 functions matching in the October 2026 progress snapshot; the project remains in progress.
MIT license.

name: Harvest Moon: Back to Nature: matching PS1 executable reconstruction
description_en: backtonature-decompiled reconstructs the US PlayStation release of Harvest Moon: Back to Nature as C that compiles to a byte-identical SLUS_011.15 executable. Its build generates reference assembly and game data locally from a user-provided copy, then checks individual functions and the full executable.
description_zh: backtonature-decompiled 将美版 PlayStation 游戏 Harvest Moon: Back to Nature 重建为 C 源码，编译得到逐字节一致的 SLUS_011.15。构建时从用户自备游戏生成参考汇编和数据，并检查各函数及完整程序。
requirements: A legally obtained US SLUS-01115 game copy and a PSY-Q 4.6 SDK are required.
Building requires Docker and Python 3.10+ on the host.
The reconstructed scope excludes linked PSY-Q runtime libraries and A_FILE.BIN code overlays.
Unlicense.

name: Virtua Cop: statically recompiling the Model 2 arcade game
description_en: Virtua Cop statically recompiles the Sega Model 2 arcade game's i960 program ROM into C for a native Windows build. A ROM loader prepares flat images from the user's ROM set, and the generated C links with model2recomp to model the board and render the game. The author reports that the game boots and plays a stage; sound is unimplemented.
description_zh: Virtua Cop 将 Sega Model 2 街机游戏的 i960 程序 ROM 静态转换为 C，构建原生 Windows 程序。ROM 加载器从用户提供的 ROM 集生成平坦镜像，生成的 C 代码与 model2recomp 链接，由后者模拟主板并渲染游戏。作者报告游戏可以启动并游玩关卡；声音尚未实现。
requirements: A Virtua Cop vcop or vcopa ROM set owned or dumped by the user.
Windows 10 or 11, Visual Studio 2022, CMake 3.20 or newer, SDL2 via vcpkg, and Python 3.10 or newer.
Sound is not implemented, and a full stage playthrough has not been checked.
MIT License.

name: Digimon World 2003: a native PC port from decompiled C
description_en: Digimon World 2003 is ported from decompiled C code for the European PlayStation release into a native Windows program. The port replaces console graphics, audio, files, controls and memory card services with PC implementations using OpenGL and SDL, and reads game content from the user's disc image.
description_zh: 该项目将欧洲版 PlayStation 游戏 Digimon World 2003 的反编译 C 代码编译成原生 Windows 程序，以 OpenGL 和 SDL 实现图形、音频、文件、控制及记忆卡服务，并从用户提供的光盘镜像读取游戏内容。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 and a graphics card supporting OpenGL 3.3.
A disc image of Digimon World 2003 (Europe), SLES-03936; a .cue/.bin pair is preferred.
The American and Japanese releases are refused by the port.
MIT License.

name: ct-recomp: statically recompiling Chrono Trigger
description_en: ct-recomp statically translates Chrono Trigger US 1.0's 65816 routines into C and runs them with a C runtime, interpreter fallback and SDL2 front end. Its tools compare memory, images and instruction traces with Mesen 2. The author reports 1,414 of 2,036 known functions compiled to C.
description_zh: ct-recomp 将《Chrono Trigger》美国版 1.0 的 65816 例程静态转换为 C，配合 C 运行时、解释器回退和 SDL2 前端运行。工具可与 Mesen 2 比较内存、画面和指令轨迹；作者报告 2,036 个已知函数中有 1,414 个编译为 C。
requirements: Requires a user-supplied, headerless Chrono Trigger US 1.0 ROM for the game build.
Requires CMake 3.20+, a C11 compiler and Python 3.11+; SDL2 is needed for the graphical front end.
The author reports 1,414 of 2,036 known functions recompiled; the remainder uses the interpreter.
MIT licence.

name: Sightline: a native GoldenEye 007 engine port
description_en: Sightline ports the GoldenEye 007 Nintendo 64 decompilation to a native Windows executable with a platform layer and OpenGL renderer. It reads game content from the user's USA ROM and retains a matching build and per-tick trace harness for checking changes to game logic.
description_zh: Sightline 将 Nintendo 64《GoldenEye 007》的反编译代码移植为 Windows 原生程序，配有平台适配层和 OpenGL 渲染器。游戏内容从用户的美国版 ROM 读取；项目保留匹配构建和逐逻辑时步记录状态哈希的轨迹工具，用于检查游戏逻辑变化。
requirements: Requires a compatible user-supplied GoldenEye 007 USA .z64 ROM dump.
The native build targets Windows; the proposed smarter AI, dynamic lighting and NIGHTWATCH mode remain goals.
Project code is licensed under 0BSD; project-authored assets are CC0 1.0, according to the licence files.

name: Crazy Taxi decomp: rebuilding the European Dreamcast game from C
description_en: Crazy Taxi decomp reconstructs the European Dreamcast game's executable with recovered C and per-function SH-4 assembly generated from the user's disc. Its pipeline maps game assets, checks C functions against original behavior and builds a disc image with the reconstructed executable. The author reports a byte-for-byte executable rebuild and a playable game.
description_zh: Crazy Taxi decomp 使用从用户光盘生成的逐函数 SH-4 汇编和恢复的 C 代码，重建欧洲版 Dreamcast 游戏可执行文件。其流程映射游戏资源、比较 C 函数与原版行为，并生成包含重建程序的光盘镜像。作者报告可执行文件逐字节一致，游戏可以游玩。
requirements: An owned Crazy Taxi (Europe) GD-ROM as a .gdi with track files, plus a Katana SDK.
Python 3 and Docker; Linux x86_64 can use wibo with DC_LOCAL=1 instead of Docker.
Other regional releases are refused by setup.sh.
No licence file in the repository.

name: mh3u-port: statically recompiling MH3U for PC
description_en: mh3u-port statically recompiles the USA v32 Wii U release of MH3U for Windows and Linux. It translates the game's PowerPC functions into C, runs them with a Rust replacement for Wii U system libraries, and converts GPU shader programs to WGSL. The author reports that it reaches the village and runs quests, with some graphics effects unfinished.
description_zh: mh3u-port 将 MH3U 的 Wii U 美版 v32 静态重编译到 Windows 和 Linux。它把游戏的 PowerPC 函数转换为 C，用 Rust 运行时代替 Wii U 系统库，并把 GPU 着色器程序转换为 WGSL。作者称当前可进入村庄并执行任务，但部分图形效果仍未完成。
requirements: Supply a personally dumped, decrypted USA base game and v32 update in code/, content/ and meta/ folders.
A Vulkan or Direct3D 12 capable GPU and an x86-64 CPU with FMA are required; the documented builds use Rust and platform-specific C toolchains.
Online play and other network features are unsupported; graphics effects, dump hash checking and CI remain unfinished.
AGPL-3.0-only license.

name: DoConfig-Decompilation: reconstructing Cave Story's options program
description_en: DoConfig-Decompilation reconstructs the options program for Cave Story as recompilable C++ source. The author reports that the rebuilt program behaves like the original.
description_zh: DoConfig-Decompilation 以可重新编译的 C++ 源码重建《洞窟物语》的设置程序。作者称编译后的程序与原版行为相同。
requirements: No licence file in the repository.

name: ChronoRET: matching 65816 reconstruction of Chrono Trigger
description_en: ChronoRET reconstructs the US SNES release of Chrono Trigger as labelled 65816 assembly. Its build extracts remaining data from a user-supplied ROM, assembles a complete image and compares it byte for byte with the original; progress records separate code matching from data coverage.
description_zh: ChronoRET 用带标签的 65816 汇编重建美版 SNES 游戏 Chrono Trigger。构建流程从用户自备 ROM 提取尚未写成源码的数据，组装完整映像并逐字节比较；进度记录区分代码匹配与数据覆盖。
requirements: A legally dumped, unheadered 4 MiB US 1.0 Chrono Trigger ROM is required.
Building requires asar 1.91, Python 3.10+ and make; a debugger-equipped SNES emulator is recommended for tracing.
Data not yet expressed in source is extracted from the user's ROM during the build.
MIT license.

name: xtractedott: reconstructing the OTT compressor DSP core
description_en: xtractedott reconstructs portions of Xfer Records' OTT VST multiband compressor in C. Its source covers three-band crossover filters, upward and downward compression, envelope following and parameter mapping. The author describes the code as partly incorrect and unable to build.
description_zh: xtractedott 以 C 语言重构 Xfer Records 的 OTT VST 多频段压缩器，代码涉及三频段分频滤波、向上与向下压缩、包络跟踪及参数映射。作者指出实现仍有部分错误，且目前无法构建。
requirements: The implementation is unfinished, partly incorrect and currently cannot build.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Disruptor Recompiled: rebuilding the PlayStation game for Windows
description_en: Disruptor Recompiled translates the USA PlayStation release of Disruptor into C with PSXRecomp and builds a native Windows executable from the player's disc image. Its repository adds framework patches and game-specific code for widescreen display, input and presentation changes.
description_zh: Disruptor Recompiled 使用 PSXRecomp 将美国版 PlayStation《Disruptor》程序转换为 C，并根据玩家的光盘镜像在本机生成 Windows 可执行文件。仓库还包含框架补丁和游戏专用代码，支持宽屏、输入及画面调整。
requirements: Requires Windows 10 or 11 64-bit, an OpenGL 3.3 graphics card and a user-supplied Disruptor USA .bin or .iso image.
The release is a release candidate; frame interpolation and faster loading are experimental.
PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0.

name: Wizardry 8 decompilation: reconstructing the Windows game and libraries
description_en: Wizardry 8 decompilation reconstructs the Windows game's executable and supporting libraries as C and C++ and compares rebuilt functions with retail code. Its workflow combines Ghidra analysis, Visual C++ 6 builds, reccmp comparisons and runtime tests; the recovered executable runs with original game data.
description_zh: Wizardry 8 decompilation 将 Windows 版游戏可执行文件及配套库重构为 C/C++，并把重编译函数与原版代码比较。流程结合 Ghidra 分析、Visual C++ 6 构建、reccmp 比对和运行时测试；重构后的程序使用原版游戏数据运行。
requirements: Requires a legally obtained Wizardry 8 copy; the current workflow uses the GOG release.
Development uses uv, Docker, Wine, Java 25, a pinned Ghidra fork, CMake and reccmp.
Semantic, binary-structure and behavioral audits remain open.
The SGP component retains Strategy First's non-commercial SFI Source Code License Agreement; no project-wide licence file is listed.

name: WinTex: an Under a Killing Moon engine reimplementation
description_en: WinTex reimplements a Windows-native engine for Under a Killing Moon using files from the original game. Its C++ source reads game data, extracts graphics from AP resources and renders them with a DirectX-based interface; support for The Pandora Directive is planned.
description_zh: WinTex 使用原版游戏文件重建《Under a Killing Moon》的 Windows 原生引擎。C++ 代码读取游戏数据、从 AP 资源提取图像，并通过 DirectX 界面渲染；《The Pandora Directive》的支持仍属规划。
requirements: Windows and copies of the original game files.
The Pandora Directive is a future target.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Road Rash 64 Recompiled: a native PC port of the N64 game
description_en: Road Rash 64 Recompiled builds a PC version of the N64 game from the user's USA v1.0 ROM. The project provides Windows and experimental Linux packages, game-specific rendering and input changes, and optional local import of Mario Kart 64 tracks from a second user-supplied ROM.
description_zh: Road Rash 64 Recompiled 从用户提供的美版 v1.0 ROM 构建 N64 游戏的 PC 版本。项目提供 Windows 和实验性 Linux 包、游戏专用渲染与输入修改，还可从用户另行提供的《Mario Kart 64》ROM 在本地导入赛道。
requirements: Requires the user's Road Rash 64 USA v1.0 ROM; optional Mario Kart 64 track import requires that game's USA ROM.
Linux, online play and imported Mario Kart 64 content are experimental.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Bushido Blade 2: matching decompilation of the North American PS1 executable
description_en: Bushido Blade 2 reconstructs the North American PlayStation game's SLUS_006.63 executable from C and retained canonical assembly. Its build extracts a user-supplied disc, compiles the reconstructed sources and checks the resulting executable against the original SHA-1; the author reports a byte-identical build.
description_zh: Bushido Blade 2 以 C 代码和保留的规范汇编重建北美版 PlayStation 游戏可执行文件 SLUS_006.63。构建流程从用户提供的光盘提取内容、编译重建源码，再以原版 SHA-1 比较输出；作者报告构建结果逐字节一致。
requirements: An unmodified North American Bushido Blade 2 disc image in BIN and CUE form is required.
The build environment is Windows with WSL Ubuntu 24.04 or Linux.
The README reports remaining cleanup and readability work.
No licence file in the repository.

name: War1: a C reimplementation of Warcraft: Orcs & Humans
description_en: War1 reimplements Warcraft: Orcs & Humans in C as an RTS engine that reads the original game's DATA.WAR assets.
