It implements unit movement and training, building construction, resource gathering, fog of war, spells and basic enemy behavior; AI, cinematics and save/load are still listed as unfinished.
description_zh: War1 用 C 重建《Warcraft: Orcs & Humans》的即时战略游戏引擎，读取原版 DATA.WAR 资源。项目实现了单位移动与训练、建筑、资源采集、战争迷雾、法术和基本敌人行为；AI、过场动画及存档读档仍列为待开发功能。
requirements: Provide DATA.WAR from an original or shareware copy of Warcraft: Orcs & Humans.
Build with a C compiler using the project's nob build entry point.
AI, cinematics and save/load are listed as unfinished.
Zlib license.

name: SSX 3: a work-in-progress GameCube decompilation
description_en: SSX 3 reconstructs source for the USA Rev 0 GameCube release as an unfinished decompilation. Its configuration uses a user-supplied disc image to prepare a Ninja build, while objdiff compares rebuilt objects with the original game.
description_zh: SSX 3 项目正在重建 GameCube 美版 Rev 0 游戏源码。配置流程读取用户自备的光盘镜像并生成 Ninja 构建；objdiff 用于比较重建目标文件与原游戏。
requirements: Supply an SSX 3 USA Rev 0 disc image in one of the documented supported formats.
Install Python and Ninja; platform-specific instructions also describe Wine where needed.
The decompilation is a work in progress.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: Glover: an in-progress Nintendo 64 decompilation
description_en: Glover is an in-progress decompilation of the Nintendo 64 game, with C source and assembly for functions that remain nonmatching. Its Makefile defines a MIPS cross-build for the game and separates matching from nonmatching build settings. The author describes Claude as a major contributor to the work.
description_zh: Glover 是 Nintendo 64 游戏的开发中反编译项目，包含 C 源码及尚未匹配函数的汇编。Makefile 配置了面向该游戏的 MIPS 交叉构建，并区分匹配与非匹配构建设置。作者称 Claude 参与了大量工作。
requirements: A MIPS cross-toolchain and Python 3 are required by the Makefile.
The decompilation is in progress.
No licence file in the repository.

name: RustyWorld: a Rust reimplementation of the Another World engine
description_en: RustyWorld reimplements the Another World game engine in Rust and runs on the user's original data. Its VM separates instruction decoding from execution and groups related opcodes, while minifb handles video and input and rodio handles audio.
description_zh: RustyWorld 用 Rust 重建 Another World 游戏引擎，读取用户提供的原版数据。其虚拟机将指令解码与执行分离，并合并相关操作码；视频和输入使用 minifb，音频使用 rodio。
requirements: Copy the original data folder to $PWD/data and run with Cargo.
Load and save are missing; the author reports testing only on Linux.
MIT license.

name: OpenSolomonsKey: a Linux and Windows port of Solomon's Key
description_en: OpenSolomonsKey ports the 1986 arcade game Solomon's Key to Linux and Windows in C++. Its source includes gameplay, graphics, audio, level handling and platform entry points, with build scripts for the supported systems.
description_zh: OpenSolomonsKey 以 C++ 将 1986 年街机游戏《Solomon's Key》移植到 Linux 和 Windows。源码包含玩法、图形、音频、关卡处理及平台入口，并提供构建脚本。
requirements: Windows builds require glm in an incl folder at the project root; Linux builds require Xlib and ALSA development libraries.
The level file format is described as planned.
Released under the Unlicense.

name: Sonic Adventure DX: an early matching decompilation of the 2014 Steam release
description_en: Sonic Adventure DX is being reconstructed from its 2014 Steam executable as C and C++ source that matches retail machine code function by function. The project uses the identified Visual C++ 2010 SP1 compiler, game-specific function and code-generation maps, and reccmp scores to compare rebuilt functions. The author reports an early stage with six exact function matches.
description_zh: 项目从 2014 年 Steam 版《Sonic Adventure DX》的可执行文件重建 C 与 C++ 源码，逐函数追求与零售版机器码一致。它使用识别出的 Visual C++ 2010 SP1 编译器、游戏专属函数及代码生成映射，并通过 reccmp 比较重建函数。作者报告项目尚处早期，已有六个函数精确匹配。
requirements: A user-owned 2014 Steam release Sonic Adventure DX.exe with the documented hash is required.
The workflow requires Windows 10 build 17063 or newer, Python 3.10 or newer, git and Visual C++ 2010 SP1.
The author reports six matched functions out of 16,537.
No licence file in the repository.

name: GoldenPad: GoldenEye 007 rebuilt for Apple devices
description_en: GoldenPad runs GoldenEye 007 on iPhone, iPad and Apple Silicon Mac using statically recompiled game code from GoldenEye64Recomp. Its Apple host adds touch and controller input, saves and audio, while RT64 presents graphics through Metal. Users generate the game-bearing build from their own US retail ROM.
description_zh: GoldenPad 基于 GoldenEye64Recomp 的静态重编译代码，在 iPhone、iPad 和 Apple Silicon Mac 上运行《GoldenEye 007》。Apple 平台层提供触控、手柄、存档与音频，RT64 通过 Metal 渲染；含游戏代码的版本由用户自己的美版 ROM 构建。
requirements: A user-owned US GoldenEye 007 Nintendo 64 ROM is required to generate the game-bearing build.
iPhone and iPad builds require iOS or iPadOS 17+; the Mac runtime is an Apple Silicon alpha.
An Apple Silicon Mac with Xcode and PadMint is the documented build route; a Windows 11 PadMint route is experimental.
The Mac build has open performance and renderer parity issues, and complete multiplayer acceptance remains open.

name: Dino Crisis 2 Recompiled: a PSXRecomp setup candidate
description_en: Dino Crisis 2 Recompiled provides a PSXRecomp configuration and portable setup candidate for the SLUS-01279 PlayStation game. The setup wizard takes a user-supplied disc image and BIOS, then generates and rebuilds the program; gameplay acceptance remains pending.
description_zh: Dino Crisis 2 Recompiled 为 PlayStation 版 SLUS-01279 提供 PSXRecomp 配置和便携安装候选流程。安装向导读取用户提供的光盘映像与 BIOS，随后生成并重新构建程序；游戏运行验收仍待完成。
requirements: A user-supplied SLUS-01279 disc and SCPH-5502/5552 Europe BIOS are required.
Linux and macOS setup requires CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and a C/C++ compiler.
Package setup and gameplay acceptance are pending.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Digimon World DS: matching Nintendo DS decompilation
description_en: Digimon World DS reconstructs the North American Nintendo DS game's ARM9 program and overlays as matching C source. Its dsd-based build takes code still awaiting decompilation from the user's ROM, links recovered functions into the modules and checks the output byte for byte; the author reports 2,386 of 3,665 game functions in C as of October 2026.
description_zh: Digimon World DS 将北美版 Nintendo DS 游戏的 ARM9 主程序及覆盖模块重建为匹配原版的 C 源码。构建流程借助 dsd 从用户 ROM 中拆出尚未反编译的代码，链接已恢复的函数并逐字节比较；作者报告截至 2026 年 10 月，3,665 个游戏函数中已有 2,386 个写成 C。
requirements: Supply the North American ADNE ROM; whole-ROM hash matching also requires a DS ARM7 BIOS file.
The documented Linux build uses Python, Ninja, dsd, Metrowerks mwccarm 1.2/sp4 and related tools.
The decompilation is incomplete; unrecovered code is delinked from the original ROM.
MIT license.

name: OpenTS: reconstructing the Tiberian Sun engine
description_en: OpenTS reconstructs the Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun 2.03 Firestorm engine as a standalone program. It combines GPL-released source from related Command & Conquer games with reverse engineering of the original executable, and uses assets from the user's installed game.
description_zh: OpenTS 将《Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun》2.03 Firestorm 引擎重建为独立程序。项目结合相关《Command & Conquer》游戏公开的 GPL 源码与原始可执行文件逆向成果，使用用户已安装游戏中的资源。
requirements: An installed Tiberian Sun copy from Steam or the EA App supplies the original assets.
Windows 10 version 1903 or newer and an SSE4.2-capable processor are required.
The 32-bit and 64-bit builds use incompatible save and network packet widths.
GPL-3.0-or-later license; source derived from Electronic Arts material carries additional GPL Section 7 terms.

name: Zelda3: a C reimplementation of A Link to the Past
description_en: Zelda3 reimplements The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past in C, extracting levels and images from the user's US SNES ROM. It can run the original machine code beside the replacement and compare RAM state after each frame; the author reports that the game is playable from start to end.
description_zh: Zelda3 用 C 语言重建 The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past，并从用户的美版 SNES ROM 提取关卡和图像。它可并行运行原始机器码与重建实现，逐帧比较内存状态；作者称游戏已可从头游玩至结尾。
requirements: Requires the user's US-region ROM named zelda3.sfc with the SHA-256 hash documented in BUILDING.md.
Must be built from source; the documented Windows path uses Python, TCC and SDL2.
Licensed under MIT.

name: Verdite1: porting the Japanese King's Field to PC and Android
description_en: Verdite1 ports the Japanese PlayStation release of King's Field to Windows, Linux, and Android as native C/C++ built from an existing decompilation and King's Field Enhanced. It reads a user-provided SLPS-00017 disc image and adds widescreen display, keyboard and mouse controls, rendering changes, and mod support.
description_zh: Verdite1 基于已有的反编译源码和 King's Field Enhanced，以原生 C/C++ 将日版 PlayStation《King's Field》移植到 Windows、Linux 和 Android。程序读取用户提供的 SLPS-00017 光盘镜像，并加入宽屏显示、键盘鼠标操作、画面改进和模组支持。
requirements: A dump of the Japanese PlayStation release SLPS-00017 in .cue/.bin, .iso, or .chd format.
Android builds require arm64 and Android 10 or later.
The port is in development; features from the main branch are still being carried over.
MIT License.

name: Ratchet & Clank 2: a functional reconstruction of PAL game systems
description_en: RAC2Decomp studies the PAL PlayStation 2 release of Ratchet & Clank 2: Going Commando and translates observed engine behavior into C. Its workflow uses Ghidra for static analysis and the PCSX2 debugger for runtime traces; the repository includes code and notes on boot state, graphics initialization, and text rendering.
description_zh: RAC2Decomp 研究《瑞奇与叮当 2：突击队员》PS2 PAL 版，并将观察到的引擎行为改写为 C。项目使用 Ghidra 做静态分析、PCSX2 调试器跟踪运行，仓库含启动状态、图形初始化和文字渲染的代码与笔记。
requirements: A copy of the PAL SCES-516.07 executable is needed for analysis.
The documented workflow uses Ghidra 11.x or later with MIPS-R5900 analyzers and the PCSX2 debugger.
The functional reconstruction is at an early stage; graphics, input, and timing systems remain pending.
MIT.

name: Sonic Adventure DX: a multi-version GameCube decompilation
description_en: doldecomp/sadx reconstructs Sonic Adventure DX for GameCube across eight prototype, demo and retail versions. Its build uses extracted game DOL and REL files, builds DOLs and disassembles REL modules as the decompilation progresses.
description_zh: doldecomp/sadx 重建 GameCube 版《Sonic Adventure DX》，覆盖八个原型、试玩及零售版本。构建使用从用户游戏中提取的 DOL 和 REL 文件，生成 DOL 并反汇编 REL 模块。
requirements: Extract sys/main.dol and files/*.rel from a supported game version.
Python and Ninja are required; some platforms need Wine or WiBo.
For non-Preview versions, decompress underscore-prefixed REL files with Sonic Adventure Toolset.
The decompilation is work in progress.

name: Army of Two: The 40th Day — an Xbox 360 recompilation
description_en: Army of Two: The 40th Day Recomp translates the Xbox 360 game's PowerPC default.xex into C++ with ReXGlue for a Windows x64 port. Game-specific patches and configuration support the proof of concept. The author reports early menus and Shanghai gameplay, while later engine functions, boss scripts and saves remain unfinished.
description_zh: Army of Two: The 40th Day Recomp 借助 ReXGlue 将 Xbox 360 游戏 default.xex 中的 PowerPC 代码转为 C++，构建 Windows x64 移植版本。项目包含游戏专用补丁和配置；作者报告可进入前期菜单及上海关卡，后续引擎功能、首领脚本和存档仍未完成。
requirements: Windows 10/11 x64 with Direct3D 12 and the user's extracted Xbox 360 disc.
Visual Studio C++ development tools, Clang tools for Windows and CMake.
The full game cannot yet be completed; unrecompiled functions may cause crashes.
No licence file in the repository.

name: I COULD HAVE GIVEN YOU THE WORLD: a native 007 N64 port
description_en: I COULD HAVE GIVEN YOU THE WORLD ports the N64 game 007: The World Is Not Enough to PC and Steam Deck. Its first launch compiles native game code locally from the user's ROM; the project adds widescreen rendering, modern controls and save features.
description_zh: I COULD HAVE GIVEN YOU THE WORLD 将 N64《007：黑日危机》移植到 PC 和 Steam Deck。首次启动时从用户的 ROM 本地编译本机游戏代码，并加入宽屏渲染、现代控制方式和存档功能。
requirements: Requires the user's The World Is Not Enough USA revision 0 ROM.
Android and Mac builds are listed as future work.
No licence file in the repository.

name: ReFlood: reconstructing the Amiga game Flood in C and SDL2
description_en: ReFlood reconstructs the Amiga game Flood as a C99 program with an SDL2 host, using assets extracted from the player's own disk image. Its reports map the game's custom disk layout and document behavior recovered from the original, while the build also offers a headless core and a level editor.
description_zh: ReFlood 将 Amiga 游戏 Flood 重建为 C99 程序，并用 SDL2 提供图形界面；素材从玩家自己的磁盘镜像提取。分析报告记录了原作的自定义磁盘结构和游戏行为，构建中还包括无界面核心与关卡编辑器。
requirements: Supply a legally obtained Flood IPF image of the supported revision and disk-analyse with SPS/CAPS IPF support.
Build requirements are CMake 3.16+, a C99 compiler, SDL2 development files, and Python 3.
Editor trigger creation and editing are unavailable; local multiplayer is experimental.

name: ReHLDS: reconstructing the Half-Life dedicated server
description_en: ReHLDS reconstructs the Half-Life dedicated server from DWARF debug information embedded in the Linux HLDS engine_i486.so for builds 6152/6153. Its replacement engine fixes reported defects and provides an extended API for mods and plugins.
description_zh: ReHLDS 利用 Linux 版 HLDS build 6152/6153 的 engine_i486.so 内嵌 DWARF 调试信息重建 Half-Life 专用服务器。替代引擎修复项目发现的缺陷，并为模组和插件提供扩展 API。
requirements: Requires a compatible pre-anniversary HLDS installation, engine version 8684 or earlier.
Runtime binaries require SSE, SSE2 and SSE3.
The replacement is not binary-compatible with the original HLDS for plugins that analyze engine code.
Licensed under MIT.

name: rust-theft-auto: reimplementing the original Grand Theft Auto engine
description_en: rust-theft-auto reimplements the original Grand Theft Auto engine in Rust using map and style files from a player's installation. The source includes map structures, tile and style handling, and a renderer. Reimplementing gameplay and extending maps and missions are stated goals.
description_zh: rust-theft-auto 使用玩家安装目录中的地图和样式文件，以 Rust 重建初代 Grand Theft Auto 引擎。源码包含地图结构、图块与样式处理以及渲染器；重建玩法、扩展地图和任务属于项目目标。
requirements: The original game's nyc.cmp and style001.g24 files are required in data/.
Gameplay reimplementation is a stated goal.
GNU Affero General Public License version 3.

name: PSA VAN-CAN protocol bridge: translating vehicle bus generations
description_en: PSA VAN-CAN protocol bridge converts vehicle messages from AEE2001 to AEE2004 or AEE2010, and from AEE2004 to AEE2010, so newer PSA head units and displays can work in older cars. Its ESP32 firmware handles VAN and CAN traffic, including steering controls, dashboard data and display messages. The repository documents VAN frame encoding, fields, checks and reply timing.
description_zh: PSA VAN-CAN protocol bridge 将 AEE2001 车载网络的消息转换为 AEE2004 或 AEE2010 消息，也将 AEE2004 消息转换为 AEE2010 消息，使较新的 PSA 主机和显示屏可用于旧款车辆。ESP32 固件处理 VAN 与 CAN 流量，包括方向盘控制、仪表数据和显示消息；仓库还记录 VAN 帧编码、字段、校验与应答时序。
requirements: A compatible custom PCB is required; the documented VAN-CAN hardware uses an ESP32, CAN transceivers and a TSS463C VAN controller.
VAN-CAN operation was tested on a 2004 Peugeot 307 SW.
Mixed-generation head unit and display combinations are unsupported.

name: SuperMetroidSNESRecomp: a selective 65816 static recompilation
description_en: SuperMetroidSNESRecomp translates selected Super Metroid 65816 functions into native C with snesrecomp and executes other paths from the user's ROM through an interpreter. Its game-specific runtime adds optional rendering and gameplay features plus replay capture for diagnosing divergences. The author reports boot, demo, door traversal, pause and ship-save checks while broader progression testing continues.
description_zh: SuperMetroidSNESRecomp 使用 snesrecomp 将《超级密特罗德》的部分 65816 函数翻译为原生 C，其余路径通过解释器从用户 ROM 执行。游戏专用运行时加入可选画面与玩法功能，并提供用于定位偏差的回放采集。作者称已检查启动、演示、穿门、暂停和飞船存档，更多流程仍待测试。
requirements: Provide your own unmodified Super Metroid ROM.
Source regeneration requires the pinned snesrecomp framework and documented build tools.
Broader end-to-end regression testing remains pending.
PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0.

name: mlbis: matching Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story decompilation
description_en: mlbis reconstructs the Nintendo DS game Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story as C/C++ source intended to match the retail ROM byte for byte. Its tooling compiles units with CodeWarrior, compares functions and data objects against delinked ROM targets, and relinks modules for byte comparison.
description_zh: mlbis 将 Nintendo DS 游戏 Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story 重建为 C/C++ 源码，目标是与零售版 ROM 按字节一致。工具使用 CodeWarrior 编译单元，对照拆分后的 ROM 比较函数与数据对象，并重新链接模块进行字节比对。
requirements: Supply your own legally owned game ROM, CodeWarrior mwccarm versions 2.0/sp1p2 and 2.0/sp2p3, its FLEXlm license, and objdiff tools.
Set up the NitroSDK, NitroSystem, and mw-libraries submodules; Windows is the only tested platform.
The author reports 1579 of 1869 main_7 functions matched and 134 modules byte-exact.

name: Sexy Parodius Recompiled: a PlayStation recompilation build kit
description_en: Sexy Parodius Recompiled configures PSXRecomp to generate and compile the Japanese PlayStation release of Sexy Parodius from a user-supplied disc. The repository contains game-specific identity, symbols, seeds and build configuration; the author reports a Windows build reaching the title screen and attract-mode gameplay.
description_zh: Sexy Parodius Recompiled 配置 PSXRecomp，从用户提供的日版 PlayStation《Sexy Parodius》光盘生成并编译游戏代码。仓库包含游戏专用的版本识别信息、符号、函数种子和构建配置；作者报告 Windows 构建已进入标题画面和演示玩法。
requirements: Supply a matching Japanese Sexy Parodius SLPM-86009 CUE/BIN disc dump.
The first build needs Python 3 and a compatible CMake/Ninja toolchain or tools obtained by the setup wizard.
Gameplay verification is limited to the documented Windows boot and attract-mode paths.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Luigi's Mansion: a four-version GameCube decompilation
description_en: Luigi's Mansion decomp reconstructs source for four GameCube releases: USA Rev 0, Japan Rev 0 and PAL Revs 0 and 1. The repository supplies game C and C++ files, symbols and per-version build configurations, with Ninja builds and objdiff support starting from a user-supplied disc image.
description_zh: Luigi's Mansion decomp 重建 GameCube 美版 Rev 0、日版 Rev 0 及 PAL 版 Rev 0、Rev 1 的源码。仓库提供游戏 C/C++ 文件、符号表和分版本构建配置，使用用户光盘镜像进行 Ninja 构建并支持 objdiff 比较。
requirements: An existing copy of the selected Luigi's Mansion release is required.
Python and Ninja are listed for configuration and builds.
The decompilation is a work in progress.

name: Encounter HD: rebuilding the 1983 Oric adventure
description_en: Encounter HD rebuilds the 1983 Oric text adventure in C and assembly for floppy-based Oric hardware. The new version revises item interactions and hazards, replaces action-count timing with a clock, and adds graphics, audio and alternative routes through some obstacles.
description_zh: Encounter HD 用 C 和汇编为软盘版 Oric 重制 1983 年的文字冒险游戏。新版调整物品互动和危险设计，以时钟取代按行动次数计时，并加入图像、音频及部分障碍的替代解法。
requirements: An Oric computer or the documented Oricutron emulator setup.
The project is described as finished, with occasional tweaks and bug fixes.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Defender: annotated arcade disassembly
description_en: Defender-Source-Code documents the Williams Defender arcade game in an annotated disassembly. It labels PCB registers, RAM variables and game routines, with separate notes for palette values and ROM check bytes.
description_zh: Defender-Source-Code 以带注释的反汇编记录 Williams 街机游戏 Defender。内容标注电路板寄存器、RAM 变量和游戏例程，另附调色板数值与 ROM 校验字节笔记。
requirements: The disassembly is marked as work in progress.
No licence file in the repository.

name: ZONE OF THE ENDERS: an early game decompilation
description_en: zoe1 is an early decompilation of the 2001 game ZONE OF THE ENDERS. Its source implements the game's string-hash routine and sketches cache-system functions, many of which are still marked for decompilation.
description_zh: zoe1 对 2001 年的 ZONE OF THE ENDERS 进行反编译。仓库实现了游戏使用的字符串哈希函数，也列出缓存系统函数；其中许多函数仍待还原。
requirements: The cache-system functions shown in source/libfs/cache.cc are largely marked for decompilation.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Banjo-Tooie: Scurvy Dog Port — a static PC recompilation
description_en: Banjo-Tooie: Scurvy Dog Port translates the game's Nintendo 64 code with N64Recomp and renders a native Windows port with RT64. Game-specific patches and runtime adapters handle behavior and presentation, including widescreen rendering and interpolation. The author describes the current release as alpha.
description_zh: Banjo-Tooie: Scurvy Dog Port 使用 N64Recomp 转换《班卓与图伊》的任天堂 64 代码，并通过 RT64 在 Windows 上原生渲染。项目以游戏专用补丁和运行时适配器处理行为及画面，包括宽屏和插帧；作者将当前版本标为 alpha。
requirements: Requires the user's own Banjo-Tooie NTSC-U 1.0 ROM.
Current release targets Windows x64.
The release is alpha; texture pack support is untested, and code mods and ROM patches are unsupported.
GPL-3.0-only license for licensable project material.

name: VETTE! 2026: a disassembly-based game reconstruction
description_en: VETTE! 2026 rebuilds the DOS racing game in C++20 and SDL3 from disassembly and documented format research. The original runs in a built-in emulator while native routines are added and compared incrementally; the port also reads optional PC-98 and Macintosh art and sound from the user's copies.
description_zh: VETTE! 2026 根据反汇编及文件格式研究，以 C++20 和 SDL3 重建 DOS 赛车游戏。原版先在内置模拟器中运行，原生例程逐步加入并逐一对比；程序还可从用户自己的 PC-98 和 Macintosh 副本读取可选的图像与声音。
requirements: The user's original DOS VETTE! files are required; PC-98 and Macintosh copies are optional.
Building requires CMake 3.24 or newer and a C++20 compiler; SDL3 is used.
Native C++ routine porting is still at an early stage.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Kirby Air Ride: a three-region GameCube decompilation
description_en: KAR reconstructs Kirby Air Ride code for the USA, Japan and Europe GameCube releases using decomp-toolkit and CodeWarrior build settings. It keeps source, symbols and split metadata for comparison with the user's extracted discs; data-split notes describe source ownership inferred from strings, cross-references and layout.
description_zh: KAR 使用 decomp-toolkit 和 CodeWarrior 构建配置，重建《Kirby Air Ride》美、日、欧三个 GameCube 版本的代码。项目保存源码、符号和拆分元数据，用于与用户提取的光盘文件比对；数据拆分笔记依据字符串、交叉引用和布局推断数据归属。
requirements: Provide an extracted game disc with sys/main.dol under orig/<GAMEID>.
CodeWarrior for GameCube 2.4.2 build 81 is the documented game-code baseline.
The decompilation is in progress; some small-data and BSS ownership remains provisional.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: Captain America Super Soldier Recompiled: a title-screen build
description_en: Captain America Super Soldier Recompiled configures ReXGlue v0.4 to build the Xbox 360 game as a native program. The repository includes a title manifest and host application source. The author reports a title-screen boot followed by a crash when story mode loads because addresses remain missing from the configuration.
description_zh: Captain America Super Soldier Recompiled 配置 ReXGlue v0.4，将 Xbox 360 版游戏构建为原生程序。仓库包含游戏清单和宿主程序源码。作者报告版本可进入标题画面，但因配置中缺少地址，加载剧情模式时会崩溃。
requirements: ReXGlue v0.4 is used for the build.
Story mode currently crashes during loading because configuration addresses are missing.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Lazarus: a Mass Effect 2 static recompilation for Nintendo Switch
description_en: Lazarus translates the Xbox 360 version of Mass Effect 2 with Title Update 2 from PowerPC code into C++ for Nintendo Switch. It converts Xenos shaders ahead of time and uses a deko3d renderer that handles the game's Direct3D calls. The repository includes game-specific hooks, native function replacements and build documentation for user-supplied discs.
description_zh: Lazarus 将 Xbox 360 版《Mass Effect 2》及 Title Update 2 的 PowerPC 代码转换为 C++，用于 Nintendo Switch。它预先转换 Xenos 着色器，并通过 deko3d 渲染器处理游戏的 Direct3D 调用。仓库还包含游戏专用钩子、原生函数替换和基于用户自备光盘的构建说明。
requirements: A homebrew-capable Nintendo Switch, the user's two Mass Effect 2 Xbox 360 discs and the corresponding Title Update 2 package are required.
The build produces the NRO and converted shaders from the user's files; the build chain has not yet been rerun from a fresh clone.
Heavy scenes can have frame-rate drops and short audio dropouts; 2x MSAA, lens flares and online services are unavailable.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: Prehistorik_js: a first-level demo rewrite
description_en: Prehistorik_js rewrites the first level of a specified Prehistorik playable demo in C. Its source includes game, cave, object, and level code alongside scripts for unpacking and converting DOS resources.
description_zh: Prehistorik_js 用 C 重写指定 Prehistorik 可玩试玩版的第一关。源码包含游戏流程、洞穴、对象和关卡代码，并配有 DOS 资源解包与转换脚本。
requirements: The rewrite covers the first level of the specified playable demo.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Star Wars Episode I: Racer: an N64 static recompilation
description_en: Racer statically recompiles the N64 release of Star Wars Episode I: Racer with N64Recomp, N64ModernRuntime and RT64. Its ROM-analysis and symbol tools support game-specific fixes for libultra calls, split functions, asset loading and controller input; the author reports driving into a tournament race.
description_zh: Racer 使用 N64Recomp、N64ModernRuntime 和 RT64 静态重编译 N64 版 Star Wars Episode I: Racer。ROM 分析与符号工具支持修复游戏专用的 libultra 调用、拆分函数、资源加载和手柄输入；作者报告已能进入并驾驶锦标赛比赛。
requirements: A legally obtained USA Star Wars Episode I: Racer N64 ROM is required.
The recompilation workflow needs Python 3, Make and N64Recomp.
The project marks widescreen experimental and a playable build in progress.
MIT License.

name: Xenosaga Episode I: an early PS2 matching decompilation
description_en: Xenosaga-I-Decomp recovers C functions from the NTSC-U PS2 executable of Xenosaga Episode I and compares compiled bytes with the original ELF. Its tools split the executable, extract symbols and track decompilation progress. The author reports a byte-matching full executable build with a small fraction of functions rewritten in C; Japanese releases are planned.
description_zh: Xenosaga-I-Decomp 从美版 PS2《异度传说 I》的可执行文件恢复 C 函数，并将编译后的字节与原版 ELF 比较。工具负责拆分程序、提取符号和统计进度。作者报告整体可执行文件可按字节匹配，但目前只有少量函数改写为 C；日版仍在计划中。
requirements: A legally obtained NTSC-U game copy and its SLUS_204.69 ELF are required.
The documented setup uses WSL2, Ubuntu 24 or native Linux and installs PS2DEV and EE-GCC tooling.
The C decompilation is at an early stage; Japanese versions are planned.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Chrono Trigger: a frame-checked native C reimplementation
description_en: Chrono Trigger Reimplemented ports the USA SNES game to handwritten C and compares ported routines frame by frame against the original ROM. Its development runtime combines native routines with generated C and a 65816 interpreter while the attract sequence, field, menu, event and battle systems are being ported.
description_zh: Chrono Trigger Reimplemented 将美版 SNES 游戏逐步移植为手写 C，并逐帧与原版 ROM 比较。开发运行时结合已移植函数、生成的 C 代码和 65816 解释器；开场、场景、菜单、事件及战斗系统仍在移植。
requirements: The user's Chrono Trigger USA ROM matching the documented checksum is required.
Native porting is partial; the author reports shadow-mode validation over 26 input movies.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Technician Ted: an annotated ZX Spectrum disassembly
description_en: chipfact is an annotated disassembly of the 1984 computer game Technician Ted. Its SkoolKit sources cover the game and its loader, with separate room-format and loader notes in the repository.
description_zh: chipfact 是 1984 年电脑游戏《Technician Ted》的带注释反汇编。仓库中的 SkoolKit 源文件涵盖游戏和加载器，并另有房间格式及加载器笔记。
requirements: No licence file in the repository.

name: Harvest: decompiling and porting Massive Encounter
description_en: Harvest reconstructs C++ for the Linux amd64 1.18 release of Harvest: Massive Encounter and ports the recovered game and engine code to desktop and web platforms. Matching tools compare compiled objects with the original executable; the port replaces the platform layer with Zig, SDL3 and related components and reads separately supplied game data.
description_zh: Harvest 重建 Harvest: Massive Encounter Linux amd64 1.18 版的 C++ 源码，并将恢复的游戏及引擎代码移植到桌面和网页平台。匹配工具将编译后的目标文件与原可执行文件比较；移植版以 Zig、SDL3 等替换平台层，并读取另行提供的游戏数据。
requirements: Supply the original Linux amd64 1.18 executable for matching. The desktop port needs game data from an installed copy; the browser port downloads game data automatically.
Matching uses the documented GCC 4.4.3 toolchain image with Docker or Podman; the port build uses Zig 0.17 and just.
The matching decompilation proceeds function by function.
No licence file in the repository.

name: The Last Guardian: a Windows port through PS4 compatibility layers
description_en: TLG-Port runs The Last Guardian's PS4 executable on Windows through game-specific replacements for PS4 system libraries. It executes the game's x86-64 instructions on the host CPU and maps graphics commands to Vulkan while converting shaders to SPIR-V during play.
description_zh: TLG-Port 在 Windows 上加载 The Last Guardian 的 PS4 可执行文件，以针对游戏实现的系统库替代层提供运行环境。游戏 x86-64 指令由宿主 CPU 执行，图形命令映射至 Vulkan，着色器在运行时转为 SPIR-V。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 x64 and a Vulkan 1.3 GPU with about 4 GB of video memory are required.
A personally supplied, decrypted PS4 game folder for CUSA03627 or CUSA03745 at version 01.00 with update 01.03 is required.
AMD and Intel graphics remain untested; occasional area-loading crashes and several audio and menu issues are documented.
GPL-3.0-or-later License.

name: adam: an N64 recompilation of Neon Genesis Evangelion
description_en: adam recompiles the Japanese N64 release of Neon Genesis Evangelion into a native Windows program using N64Recomp and RT64. It provides an ahead of time build pipeline and a live build that translates code from the player's ROM at startup, with game-specific overlay, audio and input support.
description_zh: adam 使用 N64Recomp 和 RT64，把日版 N64 游戏 Neon Genesis Evangelion 重编译为 Windows 原生程序。它提供预先转换的构建流程，也提供启动时从玩家 ROM 转换游戏代码的版本，并处理游戏专用的覆盖层、音频和输入。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 x64, a Direct3D 12 or Vulkan GPU and the Japanese 32 MB .z64 ROM.
Source builds require Visual Studio C++, LLVM clang-cl, Python 3.12 with splat64[mips], Git and pinned N64Recomp dependencies.
The author reports play through the first mission and start of the second; some game code overlays have never run.

name: PanzerChasm: recreating Chasm: The Rift with original game data
description_en: PanzerChasm recreates Chasm: The Rift in C++ as an SDL2 game that loads the player's original CSM.BIN data file. The repository includes game and rendering source, shaders, and notes on the game's binary formats.
description_zh: PanzerChasm 用 C++ 和 SDL2 重建 Chasm: The Rift，运行时读取玩家原版游戏的 CSM.BIN 数据文件。仓库包含游戏与渲染源码、着色器，以及游戏二进制格式笔记。
requirements: An original Chasm: The Rift installation and its CSM.BIN data file are required.
An SDL2-supported platform; OpenGL mode requires OpenGL 3.3.
GNU GPL v3, as stated in the README.

name: Dogcomp: a PAL PlayStation 2 decompilation of Dog's Life
description_en: Dogcomp decompiles the PAL PlayStation 2 release of Dog's Life into C++ source. Its Splat-based build splits the user-provided SCES_512.48 executable, inserts assembly for functions without a C++ match, links the result and compares its checksum with the original.
description_zh: Dogcomp 将《Dog's Life》PAL 版 PlayStation 2 游戏反编译为 C++ 源码。其构建流程用 Splat 拆分用户提供的 SCES_512.48 程序，对尚未匹配的函数保留汇编，链接后将校验和与原版比较。
requirements: The SCES_512.48 ELF from a personal game copy is required.
The documented setup uses Linux or Windows through WSL, Python 3.9+, MIPS binutils and Ninja.
Nonmatching functions remain as split assembly.
No licence file in the repository.

name: osdbits: reconstructing the PlayStation 2 OSDSYS opening
description_en: osdbits reconstructs the PlayStation 2 OSDSYS opening animation as a standalone Emotion Engine program from a retail boot ROM image. It ports towers, fog, light streaks and refractive cubes, and compares output with GS dumps and savestates. The repository also includes VU microcode disassembly and notes on menu rendering; textures are extracted locally from the user's BIOS dump.
description_zh: osdbits 从零售版 PS2 启动 ROM 的 OSDSYS 镜像重建开机动画，生成独立的 Emotion Engine 程序。它移植塔群、雾、光迹和折射立方体，并用 GS 转储与保存状态比较结果。仓库还收录 VU 微代码反汇编及菜单渲染分析；纹理由用户自己的 BIOS 转储在本地提取。
requirements: A PS2 BIOS image dumped from the user's own console for texture extraction.
The SCE PS2 EE toolchain with ee-gcc, ee-dvp-as and SDK at /usr/local/sce/ee.
The opening is reconstructed; the illegal disc screen lacks ROM comparison and the menu/browser is documented only.
No licence file in the repository.

name: MechWarrior SDL port: reconstructing the 1989 game in C17
description_en: MechWarrior SDL port reconstructs the 1989 game's campaign and combat systems in C17 and SDL3 for Windows x64. It reads resources and executable-authored tables from the player's installation; the author reports an experimental build reaching briefing, movement, firing and combat return.
description_zh: MechWarrior SDL port 用 C17 和 SDL3 为 Windows x64 重建 1989 年游戏的战役与战斗系统。程序从玩家的安装目录读取资源及可执行文件中的原始数据表；作者称实验性版本已能完成简报、移动、射击和战斗返回流程。
requirements: A legally obtained original MechWarrior installation, including executable-authored tables, is required.
Windows x64, Visual Studio C++, CMake, PowerShell and SDL3 are required.
Full campaign, scenario and audiovisual coverage remains incomplete.
The MIT grant applies only to project-authored material within contributors' rights; reconstructed game expressions are excluded.

name: Pocket Wormhole: an Android port of the FTL engine reimplementation
description_en: Pocket Wormhole brings the Project Wormhole reimplementation of FTL: Faster Than Light to Android using the player's ftl.dat. Its port replaces desktop OpenGL, OpenAL, GLFW and Slick2D interfaces with Android graphics, audio and touch input layers, and adds save export and import for compatible game runs.
description_zh: Pocket Wormhole 将 Project Wormhole 对 FTL: Faster Than Light 的引擎重实现移植到 Android，读取玩家自己的 ftl.dat。移植层以 Android 图形、音频和触控实现替换桌面端的 OpenGL、OpenAL、GLFW 与 Slick2D 接口，并支持导入、导出兼容的游戏存档。
requirements: Android 8.0 or newer and a GLES 3.0 GPU.
A personally owned FTL copy supplying ftl.dat.
Building requires JDK 17 and Android SDK platform 34 with build-tools 34.0.0.
XSLT-based mod patches are unsupported; exports transfer faithfully only at a new sector's entry beacon.
GPL-2.0 or later.

name: BaK GL: rebuilding Betrayal at Krondor mechanics
description_en: BaKGL reimplements Betrayal at Krondor in a C++ and OpenGL engine built around original game data. It reconstructs exploration, quests, shops, inventory and other mechanics, includes resource explorers and an image extractor, and allows replacement textures. Combat remains in progress.
description_zh: BaKGL 以 C++ 和 OpenGL 引擎重建《克朗多的背叛》，读取原版游戏数据。它实现探索、任务、商店、背包等机制，并提供资源查看及图像导出工具，也支持替换纹理；战斗系统仍在开发中。
requirements: A copy of Betrayal at Krondor is needed for its data files.
Building requires CMake, SDL2, OpenGL, GLEW, freeglut and a C++23-capable compiler.
Combat is in progress, and macOS is not currently supported.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: ZumaTAS: a JavaScript port of Zuma Deluxe and search-generated TAS
description_en: ZumaTAS ports Zuma Deluxe game logic from the CircleShootApp decompilation into a deterministic JavaScript simulation for browser and Node.js use. It includes asset extraction from a user's game installation, a replay viewer, search programs, and recorded tool-assisted play through all 76 Adventure levels. The author reports an 8:12 total for the published run.
description_zh: ZumaTAS 依据 CircleShootApp 的反编译成果，将《Zuma Deluxe》游戏逻辑移植为可在浏览器和 Node.js 中使用的确定性 JavaScript 模拟器。项目提供从用户游戏安装目录提取资源的脚本、回放界面、搜索程序及冒险模式 76 关的 TAS 录像；作者报告公开录像总用时为 8:12。
requirements: Supply your own Zuma Deluxe installation; the repository omits its art, audio, fonts, and level data.
Asset generation requires Python 3.9+, Pillow, and NumPy; TAS tools require Node.js 18+.
A different game version can cause the recorded replay to desynchronize.
MIT licence.

name: Alien Trilogy: a byte-matched PS1 source reconstruction
description_en: Alien Trilogy reconstructs C source for the USA PlayStation game executable SLUS_000.07 using its original GCC 2.5.7 toolchain. Per-function comparisons check rebuilt code and relocations against retail bytes; a gate overlays rebuilt units on the user's executable and checks the complete hash. The author reports 645 byte-matched game C functions, with remaining gaps and pending source-quality work documented.
description_zh: Alien Trilogy 使用原版 GCC 2.5.7 工具链重建美版 PlayStation 游戏可执行文件 SLUS_000.07 的 C 源码。逐函数比较检查编译后的机器码及重定位是否与零售版一致；整文件检查则将重建单元覆盖到用户提供的原版可执行文件上，并核对完整文件的哈希。作者报告已有 645 个游戏 C 函数逐字节匹配，并记录了剩余缺口和仍需改进的源码质量问题。
requirements: A personal copy of the retail SLUS_000.07 executable is required.
The pinned PsyQ toolchain, Runtime Library 3.3 SDK, Python 3 and DOSBox-X are required.
The author reports 452 remaining byte gaps and eight MATCH-PENDING functions.
MIT license.

name: Mario Party 3: a partial Nintendo 64 decompilation
description_en: mp3 partially decompiles the US Nintendo 64 release of Mario Party 3 into C source. Its build extracts a user-provided big-endian ROM and reassembles the game; the author describes fully decompiled overlays that can be edited and rebuilt. The repository is archived.
description_zh: mp3 将美版 Nintendo 64《马力欧派对 3》的部分代码反编译为 C。构建过程从用户自行提供的大端序 ROM 提取内容并重新组装；作者说明部分已完整反编译的覆盖模块可修改后重建。仓库已归档。
requirements: Requires a user-provided US Mario Party 3 ROM in big-endian .z64 format.
Requires Python 3, pip and the listed ROM-analysis packages.
Only a small percentage of the game is decompiled; the repository is archived.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Dreerally: a Death Rally engine reimplementation
description_en: Dreerally recreates the Windows version of Death Rally as a replacement executable that reads files from an original game copy. Its C source covers game systems and rendering, and accompanying scripts extract or decrypt BPA, BPK, music, and save data.
description_zh: Dreerally 重新实现 Windows 版 Death Rally，编译后的程序替代原有可执行文件，并读取玩家持有的原版游戏文件。仓库中的 C 源码覆盖游戏系统与渲染，附带脚本可提取或解密 BPA、BPK、音乐和存档数据。
requirements: An original Windows copy of Death Rally and its listed game files are required.
Build with Visual Studio 2010–2017 or the Linux Makefile.
Multiplayer is not implemented.
The project describes its code as public domain; the included license file states CC BY-SA 4.0 for repository contents unless otherwise noted.

name: LSD: Dream Emulator: an early PlayStation decompilation
description_en: LSD Decompiled is an early-stage C decompilation of the PlayStation game LSD: Dream Emulator. Its documented workflow uses a user-supplied game executable and a MIPS cross-toolchain, then checks the rebuilt executable's hash. Many functions and filenames are still being identified.
description_zh: LSD Decompiled 是 PlayStation 游戏《LSD: Dream Emulator》的早期 C 语言反编译项目。文档中的流程使用用户提供的游戏可执行文件和 MIPS 交叉工具链，并校验重建产物的哈希。许多函数及文件名仍在识别中。
requirements: Linux or Windows WSL2, Python 3.8 or newer, Git, and the documented MIPS build tools are required.
A user-provided game executable named SLPS_015.56 is required.
Many functions and filenames are still being identified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: ROLLER: reconstructing Whiplash/Fatal Racing for modern PCs
description_en: ROLLER aims to reimplement the functionality of the 1995 game Whiplash/Fatal Racing for modern PCs. Its C implementation substitutes DOS-specific functions with SDL and Windows or Unix equivalents, and its documentation records symbol and executable analysis used during reconstruction.
description_zh: ROLLER 旨在以 C 语言重新实现 1995 年游戏《Whiplash/Fatal Racing》的功能，使其能够在现代电脑上运行。项目以 SDL 及 Windows、Unix 平台的对应接口替代 DOS 专用函数，并记录重建过程中使用的符号与可执行文件分析方法。
requirements: A retail game copy supplies assets for native installations; the browser build uses a bundled freeware demo.
Zig 0.15.2 for the documented build workflow.

name: OpenKeeper: a Dungeon Keeper II game and engine remake
description_en: OpenKeeper reimplements the Dungeon Keeper II game and engine as a cross-platform Java application using JMonkeyEngine. It targets version 1.7 and three bonus packs, loading assets from the user's original game copy.
description_zh: OpenKeeper 使用 Java 和 JMonkeyEngine 跨平台重做《地下城守护者 II》的游戏与引擎，目标涵盖 1.7 版和三个附加包。运行及开发需要用户持有原版游戏素材。
requirements: An original Dungeon Keeper II copy is required for its assets.
The project uses JME 3.9 and Java 25.
Full implementation of version 1.7 and three bonus packs is a stated goal.
GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: n64dd: decompiling Ocarina of Time's Disk Drive code
description_en: n64dd reconstructs the Nintendo 64 Disk Drive component found in an Ocarina of Time ROM as C and assembly. Its scripts extract a user-supplied NTSC US ROM, produce disassembly and build the component; the Makefile provides an MD5 comparison mode for output.
description_zh: n64dd 将《塞尔达传说：时之笛》ROM 中的任天堂 64DD 组件还原为 C 与汇编。脚本从用户提供的美版 NTSC ROM 提取内容、生成反汇编并构建组件；Makefile 提供输出的 MD5 比较模式。
requirements: Requires an NTSC 1.0 US Ocarina of Time ROM at oot/baserom_oot_ne0.z64.
Requires Python dependencies from requirements.txt and the build toolchain selected by the Makefile.

name: OpenMTV: Mad TV decompiled and ported to modern systems
description_en: OpenMTV ports the 1991 DOS game Mad TV to Windows, macOS, and Linux using readable C reconstructed from its executable. A static recompiler supplies machine-level C for remaining code, while a DOS and hardware runtime supports the game and comparisons with original behavior.
description_zh: OpenMTV 从 1991 年 DOS 游戏 Mad TV 的可执行文件重建可读 C 源码，并移植到 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。静态重编译器为其余代码生成机器级 C，DOS 与硬件运行时负责运行游戏并对照原版行为。
requirements: Supply your own Mad TV files: MTV.EXE, INTRO.EXE, SOURCE1.RSC, SOURCE2.RSC, MCV.BIN, and DATAV.PCK for source builds.
Source builds require a C compiler, make, SDL2, Python 3.8+ with capstone, and Go 1.25+ for the launcher.
The author reports 591 of 601 game functions in readable C; the remainder uses machine-level C.

name: Another Mind: matching PlayStation source reconstruction
description_en: Another Mind reconstructs C source for Squaresoft's Japanese PlayStation 1 game. Its workflow extracts the user's retail disc, converts assembly placeholders with m2c, and checks compiled output against the retail executable's SHA-1. The author reports 226 decompiled functions out of 900.
description_zh: Another Mind 重建 Squaresoft 日版 PlayStation 1 游戏的 C 源码。流程从用户的零售版光盘提取文件，用 m2c 将汇编占位内容转换为 C，并以 SHA-1 比较编译结果与原版程序；作者报告已反编译 900 个函数中的 226 个。
requirements: A Japanese retail BIN/CUE disc image is required.
Go, Ninja, 7z, bchunk, MIPS cross-tools, and Python dependencies are listed for the build.
The author reports 226 of 900 functions decompiled.
No licence file in the repository.

name: South Park: Tenorman's Revenge: an Xbox 360 static recompilation
description_en: South Park: Tenorman's Revenge is ported to Windows and Linux by translating its Xbox 360 executable to native PC code with ReXGlue. The project includes a package importer, launcher, and game-specific function analysis; the author reports that levels play on Windows while a full playthrough remains unconfirmed.
description_zh: 该项目通过 ReXGlue 将《South Park: Tenorman's Revenge》的 Xbox 360 可执行文件转译为 PC 原生代码，面向 Windows 和 Linux。仓库包含游戏包导入器、启动器及游戏专用函数分析；作者报告 Windows 版可游玩关卡，但尚未确认完整通关。
requirements: Provide your own South Park: Tenorman's Revenge XBLA package matching title ID 58410B80 and the documented default.xex version.
Use Windows 10 or 11 x64 with a DirectX 12 GPU, or x64 Linux with Vulkan.
A full playthrough remains unconfirmed.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Super Mario Sunshine: an Android port of the decompiled game
description_en: sms-android ports Super Mario Sunshine to native ARM64 Android using decompiled game source, OpenGL ES 3.0, and SDL2 input. It reads a user-provided USA GameCube GMSE01 ISO and adds on-screen touch controls alongside USB and Bluetooth gamepad support.
description_zh: sms-android 基于《Super Mario Sunshine》的反编译源码构建 ARM64 Android 原生移植版，使用 OpenGL ES 3.0 和 SDL2 输入。程序读取用户提供的美版 GameCube GMSE01 ISO，并提供屏幕触控及 USB、蓝牙手柄支持。
requirements: An ARM64 device running Android 8.0+ with OpenGL ES 3.0+.
A personal USA GameCube GMSE01 ISO of Super Mario Sunshine.
For builds: JDK 17, Android SDK API 34, Android NDK 26.3.11579264, and CMake 3.22.1+.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Black & White: reconstructing the game from its x86 binary
description_en: Black & White reconstructs the 2001 game's systems in portable C++ using analysis of its original x86 executable. An IDA and Ghidra pipeline walks RTTI vtables to recover class methods; the native viewer runs reconstructed world loading, physics, animation, scripting and audio paths.
description_zh: Black & White 通过分析 2001 年原版游戏的 x86 可执行文件，以 C++ 重建游戏系统。IDA 与 Ghidra 流程沿 RTTI 虚函数表恢复类方法；原生查看器运行重建的场景加载、物理、动画、脚本和音频功能。
requirements: A personal copy of the Black & White v1.0 binary is needed for the decompilation pipeline.
IDA Professional 9.1 idalib is the primary decompiler; Ghidra is used for comparison.
The native reconstruction remains partial.
MIT.

name: Open KF: a Killing Floor reimplementation in Rust and Bevy
description_en: Open KF reimplements the 2009 Killing Floor engine and gameplay in Rust and Bevy, reading maps, textures, audio and other resources from the user’s installed copy. Its ue-assets crate parses Unreal packages and provides commands to inspect objects, scripts, meshes and BSP data. The project offers single-player play and experimental cooperative multiplayer.
description_zh: Open KF 使用 Rust 和 Bevy 重建 2009 年《Killing Floor》的引擎与玩法，从用户安装的原版读取地图、贴图、音频等资源。ue-assets 模块解析 Unreal 资源包，并提供检查对象、脚本、网格和 BSP 数据的命令。项目支持单人游戏及实验性的合作多人模式。
requirements: An installed Steam copy of Killing Floor is required.
Building from source requires Nix with flakes, Rust and Bevy’s system libraries.
Cooperative multiplayer is experimental.
The source code is dual-licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0.

name: Jet Force Gemini: Recompiled — an N64 static recompilation port
description_en: Jet Force Gemini: Recompiled translates the US N64 game's code from a user-supplied ROM into C with N64Recomp and runs it with N64ModernRuntime and RT64. The native port supports Windows, Linux and Steam Deck, with revised controls, display options and mod loading. The repository also contains game-specific source and build scripts.
description_zh: Jet Force Gemini: Recompiled 使用 N64Recomp 将用户自备的美版 N64 ROM 代码转换为 C，并通过 N64ModernRuntime 和 RT64 运行。原生移植支持 Windows、Linux 和 Steam Deck，提供新的操作方式、显示选项与模组加载；仓库还包含游戏专用源码和构建脚本。
requirements: Provide the US Jet Force Gemini ROM in .z64 format with the SHA-1 listed in the README.
Windows builds require Visual Studio 2022, Git and Python 3; Linux builds require clang 15 or newer and CMake.
The Linux release files run on Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, Debian 12 or newer, current Fedora, and SteamOS 3.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: OpenApe: reconstructing the Call of Duty 4 Asset Manager
description_en: OpenApe reimplements the Call of Duty 4 mod tools' asset_manager.exe as a C++20 desktop editor. The author attributes its format knowledge to machine-assisted analysis of decompiled binaries. It reads GDF definitions and GDT game data, and previews models, animations and materials using the game's compiled shaders.
description_zh: OpenApe 用 C++20 重建《使命召唤 4》模组工具中的 asset_manager.exe 桌面编辑器。作者称，其格式知识来自对反编译程序的机器辅助分析。程序读取 GDF 定义和 GDT 游戏数据，并使用游戏的已编译着色器预览模型、动画和材质。
requirements: Building requires Visual Studio 2022 or 2026 with the C++ toolset and Windows SDK.
Editing requires a Call of Duty 4 project tree with deffiles and GDT files in source_data or the folders listed in bin\converter_gdt_dirs_0.txt.
MIT licence.

name: OpenDaed: reimplementing The Daedalus Encounter
description_en: OpenDaed reimplements the interactive-movie puzzle game The Daedalus Encounter in C++ using the original CD data. Its source includes game-file readers, an interpreter, video playback and puzzle implementations. The author describes an early build that runs the opening scenes but is not yet playable end to end.
description_zh: OpenDaed 以 C++ 重建互动电影解谜游戏 The Daedalus Encounter，并读取原版光盘数据。源码包含游戏文件读取、解释执行、视频播放及谜题实现。作者称早期版本可运行开场场景，但尚不能完整游玩。
requirements: Original game CD data is required.
Building requires CMake, SDL2, SDL2_image and the libSDL2pp submodule.
The project is at an early stage and is not yet fully playable.
GNU General Public License version 3.

name: Aidyn Chronicles: Ghidra-derived N64 source reconstruction
description_en: Aidyn Chronicles: The First Mage is examined through Splat configurations and symbol tables for debug and NTSC 1.0 builds. The repository contains headers and manually cleaned, Ghidra-derived pseudocode for game source files, which the author describes as untested.
description_zh: 该项目使用 Splat 配置和符号表分析 N64 游戏 Aidyn Chronicles: The First Mage 的调试版及 NTSC 1.0 版。仓库提供头文件和经手工整理的 Ghidra 伪代码；作者说明这些代码未经测试。
requirements: The source covers debug and NTSC 1.0 builds.
The pseudocode is untested.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Galaxy on Fire 2: matching reconstruction of the Android Abyss Engine library
description_en: Galaxy on Fire 2 reconstructs C++ for the Android game's Abyss Engine library, libgof2hdaa.so. Its NDK r18b build compiles ARM objects, links a shared library and compares functions and symbols with the original; notes record unresolved type and control-flow matches.
description_zh: Galaxy on Fire 2 为 Android 版游戏的 Abyss Engine 库 libgof2hdaa.so 重建 C++。项目使用 NDK r18b 编译 ARM 目标文件、链接共享库，并与原版逐函数和逐符号比较；研究笔记记录了尚未解决的类型与控制流匹配问题。
requirements: The original Android ARM32 libgof2hdaa.so is required for comparison.
An x86_64 Linux host or an x86_64 macOS environment is required; Apple Silicon runs the toolchain through Rosetta 2. CMake obtains NDK r18b.
The reconstruction remains a work in progress with unmatched functions.

name: Super Mario Advance 4: an exact-match Armips disassembly
description_en: Super Mario Advance 4: Super Mario Bros. 3 U rev 1 is reconstructed as Armips assembly that the author reports reassembles to an exact ROM match. The project replaces ROM pointers with labels and supplies scripts to extract required graphics and sound data from the player's original ROM. A Wii U Virtual Console variant is supported when its data is supplied.
description_zh: 《Super Mario Advance 4: Super Mario Bros. 3》美版修订版 1 被重建为 Armips 汇编；作者报告可重新汇编成完全匹配的 ROM。项目将 ROM 指针改为标签，并提供从玩家原版 ROM 提取图像和声音数据的脚本；使用对应数据时也支持 Wii U Virtual Console 版本。
requirements: Armips and the original Super Mario Advance 4 ROM are required.
Extract graphics and sound data from the original ROM before assembling.
The replaced ROM pointers have not been thoroughly tested for arbitrary code additions or removals.
No licence file in the repository.

name: pc-megamanxcm: a native Mega Man X: Command Mission port
description_en: pc-megamanxcm develops a native PC port of Mega Man X: Command Mission from the European GameCube release. It maps names from a symbol table left on the disc to the stripped DOL, then uses wiikit to translate PowerPC code to C++ and replace console hardware services. The author reports play through the opening scenes with audio; saving remains unavailable.
description_zh: pc-megamanxcm 基于欧版 GameCube《洛克人 X 指令任务》开发原生 PC 移植版。项目将光盘遗留符号表中的名称映射到去符号 DOL，再用 wiikit 把 PowerPC 代码转为 C++ 并替代主机硬件服务。作者报告开场剧情和音频可运行；存档功能尚不可用。
requirements: A user-supplied GXRP08 European GameCube disc image is required.
Python 3.8+ is needed for tools; building requires CMake, Ninja, a C++20 compiler, SDL3, and wiikit; running requires OpenGL 4.5.
Saving is unavailable and little beyond the opening has been played.
MIT license.

name: Suikoden II: a disc-local PlayStation static recompilation
description_en: Suikoden II Recomp configures psxrecomp to generate and compile the US PlayStation game from the player's SLUS-00958 disc image and SCPH-1001 BIOS. A recomp-ui setup host collects those inputs and builds normal and diagnostic executables locally.
description_zh: Suikoden II Recomp 配置 psxrecomp，从玩家提供的 SLUS-00958 美版光盘镜像和 SCPH-1001 BIOS 在本地生成、编译游戏。recomp-ui 安装程序收集所需文件，并构建普通版和诊断版程序。
requirements: Own Suikoden II USA SLUS-00958 as a supported CUE/BIN or CHD image, plus a legally dumped SCPH-1001 USA BIOS.
Linux and macOS setup needs CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and a C/C++ compiler.
The author reports Windows setup, compilation and headless startup checks; Linux and macOS gameplay checks remain pending.
GPL-3.0-only for project files; psxrecomp and recomp-ui retain separate licences.

name: Exolon: an HTML5 remake of the ZX Spectrum game
description_en: Exolon recreates the 1987 ZX Spectrum game as an HTML5 game built with melonJS. Its repository includes JavaScript game code and TMX level maps, and the author recommends Firefox or Chrome for play.
description_zh: Exolon 用 melonJS 将 1987 年的 ZX Spectrum 游戏重制为 HTML5 游戏。仓库包含 JavaScript 游戏代码和 TMX 关卡地图；作者建议使用 Firefox 或 Chrome。
requirements: Firefox or Chrome is recommended for play.
MIT license.

name: Guilty Gear X Plus: decompiling the Korean release
description_en: Guilty Gear X Plus is decompiled into game-specific C source, headers and symbol maps for the Korean release. The build starts from an extracted SLPM_645.25 executable, then uses configure.py and Ninja; the repository also contains a decompilation permuter for matching C functions to target assembly.
description_zh: 项目针对韩版 Guilty Gear X Plus 保存游戏专用的 C 源码、头文件和符号映射。构建时先从游戏镜像提取 SLPM_645.25，再运行 configure.py 与 Ninja；仓库还包含用于调整 C 函数以匹配目标汇编的工具。
requirements: Extract SLPM_645.25 from a Guilty Gear X Plus (Korean) ISO and place it in the iso directory.
Run configure.py and Ninja to build.

name: Soulbrandt: a native Demon's Souls PC port
description_en: Soulbrandt converts the US PlayStation 3 release of Demon's Souls into a native Windows and Linux port using the player's game files. Setup uses RPCS3 to decrypt the required files or accepts files the player has decrypted, then builds the port locally. The project includes game-specific analysis, runtime integration, rendering, controls and online services.
description_zh: Soulbrandt 使用玩家的美版 PS3 游戏文件，构建《恶魔之魂》的 Windows 和 Linux 原生移植版。安装程序借助 RPCS3 解密所需文件，也可接收玩家已解密的文件，然后在本地构建程序。项目还包含针对游戏的分析、运行时集成、渲染、操作和在线服务。
requirements: A Demon's Souls US BLUS30443 version 1.00 game folder is required.
Setup needs RPCS3 with PS3 system software or files decrypted by the user; an internet connection is required during setup.
The 0.1.0 release is an alpha, and Linux has received less testing than Windows.
MIT license.

name: OpenDUNE: a native recreation of Dune II
description_en: OpenDUNE recreates Dune II in ANSI C for desktop systems and Atari TOS. Desktop builds use SDL or SDL2; the game reads original Dune II 1.07 data files, including dune2.exe, from a user-provided data directory.
description_zh: OpenDUNE 以 ANSI C 重建《沙丘 II》，可在桌面系统和 Atari TOS 上运行。桌面版本使用 SDL 或 SDL2；游戏从用户提供的数据目录读取原版 Dune II 1.07 数据文件，包括 dune2.exe。
requirements: Original Dune II 1.07 data files, including dune2.exe, must be placed in data/.
The source uses SDL or SDL2; Linux and FreeBSD users need LibSDL installed.
The project documents a sound-output issue that can block the house selection screen.
GPL-2.0 license.

name: VERA20K: rebuilding Red Alert 2: Yuri's Revenge in Rust
description_en: VERA20K rebuilds the Red Alert 2: Yuri's Revenge engine in Rust while reading the user's original game files. The project says coding agents study the original engine with Ghidra, implement its behavior in a new simulation and rendering architecture, and compare results with the original through tools and playtests.
description_zh: VERA20K 用 Rust 重建《红色警戒 2：尤里的复仇》引擎，并读取用户自己的原版游戏文件。项目称编程智能体使用 Ghidra 研究原引擎，在新的模拟与渲染架构中实现其行为，再通过对照工具和游戏测试与原版比较。
requirements: Requires the user's own copy of Red Alert 2: Yuri's Revenge.
Building requires Rust 1.97 or later, Git and platform build tools.
Campaign missions can start, but objectives, triggers, scripted transitions, saving and loading still need work.
Code is licensed under GPLv3 with additional terms; art added to the project's art/ folder defaults to CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

name: Habbo: a Flash-client server emulator
description_en: Habbo recreates server-side services for the Habbo Flash client in Node.js. Its source accepts TCP connections, dispatches client packets and defines handshake, user, navigator and room messages; the README presents development screenshots of a running Flash client.
description_zh: Habbo 以 Node.js 重建面向 Habbo Flash 客户端的服务器服务。源码接收 TCP 连接、分发客户端封包，并定义握手、用户、导航和房间消息；项目文档展示了 Flash 客户端运行时的开发截图。
requirements: Node.js and the dependencies declared in package.json.
The network code marks packet decryption as unfinished.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: Bushido Blade 2: a disc-local PlayStation static recompilation
description_en: Bushido Blade 2 Recomp configures psxrecomp to generate and compile the US PlayStation release from the player's SLUS-00663 disc image and SCPH-1001 BIOS. Its recomp-ui setup host creates normal and diagnostic builds on the player's machine.
description_zh: Bushido Blade 2 Recomp 配置 psxrecomp，从玩家提供的 SLUS-00663 美版光盘镜像和 SCPH-1001 BIOS 生成、编译游戏。recomp-ui 安装程序在玩家设备上构建普通版和诊断版。
requirements: Own Bushido Blade 2 USA SLUS-00663 as a supported CUE/BIN or CHD image, plus a legally dumped SCPH-1001 USA BIOS.
Linux and macOS setup needs CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and a C/C++ compiler.
The author reports Windows setup, compilation and headless startup checks; Linux and macOS gameplay checks remain pending.
GPL-3.0-only for project files; psxrecomp and recomp-ui retain separate licences.

name: OpenD2: rebuilding the Diablo II engine
description_en: OpenD2 rewrites the Diablo II game engine in C++ to use the original game’s data and save files. Its source includes MPQ archive, rendering, audio, networking, and game components. The README reports that most of the main menu works, while TCP/IP games stall during loading.
description_zh: OpenD2 用 C++ 重写 Diablo II 游戏引擎，使用原版游戏数据和存档。源码包含 MPQ 档案、渲染、音频、网络及游戏模块。README 称主菜单的大部分功能可用，但 TCP/IP 游戏会在加载时停住。
requirements: An original Diablo II installation and game files.
Windows builds require CMake and Visual Studio 2017 or later; Linux builds require GLEW, GLM, and SDL2 development packages.
Most game code is unfinished, and TCP/IP games stall during loading.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: rd-131655: reconstructing an unreleased Minecraft cave test
description_en: rd-131655 recreates an unreleased pre-classic Minecraft cave test from its first public video and contemporary IRC logs. The Java implementation includes cave generation and 8×8×8 chunks, and the project provides a Gradle run task.
description_zh: rd-131655 根据最早公开的视频及同期 IRC 日志，重建未发布的 Minecraft 早期洞穴测试。Java 实现包含洞穴生成和 8×8×8 区块，并提供 Gradle 运行任务。
requirements: Gradle is used to run the Java project.
The original build was never publicly released; the reconstruction is based on video and logs.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Go Vacation: a halted Wii decompilation
description_en: Go Vacation is a Wii game decompilation with source and build configurations for several game versions. The author halted work because the game's main code sits in relocatable RSO modules that the decompilation toolkit did not support.
description_zh: Go Vacation 是 Wii 游戏的反编译项目，仓库提供多个版本的源码和构建配置。作者因游戏主要代码位于反编译工具包尚未支持的可重定位 RSO 模块中而暂停开发。
requirements: Work is halted because the decompilation toolkit lacks support for the game's relocatable RSO modules.

name: Zombies Ate My Neighbors: a ROM-checked C port
description_en: The Zombies Ate My Neighbors PC Port rewrites the SNES game's logic in C and checks it against execution of the user's original ROM. An in-tree tracer produces code/data logs and memory maps, while a co-simulation harness compares port behavior with the reference core; the port also adds widescreen display and controller options.
description_zh: Zombies Ate My Neighbors PC Port 以 C 重写 SNES 游戏逻辑，并与用户自有 ROM 的执行结果对照。仓库内的追踪器生成代码与数据日志、内存映射；协同模拟工具将移植版行为与参考核心比较。移植版还加入宽屏显示和手柄选项。
requirements: User-supplied USA SNES ROM matching the listed hashes.
The Linux build is described as experimental.
The author says the port remains a work in progress and some game execution is still emulated.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Heretic2: adapting reconstructed game code to Yamagi Quake II
description_en: Heretic2 adapts Heretic 2 game code from an earlier reconstruction project to a customized Yamagi Quake II Remaster engine. Its source and progress notes cover differences in effects, movement, rendering and save handling while targeting single-player play from Heretic 2 game data.
description_zh: Heretic2 将早期重建项目中的《Heretic 2》游戏代码适配到定制的 Yamagi Quake II Remaster 引擎。源码和进度笔记记录特效、移动、渲染及存档处理的差异，目标是使用《Heretic 2》游戏数据运行单人模式。
requirements: The documented test setup uses data from the Heretic 2 Loki release.
Single-player support is the priority; the author describes the work as an early-stage project.
Save handling and several gameplay systems remain incomplete.
The repository LICENSE lists GPLv2-covered Quake II code and multiple component licences.

name: Escape Velocity Nova: an engine reimplementation guided by decompilation
description_en: evnova-decomp reimplements the Escape Velocity Nova engine in C++23 and SDL3 using data from a local Windows Community Edition installation. Its research notes cover resource formats, missions and gameplay behavior, while Ghidra-based tools support comparison with original functions. The author reports a playable storyline but notes missing features and timing differences.
description_zh: evnova-decomp 使用 C++23 和 SDL3 重建《Escape Velocity Nova》引擎，读取用户本地安装的 Windows Community Edition 数据。研究笔记记录资源格式、任务及游戏行为，基于 Ghidra 的工具支持与原始函数比较。作者报告一条剧情线可游玩，同时指出仍有缺失功能和时序差异。
requirements: Requires an installed copy of Escape Velocity Nova Windows Community Edition data.
Builds require CMake 3.25+, Ninja, a C++23-capable compiler and vcpkg.
QuickTime movies, shield bubbles and some specific behaviors remain unsupported; timing and AI behavior can differ.
MIT applies to material the author holds copyright over.

name: HWDE-decomp: matching Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition functions
description_en: HWDE-decomp reconstructs functions from Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition update 1.0.1 as C++ intended to match the AArch64 main module. Its checker compiles source with specified Clang flags, resolves relocations, and compares function words with an original module extracted by the user.
description_zh: HWDE-decomp 将 Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition 更新版 1.0.1 的函数重建为 C++，目标是匹配 AArch64 main 模块。检查工具按指定 Clang 参数编译源码、解析重定位，并与用户自行提取的原版模块逐字比较函数。
requirements: Supply a legally obtained game copy and extract update 1.0.1's main module to the documented path.
Clang 3.9.1 and the listed AArch64 compilation flags are used for matching.
The author reports 8,236 of 8,426 attempted functions matching, with 190 near misses.
No licence file in the repository.

name: uo-client: reconstructing the Ultima Online 2.0.7 client
description_en: uo-client reconstructs the Ultima Online T2A 2.0.7 client in C++, including its packet protocol, MUL asset loading and isometric display. The author describes consulting the decompiled original in IDA, recording findings in its database and comparing renderer output and protocol behavior with the original. The client targets the UO Demo shard and includes a JavaScript-driven navigation bot.
description_zh: uo-client 用 C++ 重建 Ultima Online T2A 2.0.7 客户端，涵盖数据包协议、MUL 资源加载和等距视角画面。作者在 IDA 中研究原版客户端的反编译结果，将确认的发现写回 IDA 数据库，并对照原版检查渲染结果和协议行为。客户端面向 UO Demo 服务器，内含由 JavaScript 驱动的导航机器人。
requirements: The UO Demo shard is the supported server.
Original Ultima Online game assets are required for the asset loaders and renderer.
The license permits noncommercial use, modification and distribution with attribution.

name: Robot War Engine: a Total Annihilation-compatible engine reconstruction
description_en: Robot War Engine rebuilds a Total Annihilation-compatible strategy-game engine that runs on the player's original data files. Its C++ core parses HPI archives, GAF sprites, 3DO models and COB unit scripts, while a separate Electron launcher provides a multiplayer lobby.
description_zh: Robot War Engine 重建兼容《横扫千军》的即时战略引擎，运行时读取玩家自备的原版数据。C++ 核心解析 HPI 归档、GAF 精灵、3DO 模型和 COB 单位脚本；独立 Electron 启动器提供多人游戏大厅。
requirements: Original Total Annihilation data files are required to run the game.
The project documents Windows builds and Linux builds; macOS is not regularly tested.
There is no stable release.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Mega Man 9: a matching WiiWare decompilation
description_en: Mega Man 9 is being reconstructed as C source for the US WiiWare release WR9E, with the original CodeWarrior toolchain used to match game functions. The build combines reconstructed units with split original objects and compares the resulting DOL against the target SHA-1. The author reports 1,760 exact game-function matches out of 2,941; source remains split by function.
description_zh: 项目将美版 WiiWare 游戏《Mega Man 9》（WR9E）重建为 C 源码，使用原版 CodeWarrior 工具链匹配游戏函数。构建流程将重建单元与从原版拆分的目标文件链接，再以 SHA-1 比较生成的 DOL。作者报告 2,941 个游戏函数中有 1,760 个精确匹配；源码目前按函数拆分。
requirements: A user-owned US WiiWare WR9E main DOL is required; it is absent from the repository.
The build requires CodeWarrior Wii/1.0, Python 3 and Ninja; non-Windows hosts need a Win32 wrapper.
The author reports that original translation units have not yet been recovered.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: Hookshot: static recompilation of the Switch 2 Ocarina of Time remake
description_en: Hookshot statically recompiles the Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time into a native Windows or Linux program using the user's game files. Its pipeline lifts AArch64 game code to C, implements Horizon OS and NVN2 natively, and renders GPU work with Vulkan.
description_zh: Hookshot 使用用户自己的游戏文件，将 Switch 2 重制版《塞尔达传说：时之笛》静态重编译为 Windows 或 Linux 原生程序。其构建流程将游戏的 AArch64 代码转换为 C，在 PC 端重新实现 Horizon OS 和 NVN2，并通过 Vulkan 执行图形渲染。
requirements: A copy of the supported game version: program 0400486024DEC000, update v131072, build e0f3ccfa; input as a .nup file or romfs and exefs folders.
64-bit Windows 10 or 11, or 64-bit Linux with glibc 2.35 or newer, and an AVX2 CPU.
A Vulkan 1.3 graphics card with mesh shaders; 16 GB RAM and about 60 GB of free space for building.
Experimental; testing has focused mainly on the start of the game, and some areas still have crashes or graphics issues.

name: Test Drive SDL3: reconstructing the DOS and Amiga game ports
description_en: Test Drive SDL3 ports the DOS EGA, CGA and Hercules versions and the Amiga version of the 1987 game to native SDL3 programs. Reverse-engineering specifications cover game flow, simulation, rendering and platform behavior, while a separate document covers file formats. The ports read user-supplied original game files.
description_zh: Test Drive SDL3 将 1987 年《Test Drive》的 DOS EGA、CGA、Hercules 版本及 Amiga 版本移植为 SDL3 原生程序。逆向工程规格文档涵盖游戏流程、模拟、渲染和平台行为，另有文档记录文件格式。移植程序读取用户提供的原版游戏文件。
requirements: Original DOS game files or an Amiga disk image or extracted files are required.
Building requires CMake 3.24+, C11 and SDL3; the launcher also needs C++17 and wxWidgets 3.2.
The game-file folder must be writable for high scores.
MIT License.

name: Greenwood: a matching Robin Hood decompilation
description_en: Greenwood reconstructs Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood v1.1 as C++ intended to compile into byte-identical machine code with Microsoft Visual C++ 6.0 SP6. The repository contains game-specific source for actors, artificial intelligence and other systems, and uses compiled-function comparison tools to track matching progress. The author reports 4,723 of 6,113 game functions decompiled.
description_zh: Greenwood 将《Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood》v1.1 重建为 C++ 源码，目标是经 Microsoft Visual C++ 6.0 SP6 编译后生成逐字节一致的机器码。仓库包含角色、人工智能等游戏系统的专属源码，并使用函数比较工具跟踪匹配进度。作者报告已反编译 6,113 个游戏函数中的 4,723 个。
requirements: The target is Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood v1.1.
Matching uses Microsoft Visual C++ 6.0 SP6.
The author reports 4,723 of 6,113 game functions decompiled.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Black & White: decompiling the Windows and Classic Mac OS game builds
description_en: Black & White is being reconstructed as C and C++ source for multiple Windows PE/COFF and Classic Mac OS PEF releases. The workflow splits user-supplied game binaries into objects, builds reconstructed source with period toolchains, and compares objects with objdiff.
description_zh: 项目为多个 Windows PE/COFF 与经典 Mac OS PEF 版本的《Black & White》重建 C/C++ 源码。工作流程将用户自备游戏程序拆分为目标文件，使用对应年代的工具链编译重建源码，再借助 objdiff 对照。
requirements: An existing game copy and the original binaries for the selected version are required; Windows builds also need the game's DLLs.
The documented Windows builds require decrypted executables and period MSVC libraries; Python and Ninja drive configuration and builds.
The decompilation is in progress across multiple versions.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: Igor: interpreting the original Objetivo Uikokahonia executable
description_en: Igor runs the Spanish CD release of Igor: Objetivo Uikokahonia through an x86 decoder and interpreter built from analysis of the original executable. It extracts game data and replaces higher-level palette, display and input routines, with separate notes on the executable's structure.
description_zh: Igor 根据原版可执行文件的分析实现 x86 解码器和解释器，用于运行 Igor: Objetivo Uikokahonia 西班牙语 CD 版。项目提取游戏数据，并重写调色板、显示和输入等高层函数，另有文档记录可执行文件结构。
requirements: Original Spanish CD files IGOR.DAT and IGOR.EXE, plus igor.bin.
SDL, Vorbis, zlib and OpenGL for the documented Makefile build.
The author describes the program as a proof of concept; the original save/load screen is missing.
No licence file in the repository.

name: FS15 Reconstruction: Farming Simulator 15 and GIANTS Engine 6 component recovery
description_en: FS15 Reconstruction recovers components of Farming Simulator 15 and GIANTS Engine 6 from the Windows 1.4.2.0 release. It combines decompilation, recovered scripts and native component comparisons with experimental gameplay and Linux hosts. The author reports that original GE6 code reaches a Linux-rendered farm view, while full engine and farming behavior remain incomplete.
description_zh: FS15 Reconstruction 以 Windows 版 Farming Simulator 15 1.4.2.0 为参照，恢复 GIANTS Engine 6 的部分组件。项目结合反编译、脚本恢复和原生组件比对，构建实验性游戏运行环境及 Linux 运行路径。作者报告原始 GE6 代码已在 Linux 上显示农场画面；完整引擎和农场玩法仍未完成。
requirements: Requires a local installation of Farming Simulator 15 for Windows, version 1.4.2.0, to reproduce game-resource results.
The reconstructed gameplay host is experimental; sustained walking, driving, farming, and Windows graphics and gameplay parity remain unverified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Portémon Nitro: a HeartGold and SoulSilver engine port
description_en: Portémon Nitro reimplements the Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver engine in LÖVE for PCs and mobile devices. It reads a user-owned Nintendo DS ROM, derives game data locally, and separates ROM interpretation from runtime behavior and the app interface. The repository contains Lua game code, Nintendo DS and game-specific libraries, and ROM import tooling.
description_zh: Portémon Nitro 使用 LÖVE 重建 Pokémon HeartGold 与 SoulSilver 的游戏引擎，面向电脑和移动设备。项目读取用户自有的 Nintendo DS ROM，在本地生成游戏数据，并将 ROM 解析、运行时行为与应用界面分离。仓库包含 Lua 游戏代码、Nintendo DS 与游戏专用库，以及 ROM 导入工具。
requirements: Requires a user-owned compatible canonical US Pokémon HeartGold or SoulSilver ROM.
Runs through the LÖVE framework.
AGPL-3.0 License.

name: F-Zero X: an early US N64 decompilation
description_en: F-Zero X reconstructs parts of the US Nintendo 64 game in C, alongside assembly extracted from the user's ROM. Its build extracts a user-supplied Z64 ROM and produces a ROM with a published SHA-1 target. The author describes the codebase as early research and says its output is not yet suitable as a general modification base.
description_zh: F-Zero X 以 C 语言重建美版 Nintendo 64 游戏的部分代码，构建时还会从用户的 ROM 提取汇编代码。构建流程使用用户提供的 Z64 ROM，生成的 ROM 有公布的 SHA-1 目标值。作者说明项目仍处于早期研究阶段，暂不适合作为通用修改基础。
requirements: Provide a legally obtained USA F-Zero X ROM in Z64 format as baserom.us.z64.
Requires Python 3.10 or newer and a MIPS64 toolchain.
The reconstructed ROM is not yet shiftable or suitable for general source modifications.
No licence file in the repository.

name: NHL24 PC: running NHL 24 on Windows through a game-specific PS4 runtime
description_en: NHL24 PC runs the PS4 version of NHL 24 on Windows through a game-specific shadPS4 fork. It executes the game's x86-64 code directly, replaces PS4 system-library calls with native implementations, translates GCN shaders to SPIR-V for Vulkan, and extracts the user's own base and update PKGs through its launcher.
description_zh: NHL24 PC 基于针对《NHL 24》调整的 shadPS4 分支，在 Windows 上运行其 PS4 版本。它直接执行游戏的 x86-64 代码，以本地实现处理 PS4 系统库调用，将 GCN 着色器转换为 SPIR-V 供 Vulkan 使用，并通过启动器解包用户自己的基础版及更新版 PKG。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 x64 and a Vulkan 1.3 GPU.
A user-provided NHL 24 PS4 base PKG, version 1.00, for CUSA37933 or CUSA37934; the 1.60 update is optional.
The author reports that European update 1.60 testing remains pending and that rare device-lost crashes occur.
GPL-2.0-or-later license.

name: Halo 3 Delta: reconstructing halo3_cache_release.xex
description_en: The Halo 3 Delta project targets halo3_cache_release.xex from build 08172.07.03.08.2240.delta for ReXGlue-based recompilation. The repository contains C++ game source modules and a CMake configuration that includes them in the executable target.
description_zh: Halo 3 Delta 项目以 08172.07.03.08.2240.delta 版本的 halo3_cache_release.xex 为 ReXGlue 重编译目标。仓库包含 C++ 游戏源码模块，以及将这些模块加入可执行文件构建目标的 CMake 配置。
requirements: ReXGlue for the generated build configuration.
CMake 3.25 or later and a C++23 compiler.
BSD-3-Clause license.

name: Xena: Warrior Princess Recompiled: a PlayStation setup host
description_en: Xena: Warrior Princess Recompiled configures PSXRecomp and recomp-ui to generate a native build of the USA PlayStation game from a user's disc and BIOS. Its repository contains game configuration, symbol seeds and setup-host build files; the project report identifies gameplay, input, audio and save checks as outstanding.
description_zh: Xena: Warrior Princess Recompiled 配置 PSXRecomp 和 recomp-ui，使用用户的光盘及 BIOS 为美版 PlayStation 游戏生成原生程序。仓库包含游戏配置、符号种子和安装程序的构建文件；项目报告称游戏运行、输入、音频及存档检验仍待完成。
requirements: Supply your own USA Xena: Warrior Princess disc and legal SCPH-1001 BIOS dump.
Building requires the pinned PSXRecomp framework, Python 3, CMake, Ninja and a C/C++ toolchain.
Operator-visible gameplay, input, audio and save checks remain open.
Project-owned files use GPL-3.0-only; PSXRecomp and recomp-ui retain separate licences.

name: OpenBreed: reconstructing the classic Alien Breed games
description_en: OpenBreed investigates and reimplements Alien Breed Special Edition 92, Alien Breed II and Alien Breed: Tower Assault. Its C# editor reads maps, sprites, tiles and image formats from original resources, while the author works to recover behavior and tables stored in the games' executables. The game engine lacks game-specific logic and is not yet playable.
description_zh: OpenBreed 研究并重建《Alien Breed Special Edition 92》《Alien Breed II》与《Alien Breed: Tower Assault》。其 C# 编辑器读取原版地图、精灵图、图块和图像格式，作者还在还原固化于游戏可执行文件中的行为与数据表。游戏引擎尚缺少具体玩法逻辑，暂不可玩。
requirements: Original game resources are needed for the editor and reimplementation.
Development uses .NET 6.0 and Visual Studio 2022 or a compatible environment.
Game-specific logic is unfinished; the game is not yet playable.
No licence file in the repository.

name: ProTanki Server: reconstructing a game server for an older client
description_en: ProTanki Server reimplements a ProTanki game server in Kotlin for client library-20221001-223140. Its source includes packet processing and handlers for authentication, battles, chat, garage and other game operations; a later protocol update prevents support for newer clients.
description_zh: ProTanki Server 使用 Kotlin 重新实现 ProTanki 游戏服务器，支持的最新客户端版本为 library-20221001-223140。源码包含数据包处理，以及认证、战斗、聊天和车库等游戏操作的处理器；后续协议更新使其无法支持更新的客户端。
requirements: JDK 17 for building.
A ProTanki client no newer than library-20221001-223140.
The project is a work in progress and is no longer maintained.
MIT.

name: aioharmony: Logitech Harmony Hub protocol notes and client
description_en: aioharmony documents Logitech Harmony Hub authentication and control messages while providing an asyncio client for the device. Its protocol notes describe remote ID discovery, session-token exchange, and XMPP IQ stanzas. The client exposes activity, configuration, and device-command operations over WebSockets or XMPP.
description_zh: aioharmony 记录 Logitech Harmony Hub 的身份验证与控制消息，并提供 asyncio 客户端。协议资料描述远程 ID 获取、会话令牌交换和 XMPP IQ 消息；客户端通过 WebSockets 或 XMPP 查询配置、切换活动并发送设备命令。
requirements: A Logitech Harmony Link or Harmony Hub is required.
Python 3.10 or newer is required; XMPP use requires a hub with XMPP enabled.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: Sonic the Hedgehog: a Master System Z80 static recompilation
description_en: SonicTheHedgehogSMSRecomp translates the Sega Master System Sonic the Hedgehog Z80 program ahead of time into native C with smsggrecomp. Its game configuration records ROM identity and control-flow data, while the runtime models video, sound, ports, and the mapper; unresolved computed jumps can use a Z80 interpreter.
description_zh: SonicTheHedgehogSMSRecomp 使用 smsggrecomp 将 Sega Master System 版《Sonic the Hedgehog》的 Z80 程序预先转译为原生 C。游戏配置记录 ROM 身份和控制流数据，运行时模拟视频、声音、端口及存储映射；无法静态解析的计算跳转可交给 Z80 解释器。
requirements: Supply your own legally dumped Sonic the Hedgehog Master System ROM matching CRC32 B519E833.
The documented source build uses Windows CMake, Ninja, GCC, and SDL2.
The author reports assisted route coverage; full unassisted gameplay remains unverified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Top Spin 4 Recomp: a native Xbox 360 game port
description_en: Top Spin 4 Recomp ports the Xbox 360 game Top Spin 4 to Windows through ahead-of-time translation of its PowerPC code with ReXGlue. A game-specific renderer maps its Direct3D 9 calls to Vulkan, and a launcher prepares files from the user’s disc image and Title Update 1. The author reports working exhibition, career, academy, and local multiplayer modes.
description_zh: Top Spin 4 Recomp 使用 ReXGlue 提前翻译 Xbox 360 版 Top Spin 4 的 PowerPC 代码，将游戏移植到 Windows。专用渲染器把游戏的 Direct3D 9 调用映射到 Vulkan，启动器则从用户自己的光盘镜像和 Title Update 1 准备文件。作者报告表演赛、生涯、训练和本地多人模式可用。
requirements: Provide your own Top Spin 4 disc image with media ID 60819732 and Title Update 1 dumped from your console.
Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, a Vulkan GPU, and about 6 GB of free space are required.
Online multiplayer is unsupported; NVIDIA GPUs, other Intel GPUs, and Windows 10 are listed as untested.

name: Duke2Reconstructed: matching Duke Nukem II source reconstruction
description_en: Duke2Reconstructed rebuilds Duke Nukem II's DOS source in C and assembly from disassembly of the original executable. The author reports that an era-appropriate build produces a byte-identical binary after LZEXE compression, while original names and file organization remain approximations.
description_zh: Duke2Reconstructed 根据 Duke Nukem II 原版可执行文件的反汇编，以 C 和汇编重建 DOS 源码。作者报告，使用当年的工具链构建并经 LZEXE 压缩后可得到逐字节一致的程序；原始命名和文件组织仍属推测。
requirements: An era-appropriate DOS toolchain is required for the documented build.
Original identifiers and source-file organization cannot be recovered exactly from the executable.
GPL-2.0 license.

name: Open Ocarina: a PC source port of Ocarina of Time
