description_en: Open Ocarina ports the Ocarina of Time decompilation to a Windows build using assets extracted from the player's ROM. It adds adjustable frame rates, free camera control, keyboard and gamepad mappings, and support for GLideN64 texture packs.
description_zh: Open Ocarina 将《Ocarina of Time》反编译项目移植为 Windows 版本，构建时从玩家的 ROM 提取资源。移植版加入可调帧率、自由镜头、键盘及手柄按键映射，并支持 GLideN64 高清纹理包。
requirements: A prior copy of a supported Ocarina of Time ROM is required to extract assets.
Visual Studio 2019 or later is the documented supported build environment, limited to 32-bit Win32 builds.
The README marks higher frame rates as experimental and states Linux and macOS are unsupported.
GPL-2.0 applies only to commits after 27 December 2021; earlier upstream source was not retroactively relicensed.

name: Ms. Pac-Man: Namco NES disassembly
description_en: Ms. Pac-Man reconstructs assembly source and data layouts for the 1993 Namco/Now Production NES release. The repository separates maze and screen layout data from the main disassembly and directs users to extract graphics from their own ROM before assembling with CC65.
description_zh: Ms. Pac-Man 项目整理 1993 年 Namco/Now Production 版 NES 游戏的汇编源码和数据布局。仓库将迷宫及画面布局数据与主反汇编分开；构建前需从用户自备 ROM 提取图形，并使用 CC65 汇编。
requirements: Extract the graphics data from an original ROM.
Assemble with CC65.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Mario Party 6: a partial GameCube decompilation
description_en: MarioParty6 partially decompiles the GameCube game Mario Party 6. Its two C source files cover random-number routines and dynamic-module loading, with headers, a symbol map and a script that compiles the source files.
description_zh: MarioParty6 对 GameCube 游戏《Mario Party 6》进行部分反编译。仓库中的两个 C 源文件涉及随机数例程与动态模块加载，并附有头文件、符号映射和源码编译脚本。
requirements: The build script expects a Metrowerks GameCube compiler at compilers/GC/2.6/mwcceppc.exe.
The reconstructed C source currently comprises two files.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Shiren the Wanderer 2: matching N64 decompilation
description_en: Shiren the Wanderer 2 reconstructs most mapped CPU functions of the Japanese Nintendo 64 game as matching C and C++ source; the accounted CPU catalogue also includes classified handwritten assembly and libgcc helpers. The author reports byte-identical full-ROM acceptance builds.
description_zh: 《Shiren the Wanderer 2》将日版 Nintendo 64 游戏中大部分已映射的 CPU 函数重建为匹配原版的 C/C++ 源码；已统计的 CPU 代码还包括分类记录的手写汇编例程和 libgcc 函数。作者报告完整 ROM 的验收构建逐字节一致。
requirements: Use x86_64 Linux, Python 3.12, uv and the documented pinned toolchain dependencies.
Supply your own ROM and the N64 SDK RSP audio object n_aspMain.o.
A full build currently also requires private evidence omitted from the public repository.

name: Call of Duty 3: a multiplayer ReXGlue recompilation checkpoint
description_en: Call of Duty 3 Recompilation applies ReXGlue to the game's multiplayer executable. Its code defines PowerPC hooks and network-service stubs, while a function table names game routines for code generation. The project represents an early game-specific recompilation checkpoint.
description_zh: Call of Duty 3 Recompilation 使用 ReXGlue 处理游戏的多人模式程序。仓库代码定义 PowerPC 钩子和网络服务存根，函数表为代码生成标注游戏例程，呈现了游戏专用的早期重编译进展。
requirements: ReXGlue SDK, CMake 3.25 or later, and a C++23 toolchain are required.
The network-service replacements are currently stubs.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Rugrats: Search for Reptar: a Rust reconstruction of the PlayStation game
description_en: rugrats reconstructs the North American PlayStation game Rugrats: Search for Reptar as a native Rust PC game using data read from the player's own disc. Separate readers decode models, rooms, animation, sound and cinematics, while a new runtime implements controls, physics, level rules and saving. The author reports start-to-finish playability and records reverse-engineering findings in a worklog and format reference.
description_zh: rugrats 将美版 PS 游戏《淘气小兵兵：寻找雷普塔》重建为原生 Rust PC 游戏，从玩家自己的光盘读取数据。专用读取器解析模型、房间、动画、声音和过场，新运行时实现操作、物理、关卡规则和存档。作者报告可从头玩到结尾，并在工程日志和格式参考中记录逆向发现。
requirements: A North American SLUS-00650 .cue and .bin disc image, current stable Rust and suitable graphics support are required.
Other game regions are unsupported; the start-to-finish result is author-reported.
MIT or Apache-2.0 licence.

name: snatcher-port: reconstructing Sega CD Snatcher for desktop
description_en: snatcher-port investigates the Sega CD version of Snatcher and builds a desktop Mega CD runtime around code and data supplied from the user's disc. Its findings describe the main and sub CPU roles, while the engine implements game-needed hardware and BIOS services and offers a build-time 68000 translation path.
description_zh: snatcher-port 研究 Sega CD 版《Snatcher》，并围绕用户自备光盘中的代码与数据构建桌面 Mega CD 运行环境。研究记录区分主、副 CPU 的职责；引擎实现游戏所需硬件及 BIOS 服务，并提供构建时的 68000 代码转译路径。
requirements: Supply your own Sega CD Snatcher disc image; PC Engine CD work also requires that edition's disc.
Desktop builds use C++20 and SDL3, with documented Nix or Homebrew toolchains.
The PC Engine CD remaster and UE5 reimagining are separate development goals.
No licence file in the repository.

name: FPC Atomic: reconstructing Atomic Bomberman multiplayer
description_en: FPC Atomic recreates Atomic Bomberman multiplayer in Free Pascal, replacing its IPX networking with TCP/IP and adding custom AI and SDL2 controller support. Players can extract assets from their own game disc or generate original graphics and sounds with the included asset generator.
description_zh: FPC Atomic 用 Free Pascal 重建 Atomic Bomberman 多人玩法，以 TCP/IP 替代原版 IPX 联机方式，并加入自编 AI 与 SDL2 手柄支持。玩家可从自有游戏光盘提取资源，也可使用附带工具生成原创图像和声音。
requirements: The launcher can generate assets, or users can extract them from their own Atomic Bomberman disc.
Building requires Lazarus IDE and the libraries listed in the build instructions.
Single-player mode and Carry Bomb are absent; some behavior is inferred from the original.
The project offers Postcardware or a modified LGPL licence, as described in license.md.

name: L4D PC Recomp: a Left 4 Dead Xbox 360 boot harness
description_en: L4D PC Recomp uses XenonRecomp to lift Left 4 Dead's Xbox 360 PowerPC modules into C++ for a Windows x64 boot harness. The repository provides per-module configs, a guest-memory arena, dispatch table and kernel stubs. Its documented progress reaches launcher and filesystem initialization; rendering and gameplay remain unfinished.
description_zh: L4D PC Recomp 使用 XenonRecomp 将 Xbox 360 版《Left 4 Dead》的 PowerPC 模块转换为 C++，接入 Windows x64 启动程序。仓库提供逐模块配置、来宾内存区、调用分发表和内核桩。记录的进展已到启动器与文件系统初始化，渲染和游戏运行尚未完成。
requirements: Windows 10/11 x64, LLVM/Clang 17+, Ninja, Python 3.10+ and XenonRecomp are required.
The user's Xbox 360 Left 4 Dead game files are required; translated C++ must be generated locally.
Rendering and gameplay are unfinished.
GPL-3.0-or-later license.

name: Shining Force CD: a reassemblable game disassembly
description_en: SFCDDISASM provides an assembly disassembly of Shining Force CD for documenting and editing the game. Its scripts split a user-supplied US ISO into data chunks and combine them with the assembly; the author reports that the rebuilt ISO matches the original bit for bit. Some disassembly formatting remains unfinished.
description_zh: SFCDDISASM 提供《Shining Force CD》的汇编反汇编，用于记录和修改游戏。脚本从玩家自备的美版 ISO 提取数据块，再与汇编源码组合；作者报告重建的 ISO 与原版逐位一致。部分反汇编格式整理仍未完成。
requirements: Provide the original US ISO with 2048-byte sectors.
Use the included split and build scripts; modifying code requires 68k assembly knowledge.
The disassembly is incomplete in parts and may need formatting work before safe modification.
No licence file in the repository.

name: d3b-emu: reconstructing a Diablo III Beta server
description_en: d3b-emu reconstructs a server for Diablo III Beta client version 0.3.0.7447 in C# and .NET 8. Based on an earlier mooege version, it updates opcodes and message definitions and implements beta-era game systems, while Battle.net handling, item persistence and skill accuracy remain incomplete.
description_zh: d3b-emu 使用 C# 和 .NET 8 为《Diablo III》Beta 客户端 0.3.0.7447 重建服务器。项目基于早期 mooege 版本，更新操作码和消息定义，并实现部分 Beta 时期游戏系统；Battle.net 处理、物品存储和技能准确性仍不完整。
requirements: Diablo III Beta client 0.3.0.7447 and its ClientData.mpq, CoreData.mpq and base patch files are required.
The server is built for .NET 8.
Battle.net and game server systems are unfinished; item saves and some skill behavior remain inaccurate.
AGPL-3.0 licence.

name: Armored Core: a European-disc recompilation setup host
description_en: Armored Core Recompiled packages a psxrecomp setup host for the European PlayStation release of Armored Core. It accepts the user's disc image and generates and builds the translated game locally with recomp-ui. The author reports private-package gameplay while exact-package acceptance checks remain open.
description_zh: Armored Core Recompiled 为欧版 PlayStation 游戏 Armored Core 提供 psxrecomp 安装项目。它读取用户的光盘镜像，通过 recomp-ui 在本地生成并构建转译后的游戏。作者报告私有构建已进入游戏，成品包验收仍待完成。
requirements: The user's supported European Armored Core disc image.
Windows x64 is the documented release platform; local builds use psxrecomp, CMake and Ninja.
Exact-package setup and startup checks remain open.
GPL-3.0 license for project-owned files.

name: Portal 2: static recompilation for Apple silicon
description_en: Portal 2 is statically recompiled from its Linux x86 modules into a native ARM64 application for macOS and iPhone. Preparation tools lay out ELF modules and apply relocations; a lifter emits C functions that are compiled with a runtime for libc, threading, SDL2, graphics and Steam interfaces. The author reports playable builds on Mac and iPhone.
description_zh: 该项目把 Portal 2 的 Linux x86 模块静态重编译为适用于 macOS 和 iPhone 的 ARM64 应用。准备工具处理 ELF 模块布局与重定位，提升器将函数转换为 C，再与实现 libc、线程、SDL2、图形和 Steam 接口的运行时一起编译。作者报告 Mac 和 iPhone 版本可游玩。
requirements: An Apple silicon Mac with Python 3.9 or newer, Homebrew, Xcode command line tools, SDL2, FreeType and Fontconfig.
An owned Portal 2 copy with its game folder and Linux binaries from Steam depot 661.
iPhone builds require Xcode, iOS 17 or newer, Developer Mode and about 12 GB of device space.
Built against Linux depot 661 manifest 8940703274703023246; another release needs new indirect-call roots.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: oot-vc: decompiling the Wii Virtual Console N64 emulator
description_en: oot-vc reconstructs the N64 emulator used in Wii Virtual Console releases of Ocarina of Time, Super Mario 64, and Mario Kart 64. It builds against a user-extracted content1.app and provides DOL and function diffing tools, with work mainly focused on the Japanese Ocarina of Time release.
description_zh: oot-vc 重建 Wii Virtual Console 版 Ocarina of Time、Super Mario 64 和 Mario Kart 64 所用的 N64 模拟器。项目使用用户提取的 content1.app 构建，并提供 DOL 与函数差异比对工具；当前主要针对日版 Ocarina of Time。
requirements: Extract content1.app from the Wii Virtual Console WAD for the chosen version.
Git, Ninja, and Python 3 are required; macOS or non-x86 Linux also requires Wine.
The decompilation is in progress and mainly targets oot-j.

name: TOMB4: decompiling the PC version of Tomb Raider 4
description_en: TOMB4 reconstructs source for the PC version of Tomb Raider 4. The repository contains C and C++ game routines, Windows build projects, a changelog of game fixes and installation instructions that use an existing game installation.
description_zh: TOMB4 重建 PC 版《Tomb Raider 4》的源代码。仓库包含 C/C++ 游戏例程、Windows 构建工程、游戏修复记录，以及基于现有游戏安装目录的使用说明。
requirements: An existing Tomb Raider 4 installation or game CD files are used for installation.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: NetspherePirates: an S4 League Patch 34 server emulator
description_en: NetspherePirates recreates a server for the S4 League Patch 34 client, identified as EU v1139 Season 1. Its C# source defines game login outcomes, channel responses and serialized server information.
description_zh: NetspherePirates 以 C# 重建 S4 League 第 34 版客户端的服务器，对应 EU v1139 Season 1。代码包含游戏登录结果、频道响应及服务器信息的序列化结构。
requirements: .NET Core 2.1, MariaDB or MySQL, and Redis.
On Windows, .NET Framework 4.7.2.
S4 League Patch 34 (EU v1139) client.
The emulator is described as experimental.
No licence file in the repository.

name: FPGABoy: Game Boy hardware implementation on FPGA
description_en: FPGABoy reconstructs Nintendo Game Boy hardware in an FPGA design. The repository contains Verilog modules for the console's processor interface, PPU, memory, controls and video output, plus a design paper. The author states that the current version is nonfunctional.
description_zh: FPGABoy 以 FPGA 设计重建 Nintendo Game Boy 硬件。仓库包含处理器接口、PPU、内存、控制输入和视频输出的 Verilog 模块，以及设计论文。作者说明当前版本无法运行。
requirements: The current design targets a Digilent Atlys board with a Spartan-6 FPGA; development uses Xilinx ISE WebPACK 13.4.
The current version is nonfunctional, with some input and video interfaces still in development or untested.
Licensed under MIT.

name: The Order: 1886: a native PC runtime for the PS4 game
description_en: The Order: 1886 PC port runs the user's PS4 game executable natively on a Windows x86-64 processor through replacement system libraries. It uses the shadPS4 video core to translate PS4 GPU commands and shaders to Vulkan; the author reports reaching a rendered prologue with CUSA00035 version 01.02.
description_zh: The Order: 1886 PC 移植版通过替代 PS4 系统库，在 Windows x86-64 处理器上原生运行用户的游戏可执行文件。图形部分使用 shadPS4 视频核心将 PS4 GPU 命令和着色器转为 Vulkan；作者报告 CUSA00035 01.02 可进入并渲染序章。
requirements: A dump of the user's own game copy containing eboot.bin, sce_module and sce_sys is required.
The documented setup requires 64-bit Windows 10 version 1903 or later or Windows 11, an AVX CPU, and Vulkan 1.3 graphics.
The author reports testing CUSA00035 version 01.02 on Windows 11 with an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU.
Gameplay after the prologue, sound, saves, other GPUs, regions and Linux remain unchecked.
GNU General Public License v2.

name: Pac-Man Championship Edition: a native PC static recompilation
description_en: Pac-Man Championship Edition recompiles the Xbox 360 Live Arcade game's PowerPC code to x86-64 for a native Windows build using ReXGlue. Game-specific hooks adjust frame pacing and playfield placement, and an optional mode rearranges Championship Mode mazes. The repository also records Xbox 360 imports found during an earlier XenonRecomp attempt.
description_zh: Pac-Man Championship Edition 使用 ReXGlue 将 Xbox 360 Live Arcade 游戏的 PowerPC 代码静态重编译为 Windows 原生 x86-64 程序。游戏专用钩子调整帧节奏和迷宫画面位置，可选模式改变 Championship Mode 的迷宫顺序。仓库还记录了早期 XenonRecomp 尝试中发现的 Xbox 360 导入函数。
requirements: The user's own Xbox 360 game dump as an STFS package or extracted default.xex with media and data files.
Building requires Windows, Visual Studio 2026 C++ and Clang tools, CMake and a patched ReXGlue SDK.
MIT No Attribution license.

name: Open4DBoxing: static recompilation of 4D Sports Boxing
description_en: Open4DBoxing rebuilds the DOS game 4D Sports Boxing by recompiling four game executables and five sound drivers from machine code into C. A project runtime models DOS, BIOS, video and sound hardware, while SDL2 provides the frontend; the author reports comparisons with the original in DOSBox-X.
description_zh: Open4DBoxing 将 DOS 游戏《4D Sports Boxing》的四个程序及五个音效驱动从机器码重编译为 C。项目运行时模拟 DOS、BIOS、显卡与声卡，前端使用 SDL2；作者报告已与 DOSBox-X 中的原版进行对比。
requirements: Provide your own copy of the game's two floppy images or extracted files.
Build with Meson and SDL2; MT-32 sound additionally needs Munt and user-supplied ROMs.
The author reports differences in fight animation phase.
GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: Super Paper Mario: a selective matching Wii decompilation
description_en: spm-decomp reconstructs selected Super Paper Mario code for Wii releases, chiefly the two PAL revisions, using decomp-toolkit and matching-object annotations. Its build reads a user-provided disc image; the project explicitly confines work to selected game components rather than the full game or a platform port.
description_zh: spm-decomp 使用 decomp-toolkit 和匹配对象标注，重建 Wii 游戏《Super Paper Mario》的部分代码，重点是两个 PAL 修订版。构建时读取使用者自备的光盘映像；项目范围限定为部分游戏组件。
requirements: Provide a supported Super Paper Mario disc image in the matching orig version directory.
Python and ninja are required for the documented build workflow.
The project covers selected game components; SDK, NW4R and MSL libraries are outside its scope.
CC0-1.0 licence.

name: Project Vekta: a static recompilation of Killzone HD
description_en: Project Vekta builds a native Linux or Windows port of the PS3 game Killzone HD by translating its PPU and SPU code to C++ with a patched ps3recomp. Its runtime replaces PS3 services and replays graphics commands through Vulkan; players generate the game code locally from their own files.
description_zh: Project Vekta 使用带补丁的 ps3recomp 将 PS3 游戏 Killzone HD 的 PPU 和 SPU 代码翻译为 C++，构建 Linux 或 Windows 原生移植版。运行时替代 PS3 系统服务，并通过 Vulkan 重放图形命令；游戏代码由玩家使用自己的文件在本地生成。
requirements: Requires the player's Killzone HD package, decrypted EBOOT and data archive, and decrypted libsre from their own PS3 firmware.
Building on Linux x64 requires clang, CMake, Ninja, Python 3, SDL2, zlib, glslang and Vulkan headers; Windows builds additionally require a MinGW-w64 sysroot.
Requires an AVX2 CPU and Vulkan GPU.
The author reports one campaign level completed by hand; levels 2 through 11 have not each been played to completion.
MIT license.

name: Re-Comprehend: rebuilding Penguin Software adventure engines
description_en: Re-Comprehend reimplements the Comprehend and Graphics Magician engines for Penguin Software adventures including Transylvania, Crimson Crown and OO-Topos. It reads the user's original DOS game files, preserves the original save format, and offers data dumps and runtime commands for inspecting objects, rooms and state.
description_zh: Re-Comprehend 重新实现了用于 Transylvania、Crimson Crown 和 OO-Topos 等作品的 Comprehend 与 Graphics Magician 引擎。程序读取用户的原版 DOS 游戏文件，沿用原版存档格式，并提供对象、房间和状态的导出与调试命令。
requirements: A copy of the original DOS game and LibSDL2.
Builds have been tested only on Linux.
Talisman is not currently working; some opcodes and graphics features remain incomplete.
CC0-1.0 dedication.

name: Monster Hunter: PS2 decompilation and PC/Xbox ports
description_en: Monster Hunter decompiles Japanese PS2 releases of Monster Hunter, Monster Hunter G and Monster Hunter 2 into C checked against users' discs, then runs the reconstructed code on PC and the original Xbox through new platform layers. The tools survey ELF symbols, extract AFS data and overlays, and compare compiled functions with original bytes. The author reports playable PC and Xbox builds for the first two games, while Monster Hunter 2 remains at an early port stage.
description_zh: Monster Hunter 将日版 PS2《怪物猎人》《怪物猎人 G》和《怪物猎人 2》反编译为 C，以用户自己的光盘核对代码，再通过新平台层移植到 PC 和初代 Xbox。工具可调查 ELF 符号、提取 AFS 数据及覆盖模块，并逐函数比较编译字节。作者报告前两作已有可玩的 PC 和 Xbox 版本，《怪物猎人 2》的移植仍处早期。
requirements: Users must provide their own game disc images and original PS2 compilers for byte comparison.
The project documents a Linux setup using splat64 and PS2 EE binutils.
Monster Hunter 2's PC port is at an early stage; its Xbox port has not been tried.
MIT license for the project's own code, tools and documentation.

name: Dark Rift: a game decompilation and combat-state analysis
description_en: Dark Rift is a game decompilation with reconstructed gameplay, audio, model, and system source files. Its research notes map player move IDs through combat states and transition rules loaded from character .db files.
description_zh: Dark Rift 是游戏反编译项目，包含玩法、音频、模型及系统模块的重建源码。研究笔记分析了角色 .db 文件加载的玩家动作 ID、战斗状态及状态转换规则。
requirements: No licence file in the repository.

name: RestoRoom: researching a Rec Room server reconstruction
description_en: RestoRoom investigates Rec Room's client-to-server behavior as groundwork for a replacement server. Its current findings list API endpoints and documented rec.net subdomains, with a packet capture in the repository; account, room and relay services are still planned.
description_zh: RestoRoom 调查 Rec Room 客户端与服务器的通信，为重建服务器做准备。现有成果包括 API 端点清单、rec.net 子域名文档和仓库中的流量捕获文件；账号、房间和中继服务仍在计划阶段。
requirements: The project is in an early research phase; no playable server exists.
Account, room and Photon relay servers have not started.
No licence file in the repository.

name: WWE 2K14 Recomp: a native Windows port by Xbox 360 static recompilation
description_en: WWE 2K14 Recomp builds a native Windows x64 port by translating the Xbox 360 game's PowerPC code into C++ ahead of time with ReXGlue. Its game-specific work maps functions in title update 2.0.1.0 and repairs startup, cloth, texture and timing behavior. The author reports working menus, exhibition matches and saves, while several modes remain incompletely tested.
description_zh: WWE 2K14 Recomp 使用 ReXGlue 预先将 Xbox 360 版游戏的 PowerPC 代码转换为 C++，构建 Windows x64 原生移植版。项目为 2.0.1.0 标题更新映射函数，并修复启动、布料、纹理和计时问题。作者报告菜单、表演赛和存档可用，部分模式仍缺乏完整测试。
requirements: Supply your own Xbox 360 copy of WWE 2K14 and title update 2.0.1.0 files.
Playing requires Windows and a Vulkan-capable GPU; the documented build host is Ubuntu 24.04 with LLVM 20.
The author reports that Universe, Creation Suite and the full roster of arenas and wrestlers are not fully tested.
BSD 3-Clause License covers the project's hand-written source code.

name: Glover: partial N64 matching decompilation
description_en: Glover reconstructs part of the North American N64 game's code in C alongside assembly segments. Its build takes a user-provided base ROM, and its progress script classifies functions using the built ELF and locally generated nonmatching assembly files.
description_zh: Glover 以 C 语言重建北美版 N64 游戏的部分代码，并保留汇编分段。构建需要用户提供基础 ROM；进度脚本结合生成的 ELF 和本地生成的未匹配汇编文件，对函数进行分类。
requirements: A Glover North America base ROM named baserom.us.z64 is required.
The C source remains partial, with many functions included as nonmatching assembly.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Ratchet & Clank Future: Tools of Destruction: early PS3 matching decompilation
description_en: Ratchet & Clank Future: Tools of Destruction is an early matching decompilation of the USA PlayStation 3 release. Its tools inspect the package, SELF container and decrypted PPU ELF, recover function boundaries and compare compiled C bodies with retail bytes. The author reports byte-exact results for an initial set of functions while the full executable remains a long-term target.
description_zh: Ratchet & Clank Future: Tools of Destruction 是美版 PS3 游戏的早期字节匹配反编译项目。工具检查 PKG、SELF 容器和解密后的 PPU ELF，恢复函数边界，并将编译后的 C 函数与零售版字节比较。作者报告一批初始函数已逐字节匹配，完整可执行文件仍待重建。
requirements: A lawful copy of the USA PS3 release and locally decrypted executable are required for executable analysis.
SELF decryption requires the contributor's local console key material.
The reconstruction is at an early stage, with an initial set of byte-exact functions.
GPL-3.0 license for independently authored material.

name: SWGEmu Core3: reconstructing the classic Star Wars Galaxies server
description_en: SWGEmu Core3 reconstructs the server for the pre-Combat Upgrade era of Star Wars Galaxies. Its authors describe reverse-engineering the original behavior from scratch and implementing a new engine and game logic; the repository contains C++ server code and extensive Lua gameplay scripts.
description_zh: SWGEmu Core3 重建战斗系统改版前的 Star Wars Galaxies 服务器。项目作者称从头逆向研究原有行为，并实现新的引擎和游戏逻辑；仓库包含 C++ 服务器代码及大量 Lua 游戏脚本。
requirements: Client TRE data files are needed to run the server.
The documented manual build targets Debian 12 with CMake, MariaDB, BerkeleyDB, Lua 5.3, Clang 19 and other listed libraries.
AGPL-3.0 licence.

name: WinWar: rewriting Warcraft: Orcs & Humans with original game data
description_en: WinWar rewrites Warcraft: Orcs & Humans as a C# and MonoGame desktop port for Windows, Linux and macOS. It loads the original game's WAR art and level files from a user-supplied retail or demo copy. The project is archived.
description_zh: WinWar 用 C# 和 MonoGame 将 Warcraft: Orcs & Humans 重写为 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 桌面程序，运行时读取用户自备正式版或试玩版中的 WAR 美术与关卡文件。项目已归档。
requirements: A Warcraft: Orcs & Humans retail or demo copy is required for its DATA files.
Visual Studio 2022 is specified for compiling the desktop solution.
The project is archived; iOS code is nonfunctional.
MIT license.

name: Project Topaz: a Final Fantasy XI server emulation
description_en: Project Topaz recreates an online server for Final Fantasy XI with C++ services, Lua game scripts and SQL data. Some retail game behavior remains unimplemented.
description_zh: Project Topaz 以 C++ 服务、Lua 游戏脚本和 SQL 数据重建 Final Fantasy XI 在线服务器。部分原版游戏行为尚未实现。
requirements: An FFXI client is needed to connect to the server.
Some retail behavior remains unimplemented.
Source files use GPL-3.0 or AGPL-3.0 according to their markings and the Project Topaz License.

name: MQB-sniffer: decoding Golf MK7 CAN diagnostic exchanges
description_en: MQB-sniffer documents CAN diagnostic traffic on a 2016 Volkswagen Golf MK7 by capturing exchanges between an OBDeleven adapter and the car. It identifies request and response IDs and records examples for engine RPM, ambient light, selected gear and gearbox mode.
description_zh: MQB-sniffer 通过截取 OBDeleven 适配器与 2016 年 Volkswagen Golf MK7 的通信，记录 CAN 诊断流量。文档标出请求与响应 ID，并给出发动机转速、环境光、当前挡位和变速箱模式的报文示例。
requirements: The documented capture setup uses a Golf MK7, OBDeleven, an ELM327 adapter and an OBD2 splitter.
The author reports buffer overflows on cheap ELM327 adapters and communication problems with MCP2515 sniffing.
No licence file in the repository.

name: NTRDisasm: documenting NTR 2.0 custom firmware
description_en: NTRDisasm investigates the NTR 2.0 custom firmware for Nintendo N3DS. Its assembly listing and IDA script support study of code injection, hooks, in-game menus, service handles, debugger components, and privileged ARM11 calls.
description_zh: NTRDisasm 研究 Nintendo N3DS 的 NTR 2.0 自定义固件。仓库中的汇编清单和 IDA 脚本用于分析代码注入、钩子、游戏内菜单、服务句柄、调试器组件及特权 ARM11 调用。
requirements: The investigation is a work in progress.
No licence file in the repository.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Spirit Tracks: hand-decompiled Nintendo DS source
description_en: A work-in-progress hand decompilation recreates source for the Nintendo DS game The Legend of Zelda: Spirit Tracks. Its build accepts an owned base ROM for asset extraction and lists Japanese, European and US releases, with Europe Revision 0 as the default.
description_zh: 项目手工反编译 Nintendo DS 游戏《塞尔达传说：大地的汽笛》，逐步重建源码。构建时从玩家拥有的原版 ROM 提取资源，列出日版、欧版和美版，默认使用欧版修订版 0。
requirements: An owned copy of a supported Spirit Tracks ROM is required to extract assets.
Windows or Linux, Python 3.11+, GCC 9+ and Ninja are required for the documented build.
The decompilation is a work in progress.

name: reUndr: a PS5 port of Need for Speed: Underground
description_en: reUndr ports the original Xbox Need for Speed: Underground to homebrew-enabled PS5 consoles using an existing static recompilation and a PS5 replacement runtime for graphics, audio, input, and system services. It imports game data from the user's USA Xbox disc image.
description_zh: reUndr 利用已有的静态重编译成果和 PS5 替代运行时，将 Xbox 版 Need for Speed: Underground 移植到可运行自制软件的 PS5。运行时接管图形、音频、输入和系统服务，游戏数据由用户的美版 Xbox 光盘镜像导入。
requirements: A homebrew-enabled PS5 with ShadowMountPlus, FTP access, and about 1.6 GB free space is required.
A user-owned USA Xbox disc image or extracted files are required; other regional releases may fail.
The PS5 host and tools use MIT; the combined executable includes GPL-3.0-or-later components.

name: COD6-NX: Xbox 360 Modern Warfare 2 recompilation for Switch
description_en: COD6-NX ports the Xbox 360 Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 to Nintendo Switch by recompiling game code for ARM64 with ReXGlue. Its custom Vulkan renderer consumes the game's PM4 command ring and manages textures, pipelines and render targets; development notes record observed rendering failures.
description_zh: COD6-NX 使用 ReXGlue 将 Xbox 360 版 Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 的代码重编译为 ARM64，移植至 Nintendo Switch。自制 Vulkan 渲染器读取游戏的 PM4 命令环，并管理纹理、管线与渲染目标；开发记录详述已观察到的渲染故障。
requirements: A legally owned Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 copy and locally extracted game files.
The author reports texture corruption during play, unfinished lighting and particle paths, and severe performance drops in campaign missions.
GNU GPL version 3.

name: YaPang: matching decompilation of the PangYa client and renderer
description_en: YaPang reconstructs the 2011 PangYa client and Direct3D renderer as C++ source checked function by function with objdiff against the original binaries. A separate JP client code area is functionally decompiled for a port. Third-party libraries are excluded from the decompilation.
description_zh: YaPang 将 2011 年的 PangYa 客户端及 Direct3D 渲染器重建为 C++，用 objdiff 逐函数对照原始二进制文件。另有供移植使用的日版客户端代码，按功能反编译；第三方库不在反编译范围内。
requirements: A legally obtained PangYa copy is required for building or running.
Matching uses Visual C++ .NET 2003 SP1 and the original compiler flags.
Third-party libraries are excluded, and the JP 983 code is not part of the matching build.
The contributors' original work is CC0 1.0.

name: tomb3: decompiling PC Tomb Raider 3
description_en: tomb3 reconstructs the PC Tomb Raider 3 game as C++ source. Its changelog reports a completed decompilation and newly compiled executable, alongside renderer changes, gameplay fixes, and support for the game's original installed data.
description_zh: tomb3 将 PC 版 Tomb Raider 3 重建为 C++ 源码。更新日志称反编译已完成并编译出新可执行文件，同时记录了渲染器改动、玩法修复，以及使用原版安装数据的方式。
requirements: Requires an installed Steam, GOG, or CD copy of Tomb Raider 3 with its game data.
Licensed under GPL-3.0.

name: Pokémon Aurora Ticket Distribution: a GBA disassembly
description_en: Pokémon Aurora Ticket Distribution's US GBA ROM is reconstructed as assembly and C source. The repository includes a Makefile, linker configuration and setup instructions for building auroraticket.gba against a user-provided original ROM.
description_zh: 项目以汇编和 C 源码重建美版 Pokémon Aurora Ticket Distribution GBA ROM。仓库提供 Makefile、链接配置及安装说明，以用户提供的原版 ROM 构建 auroraticket.gba。
requirements: The original US Pokémon Aurora Ticket Distribution ROM must be supplied as baserom.gba.
devkitARM and the documented build dependencies are required.
No project-wide license file appears at the repository root.

name: Birdman64: a native Pilotwings 64 port
description_en: Birdman64 ports Pilotwings 64 to native PC play by compiling decompiled game source against a user-supplied US ROM during first-time setup. Its runtime adds widescreen rendering, modern controls and two-player split-screen; the project also describes experimental Android support and iOS test builds.
description_zh: Birdman64 将《Pilotwings 64》移植为原生 PC 游戏，首次启动时结合用户提供的美版 ROM 编译反编译源码。运行时加入宽屏、现代手柄操作和双人分屏；项目还提供实验性 Android 支持与 iOS 测试构建。
requirements: A user-provided US Pilotwings 64 ROM is required.
Windows 10 or 11 64-bit or a recent 64-bit Linux distribution is required for the main PC releases; first-time setup needs internet access.
Android support is experimental; iOS test builds must be built by the user.
MIT license.

name: ktm-can: decoding KTM motorcycle CAN messages
description_en: ktm-can documents and parses CAN messages observed on a 2020 KTM 690 Enduro R motorcycle. Its Python decoder maps message IDs to fields including engine speed, throttle, gear, wheel speed and brake pressure; scripts inspect live and captured traffic. The author confirmed the documented data on that motorcycle.
description_zh: ktm-can 记录并解析在 2020 款 KTM 690 Enduro R 摩托车上观察到的 CAN 消息。Python 解码器将消息 ID 对应到发动机转速、油门、挡位、轮速和制动压力等字段，脚本用于检查实时及记录的流量。作者在该车型上确认了文档中的数据。
requirements: Python 3.8 or later; live-bus inspection also requires CAN hardware and python-can.
The documented data was confirmed on the author's 2020 KTM 690 Enduro R; other models remain unverified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: BakuganBB-recomp: an accessible PC recompilation of Bakugan Battle Brawlers
description_en: BakuganBB-recomp is an early PC recompilation project for the Xbox 360 game Bakugan Battle Brawlers, with Linux as its first target. Its code includes speech and spatial-audio components intended to improve accessibility for blind players, while investigation notes document the executable, runtime imports and game interfaces.
description_zh: BakuganBB-recomp 是 Xbox 360 游戏《Bakugan Battle Brawlers》的早期 PC 重编译项目，以 Linux 为首个目标平台。项目包含面向盲人玩家的语音与空间音频组件，研究笔记记录了可执行文件、运行时导入和游戏接口。
requirements: Users need their own game files and the Linux build dependencies described in the build guide.
Input and audio work, but crashes and unfinished features remain; the author has not tested far into the game.
BSD-3-Clause license for original code and documentation.

name: Butterscotch: rebuilding the GameMaker: Studio runner
description_en: Butterscotch reimplements the GameMaker: Studio runner in C so exported games can execute on additional platforms. It interprets GameMaker bytecode and documents support for WAD versions 8 through 17, with desktop, web, and console targets. Bytecode support remains in progress, and native-code YYC and GMRT games are outside its stated scope.
description_zh: Butterscotch 用 C 重建 GameMaker: Studio 运行器，让导出的游戏在其他平台执行。它解释 GameMaker 字节码，文档列出 WAD 8 至 17 版本，并提供桌面、网页及游戏主机目标。字节码支持仍在开发中，YYC 和 GMRT 原生代码游戏不在支持范围内。
requirements: Requires a compatible GameMaker: Studio game exported as bytecode; WAD versions 8 through 17 are listed.
Bytecode support is still in progress; YYC, GMRT, and pre-WAD 8 games are unsupported.
Licensed under AGPL-3.0.

name: Sly 2: Band of Thieves: a matching PS2 decompilation
description_en: Sly 2: Band of Thieves reconstructs the USA PlayStation 2 executable as C and C++ built with period ee-gcc and SN assembler tools. Per-function compilation and relocation-aware comparison check the output against the owner's disc; the author reports that all 6,662 functions match byte for byte.
description_zh: Sly 2: Band of Thieves 将美版 PS2 可执行文件重建为 C/C++，使用对应时期的 ee-gcc 与 SN 汇编器构建。逐函数编译和感知重定位的对比会检查用户光盘中的原版程序；作者报告全部 6,662 个函数逐字节匹配。
requirements: A user's USA Sly 2 disc image and Linux or WSL are required.
The build uses ee-gcc 2.95.3 build 136, SN ps2eeas and Python tooling.
Most functions still have address-based names and m2c-style types.
No licence file in the repository.

name: FreQuency: reconstructed PlayStation 2 source and runtime
description_en: FreQuency reconstructs source and runtime components for the 2001 PlayStation 2 rhythm game. Its build uses ps2dev compilers for the Emotion Engine and IOP, reconstructed Sony library routines, and an optional user-supplied disc image to create a Mode 2 CD image with rebuilt executable and EZMIDI.IRX files.
description_zh: FreQuency 重建了 2001 年 PlayStation 2 同名节奏游戏的源码和运行组件。构建流程使用 ps2dev 的 Emotion Engine 与 IOP 编译器、重建的 Sony 库例程，并可读取用户自备的光盘镜像，生成包含重建可执行文件和 EZMIDI.IRX 的 Mode 2 CD 镜像。
requirements: Building requires ps2dev cross compilers for the Emotion Engine and IOP, their runtimes and the IRX fixup tool.
A user-owned FreQuency disc image or disc root is required to build the replacement CD image.
A disc-root copy needs the original disc's first 12 sectors for its boot logo when console booting is required.
The project's own code is MIT licensed; bundled third-party code retains its own licenses.

name: Xbox-Smartglass-Core: an Xbox One SmartGlass protocol client
description_en: Xbox-Smartglass-Core implements Xbox One SmartGlass communication in Python, including console discovery and control, media commands, Stump Live TV functions and title auxiliary streams. Its packet models, capture fixture and protocol documentation preserve details of the message exchanges.
description_zh: Xbox-Smartglass-Core 用 Python 实现 Xbox One 的 SmartGlass 通信，覆盖主机发现与控制、媒体命令、Stump 直播电视功能和游戏辅助数据流。仓库中的数据包模型、抓包样本及协议文档记录了消息交互细节。
requirements: Python 3.7 or newer is specified by the package.
Some functions, including GameDVR recording, require Microsoft Account authentication.
MIT license.

name: BarrelPad: an Apple port of the reconstructed Diddy Kong Racing engine
description_en: BarrelPad adapts Golden Balloon's decompilation-based Diddy Kong Racing port for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. It adds Apple lifecycle integration, game-specific touch and controller input, and local loading of the user's ROM while the reconstructed game logic runs as native host code.
description_zh: BarrelPad 将基于反编译成果的 Golden Balloon《Diddy Kong Racing》移植到 Mac、iPhone 和 iPad。项目加入 Apple 平台生命周期处理、游戏专用触控与手柄输入，以及用户自备 ROM 的本地加载；重建的游戏逻辑以原生宿主代码运行。
requirements: Supply a supported Diddy Kong Racing ROM; US 1.1 is documented as tested.
Build with a Mac, Xcode, and the documented CMake, Ninja, and package tools.
Physical-device installation requires an Apple development identity and provisioning profile.
Consult RIGHTS_AND_LICENSES.md for the project's rights and licensing boundaries.

name: Gauntlet Dark Legacy: a C++ and Vulkan engine reconstruction
description_en: Gauntlet Dark Legacy is ported to Windows and Linux through a C++ and Vulkan reconstruction of its engine. The build reads the game's asset tree extracted from the user's USA GameCube disc; the repository supplies engine code, shaders and asset setup scripts.
description_zh: 该项目以 C++ 和 Vulkan 重建 Gauntlet Dark Legacy 引擎，提供 Windows 与 Linux 移植版。构建过程读取用户从美版 GameCube 光盘提取的资源树；仓库包含引擎代码、着色器和资源配置脚本。
requirements: The user's own USA GameCube Gauntlet Dark Legacy disc image, GUNE5D, is required.
Windows 10/11 x64 or Ubuntu 24.04+ x86-64 with a Vulkan 1.3 graphics driver is required.
GNU GPL v3.0-only for the project's original code.

name: HPCOS GC: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets recompiled for PC
description_en: HPCOS GC uses DolRecomp to translate the GameCube PowerPC code of Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets for a native PC runtime based on ModernGekko. Its title-specific additions include dynamic widescreen, field-of-view controls and a PC settings menu; subsequent development moved to GekkoAOT.
description_zh: HPCOS GC 使用 DolRecomp 转换 GameCube 版《Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets》的 PowerPC 代码，并以 ModernGekko 构建 PC 原生运行时。游戏专用改动包括动态宽屏、视角控制和 PC 设置菜单；后续开发已迁至 GekkoAOT。
requirements: Supply a legally obtained North American GameCube copy of the game.
The project is experimental and no longer maintained at this repository.
GPL-3.0 licensed.

name: GearsUE3: rebuilding Gears of War around Xenia dynarecs
description_en: GearsUE3 is developing a native engine port for the Xbox 360 Gears of War games, with Gears of War 1 as its active target. Its planned product combines Xenia Xenon dynarecs and system services with title-specific native function overrides. The repository records code maps and reverse-engineering findings. The current launcher cannot start that product because image loading and runtime composition remain unwired.
description_zh: GearsUE3 正在为 Xbox 360《战争机器》系列开发原生引擎移植版，目前以初代为目标。计划中的产品将结合 Xenia 的 Xenon 动态重编译器、系统服务和针对游戏函数的原生替代实现。仓库记录了代码映射和逆向分析结果。镜像加载与运行时组件尚未接通，因此当前启动器无法启动该产品。
requirements: A legally owned Xbox 360 Gears of War 1 disc image of the supported retail revision.
The current ./run.sh refuses to launch the planned product; image loading and runtime-service composition remain unfinished.
First-party code is MIT licensed; bundled components retain their stated third-party licences.

name: Test Drive II: The Duel: an SDL3 reconstruction of the DOS EGA game
description_en: Test Drive II: The Duel is reimplemented in C for SDL3 from analysis of the DOS EGA game. The port loads the user's original executable and data, while accompanying tools unpack EXEPACK files, disassemble x86 code and decode resource archives. Function indexes, porting specifications and file-format notes document the reconstruction.
description_zh: Test Drive II: The Duel 项目依据 DOS EGA 版本的分析结果，以 C 和 SDL3 重构游戏。移植版读取用户自己的原版可执行文件及数据；附带工具可解包 EXEPACK 文件、反汇编 x86 代码并解码资源包。函数索引、移植规格和文件格式文档记录了重构过程。
requirements: The user's own writable Test Drive II game-file directory, including TD2EGA.EXE and the listed data archives, is required.
Building requires CMake 3.24+, a C11 compiler and SDL3.
Only the EGA version is ported; CGA, Hercules and Tandy versions remain unported.
MIT License.

name: azure: matching decompilation of Azure Dreams
description_en: azure reconstructs source for the PlayStation game Azure Dreams and builds PSX executables from a user-supplied CD image. Its workflow extracts code and data, compiles C with a source-built PSY-Q 4.1-compatible compiler, and documents per-function matching work and unresolved overlays.
description_zh: azure 重建 PlayStation 游戏 Azure Dreams 的源码，并从用户提供的光盘镜像构建 PSX 可执行文件。项目提取代码和数据，使用从源码构建的 PSY-Q 4.1 兼容编译器编译 C，并记录逐函数匹配及尚待处理的覆盖段。
requirements: Supply the Azure Dreams CD image as az.bin with the SHA256 specified in the README.
Provide PSY-Q headers and libraries, Docker, MIPS GNU binutils, Python and uv.
The decompilation is in progress; the author states that overlays still need matching work.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Street Fighter Alpha 3 MAX: a partial PSP decompilation with a native runtime
description_en: Street Fighter Alpha 3 MAX: Decomp reconstructs the PSP game's functions as readable C inside a native PC runtime. Functions not yet decompiled are translated from the PSP program during the build, while parity tests compare selected runs frame by frame. The author reports 412 of 14,881 functions decompiled; the US ULUS-10062 disc supplies the program and assets.
description_zh: Street Fighter Alpha 3 MAX: Decomp 将 PSP 游戏函数逐步重建为可读的 C 代码，并放入原生 PC 运行环境。尚未反编译的函数在构建时由 PSP 程序翻译生成，一致性测试逐帧比较部分运行场景。作者报告已有 14,881 个函数中的 412 个完成反编译；程序和资源来自用户的美版 ULUS-10062 光盘。
requirements: A user-owned Street Fighter Alpha 3 MAX US PSP ISO, ULUS-10062, is required.
The documented platforms are Windows 10/11 x64, Linux x64 and macOS 11 or later on Apple Silicon.
The Japanese version is extracted but not yet buildable.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Chrono Trigger: a matching SNES US 1.0 disassembly
description_en: Chrono Trigger US 1.0 is reconstructed as banked SNES assembly with symbolic pointer tables and RAM labels. A build script extracts data blobs from the user's ROM, assembles the source with asar, and checks that the result is byte-identical to the input ROM.
description_zh: 该项目将《时空之轮》SNES 美国版 1.0 重建为按存储区组织的汇编代码，带有符号指针表和 RAM 标签。构建脚本从用户 ROM 提取数据，用 asar 汇编，并比较生成文件与原 ROM 是否逐字节一致。
requirements: Supply an unheadered Chrono Trigger US v1.0 ROM with CRC32 2D206BF7.
Install asar on PATH or place it at tools/asar.

name: Tetris: an annotated Game Boy disassembly
description_en: Tetris reconstructs the Game Boy World Rev A release as an assembly listing generated with gbdasm and annotated by hand. The README gives RGBDS assembly and linking commands plus file and MD5 comparisons for checking the rebuilt ROM.
description_zh: Tetris 项目将 Game Boy World Rev A 版本重建为由 gbdasm 生成、再经人工注释的汇编清单。README 给出 RGBDS 汇编和链接命令，并说明如何通过文件比较或 MD5 校验重建 ROM。
requirements: Use the RGBDS toolchain and the documented Game Boy Tetris World Rev A ROM for comparison.
No licence file in the repository.

name: YodaStoriesNG: rebuilding Yoda Stories and Indiana Jones from their data files
description_en: YodaStoriesNG reimplements Star Wars: Yoda Stories and Indiana Jones and His Desktop Adventures in C# and SDL2 using each game's original data file. It parses tiles, zones, puzzles and IACT scripts, reconstructs world generation, and provides script disassembly and other inspection windows. The author reports complete Yoda Stories play and remaining Indiana Jones puzzle gaps.
description_zh: YodaStoriesNG 用 C# 和 SDL2 重建 Star Wars: Yoda Stories 与 Indiana Jones and His Desktop Adventures，读取各自的原版数据文件。它解析图块、区域、谜题和 IACT 脚本，重建世界生成流程，并提供脚本反汇编等检查窗口。作者称 Yoda Stories 可完整游玩，Indiana Jones 仍有谜题缺口。
requirements: Provide your own YODESK.DTA or DESKTOP.DAW game data.
Building from source requires the .NET 8 SDK.
The author reports that some Indiana Jones worlds still stop at puzzles the mission bot has not learned.
MIT license.

name: Mario Party 5: a GameCube decompilation
description_en: Mario Party 5 is reconstructed as a work-in-progress GameCube decompilation for the USA Rev 0 release. The project uses a user-owned disc image, Python configuration and Ninja builds; its source tree contains C code and symbol maps for the main program and REL modules.
description_zh: 该项目针对美版 Rev 0 的 Mario Party 5 进行 GameCube 游戏反编译，目前仍在进行中。构建流程使用用户自有光盘镜像、Python 配置和 Ninja；源码树包含主程序及 REL 模块的 C 代码与符号表。
requirements: Provide a Mario Party 5 USA Rev 0 disc image in a supported format.
Use Python and Ninja; platform-specific tooling is described for Windows, macOS and Linux.
The decompilation is a work in progress.

name: Lordran Native: rehosting Dark Souls: Remastered on Apple devices
description_en: Lordran Native ports the Nintendo Switch release of Dark Souls: Remastered to Apple devices by running its ARM64 code directly. A rewriter adapts kernel-dependent instructions, a host supplies Horizon services, and a Metal layer implements NVN graphics. The project packages locally supplied NSP files and keys into macOS or unsigned iOS builds.
description_zh: Lordran Native 将 Switch 版《黑暗之魂：重制版》移植到 Apple 设备，直接运行游戏的 ARM64 代码。改写器处理依赖内核的指令，宿主程序提供 Horizon 服务，图形层以 Metal 实现 NVN；用户可用自己的 NSP 文件和密钥打包 macOS 或未签名 iOS 构建。
requirements: An Apple Silicon Mac with Xcode and Homebrew for the standard build route.
User-owned base and 1.0.3 update NSP files plus prod.keys; both NSPs are required for shader extraction.
The port is experimental, with graphics and device compatibility still needing validation.
MIT License.

name: Airborne Ranger: lifting a DOS game into a C port
description_en: Airborne Ranger ports the 1987 DOS game to C by lifting AR.EXE and its TANDYSND.EXE overlay with a masm2c-style translator, then hand-checking the output against the reference binaries. An SDL2 frontend runs with the player's original files, and the repository includes lifted code, generation scripts and tests.
description_zh: Airborne Ranger 用 masm2c 风格的翻译器将 1987 年 DOS 游戏的 AR.EXE 及 TANDYSND.EXE 覆盖程序提升为 C，再与原版二进制文件人工核对。SDL2 前端读取玩家自己的游戏文件；仓库包含提升后的代码、生成脚本和测试。
requirements: An original DOS copy of Airborne Ranger is required to run the port.
SDL2 is used for the frontend; documented builds cover Linux, Windows x64 and Android TV.
The WebAssembly workflow is an experimental skeleton.
No licence file in the repository.

name: FM4-Recomp: a Forza Motorsport 4 static recompilation
description_en: FM4-Recomp statically recompiles the Xbox 360 release of Forza Motorsport 4 for Windows x64 using ReXGlue. Based on Pinyon Shift, it provides game-specific analysis configurations, runtime hooks, SDK patches and a disc-verifying launcher. Its 0.1.0 changelog reports a playable Windows preview.
description_zh: FM4-Recomp 使用 ReXGlue，将 Xbox 360 版《Forza Motorsport 4》静态重编译为 Windows x64 程序。项目基于 Pinyon Shift，提供本作的分析配置、运行时钩子、SDK 补丁和光盘校验启动器。其 0.1.0 更新日志报告了可游玩的 Windows 预览版。
requirements: The user's Forza Motorsport 4 retail Disc 1 is required.
Windows 10 version 1903 or newer or Windows 11 x64, SSE4.1 CPU, DirectX 12 GPU, 8 GB RAM and 25 GB free storage are specified.
Function discovery and indirect-branch mapping remain in progress.
BSD-3-Clause license.

name: Need for Speed: Most Wanted for Android — Xbox static recompilation for Android
description_en: Need for Speed: Most Wanted for Android ports the original Xbox Black Edition to Android arm64 by translating its x86 XBE code to C++ with XboxXBE-Recomp. A Vulkan host renders the game, while SDL3 handles windowing, input and audio; the port also provides touch controls and graphics settings.
description_zh: Need for Speed: Most Wanted for Android 使用 XboxXBE-Recomp 将初代 Xbox Black Edition 的 x86 XBE 代码静态转换为 C++，再构建为 Android arm64 版本。移植版以 Vulkan 渲染画面，通过 SDL3 处理窗口、输入和音频，并提供触控及图形设置。
requirements: Provide files from a legally acquired USA Black Edition Xbox copy of the game.
Android 10 or newer on arm64, a Vulkan 1.1 GPU driver, 4 GB of memory and 4 GB of storage.
Building requires a Windows PC, Visual Studio 2022, Android Studio with SDK Platform 34, NDK 28.2.13676358 and CMake 3.31.6, plus Java 17–21.
Work in progress; the visibility test for sun glare is not yet calculated.

name: mgs_reversing: matching Metal Gear Solid Integral source reconstruction
description_en: mgs_reversing reconstructs Metal Gear Solid Integral for PlayStation as C source intended to compile to the same assembly as the original. The author reports that the SLPM_862.47, SLPM_862.48 and SLPM_862.49 main executables are fully decompiled; work on stage overlays continues.
description_zh: mgs_reversing 将 PlayStation 版《Metal Gear Solid Integral》还原为 C 源码，目标是编译出与原版相同的汇编。作者报告 SLPM_862.47、SLPM_862.48 和 SLPM_862.49 三个主程序已完成反编译，关卡覆盖层仍在处理。
requirements: The source targets the PlayStation release of Metal Gear Solid Integral.
The author reports complete main-executable decompilation; stage overlays remain unfinished.
No licence file in the repository.

name: NanoBoyAdvance: cycle-level Game Boy Advance hardware emulation
description_en: NanoBoyAdvance reconstructs Game Boy Advance hardware behavior in a cycle-level emulator. It models CPU, DMA, timers, PPU and Game Pak prefetch, and provides palette, tile, background and sprite viewers. The author reports passing several GBA accuracy suites.
description_zh: NanoBoyAdvance 通过逐周期模拟器重建 Game Boy Advance 硬件行为，涵盖 CPU、DMA、定时器、PPU 和 Game Pak 预取，并提供调色板、图块、背景及精灵查看器。作者报告其通过了多套 GBA 准确性测试。
requirements: Running a ROM requires a Game Boy Advance BIOS file.
Building requires a C++20 compiler, CMake 3.24 or newer, SDL 3.0.0 or newer and Qt 6.0 or newer.
Licensed under GNU GPL-3.0 or later.

name: SSX 3: an in-progress matching PS2 decompilation
description_en: SSX 3 reconstructs source for the NTSC-U PlayStation 2 game with the goal of matching its executable. The repository includes C++ source, build configuration and working notes on functions, data structures and subsystems such as rider physics, animation and world streaming.
description_zh: SSX 3 项目重建美版 PS2 游戏源码，目标是与原可执行文件匹配。仓库提供 C++ 源码、构建配置，以及函数、数据结构和滑手物理、动画、世界流送等子系统的分析笔记。
requirements: A legally obtained NTSC-U SSX 3 disc image is required.
Builds require Linux capable of running 32-bit applications, MIPS binutils, Ninja, Wine and Python dependencies; WSL2 is documented as an option.
The decompilation is in progress; other regions and versions are outside the current target.

name: Sonic Generations Recompiled: an Xbox 360 static recompilation
description_en: Sonic Generations Recompiled translates the Xbox 360 game's PowerPC code into native C++ with XenonRecomp and builds host services for kernel calls, audio, input, files and graphics. A newer Windows path uses ReXGlue with Vulkan graphics experiments; the author describes both paths as incomplete for game-level play.
description_zh: Sonic Generations Recompiled 使用 XenonRecomp 将 Xbox 360 版游戏的 PowerPC 代码转换为原生 C++，并构建内核调用、音频、输入、文件和图形运行服务。较新的 Windows 路线采用 ReXGlue 并试验 Vulkan 图形；作者说明两条路线都尚未达到完整游玩状态。
requirements: Supply your own Xbox 360 Sonic Generations ISO/XISO dump or extracted folder containing default.xex.
The full runtime requires Clang or clang-cl and the documented XenonRecomp and XenosRecomp toolchain.
Level loading, correct game graphics and completion remain unconfirmed.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: Dino Crisis - Modern Edition: a disc-built Windows recompilation
description_en: Dino Crisis - Modern Edition rebuilds the PlayStation game Dino Crisis as a native Windows program from the user's disc image. Its installer recompiles the game code to C and combines it with a runtime supplying a new renderer, camera, controls and mod support; the repository includes build scripts and hooks for supported disc versions.
description_zh: Dino Crisis - Modern Edition 使用用户自己的 PlayStation 版 Dino Crisis 光盘镜像构建原生 Windows 程序。安装器将游戏代码重编译为 C，并结合项目运行时提供新渲染器、镜头、操作方式和模组支持；仓库还包含构建脚本及各光盘版本的挂钩代码。
requirements: Requires a supported Dino Crisis Track 1 .bin or .cue disc image; PAL editions also require a matching .sbi file.
Requires 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 and a Vulkan-capable graphics card.
The mod's own files use MIT; the recompiler framework and modifications use PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.

name: Hunchback: an in-progress ZX Spectrum disassembly
description_en: Hunchback is an in-progress SkoolKit disassembly of the ZX Spectrum game. The repository includes a .skool listing, SkoolKit control and reference files, and a build script for the published disassembly.
description_zh: Hunchback 是使用 SkoolKit 编写的 ZX Spectrum 游戏反汇编项目，仍在进行中。仓库包含 .skool 清单、SkoolKit 控制与引用文件，以及发布清单的构建脚本。
requirements: SkoolKit is the documented disassembly tool.
The disassembly is a work in progress.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Sonic Adventure 2 — Nintendo Switch port: an Xbox 360 static recompilation
description_en: The Sonic Adventure 2 Nintendo Switch port translates the Xbox 360 game's default.xex and stage-data module to C++ with ReXGlue and draws through a deko3d renderer. Its repository includes game-specific code, renderer changes and notes on executable behavior. The author reports near-60 FPS single-player results in tested scenes, with heavier two-player scenes running slower.
description_zh: Sonic Adventure 2 的 Nintendo Switch 移植使用 ReXGlue 将 Xbox 360 版 default.xex 和关卡数据模块转换为 C++，再通过 deko3d 渲染。仓库包含游戏专用代码、渲染器修改和可执行文件分析笔记。作者报告测试场景中的单人模式接近 60 FPS，双人复杂场景速度较低。
requirements: The user's Xbox 360 Xbox Live Arcade game content package is required; Battle DLC is optional.
Installation requires a Switch launch mode with sufficient memory; Album applet mode is insufficient.
The first run after installation or update compiles shaders as they are encountered.
The repository includes a GPL-3.0 license file.

name: WindowWaker: a Windows port of The Wind Waker from decompiled code
description_en: WindowWaker builds a native Windows port of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker from a community decompilation of the USA GameCube release. The fork adds a Windows build and presentation interpolation for 60 and 120 FPS while game simulation remains at 30 Hz; the build generates asset headers from the user's disc image.
description_zh: WindowWaker 基于美版 GameCube《The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker》的社区反编译代码构建 Windows 原生移植版。该分支加入 Windows 构建及 60、120 FPS 的画面插值，游戏模拟维持 30 Hz；构建时从用户的光盘镜像生成资源头文件。
requirements: An uncompressed USA GZLE01 revision 0 GameCube ISO is required.
The Windows build requires Visual Studio 2022, CMake 3.28 or later, Python 3.10 or later and Git.
The fork maintains its Windows PC build.
MIT license for the port code; the imported game decompilation is CC0-1.0.

name: SW_RACER_RE: selected functions from Star Wars Episode I: Racer
description_en: SW_RACER_RE maps and reimplements selected functions from Star Wars Episode I: Racer to support game modifications. Symbol files and Ghidra scripts record recovered addresses, while a dinput.dll hook can replace original functions with reconstructed code during play.
description_zh: SW_RACER_RE 为 Star Wars Episode I: Racer 记录并重实现部分函数，以支持游戏修改。符号文件和 Ghidra 脚本保存恢复出的地址；dinput.dll 钩子可在运行时用重建代码替换原函数。
requirements: Contributing requires Ghidra, Python and a Windows C compiler; using the dinput.dll hook requires a compatible game installation.
The freshly installed GOG executable is the documented version; other versions have not been tested.
The project covers selected functions rather than the entire game.
AGPL-3.0.

name: Call of Duty 2: Big Red One: reconstructing Xbox game code in C++
description_en: Call of Duty 2: Big Red One reconstructs the original Xbox game's code as C++ toward a native Linux and Windows build. Ghidra analysis and function naming support the work; a comparison harness checks rewritten functions against the originals, primarily during gameplay and, for some functions, offline. The author reports 7,067 rewritten functions, while most mission-script functions remain unfinished.
description_zh: Call of Duty 2: Big Red One 将原版 Xbox 游戏代码重建为 C++，目标是在 Linux 和 Windows 上原生构建。项目使用 Ghidra 分析和函数命名，并通过对比工具将重写函数与原始函数比较：主要在游戏运行时验证，部分函数则离线验证。作者报告已重写 7,067 个函数，大多数任务脚本函数仍待重写。
requirements: Requires the user's own Call of Duty 2: Big Red One Xbox game files.
The author reports 7,067 rewritten functions; most mission-script functions remain to be rewritten.
Project-authored code is licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later; third-party licenses are listed in LICENSES/README.md.

name: Destruction Derby 2 Recompiled: a PlayStation setup host for local static recompilation
description_en: Destruction Derby 2 Recompiled provides a setup host and game-specific configuration for locally generating a PlayStation static recompilation from the user's USA disc. It uses PSXRecomp and recomp-ui, with function seeds and symbol mapping. Project notes document a multi-BIN disc identity correction, and the author reports gameplay in a private build.
description_zh: Destruction Derby 2 Recompiled 提供安装程序和游戏专用配置，可用用户自己的美版光盘在本地生成 PlayStation 静态重编译版本。项目使用 PSXRecomp 和 recomp-ui，包含函数种子及符号映射。开发记录说明了多 BIN 光盘标识的修正；作者报告私人构建版已进入游戏流程。
requirements: The user's own supported USA Destruction Derby 2 disc image is required; retail BIOS files are supplied locally when needed.
Windows x64 is the documented release platform; Linux and macOS packages remain candidates pending native checks.
Exact-package setup, startup and disc-identity checks remain open for release candidates.
Project-owned files are GPL-3.0-only; PSXRecomp and recomp-ui have separate licences.

name: Citadel: a System Shock fan remake
description_en: Citadel recreates the 1994 System Shock in Unity, aiming to retain the original game while adding 3D models, station details, particles and sound effects. Its Unity project contains gameplay scripts and assets, and it reads audio from the user's System Shock RES data.
description_zh: Citadel 使用 Unity 重制 1994 年的 System Shock，在沿用原游戏内容的同时加入 3D 模型、空间细节、粒子效果和音效。仓库提供游戏脚本与素材，音频从用户的 System Shock RES 数据读取。
requirements: Audio requires RES files from an original System Shock or System Shock: Enhanced Edition installation.
Development requires Unity 2020.3.48f1, Blender 2.79b or newer, and Texture2DArray Importer 1.5.0.
The remake is in final testing and polishing; some features may be broken or missing.
MIT-0.

name: Project 8 Plus: a native recompilation of Tony Hawk's Project 8
description_en: Project 8 Plus builds a native PC port of the PS3 Tony Hawk's Project 8 from a user's game copy. Its launcher uses RPCS3 for setup decryption and ps3recomp for static recompilation, then adds display options, texture upscaling, and Lua mod support.
description_zh: Project 8 Plus 从用户自备的 PS3《Tony Hawk's Project 8》构建原生 PC 移植版。启动器在设置阶段借助 RPCS3 解密，并用 ps3recomp 静态重编译；移植版还提供显示选项、纹理放大和 Lua 模组支持。
requirements: Own PS3 US disc dump BLUS30011 version 01.02 and RPCS3 for setup.
Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, with a DirectX 12 graphics card, about 4 GB free space, and an internet connection during setup.
Linux support is experimental.
MIT license.

name: OpenOMF: a multi-platform remake of One Must Fall 2097
description_en: OpenOMF is a remake of the 1994 DOS fighting game One Must Fall 2097 for Linux, macOS, Windows and other platforms. It includes networking intended to make multiplayer easier to use than the original game's IPX setup.
description_zh: OpenOMF 是 1994 年 DOS 格斗游戏《One Must Fall 2097》的重制版，面向 Linux、macOS、Windows 等平台。项目包含联网功能，旨在简化原版游戏基于 IPX 的多人游戏配置。
requirements: Source builds require at least GCC 9, Clang 10 or supported MSVC, plus the libraries listed in BUILD.md.
MIT license.

name: ClassicUO: Ultima Online Classic Client reimplementation
description_en: ClassicUO recreates the Ultima Online Classic Client in C# on FNA-XNA. Its source includes game asset loaders and client logic for a separately obtained installation, and the authors describe testing primarily against free shards.
description_zh: ClassicUO 基于 FNA-XNA，以 C# 重建 Ultima Online Classic Client。源码包含游戏资源加载器和客户端逻辑，运行时使用另行取得的游戏安装文件；作者称主要针对非官方游戏服务器进行测试。
requirements: Requires a legally obtained copy of the Ultima Online Classic Client.
The client is under heavy development and is primarily tested against free shards.
LICENSE.md states BSD-2-Clause, while README.md states BSD 4.

name: WET: a ReXGlue Xbox 360 PC port
description_en: WET is a PC port of the Xbox 360 game built with ReXGlue from the user's disc image. Its setup script applies input patches and generates game code, while the project supplies host code, ultrawide display changes and Windows and Linux build paths.
description_zh: WET 使用 ReXGlue 从用户的 Xbox 360 光盘镜像构建 PC 移植版。安装脚本应用输入补丁并生成游戏代码；仓库还提供宿主代码、超宽屏显示改动，以及 Windows 和 Linux 构建流程。
requirements: The user's WET Xbox 360 ISO.
Windows 10 or 11 x64, or Linux x64 with Vulkan; builds require Clang, CMake, Ninja and Git.
The Windows launcher uses WPF; Linux users extract the ISO into game/ and build with the Linux preset.
MIT license for port code.

name: Sonic the Hedgehog: a generated Sega Master System disassembly
description_en: Sonic the Hedgehog disassembles the Sega Master System game from a user-supplied ROM. A Python unpacker and annotation file generate Z80 assembly, which WLA-DX assembles into an output ROM; the repository also includes ROM asset-location and level-viewing tools.
description_zh: Sonic the Hedgehog 从用户提供的 Sega Master System 游戏 ROM 生成 Z80 反汇编。Python 拆解器结合注释文件输出汇编，再由 WLA-DX 构建 ROM；仓库还提供素材位置查看和关卡查看工具。
requirements: Supply the Sega Master System Sonic the Hedgehog ROM as baserom/sonic1.sms.
WLA-DX, Python 3, GNU Make and mypy are required for the documented build.
The disassembly is a work in progress, and the asset-location tool is described as out of date.
No licence file in the repository.

name: minecraft: a Minecraft Xbox 360 recompilation prototype
description_en: minecraft configures ReXGlue to recompile Minecraft: Xbox 360 Edition into a native program using extracted game files. It includes a title configuration, build wiring and an application entry point. The author reports that the current build displays only a black screen.
description_zh: minecraft 使用 ReXGlue 配置《Minecraft: Xbox 360 Edition》的原生重编译程序，包含游戏专用配置、构建文件和程序入口，运行时使用提取的游戏文件。作者称当前构建仅显示黑屏。
requirements: Set up the ReXGlue SDK and extract the game files into assets.
The current build displays only a black screen.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Super Monkey Ball 2 Sakura Edition Vita: an Android game port
description_en: Super Monkey Ball 2 Sakura Edition Vita runs the Android game on PS Vita by loading its ARMv7 executable, resolving imports with native functions and applying platform patches. The setup uses the player's APK and downloaded cache files from versions released before the game became free to play.
description_zh: Super Monkey Ball 2 Sakura Edition Vita 在 PS Vita 上加载 Android 版游戏的 ARMv7 可执行文件，以原生函数解析导入项并施加平台补丁。安装需要玩家自备的 APK，以及游戏改为免费模式前版本下载的缓存文件。
requirements: A PS Vita with kubridge, FdFix or rePatch, and libshacccg.suprx is required.
A legally obtained Android APK and cache files from a version before the game became free to play are required.
Building requires a softfp VitaSDK and the listed audio, graphics and bridge libraries.
MIT License.

name: F-Zero X: a work-in-progress matching Nintendo 64 decompilation
description_en: F-Zero X reconstructs the Nintendo 64 game's source as a work-in-progress matching decompilation. Its build takes a user-supplied US or Japanese revision 1.0 ROM, extracts assets, disassembles code, and rebuilds a ROM whose checksum is checked. The repository contains game C source and per-version asset layouts.
description_zh: F-Zero X 以匹配反编译方式逐步重建 Nintendo 64 游戏源码。构建流程使用用户提供的美版或日版 1.0 ROM，提取资源、反汇编代码并重建 ROM，再检查校验值。仓库包含游戏 C 源码及分版本资源布局。
requirements: A user-supplied US or Japanese F-Zero X revision 1.0 ROM is required.
The documented build needs a MIPS binutils toolchain, Python dependencies, submodules, and platform build tools.
The decompilation is a work in progress.
CC0-1.0 licence.

name: Sheep, Dog 'n' Wolf: a decompiled multiplatform implementation
description_en: Rewooled reconstructs the PC game Sheep, Dog 'n' Wolf from machine-code analysis and runs it on Windows, macOS and Linux using SDL3. Its source covers the game engine, objects, input and rendering, while the runtime reads assets from the user's game copy.
description_zh: Rewooled 通过机器码分析重建 PC 游戏 Sheep, Dog 'n' Wolf，并借助 SDL3 在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上运行。源码涵盖引擎、对象、输入和渲染；运行时从用户自己的游戏副本读取资源。
requirements: Provide files from an original copy of Sheep, Dog 'n' Wolf.
Builds are documented for Windows x64, macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64 or arm64.
PSX files are supported but not fully tested and have known quirks.
MIT License.

name: Comet: reconstructing GOG Galaxy's game communication service
description_en: Comet reimplements the game-facing GOG Galaxy Communication Service in Rust for use with alternative game launchers. It handles named SDK requests for library and authentication data, achievements, leaderboards, sessions, and overlay notifications. The project documents tracing Communication Service calls and identifies request types still pending.
description_zh: Comet 用 Rust 重建面向游戏的 GOG Galaxy Communication Service，供其他游戏启动器使用。它处理游戏库与认证信息、成就、排行榜、会话及叠加层通知等 SDK 请求。项目还记录了服务调用跟踪方法，并列出尚未实现的请求。
requirements: Requires GOG access_token, refresh_token, and user_id, which may be imported from a supported launcher.
Some SDK versions require registration of the bundled dummy Windows service.
GET_GLOBAL_STATS_REQUEST and two overlay notifications, GAME_JOIN_REQUEST_NOTIFICATION and GAME_INVITE_SENT_NOTIFICATION, are listed as unfinished.
Licensed under Apache-2.0.

name: Monster Hunter Tri: a matching Wii decompilation
description_en: Monster Hunter Tri is an in-progress matching decompilation of the USA Wii release RMHE08 in C and C++. Its build links matching reconstructed units with original bytes for unfinished regions, then checks main.dol against a recorded SHA-1. The project tracks split translation units, symbols and per-function scores, and documents compiler-matching techniques and build checks.
description_zh: Monster Hunter Tri 项目正以 C 和 C++ 对美版 Wii 游戏 RMHE08 进行匹配式反编译。构建流程将已匹配的重建单元与未完成区域的原版字节链接，并用记录的 SHA-1 检查 main.dol。项目维护编译单元拆分、符号表和逐函数得分，也记录编译器匹配方法及构建检查。
requirements: A user-owned RMHE08 main.dol and mh3.sel from the Wii disc are required.
The build requires Python 3.12 or newer and Ninja; non-Windows hosts need a Win32 wrapper for Metrowerks compilers.
Only units whose output matches are marked Matching; other regions retain original bytes.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: RedBaron_Recomp: a Snoopy Flying Ace Xbox 360 recompilation
description_en: RedBaron_Recomp builds a native Windows x64 version of the Xbox 360 game Snoopy Flying Ace with ReXGlue and ReXAuto. Its launcher extracts the player's game files, generates code and compiles the port locally; repository patches adapt the runtime for graphics, controls and online services.
description_zh: RedBaron_Recomp 使用 ReXGlue 和 ReXAuto 构建 Xbox 360 游戏 Snoopy Flying Ace 的 Windows x64 原生版本。启动器从玩家的游戏文件提取内容，在本地生成代码并编译；仓库补丁适配图形、操作和在线服务。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 x64, .NET Framework 4.8 and a Direct3D 12-capable graphics card are required.
The player's compatible Xbox 360 game files are required; DLC is supplied separately.
Version 0.21 is a public testing release; four-player local play is unimplemented.
No licence file in the repository.

name: X-Settlers: reconstructing Settlers 3/4 maps and rendering
description_en: X-Settlers is an early C++17 reimplementation effort for The Settlers 3/4 that renders map terrain and documents Settlers 3 map partitions. Its format notes identify map information, player and team data, previews, areas, buildings and resources. Loading graphics and maps directly from an original installation remains planned.
description_zh: X-Settlers 是《工人物语》3/4 的早期 C++17 重建项目，已实现地图地形渲染，并记录《工人物语 3》地图分区。格式笔记列出地图信息、玩家与队伍数据、预览图、区域、建筑及资源；直接读取原版安装目录中的图像和地图仍属计划。
requirements: Requires C++17, CMake 3.19+ and SDL 2.0; the documented Windows build uses Visual Studio 2019.
The repository's git submodules must be included for the build.
Direct loading of Settlers 3 graphics and maps from the original installation is planned.
Apache-2.0.

name: KlingonWin10WPF: rebuilding the Star Trek: Klingon FMV player
description_en: KlingonWin10WPF rebuilds the FMV player for Star Trek: Klingon Immersion Studies as a Windows application using the user's original disc videos. Its code handles scenes, clickable hotspots and saves, with video playback through libVLC. The author reports missing button lighting in one scene, no save prompt on exit and hotspot drift after some window resizing.
description_zh: KlingonWin10WPF 将 Star Trek: Klingon Immersion Studies 的全动态影像播放器重建为 Windows 应用，使用玩家原版光盘中的视频。代码处理场景、可点击热点和存档，并通过 libVLC 播放视频；作者指出某场景按钮灯光、退出时存档提示及缩放窗口后的热点位置仍有问题。
requirements: Original game discs and specified AVI files.
Visual Studio 2019 Community Edition and restored NuGet packages for building.
Some button lighting, exit-save prompting and resized-window hotspot positions remain incomplete.
MIT licence for the engine code.

name: Space Invaders 8080 Static Recompiler: an arcade ROM to C++ translation
description_en: Space Invaders 8080 Static Recompiler translates the 1978 arcade game's Intel 8080 ROM into generated C++ before execution. Its lifter uses a linear sweep and branch-target discovery, while an SDL3 runner models I/O ports, a shift register, video output and timed interrupts. The four original ROM files are supplied by the user.
description_zh: Space Invaders 8080 Static Recompiler 在运行前将 1978 年街机游戏的 Intel 8080 ROM 转换为生成的 C++。提升器使用线性扫描和分支目标发现；SDL3 运行程序模拟 I/O 端口、移位寄存器、视频输出和定时中断。四个原版 ROM 文件由用户提供。
requirements: The user must supply the four Space Invaders ROM files under Data/.
Building requires a C++11-capable compiler and SDL3 development libraries.
The author describes an interpreter fallback for computed PCHL jumps.
MIT license.

name: SNES Station: reconstructing the PS2 emulator executable
description_en: SNES Station Decompilation reconstructs the PlayStation 2 SNES Station v0.23 WIP executable through source recovery, historical toolchain matching and image comparison. Its analysis covers the emulator core, PS2 runtime, renderer and SJCRUNCH container. The author reports a byte-identical rebuilt packed ELF against a user-supplied reference.
description_zh: SNES Station Decompilation 通过源码恢复、历史工具链匹配与映像比较，重建 PS2 版 SNES Station v0.23 WIP 可执行文件。研究涵盖模拟器核心、PS2 运行时、渲染器和 SJCRUNCH 容器；作者报告生成的打包 ELF 与用户提供的原版逐字节一致。
requirements: A legally obtained original/SNES_EMU.ELF reference is required for the complete reproduction check.
Repository checks require Python 3, GNU Make and a host C compiler; full reproduction uses the historical PS2 toolchain.
The author reports a byte-identical packed ELF build.

name: Ikachan3: decompiling the Nintendo 3DS release
description_en: Ikachan3 decompiles the Nintendo 3DS version of Ikachan into game source organized by subsystem. Its build uses the armcc compiler, and a user-provided original code.bin enables binary comparison. The repository includes source for player, map, sound and other game components.
description_zh: Ikachan3 按子系统整理 Nintendo 3DS 版 Ikachan 的反编译源码，涵盖玩家、地图、声音等组件。构建使用 armcc；用户提供原版 code.bin 后可进行二进制比较。
requirements: armcc compiler version 973 is required in the Compilers directory.
An original code.bin in orig/ is required for diffing.
No licence file in the repository.

name: NFL Street 2: an evidence-tracked GameCube matching decompilation
description_en: NFL Street 2 reconstructs C and C++ source for the USA GameCube release with a byte-identical executable as its goal. The build inserts reconstructed units into an original-object baseline and checks the resulting main.dol hash; a trial tool compares individual functions. Configuration files record names, unit boundaries and supporting evidence.
description_zh: NFL Street 2 为美国版 GameCube 游戏重建 C/C++ 源码，以生成逐字节一致的可执行文件为目标。构建流程将重建单元放入原始目标文件基线，检查 main.dol 哈希；试编工具可逐函数比较。配置文件记录名称、编译单元边界及相应依据。
requirements: A user-owned NFL Street 2 GameCube disc image and extracted main.dol are required.
The documented tools support Python 3.9 or newer on Linux x86-64 and macOS ARM64.
The matching source is still in progress; the hash-checked build retains original bytes for unreconstructed units.
No licence file in the repository.

name: PS3Sharp: reconstructing the PS3 TMAPI debug protocol
description_en: PS3Sharp implements a cross-platform .NET client for PlayStation 3 memory access through TMAPI and other backends. The author reports reconstructing the SN Systems TMAPI debug protocol from Wireshark captures, enabling direct TCP access without Target Manager; the library also supports PS3MAPI, CCAPI and RPCS3.
description_zh: PS3Sharp 是跨平台 .NET 库，可通过 TMAPI 等后端访问 PlayStation 3 内存。作者报告依据 Wireshark 抓包重建了 SN Systems TMAPI 调试协议，使客户端无需 Target Manager 即可直接通过 TCP 连接；库还支持 PS3MAPI、CCAPI 和 RPCS3。
requirements: A PS3 debug interface or RPCS3 is required for integration use.
CCAPI requires Windows x86 and its DLL; RPCS3 requires an x64 build.
Integration tests require a PS3 or RPCS3.
MIT licence.

name: Settlers.ts: decoding Settlers 4 data for a browser remake
description_en: Settlers.ts builds a browser-based Settlers 4 remake in TypeScript using files from the user's game installation. Its readers decode LIB archives, graphics, maps and saves, while WebGL renders map landscapes. Object drawing, settlers, buildings and game logic are listed as future work.
description_zh: Settlers.ts 用 TypeScript 和用户自己的 Settlers 4 文件开发浏览器版重制项目。文件读取器解析 LIB 归档、图形、地图与存档，WebGL 用于渲染地形；物体、居民、建筑绘制及游戏逻辑仍在计划中。
requirements: Node.js and a Settlers 4 installation containing game.lib, gfx.lib and GFX files are required.
Object, settler and building rendering and game logic are unfinished.
MIT.

name: XC2 Recomp: statically recompiling Xenoblade Chronicles 2
description_en: XC2 Recomp statically translates the Nintendo Switch game Xenoblade Chronicles 2 into a native x86-64 application for Windows and Linux. Its setup extracts the user's game and update files, lifts ARM64 code, and builds a runtime with Vulkan rendering. The author reports that the early build reaches the title screen and runs through the opening battle into Goldmouth.
description_zh: XC2 Recomp 将 Nintendo Switch 游戏《Xenoblade Chronicles 2》的 ARM64 代码静态转译为可在 Windows 和 Linux 上运行的原生 x86-64 程序。安装流程从用户自己的游戏及更新文件中提取内容、转译代码，并构建采用 Vulkan 渲染的运行时。作者报告，早期版本可进入标题画面，并从开场战斗运行到 Goldmouth。
requirements: A user-supplied Xenoblade Chronicles 2 base game, final update, and console prod.keys are required.
Windows 10 or newer, or Linux 6.7 or newer with glibc 2.34; an AVX2 CPU, Vulkan 1.3 GPU with VK_EXT_external_memory_host, and about 25 GiB of setup space are required.
The project is in early development; custom aspect ratios and VRR are planned.
MIT licence for the project's own code.

name: OpenDrakan: reconstructing Drakan's Riot Engine
description_en: OpenDrakan reconstructs Riot Engine for Drakan: Order of the Flame on GNU/Linux. Its C++ project loads original game levels, includes an SRSC data extractor, and documents database structures and UDP/TCP network exchanges.
description_zh: OpenDrakan 用 C++ 为 Drakan: Order of the Flame 重建 Riot Engine，面向 GNU/Linux。项目可加载原版关卡，提供 SRSC 数据提取工具，并记录数据库结构和 UDP/TCP 网络通信。
requirements: A legal Drakan copy is required, along with zlib, GLM, Bullet Physics, CMake, OpenSceneGraph and OpenAL for the available renderer.
The replacement engine is early-stage and cannot yet play the full game.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Pal3.Unity: reconstructing Sword and Fairy 3 and Wenqing Pian in Unity
description_en: Pal3.Unity reimplements The Legend of Sword and Fairy 3 and its Wenqing Pian expansion in C# and Unity. It rewrites game logic and reproduces behaviour and effects while loading assets from the user's original game installation.
description_zh: Pal3.Unity 使用 C# 和 Unity 重建《仙剑奇侠传三》及外传《问情篇》。项目重写游戏逻辑，从用户的原版安装目录读取资源，并复现游戏行为与效果。
requirements: Unity 6 and the original files for either supported game.
Bink cutscenes must be converted to a Unity-supported video format; Linux uses WebM.
The source states that some VFX prefabs and toon shaders from the Unity Asset Store are unavailable in the repository.
GPL-3.0 applies to the project's code; Unity assets and other assets and plugins are excluded from that licence.

name: DoomRPG-RE: reconstructing Doom RPG in C
description_en: DoomRPG-RE reconstructs Doom RPG as a C program with gameplay, combat, menus, rendering and input modules. Its SDL-based executable loads game data from DoomRPG.zip and builds through CMake with audio and compression dependencies.
description_zh: DoomRPG-RE 用 C 重建《毁灭战士 RPG》，包含游戏逻辑、战斗、菜单、渲染和输入模块。其基于 SDL 的程序从 DoomRPG.zip 加载游戏数据，并通过 CMake 构建，依赖音频与压缩库。
requirements: CMake, SDL2, SDL2-Mixer, zlib and FluidSynth are required to build.
The executable loads DoomRPG.zip as its game data input.

name: Mario & Luigi: Partners in Time: matching DS decompilation
description_en: Mario & Luigi: Partners in Time is a work-in-progress C and C++ decompilation of the European Nintendo DS release, generated with AI under human direction and supervision. The author reports a byte-for-byte ROM rebuild; matching source is gradually replacing assembly, with emulator checks used to confirm game behavior.
description_zh: Mario & Luigi: Partners in Time 是欧版 Nintendo DS 游戏的 C/C++ 反编译项目，源码由生成式 AI 在人工指导和监督下生成。作者报告 ROM 可逐字节重建；匹配原版的源码正逐步替换汇编，并使用模拟器检查游戏行为。
requirements: Use Windows, Python 3.11 or newer, Ninja and a compatible Metrowerks ARM toolchain.
Supply your own decrypted European ROM.
High-level source is still replacing remaining assembly; field and battle scripts remain major tasks.

name: Wreckless: recompiling The Yakuza Missions for Windows
description_en: Wreckless uses xboxrecomp to translate the original Xbox game's x86 code into C and compile a native Windows executable. Its analysis documents XBE sections, kernel imports, function recovery and ABI work. The author reports that initialization runs but rendering and gameplay are still blocked by an indirect call into a function body.
description_zh: Wreckless 使用 xboxrecomp 将原版 Xbox 游戏的 x86 代码转换为 C，并编译成 Windows 原生程序。项目记录了 XBE 区段、内核导入、函数识别和 ABI 恢复。作者报告初始化已运行，但函数内部的间接调用仍阻碍画面和游戏流程。
requirements: The user's own default.xbe and an xboxrecomp checkout.
Windows with Visual Studio 2022, CMake 3.20+ and Python 3.10+ with capstone.
Rendering and gameplay have not started; an indirect call remains unresolved.
MIT license.

name: Star Wars Trilogy Arcade: a native PC port from PowerPC static recompilation
description_en: Star Wars Trilogy Arcade is ported to PC by statically translating its PowerPC game code to C++ and supplying new graphics, sound and control systems. The project documents Sega Model 3 Step 2.1 hardware and uses a Vulkan renderer; its build requires the player’s own Rev. A arcade ROM.
description_zh: 该项目将 Star Wars Trilogy Arcade 的 PowerPC 游戏代码静态翻译为 C++，并配套实现图形、声音和控制系统，使其在 PC 上原生运行。项目记录了 Sega Model 3 Step 2.1 硬件，使用 Vulkan 渲染器；构建需要玩家自备 Rev. A 街机 ROM。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and a GPU with a Vulkan 1.3 driver.
A personal copy of the swtrilgy.zip Rev. A ROM set containing epr-21119.ic8; other game versions are unsupported.
Python 3 and Visual Studio 2022 C++ build tools with MSVC, CMake and a Windows SDK.
Extra game modes are listed as coming soon.
MIT License for the project code; third-party components retain their own licences.

name: ppengine: a Pole Position remake from arcade ROM analysis
description_en: ppengine recreates Atari's Pole Position as a 3D game using logic reverse engineered from the arcade ROMs. Its C source builds a playable client with steering, braking, acceleration and gear changes, while the title screen remains unfinished.
description_zh: ppengine 利用从街机 ROM 逆向得到的逻辑，将 Atari《Pole Position》重建为 3D 游戏。C 源码可构建可玩的客户端，支持转向、刹车、加速和换挡；标题画面仍未完成。
requirements: Building is documented primarily for Linux with GCC 4.0+, Make, SDL2 development libraries, OpenSceneGraph and Gorilla Audio.
Windows and macOS have not been tested.
The title screen is unimplemented.
No licence file in the repository.
