name: SwitchWaker: a native port of The Wind Waker from decompiled source
description_en: SwitchWaker ports the GameCube game The Wind Waker to Mac, Linux and Switch by compiling imported decompiled source and running it through a new platform layer with Aurora rendering. Build scripts generate required asset headers from a user's GZLE01 or GZLP01 revision 0 disc.
description_zh: SwitchWaker 将 GameCube 游戏《The Wind Waker》的反编译代码编译为 Mac、Linux 和 Switch 原生版本，并通过新平台层和 Aurora 渲染运行。构建脚本从玩家自备的 GZLE01 或 GZLP01 revision 0 光盘生成所需资源头文件。
requirements: A legally obtained, uncompressed GZLE01 or GZLP01 revision 0 ISO is required.
Builds target Mac, Linux or Switch homebrew; native Windows support is unfinished.
MIT license for the port; imported game source has its own CC0-1.0 license.

name: The Phantom Menace: a PlayStation static recompilation and matching decompilation
description_en: The Phantom Menace project runs a static recompilation of the USA Rev 1 PlayStation game natively on desktop and M5Stack Tab5. Its recompiler translates MIPS code into C at build time and runs it with a PlayStation hardware runtime. A matching decompilation aims to replace the generated code function by function; the author reports native gameplay, while the initial handwritten C functions remain nonmatching.
description_zh: 该项目通过静态重编译，使美版 Rev 1《Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace》PlayStation 游戏在桌面设备和 M5Stack Tab5 上原生运行。专用重编译器在构建时将 MIPS 代码转换为 C，再通过 PlayStation 硬件运行环境执行。同步进行的匹配反编译计划逐函数替换生成代码；作者报告原生版本已可游玩，但最初编写的 C 函数尚未达到机器码匹配。
requirements: A user-owned USA Rev 1 PlayStation disc image and SLUS_008.84 executable are required.
The matching build uses PSY-Q 4.3 GCC 2.8.1 and associated MIPS tooling.
The author reports that the initial hand-written C functions remain nonmatching.
MIT license.

name: Dragon Quest IV: a Nintendo DS decompilation of the European release
description_en: DQIV-DECOMP reconstructs the European Nintendo DS release of Dragon Quest IV as C++ using ds-decomp. Its build consumes a user-supplied ROM, compiles the reconstructed ARM9 code and overlays with Ninja, and offers objdiff comparisons; an ARM7 BIOS dump enables the optional matching-ROM build.
description_zh: DQIV-DECOMP 使用 ds-decomp 将欧版 Nintendo DS《Dragon Quest IV》重建为 C++ 源码。Ninja 构建流程读取用户自备 ROM，编译 ARM9 代码与覆盖层，并支持用 objdiff 比对；可选的精确匹配构建还需要从自有 DS 提取 ARM7 BIOS。
requirements: Supply a clean European Dragon Quest IV ROM in the extract folder; only EUR is supported.
Windows or Linux, Python 3.11+, GCC 9+, and Ninja are required.
An ARM7 BIOS extracted from a DS is required for the optional matching-ROM build.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Ghost in the Shell: a PlayStation recompilation setup host
description_en: Ghost in the Shell Recompiled is a PSXRecomp setup host for the European PlayStation game. The wizard accepts the user's CUE disc and BIOS, then generates and builds the translated code locally. The author records acceptance of a corrected Windows development build and leaves package setup, gameplay and save checks open.
description_zh: Ghost in the Shell Recompiled 是欧版 PlayStation 游戏的 PSXRecomp 安装项目。向导读取用户的 CUE 光盘和 BIOS，在本地生成并构建转译代码。作者记录了修正后 Windows 开发版的验收结果；成品包安装、游戏流程和存档检查仍待完成。
requirements: The user's SCES-01050 game disc and SCPH-5502/5552 European BIOS.
Linux and macOS setup requires CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and a C/C++ compiler.
Package setup, gameplay and save/load acceptance remain open.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Professor Layton: Curious Village HD Vita: an Android game rehosting port
description_en: Professor Layton: Curious Village HD Vita runs the Android game on PS Vita by loading its ARMv7 executable, resolving Android imports with native functions and patching platform behavior. The loader uses the player's APK and OBB data; the author notes occasional video problems and slow animation after puzzle solutions.
description_zh: Professor Layton: Curious Village HD Vita 将 Android 版游戏的 ARMv7 可执行文件加载到 PS Vita，借助原生函数解析导入项，并修补平台相关行为。加载器使用玩家自备的 APK 和 OBB 数据；作者记录了偶发的视频问题及解谜后动画缓慢的问题。
requirements: A legally obtained Android APK and OBB from a compatible version are required; versions 1.0.1 and 1.0.3 were tested.
PS Vita setup requires kubridge, FdFix or rePatch, and libshacccg.suprx.
Videos can occasionally freeze or lack audio; post-puzzle animation can be slow.
MIT License.

name: ReMech2: rebuilding MechWarrior 2 from decompiled code and original game data
description_en: ReMech2 rebuilds MechWarrior 2: 31st Century Combat for Windows and Linux using a Rust runtime and decompiled C/C++ game code from the related demech2 project. It loads data from the user's original disc or installation and adds modern input, audio, rendering and widescreen support.
description_zh: ReMech2 使用 Rust 运行时及相关 demech2 项目的 C/C++ 反编译代码，在 Windows 和 Linux 上重建《MechWarrior 2: 31st Century Combat》。它读取用户原版光盘或安装目录中的数据，并加入现代输入、音频、渲染和宽屏支持。
requirements: An English software-rendered release of MechWarrior 2 on CD, disc image or in an installed folder.
For building: Rust, a C/C++ compiler and libclang; Linux also needs clang, mold, ALSA and udev development packages, while Windows uses MinGW-w64.
Work in progress; Ghost Bear's Legacy, Mercenaries and several hardware-accelerated releases are unsupported.
GPL-3.0-or-later; the included demech2 decompiled code is LGPL-3.0-or-later.

name: Wonder: a matching decompilation of Wonder Project J2
description_en: Wonder reconstructs code for the Japanese Nintendo 64 release of Wonder Project J2 and rebuilds a hash-checked ROM from the user's copy. Its source tree contains C, assembly and extraction tools, while its notes describe the game's ROM layout and SPI compression variants.
description_zh: Wonder 重建《Wonder Project J2》日版 N64 游戏代码，并利用用户自备的 ROM 构建可按哈希值比对的镜像。仓库包含 C、汇编及提取工具，文档还记录 ROM 布局和 SPI 压缩变体。
requirements: A prior copy of the game ROM is required to extract assets and assembly.
The build uses MIPS binutils, Python and platform-specific build dependencies.
The author reports the game-code decompilation is in progress and reports 41.82% byte progress.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: BattleTanx: Global Assault: an N64 static recompilation port
description_en: BattleTanx: Global Assault is ported to PC by statically recompiling its Nintendo 64 code with N64Recomp and running it on N64ModernRuntime with RT64 rendering. The repository includes a corrected function-boundary map, game-specific runtime changes and a log of the investigations behind them.
description_zh: BattleTanx: Global Assault 使用 N64Recomp 静态重编译 Nintendo 64 游戏代码，并通过 N64ModernRuntime 和 RT64 在 PC 上运行。仓库包含修订过的函数边界符号表、针对游戏的运行时修改，以及相关调查日志。
requirements: The user's own BattleTanx: Global Assault USA ROM matching the documented SHA-1.
The author describes the port as a beta tested on Windows 10.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: OpenCrossing-Xbox: an original Xbox port of Animal Crossing
description_en: OpenCrossing-Xbox compiles the decompiled GameCube code of Animal Crossing for the original Xbox and reads data from the user's USA Rev 0 disc image. Its Xbox-specific layer adapts video, audio, input, memory and file paths, including a renderer path to the NV2A GPU.
description_zh: OpenCrossing-Xbox 将 GameCube 版《Animal Crossing》的反编译代码编译到初代 Xbox，并从用户提供的美版 Rev 0 光盘镜像读取数据。Xbox 专用适配层处理视频、音频、输入、内存和文件路径，包括通往 NV2A GPU 的渲染路径。
requirements: An original Xbox capable of homebrew and the user's Animal Crossing USA GAFE01 Rev 0 disc image are required.
A stock 64 MB Xbox is the documented hardware target.
PAL, Japanese, e+ and Rev 1 discs are unsupported; some game features and visual details remain limited.
The decompiled code is CC0; the port layer is MIT.

name: The Minish Cap: a native PC port of the GBA decompilation
description_en: The Minish Cap PC port compiles the GBA game's recovered C source for Linux, Windows and macOS. It replaces GBA hardware with SDL3, a software PPU renderer and agbplay audio, extracts assets from the user's ROM, and currently supports the USA and EU releases for native play.
description_zh: The Minish Cap PC 移植版将 GBA 游戏恢复的 C 源码编译到 Linux、Windows 和 macOS，使用 SDL3、软件 PPU 渲染器和 agbplay 音频组件替代 GBA 硬件。它从用户自己的 ROM 提取资源，目前原生运行支持美版和欧版。
requirements: An original game ROM is required; the repository does not include game assets.
The PC build uses Python 3, xmake, SDL3, libpng, fmt and nlohmann-json.
The PC port currently supports USA and EU ROMs; the author describes rendering and gameplay paths as unfinished.
No licence file in the repository.

name: PFire: reconstructing an XFire server from its messaging protocol
description_en: PFire reconstructs an XFire server for client 1.127 using the service's messaging protocol. Its .NET implementation handles login, friends, status and chat, and the repository includes a specification of XFire message framing and attributes based on reverse-engineered protocol work.
description_zh: PFire 依据 XFire 消息协议重建兼容 1.127 客户端的服务器。其 .NET 实现处理登录、好友、状态和聊天，仓库还收录基于逆向研究的消息帧与属性格式说明。
requirements: .NET 10 SDK and XFire client v1.127 are listed as requirements.
The client must be directed to the local server by mapping cs.xfire.com in the hosts file.
The source lists friend search, requests, status and one-to-one chat as working features.
MIT license.

name: Shittim Server: reconstructing Blue Archive services
description_en: Shittim Server reconstructs services used by the Steam release of Blue Archive as a local C# ASP.NET Core server backed by SQLite. It redirects and patches the installed client to connect locally, and its Frida capture tool inspects plaintext responses at the client's decryption boundary to inform protocol implementation.
description_zh: Shittim Server 用 C#、ASP.NET Core 和 SQLite 重建 Steam 版《Blue Archive》所需的本地服务。项目通过重定向和修改已安装客户端使其连接本地服务器，并用 Frida 在客户端解密边界捕获明文响应，辅助协议实现。
requirements: The Steam release of Blue Archive, .NET 10 and mitmproxy are required.
The server requires the installed client to be redirected and its gateway key patched.
The author describes the game as just playable, with selected features implemented.

name: Luigi's Mansion: a multi-region GameCube decompilation
description_en: The archived Luigi's Mansion project reconstructs source for USA, Japanese and two PAL GameCube revisions. It builds from a user-provided disc image and provides objdiff configuration to compare reconstructed objects with the originals; its README points to a newer continuation.
description_zh: 这份已归档的 Luigi's Mansion 项目重建美版、日版及两个 PAL 修订版的 GameCube 游戏源码。构建需要用户提供光盘镜像；项目提供 objdiff 配置，用于比较重建的目标文件与原始目标文件。README 指向后续项目。
requirements: A supported Luigi's Mansion disc image is required.
Python and Ninja are required for the documented build.
The project is unfinished and its README directs readers to a newer continuation.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: RFL: decompiling the Wii Mii library
description_en: RFL reconstructs the Wii library responsible for handling Miis from an original game image. The build targets the 20080306 version from Challenge Me: Word Puzzles, and objdiff compares built objects; the author reports matching release builds and two unmatched debug functions.
description_zh: RFL 从原版游戏镜像重建 Wii 的 Mii 处理库。构建目标是《Challenge Me: Word Puzzles》中的 20080306 版本，使用 objdiff 比较目标文件；作者称发布版已匹配，调试版仍有两个函数未匹配。
requirements: A user-provided Challenge Me: Word Puzzles disc image is required for building.
Building is supported only for version 20080306.
Python and Ninja are required.
The author reports two unmatched debug-build functions.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Fire Emblem: a partial US GBA disassembly and decompilation
description_en: fe7_us reconstructs parts of the US Game Boy Advance release of Fire Emblem as assembly and C. The project builds a SHA-1-listed ROM from the user's base ROM and presents its partial decompilation as a modding and research reference.
description_zh: fe7_us 以汇编和 C 代码重建美版 GBA《Fire Emblem》的部分内容。项目从用户的基础 ROM 构建带有 SHA-1 标识的 ROM，并将现阶段成果用于模组制作和研究参考。
requirements: A US Fire Emblem GBA dump named baserom.gba.
Debian or Ubuntu, including WSL2, with build-essential, gcc-arm-none-eabi, and agbcc.
The decompilation is partial.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Shadow the Hedgehog: a PS2 static recompilation checkpoint
description_en: Shadow the Hedgehog Recomp translates the PS2 game's MIPS and VU code into native C++ with PS2Recomp and links it to ps2xRuntime. The author reports static compilation, linking and bootloader initialization; video bypass, menus, input and 3D gameplay remain unfinished.
description_zh: Shadow the Hedgehog Recomp 使用 PS2Recomp 将 PS2 游戏的 MIPS 与 VU 代码转为原生 C++，并连接 ps2xRuntime。作者报告静态编译、链接及引导程序初始化已完成；视频跳过、菜单、输入和 3D 游戏流程仍未完成。
requirements: A local PS2 game dump and PS2Recomp checkout.
CMake 3.21+, Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools or clang-cl with C++20 support.
Menus and in-game 3D remain unfinished.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: MadagascarDecomp: reconstructing Madagascar's source
description_en: MadagascarDecomp is a work-in-progress C++ decompilation of the 2005 game Madagascar. Its build uses Visual C++ Toolkit 2003 and RenderWare Graphics SDK, with reccmp scripts for comparing compiled output to an original Game.exe.
description_zh: MadagascarDecomp 是 2005 年游戏《Madagascar》的 C++ 反编译项目，仍在进行中。构建使用 Visual C++ Toolkit 2003 和 RenderWare Graphics SDK，并提供 reccmp 脚本，将编译结果与原版 Game.exe 比对。
requirements: Visual C++ Toolkit 2003, an x86 Windows SDK, RenderWare Graphics SDK and Python 3.10+ are required for the build.
An original Game.exe is required for reccmp comparison.
The decompilation is a work in progress.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Robotron: 2084: a ZX Spectrum disassembly
description_en: Robotron: 2084 is a SkoolKit disassembly of the ZX Spectrum game. The repository stores the SkoolKit source and control files and provides a script to generate browsable hexadecimal or decimal listings.
description_zh: Robotron: 2084 收录 ZX Spectrum 版游戏的 SkoolKit 反汇编资料。仓库保存 SkoolKit 源文件与控制文件，并提供脚本生成十六进制或十进制的可浏览代码清单。
requirements: SkoolKit or a SkoolKit checkout configured through SKOOLKIT_HOME is needed to build the HTML listing.
The source says users need to own the original game to disassemble its code.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: River Raid: an annotated ZX Spectrum disassembly
description_en: River Raid is reverse-engineered from its ZX Spectrum 48K tape image into an annotated SkoolKit disassembly. Pasmo assembles the generated source for comparison with a game snapshot, and the repository records gameplay-loop and data-structure findings. The author reports a byte-identical build while routine documentation is still in progress.
description_zh: 项目从 ZX Spectrum 48K《River Raid》的磁带映像生成带注释的 SkoolKit 反汇编，并用 Pasmo 汇编后与游戏快照比较。仓库记录了主循环和数据结构的研究；作者报告构建结果字节一致，但例程文档仍在补充。
requirements: The original game tape image, SkoolKit 8.4 or newer, and Pasmo are required.
The project plan reports descriptions for 37 of 229 routines at its stated checkpoint.
No licence file in the repository.

name: StarshipPad: bringing the Star Fox 64 source port to iOS
description_en: StarshipPad adapts the decompilation-based Star Fox 64 source port Starship into an iPhone and iPad application. Its maintained patches and build scripts add Metal rendering, touch flight controls, controller handling and local ROM import through Files.
description_zh: StarshipPad 将基于 Star Fox 64 反编译成果的源码移植版 Starship 适配为 iPhone 和 iPad 应用。项目维护的补丁与构建脚本加入 Metal 渲染、触屏飞行控制、手柄处理，以及通过“文件”应用导入本地 ROM。
requirements: iOS or iPadOS 16 or newer and a supported personal Star Fox 64 ROM are required.
Local builds require a Mac with Xcode and the listed build libraries.
Phone controls and sustained device performance remain under validation.
MIT.

name: MeleePad: a native Apple static recompilation of Super Smash Bros. Melee
description_en: MeleePad ports Super Smash Bros. Melee to iPhone, iPad and Apple Silicon Mac by compiling PowerPC code translated from a player-supplied GameCube disc into ARM64 code ahead of time. It joins a Dolphin-derived runtime to Metal, UIKit, Apple audio and touch or physical controls.
description_zh: MeleePad 从玩家自备的 GameCube 光盘提取 Super Smash Bros. Melee 的 PowerPC 代码，预先转换并编译为 ARM64，供 iPhone、iPad 和 Apple Silicon Mac 运行。项目将 Dolphin 衍生运行时接入 Metal、UIKit、Apple 音频以及触控和实体控制器。
requirements: Own supported Super Smash Bros. Melee GALE01 USA v1.00 or v1.02 disc image.
iOS or iPadOS 16+, or macOS 14+; the standard build route uses an Apple Silicon Mac with Xcode and PadMint.
The Windows build route is experimental; iPhone and iPad rendering defects remain.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: Shaun Palmer's Pro Snowboarder: a PS2 decompilation and format study
description_en: SPPS reconstructs Shaun Palmer's Pro Snowboarder for PlayStation 2 as C source and rebuilds game executables with splat and a matching-function workflow. Its notes document release hashes and the game's DATA.DAT asset archive, including sector-based entry offsets and sizes.
description_zh: SPPS 将 PS2 游戏《Shaun Palmer's Pro Snowboarder》重建为 C 源码，并借助 splat 和函数匹配流程重新构建可执行文件。项目还记录发行版本哈希，以及 DATA.DAT 资源归档按扇区保存条目偏移和大小的结构。
requirements: A SPPS SLUS_201.99 or SLPM_651.98 ELF binary is required.
Linux or WSL, Python 3, 7Zip and the project build dependencies are required.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Einhander: a PlayStation static recompilation project
description_en: Einhander configures psxrecomp to generate a native build of the PlayStation game from a user-supplied disc. Its repository includes game configuration, function seeds, symbol synchronization and trace analysis scripts, with recomp-ui used for the launcher.
description_zh: Einhander 配置 psxrecomp，从用户提供的 PlayStation 游戏光盘生成本机版本。仓库包含游戏配置、函数种子、符号同步和跟踪分析脚本，并使用 recomp-ui 作为启动界面。
requirements: Requires the user's original Einhander disc image and the psxrecomp submodule.
The project is marked experimental.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Banjo-Tooie: a partial DLL decompilation and ROM build
description_en: banjo2 reconstructs Banjo-Tooie DLL code for Nintendo 64 ROM builds. Its Makefile selects North American, Japanese, European or Australian versions and includes a matching-output option; project notes document compiling and comparing individual DLL binaries.
description_zh: banjo2 重建《Banjo-Tooie》的 DLL 代码，用于生成 Nintendo 64 ROM。Makefile 可选择北美、日本、欧洲或澳大利亚版本，并提供匹配原版输出的选项；项目笔记记录了单个 DLL 的编译与二进制比较方法。
requirements: A matching original Banjo-Tooie ROM and the documented MIPS toolchain are needed for build comparison.
No licence file in the repository.

name: RTWDecomp: matching decompilation of Rome: Total War Gold
description_en: RTWDecomp reconstructs source for the Steam release of Rome: Total War Gold from its Windows x86 RomeTW.exe. It splits the PE into translation units, uses Visual C++ 6.0 SP6 and objdiff to compare compiled functions, and publishes findings on command-line options, console commands and gameplay mechanics.
description_zh: RTWDecomp 根据 Steam 版 Rome: Total War Gold 的 Windows x86 可执行文件 RomeTW.exe 重建源码。项目将 PE 拆分为编译单元，使用 Visual C++ 6.0 SP6 和 objdiff 比对函数，并整理命令行选项、控制台命令及游戏机制的研究结果。
requirements: Windows, Python 3.11+ and Ninja are required for the documented build.
A user-owned Steam RomeTW.exe is required; Visual C++ 6.0 SP6 is needed to compile reconstructed units.
The decompilation is in progress, and data is not yet split per unit.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Spyro 2: Gateway to Glimmer: matching PlayStation decompilation
description_en: Spyro 2: Gateway to Glimmer is being reconstructed as matching C for the European PlayStation release SCES-021.04. The build uses GCC 2.7.2 and an ASPSX 2.56-compatible pipeline for the main executable and 32 WAD overlays. The author reports a byte-identical rebuild of the executable, overlays, and complete WAD while C replacement remains partial.
description_zh: Spyro 2: Gateway to Glimmer 针对欧洲版 PlayStation 游戏 SCES-021.04 重建匹配的 C 代码。构建流程使用 GCC 2.7.2 和兼容 ASPSX 2.56 的工具链，覆盖主程序与 32 个 WAD 覆盖模块。作者报告这些输出及完整 WAD 已逐字节一致，但 C 代码替换仍在进行。
requirements: Linux x86_64 and the executable and WAD from the user's retail copy are required.
C replacement is incomplete; the author reports 21.578% combined game-code progress.
CC0-1.0 applies to project contributions; third-party game materials retain their own rights.

name: Serial Experiments Lain: matching PlayStation decompilation and native port
description_en: Serial Experiments Lain is reconstructed as C source for the PlayStation release and ported to Windows, macOS and Linux through a reimplementation of PlayStation SDK calls. The author reports that the rebuilt executable matches the retail binary byte for byte; the native client reads media and data from the user's two original discs.
description_zh: 项目将 PlayStation 版 Serial Experiments Lain 重建为 C 源码，并通过重实现 PlayStation SDK 调用移植到 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。作者报告重建的可执行文件与零售版逐字节一致；原生客户端从用户自备的两张原版光盘读取媒体和数据。
requirements: Two original Japanese PlayStation discs dumped as Redump .cue and .bin images are required for the native client.
The decompilation build requires Python 3, Docker, and the disc images; the native build requires CMake, a C/C++ compiler, SDL2, and OpenAL.
The author reports a byte-identical executable and 321 matching game functions.
MIT license.

name: Wobbledogs: reconstructing Unity managed assemblies
description_en: Wobbledogs reconstructs the Steam Windows game's managed assemblies by decompiling IL with ILSpy and recompiling the resulting C# with Roslyn against the game's Mono profile. Scripts export assemblies from an owned install, repair documented decompiler artifacts, package a runnable tree, and compare code and boot behavior. The author reports a 69.80% code match.
description_zh: Wobbledogs 通过 ILSpy 将 Steam Windows 版游戏托管程序集中的 IL 反编译为 C#，再用 Roslyn 引用游戏自带的 Mono 类库重新编译。脚本负责导出程序集、修复反编译产物、打包可运行目录，并比较代码和启动行为。作者报告代码匹配率为 69.80%。
requirements: A legitimate Steam Windows copy of Wobbledogs is required.
Build tools include Bash, Python 3, GNU patch, ILSpy ilspycmd, and a .NET SDK with Roslyn csc; running the result needs Proton GE and GPU/Vulkan support.
The Unity project and its scenes, prefabs, and materials are outside the reconstruction.
MIT covers the repository's original tooling and documentation.

name: Redneck Rampage: source reconstruction for two games
description_en: Redneck-Rampage-RE reconstructs source code for Redneck Rampage and Redneck Rampage Rides Again. The repository contains C and assembly game and engine files and identifies Watcom 10.5 as the build compiler.
description_zh: Redneck-Rampage-RE 重建《Redneck Rampage》及《Redneck Rampage Rides Again》的源码。仓库包含游戏与引擎的 C、汇编文件，构建需要 Watcom 10.5。
requirements: Watcom 10.5 is required to build.

name: Ladder: reconstructing the CP/M arcade game in Go
description_en: Ladder reimplements the 1982 CP/M arcade game in Go. The author observes the original in a CP/M emulator and consults an earlier Java version while rebuilding its platform, ladder and falling-object gameplay; development remains in progress.
description_zh: Ladder 用 Go 重实现 1982 年的 CP/M 街机游戏。作者在 CP/M 模拟器中观察原版，并参考较早的 Java 实现，重建平台、梯子和落物玩法；项目仍在开发。
requirements: Go is used to build the reimplementation.
The author describes the work as in progress.
MIT.

name: dRally: a native Death Rally port for Linux and BSD
description_en: dRally is a C and SDL2 project to port Death Rally (1996) to Linux and BSD. Its installation instructions use asset archives extracted from the original game.
description_zh: dRally 是以 C 和 SDL2 将 1996 年的《Death Rally》移植到 Linux 和 BSD 的项目。其安装说明使用从原版游戏提取的素材档案。
requirements: A C compiler, GNU Make, and SDL2 are required on Linux.
Original Death Rally game assets are required.
Multiplayer is unavailable.
Licensed under MIT.

name: Crazy Taxi: an Xbox 360 XBLA static recompilation for PC
description_en: ctxbla statically recompiles the 2010 Xbox 360 XBLA release of Crazy Taxi into native x86-64 PC code with XenonRecomp and ReXGlue. The repository documents STFS and XEX extraction, executable-section analysis, game-specific stubs, and input and timing fixes. The author reports that the runtime reaches gameplay, while in-game audio is absent and some gameplay events can crash.
description_zh: ctxbla 使用 XenonRecomp 和 ReXGlue，将 2010 年 Xbox 360 XBLA 版 Crazy Taxi 静态重编译为原生 x86-64 PC 程序。仓库记录 STFS 与 XEX 提取、可执行文件分段分析、游戏专用接口桩、输入与计时修正；作者报告程序已能进入游戏，但仍有音频和崩溃问题。
requirements: A legally obtained Crazy Taxi XBLA copy; game files and generated code are produced locally.
CMake 3.25+, Clang 18+, Ninja, Python 3.8+, ReXGlue SDK v0.1.0, and patched XenonRecomp.
The author reports that in-game audio is absent and some gameplay events can crash or hang.
MIT license.

name: Warblade Service Release: decompiling Warblade 1.34 and replacing PTK with SDL
description_en: Warblade Service Release reconstructs Warblade 1.34 game code from its debug build and provides an SDL-based modern release. A PTK branch preserves function-level binary matches, while the SDL branch replaces PTK and BASS and adds window, rendering and interpolation options. Both branches use assets from a local Warblade installation.
description_zh: Warblade Service Release 从《Warblade》1.34 调试版重建游戏代码，并提供基于 SDL 的现代版本。PTK 分支保留逐函数二进制匹配，SDL 分支替换 PTK 和 BASS，并增加窗口、渲染及插帧选项；两个分支都使用用户本地安装的游戏资源。
requirements: Requires a Warblade 1.34 installation and its assets.
The PTK branch requires Visual Studio 2008 C++ RTM; the SDL branch requires Visual Studio 2026 with C++ support and vcpkg.
The full executable cannot match the original byte for byte because of debug-time patching.
No licence file in the repository.

name: MUA PC Port: three Xbox 360 games statically recompiled
description_en: MUA PC Port statically recompiles three related Xbox 360 games into separate native programs using ReXGlue. A shared launcher installs each game from the user's disc image and starts its runtime on Windows, with experimental Linux and Steam Deck support.
description_zh: MUA PC Port 使用 ReXGlue 将三款相关 Xbox 360 游戏分别静态重编译为原生程序。共用启动器从用户的光盘镜像安装各游戏并启动对应运行时；支持 Windows，Linux 与 Steam Deck 支持仍属实验阶段。
requirements: A user-owned Xbox 360 disc image matching each selected game's listed Title ID and Media ID is required.
Windows 10/11 x64 requires a DirectX 12 graphics card; Linux x86_64 requires glibc 2.31+ and Vulkan.
Linux and Steam Deck support is experimental.

name: OpenOrion2: a partial Master of Orion II remake and save viewer
description_en: OpenOrion2 is a partial C++ remake of Master of Orion II: Battle at Antares that reads the original game's LBX resources and saved games. Its current interface can load existing saves as a viewer; starting a new game and gameplay remain unimplemented.
description_zh: OpenOrion2 是 Master of Orion II: Battle at Antares 的部分 C++ 重建，读取原版游戏的 LBX 资源和存档。目前程序可作为存档查看器载入已有进度，尚不能开始新游戏或进行游戏。
requirements: Original Master of Orion II LBX game files and existing saves.
LibSDL2 and SDL2_mixer.
Gameplay and starting a new game are not implemented.
GPL-2.0 License.

name: ClayFighter 64: recompiling and combining two N64 ClayFighter games
description_en: ClayFighter 64 builds a native Linux and Windows game from statically recompiled ClayFighter 63⅓ CPU and RSP audio code, adding four characters from ClayFighter: Sculptor's Cut. Its installer checks both user-supplied USA ROMs and assembles the combined game data locally; RT64 handles rendering.
description_zh: ClayFighter 64 将 ClayFighter 63⅓ 的 CPU 和 RSP 音频代码静态重编译为 Linux 与 Windows 原生程序，并加入 ClayFighter: Sculptor's Cut 的四名角色。安装器检查用户提供的两份美国版 ROM，在本地组合游戏数据；图形由 RT64 渲染。
requirements: Both user-supplied USA ROMs: ClayFighter 63⅓ and ClayFighter: Sculptor's Cut.
Linux or Windows x86-64, SSSE3 and SSE4.1 CPU support, and a Vulkan-capable GPU and driver.
Newly authored port code uses GPL-3.0-or-later; dependencies retain their licenses.

name: Chronoshift: incrementally rebuilding Command & Conquer: Red Alert
description_en: Chronoshift incrementally reimplements Command & Conquer: Red Alert in C++. Its launcher and DLL supply rewritten game functions while the original executable supplies functions still pending, so the current build targets the English 3.03 beta patch.
description_zh: Chronoshift 用 C++ 逐步重建《Command & Conquer: Red Alert》。启动器和 DLL 提供已重写的游戏函数，尚未实现的部分仍由原版可执行文件提供；当前构建针对英语版 3.03 beta 补丁。
requirements: The original Red Alert installation with the English 3.03 beta patch is required.
A working build currently requires Open Watcom and CMake on Windows.
Source is GPL version 2 or later with a temporary exception for linking to the original binary.

name: The Simpsons: Hit & Run: an Android port with native touch controls
description_en: The Simpsons: Hit & Run Android adapts an earlier Switch and PS Vita port of the game for Android. It adds native touch controls and an in-game control-layout editor, supports external controllers, and loads assets supplied from the player's PC copy.
description_zh: The Simpsons: Hit & Run Android 以先前的 Switch 和 PS Vita 移植版为基础，适配 Android，加入原生触控和游戏内按键布局编辑器，并支持外接手柄。游戏资源需由玩家从自己的 PC 版副本提供。
requirements: Android 7.0 or later and the player's own backup of the PC game assets are required.
The author notes that minor bugs or unexpected behavior may remain.
No licence file in the repository.

name: PES6 native: a Windows recompilation of Pro Evolution Soccer 6
description_en: PES6 native builds a Windows x64 version of the European Xbox 360 release of Pro Evolution Soccer 6 by translating its PowerPC code to C++ with ReXGlue. The repository supplies project manifests, a ReXGlue SDK patch, native host code, an ISO extractor, and a builder that uses the player's own game copy.
description_zh: PES6 native 使用 ReXGlue 将欧版 Xbox 360 游戏 Pro Evolution Soccer 6 的 PowerPC 代码翻译为 C++，构建 Windows x64 原生程序。仓库提供项目清单、ReXGlue SDK 补丁、宿主代码、ISO 提取器和使用玩家自备游戏副本的构建程序。
requirements: A lawfully obtained European Xbox 360 copy of Pro Evolution Soccer 6, title ID 4B4E07DA.
Windows 10 or 11 x64 with a Direct3D 12 GPU, internet access, and temporary build space.
Android support is absent from the pinned SDK integration.
Original project code is MIT licensed; the ReXGlue patch retains BSD 3-Clause terms.

name: cod4map: reconstructing the Call of Duty 4 BSP compiler
description_en: cod4map reconstructs the BSP compiler shipped with the 2007 Call of Duty 4 mod tools from its executable. Its C and C++ source builds a 32-bit Windows cod4map.exe; the project uses x87-oriented compiler flags because SSE2 floating-point generation changes BSP output bytes.
description_zh: cod4map 根据 2007 年随 Call of Duty 4 模组工具发布的可执行文件重建 BSP 编译器。其 C/C++ 源码构建 32 位 Windows 版 cod4map.exe；项目采用面向 x87 的编译参数，因为 SSE2 浮点代码会改变 BSP 输出字节。
requirements: Use Visual Studio 2019 or later with the x86 C++ toolset and CMake 3.21 or later.
Run the resulting program from the Call of Duty 4 mod tools directory.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Need for Speed: Underground 2: an Xbox static recompilation for Switch and Linux
description_en: nfsu2-sw turns the NTSC-U original Xbox release of Need for Speed: Underground 2 into native Nintendo Switch and Linux builds. Its vendored xboxrecomp toolkit lifts default.xbe to C, while the project adds host integration, renderer options, audio and game-specific overrides; game data comes from the player's extracted disc.
description_zh: nfsu2-sw 将 Xbox 美版《Need for Speed: Underground 2》转换为 Nintendo Switch 和 Linux 原生程序。内置 xboxrecomp 工具把 default.xbe 提升为 C 代码，项目另提供宿主适配、渲染选项、音频和针对游戏的覆盖实现；游戏数据取自玩家自行提取的光盘。
requirements: The player's own extracted NTSC-U Xbox disc, including default.xbe and game data.
Linux builds use SDL2 with OpenGL or Vulkan; Switch builds use devkitA64 and switch-sdl2, with additional components for Vulkan.
Generated C code and game data are not committed.
No licence file for the port is identified in the repository; the vendored xboxrecomp has its own licence.

name: poggadaj: rebuilding Gadu-Gadu backend services
description_en: poggadaj rebuilds Gadu-Gadu backend services in Go for historical messaging clients. A TCP service handles login, presence, contacts, and messages across several client versions, while an HTTP service supplies client endpoints and a web frontend provides account access.
description_zh: poggadaj 用 Go 重建面向旧版 Gadu-Gadu 即时通信客户端的后端服务。TCP 服务处理多个客户端版本的登录、在线状态、联系人和消息；HTTP 服务提供客户端接口，并配有账号管理网页。
requirements: Docker Compose orchestrates the documented service deployment; the services are written in Go.
Client support varies by Gadu-Gadu version; P2P and HTTP registration are absent.
AGPL-3.0 license.

name: Halo CE Decomp Remix: VR, PC and Android port
description_en: Adapts the Halo: Combat Evolved Xbox decompilation into builds for standalone VR headsets, Windows PC and Android. The port adds VR interaction and controller handling, PC and mobile launch paths, game-data import and campaign networking. It draws on the OpenCE port and requires the player's Halo game data.
description_zh: 基于 Xbox 版《Halo: Combat Evolved》的反编译成果，制作独立 VR 头显、Windows PC 和 Android 移植版。项目在 OpenCE 基础上加入 VR 交互与控制器适配、各平台启动流程、游戏数据导入和战役联机功能，并使用玩家提供的游戏数据。
requirements: Provide a personal Halo game image or data set.
Quest builds require sideloading; Windows PC VR requires an OpenXR runtime.
Several VR interactions, broad mod support and some device paths remain experimental.
AGPL-3.0-or-later.

name: PTCGP Private Server: a local Pokémon TCG Pocket service
description_en: PTCGP Private Server replaces selected Pokémon TCG Pocket 1.8.1 online services with local HTTPS and gRPC endpoints for profiles, collections and pack openings. A Windows controller routes a rooted Android client's traffic to per-device servers, checks the client build and imports game data from the user's installation.
description_zh: PTCGP Private Server 为 Pokémon TCG Pocket 1.8.1 提供本地 HTTPS 与 gRPC 服务，处理账号资料、卡牌收藏及开包。Windows 控制程序将已 root 的 Android 客户端流量转发至各设备对应的服务，校验客户端版本，并从用户安装的游戏导入数据。
requirements: Windows 10 or later and Pokémon TCG Pocket 1.8.1 installed by the user.
A rooted 64-bit Android phone or emulator with ADB, adb reverse and writable system mounts.
PvP matchmaking and the Battle/Connect stream are unimplemented.
MIT License.

name: Prototype: incremental behavioral decompilation through a hooked DLL
description_en: Prototype incrementally reconstructs functions from the 2009 PC game's engine DLL as readable C++. A proxy xinput1_3.dll redirects calls to replacement functions; the project saves Ghidra annotations and checks replacement behavior against the original at runtime. The author reports 28 replaced functions.
description_zh: 该项目逐步将 2009 年 PC 游戏《Prototype》的引擎 DLL 函数重建为可读的 C++。代理 xinput1_3.dll 将调用导向替换函数；项目保存 Ghidra 分析注释，并在运行时将替换函数的行为与原版比对。作者报告已替换 28 个函数。
requirements: Linux, Ghidra 12.1.2 and the user's Steam copy of Prototype are required for the documented workflow.
The reconstruction is incremental; the author reports 28 replaced functions.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Blues Brothers: rewritten engines for three Titus games
description_en: blues rewrites the engines of Blues Brothers and Blues Brothers: Jukebox Adventure in C, with support for Prehistorik 2. It loads original Amiga or DOS data files and adds horizontal scrolling and configurable screen size.
description_zh: blues 用 C 重实现《Blues Brothers》和《Blues Brothers: Jukebox Adventure》的引擎，并支持《Prehistorik 2》。程序读取原版 Amiga 或 DOS 数据文件，增加横向滚动和可配置的画面尺寸。
requirements: Blues Brothers requires Amiga or DOS full-game or demo data; Jukebox Adventure requires DOS data; Prehistorik 2 requires DOS full-game or demo data.
The Makefile uses SDL2 and libmodplug for its desktop build.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Dejavu: reimplementing classic Game Maker
description_en: Dejavu reimplements classic Game Maker in Rust to run existing projects and games on modern platforms. Its source includes GML parsing, compilation and interpretation, project reading, and a game runtime; the CLI accepts GMK projects, EXE games, and GML scripts. The implementation is early-stage, with GML and drag-and-drop code running while more APIs remain to be added.
description_zh: Dejavu 用 Rust 重建经典 Game Maker，使已有项目和游戏可在现代平台运行。代码包含 GML 解析、编译与解释、项目读取及游戏运行时；命令行接受 GMK 项目、EXE 游戏和 GML 脚本。项目仍处早期，已可运行 GML 与拖放代码，更多 API 尚待实现。
requirements: A nightly Rust toolchain is currently required.
Input can be a Game Maker 8.0 GMK project, a game EXE, or a GML script.
The implementation is in an early stage with partial API support.
Dual MIT and Apache-2.0 licenses.

name: Tom and Jerry: War of the Whiskers: an experimental GameCube decompilation
description_en: wotwdecomp reconstructs the GameCube game Tom and Jerry: War of the Whiskers with C++ and assembly and builds a specified main.dol. Its Makefile combines reconstructed functions, remaining assembly, and the required GameCube toolchains. The author describes the build as experimental because unresolved hardcoded pointers prevent shifting it for general changes.
description_zh: wotwdecomp 以 C++ 和汇编重建 GameCube 游戏《Tom and Jerry: War of the Whiskers》，并构建指定哈希的 main.dol。Makefile 组合已重建函数、剩余汇编和 GameCube 工具链。作者指出硬编码指针尚未全部解析，当前无法移动代码布局以进行一般改动。
requirements: Supply a clean game DOL named baserom.dol.
The build requires devkitPro, Python 3, GCC, a GameCube Metrowerks compiler, and ProDG 1.2.2.33.
Unresolved hardcoded pointers prevent shifting the build for general source changes.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Recompia: a native Pokémon Pokopia build for Windows
description_en: Recompia builds a native Windows version of the Switch 2 game Pokémon Pokopia from the user's extracted game files. The project extends pokopia-native with its own game-build code and launcher, and describes a setup process that compiles the game and prepares a shader cache. It also documents Linux use through Proton.
description_zh: Recompia 从用户自行提取的 Switch 2《Pokémon Pokopia》文件构建 Windows 原生版本。它在 pokopia-native 基础上提供游戏构建代码和启动器；设置流程会编译游戏并生成着色器缓存。项目还说明了通过 Proton 在 Linux 上使用的方法。
requirements: Requires the user's own extracted Pokémon Pokopia game, version 2.0.1a.
The Windows setup compiles the game and then builds a shader cache; Linux use is documented through Proton.
FSR 3 and DLSS/DLAA are present but require rework, according to the author.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: Link's Awakening DX: static recompilation of the Game Boy Color ROM
description_en: LinksAwakening converts a user-supplied The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX Game Boy Color ROM into C and builds a native Windows program. It uses gb-recompiled for code translation and runtime support, with an interpreter fallback for unresolved jumps and tools that compare hardware traces against SameBoy.
description_zh: LinksAwakening 把用户提供的 The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX Game Boy Color ROM 转为 C，并构建 Windows 原生程序。它使用 gb-recompiled 完成代码转换和运行支持，对无法提前解析的跳转使用解释器回退，并提供与 SameBoy 比较硬件轨迹的工具。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 and the user's own Link's Awakening DX ROM as .gbc or a ZIP containing one ROM.
The tested ROM is USA/Europe Rev 2; other revisions are untested.
MSYS2 and its compiler packages are used for source builds.
MIT license for repository code.

name: OpenMCM2: a Rust engine reconstruction of Motocross Madness 2
description_en: OpenMCM2 rebuilds the Motocross Madness 2 engine in Rust from a study of the original game. It reads the user's game files, including RS2 archives, terrain, scenes, models and UI data, and implements racing, bike physics, menus and network races between OpenMCM2 copies. The author reports that some jump landings, rough ground and object collisions still differ from the original.
description_zh: OpenMCM2 根据原版《Motocross Madness 2》重建 Rust 引擎，读取玩家自备的 RS2 归档、地形、场景、模型及界面数据，并实现比赛、摩托车物理、菜单和 OpenMCM2 实例之间的联机比赛。作者报告部分跳跃落地、崎岖地面及物体碰撞行为仍与原版不同。
requirements: Requires the user's own copy of Motocross Madness 2, supplied as an installed folder, disc, or supported CD image.
Builds on macOS, Windows, and Linux with Rust; the documented Linux build requires ALSA and libudev headers, and gamepad support can be disabled.
The author reports differences from the original in some jump landings, rough ground, object collisions, and computer-rider behavior.
MIT or Apache-2.0 at the user's option; the Indeo 5 decoder crate is LGPL-2.1-or-later.

name: MetroidPrimeHuntersRecomp: a native Metroid Prime Hunters recompilation
description_en: MetroidPrimeHuntersRecomp builds a native alpha of Metroid Prime Hunters USA revision 0 with ndsrecomp and a player-supplied ROM. It includes game-specific execution coverage, controls and rendering work. A separate investigation documents the game's Wi-Fi datagram framing and typed messages.
description_zh: MetroidPrimeHuntersRecomp 借助 ndsrecomp 和玩家提供的美版修订 0 ROM，构建 Metroid Prime Hunters 的原生 alpha 版本。项目包含针对游戏的执行覆盖、操作与渲染适配，并另行记录 Wi-Fi 数据报封装及消息类型。
requirements: A legally obtained Metroid Prime Hunters USA revision-0 .nds ROM is required.
The release is an alpha with incomplete gameplay coverage and experimental online play.
MIT license.

name: Rex: SkoolKit disassembly of both ZX Spectrum game sides
description_en: skRex presents disassemblies of both sides of the ZX Spectrum game Rex. The repository stores Side A and Side B SkoolKit source and reference files, and documents rendering the development version to HTML with skool2html.py.
description_zh: skRex 收录 ZX Spectrum 游戏 Rex 的 Side A 与 Side B 反汇编，仓库保存 SkoolKit 源文件及参考文件，并说明如何用 skool2html.py 将开发版本生成 HTML。
requirements: A development version of SkoolKit to render the disassembly as HTML.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Rock Band 3: agent-assisted Xbox 360 matching decompilation
description_en: rb3-xenon reconstructs Rock Band 3 Xbox 360 code in C++ and compares compiler output with the retail executable function by function. It uses the original MSVC Xbox 360 toolchain and extensive game-specific analysis and workflow code; the author reports 98.9% of game-code functions byte matched.
description_zh: rb3-xenon 以 C++ 重建 Xbox 360 版 Rock Band 3 代码，逐函数将编译输出与零售版可执行文件比较。项目使用原版 MSVC Xbox 360 工具链，并包含大量针对游戏的分析和工作流代码；作者报告游戏代码函数中有 98.9% 实现逐字节匹配。
requirements: Own copy of Rock Band 3 and the original Xbox 360 MSVC toolchain for matching builds.
The author reports 98.9% of game-code functions byte matched; the project remains incomplete.

name: Sonic the Fighters (PC): a ReXGlue native port
description_en: Sonic the Fighters (PC) uses a game-specific ReXGlue manifest to translate the player's XBLA default.xex from PowerPC instructions into C++ and build a native PC or Linux program. The author describes the current port as single player and controller driven.
description_zh: Sonic the Fighters (PC) 使用游戏专用 ReXGlue 清单，从玩家的 XBLA 版 default.xex 将 PowerPC 指令转换为 C++，构建 PC 或 Linux 原生程序。作者称当前移植版仅支持单人游玩，并需要控制器。
requirements: Provide a legal Sonic the Fighters XBLA copy and unpack it into _unpacked/.
Build with ReXGlue SDK; the project expects the SDK in an adjacent directory.
A connected controller is required; online play is unavailable.
No licence file in the repository.

name: payne-recomp: a native recompilation of Max Payne for Xbox
description_en: payne-recomp translates the PAL Xbox release of Max Payne into C on the user's machine and builds native Windows or Apple Silicon programs against DirectXbox-Recomp. Game-specific seeds, symbols and overrides accompany the build; the author reports that all 67 levels load in short scripted checks.
description_zh: payne-recomp 在用户设备上把 PAL 版 Xbox Max Payne 转换为 C，并借助 DirectXbox-Recomp 构建 Windows 或 Apple Silicon 原生程序。仓库提供游戏专用的函数种子、符号和替换代码；作者报告全部 67 关均通过短时脚本加载检查。
requirements: A user-supplied extracted PAL Xbox copy of Max Payne is required.
Windows 10/11 x64 or an Apple Silicon Mac, CMake 3.20+, Git and Python 3.10+ with capstone are required.
The author has not checked full level completion, save loading or credits on the current build.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Ozymandias: a Godot engine reconstruction for Pharaoh and Zeus
description_en: Ozymandias recreates the engine of the city-building games Pharaoh, Zeus and related titles in Godot 3.6 Mono. Its project tree contains game-system scripts, scenes and interface code that use files from an original game installation. The author describes the current implementation as early, with basic structure and menu logic.
description_zh: Ozymandias 使用 Godot 3.6 Mono 重建《Pharaoh》《Zeus》等城市建设游戏的引擎。仓库包含读取原版文件的游戏系统脚本、场景和界面代码。作者称项目仍处早期阶段，目前主要具备基础结构与菜单逻辑。
requirements: Original game files are required to build and play.
Godot 3.6 Mono/.NET is required for the current project.
The current implementation has basic structure and menu logic only.
No project-level licence file is listed.

name: VerilogBoy: reconstructing Game Boy hardware in Verilog
description_en: VerilogBoy reconstructs a Game Boy-compatible console as Verilog RTL for the Pano Logic G1 FPGA device. Its modules implement the SM83 CPU, pixel processing, audio, DMA, and timers, while CPU notes and test results document the behavior used to guide the implementation.
description_zh: VerilogBoy 以 Verilog RTL 重建兼容 Game Boy 的主机，目标设备为 Pano Logic G1 FPGA。模块涵盖 SM83 CPU、图像处理、音频、DMA 和计时器；CPU 笔记及测试结果记录了实现所依据的行为。
requirements: A Pano Logic G1 device for the supported hardware target.
The project is still being refactored; its PPU differs from the original pipeline and accuracy improvements remain planned.
Open Hardware Description License 1.0.

name: The Urbz: Sims in the City: GameCube matching decompilation
description_en: The Urbz: Sims in the City GameCube decompilation reconstructs game code for the GUBE69 release. Its decomp.wtf and decomp-toolkit workflow configures a main.dol rebuild, compares the result byte for byte with the user's copy, and uses objdiff to inspect function progress. The repository includes game-specific C sources, symbols, and split configuration.
description_zh: The Urbz: Sims in the City 的 GameCube 反编译针对 GUBE69 版本重建游戏代码。项目使用 decomp.wtf 与 decomp-toolkit 配置 main.dol 构建，与用户的原版逐字节比较，并用 objdiff 查看函数进度；仓库包含游戏专属 C 源码、符号和拆分配置。
requirements: A personal copy of the game in orig/GUBE69/ is required.
Python and Ninja are used to configure and build; the README names CodeWarrior GC/1.3.2 as the compiler.

name: OpenMU: a reconstructed MU Online server and packet reference
description_en: OpenMU reconstructs a MU Online server from scratch, focusing on the Season 6 Episode 3 English client protocol. Its C# implementation is accompanied by packet references that map identifiers, byte fields, send conditions and effects on the game client.
description_zh: OpenMU 从零重建 MU Online 服务器，重点支持 Season 6 Episode 3 客户端使用的英文协议。其 C# 实现配有数据包参考资料，记录消息标识、字节字段、发送条件及对游戏客户端的影响。
requirements: A compatible MU Online client is needed to connect to the server.
The project focuses on Season 6 Episode 3 using the English protocol and remains under development.
MIT licence.

name: The Hobbit: a SkoolKit disassembly of the ZX Spectrum game
description_en: The Hobbit documents a disassembly of the ZX Spectrum game in SkoolKit source files. The repository includes annotations and scripts that generate browsable hexadecimal or decimal disassembly pages.
description_zh: The Hobbit 使用 SkoolKit 源文件记录 ZX Spectrum 游戏《The Hobbit》的反汇编。仓库含注释和脚本，可生成按十六进制或十进制显示的网页版本。
requirements: SkoolKit or a SkoolKit checkout is required to generate the development HTML pages.
The author states that an original game copy is needed to disassemble its code.
No licence file in the repository.

name: UNO!: a Game Boy Color disassembly
description_en: UNO! reconstructs the Game Boy Color game's ROM as assembly source. Its RGBDS Makefile assembles the source, links a ROM and offers an MD5 comparison against the recorded target hash.
description_zh: UNO! 将 Game Boy Color 游戏 ROM 重建为汇编源码。RGBDS Makefile 汇编并链接生成 ROM，还提供与记录的目标哈希进行 MD5 比较的命令。
requirements: Install RGBDS and the platform-specific build tools described in INSTALL.md.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Another World JS: a browser port interpreting the game's bytecode
description_en: Another World JS ports Another World to an HTML5 browser runtime by implementing its 26 game bytecode opcodes in JavaScript. Extraction scripts convert original DOS and 15th anniversary data files into JavaScript input; the port adds palette switching, alternate resolutions and rewind.
description_zh: Another World JS 通过在 JavaScript 中实现 26 条游戏字节码指令，将 Another World 移植到 HTML5 浏览器环境。配套脚本把原版 DOS 或十五周年版数据转换为 JavaScript 输入，并加入调色板切换、分辨率选择和回退功能。
requirements: Original Another World data files must be extracted and converted with the provided scripts.
Music and sound playback and 15th anniversary background transparency are absent.
No licence file in the repository.

name: OpenBarnyard: decompiling Barnyard and the TOSHI 2.0 engine
description_en: OpenBarnyard reconstructs C++ source for the Windows game Barnyard and its TOSHI 2.0 engine. The repository contains game and engine source, progress tooling and Windows project generation scripts.
description_zh: OpenBarnyard 重建 Windows 游戏《Barnyard》及其 TOSHI 2.0 引擎的 C++ 源代码。仓库包含游戏与引擎代码、进度工具和 Windows 项目生成脚本。
requirements: Windows builds require Visual Studio 2026 and initialized submodules.
The repository's License.md supplies project-specific terms for the decompilation.

name: DirkSimple: reconstructing Dragon's Lair and Cliff Hanger game logic
description_en: DirkSimple reconstructs Dragon's Lair and Cliff Hanger laserdisc game logic in Lua, playing user-supplied original footage through a C FMV runtime. It accepts Ogg Theora video with matching timing and can be built as a standalone SDL player or a libretro core.
description_zh: DirkSimple 用 Lua 重建 Dragon's Lair 和 Cliff Hanger 的激光影碟游戏逻辑，由 C 语言 FMV 运行层播放用户提供的原版影像。输入需为时序匹配的 Ogg Theora 视频，可构建为独立 SDL 播放器或 libretro 核心。
requirements: Original game footage converted to a correctly timed Ogg Theora file is required.
CMake and SDL2 development libraries are required for the standalone build.
Other FMV games beyond Dragon's Lair and Cliff Hanger are not implemented.
Zlib license.

name: Professor Layton: Lost Future HD Vita: an Android executable port
description_en: Professor Layton: Lost Future HD Vita runs the Android ARMv7 game executables on PS Vita by loading them into memory, resolving imports with native functions and applying patches. The user supplies the Android APK and OBB files.
description_zh: Professor Layton: Lost Future HD Vita 将游戏的 Android ARMv7 可执行文件加载到 PS Vita 内存，使用本机函数解析导入并应用补丁。用户需自备 Android APK 和 OBB 文件。
requirements: Supply an Android game version that uses an OBB file; v1.0.1 was tested.
PS Vita setup requires kubridge and libshacccg.suprx; install FdFix unless using the rePatch plugin.
The loader build requires vitasdk with softfp and the listed Vita libraries.
MIT licensed.

name: OMK: reconstructing the Omikron game engine
description_en: OMK reimplements the engine of Omikron: The Nomad Soul in C++20 using files from a user's game copy. Its documentation records asset formats, the script VM and game state, while the engine covers opening sequences, city exploration, menus and combat; the author reports that a cold-start event trace matches all 42 recorded original events.
description_zh: OMK 用 C++20 重建 Omikron: The Nomad Soul 的引擎，读取用户自有游戏副本的数据。文档记录资源格式、脚本虚拟机和游戏状态；引擎覆盖开场、城市探索、菜单与战斗。作者报告冷启动事件轨迹与原版记录的 42 个事件全部对应。
requirements: Provide data files from your own copy of Omikron: The Nomad Soul.
Build the C++20 engine with make.
The game is unfinished; the author says more behavior has been measured than played through.
GPL-3.0-or-later license for the engine code.

name: ReStuff: recompiling Naughty Bear Gold Edition
description_en: ReStuff statically recompiles the Xbox 360 game Naughty Bear Gold Edition using the ReXGlue SDK. Its host code includes Vulkan rendering, guest D3D hooks, texture decoding and shader translation, while diagnostic scripts and reports track game-specific boot and graphics behavior.
description_zh: ReStuff 使用 ReXGlue SDK 对 Xbox 360 游戏《Naughty Bear Gold Edition》进行静态重编译。宿主端代码包含 Vulkan 渲染、游戏 D3D 调用钩子、纹理解码及着色器翻译，另有脚本和报告记录启动与图形问题。
requirements: A user's own Naughty Bear Gold Edition ISO is required for installation through the documented launcher.
Building uses the ReXGlue SDK.
No licence file in the repository.

name: HALBERD: a PC port of Kirby 64
description_en: HALBERD ports the Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards decompilation to PC with libultraship for rendering and input, and Torch for extracting resources from the user's N64 ROM. Its own platform code supplies libultra shims and runtime bridges; the author reports working menus and level loading.
description_zh: HALBERD 将《Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards》的反编译代码移植到 PC，使用 libultraship 处理渲染和输入、Torch 从用户的 N64 ROM 提取资源。项目的平台层提供 libultra 适配和运行时接口；作者报告菜单及关卡加载已可运行。
requirements: A legally owned US Kirby 64 ROM matching the documented SHA-1 is required.
The documented build runs on Linux or Windows through WSL2 and fetches the decompilation, libultraship and Torch dependencies.
Player spawning, in-level rendering and audio remain in development.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Arcanum Community Edition: rebuilding Arcanum for modern systems
description_en: Arcanum Community Edition rebuilds Arcanum as a replacement executable for modern operating systems while using data from the player's game installation. Its C source covers game and engine modules, with named APIs and annotations in some areas and unresolved names in others.
description_zh: Arcanum Community Edition 将《奥秘》重建为可在现代系统运行、读取玩家原版游戏数据的替代程序。其 C 源码覆盖游戏和引擎模块；部分 API 已命名并加注释，另一些仍保留难以辨认的名称。
requirements: A purchased Arcanum installation and its game data files are required.
The project is labeled a beta; the author reports testing a speedrun rather than every game path.
Android and iOS versions lack touch controls and are not intended for players.
Sustainable Use License 1.0.

name: Erupe: reconstructing Monster Hunter Frontier online services
description_en: Erupe reconstructs Monster Hunter Frontier's online server in Go, providing sign-in, entrance and channel services for game clients. Its code handles game messages and quest data, and an accompanying TCP observer decrypts and records position-bearing packets for protocol work.
description_zh: Erupe 用 Go 重建《怪物猎人 Frontier》的在线服务端，提供登录、入口和频道服务。代码处理游戏消息与任务数据，附带的 TCP 观察工具会解密并记录含位置信息的数据包，供协议分析使用。
requirements: A Monster Hunter Frontier client is required; the README recommends G10 or later.
Go 1.25 or later and PostgreSQL are required to build and host the server.
Quest and scenario files must be supplied separately for quests to load.
MIT License.

name: T.O.R.E-Fighters: rebuilding Jane's Fighters Anthology in Rust
description_en: T.O.R.E-Fighters rebuilds Jane's Fighters Anthology in Rust around observed player-visible behavior. It imports resources from the player's retail copy, implements flight and quick missions, and documents original formats, feature coverage and approximations where behavior remains uncertain.
description_zh: T.O.R.E-Fighters 根据玩家可见行为，以 Rust 重建《Jane's Fighters Anthology》。它从玩家自备的零售版导入资源，实现飞行和快速任务，并记录原版格式、功能覆盖情况及尚未确定行为的近似实现。
requirements: A retail copy of Jane's Fighters Anthology, installed or on disc 1, is required.
A mounted folder is required for an ISO image; the program does not read the image directly.
Some behavior uses documented approximations and missions and campaigns remain planned.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Tokyo Jungle Recompiled: a PS3 static recompilation bring-up
description_en: Tokyo Jungle Recompiled translates the PS3 game's PowerPC executable into native PC code with ps3recomp and supplies game-specific loading, import and runtime glue. Its investigation documents PPU functions, SPU workloads, asset loading and a main-loop wait that currently blocks geometry rendering.
description_zh: Tokyo Jungle Recompiled 使用 ps3recomp 将 PS3 游戏的 PowerPC 可执行文件转换为 PC 原生代码，并提供游戏专用的加载、导入解析和运行时衔接代码。调查记录涵盖 PPU 函数、SPU 工作负载、资源加载，以及目前阻止几何图形绘制的主循环等待问题。
requirements: The user's own Tokyo Jungle game files and the ps3recomp toolchain.
The current port reaches a D3D12 window and clear frame but has no geometry, host audio output or input support.
MIT License.

name: rushrecomp: static recompilation and analysis of Sonic Rush
description_en: rushrecomp translates Sonic Rush's Nintendo DS ARM9 and ARM7 code to C ahead of time with ndsrecomp and maintains a parallel manual x86-32 path based on decompiled subsystems. Its notes map ROM functions and hardware accesses, while the manual path records partial function coverage and unresolved stubs.
description_zh: rushrecomp 使用 ndsrecomp 预先将 Nintendo DS《Sonic Rush》的 ARM9 和 ARM7 代码转换为 C，同时维护基于已反编译子系统的手工 x86-32 路线。项目笔记记录 ROM 函数和硬件访问；手工路线仍有部分函数未覆盖、存根尚待实现。
requirements: Supply your own Sonic Rush USA Nintendo DS ROM.
Requires built nds_recompile and nds_runner tools; the documented function-finder patch is required before generation.
The manual reconstruction has incomplete function coverage and unresolved stubs.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Champions: Return to Arms: byte-matched PS2 function reconstruction
description_en: Champions: Return to Arms reconstructs independently authored C++ for the US v2.00 PlayStation 2 game, checking complete functions against the original executable byte by byte. The author reports eight matching functions covering 64 bytes; the repository includes a function ledger, verifier and sanitized comparison receipt.
description_zh: Champions: Return to Arms 项目为美版 v2.00 PlayStation 2 游戏独立编写 C++ 源码，并将完整函数与原版可执行文件逐字节比较。作者报告已有八个匹配函数、共 64 字节；仓库包含函数台账、验证工具和去除原始字节的比对记录。
requirements: Python 3.10+ is required for metadata checks and the synthetic test suite.
A user-owned SLUS_209.73 executable and MIPS-capable Clang are required for a fresh byte comparison.
The reconstruction covers eight complete functions and has no complete linked PS2 executable or playable game.
MIT license applies to the authored code and documentation.

name: Fallout: New Vegas: a work-in-progress decompilation
description_en: Fallout: New Vegas is being reconstructed from the USA 2010-11-10 Fallout_Release_MemDebug.xex in a work-in-progress decompilation. The project builds source with Python and Ninja and configures objdiff to compare rebuilt objects with the original.
description_zh: 该项目针对《Fallout: New Vegas》美版 2010-11-10 的 Fallout_Release_MemDebug.xex 重建源码。使用 Python 和 Ninja 构建，并通过 objdiff 对比重建的目标文件与原版。
requirements: An existing copy of the supported game XEX is required in orig/425307E0.
Python and Ninja are required; objdiff is used for diffing.
Decompilation is in progress.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: Tokimeki Memorial: Forever With You: a PS1 decompilation in progress
description_en: tokimemo is a work-in-progress reconstruction of Tokimeki Memorial: Forever With You for PlayStation version 1.1. It records executable segments and symbol addresses in a PS1 splat configuration, with assembly source and a Makefile for rebuilding the target executable.
description_zh: tokimemo 正在重建 PlayStation 版 Tokimeki Memorial: Forever With You 1.1。项目在 PS1 splat 配置中记录可执行文件分段和符号地址，并提供汇编源码及用于重建目标程序的 Makefile。
requirements: The target PlayStation version 1.1 executable for the configured build.
The decompilation is a work in progress.

name: Tekken 6 Recomp: an Xbox 360 static recompilation
description_en: Tekken 6 Recomp generates native code from the Xbox 360 release of Tekken 6 using a patched ReXGlue SDK. It provides a game manifest, host code and runtime compatibility patches, with build paths for Windows and macOS. Its builders extract the user's own game image before code generation.
description_zh: Tekken 6 Recomp 使用经过补丁修改的 ReXGlue SDK，从 Xbox 360 版 Tekken 6 生成原生代码。项目提供游戏配置、宿主代码及运行时兼容补丁，并记录 Windows 与 macOS 构建流程。构建器先从用户自有的游戏镜像提取输入。
requirements: A user-provided Xbox 360 Tekken 6 XEX or supported USA/Europe Rev 1 ISO.
Windows builds use LLVM-MinGW; macOS builds require the stated Apple Silicon or Intel macOS versions.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Dungeon Keeper Remake: a C++ engine for the original game data
description_en: Dungeon Keeper Remake is a C++ remake of Dungeon Keeper being developed with DirectX 11 and XAudio2 for use with the original game installation. The project uses RNC decompression for compressed assets and a Smacker decoder for game videos.
description_zh: Dungeon Keeper Remake 是使用 C++、DirectX 11 和 XAudio2 开发的《Dungeon Keeper》重制项目，计划与原版游戏安装目录配合使用。项目使用 RNC 解压游戏资源，并用 Smacker 解码器处理游戏视频。
requirements: An original Dungeon Keeper installation.
Windows 10 SDK and Visual Studio 2017 to compile.
No licence file in the repository.

name: BrightEyes: recreating Realms of Arkania games
description_en: BrightEyes reverse engineers MS-DOS-era games and aims to recreate them for modern platforms. It began with Realms of Arkania: Blade of Destiny, and the repository contains C, C++, assembly and build files.
description_zh: BrightEyes 对 MS-DOS 时代的游戏进行逆向研究，目标是重建可在现代平台使用的版本。项目始于《Realms of Arkania: Blade of Destiny》，仓库包含 C、C++、汇编及构建文件。
requirements: GPL-3.0 license.

name: Demon's Souls PC: a PS3 static recompilation for Windows
description_en: Demon's Souls PC ports the North American PS3 release of Demon's Souls to Windows x64 by lifting PowerPC and SPU code to C and linking it with replacements for PS3 system libraries. It uses Direct3D 12, WASAPI and a .NET launcher; the author reports booting through Boletarian Palace 1-1 on one reference machine.
description_zh: Demon's Souls PC 将北美版 PS3《Demon's Souls》的 PowerPC 和 SPU 代码预先转换为 C，编译并链接独立重新实现的 PS3 系统库，生成 Windows x64 原生程序。图形使用 Direct3D 12，音频使用 WASAPI，并配有 .NET 启动器；作者报告在一台参考机器上运行至 Boletarian Palace 1-1。
requirements: Windows 10/11 x64 and a GPU supporting D3D12 feature level 12.0 or higher.
Supply the PS3 North America BLUS30443 game files and a decrypted EBOOT.ELF from your own copy.
The alpha prototype was validated on one reference machine; later areas and online play remain unsupported or untested.
MIT license.

name: Final Fantasy Dimensions Vita: rehosting the Android game on PS Vita
description_en: Final Fantasy Dimensions Vita runs the Android release of Final Fantasy Dimensions on PS Vita by loading its ARMv6 executable into memory. The loader resolves Android imports with native functions and applies patches; the player supplies the game's APK and OBB data.
description_zh: Final Fantasy Dimensions Vita 在 PS Vita 内存中装载《Final Fantasy Dimensions》Android 版的 ARMv6 程序，以原生函数处理导入项并应用补丁。玩家需自行提供 APK 和 OBB 游戏数据。
requirements: A PS Vita with kubridge and libshacccg.suprx is required; install FdFix unless using rePatch.
A legally obtained Android Final Fantasy Dimensions APK and OBB are required; the author reports testing with game version 1.1.3.
Source builds require a softfp VitaSDK and the listed graphics and audio libraries.
MIT license.

name: Shinobi Legions: Saturn code analysis and PC port
description_en: Reconstructs Shinobi Legions for PC from analysis of its Sega Saturn SH-2 code and disc formats. A C11 and SDL2 port rewrites game functions while retaining the original memory layout; the author reports that the title, 18 stages, bosses, and ending run using files extracted from the user's disc.
description_zh: 基于 Sega Saturn 的 SH-2 代码及光盘格式分析，将《Shinobi Legions》重建为 PC 游戏。C11 与 SDL2 移植版逐函数改写游戏逻辑并保留原内存布局；作者报告标题画面、18 个关卡、首领及结局均可运行，游戏文件从用户光盘提取。
requirements: Requires the user's Shinobi Legions USA disc image for game files.
The PC build requires a C11 GCC toolchain, CMake 3.16+, and SDL2 2.0.18+; MSVC is unsupported.
No licence file in the repository.

name: WHITE ALBUM2: a shared engine migration from static recompilation
description_en: The WHITE ALBUM2 port shares game logic between Windows x64 and Android ARM64 while migrating from a hybrid static recompilation to a native C++ compatibility engine. Current native components handle save flags, script behavior and resource processing; the delivered shared-aot build still uses recompiled functions. Original PAK files remain external.
description_zh: WHITE ALBUM2 移植项目在 Windows x64 与 Android ARM64 间共用游戏逻辑，并将静态重编译与原生子系统混合实现逐步迁移到 C++ 兼容引擎。现有原生组件处理存档标志、脚本行为和资源流程；已交付的 shared-aot 版本仍使用重编译函数。原版 PAK 文件由用户另行提供。
requirements: Authorized original game resources and private cached inputs are required for a full-game build.
The native engine migration is incomplete; the current shared-aot release retains recompiled functions and original address state.
The project MIT license covers newly written project code and documentation; third-party and game-derived inputs have separate terms.

name: JSettlers: a Java remake of The Settlers III
description_en: JSettlers recreates The Settlers III as a Java game for Windows, Linux and Android. Its own engine and game code use GFX and SND files from an original or demo installation, with MAP files optional. The author describes the project as alpha software.
description_zh: JSettlers 使用 Java 重建 The Settlers III，可在 Windows、Linux 和 Android 上运行。其引擎和游戏代码读取原版或演示版的 GFX、SND 文件，MAP 文件可选。作者将当前版本标为 alpha。
requirements: Supply the GFX and SND folders from The Settlers III or its demo; MAP is optional.
The desktop version requires Java 11 or newer.
Alpha status includes bugs, save incompatibilities after changes and server failures; macOS support is broken.
MIT license.

name: Street Fighter II Recompiled: a CPS1 static recompilation
description_en: Street Fighter II Recompiled translates the CPS1 arcade game's Motorola 68000 code into C using ROM analysis, Capstone disassembly and a project-specific generator. Its native build links to a sibling CPS1 runtime for video, audio and input; the author reports reaching the character-select screen.
description_zh: Street Fighter II Recompiled 对 CPS1 街机版 ROM 进行分析，借助 Capstone 反汇编和专用生成器将 Motorola 68000 代码转为 C。原生构建依赖同级的 CPS1 运行时处理画面、声音和输入；作者报告已运行至角色选择画面。
requirements: The user's Street Fighter II ROM and the sibling cps1recomp runtime are required.
Windows 11, CMake 3.16 or newer, SDL2, Visual Studio 2022 and Python 3.8 or newer with Capstone are listed for building.
The author reports reaching the character-select screen; character portraits remain in progress.
MIT license.

name: World of Kartcraft: porting Crash Team Racing physics into WoW
description_en: World of Kartcraft ports Crash Team Racing's driving model, read from a decompilation, into a Rust World of Warcraft 1.12.1 client. It recreates kart handling, powerslides and boosts in Azeroth while setup extracts kart data from the user's CTR disc and reads a separate WoW installation. The project documents the physics port and the resulting multiplayer kart systems.
description_zh: World of Kartcraft 将从《古惑狼赛车》反编译成果整理出的驾驶模型移植进 Rust 版《魔兽世界》1.12.1 客户端，在艾泽拉斯实现卡丁车操控、漂移和加速。安装流程从用户的 CTR 光盘提取车辆数据，并读取独立的 WoW 安装；项目也记录了物理移植和多人卡丁车系统。
requirements: Supply an English World of Warcraft 1.12.1 build 5875 installation and a US Crash Team Racing PlayStation disc image.
The documented source setup uses Windows or Linux, Docker and about 20 GB of free space.
The project describes rough edges in its current state.
The Rust workspace declares MIT or Apache-2.0; the repository also contains GPL-3.0 and separate cosmetic-art terms.

name: tkdr-recomp: a PSP static recompilation of Tekken: Dark Resurrection
description_en: tkdr-recomp runs the PSP release of Tekken: Dark Resurrection by translating its MIPS executable ahead of time to C for native builds or WebAssembly in the browser. A custom runtime supplies PSP library calls, scheduling, graphics, audio, and input. The author reports working boot, menus, movies, saves, and full matches, with Quick Battle explored from boot.
description_zh: tkdr-recomp 将 PSP 版《Tekken: Dark Resurrection》的 MIPS 可执行文件预先转换为 C，以构建原生程序；浏览器版本则在浏览器内将其转换为 WebAssembly。自制运行时提供 PSP 库调用、调度、图形、音频和输入功能。作者报告游戏可启动，菜单、影片、存档及完整对战可用，并已从启动流程测试 Quick Battle。
requirements: Supply your own ULUS-10139 USA v1.00 UMD dump as ISO or CSO and its decrypted EBOOT.
Native builds require macOS or Linux, Python 3, CMake, Ninja, a C/C++ compiler, and SDL2; browser builds require Emscripten.
A recent browser with WebGL 2 is required for browser play.
SAS reverb and ad-hoc multiplayer are missing; other modes are less explored.
Project code is MIT; included third-party components retain their own licences.

name: DishSoap: an Android port of The Dishwasher: Dead Samurai
description_en: DishSoap ports the Xbox 360 game The Dishwasher: Dead Samurai to Android using managed code decompiled locally from the owner's game copy. Repository code provides MonoGame platform shims, an on-device content importer, audio decoding, controls and save support; building from source also requires manual XNA-to-MonoGame edits.
description_zh: DishSoap 将 Xbox 360 游戏《The Dishwasher: Dead Samurai》移植到 Android，游戏托管代码由用户从自有副本本地反编译。仓库提供 MonoGame 平台适配、设备端内容导入、音频解码、操作和存档代码；源码构建还需手工完成 XNA 到 MonoGame 的修改。
requirements: An arm64-v8a Android device running Android 5.0 or newer and the user's game data are required to play.
Source builds require a local decompilation of game.exe with ilspycmd 9.1.0.7988 and manual porting edits.
The repository's MIT license applies to its original code, scripts, documentation and artwork.
The port is arm64-v8a only.

name: Wanted: Monty Mole: a ZX Spectrum disassembly
description_en: monty is a SkoolKit disassembly of the 1984 ZX Spectrum game Wanted: Monty Mole. The repository includes separate skool sources for the game and loader, plus control files and a build script.
description_zh: monty 是 1984 年 ZX Spectrum 游戏《Wanted: Monty Mole》的 SkoolKit 反汇编，仓库分别保存游戏和加载器的 skool 源文件，以及控制文件和构建脚本。
requirements: No licence file in the repository.

name: Biohazard Outbreak decomp: matching PS2 game reconstruction
description_en: Biohazard Outbreak decomp reconstructs C for the Japanese PS2 releases of Biohazard Outbreak and File 2, checking locally rebuilt executables and overlays against the originals. Its extraction, survey and function-comparison tools operate on user-supplied discs; the author reports 238 byte-matching File 1 functions, while File 2 C decompilation has not started.
description_zh: Biohazard Outbreak decomp 为日版 PS2《Biohazard Outbreak》及《File 2》重建 C 代码，并将本地构建的可执行文件和覆盖模块与原版逐字节比较。提取、调查和函数比对工具使用用户自备光盘；作者报告 File 1 已有 238 个字节匹配的函数，File 2 的 C 反编译尚未开始。
requirements: Own Japanese PS2 disc images for the supported releases; the optional English targets use patched images.
Build on Linux or WSL2 with Python, MIPS binutils, the project dependencies and locally obtained Metrowerks compilers.
File 2 C decompilation has not started; 77 written File 1 functions remain nonmatching.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: Extreme-G 2: functional N64 decompilation
description_en: Reconstructs Extreme-G 2 for Nintendo 64 as C and assembly using IDO 7.1, aiming for functional equivalence rather than a byte-identical C rebuild. The author's notes report byte-exact boot assembly sections; linking and checking the main decompressed code remain pending.
description_zh: 使用 IDO 7.1 将 N64 游戏《Extreme-G 2》重建为 C 和汇编代码，目标是功能等效，而非使 C 代码的构建结果逐字节一致。作者的笔记报告启动汇编段已做到字节一致；解压后的主程序代码仍需链接脚本，链接和比对尚未完成。
requirements: Uses IDO 7.1, MIPS binutils, and Python 3.
The C reconstruction targets functional equivalence; the main decompressed code still needs a linker script.

name: nfsmw-nx: statically recompiling Need for Speed: Most Wanted for Switch
description_en: nfsmw-nx ports the Xbox 360 release of Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005) to Nintendo Switch through static recompilation. ReXGlue translates the game's PowerPC default.xex to C++, while a Switch runtime supplies console services and a Vulkan renderer on NVK draws its graphics. Installation derives shaders and game data from the player's own disc.
description_zh: nfsmw-nx 通过静态重编译将 Xbox 360 版 Need for Speed: Most Wanted（2005）移植到 Nintendo Switch。ReXGlue 把游戏的 PowerPC default.xex 转为 C++，Switch 运行时提供主机服务，NVK 上的 Vulkan 渲染器负责画面；安装时从玩家自己的光盘生成着色器并取得游戏数据。
requirements: An owned Xbox 360 game disc image or extracted disc containing default.xex.
Nintendo Switch homebrew launch with a game override or a forwarder using a 39-bit address space; Album applet mode lacks enough memory.
The author reports first-race shader pipeline compilation can cause brief stutter.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: swos-port: a DOS Sensible World of Soccer port with recorded behaviour checks
description_en: swos-port adapts the DOS Sensible World of Soccer 96/97 to C++ and SDL. It combines generated translations of original assembly routines with rewritten systems and compares port state frame by frame against recordings from the DOS game.
description_zh: swos-port 将 DOS 版《Sensible World of Soccer 96/97》移植到 C++ 与 SDL。工程结合原版汇编例程的自动转换结果和逐步重写的系统，并按帧比较移植版与 DOS 游戏录制状态。
requirements: A legally obtained SWOS copy for normal development builds.
Visual Studio 2022 and Python 3.8 or newer for the documented Windows build.
The port remains under development, with some routines still mechanically generated.
No licence file in the repository.

name: lastwar-client: reconstructing Last War's network layer
description_en: lastwar-client reconstructs the network layer of the mobile game Last War: Survival Game in Go. Based on APK analysis and captured traffic, it implements GSL RSA/AES bootstrap, SFS2X framing and the SFSObject binary codec, and publishes a dossier of commands, fields and live observations.
description_zh: lastwar-client 用 Go 重建手游《Last War: Survival Game》的网络层。项目结合 APK 分析和流量捕获，实现 GSL RSA/AES 启动流程、SFS2X 帧处理及 SFSObject 二进制编解码，并发布命令、字段和实际连接观察记录。
requirements: Requires Go 1.27.3 as declared in go.mod.
Reconnecting an established account needs session values from that account's own client login.
Some command paths are documented from static analysis and remain unconfirmed against the live service.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: EOO: a Nintendo DS Wii-connection utility decompilation
description_en: EOO reconstructs the Nintendo DS Wii connection utility stored in Pokémon Diamond and Pearl. Its ARM7 and ARM9 assembly and C sources build an NDS image identified by SHA-1. Contributor guidance describes replacing extracted assembly with C that compiles to the same instructions.
description_zh: EOO 重建《宝可梦 钻石／珍珠》内置的 Nintendo DS Wii 连接工具。仓库中的 ARM7、ARM9 汇编和 C 源码用于生成带有 SHA-1 标识的 NDS 镜像；贡献文档说明如何用可编译为相同指令的 C 代码替换提取的汇编。
requirements: The build requires the relevant Metrowerks ARM compiler and Nitro SDK.
Linux builds require ARM binutils, Wine and development packages.
The project is converting extracted ARM assembly to matching C.
No project-level licence file is shown; tools/scaninc has its own LICENSE file.

name: gta1_re: reconstructing Grand Theft Auto's executable
description_en: gta1_re reconstructs Grand Theft Auto's game code in C++ and configures comparison with a specified Grand Theft Auto.exe. The source labels functions and globals with original addresses, while CMake offers a matching build and an SDL3 graphics option.
description_zh: gta1_re 用 C++ 重建 Grand Theft Auto 游戏代码，并配置与指定 Grand Theft Auto.exe 的比较。源码标注原程序中函数和全局变量的地址；CMake 提供匹配构建及 SDL3 图形选项。
requirements: A Grand Theft Auto.exe matching the configured SHA-256 is the comparison target.
The matching build requires the specified MSVC compiler range.
The source defines a breakpoint-and-abort macro for unimplemented paths.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Super Mario Bros. Deluxe: partial exact-match disassembly
description_en: Reconstructs banks of the US version 1.1 Super Mario Bros. Deluxe ROM as WLA DX assembly. The author reports exact matches for the listed code and level-data banks and selected graphics banks, apart from the calculated checksum; other graphics banks and some pointer formats remain unresolved.
description_zh: 将《Super Mario Bros. Deluxe》美版 1.1 的部分 ROM 存储区重建为 WLA DX 汇编。作者报告列出的代码存储区、关卡数据存储区及部分图形存储区可精确匹配，自动计算的校验和除外；其余图形存储区及部分指针格式尚待厘清。
requirements: Requires WLA DX and a vanilla Super Mario Bros. Deluxe ROM from which to extract graphics and tilemap data.
The listed banks match except for the calculated checksum; several graphics banks and music-data pointers remain unresolved.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Luigi's Mansion (3DS): partial ARM source reconstruction
description_en: Luigi's Mansion (3DS) Decompilation recovers C source from the Nintendo 3DS release, with implemented formatter, startup, runtime and game-state functions. Its tools extract a user-provided decrypted dump, generate ARM disassembly and run headless Ghidra analysis; the main game entry remains unfinished.
description_zh: Luigi's Mansion (3DS) Decompilation 从 Nintendo 3DS 版本恢复 C 源码，已实现格式化、启动、运行时及游戏状态相关函数。工具可提取用户自备的解密转储、生成 ARM 反汇编并以无界面模式运行 Ghidra；游戏主入口仍待完成。
requirements: Python 3.10+, ctrtool and a personally dumped, decrypted game copy are required for extraction.
Ghidra with ARM:LE:32:v6 is recommended for analysis.
Decimal floating-point formatting, some system calls and the main game entry remain incomplete or stubbed.
MIT license applies to the decompiled source.

name: Turok 3: an archived multi-version decompilation
description_en: turok3 preserves a Turok 3 decompilation covering several dated builds and the US and EU Nintendo 64 releases. Its workflow extracts code and assets from a user-supplied ROM, builds a selected version and checks the result. The author has ended maintenance.
description_zh: turok3 保存了《Turok 3》的反编译工程，涵盖数个按日期标识的构建版本，以及 Nintendo 64 美版和欧版。其流程从用户自备的 ROM 提取代码与资源，构建指定版本并检查结果。作者已停止维护该项目。
requirements: A supported Turok 3 ROM supplied by the user.
Linux build requirements include git, build-essential, binutils-mips-linux-gnu and Python 3.
The author no longer maintains the project.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Trashman: a SkoolKit disassembly of the ZX Spectrum game
description_en: Trashman documents a disassembly of the ZX Spectrum game using SkoolKit. The repository contains SkoolKit source and scripts for generating browsable hexadecimal or decimal HTML listings.
description_zh: Trashman 使用 SkoolKit 整理 ZX Spectrum 游戏《Trashman》的反汇编结果。仓库包含 SkoolKit 源文件，以及生成十六进制或十进制 HTML 浏览页面的脚本。
requirements: SkoolKit, or a SkoolKit checkout configured through SKOOLKIT_HOME, is needed to build the development HTML pages.
An original copy of Trashman is needed to disassemble its code.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Summoner 2: matching PlayStation 2 decompilation
description_en: Reconstructs the PlayStation 2 version of Summoner 2 as C++ source that is compared with the original executable. Splat separates executable units, objdiff checks functions, and the build links matched units from source while rejecting byte differences.
description_zh: 将 PlayStation 2 版《Summoner 2》重建为 C++ 源码并与原版程序比较。splat 拆分程序单元，objdiff 逐函数检查，构建系统从源码链接已匹配单元，并在出现字节差异时停止。
requirements: Requires a user-owned copy of Summoner 2, Python 3.11+, and either an Apple Silicon Mac or x86-64 Linux machine; Macs also need Rosetta 2.
PS2 binutils, the compiler, wibo, and objdiff-cli are fetched by the build setup.
No licence file in the repository.

name: 3D Pinball — Space Cadet: a Nintendo DS port of the decompilation
description_en: 3dpinball-nds adapts the Space Cadet Pinball decompilation into a Nintendo DS port built with BlocksDS. Its ARM7 and ARM9 source implements the handheld platform layer, while game data comes from the user's Windows release.
description_zh: 3dpinball-nds 基于《Space Cadet Pinball》的反编译源码，用 BlocksDS 构建 Nintendo DS 移植版。ARM7 和 ARM9 源码实现掌机平台适配，游戏数据由用户的 Windows 版本提供。
requirements: Requires BlocksDS to build and the user's Space Cadet Pinball game data on the SD card.
Full Tilt! Pinball's CADET.DAT is unsupported; some table lights display incorrectly in DS mode.
MIT license.

name: Doraemon 1: decompiling Nobita to Mittsu no Seireiseki
description_en: Doraemon 1 decompiles the Nintendo 64 game Doraemon: Nobita to Mittsu no Seireiseki into C and assembly that build a doraemon.z64 image from a user-supplied ROM. The repository includes game source, headers and a build workflow with a stated output MD5.
description_zh: Doraemon 1 将 Nintendo 64 游戏《哆啦A梦：大雄与三个精灵石》反编译为 C 与汇编，并从用户提供的 ROM 构建 doraemon.z64。仓库包含游戏源码、头文件和构建流程，README 给出目标输出的 MD5。
requirements: Provide the game's ROM at the repository root as baserom.z64.
Make, Git, a MIPS toolchain, Python 3 and the packages in requirements.txt are needed.
The README marks the decompilation as partial.
The LICENSE file begins with NON-AI CC0 1.0 Universal.

name: openDarkEngine: rebuilding support for Dark Engine game data
