description_en: openDarkEngine rebuilds an engine for data files from the original Dark Engine games. Its current code displays levels and objects, while its documentation describes incomplete lighting, simulation and scripting and a planned replacement of the Ogre3D renderer.
description_zh: openDarkEngine 重建可读取原版 Dark Engine 游戏数据文件的引擎。现有代码能够显示关卡和物件；文档说明光照、模拟和脚本仍不完整，并计划替换 Ogre3D 渲染器。
requirements: Original Dark Engine game data files are the intended inputs.
Build instructions are partly obsolete during the renderer cleanup.
GNU General Public License version 2.

name: PC-ROA: statically recompiling Ragnarok Odyssey ACE for PC
description_en: PC-ROA investigates the PS3 disc and executable of Ragnarok Odyssey ACE and statically recompiles the game's code to C++ for a PC runtime. Its repository includes disc readers, format documentation, extraction tools, and a separate reimplementation used for comparison. The author reports that the current build reaches the first quests and fights.
description_zh: PC-ROA 研究 PS3 游戏 Ragnarok Odyssey ACE 的光盘与可执行文件，并将游戏代码静态重编译为 C++，接入 PC 运行时。仓库包含光盘读取器、格式文档、提取工具，以及用于对照的独立重实现。作者报告当前版本可进入初期任务并战斗。
requirements: A personal copy of the Ragnarok Odyssey ACE disc; the project generates translated code locally from that input.
The ps3kit submodule is required for the recompilation runtime.
The author reports play only through the first quests at the current stage.
MIT license.

name: LEGO Racers: an N64 source reconstruction in progress
description_en: LEGO Racers is an N64 source reconstruction that splits a user-supplied, hash-matched ROM with splat and builds C and C++ source alongside assembly-backed functions. Its configuration recognizes two ROM hashes and generates region-specific build files.
description_zh: LEGO Racers 是进行中的 N64 游戏源码重建项目。配置脚本校验用户提供的 ROM 哈希，用 splat 拆分 ROM，并为 C、C++ 和仍由汇编承载的函数生成构建文件；脚本识别两个地区版本。
requirements: A ROM matching one of the two configured hashes and the compiler binaries expected under tools/bin are required.
Some functions remain assembly-backed.
Python 3.12 or newer is specified in pyproject.toml.
No licence file in the repository.

name: SkiFree SDL: an SDL2 port of decompiled SkiFree
description_en: SkiFree SDL adapts an existing decompilation of the Microsoft Entertainment Pack game SkiFree into a cross-platform SDL2 source port. It contains the C source and CMake build files, while the player supplies original graphics and icon resources for the build.
description_zh: SkiFree SDL 将 Microsoft Entertainment Pack 游戏 SkiFree 的现有反编译源码改造为跨平台 SDL2 移植版。仓库提供 C 源码和 CMake 构建文件；编译所需的原版图形与图标资源由用户提供。
requirements: Original SkiFree graphics and icon resources must be placed in resources/.
SDL2, SDL2_image, SDL2_ttf and CMake are required.
Mouse support is planned; sound is mentioned as a possibility.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Gran Turismo 2: reconstructing PS1 executables and overlays
description_en: gt2-reversing reconstructs code for Gran Turismo 2's PlayStation release from the North American 1.2 simulation disc. Its build produces the SCUS_944.88 executable and six overlay executables from user-supplied originals, while the source tree contains C implementations, symbols and split configurations.
description_zh: gt2-reversing 从《Gran Turismo 2》北美 1.2 版模拟光盘重建 PS1 程序。构建流程使用用户提供的原始文件生成 SCUS_944.88 主程序及六个覆盖段程序；仓库包含 C 实现、符号和拆分配置。
requirements: A user-owned North American 1.2 simulation disc supplying SCUS_944.88 and GT2.OVL is required.
Building requires Linux, Python 3 with splat, MIPS-compatible binutils, Ninja and initialized submodules.
The build currently supports US 1.2 only and does not reassemble a matching GT2.OVL archive.
CC0-1.0 covers the project's work outside tools and include/*.asm; tools retain their own licenses, while the licenses of some included macros are unclear.

name: Lunar 2: Eternal Blue Complete: a PlayStation decompilation
description_en: The project reconstructs code for the PlayStation release of Lunar 2: Eternal Blue Complete, identified as SLUS_010.71. Its build extracts code and data from the user's game files and rebuilds boot.dat, while C sources, symbols and an asm-differ workflow support continued function work.
description_zh: 项目重建 PlayStation 版《Lunar 2: Eternal Blue Complete》SLUS_010.71 的代码。构建流程从用户的游戏文件提取代码与数据并重建 boot.dat；C 源码、符号文件及 asm-differ 流程用于继续逐函数重建。
requirements: Provide the matching SLUS_010.71 game ISO and extract its contents into the stated folder.
The documented environment is Ubuntu 20.04, directly or through WSL2 or Docker, with mips-elf binutils and listed packages.
No licence file in the repository.

name: ReGTA Chinatown Wars PSP Recompilation: a native Windows port
description_en: ReGTA Chinatown Wars PSP Recompilation targets the Europe v1.01 PSP release of Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars for a Windows x64 port. Its C++20 mainline compiles original MIPS control flow ahead of time and supplies PSP services, graphics and audio; the repository also documents analysis of the original executable.
description_zh: ReGTA Chinatown Wars PSP Recompilation 面向欧版 v1.01《Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars》PSP 游戏，开发 Windows x64 移植版。C++20 主线提前编译原始 MIPS 控制流，并提供 PSP 服务、图形和音频实现；仓库还记录了对原始可执行文件的分析。
requirements: Targets the PSP Europe ULES-01347 v1.01 release and requires the user's own supported PSP copy and privately generated data.
Requires a prepared local Clang/MSVC environment and private generated sources for the current build recipe.
A fresh public clone has no packaged ISO-to-build setup or public playtest download.
The author reports completing five story missions and a taxi activity in a private playtest; wider campaign validation and performance work remain.
Project contributions are GPL-3.0-only; inherited components retain their own terms.

name: Alleyway: annotated Game Boy disassembly and decompilation
description_en: Alleyway documents a Game Boy disassembly and experimental C decompilation of the game's World ROM revision. It names roughly 200 functions and reports findings about an unused tilemap routine, serial-port-based RNG seeding and a paddle wall-clip bug; RGBDS commands assemble the ROM.
description_zh: Alleyway 项目记录 Game Boy 游戏 World 版 ROM 的反汇编及实验性 C 反编译。它为约 200 个函数命名，并报告未使用的图块映射例程、串口随机数种子及挡板穿墙错误等发现；ROM 通过 RGBDS 命令汇编。
requirements: Use RGBDS to assemble and link the source; the documented World Rev A ROM can be used to compare the result.
The ROM is not included; some data remains unnamed and the C decompilation is exploratory.
MIT license.

name: Xenoblade Chronicles 2: matching decompilation of the Switch executable
description_en: xc2-decomp reconstructs Xenoblade Chronicles 2 version 1.0.0 C++ for Nintendo Switch and checks functions against the original AArch64 executable. Its Nix environment provides Clang 3.9.1 and analysis tools; check compiles reconstructed functions and reports byte differences. The author reports 37,087 of 48,739 named functions matched.
description_zh: xc2-decomp 重建 Nintendo Switch 版《异度神剑 2》1.0.0 的 C++ 代码，并逐函数与原始 AArch64 可执行文件比较。Nix 环境提供 Clang 3.9.1 和分析工具；check 编译重建函数并报告字节差异。作者报告 48,739 个具名函数中已有 37,087 个匹配。
requirements: Requires a user-supplied Xenoblade Chronicles 2 version 1.0.0 XCI dump and matching console prod.keys.
Requires Nix with flakes enabled; the development shell supplies the compiler and analysis tools.
The author reports 37,087 of 48,739 named functions matched.

name: Money Idol Exchanger: a Game Boy ROM disassembly
description_en: Money Idol Exchanger is a banked assembly disassembly of the Game Boy game. Its RGBDS Makefile assembles the sources into game.gb, and the project specifies an MD5 goal for comparing the resulting ROM.
description_zh: Money Idol Exchanger 收录这款 Game Boy 游戏按 ROM 存储体划分的汇编源码。Makefile 使用 RGBDS 将源码组装为 game.gb，项目给出用于比对构建结果的目标 MD5 值。
requirements: The documented game.gb build uses RGBDS tools rgbasm, rgblink and rgbfix; its PNG conversion rules use rgbgfx.
The project specifies an MD5 goal for the built game.gb.
No licence file is listed in the repository.

name: Lilium Salvation: reconstructing Dark Salvation engine support
description_en: Lilium Salvation reimplements engine support for Dark Salvation on a Lilium Arena codebase. It runs the game's existing QVMs from user-supplied data files and adds display modes; the author says versions 1.0.6 and 1.0.7 were tried through the first level.
description_zh: Lilium Salvation 基于 Lilium Arena 重建《Dark Salvation》的引擎支持，运行用户提供的游戏数据文件中的 QVM，并加入多种显示模式。作者称已用 1.0.6 和 1.0.7 版测试到第一关。
requirements: Dark Salvation data files are required to run the game.
GNU Make and a C compiler are required; Linux builds also need SDL 2 libraries and headers.
The author reports testing only the first level and says network and demo compatibility may be incomplete.
GPL-2.0-or-later applies to Lilium Salvation; Dark Salvation data files have a separate licence.

name: Rise of Legends: static recompilation of the Win32 game
description_en: Rise of Legends statically recompiles the game's final Win32 executable to native C with pcrecomp, then runs the lifted code in a 32-bit host that maps the original image and binds its imports. The author reports playable Quick Battle skirmishes and progress into the Vinci campaign's first mission from a build assembled using the user's retail discs.
description_zh: Rise of Legends 使用 pcrecomp 将游戏最终版 Win32 可执行文件静态重编译为原生 C，再由 32 位宿主映射原始映像并绑定导入函数。作者报告，基于用户零售光盘构建的版本可运行 Quick Battle 遭遇战，并进入 Vinci 战役首个任务。
requirements: Supply the EN four-disc retail set or disc images and the 2.5 patch.
Windows 10/11, Python 3.10+, git, innoextract 1.9+ and the pinned pcrecomp checkout are documented prerequisites.
A complete campaign mission has not yet been reported as finished.
MIT license.

name: AC1_RE: Armored Core analysis and matching decompilation
description_en: AC1_RE documents and analyzes the North American PlayStation release of Armored Core, including its executable, overlays, mission pipeline, text system and asset formats. It provides behavioral C models, matching-decompilation work, Ghidra scripts, extraction and repacking tools, and local viewers for game structures.
description_zh: AC1_RE 分析并记录北美版 PlayStation《Armored Core》的可执行文件、覆盖层、任务流程、文本系统和资源格式。仓库提供行为 C 模型、匹配反编译工作成果、Ghidra 脚本、提取与重打包工具，以及查看游戏结构的本地界面。
requirements: Provide your own legally obtained SLUS-01323 Armored Core disc image; the documentation also identifies applicable addresses in SCUS-94182.
A mipsel toolchain is required to build C patches.
Japanese and European releases are outside the documented address scope.
MIT License for the repository's original code.

name: OpenDAoC: recreating a Dark Age of Camelot server
description_en: OpenDAoC recreates a Dark Age of Camelot server focused on the 1.65 game experience. Its C# code handles game sessions and packets, and its protocol notes describe optional RSA key transport and RC4 packet encryption for 1.127 and 1.130 clients.
description_zh: OpenDAoC 重建《Dark Age of Camelot》服务器，重点还原 1.65 版本的游戏体验。C# 代码处理游戏会话和数据包；协议文档还说明 1.127 与 1.130 客户端可选的 RSA 密钥传输和 RC4 数据包加密。
requirements: Docker Compose is documented as the easiest way to run the server.
The optional RSA handshake is documented for client versions 1.127 and 1.130 and requires a matching public key in game.dll.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Fallout 2 Community Edition: a cross-platform Fallout 2 reimplementation
description_en: Fallout 2 Community Edition reimplements Fallout 2 as a cross-platform game engine that uses data from the player's own copy. The C++ source includes combat, art, audio, and interface components; the project adds engine fixes and quality-of-life changes while retaining the original gameplay.
description_zh: Fallout 2 Community Edition 将 Fallout 2 重实现为跨平台游戏引擎，运行时读取玩家自备副本中的数据。其 C++ 源码包含战斗、美术资源、音频和界面模块，在保留原有玩法的同时加入引擎修复及操作改进。
requirements: An owned copy of Fallout 2 and its game data files are required.
Some total conversion mods remain unsupported or untested, and only a subset of Sfall settings is implemented.
Sustainable Use License 1.0.

name: OpenBiohazard2: a Go engine reimplementation of Resident Evil 2
description_en: OpenBiohazard2 reimplements the original Resident Evil 2 engine in Go with OpenGL rendering and data from the user's game installation. The code includes room scripts, game state, rendering and parsers for game file formats. Audio, enemy AI and several gameplay systems remain unfinished.
description_zh: OpenBiohazard2 使用 Go 和 OpenGL 重实现原版《Resident Evil 2》的引擎，并读取用户游戏安装目录中的数据。源码包含房间脚本、游戏状态、渲染和多种游戏文件格式解析器；音频、敌人 AI 等系统仍未完成。
requirements: A copy of the original Resident Evil 2; copy its installed game data into data/.
Go toolchain for the documented go build step.
Audio, inventory, enemy AI, puzzles and door transitions are listed as unfinished.
MIT license.

name: Sonic 1 C Port: reconstructing Mega Drive game code in C
description_en: Sonic 1 C Port translates Sonic the Hedgehog revision 1 code from a Mega Drive ROM into C, then manually repairs generated control flow. A Rust runner and Speedshoes emulation framework compare C-side game state with the original and support instruction-level accuracy checks.
description_zh: Sonic 1 C Port 从 Mega Drive 版 Sonic the Hedgehog 修订版 1 的 ROM 生成 C 代码，再手工修正复杂控制流。Rust 运行器和 Speedshoes 模拟框架会比较 C 侧与原版的游戏状态，并支持逐指令精度检查。
requirements: An original REV01 ROM named sonic1.bin is required.
The documented build uses TCC and Rust 2021 edition.
Horizontal blank handling remains unported; build instructions are marked out of date.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Aironauts: an early PlayStation decompilation of OUTROE.EXE
description_en: Aironauts-decomp reconstructs source for the OUTROE.EXE executable of the PAL PlayStation game Aironauts. It extracts the user's disc files, splits the executable into assembly and data, and attempts to rebuild an executable that passes the project's comparison check; current C work focuses on SDK functions.
description_zh: Aironauts-decomp 为 PAL 版 PlayStation 游戏 Aironauts 的 OUTROE.EXE 重建源码。项目从用户的光盘文件提取内容，拆分汇编与数据，并尝试重新构建通过项目校验的可执行文件；当前 C 语言工作侧重 SDK 函数。
requirements: Requires the user's Aironauts copy as one CUE file and four BIN files.
The setup calls for the cue-supporting mkpsxiso fork and the project's extraction and build tools.
Only OUTROE.EXE is currently included; other game executables may never be covered.
AGPL-3.0 license.

name: FNV-nx: an experimental Fallout: New Vegas PC-to-Switch recompilation
description_en: FNV-nx investigates a native Nintendo Switch port of Fallout: New Vegas by translating PC x86 code ahead of time and implementing Windows ABI services and a Vulkan graphics path. The repository documents Ghidra analysis and diagnostic tests; the author reports a Switch hardware test that reached the game menu and opening movie, while gameplay loading remains unverified.
description_zh: FNV-nx 探索将《Fallout: New Vegas》PC 版 x86 代码预先转译为 ARM64，并通过 Windows ABI 服务和 Vulkan 图形路径在 Nintendo Switch 上运行。仓库记录了 Ghidra 分析和诊断测试；作者报告 Switch 真机测试已进入游戏菜单并播放开场影片，但尚未确认能否载入游戏流程。
requirements: Use locally available, authorized FalloutNV.exe and Data files for game-specific work.
The native Switch port remains experimental; gameplay loading remains unverified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: TF15-Client: rebuilding the Team Fortress Classic client
description_en: TF15-Client rebuilds the Team Fortress Classic client in C++ for Xash3D FWGS. It provides Android, Linux and Windows builds and uses the valve and tfc folders from a Steam copy of the game.
description_zh: TF15-Client 用 C++ 重建 Team Fortress Classic 客户端，配合 Xash3D FWGS 运行，并提供 Android、Linux 和 Windows 构建方式。运行时需要从 Steam 版游戏复制 valve 和 tfc 文件夹。
requirements: A Steam copy of Team Fortress Classic and its valve and tfc folders are required.
A recent developer build of Xash3D FWGS is required.
The repository includes a Half-Life 1 SDK license.

name: Wario World: an in-progress GameCube decompilation
description_en: Wario World reconstructs the US GameCube game's code through an in-progress decompilation and disassembly. The repository provides assembly, linker configuration and a build workflow; the author reports that the current disassembly can be reassembled.
description_zh: Wario World 对美版 GameCube 游戏进行反编译和反汇编重建。仓库提供汇编源码、链接配置与构建流程；作者报告现有反汇编内容可以重新汇编。
requirements: Metrowerks CodeWarrior 2.0 and 2.7 embedded PowerPC compilers, Python and Wine are required; Docker is offered as a build route.
The decompilation is a work in progress.
No licence file in the repository.

name: sekiro-rs: a Rust and Bevy reconstruction of Sekiro
description_en: sekiro-rs rebuilds parts of Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice in Rust and Bevy using data extracted from a user's Steam installation. It interprets Havok Script and behavior graphs, TAE events and Lua AI scripts, reads game formats including FLVER and MSB, and rewrites engine combat rules identified through static analysis.
description_zh: sekiro-rs 使用 Rust 与 Bevy，从用户安装的 Steam 版 Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice 提取数据并重建部分游戏。它运行 Havok Script、行为图、TAE 事件和 Lua AI 脚本，读取 FLVER、MSB 等格式，并根据静态分析重写战斗规则。
requirements: A Steam copy of Sekiro v1.6.0.0 and about 50 GB of local cache space are required.
Windows build setup uses stable Rust with MSVC and Visual Studio C++ build tools.
Game flow and several systems remain partial.
MIT or Apache-2.0, at the user's option.

name: DBZ Budokai 1 HD Collection: a Windows static recompilation and mod pipeline
description_en: DBZ Budokai 1 HD Collection builds a Windows port by statically recompiling the Xbox 360 game's PowerPC code with ReXGlue SDK. Its launcher selects USA or EU assets, and its mod tools overlay AFS entries and convert character models between Budokai releases.
description_zh: DBZ Budokai 1 HD Collection 借助 ReXGlue SDK 静态重编译 Xbox 360 版游戏的 PowerPC 代码，构建 Windows 移植版。启动器可选择美国版或欧洲版资源；模组工具通过 AFS 条目覆盖加载修改，并转换不同 Budokai 作品的角色模型。
requirements: Provide default.xex and the data_*.afs files from a legal copy of the chosen region.
Build with a C++23 compiler, CMake 3.25 or later and ReXGlue SDK with the repository's runtime patches.
The model pipeline needs Python 3 and game assets; Budokai 3 model ports also need its data_cmn.afs.
MIT license.

name: Project Gotham Racing: an Xbox static recompilation for Windows
description_en: Project Gotham Racing is ported from the original Xbox to Windows by statically recompiling the game's x86 code with Xbox XBE Recomp. The port supplies Windows implementations of Xbox graphics, sound and system interfaces and builds the game from the user's disc. Its findings also document XBE sections and the GOTHPOK asset container.
description_zh: 该项目使用 Xbox XBE Recomp 将初代 Xbox 版 Project Gotham Racing 的 x86 代码静态重编译到 Windows。移植版本实现了 Xbox 图形、声音和系统接口的 Windows 替代层，并从用户的游戏光盘构建；研究记录还描述了 XBE 段和 GOTHPOK 资源容器。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11, 64 bit, with a Direct3D 11 or 12 GPU.
An owned supported Project Gotham Racing Xbox disc image or extracted disc files.
Source builds require Visual Studio 2022 with C++ tools and the SDK submodule.
MIT license.

name: Folklore: a PS3 static recompilation for Windows
description_en: Folklore statically recompiles the PS3 game's PowerPC and SPU code from a player-supplied disc into C++ and a native Windows executable. The port uses ps3recomp with project patches, reimplements the SPURS job system and renders through Direct3D 12. The author reports that it boots and plays on the author's PC, with rough edges.
description_zh: Folklore 从玩家自有的 PS3 光盘提取 PowerPC 与 SPU 代码，静态转换为 C++ 并构建 Windows 原生程序。移植版使用经项目补丁修改的 ps3recomp，重建 SPURS 作业系统，并通过 Direct3D 12 渲染。作者报告游戏已可在其电脑上启动和游玩，但仍有瑕疵。
requirements: A player-owned North American BCUS98147 or European BCES00050 Folklore disc dump is required; the Japanese release is unsupported.
Windows 10/11 x64, a Direct3D 12 GPU, an AVX2 CPU and about 30 GB of free space are required.
The author reports playability on one Windows 11 PC and expects rough edges.
MIT license.

name: SMG-3DS: an unfinished Super Mario Galaxy port to New 3DS
description_en: SMG-3DS ports Super Mario Galaxy to New 3DS by compiling Petari's decompiled game code and implementing the Wii interfaces it calls. The port translates GX graphics to PICA200 and runs the Wii audio DSP in software. The author reports playable but slow hardware performance, and the project is archived.
description_zh: SMG-3DS 将 Petari 反编译的 Super Mario Galaxy 代码编译到 New 3DS，并实现游戏调用的 Wii 接口。项目把 GX 图形转换到 PICA200，同时用软件运行 Wii 音频 DSP。作者报告实体设备上虽可游玩但速度较慢；项目已归档。
requirements: Use a New 3DS or New 2DS and provide a USA RMGE01 disc image on the SD card.
Build with the documented devkitARM toolchain and Petari submodule.
The project is archived and unfinished; hardware graphics and performance issues remain.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: GT Advance 3: matching GBA ROM reconstruction
description_en: GT Advance 3 reconstructs the US Game Boy Advance ROM from C, assembly and registered data generators. The author reports an 8 MiB byte-identical build and tracks compiler-generated C matches separately from assembly-backed functions and preserved data payloads.
description_zh: GT Advance 3 使用 C、汇编和登记的数据生成工具重建美版 Game Boy Advance ROM。作者报告可构建逐字节相同的 8 MiB ROM，并将编译器生成的 C 匹配结果与汇编函数及保留的数据载荷分开统计。
requirements: Python 3.11+, GNU Make, Git, a host C/C++ compiler, Clang, ARM GCC/binutils, shasum and pyelftools are required for the documented build.
A user-owned US ROM named baserom.gba is required for comparison.
Some functions remain assembly-backed, and some data payloads are preserved or extracted from the reference ROM.
CC0-1.0 applies to the project's reconstruction, tooling and documentation.

name: Everyone's A Wally: a ZX Spectrum disassembly
description_en: wally is a disassembly of the ZX Spectrum game Everyone's A Wally. Its repository contains SkoolKit sources for the game and loader, Z80 assembly, reference files and build scripts.
description_zh: wally 是 ZX Spectrum 游戏《Everyone's A Wally》的反汇编。仓库包含游戏与加载器的 SkoolKit 源文件、Z80 汇编、参考文件和构建脚本。
requirements: No licence file in the repository.

name: NSMBWiicompiled: a Windows static recompilation of New Super Mario Bros. Wii
description_en: NSMBWiicompiled converts New Super Mario Bros. Wii PAL revision 1 into a native Windows game through static recompilation. Its translator parses PowerPC code from Wii DOL files and emits C++ for a native runtime, while the player's disc supplies game assets. The port adds resolution, widescreen, input and multiplayer options.
description_zh: NSMBWiicompiled 通过静态重编译将 New Super Mario Bros. Wii 的 PAL Rev 1 版本转换为 Windows 原生游戏。其转换器解析 Wii DOL 文件中的 PowerPC 代码并生成供原生运行时使用的 C++，游戏资源取自玩家自备光盘。移植版增加分辨率、宽屏、输入和多人游玩选项。
requirements: The user's own New Super Mario Bros. Wii PAL revision 1 disc dump is required; the US disc is unsupported.
The port targets 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 with an AVX2 CPU and a Direct3D 12 or Vulkan GPU.
Changing resolution during a level can freeze animated tiles; Wii Remote input is unsupported.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: Torchlight Rekindled: a portable engine following the Xbox 360 game
description_en: Torchlight Rekindled implements an engine for the 2009 game Torchlight, following the logic of its Xbox 360 release. It uses OGRE 14 and ParticleUniverse for rendering, runs on Switch, mobile and desktop platforms, and reads a user's PC or Xbox 360 game archive at runtime.
description_zh: Torchlight Rekindled 为 2009 年游戏《火炬之光》实现新引擎，游戏逻辑参照 Xbox 360 版。项目使用 OGRE 14 和 ParticleUniverse 渲染，可在 Switch、移动设备和桌面平台运行，并在运行时读取玩家提供的 PC 或 Xbox 360 游戏归档。
requirements: An owned PC or Xbox 360 Torchlight copy and its pak.zip or Pak.zip are required.
Building requires Ninja and Python 3 with Pillow, plus platform-specific toolchains.
The built-in interface used with PC archives is under construction.

name: Midnight Ghost Stone: a native Metal Gear Solid recompilation
description_en: Midnight Ghost Stone builds a native PC version of the PlayStation Metal Gear Solid from its USA v1.0 discs. It statically recompiles most MIPS game logic, substitutes selected decompiled C routines checked against the executable, and presents locally imported meshes and textures through Vulkan. The author labels the Linux and Windows alpha packages experimental and unqualified for a complete campaign.
description_zh: Midnight Ghost Stone 根据初代《Metal Gear Solid》的美版 1.0 光盘构建原生 PC 版本。项目将大部分 MIPS 游戏逻辑静态重编译，以对照美版可执行文件检查过的部分 C 例程替换相应代码，并通过 Vulkan 呈现本地导入的模型与纹理。作者将 Linux 和 Windows alpha 包标为实验版本，尚未确认其可完成整场游戏。
requirements: Both original USA v1.0 discs, SLUS-00594 and SLUS-00776, as BIN or supported CUE/BIN images.
Linux or Windows x64 with a working Vulkan driver; Linux development builds require Python 3.11+, CMake 3.20+, Ninja, C++20, SDL 2.26+ and glslc.
Alpha packages have not been qualified for full campaign completion or physical Steam Deck compatibility.
The LICENSE file contains GPL-3.0-or-later terms for the PS1Recomp component; third-party notices govern other components.

name: Maniac Mansion: a commented C64 engine and loader disassembly
description_en: Maniac Mansion's Commodore 64 engine and special disk loaders are documented in a reconstructed, commented disassembly. The material groups more than 500 routines into modules covering rendering, audio, input, resource loading and the script interpreter; the author reports that all code is commented.
description_zh: 这份重构并注释的反汇编资料记录了 C64 版《Maniac Mansion》的游戏引擎和专用磁盘加载器。资料将 500 多个例程按图形、声音、输入、资源加载及脚本解释器等模块整理；作者称全部代码均已添加注释。
requirements: Reading the routines requires familiarity with 6502 assembly; understanding their hardware interactions also benefits from knowledge of C64 chips and interrupts.
Naming and explanation improvements remain pending.
No licence file in the repository.

name: B3-Express: statically recompiling Bayonetta 3 for Windows
description_en: B3-Express ports Bayonetta 3 v1.2.0 to Windows by recompiling its ARM64 code to x86 with a modified ScarletNX runtime. An NVN-level Vulkan renderer draws the game, and a launcher checks an extracted game dump, copies its files and compiles the code on the user's PC. The repository also contains diagnostic notes on rendering and runtime issues.
description_zh: B3-Express 使用修改过的 ScarletNX 运行时，将《Bayonetta 3》v1.2.0 的 ARM64 代码重编译为面向 Windows 的 x86 代码。NVN 层的 Vulkan 渲染器负责绘图；启动器检查用户提取的游戏文件、复制文件并在本机编译代码。仓库还记录了渲染和运行时问题的诊断过程。
requirements: Provide a legally dumped Bayonetta 3 v1.2.0 copy extracted into exefs and romfs folders.
Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit; a Vulkan 1.3 GPU driver; about 20 GB of free disk space and at least 4 GB of free RAM during compilation.
The author reports testing on one Windows 11 PC; AMD GPUs have not been tried on this build.
GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: Duck Hunt: an NES disassembly
description_en: Duck Hunt reconstructs NES game code and data as assembly files. The project directs users to extract graphics from their own ROM and assemble the source with ASM6N.
description_zh: Duck Hunt 将 NES 游戏代码和数据整理为汇编文件。项目要求用户从自备 ROM 提取图形，并使用 ASM6N 汇编源码。
requirements: Extract graphics data from an original Duck Hunt ROM.
Use ASM6N to assemble the source.
No licence file in the repository.

name: eZeus: rebuilding Zeus: Master of Olympus from original game files
description_en: eZeus reimplements Zeus: Master of Olympus and its Poseidon expansion as a C++ game using the player's original files. It supports the original adventures and adds optional behavior such as an alternate walker implementation and building two cities at once.
description_zh: eZeus 用 C++ 重建《Zeus: Master of Olympus》及 Poseidon 资料片，运行时需要玩家的原版游戏文件。它支持原版冒险内容，并提供另一套行人实现和同时建造两座城市等可选功能。
requirements: Original Zeus: Master of Olympus and Poseidon game files.
Only English and Polish editions are supported.
Only Windows binaries are provided; Linux requires a local build.
GNU General Public License version 3.

name: Helion: rebuilding a Doom-compatible engine
description_en: Helion rebuilds a Doom-compatible engine with static rendering and state management for dynamic map changes. It reads user-supplied IWAD game data and supports WADs targeting vanilla Doom, Boom, MBF, MBF21, ID24 and part of UDMF.
description_zh: Helion 重建兼容 Doom 的引擎，以静态渲染和状态管理处理地图变化。它读取用户提供的 IWAD 游戏数据，支持面向原版 Doom、Boom、MBF、MBF21、ID24 的 WAD，并部分支持 UDMF。
requirements: A user-supplied IWAD game data file and an OpenGL 3.3-compatible GPU.
Windows 7 x64, Linux x64 or an M-series macOS ARM64 device.
UDMF support is partial.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: MILLI4C: a Mario & Luigi: Dream Team decompilation
description_en: MILLI4C reconstructs C++ source for the US 1.0 release of Mario & Luigi: Dream Team, targeting a matching build of its code.bin. The repository includes game source, headers, CRO configuration and a build script that produces code.bin and MILLI4C.axf.
description_zh: MILLI4C 重建《Mario & Luigi: Dream Team》美版 1.0 的 C++ 源码，目标是匹配原版 code.bin。仓库包含游戏源码、头文件、CRO 配置，以及生成 code.bin 和 MILLI4C.axf 的构建脚本。
requirements: The user's decompressed US 1.0 code.bin is required.
ARMCC 4.1 Build 894, DevkitARM and Windows are listed build requirements.
CRO support is planned; RomFS building is outside the project's scope.

name: volvo_vida_db: reconstructing Volvo D2 ECU communication from VIDA
description_en: volvo_vida_db reconstructs Volvo D2 ECU communication from VIDA 2014D database definitions and decompiled .NET services. Its scripts extract vehicle profiles and ECU parameters, form CAN request frames, reassemble multi-frame responses and decode parameter values for P1/P2-era vehicles.
description_zh: volvo_vida_db 从 VIDA 2014D 数据库定义及反编译的 .NET 服务重建 Volvo D2 ECU 通信。脚本提取车型配置和 ECU 参数，构造 CAN 请求帧、重组多帧应答，并解析 P1/P2 时代车辆的参数值。
requirements: Access to a Volvo VIDA 2014D database is required for extraction.
Python 3.10+ with duckdb, pandas and inquirer is required for the Python scripts.
PowerShell 7 with the SqlServer module or the batch extraction path is used to generate CSV data.
No licence file in the repository.

name: 007: From Russia with Love: an original Xbox recompilation for PC
description_en: 007: From Russia with Love - XBE Recomp ports the original Xbox game to Windows using Xbox XBE Recomp. It compiles code from the user's USA or European game files for PC on first start, with a runtime that adds display, graphics and input options.
description_zh: 007: From Russia with Love - XBE Recomp 使用 Xbox XBE Recomp 将初代 Xbox 游戏移植到 Windows。首次启动时，它从用户提供的美版或欧版游戏文件编译 PC 代码；运行时增加显示、图形和输入选项。
requirements: Provide an ISO or extracted files from a legally acquired USA or European copy; building requires extracted files including default.xbe.
Windows 10 64-bit, an SSE4.2 and POPCNT CPU, and a Direct3D 12 GPU are specified.
Building from source requires Visual Studio 2022 with C++, Clang and CMake components.
No licence file in the repository.

name: SegaSonic The Hedgehog: arcade code reconstructed in C
description_en: SegaSonic The Hedgehog reconstructs the Sega System 32 arcade game's NEC V60 and Z80 programs as readable C. Its tools disassemble and decompile code, extract assets from the user's MAME ROM set, and compare game, video and sound behavior with reference runs frame by frame. The author reports Windows play for the SDL2 port; Linux and macOS builds had not been tried.
description_zh: SegaSonic The Hedgehog 将 Sega System 32 街机游戏的 NEC V60 和 Z80 程序重建为可读 C 代码。工具从玩家的 MAME ROM 集合中反汇编、反编译并提取资源，再逐帧对照游戏、画面与声音行为。作者报告 SDL2 移植版已在 Windows 游玩，Linux 与 macOS 尚未尝试。
requirements: The user's SegaSonic The Hedgehog MAME sonic ROM set, Japan revision C.
Python 3.10+, CMake 3.20+ and a C11/C++17 compiler.
The SDL2 port was built and played on Windows; Linux and macOS were not tried.
BSD-3-Clause licence.

name: OpenGD: a Geometry Dash gameplay reimplementation
description_en: OpenGD reimplements Geometry Dash gameplay in C++ on Axmol, aiming to match the original game. It requires resources from Geometry Dash 2.1 or 2.2; the documented gameplay rewrite currently leaves levels unplayable.
description_zh: OpenGD 使用 C++ 和 Axmol 重建 Geometry Dash 玩法，以原作行为为目标。运行需要 Geometry Dash 2.1 或 2.2 的资源；当前玩法重写阶段尚无法游玩关卡。
requirements: Requires Geometry Dash 2.1 or 2.2 resources to run.
Building requires PowerShell, CMake, a C++20 compiler and Axmol.
The project is unmaintained, and levels are currently unplayable.
Licensed under GPL-3.0.

name: Extreme-G Recompiled: an incomplete N64 static recompilation
description_en: Extreme-G Recompiled analyzes the N64 game's custom LZSS ROM blocks and prepares its MIPS code for N64Recomp translation to C for a native Windows build. The project includes function symbols and an SDL2/RT64 runtime scaffold; the author reports that startup reaches audio initialization before crashing because a data section is uninitialized.
description_zh: Extreme-G Recompiled 分析 N64 游戏 ROM 中的自定义 LZSS 数据块，并准备其 MIPS 代码，供 N64Recomp 转换为 C 源码以构建 Windows 原生程序。项目包含函数符号表和 SDL2/RT64 运行时框架；作者报告启动过程进入音频初始化后，因数据段未初始化而崩溃。
requirements: The user's legally obtained USA Extreme-G ROM, N64Recomp, Visual Studio 2022 and CMake 3.20 or newer are required.
The author reports a crash during audio initialization; the build is not playable.
MIT license.

name: OpenPol: an early Polanie reimplementation
description_en: OpenPol reimplements the Polish RTS Polanie in Rust and includes tools for reading and extracting its data formats. The current program plays intros, loads some game files, and displays the main menu and cursor; other gameplay remains unfinished.
description_zh: OpenPol 用 Rust 重建波兰即时战略游戏《Polanie》，并提供读取、提取游戏数据格式的工具。目前可播放片头、载入部分数据文件，并显示主菜单和鼠标指针；其余玩法尚未完成。
requirements: The current implementation is limited to intros, data loading, and the main menu.

name: GT2 RecompOne: Gran Turismo 2 static recompilation with multiplayer
description_en: GT2 RecompOne translates Gran Turismo 2's PlayStation MIPS code into C# ahead of time and runs it as a .NET program with replacement console services. Game-specific hooks and symbol maps support an added multiplayer mode with LAN discovery, direct UDP connections and a relay.
description_zh: GT2 RecompOne 预先将 PlayStation《跑车浪漫旅 2》的 MIPS 代码转换为 C#，通过替代主机服务的 .NET 运行时执行。项目的游戏钩子和符号表支持新增多人模式，可通过局域网发现、UDP 直连或中继竞速。
requirements: The Gran Turismo 2 Combined Disc (USA) image in .cue/.bin or .chd form and the .NET 10 SDK are required.
The author reports builds and gameplay on Windows; multiplayer is in alpha.
MIT License.

name: Donkey Kong Country 2: an SNES disassembly
description_en: Donkey Kong Country 2 Disassembly reconstructs the USA 1.0 SNES game's assembly and memory maps. Its Asar scripts extract required assets from a user-supplied, headerless ROM, while the repository keeps the disassembly and patch scaffolding.
description_zh: Donkey Kong Country 2 Disassembly 重建美版 1.0《大金刚国度 2》的 SNES 汇编与内存映射。附带的 Asar 脚本从用户自备的无文件头 ROM 提取所需素材，仓库存放反汇编代码和补丁框架。
requirements: A clean, headerless Donkey Kong Country 2 USA v1.0 ROM.
SNES ROM Framework v1.1.2 is included with the project download.
GPL-3.0 license.

name: Vange-rs: reimplementing Vangers in Rust
description_en: vange-rs reimplements Vangers in Rust with wgpu graphics, aiming to reproduce its worlds, vehicles and single-player behavior using original game resources. The repository includes a playable road binary, model and level viewers, resource conversion tools and technical notes on rendering and data formats.
description_zh: vange-rs 使用 Rust 和 wgpu 重做《Vangers》，目标是借助原版游戏资源重现其世界、载具和单人游戏行为。仓库包含可游玩的 road 主程序、模型与关卡查看器、资源转换工具，以及有关渲染和数据格式的技术记录。
requirements: An original Vangers copy is required to use the project with mechouses.
The configuration can point to data from the published Vangers source tree.
Apache-2.0 license.

name: Animal Crossing gcNX: a native Switch port of the GameCube decompilation
description_en: Animal Crossing gcNX ports the decompiled GameCube game to Nintendo Switch by compiling its code for ARM and translating GX graphics to OpenGL ES. It reads game resources from the user's USA disc image; the repository also documents an Android port built on the same decompilation.
description_zh: Animal Crossing gcNX 将 GameCube 版游戏的反编译代码编译到 Nintendo Switch 的 ARM 平台，并把 GX 图形调用转换为 OpenGL ES。游戏资源从用户的美版光盘镜像读取；仓库还记录了基于同一反编译成果的 Android 移植版。
requirements: A Switch running Atmosphère and a personal Animal Crossing USA GAFE01 disc image in ISO, GCM or CISO format are required for the Switch port.
The Switch port is described as beta.
The licence file identifies CC0 for upstream decompilation code and MIT for the PC port layer; other components have their own terms.

name: LEGO Rock Raiders: a C and C++ decompilation project
description_en: LegoRockRaiders reconstructs LEGO Rock Raiders game code in C and C++. Its source tree covers rendering, audio, input, levels, objects, and gameplay systems, with a CMake build. The project cites a separate LEGO Rock Raiders analysis repository as a resource.
description_zh: LegoRockRaiders 以 C 和 C++ 重建《LEGO Rock Raiders》的游戏代码。源码涵盖渲染、音频、输入、关卡、对象及玩法系统，并提供 CMake 构建配置；项目注明参考了另一个《LEGO Rock Raiders》分析仓库。
requirements: The root CMake configuration requires CMake 3.25 or later.
No licence file in the repository.

name: NeoXResearch: investigating NeoX archives and Python bytecode
description_en: NeoXResearch investigates NetEase's NeoX game engine through static analysis and dynamic debugging of its native library. It documents NPK archive headers and metadata entries, the file-loading and decryption path, and changes to Python bytecode opcodes. Python scripts support NPK unpacking, decryption and bytecode repair.
description_zh: NeoXResearch 通过静态分析与动态调试研究网易 NeoX 游戏引擎的原生库。资料记录 NPK 归档头与元数据项、文件加载和解密流程，以及 Python 字节码操作码的改动；附带的 Python 脚本用于解包、解密和修复字节码。
requirements: The documented analysis uses IDA Pro and dynamic debugging of a NeoX core shared object.
The bytecode workflow compares NeoX's Python 2.7 implementation with CPython and uses uncompyle6.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Powerslide Remake: rebuilding the arcade racer on original game data
description_en: Powerslide Remake reconstructs the arcade racer's main features in a cross-platform C++ application built on Ogre. It reads the original game's data.pf, gameshell.pf and store.pf archives and provides racing, AI and multiplayer features. Builds target Windows, Linux and Android.
description_zh: Powerslide Remake 使用 Ogre 构建跨平台 C++ 程序，重建 Powerslide 赛车游戏的主要玩法。程序读取原版 data.pf、gameshell.pf 和 store.pf，包含赛车、AI 与多人游戏功能，面向 Windows、Linux 和 Android。
requirements: The original game's data.pf, gameshell.pf and store.pf archives are required.
Building requires CMake, a C++03 compiler and Ogre 1.9.0; OpenAL is required when audio support is enabled.
Integrated graphics are unsupported on PC according to the author.
MIT License.

name: Big Brain Academy: Wii Degree — an in-progress matching decompilation
description_en: Big Brain Academy: Wii Degree is a work-in-progress Wii decompilation with C and C++ source for EGG, nw4r, and SDK components. Its build configuration records matching status per object and checks the rebuilt RYWE01 main.dol against a SHA-1 target.
description_zh: Big Brain Academy: Wii Degree 是进行中的 Wii 游戏反编译项目，已有 EGG、nw4r 和 SDK 组件的 C/C++ 源码。构建配置逐个标记目标文件的匹配状态，并以 SHA-1 校验 RYWE01 版 main.dol。
requirements: The RYWE01 original main.dol is the configured target input.
The decompilation is in progress; some configured objects are nonmatching.

name: Kirby's Tilt 'n' Tumble: a Game Boy Color disassembly
description_en: Kirby's Tilt 'n' Tumble is represented as banked Game Boy Color assembly built with RGBDS. The repository includes assembly for the cartridge banks and a Makefile target that compares the rebuilt ROM with a stored MD5 reference.
description_zh: 该项目将《星之卡比：倾斜翻滚》表示为按存储区组织的 Game Boy Color 汇编代码，并用 RGBDS 构建。仓库含各区汇编文件，Makefile 提供与保存的 MD5 参考值比较的目标。
requirements: The documented Windows build uses Cygwin with make, git, and gcc-core.
RGBDS executables are required in a local bin directory.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Touhou Eiyashou: matching-source reconstruction of version 1.00d
description_en: Touhou Eiyashou reconstructs C++ source for the Japanese 1.00d release of Touhou 8 and compares rebuilt code with the original executable using reccmp. The public repository contains source, build scripts and mapping data; further decompilation is being developed privately until completion.
description_zh: 该项目重建东方永夜抄日文 1.00d 版的 C++ 源码，并用 reccmp 对比重编译结果与原版可执行文件。公开仓库包含源码、构建脚本和映射数据；后续反编译工作暂在私下进行。
requirements: An original th08.exe version 1.00d is required.
The build uses Python 3.4 or newer, Visual Studio 2002 and DirectX 8.0; Linux and macOS workflows also use Wine and msiextract.
The public source is an early, unfinished snapshot.
MIT.

name: AGS Aging Cartridge: disassembling version 7.0
description_en: The project reconstructs AGS Aging Cartridge 7.0 from a user-supplied Game Boy Advance ROM as assembly and C source. Its build targets an aging.gba image with a published SHA-1 and uses devkitARM and pokeruby-tools.
description_zh: 该项目以用户提供的 Game Boy Advance ROM 为输入，将 AGS Aging Cartridge 7.0 重建为汇编与 C 源码。构建输出为给出 SHA-1 的 aging.gba，使用 devkitARM 和 pokeruby-tools。
requirements: Provide an AGS Aging Cartridge 7.0 ROM named baserom.gba.
Install devkitARM and copy pokeruby-tools into the repository before building with make.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Ultima IV: near-matching reconstruction of its DOS executables
description_en: Ultima IV decompiled reconstructs the PC game's AVATAR.EXE and TITLE.EXE as C and assembly source. The author reports that compiling and linking the recovered files with Microsoft C Compiler 4.00 produces executables about ten bytes different from each original.
description_zh: Ultima IV decompiled 将 PC 版游戏的 AVATAR.EXE 和 TITLE.EXE 重建为 C 与汇编源码。作者报告，使用 Microsoft C Compiler 4.00 编译链接后，每个新可执行文件与原版约相差十字节。
requirements: Rebuilding uses Microsoft C Compiler 4.00.
The author reports roughly ten bytes of difference per rebuilt executable.
Only CGA.DRV was reversed among the separate graphics drivers.
No licence file in the repository.

name: NHL Legacy: Xbox 360 static recompilation and Vulkan port
description_en: Uses ReXGlue to statically recompile the Xbox 360 NHL Legacy executable into a native Windows program. A game-specific Vulkan renderer and host code handle presentation, while a builder prepares an installation from the player's ISO or extracted game folder. The source also documents graphics investigations and diagnostic tools.
description_zh: 使用 ReXGlue 将 Xbox 360 版《NHL Legacy》可执行文件静态重编译为原生 Windows 程序。专用 Vulkan 渲染器与主机代码负责画面输出，构建工具从玩家的 ISO 或已提取游戏目录准备安装；项目还记录了图形问题调查及诊断工具。
requirements: Provide a personal NHL Legacy disc dump as an ISO or extracted folder containing default.xex; the builder checks its hash.
Requires Windows 10/11 x64 or Linux through Proton, a Vulkan-capable GPU and about 10 GB of disk space.
Only the specified unmodified game image passes validation.

name: OCTR: a native CTR Nitro-Fueled PC port with online play
description_en: OCTR adapts Crash Team Racing: Nitro-Fueled's PS4 executable to Windows and Linux while running its x86-64 code directly on the host CPU. A replacement PS4 runtime and shadPS4-derived Vulkan renderer support the game, and this fork adds community-server races, private rooms, friends, and the Pit Stop.
description_zh: OCTR 将《Crash Team Racing: Nitro-Fueled》的 PS4 可执行文件移植到 Windows 和 Linux，由主机 CPU 直接执行其 x86-64 代码。项目以替代 PS4 运行时和基于 shadPS4 的 Vulkan 渲染器支撑游戏，并加入社区服务器赛事、私人房间、好友及 Pit Stop。
requirements: A user-provided dump of Crash Team Racing: Nitro-Fueled and its 1.21 update is required.
Windows 10/11 or Linux is described; the Windows build is reported playable.
GPL-2.0 license.

name: Battle Arena Toshinden Recompiled: a PlayStation static recompilation
description_en: Battle Arena Toshinden Recompiled generates native code from the USA PlayStation release using psxrecomp and a user-supplied 14-track disc. It adds title-specific widescreen, frame blending and roster mods, with a launcher for disc setup and two-player rollback netplay.
description_zh: Battle Arena Toshinden Recompiled 使用 psxrecomp 和用户提供的 14 轨 PlayStation 美国版光盘生成原生代码。项目提供游戏专用宽屏、帧混合及角色阵容模组，并配备光盘设置启动器与双人回滚联机功能。
requirements: A legally obtained USA 14-track BIN/CUE image of Battle Arena Toshinden is required.
The current public package is a Windows ZIP; the earlier Linux AppImage requires glibc 2.38 or newer.
The game remains an early release; the documented runtime scope reaches combat.
PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 applies to the project's covered code.

name: Fallout-NV-MacOS: static recompilation of Fallout: New Vegas for Apple Silicon
description_en: Fallout-NV-MacOS translates the 32-bit Windows executable of Fallout: New Vegas through Ghidra P-code into C for native Apple Silicon builds. A host supplies Win32 and COM shims plus Direct3D 9-to-Metal rendering, while a differential tester compares translated functions with the original x86 instructions in Unicorn. The author reports an hour of scripted play; audio, Bink video, and gamepad support remain unfinished.
description_zh: Fallout-NV-MacOS 通过 Ghidra P-code 将 Fallout: New Vegas 的 32 位 Windows 可执行文件翻译为 C，并在 Apple Silicon 上原生编译。宿主实现 Win32、COM 兼容层及 Direct3D 9 到 Metal 的渲染转换；差分测试器使用 Unicorn 比较翻译后函数与原始 x86 指令。作者报告完成一小时脚本化游玩；音频、Bink 视频和手柄支持尚未完成。
requirements: A legally owned, unencrypted 32-bit Windows copy of Fallout: New Vegas or another 32-bit Windows game executable.
Apple Silicon macOS, Ghidra 12, clang, Python 3.9+, Unicorn 2.1.4 or newer, and numpy.
Audio, Bink video, gamepad support, and NVSE mods are unfinished.
MIT license.

name: Bomberman 64: Recompiled — an N64 static recompilation
description_en: Bomberman 64: Recompiled statically recompiles the US Nintendo 64 release of Bomberman 64 into a native port with N64: Recompiled. RT64 supplies rendering, while headers and selected functions from the separate decompilation project support patches and enhancements.
description_zh: Bomberman 64: Recompiled 使用 N64: Recompiled 将美国版 Nintendo 64《炸弹人 64》静态重编译为原生移植版。RT64 负责渲染；项目使用独立反编译工程的头文件和部分函数制作补丁与增强功能。
requirements: Own US version 1.0 Bomberman 64 ROM.
A GPU supporting Direct3D 12 Shader Model 6, Vulkan 1.2 or Metal Argument Buffers Tier 2; x86-64 builds require SSE4.1.
The source reports that overlays and some other software can cause rendering or performance issues.
GPL-3.0 License.

name: BrawlerPad: an Apple-platform port of Super Smash Bros. 64
description_en: BrawlerPad adapts the BattleShip Super Smash Bros. 64 source port for Apple Silicon macOS, iPhone and iPad. Its patches add Metal app integration, user-ROM resource extraction, touch controls and controller lifecycle handling while compiling the decompiled game code ahead of time.
description_zh: BrawlerPad 将 BattleShip 的 Super Smash Bros. 64 源码移植到 Apple Silicon macOS、iPhone 和 iPad。项目通过补丁加入 Metal 应用集成、用户 ROM 资源提取、触控操作与手柄连接管理，并预先编译游戏反编译代码。
requirements: A legally obtained supported US Super Smash Bros. 64 ROM is required.
An Apple Silicon Mac, Xcode and the build-guide dependencies are required for local builds.
Long-match audio, multitouch, reset, rotation and controller acceptance checks remain open.
The repository's rights and licensing terms are documented in RIGHTS_AND_LICENSES.md.

name: Future Cop: L.A.P.D.: a PlayStation static recompilation kit
description_en: Future Cop: L.A.P.D. configures PSXRecomp and a setup host to generate and compile the European PlayStation game locally from a user's disc and BIOS. The repository contains game identity, symbol seeds and build files; the author reports a Windows clean setup, compilation and headless start check.
description_zh: Future Cop: L.A.P.D. 配置 PSXRecomp 和构建宿主，从用户提供的欧洲版 PlayStation 光盘及 BIOS 在本地生成、编译游戏。仓库包含游戏版本识别信息、符号种子及构建文件；作者报告 Windows 环境完成了全新安装、编译和无界面启动检查。
requirements: Supply a matching SLES-01449 Future Cop: L.A.P.D. CUE/BIN or CHD image and your own SCPH-5552 European BIOS dump.
Linux and macOS setup require CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and C/C++ build tools.
Native setup and gameplay on Linux and macOS remain unverified.
Project-owned files use GPL-3.0-only; PSXRecomp and recomp-ui retain separate licences.

name: Azura: a native Gears of War 3 port from static recompilation
description_en: Azura builds a native macOS, Linux or Windows version of Gears of War 3 by translating the user's Xbox 360 PowerPC executable to C++ with ReXGlue. Its runtime replaces console services and graphics with Metal or Vulkan backends, while a Tauri launcher prepares the user's game files.
description_zh: Azura 使用 ReXGlue 将用户自备的 Xbox 360 版《Gears of War 3》PowerPC 可执行文件预先转换为 C++，构建 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 原生版本。运行时提供主机系统服务，并通过 Metal 或 Vulkan 后端处理图形；Tauri 启动器负责准备用户的游戏文件。
requirements: A supported Gears of War 3 copy with default.xex is required; supported editions are World, España and Latinoamérica.
The launcher supports Apple Silicon macOS 13.3+, Linux x86-64 with glibc 2.35+, or Windows 10/11 x86-64 with Vulkan.
Source builds require ReXGlue SDK 0.10.0 and the platform toolchain described in the README.
Online co-op and multiplayer are not yet available.
Azura code uses PolyForm Strict License 1.0.0; patches retain their upstream licenses.

name: Champions of Norrath: matching PS2 function reconstruction
description_en: Champions of Norrath reconstructs C functions for the PlayStation 2 release SLUS-20565 and compares compiled output byte for byte with the user's game copy. The saved decompdecomp project separates matching functions from unfinished attempts. The author reports 6,018 matches among 8,984 functions.
description_zh: Champions of Norrath 为 PS2 版本 SLUS-20565 重建 C 函数，并将编译结果与用户自有游戏副本逐字节比较。保存的 decompdecomp 项目区分已匹配函数和未完成尝试；作者报告 8,984 个函数中有 6,018 个匹配。
requirements: decompdecomp, the saved PS2 compiler setup, and a matching personal copy of the game are required.
Windows PS2 compilers require WSL 2; macOS is unsupported by the stated release.
The author reports 6,018 of 8,984 functions matching.
MIT applies only to contributor-authored original work, excluding reconstructed game code.

name: PSP2I_Recomp: a native Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity port
description_en: PSP2I_Recomp uses psprecomp to generate native code from Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity's PSP EBOOT.BIN and builds host programs for Windows, Android and experimental Apple Silicon macOS. Its source supplies game hooks, rendering, SDL3 input and audio integration.
description_zh: PSP2I_Recomp 使用 psprecomp 从 Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity 的 PSP EBOOT.BIN 生成原生代码，构建 Windows、Android 及实验性 Apple Silicon macOS 版本。仓库提供游戏钩子、渲染、SDL3 输入和音频集成代码。
requirements: A legally obtained copy of Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity with its EBOOT.BIN.
For the documented Windows build: Visual Studio C++ tools, CMake, Git, FFmpeg 9.0.1, SDL3 3.4.18 and psprecomp.
The 60 FPS mode is incomplete and ad hoc networking has limited support.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Hybrid Heaven: Recompiled: a native N64 port
description_en: Hybrid Heaven: Recompiled statically recompiles the USA release of Hybrid Heaven with N64Recomp into a Windows and Linux port. It supplies game-specific code loading, widescreen presentation and controller support; the author reports progress through the first battles.
description_zh: Hybrid Heaven: Recompiled 使用 N64Recomp 将美版 Hybrid Heaven 静态重编译为 Windows 和 Linux 程序，加入针对该游戏的代码加载、宽屏显示和控制器支持。作者报告目前已运行至最初的战斗。
requirements: A personally dumped Hybrid Heaven (USA) ROM matching the documented SHA-1, as .z64, .n64, .v64 or ZIP.
The port remains in early testing; only the start through the first battles has been played.
The project's own code is MIT licensed; distributed binaries link GPL-3.0 N64ModernRuntime.

name: PictoChat: a matching DSi system-title decompilation
description_en: PictoChat's standalone DSi system title is being reconstructed as matching C source for its ARM components. The workflow extracts a player's own title and BIOS dumps, compiles candidate functions with mwccarm and compares bytes with relocation awareness. The author reports 1,048 matched functions out of a current estimate of 1,551.
description_zh: 项目将 DSi 独立系统应用 PictoChat 的 ARM 组件重建为可匹配的 C 源码。流程从用户自有的应用和 BIOS 转储中提取文件，使用 mwccarm 编译候选函数并进行考虑重定位的逐字节比较。作者报告当前估计的 1,551 个函数中已有 1,048 个匹配。
requirements: User-supplied PictoChat title and ARM7 BIOS dumps are required.
The matching workflow uses the mwccarm 2.0 toolchain and documented Python packages.
The decompilation is incomplete; the dsd configuration is not yet populated.
MIT License for the repository's original work.

name: Forza Motorsport 3: Xbox 360 static recompilation for PC
description_en: Forza Motorsport 3 is being statically recompiled from its Xbox 360 PowerPC executable into C++ for a native Windows port. ReXGlue generates the code, while the project supplies console services and a launcher that installs and checks data from the user's two discs.
description_zh: 该项目使用 ReXGlue 将 Xbox 360 版 Forza Motorsport 3 的 PowerPC 可执行代码静态转换为 C++，并提供 Windows 运行时。启动器从玩家自己的两张光盘安装及校验游戏数据。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 x64; building requires MSVC, LLVM/Clang 20+, CMake 3.25+, Ninja, and Git for Windows.
Own copies of both supported USA game discs are required; Disc 1 supplies default.xex for code generation.
Career mode, local multiplayer, and other modes need more testing; Xbox Live is unavailable.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Xbox 360 Quake 4 decomp: static recompilation with a native renderer
description_en: Xbox 360 Quake 4 decomp builds a Windows port by translating a user-supplied Xbox 360 Quake 4 executable with ReXGlue and attaching game-specific hooks. Its alternate q4hle build routes the game's Direct3D calls through a native D3D11 renderer; the author reports testing the opening levels and documents remaining crashes and limited audio testing.
description_zh: Xbox 360 Quake 4 decomp 使用 ReXGlue 翻译用户自备的 Xbox 360《Quake 4》可执行文件，并接入游戏专用钩子，构建 Windows 移植版。另一种 q4hle 构建将游戏的 Direct3D 调用交给原生 D3D11 渲染器；作者报告已测试开头关卡，后续仍可能崩溃，音频测试也有限。
requirements: A legally obtained Xbox 360 copy of Quake 4.
Windows 10/11, Visual Studio 2022 with Clang tools, CMake 3.25+, Ninja, Git and the matching ReXGlue SDK.
The author has tested only the first couple of levels; later play and audio remain limited.
GPL-2.0 license.

name: Golden Sun Recompiled for Android: an on-device recompilation port
description_en: Golden Sun Recompiled for Android ports the Golden Sun recompilation workflow to Android and builds game code from the player's ROMs on the device. It supports Golden Sun and The Lost Age, with touch controls, renderer options and save transfer between the games.
description_zh: Golden Sun Recompiled for Android 将 Golden Sun 重编译流程移植到 Android，并在设备上从玩家的 ROM 构建游戏代码。应用支持 Golden Sun 和 The Lost Age，提供触屏控制、渲染方式选择及两作之间的存档继承。
requirements: Personally obtained Golden Sun ROMs; The Lost Age ROM is optional.
About 800 MB of free device storage for processing each game.
The author describes the port as beta and reports limited device testing; its cross-game continuation mode is still under test.
The bundled engine uses the PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license, which limits the port to noncommercial use.

name: wage-engine: a World Builder adventure engine reimplementation
description_en: wage-engine reimplements the World Builder engine for classic Mac graphic text adventures in Java. It loads Mac resource data for scenes, characters, objects, sound, and scripts, and converts script bytes into readable commands.
description_zh: wage-engine 用 Java 重建经典 Mac 图文冒险游戏的 World Builder 引擎。它读取场景、角色、物品、声音及脚本的 Mac 资源数据，并将脚本字节转换为可读命令。
requirements: World Builder game files are required as input.

name: Weltall: rebuilding Xenogears in Unreal Engine 5
description_en: Weltall rebuilds the PlayStation game Xenogears as a native Unreal Engine 5 port that reads content from the user's disc images. Its source implements field and battle rendering, game systems, input, saves, and disc-data handling. The author reports checking gameplay behavior against the original code and completing a playthrough of both discs.
description_zh: Weltall 使用 Unreal Engine 5 将 PlayStation 游戏 Xenogears 重建为原生移植版，并从用户自己的光盘镜像读取内容。源码实现了场景与战斗渲染、游戏系统、输入、存档和光盘数据处理。作者报告已将玩法行为与原始代码比对，并完成两张光盘的通关。
requirements: A user-supplied USA Xenogears disc set or supported English undub is required.
Windows 10 or 11 x64 with a DirectX 12 GPU, or 64-bit Linux with a Vulkan driver, is required for the documented desktop builds.
Japanese retail discs are not playable; raw-sector images preserve movie audio, while 2048-byte ISO images have silent movies.
MIT licence for the project code.

name: DOD13-Client: reconstructing the Day of Defeat 1.3 client library
description_en: DOD13-Client reconstructs the Day of Defeat 1.3 client library function by function on hlsdk-portable for Xash3D FWGS. It replaces client.dll or client.so, restores weapons, HUD, effects, movement, and menus, and documents engine messages and client mechanics.
description_zh: DOD13-Client 在 hlsdk-portable 基础上逐函数重建《Day of Defeat 1.3》的客户端库，供 Xash3D FWGS 替换 client.dll 或 client.so。项目恢复武器、HUD、特效、移动和菜单，并记录引擎消息及客户端机制。
requirements: An owned Day of Defeat Steam installation and a current Xash3D FWGS developer build.
C99 and C++11 compiler with Python 3 or CMake 3.15+ for desktop builds.
The author reports Windows x86 and Android checks; Windows x64 and Linux builds have not been played, and the macOS build has not been run on a Mac.
Half-Life 1 SDK license for the code, with third-party parts under their own licenses.

name: GHMetalRecomp: a Windows static recompilation of Guitar Hero: Metallica
description_en: GHMetalRecomp statically recompiles the Xbox 360 Guitar Hero: Metallica executable for native Windows play using ReXGlue and the user's disc. Its game-specific code and launcher add controller and microphone support, display options and fixes described in per-issue engineering notes.
description_zh: GHMetalRecomp 使用 ReXGlue 和用户自备光盘，将 Xbox 360 版《Guitar Hero: Metallica》静态重编译为 Windows 原生程序。游戏专用代码和启动器提供控制器、麦克风与显示设置，工程笔记逐项记录修复过程。
requirements: An owned USA or Europe Xbox 360 disc image of Guitar Hero: Metallica is required.
Windows 10 or 11, a Vulkan-capable GPU and the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable are required.
The author labels the port beta; drums, AMD graphics cards and Wii or PS3 instruments were untested at the stated release.
MIT license for project code.

name: BIT.TRIP COMPLETE: a Wii decompilation
description_en: BIT.TRIP COMPLETE is an in-progress Wii decompilation of game ID SVTEXS. Its decomp-toolkit configuration splits the DOL into build objects from a user-supplied disc image, while objdiff supports function comparisons. The repository includes a small set of game-specific C++ sources and build hashes.
description_zh: BIT.TRIP COMPLETE 是针对 Wii 游戏编号 SVTEXS 的进行中反编译工程。decomp-toolkit 配置从用户提供的光盘镜像拆分 DOL 并生成构建对象，objdiff 用于比较函数；仓库包含少量游戏专属 C++ 源码及构建哈希。
requirements: An existing copy of the game disc image is required in orig/SVTEXS.
Python and Ninja are required for configuration and build.

name: UniSpy Server: rebuilding GameSpy services in Python
description_en: UniSpy Server rebuilds GameSpy online services in Python using published GameSpy protocol research and an earlier server library as references. Its source organizes handlers for chat, game status, traffic relay, NAT negotiation, presence, query reporting, server browsing, and web services. The project documents Docker-based setup with PostgreSQL and Redis.
description_zh: UniSpy Server 参考公开的 GameSpy 协议研究及早期服务器库，以 Python 重建 GameSpy 在线服务。源码按聊天、游戏状态、流量中继、NAT 协商、在线状态、查询上报、服务器浏览及网页服务组织处理模块。项目提供基于 Docker、PostgreSQL 和 Redis 的部署说明。
requirements: Docker setup uses PostgreSQL and Redis services.
The Python server is a rewrite of an earlier C# implementation.
Licensed under AGPL-3.0.

name: The Urbz: Sims in the City: Nintendo DS ARM9 disassembly and function map
description_en: urbz-re investigates the USA Nintendo DS release of The Urbz: Sims in the City through an ARM9 split, assembly listings, symbol names, and function notes. Its build script checks a user-supplied ROM and regenerates assembly with ds-decomp 0.12.1. The source tree has no matched C yet; the author reports that 280 ARM9 functions have been read.
description_zh: urbz-re 研究美版 Nintendo DS 游戏 The Urbz: Sims in the City，以 ARM9 拆分配置、汇编清单、符号命名和函数笔记记录发现。构建脚本校验用户提供的 ROM，并使用 ds-decomp 0.12.1 重新生成汇编。目前没有匹配的 C 源码；作者报告已研读 280 个 ARM9 函数。
requirements: A personal copy of the USA ASIE ROM is required.
ds-decomp 0.12.1 and Python 3 are used for the build.
Matched C has not started; the CodeWarrior compiler version remains unidentified.
No licence file in the repository.

name: OpenTESArena: a new engine for The Elder Scrolls: Arena
description_en: OpenTESArena rebuilds the 1994 DOS game The Elder Scrolls: Arena in a new C++ engine using separately obtained game assets. It implements combat, items, shops, citizens, travel, and most character creation, while documenting original-game behavior and parsing Arena asset formats. Quests, spells, and saving remain unfinished.
description_zh: OpenTESArena 用新的 C++ 引擎重建 1994 年 DOS 游戏 The Elder Scrolls: Arena，游戏资源由用户另行获取。项目实现了战斗、物品、商店、市民、旅行及大部分角色创建功能，记录原版游戏的运行机制，并解析 Arena 资源格式。任务、法术和存档功能仍未完成。
requirements: The Elder Scrolls: Arena game data must be obtained separately; the repository does not distribute game assets.
Building from source requires Git, CMake, SDL 2.0.12, OpenAL Soft 1.19.1, and Vulkan 1.3.280; WildMIDI 0.5.0 is required for music.
Plate item materials, potions, quests, spells, and loading or saving are not yet implemented.
MIT license.

name: Nightmare Creatures II: a PlayStation local recompilation kit
description_en: Nightmare Creatures II provides a title-specific psxrecomp setup kit for the USA PlayStation release. A setup wizard accepts the user's disc image and SCPH-1001 BIOS, then generates and compiles the game locally through psxrecomp and recomp-ui. The repository includes game configuration, symbols and setup code.
description_zh: Nightmare Creatures II 为美版 PlayStation 游戏提供专用 psxrecomp 构建套件。安装向导接收用户的光盘镜像和 SCPH-1001 BIOS，再通过 psxrecomp 与 recomp-ui 在本地生成并编译游戏；仓库包含游戏配置、符号信息和安装代码。
requirements: The user's own SLUS-01112 disc image and SCPH-1001 USA BIOS dump.
On Linux and macOS, CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and a C/C++ compiler are required for setup.
The author reports Windows setup and headless startup checks; Linux and macOS gameplay remain untested.
GPL-3.0-only license for project-owned files.

name: rr-pc-port: reconstructing a playable Ridge Racer race on PC
description_en: rr-pc-port reconstructs a playable PC race slice of the 1994 PlayStation Ridge Racer by re-expressing game logic in portable C. It ports selected functions and fixed-point driving behavior, reads course and resource data from the user's local game files, and renders through an optional SDL2 host. Its roadmap separates confirmed behavior from documented approximations.
description_zh: rr-pc-port 将 1994 年 PlayStation 版 Ridge Racer 的游戏逻辑改写为可移植 C 代码，在 PC 上重建可玩的比赛片段。项目移植部分函数和定点数驾驶行为，从用户本地游戏文件读取赛道与资源数据，并可通过 SDL2 显示；路线文档区分已确认行为与近似实现。
requirements: Provide your own Ridge Racer game files for course, texture, sound and executable data.
Build with a host GCC or Clang toolchain; SDL2 is optional.
The port is a partial race slice, with some behavior documented as approximate.
MIT License.

name: Rewritten: a functional reconstruction of Minecraft Xbox 360 Title Update 2
description_en: Rewritten is a functional C++ decompilation project for Minecraft Legacy Console Edition Title Update 2 on Xbox 360. It aims to recreate the game's behavior without byte matching; the contribution notes describe using a patched TU2 XEX with Ghidra or IDA Pro.
description_zh: Rewritten 是针对 Xbox 360 版《Minecraft》旧主机版 Title Update 2 的 C++ 功能性反编译项目。项目以重现游戏行为为目标，不追求逐字节匹配；贡献说明介绍了如何使用修补后的 TU2 XEX，以及 Ghidra 或 IDA Pro。
requirements: The game at Title Update 2 and its assets are required.
Building requires Windows, XDK v2.0.21119 and CMake.
Build instructions are incomplete.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Rampage: a SkoolKit disassembly of the ZX Spectrum game
description_en: Rampage documents the ZX Spectrum game's code as a SkoolKit disassembly. Its source tree contains the .skool listing and reference files, with a script to generate a browsable HTML version.
description_zh: Rampage 使用 SkoolKit 记录 ZX Spectrum 游戏代码的反汇编。仓库含 .skool 清单和引用文件，并提供生成可浏览 HTML 版本的脚本。
requirements: An original copy of Rampage is required to disassemble the game code.
Install SkoolKit or point SKOOLKIT_HOME to a SkoolKit checkout to build the HTML output.
No licence file in the repository.

name: Panzer Dragoon Saga: Saturn asset-format research and extraction tools
description_en: This Panzer Dragoon Saga project investigates Sega Saturn disc and asset formats. The repository documents MCB/CGB models, CPK video, PRG subtitles and audio formats, with Python extractors and browser viewers. The author reports results for model, video, music, font and texture extraction and conversion.
description_zh: 该项目研究 Sega Saturn 游戏《Panzer Dragoon Saga》的光盘和资源格式，记录 MCB/CGB 模型、CPK 视频、PRG 字幕及音频格式，并提供 Python 提取工具和浏览器查看器。作者报告了模型、视频、音乐、字体和纹理的提取与转换成果。
requirements: A personally supplied Panzer Dragoon Saga raw Mode 2 .bin disc image is required.
Python 3.6 or newer is required; FFmpeg is needed for video muxing, and a WebGL browser for viewers.
PCM extraction and some 2D format parsing remain unfinished.
MIT License.

name: Tony & Friends: New Adventures: a reccmp-guided decompilation
description_en: Tony & Friends: New Adventures reconstructs C and C++ source for the 1999 32-bit Windows game and its bundled sound library. It builds with period Visual C++ toolchains and uses reccmp to compare functions against the original TONY2.EXE; the author reports a few documented near matches.
description_zh: Tony & Friends: New Adventures 重建这款 1999 年 32 位 Windows 游戏及附带声音库的 C/C++ 源码。项目使用对应年代的 Visual C++ 工具链构建，并通过 reccmp 与原版 TONY2.EXE 比对函数；作者称仍有少量已记录的近似匹配。
requirements: Visual C++ 5.0 SP3, Visual C++ 6.0 RTM, CMake and Python 3 are required for the documented build and comparison.
An original TONY2.EXE is required for reccmp comparison.
Build output targets 32-bit Windows; some functions remain documented near matches.
LGPL-3.0 license.

name: Diddy Kong Racing: matching N64 decompilation
description_en: Diddy Kong Racing reconstructs the N64 game's source code and builds against a user-supplied ROM. It extracts assets locally and compares rebuilt function assembly with the base ROM; the author reports complete decompilation for the default US version while documentation remains unfinished.
description_zh: Diddy Kong Racing 重建 N64 游戏源码，使用用户提供的 ROM 在本地提取资源，并将重编译函数的汇编与原版 ROM 比较。作者报告默认美版的反编译已完成，文档整理仍未完成。
requirements: An original Diddy Kong Racing ROM is required to extract assets.
Builds require the documented compiler, make and platform dependencies.
The author reports 100.00% decompilation and 69.02% documentation progress for us.v77 as of October 1, 2026.
CC0-1.0 license.

name: The Sims Bustin' Out: early GameCube decompilation and symbol mapping
description_en: The Sims Bustin' Out GameCube decompilation targets the USA Rev 0 G4ME69 release. It combines decomp-toolkit build configuration, initial C files, and custom scripts that infer possible symbol matches from another GameCube decompilation. The author describes the split mapping as very early and largely heuristic.
description_zh: The Sims Bustin' Out 的 GameCube 反编译针对美版 Rev 0、编号 G4ME69。工程结合 decomp-toolkit 构建配置、初始 C 文件与自制脚本，借助另一个 GameCube 反编译项目推测符号对应关系。作者说明当前拆分映射仍属早期阶段，主要依赖启发式比较。
requirements: An existing GameCube disc image for G4ME69 is required.
Python and Ninja are required for the documented build.
The split mapping is early and the heuristic symbol comparisons had not been manually reviewed when documented.
MIT.

name: Professor Layton: Pandora's Box HD: rehosting the Android game on Vita
description_en: This Vita port runs Professor Layton: Pandora's Box HD by loading its Android ARMv7 executable, resolving imports with native functions, and applying compatibility patches. The loader uses game files supplied from an Android APK and OBB, with version 1.0.1 documented as tested.
description_zh: 该 Vita 移植版加载《Professor Layton: Pandora's Box HD》的 Android ARMv7 可执行文件，通过原生函数解析导入项并应用兼容补丁。加载器使用用户从 Android APK 和 OBB 提供的游戏文件；文档记录了 1.0.1 版的测试。
requirements: Provide a legally obtained Android APK and OBB from a version that still uses OBB; version 1.0.1 is documented as tested.
PS Vita setup requires kubridge, FdFix or rePatch, and libshacccg.suprx.
Some videos may fail to play and the post-puzzle animation can be slow.
MIT licence.

name: DexSQL
description_en: Queries classes, methods, fields, strings, call edges and Smali disassembly across Android APK and DEX files with SQL. Shipped as a single prebuilt binary that runs either as a local stdio MCP server (`dexsql mcp`) or as a standalone CLI (`dexsql query`).
description_zh: 使用 SQL 查询 Android APK 与 DEX 文件中的类、方法、字段、字符串、调用边及 Smali 反汇编。以单个预构建二进制发布，既可作为本地 stdio MCP 服务（`dexsql mcp`）运行，也可作为独立命令行工具（`dexsql query`）使用。
requirements: Download the matching prebuilt binary for Linux, macOS or Windows on x86_64 or arm64, and supply local APK or DEX files. The latest release at the pinned commit is v0.1.5; core engine source is unavailable.

The proprietary DexSQL Binary License 1.0 allows free use and verbatim redistribution of the unmodified archive but prohibits reverse engineering, modification and commercial redistribution of the binary. The installation skill, benchmark harness and documentation use the separate MIT LICENSE-AUXILIARY.
Author benchmarks use a 372 MiB QQ 9.3.55 APK with 41 DEX files for eight code-location queries; DexDec’s warm reference cache is faster on repeated direct-caller lookups.

name: PSPRecomp: statically recompiling GTA: Vice City Stories into a native Windows build
description_en: Provides a PSP static-recompilation framework that analyzes Allegrex/MIPS executables and emits C++ for a native host runtime. Its Vice City Stories profile checks in code generated for the US ULUS-10160 executable, plus HLE, Direct3D 12 rendering, audio and input layers. The decrypted executable and game data come from the user’s own copy, and no gameplay status is published.
description_zh: 提供 PSP 静态重编译框架，分析 Allegrex／MIPS 可执行文件并生成 C++，交由原生宿主运行时执行。其 Vice City Stories 配置档收录针对美版 ULUS-10160 可执行文件生成的代码，以及 HLE、Direct3D 12 渲染、音频与输入层。已解密的可执行文件和游戏数据需来自使用者自己的副本，项目未公布游戏运行状态。
requirements: Windows, Visual Studio 2022, MSVC, Direct3D 12, CMake 3.20 or newer and a C++20 compiler are required for the Vice City Stories profile.
Supply your own NTSC-U ULUS-10160 decrypted EBOOT matching the configured SHA-256 and PSP_GAME/USRDIR game data.
The profile builds VCSNative.exe for one PSP release; no gameplay compatibility or completion report is published. Missing functions and unsupported instructions stop execution.
ctest covers framework regressions and profile components, including synthetic graphics rendering, bootstrap paths and audio resampling.

Framework code is MIT. The profile includes FFmpeg (LGPL 2.1+), SMAA, HDR shader material, MIT Project2DFX-derived data and CloudWorks material (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0). The generated corpus and original game content retain their separate rights.

name: HaloPad: Halo on Apple devices through a decompilation port and x86 recompilation
description_en: Brings Halo: Combat Evolved to iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Macs through two engines. The Xbox edition builds a pinned OpenCE port of the community Xbox decompilation, while Custom Edition translates the user’s own haloce.exe 1.10 from x86 to ARM64 ahead of time, with HaloPad supplying Windows, Direct3D 9, input, audio and network services. The project discloses substantial AI assistance and records device results in a status log.
description_zh: 通过两套引擎将 Halo: Combat Evolved 带到 iPhone、iPad 和 Apple 芯片 Mac。Xbox 版构建固定版本的 OpenCE，即社区 Xbox 反编译成果的移植；Custom Edition 则将使用者自己的 haloce.exe 1.10 从 x86 提前转换为 ARM64，并由 HaloPad 提供 Windows、Direct3D 9、输入、音频和网络服务。项目披露了大量 AI 辅助，并在状态日志中记录设备测试结果。
requirements: Preview release 0.3.10 provides a PadMint recipe and checksums, with no public IPA. Personal builds contain Halo game code and must not be shared. Tested devices include iPad Pro 12.9-inch (6th generation), iPhone 14 and Apple silicon Macs; Xbox graphics still have differences.

Xbox edition needs the user’s original-Xbox Halo: Combat Evolved disc image; only USA maps build 01.10.12.2276 was tested. Custom Edition needs HaloCESetup.exe 1.00 and the user’s product key; the builder fetches Bungie’s 1.10 update. Retail Halo PC, Anniversary, Master Chief Collection and later games are unsupported.

iOS/iPadOS 17.4+ or macOS 14.4+ on Apple silicon. Building with PadMint needs an Apple silicon Mac, Xcode 26+ and about 35 GB free for the first Xbox build; the Xbox edition also has a GitHub Actions workflow. Custom Edition additionally needs Wine and pinned M-HT SR tools.
Known limits include first-use hitches, softer Xbox textures, occasional controller loss and DLL mods such as Chimera not loading.
No project-wide public license grant is stated; RIGHTS-STATUS.md says publication is not authorized. Reconstructed Bungie/Microsoft code and original game assets retain their rights.

name: UE5 BINKA to WAV
description_en: Rejoins UE5 BINKA audio exported by FModel and calls an external Bink decoder to produce WAV files, with a Windows GUI, batch CLI and paired-asset metadata warnings.
description_zh: 重新拼接 FModel 导出的 UE5 BINKA 音频，并调用外部 Bink 解码器生成 WAV，提供 Windows 图形界面、批量命令行和配对资源的元数据异常提示。
requirements: Windows and a separately obtained binkadec.exe that writes a proper WAV header. This proprietary decoder is not bundled. Running the source requires Python 3.9+; the GUI uses tkinter, and packaging uses PyInstaller.

Inputs are matching .ubulk and .uasset or .uexp files, or a complete .binka file. The wrapper locates the UEBA header, rejoins it with the bulk stream and delegates decoding. Other cooked codecs and inline-only assets are outside the documented scope.

For paired assets, sample-rate and channel mismatches or a duration difference above 2% become warnings. They do not fail the CLI exit code, and --quiet suppresses them. Direct .binka inputs have no original-asset metadata comparison; header checks do not establish audio fidelity.
MIT covers this repository code, not binkadec or game assets. The README credits FModel, BinkadecWithWavHeader and ue2wav prior art.

name: Silent Hill: matching PlayStation decompilation of the executable and overlays
description_en: Reconstructs Silent Hill’s PlayStation code, the main executable plus its engine, screen and map overlays, as C that rebuilds byte-identical binaries from the user’s own NTSC-U 1.1 disc image. The project focuses on matching and naming. decomp.dev reports every function matched for the pinned commit, while data migration, shiftable builds and documentation remain open.
description_zh: 将 Silent Hill 的 PlayStation 代码（主可执行文件及其引擎、界面和地图覆盖模块）重建为 C，可依据使用者自备的北美 1.1 版光盘镜像构建出逐字节一致的二进制文件。项目专注于匹配与命名。decomp.dev 报告所列提交的全部函数均已匹配，数据迁移、可重定位构建和文档工作仍待完成。
requirements: Target NTSC-U 1.1 (SLUS-00707); configurations also cover PAL 1.0 and three NTSC-J releases. The output is the PlayStation executable and overlays; the codebase is not port-ready.
Supply a personal NTSC-U 1.1 disc dump as one .BIN with the setup guide SHA-1 under rom/image. The repository includes some Sony PsyQ 4.3/4.4 library objects and prebuilt compiler and ISO tools.
The Make build uses Linux or WSL2, git, build-essential, MIPS binutils and cpp, Python 3, bchunk, 7z and recursive submodules. Native Windows Ninja builds are reported to mismatch.
The build compares SHA-256 hashes for the executable and overlays; the project reports 6,527 of 6,527 functions matched and 36.99% of data matched.
Project code is GPLv3; the game data and Sony SDK objects retain separate rights.

name: GoonFi V2: byte-identical Rust recompilation of a Solana program
description_en: OtterSec researchers describe an agent pipeline that reconstructed Rust source for the closed-source GoonFi V2 Solana program until a rebuild with the original toolchain reproduced the deployed ELF. Per-function instruction scoring, a deterministic merge judge and bans on assembly and other score-gaming constructs steered the agents; matching function order and panic-location paths closed the last differences. The article and a companion repository document the method and a verification script, while the internal tooling and agent transcripts remain unpublished.
description_zh: OtterSec 研究人员介绍了一套智能体流程：为闭源的 GoonFi V2 Solana 程序重建 Rust 源码，直至用原工具链重新构建即可复现所部署的 ELF。逐函数指令评分、确定性合并评审，以及对汇编等刷分写法的禁用约束引导智能体工作；对齐函数顺序和 panic 位置路径后，最后的差异得以消除。文章与配套仓库记录了方法和验证脚本，内部工具及智能体对话记录仍未公开。
requirements: The target is GoonFi V2 as deployed at slot 448984043; the live program was upgraded on 2026-10-06, so verification uses the earlier ELF.
The reconstruction uses the deployed binary, program IDL and on-chain transactions. The core agent harness, merge judge and transcripts are unpublished.

build.sh requires Linux x86-64 and downloads Solana platform-tools v1.48 (rustc 1.84.1-dev, LLVM 19.1.7). VERIFY.sh needs an Alchemy archive key or another archival RPC to recover the original ELF from deploy-transaction writes and compare it byte for byte.
The companion repository names no license for its reconstructed source; rights to the original closed-source program remain with its owner.

name: Jet Set Radio Future: early matching Xbox decompilation
description_en: An early matching decompilation of the North American standalone Xbox release of Jet Set Radio Future, hosted on Codeberg. Contributors delink default.xbe into per-source object files in Ghidra, then write C++ that compiles to matching objects with Visual C++ 7.0, compared with objdiff. Its README reports 1.50% of the XBE decompiled so far and disallows contributions made with large language models.
description_zh: 托管于 Codeberg 的早期一致性反编译项目，目标是 Jet Set Radio Future 北美单独发行版的 Xbox 可执行文件。贡献者先在 Ghidra 中把 default.xbe 拆分为对应各源文件的目标文件，再编写经 Visual C++ 7.0 编译后与之一致的 C++ 代码，并用 objdiff 比对。README 报告目前已完成整个 XBE 的 1.50%，并禁止使用大语言模型完成的贡献。
requirements: The project reports 1.50% of the XBE decompiled; linking a Windows executable and repackaging it for Xbox remain planned steps. No rebuilt executable or playable build is available yet. The Ghidra getting-started guide has TODO import instructions.
Contributors need default.xbe from the NTSC-U standalone Jet Set Radio Future disc. The repository supplies reconstructed sources and Ghidra import listings, without the game executable or assets.

Use Microsoft Visual C++ 7.0 (Visual C++ .NET 2002), Git, Java 21 or newer, Ghidra 12.0.3 with XboxDev XBE and ghidra-delinker-extension v0.8.0, and objdiff 3.8.1 with objdiff-cli on PATH. Outside Windows, run the compiler through Wine. The Microsoft compiler is separately licensed.

The repository is CC0 1.0; its Ghidra scripts directory includes GPL-3.0 text. Game and toolchain rights remain separate. The README prohibits contributions made with large language models or generative AI and merge requests from agent-driven forks.

name: darling-lol: running the macOS League of Legends client on Linux through Darling
description_en: Patches the Darling macOS compatibility layer so that Riot’s macOS League of Legends client and game run on x86-64 Linux. The changes span Darling and 30 of its components, including Metal/Indium, AppKit, QuartzCore, CoreAudio, the kernel shim and darlingserver, with build, install and launch tooling. It is an experimental rehosting layer; playability and frame-rate results are author-reported.
description_zh: 修补 Darling macOS 兼容层，使 Riot 的 macOS 版《英雄联盟》客户端与游戏能在 x86-64 Linux 上运行。改动覆盖 Darling 本体及其 30 个组件，包括 Metal／Indium、AppKit、QuartzCore、CoreAudio、内核垫片与 darlingserver，并附构建、安装和启动工具。这是实验性的兼容层重新托管方案；可玩性与帧率结果均为作者报告。
requirements: Requires x86-64 Linux 5.14+, X11 or Xwayland, and a hardware Vulkan/OpenGL driver. Only AMD RADV has been exercised; NVIDIA support is unverified. Building needs Git LFS, CMake, Clang/LLD with LLVM development files, Python 3.12+, Darling build dependencies, and at least 50 GB of disk. The experimental Nix flake builds the runtime locally.
