Applies patches to Darling and 30 pinned components. Riot and League clients launch and manually played ARAM matches have run; installation through Riot’s interface can stall. The README calls this a development snapshot.

Users supply the League client through Riot’s installer and sign in there. Game files, Riot installers, account data, Apple SDK binaries, and compiled runtimes are excluded from the repository. TESTING.md excludes debuggers, client API calls, hooks, and input automation.

Original tooling is GPL-3.0; patches retain their target files’ licenses, including GPL, LGPL, APSL, BSD, and Apache terms. The README warns that play in this environment can cause suspensions or permanent bans and advises against using it currently.

name: ReC98: the Touhou PC-98 Restoration Project
description_en: Reconstructs C++ and assembly source for the first five Touhou games, released by ZUN for the NEC PC-9801 in 1997–1998, under a rule that no master commit may change the decompressed program image or relocations of any original executable as compared by the project’s mzdiff tool. TH01 was fully decompiled in August 2022; code not yet decompiled stays in the tree as IDA-generated disassembly, and the project’s blog documents what each part of ZUN’s code does. Separate debloated and anniversary branches restructure the code and fix bugs as bases for ports and mods.
description_zh: 为 ZUN 于 1997–1998 年在 NEC PC-9801 上发布的前五部东方 Project 游戏重建 C++ 与汇编源码，并规定 master 分支的任何提交都不得改变任一原始可执行文件经解压后的程序映像或重定位，以项目自己的 mzdiff 工具比对。TH01 已于 2022 年 8 月完成全部反编译；尚未反编译的代码以 IDA 生成的反汇编形式保留在仓库中，项目博客则逐一记录 ZUN 代码各部分的作用。另有 debloated 与 anniversary 分支重组代码并修复缺陷，供移植与模组作为基础。
requirements: The project targets the first five Touhou PC-98 games. TH01 was fully decompiled in August 2022; other games remain in progress. Master permits only instruction-encoding differences and trailing zero padding under mzdiff; ports use the debloated branch and bug fixes use anniversary or single-fix branches.

Running the built PC-98 executables requires each game’s original files beside the output. The repository omits original asset data. Builds require Borland Turbo C++ 4.0J and Borland Turbo Assembler 5.0 or later (TASM32.EXE); neither is bundled.
Windows 11 x64 and Windows XP 32-bit are tier-1 build platforms; Wine on 64-bit x86 Unix is tier 2. The output runs in DOSBox-X or the project’s Neko Project II debug fork.

The root has no license file. Bundled MS-DOS Player and Tup builds are GPLv2; master.lib, the Pi loader, SPRITE16 and KAJA PMD files are third-party components. Rights to the original games remain with their owner.

name: LibrePods: AirPods features on Android and Linux through a reverse-engineered protocol
description_en: Implements the proprietary protocol that AirPods use with Apple devices, which the author reports reverse-engineering, so that Android and Linux apps can switch noise-control modes, read ear detection and accurate battery levels, and use conversational awareness, head gestures and hearing-aid settings. The repository documents captured packet formats, opcodes and control commands alongside the Android app and the Linux app. Several features need root on Android or remain experimental.
description_zh: 实现 AirPods 与苹果设备之间使用的专有协议（作者称由其本人逆向得出），使 Android 和 Linux 应用能够切换降噪模式、读取入耳检测和准确电量，并使用对话感知、头部手势和助听设置。仓库除 Android 应用和 Linux 应用外，还记录了抓包得到的数据包格式、操作码和控制命令。部分功能在 Android 上需要 root，或仍处于实验阶段。
requirements: Android release v1.0.4 is at the pinned main commit. The v2.0.0 Android rewrite is alpha; main contains the Qt 6 Linux app, and a Rust rewrite is on linux/rust. Find My, head-tracked spatial audio and high-quality two-way audio remain unknown, planned or experimental.
Use your own AirPods and a supported Android or Linux device. Protocol notes describe Bluetooth L2CAP traffic observed on AirPods Pro 2 (USB-C) firmware 7A305; other models and firmware may differ.

On Android, root and Xposed are needed for the Bluetooth-stack workaround except on ColorOS/OxygenOS 16, realme UI 7.0 and Pixel devices on Android 16 QPR3. Vendor-ID-hook features always need root. The Linux app needs CMake 3.16+, Qt 6, OpenSSL and libpulse.
Android CI builds FOSS APKs; the Rust Linux branch has a binary build workflow. The repository has no published protocol conformance suite.

License: GPL-3.0-or-later. Some UI components are Apache-2.0. Apple fonts, product images and AirPods firmware retain their own rights; the Android build includes SF Pro and AirPods images, and the Linux app uses SF Symbols 6.

name: Fallout 2 Reference Edition: reverse-engineered C source of the original engine
description_en: Restores C source for Fallout 2’s Windows engine from the original binary, keeping as close to the original as possible with all its imperfections. The resulting fallout2-re.exe is a drop-in replacement for fallout2.exe that runs on the user’s own GOG or Steam copy. README says a few non-essential functions remain undecompiled; the code became the basis of the separate Fallout 2 Community Edition, and its author calls wide publication legally questionable.
description_zh: 依据原始二进制文件还原《辐射 2》Windows 引擎的 C 源码，力求连同原有缺陷在内尽量贴近原版。构建出的 fallout2-re.exe 可直接替换 fallout2.exe，运行使用者自己的 GOG 或 Steam 版游戏。README 称仍有少数非关键函数尚未反编译；这份代码后来成为独立的 Fallout 2 Community Edition 的基础，作者本人则认为向公众广泛发布在法律上存疑。
requirements: A personal Fallout 2 installation, including the GOG or Steam editions, supplies the game data. Copy the built fallout2-re.exe into that directory in place of fallout2.exe.
CMake 3.13 or newer builds a 32-bit Windows executable; CI uses Visual Studio 2019 for Win32. The project uses Win32 and DirectX interfaces.
A few non-essential functions remain undecompiled. CI compiles the executable; the repository has no tests or binary matching checks.
Sustainable Use License 1.0 permits internal, personal and non-commercial use and free non-commercial distribution. Bundled zlib and fpattern retain their own licenses.

name: PsyZ
description_en: C porting library that replaces the API of PSY-Q, Sony's PlayStation runtime library, with native implementations, so decompiled or original PlayStation source can be compiled for Linux, macOS, iOS, Windows, WebAssembly and PSP while still building for the console. It aims at PSY-Q API compatibility and offers an optional GPU and SPU emulation layer behind emulated MMIO endpoints, and carries a matching decompilation of the PSY-Q 4.0 libraries.
description_zh: 用 C 编写的移植库，以原生实现替换 Sony PlayStation 运行时库 PSY-Q 的 API，使反编译得到的或原有的 PlayStation 源码能够在 Linux、macOS、iOS、Windows、WebAssembly 和 PSP 上编译，同时仍可为主机本身构建。它以 PSY-Q API 兼容为目标，另提供经由仿真 MMIO 端点访问的可选 GPU 与 SPU 仿真层，并包含对 PSY-Q 4.0 库的匹配反编译。
requirements: CMake 3.21 or newer, a C11 compiler, SDL3 and a recursive clone of the SDL, cimgui and nugget submodules are needed; WebAssembly builds use Emscripten.

A game port needs reconstructed C source and the changes in the porting guide, including ordered-table and primitive-tag types and 64-bit pointer fixes. The PSY-Q decompilation is ongoing; hardware-dependent game bugs may behave differently.
Optional PlayStation SDK setup downloads proprietary PSY-Q 4.0 and 4.7 SDK archives hosted by the project to cross-compile and check the decompiled libraries.
CI tests Linux, Windows, macOS and PSP builds; the reported Symphony of the Night prologue comparison is a single author measurement.
Licensing varies: nugget, psyq2elf, samples and ztest are MIT; psyz/src/platform and psyz/src/psyz are MPL-2.0; psyz/include and psyz/src/psyq are unlicensed; decomp/ has its own MIT license.

name: DirectMusic: an open reimplementation of Microsoft’s music API
description_en: Re-implements DirectMusic, the adaptive-soundtrack API Microsoft shipped with early DirectX, as a portable C11 library that loads a game’s segment, style and DLS instrument files and renders the music to PCM. The README lists only the Gothic and Gothic II (Night of the Raven) soundtracks as tested, and as working “somewhat” correctly; the project calls itself incomplete and under heavy development. Instruments play through a vendored TinySoundFont synthesizer after DLS-to-SoundFont conversion.
description_zh: 以可移植的 C11 库重新实现 DirectMusic，即 Microsoft 随早期 DirectX 提供的自适应配乐 API；它载入游戏的段落（segment）、风格（style）和 DLS 音色文件，并将音乐渲染为 PCM。README 只列出 Gothic 与 Gothic II（含 Night of the Raven）的配乐经过测试，且只是“大致”正确；项目自称尚不完整、仍在大力开发中。乐器经 DLS 转 SoundFont 后由内置的 TinySoundFont 合成器发声。
requirements: The C11 library exposes its own DmLoader, DmSegment and DmPerformance API. End-and-intro embellishment, some curves and message types remain unimplemented.
Users supply their own .sgt segments, .sty styles and .dls collections from game data through a resolver callback; the repository ships none of these files.
Building needs a C11 compiler and CMake 3.10+. Linux, macOS and Windows are supported. The play-segment example needs <unistd.h> and <sys/stat.h>.

The README reports the Gothic and Gothic II soundtracks working “somewhat” correctly. CI builds the library for Linux, Android, macOS and Windows; no test suite or Microsoft runtime output comparison is listed.
LICENSE.md grants the MIT License (Modern Variant) for project code. TinySoundFont, miniaudio and the Gothic II theme rendering have separate rights; game music retains its rights.

name: Apple Data Formats and Knowledge
description_en: The Hack Different community's knowledge base on Apple hardware, firmware and operating-system internals, set up and largely maintained by Rick Mark, which pairs a long categorized link list with original pages and machine-readable YAML data. The README groups references from Mach-O, the dyld shared cache, img4 and boot policy to the Secure Enclave, basebands, USB and Lightning, wireless protocols and diagnostic formats, while the data folder holds 56 topic files plus per-device, certificate and firmware-key records on devices, chips, IPSW builds, Mach-O constants, NVRAM, boot arguments, lockdownd services and entitlements. Rake tasks regenerate parts of the data from Apple's update feeds, The iPhone Wiki and local Apple binaries, and the data is also published as apple-data packages for Ruby, Python and Node.js.
description_zh: Hack Different 社区维护的 Apple 硬件、固件与操作系统内部机制知识库，由 Rick Mark 搭建并主要维护，将一份篇幅很长的分类链接列表与原创页面和机器可读的 YAML 数据结合在一起。README 按领域整理参考资料，从 Mach-O、dyld 共享缓存、img4 和启动策略，到安全隔区（Secure Enclave）、基带、USB 与 Lightning、无线协议以及诊断数据格式；数据目录则有 56 个主题文件，另有按设备、证书和固件密钥分列的记录，涵盖设备、芯片、IPSW 版本、Mach-O 常量、NVRAM、启动参数、lockdownd 服务和权限（entitlements）。仓库中的 Rake 任务会从 Apple 的更新源、The iPhone Wiki 和本机 Apple 二进制文件重新生成部分数据，这些数据也以 apple-data 软件包形式发布到 Ruby、Python 和 Node.js 生态。
requirements: Reading needs a browser. Building the Jekyll site and running Rake tasks needs Ruby 4.0.5 and Bundler; BUILD.md covers macOS and Debian/Ubuntu setup with hunspell and overcommit hooks. Tasks deriving data from Mach-O binaries or kernel collections read Apple software on the user’s Mac.
The data-format guide calls the formats v0 and subject to change; several README topics are headings without links.

The keybags data includes bootloader firmware decryption keys and IVs credited to The iPhone Wiki; the symbols folder includes listings from Apple frameworks. The README also links jailbreaks, exploit write-ups and third-party Apple boot ROM copies.

The README states code and data are MIT-licensed and documents are also CC BY-SA 4.0. It excludes contributions based on AppleInternal or other DMCA-protected material; linked projects and Apple software keep their own terms.

name: memory of alessa: an in-progress Silent Hill 3 PS2 matching decompilation
description_en: Decompiles the PS2 executable and 40 overlays of Silent Hill 3 (NTSC-U v1.02) into C for Metrowerks CodeWarrior, and works alongside on the Silent Hill 2 engine, whose debug symbols from a 2001 prototype supply original names for shared code. Builds link with generated assembly for unmatched functions and are checked by SHA-256 against committed hashes. The README calls the project early-stage; decomp.dev reports about 9% of Silent Hill 3 functions and 58% of Silent Hill 2 functions matched at the pinned commit.
description_zh: 将 Silent Hill 3（《寂静岭 3》，NTSC-U v1.02）的 PS2 可执行文件及 40 个覆盖模块反编译为面向 Metrowerks CodeWarrior 的 C，同时反编译 Silent Hill 2 引擎，借助 2001 年原型版的调试符号为共享代码提供原始命名。构建时尚未匹配的函数仍使用生成的汇编，链接结果以 SHA-256 对照仓库中提交的哈希。README 称项目尚处早期；decomp.dev 报告所列提交时 Silent Hill 3 约 9%、Silent Hill 2 约 58% 的函数已匹配。
requirements: Targets Silent Hill 3 NTSC-U v1.02 (SLUS_206.22) and the Silent Hill 2 engine from the 0.10 VW047-U1 prototype. Builds use assembly for unmatched functions; the project reports 718/8,002 and 2,530/4,371 functions matched respectively.
Supply the Silent Hill 3 SLUS_206.22 executable and B0.MFA archive; the optional Silent Hill 2 build needs prototype SLUS_202.28 and its overlays.

Hosts are x86-64 Linux, Apple Silicon macOS or Windows through WSL, with Python 3, wget and build tools. make downloads CodeWarrior PS2 3.0.3 for Silent Hill 3 or 2.4 for Silent Hill 2, wibo, PS2 binutils v0.10 and objdiff; it uses the mwccgap submodule.
diff.sh compares the rebuilt executable and overlays with SHA-256 entries; outside CI a mismatch does not fail make. CI uses a private container image.

Project code is MIT; the games and assets retain separate rights. Fifteen files carry Sony confidential notices, and the vsm trees contain disassembled VU microcode. The project prohibits LLM contributions from 2026-09-26.

name: Azel: reverse engineering Panzer Dragoon Saga into native C++
description_en: Reconstructs the Sega Saturn RPG Panzer Dragoon Saga as native C++, rewriting the game’s SH-2 routines for its kernel, field, town, battle, menu and audio systems. The rewritten code loads the user’s original disc files and reads their tables by Saturn address, rendering through bgfx and SDL with ImGui debugging views. README calls the project very early: the opening is semi-playable, with bugs, up to the Arachnoth battle, and no byte-matching rebuild is attempted.
description_zh: 将 Sega Saturn 角色扮演游戏 Panzer Dragoon Saga 重建为原生 C++，重写了游戏内核、野外、城镇、战斗、菜单和音频系统的 SH-2 例程。重写后的代码载入使用者自备的原版光盘文件，并按 Saturn 地址读取其中的数据表，通过 bgfx 和 SDL 渲染，另有 ImGui 调试视图。README 称项目仍处于很早期：游戏开头部分可勉强游玩（有错误），直到 Arachnoth 战斗为止；项目也不尝试逐字节一致的重建。
requirements: Supply disc 1 files from your own copy of Panzer Dragoon Saga in data/; the game loads original .MCB/.CGB bundles. The README names no region or version.
Windows builds use Visual Studio 2022, CMake, recursive submodules and vs2022.bat. The README reports the opening as semi-playable, with bugs, through the Arachnoth battle.

The project is MIT-licensed; submodules keep their own licenses. The vendored aosdk includes BSD, zlib, GPL and an old MAME license that forbids commercial use. Original game files and sample music retain their rights holders' terms.

name: OpenTS2: an open-source reimplementation of The Sims 2 in Unity
description_en: Reimplements The Sims 2 in the Unity engine, reading the user’s Ultimate Collection installation through its own C# code for the game’s DBPF packages and asset formats, which the project also aims to offer as modular libraries. README reports an early stage: a basic main menu with a neighborhood chooser, neighborhood previews and a basic neighborhood view, while the tree also holds lot, build-mode, Sim and SimAntics code. README credits FreeSO for much of its code and structure.
description_zh: 在 Unity 引擎中重新实现《模拟人生 2》，以自行编写的 C# 代码读取使用者终极典藏版安装中的 DBPF 包和各类素材格式，项目也希望把这些代码提供为模块化的库。README 称项目尚处早期：已实现带社区选择器的基础主菜单、社区信息预览和基础社区视图，而仓库中另有地块、建造模式、模拟市民和 SimAntics 相关代码。README 致谢 FreeSO 提供了大量代码和结构。
requirements: OpenTS2 runs from the Unity editor and uses Unity 2020.3.32f1; Visual Studio 2019 is recommended. The README lists a basic menu and neighborhood views as current progress and names no supported play platforms.
Supply The Sims 2 Ultimate Collection. Copy config.example.json to config.json and set the game, user-data, expansion, and stuff-pack directories.

The repository has no releases or tags and does not supply the game installation. Its test packages include apparent excerpts of game data, including an effects package expected to contain 1,792 particle effects.
CI runs Unity Test Runner tests for DBPF packages and related fields; the README also describes integration test scenes.
LICENSE.md uses MPL-2.0. Bundled third-party components retain their own terms; The Sims 2 and its game data belong to Electronic Arts.

name: Skate 3 Mobile: an Android ARM64 fork of Skate3Recomp
description_en: Carries the Skate3Recomp static recompilation of the Xbox 360 Skate 3 to Android: rexglue translates the configured PowerPC guest functions, and Android Clang compiles them into ARM64 libraries linked against a compatibility runtime. Runtime hooks pass the game’s meshes, textures and shader state to a native Vulkan scene renderer, and this fork adds SDL3 input and audio, a multitouch overlay and handheld performance profiles. The author calls it an experimental developer build that is playable on the Anbernic RG406V.
description_zh: 将 Xbox 360 版《Skate 3》的 Skate3Recomp 静态重编译移植到 Android：rexglue 转译所配置的 PowerPC 客体函数，再由 Android Clang 编译为 ARM64 库，并与兼容运行时链接。运行时钩子把游戏的网格、纹理和着色器状态交给原生 Vulkan 场景渲染器；这一分支另行加入 SDL3 输入与音频、多点触控覆盖层以及掌机性能配置。作者称其为实验性的开发者构建，可在 Anbernic RG406V 上游玩。
requirements: Android 13+, ARM64 with ARMv8.2 FP16 and dot-product support, Vulkan, and about 8 GiB of free app storage. The RG406V is the verified device; the developer build has visual bugs, missing effects and device-specific problems.

Players supply an ISO dumped from their own supported USA or Europe Xbox 360 copy. The app verifies it by SHA-256 and installs Title Update 3, downloaded by default from a third-party title-update site or selected manually. Source builds require extracted default.xex, EAWebKit XEX and Title Update 3.

Source builds need Android SDK 35, NDK r27c, JDK 17+, CMake, Ninja, Clang and recursive submodules, including the Android rexglue runtime fork. Optional Adreno Turnip driver packages are user supplied.
The v2.1 release checks report eight passing automated suites, APK checks and an RG406V startup, rendering and resume test. The 60 FPS setting is a guest cap.
The fork declares no license for its own code. The rexglue runtime fork carries a BSD-3-Clause notice, libadrenotools is BSD-2-Clause, and Electronic Arts retains rights to Skate 3.

name: pymobiledevice3
description_en: Pure Python 3 library and command-line tool for communicating with iPhones, iPads and other iOS devices from Windows, Linux or macOS, implementing usbmux, lockdown and its services, DTX-based developer (DVT) services and the RemoteXPC tunnels that iOS 17+ uses for developer access. Commands cover device discovery and port forwarding, syslog and crash-report collection, AFC file access, app and profile management, PCAP capture of device traffic, Bluetooth HCI logging, WebInspector automation with a Chrome DevTools Protocol bridge for Safari and WebViews, and DVT tooling such as process monitoring and screenshots; firmware update, recovery/DFU and backups are also handled. Its protocol-internals documentation walks through the usbmux, lockdown, DTX and RemoteXPC layers, and helper scripts in misc/ sniff plist and RemoteXPC traffic.
description_zh: 纯 Python 3 实现的库和命令行工具，可在 Windows、Linux 或 macOS 上与 iPhone、iPad 等 iOS 设备通信，实现了 usbmux、lockdown 及其服务、基于 DTX 的开发者（DVT）服务，以及 iOS 17+ 开发者访问所用的 RemoteXPC 隧道。命令涵盖设备发现与端口转发、syslog 和崩溃报告收集、AFC 文件访问、应用与描述文件管理、设备流量 PCAP 抓包、蓝牙 HCI 日志、借助 Chrome DevTools 协议桥调试 Safari 和 WebView 的 WebInspector 自动化，以及进程监控、截图等 DVT 工具；也支持固件更新、恢复／DFU 模式和备份。其协议内部文档逐层讲解 usbmux、lockdown、DTX 和 RemoteXPC，misc/ 中的辅助脚本可嗅探 plist 和 RemoteXPC 流量。
requirements: Version v11.38.0 was published to GitHub and PyPI on 2026-10-19. The README names PyPI as the only official distribution channel and says third-party packages such as AUR may be outdated. Requires Python 3.9+.

Needs a connected or networked iOS device the user controls. Windows needs iTunes for the Apple Mobile Device Service and Linux needs usbmuxd; macOS uses the system usbmuxd. OpenSSL is required for iOS versions before 13 and libusb for recovery/DFU. The tunnels guide says iOS 17.4+ developer commands open an in-process tunnel without root, while iOS 17.0-17.3.1 on Linux or Windows needs a root tunneld.

Developer services require Developer Mode and Apple's Developer Disk Image. The auto-mounter's developer_disk_image dependency downloads Apple image files from a separate rehosting repository; Apple's files retain Apple's rights.
GPL-3.0-or-later. The repository also ships a device-operator agent skill for driving devices through the CLI.

name: SwitchWakerHD: a Nintendo Switch port of the Wind Waker HD recompilation
description_en: Ports the ZeldaWWHDRecomp static recompilation of The Wind Waker HD to the Nintendo Switch as homebrew, adding a libnx platform layer and a renderer that draws the game’s GX2 graphics with deko3d, with translated shaders compiled on the console by uam. Game code is recompiled locally from the user’s own Wii U dump, so no Switch binaries are released. README reports the game playable handheld and docked at stock clocks, at 26–30 fps in its own measurements, and states that nearly all of the Switch work was written by Claude Code under human direction and hardware testing.
description_zh: 将 ZeldaWWHDRecomp 对《塞尔达传说 风之杖 HD》的静态重编译以自制软件形式移植到 Nintendo Switch，新增 libnx 平台层和以 deko3d 绘制游戏 GX2 图形的渲染器，转换后的着色器在主机上由 uam 编译。游戏代码由使用者自己的 Wii U 转储在本地重编译生成，因此不发布 Switch 版二进制。README 报告游戏在默认频率下于掌机和底座模式均可游玩，其自测帧率为 26–30 fps，并说明几乎全部 Switch 移植工作由 Claude Code 在人工指导和实机测试下编写。
requirements: Requires the user’s own Wii U dump of the USA or European release, version 0 without the update. Disc extraction needs the disc key and Wii U common key; the runtime checks code/cking.rpx. NRO files and shader caches built from the dump contain game content and must not be shared.

Builds need Python 3 with pycryptodome and devkitpro/devkita64 in Docker or Podman, or native devkitPro on Windows. The game runs on a Switch with Atmosphère and Homebrew Menu, launched in title mode for sufficient memory. Generated code needs substantial memory per compiled file.

The project reports handheld and docked play at stock clocks, around 26–30 fps in its measurements, with sound, saves, save states and mods. Testing focused on the opening island, Dragon Roost and surrounding sea; known issues are in docs/switch-port.md. CI tests desktop and Android runtimes with placeholder guest code; the Switch NRO is built and tested on hardware.

This fork retains ZeldaWWHDRecomp desktop and Android targets while adding a Switch platform layer and renderer. The author reports that Claude Code wrote nearly all Switch work under human direction and hardware testing.
Code is MPL-2.0. Vendored Cemu, uam, {fmt}, Dear ImGui, xxHash and metal-cpp retain their licenses; game content retains its owner’s rights.

name: Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver: a fork reporting a complete LLM-agent decompilation
description_en: Continues pret’s HeartGold/SoulSilver disassembly in a separate fork that reports the US Nintendo DS releases fully decompiled to C and C++ with LLM agents, while both ROMs still rebuild byte-for-byte against their retail SHA-1s. A checked-in progress report counts about 99% of mapped code bytes as C or C++, and a batch-by-batch work log records each replaced assembly range and the hash checks that followed. README says pret does not accept AI-generated code and does not want to be associated with the fork.
description_zh: 在另一个分叉中延续 pret 的《宝可梦 心金／魂银》反汇编项目，报告已借助大语言模型智能体将美版 Nintendo DS 游戏完全反编译为 C 和 C++，两个 ROM 仍可按零售版 SHA-1 逐字节重建。仓库中的进度报告将约 99% 的已映射代码字节计为 C 或 C++，逐批次的工作日志记录了每段被替换的汇编范围及其后的哈希校验。README 说明 pret 不接受 AI 生成的代码，也不希望与该分叉产生关联。
requirements: The fork reports HeartGold and SoulSilver builds matching the US retail ROM SHA-1 hashes. Its HeartGold progress snapshot counts 97.9% of mapped code bytes as C, 1.4% as C++ and 0.6% as original assembly; INSTALL.md defines this as a source-language measure.

Builds require a legally obtained Metrowerks mwccarm 2.0/sp2p2 compiler and license file, plus tools/bin and linker templates from a Nitro SDK archive. Both proprietary inputs are supplied by the user. The repository includes DS filesystem assets under files/ and decompiled libraries under lib/.

Linux requires binutils-arm-none-eabi, Wine, Python 3, libpng, pkg-config and pugixml. Windows uses devkitARM under Cygwin or MSYS2; macOS requires 10.15 or later and Rosetta 2 on Apple silicon. The build checks ARM binaries, filesystem and ROM hashes; the fork’s GitHub build workflow is disabled.
The repository has no license file. Its README reports LLM-agent assistance and asks contributors to keep this fork’s code out of pret/pokeheartgold; pret prohibits LLM-generated contributions.

name: Validity90: reverse engineering a Validity/Synaptics fingerprint-reader protocol
description_en: Reverse engineers the USB protocol of the Validity/Synaptics laptop fingerprint readers 138a:0090, 138a:0094, 138a:0097, 06cb:0081 and 06cb:009a, aiming at a written specification and a free libfprint driver. The repository holds a draft specification of the initialization sequence and of the modified TLS 1.2 handshake the readers use, a Wireshark Lua dissector that decrypts traffic after the key exchange, and a standalone C prototype that talks to a reader over libusb. The README calls the prototype extremely ugly code to be rewritten for the driver, and marks the integrated libfprint driver as not ready.
description_zh: 逆向分析 Validity/Synaptics 笔记本指纹读取器 138a:0090、138a:0094、138a:0097、06cb:0081 和 06cb:009a 的 USB 协议，目标是写出协议规范和自由的 libfprint 驱动。仓库包含初始化流程及这些读取器所用改版 TLS 1.2 握手的规范草稿、一个在密钥交换后解密通信的 Wireshark Lua 解析器，以及一个通过 libusb 与读取器通信的独立 C 原型。README 称原型代码非常粗糙，编写驱动时会完全重写，并注明集成到 libfprint 的驱动尚未就绪。
requirements: The README reports prototype scanning and image output for 138a:0090, scanning for 138a:0097, and initialization and LEDs without scanning for 06cb:009a. The integrated libfprint driver is not ready; configuration, pre-TLS key exchange, device operations and image format remain in progress.

The prototype needs a listed USB reader and read access to the machine DMI product serial for its session key. Its Makefile permissions target uses sudo. On Linux it builds against NSS, OpenSSL, libgcrypt, libusb-1.0, libpng and GLib. The dissector needs Wireshark Lua and lua-lockbox.
make test checks utility functions and one initialization-response parse. Device results are recorded in the README status table and prototype logs.
License: LGPL-2.1-or-later for the project code; the libfprint copy and submodule retain their own notices. The published specification and prototype contain recovered keys and byte sequences.

name: Open Steam Controller: reverse-engineered Steam Controller firmware
description_en: Documents the reverse engineering of Valve's original Steam Controller, whose LPC11U37F main-processor firmware the author ran in a modified pinkySim simulator to log its hardware accesses, and uses the findings to write replacement firmware. Build options turn the controller into a USB-serial development board for querying its peripherals, or into a wired Nintendo Switch controller that presents itself as a PowerA pad. A Qt converter writes MusicXML songs as startup and shutdown jingles into an EEPROM area that the official firmware also reads, and notes record the board's pin connections and USB messages.
description_zh: 记录对 Valve 初代 Steam Controller 的逆向工程：作者在修改版 pinkySim 模拟器中运行其 LPC11U37F 主处理器固件并记录硬件访问，再据此编写替代固件。不同构建选项可让手柄成为通过 USB 串口查询外设的开发板，或伪装成 PowerA 手柄、供 Nintendo Switch 使用的有线控制器。Qt 转换工具可把 MusicXML 乐曲写入官方固件同样会读取的 EEPROM 区域，作为开机和关机提示音；另有文档记录主板引脚连接和 USB 消息。
requirements: The replacement firmware targets the Steam Controller Luna_mainboard V000456-00 rev3 board and its LPC11U37F processor. The nRF51822 Bluetooth firmware remains original.

A Steam Controller with that board is needed to run the custom firmware or jingle workflow. Repeating the simulation requires Valve’s vcf_wired_controller_d0g_57bf5c10.bin firmware and an LPC11U37 16 kB boot ROM dump, supplied separately.

Firmware builds use LPCXpresso IDE v8.2.2 and the bundled NXP lpc_chip_11uxx_lib; select DEV_BOARD_FW or SWITCH_WIRED_POWERA_FW in fw_cfg.h. SCJingleConverter uses Qt 5.12; SteamControllerConfig.py uses PyUSB.

Author source files carry MIT notices; the bundled NXP LPCOpen library is limited to NXP microcontrollers. The repository has no license file. The custom firmware embeds default jingle data from Valve firmware and a HID report descriptor copied from a PowerA controller.

name: wasmdec
description_en: Command-line decompiler that parses a WebAssembly binary or text-format module with Binaryen and emits pseudo-C: globals, imported and defined functions with their locals and control flow, and a preamble of C helpers for WebAssembly operations. Several modules can be decompiled into one file with module-name prefixes, a memdump mode writes the module’s memory and table to files instead, and an Emscripten build of wasmdec powers an online demo. Development stopped at version 1.2.1 in 2018.
description_zh: 命令行反编译器，借助 Binaryen 解析 WebAssembly 二进制或文本格式模块，输出伪 C 代码：包括全局变量、导入与已定义的函数及其局部变量和控制流，并附带实现 WebAssembly 运算的 C 辅助函数前导部分。可将多个模块反编译到同一文件并以模块名作前缀；memdump 模式则改为把模块的内存和表写入文件。wasmdec 自身的 Emscripten 构建支撑着一个在线演示。开发停留在 2018 年的 1.2.1 版。
requirements: Source builds need g++ with C++14, Make, CMake and the Binaryen, cxxopts and WebAssembly testsuite submodules; GCC 7 or newer is recommended. The 1.2.1 download is a Linux x86-64 archive.

Input is a .wasm binary or .wast text module. The asm.js mode needs a compile-time flag that the Makefile does not set; parsing relies on the pinned 2018 Binaryen and may reject newer WebAssembly features.
Output is pseudo-C. Tests decompile seven bundled fixtures and spec testsuite cases and check exit status.
The examples include machine-translated code from the commercial game diep.io; rights to that output remain with the original owner.
The project is MIT; Binaryen, cxxopts and the testsuite submodules retain their own licenses.

name: dumpulator
description_en: Python library that emulates user-mode code from minidumps of 64-bit and 32-bit Windows processes with Unicorn. Because the dump supplies the full process memory, only system calls are emulated, and analysts can call functions, run code between two addresses, trace instructions and read results such as decrypted strings. The README presents it for malware analysis, such as configuration extraction and unpacking, and for dynamic analysis generally; syscalls can be reimplemented or hooked in Python with typed structure declarations.
description_zh: 基于 Unicorn 的 Python 库，用于模拟 Windows 64 位和 32 位进程 minidump 中的用户态代码。由于转储提供了完整的进程内存，只需模拟系统调用，分析者即可调用函数、在两个地址之间运行代码、跟踪指令，并读取解密后的字符串等结果。README 将其用于恶意软件分析（如配置提取和脱壳）及一般的动态分析；可用 Python 重新实现或挂钩系统调用，并以类型化方式声明结构体。
requirements: The README calls dumpulator a prototype. PyPI release 0.2.6 and the source setup.cfg version 1.0.0 differ; version 1.0.0 has no release.
Input is a full-memory minidump of the analyst’s target process. At the pinned commit, 38 of 463 declared Zw* syscalls have handlers; the others raise NotImplementedError.
Python 3.9+, unicorn ~=2.0.0, pefile and capstone ~=4.0.2. A patched minidump parser is vendored. CI tests on Windows Server 2019 with Python 3.9.
CI downloads project-hosted x64 and x86 test minidumps and runs the getting-started scripts and exception tests. The full-process fixtures include loaded Windows system modules.
LICENSE is BSL-1.0. Emulation reflects one memory snapshot and the implemented syscalls.

name: Ember Mug: reverse-engineered Bluetooth LE characteristics
description_en: Documents the Bluetooth Low Energy GATT interface of Ember smart mugs, worked out from an Ember Mug 2 and a decompiled copy of the Android Ember app. Per-characteristic pages give UUIDs, read, write and notify methods and byte layouts for the mug name, LED colour, current and target temperature, temperature unit, battery and charging status, liquid level and state, date and time zone, firmware and hardware versions, and push events. A separate page lists the analytics fields that the decompiled app sends to Ember’s collection server.
description_zh: 记录 Ember 智能马克杯的低功耗蓝牙 GATT 接口，依据一只 Ember Mug 2 和反编译的 Android 版 Ember 应用推断得出。各特征页面给出 UUID、读取／写入／通知方式及字节布局，涵盖杯子名称、LED 颜色、当前温度与目标温度、温度单位、电量与充电状态、液位与液体状态、日期与时区、固件与硬件版本以及推送事件。另有一页列出反编译应用向 Ember 数据收集服务器发送的分析字段。
requirements: The documentation covers observations from an Ember Mug 2; other Ember mugs may differ. Some characteristic meanings are tentative, including a battery byte likely to be voltage and liquid level that seems to update only while charging.

Applying the findings needs an Ember mug and a BLE client that reads, writes and subscribes to characteristics under service UUID fc543622236c4c948fa9944a3e5353fa. Writing 0000 as target temperature turns the heater off.
The findings were derived from a decompiled Android APK. The repository includes documentation and short excerpts of Ember app code, with no client code or tests.
The documentation is MIT-licensed; quoted Ember app code retains Ember’s rights.

name: BM2 Battery Monitor: reconstructing an encrypted BLE voltage protocol
description_en: Reimplements the Bluetooth Low Energy protocol of the BM2 (Battery Monitor 2) car battery monitor for independent voltage readings. A Python client built on Bleak decrypts the monitor's AES-encrypted notifications to read the current voltage and request the stored voltage history, an ESPHome template exposes the voltage from an ESP32, and example apps view and dump readings or forward them over MQTT. The author's write-up reports that the key and packet layout were recovered from the vendor app; results are author- and contributor-reported.
description_zh: 重新实现 BM2（Battery Monitor 2）汽车电池监测器的低功耗蓝牙协议，使其读数无需厂商的 Android 应用即可使用。基于 Bleak 的 Python 客户端会解密监测器以 AES 加密的通知，读取当前电压并请求设备存储的电压历史；ESPHome 模板可在 ESP32 上提供电压读数，示例应用则用于查看、导出读数或通过 MQTT 转发。作者的说明称密钥和数据包格式是从厂商应用中恢复的；结果均为作者及贡献者报告。
requirements: The bm2 0.1.0 package requires Python 3.8+. The client reads current voltage and history; history timestamps are inferred at two-minute intervals, while the ESPHome template reads current voltage only.
Supply a BM2 monitor and its Bluetooth address. The client and ESPHome template include the AES-128-CBC key recovered from the vendor app.

The Python client uses Bleak ~0.14.2 and PyCryptodome; its reconnect path calls Linux bluetoothctl. MQTT adds paho-mqtt ~1.6.1. The ESPHome template targets a nodemcu-32s ESP32 with Arduino, mbedtls and Wi-Fi, MQTT and MAC secrets.
The repository has a mypy check but no tests or CI. The history fix reports testing on Linux Mint 22.3 with a PowerHouse BM2 N2099A; coverage of other BM2 models is unspecified.
Code is MIT under LICENSE.txt; the device and vendor app retain their rights.

name: qc_debug_monitor
description_en: Python monitor by Dmytro Oleksiuk (Cr4sh) that reads debug messages from Qualcomm cellular-modem firmware in real time over the modem's DIAG serial port, on a rooted Android phone or a USB modem. It enables message reporting for chosen 16-bit subsystem IDs, prints or logs text messages with their firmware source file and line, and decodes terse messages, which carry only a 32-bit format-string hash and arguments, when given a hash database. A discovery mode lists the subsystem ID ranges a modem answers to, and logs can be split into one file per subsystem.
description_zh: 由 Dmytro Oleksiuk（Cr4sh）编写的 Python 监视工具，通过调制解调器的 DIAG 串口实时读取高通蜂窝调制解调器固件的调试消息，可用于已 root 的 Android 手机或 USB 调制解调器。它为选定的 16 位子系统 ID 开启消息上报，输出或记录附带固件源文件名和行号的文本消息；提供哈希数据库时，还能解码只含 32 位格式字符串哈希及参数的精简（terse）消息。发现模式可列出调制解调器响应的子系统 ID 范围，日志也可按子系统分别写入单独文件。
requirements: Run the Python 2 script with pySerial and access to a serial device such as /dev/ttyUSB0; the README uses sudo. The repository has no tags or releases.
A Qualcomm modem with an exposed DIAG serial port is required. The documented Quectel EC25 example uses an MDM9607; other devices may need subsystem ranges found with discovery mode.

Terse-message decoding requires an external database of Qualcomm firmware debug-message hashes. The README gives no provenance or reuse terms for that database; without it, terse messages remain undecoded.
The README describes example logs from an EC25 connected to an srsLTE eNodeB and labels subsystem descriptions as guesses. The repository contains no firmware images, and the project has no tests.
The repository has no license file or license statement.

name: McSema
description_en: Archived Trail of Bits executable lifter that translates 32- and 64-bit Linux ELF and Windows PE binaries into LLVM bitcode for analysis or recompilation. Control-flow recovery runs in mcsema-disass, which relies on IDA Pro to write a protobuf CFG, and mcsema-lift then translates instructions through the Remill library; the README lists most x86 and x86-64 integer, x87, MMX, SSE and AVX instructions plus subsets of AArch64, SPARC32 and SPARC64. Lifted bitcode can go through LLVM passes, KLEE or libFuzzer, or be compiled back into a runnable program.
description_zh: Trail of Bits 开发、现已归档的可执行文件提升器，可将 32 位和 64 位 Linux ELF 与 Windows PE 二进制转换为 LLVM bitcode，用于分析或重新编译。控制流恢复由 mcsema-disass 完成，它依赖 IDA Pro 输出 protobuf 格式的控制流图，随后 mcsema-lift 借助 Remill 库翻译指令；README 列出其支持大部分 x86 与 x86-64 整数、x87、MMX、SSE 和 AVX 指令，以及 AArch64、SPARC32 和 SPARC64 的部分指令。提升得到的 bitcode 可交给 LLVM 优化遍、KLEE 或 libFuzzer 处理，也可重新编译成可运行的程序。
requirements: The archived repository is read-only. The README supports LLVM 9–11; v3.0.24 has prebuilt archives for Ubuntu 18.04 and 20.04 amd64.

Control-flow recovery requires IDA Pro 7.5+. The experimental DynInst frontend is unsupported. Builds need CMake 3.14+, Python 3.8 with protobuf and clang bindings, and pinned Remill and Anvill commits. macOS and Windows builds are experimental or untested.

Inputs are analyst-supplied compiler-generated ELF or PE binaries. Limitations.md excludes packed, encrypted, obfuscated and self-modifying code and raw firmware blobs; it also notes exception and floating-point limitations.
The repository includes Maze examples, prebuilt test CFGs and an encrypted Binary Ninja CI archive.
AGPL-3.0; IDA Pro, Binary Ninja and LLVM retain their own terms.

name: retoolkit
description_en: Windows setup program, built with Inno Setup, that installs a ready-made x86/x64 reverse-engineering and malware-analysis toolkit as selectable components: debuggers, decompilers, hex editors, PE, ELF, .NET, Java, Go, Delphi and AutoIt analyzers, and process-inspection, unpacking, network, OLE/PDF and signature tools. Tools open from a desktop launcher or from a retoolkit entry in Explorer's right-click menu that passes the selected file; the README says some come preconfigured, such as x64dbg with plugins and command-line tools that run from any directory. The repository holds only the installer scripts, while the bundled programs are third-party tools under their own terms.
description_zh: 基于 Inno Setup 构建的 Windows 安装程序，以可选组件的形式安装一套现成的 x86/x64 逆向工程与恶意软件分析工具集：调试器、反编译器、十六进制编辑器，PE、ELF、.NET、Java、Go、Delphi 和 AutoIt 分析工具，以及进程检查、脱壳、网络、OLE/PDF 和特征匹配工具。可从桌面启动器打开工具，也可通过资源管理器右键菜单中的 retoolkit 项把所选文件直接交给工具；README 称部分工具已预先配置，例如带插件的 x64dbg，以及可在任意目录运行的命令行工具。仓库只包含安装脚本，打包的程序都是第三方工具，各自适用其条款。
requirements: Release 2026.04 was published on 2026-05-16 as a roughly 2 GB 7z archive containing the setup program. The main branch also adds copyright and attribution notices and adjusts the Nmap and Wireshark scripts.

For x86 and x64 Windows hosts; the JDK component, which is also installed with Ghidra, runs only in 64-bit install mode. The README says some included tools are not open source and come from uncertain sources, advises installing the toolkit only in a virtual machine at the user's own responsibility, and notes that Windows Defender may flag files during installation. Analysis inputs are the user's own samples.

The .iss scripts copy tool files from a local source folder that is not in the repository, so the setup program cannot be rebuilt from the repository alone; CHECKSUMS.txt lists MD5 hashes for 35,444 bundled files.

COPYING.txt applies Apache-2.0 to the installer scripts; every bundled program keeps its own license. Besides open-source tools such as Ghidra, x64dbg and ImHex, CHECKSUMS.txt lists executables for pestudio, HxD, API Monitor with its kernel drivers, Exeinfo PE and Resource Hacker, and the installers jdk-25_windows-x64_bin.exe and npcap-1.87.exe. The README states that only software authorized for redistribution by its license or by its authors is included.

name: Snake & Apple: macOS internals and security article series
description_en: Code repository for Karol Mazurek’s Snake & Apple article series on macOS internals and security research. Chapters cover Mach-O, code signing, binary hardening checks, dylibs and dyld, AMFI, antivirus components, the App Sandbox and SIP, TCC and the XNU kernel, plus app bundles, and the README links each article and its follow-ups. CrimsonUroboros, the series’ LIEF-based Python analysis tool, grows with each chapter and groups its options by those topics, and smaller scripts parse trust caches, code signatures, sandbox profiles and TCC databases.
description_zh: Karol Mazurek 的 Snake & Apple 系列文章的代码仓库，内容是 macOS 内部机制与安全研究。各章涵盖 Mach-O、代码签名、二进制加固检查、dylib 与 dyld、AMFI、防病毒组件、App Sandbox 与 SIP、TCC 和 XNU 内核，另有应用包相关主题，README 链接了每篇文章及其后续文章。系列的核心工具 CrimsonUroboros 基于 LIEF 用 Python 编写，随章节逐步扩充，并按上述主题分组提供选项；另有一些小脚本用于解析信任缓存、代码签名、沙盒配置文件和 TCC 数据库。
requirements: Articles are hosted on Medium, Patreon and the AFINE blog, with one in Phrack. Asterisk-marked articles require paid Patreon access; the Apple Intelligence chapter is unfinished.

The tools target macOS and Mach-O files. CrimsonUroboros needs Python and pinned dependencies including LIEF 0.15.1, pyimg4, asn1crypto, treelib, xattr and python-magic. Chapter directories retain earlier versions.

Each chapter’s mac folder holds macOS source for reference and copies of presentations. The repository includes third-party PDFs and a decompiler listing of a private Apple LaunchServices function; their redistribution terms are unspecified.
The repository declares GPL-3.0. Apple software, decompiled Apple code and third-party presentations retain their own rights. A test module covers CrimsonUroboros.

name: D-810 ng
description_en: A refactored, updated fork of Boris Batteux's D-810 IDA Pro plugin that deobfuscates code at decompilation time by rewriting Hex-Rays microcode. Z3-verified instruction rules simplify mixed-boolean-arithmetic, opaque predicates and constant obfuscation across maturity levels, while control-flow unflatteners restore natural flow from O-LLVM, Tigress, Approov and Hodur (PlugX) dispatcher patterns. Rules are declared in a configurable DSL and project JSON, so new patterns can be added without editing the source, and optional Cython extensions speed up the hot paths with pure-Python fallbacks.
description_zh: 对 Boris Batteux 的 D-810 IDA Pro 插件进行重构和更新的分支，在反编译时通过改写 Hex-Rays 微码来反混淆代码。经 Z3 验证的指令规则可在多个成熟度层级上简化混合布尔算术、不透明谓词和常量混淆，控制流反扁平化器则可从 O-LLVM、Tigress、Approov 和 Hodur（PlugX）等分发器模式中还原自然控制流。规则以可配置的 DSL 和项目 JSON 声明，无需修改源码即可添加新模式；可选的 Cython 扩展用于加速热点路径，并提供纯 Python 回退实现。
requirements: IDA 9 or later with Python 3.10+ is required. Copy the repository into IDA’s plugins directory and load it with Ctrl-Shift-D. The README warns that incorrect microcode edits can crash IDA.

The pure-Python install uses pip install -e .; optional Cython speedups clone the public MIT-licensed Hex-Rays IDA SDK unless IDA_SDK names an existing copy. The z3-solver helper installs into an isolated user directory, configurable with D810_SPEEDUPS_DIR.
The committed LICENSE is AGPL-3.0, while the README states LGPL v3. The project credits Boris Batteux’s D-810 and Rolf Rolles’s HexRaysDeob.

name: Anvill
description_en: Trail of Bits machine-code lifter built on Remill that aims to produce high-quality LLVM bitcode, close to what Clang would emit for a semantically equivalent C function, for Rellic to decompile further into C. Its anvill-decompile-spec tool lifts the functions and global variables described in a Protobuf specification of a binary's low-level ABI information into LLVM IR or bitcode, and LLVM passes lower Remill intrinsics and recover stack frames, jump tables and switches. The README says the main branch reads specifications from an in-development, closed-source Ghidra plugin, while open-source Binary Ninja spec generation remains at the binja-final-version tag.
description_zh: Trail of Bits 基于 Remill 开发的机器码提升器，目标是生成高质量的 LLVM bitcode，使其接近 Clang 编译语义等价的 C 函数时产生的结果，再交由 Rellic 进一步反编译为 C。其 anvill-decompile-spec 工具读取描述二进制底层 ABI 信息的 Protobuf 规格文件，把其中的函数和全局变量提升为 LLVM IR 或 bitcode；一组 LLVM 遍负责降级 Remill 内建函数，并恢复栈帧、跳转表和 switch 结构。README 称 main 分支读取的规格文件由一个仍在开发、尚未开源的 Ghidra 插件生成，开源的 Binary Ninja 规格生成脚本则保留在 binja-final-version 标签中。
requirements: The latest GitHub release is v0.1.39 (2021-02-22); later tags reach v0.2.1. The pinned master commit is six commits ahead of that tag, with its last code change dated 2022-12-06.
Linux was tested on Ubuntu 20.04. CMakeLists.txt requires CMake 3.19; the README also lists Clang 12+, Remill, Python 3.9 and Ghidra. CI builds with LLVM 14 and 15 on Ubuntu 20.04 and macOS 11.

anvill-decompile-spec requires a Protobuf specification of functions, globals and memory ranges. The README directs open-source users to the binja-final-version tag; CI installs a Ghidra spec generator from a private repository. Supported calling conventions include x86, x86-64, AArch32, AArch64 and SPARC.
CI uses encrypted Binary Ninja archives and passphrase-protected AMP challenge binaries for integration tests.
License: AGPL-3.0. Enable unit tests with -DANVILL_ENABLE_TESTS=true.

name: XRefer
description_en: A Python plugin for IDA Pro from Google's FLARE team that adds a custom navigation interface. XRefer traces execution paths from entry points, groups the binary into clusters of related functions, and surfaces downstream behaviors and artifacts, with path graphs for context. It can ingest external data such as API traces from the VMRay and CAPE sandboxes, capa results and user-defined indirect cross-references. An optional integration sends extracted artifacts to Google's Gemini model to generate natural-language descriptions of code relationships and cluster-based function labels.
description_zh: Google FLARE 团队为 IDA Pro 开发的 Python 插件，提供自定义导航界面。XRefer 从入口点追踪执行路径，将二进制划分为相关函数的聚类，并呈现下游行为和产物，配以路径图提供上下文。它可以摄入外部数据，如来自 VMRay 和 CAPE 沙箱的 API 跟踪、capa 结果以及用户自定义的间接交叉引用。可选的集成会把提取的产物发送给 Google 的 Gemini 模型，生成代码关系的自然语言描述和基于聚类的函数标签。
requirements: IDA Pro with Python. Install through hcli or copy plugins/ into IDA’s plugins directory, install requirements.txt, and restart IDA. The asciinet dependency needs a JRE on PATH.
Optional enrichment accepts VMRay and CAPE API traces, capa output and user-defined indirect cross-references.
When enabled, optional LLM features send extracted APIs, strings, library references and function relationships to external services such as Google Gemini; all LLM features can be disabled.
The repository includes two AES-encrypted third-party sample archives under test_samples/ without documented passwords or provenance.
License: Apache-2.0 for the plugin.

name: dsdump (paradiseduo wrapper)
description_en: Python wrapper around a prebuilt copy of Derek Selander's dsdump, an improved nm and Objective-C and Swift class-dump for Mach-O binaries, that writes each dumped protocol, class, category and Swift type to its own .h or .swift file instead of a single console stream. It runs the bundled executable once with --objc and once with --swift for the chosen arm64 or armv7 slice, and -d demangles Swift names through Xcode's swift-demangle at a speed cost. The README now points users to the author's resymbol instead.
description_zh: 围绕 Derek Selander 的 dsdump 预编译副本编写的 Python 封装。dsdump 是改进版的 nm 及 Objective-C 与 Swift class-dump 工具，用于 Mach-O 二进制；该封装把导出的每个协议、类、分类和 Swift 类型分别写入单独的 .h 或 .swift 文件，而不是全部输出到控制台。它针对所选的 arm64 或 armv7 架构分别以 --objc 和 --swift 运行随附的可执行文件，-d 选项借助 Xcode 的 swift-demangle 还原 Swift 名称，但会降低速度。README 现已建议用户改用作者的 resymbol。
requirements: macOS and Python 3 are needed to run the bundled x86-64 dsdump executable from the repository directory. -a accepts arm64 or armv7; -d needs Xcode command-line tools for swift-demangle.
Supply a Mach-O executable for analysis. The wrapper parses dsdump output into Objective-C headers and Swift declarations, with some Swift method names shown as <stripped>.
The repository has no tests. Its README recommends the author’s resymbol replacement.
The repository and archived upstream have no license file for the wrapper or bundled executable.

name: outrun: a Sonic Runners custom server
description_en: Reimplements the game server for the Sonic Runners mobile game as a Go service, so Android and iOS clients redirected to it can log in, play Timed and Story modes and use the shop, roulettes, character and Chao progression, events, notices and basic rankings. The README says it was reverse engineered from the Sonic Runners Revival server, on whose code it bases much of its own; it serves about 40 HTTP endpoints of the client's API, decrypts and encrypts AES-CBC request payloads and keeps player state in a bbolt database.
description_zh: 以 Go 服务重新实现手游 Sonic Runners 的游戏服务器，使改为连接它的 Android 和 iOS 客户端能够登录、游玩计时模式和故事模式，并使用商店、轮盘、角色与 Chao 养成、活动、公告和基础排行榜。README 称它是从 Sonic Runners Revival 服务器逆向而来，自身大量代码也以该服务器为基础；它提供客户端 API 的约 40 个 HTTP 端点，对 AES-CBC 请求载荷进行解密和加密，并用 bbolt 数据库保存玩家状态。
requirements: Release v1.0.1 provides Windows, macOS and Linux server builds for amd64 and arm64. The README aims to cover every non-debug endpoint; no tests are listed.

Builds with Go. go.mod declares Go 1.17, while the README build steps use Go 1.15.8 and warn that Go 1.16+ breaks some RPC programs. Configuration uses config.json and optional event, info and game files; the default client port is 9001.
Play needs the user’s Sonic Runners client. The README targets the v2.0.3 Android APK, modified to connect to the server. The repository contains no client or game assets.
The README credits contributors for the client-traffic AES key, traffic logs and story-mode data.
Server code is GPL-3.0; the game, client, assets and trademarks retain their own rights.

name: Smart ring protocol: documenting the Oura Ring BLE protocol and event format
description_en: Documents the Oura Ring Bluetooth Low Energy request and response framing, request tags and payloads, and binary event stream. The BLE notes are confirmed on Oura Ring 4. Many packets remain unknown. The author says the event reference and Node.js parser were generated from the Oura app event-parser library and await manual verification.
description_zh: 记录 Oura Ring 蓝牙低功耗请求与响应的帧结构、请求标签及载荷，以及二进制事件流。BLE 笔记在 Oura Ring 4 上得到确认。许多数据包仍未知。作者称事件参考文档和 Node.js 解析器依据 Oura 应用的事件解析库生成，尚待人工验证。
requirements: The repository documents the Oura Ring BLE framing and event stream, currently for Oura Ring 4. Many packet fields remain unknown.
Use an Oura Ring 4 for the confirmed BLE notes. The repository documents per-device authentication and key recovery from an iOS app backup.
The Node.js events parser derives from the Oura Android app 6.2.0 event-parser library; later app or firmware versions may differ.
The event notes and parser are author-reported AI-generated work awaiting manual verification. The repository has no tests or CI.
The repository has no license file; reuse rights for the notes and parser are unstated.

name: open-desk-lamp-firmware: replacement firmware for the Xiaomi desk lamp
description_en: Replaces the ESP8266-based Xiaomi desk lamp firmware with an open implementation of the lamp's local power, dimming and colour-temperature controls, based on the documented board wiring.
description_zh: 根据主板接线，为基于 ESP8266 的小米台灯实现替代固件，提供本地开关、调光和色温控制。
requirements: The firmware covers the lamp's local knob controls: power, dimming and colour temperature; the author's hardware variant is the documented target.

Installation requires opening the lamp, wiring U0RX, U0TX, GPIO0 and GND to a USB serial adapter, and overwriting stock firmware. Back up the original flash; the backup contains Wi-Fi credentials. Check flash size for other variants.
Build with CMake 2.8+, xtensa-lx106-elf from esp-open-sdk and Espressif's ESP8266 NONOS SDK. CI compiles the firmware but runs no tests.
The project uses MIT; Espressif's SDK libraries have their own modified MIT license. Stock firmware and the Xiaomi app retain their own terms.

name: JS Deobfuscator (kuizuo)
description_en: Babel AST-based JavaScript deobfuscator with a CLI, a TypeScript API in the workspace package deob, and a browser playground built with Nuxt 3 and Monaco. It locates string-array decoders by array length, call count or analyst-supplied setup code and decoder names, evaluates them to inline the decoded strings, unflattens control flow, removes dead code and self-defending or anti-debug logic, merges object properties and renames mangled identifiers, repeating passes for heavily obfuscated input. The README credits webcrack as an inspiration, and its examples include javascript-obfuscator and jsjiami v6 output, the string-array style the catalog's obfuscator-io-deobfuscator entry also covers.
description_zh: 基于 Babel AST 的 JavaScript 反混淆工具，提供命令行、工作区软件包 deob 中的 TypeScript API，以及用 Nuxt 3 和 Monaco 构建的浏览器在线演练场。它可按字符串数组长度、调用次数，或分析者提供的预置代码与解密函数名来定位字符串数组解密函数，执行这些函数以内联解密后的字符串，并能还原控制流平坦化、删除死代码及自我防护和反调试逻辑、合并对象属性、重命名被混淆的标识符，对重度混淆的代码会多轮处理。README 称其受 webcrack 启发；示例包含 javascript-obfuscator 和 jsjiami v6 的输出，与本目录 obfuscator-io-deobfuscator 条目所处理的字符串数组混淆属于同一类。
requirements: From a clone, run pnpm install (workspace pins pnpm 11.21.0), then pnpm exec deob on a file or standard input, or pnpm tmp for tmp/input.js. The browser playground is at js-deobfuscator.vercel.app.

Decoder code executes in isolated-vm with a 10-second timeout in Node; if that call fails, the code falls back to the host global eval. Process untrusted scripts in an isolated environment. Customized samples may require analyst-supplied setupCode and decoder names.

The example directory includes obfuscated scripts and restored outputs; the repository gives no provenance or redistribution terms for those samples. The root LICENSE is MIT; packages/deob/package.json does not declare a license.

name: sasquatch
description_en: Patches to the unsquashfs utility from squashfs-tools 4.3 that try to read as many vendor-modified SquashFS implementations from embedded firmware as possible. Simple header changes are handled automatically; when a vendor has altered the LZMA compression options or how they are stored in data blocks, it tries to resolve them by brute force with added lzma-adaptive, lzma-alt and lzma-ddwrt decompressors. Extra options let analysts force the decompressor, SquashFS version, endianness and lzma-adaptive parameters and turn on trace output.
description_zh: 针对 squashfs-tools 4.3 中 unsquashfs 工具的一组补丁，力求读取嵌入式固件中尽可能多的厂商改版 SquashFS 实现。头部字段的简单改动会被自动识别；若厂商改动了 LZMA 压缩参数或其在数据块中的存放方式，它会借助新增的 lzma-adaptive、lzma-alt 和 lzma-ddwrt 解压器以暴力尝试的方式加以识别。新增的命令行选项可让分析人员强制指定解压器、SquashFS 版本、字节序和 lzma-adaptive 参数，并开启跟踪输出。
requirements: The README calls the patch set beta. Open issues report build failures with GCC 10 and later; unblob documents a separate ONEKEY package.

build.sh downloads the squashfs-tools 4.3 tarball from SourceForge, applies patches/patch0.txt, builds, and installs with sudo make install; on apt systems it first installs build-essential and the liblzma, liblzo2 and zlib development packages with sudo.

Input is a SquashFS image or firmware file the user supplies; the repository commits no firmware images. Its only files are the README, build.sh and the 1.1 MB patch, which adds bundled LZMA SDK decoder copies under their LGPL/CPL texts and, in the lzmalt decoder, a 289-line VxWorks type header (vxTypesOld.h) marked Copyright 1984-1997 Wind River Systems with no license notice.
The repository has no license file. squashfs-tools is GPL-licensed; bundled LZMA decoder code has LGPL/CPL terms, and the included VxWorks type header has a copyright notice without a license.

name: BtleJack
description_en: Capture Bluetooth Low Energy connections with compatible nRF51822-based boards and export packets for Wireshark analysis.
description_zh: 使用兼容的 nRF51822 开发板采集低功耗蓝牙连接，并导出数据包供 Wireshark 分析。
requirements: Requires a POSIX system, the Python 3 client and compatible hardware with matching firmware, such as one to three BBC Micro:Bit devices or the listed nRF51822 sniffers.
BLE 5/5.1 support is limited to the 1 Mbps uncoded PHY and excludes channel-map updates.

name: can-utils
description_en: Record, filter, compare and replay SocketCAN traffic with tools for raw CAN, ISO-TP and J1939 analysis.
description_zh: 使用面向原始 CAN、ISO-TP 和 J1939 分析的工具，记录、过滤、比较及重放 SocketCAN 流量。
requirements: Needs the Linux SocketCAN subsystem and an appropriate CAN or virtual-CAN interface. The project documents native Linux and cross-compiled Android/Raspberry Pi builds using CMake.
candump and cansniffer expose frames and changing bytes; they do not infer proprietary signal semantics. ISO-TP and J1939 commands additionally depend on the corresponding kernel support.

name: Compiler Explorer
description_en: Compare source constructs with compiler-generated assembly to study optimizations and recognize code patterns during reverse engineering.
description_zh: 比较源码结构与编译器生成的汇编，研究优化方式并辅助识别逆向分析中的代码模式。
requirements: Use the hosted interface or run a local instance with Node.js and configured compiler binaries. The pinned checkout’s .node-version is 22.23.4; the README accepts that version or newer and documents make-based setup.
The tool compiles supplied source for comparison; it does not recover source from an arbitrary binary. The hosted compiler inventory and a local instance’s configured compilers can differ.

name: Dr. Memory
description_en: Instrument running application binaries to diagnose invalid memory access, uninitialized reads, use-after-free and leaks.
description_zh: 对运行中的应用二进制插桩，诊断非法内存访问、未初始化读取、释放后使用及泄漏。
requirements: Built on DynamoRIO and distributed in platform-specific packages. The README describes Windows, Linux, macOS and Android operation on IA-32, AMD64 and ARM; supported package/host combinations must match the selected release.
The target runs under instrumentation. Windows adds handle/GDI/TLS diagnostics and the drstrace system-call tracer; these Windows-specific features do not apply to every host.

name: FIRMADYNE
description_en: Rehost extracted Linux-based embedded firmware with instrumented kernels, NVRAM emulation and inferred network configuration.
description_zh: 通过插桩内核、NVRAM 模拟和网络配置推断，重托管提取出的嵌入式 Linux 固件。
requirements: The documented environment uses Linux, QEMU, PostgreSQL, extraction dependencies and recursively cloned components, with modified MIPS/ARM kernels. The README explicitly excludes x86 firmware emulation.

The project is marked a research prototype, not production-ready. Its setup includes legacy Python/binwalk tooling, and missing NVRAM values or unsuccessful network inference can require manual adaptation.

name: flashrom
description_en: Identify and read supported flash chips to obtain firmware images for offline inspection, with separate write and verification operations.
description_zh: 识别并读取受支持的闪存芯片，获取用于离线检查的固件镜像，另提供写入和验证操作。
requirements: Requires a supported programmer or mainboard/chip combination. Source builds use Meson; the tool covers interfaces including SPI, LPC, FWH and parallel flash.

The README warns against laptop use because embedded-controller interactions can damage the device, and calls for a backup before writing. Chip access is hardware-specific rather than a universal firmware extractor.

name: smali/baksmali (Google fork)
description_en: Assemble and disassemble Android DEX bytecode using Google’s continuation of smali/baksmali.
description_zh: 使用 Google 延续维护的 smali／baksmali 汇编和反汇编 Android DEX 字节码。
requirements: Build and test with OpenJDK 11; the README states newer OpenJDK versions are unsupported by parts of the build. Command-line use requires the fat JAR build.

This fork changes the namespace to com.android.tools.smali and publishes 3.x artifacts through Google Maven. It is distinct from the unmaintained original org.jf 2.x project and provides bytecode assembly/disassembly, not Java-source decompilation.

name: Intel XED
description_en: Encode and decode x86 instructions through Intel’s library and example analysis utilities.
description_zh: 通过 Intel 的库及分析示例工具编码和解码 x86 指令。
requirements: Source builds require Python, a native build toolchain and the separate mbuild checkout alongside xed. The build produces platform-specific static or shared libraries and optional examples.
The tool encodes and decodes x86 instructions. Encoder-only and decoder-only configurations are available to reduce library size.

name: InternalBlue
description_en: Study and patch supported Broadcom/Cypress Bluetooth firmware while observing link-layer traffic on the participating device.
description_zh: 研究和修补受支持的 Broadcom／Cypress 蓝牙固件，并观察参与通信设备的链路层流量。
requirements: Requires a supported chipset, firmware profile and OS-specific backend. The README lists rooted Android 6–11, jailbroken iOS 12–14, specified macOS versions, Linux BlueZ excluding WSL, and a separate BTstack route.
Monitoring is from the device running InternalBlue. Firmware protections can disable RAM read/write commands after driver initialization and require device-specific adaptations.

name: JD-Core
description_en: Embed the Java decompiler engine used by JD-GUI through loader and printer interfaces.
description_zh: 通过加载器和输出接口嵌入 JD-GUI 使用的 Java 反编译引擎。
requirements: Supply JVM class bytes and implement the Loader and Printer interfaces in a Java application; the Gradle wrapper builds the library JAR.
The pinned README documents Java 1.1.8–12.0, including lambdas, method references and default methods, and declares GPLv3. The documented class-file range ends at Java 12.0.

name: Keystone
description_en: Assemble instruction text into machine code through a common API covering x86, Arm, MIPS and other architectures.
description_zh: 通过统一 API 将汇编指令文本转换为机器码，覆盖 x86、Arm、MIPS 等架构。
requirements: Use the native C/C++ library or a supported language binding; build instructions cover Windows and Unix-like hosts, with vcpkg as an alternative installation route.
The project offers GPLv2 with its EXCEPTIONS-CLIENT terms or a commercial license. It is an assembler framework; decompilation and executable reconstruction require other tools.

name: libsigrokdecode
description_en: Run sigrok’s Python protocol decoders through a C library to interpret captured digital signals.
description_zh: 通过 C 库运行 sigrok 的 Python 协议解码器，解释采集到的数字信号。
requirements: Source builds require a C compiler, make, pkg-config, GLib 2.34+ and Python 3.2+; Git builds additionally need Autoconf, Automake and Libtool. A client supplies captured signal data.
The library and its integral decoders use GPLv3-or-later. Git snapshots have no stable-API guarantee; the README recommends release tarballs for distribution packaging.

name: MC Extractor
description_en: Find and extract CPU microcode from firmware images, inspect microcode headers and compare entries against a version database.
description_zh: 从固件镜像中查找并提取 CPU 微码，检查微码头，并与版本数据库中的记录比较。
requirements: Supply MCE.py together with its required MCE.db database, Python 3.7+, colorama and pltable. The README documents Windows, Linux and macOS.
The documented families are Intel, AMD, VIA and Freescale. New or outdated classifications depend on the database; the tool analyzes microcode headers and checksums.

name: Microsoft Detours
description_en: Monitor Windows API calls by embedding instrumentation into a program’s execution path.
description_zh: 在程序执行路径中嵌入插桩代码，以监测 Windows API 调用。
requirements: Requires Windows and a native application/toolchain that can integrate the Detours library. The README describes the Windows NT family and identifies the source as version 4.0.1.
Windows Store applications cannot use Detours because required APIs are unavailable there. Detours is MIT-licensed.

name: Mono.Cecil
description_en: Inspect and modify .NET metadata and CIL code without loading target assemblies through Reflection.
description_zh: 无需通过 Reflection 加载目标程序集，即可检查和修改 .NET 元数据及 CIL 代码。
requirements: Integrate the library into a .NET application and supply ECMA CIL assemblies; the pinned project targets .NET Standard 2.0 and .NET Framework 4.0.
The object model supports metadata and IL rewriting in a programming library.

name: MTKClient
description_en: Inspect MediaTek device flash and partitions through chipset-specific boot-ROM or preloader interfaces.
description_zh: 通过与芯片相关的 boot-ROM 或 preloader 接口检查联发科设备的闪存及分区。
requirements: Needs compatible MediaTek hardware, its USB interface and the project dependencies. Linux instructions specify Python 3.10+; Windows instructions specify Python 3.9+, MTK port drivers and UsbDk. macOS has separate macFUSE/libusb setup and Apple Silicon notes.

The listed V6 chipsets require a suitable device loader and preloader mode; their patched boot ROM is not supported through the older boot-ROM route. Flash writes and loader support are device-specific.

name: PANDA
description_en: Record and replay whole-system execution for repeated inspection, plugin analysis and dynamic taint tracking.
description_zh: 记录和重放全系统执行，用于重复检查、插件分析及动态污点跟踪。
requirements: Needs guest images or compatible recordings and the PANDA/PyPANDA runtime. The README’s distributed binaries target 64-bit Ubuntu 22.04; LLVM-based taint features require LLVM 14.
Record/replay supports x86, x86-64 and ARM guests. Recordings cannot be moved between 32-bit and 64-bit PANDA builds.

name: pefile
description_en: Inspect PE headers, sections, resources and malformed values through a Python API with limited in-place editing.
description_zh: 通过 Python API 检查 PE 头、节、资源及异常字段值，并进行有限的原位编辑。
requirements: Install pefile with Python 3; the module is self-contained and documents Windows, macOS and Linux operation. Understanding the PE layout is needed to interpret its structures.
Its editing helpers do not rearrange PE structures to make room for new fields. Signature verification is referred to a separate project.

name: PolyTracker
description_en: Trace how parser functions consume input bytes by rebuilding programs with LLVM data-flow instrumentation and inspecting the resulting trace.
description_zh: 通过 LLVM 数据流插桩重新构建程序，跟踪解析器函数如何使用输入字节，并检查产生的跟踪数据。
requirements: Needs a target that can be built and instrumented, typically C/C++, plus the specialized LLVM environment. The documented quickstart uses Python tooling and Docker.
Tracing requires rebuilding the target with LLVM instrumentation. Grammar extraction is experimental; host-mounted trace databases can cause severe virtual-machine/container slowdown.

name: pyelftools
description_en: Parse ELF executables and DWARF debugging information from Python for scripted binary inspection.
description_zh: 通过 Python 解析 ELF 可执行文件和 DWARF 调试信息，用于编写二进制检查脚本。
requirements: The pinned README requires Python 3.11+ and no external dependencies; install the pyelftools package or import a source checkout.
Inputs are ELF files and available DWARF data. The API exposes format and debug information.

name: rustc-demangle
description_en: Turn mangled Rust symbols into readable names for symbol inspection and binary-analysis tooling.
description_zh: 将经过名称修饰的 Rust 符号转为可读名称，用于符号检查和二进制分析工具。
requirements: Use the Rust crate through Cargo, or build the separate C API wrapper with Cargo. A mostly equivalent native C implementation is available but described as less supported.
The library operates on supplied symbol strings and does not recover stripped identifiers. It offers a choice of MIT or Apache-2.0 licensing and does not require allocation or OS support.

name: Scylla
description_en: Inspect and rebuild x86/x64 PE import tables and repair process dumps during executable analysis.
description_zh: 在可执行文件分析中检查和重建 x86／x64 PE 导入表，并修复进程转储。
requirements: This is a legacy Windows C/C++ tool, designed around Windows 7 x64, with x86/x64 input support and optional import-reconstruction plugins. Its source is GPLv3.
The README documents unresolved GetProcAddress cases, ambiguous Windows XP x64 exports and incompatible older plugins. Repaired imports can require manual review.

name: TitanEngine Community Edition
description_en: Embed a Windows debugging engine with breakpoint, exception, process-dump and import-reconstruction support.
description_zh: 嵌入提供断点、异常、进程转储和导入表重建功能的 Windows 调试引擎。
requirements: Use the native C/C++ headers and a Windows build environment. The pinned CMake configuration requires CMake 3.15+ and an out-of-source build, and includes diStorm and Scylla-derived components.
The README warns that Lua, Python, MASM and Delphi bindings may not work correctly because their headers were not updated.

name: Ubertooth
description_en: Capture Bluetooth radio traffic using the Ubertooth hardware platform and its host analysis tools.
description_zh: 使用 Ubertooth 硬件平台及宿主分析工具采集蓝牙无线流量。
requirements: Needs Ubertooth hardware, compatible firmware, host tools and libbtbb. The pinned README names the paired 2020-12-R1 firmware/software and libbtbb releases.
The documented scope is BLE sniffing and some Basic Rate Bluetooth Classic data.

name: Umap2
description_en: Explore a USB host’s supported device classes and vendor-specific behavior through programmable device emulation.
description_zh: 通过可编程设备模拟，研究 USB 主机支持的设备类别及厂商特定行为。
requirements: Needs supported USB-device hardware such as Facedancer or Raspdancer; GadgetFS support is partial. The README installs the experimental package from source rather than PyPI.

The project is alpha-stage legacy tooling. Most components claim Python 2/3 compatibility, but the kitty fuzzer requires Python 2; host-OS detection is unimplemented and the tool does not fuzz the MTP layer.

name: Volatility 3
description_en: Inspect operating-system memory samples to recover processes, modules and other runtime artifacts through forensic plugins.
description_zh: 通过取证插件检查操作系统内存样本，恢复进程、模块及其他运行时制品。
requirements: Requires a supported memory image, appropriate symbol tables and Python; the pinned README specifies Python 3.8+. The default branch is develop, while stable is the release branch.

Windows symbols may be downloaded and cached automatically; Linux and macOS symbols can need manual generation with matching kernel information. The project uses the custom Volatility Software License.

name: The Blind Walleye: a static rebuild of the marketing site
description_en: Rebuilds the public Blind Walleye site as a Next.js app. The shipped capture source/pages/index.html is one input page, and node scripts/compare-visual.mjs pixel-diffs the replica against the capture and exits 1 if any page exceeds the diff threshold.
description_zh: 把公开的 Blind Walleye 网站重建为 Next.js 应用。随仓库提供的抓取页 source/pages/index.html 是其中一页输入，node scripts/compare-visual.mjs 把复刻页与抓取页做像素比较，任一页超过阈值就以状态 1 退出。
requirements: The README calls the project a 1:1 copy of https://www.theblindwalleye.com, statically rendered in Next.js. source/ holds the capture. The app prerenders /, /menu, and /events, and the captured 404 is rendered as well. source/pages contains index.html, menu.html, events.html, and __404.html.

The README says node scripts/compare-visual.mjs screenshots the captured source and the replica at 1440, 991, and 390 pixels wide. The script's default MAX_DIFF_PCT is 0.5, and it exits 1 when any page's diff percent is above that threshold.
The README names no license.

name: Destruction Derby 64: a matching decompilation of the US ROM
description_en: A matching decompilation of the US Nintendo 64 ROM of Destruction Derby 64. The user supplies baserom.z64, SHA-1 a2c0799e13566d1b723299592cfcac9387f25fa7; the default make target rebuilds the ROM and sha1sum checks it against dd64.sha1.
description_zh: 任天堂 64 美版 Destruction Derby 64 的匹配反编译。用户提供 baserom.z64，SHA-1 为 a2c0799e13566d1b723299592cfcac9387f25fa7；默认的 make 目标重建 ROM，并用 sha1sum 对照 dd64.sha1。
requirements: The README says the builder supplies Destruction Derby 64 (USA) as baserom.z64 with that SHA-1, and that the ROM is not in the repository. It says a matching build prints build/dd64.z64: OK, and that 1510 of 1548 functions are C. It also describes the repository as a hands-off agent experiment whose author did not review the code.
The Makefile's default goal is check, which runs sha1sum -c on dd64.sha1. That file expects build/dd64.z64 to have the same SHA-1.
The pinned root listing has no LICENSE file, and the README states no license.

name: EchoPod: replacement firmware for the Snowsky Echo Mini 8 GB
description_en: Replacement firmware for the Snowsky (FiiO) Echo Mini 8 GB player. The stock update image is HIFIECnn.IMG, and cmake --preset release followed by cmake --build --preset release writes build/release/HIFIEC90.IMG.
description_zh: Snowsky（FiiO）Echo Mini 8 GB 播放器的替代固件。输入是原厂更新镜像 HIFIECnn.IMG；依次执行 cmake --preset release 和 cmake --build --preset release 会写出 build/release/HIFIEC90.IMG。
requirements: The 8 GB Snowsky Echo Mini uses HIFIECnn.IMG update images; FiiO 3.7.0, 3.9.0 and 4.0.0 are tested starting points. EchoPod rejects the 512 MB model’s MINIVnnn.IMG file.
The release preset builds HIFIEC90.IMG. The project describes early development and reports testing on one player.
EchoPod is GPL-3.0-or-later. Bundled Inter and Noto CJK fonts use SIL OFL 1.1; libmad uses GPL-2.0-or-later.

name: GLaBIOS: a scratch-built 8K ROM BIOS
description_en: A scratch-built open ROM BIOS for vintage PC, XT, and 8088-class machines. The shipped assembly source src/GLABIOS.ASM is the build input; src/MAKE.BAT runs MASM and LINK, then GLA2ROM writes GLABIOS.ROM, which the GLA2ROM readme calls an 8KiB ROM image.
description_zh: 面向老式 PC、XT 和 8088 机器、从零编写的开源 ROM BIOS。构建输入是随仓库提供的汇编源文件 src/GLABIOS.ASM；src/MAKE.BAT 运行 MASM 和 LINK，再由 GLA2ROM 写出 GLABIOS.ROM，GLA2ROM 的说明称其为 8KiB ROM 镜像。
requirements: The README describes an 8K PC-compatible BIOS for vintage PC, XT, and 8088 machines; its pinned commit is v0.4.2 and also describes a Version 0.8b preview.

src/GLABIOS.ASM is in the tree. src/MAKE.BAT runs MASM GLABIOS, LINK GLABIOS, and then GLA2ROM on GLABIOS.EXE to write GLABIOS.ROM. src/gla2rom/README.md says that command produces an 8KiB ROM image and must run under DOS or a DOS emulator.
LICENSE is the GNU GPL version 3 text, and the README identifies the project as GPLv3.

name: HyperCard 1.2.2: a static recompilation of the classic Mac app
description_en: Statically recompiles HyperCard 1.2.2, a classic Mac application. The user supplies the file named HyperCard; tools/corpus.json records 2642 covered call sites out of 3166, and tools/conformance.py fails if that count drops.
description_zh: 静态重编译经典 Mac 应用 HyperCard 1.2.2。用户提供名为 HyperCard 的文件；tools/corpus.json 记下 3166 个调用点中已覆盖 2642 个，tools/conformance.py 在这个数字下降时失败。
requirements: Requires the user’s HyperCard 1.2.2 file. The README reports 2,642 of 3,166 call sites covered and 97–100 percent instruction coverage for 21 CODE segments; corpus images are copyrighted Mac media stored outside the repository.
The toolkit is MIT licensed and ships no Apple ROM, System software or copyrighted disc data.

name: Legend of Mana: a matching decompilation of the PlayStation game
description_en: A matching decompilation of Legend of Mana on the PlayStation. The user supplies the North American executable SLUS_010.13, SHA-1 d11dfdd50d412ac3fa3e2eb80fbde138da118f27; make verify-bins checks the rebuilt main executable and overlays against the disc files.
description_zh: PlayStation 游戏 Legend of Mana 的匹配反编译。用户提供北美可执行文件 SLUS_010.13，SHA-1 为 d11dfdd50d412ac3fa3e2eb80fbde138da118f27；make verify-bins 把重建的主程序和覆盖模块与光盘文件核对。
requirements: Commit c34db9803ae8cb58d45060a8246e161de690ece3. The README says both the North American and Japanese releases are 100 percent matched. North America is disc SLUS-01013, main executable SLUS_010.13, SHA-1 d11dfdd50d412ac3fa3e2eb80fbde138da118f27. Japan is SLPS-02170, main executable SLPS_021.70, SHA-1 b067188a92e4de9a4db7bb7e5343c757e9884bfa. The game executable is excluded from the repository; disc/ is gitignored.

make verify-bins checks the North American modules, and make verify-bins VERSION=jp checks the Japanese modules. The README says the main executable and all 17 overlays are fully linked, and that the Psy-Q SDK libraries are still linked from the original assembly.
LICENSE is the MIT license, copyright 2026 Christopher Harris (celophi). Retail game files are excluded.

name: LoreMaps: a static rewrite of a fantasy-map atlas
description_en: A static Astro atlas rewritten from the project’s earlier ASP.NET MVC site. Shipped map definitions in src/maps name each tile pyramid, image size, and meters-per-pixel scale, and npm run build writes the static site to dist/.
description_zh: 从该项目早先的 ASP.NET MVC 站点重写而来的 Astro 静态地图集。随仓库提供的 src/maps 地图定义写明瓦片地址、图像尺寸和每像素米数；npm run build 把静态站点写到 dist/。
requirements: The README calls this a from-scratch rewrite of the aspnet-mvc-live branch as a static site, with Leaflet 1.9 as the only runtime dependency. package.json requires Node.js >= 22.12.0, and its build script is astro build. The README says npm run build writes static output to dist/.

src/maps/faerun.ts ships a 4763 by 3185 image, tilesUrl https://loremaps.github.io/LoreMaps-Faerun-Tiles/Tiles, and metersPerPixel 1287.473. src/maps/got.ts ships a 4642 by 4642 image, tilesUrl https://loremaps.github.io/LoreMaps-GoT-Tiles/Tiles, and metersPerPixel 2266.681.

The pinned tree has no LICENSE file. The README credits the Faerûn image to Pocket Plane Group and the Known World map to serMountainGoat under CC-BY-NC-SA. got.ts links the CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 deed. Tile images are hosted outside this repository.

name: NewPipe: an Android front end for YouTube and PeerTube
description_en: NewPipe is an Android front end for YouTube, YouTube Music and PeerTube. It gets service data from public APIs where available and otherwise parses websites or uses internal APIs to search and play streams.
description_zh: NewPipe 是面向 YouTube、YouTube Music 和 PeerTube 的 Android 前端。它在可用时使用公开 API 获取服务数据，否则解析网站或使用内部 API 来搜索和播放流媒体。
requirements: Android app distributed through F-Droid and GitHub releases. The supported services listed in the README include YouTube, YouTube Music and PeerTube instances.
The app obtains service data through official APIs where available and otherwise parses websites or uses internal APIs.
License: GPL-3.0; streaming services retain their own terms.

name: openbst: a C reimplementation of BeSTspeech
description_en: A from-scratch C reimplementation of the Berkeley Speech Technologies formant synthesizer sold as BeSTspeech and shipped in HumanWare Keynote GOLD. The original binaries are the comparison input and are not in the repository; make selftest checks tests/golden.txt, and make test compares the engine with those binaries.
description_zh: 把 Berkeley Speech Technologies 的共振峰合成器 BeSTspeech（HumanWare Keynote GOLD 所带的引擎）从零重实现为 C。对照输入是原二进制，仓库不附带这些文件；make selftest 核对 tests/golden.txt，make test 在仿真器中与这些二进制比较。
requirements: Commit a151e78f66009bc74367974d14476061f3552346. The README names twenty builds: the 1995 32-bit English engine, six 1998 16-bit modules (English, Dutch, French, German, Italian, and Spanish), and thirteen 2006 32-bit builds. Put the original binaries under dll/1995, dll/1998, and dll/2006. They are not in the repository. make still writes build/libbst.a, build/libbst.so, and build/bstspeak, because src/data holds the lifted tables.
