The README says the 1995 build is bit-exact on 24 utterances, the six 1998 modules match 226 words and 20793 frames with 144 utterances sample for sample, the thirteen 2006 builds match 2358 utterances, and tests/lifttest.sh checks 411894 utterances. Those runs need the original binaries. make test is that gate. Without the binaries, make selftest checks tests/golden.txt, which the README says holds sample counts and hashes for 4906 utterances written from the binaries by make golden.

LICENSE puts the code, tests, and tools under the MIT license, copyright 2026 Stanislaw Przedzinkowski, and says the tables read from Berkeley Speech Technologies’ binaries, later HumanWare’s, are not covered by that license.

name: OpenHaystack: tracking tags that use Apple Find My
description_en: OpenHaystack uses a reconstructed Apple Find My protocol to build personal Bluetooth tracking tags and a Mac app that queries their location reports.
description_zh: OpenHaystack 利用逆向还原的 Apple“查找”网络协议制作个人蓝牙追踪标签，并通过 Mac 应用查询其位置报告。
requirements: Requires macOS 11 or later, a Bluetooth device such as a BBC micro:bit, and the OpenHaystack Mail plugin to download location reports. Installation temporarily disables Gatekeeper while enabling the plugin.
The accessory firmware broadcasts a fixed public key, allowing nearby devices to track the tag. The project is experimental and incomplete.
License: AGPL-3.0.

name: openrsync: an ISC implementation of rsync protocol 27
description_en: An ISC-licensed rsync that copies a directory and checks the result. regress/functional/test00_simple.test builds dir1/one.txt, an expected tree under dir2, runs openrsync -a from dir1 to dir3, and compare_trees diffs the listings and file contents.
description_zh: 一个 ISC 许可的 rsync 实现，复制目录并核对结果。regress/functional/test00_simple.test 生成 dir1/one.txt 和 dir2 下的预期目录树，用 openrsync -a 把 dir1 复制到 dir3，再由 compare_trees 比较目录清单和文件内容。
requirements: Commit 8235c68f11b4fad5e24849a01d04ea153c29ee28. The README calls openrsync an implementation of rsync with a BSD (ISC) license, compatible with rsync 3.1.3 and with any peer that supports protocol 27. rsync.5 says it is compatible with version 27 of the reference. The officially supported system is OpenBSD.

regress/functional/conf.sh sets rsync to ./openrsync unless that variable is already set. test00_simple.test creates dir1/one.txt with mkdirfile, builds the same file under dir2/dir1, runs $rsync -a dir1 dir3, and calls compare_trees dir2 dir3. compare_trees diffs file listings, directory listings, and then file contents with diff -ru. make regress_functional runs these tests.
LICENSE.md grants permission to use, copy, modify, and/or distribute the software for any purpose, provided the copyright notice is kept. The copyright line is 2019, Kristaps Dzonsons.

name: PC-BASIC: a GW-BASIC-family interpreter
description_en: A cross-platform interpreter for GW-BASIC, BASICA, PCjr Cartridge BASIC, and Tandy 1000 GWBASIC. Release v2.0.8 is commit 6a3a035b0a1c1029d48bc9284e642b6b4bd64fb5; the shipped program tests/basic/gwbasic/PRINT_USING_scientific/TEST.BAS is compared byte for byte with model/OUTPUT.TXT.
description_zh: 面向 GW-BASIC、BASICA、PCjr Cartridge BASIC 和 Tandy 1000 GWBASIC 的跨平台解释器。发布版 v2.0.8 是提交 6a3a035b0a1c1029d48bc9284e642b6b4bd64fb5；随仓库提供的 tests/basic/gwbasic/PRINT_USING_scientific/TEST.BAS 与 model/OUTPUT.TXT 做整文件字节比较。
requirements: The README calls PC-BASIC a free interpreter for those four BASIC dialects, aiming for bug-for-bug compatibility, running .BAS programs, and using Microsoft Binary Format floating point. Tag v2.0.8 points at commit 6a3a035b0a1c1029d48bc9284e642b6b4bd64fb5. Desktop installers are published on that GitHub release.

At that commit, tests/basic/gwbasic/PRINT_USING_scientific/TEST.BAS is 362 bytes. PCBASIC.INI in the same directory sets run=TEST.BAS and quit=True. The oracle model/OUTPUT.TXT is 82 bytes. tests/basic/testbasic.py compares each model file with filecmp.cmp and shallow=False, a full byte compare.
The README says the program is released under GPL version 3. LICENSE.md grants the GNU GPL version 3 or, at the recipient’s option, any later version.

name: ReactOS: a Windows NT-compatible operating system
description_en: Builds an open operating system intended to run applications and drivers written for the Windows NT family. The README focuses compatibility work on Windows Server 2003 and installs onto a FAT16 or FAT32 boot partition.
description_zh: 构建一个开源操作系统，目标是运行为 Windows NT 家族编写的应用程序和驱动程序。README 把兼容工作集中在 Windows Server 2003，并安装到 FAT16 或 FAT32 启动分区。
requirements: Installation requires a FAT16 or FAT32 active boot partition. The README focuses compatibility work on Windows Server 2003 and links release 0.4.16.
Project code is GPL-2.0. Rights to Windows remain with its owner.

name: ScummVM: replacement executables for classic adventure games
description_en: Replaces the executables of classic adventure games and RPGs with one program that runs the user's original data files. It began with LucasArts SCUMM games and now names many other titles.
description_zh: 用一个程序替换经典冒险游戏和 RPG 的可执行文件，运行用户自备的原始数据文件。它从 LucasArts 的 SCUMM 游戏开始，README 现在还列出许多其他作品。
requirements: ScummVM runs supported adventure and role-playing games from user-supplied original game data files.
Supported games include Broken Sword, Myst and Blade Runner; supported editions and features vary by title.
GPL-3.0, with COPYING in the tree. Game data remains under its own rights.

name: TC66 custom firmware: a replacement image for the RuiDeng USB-C meter
description_en: Replacement firmware for the RuiDeng TC66 and TC66C USB-C meters. Stock firmware is not in the repository; make release in rust/ writes tc66fw-release.enc.bin, an AES-encrypted image for the stock bootloader.
description_zh: RuiDeng TC66 和 TC66C USB-C 功率计的替代固件。原厂固件不在仓库中；在 rust/ 中执行 make release 会写出 tc66fw-release.enc.bin，这是给原厂 bootloader 使用的 AES 加密镜像。
requirements: Commit 65accb42ce94526649f7553c927d4edae9389a71. The README says the TC66C, with a GD32F150G8 MCU, has been tested, and that the TC66 uses the same board design and has not been tested. Other RuiDeng meters are not supported. The stock image is not redistributed. uv run tc66flash.py stock downloads official V1.18 and checks SHA-256 ef796b29557c91e0a469740ba1934ca0a838916c76ab55eb6d1253da32830940. tools/tc66flash.py maps USB IDs 0x28E9:0x018A.
From rust/, make release writes tc66fw-release.enc.bin. The Makefile calls that file an AES-encrypted image for the stock bootloader. The README says the bootloader itself is never written.
LICENSE is the MIT license, copyright 2026 Fletcher.

name: Thermal Master P3: a browser client for the vendor USB protocol
description_en: A browser viewer for the Thermal Master P3, which speaks a vendor USB protocol over vendor USB control transfers. tests/test_webusb.mjs compares built commands with captured 18-byte transfers, including read_name, and parses a captured status buffer.
description_zh: 面向 Thermal Master P3 的浏览器查看器。这台相机使用厂商 USB 协议，通过厂商 USB 控制传输通信。tests/test_webusb.mjs 把生成的命令与抓到的 18 字节传输比较，其中包括 read_name，并解析一段抓到的状态缓冲。
requirements: The browser viewer targets Thermal Master P3 USB ID 3474:45a2 and 256 × 192 frames. The README reports P1 as untested.
Captured 18-byte vendor-control commands and a 192-byte status buffer are checked in tests/test_webusb.mjs.
License: Apache-2.0.

name: UV-K5: an open reimplementation of Quan Sheng firmware v2.1.27
description_en: An archived reimplementation of the Quan Sheng UV-K5 handheld-radio firmware v2.1.27. After the submodules are fetched, make writes firmware.bin and firmware.packed.bin for the radio’s DP32G030.
description_zh: 已归档的泉盛 UV-K5 手台固件 v2.1.27 重实现。取回子模块后，make 为收音机上的 DP32G030 写出 firmware.bin 和 firmware.packed.bin。
requirements: The repository is archived. It reimplements Quan Sheng UV-K5 firmware v2.1.27 without customizations and recommends arm-none-eabi GCC 10.3.1.
Fetch submodules, then run make. The build targets cortex-m0 and produces firmware.bin for k5prog and firmware.packed.bin for the official updater.
LICENSE is the Apache License, Version 2.0.

name: viaduct: a Linux port of NetNewsWire
description_en: A Linux RSS reader in Rust and GTK4 that the README calls a port of NetNewsWire. A local OPML file is the account input; cargo build --release writes target/release/viaduct, and the CI workflow runs cargo test --workspace.
description_zh: README 称为 NetNewsWire 移植的 Linux RSS 阅读器，用 Rust 和 GTK4 编写。本地账户的输入是磁盘上的 OPML；cargo build --release 写出 target/release/viaduct，CI 工作流运行 cargo test --workspace。
requirements: Commit a0622903b93da2c2752244cf6d415377a41fbe7a. The README says Viaduct translates NetNewsWire’s local-account architecture. Local accounts keep OPML on disk as the source of truth; Inoreader is the other supported account. The .netnewswire reference tree is gitignored, so that tree is not in the public Git history.

cargo build --release writes target/release/viaduct. The README names gtk4 and WebKitGTK 6.0 as build dependencies. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets and xvfb-run -a cargo test --workspace.
LICENSE is the MIT license, with copyright lines for Brent Simmons and Ranchero Software (2002-2026) and Brandon LaRocque (2026).

name: zalo-linux: a Linux package of the Zalo desktop app
description_en: Repackages VNG's Zalo desktop app for Linux from the official macOS installer. The harness builds a .deb, and a headless smoke script expects the extracted bundle to open a window.
description_zh: 把 VNG 的 Zalo 桌面应用从官方 macOS 安装包重新打包到 Linux。构建工具生成 .deb，无界面冒烟脚本期望解出的程序能打开窗口。
requirements: The README says npm run setup downloads the macOS DMG, extracts the bundle, and builds native modules, and that npm run build produces dist/Zalo-<version>.deb. The extracted app directory is gitignored. The project says it is not affiliated with or endorsed by VNG.
scripts/_smoke-boot.sh treats SMOKE_OK after headless boot as success.
LICENSE is the MIT license and states that the grant covers the build harness only. The Zalo application bundle is proprietary to VNG and is not in the repository.

name: OpenTV: a portable C rebuild of Centigram TruVoice
description_en: Rebuilds Centigram TruVoice, the 1997 text-to-speech engine, as portable C. tools/difftest.py compares PCM from the C build with the original DLL across the corpus checked in that script.
description_zh: 把 Centigram 的 TruVoice（1997 年文本转语音引擎）重建为可移植 C。tools/difftest.py 用脚本中的语料，把 C 构建的 PCM 与原始 DLL 对照。
requirements: Needs an x86_64 mingw-w64 toolchain, used in -m32 freestanding mode for the 32-bit build, plus dlltool and Python 3. Put CGRM_EN.DLL in TruVoice/. That DLL is not in the repository. pefile is only required by the tools that read a DLL.
The README describes a C library, a command-line speaker, and an NVDA add-on, at 32 and 64 bits. It says SAPI 4 COM glue, config dialogs, and waveOut playback are documented but not ported.

The README says tools/difftest.py runs 59 corpus inputs in 335 configurations and demands identical PCM, for the hooked build and the standalone 32-bit and 64-bit ports. --ref compares those builds with a recording from the installed engine.
LICENSE is the MIT License, copyright 2026 RetroBunn. The original TruVoice DLL is not in the repository and is not part of that grant.

name: L&H TruVoice: a portable C rebuild of tv_enua.dll
description_en: Rebuilds Lernout & Hauspie TruVoice 6.00 build 10, the SAPI 4 American English engine in tv_enua.dll, as C99. The port reads that DLL's tables at run time and checks PCM against the running engine.
description_zh: 把 Lernout & Hauspie TruVoice 6.00 build 10（SAPI 4 美式英语引擎 tv_enua.dll）重建为 C99。移植在运行时读取该 DLL 的表，并与正在运行的引擎对照 PCM。
requirements: Needs a C99 compiler and your own tv_enua.dll 6.00 build 10. The README says the engine is not in the repository and that the port reads its tables from that DLL at run time.

Ten named voices share one formant synthesizer. The README says src/gen_back.inc, gen_tag.inc, and gen_norm.inc are the engine's logic translated from a decompilation, and distinguishes those files from the hand-written C.

The README's end-to-end row reports 330/330, 130/130, 230/230, 400/400, and 140/140 identical results for the listed text sets, and says x86 and x64 builds match each other. One command it names is python tools/e2e_text.py tests/hard.txt.
LICENSE is the MIT License, copyright 2026 KamiKitsune420. The original engine is not included.

name: Microsoft Anna: a bit-exact C rebuild of the TTS20 engine
description_en: Rebuilds Microsoft Anna, the Windows Vista and Windows 7 TTS20 voice, as C99 that reads the original voice data files. The README reports bit-exact PCM against the real engine on its test lines.
description_zh: 把 Microsoft Anna（Windows Vista 与 Windows 7 的 TTS20 语音）重建为读取原始语音数据文件的 C99。README 报告其测试句与真实引擎的 PCM 逐位一致。
requirements: Needs a C99 compiler and your own Anna data from a Windows Vista or 7 install, or from the Windows 7 voices installer. The README says no Microsoft code or data is in the repository. It says not to use -ffast-math and to keep -ffp-contract=off.
This is the SAPI 5 TTS20 engine the README calls Mulan internally. tools/anna_extract.py is the command the README gives for turning an install or the voices installer into the data folder.

The README's end-to-end row says 579/579 test lines are bit-exact, including the SAPI XML tags it lists, and identical with MSVC x86/x64, clang, and GCC. Its WMA Voice 9 row says all 66218 blocks plus 25000 random reads match Windows' 32-bit WMSPDMOD.DLL.
LICENSE is the MIT License, copyright 2026 KamiKitsune420. The voice data remains Microsoft's and is not included.

name: OneCore TTS: a C rebuild of David, Zira and Mark
description_en: Rebuilds the Windows OneCore text-to-speech engine MSTTSEngine_OneCore.dll 10.3, the David, Zira, and Mark voices, as C99 that reads the original voice files. The README reports sample-for-sample PCM on its corpus, with two Zira lines excepted.
description_zh: 把 Windows OneCore 文本转语音引擎 MSTTSEngine_OneCore.dll 10.3（David、Zira 和 Mark）重建为读取原始语音文件的 C99。README 报告语料上逐样本一致的 PCM，并写明 Zira 有两句例外。
requirements: Needs a C99 compiler and your own M1033David, M1033Zira, or M1033Mark files plus MSTTSLocEnUS.dat from a Windows install. The README says those files are not in the repository. It says never to use -ffast-math and to keep -ffp-contract=off.
David runs in floating point. Zira and Mark run in fixed point. The README says no Microsoft code or data is included.
The README's end-to-end row says David 375/375, Mark 375/375, and Zira 373/375 are bit-exact, and that the two Zira misses are lang lines. It says MSVC x64, MSVC x86, and gcc give identical results.
The README says MIT for the code in the repository and points at LICENSE. That file is the MIT License, copyright 2026 KamiKitsune420. The voices and the original engine are not included.

name: Microsoft Sam: a portable C rebuild of the SAPI 5 engine
description_en: Rebuilds the Windows XP SAPI 5 engine spttseng.dll for Microsoft Sam, Mike, and Mary as C99 that reads the original voice files. The README reports audio of the same length with every sample within ±1 LSB of the 16-bit engine.
description_zh: 把 Windows XP 的 SAPI 5 引擎 spttseng.dll（Microsoft Sam、Mike 和 Mary）重建为读取原始语音文件的 C99。README 报告音频长度相同，每个样本与 16 位引擎相差不超过 ±1 LSB。
requirements: Needs a C99 compiler and your own Sam.spd, Mike.spd, or Mary.spd with the matching .sdf files, plus LTTS1033.LXA and r1033tts.LXA. The README says the voice data is not included.

Sam, Mike, and Mary share one engine. The README also describes SAPI 4 voice effects rebuilt as an audio effect, and says the SAPI 4 voices themselves are not ported. It says the small tables in src/sam_abbrev_tab.h, src/sam_pos_rules.h, and src/sam_words_tab.h were transcribed from the engine.

The README says about 99.7% of samples match exactly and the rest differ by float rounding, and reports 21/21 corpus sentences, 104/104 number and date lines, 100/100 homograph sentences, and 180/180 paragraphs of Alice in Wonderland. tools/compare_corpus.py compares the C output with WAVs that the README says are not included.
The README says MIT for the code and points at LICENSE. That file is the MIT License, copyright 2026 KamiKitsune420. Microsoft voice data is not included.

name: Eloquence 6.1: a C rebuild of ECI.DLL
description_en: Rebuilds ETI Eloquence 6.1.0.2, the US English ECI.DLL plus ENU.SYN, as C with a drop-in ECI.DLL for x86 and x64. This is KamiKitsune420/eloquence-decomp, a different tree from Mudb0y/openevv.
description_zh: 把 ETI Eloquence 6.1.0.2（美式英语 ECI.DLL 与 ENU.SYN）重建为 C，并提供可替换的 x86 与 x64 ECI.DLL。
requirements: The README's build is on Windows with Visual Studio, from PowerShell. Put your own ECI.DLL, ECI.INI, and ENU.SYN in pkg/. It prints MD5 6c39acb7c1f0f62b3cae019f45b224fc for ENU.SYN. It says those files are not in the repository and must not be added.

The README describes a hand-written formant synthesizer, Delta rules lifted by tools/delta_lift.py, and the remaining functions recompiled instruction by instruction with tools/x2c.py. The drop-in DLL is US English only.

The README says klatt_check is bit-exact on 19,902 recorded frames, and that python tools/eci_compare.py runs every API script in tests/eci/ through the real DLL and the port, comparing calls, return values, callbacks, and samples.
The repository root has no LICENSE file; the README names no license.

name: Prose 2000 Reborn: a C decompilation of the speech board
description_en: Decompiles the Speech Plus and Telesensory Systems Prose 2000 text-to-speech firmware, an 8086 host plus an NEC uPD7720 DSP, into C. The README says the build does not need an emulator or ROM files.
description_zh: 把 Speech Plus 与 Telesensory Systems 的 Prose 2000 文本转语音固件（8086 主机加 NEC µPD7720 DSP）反编译为 C。README 写明构建不需要模拟器或 ROM 文件。
requirements: The README's default build produces the speech library, prose_say, the samples, and the v3.4.1 tests. -DPROSE_VERSION=1 builds the v1.1 tests instead. It says the v1.1 DSP program was never dumped, so v1.1 frames are played through the v3.12 DSP model and that audio is an approximation.
Two firmware versions are in the tree: v3.4.1 (1988) and v1.1 (1983). The README says src/data holds data extracted from the ROMs, and src/tests holds the players and replay tests.

The README says every stage was checked against an emulator of the original board, byte-exact on captured calls and frame- or sample-exact end to end. It says the replay tests are described in REFERENCE.md §14. build/pipeline_play speaks one line.
The reviewed root has no LICENSE file. The README says the original firmware was proprietary to Telesensory Systems and Speech Plus. The README names no license for the repository.

name: GEOS 2.0: source that rebuilds the cbmfiles KERNAL binaries
description_en: Reorganized cc65 source for GEOS 2.0 on the Commodore 64 and 128. The README says a standard compile generates binaries identical to the GEOS 64 2.0 and GEOS 128 2.0 distribution binaries, and make regress compares the bsw and wheels builds with the reference tree.
description_zh: Commodore 64 与 128 上 GEOS 2.0 的整理后 cc65 源码。README 写明标准编译生成与 GEOS 64 2.0 和 GEOS 128 2.0 发行二进制相同的文件，并且 make regress 把 bsw 与 wheels 构建与参考树比较。
requirements: The README builds with make. reference/ holds the original binaries from the cbmfiles.com version. make regress builds the bsw and wheels variants and compares them with those references.

The README says this tree does not use the original encrypted loader and that the kernel is plaintext, matching the cbmfiles.com version it describes. It says the serial number 0x58B5 is pre-filled to match that version.
make regress is the comparison named in the README.

The repository root has no LICENSE file. The README says the intellectual property added by the reverse-engineering and the subsequent improvements is in the public domain, asks to be credited, and says to respect the license of the underlying GEOS work.

name: geoWrite 2.1: source that rebuilds the original binaries
description_en: Reverse-engineered cc65 source for geoWrite 2.1, the GEOS word processor, in English and German. The README says a standard compile generates binaries identical to the English and German geoWrite 2.1 distribution binaries. The orig tree holds the collected original versions.
description_zh: GEOS 文字处理器 geoWrite 2.1 英语版与德语版的逆向 cc65 源码。README 写明标准编译生成与英语及德语 geoWrite 2.1 发行二进制相同的文件。orig 树存放收集到的原始版本。
requirements: Requires make, cc65 and Python for protected-code encryption. make builds the English version; LOCALE=de make builds the German version. The orig/ directory contains the original binaries.
A standard compile rebuilds the GEOS-bundled English and German geoWrite 2.1 binaries byte for byte; source comments remain incomplete.
The README places new reverse-engineered work in the public domain, requests credit and asks users to respect the underlying GEOS license. The repository root has no LICENSE file.

name: libmd12: a C model of the E-mu SP-1200 and SP-12 audio path
description_en: A C99 library of the E-mu SP-1200 and SP-12 sampler audio path: pitch playback, filters, and the dynamic filter. The README says firmware behavior comes from running E-mu's operating-system code in a Z80 emulator, and make check runs the shipped suite.
description_zh: E-mu SP-1200 与 SP-12 采样器音频通路的 C99 库：音高回放、滤波器和动态滤波器。README 写明固件行为来自在 Z80 模拟器中运行 E-mu 的操作系统代码，并且 make check 运行随附测试。
requirements: Needs a C99 compiler and make. make builds the library and command-line tools. The README says the table generators and checks also need Python 3 with NumPy and SciPy, ngspice, an arm-none-eabi toolchain, and QEMU.

The README says the semitone and decay tables are E-mu's, read from SP-1200 OS 1.2, Rossum's SP-1200 OS 1.04, and the SP-12 Turbo 2.6 images it names. It points at dumped images in Lytrix/EMU-SP1200 for the required firmware inputs.

The README says make check runs 341 checks and make m7check runs those same 341 checks under QEMU for a Cortex-M7 with a single-precision FPU. It also reports filter comparisons with ngspice and with John Nolting's SP-12 recordings, which it says to download.
LICENSE is the MIT License, copyright 2026 Stanislaw Przedzinkowski.

name: reAL: a dsound.dll checked against Windows and ALchemy
description_en: A drop-in dsound.dll that reimplements Creative ALchemy and DirectSound behavior, including DirectMusic pieces the README names. ./build.sh builds the DLL and runs the native unit tests. The README says comparisons with Microsoft's DLLs are line-by-line and event-by-event.
description_zh: 可替换的 dsound.dll，重建 Creative ALchemy 与 DirectSound 行为，包括 README 点名的 DirectMusic 部分。./build.sh 构建 DLL 并运行本机单元测试。README 写明与微软 DLL 的比较是逐行和逐事件的。
requirements: ./build.sh builds dsound.dll, the tracers, the test programs, and runs the native unit tests. The README says the repository contains no Creative or Microsoft code or binaries, so a comparison with those DLLs needs the DLLs from a Windows install.

The README describes DirectSound answers checked against Windows 7, and SetFX effects it calls bit-exact ports of Microsoft's effects. It also describes an optional HRTF path. The built-in set is the MIT KEMAR measurements it credits.

The README says test programs are run against both implementations and their output is compared line by line, and that offline captures are compared event by event. It names tests/comcmp.sh and tests/fuzzcmp.py.
LICENSE is the MIT License, copyright 2026 Neth. The README says ALchemy is copyright Creative Technology.

name: Decompile-Bench
description_en: A dataset of binary-source function pairs published for the LLM4Decompile project. The dataset card says it holds two million pairs condensed from 100 million collected pairs, including C and C++ source, and that the binaries were compiled from permissively licensed GitHub projects.
description_zh: LLM4Decompile 项目发布的二进制与源码函数对数据集。数据集说明写明其中有两百万对，由收集到的一亿对压缩而来，包含 C 和 C++ 源码，二进制来自采用宽松许可证的 GitHub 项目。
requirements: The dataset card licenses decompile-bench under CC0-1.0.
The card lists name, code, asm and file columns for two million binary-source function pairs condensed from 100 million collected pairs; the binaries came from permissively licensed GitHub projects.
The card links decompile-bench-raw and decompile-bench-bins as separate datasets.

name: OpenJKDF2: C reimplementation of Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II
description_en: OpenJKDF2 is a function-by-function reimplementation of Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II in C. The README lists 64-bit Windows, macOS, and Linux builds that use SDL2, OpenAL, and OpenGL 3.3, plus ARM64 Android, Nintendo DSi, Dreamcast, 32-bit Windows, and an Emscripten WebAssembly build. Source files follow the original game layout, using symbols from the Grim Fandango Remaster ports and assertions from other games, and the tree includes the byacc and flex versions used to parse COG scripts.
description_zh: OpenJKDF2 用 C 语言逐函数重新实现 Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II。README 列出使用 SDL2、OpenAL 和 OpenGL 3.3 的 64 位 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 构建，以及 ARM64 Android、Nintendo DSi、Dreamcast、32 位 Windows 和 Emscripten WebAssembly 构建。源文件布局贴近原版游戏，依据 Grim Fandango Remaster 移植中的符号以及其他游戏中的断言，并包含解析 COG 脚本所用的 byacc 和 flex。
requirements: Running it requires game data from a valid copy of Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II. Original game assets are not in the repository. The README names the GOG and Steam releases and recommends GOG because that release is DRM-free and includes an Ogg Vorbis soundtrack.

The README lists these supported configurations: 64-bit Windows, macOS x86_64 and AArch64, and 64-bit Linux with SDL2, OpenAL, and OpenGL 3.3; ARM64 Android with OpenGL ES 3; Nintendo DSi and Dreamcast with custom renderers; 32-bit Windows with OpenGL 1.1; and Emscripten with WebGL 2. On Linux, paths and filenames may be case-sensitive.
GitHub reports the repository license as NOASSERTION.

name: Crackdown Recompiled: native PC port of Xbox 360 Crackdown
description_en: Native PC recompilation of the Xbox 360 game Crackdown. Static recompilation with the ReXGlue SDK produces a Windows build using Direct3D 12 and an experimental native Linux and Steam Deck build using Vulkan. The repository does not contain the game files, and the recompiled C++ is generated from the user's own disc.
description_zh: Xbox 360 游戏 Crackdown 的原生 PC 重编译。项目使用 ReXGlue SDK 进行静态重编译，生成采用 Direct3D 12 的 Windows 构建，以及采用 Vulkan 的实验性 Linux 与 Steam Deck 原生构建。仓库不包含游戏文件，重编译得到的 C++ 由使用者自己的光盘在本地生成。
requirements: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) with a DirectX 12 graphics card and the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 x64 redistributable, or 64-bit x86 Linux with glibc 2.31 or newer, a Vulkan driver, and an X11 or Wayland desktop. The Linux and Steam Deck builds are described as experimental.

Requires the user's own Crackdown Xbox 360 retail disc (2007), the original release without a title update: Title ID 4D5307DC and Default.xex of 14,270,464 bytes. The launcher accepts a disc image or extracted files and refuses other versions. No game files are included.

Source builds need the submodules, Visual Studio with the C++ and LLVM/Clang components, disc files placed so that game/assets/Default.xex exists, and ReXGlue SDK 0.10.0, which tools/codegen.ps1 downloads. The Linux AppImage is built with tools/package-linux.sh after that C++ has been generated.

Original project code is GPL-2.0-only. ReXGlue is BSD 3-Clause, and the pinned TRG Launcher v1.1.0 is MIT. Game files are outside the project license. The README says AI tools assisted analysis, development, debugging and documentation, and that the maintainer directed, tested and reviewed those changes.

name: AC6Recomp: static recompilation of Ace Combat 6
description_en: AC6Recomp is a native PC port of Ace Combat 6: Fires of Liberation built with the ReXGlue SDK. The README says the Xbox 360 PowerPC game code is statically recompiled to x86-64, while visible rendering stays in the vendored RexGlue/Xenia graphics backend. It describes the project as a work in progress that can boot and run in game.
description_zh: AC6Recomp 是基于 ReXGlue SDK 的《皇牌空战 6：解放之火》原生 PC 移植。README 写明 Xbox 360 的 PowerPC 游戏代码被静态重编译为 x86-64，而可见的渲染仍由随仓库提供的 RexGlue/Xenia 图形后端负责。它把项目描述为仍在开发中、可以启动并进入游戏的版本。
requirements: The README says the repository contains source code only and the user supplies a legally obtained copy of the game.
The README says the project is unfinished: it can boot and run in game, and bugs, crashes, and missing functionality are expected.
The README points the license to LICENSE. GitHub reports BSD-3-Clause.

name: FoxDec
description_en: FoxDec is a research decompiler for formally checked lifting of x86-64 binaries to recompilable NASM. The current version uses NASM as its intermediate representation, and an earlier version lifted C. The README limits inputs to sequential C binaries that follow the System V AMD64 ABI, and the quick start runs through Docker.
description_zh: FoxDec 是一个研究性反编译器，把 x86-64 二进制形式化地提升为可重新汇编的 NASM。当前版本以 NASM 作为中间表示，较早版本则提升为 C。README 将输入限制为遵循 System V AMD64 ABI 的顺序 C 二进制，快速开始通过 Docker 运行。
requirements: Inputs must be x86-64 ELF binaries compiled from C under the System V AMD64 ABI. The README excludes C++ and concurrent code.
The published quick start downloads a FoxDec zip and uses Docker. Building without Docker is documented for developers in foxdec/docs/build.md. Recompiling the NASM output uses nasm and gcc.
GitHub reports the license as Apache-2.0.

name: Computer Archeology: disassembly notes for arcade games
description_en: Computer Archeology stores the markdown disassemblies and notes that its toolchain renders into the pages at computerarcheology.com. Assembly files stay in GitHub-flavored markdown, and a names-in-code pass links memory operands to named definitions. The README starts the renderer with py -m computerarcheology.carender.app.
description_zh: Computer Archeology 存放由工具链渲染到 computerarcheology.com 的 Markdown 反汇编和注释。汇编文件保持 GitHub 风味的 Markdown，names-in-code 会把内存操作数链接到已命名的定义。README 用 py -m computerarcheology.carender.app 启动渲染器。
requirements: Python runs the renderer modules computerarcheology.carender.app and computerarcheology.carender.development_server.
The repository has no license file.

name: GCRecomp
description_en: GCRecomp is a static recompiler that translates GameCube PowerPC DOL binaries into Rust and then into native executables. The README says it is inspired by N64Recomp and names Windows, Linux, and macOS as targets for the generated executables. The project text is dedicated under CC0 1.0 and also points readers to an EULA.
description_zh: GCRecomp 是一个静态重编译器，把 GameCube PowerPC DOL 二进制翻译成 Rust，再生成原生可执行文件。README 写明它受 N64Recomp 启发，并把生成的可执行文件目标写为 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。项目文本以 CC0 1.0 贡献到公共领域，同时指向一份最终用户许可协议。
requirements: Users supply their own GameCube dumps. The README says the repository omits Nintendo code, SDKs, and game assets.
The README's Rust badge names Rust 1.70 or newer.
The README licenses the project under CC0 1.0 Universal and also links an end-user license agreement.

name: AC4-Port: native Windows port of Armored Core 4
description_en: AC4-Port is an unofficial native Windows build of ARMORED CORE 4 for the PS3 USA release BLUS30027. The README describes static recompilation of about 3.6 million PowerPC instructions into C++, with SPU programs translated ahead of time, RSX commands drawn through Direct3D 11, and shaders converted to HLSL. The repository leaves out game data, game code, and keys.
description_zh: AC4-Port 是 PS3 美版 BLUS30027《装甲核心 4》的非官方原生 Windows 构建。README 描述把大约 360 万条 PowerPC 指令静态重编译为 C++，SPU 程序预先翻译，RSX 命令经 Direct3D 11 绘制，着色器转换为 HLSL。仓库不含游戏数据、游戏代码和密钥。
requirements: A copy of ARMORED CORE 4 (US disc, BLUS30027) with the PS3_GAME folder, RPCS3 for a one-time decrypt during setup, and Sony's PS3 system software 4.93 file PS3UPDAT.PUP. The README asks for about 4 GB of free disk space.
The result is a 64-bit Windows program. Setup downloads a compiler toolchain of about 250 MB.
GitHub reports the license as MIT.

name: Angry Birds Decompilation: Lua script recovery
description_en: Angry Birds Decompilation documents recovery of Lua scripts from the PC ports of the Angry Birds games. The README's automatic path runs birdout.py with Python 3, 7-Zip, and a JDK, and the manual path uses OpenSSL, 7-Zip, and unluac. It points readers to their own PC-port files.
description_zh: Angry Birds Decompilation 记录如何从《愤怒的小鸟》PC 移植版中恢复 Lua 脚本。README 的自动路径用 Python 3、7-Zip 和 JDK 运行 birdout.py，手动路径使用 OpenSSL、7-Zip 和 unluac。它要求读者使用自己的 PC 移植版文件。
requirements: Python 3, 7-Zip on PATH, and a JDK. The manual path also uses OpenSSL and unluac.jar.
The scripts read Lua files from the reader's own Angry Birds PC ports.
GitHub's license metadata for this repository is empty.

name: Dragodis
description_en: Dragodis is a Python framework for writing disassembler scripts that run on more than one disassembler. The README lists Ghidra, IDA Pro, and Vivisect as backends, and shows installation with pip install dragodis followed by a backend install documented in docs/install.md.
description_zh: Dragodis 是一个 Python 框架，用来编写能在多个反汇编器上运行的脚本。README 列出的后端有 Ghidra、IDA Pro 和 Vivisect，安装方式是 pip install dragodis，然后按 docs/install.md 安装后端。
requirements: Install with pip install dragodis, then install a backend disassembler using docs/install.md.
The examples open a local binary through dragodis.Ghidra or dragodis.IDA.
GitHub reports the repository license as NOASSERTION.

name: RSDKv2 Decompilation: Retro Engine v2
description_en: RSDKv2 Decompilation is a decompilation of Retro Engine v2, the engine used by the 2008 Sonic Nexus demo. The README adds a built-in mod loader, a settings.ini file, and debug keys, and it builds with CMake. Running it requires Sonic Nexus 2008 demo assets, which are left out of the repository.
description_zh: RSDKv2 Decompilation 是 Retro Engine v2 的反编译，该引擎用于 2008 年 Sonic Nexus 演示版。README 加入了内置模组加载器、settings.ini 和调试按键，并用 CMake 构建。运行需要 Sonic Nexus 2008 演示版资源，这些资源不在仓库中。
requirements: Sonic Nexus 2008 demo assets are required to run. Clone with git submodules; the README says a GitHub source ZIP omits them.

Windows builds use Visual Studio with the Desktop development with C++ workload, vcpkg, SDL2, libogg, and libvorbis. Linux package lists include cmake, SDL2, libogg, and libvorbis. macOS follows dependencies/mac/dependencies.txt and an Xcode project.
GitHub reports the repository license as NOASSERTION.

name: Thunderball: decompilation of Peggle Deluxe
description_en: Thunderball aims to decompile the English 1.01 executable of Peggle Deluxe from the Steam release. The README says many names come from unstripped ports cross-referenced with the Windows binary, and accuracy checks use reccmp. The repository omits the game assets.
description_zh: Thunderball 旨在反编译 Steam 版 Peggle Deluxe 的英文 1.01 可执行文件。README 写明许多名称来自未剥离符号的其他平台移植，并与这份 Windows 二进制对照，准确性检查使用 reccmp。仓库不含游戏资源。
requirements: CMake 3.25 or higher, Ninja, and Microsoft Visual C++ 14. The README says to place a portable MSVC toolchain in Thunderball/msvc80 and run cmake --workflow --preset release-x86.
A copy of Peggle Deluxe supplies the assets. The Steam English 1.01 executable is the named target.
reccmp is installed with pip install git+https://github.com/isledecomp/reccmp.
GitHub reports the repository license as NOASSERTION. The README links LICENSE.md.

name: GBA-Recomp
description_en: GBA-Recomp is a Rust static-recompilation toolkit and runtime for Game Boy Advance cartridges. It translates a ROM ahead of time into a native executable, and the runtime models the PPU, APU, DMA, timers, IRQ, saves, input, and RTC. The README says the user supplies a BIOS and a game, and that the project is dual-licensed MIT or Apache-2.0.
description_zh: GBA-Recomp 是面向 Game Boy Advance 卡带的 Rust 静态重编译工具包和运行时。它预先把 ROM 翻译成本机可执行文件，运行时提供 PPU、APU、DMA、定时器、IRQ、存档、输入和 RTC 的硬件模型。README 要求用户自备 BIOS 和游戏，并把项目双重许可为 MIT 或 Apache-2.0。
requirements: The user builds from their own ROM image and BIOS. The README says the repository contains no recompiled game output.
Platform dependencies for macOS, Linux, Windows, and Android are listed in BUILDING.md. The engine emits C11 and compiles it locally.
The README dual-licenses the project under MIT or Apache-2.0.

name: MBBSDASM
description_en: MBBSDASM is a C# disassembler for 16-bit New Executable (NE) EXE and DLL files, written with .NET Core. It was built to study The Major BBS and Worldgroup modules, and the README says it also disassembles other NE files, with Solitaire and Calculator from Windows 3.1 used as checks. A text UI starts when the program is run with no arguments.
description_zh: MBBSDASM 是用 C# 和 .NET Core 编写的 16 位 New Executable（NE）EXE 与 DLL 反汇编器。它用来研究 The Major BBS 和 Worldgroup 模块，README 写明它也能反汇编其他 NE 文件，并用 Windows 3.1 的纸牌和计算器做过检查。不带参数运行时会启动文本界面。
requirements: .NET Core hosts the disassembler. The text UI uses Terminal.Gui. One command-line form in the README is -i input.dll -o output.txt -strings -analysis.
The README licenses MBBSDASM under the 2-clause BSD License. It also names SharpDisasm as 2-clause BSD and Terminal.Gui as MIT.

name: cor64: C# Nintendo 64 emulator
description_en: cor64 is a work-in-progress Nintendo 64 emulator written in C#. The README builds and runs it with nuke, and lists .NET Framework or Mono, .NET Core 3.x or newer, and GLFW development libraries on Linux. Global dotnet tools named in the README are Paket and nuke.globaltool.
description_zh: cor64 是一个用 C# 编写、仍在开发中的 Nintendo 64 模拟器。README 用 nuke 构建并运行它，并列出 .NET Framework 或 Mono、.NET Core 3.x 或更新版本，以及 Linux 上的 GLFW 开发库。README 点名的全局 dotnet 工具是 Paket 和 nuke.globaltool。
requirements: .NET Framework or Mono, .NET Core 3.x or higher, and the global dotnet tools Paket and nuke.globaltool. Linux builds need GLFW development libraries.
Build and run with nuke Run. Tests use nuke Test.
GitHub reports the license as MIT.

name: OpenSHC: reimplementation of Stronghold Crusader
description_en: OpenSHC is an open-source reimplementation of Stronghold Crusader. It builds as a DLL loaded at game start and hooks functions that have a functionally identical reimplementation. The README requires Stronghold Crusader 1.41 in a Latin-language version such as English or German.
description_zh: OpenSHC 是《要塞：十字军东征》的开源重实现。它构建为一个在游戏启动时加载的 DLL，并挂钩那些已有功能等价重实现的函数。README 要求《要塞：十字军东征》1.41 的拉丁语版本，例如英语或德语。
requirements: Stronghold Crusader 1.41 (Latin version). The README names the Steam release as the easiest copy to obtain and asks for a Latin-language install such as English or German.
Development uses CMake 3.24 or later, Python 3, and clang-format 22 or later, installed with python -m pip install clang-format.
GitHub reports the license as GPL-3.0.
